########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_admin\modules\noclip.lua
local noclip = false
local cam = 0
local speed = 1
local maxSpeed = 16
local noclipEntity

local function disabledControls()
    HudWeaponWheelIgnoreSelection()
    DisableAllControlActions(0)
    DisableAllControlActions(1)
    DisableAllControlActions(2)
    EnableControlAction(0, 220, true)
    EnableControlAction(0, 221, true)
    EnableControlAction(0, 245, true)
end

local function setupCam()
    local rotation = GetEntityRotation(noclipEntity)
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(noclipEntity)

    cam = CreateCameraWithParams("DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA", coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, 0.0, 0.0, rotation.z, 75.0, false, 2)
    SetCamActive(cam, true)
    RenderScriptCams(true, true, 1000, false, false)
    AttachCamToEntity(cam, noclipEntity, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, true)
end

local function destoryCam()
    Wait(100)
    SetGameplayCamRelativeHeading(0)
    RenderScriptCams(false, true, 1000, true, true)
    DetachEntity(noclipEntity, true, true)
    SetCamActive(cam, false)
    DestroyCam(cam, true)
end

local isControlAlwaysPressed = function(inputGroup, control)
    return IsControlPressed(inputGroup, control) or IsDisabledControlPressed(inputGroup, control)
end

local function updateCameraRotation()
    local rightAxisX = GetControlNormal(0, 220)
    local rightAxisY = GetControlNormal(0, 221)
    local rotation = GetCamRot(cam, 2)
    local yValue = rightAxisY * -5
    local newX
    local newZ = rotation.z + (rightAxisX * -10)

    if (rotation.x + yValue > -89.0) and (rotation.x + yValue < 89.0) then
        newX = rotation.x + yValue
    end

    if newX ~= nil and newZ ~= nil then
        SetCamRot(cam, newX, rotation.y, newZ, 2)
    end

    SetEntityHeading(noclipEntity, math.max(0, (rotation.z % 360)))
end

local function teleportToGround()
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(noclipEntity)
    local rayCast = StartShapeTestRay(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, coords.x, coords.y, -10000.0, 1, 0, 0)
    local _, hit, hitCoords = GetShapeTestResult(rayCast)

    if hit == 1 then
        SetEntityCoords(noclipEntity, hitCoords.x, hitCoords.y, hitCoords.z, false, false, false, false)
    else
        SetEntityCoords(noclipEntity, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false, false)
    end
end

local function toggleBehavior(bool)
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(noclipEntity)

    RequestCollisionAtCoord(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)
    FreezeEntityPosition(noclipEntity, bool)
    SetEntityCollision(noclipEntity, not bool, not bool)
    SetEntityVisible(noclipEntity, not bool, not bool)
    SetEntityInvincible(noclipEntity, bool)
    SetEntityAlpha(noclipEntity, 255, false)
    SetLocalPlayerVisibleLocally(true)
    SetEveryoneIgnorePlayer(noclipEntity, bool)
    SetPoliceIgnorePlayer(noclipEntity, bool)
end

local function updateSpeed()
    if isControlAlwaysPressed(2, 14) then
        speed = speed - 0.5
        if speed < 0.5 then
            speed = 0.5
        end
    elseif isControlAlwaysPressed(2, 15) then
        speed = speed + 0.5
        if speed > maxSpeed then
            speed = maxSpeed
        end
    elseif IsDisabledControlJustReleased(0, 348) then
        speed = 1
    end
end

local function updateMovement()
    local multi = 1.0
    if isControlAlwaysPressed(0, 21) then
        multi = 2
    elseif isControlAlwaysPressed(0, 19) then
        multi = 4
    elseif isControlAlwaysPressed(0, 36) then
        multi = 0.25
    end

    local moveSpeed = 0.5 * speed * multi
    local verticalMultiplier = (speed * multi) / 178

    if isControlAlwaysPressed(0, 32) then
        local pitch = GetCamRot(cam, 2)
        local verticalOffset = pitch.x * verticalMultiplier
        local newCoords = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(noclipEntity, 0.0, moveSpeed, verticalOffset)
        SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(noclipEntity, newCoords.x, newCoords.y, newCoords.z, false, false, false)
    elseif isControlAlwaysPressed(0, 33) then
        local pitch = GetCamRot(cam, 2)
        local verticalOffset = pitch.x * verticalMultiplier
        local newCoords = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(noclipEntity, 0.0, -moveSpeed, -verticalOffset)
        SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(noclipEntity, newCoords.x, newCoords.y, newCoords.z, false, false, false)
    end

    if isControlAlwaysPressed(0, 34) then
        local newCoords = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(noclipEntity, -moveSpeed, 0.0, 0.0)
        SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(noclipEntity, newCoords.x, newCoords.y, newCoords.z, false, false, false)
    elseif isControlAlwaysPressed(0, 35) then
        local newCoords = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(noclipEntity, moveSpeed, 0.0, 0.0)
        SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(noclipEntity, newCoords.x, newCoords.y, newCoords.z, false, false, false)
    end

    if isControlAlwaysPressed(0, 44) then
        local newCoords = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(noclipEntity, 0.0, 0.0, moveSpeed)
        SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(noclipEntity, newCoords.x, newCoords.y, newCoords.z, false, false, false)
    elseif isControlAlwaysPressed(0, 46) then
        local newCoords = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(noclipEntity, 0.0, 0.0, -moveSpeed)
        SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(noclipEntity, newCoords.x, newCoords.y, newCoords.z, false, false, false)
    end
end

local utils = require 'modules.lib.utils'

return {
    toggle = function (actionData)
        if not utils.validate(actionData) then
            return
        end

        noclip = not noclip

        local msg = noclip and 'active' or 'non active'
        lib.notify({ description = 'Noclip mode ' .. msg })

        if cache.vehicle then
            noclipEntity = cache.vehicle
        else
            noclipEntity = cache.ped
        end

        if noclip then
            setupCam()
            toggleBehavior(true)
            while noclip do
                Wait(0)
                updateCameraRotation()
                disabledControls()
                updateSpeed()
                updateMovement()
            end
        else
            destoryCam()
            teleportToGround()
            toggleBehavior(false)
        end
    end
}

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_admin\modules\playerBlip.lua
local BLIP_SPRITE <const> = 1
local BLIP_CATEGORY <const> = 7

local showBlips = false
local stamp = 0

---@class AdminPlayerBlip
---@field handle number
---@field name? string
---@field stamp number

---@type table<number, AdminPlayerBlip>
local blips = {}

---@type table<number, string>
local names = {}

local DoesBlipExist = DoesBlipExist
local RemoveBlip = RemoveBlip
local AddBlipForCoord = AddBlipForCoord
local SetBlipCoords = SetBlipCoords
local SetBlipSprite = SetBlipSprite
local SetBlipCategory = SetBlipCategory
local SetBlipColour = SetBlipColour
local SetBlipDisplay = SetBlipDisplay
local BeginTextCommandSetBlipName = BeginTextCommandSetBlipName
local AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName = AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName
local EndTextCommandSetBlipName = EndTextCommandSetBlipName
local pairs = pairs

---@param x number
---@param y number
---@return number handle
local function createBlip(x, y)
    local handle = AddBlipForCoord(x, y, 0.0)

    SetBlipSprite(handle, BLIP_SPRITE)
    SetBlipCategory(handle, BLIP_CATEGORY)
    SetBlipColour(handle, 0)
    SetBlipDisplay(handle, 6)

    return handle
end

---@param id number
local function dropBlip(id)
    local handle = blips[id].handle

    if DoesBlipExist(handle) then
        RemoveBlip(handle)
    end

    blips[id] = nil
end

local function clearBlips()
    for id in pairs(blips) do
        dropBlip(id)
    end

    for id in pairs(names) do
        names[id] = nil
    end
end

---@param id number
---@param x number
---@param y number
local function syncBlip(id, x, y)
    local entry = blips[id]

    if entry and DoesBlipExist(entry.handle) then
        SetBlipCoords(entry.handle, x, y, 0.0)
    else
        entry = { handle = createBlip(x, y), stamp = stamp }
        blips[id] = entry
    end

    local name = names[id] or ''

    if entry.name ~= name then
        entry.name = name
        BeginTextCommandSetBlipName('STRING')
        AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(name)
        EndTextCommandSetBlipName(entry.handle)
    end

    entry.stamp = stamp
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_admin:blips:update', function(coords, nameData)
    if not showBlips then return end

    if nameData then
        for id, name in pairs(nameData) do
            names[id] = name
        end
    end

    stamp = stamp + 1

    local selfId = cache.serverId

    for i = 1, #coords, 3 do
        local id = coords[i]

        if id ~= selfId then
            syncBlip(id, coords[i + 1] + 0.0, coords[i + 2] + 0.0)
        end
    end

    for id, entry in pairs(blips) do
        if entry.stamp ~= stamp then
            dropBlip(id)
            names[id] = nil
        end
    end
end)

return {
    toggle = function()
        showBlips = not showBlips

        if not showBlips then
            clearBlips()
        end

        TriggerServerEvent('sm_admin:blips:subscribe', showBlips)
        lib.notify({ description = showBlips and 'Player blip active' or 'Player blip non active' })
    end
}

        SetMpGamerTagAlpha(tag, 4, 255)

        SetMpGamerTagHealthBarColour(tag, 25)

        local isPlayerTalking = NetworkIsPlayerTalking(playerId)
        local isPlayerInvincible = GetPlayerInvincible(playerId)

        if showNames then
            SetMpGamerTagVisibility(tag, 0, true)

            SetMpGamerTagVisibility(tag, 0, false)
            SetMpGamerTagVisibility(tag, 2, false)
            SetMpGamerTagVisibility(tag, 4, false)

---@class EmbedField

---@class LogData

local utils = require 'modules.lib.utils'

---@param fields table<string, any>
---@return EmbedField[]
local function FormatFields(fields)
    local embedFields = {}

    for key, value in pairs(fields) do
        local formattedValue = value

        if type(value) == 'table' then
            formattedValue = json.encode(value, {indent = true})
        elseif type(value) == 'boolean' then
            formattedValue = value and 'Yes' or 'No'
        elseif type(value) == 'nil' then
            formattedValue = 'N/A'
        else
            formattedValue = tostring(value)
        end

        table.insert(embedFields, {
            name = key,
            value = formattedValue,
            inline = true
        })
    end

    return embedFields
end

---@param color string|number|nil
---@return number
local function GetColor(color)
    if type(color) == 'number' then
        return color
    elseif type(color) == 'string' then
        return DiscordColors[color] or DiscordColors.default
    end
    return DiscordColors.default
end

local LOG_USERNAME = 'SMLogs'
local LOG_AVATAR = GetConvar('smlogs_avatar', 'https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1218808338956161062/1412428693174882496/Satu_Mimpi_Logo.png?ex=6adffdfa&is=6adeac7a&hm=b70092015422fd1db0bfb8245e8e078d91e132451074ffc383d634ee9e156371&=&format=webp&quality=lossless')

local function CreatePlayerInfo(source, embed, isTarget)
    local identifiers = exports.sm_core:GetIdentifier(source) or {}
    local discord = identifiers.discord and identifiers.discord:match('^discord:(%d+)')

    table.insert(embed.fields, {
        name = isTarget and 'Target' or 'Admin',
        value = ('[%s] %s\nCharacter: %s\nSteam: `%s`\nDiscord: %s'):format(
            source,
            GetPlayerName(source) or 'Offline',
            exports.sm_core:GetName(source) or 'N/A',
            identifiers.steam or '-',
            discord and ('<@%s>'):format(discord) or '-'
        ),
        inline = true
    })
end

---@param logData LogData
---@param source? number
---@param targetSource? number
---@return DiscordEmbed
local function CreateEmbed(logData, source, targetSource)
    local embed = {
        title = logData.title or 'Admin Log',
        description = logData.description,
        color = GetColor(logData.color),
        fields = {},
        timestamp = logData.timestamp ~= false and os.date('!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') or nil
    }

    if source then
        CreatePlayerInfo(source, embed, false)
    end

    if targetSource then
        CreatePlayerInfo(targetSource, embed, true)
    end

    if not source and not targetSource and logData.author then
        embed.author = {
            name = logData.author.name,
            icon_url = logData.author.icon
        }
    end

    if logData.fields then
        local customFields = FormatFields(logData.fields)
        for _, field in ipairs(customFields) do
            table.insert(embed.fields, field)
        end
    end

    embed.footer = {
        text = logData.footer or 'SMLogs â€¢ Admin'
    }

    if logData.thumbnail then
        embed.thumbnail = {
            url = logData.thumbnail
        }
    end

    if logData.image then
        embed.image = {
            url = logData.image
        }
    end

    return embed
end

---@param webhook string
---@param embed DiscordEmbed
local function SendToDiscord(webhook, embed)
    local payload = json.encode({
        username = LOG_USERNAME,
        avatar_url = LOG_AVATAR,
        embeds = {embed}
    })

    PerformHttpRequest(webhook, function(statusCode, response)
        if statusCode ~= 204 then
            lib.print.error('Failed to send log: ' .. statusCode)
            if response then
                lib.print.error('Response: ' .. response)
            end
        end
    end, 'POST', payload, {
        ['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
    })
end

---@param source number
---@param serverLog ServerLogs
---@param fields? table<string, any>
---@param targetSource? number
function Logs.Send(source, serverLog, fields, targetSource)
    if not serverLog or not serverLog.enable then
        return
    end

    if not serverLog.webhook or serverLog.webhook == '' then
        lib.print.warn('Webhook not configured')
        return
    end

    if serverLog.onlyFor and not utils.havePerms(source, { onlyFor = serverLog.onlyFor }) then
        return
    end

    local logData = {
        title = serverLog.title,
        description = serverLog.description,
        color = serverLog.color,
        fields = fields or serverLog.fields,
        thumbnail = serverLog.thumbnail,
        image = serverLog.image,
        footer = serverLog.footer,
        timestamp = serverLog.timestamp,
        author = serverLog.author
    }

    local embed = CreateEmbed(logData, source, targetSource)
    SendToDiscord(serverLog.webhook, embed)
end

Logs.Colors = DiscordColors

return Logs

if lib.context == 'server' then
    
    ---@param source number
    ---@param checkType 'ace' | 'identifier'
    ---@param groups? string|string[]
    ---@return boolean
    local function havePermissions(source, checkType, groups)
        if not groups then return false end
        if type(groups) == 'string' then groups = {groups} end

        if checkType == 'ace' then
            for i = 1, #groups do
                local group = groups[i]

                if IsPlayerAceAllowed(source --[[@as string]], group) then
                    return true
                end
            end
        elseif checkType == 'identifier' then
            local identifier = exports.sm_core:GetIdentifier(source) --[[@as PlayerIdentifier]]
            if not identifier then return false end

            for i = 1, #groups do
                local group = groups[i]
                local identType = group:match('^(%w+):(.+)$')

                if identifier[identType] == group then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end

        return false
    end

    local EXTRA_EVENT_ACTIONS = {
        ['sm_admin:installHarness'] = { 'admin.maxperformance' },
    }

    ---@type table<string, table<string, boolean>>?
    local eventActions

    ---@return table<string, table<string, boolean>>
    local function getEventActions()
        if eventActions then return eventActions end

        eventActions = {}

        for actionType, list in pairs(require 'config.action') do
            if type(list) == 'table' then
                for key, act in pairs(list) do
                    local event = type(act) == 'table' and act.localServerEvent
                    if event then
                        eventActions[event] = eventActions[event] or {}
                        eventActions[event][('%s.%s'):format(actionType, key)] = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for event, keys in pairs(EXTRA_EVENT_ACTIONS) do
            eventActions[event] = eventActions[event] or {}
            for i = 1, #keys do
                eventActions[event][keys[i]] = true
            end
        end

        return eventActions
    end

    ---@param action any
    ---@return ActionData?
    local function resolveAction(action)
        if type(action) ~= 'table' or type(action.type) ~= 'string' or type(action.action) ~= 'string' then
            return nil
        end

        local list = require 'config.action'[action.type]
        return type(list) == 'table' and list[action.action] or nil
    end

    ---@param name string
    ---@param cb fun(tk: string, actionData: ActionProps, options: any, args: any)
    function utils.registerEvent(name, cb)
        return RegisterNetEvent(name, function(tk, actionData, options)
            local src = source
            local allowed = getEventActions()[name]
            local key = type(actionData) == 'table' and ('%s.%s'):format(tostring(actionData.type), tostring(actionData.action))

            if not allowed or not key or not allowed[key] then
                lib.print.warn(('[sm_admin] %s (%s) memanggil %s dengan action %s yang tidak cocok'):format(GetPlayerName(src), src, name, tostring(key)))
                return
            end

            local act = resolveAction(actionData)
            cb(tk, actionData, options, act and act.args)
        end)
    end

    ---@param source number
    ---@param opt ActionPerms
    function utils.havePerms(source, opt)
        if opt.perms then
            return havePermissions(source, 'ace', opt.perms)
        end

        return havePermissions(source, 'identifier', opt.onlyFor)
    end

    ---@param source number
    ---@param opt any
    ---@return boolean
    function utils.clientPermCheck(source, opt)
        if type(opt) ~= 'table' then return false end

        if opt.type then
            local act = resolveAction(opt)
            if not act then return false end
            return utils.havePerms(source, { perms = act.perms, onlyFor = act.onlyFor })
        end

        if type(opt.perms) == 'string' then
            return havePermissions(source, 'ace', opt.perms)
        end

        return false
    end

    function utils.validate(source, tk, action)
        if not exports.se_v2:validate(source, tk) then
            return
        end

        local act = resolveAction(action) --[[@as ActionData]]

        if not act then
            return
        end

        ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: param-type-mismatch
        if not utils.havePerms(source, {perms = act.perms, onlyFor = act.onlyFor}) then
            lib.notify(source, { description = 'Kamu tidak ada akses!', type = 'error' })
            return
        end

        return act
    end

    ---@param plate string
    ---@return boolean Exist
    function utils.plate_exist(plate)
        local result = sql:scalar_async([[
            SELECT 1 FROM player_vehicles WHERE plate = ? LIMIT 1
        ]], { plate })
        return result ~= nil
    end

    --- @param prefix string?
    --- @return string|nil VehiclePlate
    function utils.getRandomPlate(prefix)
        local platePrefix = prefix or lib.string.random('....')

        for _ = 1, 30 do
            local plate = platePrefix .. lib.string.random('....')
            if not utils.plate_exist(plate) then
                return plate
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    ---@param plate string
    function utils.findVehicleByPlate(plate)
        local vehicles = GetAllVehicles()

        for i=1, #vehicles do
            local vehicle = vehicles[i]
            local vehPlate = GetVehicleNumberPlateText(vehicle)
            local trimPlate = qbLib.string.trim(vehPlate)

            if trimPlate == qbLib.string.trim(plate) then
                return vehicle
            end
        end

        return false
    end
elseif lib.context == 'client' then
    ---@param perms ActionPerms
    function utils.havePerms(perms)
        local havePermissions = lib.callback.await('sm_admin:havePermissions', false, perms)

        if not havePermissions then
            lib.notify({
                description = 'Kamu tidak memiliki permissions untuk melakukan ini.',
                type = 'error'
            })
            return
        end

        return true
    end

    function utils.validate(action)

        local act = require 'config.action'[action.type]?[action.action] --[[@as ActionData]]

        if not act then
            return
        end

        ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: param-type-mismatch
        if not utils.havePerms({ type = action.type, action = action.action }) then
            lib.notify({ description = 'Kamu tidak ada akses!', type = 'error' })
            return
        end

        return act
    end
end

return utils

---@type table<number, number>
local isolated = {}

---@param source number
---@return string?
local function identifier(source)
    return Framework.GetIdentifier(source)
end

lib.callback.register("rhd_appearance:getPlayerAces", function(source)
    local names = {}

    require("server.blacklist").aceNames(names)
    require("server.peds").aceNames(names)

    local aces = {}

    for name in pairs(names) do
        if IsPlayerAceAllowed(source, name) then
            aces[name] = true
        end
    end

    return aces
end)

lib.callback.register("rhd_appearance:get", function(source, model)
    local id = identifier(source)

    if not id then return end

    return Framework.GetAppearance(id, model)
end)

lib.callback.register("rhd_appearance:save", function(source, appearance)
    local id = identifier(source)

    if not id or not require("server.validate").appearance(appearance) then return false end
    if require("server.blacklist").blocks(source, appearance) then return false end

    Framework.SaveAppearance(id, appearance)

    return true
end)

lib.callback.register("rhd_appearance:character:isolate", function(source)
    if isolated[source] then return true end

    isolated[source] = GetPlayerRoutingBucket(source)

    SetPlayerRoutingBucket(source, 1000 + source)

    return true
end)

lib.callback.register("rhd_appearance:character:restore", function(source)
    local previous = isolated[source]

    if previous then
        SetPlayerRoutingBucket(source, previous)
        isolated[source] = nil
    end

    return true
end)

AddEventHandler("playerDropped", function()
    isolated[source] = nil
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_appearance\bridge\framework.lua
local SUPPORTED = {
    { name = "qbx", resource = "qbx_core" },
    { name = "qb", resource = "qb-core" },
    { name = "esx", resource = "es_extended" },
    { name = "ox", resource = "ox_core" }
}

---@return string
local function detect()
    for i = 1, #SUPPORTED do
        local entry = SUPPORTED[i]

        if GetResourceState(entry.resource) ~= "missing" then
            return entry.name
        end
    end

    error("rhd_appearance: no supported framework found (qbx_core, qb-core, es_extended, ox_core)")
end

local name = detect()
Framework = require(("bridge.framework.%s.%s"):format(name, lib.context))
Framework.name = name

---@param target string
---@return boolean
function Framework.is(target)
    return name == target
end

---@param required RequireJobs
---@param gradeOf fun(name: string): number?
---@return boolean
local function holds(required, gradeOf)
    if type(required) == "string" then
        return gradeOf(required) ~= nil
    end

    for key, value in pairs(required) do
        if type(key) == "number" then
            ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: param-type-mismatch
            if gradeOf(value) then return true end
        else
            ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: param-type-mismatch
            local grade = gradeOf(key)

            if grade then
                if type(value) == "number" then
                    if grade >= value then return true end
                else
                    for i = 1, #value do
                        if value[i] == grade then return true end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

---@param required RequireJobs
---@return boolean
function Framework.holdsJob(required)
    return holds(required, Framework.jobGrade)
end

---@param required RequireJobs
---@return boolean
function Framework.holdsGang(required)
    return holds(required, Framework.gangGrade)
end

---@param source number
---@param required RequireJobs
---@return boolean
function Framework.playerHoldsJob(source, required)
    return holds(required, function(name) return Framework.PlayerJobGrade(source, name) end)
end

---@param source number
---@param required RequireJobs
---@return boolean
function Framework.playerHoldsGang(source, required)
    return holds(required, function(name) return Framework.PlayerGangGrade(source, name) end)
end

local ESX = exports["es_extended"]:getSharedObject()

local framework = {}

---@param source number
---@return string?
function framework.GetIdentifier(source)
    local player = ESX.GetPlayerFromId(source)

    return player and player.identifier
end

---@param group table?
---@param name string
---@return number?
local function gradeOf(group, name)
    if not group or group.name ~= name then return nil end

    return tonumber(group.grade) or 0
end

---@param source number
---@param name string
---@return number? grade
function framework.PlayerJobGrade(source, name)
    local player = ESX.GetPlayerFromId(source)

    return player and gradeOf(player.job, name) or nil
end

---@param source number
---@param name string
---@return number? grade
function framework.PlayerGangGrade(source, name)
    return nil
end

---@param identifier string
---@return PedAppearance?
function framework.GetAppearance(identifier)
    return storage.getUserClothing(identifier)
end

---@param identifier string
---@param appearance PedAppearance
function framework.SaveAppearance(identifier, appearance)
    storage.saveUserClothing(identifier, appearance)
end

---@param account string
---@return string
local function accountName(account)
    return account == "cash" and "money" or account
end

---@param source number
---@param account string
---@param amount number
---@return boolean
function framework.HasMoney(source, account, amount)
    local player = ESX.GetPlayerFromId(source)

    if not player then return false end

    return player.getAccount(accountName(account)).money >= amount
end

---@param source number
---@param account string
---@param amount number
---@return boolean
function framework.RemoveMoney(source, account, amount)
    local player = ESX.GetPlayerFromId(source)

    if not player then return false end

    local name = accountName(account)

    if player.getAccount(name).money < amount then return false end

    player.removeAccountMoney(name, amount)

    return true
end

RegisterNetEvent("esx:playerLoaded", function(playerId)
    events.emit("playerLoaded", playerId)
end)

---@param name string
---@param cb fun(source: number)
function framework.registerUsableItem(name, cb)
    ESX.RegisterUsableItem(name, cb)
end

return framework

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_appearance\compat\common.lua
local ped = require "core.ped"
local editor = require "core.editor"
local settings = require "core.settings"
local halfped = require "features.halfped"
local forced = require "features.forced"

local compat = {}

---@param resource string
---@param name string
---@param fn function
function compat.alias(resource, name, fn)
    AddEventHandler(("__cfx_export_%s_%s"):format(resource, name), function(setCB)
        setCB(fn)
    end)
end

---@param outfit table?
function compat.wearOutfit(outfit)
    if not outfit then return end

    local model = outfit.model or ped.getModel(cache.ped)
    local slot = settings.blocked({ model = model, components = outfit.components or {}, props = outfit.props or {} })

    if slot then
        return lib.notify({ description = locale("outfits.blocked", settings.label(slot)), type = "error" })
    end

    if outfit.model and ped.getModel(cache.ped) ~= outfit.model then
        local stored = lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:get", false, outfit.model)

        if not stored then
            return lib.notify({ description = locale("outfits.wrongModel"), type = "error" })
        end

        ped.applyToPlayer(stored)
    end

    ped.setComponents(cache.ped, halfped.strip(outfit.components or {}, ped.gender(cache.ped)))
    ped.setProps(cache.ped, outfit.props or {})

    editor.save(ped.get(cache.ped))
end

---@param clothes table?
function compat.wearClothes(clothes)
    if not clothes then return end

    ped.setComponents(cache.ped, clothes.components or {})
    ped.setProps(cache.ped, clothes.props or {})
    forced.reapply()
end

---@return fun(name: string)
function compat.reporter()
    local warned = {}

    return function(name)
        if warned[name] then return end

        warned[name] = true

        print(("^3[rhd_appearance]^7 '%s' is part of illenium job management, which is not implemented.")
            :format(name))
    end
end

return compat

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_appearance\compat\illenium-appearance\server.lua
local outfits = require "server.outfits"
local shopConfig = require "config.shops"
local blacklist = require "server.blacklist"
local peds = require "server.peds"
local validate = require "server.validate"

---@type table<number, table>
local uniforms = {}

---@param shopType string
---@return number?
local function costOf(shopType)
    local cost = shopConfig.costs[shopType]

    return cost and cost > 0 and cost or nil
end

lib.callback.register("illenium-appearance:server:getAppearance", function(source, model)
    return exports[cache.resource]:getAppearance(source, model)
end)

lib.callback.register("illenium-appearance:server:GetPlayerAces", function(source)
    local names = {}

    blacklist.aceNames(names)
    peds.aceNames(names)

    local allowed = {}

    for ace in pairs(names) do
        if IsPlayerAceAllowed(source, ace) then
            allowed[#allowed + 1] = ace
        end
    end

    return allowed
end)

lib.callback.register("illenium-appearance:server:hasMoney", function(source, shopType)
    local cost = costOf(shopType)

    if not cost then return true, 0 end

    return Framework.HasMoney(source, shopConfig.account, cost), cost
end)

lib.callback.register("illenium-appearance:server:payForTattoo", function(source, tattoo)
    local cost = type(tattoo) == "table" and tonumber(tattoo.cost) or nil

    cost = cost or costOf("tattoo")

    if not cost then return true end

    return Framework.RemoveMoney(source, shopConfig.account, cost) == true
end)

lib.callback.register("illenium-appearance:server:getOutfits", function(source)
    return outfits.get(source)
end)

lib.callback.register("illenium-appearance:server:generateOutfitCode", function(source, outfitID)
    return outfits.generateCode(source, outfitID)
end)

lib.callback.register("illenium-appearance:server:importOutfitCode", function(source, outfitName, outfitCode)
    return outfits.import(source, outfitName, outfitCode)
end)

lib.callback.register("illenium-appearance:server:getUniform", function(source)
    return uniforms[source]
end)

RegisterNetEvent("illenium-appearance:server:saveAppearance", function(appearance)
    exports[cache.resource]:saveAppearance(source, appearance)
end)

RegisterNetEvent("illenium-appearance:server:chargeCustomer", function(shopType)
    local cost = costOf(shopType)

    if not cost then return end

    Framework.RemoveMoney(source, shopConfig.account, cost)
end)

RegisterNetEvent("illenium-appearance:server:saveOutfit", function(name, model, components, props)
    outfits.save(source, name, model, components, props)
end)

RegisterNetEvent("illenium-appearance:server:updateOutfit", function(id, model, components, props)
    outfits.update(source, id, model, components, props)
end)

RegisterNetEvent("illenium-appearance:server:deleteOutfit", function(id)
    outfits.remove(source, id)
end)

RegisterNetEvent("illenium-appearance:server:syncUniform", function(uniform)
    if uniform ~= nil and not validate.slots(uniform.components, "component_id") then return end

    uniforms[source] = uniform
end)

RegisterNetEvent("illenium-appearance:server:resetOutfitCache", function()
    uniforms[source] = nil
end)

AddEventHandler("playerDropped", function()
    uniforms[source] = nil
end)

---@type table<string, boolean>
local warned = {}

---@param name string
local function unsupported(name)
    if warned[name] then return end

    warned[name] = true

    print(("^3[rhd_appearance]^7 '%s' is part of illenium job management, which is not implemented.")
        :format(name))
end

    unsupported("getManagementOutfits")

    return {}
end)

    unsupported("esx:getGradesForJob")

    return {}
end)

    unsupported("saveManagementOutfit")
end)

RegisterNetEvent("illenium-appearance:server:deleteManagementOutfit", function()
    unsupported("deleteManagementOutfit")
end)

    SetPlayerRoutingBucket(source, source)
end)

RegisterNetEvent("illenium-appearance:server:ResetRoutingBucket", function()
    SetPlayerRoutingBucket(source, 0)
end)

---@class ClothingConfig
---@field keybind { key: string|false, mapper: string }
---@field interval number
return {
    --- Opens the full clothing rail outside the editor. Set key to false to leave it unbound.
    keybind = {
        key = "K",
        mapper = "keyboard"
    },

    --- Milliseconds a piece is left alone after being toggled, so a double click counts once.

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_appearance\config\peds.lua
--[[
    Which ped models the editor offers.

    In "allowlist" mode only the models named below are offered. In "blacklist" mode every model in
    data/peds.lua is offered except the ones named below. Either way a group with no requirement
    applies to everybody, and a group that names a job, gang, ace or citizen id applies only to
    whoever meets it: in allowlist mode meeting it hands the models over, in blacklist mode meeting
    it hands them back.

    Job and gang requirements accept the same shapes as the blacklist: "police", { "police", "ems" },
    { police = 3 } for grade 3 and up, or { police = { 2, 5 } } for those grades exactly.

    A lone "*" stands in for every model in data/peds.lua, and keeps covering whatever is added to it
    later. Naming models one by one is only worth it for a rule that should stay fixed.

    Admins add further rules through /appearanceadmin. Once the panel has imported this file, the
    database takes over and what is written here is no longer read.
]]
---@type { mode: "allowlist"|"blacklist", groups: PedGroup[] }
return {
    mode = "allowlist",
    groups = {}
}

local constants = require "data.constants"

local PRESETS = constants.CAMERA.presets
local ZOOM_ZONES = constants.CAMERA.zoomZones
local LIMITS = constants.CAMERA.limits
local ORBIT = constants.CAMERA.orbit

---@param from number
---@param to number
---@param ratio number
---@return number
local function lerp(from, to, ratio)
    return from * (1.0 - ratio) + to * ratio
end

---@param value number
---@param min number
---@param max number
---@return number
local function clamp(value, min, max)
    return math.min(max, math.max(min, value))
end

---@class OrbitState
---@field target number
---@field anchor vector3
---@field yaw number
---@field targetYaw number
---@field pitch number
---@field targetPitch number

local state = {
    handle = nil,
    active = false,
    suspended = false,
    origin = nil,
    sideX = 0.0,
    sideY = 0.0,
    z = 0.5,
    targetZ = 0.5,
    fov = 50.0,
    targetFov = 50.0,
    heading = 0.0,
    targetHeading = 0.0,
    token = 0,
    ---@type OrbitState?
    orbit = nil
}

---@return number
local function zoomLimit()
    for i = 1, #ZOOM_ZONES do
        if state.targetZ >= ZOOM_ZONES[i].minZ then
            return ZOOM_ZONES[i].minFov
        end
    end

    return ZOOM_ZONES[#ZOOM_ZONES].minFov
end

---@return vector3
local function findOrigin()
    local ped = cache.ped
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local front = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(ped, 0.0, LIMITS.distance, 0.0)

    local handle = StartShapeTestCapsule(
        coords.x, coords.y, coords.z + 0.5,
        front.x, front.y, coords.z + 0.5,
        0.4, 23, ped, 0
    )

    local status, hit, hitCoords
    local attempts = 0

    repeat
        status, hit, hitCoords = GetShapeTestResult(handle)
        attempts += 1
        Wait(0)
    until status ~= 1 or attempts > 20

    if status == 2 and hit then
        local distance = #(vec3(hitCoords.x, hitCoords.y, coords.z) - coords)

        if distance >= LIMITS.minDistance and distance <= LIMITS.distance then
            return vec3(hitCoords.x, hitCoords.y, coords.z)
        end
    end

    return vec3(front.x, front.y, coords.z)
end

---@param coords vector3
---@return number x
---@return number y
local function sideDirection(coords)
    local dx = coords.x - state.origin.x
    local dy = coords.y - state.origin.y
    local length = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)

    if length == 0.0 then return 0.0, 0.0 end

    return -dy / length, dx / length
end

local function project()
    if not state.handle then return end

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local height = coords.z + state.z
    local shift = 2.0 * LIMITS.distance * math.tan(math.rad(state.fov) * 0.5) * LIMITS.sideShift

    SetCamFov(state.handle, state.fov)
    SetCamCoord(state.handle, state.origin.x, state.origin.y, height)
    PointCamAtCoord(state.handle, coords.x + state.sideX * shift, coords.y + state.sideY * shift, height)
end

---@param target number
---@return vector3
local function headOf(target)
    return GetPedBoneCoords(target, ORBIT.bone, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
end

local function projectOrbit()
    local orbit = state.orbit

    if not state.handle or not orbit then return end

    local anchor = orbit.anchor
    local heading = math.rad(GetEntityHeading(orbit.target) + orbit.yaw)
    local pitch = math.rad(orbit.pitch)
    local flat = ORBIT.distance * math.cos(pitch)

    SetCamFov(state.handle, state.fov)
    SetCamCoord(state.handle,
        anchor.x - math.sin(heading) * flat,
        anchor.y + math.cos(heading) * flat,
        anchor.z + ORBIT.height + ORBIT.distance * math.sin(pitch))
    PointCamAtCoord(state.handle, anchor.x, anchor.y, anchor.z + ORBIT.height)
end

local camera = {}

local INTRO_FOV = 1.35

---@param key string
function camera.preset(key)
    local orbit = state.orbit

    if orbit then
        orbit.targetYaw = 0.0
        orbit.targetPitch = ORBIT.pitch
        state.targetFov = ORBIT.fov

        return
    end

    local preset = PRESETS[key]

    if not preset then return end

    state.targetZ = preset.z
    state.targetFov = preset.fov
end

---@param dx number
---@param dy number
function camera.move(dx, dy)
    local orbit = state.orbit

    if orbit then
        orbit.targetYaw = clamp(orbit.targetYaw - dx * ORBIT.turnSpeed, -ORBIT.maxYaw, ORBIT.maxYaw)
        orbit.targetPitch = clamp(orbit.targetPitch + dy * ORBIT.pitchSpeed, ORBIT.minPitch, ORBIT.maxPitch)

        return
    end

    state.targetZ = clamp(state.targetZ + dy * LIMITS.moveSpeed, LIMITS.minZ, LIMITS.maxZ)
    state.targetHeading = state.targetHeading + dx * LIMITS.turnSpeed
end

---@param steps number
function camera.zoom(steps)
    if state.orbit then
        state.targetFov = clamp(state.targetFov + steps * ORBIT.zoomStep, ORBIT.minFov, ORBIT.maxFov)

        return
    end

    state.targetFov = clamp(state.targetFov + steps * LIMITS.zoomStep, zoomLimit(), LIMITS.maxFov)
end

function camera.start()
    local preset = PRESETS.default
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)

    state.orbit = nil
    state.origin = findOrigin()
    state.sideX, state.sideY = sideDirection(coords)
    state.z, state.targetZ = preset.z, preset.z
    state.fov, state.targetFov = math.min(LIMITS.maxFov, preset.fov * INTRO_FOV), preset.fov
    state.heading = GetEntityHeading(cache.ped)
    state.targetHeading = state.heading

    state.handle = CreateCameraWithParams("DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA", state.origin.x, state.origin.y,
        coords.z + state.z, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, state.fov, false, 0)

    SetCamActive(state.handle, true)
    project()

    state.active = true
    state.token += 1

    local token = state.token

    CreateThread(function()
        while state.active and state.token == token do
            if state.suspended then
                Wait(0)
                goto continue
            end

            do
                local frameTime = GetFrameTime()

                state.targetFov = math.max(zoomLimit(), state.targetFov)
                state.z = lerp(state.z, state.targetZ, 10.0 * frameTime)
                state.fov = lerp(state.fov, state.targetFov, 5.0 * frameTime)
                state.heading = lerp(state.heading, state.targetHeading, 5.0 * frameTime)

                SetEntityHeading(cache.ped, state.heading)
                project()
            end

            Wait(0)
            ::continue::
        end
    end)
end

---@param target number
function camera.orbit(target)
    state.orbit = {
        target = target,
        anchor = headOf(target),
        yaw = 0.0,
        targetYaw = 0.0,
        pitch = ORBIT.pitch,
        targetPitch = ORBIT.pitch
    }

    state.fov, state.targetFov = math.min(ORBIT.maxFov, ORBIT.fov * INTRO_FOV), ORBIT.fov

    local anchor = state.orbit.anchor

    state.handle = CreateCameraWithParams("DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA", anchor.x, anchor.y, anchor.z,
        0.0, 0.0, 0.0, state.fov, false, 0)

    SetCamActive(state.handle, true)
    projectOrbit()

    state.active = true
    state.token += 1

    local token = state.token

    CreateThread(function()
        while state.active and state.orbit and state.token == token do
            local orbit = state.orbit --[[@as OrbitState]]

            if DoesEntityExist(orbit.target) then
                local frameTime = GetFrameTime()
                local head = headOf(orbit.target)
                local follow = math.min(1.0, ORBIT.follow * frameTime)

                orbit.anchor = vec3(
                    lerp(orbit.anchor.x, head.x, follow),
                    lerp(orbit.anchor.y, head.y, follow),
                    lerp(orbit.anchor.z, head.z, follow)
                )
                orbit.yaw = lerp(orbit.yaw, orbit.targetYaw, 5.0 * frameTime)
                orbit.pitch = lerp(orbit.pitch, orbit.targetPitch, 5.0 * frameTime)
                state.fov = lerp(state.fov, state.targetFov, 5.0 * frameTime)

                projectOrbit()
            end

            Wait(0)
        end
    end)
end

function camera.suspend()
    state.suspended = true
end

function camera.resume()
    state.suspended = false
end

function camera.stop()
    state.active = false
    state.suspended = false
    state.orbit = nil
    state.token += 1

    if state.handle then
        DestroyCam(state.handle, false)
        state.handle = nil
    end
end

return camera

local config = require "config.editor"
local menus = require "config.menu"
local customAnimations = require "config.animation"
local ped = require "core.ped"

local STATS_HOLD = 1000

local TRY_ON_ANIMATIONS = {
    {
        components = { 3, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11, 33 },
        dict = "clothingshirt",
        clips = {
            "try_shirt_positive_a",
            "try_shirt_positive_b",

        }

---@type PedAppearance?
local original
---@type table?
local menuConfig
---@type fun(appearance: PedAppearance|boolean?)?
local finish
---@type number?
local heading

---@class EditorSession
---@field target number
---@field original PedAppearance

local session

---@type { health: number, armour: number }?
local savedStats
local statsDepth = 0

local playingTryOn = false
local animToken = 0

local editor = {}

local function backupStats()
    statsDepth += 1

    if savedStats then return end

    savedStats = {
        health = GetEntityHealth(cache.ped),
        armour = GetPedArmour(cache.ped)
    }
end

local function restoreStats()
    if statsDepth > 0 then
        statsDepth -= 1

        if statsDepth > 0 then return end
    end

    local previous = savedStats

    savedStats = nil

    if not previous then return end

    SetEntityMaxHealth(cache.ped, 200)

    local deadline = GetGameTimer() + STATS_HOLD

    repeat
        SetEntityHealth(cache.ped, previous.health)
        SetPedArmour(cache.ped, previous.armour)
        Wait(0)
    until GetGameTimer() >= deadline

    SetPlayerHealthRechargeMultiplier(cache.playerId, 0.0)
    SetPlayerHealthRechargeLimit(cache.playerId, 0.0)
end

---@param entity number
---@return boolean
local function animDisabled(entity)
    local list = config.disableAnimForPeds

    if #list == 0 then return false end

    local model = GetEntityModel(entity)

    for i = 1, #list do
        if model == joaat(list[i]) then return true end
    end

    return false
end

---@param componentId number
---@return table?
local function animationFor(componentId)
    for i = 1, #TRY_ON_ANIMATIONS do
        local animation = TRY_ON_ANIMATIONS[i]

        for j = 1, #animation.components do
            if animation.components[j] == componentId then
                return animation
            end
        end
    end
end

---@param entity number
---@param clearTasks boolean?
function editor.idle(entity, clearTasks)
    if not editor.active() or session or animDisabled(entity) then return end

    if clearTasks then
        ClearPedTasksImmediately(entity)
    end

    local dict = ped.gender(entity) == "male" and "move_m@generic" or "move_f@generic"

    lib.playAnim(entity, dict, "idle", 1.0, -1.0, -1, 1)
end

---@param entity number
---@param componentId number
function editor.tryOn(entity, componentId)
    if not editor.active() or session or playingTryOn or animDisabled(entity) then return end

    local animation = animationFor(componentId)

    if not animation then return end

    local clip = animation.clips[math.random(1, #animation.clips)]
    local current = animToken

    ClearPedTasks(entity)
    lib.playAnim(entity, animation.dict, clip, 1.0, -1.0, -1, 0)

    playingTryOn = true

    CreateThread(function()
        Wait(GetAnimDuration(animation.dict, clip) * 1000)

        if current == animToken then
            editor.idle(entity)
        end

        playingTryOn = false
    end)
end

---@return boolean
function editor.active()
    return menuConfig ~= nil
end

---@return { name: string, keyboard: string }[]
function editor.animations()
    local names = {}

    for name in pairs(customAnimations) do
        names[#names + 1] = name
    end

    table.sort(names)

    local result = table.create(#names, 0)

    for i = 1, #names do
        result[i] = { name = names[i], keyboard = customAnimations[names[i]].keyboard }
    end

    return result
end

---@param name string
---@return boolean
function editor.playAnimation(name)
    local animation = customAnimations[name]

    if not animation or not editor.active() or session or animDisabled(cache.ped) then return false end

    local current = animToken

    ClearPedTasks(cache.ped)
    lib.playAnim(cache.ped, animation.dict, animation.name, 1.0, -1.0, -1, 0)

    CreateThread(function()
        Wait(GetAnimDuration(animation.dict, animation.name) * 1000)

        if current == animToken then editor.idle(cache.ped) end
    end)

    return true
end

---@return table?
function editor.config()
    if not menuConfig then return end

    local conf = table.clone(menuConfig)

    conf.automaticFade = config.automaticFade

    return conf
end

---@return PedAppearance?
function editor.original()
    return original
end

---@return number?
function editor.heading()
    return heading
end

---@return EditorSession?
function editor.session()
    return session
end

---@param appearance PedAppearance
---@return boolean saved
function editor.save(appearance)
    if forced.active() then return false end

    local saved = lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:save", false, appearance) == true

    if not saved then
        lib.notify({ description = locale("notify.saveFailed"), type = "error" })
    end

    return saved
end

---@param appearance PedAppearance
---@return boolean saved
function editor.commit(appearance)
    if not editor.save(appearance) then return false end

    original = appearance

    return true
end

function editor.load()
    local data = lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:get", false)

    if not data then return end

    if not events.emit("onReloadskin", cache.ped, data) then return end

    backupStats()
    ped.applyToPlayer(data, true)

    if settings.repair(cache.ped, data) then
        ped.setComponents(cache.ped, data.components)
        ped.setProps(cache.ped, data.props)
    end

    items.reapply()
    forced.apply()
    restoreStats()

    events.emit("onReloadskinDone", cache.ped, data)
end

---@param conf table?
---@param cb? fun(appearance: PedAppearance|boolean?): boolean?
---@param barber EditorSession?
---@return boolean opened
function editor.open(conf, cb, barber)
    if editor.active() then return false end

    if not events.emit("onClothingMenuOpen", cache.ped, conf or menus.default) then return false end

    repeat Wait(0) until IsScreenFadedIn() and not IsPlayerTeleportActive() and not IsPlayerSwitchInProgress()

    if editor.active() then return false end

    clothing.closeRail()
    clothing.reset(false)

    session = barber
    original = barber and barber.original or ped.get(cache.ped)
    heading = not barber and GetEntityHeading(cache.ped) or nil
    menuConfig = conf or menus.default
    finish = cb

    if barber then
        camera.orbit(barber.target)
    else
        backupStats()
        camera.start()
    end

    SetNuiFocus(true, true)
    SetNuiFocusKeepInput(false)
    RenderScriptCams(true, false, 0, true, true)
    SetEntityInvincible(cache.ped, config.invincibleDuringCustomization)

    if not barber then
        TaskStandStill(cache.ped, -1)
        editor.idle(cache.ped, true)
    end

    if config.hideRadar then DisplayRadar(false) end

    SendNuiMessage(json.encode({
        action = "appearance_display",
        data = { asynchronous = config.asynchronousLoading }
    }))

    CreateThread(function()
        while editor.active() do
            events.emit("onClothingMenuTick", cache.ped)
            Wait(0)
        end
    end)

    clothing.push()

    return true
end

---@param appearance PedAppearance|boolean?
function editor.close(appearance)
    if not editor.active() then return end

    clothing.reset(false)

    local restore = original
    local previousHeading = heading
    local cb = finish
    local barber = session

    original = nil
    heading = nil
    menuConfig = nil
    finish = nil
    session = nil
    animToken += 1
    playingTryOn = false

    RenderScriptCams(false, false, 0, true, true)
    camera.stop()
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)

    if config.hideRadar then DisplayRadar(true) end

    SetEntityInvincible(cache.ped, false)

    SendNuiMessage(json.encode({
        action = "appearance_hide",
        data = {}
    }))

    if barber then
        settings.reset()
        admin.reset()

        if cb then cb(appearance) end

        events.emit("onClothingMenuClose", cache.ped, nil)

        return
    end

    if not appearance and restore then
        ped.applyToPlayer(restore, true)
        items.reapply()
    end

    if previousHeading then
        SetEntityHeading(cache.ped, previousHeading)
    end

    ClearPedTasksImmediately(cache.ped)

    restoreStats()
    settings.reset()
    admin.reset()

    local keep = appearance ~= nil

    if cb then
        local decision = cb(appearance)

        if decision ~= nil then keep = decision end
    end

    if keep then
        editor.save((appearance or ped.get(cache.ped)) --[[@as PedAppearance]])
    elseif appearance and restore then
        backupStats()
        ped.applyToPlayer(restore, true)
        items.reapply()
        restoreStats()
    end

    events.emit("onClothingMenuClose", cache.ped, appearance)
end

AddEventHandler("onResourceStop", function(resource)
    if resource == GetCurrentResourceName() then
        SetNuiFocus(false, false)
        SetNuiFocusKeepInput(false)
    end
end)

return editor

            Citizen.PointerValueIntInitialized(0), Citizen.PointerValueIntInitialized(0),

        shapeThird = shapeThird,

        skinSecond = skinSecond,
        skinThird = skinThird,

---@param entity number

        values[overlays[i]] = {
            style = style,
            opacity = opacity,
            color = color,
            secondColor = secondColor
        }
    end

    return values
end

---@param entity number
---@param values PedHeadOverlays
function ped.setHeadOverlays(entity, values)
    local overlays = constants.HEAD_OVERLAYS

    for i = 1, #overlays do
        local name = overlays[i]
        local overlay = values[name]

        if overlay then
            SetPedHeadOverlay(entity, i - 1, overlay.style, (overlay.opacity or 0) + 0.0)

            if overlay.color then
                SetPedHeadOverlayColor(entity, i - 1, SECOND_COLOR[name] and 2 or 1, overlay.color, overlay.secondColor)
            end
        end
    end
end

---@param entity number
---@return number
function ped.getEyeColor(entity)
    local value = GetPedEyeColor(entity)

    return value < #constants.EYE_COLORS and value or 0
end

---@param entity number
---@param value number
function ped.setEyeColor(entity, value)
    SetPedEyeColor(entity, value)
end

---@param entity number
---@param style number
local function applyFade(entity, style)
    local decoration = constants.HAIR_DECORATIONS[ped.gender(entity)][style]

    if decoration then
        AddPedDecorationFromHashes(entity, decoration[1], decoration[2])
    end
end

---@param entity number
---@param tattoo Tattoo
---@param male boolean
local function addTattoo(entity, tattoo, male)
    local hash = male and tattoo.hashMale or tattoo.hashFemale

    for _ = 1, (tattoo.opacity or 0.1) * 10 do
        AddPedDecorationFromHashes(entity, joaat(tattoo.collection), joaat(hash))
    end
end

---@return PedTattoos
function ped.getTattoos()
    return worn
end

---@param entity number
---@param style number? hair drawable to pick the fade for, defaults to the one currently worn
function ped.applyTattoos(entity, style)
    local male = ped.gender(entity) == "male"

    ClearPedDecorations(entity)

    if config.automaticFade then
        worn[HAIR_ZONE] = {}

        applyFade(entity, style or GetPedDrawableVariation(entity, HAIR_COMPONENT))
    elseif hairFade ~= NO_FADE then
        worn[HAIR_ZONE] = {}

        applyFade(entity, hairFade)
    end

    for zone in pairs(worn) do
        for i = 1, #worn[zone] do
            addTattoo(entity, worn[zone][i], male)
        end
    end
end

---@param entity number
---@param list PedTattoos
function ped.setTattoos(entity, list)
    worn = list or {}

    ped.applyTattoos(entity)
end

---@param entity number
---@param list PedTattoos
---@param tattoo Tattoo
function ped.previewTattoo(entity, list, tattoo)
    local male = ped.gender(entity) == "male"

    ClearPedDecorations(entity)
    addTattoo(entity, tattoo, male)

    for zone in pairs(list) do
        for i = 1, #list[zone] do
            local other = list[zone][i]

            if other.name ~= tattoo.name then
                addTattoo(entity, other, male)
            end
        end
    end

    if config.automaticFade then
        applyFade(entity, GetPedDrawableVariation(entity, HAIR_COMPONENT))
    elseif hairFade ~= NO_FADE then
        applyFade(entity, hairFade)
    end
end

---@param entity number
---@return PedHair
function ped.getHair(entity)
    return {
        style = GetPedDrawableVariation(entity, HAIR_COMPONENT),
        color = GetPedHairColor(entity),
        highlight = GetPedHairHighlightColor(entity),
        texture = GetPedTextureVariation(entity, HAIR_COMPONENT),
        fade = hairFade
    }
end

---@param entity number
---@param value PedHair
function ped.setHair(entity, value)
    SetPedComponentVariation(entity, HAIR_COMPONENT, value.style, value.texture, 0)
    SetPedHairTint(entity, value.color, value.highlight)

    hairFade = value.fade or NO_FADE

    if ped.isFreemode(entity) then
        ped.applyTattoos(entity, value.style)
    end
end

---@param entity number
---@return PedAppearance
function ped.get(entity)
    return {
        model = ped.getModel(entity),
        headBlend = ped.getHeadBlend(entity),
        faceFeatures = ped.getFaceFeatures(entity),
        headOverlays = ped.getHeadOverlays(entity),
        components = ped.getComponents(entity),
        props = ped.getProps(entity),
        hair = ped.getHair(entity),
        tattoos = ped.getTattoos(),
        eyeColor = ped.getEyeColor(entity)
    }
end

---@param entity number
---@param appearance PedAppearance
function ped.apply(entity, appearance)
    if appearance.components then ped.setComponents(entity, appearance.components) end
    if appearance.props then ped.setProps(entity, appearance.props) end
    if appearance.headBlend then ped.setHeadBlend(entity, appearance.headBlend) end
    if appearance.faceFeatures then ped.setFaceFeatures(entity, appearance.faceFeatures) end
    if appearance.headOverlays then ped.setHeadOverlays(entity, appearance.headOverlays) end
    if appearance.eyeColor then ped.setEyeColor(entity, appearance.eyeColor) end

    worn = appearance.tattoos or {}

    if appearance.hair then
        ped.setHair(entity, appearance.hair)
    else
        ped.applyTattoos(entity)
    end
end

---@param entity number
---@param list PedComponent[]?
local function preloadComponents(entity, list)
    if not list then return end

    local freemode = ped.isFreemode(entity)

    for i = 1, #list do
        local component = list[i]

        if not (freemode and LOCKED_COMPONENTS[component.component_id]) then
            SetPedPreloadVariationData(entity, component.component_id, component.drawable, component.texture)
        end
    end

    local deadline = GetGameTimer() + PRELOAD_TIMEOUT

    while DoesEntityExist(entity) and not HasPedPreloadVariationDataFinished(entity) and GetGameTimer() < deadline do
        Wait(0)
    end
end

---@param appearance PedAppearance
---@return number entity
function ped.applyToPlayer(appearance, force)
    local entity = ped.setModel(appearance.model, force)

    preloadComponents(entity, appearance.components)

    local current = cache.ped

    ped.apply(current, appearance)

    if DoesEntityExist(entity) then
        ReleasePedPreloadVariationData(entity)
    end

    return current
end

return ped

---@return table<string, BlacklistEntry[]>
local function storedEntries()
    if stored then return stored end

    local data = Net.awaitPush(function() return blacklistData end)

    if not data then return EMPTY end

    stored = data.entries or EMPTY
    configImported = data.imported == true

    return stored
end

---@param gender string
---@param category string
---@param slot string
---@return BlacklistEntry[]
local function entriesFor(gender, category, slot)
    local extra = storedEntries()[gender .. "/" .. category .. "/" .. slot]
    local group = not configImported and config[gender] or EMPTY
    local base = (category == "hair" and group.hair or group[category] and group[category][slot]) or EMPTY
    local owned = category ~= "hair" and items.entries(gender, slot) or nil

    if not extra and not owned then return base end

    local result = table.create(#base + (extra and #extra or 0) + (owned and #owned or 0), 0)

    table.move(base, 1, #base, 1, result)

    if extra then
        table.move(extra, 1, #extra, #result + 1, result)
    end

    if owned then
        table.move(owned, 1, #owned, #result + 1, result)
    end

    return result
end

---@param list any[]
---@param value any
---@return boolean
local function contains(list, value)
    for i = 1, #list do
        if list[i] == value then return true end
    end

    return false
end

---@param list any[]
---@param values any[]
---@return boolean
local function containsAny(list, values)
    for i = 1, #list do
        if contains(values, list[i]) then return true end
    end

    return false
end

---@param entry BlacklistEntry
---@return boolean
local function unlocked(entry)
    local state = Framework.getState()

    if entry.jobs and Framework.holdsJob(entry.jobs) then return true end
    if entry.gangs and Framework.holdsGang(entry.gangs) then return true end
    if entry.aces and containsAny(entry.aces, aces()) then return true end
    local ids = entry.identifiers or entry.citizenids

    if ids and state.identifier and contains(ids, state.identifier) then return true end

    return false
end

---@return BlacklistSettings
local function noBlacklist()
    return { drawables = {}, textures = {} }
end

---@param entries BlacklistEntry[]
---@param drawable number
---@return BlacklistSettings
local function blacklistOf(entries, drawable)
    local result = noBlacklist()

    for i = 1, #entries do
        local entry = entries[i]

        if not unlocked(entry) and entry.drawables then
            local restrictsTextures = entry.textures and #entry.textures > 0

            for j = 1, #entry.drawables do
                local blocked = entry.drawables[j]

                if not restrictsTextures then
                    result.drawables[#result.drawables + 1] = blocked
                elseif blocked == drawable then
                    for k = 1, #entry.textures do
                        result.textures[#result.textures + 1] = entry.textures[k]
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return result
end

---@param blacklist BlacklistSettings
---@param componentId number
---@param gender string
local function appendHalfPedBlacklist(blacklist, componentId, gender)
    if componentId ~= DECAL_COMPONENT then return end

    local blocked = halfped.blockedDecals(gender)

    for i = 1, #blocked do
        blacklist.drawables[#blacklist.drawables + 1] = blocked[i]
    end
end

---@param gender string
---@return table<string, RangeSetting>
local function headBlendFor(gender)
    local face = halfped.disabledFace(gender)

    if not face or halfped.hasAnyAccess(gender) then return HEAD_BLEND end

    local values = table.create(0, #HEAD_BLEND_FIELDS)

    for i = 1, #HEAD_BLEND_FIELDS do
        local name = HEAD_BLEND_FIELDS[i]
        local range = HEAD_BLEND[name]

        if face >= range.min and face <= range.max then
            values[name] = { min = range.min, max = range.max, factor = range.factor, blacklist = { face } }
        else
            values[name] = range
        end
    end

    return values
end

---@return { hair: number[][], makeUp: number[][] }
local function colors()
    if not palette then
        palette = { hair = {}, makeUp = {} }

        for i = 0, GetNumHairColors() - 1 do
            palette.hair[i + 1] = { GetPedHairRgbColor(i) }
        end

        for i = 0, GetNumMakeupColors() - 1 do
            palette.makeUp[i + 1] = { GetPedMakeupRgbColor(i) }
        end
    end

    return palette
end

    local values = table.create(0, #overlays)

    for i = 1, #overlays do
        local name = overlays[i]

        values[name] = {
            style = { min = 0, max = GetPedHeadOverlayNum(i - 1) - 1 },
            opacity = RANGES.overlayOpacity

        if HAIR_COLORED[name] then
            values[name].color = { items = items.hair }
        elseif MAKEUP_COLORED[name] then
            values[name].color = { items = items.makeUp }

    end

    return values
end

---@param entity number
---@return table
local function tattoos(entity)
    local key = ped.gender(entity) == "male" and "hashMale" or "hashFemale"
    local items = {}

    for zone, list in pairs(catalogue) do
        items[zone] = {}

        for i = 1, #list do

---@param entry table
---@return boolean
local function unconditional(entry)
    return not (entry.jobs or entry.gangs or entry.aces or entry.identifiers)
end

---@return { mode: string, rules: PedRule[], imported: boolean }
local function pedState()
    if not pedRules then
        pedRules = Net.awaitPush(function() return pedData end)
            or { mode = pedConfig.mode, rules = EMPTY, imported = false }
    end

    return pedRules
end

---@return string[]
local function models()
    if allowedModels then return allowedModels end

    local state = pedState()
    local allow = state.mode ~= "blacklist"
    local rules = state.rules or EMPTY
    local groups = state.imported and EMPTY or pedConfig.groups
    local touched = {}
    local everything = false

    local function collect(rule)
        ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: param-type-mismatch
        local holds = unconditional(rule) or unlocked(rule)

        if holds ~= allow then return end

        local list = rule.models

        if #list == 1 and list[1] == "*" then
            everything = true

            return
        end

        for i = 1, #list do
            touched[list[i]] = true
        end
    end

    for i = 1, #groups do collect(groups[i]) end
    for i = 1, #rules do collect(rules[i]) end

    allowedModels = {}

    if allow and everything then
        table.move(pedModels, 1, #pedModels, 1, allowedModels)

        return allowedModels
    end

    if allow then
        for i = 1, #pedModels do
            if touched[pedModels[i]] then
                allowedModels[#allowedModels + 1] = pedModels[i]
            end
        end

        return allowedModels
    end

    if everything then return allowedModels end

    for i = 1, #pedModels do
        if not touched[pedModels[i]] then
            allowedModels[#allowedModels + 1] = pedModels[i]
        end
    end

    return allowedModels
end

---@param entity number
---@param componentId number
---@return table
function settings.component(entity, componentId)
    local drawable = GetPedDrawableVariation(entity, componentId)
    local slot = COMPONENT_SLOTS[componentId]
    local gender = ped.gender(entity)
    local freemode = ped.isFreemode(entity)

    local blacklist = slot and freemode
        and blacklistOf(entriesFor(gender, "components", slot), drawable)
        or noBlacklist()

    appendHalfPedBlacklist(blacklist, componentId, gender)

    return {
        component_id = componentId,
        drawable = {
            min = 0,
            max = GetNumberOfPedDrawableVariations(entity, componentId) - 1
        },
        texture = {
            min = 0,
            max = GetNumberOfPedTextureVariations(entity, componentId, drawable) - 1
        },
        blacklist = blacklist,
        locked = slot ~= nil and wardrobe.holds(slot)
    }
end

---@param entity number
---@param propId number
---@return table
function settings.prop(entity, propId)
    local drawable = GetPedPropIndex(entity, propId)
    local slot = PROP_SLOTS[propId]

    return {
        prop_id = propId,
        drawable = {
            min = -1,
            max = GetNumberOfPedPropDrawableVariations(entity, propId) - 1
        },
        texture = {
            min = -1,
            max = GetNumberOfPedPropTextureVariations(entity, propId, drawable) - 1
        },
        blacklist = slot and ped.isFreemode(entity)
            and blacklistOf(entriesFor(ped.gender(entity), "props", slot), drawable)
            or noBlacklist(),
        locked = slot ~= nil and wardrobe.holds(slot)
    }
end

---@type table<string, number>
local fadeCeiling = {}

---@param gender string
---@return number
local function hairFadeMax(gender)
    local cached = fadeCeiling[gender]

    if cached then return cached end

    local highest = -1

    for index in pairs(constants.HAIR_DECORATIONS[gender] or EMPTY) do
        if index > highest then highest = index end
    end

    fadeCeiling[gender] = highest

    return highest
end

---@class HairBlacklist
---@field drawables number[]
---@field textures table<string, number[]>

---@param blocked HairBlacklist
---@param style number
---@return BlacklistSettings
local function hairBlacklistFor(blocked, style)
    return {
        drawables = blocked.drawables or {},
        textures = blocked.textures and blocked.textures[tostring(style)] or {}
    }
end

---@param entity number
---@param style number?
---@param blocked HairBlacklist?
---@return table
function settings.hair(entity, style, blocked)
    local items = colors()

    style = style or GetPedDrawableVariation(entity, HAIR_COMPONENT)

    local blacklist

    if blocked then
        blacklist = hairBlacklistFor(blocked, style)
    elseif ped.isFreemode(entity) then
        blacklist = blacklistOf(entriesFor(ped.gender(entity), "hair", ""), style)
    else
        blacklist = noBlacklist()
    end

    return {
        style = {
            min = 0,
            max = GetNumberOfPedDrawableVariations(entity, HAIR_COMPONENT) - 1
        },
        color = { items = items.hair },
        highlight = { items = items.hair },
        texture = {
            min = 0,
            max = GetNumberOfPedTextureVariations(entity, HAIR_COMPONENT, style) - 1
        },
        fade = {
            min = -1,
            max = hairFadeMax(ped.gender(entity))
        },
        blacklist = blacklist
    }
end

---@param entity number
---@return HairBlacklist
function settings.hairBlacklist(entity)
    local result = { drawables = {}, textures = {} }

    if not ped.isFreemode(entity) then return result end

    local entries = entriesFor(ped.gender(entity), "hair", "")

    for i = 1, #entries do
        local entry = entries[i]

        if not unlocked(entry) and entry.drawables then
            local restrictsTextures = entry.textures and #entry.textures > 0

            for j = 1, #entry.drawables do
                local blocked = entry.drawables[j]

                if restrictsTextures then
                    local key = tostring(blocked)
                    local list = result.textures[key] or {}

                    for k = 1, #entry.textures do
                        list[#list + 1] = entry.textures[k]
                    end

                    result.textures[key] = list
                else
                    result.drawables[#result.drawables + 1] = blocked
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return result
end

---@param entity number
---@return table
function settings.all(entity)
    local components = table.create(#constants.COMPONENTS, 0)

    for i = 1, #constants.COMPONENTS do
        components[i] = settings.component(entity, constants.COMPONENTS[i])
    end

    local props = table.create(#constants.PROPS, 0)

    for i = 1, #constants.PROPS do
        props[i] = settings.prop(entity, constants.PROPS[i])
    end

    return {
        ped = { model = { items = models() } },
        components = components,
        props = props,
        headBlend = headBlendFor(ped.gender(entity)),
        faceFeatures = FACE_FEATURES,
        headOverlays = headOverlays(),
        hair = settings.hair(entity),
        eyeColor = RANGES.eyeColor,
        tattoos = tattoos(entity)
    }
end

function settings.reset()
    allowedAces = nil
    allowedModels = nil
    pedRules = nil
    stored = nil
end

---@param gender string
---@param category string
---@param slot string
---@param componentId number?
---@param drawable number
---@param texture number
---@return boolean drawableBlocked
---@return boolean textureBlocked
local function pieceState(gender, category, slot, componentId, drawable, texture)
    local result = blacklistOf(entriesFor(gender, category, slot), drawable)

    if componentId then
        appendHalfPedBlacklist(result, componentId, gender)
    end

    return contains(result.drawables, drawable), contains(result.textures, texture)
end

---@param gender string
---@param category string
---@param slot string
---@param componentId number?
---@param drawable number
---@param texture number
---@return boolean
local function pieceBlocked(gender, category, slot, componentId, drawable, texture)
    local drawableBlocked, textureBlocked = pieceState(gender, category, slot, componentId, drawable, texture)

    return drawableBlocked or textureBlocked
end

---@alias ClothingLook { model: string, components: PedComponent[]?, props: PedProp[]? }

---@param appearance ClothingLook
---@param handle fun(gender: string, category: string, slot: string, componentId: number?, piece: table): boolean?
---@return string? slot
local function walk(appearance, handle)
    local gender = GENDER_BY_MODEL[appearance.model]

    if not gender then return end

    local components = appearance.components or {}

    for i = 1, #components do
        local piece = components[i]
        local slot = COMPONENT_SLOTS[piece.component_id]

        if slot and handle(gender, "components", slot, piece.component_id, piece) then
            return slot
        end
    end

    local props = appearance.props or {}

    for i = 1, #props do
        local piece = props[i]
        local slot = PROP_SLOTS[piece.prop_id]

        if slot and piece.drawable >= 0 and handle(gender, "props", slot, nil, piece) then
            return slot
        end
    end
end

local SLOT_LABELS = { shirts = "shirt" }

---@param slot string
---@return string
function settings.label(slot)
    local entry = constants.SLOTS[slot]

    if not entry then return slot end

    return locale(("UI.%s.%s"):format(entry.category, SLOT_LABELS[slot] or slot))
end

---@param appearance ClothingLook
---@return string? slot
function settings.blocked(appearance)
    return walk(appearance, function(gender, category, slot, componentId, piece)
        return pieceBlocked(gender, category, slot, componentId, piece.drawable, piece.texture)
    end)
end

---@param entity number
---@param appearance ClothingLook
---@return boolean changed
function settings.repair(entity, appearance)
    local changed = false

    ---@param piece table
    ---@param drawable number
    ---@return number count
    local function textureCount(piece, drawable)
        return piece.prop_id
            and GetNumberOfPedPropTextureVariations(entity, piece.prop_id, drawable)
            or GetNumberOfPedTextureVariations(entity, piece.component_id, drawable)
    end

    walk(appearance, function(gender, category, slot, componentId, piece)
        local drawableBlocked, textureBlocked = pieceState(gender, category, slot, componentId,
            piece.drawable, piece.texture)

        if not drawableBlocked and not textureBlocked then return end

        local isProp = category == "props"

        if not drawableBlocked then
            local count = textureCount(piece, piece.drawable)

            for step = 1, count do
                local candidate = (piece.texture + step) % count
                local _, blocked = pieceState(gender, category, slot, componentId, piece.drawable, candidate)

                if not blocked then
                    piece.texture = candidate
                    changed = true

                    return
                end
            end
        end

        local count = isProp
            and GetNumberOfPedPropDrawableVariations(entity, piece.prop_id)
            or GetNumberOfPedDrawableVariations(entity, piece.component_id)

        for step = 1, count do
            local candidate = (piece.drawable + step) % count

            if not pieceState(gender, category, slot, componentId, candidate, 0) then
                piece.drawable = candidate
                piece.texture = 0
                changed = true

                for texture = 0, textureCount(piece, candidate) - 1 do
                    local _, blocked = pieceState(gender, category, slot, componentId, candidate, texture)

                    if not blocked then
                        piece.texture = texture
                        break
                    end
                end

                return
            end
        end

        piece.drawable = isProp and -1 or 0
        piece.texture = isProp and -1 or 0
        changed = true
    end)

    return changed
end

return settings

local variations = {}

for i=1, #variationConfigs do
    local variation = variationConfigs[i]
    if not variations[variation.type] then
        variations[variation.type] = {}
    end

    if not variations[variation.type][variation.gender] then
        variations[variation.type][variation.gender] = {}
    end

    if variation.single or variation.type == 'gloves' then
        variations[variation.type][variation.gender][variation.first] = variation.second
    else
        variations[variation.type][variation.gender][variation.first] = variation.second
        variations[variation.type][variation.gender][variation.second] = variation.first
    end
end

return variations
