local function pushUpdate()
    nui.send('update', snapshot())
end

local function clearStage()
    ClearPedTasksImmediately(PlayerPedId())

    if staged.partner and DoesEntityExist(staged.partner) then
        DeleteEntity(staged.partner)
    end

    if staged.placeholder and DoesEntityExist(staged.placeholder) then
        DeleteEntity(staged.placeholder)
    end

    utils.deleteAll(staged.props)

    if staged.dict then
        RemoveAnimDict(staged.dict)
    end

    staged.partner = nil
    staged.placeholder = nil
    staged.dict = nil
    staged.handle = nil
    staged.anchor = nil
    staged.origin = nil
    staged.idle = nil
    staged.bed = nil
    staged.view = nil
end

---@param ped number
---@param partner number
local function walkAway(ped, partner)
    local leave = selection.partnerLeave
    local origin = GetEntityCoords(partner)
    local side = GetOffsetFromEntityGivenWorldCoords(ped, origin.x, origin.y, origin.z).x < 0.0 and -1.0 or 1.0
    local away = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(ped, side * leave.side, -leave.back, 0.0)
    local heading = GetHeadingFromVector_2d(away.x - origin.x, away.y - origin.y)
    local deadline = GetGameTimer() + leave.waitMs

    ClearPedTasks(partner)
    TaskGoStraightToCoord(partner, away.x, away.y, away.z, 1.0, leave.waitMs * 2, heading, 0.5)

    CreateThread(function()
        while DoesEntityExist(partner) do
            local far = #(GetEntityCoords(partner) - GetEntityCoords(ped)) >= leave.removeDistance

            if far or IsPedFalling(partner) or GetGameTimer() >= deadline then
                FreezeEntityPosition(partner, true)
                DeleteEntity(partner)
                break
            end

            Wait(0)
        end
    end)
end

---@param ped number
local function settle(ped)
    local origin = staged.origin

    if not staged.idle or not origin then
        staged.anchor = nil
        return ClearPedTasks(ped)
    end

    local handle = CreateSynchronizedScene(origin.x, origin.y, origin.z, 0.0, 0.0, origin.w, 2)

    SetSynchronizedSceneLooped(handle, true)
    TaskSynchronizedScene(ped, handle, staged.dict, staged.idle, SETTLE_BLEND, -4.0, 1, 16, 1000.0, 0)
    staged.handle = handle
    staged.anchor = handle
end

---@param ped number
---@param bed { scene: table, origin: vector4 }
---@return integer
local function leaveBed(ped, bed)
    local scene, origin = bed.scene, bed.origin
    local exit = scene.exits[math.random(#scene.exits)]
    local handle = CreateSynchronizedScene(origin.x, origin.y, origin.z, 0.0, 0.0, origin.w, 2)

    SetSynchronizedSceneHoldLastFrame(handle, true)
    TaskSynchronizedScene(ped, handle, scene.dict, exit.player, EXIT_BLEND, -4.0, 1, 16, 1000.0, 0)

    if staged.partner and DoesEntityExist(staged.partner) then
        TaskSynchronizedScene(staged.partner, handle, scene.dict, exit.partner, EXIT_BLEND, -4.0, 1, 16, 1000.0, 0)
    end

    staged.handle = handle
    staged.anchor = handle
    camera.follow(ped, HEAD_BONE, not scene.camera.focus and scene.camera.shift or 0.0)

    return math.floor(GetAnimDuration(scene.dict, exit.player) * 1000)
end

---@param ped number
---@return integer waitMs
local function leaveStage(ped)
    utils.deleteAll(staged.props)

    if staged.bed then
        return leaveBed(ped, staged.bed)
    end

    local partner = staged.partner

    staged.partner = nil

    if partner and DoesEntityExist(partner) then
        walkAway(ped, partner)
        ClearPedTasks(ped)
        staged.anchor = nil

        return selection.partnerLeave.waitMs
    end

    settle(ped)

    return 0
end

---@return boolean
local function holdStage()
    local handle = staged.anchor

    if not handle or not IsSynchronizedSceneRunning(handle) then return false end

    SetSynchronizedSceneRate(handle, 0.0)

    return true
end

---@param character table
---@param duo boolean
---@return vector4
local function spotFor(character, duo)
    local spot = spots[character.citizenid]

    if spot and spot.duo == duo then return spot.coords end

    local pool = duo and selection.duo or selection.solo
    local coords = pool[math.random(#pool)]

    spots[character.citizenid] = { duo = duo, coords = coords }

    return coords
end

---@param ped number
---@param coords vector4
local function stageDrinking(ped, coords)
    local drinking = selection.drinking

    if not utils.loadAnimDict(drinking.dict) then return end

    staged.dict = drinking.dict

    local origin = vec4(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z - 0.95, drinking.rotation)
    local handle = CreateSynchronizedScene(origin.x, origin.y, origin.z, 0.0, 0.0, origin.w, 2)

    SetSynchronizedSceneLooped(handle, true)
    TaskSynchronizedScene(ped, handle, drinking.dict, drinking.clip, STAGE_BLEND, -4.0, 1, 16, 1000.0, 0)
    staged.origin = origin
    staged.idle = drinking.idle

    for i = 1, #drinking.props do
        local prop = drinking.props[i]
        local object = utils.createObject(prop.model, coords, PROP_TIMEOUT)

        if object then
            staged.props[#staged.props + 1] = object
            PlaySynchronizedEntityAnim(object, handle, prop.clip, drinking.dict, 1000.0, -4.0, 0, 1000.0)
        end
    end

    staged.handle = handle
end

---@param partner table
---@return { bed?: table, anim?: table }?
local function coupleScene(partner)
    waitSkin(partner.citizenid, SKIN_TIMEOUT)

    local beds = selection.bedroom
    local bed = selection.duoScene[partner.type] == 'bedroom' and beds[math.random(#beds)] or nil
    local anims = selection.couple[partner.type]
    local anim = not bed and anims[math.random(#anims)] or nil
    local dict = bed and bed.dict or anim.dict
    local skin = skinFor(partner.citizenid, partner.gender)

    if not utils.loadAnimDict(dict) then return end

    if not utils.loadModel(skin.model, PARTNER_TIMEOUT) then
        RemoveAnimDict(dict)
        return
    end

    return { bed = bed, anim = anim }
end

---@param ped number
---@param coords vector4
---@param partner table
---@param anim table
local function stageCouple(ped, coords, partner, anim)
    local skin = skinFor(partner.citizenid, partner.gender)
    local z, heading, own, other = coords.z, coords.w, nil, nil

    if partner.type == 'bff' then
        z = coords.z - 1.0
        heading = coords.w + 90.0
        own = anim.left
        other = anim.right
    else
        local female = GetEntityModel(ped) == FEMALE

        own = female and anim.female or anim.male
        other = female and anim.male or anim.female
    end

    staged.dict = anim.dict

    local partnerPed = utils.createPed(skin.model, coords, PARTNER_TIMEOUT)
    local handle = CreateSynchronizedScene(coords.x, coords.y, z, 0.0, 0.0, heading, 2)

    SetSynchronizedSceneLooped(handle, true)
    TaskSynchronizedScene(ped, handle, anim.dict, own, STAGE_BLEND, LEAVE_BLEND, 1, 16, 1000.0, 0)
    staged.handle = handle

    if not partnerPed then return end

    utils.applyPed(partnerPed, skin)
    staged.partner = partnerPed
    TaskSynchronizedScene(partnerPed, handle, anim.dict, other, STAGE_BLEND, LEAVE_BLEND, 1, 16, 1000.0, 0)
end

---@param ped number
---@param bed table
---@param partner table
local function stageBed(ped, bed, partner)
    local skin = skinFor(partner.citizenid, partner.gender)
    local origin = vec4(bed.coords.x, bed.coords.y, bed.coords.z + bed.deltaZ, bed.coords.w)

    staged.dict = bed.dict

    local partnerPed = utils.createPed(skin.model, bed.coords, PARTNER_TIMEOUT)
    local handle = CreateSynchronizedScene(origin.x, origin.y, origin.z, 0.0, 0.0, origin.w, 2)

    SetSynchronizedSceneLooped(handle, true)
    TaskSynchronizedScene(ped, handle, bed.dict, bed.idle.player, STAGE_BLEND, -4.0, 1, 16, 1000.0, 0)
    staged.handle = handle
    staged.bed = { scene = bed, origin = origin }

    if not partnerPed then return end

    utils.applyPed(partnerPed, skin)
    staged.partner = partnerPed
    TaskSynchronizedScene(partnerPed, handle, bed.dict, bed.idle.partner, STAGE_BLEND, -4.0, 1, 16, 1000.0, 0)
end

---@param ped number
---@param scene table
local function stageChild(ped, scene)
    local coords = scene.coords
    local found, ground = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z + 0.5, false)

    SetEntityCoords(ped, coords.x, coords.y, found and ground or coords.z - 1.0, false, false, false, false)
    SetEntityHeading(ped, coords.w)

    if not utils.loadAnimDict(scene.dict) then return end

    staged.dict = scene.dict
    TaskPlayAnim(ped, scene.dict, scene.clip, 5.0, 5.0, -1, scene.flag, 0.0, false, false, false)
end

---@param ped number
---@param anchor vector3
---@param heading number
---@param view table
---@return CameraFocus
local function sceneView(ped, anchor, heading, view)
    local position, focus = view.position, view.focus
    local eye = GetOffsetFromCoordAndHeadingInWorldCoords(anchor.x, anchor.y, anchor.z, heading, position.x, position.y, position.z)
    local target = focus and GetOffsetFromCoordAndHeadingInWorldCoords(anchor.x, anchor.y, anchor.z, heading, focus.x, focus.y, focus.z)
        or camera.aside(eye, GetPedBoneCoords(ped, HEAD_BONE, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), view.shift or 0.0)

    staged.view = { config = view, anchor = anchor, heading = heading, label = 'camera' }

    return {
        position = eye,
        target = target,
        fov = view.fov,
        dof = { near = 0.5, far = 4.0 },
    }
end

---@param ped number
---@return vector3
local function anchorOf(ped)
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local partner = staged.partner

    if partner and DoesEntityExist(partner) then
        return (coords + GetEntityCoords(partner)) / 2
    end

    return coords
end

---@param spot vector4
---@param anchor vector3
---@param duo boolean
---@return CameraFocus
local function viewFor(spot, anchor, duo)
    local view = duo and selection.camera.duo or selection.camera.solo
    local position, focus = view.position, view.focus

    staged.view = { config = view, anchor = anchor, heading = spot.w, label = duo and 'duo' or 'solo' }

    return {
        position = GetOffsetFromCoordAndHeadingInWorldCoords(anchor.x, anchor.y, anchor.z, spot.w, position.x, position.y, position.z),
        target = GetOffsetFromCoordAndHeadingInWorldCoords(anchor.x, anchor.y, anchor.z, spot.w, focus.x, focus.y, focus.z),
        fov = view.fov,
        dof = { near = 0.5, far = 4.0 },
    }
end

---@param model string|number
local function requestModel(model)
    local hash = type(model) == 'string' and joaat(model) or model

    if IsModelInCdimage(hash) then
        RequestModel(hash)
    end
end

---@param character table
---@param child table?
---@param partner table?
local function prefetch(character, child, partner)
    requestModel(skinFor(character.citizenid, character.gender).model)

    if child then
        RequestAnimDict(child.dict)
        return
    end

    if not partner then
        local drinking = selection.drinking

        RequestAnimDict(drinking.dict)

        for i = 1, #drinking.props do
            requestModel(drinking.props[i].model)
        end

        return
    end

    if waitSkin(partner.citizenid, SKIN_TIMEOUT) then
        requestModel(skinFor(partner.citizenid, partner.gender).model)
    end

    local scenes = selection.duoScene[partner.type] == 'bedroom' and selection.bedroom or selection.couple[partner.type]

    for i = 1, #scenes do
        RequestAnimDict(scenes[i].dict)
    end
end

---@param character table
---@return CameraFocus
local function buildPreview(character)
    clearStage()

    if not waitSkin(character.citizenid, SKIN_TIMEOUT) then
        lib.print.warn(('memuat karakter: skin %s belum diterima, pakai default'):format(character.citizenid))
    end

    local child = character.child and selection.child or nil
    local partner = not child and character.partner or nil

    if partner?.child then
        partner = nil
    end

    local began = GetGameTimer()

    prefetch(character, child, partner)

    local ped = utils.applyPlayer(skinFor(character.citizenid, character.gender), character.gender)
    local modelAt = GetGameTimer()
    local scene = partner and coupleScene(partner)
    local partnerAt = GetGameTimer()
    local bed = scene and scene.bed
    local spot = child and child.coords or bed and bed.coords or spotFor(character, scene ~= nil)

    utils.teleport(ped, spot, true)
    ResetEntityAlpha(ped)
    SetEntityVisible(ped, true, false)

    local placedAt = GetGameTimer()

    if child then
        stageChild(ped, child)
    elseif bed then
        stageBed(ped, bed, partner)
    elseif scene then
        stageCouple(ped, spot, partner, scene.anim)
    else
        stageDrinking(ped, spot)
    end

    lib.print.info(('memuat karakter: model %d ms (%s), pasangan %d ms, lokasi %d ms, pose %d ms'):format(modelAt - began, tostring(skinFor(character.citizenid, character.gender).model), partnerAt - modelAt, placedAt - partnerAt, GetGameTimer() - placedAt))
    Wait(250)

    if child then
        return sceneView(ped, GetEntityCoords(ped), child.coords.w, child.camera)
    elseif bed then
        return sceneView(ped, bed.coords.xyz, bed.coords.w, bed.camera)
    end

    return viewFor(spot, anchorOf(ped), scene ~= nil)
end

---@param build fun(...): CameraFocus
---@param ... any
---@return CameraFocus
local function safely(build, ...)
    local ok, view = pcall(build, ...)

    if ok then return view end

    lib.print.error(('gagal menyiapkan scene: %s'):format(view))

    local spot = selection.solo[1]

    return viewFor(spot, spot.xyz, false)
end

---@param index integer
local function preview(index)
    local character = state.characters[index]
    if not character then return end

    state.index = index
    state.registering = false

    utils.fadeOut(250)
    camera.focus(safely(buildPreview, character))
    utils.fadeIn(400)
end

---@return vector4
local function registerSpot()
    local character = state.characters[state.index]
    local spot = character and spots[character.citizenid]

    if spot and not spot.duo then return spot.coords end

    return selection.solo[math.random(#selection.solo)]
end

---@return CameraFocus
local function buildRegister()
    state.registering = true

    clearStage()

    local spot = registerSpot()
    local placeholder = selection.placeholder
    local player = PlayerPedId()

    utils.teleport(player, spot, true)
    SetEntityVisible(player, false, false)

    local ped = utils.createPed(placeholder.models[math.random(#placeholder.models)], spot)
    local anchor = player

    if ped and DoesEntityExist(ped) then
        SetEntityAlpha(ped, placeholder.alpha, false)
        SetEntityNoCollisionEntity(ped, player, false)
        staged.placeholder = ped
        stageDrinking(ped, spot)
        anchor = ped
        Wait(250)
    end

    return viewFor(spot, GetEntityCoords(anchor), false)
end

local function stageRegister()
    utils.fadeOut(250)
    camera.focus(safely(buildRegister))
    utils.fadeIn(800)
end

---@param citizenid string
local function refreshIfCurrent(citizenid)
    local character = state.characters[state.index]

    if state.active and not state.registering and not state.busy and character?.citizenid == citizenid then
        state.busy = true
        preview(state.index)
        state.busy = false
    end
end

---@return table|false
function select.load()
    received = nil
    table.wipe(skins)
    table.wipe(decoded)

    local began = GetGameTimer()

    TriggerServerEvent('sm_characters:server:fetch')

    local payload = net.awaitPush(function() return received end, FETCH_TIMEOUT)

    if not payload then
        lib.print.warn(('memuat karakter: data %s (%d ms)'):format(payload == false and 'ditolak server' or 'tidak diterima', GetGameTimer() - began))
        return false
    end

    lib.print.info(('memuat karakter: data diterima (%d ms)'):format(GetGameTimer() - began))

    return payload
end

local function settleWorld()
    local ped = PlayerPedId()
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)

    pcall(lib.waitFor, function()
        RequestCollisionAtCoord(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)

        return HasCollisionLoadedAroundEntity(ped) or nil
    end, nil, SETTLE_TIMEOUT)
end

---@param payload table
---@return CameraFocus
function select.prepare(payload)
    local began = GetGameTimer()

    state.active = true
    state.busy = true
    state.characters = payload.characters
    state.incoming = payload.incoming
    state.outgoing = payload.outgoing
    state.slots = payload.slots
    state.canDelete = payload.canDelete
    state.index = 1
    state.registering = false

    table.wipe(spots)

    local view = #state.characters == 0 and safely(buildRegister) or safely(buildPreview, state.characters[1])

    lib.print.info(('memuat karakter: scene siap (%d ms)'):format(GetGameTimer() - began))

    return view
end

---@param view CameraFocus
function select.show(view)
    settleWorld()
    spawn.preload()
    world.lock(selection.hour, selection.minute, selection.weather)
    camera.focus(view)
    utils.fadeIn(1200)

    state.busy = false
    nui.send('select', snapshot())
    nui.focus(true)
end

---@param keepStage? boolean
function select.close(keepStage)
    state.active = false

    if not keepStage then
        clearStage()
    end

    nui.send('hide')
    nui.focus(false)
end

---@return boolean
function select.isActive()
    return state.active
end

---@return { config: table, anchor: vector3, heading: number, label: string }?
function select.view()
    return state.active and staged.view or nil
end

---@param kind string
---@param payload table
function select.sync(kind, payload)
    if not state.active then return end

    if kind == 'incoming' then
        state.incoming[#state.incoming + 1] = payload
    elseif kind == 'incomingRemoved' then
        removeWhere(state.incoming, function(item) return item.id == payload.id end)
    elseif kind == 'outgoingRemoved' then
        removeWhere(state.outgoing, function(item) return item.id == payload.id end)
    elseif kind == 'linked' then
        local character = findCharacter(payload.citizenid)

        if character then
            character.partner = payload.partner
            removeWhere(state.outgoing, function(item) return item.sender == payload.citizenid end)
        end
    elseif kind == 'unlinked' then
        local character = findCharacter(payload.citizenid)

        if character then
            character.partner = nil
        end
    end

    pushUpdate()

    if kind == 'linked' or kind == 'unlinked' then
        refreshIfCurrent(payload.citizenid)
    end
end

RegisterNUICallback('preview', function(data, cb)
    local index = math.tointeger(data?.index)

    if not state.active or state.busy or not index or not state.characters[index] then
        return cb(false)
    end

    state.busy = true
    preview(index)
    state.busy = false
    cb(true)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('register', function(data, cb)
    if not state.active or state.busy then return cb(false) end

    state.busy = true

    if data?.open then
        stageRegister()
    elseif #state.characters > 0 then
        preview(state.index)
    end

    state.busy = false
    cb(true)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('create', function(data, cb)
    if not state.active or state.busy or type(data) ~= 'table' then return cb({ error = 'invalid' }) end

    state.busy = true

    local result = lib.callback.await('sm_characters:create', false, {
        firstname = data.firstname,
        lastname = data.lastname,
        birthdate = data.birthdate,
        gender = data.gender,
        nationality = data.nationality,
    })

    if not result?.coords then
        state.busy = false
        return cb({ error = result?.error or 'failed' })
    end

    cb({ ok = true })

    local gender = data.gender == 'female' and 'female' or 'male'

    select.close(true)
    utils.fadeOut(500)
    clearStage()
    utils.applyPlayer(utils.defaultAppearance(gender), gender)
    spawn.newCharacter(result.coords, gender)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('play', function(data, cb)
    local character = state.active and not state.busy and findCharacter(data?.citizenid)
    if not character then return cb(false) end

    state.busy = true

    local list = lib.callback.await('sm_characters:select', false, character.citizenid)

    if not list then
        state.busy = false
        return cb(false)
    end

    cb(true)
    select.close(true)

    local waitMs = leaveStage(PlayerPedId())

    if waitMs > 0 then
        Wait(waitMs)
    end

    local info = { name = ('%s %s'):format(character.firstname, character.lastname), child = character.child }

    spawn.phone(list, info, clearStage, holdStage)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('delete', function(data, cb)
    local character, index = findCharacter(data?.citizenid)
    if not state.active or state.busy or not character or not state.canDelete then return cb(false) end

    state.busy = true

    local ok = lib.callback.await('sm_characters:delete', false, character.citizenid)

    if ok then
        table.remove(state.characters, index)
        spots[character.citizenid] = nil

        if #state.characters == 0 then
            stageRegister()
        else
            preview(1)
        end

        pushUpdate()
    end

    state.busy = false
    cb(ok == true)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('invite', function(data, cb)
    if not state.active or type(data) ~= 'table' then return cb({ error = 'invalid' }) end

    local result = lib.callback.await('sm_characters:partner:invite', false, data.from, data.target, data.type)

    if result?.invite then
        state.outgoing[#state.outgoing + 1] = result.invite
        pushUpdate()
    end

    cb(result or { error = 'failed' })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('inviteRespond', function(data, cb)
    local id = math.tointeger(data?.id)
    if not id then return cb({ error = 'invalid' }) end

    local result = lib.callback.await('sm_characters:partner:respond', false, id, data.accept == true)

    if result?.ok and state.active then
        removeWhere(state.incoming, function(item) return item.id == id end)

        local character = result.partner and findCharacter(result.citizenid)

        if character then
            character.partner = result.partner

            removeWhere(state.incoming, function(item)
                return item.target == result.citizenid or item.sender == result.partner.citizenid
            end)

            removeWhere(state.outgoing, function(item) return item.sender == result.citizenid end)
        end

        pushUpdate()

        if character then
            refreshIfCurrent(result.citizenid)
        end
    end

    cb(result or { error = 'failed' })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('inviteCancel', function(data, cb)
    local id = math.tointeger(data?.id)
    if not state.active or not id then return cb(false) end

    local ok = lib.callback.await('sm_characters:partner:cancel', false, id)

    if ok then
        removeWhere(state.outgoing, function(item) return item.id == id end)
        pushUpdate()
    end

    cb(ok == true)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('partnerRemove', function(data, cb)
    local character = state.active and findCharacter(data?.citizenid)
    if not character then return cb(false) end

    local ok = lib.callback.await('sm_characters:partner:remove', false, character.citizenid)

    if ok then
        character.partner = nil
        pushUpdate()
        refreshIfCurrent(character.citizenid)
    end

    cb(ok == true)
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource then return end

    clearStage()
    camera.destroy(0)
end)


return select


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_character\client\spawn.lua
local config = require 'config.client'
local camera = require 'modules.client.camera'
local utils = require 'modules.client.utils'
local world = require 'modules.client.world'
local nui = require 'modules.client.nui'
local phone = require 'client.phone'

local PRESPAWN_MS <const> = 2000
local SETTLE_MS <const> = 500
local APPEARANCE_START_TIMEOUT <const> = 4000
local APPEARANCE_DONE_TIMEOUT <const> = 15000
local APPEARANCE_SETTLE_MS <const> = 300
local RELEASE_KEY <const> = 38
local SPAWN_LIFT <const> = 1.0

local spawn = {}

---@class SpawnInfo
---@field name string
---@field child? boolean

---@type SpawnInfo?
local current
---@type fun()?
local cleanup
---@type table[]
local locations = {}
local busy = false

---@param coords vector4
---@return vector4
local function lifted(coords)
    return vec4(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z + SPAWN_LIFT, coords.w)
end

---@param ped number
local function reveal(ped)
    camera.destroy(0)
    world.unlock()
    ClearPedTasksImmediately(ped)
    SetEntityVisible(ped, true, false)

    Wait(SETTLE_MS)
    utils.fadeIn(1000)
end

---@param ped number
local function release(ped)
    NetworkEndTutorialSession()
    FreezeEntityPosition(ped, false)

    TriggerServerEvent('sm_characters:server:spawned')
    TriggerServerEvent('QBCore:Server:OnPlayerLoaded')
    TriggerEvent('QBCore:Client:OnPlayerLoaded')

    current = nil
    cleanup = nil
    busy = false
end

local function waitAppearance()
    local state = LocalPlayer.state

    local started = pcall(lib.waitFor, function()
        return state.hide_itemattach == true or nil
    end, nil, APPEARANCE_START_TIMEOUT)

    if started then
        pcall(lib.waitFor, function()
            return state.hide_itemattach ~= true or nil
        end, nil, APPEARANCE_DONE_TIMEOUT)
    end

    Wait(APPEARANCE_SETTLE_MS)
end

local function waitRelease()
    lib.showTextUI('[E] Mulai bermain')

    while not IsControlJustPressed(0, RELEASE_KEY) do
        Wait(0)
    end

    lib.hideTextUI()
end

---@param isNew boolean
local function complete(isNew)
    pcall(lib.waitFor, function()
        return LocalPlayer.state.isLoggedIn or nil
    end, nil, 15000)

    DisplayRadar(true)
    config.hud.show()

    TriggerEvent('rhd_spawn:client:onSpawn', isNew)
    TriggerServerEvent('rhd_spawn:server:onSpawn', isNew)
end

---@param location { label: string, coords: vector4, freezeControl?: boolean }
local function arrive(location)
    utils.fadeOut(500)
    phone.close(true)

    if cleanup then
        cleanup()
    end

    camera.destroy(0)
    Wait(PRESPAWN_MS)

    local ped = PlayerPedId()

    utils.teleport(ped, lifted(location.coords))
    reveal(ped)

    nui.send('arrival', { label = location.label, duration = config.spawn.arrivalTitleMs })
    Wait(config.spawn.arrivalTitleMs + 600)

    if location.freezeControl then
        waitRelease()
    end

    release(ped)
    waitAppearance()
    complete(false)
end

---@param id string
local function onPick(id)
    if busy then return end

    busy = true

    local location = lib.callback.await('sm_characters:spawn', false, id)

    if not location then
        busy = false
        lib.notify({ description = 'Lokasi tidak valid, coba pilih lagi.', type = 'error' })
        phone.rerender(locations, { name = current?.name })
        return
    end

    arrive(location)
end

function spawn.preload()
    phone.preload()
end

---@param list table[]
---@param info SpawnInfo
---@param onArrive? fun()
---@param onHold? fun(): boolean
function spawn.phone(list, info, onArrive, onHold)
    current = info
    cleanup = onArrive
    locations = list
    busy = false
    phone.open(list, { name = info.name }, onPick, { child = info.child, steady = onHold })
end

---@param coords vector4
---@param gender 'male'|'female'
function spawn.newCharacter(coords, gender)
    utils.fadeOut(500)
    camera.destroy(0)
    Wait(PRESPAWN_MS)

    local ped = PlayerPedId()

    utils.teleport(ped, lifted(coords))
    reveal(ped)
    release(ped)

    local completed = false

    local function finished()
        if completed then return end

        completed = true

        CreateThread(function()
            complete(true)
        end)
    end

    exports.sm_appearance:createCharacter(gender, finished, finished)
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_characters:client:forceSpawn', function(location)
    if GetInvokingResource() or not phone.isOpen() or busy then return end

    busy = true
    arrive(location)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_characters:client:rerender', function(list)
    if GetInvokingResource() or not current then return end

    locations = list
    phone.render(list, { name = current.name })
end)

return spawn

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_character\modules\net.lua
local Net = {}

---@param event string
---@param player number
---@param ... any
function Net.emitLatentClient(event, player, ...)
    local payload = msgpack.pack_args(...)
    local payloadLen = #payload
    local bps = payloadLen + 1000
    TriggerLatentClientEventInternal(event, player --[[@as string]], payload, payloadLen, bps)
end

---@generic T
---@param get fun(): T?
---@param timeout number?
---@return T?
function Net.awaitPush(get, timeout)
    local value = get()

    if value ~= nil then return value end

    local deadline = GetGameTimer() + (timeout or 5000)

    repeat
        Wait(0)
        value = get()
    until value ~= nil or GetGameTimer() > deadline

    return value
end

return Net


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_character\modules\client\camera.lua
local camera = {}

local FOLLOW_FLAGS <const> = 17
local FOLLOW_MARGIN <const> = 0.25
local FOLLOW_RECENTER_MS <const> = 2000
local DEFAULT_DOF <const> = { near = 0.5, far = 2.0 }

---@class CameraView
---@field position vector3
---@field target vector3
---@field fov number
---@field dof { near: number, far: number }|false

---@type number?
local active
---@type CameraView?
local view
local token = 0

---@param t number
---@return number
local function smooth(t)
    if t >= 1.0 then return 1.0 end

    return t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t)
end

---@param from vector3
---@param first vector3
---@param second vector3
---@param to vector3
---@param t number
---@return vector3
local function bezier(from, first, second, to, t)
    local u = 1.0 - t

    return from * (u * u * u) + first * (3.0 * u * u * t) + second * (3.0 * u * t * t) + to * (t * t * t)
end

---@param position vector3
---@param fov number
---@return number
local function create(position, fov)
    return CreateCamWithParams('DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA', position.x, position.y, position.z, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, fov, false, 2)
end

---@param cam number
---@param easeMs number
local function activate(cam, easeMs)
    local previous = active

    active = cam
    token += 1

    if previous and DoesCamExist(previous) and easeMs > 0 then
        SetCamActiveWithInterp(cam, previous, easeMs, 1, 1)
        SetTimeout(easeMs + 100, function()
            DestroyCam(previous, false)
        end)
    else
        SetCamActive(cam, true)
        RenderScriptCams(true, false, 0, true, false)

        if previous then
            DestroyCam(previous, false)
        end
    end

    return token
end

---@class CameraFocus
---@field position vector3
---@field target vector3
---@field fov number
---@field dof? { near: number, far: number }|false
---@field easeMs? number

---@param data CameraFocus
---@return promise
function camera.focus(data)
    local done = promise.new()
    local cam = create(data.position, data.fov)
    local dof = data.dof ~= false and (data.dof or DEFAULT_DOF) or false

    PointCamAtCoord(cam, data.target.x, data.target.y, data.target.z)

    if dof then
        SetCamUseShallowDofMode(cam, true)
        SetCamNearDof(cam, dof.near)
        SetCamFarDof(cam, dof.far)
        SetCamDofStrength(cam, 1.0)
    end

    local id = activate(cam, data.easeMs or 0)

    view = { position = data.position, target = data.target, fov = data.fov, dof = dof }
    done:resolve(true)

    if dof then
        CreateThread(function()
            while id == token and DoesCamExist(cam) do
                SetUseHiDof()
                Wait(0)
            end
        end)
    end

    return done
end

---@param data CameraFocus
---@param durationMs integer
---@param via? { [1]: vector3, [2]: vector3 }
function camera.glide(data, durationMs, via)
    local cam, from = active, view

    if not cam or not DoesCamExist(cam) or not from or durationMs <= 0 then
        camera.focus(data)
        return
    end

    token += 1

    local id = token
    local dof = data.dof ~= false and (data.dof or DEFAULT_DOF) or false
    local fromDof = from.dof or dof
    local began = GetGameTimer()

    view = { position = data.position, target = data.target, fov = data.fov, dof = dof }

    if dof then
        SetCamUseShallowDofMode(cam, true)
        SetCamDofStrength(cam, 1.0)
    end

    CreateThread(function()
        while id == token and DoesCamExist(cam) do
            local t = smooth(math.min(1.0, (GetGameTimer() - began) / durationMs))
            local position = via and bezier(from.position, via[1], via[2], data.position, t) or from.position + (data.position - from.position) * t
            local target = from.target + (data.target - from.target) * t

            SetCamCoord(cam, position.x, position.y, position.z)
            PointCamAtCoord(cam, target.x, target.y, target.z)
            SetCamFov(cam, from.fov + (data.fov - from.fov) * t)

            if dof and fromDof then
                SetCamNearDof(cam, fromDof.near + (dof.near - fromDof.near) * t)
                SetCamFarDof(cam, fromDof.far + (dof.far - fromDof.far) * t)
                SetUseHiDof()
            end

            Wait(0)
        end
    end)
end

---@return CameraView?
function camera.view()
    return view
end

---@param from vector3
---@param point vector3
---@param amount number
---@return vector3
function camera.aside(from, point, amount)
    local direction = point - from
    local length = math.sqrt(direction.x * direction.x + direction.y * direction.y)

    if amount == 0.0 or length < 0.001 then return point end

    return point - vec3(direction.y / length, -direction.x / length, 0.0) * amount
end

---@param from vector3
---@param to vector3
---@param ignore number
---@return vector3
local function reachable(from, to, ignore)
    local path = to - from
    local length = #path

    if length < 0.001 then return to end

    local direction = path / length
    local reach = to + direction * FOLLOW_MARGIN
    local probe = StartExpensiveSynchronousShapeTestLosProbe(from.x, from.y, from.z, reach.x, reach.y, reach.z, FOLLOW_FLAGS, ignore, 4)
    local _, hit, coords = GetShapeTestResult(probe)

    if hit ~= true and hit ~= 1 then return to end

    local free = #(coords - from) - FOLLOW_MARGIN

    return free > 0.0 and from + direction * math.min(free, length) or from
end

---@param from vector3
---@param point vector3
---@param angle number
---@return vector3
local function turned(from, point, angle)
    local direction = point - from
    local cos, sin = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)

    return from + vec3(direction.x * cos - direction.y * sin, direction.x * sin + direction.y * cos, direction.z)
end

---@param ped number
---@param bone integer
---@param shift? number
function camera.follow(ped, bone, shift)
    local cam = active
    if not cam then return end

    token += 1

    local id = token

    CreateThread(function()
        local position = GetCamCoord(cam)
        local offset = position - GetEntityCoords(ped)
        local target = GetPedBoneCoords(ped, bone, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
        local flat = target - position
        local angle = math.atan(shift or 0.0, math.sqrt(flat.x * flat.x + flat.y * flat.y))
        local began = GetGameTimer()

        while id == token and DoesCamExist(cam) and DoesEntityExist(ped) do
            local frame = GetFrameTime()
            local desired = reachable(position, GetEntityCoords(ped) + offset, ped)
            local recenter = smooth(math.min(1.0, (GetGameTimer() - began) / FOLLOW_RECENTER_MS))

            position = position + (desired - position) * math.min(1.0, frame * 1.5)
            target = target + (GetPedBoneCoords(ped, bone, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0) - target) * math.min(1.0, frame * 3.0)

            local aim = turned(position, target, angle * (1.0 - recenter))

            if view then
                view.position = position
                view.target = aim
            end

            SetCamCoord(cam, position.x, position.y, position.z)
            PointCamAtCoord(cam, aim.x, aim.y, aim.z)
            SetUseHiDof()
            Wait(0)
        end
    end)
end

---@param easeMs? number
function camera.destroy(easeMs)
    token += 1
    view = nil

    if not active then return end

    RenderScriptCams(false, (easeMs or 0) > 0, easeMs or 0, true, false)
    DestroyCam(active, false)
    active = nil
end

---@return number?
function camera.handle()
    return active
end

return camera

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_character\modules\client\utils.lua
local default = require 'data.default'

local appearance = exports.sm_appearance

local utils = {}

local sin, cos, rad = math.sin, math.cos, math.rad

local MODEL_TIMEOUT <const> = 30000
local PLAYER_TIMEOUT <const> = 300000
local ANIM_TIMEOUT <const> = 30000
local FADE_GRACE <const> = 1000
local WORLD_TIMEOUT <const> = 5000
local COLLISION_TIMEOUT <const> = 15000

---@param ms number
function utils.fadeOut(ms)
    if IsScreenFadedOut() then return end

    DoScreenFadeOut(ms)

    local deadline = GetGameTimer() + ms + FADE_GRACE

    while not IsScreenFadedOut() and GetGameTimer() < deadline do
        Wait(0)
    end
end

---@param model number|string
---@param timeout? number
---@return number?
function utils.loadModel(model, timeout)
    local ok, result = pcall(lib.requestModel, model, timeout or MODEL_TIMEOUT)

    if ok then return result end

    lib.print.warn(result)
end

---@param dict string
---@param timeout? number
---@return boolean
function utils.loadAnimDict(dict, timeout)
    local ok, result = pcall(lib.requestAnimDict, dict, timeout or ANIM_TIMEOUT)

    if not ok then
        lib.print.warn(result)
    end

    return ok
end

---@param ms number
function utils.fadeIn(ms)
    DoScreenFadeIn(ms)
end

---@param coords vector4
---@param offset vector3
---@return vector3
function utils.offsetToWorld(coords, offset)
    local angle = rad(coords.w)

    return vec3(
        coords.x + cos(angle) * offset.x - sin(angle) * offset.y,
        coords.y + sin(angle) * offset.x + cos(angle) * offset.y,
        coords.z + offset.z
    )
end

---@param ped number
---@param coords vector4
local function waitWorld(ped, coords)
    local timeout = GetGameTimer() + WORLD_TIMEOUT

    while not HasCollisionLoadedAroundEntity(ped) and GetGameTimer() < timeout do
        RequestCollisionAtCoord(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)
        Wait(0)
    end

    if not HasCollisionLoadedAroundEntity(ped) then
        lib.print.warn(('lokasi: collision belum termuat setelah %d ms'):format(WORLD_TIMEOUT))
    end

    local interior = GetInteriorAtCoords(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)

    if interior == 0 then return end

    timeout = GetGameTimer() + WORLD_TIMEOUT
    PinInteriorInMemory(interior)

    while not IsInteriorReady(interior) and GetGameTimer() < timeout do
        Wait(0)
    end
end

---@param ped number
local function waitCollision(ped)
    local ok = pcall(lib.waitFor, function()
        return HasCollisionLoadedAroundEntity(ped) or nil
    end, nil, COLLISION_TIMEOUT)

    if not ok then
        lib.print.warn(('collision belum termuat setelah %d ms'):format(COLLISION_TIMEOUT))
    end
end

---@param ped number
---@param coords vector4
---@param waitScene? boolean
function utils.teleport(ped, coords, waitScene)
    FreezeEntityPosition(ped, true)
    SetFocusPosAndVel(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(ped, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false)
    SetEntityHeading(ped, coords.w)
    RequestCollisionAtCoord(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)

    if waitScene then
        waitWorld(ped, coords)
    else
        waitCollision(ped)
    end

    ClearFocus()
end

---@param raw string|false|nil
---@return table?
function utils.decodeSkin(raw)
    if type(raw) ~= 'string' then return end

    local ok, skin = pcall(json.decode, raw)
    if not ok or type(skin) ~= 'table' or not skin.model then return end

    return skin
end

---@param gender 'male'|'female'
---@return table

    return default.appearance[gender == 'female' and 2 or 1]
end

---@param skin table

    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        appearance:applyAppearance(ped, skin)
    end)

    if not ok then
        lib.print.warn(('gagal menerapkan appearance: %s'):format(result))
    end
end

---@param skin table
---@param gender? 'male'|'female'
---@return number ped
function utils.applyPlayer(skin, gender)
    local model = utils.loadModel(skin.model, PLAYER_TIMEOUT)

    if not model and gender then
        skin = utils.defaultAppearance(gender)
        model = utils.loadModel(skin.model, PLAYER_TIMEOUT)
    end

    if not model then return PlayerPedId() end

    SetPlayerModel(cache.playerId, model)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)

    local ped = PlayerPedId()

    SetPedDefaultComponentVariation(ped)
    utils.applyPed(ped, skin)

    return ped
end

---@param model number|string
---@param coords vector4
---@param timeout? number
---@return number?
function utils.createPed(model, coords, timeout)
    local hash = utils.loadModel(model, timeout)
    if not hash then return end

    local ped = CreatePed(4, hash, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, coords.w, false, false)

    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(hash)

    if ped == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(ped) then return end

    SetEntityInvincible(ped, true)
    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(ped, true)
    SetPedDefaultComponentVariation(ped)

    return ped
end

---@param model number|string
---@param coords vector3|vector4
---@param timeout? number
---@return number?
function utils.createObject(model, coords, timeout)
    local hash = utils.loadModel(model, timeout)
    if not hash then return end

    local object = CreateObject(hash, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false)

    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(hash)

    if object == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(object) then return end

    SetEntityCollision(object, false, false)

    return object
end

---@param entities number[]
function utils.deleteAll(entities)
    for i = #entities, 1, -1 do
        local entity = entities[i]

        if DoesEntityExist(entity) then
            DeleteEntity(entity)
        end

        entities[i] = nil
    end
end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_character\modules\client\world.lua
local config = require 'config.client'

local world = {}

---@type { hour: integer, minute: integer, weather: string }?
local locked

---@param weather string
local function applyWeather(weather)
    ClearOverrideWeather()
    ClearWeatherTypePersist()
    SetWeatherTypePersist(weather)
    SetWeatherTypeNow(weather)
    SetWeatherTypeNowPersist(weather)
end

---@param hour integer
---@param minute integer
---@param weather string
function world.lock(hour, minute, weather)
    local running = locked ~= nil

    locked = { hour = hour, minute = minute, weather = weather }
    config.weatherSync(false, weather)
    applyWeather(weather)
    NetworkOverrideClockTime(hour, minute, 0)
    SetArtificialLightsState(false)

    if running then return end

    CreateThread(function()
        while locked do
            if config.weatherSync(false, locked.weather) then
                applyWeather(locked.weather)
            end

            NetworkOverrideClockTime(locked.hour, locked.minute, 0)
            SetArtificialLightsState(false)
            Wait(250)
        end
    end)
end

function world.unlock()
    if not locked then return end

    locked = nil
    NetworkClearClockTimeOverride()
    ClearWeatherTypePersist()
    SetArtificialLightsState(GlobalState.blackOut == true)
    config.weatherSync(true)
end

return world

local QBCore = exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject()

local SlotOverrides = {
    -- ['license:xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx'] = 8,
}

local function getSlots(license)
    local override = SlotOverrides[license]
    if override then return override end
    local convar = tonumber(GetConvar('sm_characters_slots', ''))
    return math.max(1, convar or DEFAULT_SLOTS)
end

local function notify(src, message, kind)
    TriggerClientEvent('sm_characters:client:notify', src, message, kind or 'error')
end

local function decode(value)
    if type(value) == 'table' then return value end
    if type(value) ~= 'string' or value == '' then return {} end
    local ok, result = pcall(json.decode, value)
    if ok and type(result) == 'table' then return result end
    return {}
end

local function getLicense(src)
    return QBCore.Functions.GetIdentifier(src, 'license') or GetPlayerIdentifierByType(src, 'license')
end

local function fullName(charinfo)
    if not charinfo then return 'Warga' end
    return ('%s %s'):format(charinfo.firstname or '', charinfo.lastname or ''):gsub('^%s*(.-)%s*$', '%1')
end

local function generatePhone()
    for _ = 1, 25 do
        local phone = ('%03d%04d'):format(math.random(100, 999), math.random(0, 9999))
        local taken = MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT citizenid FROM players WHERE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(charinfo, "$.phone")) = ?', { phone })
        if not taken then return phone end
    end
    return ('%03d%04d'):format(math.random(100, 999), math.random(0, 9999))
end

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Fetch daftar karakter
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function buildInvites(ids, byCitizen)
    local incoming, outgoing = {}, {}

    if #ids == 0 then return incoming, outgoing end

    local placeholders = {}
    for i = 1, #ids do placeholders[i] = '?' end
    placeholders = table.concat(placeholders, ',')

    local params = {}
    for i = 1, #ids do params[#params + 1] = ids[i] end
    for i = 1, #ids do params[#params + 1] = ids[i] end
    params[#params + 1] = os.time()

    local rows = MySQL.query.await(([[
        SELECT i.citizenid, i.target, i.expires,
               p1.charinfo AS frominfo, p2.charinfo AS toinfo
        FROM character_invites i
        LEFT JOIN players p1 ON p1.citizenid = i.citizenid
        LEFT JOIN players p2 ON p2.citizenid = i.target
        WHERE (i.citizenid IN (%s) OR i.target IN (%s)) AND i.expires > ?
    ]]):format(placeholders, placeholders), params) or {}

    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
        local mine = byCitizen[row.target]
        local theirs = byCitizen[row.citizenid]

        if mine then
            incoming[#incoming + 1] = {
                citizenid = row.citizenid,
                name = fullName(decode(row.frominfo)),
                expires = tonumber(row.expires) or 0,
            }
        end

        if theirs then
            outgoing[#outgoing + 1] = {
                citizenid = row.target,
                name = fullName(decode(row.toinfo)),
                expires = tonumber(row.expires) or 0,
            }
        end
    end

    return incoming, outgoing
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_characters:server:fetch', function()
    local src = source
    local license = getLicense(src)

    local payload = { characters = {}, incoming = {}, outgoing = {}, slots = 0, canDelete = false }

    if not license then
        TriggerClientEvent('sm_characters:client:characters', src, payload)
        TriggerClientEvent('sm_characters:client:skins', src, {})
        return
    end

    local slots = getSlots(license)
    local rows = MySQL.query.await('SELECT * FROM players WHERE license = ? ORDER BY id ASC', { license }) or {}

    local characters, ids, byCitizen = {}, {}, {}

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local row = rows[i]
        local entry = {}

        for key, value in pairs(row) do entry[key] = value end

        entry.charinfo = decode(row.charinfo)
        entry.money    = decode(row.money)
        entry.job      = decode(row.job)
        entry.gang     = decode(row.gang)
        entry.position = decode(row.position)
        entry.metadata = decode(row.metadata)

        entry.firstname   = entry.charinfo.firstname
        entry.lastname    = entry.charinfo.lastname
        entry.gender      = entry.charinfo.gender
        entry.birthdate   = entry.charinfo.birthdate
        entry.phone       = entry.charinfo.phone
        entry.nationality = entry.charinfo.nationality

        characters[#characters + 1] = entry
        ids[#ids + 1] = row.citizenid
        byCitizen[row.citizenid] = true
    end

    local skins = {}

    if #ids > 0 then
        local placeholders = {}
        for i = 1, #ids do placeholders[i] = '?' end

        local skinOk, skinRows = pcall(function()
            return MySQL.query.await(
                ('SELECT citizenid, skin FROM playerskins WHERE active = 1 AND citizenid IN (%s)'):format(table.concat(placeholders, ',')), ids) or {}
        end)
        if not skinOk then skinRows = {} end

        for _, row in ipairs(skinRows) do
            local skin = row.skin or row.appearance
            if not skin and row.model then skin = json.encode({ model = row.model }) end
            if skin then skins[row.citizenid] = skin end
        end
    end

    local incoming, outgoing = buildInvites(ids, byCitizen)

    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM character_invites WHERE expires < ?', { os.time() })

    payload.characters = characters
    payload.incoming = incoming
    payload.outgoing = outgoing
    payload.slots = slots
    payload.canDelete = #characters > 1

    TriggerClientEvent('sm_characters:client:skins', src, skins)
    TriggerClientEvent('sm_characters:client:characters', src, payload)
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Buat karakter
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function sanitizeName(value)
    if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil end
    value = value:gsub('^%s*(.-)%s*$', '%1')
    if #value < 2 or #value > 20 then return nil end
    if not value:match('^[%a][%a%s%-]*$') then return nil end
    return value
end

local MONTHS = {
    januari = 1, februari = 2, maret = 3, april = 4, mei = 5, juni = 6, juli = 7,
    agustus = 8, september = 9, oktober = 10, november = 11, desember = 12,
    jan = 1, feb = 2, mar = 3, apr = 4, jun = 6, jul = 7, agu = 8, ags = 8, sep = 9, okt = 10, nov = 11, des = 12,
    january = 1, february = 2, march = 3, may = 5, june = 6, july = 7, august = 8, october = 10, december = 12,
}

local function sanitizeBirthdate(value)
    if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil end
    value = value:gsub('^%s*(.-)%s*$', '%1')

    local y, m, d
    local a, b, c = value:match('^(%d%d%d%d)%-(%d%d)%-(%d%d)$')

    if a then
        y, m, d = tonumber(a), tonumber(b), tonumber(c)
    else
        local day, mon, year = value:match('^(%d%d?)%s+([%a]+)%s+(%d%d%d%d)$')
        if not day then return nil end
        m = MONTHS[mon:lower()]
        if not m then return nil end
        y, d = tonumber(year), tonumber(day)
    end

    if not y or y < 1900 or y > 2015 then return nil end
    if m < 1 or m > 12 then return nil end
    if not d or d < 1 or d > 31 then return nil end

    return ('%04d-%02d-%02d'):format(y, m, d)
end

local function sanitizeGender(value)
    if value == true or value == 1 or value == 'male' or value == 'm' or value == 'M' then return 'male' end
    if value == false or value == 0 or value == 'female' or value == 'f' or value == 'F' then return 'female' end
    return nil
end

lib.callback.register('sm_characters:create', function(source, ...)
    local args = { ... }
    local input = type(args[1]) == 'table' and args[1] or {
        firstname   = args[1],
        lastname    = args[2],
        gender      = args[3],
        birthdate   = args[4],
        nationality = args[5],
    }

    local license = getLicense(source)
    if not license then return false, 'Lisensi tidak terbaca' end

    local firstname = sanitizeName(input.firstname)
    local lastname  = sanitizeName(input.lastname)

    if not firstname then return false, 'Nama depan tidak valid (2-20 huruf)' end
    if not lastname then return false, 'Nama belakang tidak valid (2-20 huruf)' end

    local gender = sanitizeGender(input.gender)
    if not gender then return false, 'Jenis kelamin tidak valid' end

    local birthdate = sanitizeBirthdate(input.birthdate)
    if not birthdate then return false, 'Tanggal lahir harus YYYY-MM-DD' end

    local slots = getSlots(license)
    local count = MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players WHERE license = ?', { license }) or 0
    if count >= slots then return false, ('Slot karakter penuh (%d/%d)'):format(count, slots) end

    local citizenid = QBCore.Player.CreateCitizenId()
    local spawn = DEFAULT_SPAWN
    local nationality = type(input.nationality) == 'string' and input.nationality:sub(1, 32) or 'Indonesia'

    local charinfo = {
        firstname = firstname,
        lastname = lastname,
        birthdate = birthdate,
        gender = gender,
        nationality = nationality,
        cid = math.random(10000, 99999),
        phone = generatePhone(),
    }

    local money = { cash = 500, bank = 5000, crypto = 0 }
    local job = { name = 'unemployed', label = 'Pengangguran', payment = 10, onduty = true, isboss = false, grade = { name = 'Freelancer', level = 0 } }
    local gang = { name = 'none', label = 'Tidak ada', grade = { name = 'Tidak ada', level = 0 } }
    local metadata = { callsign = 'NO CALLSIGN', licences = {} }

    local nextId = (MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1 FROM players') or 1)

    local params = {
        nextId,
        citizenid,
        charinfo.cid,
        license,
        ('%s %s'):format(firstname, lastname),
        json.encode(money),
        json.encode(charinfo),
        json.encode(job),
        json.encode(gang),
        json.encode(spawn),
        json.encode(metadata),
    }

    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        MySQL.insert.await([[
            INSERT INTO players (id, citizenid, cid, license, name, money, charinfo, job, gang, position, metadata)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ]], params)
    end)

    if not ok then
        -- Skema tanpa kolom cid/name.
        ok, err = pcall(function()
            MySQL.insert.await([[
                INSERT INTO players (id, citizenid, license, money, charinfo, job, gang, position, metadata)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ]], { nextId, citizenid, license, params[6], params[7], params[8], params[9], params[10], params[11] })
        end)
    end

    if not ok then
        lib.print.error(('gagal membuat karakter: %s'):format(err))
        return false, 'Gagal menyimpan karakter'
    end

    return { coords = vec4(spawn.x, spawn.y, spawn.z, spawn.w), citizenid = citizenid }
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Pilih karakter
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

lib.callback.register('sm_characters:select', function(source, citizenid)
    local license = getLicense(source)
    if not license then return false, 'Lisensi tidak terbaca' end

    if QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(source) then
        return false, 'Karakter sudah dimuat'
    end

    local owner = MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT license FROM players WHERE citizenid = ?', { citizenid })
    if not owner then return false, 'Karakter tidak ditemukan' end
    if owner ~= license then return false, 'Karakter bukan milik Anda' end

    local ok, result = pcall(QBCore.Player.Login, source, citizenid)
    if not ok then
        lib.print.error(('login gagal: %s'):format(result))
        return false, 'Gagal memuat karakter'
    end

    if not result then return false, 'Gagal memuat karakter' end

    return true, 'Karakter dimuat'
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Hapus karakter
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

lib.callback.register('sm_characters:delete', function(source, citizenid)
    local license = getLicense(source)
    if not license then return false, 'Lisensi tidak terbaca' end

    local owner = MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT license FROM players WHERE citizenid = ?', { citizenid })
    if not owner then return false, 'Karakter tidak ditemukan' end
    if owner ~= license then return false, 'Karakter bukan milik Anda' end

    local total = MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players WHERE license = ?', { license }) or 0
    if total <= 1 then return false, 'Karakter terakhir tidak bisa dihapus' end

    local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(source)
    if player and player.PlayerData.citizenid == citizenid then
        TriggerEvent('QBCore:Server:OnPlayerUnload', source)
        QBCore.Players[source] = nil
    end

    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM players WHERE citizenid = ?', { citizenid })
    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM playerskins WHERE citizenid = ?', { citizenid })
    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM character_partners WHERE citizenid = ? OR partner = ?', { citizenid, citizenid })
    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM character_invites WHERE citizenid = ? OR target = ?', { citizenid, citizenid })

    return true, 'Karakter dihapus'
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_characters:spawn', function(source, id)
    local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(source)
    if not player then return false, 'Karakter belum dimuat' end

    local position = player.PlayerData.position
    if not position or not position.x then position = locationById(id) end
    if not position or not position.x then position = DEFAULT_SPAWN end

    local heading = position.w or position.a or 0.0

    SetEntityCoords(source, position.x + 0.0, position.y + 0.0, position.z + 0.0, false, false, false, false)
    SetEntityHeading(source, heading)
    SetPlayerRoutingBucket(source, 0)

    return true
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_characters:server:spawned', function()
    local src = source
    local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(src)
    if not player then return end

    player.PlayerData.metadata.invBusy = false
    TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Player:SetPlayerData', src, player.PlayerData)
    TriggerEvent('QBCore:Server:OnPlayerSpawned', src)
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Partner
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function myCitizen(source)
    local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(source)
    return player and player.PlayerData.citizenid or nil
end

local function partnerOf(citizenid)
    return MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT partner FROM character_partners WHERE citizenid = ?', { citizenid })
end

local function pushPartnerState(source)
    local citizenid = myCitizen(source)
    if not citizenid then return end

    local partner = partnerOf(citizenid)
    local payload = { partner = nil }

    if partner then
        local info = MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT charinfo FROM players WHERE citizenid = ?', { partner })
        payload.partner = { citizenid = partner, name = fullName(decode(info)) }
    end

    local outgoing = MySQL.query.await('SELECT target AS citizenid FROM character_invites WHERE citizenid = ?', { citizenid }) or {}
    local incoming = MySQL.query.await('SELECT citizenid FROM character_invites WHERE target = ?', { citizenid }) or {}

    payload.outgoing = outgoing
    payload.incoming = incoming

    TriggerClientEvent('sm_characters:client:partnerSync', source, payload)
end

lib.callback.register('sm_characters:partner:invite', function(source, target)
    local citizenid = myCitizen(source)
    if not citizenid then return false, 'Karakter belum dimuat' end
    if type(target) ~= 'string' then return false, 'Target tidak valid' end
    if target == citizenid then return false, 'Tidak bisa mengundang diri sendiri' end

    if partnerOf(citizenid) then return false, 'Anda sudah punya partner' end
    if partnerOf(target) then return false, 'Target sudah punya partner' end

    local targetLicense = MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT license FROM players WHERE citizenid = ?', { target })
    if not targetLicense then return false, 'Karakter target tidak ditemukan' end

    local targetSrc
    for src, player in pairs(QBCore.Players) do
        if player.PlayerData.citizenid == target then targetSrc = src break end
    end
    if not targetSrc then return false, 'Target sedang offline' end

    local exists = MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT citizenid FROM character_invites WHERE citizenid = ? AND target = ?', { citizenid, target })
    if exists then return false, 'Undangan sudah dikirim' end

    MySQL.insert.await('INSERT INTO character_invites (citizenid, target, expires) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
        { citizenid, target, os.time() + INVITE_TTL })

    notify(targetSrc, 'Undangan partner masuk', 'inform')
    pushPartnerState(targetSrc)
    pushPartnerState(source)

    return true, 'Undangan dikirim'
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_characters:partner:respond', function(source, inviter, accept)
    local citizenid = myCitizen(source)
    if not citizenid then return false, 'Karakter belum dimuat' end

    local expires = MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT expires FROM character_invites WHERE citizenid = ? AND target = ?', { inviter, citizenid })
    if not expires then return false, 'Undangan tidak ditemukan' end

    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM character_invites WHERE citizenid = ? AND target = ?', { inviter, citizenid })

    if not accept then
        pushPartnerState(source)
        return true, 'Undangan ditolak'
    end

    if expires < os.time() then return false, 'Undangan kedaluwarsa' end
    if partnerOf(citizenid) or partnerOf(inviter) then return false, 'Salah satu sudah punya partner' end

    local now = os.time()
    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM character_partners WHERE citizenid IN (?, ?)', { citizenid, inviter })
    MySQL.insert.await('INSERT INTO character_partners (citizenid, partner, since) VALUES (?, ?, ?), (?, ?, ?)',
        { citizenid, inviter, now, inviter, citizenid, now })

    local inviterSrc
    for src, player in pairs(QBCore.Players) do
        if player.PlayerData.citizenid == inviter then inviterSrc = src break end
    end

    if inviterSrc then
        notify(inviterSrc, 'Undangan partner diterima', 'success')
        pushPartnerState(inviterSrc)
    end

    pushPartnerState(source)
    return true, 'Undangan diterima'
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_characters:partner:cancel', function(source, target)
    local citizenid = myCitizen(source)
    if not citizenid then return false, 'Karakter belum dimuat' end

    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM character_invites WHERE citizenid = ? AND target = ?', { citizenid, target })
    pushPartnerState(source)

    return true, 'Undangan dibatalkan'
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_characters:partner:remove', function(source, target)
    local citizenid = myCitizen(source)
    if not citizenid then return false, 'Karakter belum dimuat' end

    local partner = partnerOf(citizenid)
    if not partner then return false, 'Tidak ada partner' end
    if target and target ~= partner then return false, 'Bukan partner Anda' end

    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM character_partners WHERE citizenid IN (?, ?)', { citizenid, partner })
    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM character_invites WHERE citizenid IN (?, ?) OR target IN (?, ?)', { citizenid, partner, citizenid, partner })

    pushPartnerState(source)

    for src, player in pairs(QBCore.Players) do
        if player.PlayerData.citizenid == partner then
            notify(src, 'Partner Anda memutuskan hubungan', 'inform')
            pushPartnerState(src)
            break
        end
    end

    return true, 'Partner diputus'
end)

lib.print.info('sm_character server siap')

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_chatheme\client\commands.lua
local Config = require "config.config"

local ipairs, pairs = ipairs, pairs
local GetGameTimer = GetGameTimer
local ceil = math.ceil

local Cooldowns = {}
local CooldownExpires = {}

for name, data in pairs(Config.Commands) do
    if data.cooldown and data.cooldown > 0 then
        Cooldowns[name] = data.cooldown * 1000
    end
end

---@param command string
---@return boolean
local function CheckCooldown(command)
    local duration = Cooldowns[command]
    if not duration then return true end

    local now = GetGameTimer()
    local expires = CooldownExpires[command]

    if expires and now < expires then
        lib.notify({
            title = 'Chat',
            description = ('Tunggu %d detik lagi untuk memakai /%s.'):format(ceil((expires - now) / 1000), command),
            type = 'error'
        })
        return false
    end

    CooldownExpires[command] = now + duration
    return true
end

local function BuildText(args)
    local text = ""
    for _, v in ipairs(args) do
        text = text .. " " .. v
    end
    return text
end

local function RegisterSimpleCommand(category, useMask)
    local command = Config.Commands[category].name

    RegisterCommand(command, function(source, args)
        local text = BuildText(args)
        if text:len() == 0 then return end
        if not CheckCooldown(command) then return end

        TriggerServerEvent('sm_chatheme:server:sendMessage', {
            category = category,
            message = text,
            isImage = false,
            mask = useMask and CheckMask() or false,
        })
    end, false)
end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_chatheme\client\main.lua
local Config = require "config.config"
local DrawTextScale = Config.DefaultSettings.drawtextScale or 0.35

NuiLoaded = false
ConfigLoaded = false
WritingEffect = false
WritingPlayers = {}
ActiveSong = {}
RPTexts = {}
RPTextThread = false
ThreadType = 'native'
Dots = ""

local function GetWebLocales()
    local path = 'locales/' .. Config.Locale .. '.json'
    local file = LoadResourceFile(GetCurrentResourceName(), path)

    if not file then
        file = LoadResourceFile(GetCurrentResourceName(), 'locales/en.json')
    end

    if not file or file == '' then
        return {}
    end

    local success, content = pcall(json.decode, file)
    if not success or not content or not content['Web'] then
        return {}
    end

    return content['Web']
end

local function CheckNui()
    while not NuiLoaded do
        Wait(100)
    end
end

function SendVueMessage(action, payload)
    CheckNui()
    SendNUIMessage({
        action = action,
        payload = payload
    })
end

local function FetchNui()
    while not NuiLoaded do
        if NetworkIsSessionStarted() then
            SendNUIMessage({ action = "CHECK_NUI" })
        end
        Wait(2000)
    end

    SendVueMessage("SET_CONFIG", {
        Themes = Config.Themes,
        ThemeColors = Config.ThemeColors,
        MessageColors = Config.MessageColors,
        Categories = Config.Categories,
        QuickCommands = Config.QuickCommands,
        AllowedURLs = Config.ImageSettings.allowedURLs,
        Emojis = Config.Emojis,
        Locales = GetWebLocales(),
    })
end

function DrawDots(coords, text)
    local defaultScale = 0.65
    local camCoords = GetGameplayCamCoord()
    local dist = #(coords - camCoords)
    local scale = 200 / (GetGameplayCamFov() * dist)

    SetTextColour(255, 255, 255, 255)
    SetTextFont(0)
    SetTextScale(0.0, defaultScale * scale)
    SetTextDropshadow(0, 0, 0, 0, 55)
    SetTextDropShadow()
    SetTextCentre(true)

    BeginTextCommandDisplayText("STRING")
    AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(text)
    SetDrawOrigin(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, 0)
    EndTextCommandDisplayText(0.0, 0.0)
    ClearDrawOrigin()
end

function DrawText3D(x, y, z, text, color)
    local camCoords = GetGameplayCamCoord()
    local dist = #(vector3(x, y, z) - camCoords)
    local scale = 200 / (GetGameplayCamFov() * dist)

    SetTextColour(color.r, color.g, color.b, color.a)
    SetTextScale(0.0, DrawTextScale * scale)
    SetTextFont(4)
    SetTextDropshadow(0, 0, 0, 0, 55)
    SetTextDropShadow()
    SetTextCentre(true)

    BeginTextCommandDisplayText("STRING")
    AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(text)
    SetDrawOrigin(x, y, z, 0)
    EndTextCommandDisplayText(0.0, 0.0)
    ClearDrawOrigin()
end

function UpdateRPTexts(source, data)
    for k, v in ipairs(RPTexts) do
        if v.source == source then
            RPTexts[k] = data
            return
        end
    end
    table.insert(RPTexts, data)
end

function CheckMask()
    if not Config.AnonymousWithMask then return false end

    local ped = cache.ped
    local pedModel = GetEntityModel(ped)

    if not Config.MaskIndexs[pedModel] then return false end

    local currentMaskIndex = GetPedDrawableVariation(ped, 1)

    if Config.AnyMask then
        return currentMaskIndex > 0
    end

    return Config.MaskIndexs[pedModel][tostring(currentMaskIndex)] == true
end

    FetchNui()
end)

    if resourceName == GetCurrentResourceName() then
        Wait(1500)
        FetchNui()
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_chatheme:client:sendMessage', function(data)
    if not data then return end

    SendVueMessage('SEND_MESSAGE', data)

    local isRPCategory = data.category == 'do' or data.category == 'me' or data.category == 'dice' or data.category == 'rps'
    if not isRPCategory or data.isImage then return end

    UpdateRPTexts(data.source, data)

    if ThreadType == 'dui' then
        RPTextsDUIThread()
    else
        RPTexts3DThread()
    end

    Wait(5000)

    for k, v in ipairs(RPTexts) do
        if v.source == data.source and v.category == data.category and v.message == data.message then
            if ThreadType == 'dui' then
                SendVueMessage("REMOVE_3D_TEXT", { source = v.source })
            end
            table.remove(RPTexts, k)
            break
        end
    end
end)

        WritingPlayers[tostring(source)] = true

    end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_chatheme\client\nui.lua
local Config = require "config.config"

RegisterNUICallback('NUI_READY', function(_, cb)
    NuiLoaded = true
    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback('CONFIG_READY', function(_, cb)
    ConfigLoaded = true
    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback('CLOSE_UI', function(_, cb)
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback("EXECUTE_COMMAND", function(command, cb)
    if not ConfigLoaded then return cb('ok') end
    Wait(200)
    ExecuteCommand(command)
    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback("TOGGLE_DICE", function(_, cb)
    ExecuteCommand('dice')
    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback("TOGGLE_RPS", function(_, cb)
    ExecuteCommand('rps')
    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback("TOGGLE_THREAD", function(data, cb)
    ThreadType = data.type
    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback("SONG_PLAYING", function(data, cb)
    ActiveSong = {
        title = data.title or "Unknown Title",
        url = data.url or "",
        isPlaying = true,
        volume = Config.MusicSettings.defaultVolume,
    }

    if not ActiveSong.url or ActiveSong.url == "" then
        cb('ok')
        return
    end

    if GetResourceState("xsound") ~= "started" then
        cb('ok')
        return
    end

    exports.xsound:PlayUrl("sm_chatheme-song-" .. cache.serverId, ActiveSong.url, ActiveSong.volume, false)

    SendVueMessage("SONG_DATA", {
        title = ActiveSong.title,
        url = ActiveSong.url,
        isPlaying = true,
        volume = ActiveSong.volume,
    })

    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback("TOGGLE_PLAYING", function(_, cb)
    if not ActiveSong or not ActiveSong.url then
        cb('ok')
        return
    end

    if GetResourceState('xsound') ~= 'started' then
        cb('ok')
        return
    end

    local xsound = exports.xsound
    local songId = "sm_chatheme-song-" .. cache.serverId

    if not xsound:soundExists(songId) then
        cb('ok')
        return
    end

    local isPaused = xsound:isPaused(songId)

    if isPaused then
        xsound:Resume(songId)
    else
        xsound:Pause(songId)
    end

    local newData = xsound:getInfo(songId)
    SendVueMessage("SONG_DATA", {
        title = ActiveSong.title,
        url = ActiveSong.url,
        isPlaying = isPaused,
        volume = newData.volume,
    })

    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback("STOP_MUSIC", function(_, cb)
    if ActiveSong and ActiveSong.url and GetResourceState('xsound') == 'started' then
        local xsound = exports.xsound
        local songId = "sm_chatheme-song-" .. cache.serverId

        if xsound:soundExists(songId) then
            xsound:Destroy(songId)
            ActiveSong.isPlaying = false
        end
    end

    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback("UPDATE_VOLUME", function(data, cb)
    if ActiveSong and ActiveSong.url and GetResourceState('xsound') == 'started' then
        local xsound = exports.xsound
        local songId = "sm_chatheme-song-" .. cache.serverId

        if xsound:soundExists(songId) then
            local volume = data.volume and tonumber(data.volume) / 100 or Config.MusicSettings.defaultVolume
            xsound:setVolume(songId, volume)
        end
    end

    cb('ok')
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_chatheme\client\thread.lua
local Config = require "config.config"

local CreateThread = CreateThread
local Wait = Wait
local GetEntityCoords = GetEntityCoords
local GetPlayerPed = GetPlayerPed
local GetPlayerFromServerId = GetPlayerFromServerId
local GetHudScreenPositionFromWorldPosition = GetHudScreenPositionFromWorldPosition
local mathAbs = math.abs
local tonumber = tonumber
local next = next
local pairs = pairs

local MaxDistance = 10.0
local MoveThreshold = 0.05
local DefaultColor = { r = 255, g = 255, b = 255, a = 255 }
local DrawColors = Config.DefaultSettings.drawtextColors
local RemovePayload = {}

---@param text table
local function HideDUIText(text)
    if text.hidden then return end
    text.hidden = true
    text.oldScreenX = nil
    text.oldScreenY = nil
    RemovePayload.source = text.source
    SendVueMessage("REMOVE_3D_TEXT", RemovePayload)
end

function RPTextsDUIThread()
    if RPTextThread then return end
    RPTextThread = true

    CreateThread(function()
        while #RPTexts >= 1 do
            local playerPedCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)

            for i = 1, #RPTexts do
                local text = RPTexts[i]
                local playerId = text.source and GetPlayerFromServerId(text.source) or -1

                if playerId == -1 then
                    HideDUIText(text)
                else
                    local targetPedCoords = GetEntityCoords(GetPlayerPed(playerId))

                    if #(playerPedCoords - targetPedCoords) >= MaxDistance then
                        HideDUIText(text)
                    else
                        local offscreen, screenX, screenY = GetHudScreenPositionFromWorldPosition(
                            targetPedCoords.x, targetPedCoords.y, targetPedCoords.z + 1.0
                        )

                        if offscreen then
                            HideDUIText(text)
                        else
                            screenX = screenX * 100
                            screenY = screenY * 100
                            local oldX, oldY = text.oldScreenX, text.oldScreenY

                            if not oldX or mathAbs(oldX - screenX) > MoveThreshold or mathAbs(oldY - screenY) > MoveThreshold then
                                text.hidden = false
                                text.oldScreenX = screenX
                                text.oldScreenY = screenY
                                SendVueMessage('SHOW_3D_TEXT', {
                                    source = text.source,
                                    player = text.fullname,
                                    screenX = screenX,
                                    screenY = screenY,
                                    message = text.message,
                                    category = text.category,
                                    isDice = text.isDice,
                                    isRPS = text.isRPS,
                                    hand = text.hand or false,
                                })
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            Wait(0)
        end
        RPTextThread = false
    end)
end

function RPTexts3DThread()
    if RPText3DThread then return end
    RPText3DThread = true

    CreateThread(function()
        while #RPTexts >= 1 do
            local playerPedCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)

            for i = 1, #RPTexts do
                local text = RPTexts[i]
                local playerId = text.source and GetPlayerFromServerId(text.source) or -1

                if playerId ~= -1 then
                    local targetPedCoords = GetEntityCoords(GetPlayerPed(playerId))

                    if #(playerPedCoords - targetPedCoords) < MaxDistance then
                        DrawText3D(targetPedCoords.x, targetPedCoords.y, targetPedCoords.z, text.message, DrawColors[text.category] or DefaultColor)
                    end
                end
            end
            Wait(0)
        end
        RPText3DThread = false
    end)
end

function FWritingEffect()
    if WritingEffect then return end
    WritingEffect = true

    CreateThread(function()
        while next(WritingPlayers) ~= nil do
            local sleep = 500
            local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)

            for source in pairs(WritingPlayers) do
                local writerId = GetPlayerFromServerId(tonumber(source))
                if writerId == -1 then
                    WritingPlayers[source] = nil
                else
                    local writerCoords = GetEntityCoords(GetPlayerPed(writerId))
                    if #(playerCoords - writerCoords) <= 6.0 then
                        sleep = 0
                        DrawDots(vec3(writerCoords.x, writerCoords.y, writerCoords.z + 1.0), Dots)
                    end
                end
            end
            Wait(sleep)
        end
        WritingEffect = false
    end)
end
