---@diagnostic disable: duplicate-set-field
if GetResourceState('es_extended') ~= 'started' then return end

ESX = exports["es_extended"]:getSharedObject()

Framework = Framework or {}

Framework.GetFrameworkName = function()
    return 'es_extended'
end

---This will return a table of the players data, this is an internal table and should not be used.
---@return table
Framework.GetPlayerData = function()
    return ESX.GetPlayerData()
end

--<-- TODO swap to internal callback system
---This will return a table of all the jobs in the framework.
---@return table
Framework.GetFrameworkJobs = function()
    local jobs = lib.callback.await('sm_chatheme:callback:getFrameworkJobs', false)
    return jobs
end

---This will return the players birth date
---@return string
Framework.GetPlayerDob = function()
    local playerData = Framework.GetPlayerData()
    local dob = playerData.dateofbirth
    return dob
end

---This will return the players metadata for the specified metadata key.
---@param metadata string
---@return table | nil
Framework.GetPlayerMetaData = function(metadata)
    return Framework.GetPlayerData().metadata[metadata]
end

---This will prompt the user with a notification message
---@param message string
---@param type string
---@param time number
---@return nil
Framework.Notify = function(message, type, time)
    return ESX.ShowNotification(message, type, time)
end

---Will Display the help text message on the screen
---@param message string
---@param _ unknown
---@return nil
Framework.ShowHelpText = function(message, _)
    return exports['esx_textui']:TextUI(message, "info")
end

---This will hide the help text message on the screen
---@return nil
Framework.HideHelpText = function()
    return exports['esx_textui']:HideUI()
end

---This will return the players identifier
---@return string
Framework.GetPlayerIdentifier = function()
    local playerData = Framework.GetPlayerData()
    return playerData.identifier
end

---This will return the players first name, and the last name
---@return string
---@return string
Framework.GetPlayerName = function()
    local playerData = Framework.GetPlayerData()
    return playerData.firstName, playerData.lastName
end

---This will return the players job name, job label, job grade label and job grade level
---@return string
---@return string
---@return string
---@return string
Framework.GetPlayerJob = function()
    local playerData = Framework.GetPlayerData()
    return playerData.job.name, playerData.job.label, playerData.job.grade_label, playerData.job.grade
end

---This will return a boolean if the player has the item in their inventory
---@param item string
---@return boolean
Framework.HasItem = function(item)
	local hasItem = ESX.SearchInventory(item, true)
	return hasItem > 0 and true or false
end

---This will return a table of the players inventory
---@return table
Framework.GetPlayerInventory = function()
    local playerData = Framework.GetPlayerData()
    return playerData.inventory
end

---This will return a number of the item in the players inventory
---@param item string
---@return number
Framework.GetItemCount = function(item)
    local inventory = Framework.GetPlayerInventory()
    if not inventory then return 0 end
    return inventory[item].count or 0
end

---This will return a boolean if the player is dead
---@return boolean
Framework.GetIsPlayerDead = function()
    local playerData = Framework.GetPlayerData()
    return playerData.dead
end

RegisterNetEvent('esx:playerLoaded', function(xPlayer)
    Wait(1500)
    TriggerEvent('sm_chatheme:client:onPlayerLoaded')
end)

RegisterNetEvent('esx:onPlayerLogout', function()
    TriggerEvent('sm_chatheme:client:onPlayerUnload')
end)

RegisterNetEvent('esx:setJob', function(data)
    TriggerEvent('sm_chatheme:client:onPlayerJobUpdate', data.name, data.label, data.grade_label, data.grade)
end)

return Framework

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_chatheme\modules\framework\qb-core\client.lua
---@diagnostic disable: duplicate-set-field
if GetResourceState('qb-core') ~= 'started' then return end
if GetResourceState('qbx_core') == 'started' then return end

QBCore = exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject()

Framework = Framework or {}
Framework.Shared = QBCore.Shared

Framework.GetFrameworkName = function()
    return 'qb-core'
end

Framework.GetPlayerData = function()
    return QBPlayerData
end

Framework.GetPlayerIdentifier = function()
    return QBPlayerData.citizenid
end

Framework.GetPlayerName = function()
    local info = QBPlayerData.charinfo
    if not info then return end
    return info.firstname, info.lastname
end

Framework.GetPlayerDob = function()
    local info = QBPlayerData.charinfo
    if not info then return end
    return info.birthdate
end

Framework.GetPlayerMetaData = function(metadata)
    local meta = QBPlayerData.metadata
    if not meta then return end
    return meta[metadata]
end

Framework.GetPlayerJob = function()
    local job = QBPlayerData.job
    if not job then return end
    return job.name, job.label, job.grade.name, job.grade.level
end

Framework.GetIsPlayerDead = function()
    local meta = QBPlayerData.metadata
    if not meta then return false end
    return meta["isdead"] or meta["inlaststand"]
end

Framework.GetFrameworkJobs = function()
    local jobs = {}
    for k, v in pairs(QBCore.Shared.Jobs) do
        table.insert(jobs, {
            name = k,
            label = v.label,
            grade = v.grades
        })
    end
    return jobs
end

Framework.Notify = function(message, type, time)
    TriggerEvent('QBCore:Notify', message, 'primary', time)
end

Framework.ShowHelpText = function(message, _position)
    return exports['qb-core']:DrawText(message, _position)
end

Framework.HideHelpText = function()
    return exports['qb-core']:HideText()
end

Framework.GetItemInfo = function(item)
    local itemData = QBCore.Shared.Items[item]
    if not itemData then return {} end
    return {
        name = itemData.name,
        label = itemData.label,
        stack = itemData.unique,
        weight = itemData.weight,
        description = itemData.description,
        image = itemData.image
    }
end

Framework.HasItem = function(item)
    return QBCore.Functions.HasItem(item)
end

Framework.GetItemCount = function(item)
    local frameworkInv = QBPlayerData.items
    if not frameworkInv then return 0 end
    local count = 0
    for _, v in pairs(frameworkInv) do
        if v.name == item then
            count = count + v.amount
        end
    end
    return count
end

Framework.GetPlayerInventory = function()
    local frameworkInv = QBPlayerData.items
    if not frameworkInv then return {} end
    local items = {}
    for _, v in pairs(frameworkInv) do
        table.insert(items, {
            name = v.name,
            label = v.label,
            count = v.amount,
            slot = v.slot,
            metadata = v.info,
            stack = v.unique,
            close = v.useable,
            weight = v.weight
        })
    end
    return items
end

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:OnPlayerLoaded', function()
    Wait(1500)
    TriggerEvent('sm_chatheme:client:onPlayerLoaded')
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:OnPlayerUnload', function()
    TriggerEvent('sm_chatheme:client:onPlayerUnload')
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:OnJobUpdate', function(data)
    TriggerEvent('sm_chatheme:client:onPlayerJobUpdate', data.name, data.label, data.grade_label, data.grade)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:OnGangUpdate', function(data)
    TriggerEvent('sm_chatheme:client:onPlayerGangUpdate', data.name, data.label, data.grade.name, data.grade.level)
end)

return Framework

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_chatheme\utils\locales.lua
local Config = require 'config.config'

local function LoadLocaleFile()
    local path = 'locales/' .. Config.Locale .. '.json'
    local file = LoadResourceFile(GetCurrentResourceName(), path)

    if not file then
        file = LoadResourceFile(GetCurrentResourceName(), 'locales/en.json')
        print(('Locale file "%s" not found, falling back to default "en".'):format(Config.Locale))
    end

    return file
end

local function LoadLocale()
    local file = LoadLocaleFile()

	if not file or file == '' then
        error('Locale file is empty or not found')
    end

    local success, content = pcall(json.decode, file)

	if not success then
        error(('Failed to decode JSON from locale file: %s'):format(content))
    end


    if not content['Lua'] then
        error('Missing "Lua" section in locale file')
    end

    return content['Lua']
end

Locales = LoadLocale()

function _T(key, ...)
    if Locales[key] then
        return Locales[key]:format(...)
    end
    return key
end

local function getCore(filters)
    if not filters then return QBCore end

    local results = {}
    for i = 1, #filters do
        local key = filters[i]
        if QBCore[key] then
            results[key] = QBCore[key]
        end
    end

    return results
end

RegisterNetEvent('qb_event_client:tptocoords', function(coords)
    if source == '' then return end

    local x, y, z, h = table.unpack(coords)
    if not h then h = GetEntityHeading(cache.ped) end
    SetPedCoordsKeepVehicle(cache.ped, x, y, z)
    SetEntityHeading(cache.ped, h)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('qb_event_client:gotoMarker', function()
    if source == '' then return end

    local GetEntityCoords = GetEntityCoords
    local GetGroundZFor_3dCoord = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord

    local blipMarker <const> = GetFirstBlipInfoId(8)

    if not DoesBlipExist(blipMarker) then
        QBCore.Functions.Notify(Lang:t('error.no_waypoint'), 'error', 5000)
        return
    end

    -- Fade screen to hide how clients get teleported.
    DoScreenFadeOut(650)
    while not IsScreenFadedOut() do
        Wait(0)
    end

    local ped, coords <const> = cache.ped, GetBlipInfoIdCoord(blipMarker)
    local vehicle = GetVehiclePedIsIn(ped, false)
    local oldCoords <const> = GetEntityCoords(ped)

    -- Unpack coords instead of having to unpack them while iterating.
    -- 825.0 seems to be the max a player can reach while 0.0 being the lowest.
    local x, y, groundZ, Z_START = coords['x'], coords['y'], 850.0, 950.0
    local found = false
    if vehicle > 0 then
        FreezeEntityPosition(vehicle, true)
    else
        FreezeEntityPosition(ped, true)
    end

    for i = Z_START, 0, -25.0 do
        local z = i
        if (i % 2) ~= 0 then
            z = Z_START - i
        end

        NewLoadSceneStart(x, y, z, x, y, z, 50.0, 0)
        local curTime = GetGameTimer()
        while IsNetworkLoadingScene() do
            if GetGameTimer() - curTime > 1000 then
                break
            end
            Wait(0)
        end
        NewLoadSceneStop()
        SetPedCoordsKeepVehicle(ped, x, y, z)

        while not HasCollisionLoadedAroundEntity(ped) do
            RequestCollisionAtCoord(x, y, z)
            if GetGameTimer() - curTime > 1000 then
                break
            end
            Wait(0)
        end

        -- Get ground coord. As mentioned in the natives, this only works if the client is in render distance.
        found, groundZ = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord(x, y, z, false);
        if found then
            Wait(0)
            SetPedCoordsKeepVehicle(ped, x, y, groundZ)
            break
        end
        Wait(0)
    end

    -- Remove black screen once the loop has ended.
    DoScreenFadeIn(650)
    if vehicle > 0 then
        FreezeEntityPosition(vehicle, false)
    else
        FreezeEntityPosition(ped, false)
    end

    if not found then
        -- If we can't find the coords, set the coords to the old ones.
        -- We don't unpack them before since they aren't in a loop and only called once.
        SetPedCoordsKeepVehicle(ped, oldCoords['x'], oldCoords['y'], oldCoords['z'] - 1.0)
        QBCore.Functions.Notify(Lang:t('error.tp_error'), 'error', 5000)
    end

    -- If Z coord was found, set coords in found coords.
    SetPedCoordsKeepVehicle(ped, x, y, groundZ)
    QBCore.Functions.Notify(Lang:t('success.teleported_waypoint'), 'success', 5000)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('qb_event_client:spawnVehicle', function(vehName, serverPlate)
    if source == '' then return end

    local ok, hash = pcall(function ()
        return lib.requestModel(vehName)
    end)

    if not ok then
        if hash then
            lib.print.warn(hash)
        end
        return
    end

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local heading = GetEntityHeading(cache.ped)
    local vehicle = QBCore.Functions.SpawnVehicle(hash, nil, vec(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, heading), true, true)

    if not (vehicle and DoesEntityExist(vehicle)) then
        return
    end

    SetEntityHeading(vehicle, heading)
    local plate = serverPlate or ('SM ' .. lib.string.random('.....'))
    SetVehicleNumberPlateText(vehicle, plate)
    TriggerEvent('sm_vehiclekeys:client:setVehicleOwner', plate)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('qb_event_client:deleteVehicle', function()
    if source == '' then return end

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    
    if cache.vehicle then
        SetEntityAsMissionEntity(cache.vehicle, true, true)
        DeleteEntity(cache.vehicle)
        return
    end

    local vehicle = lib.getClosestVehicle(coords, 3.0)
    if not vehicle then
        return
    end

    SetEntityAsMissionEntity(vehicle, true, true)
    DeleteEntity(vehicle)
end)

local eventHooks = require 'modules.hooks'

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Player:setPData', function(key, val, subVal)
    if source == '' then return end

    if key == 'all' then
        QBCore.PlayerData = val
        goto skip
    end

    if not QBCore.PlayerData[key] then
        QBCore.PlayerData[key] = (subVal ~= nil) and {} or val
    end

    if subVal ~= nil then
        if type(QBCore.PlayerData[key]) ~= 'table' then
            QBCore.PlayerData[key] = {}
        end
        QBCore.PlayerData[key][val] = subVal
    else
        QBCore.PlayerData[key] = val
    end

    ::skip::

    TriggerEvent('QBCore:Player:SetPlayerData', QBCore.PlayerData)
    eventHooks('core:updatePlayerData', QBCore.PlayerData)
    eventHooks('core:updatePlayerDataBykey', key, val, subVal)
end)

local blockedWords = {
    'crytxontop', 'crytx', 'hama kontol', 'dev magang',
    'discord.gg', 'p5uquhsukq',
    'ngentot', 'lonte', 'goblok', 'kontol', 'tolol', 'tonggos',
}

local function containsBlocked(text)
    if not text then return false end
    local lower = string.lower(tostring(text))
    for _, word in ipairs(blockedWords) do
        if string.find(lower, word, 1, true) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Notify', function(text, type, length, icon)
    if containsBlocked(text) then return end
    QBCore.Functions.Notify(text, type, length, icon)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('getNotifyConfig', function(_, cb)
    cb(QBConfig.Notify)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_spawn:client:onSpawn', function(data)
    local metadata = QBCore.PlayerData.metadata

    local health = metadata.health
    local armour = metadata.armor

    Wait(1500)
    if health and type(health) == "number" then
        SetEntityMaxHealth(cache.ped, 200)
        SetEntityHealth(cache.ped, health)
    end

    if armour and type(armour) == "number" then
        SetPedArmour(cache.ped, armour)
    end
end)


---@SpawnVehicle

-- Set vehicle props
---@param netId number
---@param props table<any, any>
RegisterNetEvent('sm_core:client:setVehicleProperties', function(netId, props)
    if not props then return end
    local timeOut = GetGameTimer() + 1000
    local vehicle = NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netId)
    while true do
        if NetworkGetEntityOwner(vehicle) == cache.playerId then
            if lib.setVehicleProperties(vehicle, props) then
                return
            end
        end
        if GetGameTimer() > timeOut then
            return
        end

        Wait(50)
    end
end)

-- Clear vehicle peds
---@param vehicle number
---@param init boolean
qbLib.entityStateHandler('initVehicle', function(vehicle, _, init)
    if not init then return end

    for i = -1, 0 do
        local ped = GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, i)
        if ped ~= cache.ped and ped > 0 and NetworkGetEntityOwner(ped) == cache.playerId then
            DeleteEntity(ped)
        end
    end

    lib.waitFor(function()
        return not IsEntityWaitingForWorldCollision(vehicle)
    end)

    if NetworkGetEntityOwner(vehicle) ~= cache.playerId then return end

    local state = Entity(vehicle).state

    SetVehicleOnGroundProperly(vehicle);

    SetTimeout(0, function()
        state:set('initVehicle', nil, true)
    end)
end)

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        local pstate = LocalPlayer.state
        if pstate.isLoggedIn then
            local hunger = QBCore.PlayerData.metadata['hunger']
            local thirst = QBCore.PlayerData.metadata['thirst']
            local isDead = QBCore.PlayerData.metadata['isdead']
            local inLastStand = QBCore.PlayerData.metadata['inlaststand']
            
            if not pstate.inGhostHunting and hunger and thirst and (hunger <= 0 or thirst <= 0) and not (isDead or inLastStand) then
                local ped = PlayerPedId()
                local currentHealth = GetEntityHealth(ped)
                local decreaseThreshold = math.random(5, 10)
                SetEntityHealth(ped, currentHealth - decreaseThreshold)
            end
        end
        Wait(QBCore.Config.StatusInterval)
    end
end)

local qbExport = require 'export-functions'

local qbFn = setmetatable({}, {
    __newindex = function (self, key, fn)
        rawset(self, key, fn)

        if type(fn) == "function" then
            exports(key, fn)
            qbExport(key, fn)
        end
    end
})

local isServer = lib.context == 'server'

---@param pool string
---@param ignoreList? integer[]
---@return integer[]
local function getEntities(pool, ignoreList) -- luacheck: ignore
    ignoreList = ignoreList or {}
    local ents = GetGamePool(pool)
    local entities = {}
    local ignoreMap = {}
    for i = 1, #ignoreList do
        ignoreMap[ignoreList[i]] = true
    end

    for i = 1, #ents do
        local entity = ents[i]
        if not ignoreMap[entity] then
            entities[#entities + 1] = entity
        end
    end
    return entities
end

---@param entities integer[]
---@param coords vector3? if unset uses player coords
---@return integer closestObj or -1
---@return number closestDistance or -1
local function getClosestEntity(entities, coords) -- luacheck: ignore
    coords = type(coords) == 'table' and vec3(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z) or coords or GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local closestDistance = -1
    local closestEntity = -1
    for i = 1, #entities do
        local entity = entities[i]
        local entityCoords = GetEntityCoords(entity)
        local distance = #(entityCoords - coords)
        if closestDistance == -1 or closestDistance > distance then
            closestEntity = entity
            closestDistance = distance
        end
    end
    return closestEntity, closestDistance
end

---@param entity number
---@return vector4
function qbFn.GetCoords(entity)
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(entity, false)
    local heading = GetEntityHeading(entity)
    return vector4(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, heading)
end

    ---@deprecated use cfg ACEs instead

    ---@param permission string
    function qbFn.AddPermission(source, permission)
        if not IsPlayerAceAllowed(source --[[@as string]], permission) then
            lib.addPrincipal('player.' .. source, 'group.' .. permission)
            lib.addAce('player.' .. source, 'group.' .. permission)
            TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:OnPermissionUpdate', source)
            TriggerEvent('QBCore:Server:OnPermissionUpdate', source)
        end
    end

    ---@deprecated use cfg ACEs instead
    ---@param source Source
    ---@param permission string
    function qbFn.RemovePermission(source, permission)
        if permission then
            if IsPlayerAceAllowed(source --[[@as string]], permission) then
                lib.removePrincipal('player.' .. source, 'group.' .. permission)
                lib.removeAce('player.' .. source, 'group.' .. permission)
                TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:OnPermissionUpdate', source)
                TriggerEvent('QBCore:Server:OnPermissionUpdate', source)
            end
        else
            local hasUpdated = false

            ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: deprecated
            for _, v in pairs(QBConfig.Server.Permissions) do
                if IsPlayerAceAllowed(source --[[@as string]], v) then
                    lib.removePrincipal('player.' .. source, 'group.' .. v)
                    lib.removeAce('player.' .. source, 'group.' .. v)
                    hasUpdated = true
                end
            end
            if hasUpdated then
                TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:OnPermissionUpdate', source)
                TriggerEvent('QBCore:Server:OnPermissionUpdate', source)
            end
        end
    end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_core\lib\callback\client.lua
local pendingServerCbs = {}
local clientRateLimit   = {}

local RATE_LIMIT_MAX    = 10   -- max calls per window
local RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW = 5000 -- ms
local CB_TIMEOUT        = 15000 -- ms

local cbCounter = 0
local function makeId()
    cbCounter += 1
    return ('%d-%d-%d'):format(cache.serverId, GetGameTimer(), cbCounter)
end

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(30000)
        local now = GetGameTimer()

        for id, entry in pairs(pendingServerCbs) do
            if now > entry.expires then
                lib.print.verbose(('[cb:client] timeout: %s'):format(entry.name))
                pendingServerCbs[id] = nil
            end
        end
    end
end)

---@param name string
---@return boolean allowed
local function checkRateLimit(name)
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    local entry = clientRateLimit[name]

    if not entry or now > entry.resetAt then
        clientRateLimit[name] = { count = 1, resetAt = now + RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW }
        return true
    end

    entry.count += 1

    if entry.count > RATE_LIMIT_MAX then
        lib.print.warn(('[cb:client] rate limit exceeded: %s'):format(name))
        return false
    end

    return true
end

---@param name string Callback name
---@param cb function Handler: function(cb, ...)
local function CreateClientCallback(name, cb)
    QBCore.ClientCallbacks[name] = cb
end

---@param name string Callback name
---@param ... any Optional leading cb function, then args to server
---@return any # Returns server result when no cb provided (async)
local function TriggerCallback(name, ...)
    if not checkRateLimit(name) then return end

    local cb = nil
    local args = { ... }

    if QBCore.Shared.IsFunction(args[1]) then
        cb = args[1]
        table.remove(args, 1)
    end

    local cbId = makeId()
    local p = promise.new()

    pendingServerCbs[cbId] = {
        name     = name,
        promise  = p,
        callback = cb,
        expires  = GetGameTimer() + CB_TIMEOUT,
    }

    TriggerServerEvent('QBCore:Server:TriggerCallback', name, cbId, table.unpack(args))

    if cb == nil then
        Citizen.Await(p)
        return p.value
    end
end

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:TriggerClientCallback', function(name, cbId, ...)
    if source == '' then return end

    if not QBCore.ClientCallbacks[name] then return end

    QBCore.ClientCallbacks[name](function(...)
        TriggerServerEvent('QBCore:Server:TriggerClientCallback', cbId, ...)
    end, ...)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:TriggerCallback', function(name, cbId, ...)
    if source == '' then return end

    local entry = pendingServerCbs[cbId]
    if not entry then return end

    if entry.name ~= name then
        lib.print.warn(('[cb:client] name mismatch: got %s expected %s'):format(name, entry.name))
        return
    end

    if GetGameTimer() > entry.expires then
        pendingServerCbs[cbId] = nil
        return
    end

    pendingServerCbs[cbId] = nil

    entry.promise:resolve(...)

    if entry.callback then
        entry.callback(...)
    end
end)

return {
    CreateClientCallback = CreateClientCallback,
    TriggerCallback      = TriggerCallback,
}


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_core\lib\callback\server.lua
local pendingClientCbs = {}
local serverCbRateLimit = {}

local RATE_LIMIT_MAX    = 10   -- max calls per window
local RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW = 5000 -- ms
local CB_TIMEOUT        = 120000 -- ms sebelum entry dianggap expired

local cbCounter = 0
local function makeId(source)
    cbCounter += 1
    return ('%d-%d-%d'):format(source, GetGameTimer(), cbCounter)
end

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(30000)
        local now = GetGameTimer()

        for id, entry in pairs(pendingClientCbs) do
            if now > entry.expires then
                lib.print.verbose(('[cb:server] timeout: %s | src: %s'):format(entry.name, entry.source))
                pendingClientCbs[id] = nil
            end
        end
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    local src = source
    serverCbRateLimit[src] = nil

    for id, entry in pairs(pendingClientCbs) do
        if entry.source == src then
            pendingClientCbs[id] = nil
        end
    end
end)

---@param src number
---@param name string
---@return boolean allowed
local function checkRateLimit(src, name)
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    serverCbRateLimit[src] = serverCbRateLimit[src] or {}
    local entry = serverCbRateLimit[src][name]

    if not entry or now > entry.resetAt then
        serverCbRateLimit[src][name] = { count = 1, resetAt = now + RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW }
        return true
    end

    entry.count += 1
    if entry.count > RATE_LIMIT_MAX then
        lib.print.warn(('[cb:server] rate limit exceeded: %s | src: %s'):format(name, src))
        return false
    end

    return true
end

---@param name string Callback name
---@param source number Player server ID
---@param ... any Additional args passed to client (optional leading cb function)
---@return any # Returns callback result when no cb provided (async)
local function TriggerClientCallback(name, source, ...)
    local cb = nil
    local args = { ... }

    if QBCore.Shared.IsFunction(args[1]) then
        cb = args[1]
        table.remove(args, 1)
    end

    local cbId = makeId(source)
    local p = promise.new()

    pendingClientCbs[cbId] = {
        source   = source,
        name     = name,
        promise  = p,
        callback = cb,
        expires  = GetGameTimer() + CB_TIMEOUT,
    }

    TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:TriggerClientCallback', source, name, cbId, table.unpack(args))

    if cb == nil then
        Citizen.Await(p)
        return p.value
    end
end

---@param name string Callback name
---@param cb function Handler: function(source, cb, ...)
local function CreateCallback(name, cb)
    QBCore.ServerCallbacks[name] = cb
end

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Server:TriggerClientCallback', function(cbId, ...)
    local source = source
    local entry = pendingClientCbs[cbId]

    if not entry then return end
    if entry.source ~= source then
        lib.print.warn(('[cb:server] cbId mismatch src %s != expected %s | id: %s'):format(source))
        return
    end

    if GetGameTimer() > entry.expires then
        pendingClientCbs[cbId] = nil
        return
    end

    pendingClientCbs[cbId] = nil

    entry.promise:resolve(...)

    if entry.callback then
        entry.callback(...)
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Server:TriggerCallback', function(name, cbId, ...)
    local src = source

    if not QBCore.ServerCallbacks[name] then
        lib.print.warn(('[cb:server] callback not found: %s | src: %s'):format(name, src))
        return
    end

    if not checkRateLimit(src, name) then return end

    QBCore.ServerCallbacks[name](src, function(...)
        TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:TriggerCallback', src, name, cbId, ...)
    end, ...)
end)

return {
    TriggerClientCallback = TriggerClientCallback,
    CreateCallback        = CreateCallback,
}

local functions = {}

---@deprecated use lib.progressBar from ox_lib
---@param label string
---@param duration integer ms
---@param useWhileDead boolean
---@param canCancel boolean
---@param disableControls? {disableMovement: boolean, disableCarMovement: boolean, disableCombat: boolean, disableMouse: boolean}
---@param animation? {animDict: string, anim: string, flags: unknown}
---@param prop? unknown
---@param onFinish fun()
---@param onCancel fun()
function functions.Progressbar(_, label, duration, useWhileDead, canCancel, disableControls, animation, prop, _, onFinish, onCancel)
    if lib.progressBar({
        duration = duration,
        label = label,
        useWhileDead = useWhileDead,
        canCancel = canCancel,
        disable = {
            move = disableControls?.disableMovement,
            car = disableControls?.disableCarMovement,
            combat = disableControls?.disableCombat,
            mouse = disableControls?.disableMouse,
        },
        anim = {
            dict = animation?.animDict,
            clip = animation?.anim,
            flags = animation?.flags
        },
        prop = {
            model = prop?.model,
            pos = prop?.coords,
            rot = prop?.rotation,
        },
    }) then
        if onFinish then
            onFinish()
        end
    else
        if onCancel then
            onCancel()
        end
    end
end

---Text box popup for player which dissappears after a set time.
---@param text table|string text of the notification
---@param notifyType? NotificationType informs default styling. Defaults to 'inform'
---@param duration? integer milliseconds notification will remain on screen. Defaults to 5000
---@param subTitle? string extra text under the title
---@param notifyPosition? NotificationPosition
---@param notifyStyle? table Custom styling. Please refer too https://coxdocs.dev/ox_lib/Modules/Interface/Client/notify#libnotify
---@param notifyIcon? string Font Awesome 6 icon name
---@param notifyIconColor? string Custom color for the icon chosen before
function functions.Notify(text, notifyType, duration, subTitle, notifyPosition, notifyStyle, notifyIcon, notifyIconColor)
    local title, description
    if type(text) == 'table' then
        title = text.text or 'Placeholder'
        description = text.caption or nil
    elseif subTitle then
        title = text
        description = subTitle
    else
        description = text
    end

    local position = notifyPosition or 'top-right'

    lib.notify({
        id = title,
        title = title,
        description = description,
        duration = duration,
        type = notifyType,
        position = position,
        style = notifyStyle,
        icon = notifyIcon,
        iconColor = notifyIconColor
    })
end

return functions

local functions = {}

---@deprecated use ParticleFx natives directly
functions.StartParticleAtCoord = function(dict, ptName, looped, coords, rot, scale, alpha, color, duration) -- luacheck: ignore
    coords = type(coords) == 'table' and vec3(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z) or coords or GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)

    lib.requestNamedPtfxAsset(dict)
    UseParticleFxAssetNextCall(dict)
    SetPtfxAssetNextCall(dict)
    local particleHandle
    if looped then
        particleHandle = StartParticleFxLoopedAtCoord(ptName, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, rot.x, rot.y, rot.z, scale or 1.0, false, false, false, false)
        if color then
            SetParticleFxLoopedColour(particleHandle, color.r, color.g, color.b, false)
        end
        SetParticleFxLoopedAlpha(particleHandle, alpha or 10.0)
        if duration then
            Wait(duration)
            StopParticleFxLooped(particleHandle, false)
        end
    else
        SetParticleFxNonLoopedAlpha(alpha or 1.0)
        if color then
            SetParticleFxNonLoopedColour(color.r, color.g, color.b)
        end
        StartParticleFxNonLoopedAtCoord(ptName, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, rot.x, rot.y, rot.z, scale or 1.0, false, false, false)
    end
    return particleHandle
end

---@deprecated use ParticleFx natives directly
functions.StartParticleOnEntity = function(dict, ptName, looped, entity, bone, offset, rot, scale, alpha, color, evolution, duration) -- luacheck: ignore
    lib.requestNamedPtfxAsset(dict)
    UseParticleFxAssetNextCall(dict)
    local particleHandle = nil
    ---@cast bone number
    local pedBoneIndex = bone and GetPedBoneIndex(entity, bone) or 0
    ---@cast bone string
    local nameBoneIndex = bone and GetEntityBoneIndexByName(entity, bone) or 0
    local entityType = GetEntityType(entity)
    local boneID = entityType == 1 and (pedBoneIndex ~= 0 and pedBoneIndex) or (looped and nameBoneIndex ~= 0 and nameBoneIndex)
    if looped then
        if boneID then
            particleHandle = StartParticleFxLoopedOnEntityBone(ptName, entity, offset.x, offset.y, offset.z, rot.x, rot.y, rot.z, boneID, scale or 1.0, false, false, false)
        else
            particleHandle = StartParticleFxLoopedOnEntity(ptName, entity, offset.x, offset.y, offset.z, rot.x, rot.y, rot.z, scale or 1.0, false, false, false)
        end
        if evolution then
            SetParticleFxLoopedEvolution(particleHandle, evolution.name, evolution.amount, false)
        end
        if color then
            SetParticleFxLoopedColour(particleHandle, color.r, color.g, color.b, false)
        end
        SetParticleFxLoopedAlpha(particleHandle, alpha or 1.0)
        if duration then
            Wait(duration)
            StopParticleFxLooped(particleHandle, false)
        end
    else
        SetParticleFxNonLoopedAlpha(alpha or 1.0)
        if color then
            SetParticleFxNonLoopedColour(color.r, color.g, color.b)
        end
        if boneID then
            StartParticleFxNonLoopedOnPedBone(ptName, entity, offset.x, offset.y, offset.z, rot.x, rot.y, rot.z, boneID, scale or 1.0, false, false, false)
        else
            StartParticleFxNonLoopedOnEntity(ptName, entity, offset.x, offset.y, offset.z, rot.x, rot.y, rot.z, scale or 1.0, false, false, false)
        end
    end
    return particleHandle
end

return functions

local functions = {}

---@deprecated use qbx.spawnVehicle from modules/lib.lua
---@param model string|number
---@param cb? fun(vehicle: number)
---@param coords? vector4 player position if not specified
---@param isnetworked? boolean defaults to true
---@param teleportInto boolean teleport player to driver seat if true
function functions.SpawnVehicle(model, cb, coords, isnetworked, teleportInto)
    local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local combinedCoords = vec4(playerCoords.x, playerCoords.y, playerCoords.z, GetEntityHeading(cache.ped))
    coords = type(coords) == 'table' and vec4(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, coords.w or combinedCoords.w) or coords or combinedCoords
    model = type(model) == 'string' and joaat(model) or model
    if not IsModelInCdimage(model) then return end

    isnetworked = isnetworked == nil or isnetworked
    lib.requestModel(model)
    local veh = CreateVehicle(model, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, coords.w, isnetworked, false)
    local netid = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(veh)
    SetVehicleHasBeenOwnedByPlayer(veh, true)
    SetNetworkIdCanMigrate(netid, true)
    SetVehicleNeedsToBeHotwired(veh, false)
    SetVehRadioStation(veh, 'OFF')
    SetVehicleFuelLevel(veh, 100.0)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
    if teleportInto then TaskWarpPedIntoVehicle(cache.ped, veh, -1) end
    if cb then cb(veh) return end

    return veh, netid
end

function functions.GetVehicleProperties(vehicle)
    if not DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then
        return
    end
    
    local colorPrimary, colorSecondary = GetVehicleColours(vehicle)
    local pearlescentColor, wheelColor = GetVehicleExtraColours(vehicle)
    if GetIsVehiclePrimaryColourCustom(vehicle) then
        colorPrimary = {GetVehicleCustomPrimaryColour(vehicle)}
    end

    if GetIsVehicleSecondaryColourCustom(vehicle) then
        colorSecondary = {GetVehicleCustomSecondaryColour(vehicle)}
    end
    
    local hasCustomXenonColor, customXenonColorR, customXenonColorG, customXenonColorB = GetVehicleXenonLightsCustomColor(vehicle)
    local customXenonColor = nil
    if hasCustomXenonColor then
        customXenonColor = {customXenonColorR, customXenonColorG, customXenonColorB}
    end

    local paintTypePrimary, _, _ = GetVehicleModColor_1(vehicle)
    local paintTypeSecondary, _ = GetVehicleModColor_2(vehicle)

    local extras = {}
    for extraId = 0, 20 do
        if DoesExtraExist(vehicle, extraId) then
            extras[tostring(extraId)] = IsVehicleExtraTurnedOn(vehicle, extraId)
        end
    end

    local tireHealth = {}
    for i = 0, 3 do
        tireHealth[tostring(i)] = GetVehicleWheelHealth(vehicle, i)
    end

    local tireBurstState = {}
    for i = 0, 5 do
       tireBurstState[tostring(i)] = IsVehicleTyreBurst(vehicle, i, false)
    end

    local tireBurstCompletely = {}
    for i = 0, 5 do
        tireBurstCompletely[tostring(i)] = IsVehicleTyreBurst(vehicle, i, true)
    end

    local windowStatus = {}
    for i = 0, 7 do
        windowStatus[tostring(i)] = IsVehicleWindowIntact(vehicle, i) == 1
    end

    local doorStatus = {}
    for i = 0, 5 do
        doorStatus[tostring(i)] = IsVehicleDoorDamaged(vehicle, i) == 1
    end
    
    local deformation = nil
    if GetResourceState('VehicleDeformation') == 'started' then
        deformation = exports['VehicleDeformation']:GetVehicleDeformation(vehicle)
    end

    return {
        model = GetEntityModel(vehicle),
        doorStatus = doorStatus,
        windowStatus = windowStatus,
        tireHealth = tireHealth,
        tireBurstState = tireBurstState,
        tireBurstCompletely = tireBurstCompletely,
        plate = QBCore.Functions.GetPlate(vehicle),
        plateIndex = GetVehicleNumberPlateTextIndex(vehicle),
        
        suspensionHeight = GetVehicleSuspensionHeight(vehicle),
        wheelSize = GetVehicleWheelSize(vehicle),
        wheelWidth = GetVehicleWheelWidth(vehicle),
        driftTyres = GetDriftTyresEnabled(vehicle),

        bodyHealth = math.floor(GetVehicleBodyHealth(vehicle)),
        engineHealth = math.floor(GetVehicleEngineHealth(vehicle)),
        tankHealth = math.floor(GetVehiclePetrolTankHealth(vehicle)),
        fuelLevel = math.floor(GetVehicleFuelLevel(vehicle)),
        dirtLevel = math.floor(GetVehicleDirtLevel(vehicle)),
        oilLevel = math.floor(GetVehicleOilLevel(vehicle)),

        deformation = deformation,
        
        color1 = colorPrimary,
        color2 = colorSecondary,

        paintTypePrimary = paintTypePrimary,
        paintTypeSecondary = paintTypeSecondary,

        dashboardColor = GetVehicleDashboardColour(vehicle),
        interiorColor = GetVehicleInteriorColour(vehicle),
        pearlescentColor = pearlescentColor,

function functions.SetVehicleProperties(vehicle, props)
    if DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then
        if props.extras then
            for id, enabled in pairs(props.extras) do
                if enabled then
                    SetVehicleExtra(vehicle, tonumber(id), 0)
                else
                    SetVehicleExtra(vehicle, tonumber(id), 1)
                end
            end
        end

        local colorPrimary, colorSecondary = GetVehicleColours(vehicle)
        local pearlescentColor, wheelColor = GetVehicleExtraColours(vehicle)
        SetVehicleModKit(vehicle, 0)
        if props.plate ~= nil then
            SetVehicleNumberPlateText(vehicle, props.plate)
        end
        if props.plateIndex ~= nil then
            SetVehicleNumberPlateTextIndex(vehicle, props.plateIndex)
        end
        if props.bodyHealth ~= nil then
            SetVehicleBodyHealth(vehicle, props.bodyHealth + 0.0)
        end
        if props.engineHealth ~= nil then
            SetVehicleEngineHealth(vehicle, props.engineHealth + 0.0)
        end
        if props.tankHealth ~= nil then
            SetVehiclePetrolTankHealth(vehicle, props.tankHealth + 0.0)
        end
        if props.fuelLevel ~= nil then
            SetVehicleFuelLevel(vehicle, props.fuelLevel + 0.0)
        end
        if props.dirtLevel ~= nil then
            SetVehicleDirtLevel(vehicle, props.dirtLevel + 0.0)
        end
        if props.oilLevel ~= nil then
            SetVehicleOilLevel(vehicle, props.oilLevel + 0.0)
        end
        if props.color1 ~= nil then
            if type(props.color1) == "number" then
                SetVehicleColours(vehicle, props.color1, type(props.color2) == "number" and props.color2 or colorSecondary)
            else
                SetVehicleCustomPrimaryColour(vehicle, props.color1[1], props.color1[2], props.color1[3])
                if props.paintTypePrimary then
                    SetVehicleModColor_1(vehicle, props.paintTypePrimary, 0, props.pearlescentColor or pearlescentColor)
                end
            end
        end
        if props.color2 ~= nil then
            if type(props.color2) == "number" then
                SetVehicleColours(vehicle, type(props.color1) == "number" and props.color1 or colorPrimary, props.color2)
                if props.paintTypePrimary and type(props.color1) ~= "number" then
                    SetVehicleModColor_1(vehicle, props.paintTypePrimary, 0, props.pearlescentColor or pearlescentColor)
                end
            else
                SetVehicleCustomSecondaryColour(vehicle, props.color2[1], props.color2[2], props.color2[3])
                if props.paintTypeSecondary then
                    SetVehicleModColor_2(vehicle, props.paintTypeSecondary, 0)
                end
            end
        end
        if props.pearlescentColor ~= nil then
            SetVehicleExtraColours(vehicle, props.pearlescentColor, wheelColor)
        end
        if props.interiorColor ~= nil then
            SetVehicleInteriorColor(vehicle, props.interiorColor)
        end
        if props.dashboardColor ~= nil then
            SetVehicleDashboardColour(vehicle, props.dashboardColor)
        end
        if props.wheelColor ~= nil then
            SetVehicleExtraColours(vehicle, props.pearlescentColor or pearlescentColor, props.wheelColor)
        end
        if props.wheels ~= nil then
            SetVehicleWheelType(vehicle, props.wheels)
        end
        if props.tireHealth ~= nil then
            for wheelIndex, health in pairs(props.tireHealth) do
                SetVehicleWheelHealth(vehicle, wheelIndex, health)
            end
        end
        if props.tireBurstState ~= nil then
            for wheelIndex, burstState in pairs(props.tireBurstState) do
                if burstState then
                    SetVehicleTyreBurst(vehicle, tonumber(wheelIndex), false, 1000.0)
                end
            end
        end
        if props.tireBurstCompletely ~= nil then
            for wheelIndex, burstState in pairs(props.tireBurstCompletely) do
                if burstState then
                    SetVehicleTyreBurst(vehicle, tonumber(wheelIndex), true, 1000.0)
                end
            end
        end
        if props.windowTint ~= nil then
            SetVehicleWindowTint(vehicle, props.windowTint)
        end
        if props.windowStatus ~= nil then
            for windowIndex, smashWindow in pairs(props.windowStatus) do
                if not smashWindow then SmashVehicleWindow(vehicle, windowIndex) end
            end
        end
        if props.doorStatus ~= nil then
            for doorIndex, breakDoor in pairs(props.doorStatus) do
                if breakDoor then
                    SetVehicleDoorBroken(vehicle, tonumber(doorIndex), true)
                end
            end
        end
        if props.neonEnabled ~= nil then
            SetVehicleNeonLightEnabled(vehicle, 0, props.neonEnabled[1])
            SetVehicleNeonLightEnabled(vehicle, 1, props.neonEnabled[2])
            SetVehicleNeonLightEnabled(vehicle, 2, props.neonEnabled[3])
            SetVehicleNeonLightEnabled(vehicle, 3, props.neonEnabled[4])
        end
        if props.neonColor ~= nil then

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_core\modules\hooks.lua
-- Modified from original source https://github.com/overextended/ox_inventory/blob/main/modules/hooks/server.lua
-- Copyright (C) 2021  Linden <https://github.com/thelindat>, Dunak <https://github.com/dunak-debug>, Luke <https://github.com/LukeWasTakenn>

assert(lib.checkDependency('ox_lib', '3.8.0', true))

local eventHooks = {}
local isServer = IsDuplicityVersion()

local getTime = isServer and os.microtime or function()
    return GetGameTimer() * 1000
end

local function triggerEventHooks(event, ...)
    local hooks = eventHooks[event]
    if not hooks then return true end

    for i = 1, #hooks do
        local hook = hooks[i]

        local start = getTime()
        local success, response = pcall(hook, ...)
        local executionTime = getTime() - start

        if executionTime >= 100000 then
            local side = isServer and "SERVER" or "CLIENT"
            warn(('[%s] Execution of event hook "%s:%s:%s" took %.2fms.'):format(side, hook.resource, event, i, executionTime / 1e3))
        end

        if not success then
            local side = isServer and "SERVER" or "CLIENT"
            warn(('[%s] Error in event hook "%s:%s:%s": %s'):format(side, hook.resource, event, i, response))
        end

        if response == false then
            return false
        end
    end

    return true
end

local hookId = 0

---Registers a callback function to be triggered by a resource. Returning false from the callback function cancels the event
---@param event string
---@param cb any
---@return integer hookId
local function registerHook(event, cb)
    if not eventHooks[event] then
        eventHooks[event] = {}
    end

    local mt = getmetatable(cb)
    mt.__index = nil
    mt.__newindex = nil
    cb.resource = GetInvokingResource()
    hookId += 1
    cb.hookId = hookId

    eventHooks[event][#eventHooks[event] + 1] = cb
    return hookId
end

local function removeResourceHooks(resource, id)
    for _, hooks in pairs(eventHooks) do
        for i = #hooks, 1, -1 do
            local hook = hooks[i]

            if hook.resource == resource and (not id or hook.hookId == id) then
                table.remove(hooks, i)
            end
        end
    end
end

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', removeResourceHooks)

---@param id number hookId
local function removeHooks(id)
    local resource = GetInvokingResource() or GetCurrentResourceName()
    removeResourceHooks(resource, id)
end

exports('registerHook', registerHook)
exports('removeHooks', removeHooks)

return triggerEventHooks

---@param cb function Callback function to execute safely
---@param ... any Arguments to pass to callback
---@return any|nil result Returns callback result or nil on error
function qbLib.safecall(cb, ...)
    assert(type(cb) == 'function', 'safecall: callback must be a function')

    local success, result = pcall(cb, ...)

    if not success then
        local info = debug.getinfo(2, 'Sl')
        local source = info.source:match('^@?(.+)$') or info.source
        local line = info.currentline or 0

        lib.print.error(('safecall failed at %s:%d\n%s'):format(source, line, result))
        return nil
    end

    return result
end

---Returns the given string with its trailing whitespaces removed.
---@param str string
---@return string
function qbLib.string.trim(str)
    local trimmed = str:gsub('^%s*(.-)%s*$', '%1')
    return trimmed
end

---Returns true if the given string is nil, empty, or contains only whitespace.
---@param str string?
---@return boolean
function qbLib.string.isEmpty(str)
    return str == nil or str:match('^%s*$') ~= nil
end

---Returns the given string with its first character capitalized.
---@param str string
---@return string
function qbLib.string.capitalize(str)
    local capitalized = str:gsub('^%l', string.upper)
    return capitalized
end

---Returns the given string with its first character lowercased (camelCase start).
---@param str string
---@return string
function qbLib.string.uncapitalize(str)
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: redundant-return-value
    return str:gsub('^%u', string.lower)
end

---Rounds and returns the given number.
---@param num number
---@param decimalPlaces? integer
---@return number rounded integer if `decimalPlaces` isn't passed, number otherwise
function qbLib.math.round(num, decimalPlaces)
    if not decimalPlaces then return math.floor(num + 0.5) end
    local power = 10 ^ decimalPlaces
    return math.floor((num * power) + 0.5) / power
end

---@param t table<string, any>
---@param fn fun(val, key):any
function qbLib.table.find(t, fn)
    for k, v in pairs(t) do
        local f = fn and fn(v, k)

        if f then
            return v, k
        end
    end
end

---Returns a shallow copy of the given table (nested tables are not cloned).
---@param tbl table
---@return table
function qbLib.table.clone(tbl)
    local copy = {}
    for k, v in pairs(tbl) do
        copy[k] = v
    end
    return copy
end

---Returns a deep copy of the given table (all nested tables are recursively cloned).
---@param tbl table
---@return table
function qbLib.table.deepclone(tbl)
    local copy = {}
    for k, v in pairs(tbl) do
        if type(v) == 'table' then
            copy[k] = qbLib.table.deepclone(v)
        else
            copy[k] = v
        end
    end
    return copy
end

---Returns the number of items in a table. Useful for non-array tables.
---@param tbl table
---@return integer
function qbLib.table.size(tbl)
    local size = 0
    for _ in pairs(tbl) do
        size += 1
    end
    return size
end

---Maps and returns the values of the given table by the given subfield.
---@param tble table
---@param subfield any
---@return table<any, table[]>
function qbLib.table.mapBySubfield(tble, subfield)
    local map = {}

    for _, subTable in pairs(tble) do
        local subfieldValue = subTable[subfield]

        if subfieldValue then
            if not map[subfieldValue] then
                map[subfieldValue] = {}
            end

            map[subfieldValue][#map[subfieldValue] + 1] = subTable
        end
    end

    return map
end

---Returns the number plate of the given vehicle.
---@param vehicle integer
---@return string?
function qbLib.getVehiclePlate(vehicle)
    local plate = GetVehicleNumberPlateText(vehicle)
    if not plate then return end
    return qbLib.string.trim(plate)
end

---Generates and returns a random number plate with the given pattern.
---Note that the generated plate may or may not be already used by an existing vehicle.
---For more info about the pattern see [`lib.string.random`](https://coxdocs.dev/ox_lib/Modules/String/Shared#stringrandom) from ox_lib.
---@param pattern? string
---@return string
function qbLib.generateRandomPlate(pattern)
    pattern = pattern or '........'
    return lib.string.random(pattern):upper()
end

---Returns the cardinal direction that the given entity is staring towards, or nil if the entity doesn't exist.
---```
---                 North
---     45Â°           0Â°           315Â°
---       \    .- - - - - - -.    /
---          X                 X
---        .'   \           /   '.
---       |        \     /        |
--- West  |           X           |  East
---       |        /     \        |
---        '.   /           \   .'
---          X                 X
---       /    '- - - - - - -'    \
---     135Â°                      225Â°
---                 South
---```
---(art inspired by [`SET_PED_TURNING_THRESHOLDS`](https://github.com/citizenfx/fivem/blob/0b61c93a3308360ea70d443398eab17f47453e11/code/components/extra-natives-five/src/PedExtraNatives.cpp#L390-L400))
---@param entity integer
---@return 'North' | 'South' | 'East' | 'West'
function qbLib.getCardinalDirection(entity)
    -- heading is between 0 - 360 (excluding 360)
    local heading = GetEntityHeading(entity) % 360

    if heading < 45 or heading >= 315 then
        return 'North'
    end

    if heading >= 45 and heading < 135 then
        return 'West'
    end

    if heading >= 135 and heading < 225 then
        return 'South'
    end

    -- heading >= 225 and heading < 315
    return 'East'
end

---@param playerGroups PlayerJob
---@param job_table string|string[]|table<string, number|number[]>
---@param required_duty? boolean
---@return boolean
function qbLib.checkGroup(playerGroups, job_table, required_duty)
    if not playerGroups then return false end

    local jn = playerGroups.name
    local jt = playerGroups.type
    local jd = playerGroups.onduty
    local jg = playerGroups.grade.level

    if required_duty and not jd then
        return false
    end

    local tt = type(job_table)

    if tt == 'string' then
        return jn == job_table or jt == job_table
    end

    if tt == 'table' then
        if lib.array.isArray(job_table) then
            return lib.table.contains(job_table, jn) or lib.table.contains(job_table, jt)
        end

        local requirement = job_table[jn] or job_table[jt]
        if not requirement then return false end

        local rt = type(requirement)

        if rt == 'number' then
            return jg >= requirement
        end

        if rt == 'table' and lib.array.isArray(requirement) then
            return lib.table.contains(requirement, jg)
        end

        return false
    end

    return false
end

if isServer then
    ---@class LibSpawnVehicleParams
    ---@field model integer
    ---@field spawnSource integer | vector3 | vector4 ped id or coords
    ---@field warp? boolean | integer a ped id to warp inside the vehicle, or additionally a boolean if `spawnSource` is a ped
    ---@field props? table https://coxdocs.dev/ox_lib/Modules/VehicleProperties/Client#vehicle-properties
    ---@field bucket? integer routing bucket to move spawned entity to.

    ---Creates a vehicle on the server-side and returns its `netId`.
    ---
    ---The `CreateVehicleServerSetter` native uses only the server to create a vehicle instead of using the client as well.
    ---To get the vehicle on the client first check and wait for it to exist using the `NetworkDoesEntityExistWithNetworkId` native,
    ---then get the vehicle's id by using `NetToVeh`.
    --[[

    lib.waitFor(function()
        if NetworkDoesEntityExistWithNetworkId(netId) then
            return NetToVeh(netId)
        end
    end)
    ]]
    ---@param params LibSpawnVehicleParams
    ---@return integer netId
    ---@return number veh
    function qbLib.spawnVehicle(params)
        local model = params.model
        local source = params.spawnSource
        local sourceType = type(source)
        local warp = params.warp
        local ped = type(warp) == 'number' and warp or (sourceType == 'number' and warp and source or nil)
        local props = params.props
        local bucket = params.bucket or ped and GetEntityRoutingBucket(ped) or nil

        ---@type vector4
        local coords
        if sourceType == 'vector3' then
            coords = vec4(source.x, source.y, source.z, 0)
        elseif sourceType == 'vector4' then
            coords = source
        else
            local pedCoords = GetEntityCoords(source)
            coords = vec4(pedCoords.x, pedCoords.y, pedCoords.z, GetEntityHeading(source))
        end

        local vehData = exports.sm_core:GetVehiclesByHash(joaat(model))
        local vehicleType = vehData and vehData.type or nil

        if not vehicleType then
            warn(('No vehicle type found for model: %s temp vehicle was created and taken in type'):format(model))
            local tempVehicle = CreateVehicle(model, 0, 0, -200, 0, true, true)
            while not DoesEntityExist(tempVehicle) do Wait(0) end
            vehicleType = GetVehicleType(tempVehicle)
            DeleteEntity(tempVehicle)
        end

        local attempts = 0

        local veh, netId
        while attempts < 3 do
            veh = CreateVehicleServerSetter(model, vehicleType, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, coords.w)

            if bucket and bucket > 0 then
                exports.sm_core:SetEntityBucket(veh, bucket)
            end

            while not DoesEntityExist(veh) do Wait(0) end
            while GetVehicleNumberPlateText(veh) == '' do Wait(0) end

            if ped then
                SetPedIntoVehicle(ped, veh, -1)
            end

            if not pcall(function()
                lib.waitFor(function()
                    local owner = NetworkGetEntityOwner(veh)
                    if ped then
                        --- the owner should be transferred to the driver
                        if owner == NetworkGetEntityOwner(ped) then return true end
                    else
                        if owner ~= -1 then return true end
                    end
                end, 'client never set as owner', 15000)
            end) then
                DeleteEntity(veh)
                error('Deleting vehicle which timed out finding an owner')
            end

            local state = Entity(veh).state
            local owner = NetworkGetEntityOwner(veh)
            state:set('initVehicle', true, true)
            netId = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(veh)
            if props and type(props) == 'table' and props.plate then
                TriggerClientEvent('sm_core:client:setVehicleProperties', owner, netId, props)
                local success = pcall(function()
                    local plateMatched = false
                    lib.waitFor(function()
                        if qbLib.string.trim(GetVehicleNumberPlateText(veh)) == qbLib.string.trim(props.plate) then
                            local currentOwner = NetworkGetEntityOwner(veh)
                            assert(currentOwner == owner, ('Owner changed during vehicle init. expected=%s, actual=%s'):format(owner, currentOwner))
                            --- check that the plate matches twice, 100ms apart as a bug has been observed in which server side matches but plate is not observed by clients to match
                            if plateMatched then
                                return true
                            end
                            plateMatched = true
                            Wait(100)
                        end
                    end, 'Failed to set vehicle properties within 5 second', 5000)
                end)
                if success then
                    break
                else
                    DeleteEntity(veh)
                    attempts += 1
                end
            else
                break
            end
        end

        if attempts == 3 then
            error('unable to successfully spawn vehicle after 3 attempts')
        end

        --- prevent server from deleting a vehicle without an owner
        SetEntityOrphanMode(veh, 2)
        return netId, veh
    end
else
    ---@class LibDrawTextParams
    ---@field text string
    ---@field scale? integer default: `0.35`
    ---@field font? integer default: `4`
    ---@field color? vector4 rgba, white by default
    ---@field enableDropShadow? boolean
    ---@field enableOutline? boolean

    ---@class LibDrawText2DParams : LibDrawTextParams
    ---@field coords vector2
    ---@field width? number default: `1.0`
    ---@field height? number default: `1.0`

    ---Draws text onto the screen in 2D space for a single frame.
    ---@param params LibDrawText2DParams
    function qbLib.drawText2d(params)
        local text = params.text
        local coords = params.coords
        local scale = params.scale or 0.35
        local font = params.font or 4
        local color = params.color or vec4(255, 255, 255, 255)
        local width = params.width or 1.0
        local height = params.height or 1.0
        local enableDropShadow = params.enableDropShadow or false
        local enableOutline = params.enableOutline or false

        SetTextScale(scale, scale)
        SetTextFont(font)
        SetTextColour(math.floor(color.r), math.floor(color.g), math.floor(color.b), math.floor(color.a))
        if enableDropShadow then
            SetTextDropShadow()
        end
        if enableOutline then
            SetTextOutline()
        end

        SetTextCentre(true)
        BeginTextCommandDisplayText('STRING')
        AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(text)
        EndTextCommandDisplayText(coords.x - width / 2, coords.y - height / 2 + 0.005)
    end

    ---@class LibDrawText3DParams : LibDrawTextParams
    ---@field coords vector3
    ---@field disableDrawRect? boolean
    ---@field scale? integer | vector2 default: `vec2(0.35,0.35)`

    ---Draws text onto the screen in 3D space for a single frame.
    ---@param params LibDrawText3DParams
    function qbLib.drawText3d(params) -- luacheck: ignore
        local isScaleparamANumber = type(params.scale) == "number"
        local text = params.text
        local coords = params.coords

        ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: param-type-mismatch
        local scale = (isScaleparamANumber and vec2(params.scale, params.scale))
        or params.scale
        or vec2(0.35, 0.35)

        local font = params.font or 4
        local color = params.color or vec4(255, 255, 255, 255)
        local enableDropShadow = params.enableDropShadow or false
        local enableOutline = params.enableOutline or false

        SetTextScale(scale.x, scale.y)
        SetTextFont(font)
        SetTextColour(math.floor(color.r), math.floor(color.g), math.floor(color.b), math.floor(color.a))
        if enableDropShadow then
            SetTextDropShadow()
        end
        if enableOutline then
            SetTextOutline()
        end
        SetTextCentre(true)
        BeginTextCommandDisplayText('STRING')
        AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(text)
        SetDrawOrigin(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, 0)
        EndTextCommandDisplayText(0.0, 0.0)

        if not params.disableDrawRect then
            local factor = #text / 370
            DrawRect(0.0, 0.0125, 0.017 + factor, 0.03, 0, 0, 0, 75)
        end
        ClearDrawOrigin()
    end

    ---Gets and returns an entity handle and network id from a state bag name
    ---([source](https://github.com/overextended/ox_core/blob/main/client/utils.lua)).
    ---Statebag handlers receive changes for every entity on the server, including
    ---entities outside this client's scope which will never exist locally. Those
    ---must return quietly instead of throwing, so the wait is short and guarded.
    ---@async
    ---@param bagName string
    ---@return integer? entity, integer? netId
    function qbLib.getEntityAndNetIdFromBagName(bagName)
        local netId = tonumber(bagName:gsub('entity:', ''), 10)
        if not netId then return end

        if NetworkDoesEntityExistWithNetworkId(netId) then
            return NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netId), netId
        end

        local ok, entity = pcall(lib.waitFor, function()
            if NetworkDoesEntityExistWithNetworkId(netId) then
                return NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netId)
            end
        end, nil, 1500)

        if not ok or not entity or entity == 0 then return end

        return entity, netId
    end

    ---Returns a state bag handler made for entities
    ---([source](https://github.com/overextended/ox_core/blob/main/client/utils.lua)).
    ---@param keyFilter string
    ---@param cb fun(entity: number, netId: number, value: any, bagName: string)
    ---@return number
    function qbLib.entityStateHandler(keyFilter, cb)
        return AddStateBagChangeHandler(keyFilter, '', function(bagName, _, value)
            local entity, netId = qbLib.getEntityAndNetIdFromBagName(bagName)
            if not entity or entity == 0 or not netId then return end

            cb(entity, netId, value, bagName)
        end)
    end

    ---Deletes the specified vehicle and returns whether it was successful.
    ---@param vehicle integer
    ---@return boolean deleted
    function qbLib.deleteVehicle(vehicle)
        SetEntityAsMissionEntity(vehicle, true, true)
        DeleteVehicle(vehicle)
        return not DoesEntityExist(vehicle)
    end

    ---Returns if the local ped is wearing gloves.
    ---@return boolean
    function qbLib.isWearingGloves()
        local armIndex = GetPedDrawableVariation(cache.ped, 3)
        local model = GetEntityModel(cache.ped)
        local tble = qbLib.armsWithoutGloves[model == `mp_m_freemode_01` and 'male' or 'female']
        return not tble[armIndex]
    end

    --- Returns if the local ped is wearing a duffel bag.
    --- @return boolean
    function qbLib.isWearingDuffelbag()

        local model = GetEntityModel(cache.ped)
        local tble = qbLib.duffelbagIndexes[model == `mp_m_freemode_01` and 'male' or 'female']
        return tble[torsoIndex] == true
    end

    ---Attempts to load an audio bank and returns whether it was successful.
    ---Remember to use `ReleaseScriptAudioBank` since you can only load up to 10 banks.
    ---@param audioBank string
    ---@param timeout number?
    ---@return boolean
    function qbLib.loadAudioBank(audioBank, timeout)
        return lib.waitFor(function()
            if RequestScriptAudioBank(audioBank, false) then
                return true
            end
        end, ('timed out while requesting audio bank! (%s)'):format(audioBank), timeout or 500) or false
    end

    ---@class LibPlayAudioParams
    ---@field audioName string
    ---@field audioRef string
    ---@field returnSoundId? boolean
    ---@field audioSource? number | vector3 entity handle or vector3 coords
    ---@field range? number only used if `audioSource` is a vector3 coordinate

    ---@deprecated use mana_audio instead
    ---Plays a sound with the provided audio name and audio ref.
    ---If `returnSoundId` is false or not specified the soundId is released,
    ---otherwise the function returns the soundId without releasing it.
    ---@param params LibPlayAudioParams
    ---@return number? soundId
    function qbLib.playAudio(params)
        local audioName = params.audioName
        local audioRef = params.audioRef
        local returnSoundId = params.returnSoundId or false
        local source = params.audioSource
        local range = params.range or 5.0

        local soundId = GetSoundId()

        local sourceType = type(source)
        if sourceType == 'vector3' then
            local coords = source
            PlaySoundFromCoord(soundId, audioName, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, audioRef, false, range, false)
        elseif sourceType == 'number' then
            PlaySoundFromEntity(soundId, audioName, source, audioRef, false, false)
        else
            PlaySoundFrontend(soundId, audioName, audioRef, true)
        end

        if returnSoundId then
            return soundId
        end

        ReleaseSoundId(soundId)
    end
end

---@meta

if lib.context == 'server' then return end

local sm_core = exports.sm_core

local data = sm_core:GetPlayerData() or {}
local proxies = setmetatable({}, { __mode = 'k' })

local readonly

local function wrap(value)
    return type(value) == 'table' and readonly(value) or value
end

---@generic T : table
---@param source T
---@return T
function readonly(source)
    local proxy = proxies[source]
    if proxy then return proxy end

    proxy = setmetatable({}, {
        __index = function(_, key) return wrap(source[key]) end,
        __newindex = function(_, key)
            error(('cannot set values on a read-only table (%s)'):format(tostring(key)), 2)
        end,
        __len = function() return #source end,
        __pairs = function()
            return function(_, key)
                local k, v = next(source, key)
                return k, wrap(v)
            end, source, nil
        end,
        __metatable = 'readonly',
    })

    proxies[source] = proxy

    return proxy
end

QBPlayerData = readonly(data)

local function setData(payload)
    table.wipe(data)

    for key, value in pairs(payload) do
        data[key] = value
    end
end

AddEventHandler('QBCore:Client:OnPlayerLoaded', function()
    setData(sm_core:GetPlayerData() or {})
end)

sm_core:registerHook('core:updatePlayerDataBykey', function(key, value, subValue)
    if key == 'all' then
        setData(value or {})
        return
    end

    if subValue == nil then
        data[key] = value
        return
    end

    local field = data[key]

    if type(field) ~= 'table' then
        field = {}
        data[key] = field
    end

    field[value] = subValue
end)

local function applyBlipOptions(handle, opts)
    SetBlipSprite(handle, opts.sprite or 1)
    SetBlipColour(handle, opts.color or 0)
    SetBlipScale(handle, opts.scale or 0.8)
    SetBlipAlpha(handle, opts.alpha or 255)
    SetBlipDisplay(handle, opts.display or 4)
    SetBlipCategory(handle, opts.category or 0)
    SetBlipPriority(handle, opts.priority or 0)
    SetBlipAsShortRange(handle, opts.shortRange or false)

    local label = opts.label or 'Blip'
    BeginTextCommandSetBlipName('STRING')
    AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(label)
    EndTextCommandSetBlipName(handle)

    if opts.flashes then
        SetBlipFlashes(handle, true)
        if opts.flashTimer and opts.flashTimer > 0 then
            SetBlipFlashTimer(handle, opts.flashTimer)
        end
    end
end

---Create a blip at specific world coordinates.
---@param opts BlipOptions
---@return string id  Unique blip ID for later reference
function functions.Add(opts)
    assert(opts and opts.coords, '[sm_core:blip] opts.coords is required')

    local coords = opts.coords
    local handle = AddBlipForCoord(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)
    applyBlipOptions(handle, opts)

    local id = generateId()
    blips[id] = { handle = handle, type = 'coords', id = id }
    return id
end

---Create a radius (circle) blip at specific world coordinates.
---@param opts RadiusBlipOptions
---@return string id  Unique blip ID for later reference
function functions.AddRadius(opts)
    assert(opts and opts.coords, '[sm_core:blip] opts.coords is required')
    assert(opts.radius and opts.radius > 0, '[sm_core:blip] opts.radius must be > 0')

    local coords = opts.coords
    local handle = AddBlipForRadius(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, opts.radius)

    SetBlipColour(handle, opts.color or 2)
    SetBlipAlpha(handle, opts.alpha or 80)

    if opts.label then
        BeginTextCommandSetBlipName('STRING')
        AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(opts.label)
        EndTextCommandSetBlipName(handle)
    end

    local id = generateId()
    blips[id] = { handle = handle, type = 'radius', id = id }
    return id
end

---Create a blip attached to an entity (vehicle, ped, object).
---@param entity integer Entity handle
---@param opts BlipOptions
---@return string id
function functions.AddForEntity(entity, opts)
    assert(entity and DoesEntityExist(entity), '[sm_core:blip] entity does not exist')

    local handle = AddBlipForEntity(entity)
    applyBlipOptions(handle, opts or {})

    local id = generateId()
    blips[id] = { handle = handle, type = 'entity', id = id }
    return id
end

---Remove a blip by its ID.
---@param id string
function functions.Remove(id)
    local entry = blips[id]
    if not entry then return end

    if DoesBlipExist(entry.handle) then
        RemoveBlip(entry.handle)
    end

    blips[id] = nil
end

---Remove all blips managed by this module.
function functions.RemoveAll()
    for id, entry in pairs(blips) do
        if DoesBlipExist(entry.handle) then
            RemoveBlip(entry.handle)
        end
        blips[id] = nil
    end
end

QBCore.Commands = QBCore.Commands or {}

local ADMIN = 'group.admin'
local notify = function(src, text, kind) QBCore.Functions.Notify(src, text, kind or 'inform') end

---Shim API lama qb-core: QBCore.Commands.Add(name, help, arguments, argsrequired, callback, permission)
function QBCore.Commands.Add(name, help, arguments, argsrequired, callback, permission)
    local params = {}
    for i = 1, #(arguments or {}) do
        local arg = arguments[i]
        params[i] = { name = arg.name, help = arg.help, type = 'string', optional = not argsrequired }
    end

    local restricted = false
    if permission and permission ~= 'user' then restricted = 'group.' .. permission end

    lib.addCommand(name, { help = help, params = params, restricted = restricted }, function(source, args, raw)
        local list = {}
        for i = 1, #params do list[#list + 1] = args[params[i].name] end
        callback(source, list, raw)
    end)
end

function QBCore.Commands.Refresh() end -- suggestion sudah ditangani ox_lib

local function hasPlayerInside(vehicle)
    for seat = -1, 6 do
        local ped = GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, seat)
        if ped and ped ~= 0 and IsPedAPlayer(ped) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function getPlayer(src, id)
    local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(id)
    if not player then notify(src, Lang:t('error.not_online'), 'error') end
    return player
end

lib.addCommand('tp', {
    help = Lang:t('command.tp.help'),
    params = {
        { name = 'x', type = 'string', help = Lang:t('command.tp.params.x.help'), optional = true },
        { name = 'y', type = 'number', help = Lang:t('command.tp.params.y.help'), optional = true },
        { name = 'z', type = 'number', help = Lang:t('command.tp.params.z.help'), optional = true },
    },
    restricted = ADMIN,
}, function(source, args)
    if args.x and not args.y then
        local target = tonumber(args.x)
        if not target or not GetPlayerName(tostring(target)) then
            return notify(source, Lang:t('error.not_online'), 'error')
        end
        local coords = GetEntityCoords(GetPlayerPed(tostring(target)))
        TriggerClientEvent('qb_event_client:tptocoords', source, { coords.x, coords.y, coords.z })
    elseif args.x and args.y and args.z then
        local x = tonumber(args.x)
        if not x then return notify(source, Lang:t('error.wrong_format'), 'error') end
        TriggerClientEvent('qb_event_client:tptocoords', source, { x, args.y, args.z })
    else
        notify(source, Lang:t('error.missing_args'), 'error')
    end
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[00_core]\sm_core\server\connecting.lua
-- Rekonstruksi sm_core/server/connecting.lua

local function nowUnix() return os.time() end

local function checkBan(src)
    local license = PlayerIdentifier(src, 'license')
    local alt = PlayerIdentifier(src, QBConfig.LicenseType)
    local discord = PlayerIdentifier(src, 'discord')
    local ip = PlayerIdentifier(src, 'ip')

    local row = db.single_async(
        'SELECT id, reason, expire FROM bans WHERE license = ? OR license = ? OR discord = ? OR ip = ? ORDER BY expire DESC LIMIT 1',
        { license or '', alt or '', discord or '', ip or '' })
    if not row then return end

    local expire = tonumber(row.expire) or 0
    if expire > 2147483646 or expire > nowUnix() then
        local remaining = expire > 2147483646 and 'permanen' or os.date('%d-%m-%Y %H:%M', expire)
        return ('Kamu dibanned.\nAlasan: %s\nBerakhir: %s\nDiscord: %s'):format(
            row.reason or '-', remaining, QBConfig.Server.Discord)
    end

    db.update_async('DELETE FROM bans WHERE id = ?', { row.id }) -- ban kedaluwarsa
end

local function onPlayerConnecting(name, setKickReason, deferrals)
    local src = source
    deferrals.defer()
    Wait(0) -- wajib sebelum deferrals.update/done

    if QBConfig.Server.Closed and not IsPlayerAceAllowed(tostring(src), 'qbadmin.join') then
        return deferrals.done(QBConfig.Server.ClosedReason)
    end

    local license = PlayerIdentifier(src, QBConfig.LicenseType)
    if not license then
        if QBConfig.LicenseType == 'steam' then
            return deferrals.done('Steam tidak terdeteksi. Buka Steam, lalu jalankan ulang FiveM.')
        end
        return deferrals.done(Lang:t('error.no_valid_license'))
    end

    if QBConfig.Server.CheckDuplicateLicense and QBCore.Functions.IsLicenseInUse(license) then
        return deferrals.done(Lang:t('error.duplicate_license'))
    end

    deferrals.update(Lang:t('info.checking_ban'):format(name))
    local ok, banReason = pcall(checkBan, src)
    if not ok then
        lib.print.error(banReason)
        return deferrals.done(Lang:t('error.connecting_database_error'))
    end
    if banReason then return deferrals.done(banReason) end

    if QBConfig.Server.Whitelist then
        deferrals.update(Lang:t('info.checking_whitelisted'):format(name))
        if not QBCore.Functions.IsWhitelisted(src) then
            return deferrals.done(Lang:t('error.not_whitelisted'))
        end
    end

    deferrals.done()
end

AddEventHandler('playerConnecting', onPlayerConnecting)

-- Rekonstruksi sm_core/server/debug.lua

local function dump(obj, indent)
    indent = indent or 0
    if type(obj) ~= 'table' then return tostring(obj) end
    local pad = ('  '):rep(indent)
    local out = '{\n'
    for k, v in pairs(obj) do
        out = out .. ('%s  %s = %s\n'):format(pad, tostring(k), type(v) == 'table' and dump(v, indent + 1) or tostring(v))
    end
    return out .. pad .. '}'
end

function QBCore.Debug(resource, obj)
    print(('^3[DEBUG:%s]^7 %s'):format(resource or 'unknown', dump(obj)))
end

function QBCore.ShowError(resource, msg)
    print(('^1[ERROR:%s]^7 %s'):format(resource or 'unknown', msg))
end

function QBCore.ShowSuccess(resource, msg)
    print(('^2[OK:%s]^7 %s'):format(resource or 'unknown', msg))
end

AddEventHandler('QBCore:DebugSomething', function(resource, obj)
    QBCore.Debug(resource, obj)
end)

local function GetQBPlayers()
    return QBCore.Players
end

exports('GetQBPlayers', GetQBPlayers)
