########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\rhd_interact\framework\init.lua
local function isStarted(resource, alias)
    return GetResourceState(resource) == 'started' and (alias or resource)
end

local qb = isStarted('qb-core', 'qb')
local esx = isStarted('es_extended', 'esx')
local qbox = isStarted('qbx_core', 'qbox')

local framework = qbox or qb or esx

local path = ('framework.%s.%s'):format(framework, lib.context)

require(path)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\rhd_interact\framework\qb\client.lua
local Player = {}
local qbcore = exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject()

Player.Loaded = LocalPlayer.state.isLoggedIn
Player.PlayerData = qbcore.Functions.GetPlayerData() or {}

local function loadGroups()
    Player.groups = {
        job = Player.PlayerData.job,
        gang = Player.PlayerData.gang
    }
end

CreateThread(loadGroups)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:OnJobUpdate', function(job)
    if not Player.groups?.job then return end

    local old = Player.groups.job

    Player.groups.job = job
    TriggerEvent('rhd_interact:groupsChanged', old, Player.groups)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:OnGangUpdate', function(gang)
    if not Player.groups?.gang then return end
    
    local old = Player.groups.gang

    Player.groups.gang = gang
    TriggerEvent('rhd_interact:groupsChanged', old, Player.groups)
end)


RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:OnPlayerLoaded', function ()
    Player.Loaded = true
    loadGroups()
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:OnPlayerUnload', function()
    Player.Loaded = false
    Player.PlayerData = {}
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Player:SetPlayerData', function(val)

local Player = {}
local qbx_core = exports.qbx_core

Player.Loaded = LocalPlayer.state.isLoggedIn
Player.PlayerData = qbx_core:GetPlayerData() or {}

local function loadGroups()
    Player.groups = {
        job = Player.PlayerData.job,
        gang = Player.PlayerData.gang
    }
end

CreateThread(loadGroups)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:OnJobUpdate', function(job)
    if not Player.groups?.job then return end

    local old = Player.groups.job

    Player.groups.job = job
    TriggerEvent('rhd_interact:groupsChanged', old, Player.groups)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:OnGangUpdate', function(gang)
    if not Player.groups?.gang then return end
    
    local old = Player.groups.gang

    Player.groups.gang = gang
    TriggerEvent('rhd_interact:groupsChanged', old, Player.groups)
end)


RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:OnPlayerLoaded', function ()
    Player.Loaded = true
    loadGroups()
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:OnPlayerUnload', function()
    Player.Loaded = false
    Player.PlayerData = {}
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Player:SetPlayerData', function(val)
    Player.PlayerData = val
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\sm_barbershop\modules\nui.lua
local open = {}

local Nui = {}

local function refresh()
    local focused = next(open) ~= nil

    SetNuiFocus(focused, focused)
end

---@param name string
---@param action string
---@param data any
function Nui.open(name, action, data)
    open[name] = true
    SendNUIMessage({ action = action, data = data })
    refresh()
end

---@param name string
---@param action string
function Nui.close(name, action)
    if not open[name] then return end

    open[name] = nil
    SendNUIMessage({ action = action })
    refresh()
end

---@param name string
---@return boolean
function Nui.isOpen(name)
    return open[name] == true
end

---@param name string
---@param handler fun(payload: table): any
function Nui.callback(name, handler)
    RegisterNUICallback(name, function(payload, cb)
        local ok, result = pcall(handler, payload or {})

        if not ok then
            lib.print.error(('nui callback %s failed: %s'):format(name, result))
            cb({})

            return
        end

        cb(result == nil and {} or result)
    end)
end

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource then return end

    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
end)

return Nui


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\sm_barbershop\modules\pricing.lua
local config = Config

local Pricing = {}

local OPACITY_EPSILON = 0.001

local MIN_VALUES = {
    style = -1,
    texture = 0,
    color = 0,
    highlight = 0,
    secondColor = 0,
    fade = -1,
    eyeColor = 0,
}

---@type table<string, BarberPriceItem>
local byKey = {}

for i = 1, #config.priceItems do
    local item = config.priceItems[i]

    byKey[item.key] = item
end

Pricing.byKey = byKey

---@type table<string, BarberPriceGroup>
local groups = {}

for i = 1, #config.priceGroups do
    groups[config.priceGroups[i].id] = config.priceGroups[i]
end

---@param key string
---@return integer min
---@return integer max
function Pricing.bounds(key)
    local item = byKey[key]
    local group = item and groups[item.group]

    if not group then return 0, 0 end

    return group.min, group.max
end

---@param key string
---@return integer
function Pricing.defaultPrice(key)
    local min, max = Pricing.bounds(key)

    return math.floor((min + max) / 2)
end

---@param key string
---@return string section
---@return string? field
local function split(key)
    local section, field = key:match('^(%w+)%.(%w+)$')

    if section then
        return section, field
    end

    return key
end

---@param appearance table
---@param key string
---@return number?
function Pricing.read(appearance, key)
    local section, field = split(key)

    if not field then
        return tonumber(appearance[section])
    end

    local source = section == 'hair' and appearance.hair or (appearance.headOverlays and appearance.headOverlays[section])

    return source and tonumber(source[field]) or nil
end

---@param appearance table
---@param key string
---@param value number
function Pricing.write(appearance, key, value)
    local section, field = split(key)

    if not field then
        appearance[section] = value

        return
    end

    if section == 'hair' then
        appearance.hair = appearance.hair or {}
        appearance.hair[field] = value

        return
    end

    appearance.headOverlays = appearance.headOverlays or {}
    appearance.headOverlays[section] = appearance.headOverlays[section] or { style = 0, opacity = 0.0, color = 0, secondColor = 0 }
    appearance.headOverlays[section][field] = value
end

---@param field string
---@param value any
---@return number?
local function normalizeField(field, value)
    local number = tonumber(value)

    if not number or number ~= number then return end

    if field == 'opacity' then
        return math.floor(math.min(1, math.max(0, number)) * 100 + 0.5) / 100
    end

    local min = MIN_VALUES[field]
    local integer = min and math.tointeger(math.floor(number))

    if not integer or integer < min then return end

    return integer
end

---@param key string
---@param value any
---@return number?
function Pricing.normalize(key, value)
    if not byKey[key] then return end

    local _, field = split(key)

    return normalizeField(field or key, value)
end

local HAIR_FIELDS = { 'style', 'texture', 'color', 'highlight', 'fade' }
local OVERLAY_FIELDS = { 'style', 'opacity', 'color', 'secondColor' }

local OVERLAYS = {
    blemishes = true,
    beard = true,
    eyebrows = true,
    ageing = true,
    makeUp = true,
    blush = true,
    complexion = true,
    sunDamage = true,
    lipstick = true,
    moleAndFreckles = true,
    chestHair = true,
    bodyBlemishes = true,
}

---@param values any
---@return BarberAppearanceFields?
function Pricing.sanitizePreview(values)
    if type(values) ~= 'table' then return end

    local clean, any = {}, false

    if values.hair ~= nil then
        if type(values.hair) ~= 'table' then return end

        local hair = {}

        for i = 1, #HAIR_FIELDS do
            local field = HAIR_FIELDS[i]
            local value = normalizeField(field, values.hair[field])

            if value == nil then return end

            hair[field] = value
        end

        clean.hair, any = hair, true
    end

    if values.headOverlays ~= nil then
        if type(values.headOverlays) ~= 'table' then return end

        local overlays = {}

        for name, overlay in pairs(values.headOverlays) do
            if not OVERLAYS[name] or type(overlay) ~= 'table' then return end

            local entry = {}

            for i = 1, #OVERLAY_FIELDS do
                local field = OVERLAY_FIELDS[i]
                local value = normalizeField(field, overlay[field])

                if value == nil then return end

                entry[field] = value
            end

            overlays[name] = entry
            any = true
        end

        clean.headOverlays = overlays
    end

    if values.eyeColor ~= nil then
        local value = normalizeField('eyeColor', values.eyeColor)

        if value == nil then return end

        clean.eyeColor, any = value, true
    end

    return any and clean or nil
end

---@param appearance table
---@return BarberAppearanceFields
function Pricing.barberFields(appearance)
    return {
        hair = appearance.hair,
        headOverlays = appearance.headOverlays,
        eyeColor = appearance.eyeColor,
    }
end

---@param items BarberLineItem[]
---@return { label: string, price: integer }[]
function Pricing.describe(items)
    local lines = {}

    for i = 1, #items do
        local item = items[i]
        local group = groups[item.group] and groups[item.group].label or item.group

        lines[i] = {
            label = item.key == item.group and group or ('%s Â· %s'):format(group, item.label),
            price = item.price,
        }
    end

    return lines
end

---@param values any
---@return table<string, number>
function Pricing.sanitize(values)
    local clean = {}

    if type(values) ~= 'table' then return clean end

    for key, value in pairs(values) do
        if type(key) == 'string' then
            clean[key] = Pricing.normalize(key, value)
        end
    end

    return clean
end

---@param key string
---@param before number?
---@param after number?
---@return boolean
local function differs(key, before, after)
    if before == nil or after == nil then
        return before ~= after
    end

    if key:sub(-8) == '.opacity' then
        return math.abs(before - after) > OPACITY_EPSILON
    end

    return before ~= after
end

---@param original table
---@param values table<string, number>
---@param prices table<string, number>
---@return table final
---@return BarberLineItem[] items
---@return integer total
function Pricing.apply(original, values, prices)
    local final = lib.table.deepclone(original)
    local changed = {}

    for i = 1, #config.priceItems do
        local key = config.priceItems[i].key
        local value = values[key]

        if value ~= nil and differs(key, Pricing.read(original, key), value) then
            Pricing.write(final, key, value)
            changed[key] = true
        end
    end

    local items, total = {}, 0

    for i = 1, #config.priceItems do
        local item = config.priceItems[i]

        if changed[item.key] then
            local price = (item.includedWith and changed[item.includedWith]) and 0 or math.floor(prices[item.key] or 0)

            items[#items + 1] = { key = item.key, group = item.group, label = item.label, price = price }
            total += price
        end
    end

    return final, items, total
end

local CUT_GROUPS = { hair = true, beard = true, eyebrows = true, chestHair = true }

---@param items BarberLineItem[]
---@return boolean
function Pricing.needsCut(items)
    for i = 1, #items do
        if CUT_GROUPS[items[i].group] then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

return Pricing

---@param row table
---@return BarberServiceLog

    return {
        id = row.id,
        mode = row.mode,
        customerName = row.customer_name,
        employeeName = row.employee_name,
        amount = tonumber(row.amount) or 0,
        commission = tonumber(row.commission) or 0,
        date = row.date,
        at = row.at,
    }
end

---@return BarberTransactionLog
local function mapTransaction(row)
    return {
        id = row.id,
        type = row.tx_type,
        amount = tonumber(row.amount) or 0,
        balanceAfter = tonumber(row.balance_after) or 0,
        actorName = row.actor_name,
        note = row.note,
        date = row.date,
        at = row.at,
    }
end

---@param search string?
---@return string?
local function likePattern(search)
    if type(search) ~= 'string' or search == '' then return end

    return '%' .. search:gsub('[\\%%_]', '\\%0') .. '%'
end

---@param items table[]
---@param page integer
---@param pageSize integer
---@param total integer
---@return table
local function pageOf(items, page, pageSize, total)
    return {
        items = items,
        page = page,
        pageSize = pageSize,
        total = total,
        numberOfPages = math.max(1, math.ceil(total / pageSize)),
    }
end

---@param tableName string
---@param column string
---@return boolean
local function columnExists(tableName, column)
    local count = tonumber(db:scalar_async([[
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS
        WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = ? AND COLUMN_NAME = ?
    ]], { tableName, column })) or 0

    return count > 0
end

---@param tableName string
---@param column string
---@param definition string
local function ensureColumn(tableName, column, definition)
    if not columnExists(tableName, column) then
        db:query_async(('ALTER TABLE `%s` ADD COLUMN `%s` %s'):format(tableName, column, definition))
    end
end

---@param tableName string
---@param column string
local function dropColumn(tableName, column)
    if columnExists(tableName, column) then
        db:query_async(('ALTER TABLE `%s` DROP COLUMN `%s`'):format(tableName, column))
    end
end

function storage.ensureTables()
    db:query_async([[
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sm_barbershop_shops` (
            `shop_id` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
            `owner_citizenid` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
            `owner_name` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,

            `self_service_rate` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            `item_prices` text DEFAULT NULL,
            `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            PRIMARY KEY (`shop_id`),
            KEY `owner_citizenid` (`owner_citizenid`)
        ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
    ]])

    ensureColumn('sm_barbershop_shops', 'name', 'varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL AFTER `shop_id`')
    ensureColumn('sm_barbershop_shops', 'self_service_rate', 'int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 AFTER `commission_rate`')
    ensureColumn('sm_barbershop_shops', 'item_prices', 'text DEFAULT NULL AFTER `self_service_rate`')
    dropColumn('sm_barbershop_shops', 'self_service_price')
    dropColumn('sm_barbershop_shops', 'service_price')

    db:query_async([[
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sm_barbershop_employees` (
            `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,

            `citizenid` varchar(64) NOT NULL,

            PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
            UNIQUE KEY `shop_employee` (`shop_id`, `citizenid`),
            KEY `citizenid` (`citizenid`)
        ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
    ]])

    db:query_async([[
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sm_barbershop_services` (

            `amount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            `commission` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            `items` text DEFAULT NULL,
            `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
            KEY `shop_created` (`shop_id`, `created_at`),
            KEY `shop_employee` (`shop_id`, `employee_citizenid`)
        ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
    ]])

    ensureColumn('sm_barbershop_services', 'items', 'text DEFAULT NULL AFTER `commission`')

    db:query_async([[
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sm_barbershop_transactions` (
            `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
            `shop_id` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
            `tx_type` varchar(16) NOT NULL,

            `actor_citizenid` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
            `actor_name` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
            `note` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
            `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
            KEY `shop_created` (`shop_id`, `created_at`)
        ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
    ]])

    db:query_async([[
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sm_barbershop_roles` (

    ]])

---@return table<string, table>
function storage.loadShops()
    local rows = db:query_async('SELECT * FROM `sm_barbershop_shops`')
    local byId = {}

    if type(rows) == 'table' then
        for i = 1, #rows do
            byId[rows[i].shop_id] = rows[i]
        end
    end

    return byId
end

---@param shop BarberShop
function storage.saveShop(shop)
    db:insert_async([[
        INSERT INTO `sm_barbershop_shops`
            (shop_id, name, owner_citizenid, owner_name, balance, commission_rate, self_service_rate, item_prices)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
            name = VALUES(name),
            owner_citizenid = VALUES(owner_citizenid),
            owner_name = VALUES(owner_name),
            balance = VALUES(balance),
            commission_rate = VALUES(commission_rate),
            self_service_rate = VALUES(self_service_rate),
            item_prices = VALUES(item_prices)
    ]], {
        shop.id,
        shop.label ~= shop.defaultLabel and shop.label or nil,
        shop.ownerCitizenId,
        shop.ownerName,
        shop.balance,
        shop.commissionRate,
        shop.selfServiceRate,
        json.encode(shop.itemPrices),
    })
end

function storage.loadEmployees()

        SELECT shop_id, citizenid, name, role, DATE_FORMAT(hired_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS hired_at
        FROM `sm_barbershop_employees`
        ORDER BY id ASC
    ]])

    return type(rows) == 'table' and rows or {}
end

---@param shopId string
---@param page integer
---@param pageSize integer
---@param search string?
---@return BarberServicePage
function storage.getServiceLogs(shopId, page, pageSize, search)
    local pattern = likePattern(search)
    local filter = pattern and ' AND (customer_name LIKE ? OR employee_name LIKE ?)' or ''
    local params = pattern and { shopId, pattern, pattern } or { shopId }

    local total = tonumber(db:scalar_async(
        'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `sm_barbershop_services` WHERE shop_id = ?' .. filter,
        params
    )) or 0

    local rows = db:query_async(([[
        SELECT id, mode, customer_name, employee_name, amount, commission,
            DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%%Y-%%m-%%d') AS date, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%%H:%%i') AS at
        FROM `sm_barbershop_services`
        WHERE shop_id = ?%s
        ORDER BY id DESC
        LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
    ]]):format(filter), pattern
        and { shopId, pattern, pattern, pageSize, (page - 1) * pageSize }
        or { shopId, pageSize, (page - 1) * pageSize })

    local items = {}

    if type(rows) == 'table' then
        for i = 1, #rows do
            items[i] = mapService(rows[i])
        end
    end

    return pageOf(items, page, pageSize, total)
end

---@param shopId string
---@param page integer
---@param pageSize integer
---@param search string?
---@return BarberTransactionPage
function storage.getTransactions(shopId, page, pageSize, search)
    local pattern = likePattern(search)
    local filter = pattern and ' AND (note LIKE ? OR actor_name LIKE ? OR tx_type LIKE ?)' or ''
    local params = pattern and { shopId, pattern, pattern, pattern } or { shopId }

    local total = tonumber(db:scalar_async(
        'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `sm_barbershop_transactions` WHERE shop_id = ?' .. filter,
        params
    )) or 0

    local rows = db:query_async(([[
        SELECT id, tx_type, amount, balance_after, actor_name, note,
            DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%%Y-%%m-%%d') AS date, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%%H:%%i') AS at
        FROM `sm_barbershop_transactions`
        WHERE shop_id = ?%s
        ORDER BY id DESC
        LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
    ]]):format(filter), pattern
        and { shopId, pattern, pattern, pattern, pageSize, (page - 1) * pageSize }
        or { shopId, pageSize, (page - 1) * pageSize })

    local items = {}

    if type(rows) == 'table' then
        for i = 1, #rows do
            items[i] = mapTransaction(rows[i])
        end
    end

    return pageOf(items, page, pageSize, total)
end

---@param shopId string
---@return integer visitors
---@return integer revenue
function storage.getTodayStats(shopId)
    local row = db:single_async([[
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS visitors, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS revenue
        FROM `sm_barbershop_services`
        WHERE shop_id = ? AND DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
    ]], { shopId })

    return tonumber(row and row.visitors) or 0, tonumber(row and row.revenue) or 0
end

---@param shopId string
---@param days integer
---@return table<string, { visitors: integer, revenue: integer }>
function storage.getDailyStats(shopId, days)
    local since = os.date('%Y-%m-%d', os.time() - (days - 1) * 86400)
    local rows = db:query_async([[
        SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS visitors, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS revenue
        FROM `sm_barbershop_services`
        WHERE shop_id = ? AND DATE(created_at) >= ?
        GROUP BY DATE(created_at)
    ]], { shopId, since })

    local byDate = {}

    if type(rows) == 'table' then
        for i = 1, #rows do
            local row = rows[i]
            byDate[row.date] = { visitors = tonumber(row.visitors) or 0, revenue = tonumber(row.revenue) or 0 }
        end
    end

    return byDate
end

---@param shopId string
---@param days integer
---@return BarberEmployeeStat[]
function storage.getEmployeeStats(shopId, days)
    local since = os.date('%Y-%m-%d', os.time() - (days - 1) * 86400)
    local rows = db:query_async([[
        SELECT employee_citizenid, employee_name, COUNT(*) AS services, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS revenue
        FROM `sm_barbershop_services`
        WHERE shop_id = ? AND employee_citizenid IS NOT NULL AND DATE(created_at) >= ?
        GROUP BY employee_citizenid, employee_name
        ORDER BY services DESC, revenue DESC
    ]], { shopId, since })

    local list = {}

    if type(rows) == 'table' then
        for i = 1, #rows do
            local row = rows[i]
            list[i] = {
                citizenId = row.employee_citizenid,
                name = row.employee_name,
                services = tonumber(row.services) or 0,
                revenue = tonumber(row.revenue) or 0,
            }
        end
    end

    return list
end

---@return table[]
function storage.loadRoles()
    local rows = db:query_async('SELECT id, shop_id, role_key, label, permissions FROM `sm_barbershop_roles` ORDER BY id ASC')

    return type(rows) == 'table' and rows or {}
end

---@param shopId string
---@param roleKey string?
---@param label string
---@param permissions string
---@return integer?
function storage.addRole(shopId, roleKey, label, permissions)
    return db:insert_async(
        'INSERT INTO `sm_barbershop_roles` (shop_id, role_key, label, permissions) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
        { shopId, roleKey, label, permissions }
    )
end

---@param id integer
---@param label string
---@param permissions string
function storage.saveRole(id, label, permissions)
    db:update_async('UPDATE `sm_barbershop_roles` SET label = ?, permissions = ? WHERE id = ?', { label, permissions, id })
end

---@param id integer
function storage.removeRole(id)
    db:update_async('DELETE FROM `sm_barbershop_roles` WHERE id = ?', { id })
end

---@param citizenId string
---@param shopId string
---@param used integer
---@return integer?
function storage.addPortable(citizenId, shopId, used)
    return db:insert_async('INSERT INTO `sm_barbershop_portables` (citizenid, shop_id, used) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', { citizenId, shopId, used })
end

---@param id integer
---@param used integer
function storage.setPortableUsed(id, used)
    db:update_async('UPDATE `sm_barbershop_portables` SET used = ? WHERE id = ?', { used, id })
end

---@param id integer
function storage.removePortable(id)
    db:update_async('DELETE FROM `sm_barbershop_portables` WHERE id = ?', { id })
end

---@param citizenId string
---@return { id: integer, used: integer? }[]
function storage.portablesOf(citizenId)
    local rows = db:query_async('SELECT id, used FROM `sm_barbershop_portables` WHERE citizenid = ? ORDER BY id ASC', { citizenId })

    return type(rows) == 'table' and rows or {}
end

return storage


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\sm_barbershop\modules\text.lua
local Text = {}

---@param value any
---@param min integer
---@param max integer
---@return string?
function Text.name(value, min, max)
    if type(value) ~= 'string' then return end

    local name = value:gsub('%s+', ' '):match('^%s*(.-)%s*$')

    if #name < min or #name > max or not name:match("^[%w %.'&%-]+$") then return end

    return name
end

return Text

local config = Config
local Nui = require 'modules.nui'
local Sync = require 'modules.sync.client'

---@type string?
local currentShop

---@type integer?
local syncBaseline

---@type table<string, integer>
local syncApplied = {}

---@type BarberManagementSync[]
local pendingSync = {}

---@param baseline integer?
local function resetSync(baseline)
    syncBaseline = baseline
    syncApplied = {}
    pendingSync = {}
end

---@param payload BarberManagementSync
---@param baseline integer
---@return BarberManagementSync?
local function freshFields(payload, baseline)
    local revision = payload.revision
    local fresh

    for key, value in pairs(payload) do
        if key ~= 'shopId' and key ~= 'revision' and revision > (syncApplied[key] or baseline) then
            syncApplied[key] = revision
            fresh = fresh or { shopId = payload.shopId }
            fresh[key] = value
        end
    end

    return fresh
end

local function myRole(shopId)
    local shops = LocalPlayer.state.barberShops

    return type(shops) == 'table' and shops[shopId] or nil
end

local function notifyResult(result)
    if result and result.message then
        lib.notify({ type = result.success and 'success' or 'error', description = result.message })
    end
end

local function openTablet(shopId)
    currentShop = shopId
    resetSync(nil)
    Nui.open('management', 'barber:management:open', { shopId = shopId })
end

local function closeTablet()
    currentShop = nil
    Nui.close('management', 'barber:management:close')
end

local function serverAwait(name, ...)
    if not currentShop then return false end

    return lib.callback.await(('sm_barbershop:management:%s'):format(name), false, currentShop, ...)
end

local function toggleDuty(shopId)
    local result = lib.callback.await('sm_barbershop:management:toggleDuty', false, shopId)

    if not result.success then
        return notifyResult(result)
    end

    lib.notify({
        type = 'success',
        description = result.onDuty and 'Shift dimulai.' or 'Shift diakhiri.',
    })
end

local function purchase(shop)
    local state = Sync.shop(shop.id)

    if not state or state.owned or not state.purchesable then return end

    local answer = lib.alertDialog({
        header = state.label,
        content = ('Beli barbershop ini seharga $%s?'):format(lib.math.groupdigits(state.purchasePrice)),
        centered = true,
        cancel = true,
        labels = { cancel = 'Batal', confirm = 'Beli' },
    })

    if answer ~= 'confirm' then return end

    notifyResult(lib.callback.await('sm_barbershop:shop:purchase', false, shop.id))
end

local function nearbyServerIds()
    local players = lib.getNearbyPlayers(GetEntityCoords(cache.ped), 6.0, false)
    local ids = {}

    for i = 1, #players do
        ids[#ids + 1] = GetPlayerServerId(players[i].id)
    end

    return ids
end

    BeginTextCommandSetBlipName('STRING')

end

Nui.callback('barber:management:bootstrap', function()
    local result = serverAwait('bootstrap')

    if type(result) ~= 'table' or type(result.revision) ~= 'number' then return result end

    local pending = pendingSync

    resetSync(result.revision)

    for i = 1, #pending do
        local fresh = freshFields(pending[i], result.revision)

        if fresh then
            fresh.shopId = nil

            for key, value in pairs(fresh) do
                result[key] = value
            end
        end
    end

    return result
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_barbershop:management:sync', function(payload)
    if source == '' or type(payload) ~= 'table' or type(payload.revision) ~= 'number' then return end
    if not currentShop or payload.shopId ~= currentShop then return end

    local baseline = syncBaseline

    if not baseline then
        pendingSync[#pendingSync + 1] = payload

        return
    end

    local fresh = freshFields(payload, baseline)

    if fresh then
        SendNUIMessage({ action = 'barber:management:sync', data = fresh })
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_barbershop:management:reload', function(shopId)
    if source == '' or not currentShop or shopId ~= currentShop then return end

    resetSync(nil)
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'barber:management:reload' })
end)

    if type(value) ~= 'table' or not value[currentShop] then
        closeTablet()
    end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\sm_barbershop\modules\management\server.lua
local config = Config
local limits = config.limits

local DAY_LABELS = { 'Min', 'Sen', 'Sel', 'Rab', 'Kam', 'Jum', 'Sab' }

local function notify(source, notifyType, description)
    TriggerClientEvent('ox_lib:notify', source, {
        type = notifyType,
        description = description,
        duration = 4500,
    })
end

---@param message string
---@return BarberActionResult
local function fail(message)
    return { success = false, message = message }
end

local inventory = exports.ox_inventory

---@type table<string, BarberSupply>
local supplies = {}

for i = 1, #config.supplies do
    supplies[config.supplies[i].item] = config.supplies[i]
end

local catalog = { groups = config.priceGroups, items = {} }

for i = 1, #config.priceItems do
    local item = config.priceItems[i]

    catalog.items[i] = {
        key = item.key,
        group = item.group,
        label = item.label,
        includedWith = item.includedWith,
        defaultPrice = Pricing.defaultPrice(item.key),
    }
end

---@param shopId string
---@param actorRole string?
local function roleOptions(shopId, actorRole)
    local options = {}

    for _, role in ipairs(Roles.list(shopId)) do
        local permissions = role.permissions

        options[#options + 1] = {
            value = role.key,
            label = role.label,
            assignable = Staff.outranks(shopId, actorRole, role.key),
            manages = permissions.hire == true or permissions.fire == true or permissions.setRole == true,
        }
    end

    return options
end

---@param shopId string
local function roleSettings(shopId)
    local list = {}

    for _, role in ipairs(Roles.list(shopId)) do
        list[#list + 1] = {
            key = role.key,
            label = role.label,
            permissions = Roles.permissionList(role),
            members = Staff.countRole(shopId, role.key),
        }
    end

    return list
end

---@param shop BarberShop
local function reloadTablets(shop)
    Staff.emit(shop.id, 'sm_barbershop:management:reload', shop.id)
end

---@param shop BarberShop
---@param citizenId string
local function reloadCitizen(shop, citizenId)
    local player = Core:GetPlayerByCitizenId(citizenId)

    if player then
        TriggerClientEvent('sm_barbershop:management:reload', player.PlayerData.source, shop.id)
    end
end

---@param shopId string
local function buildDaily(shopId)
    local byDate = Storage.getDailyStats(shopId, 7)
    local series = {}
    local now = os.time()

    for offset = 6, 0, -1 do
        local ts = now - offset * 86400
        local entry = byDate[os.date('%Y-%m-%d', ts)]

        series[#series + 1] = {
            label = DAY_LABELS[os.date('*t', ts).wday],
            visitors = entry and entry.visitors or 0,
            revenue = entry and entry.revenue or 0,
        }
    end

    return series
end

---@param shop BarberShop
---@return BarberDashboard
local function dashboard(shop)
    local visitors, revenue = Storage.getTodayStats(shop.id)
    local stats = Storage.getEmployeeStats(shop.id, limits.topEmployeeDays)
    local topEmployees = {}

    for i = 1, math.min(#stats, limits.topEmployeeLimit) do
        topEmployees[i] = stats[i]
    end

    return {
        stats = {
            visitorsToday = visitors,
            revenueToday = revenue,
            staffOnDuty = Staff.dutyCount(shop.id),
            balance = shop.balance,
        },
        daily = buildDaily(shop.id),
        topEmployees = topEmployees,
        recentLogs = Storage.getRecentServices(shop.id, limits.recentLogsLimit),
    }
end

---@param source number
---@param shopId any
---@return BarberShop?, string?
local function access(source, shopId)
    local shop = Shops.get(shopId)

    if not shop then return end

    local role = Staff.roleOf(source, shop.id)

    if not role then return end

    return shop, role
end

---@param shop BarberShop
---@param build fun(): BarberManagementSync
local function sync(shop, build)
    local revision = Sync.nextRevision()
    local payload = build()

    payload.shopId = shop.id
    payload.revision = revision
    Staff.emit(shop.id, 'sm_barbershop:management:sync', payload)
end

---@param shop BarberShop
local function syncEmployees(shop)
    sync(shop, function()
        return { employees = Staff.list(shop.id), dashboard = dashboard(shop) }
    end)
end

---@param shop BarberShop
local function syncShop(shop)
    sync(shop, function()
        return { shop = Shops.publicData(shop), dashboard = dashboard(shop) }
    end)
end

local function pageOf(value)
    return math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(value) or 1))
end

local function pageSizeOf(value)
    local size = math.floor(tonumber(value) or limits.logPageSize)

    return math.min(limits.maxPageSize, math.max(1, size))
end

local function searchOf(value)
    if type(value) ~= 'string' then return end

    local term = value:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$'):sub(1, 40)

    return term ~= '' and term or nil
end

local function amountOf(value)
    local amount = tonumber(value)

    if not amount or amount ~= amount then return end

    amount = math.floor(amount)

    if amount <= 0 or amount > limits.maxFinanceAmount then return end

    return amount
end

AddEventHandler('sm_barbershop:internal:serviceRecorded', function(shopId)
    local shop = Shops.get(shopId)

    if shop then
        syncShop(shop)
    end
end)

    local shop, role = access(source, shopId)

    if not shop then return false end

    local revision = Sync.revision
    local player = Staff.getPlayer(source)

    return {
        revision = revision,
        shop = Shops.publicData(shop),
        me = {

            name = Staff.nameOf(player),
            role = role,
            onDuty = Staff.isOnDuty(source, shop.id),
            can = Staff.permissions(shop.id, role),
        },
        dashboard = dashboard(shop),
        employees = Staff.list(shop.id),
        roles = roleOptions(shop.id, role),
        roleSettings = role == 'owner' and roleSettings(shop.id) or nil,
        permissions = config.permissions,
        supplies = config.supplies,
        imagePath = GetConvar('inventory:imagepath', 'nui://ox_inventory/web/images'),
        limits = {
            maxCommissionRate = limits.maxCommissionRate,
            minSelfServiceRate = limits.minSelfServiceRate,

            maxFinanceAmount = limits.maxFinanceAmount,
            minShopName = limits.minShopName,
            maxShopName = limits.maxShopName,
            maxRoles = limits.maxRoles,
            minRoleName = limits.minRoleName,
            maxRoleName = limits.maxRoleName,
        },
        catalog = catalog,

    if not shop or not Staff.can(source, shop.id, 'logs') then return false end

    return Storage.getServiceLogs(shop.id, pageOf(page), pageSizeOf(pageSize), searchOf(search))
end)

    local shop = access(source, shopId)

    if not shop or not Staff.can(source, shop.id, 'finance') then return false end

    return Storage.getTransactions(shop.id, pageOf(page), pageSizeOf(pageSize), searchOf(search))

lib.callback.register('sm_barbershop:management:resolvePlayers', function(source, shopId, ids)
    local shop = access(source, shopId)

    if not shop or type(ids) ~= 'table' then return {} end

    local list = {}

    for i = 1, math.min(#ids, 32) do
        local id = tonumber(ids[i])
        local player = id and id ~= source and Staff.getPlayer(id)

        if player and not Staff.role(shop.id, Staff.citizenIdOf(player)) then
            list[#list + 1] = { value = id, label = Staff.nameOf(player) }
        end
    end

    return list
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_barbershop:management:toggleDuty', function(source, shopId)
    local shop = access(source, shopId)

    if not shop then return fail('Anda bukan staf barbershop ini.') end

    if not Staff.isOnDuty(source, shop.id) and not Staff.can(source, shop.id, 'duty') then
        return fail('Role Anda tidak punya izin untuk mulai shift.')
    end

    local onDuty = Staff.toggleDuty(source, shop.id)

    syncEmployees(shop)

    return { success = true, onDuty = onDuty }
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_barbershop:management:hire', function(source, shopId, targetId, role)
    local shop = access(source, shopId)

    if not shop or not Staff.can(source, shop.id, 'hire') then return fail('Anda tidak berwenang merekrut.') end

    local roleEntry = Roles.get(shop.id, role)

    if not roleEntry then return fail('Role tidak valid.') end
    if not Staff.outranks(shop.id, Staff.roleOf(source, shop.id), role) then return fail('Anda hanya bisa merekrut ke role di bawah Anda.') end
    if Staff.count(shop.id) >= limits.maxEmployees then return fail('Jumlah karyawan sudah maksimal.') end

    local target = type(targetId) == 'number' and targetId ~= source and Staff.getPlayer(targetId) or nil
    local citizenId = Staff.citizenIdOf(target)

    if not citizenId then return fail('Pemain tidak ditemukan.') end
    if Staff.role(shop.id, citizenId) then return fail('Pemain ini sudah terdaftar.') end

    Staff.hire(shop.id, citizenId, Staff.nameOf(target), role)
    notify(targetId, 'success', ('Anda direkrut sebagai %s di %s.'):format(roleEntry.label, shop.label))
    syncEmployees(shop)

    return { success = true, employees = Staff.list(shop.id) }
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_barbershop:management:setRole', function(source, shopId, citizenId, role)
    local shop = access(source, shopId)

    if not shop or not Staff.can(source, shop.id, 'setRole') then return fail('Anda tidak berwenang mengubah role.') end

    local employee = type(citizenId) == 'string' and Staff.employee(shop.id, citizenId)

    if not employee then return fail('Karyawan tidak ditemukan.') end
    if citizenId == Staff.citizenId(source) then return fail('Anda tidak bisa mengubah role sendiri.') end
    if not Roles.get(shop.id, role) then return fail('Role tidak valid.') end

    local actorRole = Staff.roleOf(source, shop.id)

    if not Staff.outranks(shop.id, actorRole, employee.role) or not Staff.outranks(shop.id, actorRole, role) then
        return fail('Anda hanya bisa mengatur role di bawah Anda.')
    end

    Staff.setRole(shop.id, citizenId, role)
    Staff.enforceDuty(shop.id)
    syncEmployees(shop)
    reloadCitizen(shop, citizenId)

    return { success = true, employees = Staff.list(shop.id) }
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_barbershop:management:fire', function(source, shopId, citizenId)
    local shop = access(source, shopId)

    if not shop or not Staff.can(source, shop.id, 'fire') then return fail('Anda tidak berwenang memecat.') end

    local employee = type(citizenId) == 'string' and Staff.employee(shop.id, citizenId)

    if not employee then return fail('Karyawan tidak ditemukan.') end
    if citizenId == Staff.citizenId(source) then return fail('Anda tidak bisa memecat diri sendiri.') end

    if not Staff.outranks(shop.id, Staff.roleOf(source, shop.id), employee.role) then
        return fail('Anda hanya bisa memecat role di bawah Anda.')
    end

    Staff.fire(shop.id, citizenId)
    syncEmployees(shop)

    return { success = true, employees = Staff.list(shop.id) }
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_barbershop:management:setPrices', function(source, shopId, prices)
    local shop = access(source, shopId)

    if not shop or not Staff.can(source, shop.id, 'prices') then return fail('Anda tidak berwenang mengatur harga.') end
    if type(prices) ~= 'table' or not Shops.setPrices(shop, prices) then return fail('Harga atau komisi di luar batas.') end

    syncShop(shop)

    return { success = true, shop = Shops.publicData(shop) }
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_barbershop:management:setName', function(source, shopId, name)
    local shop = access(source, shopId)

    if not shop or not Staff.can(source, shop.id, 'settings') then return fail('Anda tidak berwenang mengganti nama toko.') end

    if not Shops.setName(shop, name) then
        return fail(('Nama harus %d-%d karakter, hanya huruf, angka, spasi, dan . \' & -'):format(limits.minShopName, limits.maxShopName))
    end

    syncShop(shop)

    return { success = true, shop = Shops.publicData(shop) }
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_barbershop:management:saveRole', function(source, shopId, key, label, permissions)
    local shop = access(source, shopId)

    if not shop or not Staff.can(source, shop.id, 'roles') then return fail('Hanya pemilik yang bisa mengatur role.') end
    if key ~= nil and type(key) ~= 'string' then return fail('Role tidak valid.') end

    local role, message = Roles.save(shop.id, key, label, permissions)

    if not role then return fail(message --[[@as string]]) end

    Staff.enforceDuty(shop.id)
    syncEmployees(shop)
    reloadTablets(shop)

    return { success = true, key = role.key }
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_barbershop:management:deleteRole', function(source, shopId, key)

    if not shop or not Staff.can(source, shop.id, 'roles') then return fail('Hanya pemilik yang bisa mengatur role.') end
    if not Roles.get(shop.id, key) then return fail('Role tidak ditemukan.') end
    if #Roles.list(shop.id) <= 1 then return fail('Minimal harus ada satu role.') end

    local members = Staff.countRole(shop.id, key)

    if members > 0 then return fail(('Pindahkan %d karyawan di role ini terlebih dahulu.'):format(members)) end

    Roles.remove(shop.id, key)
    reloadTablets(shop)

    return { success = true }
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_barbershop:management:buySupply', function(source, shopId, itemName, quantity)
    local shop = access(source, shopId)

    if not shop or not Staff.can(source, shop.id, 'supplies') then return fail('Anda tidak berwenang membeli perlengkapan.') end

    local supply = type(itemName) == 'string' and supplies[itemName]

    if not supply then return fail('Barang tidak tersedia.') end

    local count = math.floor(tonumber(quantity) or 0)

    if count < 1 or count > supply.maxQuantity then return fail(('Jumlah harus 1-%d.'):format(supply.maxQuantity)) end

    local total = supply.price * count

    if total > shop.balance then return fail('Saldo barbershop tidak cukup.') end

    local player = Staff.getPlayer(source)

    if not player then return fail('Data pemain tidak ditemukan.') end
    local metadata = Wear.metadata(supply.item, Wear.max(supply.item))

    if not inventory:CanCarryItem(source, supply.item, count, metadata) then return fail('Inventory penuh.') end
    if not inventory:AddItem(source, supply.item, count, metadata) then return fail('Barang gagal dimasukkan ke inventory.') end

    Shops.addBalance(shop, -total)
    Storage.addTransaction({
        shopId = shop.id,
        type = 'supply',
        amount = total,
        balanceAfter = shop.balance,
        actorCitizenId = Staff.citizenIdOf(player),
        actorName = Staff.nameOf(player),
        note = ('Beli %dx %s'):format(count, supply.label),
    })
    syncShop(shop)

    return { success = true, shop = Shops.publicData(shop) }
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_barbershop:management:deposit', function(source, shopId, value)
    local shop = access(source, shopId)

    if not shop or not Staff.can(source, shop.id, 'finance') then return fail('Anda tidak berwenang mengelola keuangan.') end

    local amount = amountOf(value)

    if not amount then return fail('Jumlah tidak valid.') end

    local player = Staff.getPlayer(source)

        balanceAfter = shop.balance,

        actorName = Staff.nameOf(player),
        note = 'Setoran',
    })

end)

lib.callback.register('sm_barbershop:management:withdraw', function(source, shopId, value)

lib.callback.register('sm_barbershop:shop:purchase', function(source, shopId)
    local shop = Shops.get(shopId)

    if not shop then return fail('Barbershop tidak ditemukan.') end
    if not shop.purchesable then return fail('Barbershop ini tidak dijual.') end
    if Shops.isOwned(shop) then return fail('Barbershop ini sudah dimiliki.') end

    local player = Staff.getPlayer(source)
    local citizenId = Staff.citizenIdOf(player)

    if not player or not citizenId then return fail('Data pemain tidak ditemukan.') end

    if player.Functions.RemoveMoney(config.payment.purchase, shop.purchasePrice, 'barbershop-purchase') ~= true then
        return fail('Saldo bank tidak cukup.')
    end

    Shops.setOwner(shop, citizenId, Staff.nameOf(player))
    Storage.addTransaction({
        shopId = shop.id,
        type = 'purchase',
        amount = shop.purchasePrice,
        balanceAfter = shop.balance,
        actorCitizenId = citizenId,
        actorName = shop.ownerName,
        note = 'Pembelian barbershop',
    })
    Staff.syncPlayer(source)

    return { success = true, message = ('Anda sekarang pemilik %s.'):format(shop.label) }
end)

local LOCATE_RADIUS = 30.0
local COMMAND_USAGE = 'Pakai: /barbershop setowner [playerid] [barberid] | removeowner [barberid] | getid | goto [barberid]'

---@type table<string, vector3>
local managementOf = {}

for i = 1, #config.shops do
    managementOf[config.shops[i].id] = config.shops[i].coords.management
end

---@param source number
---@param notifyType string
---@param message string
local function reply(source, notifyType, message)
    if source == 0 then
        return print(message)
    end

    notify(source, notifyType, message)
end

---@param source number
---@return BarberShop?
local function shopNear(source)
    local ped = GetPlayerPed(source)

    if ped == 0 then return end

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local best, bestDistance

    for id, management in pairs(managementOf) do
        local distance = #(coords - management)

        if distance <= LOCATE_RADIUS and (not bestDistance or distance < bestDistance) then
            best, bestDistance = id, distance
        end
    end

    return best and Shops.get(best) or nil
end

---@type table<string, fun(source: number, first: string?, second: string?)>
local commands = {}

commands.setowner = function(source, playerId, shopId)
    local shop = Shops.get(shopId)

    if not shop then return reply(source, 'error', 'ID barbershop tidak ditemukan.') end

    local target = tonumber(playerId)
    local player = target and Staff.getPlayer(target)
    local citizenId = Staff.citizenIdOf(player)

    if not target or not citizenId then return reply(source, 'error', 'Pemain target tidak ditemukan.') end

    local previousOwner = shop.ownerCitizenId

    Shops.setOwner(shop, citizenId, Staff.nameOf(player))
    Staff.syncPlayer(target)

    if previousOwner and previousOwner ~= citizenId then
        Staff.syncCitizen(previousOwner)
    end

    syncShop(shop)
    reply(source, 'success', ('%s sekarang pemilik %s.'):format(Staff.nameOf(player), shop.label))
end

commands.removeowner = function(source, shopId)
    local shop = Shops.get(shopId)

    if not shop then return reply(source, 'error', 'ID barbershop tidak ditemukan.') end

    local previousOwner = shop.ownerCitizenId

    if not previousOwner then return reply(source, 'error', ('%s belum punya pemilik.'):format(shop.label)) end

    Shops.setOwner(shop, nil, nil)
    Staff.syncCitizen(previousOwner)
    syncShop(shop)
    reply(source, 'success', ('Pemilik %s dihapus.'):format(shop.label))
end

commands.getid = function(source)
    if source == 0 then return reply(source, 'error', 'Command ini hanya bisa dipakai di dalam game.') end

    local shop = shopNear(source)

    if not shop then return reply(source, 'error', 'Anda tidak berada di area barbershop.') end

    reply(source, 'inform', ('ID barbershop: %s (%s)'):format(shop.id, shop.label))
end

commands['goto'] = function(source, shopId)
    if source == 0 then return reply(source, 'error', 'Command ini hanya bisa dipakai di dalam game.') end

    local management = type(shopId) == 'string' and managementOf[shopId]

    if not management then return reply(source, 'error', 'ID barbershop tidak ditemukan.') end

    local ped = GetPlayerPed(source)

    if ped == 0 then return end

    SetEntityCoords(ped, management.x, management.y, management.z, false, false, false, false)
end

lib.addCommand('barbershop', {
    help = 'Kelola barbershop',
    params = {
        { name = 'action', type = 'string', help = 'setowner, removeowner, getid, atau goto' },
        { name = 'first', help = 'setowner: ID pemain Â· removeowner/goto: ID barbershop', optional = true },
        { name = 'second', help = 'setowner: ID barbershop', optional = true },
    },
    restricted = ('group.%s'):format(config.adminAce),
}, function(source, args)
    local command = commands[args.action and args.action:lower() or '']

    if not command then return reply(source, 'error', COMMAND_USAGE) end

    command(source, args.first, args.second)
end)

CreateThread(function()
    Storage.ensureTables()
    Shops.init()
    Roles.init()
    Staff.init()
    Shops.syncAll()
    TriggerEvent('sm_barbershop:internal:ready')
    Sync.start()

    Wait(1500)

    for _, player in pairs(Core:GetQBPlayers()) do
        Staff.syncPlayer(player.PlayerData.source)
    end
end)


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\sm_barbershop\modules\portable\client.lua
local config = Config
local settings = config.portable
local Sync = require 'modules.sync.client'

local PLACE_CONTROL = 38
local CANCEL_CONTROL = 194
local ROTATE_LEFT_CONTROL = 174
local ROTATE_RIGHT_CONTROL = 175
local ROTATE_SPEED = 90.0
local RAY_FLAGS = 1 | 16
local RAY_EXTRA = 5.0
local MIN_NORMAL_Z = 0.9
local GHOST_ALPHA = 160
local BLOCKED_CONTROLS = { 14, 15, 16, 17, 24, 25, 37, 38, 44, 140, 141, 142, 174, 175, 194, 257, 263 }
local HINT = '[E] Pasang  [Panah Kiri/Kanan] Putar  [Backspace] Batal'

local model = joaat(settings.model)

---@class BarberPortableObject
---@field coords vector4
---@field point CPoint
---@field inside boolean
---@field entity number?

---@type table<string, BarberPortableObject>
local objects = {}

local placing = false

local function notify(notifyType, description)
    lib.notify({ type = notifyType, description = description })
end

---@param record BarberPortableObject
local function spawn(record)
    if record.entity then return end

    lib.requestModel(model)

    if not record.inside or record.entity then
        SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)

        return
    end

    local coords = record.coords
    local entity = CreateObjectNoOffset(model, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false)

    SetEntityHeading(entity, coords.w)
    FreezeEntityPosition(entity, true)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)

    record.entity = entity
end

---@param record BarberPortableObject
local function despawn(record)
    if record.entity and DoesEntityExist(record.entity) then
        DeleteEntity(record.entity)
    end

    record.entity = nil
end

Sync.onPortables(function(list)
    ---@type table<string, boolean>
    local seen = {}

    for i = 1, #list do
        local entry = list[i]
        local id = tostring(entry.index)

        seen[id] = true

        if not objects[id] then
            ---@type BarberPortableObject
            local record

            record = {
                coords = entry.coords,
                inside = false,
                point = lib.points.new({
                    coords = entry.coords.xyz,
                    distance = settings.renderDistance,
                    onEnter = function()
                        record.inside = true
                        CreateThread(function() spawn(record) end)
                    end,
                    onExit = function()
                        record.inside = false
                        despawn(record)
                    end,
                }),
            }

            objects[id] = record
        end
    end

    for id, record in pairs(objects) do
        if not seen[id] then
            record.point:remove()
            record.inside = false
            despawn(record)
            objects[id] = nil
        end
    end
end)

---@param coords vector3
---@return boolean
local function crowded(coords)
    for i = 1, #config.shops do
        local list = config.shops[i].coords.chairs

        for j = 1, #list do
            if #(coords - list[j].xyz) < settings.spacing then return true end
        end
    end

    local list = Sync.portables()

    for i = 1, #list do
        if #(coords - list[i].coords.xyz) < settings.spacing then return true end
    end

    return false
end

---@return vector3? coords
---@return number? heading
local function choosePlacement()
    lib.requestModel(model)

    local ped = cache.ped
    local start = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local ghost = CreateObjectNoOffset(model, start.x, start.y, start.z, false, false, false)
    local heading = GetEntityHeading(ped)
    local chosen

    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
    SetEntityAlpha(ghost, GHOST_ALPHA, false)
    SetEntityCollision(ghost, false, false)
    FreezeEntityPosition(ghost, true)
    SetEntityDrawOutline(ghost, true)
    lib.showTextUI(HINT, { position = 'right-center' })

    while not (cache.vehicle or IsEntityDead(ped) or not LocalPlayer.state.barberDuty) do
        for i = 1, #BLOCKED_CONTROLS do
            DisableControlAction(0, BLOCKED_CONTROLS[i], true)
        end

        local hit, _, target, normal = lib.raycast.fromCamera(RAY_FLAGS, 4, settings.reach + RAY_EXTRA)
        local valid = hit and normal.z >= MIN_NORMAL_Z and #(target - GetEntityCoords(ped)) <= settings.reach and not crowded(target)

        if hit then
            SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(ghost, target.x, target.y, target.z, false, false, false)
        end

        SetEntityHeading(ghost, heading)
        SetEntityDrawOutlineColor(valid and 0 or 255, valid and 255 or 0, 0, 255)

        if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, ROTATE_LEFT_CONTROL) then
            heading = (heading + ROTATE_SPEED * GetFrameTime()) % 360.0
        elseif IsDisabledControlPressed(0, ROTATE_RIGHT_CONTROL) then
            heading = (heading - ROTATE_SPEED * GetFrameTime()) % 360.0
        end

        if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, CANCEL_CONTROL) then break end

        if valid and IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, PLACE_CONTROL) then
            chosen = target
            break
        end

        Wait(0)
    end

    lib.hideTextUI()
    SetEntityDrawOutline(ghost, false)
    DeleteEntity(ghost)

    return chosen, chosen and heading or nil
end

---@param _ table
---@param slot { name: string, slot: integer, metadata: table? }
exports('placeChair', function(_, slot)
    if placing then return end

    if not LocalPlayer.state.barberDuty then
        return notify('error', 'Anda harus sedang shift untuk memasang kursi cukur.')
    end

    if cache.vehicle then
        return notify('error', 'Tidak bisa memasang kursi dari dalam kendaraan.')
    end

    if not IsModelInCdimage(model) then
        return notify('error', ('Model kursi %s tidak tersedia.'):format(settings.model))
    end

    placing = true

    CreateThread(function()
        local ok, coords, heading = pcall(choosePlacement)

        if ok and coords then
            local result = lib.callback.await('sm_barbershop:portable:place', false, slot.slot, coords, heading)

            if result.success then
                notify('success', 'Kursi cukur terpasang.')
            else
                notify('error', result.message)
            end
        end

        placing = false
    end)
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource then return end

    for _, record in pairs(objects) do
        despawn(record)
    end
end)


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\sm_barbershop\modules\portable\server.lua
local config = Config
local items = config.items
local settings = config.portable
local inventory = exports.ox_inventory

local REACH_MARGIN = 1.5

local Portable = {}

---@type table<string, BarberPortableChair>
local chairs = {}

---@type table<integer, boolean>
local placed = {}

---@type table<number, boolean>
local placing = {}

---@type table<string, boolean>
local refunding = {}

local function notify(source, notifyType, description)
    TriggerClientEvent('ox_lib:notify', source, {
        type = notifyType,
        description = description,
        duration = 4500,
    })
end

---@param message string
---@return BarberActionResult
local function fail(message)
    return { success = false, message = message }
end

---@param shopId string
local function publish(shopId)
    ---@type BarberPortableSync[]
    local list = {}

    for _, chair in pairs(chairs) do
        if chair.shop == shopId then
            list[#list + 1] = { id = chair.id, coords = chair.coords, ownerId = chair.owner }
        end
    end

    Sync.setPortables(shopId, list)
end

---@param source number
---@param coords vector3
---@return boolean
local function within(source, coords)
    local ped = GetPlayerPed(source)

    return ped ~= 0 and #(GetEntityCoords(ped) - coords) <= settings.reach + REACH_MARGIN
end

---@param coords vector3
---@return boolean
local function crowded(coords)
    for i = 1, #config.shops do
        local list = config.shops[i].coords.chairs

        for j = 1, #list do
            if #(coords - list[j].xyz) < settings.spacing then return true end
        end
    end

    for _, chair in pairs(chairs) do
        if #(coords - chair.coords.xyz) < settings.spacing then return true end
    end

    return false
end

---@param source number
---@return integer
local function countOf(source)
    local total = 0

    for _, chair in pairs(chairs) do
        if chair.owner == source then
            total += 1
        end
    end

    return total
end

---@param chair BarberPortableChair
local function remove(chair)
    chairs[chair.id] = nil
    placed[chair.recordId] = nil
    publish(chair.shop)
    TriggerEvent('sm_barbershop:internal:chairRemoved', chair.shop, chair.id)
end

---@param source number
local function removeOwned(source)
    for _, chair in pairs(chairs) do
        if chair.owner == source then
            remove(chair)
        end
    end
end

---@param source number
local function refund(source)
    local citizenId = Staff.citizenId(source)

    if not citizenId or refunding[citizenId] then return end

    refunding[citizenId] = true

    local rows = Storage.portablesOf(citizenId)
    local returned, pending = 0, 0

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local row = rows[i]

        if not placed[row.id] then
            local metadata = row.used and Wear.metadata(items.chair, row.used) or nil

            if inventory:CanCarryItem(source, items.chair, 1, metadata) and inventory:AddItem(source, items.chair, 1, metadata) then
                Storage.removePortable(row.id)
                returned += 1
            else
                pending += 1
            end
        end
    end

    refunding[citizenId] = nil

    if returned > 0 then
        notify(source, 'success', ('%d kursi cukur dikembalikan ke inventory.'):format(returned))
    end

    if pending > 0 then
        notify(source, 'warning', 'Inventory penuh, kursi cukur akan dikembalikan saat login berikutnya.')
    end
end

---@param shopId string
---@param id any
---@return vector4?
function Portable.chair(shopId, id)
    local chair = type(id) == 'string' and chairs[id]

    return chair and chair.shop == shopId and chair.coords or nil
end

---@param shopId string
---@param index any
---@return boolean
function Portable.usable(shopId, index)
    local chair = type(index) == 'string' and chairs[index]

    if not chair or chair.shop ~= shopId then return type(index) ~= 'string' end

    return chair.used > 0
end

---@param shopId string
---@param index any
---@return integer? left
function Portable.consume(shopId, index)
    local chair = type(index) == 'string' and chairs[index]

    if not chair or chair.shop ~= shopId then return end

    chair.used = math.max(0, chair.used - 1)
    Storage.setPortableUsed(chair.recordId, chair.used)

    return chair.used
end

lib.callback.register('sm_barbershop:portable:place', function(source, slot, coords, heading)
    if placing[source] then return fail('Tunggu sebentar.') end

    if type(slot) ~= 'number' or type(coords) ~= 'vector3' or type(heading) ~= 'number' then
        return fail('Data penempatan tidak valid.')
    end

    heading = heading % 360.0

    if heading ~= heading or not within(source, coords) then
        return fail('Lokasi terlalu jauh.')
    end

    local shop = Shops.get(Staff.duty[source])

    if not shop then return fail('Anda harus sedang shift untuk memasang kursi cukur.') end
    if not Staff.can(source, shop.id, 'portable') then return fail('Role Anda tidak punya izin memasang kursi cukur.') end

    local citizenId = Staff.citizenId(source)

    if not citizenId then return fail('Data pemain tidak ditemukan.') end
    if countOf(source) >= settings.limit then return fail('Anda sudah memasang kursi cukur.') end
    if crowded(coords) then return fail('Terlalu dekat dengan kursi lain.') end

    local item = inventory:GetSlot(source, slot)

    if not item or item.name ~= items.chair then return fail('Kursi cukur tidak ada di inventory.') end

    local used = Wear.remaining(item.metadata)

    if used <= 0 then return fail('Kursi cukur ini sudah tidak bisa dipakai.') end
    if not inventory:RemoveItem(source, items.chair, 1, nil, slot) then return fail('Kursi cukur tidak ada di inventory.') end

    placing[source] = true

    local recordId = Storage.addPortable(citizenId, shop.id, used)

    placing[source] = nil

    if not recordId then
        inventory:AddItem(source, items.chair, 1, Wear.metadata(items.chair, used, item.metadata))

        return fail('Kursi cukur gagal dicatat.')
    end

    if not DoesPlayerExist(tostring(source)) then return fail('Pemain sudah keluar.') end

    local id = ('p%d'):format(recordId)

    chairs[id] = {
        id = id,
        shop = shop.id,
        coords = vec4(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, heading),
        owner = source,
        citizenId = citizenId,
        recordId = recordId,
        used = used,
    }

    placed[recordId] = true
    publish(shop.id)

    return { success = true }
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_barbershop:portable:pickup', function(source, id)
    local chair = type(id) == 'string' and chairs[id]

    if not chair then return fail('Kursi cukur tidak ditemukan.') end

    local citizenId = Staff.citizenId(source)

    if not citizenId or (citizenId ~= chair.citizenId and not Staff.roleOf(source, chair.shop)) then
        return fail('Anda tidak berhak mengangkat kursi ini.')
    end

    if not within(source, chair.coords.xyz) then return fail('Anda terlalu jauh dari kursi.') end
    if Sync.chairStatus(chair.shop, chair.id) then return fail('Kursi sedang dipakai.') end

    local metadata = Wear.metadata(items.chair, chair.used)

    if not inventory:CanCarryItem(source, items.chair, 1, metadata) or not inventory:AddItem(source, items.chair, 1, metadata) then
        return fail('Inventory penuh.')
    end

    remove(chair)
    Storage.removePortable(chair.recordId)

    return { success = true }
end)

AddEventHandler('sm_barbershop:internal:sessionEnded', function(shopId, index)
    local chair = type(index) == 'string' and chairs[index]

    if not chair or chair.shop ~= shopId or chair.used > 0 then return end

    chairs[chair.id] = nil
    placed[chair.recordId] = nil
    publish(chair.shop)
    Storage.removePortable(chair.recordId)

    if DoesPlayerExist(tostring(chair.owner)) then
        notify(chair.owner, 'warning', 'Kursi cukur Anda sudah habis pakai dan dibereskan.')
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('sm_barbershop:internal:ready', function()
    for _, player in pairs(Core:GetQBPlayers()) do
        CreateThread(function()
            refund(player.PlayerData.source)
        end)
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:PlayerLoaded', function(player)
    refund(player.PlayerData.source)
end)

AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:OnPlayerUnload', function(source)
    removeOwned(source)
end)

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    local source = source

    placing[source] = nil
    removeOwned(source)
end)

return Portable


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\sm_barbershop\modules\roles\server.lua
local config = Config
local limits = config.limits

local Roles = {}

---@type table<string, BarberRole[]>
local byShop = {}

---@type table<string, boolean>
local known = {}

for i = 1, #config.permissions do
    known[config.permissions[i].key] = true
end

---@param list any
---@return table<string, boolean>?
local function permissionSet(list)
    if type(list) ~= 'table' then return end

    local set = {}

    for i = 1, #list do
        local key = list[i]

        if type(key) ~= 'string' or not known[key] then return end

        set[key] = true
    end

    return set
end

---@param set table<string, boolean>
---@return string[]
local function permissionList(set)
    local list = {}

    for i = 1, #config.permissions do
        local key = config.permissions[i].key

        if set[key] then
            list[#list + 1] = key
        end
    end

    return list
end

---@param raw any
---@return table<string, boolean>
local function decode(raw)
    local ok, decoded = pcall(json.decode, type(raw) == 'string' and raw or 'null')

    return ok and permissionSet(decoded) or {}
end

---@param shopId string
---@return BarberRole[]
local function listOf(shopId)
    local list = byShop[shopId]

    if not list then
        list = {}
        byShop[shopId] = list
    end

    return list
end

function Roles.init()
    local rows = Storage.loadRoles()

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local row = rows[i]
        local list = listOf(row.shop_id)

        list[#list + 1] = {
            id = row.id,
            key = row.role_key or ('r%d'):format(row.id),
            label = row.label,
            permissions = decode(row.permissions),
        }
    end

    for i = 1, #config.shops do
        local list = listOf(config.shops[i].id)

        if #list == 0 then
            for j = 1, #config.roles do
                local default = config.roles[j]
                local permissions = permissionSet(default.permissions) or {}
                local id = Storage.addRole(config.shops[i].id, default.key, default.label, json.encode(permissionList(permissions)))

                if id then
                    list[#list + 1] = { id = id, key = default.key, label = default.label, permissions = permissions }
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

---@param shopId string
---@return BarberRole[]
function Roles.list(shopId)
    return listOf(shopId)
end

---@param shopId string
---@param key any
---@return BarberRole?
function Roles.get(shopId, key)
    if type(key) ~= 'string' then return end

    local list = listOf(shopId)

    for i = 1, #list do
        if list[i].key == key then return list[i] end
    end
end

---@param shopId string
---@param key string?
---@return table<string, boolean>
function Roles.permissions(shopId, key)
    local role = Roles.get(shopId, key)

    return role and role.permissions or {}
end

---@param role BarberRole
---@return string[]
function Roles.permissionList(role)
    return permissionList(role.permissions)
end

---@param shopId string
---@param key string?
---@param label any
---@param permissions any
---@return BarberRole?
---@return string?
function Roles.save(shopId, key, label, permissions)
    local name = Text.name(label, limits.minRoleName, limits.maxRoleName)

    if not name then
        return nil, ('Nama role harus %d-%d karakter, hanya huruf, angka, spasi, dan . \' & -'):format(limits.minRoleName, limits.maxRoleName)
    end

    local set = permissionSet(permissions)

    if not set then return nil, 'Izin tidak valid.' end

    local list = listOf(shopId)

    for i = 1, #list do
        if list[i].key ~= key and list[i].label:lower() == name:lower() then
            return nil, 'Nama role sudah dipakai.'
        end
    end

    local encoded = json.encode(permissionList(set))

    if key then
        local role = Roles.get(shopId, key)

        if not role then return nil, 'Role tidak ditemukan.' end

        role.label = name
        role.permissions = set
        Storage.saveRole(role.id, name, encoded)

        return role
    end

    if #list >= limits.maxRoles then return nil, ('Maksimal %d role.'):format(limits.maxRoles) end

    local id = Storage.addRole(shopId, nil, name, encoded)

    if not id then return nil, 'Role gagal disimpan.' end

    ---@type BarberRole
    local role = { id = id, key = ('r%d'):format(id), label = name, permissions = set }

    list[#list + 1] = role

    return role
end

---@param shopId string
---@param key string
---@return boolean
function Roles.remove(shopId, key)
    local list = listOf(shopId)

    for i = 1, #list do
        if list[i].key == key then
            Storage.removeRole(list[i].id)
            table.remove(list, i)

            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

return Roles

---@param origin BarberSceneOrigin
---@param clip string

    local pos = origin.pos
    local start = GetAnimInitialOffsetPosition(origin.dict, clip, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, 0.0, 0.0, origin.heading, 0.0, ROTATION_ORDER)
    local rotation = GetAnimInitialOffsetRotation(origin.dict, clip, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, 0.0, 0.0, origin.heading, 0.0, ROTATION_ORDER)

    return start, rotation.z
end

---@param list BarberChairEntry[]
---@param coords vector3
---@param best BarberChairEntry?
---@param bestDistance number?
---@return BarberChairEntry?
---@return number?
local function closer(list, coords, best, bestDistance)
    for i = 1, #list do
        local entry = list[i]
        local distance = #(coords - entry.coords.xyz)

        if distance <= config.chairDistance and (not bestDistance or distance < bestDistance) then
            best, bestDistance = entry, distance
        end
    end

    return best, bestDistance
end

---@param coords vector3
---@return BarberChairEntry?

    return (closer(Sync.portables(), coords, best, bestDistance))
end

---@param ped number
---@param origin BarberSceneOrigin
---@param clip string
---@param stage BarberSceneStage
---@param prop number?
---@return integer netScene
local function playNetworkScene(ped, origin, clip, stage, prop)
    local pos = origin.pos
    local scene = NetworkCreateSynchronisedScene(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, 0.0, 0.0, origin.heading, ROTATION_ORDER, stage.hold, stage.loop, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0)

    NetworkAddPedToSynchronisedScene(ped, scene, origin.dict, clip, stage.blendIn, stage.blendOut, stage.flags, 0, stage.mover or INSTANT_BLEND, 0)

    if prop and DoesEntityExist(prop) then
        FreezeEntityPosition(prop, false)
        NetworkAddEntityToSynchronisedScene(prop, scene, origin.dict, propClip(clip), INSTANT_BLEND, -INSTANT_BLEND, stage.propFlags or 0)
    end

    NetworkStartSynchronisedScene(scene)

    return scene
end

---@param scene integer
---@param networked boolean
---@param phase number
---@param timeout integer
---@param active (fun(): boolean)?
---@return boolean reached
local function waitScenePhase(scene, networked, phase, timeout, active)
    local deadline = GetGameTimer() + timeout
    local started = false

    while GetGameTimer() < deadline and (not active or active()) do
        local id = networked and NetworkGetLocalSceneFromNetworkId(scene) or scene

        if id ~= -1 and IsSynchronizedSceneRunning(id) then
            started = true

            if GetSynchronizedScenePhase(id) >= phase then return true end
        elseif started then
            return false
        end

        Wait(0)
    end

    return false
end

---@param ped number
---@param origin BarberSceneOrigin
---@param clip string
---@param stage BarberSceneStage
---@param prop number?
---@return integer scene
local function playLocalScene(ped, origin, clip, stage, prop)
    local pos = origin.pos
    local scene = CreateSynchronizedScene(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, 0.0, 0.0, origin.heading, ROTATION_ORDER)

    SetSynchronizedSceneHoldLastFrame(scene, stage.hold)
    SetSynchronizedSceneLooped(scene, stage.loop)
    TaskSynchronizedScene(ped, scene, origin.dict, clip, stage.blendIn, stage.blendOut, stage.flags, 0, stage.mover or INSTANT_BLEND, 0)

    if prop and DoesEntityExist(prop) then
        FreezeEntityPosition(prop, false)
        PlaySynchronizedEntityAnim(prop, scene, propClip(clip), origin.dict, INSTANT_BLEND, -INSTANT_BLEND, 0, INSTANT_BLEND)
        ForceEntityAiAndAnimationUpdate(prop)
    end

    return scene
end

---@param current BarberService
---@param clip string
---@param stage BarberSceneStage
---@return integer? scene
local function playKeeper(current, clip, stage)
    if not DoesEntityExist(current.keeper) then return end

    local prop = not current.attached and current.scissors or nil

    if current.networked then
        return playNetworkScene(current.keeper, current.origin, clip, stage, prop)
    end

    return playLocalScene(current.keeper, current.origin, clip, stage, prop)
end

---@param current BarberService
---@param entry string?
---@return boolean ready
local function keeperEnter(current, entry)
    local origin = current.origin
    local networked = current.networked

    local function active()
        return service == current
    end

    current.entered = true

    if not entry then
        local base = playKeeper(current, 'keeper_base', KEEPER_STAGE.join)

        return base ~= nil and waitScenePhase(base, networked, 0.0, SCENE_START_GRACE, active)
    end

    local enter = playKeeper(current, entry, KEEPER_STAGE.enter)
    local timeout = clipDuration(origin, entry) + SCENE_START_GRACE

    if not enter or not waitScenePhase(enter, networked, SCENE_END_PHASE, timeout, active) then
        return false
    end

    local base = playKeeper(current, 'keeper_base', KEEPER_STAGE.base)

    return base ~= nil and waitScenePhase(base, networked, 0.0, SCENE_START_GRACE, active)
end

---@param ped number
---@param origin BarberSceneOrigin
---@param clip string
---@param timeout integer?
local function approach(ped, origin, clip, timeout)
    local target, heading = clipStart(origin, clip)

    timeout = timeout or APPROACH_TIMEOUT

    if #(target.xy - origin.pos.xy) > 3.0 or #(GetEntityCoords(ped).xy - target.xy) < 0.2 then return end

    TaskFollowNavMeshToCoord(ped, target.x, target.y, target.z, 1.0, timeout, 0.05, 0, heading)

    local deadline = GetGameTimer() + timeout

    repeat
        Wait(0)
    until GetScriptTaskStatus(ped, APPROACH_TASK) == TASK_FINISHED or GetGameTimer() > deadline
end

---@param entities number[]
---@param from integer
---@param to integer
local function fade(entities, from, to)
    for step = 1, FADE_STEPS do
        local alpha = math.floor(from + (to - from) * step / FADE_STEPS)

        for i = 1, #entities do
            if DoesEntityExist(entities[i]) then
                SetEntityAlpha(entities[i], alpha, false)
            end
        end

        Wait(FADE_MS // FADE_STEPS)
    end
end

    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(ped, true)
end

local function releasePed(ped)
    FreezeEntityPosition(ped, false)
    SetPedCanRagdoll(ped, true)
    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(ped, false)
end

local function unlockPed(ped)
