########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\sm_consumable\client\main.lua
local inventory = exports.ox_inventory

local makanan = require 'consumable.makanan'
local minuman = require 'consumable.minuman'
local alkohol = require 'consumable.alcohol'
local other = require 'consumable.other'

local function mergeTables(...)
    local tables = {...}
    local result = {}
    for _, tbl in ipairs(tables) do
        for key, value in pairs(tbl) do
            if type(key) == 'number' then
                result[#result + 1] = value
            else
                result[key] = value
            end
        end
    end
    return result
end

local usableItems = mergeTables(makanan, minuman, other, alkohol)

local function applyDrunkEffect(duration)
    Wait(100)
    DoScreenFadeOut(1)
    Wait(1000)

    SetTimecycleModifier("spectator5")
    SetPedMotionBlur(cache.ped, true)
    SetPedMovementClipset(cache.ped, "MOVE_M@DRUNK@SLIGHTLYDRUNK", true)
    SetPedIsDrunk(cache.ped, true)
    SetPedAccuracy(cache.ped, 0)
    ShakeGameplayCam("DRUNK_SHAKE", 5.0)
    SetPedConfigFlag(cache.ped, 100, true)

    DoScreenFadeIn(1)
    Wait(duration)
    DoScreenFadeOut(1)
    Wait(1000)

    DoScreenFadeIn(1000)
    ClearTimecycleModifier()
    ResetScenarioTypesEnabled()
    ResetPedMovementClipset(cache.ped, 0)
    ShakeGameplayCam("DRUNK_SHAKE", 0.0)
    SetPedIsDrunk(cache.ped, false)
    SetPedMotionBlur(cache.ped, false)
end

local activeProps = {}

---@param prop number
local function deleteProp(prop)
    activeProps[prop] = nil

    if not DoesEntityExist(prop) then return end

    DetachEntity(prop, true, true)
    DeleteEntity(prop)
end

---@param propName string
---@param placement number[]
---@param bone number?
---@param ped number?
---@return number?
local function spawnProp(propName, placement, bone, ped)
    ped = ped or cache.ped

    local model = joaat(propName)

    if not IsModelValid(model) or not lib.requestModel(model, 1000) then return end

    if not DoesEntityExist(ped) then
        SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
        return
    end

    local x, y, z, rx, ry, rz = table.unpack(placement)
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local prop = CreateObject(model, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z + 0.2, false, false, false)

    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)

    if not DoesEntityExist(prop) then return end

    SetEntityCollision(prop, false, false)
    SetEntityCompletelyDisableCollision(prop, false, false)

    AttachEntityToEntity(prop, ped, GetPedBoneIndex(ped, bone or 60309),
        x or 0.0, y or 0.0, z or 0.0,
        rx or 0.0, ry or 0.0, rz or 0.0,
        true, true, false, true, 1, true
    )

    activeProps[prop] = true

    return prop
end

local function handleProgress(itemConfig, itemData)
    local progress = itemConfig.progress
    if not progress then return true end

    local previousEmote = exports['sm_emotes']:IsPlayerInAnim()
    local progressLabel = progress.label:gsub("{itemname}", itemData?.label or "item")

    local animDict, animClip
    local spawnedProps = {}
    local emoteData

    if progress.anim then
        animDict = progress.anim.dict
        animClip = progress.anim.clip
    elseif progress.emote then
        emoteData = exports['sm_emotes']:getEmoteByCommand(progress.emote)
        if emoteData then
            animDict = emoteData.dict
            animClip = emoteData.anim
        end
    end

    local animFlag = previousEmote and 49 or (progress.anim?.flag or 49)

    if emoteData and emoteData.AnimationOptions then
        local opts = emoteData.AnimationOptions

        if opts.Prop or opts.SecondProp then
            LocalPlayer.state:set('consumableProp', progress.emote, true)
        end

        if opts.Prop and opts.PropPlacement and #opts.PropPlacement >= 5 then
            local prop = spawnProp(opts.Prop, opts.PropPlacement, opts.PropBone)

            if prop then
                spawnedProps[#spawnedProps + 1] = prop
            end
        end

        if opts.SecondProp and opts.SecondPropPlacement and #opts.SecondPropPlacement >= 5 then
            local prop = spawnProp(opts.SecondProp, opts.SecondPropPlacement, opts.SecondPropBone)

            if prop then
                spawnedProps[#spawnedProps + 1] = prop
            end
        end
    end

    local success = lib.progressBar({
        duration = progress.duration,
        label = progressLabel,
        useWhileDead = false,
        canCancel = true,
        anim = animDict and {
            dict = animDict,
            clip = animClip,
            flag = animFlag
        } or nil,
        prop = progress.prop and {
            model = progress.prop.model,
            bone = progress.prop.bone,
            pos = progress.prop.pos,
            rot = progress.prop.rot,
        } or nil
    })

    if animDict then
        StopAnimTask(cache.ped, animDict, animClip, 0)
    end

    for i = 1, #spawnedProps do
        deleteProp(spawnedProps[i])
    end

    if LocalPlayer.state.consumableProp then
        LocalPlayer.state:set('consumableProp', nil, true)
    end

    if previousEmote then
        ExecuteCommand('e ' .. previousEmote)
    end

    if success and progress.onSuccess then
        CreateThread(function()
            progress.onSuccess(itemData)
        end)
    elseif not success and progress.onFail then
        CreateThread(function()
            progress.onFail(itemData)
        end)
    end

    return success
end

local function handleHealthEffects(config)
    if config.addHealth then
        local currentHealth = GetEntityHealth(cache.ped)
        local newHealth = math.min(currentHealth + config.addHealth, 200)
        SetEntityHealth(cache.ped, newHealth)

        SetTimeout(1000, function()
            TriggerTokenEvent('ni_consumable:saveHealthArmour')
        end)
    end

    if config.removeHealth then
        local newHealth = math.max(cache.health - config.removeHealth, 0)
        SetEntityHealth(cache.ped, newHealth)

        SetTimeout(1000, function()
            TriggerTokenEvent('ni_consumable:saveHealthArmour')
        end)
    end
end

local function handleArmourEffects(config)
    if config.addArmour then
        local maxArmour = config.maxArmour or 95
        if maxArmour < config.addArmour then
            maxArmour = config.addArmour
        end

        local newArmour = math.min(cache.armour + config.addArmour, maxArmour)
        SetPedArmour(cache.ped, newArmour)

        SetTimeout(1000, function()
            TriggerTokenEvent('ni_consumable:saveHealthArmour')
        end)
    end

    if config.removeArmour then
        local newArmour = math.max(cache.armour - config.removeArmour, 0)
        SetPedArmour(cache.ped, newArmour)

        SetTimeout(1000, function()
            TriggerTokenEvent('ni_consumable:saveHealthArmour')
        end)
    end
end

local function handleStressEffects(config)
    if config.addStress then
        TriggerTokenEvent('sm_hud:server:addStress', config.addStress)
    end

    if config.removeStress then
        TriggerTokenEvent('sm_hud:server:removeStress', config.removeStress)
    end
end

local function handleDrunkEffects(config)
    if config.drunk then
        exports.sm_resource_2:setDrunk(config.drunk)
    end

    if config.removeDrunk then
        exports.sm_resource_2:removeDrunkTime(config.removeDrunk)
    end

    if config.status?.drunkEffect then
        local duration = config.status.drunkEffect
        local durationTime = type(duration) == 'table' and math.random(duration.min, duration.max)
            or type(duration) == 'number' and duration
            or math.random(10, 20)

        exports.sm_resource_2:setDrunk(durationTime)
    end
end

local function handleSpecialEffects(config, itemData)
    if config.animCoke then
        CreateThread(function()
            applyDrunkEffect(10000)
        end)
    end

    if config.animVaksin then
        CreateThread(function()
            applyDrunkEffect(60000)
        end)
    end

    if config.showImage then
        exports['ps-ui']:ShowImage(config.showImage)
    end

    if config.clearBlood then
        ClearPedBloodDamage(cache.ped)
    end

    if config.clientFunction then
        config.clientFunction(itemData)
    end
end

local function applyItemEffects(config, itemData)
    handleHealthEffects(config)
    handleArmourEffects(config)
    handleStressEffects(config)
    handleDrunkEffects(config)
    handleSpecialEffects(config, itemData)
end

for itemKey, itemConfig in pairs(usableItems) do
    RegisterNetEvent(('consumables:client:%s'):format(itemKey), function(customLabel)
        if source ~= 65535 then return end

        local responded = false

        local function respond(success)
            if responded then return end

            responded = true

            TriggerServerEvent(('consumables:server:response:%s'):format(itemKey), success)
        end

        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            local itemData = inventory:Items(itemKey)

            if type(customLabel) == 'string' and customLabel ~= '' and itemData then
                local labelled = {}
                for key, value in pairs(itemData) do labelled[key] = value end
                labelled.label = customLabel
                itemData = labelled
            end

            if itemConfig.validateClient and not itemConfig.validateClient(itemData) then
                return respond(false)
            end

            if not handleProgress(itemConfig, itemData) then
                return respond(false)
            end

            CreateThread(function()
                applyItemEffects(itemConfig, itemData)
            end)

            respond(true)
        end)

        if not ok then
            lib.print.error(('consumable %s gagal: %s'):format(itemKey, err))
            respond(false)
        end
    end)
end

local RENDER_DISTANCE = 5.0

local remoteProps = {}

---@param serverId number
local function removeRemoteProps(serverId)
    local props = remoteProps[serverId]

    if not props then return end

    for i = 1, #props do
        deleteProp(props[i])
    end

    remoteProps[serverId] = nil
end

---@param serverId number
---@param emote string
local function renderRemoteProps(serverId, emote)
    removeRemoteProps(serverId)

    local playerId = GetPlayerFromServerId(serverId)

    if playerId == -1 then return end

    local ped = GetPlayerPed(playerId)

    if ped <= 0 or not DoesEntityExist(ped) then return end

    if #(GetEntityCoords(cache.ped) - GetEntityCoords(ped)) > RENDER_DISTANCE then return end

    local emoteData = exports['sm_emotes']:getEmoteByCommand(emote)
    local opts = emoteData and emoteData.AnimationOptions

    if not opts then return end

    local props
    local amount = 0

    if opts.Prop and opts.PropPlacement and #opts.PropPlacement >= 5 then
        local prop = spawnProp(opts.Prop, opts.PropPlacement, opts.PropBone, ped)

        if prop then
            props = props or {}
            amount += 1
            props[amount] = prop
        end
    end

    if opts.SecondProp and opts.SecondPropPlacement and #opts.SecondPropPlacement >= 5 then
        local prop = spawnProp(opts.SecondProp, opts.SecondPropPlacement, opts.SecondPropBone, ped)

        if prop then
            props = props or {}
            amount += 1
            props[amount] = prop
        end
    end

    remoteProps[serverId] = props
end

AddStateBagChangeHandler('consumableProp', nil, function(bagName, _, value)
    local serverId = tonumber(bagName:gsub('player:', ''), 10)

    if not serverId or serverId == cache.serverId then return end

    if not value then
        return removeRemoteProps(serverId)
    end

    renderRemoteProps(serverId, value)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('onPlayerDropped', function(serverId)
    removeRemoteProps(serverId)
end)

local function clearAllProps()
    local props = {}
    local amount = 0

    for prop in pairs(activeProps) do
        amount += 1
        props[amount] = prop
    end

    for i = 1, amount do
        deleteProp(props[i])
    end

    table.wipe(remoteProps)

    if LocalPlayer.state.consumableProp then
        LocalPlayer.state:set('consumableProp', nil, true)
    end
end

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:OnPlayerUnload', clearAllProps)

lib.onCache('ped', clearAllProps)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= GetCurrentResourceName() then return end

    clearAllProps()

    pcall(function()
        exports['sm_emotes']:EmoteCancel(true)
    end)
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\sm_consumable\server\main.lua
local QBCore = exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject()

local makanan = require 'consumable.makanan'
local minuman = require 'consumable.minuman'
local alkohol = require 'consumable.alcohol'
local other = require 'consumable.other'

local items = {}

local function merge(source)
    for key, value in pairs(source) do
        items[key] = value
    end
end

merge(makanan)
merge(minuman)
merge(alkohol)
merge(other)

local function clampStatus(Player, key, delta)
    local current = Player.PlayerData.metadata[key] or 100

    Player.Functions.SetMetaData(key, math.max(math.min(current + delta, 100), 0))
end

local function applyStatus(Player, cfg)
    if type(cfg.status) ~= 'table' then return end

    for key, delta in pairs(cfg.status) do
        if (key == 'hunger' or key == 'thirst') and type(delta) == 'number' then
            clampStatus(Player, key, delta)
        end
    end
end

local function useItem(source, itemName, label)
    local cfg = items[itemName]

    if not cfg then return false end

    TriggerClientEvent(('consumables:client:%s'):format(itemName), source, label)

    return true
end

exports('use', useItem)

RegisterNetEvent('consumables:server:use', function(itemName, label)
    useItem(source, itemName, label)
end)

for itemName, cfg in pairs(items) do
    RegisterNetEvent(('consumables:server:response:%s'):format(itemName), function(success)
        local source = source
        local Player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(source)

        if not Player or not success then return end

        local item = Player.Functions.GetItemByName(itemName)

        if not item then return end

        if cfg.removeItems then
            Player.Functions.RemoveItem(itemName, 1)
        end

        applyStatus(Player, cfg)
    end)
end

RegisterNetEvent('ni_consumable:saveHealthArmour', function()
    local source = source
    local Player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(source)
    local ped = GetPlayerPed(source)

    if not Player or not ped or ped == 0 then return end

    local health = GetEntityHealth(ped)
    local armour = GetPedArmour(ped)

    if health > 0 then
        Player.Functions.SetMetaData('health', math.max(health, 100))
    end

    Player.Functions.SetMetaData('armour', armour)
end)

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    TriggerClientEvent('onPlayerDropped', -1, source)
end)

lib.print.info(('sm_consumable server siap (%d item)'):format((function()
    local n = 0
    for _ in pairs(items) do n = n + 1 end
    return n
end)()))

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\sm_custom\init.lua
local resource = GetCurrentResourceName()

if GetResourceMetadata(resource, 'name', 0) ~= 'sm_custom' then
    error(('@sm_custom/init.lua cannot be loaded by %s'):format(resource), 0)
end

---@class RhdModules
---@field areas AreasClient | AreasServer
---@field billing BillingClient | BillingServer
---@field booth BoothClient | BoothServer
---@field camera CameraClient
---@field cart CartShared
---@field catalog CatalogClient
---@field discount DiscountServer
---@field fitment FitmentClient | FitmentServer
---@field install InstallClient | InstallServer
---@field interact InteractClient
---@field jobs JobsServer
---@field logs LogsServer
---@field net NetShared
---@field nitrous NitrousClient | NitrousServer
---@field placer PlacerClient
---@field pricing PricingServer
---@field receipt ReceiptClient | ReceiptServer
---@field shops ShopsClient
---@field swap SwapClient | SwapServer
---@field wheels WheelsClient
---@field zones ZonesShared | ZonesServer

local context <const> = lib.context

---@param name string
---@param side string
---@return string?
local function locate(name, side)
    if not LoadResourceFile(resource, ('modules/%s/%s.lua'):format(name, side)) then return end

    return ('modules.%s.%s'):format(name, side)
end

---@param self table
---@param name string
---@return any
local function import(self, name)
    local shared, side = locate(name, 'shared'), locate(name, context)
    if not shared and not side then return end

    local module = shared and require(shared)

    if side then
        rawset(self, name, module)

        local extended = require(side)

        local mergeable = type(extended) == 'table' and type(module) == 'table' and extended ~= module

        if mergeable and not getmetatable(extended) then
            setmetatable(extended, { __index = module })
        end

        module = extended
    end

    rawset(self, name, module)

    return module
end

---@type RhdModules
---@diagnostic disable-next-line: lowercase-global
modules = setmetatable({}, {
    __index = function(self, name)
        return import(self, name) or error(locale('log.no_module', name, context), 2)
    end,
})

for i = 1, GetNumResourceMetadata(resource, 'rhd_module') do
    local name = GetResourceMetadata(resource, 'rhd_module', i - 1)

    if not rawget(modules, name) then import(modules, name) end
end


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\sm_custom\client\main.lua
local config = require 'config.client'

---@type table<string, NitrousEffect>
local EFFECT_VIEWS <const> = { flame = 'flame', purge = 'purge' }
local RADIO_CONTROLS <const> = { 249, 19 }
local HORN_CONTROL <const> = 86

---@class FitmentEdit
---@field values FitmentValues
---@field original FitmentValues
---@field defaults? FitmentValues
---@field ranges? FitmentRanges

---@class CustomProps : VehicleProperties
---@field nitrousFlame? integer[]
---@field nitrousPurge? integer[]
---@field engineSound? string | false

---@class CustomClientSession
---@field vehicle number
---@field props VehicleProperties
---@field prices CustomPrices
---@field fitment? FitmentEdit
---@field effect? NitrousEffect
---@field shown? table
---@field zone CustomZone
---@field shop CustomShop
---@field sound string | false
---@field label string

---@class CustomShop
---@field label string
---@field mechanic boolean
---@field billing boolean
---@field install boolean
---@field repair 'manual' | 'auto'
---@field timeout number
---@field self boolean

---@class CustomOpenPayload
---@field error? 'zone' | 'vehicle' | 'job' | 'owner' | 'busy'
---@field prices CustomPrices
---@field balance { cash: number, bank: number }
---@field owned boolean
---@field mine boolean
---@field shop CustomShop

---@type table<string, string>
local OPEN_ERRORS <const> = {
    zone = 'open.zone',
    vehicle = 'open.vehicle',
    job = 'open.job',
    owner = 'open.owner',
    busy = 'open.busy',
}

---@type CustomClientSession?
local session
---@type CustomOpenPayload?
local received
---@class CustomPurchaseResult
---@field ok boolean
---@field reason? string
---@field balance { cash: number, bank: number }
---@field install? boolean
---@field menu? CatalogNode[]
---@field receipt? string

---@type CustomPurchaseResult?
local purchased
---@type { list?: table[], values?: FitmentValues }?
local answered
---@type { active: boolean, focus?: integer, sent: { wheel: integer, x: number, y: number }[] }
local picker = { active = false, sent = {} }
---@type { engine: boolean, rev: boolean, burnout: boolean, lights: boolean, horn: boolean }
local controls = { engine = true, rev = false, burnout = false, lights = false, horn = false }
local pulse = 0

---@param vehicle number
---@param props VehicleProperties
local function setProps(vehicle, props)
    local primary, secondary = props.color1, props.color2
    local base = table.clone(props)

    if type(primary) == 'table' then base.color1 = nil end
    if type(secondary) == 'table' then base.color2 = nil end

    lib.setVehicleProperties(vehicle, base)

    if type(primary) ~= 'table' and type(secondary) ~= 'table' then return end

    local pearlescent, wheel = GetVehicleExtraColours(vehicle)

    if type(primary) == 'table' then
        SetVehicleModColor_1(vehicle, props.paintType1 or 1, 0, pearlescent)
        SetVehicleCustomPrimaryColour(vehicle, primary[1], primary[2], primary[3])
    end

    if type(secondary) == 'table' then
        SetVehicleModColor_2(vehicle, props.paintType2 or 1, 0)
        SetVehicleCustomSecondaryColour(vehicle, secondary[1], secondary[2], secondary[3])
    end

    SetVehicleExtraColours(vehicle, pearlescent, wheel)
end

---@param vehicle number
local function fix(vehicle)
    SetVehicleEngineHealth(vehicle, 1000.0)
    SetVehicleBodyHealth(vehicle, 1000.0)
    SetVehiclePetrolTankHealth(vehicle, 1000.0)
    SetVehicleFixed(vehicle)
    SetVehicleDeformationFixed(vehicle)

    for index = 0, 7 do
        FixVehicleWindow(vehicle, index)
        SetVehicleTyreFixed(vehicle, index)
    end
end

---@param vehicle number
local function wash(vehicle)
    SetVehicleDirtLevel(vehicle, 0.0)
    WashDecalsFromVehicle(vehicle, 1.0)
end

local function close()
    if not session then return end

    local vehicle, props, edit = session.vehicle, session.props, session.fitment

    session = nil

    if controls.rev or controls.burnout then
        ClearPedTasks(cache.ped)
    end

    if DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then
        setProps(vehicle, props)
        modules.fitment.refresh(vehicle)

        modules.swap.release(vehicle)

        SetVehicleLights(vehicle, 0)
        SetVehicleEngineOn(vehicle, true, true, false)
        FreezeEntityPosition(vehicle, false)
    end

    if edit then
        modules.fitment.release(vehicle, edit.original)
    end

    modules.nitrous.preview(vehicle, nil, {})
    picker = { active = false, sent = {} }
    modules.camera.stop()
    config.hud.show()
    SetNuiFocusKeepInput(false)
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'close' })
    TriggerServerEvent('sm_custom:server:close')
end

---@param markers { wheel: integer, x: number, y: number }[]
---@return boolean
local function moved(markers)
    local sent = picker.sent
    if #sent ~= #markers then return true end

    for i, marker in ipairs(markers) do
        local last = sent[i]
        local shift = math.max(math.abs(last.x - marker.x), math.abs(last.y - marker.y))

        if last.wheel ~= marker.wheel or shift > 0.0015 then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

---@param force? boolean
local function syncWheels(force)
    local markers = picker.active and modules.camera.wheels() or {}

    if force or moved(markers) then
        picker.sent = markers
        SendNUIMessage({ action = 'wheels', data = { markers = markers, focus = picker.focus } })
    end
end

local function watch()
    local missing = 0

    while session do
        local vehicle = session.vehicle

        if not DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then
            print(locale('log.vehicle_gone'))
            return close()
        end

        missing = IsPedInVehicle(cache.ped, vehicle, false) and 0 or missing + 1

        if missing > 30 then
            print(locale('log.player_left'))
            return close()
        end

        if session.effect then
            modules.nitrous.keep(session.shown or session.props)
        end

        if (controls.rev or controls.burnout) and GetGameTimer() >= pulse then
            TaskVehicleTempAction(cache.ped, session.vehicle, controls.burnout and 30 or 31, 1500)
            pulse = GetGameTimer() + 1200
        end

        DisableAllControlActions(0)

        for i = 1, #RADIO_CONTROLS do
            EnableControlAction(0, RADIO_CONTROLS[i], true)
        end

        if controls.horn then
            EnableControlAction(0, HORN_CONTROL, true)
            SetControlNormal(0, HORN_CONTROL, 1.0)
        end

        HideHudAndRadarThisFrame()
        modules.camera.tick()

        if picker.active then
            syncWheels()
        end
        Wait(0)
    end
end

---@param zone CustomZone
local function open(zone)
    local vehicle = cache.vehicle
    if session or modules.install.active() or not vehicle or cache.seat ~= -1 then return end

    local netId = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(vehicle)

    received = nil
    TriggerServerEvent('sm_custom:server:open', netId, zone.id, GetVehicleClass(vehicle))

    local payload = modules.net.awaitPush(function() return received end, 5000) --[[@as CustomOpenPayload?]]

    if not payload or payload.error then
        local reason = payload and OPEN_ERRORS[payload.error]

        return lib.notify({ type = 'error', description = locale(reason or 'open.timeout') })
    end

    if cache.vehicle ~= vehicle then
        return TriggerServerEvent('sm_custom:server:close')
    end

    local props = lib.getVehicleProperties(vehicle) --[[@as CustomProps]]
    local model = GetDisplayNameFromVehicleModel(props.model --[[@as number]])
    local tank = modules.nitrous.tank(vehicle)

    if tank then
        props.nitrousFlame = tank.flame or config.nitrous.flame.colour
        props.nitrousPurge = tank.purge or config.nitrous.purge.colour
    end

    props.engineSound = modules.swap.current(vehicle)

    local catalog = modules.catalog
    local label = catalog.label(model, model)
    local menu = catalog.build(vehicle, props, payload.prices, zone)

    session = {
        vehicle = vehicle,
        props = props,
        prices = payload.prices,
        zone = zone,
        shop = payload.shop,
        sound = props.engineSound,
        label = label,
    }
    controls = { engine = true, rev = false, burnout = false, lights = false, horn = false }

    modules.net.emitLatentServer('sm_custom:server:original', props)
    FreezeEntityPosition(vehicle, true)
    SetVehicleEngineOn(vehicle, true, true, false)
    config.hud.hide()
    modules.camera.start(vehicle)

    SendNUIMessage({
        action = 'open',
        data = {
            name = label,
            class = modules.catalog.label(('VEH_CLASS_%d'):format(GetVehicleClass(vehicle)), ''),
            plate = props.plate,
            balance = payload.balance,
            props = props,
            menu = menu,
            controls = controls,
            shop = payload.shop,
        },
    })

    SetNuiFocus(true, true)
    SetNuiFocusKeepInput(true)
    CreateThread(watch)

    if not payload.owned then
        lib.notify({ type = 'info', description = locale('open.unowned') })
    elseif not payload.mine then
        lib.notify({ type = 'info', description = locale('open.customer') })
    end
end

---@return table<string, string>
local function interfaceLocales()
    local result = {}

    for key, text in pairs(lib.getLocales()) do
        local name = key:match('^ui%.(.+)$')

        if name then result[name] = text end
    end

    return result
end

    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'locales', data = interfaceLocales() })

    local vehicle = NetToVeh(netId)

end)

RegisterNUICallback('preview', function(data, cb)
    if not session then return cb(0) end

    local shown = modules.cart.merge(modules.cart.merge(session.props, data.cart), data.preview or {})

    session.shown = shown
    setProps(session.vehicle, shown)
    modules.fitment.refresh(session.vehicle)
    modules.nitrous.preview(session.vehicle, session.effect, shown)

    if shown.engineSound ~= session.sound then
        session.sound = shown.engineSound
        modules.swap.hold(session.vehicle, session.sound)
    end

    cb(modules.cart.total(session.prices, session.props, data.cart))
end)

RegisterNUICallback('fitment', function(_, cb)
    if not session then return cb(false) end

    local vehicle = session.vehicle
    local defaults, ranges = modules.wheels.probe(vehicle)

    if not session or not defaults then return cb(false) end

    local edit = session.fitment

    if not edit then
        local values = modules.wheels.capture(vehicle)

        edit = { values = values, original = modules.wheels.copy(values) }
        session.fitment = edit
        modules.fitment.hold(vehicle, values)
    elseif edit.values.rim ~= modules.wheels.rim(vehicle) then
        modules.wheels.rebase(edit.values, modules.wheels.capture(vehicle))
    end

    edit.defaults, edit.ranges = defaults, ranges

    cb({
        values = edit.values,
        defaults = defaults,
        ranges = ranges,
        targets = modules.wheels.targets(vehicle),
        stored = modules.fitment.get(vehicle) ~= nil,
    })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('fitmentAdjust', function(data, cb)
    local edit = session and session.fitment
    if not session or not edit or not edit.ranges or type(data) ~= 'table' then return cb(false) end

    cb(modules.wheels.adjust(session.vehicle, edit.values, edit.ranges, data))
end)

RegisterNUICallback('fitmentApply', function(data, cb)
    local edit = session and session.fitment
    local values = type(data) == 'table' and data.values
    if not session or not edit or type(values) ~= 'table' then return cb(false) end
    if type(values.offset) ~= 'table' or type(values.rotation) ~= 'table' then return cb(false) end

    edit.values = modules.wheels.copy(values)
    modules.fitment.hold(session.vehicle, edit.values)
    modules.fitment.share(session.vehicle)
    cb(true)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('fitmentShare', function(_, cb)
    cb(1)

    if session and session.fitment then
        modules.fitment.share(session.vehicle)
    end
end)

RegisterNUICallback('presets', function(data, cb)
    local edit = session and session.fitment
    if not session or type(data) ~= 'table' then return cb(false) end

    local action = data.action
    if action == 'get' and not edit then return cb(false) end

    answered = nil
    TriggerServerEvent('sm_custom:server:presets', action, action == 'save' and {
        name = data.name,
        public = data.public == true,
    } or data.id)

    local reply = modules.net.awaitPush(function() return answered end, 5000)

    if reply and reply.values and edit and session and session.fitment == edit then
        local values = modules.wheels.copy(reply.values)

        if values.rim ~= modules.wheels.rim(session.vehicle) then
            reply.skipped = values.rim ~= nil
            modules.wheels.rebase(values, edit.values)
        end

        edit.values, reply.values = values, values
        modules.fitment.hold(session.vehicle, edit.values)
        modules.fitment.share(session.vehicle)
    end

    cb(reply or false)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_custom:client:presets', function(reply)
    if source == '' then return end

    answered = type(reply) == 'table' and reply or {}
end)

RegisterNUICallback('wheelPick', function(data, cb)
    cb(1)

    local active = session ~= nil and type(data) == 'table' and data.active == true

    if not active and picker.focus then
        modules.camera.focusWheel(nil)
    end

    picker.active, picker.focus = active, active and picker.focus or nil
    syncWheels(true)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('wheelFocus', function(data, cb)
    cb(1)

    if not session or not picker.active or type(data) ~= 'table' then return end

    picker.focus = modules.camera.focusWheel(tonumber(data.wheel))
    syncWheels(true)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('view', function(data, cb)
    cb(1)
    picker.focus = nil
    modules.camera.focus(data.view)

    if session then
        session.effect = EFFECT_VIEWS[data.view]
        modules.nitrous.preview(session.vehicle, session.effect, session.shown or session.props)
    end
end)

RegisterNUICallback('orbit', function(data, cb)
    cb(1)
    modules.camera.orbit(data.x, data.y, data.zoom)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('camera', function(_, cb)
    cb(session ~= nil and modules.camera.toggle())
end)

RegisterNUICallback('frame', function(data, cb)
    cb(1)
    modules.camera.frame(data.left, data.top, data.right, data.bottom)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('control', function(data, cb)
    local name = data.name
    if not session or controls[name] == nil then return cb(controls) end

    local vehicle = session.vehicle
    local acting = controls.rev or controls.burnout

    controls[name] = not controls[name]

    if controls[name] and (name == 'rev' or name == 'burnout') then
        controls[name == 'rev' and 'burnout' or 'rev'] = false
        controls.engine = true
    elseif name == 'engine' and not controls.engine then
        controls.rev, controls.burnout = false, false
    end

    if acting and not (controls.rev or controls.burnout) then
        ClearPedTasks(cache.ped)
    end

    SetVehicleEngineOn(vehicle, controls.engine, true, true)
    SetVehicleLights(vehicle, controls.lights and 2 or 0)
    FreezeEntityPosition(vehicle, not controls.burnout)

    pulse = 0
    cb(controls)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('customers', function(_, cb)
    if not session or not session.shop.billing then return cb({}) end

    cb(lib.callback.await('sm_custom:server:customers', false) or {})
end)

---@param vehicle number
local function assemble(vehicle)
    close()

    if not DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then return end

    FreezeEntityPosition(vehicle, true)

    if IsPedInVehicle(cache.ped, vehicle, false) then
        TaskLeaveVehicle(cache.ped, vehicle, 0)
    end
end

RegisterNUICallback('discount', function(data, cb)
    if not session or type(data) ~= 'table' then return cb({ ok = false, reason = 'invalid' }) end

    local code = type(data.code) == 'string' and data.code or false

    cb(lib.callback.await('sm_custom:server:discount', false, code) or { ok = false, reason = 'timeout' })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('purchase', function(data, cb)
    if not session or type(data) ~= 'table' or type(data.cart) ~= 'table' then return cb({ ok = false }) end

    local billed = data.method == 'bill'

    purchased = nil
    modules.net.emitLatentServer('sm_custom:server:purchase', data.cart, data.method, {
        customer = billed and tonumber(data.customer) or nil,
        items = type(data.items) == 'table' and data.items or nil,
        vehicle = session.label,
    })

    local timeout = billed and (session.shop.timeout + 10) * 1000 or 10000
    local result = modules.net.awaitPush(function() return purchased end, timeout) --[[@as CustomPurchaseResult?]]

    if result and result.ok and result.receipt then
        cb(result)
        close()

        return lib.notify({ type = 'success', description = locale('receipt.issued', result.receipt) })
    end

    if result and result.ok and session then
        if result.install then
            cb(result)

            return assemble(session.vehicle)
        end

        local edit, bought = session.fitment, data.cart.fitment

        session.props = modules.cart.merge(session.props, data.cart)

        if edit and bought ~= nil then
            edit.original = modules.wheels.copy(bought or edit.defaults or edit.original)
        end

        if data.cart.repair then
            fix(session.vehicle)
            session.props = modules.cart.repair(session.props)
        end

        if data.cart.clean then
            wash(session.vehicle)
            session.props = modules.cart.clean(session.props)
        end
    end

    if result and not result.ok then
        lib.print.warn(('purchase failed: %s, method %s, cart %s'):format(result.reason, data.method, json.encode(data.cart)))
    end

    cb(result or { ok = false, reason = 'timeout' })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('close', function(_, cb)
    cb(1)
    close()
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource == cache.resource then close() end
end)

modules.install.start(function(vehicle, props)
    local patch = table.clone(props)

    if patch.repair then
        patch.repair = nil
        fix(vehicle)
    end

    if patch.clean then
        patch.clean = nil
        wash(vehicle)
    end

    if patch.modFrontWheels ~= nil and patch.modCustomTiresF == nil then
        patch.modCustomTiresF = GetVehicleModVariation(vehicle, 23)
    end

    if patch.modBackWheels ~= nil and patch.modCustomTiresR == nil then
        patch.modCustomTiresR = GetVehicleModVariation(vehicle, 24)
    end

    setProps(vehicle, patch)
    modules.fitment.refresh(vehicle)
end)

modules.booth.start(setProps)

modules.shops.start(open, function() return session == nil and not modules.install.active() end)
modules.billing.start(function() return session ~= nil end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\sm_custom\modules\areas\client.lua
---@class AreasClient : AreasShared
local areas = {}

---@type table<string, CZone>
local polygons = {}
---@type table<string, true>
local present = {}
---@type fun(key: string, inside: boolean)[]
local listeners = {}

---@param key string
---@param inside boolean
local function report(key, inside)
    present[key] = inside or nil
    TriggerServerEvent('sm_custom:server:area', key, inside)

    for _, listener in ipairs(listeners) do
        listener(key, inside)
    end
end

local function build()
    for _, polygon in pairs(polygons) do
        polygon:remove()
    end

    table.wipe(polygons)
    table.wipe(present)

    for key, group in pairs(modules.zones.data) do
        local shape = group.area

        if type(shape) == 'table' and type(shape.points) == 'table' and #shape.points >= 3 then
            polygons[key] = lib.zones.poly({
                points = shape.points,
                thickness = shape.thickness,
                onEnter = function() report(key, true) end,
                onExit = function() report(key, false) end,
            })
        end
    end
end

---@param listener fun(key: string, inside: boolean)
function areas.watch(listener)
    listeners[#listeners + 1] = listener
end

---@param key string
---@return boolean
function areas.inside(key)
    return present[key] == true
end

build()
modules.zones.watch(build)

return areas


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\sm_custom\modules\areas\shared.lua
---@class CustomArea
---@field points vector3[]
---@field thickness number

local Z_TOLERANCE <const> = 1.0

---@class AreasShared
local area = {
    MAX_POINTS = 32,
    MIN_HEIGHT = 1.0,
    MAX_HEIGHT = 50.0,
}

---@param points vector3[]
---@return number
function area.level(points)
    local sum = 0.0

    for _, point in ipairs(points) do
        sum += point.z
    end

    return sum / math.max(#points, 1)
end

---@param points vector3[]
---@return vector3[]
function area.flatten(points)
    local z, result = area.level(points), {}

    for i, point in ipairs(points) do
        result[i] = vec3(point.x, point.y, z)
    end

    return result
end

---@param ring vector3[]
---@param height number
---@return vector3[][]
function area.prism(ring, height)
    local offset = vec3(0.0, 0.0, height / 2)
    local count = #ring
    local segments = {}

    for i, point in ipairs(ring) do
        local bottom, top = point - offset, point + offset
        local following = count > 2 and ring[i % count + 1] or ring[i + 1]

        segments[#segments + 1] = { bottom, top }

        if following then
            segments[#segments + 1] = { bottom, following - offset }
            segments[#segments + 1] = { top, following + offset }
        end
    end

    return segments
end

---@param points vector3[]
---@param x number
---@param y number
---@return boolean
local function inside(points, x, y)
    local result, previous = false, points[#points]

    for _, current in ipairs(points) do
        local crosses = (current.y > y) ~= (previous.y > y)

        if crosses and x < (previous.x - current.x) * (y - current.y) / (previous.y - current.y) + current.x then
            result = not result
        end

        previous = current
    end

    return result
end

---@param a vector3
---@param b vector3
---@param x number
---@param y number
---@return number
local function gap(a, b, x, y)
    local dx, dy = b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y
    local length = dx * dx + dy * dy
    local t = length > 0 and math.min(math.max(((x - a.x) * dx + (y - a.y) * dy) / length, 0.0), 1.0) or 0.0
    local px, py = a.x + dx * t - x, a.y + dy * t - y

    return math.sqrt(px * px + py * py)
end

---@param shape CustomArea
---@param coords vector3
---@param margin? number
---@return boolean
function area.contains(shape, coords, margin)
    local points, slack = shape.points, margin or 0.0
    if #points < 3 then return false end
    if math.abs(coords.z - area.level(points)) > shape.thickness / 2 + Z_TOLERANCE + slack then return false end
    if inside(points, coords.x, coords.y) then return true end
    if slack <= 0.0 then return false end

    local previous = points[#points]

    for _, current in ipairs(points) do
        if gap(previous, current, coords.x, coords.y) <= slack then return true end

        previous = current
    end

    return false
end

return area

---@class BillingClient
local invoice = {}

---@type integer?
local current
---@type fun(): boolean
local busy = function() return false end

local function hide()
    current = nil
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'bill', data = false })

    if not busy() then SetNuiFocus(false, false) end
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_custom:client:bill', function(bill)
    if source == '' or type(bill) ~= 'table' or math.type(bill.id) ~= 'integer' then return end

    current = bill.id

    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'bill', data = bill })
    SetNuiFocus(true, true)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_custom:client:billClosed', function(id)
    if source == '' or id ~= current then return end

    hide()
    lib.notify({ type = 'error', description = locale('bill.expired') })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('billReply', function(data, cb)
    cb(1)

    local id = current
    if not id then return end

    local choice = type(data) == 'table' and data.choice
    local reply = (choice == 'cash' or choice == 'bank') and choice or 'decline'

    hide()
    TriggerServerEvent('sm_custom:server:billReply', id, reply)
end)

---@param handler fun(): boolean
function invoice.start(handler)
    busy = handler
end

return invoice


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\sm_custom\modules\booth\client.lua
local config = require 'config.client'

local SEND_EVERY <const> = 100

    far = 'booth.far',
    taken = 'booth.taken',

---@class BoothSurface

local paints = {
    finishes = lib.load('data.menu.options').finishes,
    groups = lib.load('data.menu.paints'),
}

---@param hex string
---@return number[]
local function rgbOf(hex)
    local value = tonumber(hex, 16) or 0

    return { (value >> 16) & 255, (value >> 8) & 255, value & 255 }
end

---@param rgb number[]
---@return number[]
local function vivid(rgb)
    local peak, low = math.max(rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3]), math.min(rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3])
    local purity = peak > 0 and (peak - low) / peak or 0
    local scale = MIST_LEVEL / math.max(peak, 1) * purity
    local grey = MIST_LEVEL * (1 - purity)

    return { grey + rgb[1] * scale, grey + rgb[2] * scale, grey + rgb[3] * scale }
end

---@type table<integer, number[]>
local tones = {}
---@type table<integer, number[][]>
local shades = {}

for _, group in ipairs(paints.groups) do
    for _, entry in ipairs(group.colors) do
        if entry.ramp then
            local list, r, g, b = {}, 0, 0, 0

            for i, hex in ipairs(entry.ramp) do
                local rgb = rgbOf(hex)

                list[i] = vivid(rgb)
                r, g, b = r + rgb[1], g + rgb[2], b + rgb[3]
            end

            local gain = BODY_GAIN / #list

            tones[entry.id] = { math.min(r * gain, 255), math.min(g * gain, 255), math.min(b * gain, 255) }
            shades[entry.id] = list
        elseif entry.hex then
            tones[entry.id] = rgbOf(entry.hex)
        end
    end
end

---@class BoothClient
local booth = {}

---@param view table

local function decorate(view)
    local result = table.clone(view)

    if view.model then
        local name = GetDisplayNameFromVehicleModel(view.model)

        result.vehicle = modules.catalog.label(name, name)
    end

    return result

---@param net any

local function vehicleOf(net)
    if type(net) ~= 'number' or not NetworkDoesEntityExistWithNetworkId(net) then return 0 end

    return NetToVeh(net)

---@param site BoothSite
---@param sync? boolean
local function project(site, sync)
    if not dui then return end

    sent = GetGameTimer()

    if not site.view then return dui:sendMessage({ standby = site.booth.label }) end

    local message = {
        view = decorate(site.view),
        paints = paints,
        control = focused == site and control or nil,
        sync = sync and (latest or { selection = site.view.selection, cursor = site.view.cursor }) or nil,
    }

    if viewing and focused == site then
        return SendNUIMessage({ action = 'boothScreen', data = message })
    end

    dui:sendMessage(message)
end

---@param a vector3
---@param b vector3
---@return vector3
local function cross(a, b)
    return vec3(a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y, a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z, a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x)
end

---@param entity integer
---@return BoothSurface
local function measure(entity)
    ---@type vector3[]
    local corners = {}

    for i, offset in ipairs(data.screen.surface) do
        corners[i] = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(entity, offset.x, offset.y, offset.z)
    end

    local across, up = corners[2] - corners[1], corners[1] - corners[4]

    return {
        center = (corners[1] + corners[3]) / 2,
        normal = norm(cross(across, up)),
        width = #across,
        height = #up,
        corners = corners,
    }
end

---@param corners vector3[]
---@param x number
---@param y number
---@return number? u
---@return number? v
local function cursorUv(corners, x, y)
    local points = {}

    for i = 1, 4 do
        local visible, sx, sy = GetScreenCoordFromWorldCoord(corners[i].x, corners[i].y, corners[i].z)
        if not visible then return end

        points[i] = { x = sx, y = sy }
    end

    local p0, p1, p2, p3 = points[1], points[2], points[3], points[4]
    local u, v = 0.5, 0.5

    for _ = 1, 10 do
        local iu, iv = 1 - u, 1 - v
        local ex = x - (iu * iv * p0.x + u * iv * p1.x + u * v * p2.x + iu * v * p3.x)
        local ey = y - (iu * iv * p0.y + u * iv * p1.y + u * v * p2.y + iu * v * p3.y)

        if math.abs(ex) < 0.00001 and math.abs(ey) < 0.00001 then break end

        local dux = -iv * p0.x + iv * p1.x + v * p2.x - v * p3.x
        local duy = -iv * p0.y + iv * p1.y + v * p2.y - v * p3.y
        local dvx = -iu * p0.x - u * p1.x + u * p2.x + iu * p3.x
        local dvy = -iu * p0.y - u * p1.y + u * p2.y + iu * p3.y
        local det = dux * dvy - duy * dvx

        if math.abs(det) < 0.0000001 then break end

        u = u + (ex * dvy - ey * dvx) / det
        v = v + (dux * ey - duy * ex) / det
    end

    return u, v
end

---@return BoothSite?
local function closest()
    local coords, found, nearest = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped), nil, math.huge

    for _, site in pairs(sites) do
        local distance = site.screen and #(coords - site.booth.screen.xyz)

        if distance and distance < nearest then found, nearest = site, distance end
    end

    return found
end

local function render()
    if rendering then return end

    rendering = true

    CreateThread(function()
        local target, model = data.screen.target, joaat(data.screen.model)

        if not IsNamedRendertargetRegistered(target) then RegisterNamedRendertarget(target, false) end
        if not IsNamedRendertargetLinked(model) then LinkNamedRendertarget(model) end

        local id = GetNamedRendertargetRenderId(target)
        local screen = lib.dui:new({
            url = ('https://cfx-nui-%s/html/screen.html'):format(cache.resource),
            width = data.screen.width,
            height = data.screen.height,
        })

        dui = screen

        while true do
            local site = focused or closest()
            if not site then break end

            if site ~= shown or GetGameTimer() - sent > RESEND then
                shown = site
                project(site)
            end

            SetTextRenderId(id)
            SetScriptGfxDrawOrder(4)
            SetScriptGfxDrawBehindPausemenu(true)
            DrawSprite(screen.dictName, screen.txtName, 0.5, 0.5, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0, 255, 255, 255, 255)
            SetTextRenderId(GetDefaultScriptRendertargetRenderId())
            Wait(0)
        end

        screen:remove()
        ReleaseNamedRendertarget(target)
        dui, shown, rendering = nil, nil, false
    end)
end

---@param model string
---@param coords vector3
---@param rotation vector3
---@return integer
local function prop(model, coords, rotation)
    local hash = lib.requestModel(model)
    local entity = CreateObjectNoOffset(hash, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false)

    SetEntityRotation(entity, rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z, 2, false)
    FreezeEntityPosition(entity, true)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(hash)

    return entity
end

---@param site BoothSite
local function stop(site)
    for _, handle in ipairs(site.fx) do
        StopParticleFxLooped(handle, false)
    end

    table.wipe(site.fx)
end

---@param site BoothSite
local function clear(site)
    stop(site)

    if site.screen and DoesEntityExist(site.screen) then DeleteEntity(site.screen) end

    for _, entity in ipairs(site.nozzles) do
        if DoesEntityExist(entity) then DeleteEntity(entity) end
    end

    site.screen = nil
    table.wipe(site.nozzles)
end

---@param site BoothSite
local function furnish(site)
    local token, entry = site.token, site.booth
    local spot = entry.screen

    if spot then
        local made, screen = pcall(prop, data.screen.model, spot.xyz, vec3(0.0, 0.0, spot.w))

        if site.token ~= token then
            if made then DeleteEntity(screen) end
            return
        end

        if made then site.screen = screen end
    end

    for _, nozzle in ipairs(entry.nozzles) do
        local ok, entity = pcall(prop, data.nozzle.model, nozzle.coords, nozzle.rotation)

        if site.token ~= token then
            if ok then DeleteEntity(entity) end
            return
        end

        if ok then site.nozzles[#site.nozzles + 1] = entity end
    end

    if site.final then mist(site, vehicleOf(site.net), site.tone or data.primer.colour) end
    if site.screen then render() end
end

---@param area BoothSurface
---@param ease integer
local function look(area, ease)
    local view, center = data.screen.camera, area.center
    local spread = math.tan(math.rad(view.fov / 2))
    local fit = math.max(area.height / 2, area.width / 2 / GetAspectRatio(false)) / spread / view.fill
    local position = center + area.normal * fit

    cam = CreateCamWithParams(
        'DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA',
        position.x,
        position.y,
        position.z,
        0.0,
        0.0,
        0.0,
        view.fov,
        true,
        2
    )
    PointCamAtCoord(cam, center.x, center.y, center.z)
    RenderScriptCams(true, ease > 0, ease, true, true)
end

---@param site BoothSite
---@param paint any
local function preview(site, paint)
    local view = site.view
    if not view or view.mode ~= 'screen' or view.status == 'spraying' or not view.initial then return end
    if type(paint) ~= 'table' then return end

    local vehicle = vehicleOf(view.net)
    if vehicle == 0 then return end

    previewing = previewing or { vehicle = vehicle, initial = view.initial }
    previewing.paint = paint
    apply(vehicle, paint)
end

---@param site BoothSite
local function claim(site)
    local vehicle = vehicleOf(site.view?.net)
    if claiming or vehicle == 0 or NetworkHasControlOfEntity(vehicle) then return end

    claiming = true

    local deadline = GetGameTimer() + CLAIM_TIME

    while focused == site and not NetworkHasControlOfEntity(vehicle) and GetGameTimer() < deadline do
        NetworkRequestControlOfEntity(vehicle)
        Wait(0)
    end

    claiming = false

    local last = previewing
    if focused ~= site or not last or not last.paint or not NetworkHasControlOfEntity(vehicle) then return end

    apply(vehicle, last.paint)
end

local function unpreview()
    local last = previewing
    if not last then return end

    previewing = nil

    if DoesEntityExist(last.vehicle) then apply(last.vehicle, last.initial) end
end

---@param site BoothSite
local function flush(site)
    if not pending then return end

    TriggerServerEvent('sm_custom:server:boothSelect', site.booth.id, pending.selection, pending.cursor)
    pending = nil
end

local function close()
    local site = focused
    if not site then return end

    focused, control, surface, latest = nil, nil, nil, nil
    flush(site)
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'boothCapture', data = false })
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'boothScreen', data = false })
    project(site)

    if viewing then
        viewing = nil
        modules.camera.stop()
    end

    if site.view?.status == 'spraying' then previewing = nil else unpreview() end

    if cam then
        RenderScriptCams(false, true, 500, true, true)
        DestroyCam(cam, false)
        cam = nil
    end

    config.hud.show()
    TriggerServerEvent('sm_custom:server:boothClose', site.booth.id)
end

---@param result any
local function failed(result)
    local known = type(result) == 'table'
    local reason = known and OPEN_ERRORS[result.reason] or 'booth.timeout'

    lib.notify({ type = 'error', description = locale(reason, known and result.name or locale('booth.someone')) })
end

local function showScreen()
    if not viewing or not surface then return end

    viewing = nil
    look(surface, 0)
    modules.camera.stop(true)
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'boothCapture', data = 'screen' })

    if focused then project(focused, true) end
end

local function showVehicle()
    local site = focused
    if not site or viewing or switching then return end

    local vehicle = vehicleOf(site.view?.net)

    if vehicle == 0 then
        return lib.notify({ type = 'error', description = locale('booth.unseen') })
    end

    switching = true

    local started = pcall(modules.camera.start, vehicle)

    switching = false

    if not started or focused ~= site then return modules.camera.stop() end

    modules.camera.frame(ORBIT_FRAME.x, ORBIT_FRAME.y, ORBIT_FRAME.z, ORBIT_FRAME.w)
    viewing = vehicle

    if cam then
        DestroyCam(cam, false)
        cam = nil
    end

    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'boothCapture', data = 'vehicle' })
    project(site, true)
end

---@param site BoothSite
local function open(site)
    if focused or opening or IsNuiFocused() then return end

    local entry = site.booth

    opening = true

    local result = lib.callback.await('sm_custom:server:boothOpen', false, entry.id)

    opening = false

    if type(result) ~= 'table' or not result.ok then return failed(result) end

    local screen = site.screen

    if focused or not site.inside or not screen or not DoesEntityExist(screen) then
        return TriggerServerEvent('sm_custom:server:boothClose', entry.id)
    end

    focused, pending, latest, site.view = site, nil, nil, result.view
    control = { process = result.process == true, billing = result.billing == true, prices = result.prices }
    surface = measure(screen)

    if result.view.changed then preview(site, result.view.selection) end

    CreateThread(function() claim(site) end)
    look(surface, 500)
    config.hud.hide()
    SetNuiFocus(true, true)
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'boothCapture', data = 'screen' })
    project(site)

    CreateThread(function()
        while focused == site do
            SetEntityLocallyInvisible(cache.ped)

            if viewing then
                if DoesEntityExist(viewing) then modules.camera.tick() else showScreen() end
            end

            Wait(0)
        end
    end)

    CreateThread(function()
        while focused == site do
            flush(site)
            Wait(SEND_EVERY)
        end
    end)
end

---@param site BoothSite
local function leave(site)
    if not site.inside then return end

    site.inside, site.token = false, site.token + 1

    if focused == site then close() end

    if prompted == site then
        prompted = nil
        modules.interact.clear()
    end

    if docked == site then
        docked, hinted = nil, nil
        lib.hideTextUI()
    end

    clear(site)
    modules.interact.hold(site.booth.id, false)
end

---@param site BoothSite
local function prompt(site)
    if focused or not site.screen then return end

    local screen = site.booth.screen.xyz
    local distance = #(GetEntityCoords(cache.ped) - screen)

    if distance > data.reach or cache.vehicle then
        if prompted == site then
            prompted = nil
            modules.interact.clear()
        end

        return
    end

    prompted = site
    modules.interact.draw(screen + LIFT, 'paint', distance, locale('booth.choose'))

    if IsControlJustReleased(0, 38) then
        prompted = nil
        modules.interact.clear()
        CreateThread(function() open(site) end)
    end
end

---@param site BoothSite
---@param vehicle integer
---@param registered boolean
local function toggle(site, vehicle, registered)
    opening = true

    local result

    if registered then
        result = lib.callback.await('sm_custom:server:boothRelease', false, site.booth.id)
    else
        local props = lib.getVehicleProperties(vehicle) --[[@as VehicleProperties]]

        result = lib.callback.await('sm_custom:server:boothRegister', false, site.booth.id, {
            color1 = props.color1,
            paintType1 = props.paintType1,
            color2 = props.color2,
            paintType2 = props.paintType2,
            pearlescentColor = props.pearlescentColor,
        }, NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(vehicle), GetVehicleClass(vehicle))
    end

    opening = false

    if type(result) ~= 'table' or not result.ok then return failed(result) end

    local text = locale(registered and 'booth.released' or 'booth.registered')

    lib.notify({ type = 'success', description = text })
end

---@param site BoothSite
---@param text string | false
local function hint(site, text)
    if text then
        if docked ~= site or hinted ~= text then lib.showTextUI(text) end

        docked, hinted = site, text
    elseif docked == site then
        docked, hinted = nil, nil
        lib.hideTextUI()
    end
end

---@param site BoothSite
local function dock(site)
    if site.booth.mode ~= 'screen' then return end

    local vehicle = cache.vehicle
    local driving = vehicle and cache.seat == -1 and not focused and NetworkGetEntityIsNetworked(vehicle)
    local parked = driving and #(GetEntityCoords(vehicle) - site.booth.vehicle.xyz) <= data.radius
    local registered = parked and vehicleOf(site.view?.net) or nil
    local release = registered ~= nil and registered == vehicle
    local text = (registered == 0 and locale('booth.register')) or (release and locale('booth.release')) or false

    hint(site, text)

    if not text then return end

    DisableControlAction(0, 86, true)

    if IsControlJustReleased(0, 38) and not opening then
        CreateThread(function() toggle(site, vehicle --[[@as integer]], release) end)
    end
end

---@param site BoothSite
local function guard(site)
    local net, now = site.view?.net, GetGameTimer()
    if not net or now < (site.guarded or 0) then return end

    site.guarded = now + 1000

    local vehicle = vehicleOf(net)

    if vehicle ~= 0 and NetworkHasControlOfEntity(vehicle) then FreezeEntityPosition(vehicle, true) end
end

---@param site BoothSite
local function tend(site)
    local token = site.token

    while site.inside and site.token == token do
        prompt(site)
        dock(site)
        guard(site)
        Wait(0)
    end
end

---@param site BoothSite
local function arrive(site)
    if site.inside then return end

    site.inside, site.token = true, site.token + 1
    modules.interact.hold(site.booth.id, true)
    CreateThread(function() furnish(site) end)
    CreateThread(function() tend(site) end)
end

---@param entry CustomBooth
---@return BoothSite
local function create(entry)
    ---@type BoothSite
    local site = { booth = entry, token = 0, round = 0, inside = false, nozzles = {}, fx = {} }

    if modules.areas.inside(entry.key) then arrive(site) end

    return site
end

local function build()
    for _, site in pairs(sites) do
        leave(site)
    end

    table.wipe(sites)

    for _, entry in ipairs(modules.zones.booths) do
        sites[entry.id] = create(entry)
    end
end

---@param a any
---@param b any
---@return boolean
local function same(a, b)
    if type(a) ~= 'table' or type(b) ~= 'table' then return a == b end

    return a[1] == b[1] and a[2] == b[2] and a[3] == b[3]
end

---@param colour any
---@return number[]
local function toneOf(colour)
    if type(colour) == 'table' then return colour end

    return tones[colour] or data.primer.colour
end

---@param colour any
---@return number[][]
local function shadesOf(colour)
    return type(colour) == 'number' and shades[colour] or { toneOf(colour) }
end

---@param vehicle integer
---@param primary boolean
---@return number[]
local function current(vehicle, primary)
    if primary and GetIsVehiclePrimaryColourCustom(vehicle) then return { GetVehicleCustomPrimaryColour(vehicle) } end

    if not primary and GetIsVehicleSecondaryColourCustom(vehicle) then
        return { GetVehicleCustomSecondaryColour(vehicle) }
    end

    local first, second = GetVehicleColours(vehicle)

    return toneOf(primary and first or second)
end

---@param a number[]
---@param b number[]
---@param t number
---@return number[]
local function lerp(a, b, t)
    return { a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t, a[3] + (b[3] - a[3]) * t }
end

---@param list number[][]
---@param time integer
---@return number[]
local function shadeAt(list, time)
    if #list < 2 then return list[1] end

    local position = time % SHADE_CYCLE / SHADE_CYCLE * #list
    local index = math.floor(position)

    return lerp(list[index + 1], list[(index + 1) % #list + 1], position - index)
end

---@param handle integer
---@param tone number[]
local function tint(handle, tone)
    SetParticleFxLoopedColour(handle, tone[1] / 255, tone[2] / 255, tone[3] / 255, false)
end

---@param site BoothSite
---@param tone number[]
local function colorize(site, tone)
    site.tone = tone

    for _, handle in ipairs(site.fx) do
        tint(handle, tone)
    end
end

---@param vehicle integer
---@return integer?
local function puff(vehicle)
    local fx = data.smoke

    if vehicle == 0 or not pcall(lib.requestNamedPtfxAsset, fx.asset) then return end

    UseParticleFxAsset(fx.asset)

    local offset, rotation = fx.offset, fx.rotation
    local handle = StartParticleFxLoopedOnEntity(
        fx.effect,
        vehicle,
        offset.x,
        offset.y,
        offset.z,
        rotation.x,
        rotation.y,
        rotation.z,
        fx.scale,
        false,
        false,
        false
    )

    SetParticleFxLoopedAlpha(handle, fx.alpha)

    return handle
end

---@param site BoothSite
---@param vehicle integer
---@param tone number[]
function mist(site, vehicle, tone)
    local nozzle = data.nozzle
    local offset, rotation = nozzle.offset, nozzle.rotation

    lib.requestNamedPtfxAsset(nozzle.asset)

    for _, entity in ipairs(site.nozzles) do
        UseParticleFxAsset(nozzle.asset)

        local handle = StartParticleFxLoopedOnEntity(
            nozzle.effect,
            entity,
            offset.x,
            offset.y,
            offset.z,
            rotation.x,
            rotation.y,
            rotation.z,
            nozzle.scale,
            false,
            false,
            false
        )

        SetParticleFxLoopedAlpha(handle, nozzle.alpha)
        site.fx[#site.fx + 1] = handle
    end

    local cloud = puff(vehicle)

    if cloud then site.fx[#site.fx + 1] = cloud end

    colorize(site, tone)
end

---@param vehicle integer
---@param primary boolean
---@param colour number[]
local function coat(vehicle, primary, colour)
    local r, g, b = math.floor(colour[1] + 0.5), math.floor(colour[2] + 0.5), math.floor(colour[3] + 0.5)

    if primary then
        SetVehicleCustomPrimaryColour(vehicle, r, g, b)
    else
        SetVehicleCustomSecondaryColour(vehicle, r, g, b)
    end
end

---@param vehicle integer
---@param channels { primary: boolean }[]
local function unramp(vehicle, channels)
    local first, second = GetVehicleColours(vehicle)
    local primary, secondary = first, second

    for _, channel in ipairs(channels) do
        if channel.primary and shades[first] then primary = PLAIN_COLOUR end
        if not channel.primary and shades[second] then secondary = PLAIN_COLOUR end
    end

    if primary ~= first or secondary ~= second then SetVehicleColours(vehicle, primary, secondary) end
end

---@param site BoothSite
---@param payload { net: integer, paint: table, initial?: table, time: integer, began?: integer, elapsed?: number }
---@param round integer
local function blend(site, payload, round)
    local vehicle = vehicleOf(payload.net)
    if vehicle == 0 then return end

    local final, initial, primer = payload.paint, payload.initial, data.primer
    local channels = {}

    if initial then apply(vehicle, initial) end

    for index, key in ipairs(LAYERS) do
        if final[key] ~= nil and not (initial and same(final[key], initial[key])) then
            local primary = index == 1

            channels[#channels + 1] = {
                key = key,
                primary = primary,
                from = current(vehicle, primary),
                to = toneOf(final[key]),
            }
        end
    end

    local list = shadesOf(final[channels[1] and channels[1].key or 'pearlescentColor'])
    local elapsed = math.min(math.max(tonumber(payload.elapsed) or 0, 0), payload.time)
    local began, split, coated = GetGameTimer() - elapsed, primer.share, false

    site.shades = list
    unramp(vehicle, channels)

    while site.round == round and DoesEntityExist(vehicle) do
        local now = GetGameTimer()
        local t = math.min((now - began) / payload.time, 1.0)
        local second = t >= split

        if second and not coated then
            coated = true
            apply(vehicle, final)
            unramp(vehicle, channels)
            colorize(site, list[1])
        end

        if second and #list > 1 then colorize(site, shadeAt(list, now)) end

        for _, channel in ipairs(channels) do
            local colour = second
                and lerp(primer.colour, channel.to, (t - split) / (1.0 - split))
                or lerp(channel.from, primer.colour, t / split)

            coat(vehicle, channel.primary, colour)
        end

        if t >= 1.0 then return apply(vehicle, final) end

        Wait(BLEND_STEP)
    end
end

---@param vehicle integer
---@param list? number[][]
local function smoke(vehicle, list)
    local handle = puff(vehicle)
    if not handle then return end

    local began, time = GetGameTimer(), data.smoke.time

    repeat
        if list then tint(handle, shadeAt(list, GetGameTimer())) end

        Wait(list and #list > 1 and BLEND_STEP or time)
    until GetGameTimer() - began >= time

    StopParticleFxLooped(handle, false)
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_custom:client:booth', function(view)
    if source == '' or type(view) ~= 'table' then return end

    local site = sites[view.id]
    if not site then return end

    local before = site.view?.net

    site.view = view

    if before and before ~= view.net then
        local vehicle = vehicleOf(before)

        if vehicle ~= 0 and NetworkHasControlOfEntity(vehicle) then FreezeEntityPosition(vehicle, false) end
    end

    if site == shown then project(site) end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_custom:client:boothSpray', function(id, payload)
    if source == '' then return end

    local site = sites[id]
    if not site then return end

    local fresh = type(payload) == 'table'

    if fresh and site.final and site.began == payload.began then return end

    site.round += 1
    stop(site)

    if not fresh then
        local vehicle, final, list = vehicleOf(site.net), site.final, site.shades

        site.net, site.final, site.shades, site.began, site.tone = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil

        if vehicle ~= 0 and final then apply(vehicle, final) end

        CreateThread(function() smoke(vehicle, list) end)
        return
    end

    local round = site.round

    site.net, site.final, site.shades, site.began = payload.net, payload.paint, nil, payload.began

    CreateThread(function()
        if pcall(mist, site, vehicleOf(payload.net), data.primer.colour) and site.round ~= round then stop(site) end

        blend(site, payload, round)
    end)
end)

---@param net any
---@return boolean
local function spraying(net)
    for _, site in pairs(sites) do
        if site.final and site.net == net then return true end
    end

    return false
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_custom:client:boothPaint', function(net, paint, preview)
    if source == '' or type(paint) ~= 'table' then return end
    if preview == true and spraying(net) then return end

    local vehicle = vehicleOf(net)

    if vehicle ~= 0 then apply(vehicle, paint) end
end)

RegisterNUICallback('boothSelect', function(body, cb)
    cb(1)

    if not focused or type(body) ~= 'table' then return end

    local site = focused

    pending = { selection = body.selection, cursor = body.cursor }
    latest = pending
    preview(site, body.selection)
    CreateThread(function() claim(site) end)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('boothMouse', function(body, cb)
    cb(1)

    local area, screen = surface, dui
    if not focused or not area or not screen or type(body) ~= 'table' then return end

    local u, v = cursorUv(area.corners, tonumber(body.x) or -1, tonumber(body.y) or -1)
    if not u or not v then return end

    local inside = u >= 0 and u <= 1 and v >= 0 and v <= 1

    if body.type == 'down' and not inside then return end

    local button = body.button == 2 and 'right' or 'left'

    screen:sendMouseMove(
        math.floor(math.min(math.max(u, 0), 1) * data.screen.width + 0.5),
        math.floor(math.min(math.max(v, 0), 1) * data.screen.height + 0.5)
    )

    if body.type == 'down' then
        screen:sendMouseDown(button)
    elseif body.type == 'up' then
        screen:sendMouseUp(button)
    elseif body.type == 'wheel' then
        screen:sendMouseWheel(0.0, -(tonumber(body.delta) or 0))
    end
end)

RegisterNUICallback('boothCustomers', function(_, cb)
    if not focused then return cb({}) end

    cb(lib.callback.await('sm_custom:server:boothCustomers', false, focused.booth.id) or {})
end)

RegisterNUICallback('boothProcess', function(body, cb)
    local site = focused
    if not site or type(body) ~= 'table' then return cb({ ok = false, reason = 'invalid' }) end

    pending = nil

    local result = lib.callback.await(
        'sm_custom:server:boothProcess',
        false,
        site.booth.id,
        body.method,
        tonumber(body.customer),
        body.selection,
        body.cursor
    )

    cb(result or { ok = false, reason = 'timeout' })

    if type(result) == 'table' and result.ok and focused == site then close() end
end)

RegisterNUICallback('boothPreview', function(body, cb)
    cb(1)

    if focused and type(body) == 'table' then preview(focused, body.selection) end
end)

RegisterNUICallback('boothClose', function(_, cb)
    cb(1)
    close()
end)

RegisterNUICallback('boothVehicle', function(_, cb)
    cb(1)
    showVehicle()
end)

RegisterNUICallback('boothScreen', function(_, cb)
    cb(1)
    showScreen()
end)

modules.areas.watch(function(key, inside)
    for _, site in pairs(sites) do
        if site.booth.key == key then
            if inside then
                arrive(site)
            else
                leave(site)
                site.round += 1
                site.view, site.net, site.final, site.shades, site.began, site.tone = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil

                if site == shown then project(site) end
            end
        end
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource then return end

    close()

    for _, site in pairs(sites) do
        clear(site)
    end
end)

---@param coords vector3
---@return integer?
function booth.nozzle(coords)
    for _, site in pairs(sites) do
        for _, entity in ipairs(site.nozzles) do
            if DoesEntityExist(entity) and #(GetEntityCoords(entity) - coords) <= MATCH then return entity end
        end
    end
end

---@param setter fun(vehicle: number, props: table)
function booth.start(setter)
    apply = setter

    build()
    modules.zones.watch(build)
end

return booth

local config = require('config.client').camera

local ORIGIN <const> = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
local SIGNS <const> = { -1.0, 1.0 }
local HEAD <const> = 31086
local HOLD <const> = 250

---@class CameraClient
local camera = {}

---@class CameraView
---@field heading number
---@field pitch number
---@field size? number
---@field fov? number
---@field target? vector3
---@field door? integer
---@field cockpit? boolean

---@class CameraSpring
---@field value number
---@field velocity number

---@type number?
local cam
local vehicle = 0
local started = 0
local clip = 0.0
---@type table<string, CameraView>
local bays = {}
local aspect = 16 / 9
local center, half, eye = ORIGIN, ORIGIN, ORIGIN
local lower, upper = ORIGIN, ORIGIN
local bounds, area = config.frame, config.frame
---@type CameraView
local view = config.views.overview
local yaw, pitch, zoom, limit = 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, config.zoom[2]
local fresh = true
local target = ORIGIN

local cabin, snap, inside = false, false, false
