local REASONS <const> = {
    receipt = 'receipt.invalid',
    denied = 'receipt.denied',
    far = 'receipt.far',
    working = 'receipt.working',
    damaged = 'receipt.damaged',
    changed = 'receipt.changed',
    locked = 'receipt.locked',
    spot = 'receipt.spot',
}

---@class ReceiptStaged
---@field netId integer
---@field shop string
---@field label string
---@field plate string

---@class ReceiptClient
local receipt = {}

---@type { id: string, netId: integer }?
local current
---@type ReceiptStaged?
local staged
local busy = false

---@param plate string
---@return string
local function trim(plate)
    return plate:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$')
end

---@param data { plate: string, model: integer, distance: number }
---@return number?
local function nearest(data)
    local origin = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local found, best

    for _, entry in ipairs(lib.getNearbyVehicles(origin, data.distance, true)) do
        local vehicle = entry.vehicle

        if GetEntityModel(vehicle) == data.model and trim(GetVehicleNumberPlateText(vehicle)) == data.plate then
            local distance = #(entry.coords - origin)

            if not best or distance < best then found, best = vehicle, distance end
        end
    end

    return found
end

local function close()
    if not current then return end

    current = nil
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'receipt', data = false })
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_custom:client:receiptUse', function(data)
    if source == '' or type(data) ~= 'table' or type(data.id) ~= 'string' then return end
    if busy or current or IsNuiFocused() then return end

    local vehicle = nearest(data)

    if not vehicle then
        return lib.notify({ type = 'error', description = locale('receipt.far', data.plate) })
    end

    busy = true

    local netId = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(vehicle)
    local result = lib.callback.await('sm_custom:server:receiptCheck', false, data.id, netId)

    busy = false

    if type(result) ~= 'table' or type(result.view) ~= 'table' then
        local reason = type(result) == 'table' and REASONS[result.error] or REASONS.receipt

        return lib.notify({ type = 'error', description = locale(reason, data.plate) })
    end

    current = { id = data.id, netId = netId }
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'receipt', data = result.view })
    SetNuiFocus(true, true)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('receiptCustomers', function(_, cb)
    if not current then return cb({}) end

    cb(lib.callback.await('sm_custom:server:receiptCustomers', false) or {})
end)

RegisterNUICallback('receiptPay', function(data, cb)
    if not current or busy or type(data) ~= 'table' then return cb({ ok = false, reason = 'invalid' }) end

    busy = true

    local result = lib.callback.await(
        'sm_custom:server:receiptPay',
        false,
        current.id,
        current.netId,
        data.method,
        tonumber(data.customer)
    )

    busy = false

    if type(result) ~= 'table' then result = { ok = false, reason = 'timeout' } end

    cb(result)

    if not result.ok then return end

    close()
    lib.notify({ type = 'success', description = locale(result.staged and 'receipt.staged' or 'receipt.applied') })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('receiptClose', function(_, cb)
    cb(1)

    if not busy then close() end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_custom:client:receiptApply', function(netId, patch)
    if source == '' or math.type(netId) ~= 'integer' or type(patch) ~= 'table' then return end
    if not NetworkDoesEntityExistWithNetworkId(netId) then return end

    modules.install.apply(NetToVeh(netId), patch)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_custom:client:staged', function(data)
    if source == '' then return end

    staged = type(data) == 'table' and math.type(data.netId) == 'integer' and data or nil
    modules.install.stage(staged)
end)

---@param zone CustomZone
---@return integer?
function receipt.pending(zone)
    if not staged or zone.key ~= staged.shop or not zone.install then return end
    if not cache.vehicle or cache.seat ~= -1 or not NetworkGetEntityIsNetworked(cache.vehicle) then return end
    if NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(cache.vehicle) ~= staged.netId then return end

    return staged.netId
end

---@param netId integer
---@param zone CustomZone
function receipt.register(netId, zone)
    if busy then return end

    busy = true

    local result = lib.callback.await('sm_custom:server:receiptRegister', false, netId, zone.id)

    busy = false

    if type(result) == 'table' and result.ok then
        return lib.notify({ type = 'success', description = locale('receipt.registered') })
    end

    local reason = type(result) == 'table' and REASONS[result.reason] or REASONS.receipt

    lib.notify({ type = 'error', description = locale(reason, staged and staged.plate or '') })
end

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource == cache.resource then close() end
end)

return receipt

local config = require 'config.client'

---@class ShopsClient
local shops = {}

---@type table<string, boolean>
local access = {}
---@type CustomZone?
local current
---@type string | false
local prompt = false
---@type CPoint[]
local points = {}
---@type integer[]
local blips = {}
---@type fun(zone: CustomZone)
local opener
---@type fun(): boolean
local idle

---@param text string | false
local function show(text)
    if text == prompt then return end

    prompt = text

    if text then lib.showTextUI(text) else lib.hideTextUI() end
end

---@return CustomZone?
function shops.current()
    return current
end

---@param id string
---@return boolean
function shops.access(id)
    return access[id] == true
end

local function clear()
    for _, point in ipairs(points) do
        point:remove()
    end

    for _, handle in ipairs(blips) do
        RemoveBlip(handle)
    end

    table.wipe(points)
    table.wipe(blips)
    table.wipe(access)

    if current then
        current = nil
        show(false)
    end
end

---@param zone CustomZone
local function watch(zone)
    local point = lib.points.new({ coords = zone.coords, distance = config.zones.distance })

    function point:onEnter()
        lib.callback('sm_custom:server:access', false, function(allowed)
            access[zone.id] = allowed == true
        end, zone.id)
    end

    function point:onExit()
        access[zone.id] = nil

        if current == zone then
            current = nil
            show(false)
        end
    end

    function point:nearby()
        if not access[zone.id] then return end

        local inside = self.currentDistance <= zone.radius and cache.vehicle and cache.seat == -1 and idle()

        if not inside then
            if current == zone then
                current = nil
                show(false)
            end

            return
        end

        local claim = modules.receipt.pending(zone)

        current = zone
        show(claim and locale('receipt.register') or ('[E] %s'):format(zone.label))
        DisableControlAction(0, 86, true)

        if IsControlJustReleased(0, 38) then
            show(false)
            CreateThread(function()
                if claim then modules.receipt.register(claim, zone) else opener(zone) end
            end)
        end
    end

    points[#points + 1] = point
end

local function build()
    clear()

    for _, blip in ipairs(modules.zones.blips) do
        local handle = AddBlipForCoord(blip.coords.x, blip.coords.y, blip.coords.z)

        SetBlipSprite(handle, blip.sprite or 446)
        SetBlipColour(handle, blip.colour or 0)
        SetBlipScale(handle, blip.scale or 0.8)
        SetBlipAsShortRange(handle, true)
        BeginTextCommandSetBlipName('STRING')
        AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(blip.label)
        EndTextCommandSetBlipName(handle)

        blips[#blips + 1] = handle
    end

    for _, zone in ipairs(modules.zones.list) do
        watch(zone)
    end
end

---@param open fun(zone: CustomZone)
---@param ready fun(): boolean
function shops.start(open, ready)
    opener, idle = open, ready

    build()
    modules.zones.watch(build)
end

return shops


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\sm_custom\modules\swap\client.lua
local QUIET <const> = 1500
local WATCH <const> = 1000
local RANGE <const> = 100.0
local SHARE_DELAY <const> = 150

---@class SwapClient
local swap = {}

---@type table<string, string>
local stored = {}
---@type table<string, true>?
local fresh = {}
---@type table<number, string | false>
local held = {}
---@type table<integer, { sound: string | false, shop: string }>
local previews = {}
---@type table<number, { sound: string | false, driver: number }>
local applied = {}
local sharing = false

---@param vehicle number
---@return string
local function plateOf(vehicle)
    return GetVehicleNumberPlateText(vehicle):match('^%s*(.-)%s*$')
end

---@param vehicle number
---@param sound string | false
local function apply(vehicle, sound)
    local radio = IsVehicleRadioOn(vehicle)

    ForceUseAudioGameObject(vehicle, sound or GetDisplayNameFromVehicleModel(GetEntityModel(vehicle)))
    applied[vehicle] = { sound = sound, driver = GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, -1) }

    if radio then return end

    CreateThread(function()
        local deadline = GetGameTimer() + QUIET

        while GetGameTimer() < deadline and DoesEntityExist(vehicle) do
            if IsVehicleRadioOn(vehicle) then SetVehRadioStation(vehicle, 'OFF') end

            Wait(0)
        end
    end)
end

---@param vehicle number
---@return string | false
local function wanted(vehicle)
    local sound = held[vehicle]
    if sound ~= nil then return sound end

    local entry = next(previews) and NetworkGetEntityIsNetworked(vehicle) and previews[NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(vehicle)]
    if entry then return entry.sound end

    return swap.current(vehicle)
end

local function sync()
    if not next(stored) and not next(held) and not next(previews) and not next(applied) then return end

    local origin = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local seen = {}

    for _, vehicle in ipairs(GetGamePool('CVehicle')) do
        if #(GetEntityCoords(vehicle) - origin) <= RANGE then
            local sound, last = wanted(vehicle), applied[vehicle]

            seen[vehicle] = true

            if sound and (not last or last.sound ~= sound or last.driver ~= GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, -1)) then
                apply(vehicle, sound)
            elseif not sound and last and last.sound then
                apply(vehicle, false)
            end
        end
    end

    for vehicle in pairs(applied) do
        if not seen[vehicle] then applied[vehicle] = nil end
    end

    for vehicle in pairs(held) do
        if not DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then held[vehicle] = nil end
    end
end

---@param vehicle number
---@return string | false
function swap.current(vehicle)
    return stored[plateOf(vehicle)] or false
end

---@param vehicle number
---@param sound string | false
function swap.hold(vehicle, sound)
    held[vehicle] = sound
    apply(vehicle, sound)

    if sharing then return end

    sharing = true

    SetTimeout(SHARE_DELAY, function()
        sharing = false

        local current = held[vehicle]

        if current ~= nil then modules.net.emitLatentServer('sm_custom:server:swapPreview', current) end
    end)
end

---@param vehicle number
function swap.release(vehicle)
    held[vehicle] = nil

    if DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then apply(vehicle, wanted(vehicle)) end
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_custom:client:swaps', function(saved, unowned)
    if source == '' then return end

    local skip = fresh or {}

    fresh = nil

    for _, list in ipairs({ saved, unowned }) do
        if type(list) == 'table' then
            for plate, sound in pairs(list) do
                if type(plate) == 'string' and type(sound) == 'string' and not skip[plate] then
                    stored[plate] = sound
                end
            end
        end
    end

    sync()
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_custom:client:swap', function(plate, sound)
    if source == '' or type(plate) ~= 'string' then return end

    if fresh then fresh[plate] = true end

    stored[plate] = type(sound) == 'string' and sound or nil

    for _, vehicle in ipairs(GetGamePool('CVehicle')) do
        if plateOf(vehicle) == plate then apply(vehicle, wanted(vehicle)) end
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_custom:client:swapPreview', function(id, shop, sound)
    if source == '' or math.type(id) ~= 'integer' or type(shop) ~= 'string' then return end

    local valid = sound == false or type(sound) == 'string'

    previews[id] = valid and modules.areas.inside(shop) and { sound = sound, shop = shop } or nil

    sync()
end)

modules.areas.watch(function(key, inside)
    if inside then return end

    for id, entry in pairs(previews) do
        if entry.shop == key then previews[id] = nil end
    end

    sync()
end)

SetInterval(sync, WATCH)
TriggerServerEvent('sm_custom:server:swaps')

return swap


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\sm_custom\modules\wheels\client.lua
local config = require('config.client').fitment

local CLONE <const> = vec3(-1084.9698, -8489.8350, 444.4068)
local DRIFT <const> = 0.0001

---@class WheelsClient
local wheels = {}

---@class FitmentValues
---@field height number
---@field size? number
---@field width? number
---@field rim? string
---@field offset table<string, number>
---@field rotation table<string, number>

---@class FitmentRange
---@field min number
---@field max number

---@class FitmentRanges
---@field height FitmentRange
---@field size? FitmentRange
---@field width? FitmentRange
---@field offset table<string, FitmentRange>
---@field rotation table<string, FitmentRange>

---@class FitmentChange
---@field property string
---@field value number
---@field mode 'group' | 'single'
---@field target? string

---@type table<number, { upper: number, lower: number }>
local baselines = {}

---@param vehicle number
---@param height number
local function setHeight(vehicle, height)
    SetVehicleSuspensionHeight(vehicle, height)

    local settings = config.suspension[GetEntityModel(vehicle)]
    if not settings then return end

    local model = GetEntityModel(vehicle)
    local base = baselines[model]

    if not base then
        base = {
            upper = GetVehicleHandlingFloat(vehicle, 'CHandlingData', 'fSuspensionUpperLimit'),
            lower = GetVehicleHandlingFloat(vehicle, 'CHandlingData', 'fSuspensionLowerLimit'),
        }
        baselines[model] = base
    end

    local shift = math.max(settings.threshold - height, 0.0) * settings.compensation
    local upper = math.max(base.upper + shift, settings.minUpperLimit)

    SetVehicleHandlingFloat(vehicle, 'CHandlingData', 'fSuspensionUpperLimit', upper)
    SetVehicleHandlingFloat(vehicle, 'CHandlingData', 'fSuspensionLowerLimit', base.lower + shift)
end

local scalar = {
    height = { get = GetVehicleSuspensionHeight, set = setHeight },
}

local sizing = {
    size = { get = GetVehicleWheelSize, set = SetVehicleWheelSize },
    width = { get = GetVehicleWheelWidth, set = SetVehicleWheelWidth },
}

local single = {
    offset = { get = GetVehicleWheelXOffset, set = SetVehicleWheelXOffset },
    rotation = { get = GetVehicleWheelYRotation, set = SetVehicleWheelYRotation },
}

---@param vehicle number
---@return string?
function wheels.key(vehicle)
    local plate = GetVehicleNumberPlateText(vehicle):match('^%s*(.-)%s*$')
    if plate == '' then return end

    return ('%s_%s'):format(plate, GetEntityModel(vehicle))
end

---@param vehicle number
---@return string?
function wheels.rim(vehicle)
    local mod = GetVehicleMod(vehicle, 23)
    if mod < 0 then return end

    return ('%d:%d'):format(GetVehicleWheelType(vehicle), mod)
end

---@param vehicle number
---@return integer
function wheels.count(vehicle)
    return math.max(GetVehicleNumberOfWheels(vehicle), 0)
end

---@param values FitmentValues
---@return FitmentValues
function wheels.copy(values)
    return {
        height = values.height,
        size = values.size,
        width = values.width,
        rim = values.rim,
        offset = table.clone(values.offset),
        rotation = table.clone(values.rotation),
    }
end

---@param values FitmentValues
---@param source FitmentValues
function wheels.rebase(values, source)
    values.rim, values.size, values.width = source.rim, source.size, source.width
end

---@param axle integer
---@param axles integer
---@return string
local function axleName(axle, axles)
    if axle == 1 then return locale('wheel.front') end
    if axle == axles then return locale('wheel.rear') end

    return locale('wheel.middle', axle - 1)
end

---@class FitmentTarget
---@field id string
---@field label string
---@field wheels integer[]

---@param vehicle number
---@return { group: FitmentTarget[], single: FitmentTarget[] }
function wheels.targets(vehicle)
    local sides = { 'wheel.left', 'wheel.right' }
    local count = wheels.count(vehicle)
    local axles = math.ceil(count / 2)
    local targets = { group = {}, single = {} }

    for axle = 1, axles do
        local first = (axle - 1) * 2

        targets.group[axle] = {
            id = ('axle:%d'):format(axle),
            label = axleName(axle, axles),
            wheels = first + 1 < count and { first, first + 1 } or { first },
        }
    end

    for wheel = 0, count - 1 do
        targets.single[wheel + 1] = {
            id = ('wheel:%d'):format(wheel),
            label = ('%s %s'):format(axleName(wheel // 2 + 1, axles), locale(sides[wheel % 2 + 1])),
            wheels = { wheel },
        }
    end

    return targets
end

---@param vehicle number
---@return FitmentValues
function wheels.capture(vehicle)
    local rim = wheels.rim(vehicle)
    local values = { offset = {}, rotation = {} }

    for property, fn in pairs(scalar) do
        values[property] = fn.get(vehicle)
    end

    if rim then
        values.rim, values.size, values.width = rim, GetVehicleWheelSize(vehicle), GetVehicleWheelWidth(vehicle)
    end

    for wheel = 0, wheels.count(vehicle) - 1 do
        for property, fn in pairs(single) do
            values[property][tostring(wheel)] = fn.get(vehicle, wheel)
        end
    end

    return values
end

---@param vehicle number
---@param values FitmentValues
function wheels.hold(vehicle, values)
    for property, fn in pairs(single) do
        for wheel, value in pairs(values[property]) do
            fn.set(vehicle, tonumber(wheel) --[[@as integer]], value)
        end
    end

    if not values.rim or values.rim ~= wheels.rim(vehicle) then return end

    for property, fn in pairs(sizing) do
        local value = values[property]

        if value and math.abs(fn.get(vehicle) - value) > DRIFT then
            fn.set(vehicle, value)
        end
    end
end

---@param vehicle number
---@param values FitmentValues
function wheels.apply(vehicle, values)
    for property, fn in pairs(scalar) do
        fn.set(vehicle, tonumber(values[property]) or 0.0)
    end

    wheels.hold(vehicle, values)
end

---@param range FitmentRange?
---@param value number
---@return boolean
local function within(range, value)
    return range ~= nil and value >= range.min and value <= range.max
end

---@param count integer
---@param mode string
---@param target any
---@return integer[]?
local function resolve(count, mode, target)
    local index = tonumber(tostring(target):match(mode == 'group' and '^axle:(%d+)$' or '^wheel:(%d+)$'))
    if not index then return end

    if mode == 'single' then
        return index < count and { index } or nil
    end

    local first = (index - 1) * 2
    if index < 1 or first >= count then return end

    return first + 1 < count and { first, first + 1 } or { first }
end

---@param vehicle number
---@param values FitmentValues
---@param ranges FitmentRanges
---@param change FitmentChange
---@return boolean
function wheels.adjust(vehicle, values, ranges, change)
    local value = tonumber(change.value)
    if not value or value ~= value then return false end

    local property = change.property
    local fn = scalar[property] or sizing[property]

    if fn then
        if not within(ranges[property], value) then return false end
        if sizing[property] and values.rim ~= wheels.rim(vehicle) then return false end

        fn.set(vehicle, value)
        values[property] = value

        return true
    end

    fn = single[property]
    local list = fn and resolve(wheels.count(vehicle), change.mode, change.target)
    if not list then return false end

    for _, wheel in ipairs(list) do
        local adjusted = change.mode == 'group' and wheel % 2 == 0 and -value or value
        if not within(ranges[property][tostring(wheel)], adjusted) then return false end
    end

    for _, wheel in ipairs(list) do
        local adjusted = change.mode == 'group' and wheel % 2 == 0 and -value or value

        fn.set(vehicle, wheel, adjusted)
        values[property][tostring(wheel)] = adjusted
    end

    return true
end

---@param initial number
---@param set fun(value: number)
---@param get fun(): number
---@param direction integer
---@return number
local function boundary(initial, set, get, direction)
    local last = initial
    local step = math.max(math.abs(initial) * 0.25, 0.025)

    for _ = 1, 12 do
        local requested = initial + direction * step

        set(requested)

        local actual = tonumber(get())
        if not actual or actual ~= actual or math.abs(actual) == math.huge then break end
        if math.abs(actual - last) < 0.0001 then break end

        last = actual

        if math.abs(actual - requested) > 0.001 then break end

        step *= 2
    end

    set(initial)

    return last
end

---@param initial number
---@param set fun(value: number)
---@param get fun(): number
---@return FitmentRange
local function range(initial, set, get)
    return { min = boundary(initial, set, get, -1), max = boundary(initial, set, get, 1) }
end

---@param vehicle number
---@return FitmentValues? defaults
---@return FitmentRanges? ranges
function wheels.probe(vehicle)
    local model = GetEntityModel(vehicle)
    local clone = CreateVehicle(model, CLONE.x, CLONE.y, CLONE.z, 0.0, false, false)

    if clone == 0 then return end

    SetEntityAlpha(clone, 0, false)
    FreezeEntityPosition(clone, true)
    SetEntityInvincible(clone, true)
    SetVehicleModKit(clone, 0)
    SetVehicleWheelType(clone, GetVehicleWheelType(vehicle))
    SetVehicleMod(clone, 15, GetVehicleMod(vehicle, 15), false)
    SetVehicleMod(clone, 23, GetVehicleMod(vehicle, 23), GetVehicleModVariation(vehicle, 23))
    SetVehicleMod(clone, 24, GetVehicleMod(vehicle, 24), GetVehicleModVariation(vehicle, 24))
    Wait(100)

    local defaults = wheels.capture(clone)
    local ranges = { offset = {}, rotation = {} }

    for _, group in ipairs(defaults.rim and { scalar, sizing } or { scalar }) do
        for property, fn in pairs(group) do
            local set = function(value) fn.set(clone, value) end
            local get = function() return fn.get(clone) end

            ranges[property] = range(defaults[property], set, get)
        end
    end

    for wheel = 0, wheels.count(clone) - 1 do
        local key = tostring(wheel)

        for property, fn in pairs(single) do
            local set = function(value) fn.set(clone, wheel, value) end
            local get = function() return fn.get(clone, wheel) end

            ranges[property][key] = range(defaults[property][key], set, get)
        end
    end

    DeleteEntity(clone)

    return defaults, ranges
end

return wheels

---@param list string[]
---@return table<string, true>
local function set(list)
    local result = {}

    for _, id in ipairs(list) do
        result[id] = true
    end

    return result
end

---@param coords vector3
---@return string
local function spot(coords)
    return ('%.2f:%.2f:%.2f'):format(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)
end

---@param ... CustomRack[]
---@return CustomZoneRack[]
local function stock(...)
    local list, byKey = {}, {}

    for i = 1, select('#', ...) do
        for _, rack in ipairs((select(i, ...))) do
            if type(rack.coords) == 'vector3' and type(rack.parts) == 'table' then
                local key = spot(rack.coords)
                local entry = byKey[key]

                if not entry then
                    entry = { coords = rack.coords, stock = {} }
                    byKey[key] = entry
                    list[#list + 1] = entry
                end

                for _, part in ipairs(rack.parts) do
                    entry.stock[part] = true

                    for _, key in ipairs(ALIASES[part] or NONE) do
                        entry.stock[key] = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return list
end

---@param blips CustomBlip[]
---@param blip CustomZoneBlip
---@param coords vector3
---@param label string
local function addBlip(blips, blip, coords, label)
    blips[#blips + 1] = {
        coords = coords,
        sprite = blip.sprite,
        colour = blip.colour,
        scale = blip.scale,
        label = blip.label or label,
    }
end

---@param key string
---@param group table
---@param list CustomZone[]
---@param blips CustomBlip[]
local function locations(key, group, list, blips)
    local blip = group.blip --[[@as CustomZoneBlip?]]
    local shared = zones.racks(group)

    for index, location in ipairs(group) do
        local zone = { id = ('%s:%d'):format(key, index), key = key, coords = location.coords } --[[@as table]]

        for _, field in ipairs(INHERIT) do
            local value = location[field]
            if value == nil then value = group[field] end

            zone[field] = value
        end

        zone.label = zone.label or key
        zone.radius = zone.radius or 3.0
        zone.racks = stock(zones.racks(location), shared)
        zone.allow = zone.menu and set(zone.menu)

        if zone.billing == nil then zone.billing = zone.groups ~= nil end
        if zone.install == nil then zone.install = zone.groups ~= nil and #zone.racks > 0 end

        zone.selfservice = location.selfservice == true
        zone.grades = type(location.grades) == 'table' and #location.grades > 0 and set(location.grades) or nil

        list[#list + 1] = zone
        byId[zone.id] = zone

        if blip and not blip.coords then
            addBlip(blips, blip, zone.coords, zone.label)
        end
    end

    if blip and blip.coords then
        addBlip(blips, blip, blip.coords, group.label or key)
    end
end

---@param booth CustomBooth
---@param group table
---@return CustomZone
local function counter(booth, group)
    return {
        id = booth.id,
        key = booth.key,
        label = booth.label,
        coords = booth.vehicle.xyz,
        radius = group.radius or 3.0,
        groups = booth.groups,
        menu = BOOTH_MENU,
        allow = set(BOOTH_MENU),
        society = booth.society,
        billing = booth.billing,
        install = false,
        racks = {},
        booth = booth.id,
    }
end

---@param key string
---@param group table
---@param booths CustomBooth[]
---@param list CustomZone[]
local function stations(key, group, booths, list)
    for index, booth in ipairs(group.booths or {}) do
        local mode = booth.mode == 'menu' and 'menu' or 'screen'
        local ready = type(booth.vehicle) == 'vector4' and (mode == 'menu' or type(booth.screen) == 'vector4')

        if ready then
            local entry = {
                id = ('%s:booth:%d'):format(key, index),
                key = key,
                label = booth.label or group.label or key,
                groups = group.groups,
                society = group.society,
                billing = group.billing == nil and group.groups ~= nil or group.billing == true,
                mode = mode,
                vehicle = booth.vehicle,
                screen = mode == 'screen' and booth.screen or nil,
                nozzles = booth.nozzles or {},
            }

            booths[#booths + 1] = entry
            byBooth[entry.id] = entry

            if mode == 'menu' then
                local zone = counter(entry, group)

                list[#list + 1] = zone
                byId[zone.id] = zone
            end
        end
    end
end

---@param data table<string, table>
function zones.load(data)
    local list, blips, booths = {}, {}, {}

    table.wipe(byId)
    table.wipe(byBooth)
    byId.admin = zones.admin

    for key, group in pairs(data) do
        locations(key, group, list, blips)
        stations(key, group, booths, list)
    end

    zones.data, zones.list, zones.blips, zones.booths = data, list, blips, booths

    for _, watcher in ipairs(watchers) do
        watcher()
    end
end

---@param watcher fun()
function zones.watch(watcher)
    watchers[#watchers + 1] = watcher
end

---@param value any
---@return any
function zones.encode(value)
    local kind = type(value)

    if kind == 'vector3' then return { x = value.x, y = value.y, z = value.z } end
    if kind == 'vector4' then return { x = value.x, y = value.y, z = value.z, w = value.w } end
    if kind ~= 'table' then return value end

    local result = {}

    for key, item in pairs(value) do
        result[key] = zones.encode(item)
    end

    return result
end

---@param value any
---@return any
function zones.decode(value)
    if type(value) ~= 'table' then return value end

    local x, y, z, w = value.x, value.y, value.z, value.w

    if type(x) == 'number' and type(y) == 'number' and type(z) == 'number' then
        return type(w) == 'number' and vec4(x, y, z, w) or vec3(x, y, z)
    end

    local result = {}

    for key, item in pairs(value) do
        result[key] = zones.decode(item)
    end

    return result
end

---@param id any
---@return CustomZone?
function zones.get(id)
    return type(id) == 'string' and byId[id] or nil
end

---@param id any
---@return CustomBooth?
function zones.booth(id)
    return type(id) == 'string' and byBooth[id] or nil
end

---@param zone CustomZone
---@param coords vector3
---@param slack? number
---@return boolean
function zones.inside(zone, coords, slack)
    local offset = coords - zone.coords

    return #offset.xy <= zone.radius + (slack or 0.0) and math.abs(offset.z) <= 4.0
end

---@param zone CustomZone | CustomBooth
---@param job? CachedJob
---@param duty? boolean
---@return boolean
function zones.member(zone, job, duty)
    local groups = zone.groups
    if not groups then return true end
    if not job then return false end

    local grade = groups[job.name]
    if type(grade) ~= 'number' or (duty and not job.onduty) then return false end

    local allowed = zone.grades
    if allowed and not allowed[job.grade] then return false end

    return job.grade >= grade
end

---@param zone CustomZone
---@param patch table
---@return boolean
function zones.permits(zone, patch)
    local allow = zone.allow
    if not allow then return true end

    for key in pairs(patch) do
        local ids = owners[key]
        local found = key == 'repair' or key == 'clean'

        for i = 1, ids and #ids or 0 do
            if allow[ids[i]] then
                found = true
                break
            end
        end

        if not found then return false end
    end

    return true
end

---@param source table
---@return CustomRack[]
function zones.racks(source)
    if type(source.racks) == 'table' then return source.racks end

    local parts = source.parts
    if type(parts) ~= 'table' then return {} end

    local list = {}

    if parts[1] then
        for i, coords in ipairs(parts) do
            list[i] = { coords = coords, parts = { 'default' } }
        end

        return list
    end

    local names, byKey = {}, {}

    for name in pairs(parts) do
        names[#names + 1] = name
    end

    table.sort(names)

    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
        for _, coords in ipairs(parts[name]) do
            local key = spot(coords)
            local rack = byKey[key]

            if not rack then
                rack = { coords = coords, parts = {} }
                byKey[key] = rack
                list[#list + 1] = rack
            end

            rack.parts[#rack.parts + 1] = name
        end
    end

    for _, rack in ipairs(list) do
        rack.parts = zones.collapse(rack.parts)
    end

    return list
end

---@param parts string[]
---@return string[]
function zones.collapse(parts)
    local result, seen = {}, {}

    for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
        local id = aliasOf[part] or part

        if not seen[id] then
            seen[id] = true
            result[#result + 1] = id
        end
    end

    return result
end

---@param zone CustomZone
---@param keys string[]
---@return vector3[]
function zones.pickups(zone, keys)
    local exact, fallback, all = {}, {}, {}

    for _, rack in ipairs(zone.racks) do
        all[#all + 1] = rack.coords

        if rack.stock.default then fallback[#fallback + 1] = rack.coords end

        for i = 1, #keys do
            if rack.stock[keys[i]] then
                exact[#exact + 1] = rack.coords
                break
            end
        end
    end

    if #exact > 0 then return exact end
    if #fallback > 0 then return fallback end

    return all
end

---@param zone CustomZone
---@param id string
---@return boolean
function zones.shows(zone, id)
    local allow = zone.allow

    return not allow or allow[id] == true or (allow.extras == true and id:find('^extra_%d') ~= nil)
end

zones.load(lib.load(GetConvarBool('sm_custom:devmode', false) and 'data.zones_dev' or 'data.zones') or {})

return zones

    FreezeEntityPosition(vehicle, true)

    DeleteVehicle(vehicle)

    return carData
end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\sm_donate\client\utils.lua
QBCore = exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject()

uiOpen = false

function isPointInPolygon(point, polygon)
    if not polygon or not polygon.points or #polygon.points == 0 then return true end

    local x, y = point.x, point.y
    local inside = false
    local j = #polygon.points

    for i = 1, #polygon.points do
        local xi, yi = polygon.points[i].x, polygon.points[i].y
        local xj, yj = polygon.points[j].x, polygon.points[j].y
        local intersect = ((yi > y) ~= (yj > y))
            and (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi)
        if intersect then inside = not inside end
        j = i
    end

    if inside and polygon.thickness then
        local baseZ = polygon.points[1].z
        if point.z < baseZ - 20.0 or point.z > baseZ + polygon.thickness + 20.0 then
            inside = false
        end
    end

    return inside
end

local TABLET_DICT = 'amb@code_human_in_bus_passenger_idles@female@tablet@idle_a'
local TABLET_ANIM = 'idle_a'
local TABLET_PROP = 'prop_cs_tablet'

local tabletProp = nil

function playTabletAnimation()
    local playerPed = PlayerPedId()

    if tabletProp and DoesEntityExist(tabletProp) then
        DeleteEntity(tabletProp)
        tabletProp = nil
    end

    RequestAnimDict(TABLET_DICT)
    while not HasAnimDictLoaded(TABLET_DICT) do Wait(0) end

    local propHash = GetHashKey(TABLET_PROP)
    RequestModel(propHash)
    while not HasModelLoaded(propHash) do Wait(0) end

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(playerPed)
    tabletProp = CreateObject(propHash, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, true, true, false)
    SetEntityAsMissionEntity(tabletProp, true, true)
    AttachEntityToEntity(tabletProp, playerPed, GetPedBoneIndex(playerPed, 28422), -0.05, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, -90.0, 0.0, true, true, false, true, 1, true)

    TaskPlayAnim(playerPed, TABLET_DICT, TABLET_ANIM, 3.0, 3.0, -1, 49, 0, false, false, false)

    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(propHash)
end

function stopTabletAnimation()
    local playerPed = PlayerPedId()

    StopAnimTask(playerPed, TABLET_DICT, TABLET_ANIM, 1.0)

    if tabletProp then
        if DoesEntityExist(tabletProp) then
            DetachEntity(tabletProp, true, true)
            DeleteEntity(tabletProp)
        end
        tabletProp = nil
    end

    RemoveAnimDict(TABLET_DICT)
end

function closeDonateUI()
    uiOpen = false
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    stopTabletAnimation()
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'forceClose' })
end

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resourceName)
    if GetCurrentResourceName() ~= resourceName then return end

    SetNuiFocus(false, false)

    local playerPed = PlayerPedId()
    StopAnimTask(playerPed, TABLET_DICT, TABLET_ANIM, 1.0)

    local tabletHash = GetHashKey(TABLET_PROP)
    for _, object in ipairs(GetGamePool('CObject')) do
        if GetEntityModel(object) == tabletHash and IsEntityAttachedToEntity(object, playerPed) then
            DetachEntity(object, true, true)
            DeleteEntity(object)
        end
    end
end)

RegisterNUICallback('closeMenu', function(_, cb)
    closeDonateUI()
    cb('ok')
end)

local firstOpening = true

local testDriveActive = false
local testDriveEndTime = 0
local testDriveVehicle = nil

function openDonateUI(initialTab)
    if uiOpen then return end

    if openSpamProtect >= GetGameTimer() then return end
    openSpamProtect = GetGameTimer() + 1500

    local playerData = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayerData()
    if not playerData or not playerData.citizenid then
        lib.notify({ description = 'Data pemain belum siap, coba lagi sebentar.', type = 'error' })
        return
    end

    if IsEntityDead(PlayerPedId()) or playerData.metadata['isdead'] or playerData.metadata['inlaststand'] then
        lib.notify({ description = 'Tidak bisa membuka menu saat sedang mati', type = 'error' })
        return
    end

    if playerData.metadata['ishandcuffed'] then
        lib.notify({ description = 'Tidak bisa membuka menu saat diborgol', type = 'error' })
        return
    end

    CreateThread(function()
        local withConfig = firstOpening
        local vipData = lib.callback.await('sm_donate:getVipData', false, withConfig)
        local bpData = lib.callback.await('sm_donate:getBattlepassData', false, withConfig)
        local gachaData = lib.callback.await('sm_donate:gachaGetData', false, withConfig)

        SetNuiFocus(true, true)
        uiOpen = true

        playTabletAnimation()

        local vipConfig
        if withConfig then
            vipConfig = {
                Categories = AK4Y.Categories,
                buyCoin = AK4Y.buyCoin,
                hotDeals = AK4Y.hotDeals,
                Translate = AK4Y.Translate,
                CustomPlatePrice = AK4Y.CustomPlatePrice,
                CustomPlateDruingPurchase = AK4Y.CustomPlateDruingPurchase,
                customizeLenghts = AK4Y.customizeLenghts,
            }
        end

        SendNUIMessage({
            action = 'openMenu',
            data = {
                initialTab = initialTab or 'donasi',
                vip = {
                    player = vipData,
                    config = vipConfig,
                },
                battlepass = bpData,
                gacha = gachaData,
            },
        })

        firstOpening = false
    end)
end

local function getCarData(itemData)
    local playerPed = PlayerPedId()
    local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(playerPed)
    local vehHash = GetHashKey(itemData.itemName)
    if not IsModelInCdimage(vehHash) then return end

    RequestModel(vehHash)
    while not HasModelLoaded(vehHash) do Wait(0) end

    local vehicle = CreateVehicle(vehHash, playerCoords.x, playerCoords.y, playerCoords.z - 200.0, 1.0, false, false)
    FreezeEntityPosition(vehicle, true)
    local carData = QBCore.Functions.GetVehicleProperties(vehicle)

    if itemData.rataKanan and itemData.rataKanan.enabled then
        SetVehicleModKit(vehicle, 0)
        SetVehicleMod(vehicle, 11, GetNumVehicleMods(vehicle, 11) - 1, false)
        SetVehicleMod(vehicle, 12, GetNumVehicleMods(vehicle, 12) - 1, false)
        SetVehicleMod(vehicle, 13, GetNumVehicleMods(vehicle, 13) - 1, false)
        SetVehicleMod(vehicle, 15, GetNumVehicleMods(vehicle, 15) - 1, false)
        SetVehicleMod(vehicle, 16, GetNumVehicleMods(vehicle, 16) - 1, false)
        ToggleVehicleMod(vehicle, 18, true)
        carData = QBCore.Functions.GetVehicleProperties(vehicle)
    end

    DeleteVehicle(vehicle)
    return carData
end

RegisterNUICallback('itemBuy', function(data, cb)
    if data.itemType == Settings.SqlVehicleType or data.itemType == Settings.SqlAirType or data.itemType == Settings.SqlBoatType then
        data.carData = getCarData(data)
        lib.callback('sm_donate:buyItem', false, function(state) cb(state) end, data)

    elseif data.itemType == 'bundle' then
        for _, v in pairs(data.giveItems) do
            if v.itemType == Settings.SqlVehicleType or v.itemType == Settings.SqlAirType or v.itemType == Settings.SqlBoatType then
                v.carData = getCarData(v)
            end
        end
        lib.callback('sm_donate:buyItem', false, function(state) cb(state) end, data)

    elseif data.itemType == 'plate' then
        if IsPedInAnyVehicle(PlayerPedId(), false) then
            local veh = GetVehiclePedIsIn(PlayerPedId(), false)
            data.oldPlate = GetVehicleNumberPlateText(veh)
            local newPlate = data.customizePopUp.plateNumber
            lib.callback('sm_donate:buyItem', false, function(state)
                SetVehicleNumberPlateText(veh, newPlate)
                if Settings.GiveAddKeys then
                    Settings.GiveAddKeysFunction(newPlate)
                end
                cb(state)
            end, data)
        else
            cb(AK4Y.Translate.youHaveToBeInVehicle)
        end

    else
        lib.callback('sm_donate:buyItem', false, function(state) cb(state) end, data)
    end
end)

local function endTestDrive(exitedVehicle)
    testDriveActive = false
    lib.hideTextUI()

    local playerPed = PlayerPedId()

    if DoesEntityExist(testDriveVehicle) then
        SetEntityAsMissionEntity(testDriveVehicle, false, true)
        DeleteVehicle(testDriveVehicle)
    end
    testDriveVehicle = nil

    if originalPosition then
        SetEntityCoords(playerPed, originalPosition.coords.x, originalPosition.coords.y, originalPosition.coords.z, false, false, false, true)
        SetEntityHeading(playerPed, originalPosition.heading)
        originalPosition = nil
    end

    TriggerTokenEvent('sm_donate:endTestDrive')

    lib.notify({
        description = exitedVehicle and 'Test drive berakhir karena keluar kendaraan' or 'Test drive selesai',
        type = 'info',
    })
end

local function spawnCarForTest(itemData, timing, savedCoords, savedHeading)
    originalPosition = { coords = savedCoords, heading = savedHeading }

    local playerPed = PlayerPedId()
    local spawnLocation = Settings.testDriveSpawn
    local vehHash = GetHashKey(itemData.itemName)

    if not IsModelInCdimage(vehHash) then
        lib.notify({ description = 'Model kendaraan tidak valid', type = 'error' })
        testDriveActive = false
        TriggerTokenEvent('sm_donate:endTestDrive')
        return
    end

    RequestModel(vehHash)
    while not HasModelLoaded(vehHash) do Wait(10) end

    local vehicle = CreateVehicle(vehHash, spawnLocation.x, spawnLocation.y, spawnLocation.z, spawnLocation.w, true, false)
    local testPlate = 'TEST' .. math.random(1000, 9999)
    SetVehicleNumberPlateText(vehicle, testPlate)
    SetVehicleOnGroundProperly(vehicle)
    SetEntityAsMissionEntity(vehicle, true, true)
    SetVehicleHasBeenOwnedByPlayer(vehicle, true)
    SetVehicleNeedsToBeHotwired(vehicle, false)
    SetVehicleEngineOn(vehicle, true, true, false)

    if itemData.itemName == 'smcruis' then
        SetVehicleModKit(vehicle, 0)
        SetVehicleMod(vehicle, 8, 0, false)
    elseif itemData.itemName == 'smm3g80' then
        SetVehicleModKit(vehicle, 0)
        RemoveVehicleMod(vehicle, 7)
        RemoveVehicleMod(vehicle, 5)
    end

    SetEntityCoords(playerPed, spawnLocation.x, spawnLocation.y, spawnLocation.z, false, false, false, true)
    SetEntityHeading(playerPed, spawnLocation.w)
    Wait(500)
    TaskWarpPedIntoVehicle(playerPed, vehicle, -1)
    TriggerEvent('sm_vehiclekeys:client:setVehicleOwner', testPlate)

    testDriveVehicle = vehicle
    testDriveEndTime = GetGameTimer() + (timing * 1000)

    lib.notify({ description = ('%s (%d detik)'):format(AK4Y.Translate.testDriveStarted, timing), type = 'success' })

    CreateThread(function()
        while testDriveActive do
            local timeLeft = math.ceil((testDriveEndTime - GetGameTimer()) / 1000)
            if timeLeft <= 0 or IsControlJustPressed(0, 38) then
                endTestDrive(false)
                break
            end
            lib.showTextUI(('[E] Hentikan Test Drive | Waktu: %02d:%02d'):format(math.floor(timeLeft / 60), timeLeft % 60), { position = 'top-center' })
            Wait(1)
        end
    end)
end

RegisterNUICallback('testDrive', function(data, cb)
    if testDriveActive then
        lib.notify({ description = 'Test drive sedang berlangsung', type = 'error' })
        cb(false)
        return
    end

    local playerPed = PlayerPedId()
    local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(playerPed)

    if not isPointInPolygon(playerCoords, Settings.TestDriveZone) then
        lib.notify({ description = 'Test drive hanya bisa dilakukan di lokasi Sumber Rezeki', type = 'error' })
        cb(false)
        return
    end

    local originalCoords = playerCoords
    local originalHeading = GetEntityHeading(playerPed)
    testDriveActive = true

    lib.callback('sm_donate:validateTestDrive', false, function(isValid)
        if not isValid then
            lib.notify({ description = AK4Y.Translate.testDriveNotAvailable or 'Test drive tidak tersedia', type = 'error' })
            testDriveActive = false
            cb(false)
            return
        end

        closeDonateUI()
        spawnCarForTest(data, Settings.testDriveTime or 60, originalCoords, originalHeading)
        cb(true)
    end, data)
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\sm_gudang\client\main.lua
local function showStashInfo(stashType)
    local stashConfig = Config.StashTypes[stashType]

    lib.alertDialog({
        header = 'Info ' .. stashConfig.label,
        content = ('**Spesifikasi Gudang:**\n\n' ..
            'â€¢ Kapasitas: %d slot\n' ..
            'â€¢ Berat maksimal: %dkg\n' ..
            'â€¢ Harga per hari: $%s\n' ..
            'â€¢ Sewa minimum: %d hari\n' ..
            'â€¢ Sewa maksimum: %d hari\n' ..
            'â€¢ **Maksimal total sewa: %d hari**'):format(
            stashConfig.slots,
            stashConfig.weight / 1000,
            lib.math.groupdigits(stashConfig.pricePerDay),
            stashConfig.minDays,
            stashConfig.maxDays,
            stashConfig.maxTotalDays or stashConfig.maxDays
        ),
        centered = true
    })
end

local function showRentalDialog(stashType, isExtension)
    local stashConfig = Config.StashTypes[stashType]

    local input = lib.inputDialog(isExtension and 'Perpanjang Sewa Gudang' or 'Sewa Gudang Baru', {
        {
            type = 'slider',
            label = 'Jumlah Hari',
            description = ('Pilih berapa hari ingin menyewa (Harga: $%s/hari)\nMaksimal total sewa: %d hari'):format(
                lib.math.groupdigits(stashConfig.pricePerDay),
                stashConfig.maxTotalDays or stashConfig.maxDays
            ),
            icon = 'calendar',
            required = true,
            default = stashConfig.minDays,
            min = stashConfig.minDays,
            max = stashConfig.maxDays,
            step = 1
        }
    })

    if not input then return end

    local days = input[1]
    local totalPrice = stashConfig.pricePerDay * days

    local confirm = lib.alertDialog({
        header = 'Konfirmasi Sewa',
        content = ('**%s**\n\n' ..
            'Durasi: %d hari\n' ..
            'Harga per hari: $%s\n' ..
            'Total biaya: $%s\n' ..
            'Maksimal total sewa: %d hari\n\n' ..
            'Apakah Anda yakin ingin melanjutkan?'):format(
            stashConfig.label,
            days,
            lib.math.groupdigits(stashConfig.pricePerDay),
            lib.math.groupdigits(totalPrice),
            stashConfig.maxTotalDays or stashConfig.maxDays
        ),
        centered = true,
        cancel = true,
        labels = {
            confirm = 'Ya, Sewa',
            cancel = 'Batal'
        }
    })

    if confirm == 'confirm' then
        TriggerServerEvent('ni_stash:server:rentStash', stashType, days)
    end
end

local function showRentalMenu(stashType, status, remainingDays)
    local stashConfig = Config.StashTypes[stashType]
    local menuOptions = {}

    if status == 'active' then
        menuOptions[#menuOptions + 1] = {
            title = 'Buka Gudang',
            description = 'Akses gudang Anda (Sisa: ' .. remainingDays .. ' hari)',
            icon = 'warehouse',
            onSelect = function()
                TriggerServerEvent('ni_stash:server:openRentalStash', stashType)
            end
        }

        menuOptions[#menuOptions + 1] = {
            title = 'Perpanjang Sewa',
            description = 'Tambah waktu sewa gudang',
            icon = 'clock',
            onSelect = function()
                showRentalDialog(stashType, true)
            end
        }
    elseif status == 'expired' then
        menuOptions[#menuOptions + 1] = {
            title = 'Perpanjang Sewa (Kedaluwarsa)',
            description = 'Sewa gudang telah kedaluwarsa, perpanjang sekarang',
            icon = 'exclamation-triangle',
            onSelect = function()
                showRentalDialog(stashType, false)
            end
        }
    else
        menuOptions[#menuOptions + 1] = {
            title = 'Sewa Gudang',
            description = 'Mulai sewa gudang baru',
            icon = 'plus',
            onSelect = function()
                showRentalDialog(stashType, false)
            end
        }
    end

    menuOptions[#menuOptions + 1] = {
        title = 'Info Gudang',
        description = 'Lihat detail gudang',
        icon = 'info',
        onSelect = function()
            showStashInfo(stashType)
        end
    }

    lib.registerContext({
        id = 'rental_stash_menu',
        title = stashConfig.label,
        options = menuOptions
    })

    lib.showContext('rental_stash_menu')
end

local function showVipInfo(vipStatus)
    local content

    if vipStatus then
        content = ('**Status VIP Anda:**\n\n' ..
            'â€¢ Status: %s\n' ..
            'â€¢ Waktu tersisa: %s\n\n' ..
            '**Akses Gudang:**\n' ..
            'â€¢ Gudang VIP: %s\n' ..
            'â€¢ Gudang VVIP: %s'):format(
            vipStatus.vip_type:upper(),
            vipStatus.timeLeft or 'Tidak diketahui',
            vipStatus.vip_type == Config.StashTypes['vip_stash'].requiresVip and 'Tersedia' or 'Tidak Tersedia',
            vipStatus.vip_type == Config.StashTypes['vvip_stash'].requiresVip and 'Tersedia' or 'Tidak Tersedia'
        )
    else
        content = '**Status VIP Anda:**\n\n' ..
            'Anda tidak memiliki status VIP aktif\n\n' ..
            'Untuk mengakses gudang VIP eksklusif,\n' ..
            'silakan hubungi admin, atau kunjungi website kami.'
    end

    lib.alertDialog({
        header = 'Info Status VIP',
        content = content,
        centered = true
    })
end

local function showVipStashMenu(vipStatus)
    local vipType = vipStatus and vipStatus.vip_type
    local menuOptions = {}

    -- Syarat akses dibaca dari Config supaya nama tier tidak perlu di-hardcode
    -- di sini; server memakai pengecekan yang sama (requiresVip).
    local function addStashOption(stashType, title, icon, capacity)
        local required = Config.StashTypes[stashType].requiresVip
        local allowed = vipType == required

        local description

        if allowed then
            description = ('Akses gudang %s eksklusif (%s)'):format(required:upper(), capacity)
        elseif vipType then
            description = ('Khusus untuk %s (Anda %s)'):format(required:upper(), tostring(vipType):upper())
        else
            description = ('Memerlukan status %s, Kapasitas (%s)'):format(required:upper(), capacity)
        end

        menuOptions[#menuOptions + 1] = {
            title = title,
            description = description,
            icon = icon,
            disabled = not allowed,
            onSelect = function()
                TriggerServerEvent('ni_stash:server:openVipStash', stashType)
            end
        }
    end

    addStashOption('vip_stash', 'Gudang VIP', 'gem', '15 ton, 100 slot')
    addStashOption('vvip_stash', 'Gudang VVIP', 'crown', '15 ton, 200 slot')

    menuOptions[#menuOptions + 1] = {
        title = 'Info Status VIP',
        description = 'Lihat status VIP Anda',
        icon = 'info',
        onSelect = function()
            showVipInfo(vipStatus)
        end
    }

    lib.registerContext({
        id = 'vip_stash_menu',
        title = 'Gudang VIP Eksklusif',
        options = menuOptions
    })

    lib.showContext('vip_stash_menu')
end

local function createBlip(coords, label, sprite, scale, colour)
    local blip = AddBlipForCoord(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)

    SetBlipSprite(blip, sprite)
    SetBlipDisplay(blip, 4)
    SetBlipScale(blip, scale)
    SetBlipColour(blip, colour)
    SetBlipAsShortRange(blip, true)
    SetBlipCategory(blip, 23)
    BeginTextCommandSetBlipName('STRING')
    AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(label)
    EndTextCommandSetBlipName(blip)
end

local function canInteract()
    return not IsPedInAnyVehicle(cache.ped, false)
end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[01_kendaraan_ekonomi]\sm_gudang\server\main.lua
local QBCore = exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject()

local function db(query, params)
    return exports.oxmysql:query(query, params or {})
end

CreateThread(function()
    db([[CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sm_gudang_rentals (
        citizenid VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
        stash_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
        expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (citizenid, stash_type)
    ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci]])
end)

local function getPlayer(source)
    return QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(source)
end

local function nearAny(source, list)
    local ped = GetPlayerPed(source)

    if not ped or ped == 0 then return false end

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)

    for i = 1, #list do
        if #(coords - list[i].coords) <= (Config.MaxInteractDistance + 2.0) then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function nearStash(source, stashType)
    local list = {}

    for i = 1, #Config.RentalLocations do
        local loc = Config.RentalLocations[i]

        if loc.stashType == stashType then list[#list + 1] = loc end
    end

    return nearAny(source, list)
end

local function getVip(source)
    local Player = getPlayer(source)

    if not Player then return nil end

    local meta = Player.PlayerData.metadata
    local vip = meta and (meta.vip or meta.vip_type)

    if type(vip) == 'string' and vip ~= '' then
        return { vip_type = vip:lower(), timeLeft = meta.vip_expires and tostring(meta.vip_expires) or 'Aktif' }
    end

    local ok, rows = pcall(db, [[SELECT vip_type, expires_at,
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, NOW(), expires_at) AS hours
        FROM player_vip WHERE citizenid = ? AND expires_at > NOW()]], { Player.PlayerData.citizenid })

    if not ok or not rows or not rows[1] then return nil end

    local row = rows[1]
    local hours = tonumber(row.hours) or 0

    return {
        vip_type = tostring(row.vip_type):lower(),
        timeLeft = ('%d hari %d jam'):format(math.floor(hours / 24), hours % 24),
    }
end

local function stashId(stashType, citizenid)
    return ('gudang_%s_%s'):format(stashType, citizenid)
end

local function openStash(source, stashType)
    local Player = getPlayer(source)
    local cfg = Config.StashTypes[stashType]

    if not Player or not cfg then return false end

    local id = stashId(stashType, Player.PlayerData.citizenid)

    exports.ox_inventory:RegisterStash(id, cfg.label, cfg.slots, cfg.weight, Player.PlayerData.citizenid)
    TriggerClientEvent('ni_stash:client:openStash', source, id)

    return true
end

local function rentalRow(citizenid, stashType)
    local rows = db('SELECT expires_at, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, NOW(), expires_at) AS days FROM sm_gudang_rentals WHERE citizenid = ? AND stash_type = ?', {
        citizenid,
        stashType,
    })

    return rows and rows[1] or nil
end

RegisterNetEvent('ni_stash:server:getStashStatus', function(stashType)
    local source = source
    local Player = getPlayer(source)
    local cfg = Config.StashTypes[stashType]

    if not Player or not cfg then return end
    if not nearStash(source, stashType) then return end

    local row = rentalRow(Player.PlayerData.citizenid, stashType)

    if not row then
        return TriggerClientEvent('ni_stash:client:receiveStashStatus', source, 'none', 0, stashType)
    end

    local days = tonumber(row.days) or 0

    if days <= 0 then
        return TriggerClientEvent('ni_stash:client:receiveStashStatus', source, 'expired', 0, stashType)
    end

    TriggerClientEvent('ni_stash:client:receiveStashStatus', source, 'active', days, stashType)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('ni_stash:server:rentStash', function(stashType, days)
    local source = source
    local Player = getPlayer(source)
    local cfg = Config.StashTypes[stashType]

    if not Player or not cfg then return end
    if not nearStash(source, stashType) then return end

    days = math.floor(tonumber(days) or 0)

    if days < cfg.minDays or days > cfg.maxDays then return end

    local row = rentalRow(Player.PlayerData.citizenid, stashType)
    local currentDays = row and math.max(tonumber(row.days) or 0, 0) or 0

    if currentDays + days > (cfg.maxTotalDays or cfg.maxDays) then
        return TriggerClientEvent('ox_lib:notify', source, {
            type = 'error',
            description = ('Maksimal total sewa %d hari'):format(cfg.maxTotalDays or cfg.maxDays),
        })
    end

    local price = cfg.pricePerDay * days

    if not Player.Functions.RemoveMoney(Config.Currency, price, ('sewa %s'):format(cfg.label)) then
        return TriggerClientEvent('ox_lib:notify', source, {
            type = 'error',
            description = 'Uang tidak cukup',
        })
    end

    local base = currentDays > 0 and ('DATE_ADD(expires_at, INTERVAL ? DAY)') or 'DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL ? DAY)'

    db(([[INSERT INTO sm_gudang_rentals (citizenid, stash_type, expires_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL ? DAY))
        ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE expires_at = %s]]):format(base), {
        Player.PlayerData.citizenid,
        stashType,
        days,
    })

    TriggerClientEvent('ox_lib:notify', source, {
        type = 'success',
        description = ('%s disewa %d hari'):format(cfg.label, days),
    })

    TriggerClientEvent('ni_stash:client:receiveStashStatus', source, 'active',
        math.min(currentDays + days, cfg.maxTotalDays or cfg.maxDays), stashType)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('ni_stash:server:openRentalStash', function(stashType)
    local source = source
    local Player = getPlayer(source)

    if not Player or not Config.StashTypes[stashType] then return end
    if not nearStash(source, stashType) then return end

    local row = rentalRow(Player.PlayerData.citizenid, stashType)

    if not row or (tonumber(row.days) or 0) <= 0 then
        return TriggerClientEvent('ox_lib:notify', source, {
            type = 'error',
            description = 'Sewa gudang sudah habis',
        })
    end

    openStash(source, stashType)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('ni_stash:server:getVipStatus', function()
    local source = source

    if not nearAny(source, Config.VipStashLocations) then return end

    TriggerClientEvent('ni_stash:client:showVipMenu', source, getVip(source))
end)

RegisterNetEvent('ni_stash:server:openVipStash', function(stashType)
    local source = source
    local cfg = Config.StashTypes[stashType]

    if not cfg or not cfg.requiresVip then return end
    if not nearAny(source, Config.VipStashLocations) then return end

    local vip = getVip(source)

    if not vip or vip.vip_type ~= cfg.requiresVip then
        return TriggerClientEvent('ox_lib:notify', source, {
            type = 'error',
            description = ('Butuh status %s'):format(cfg.requiresVip:upper()),
        })
    end

    openStash(source, stashType)
end)

lib.print.info('sm_gudang server siap')

RegisterNUICallback('preview', function (data, cb)
    local vehicle = data.vehicle --[[@as VehicleProps]]
    local created = Client.previewVehicle(vehicle)

    cb(created)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('changeColor', function (data, cb)
    Client.changeColor(data.color:match("rgb%((%d+),%s*(%d+),%s*(%d+)%)"))

    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback('spawnVehicle', function (data, cb)
    Client.drivePurchasedVehicle()
    cb(true)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('getInstallmentConfig', function(data, cb)
    cb(cfg.installment)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('buyVehicle', function (purchaseData, cb)
    local success = Client.purchaseVehicle(purchaseData)
    
    cb(success)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('testDrive', function (data, cb)
    Client.testDrive()

    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback('payInstallment', function(data, cb)
    local plate = data.plate
    local amount = data.amount

    if not plate or not amount then
        cb(false)
        return
    end

    local success = lib.callback.await('rhd_vehicleshops:payInstallment', false, plate, amount)

    if success then
        Wait(500)
        Client.refreshInstallmentData()
    end

    cb(success)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('refreshInstallments', function(data, cb)
    Client.refreshInstallmentData()
    cb(true)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('exitShop', function (data, cb)
    Client.onCloseUI(true)
    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback('exitInstallment', function (data, cb)
    Client.onCloseUI(false)
    cb('ok')
end)

    fadeAlpha = 0.0,

    baseRadius = CONFIG.DEFAULT_RADIUS
}

state.cameraPositions = {
    { az = 180, ay = 12, rm = 1.1,  name = "Depan" },
    { az = 90,  ay = 10, rm = 0.9,  name = "Kanan" },
    { az = 0,   ay = 15, rm = 1.0,  name = "Belakang" },
    { az = 270, ay = 8,  rm = 0.85, name = "Kiri" }
}

local function cos(degrees) return math.cos(math.rad(degrees)) end
local function sin(degrees) return math.sin(math.rad(degrees)) end

local function lerp(current, target, speed)
    return current + (target - current) * speed
end


local function startTransition()
    state.transitionState = TRANSITION_STATE.FADING_OUT
    state.transitionStartTime = GetGameTimer()
    state.fadeAlpha = 0.0
end

local nextCameraPosition = function()
    if state.transitionState ~= TRANSITION_STATE.IDLE then return end

    state.currentIndex = state.currentIndex + 1
    if state.currentIndex > #state.cameraPositions then
        state.currentIndex = 1
    end

    startTransition()
end

local previousCameraPosition = function()
    if state.transitionState ~= TRANSITION_STATE.IDLE then return end

    state.currentIndex = state.currentIndex - 1
    if state.currentIndex < 1 then
        state.currentIndex = #state.cameraPositions
    end

    startTransition()
end

local function getVehicleDimensions(vehicle)
    local min, max = GetModelDimensions(GetEntityModel(vehicle))
    local dimensions = {
        length = max.y - min.y,
        width = max.x - min.x,
        height = max.z - min.z
    }

    dimensions.diagonal = math.sqrt(
        dimensions.length * dimensions.length +
        dimensions.width * dimensions.width +
        dimensions.height * dimensions.height
    )

    return dimensions
end

local function calculateOptimalCameraSettings(dimensions)
    local diagonal = dimensions.diagonal
    local radius, fov

    if diagonal < 6.0 then
        radius = CONFIG.SMALL_VEHICLE_RADIUS
        fov = 55.0
    elseif diagonal < 10.0 then
        radius = CONFIG.MEDIUM_VEHICLE_RADIUS
        fov = 65.0
    else
        radius = CONFIG.LARGE_VEHICLE_RADIUS
        fov = 75.0
    end

    local aspectRatio = dimensions.length / dimensions.width
    if aspectRatio > 2.5 then
        radius = radius * 1.2
        fov = math.min(fov + 5, CONFIG.MAX_FOV)
    end

    if dimensions.height > 3.0 then
        radius = radius * 1.15
        fov = math.min(fov + 5, CONFIG.MAX_FOV)
    end

    return radius, fov
end

local function checkCollision(entityCoords, camPos)
    local rayHandle = StartShapeTestRay(
        entityCoords.x, entityCoords.y, entityCoords.z + CONFIG.ENTITY_HEIGHT_OFFSET,
        camPos.x, camPos.y, camPos.z,
        -1,
        state.entity,
        7
    )

    local _, hit, hitCoords, _, _ = GetShapeTestResult(rayHandle)

    if hit then
        local distance = #(entityCoords - vec3(hitCoords.x, hitCoords.y, hitCoords.z))
        return true, distance - CONFIG.COLLISION_CHECK_DISTANCE
    end

    return false, nil
end

local function calculateCameraPosition()
    local entityCoords = GetEntityCoords(state.entity)

    local cosAngleZ = cos(state.angleZ)
    local cosAngleY = cos(state.angleY)
    local sinAngleZ = sin(state.angleZ)
    local sinAngleY = sin(state.angleY)

    local offset = vec3(
        cosAngleZ * cosAngleY * state.radius,
        sinAngleZ * cosAngleY * state.radius,
        sinAngleY * state.radius
    )

    local desiredCamPos = vec3(
        entityCoords.x + offset.x,
        entityCoords.y + offset.y,
        entityCoords.z + offset.z
    )

    local hasCollision, safeDistance = checkCollision(entityCoords, desiredCamPos)

    if hasCollision and safeDistance then
        local adjustedRadius = math.max(CONFIG.MIN_RADIUS, safeDistance)
        offset = vec3(
            cosAngleZ * cosAngleY * adjustedRadius,
            sinAngleZ * cosAngleY * adjustedRadius,
            sinAngleY * adjustedRadius
        )

        desiredCamPos = vec3(
            entityCoords.x + offset.x,
            entityCoords.y + offset.y,
            entityCoords.z + offset.z
        )
    end

    return desiredCamPos, entityCoords
end

local function updateCameraView()
    state.angleZ = lerp(state.angleZ, state.targetAngleZ, CONFIG.LERP_SPEED)
    state.angleY = lerp(state.angleY, state.targetAngleY, CONFIG.LERP_SPEED)
    state.radius = lerp(state.radius, state.targetRadius, CONFIG.LERP_SPEED)
    state.fov = lerp(state.fov, state.targetFov, CONFIG.LERP_SPEED)

    local camPos, entityCoords = calculateCameraPosition()

    SetCamCoord(state.cam, camPos.x, camPos.y, camPos.z)
    PointCamAtCoord(state.cam, entityCoords.x, entityCoords.y, entityCoords.z + CONFIG.ENTITY_HEIGHT_OFFSET)
    SetCamFov(state.cam, state.fov)
end

local function drawFadeOverlay()
    if state.fadeAlpha > 0.0 then
        DrawRect(0.5, 0.5, 1.0, 1.0, 0, 0, 0, math.floor(state.fadeAlpha * 255))
    end
end

local function handleCameraTransition()
    if state.transitionState == TRANSITION_STATE.IDLE then
        return
    end

    local currentTime = GetGameTimer()
    local elapsed = currentTime - state.transitionStartTime
    local target = state.cameraPositions[state.currentIndex]

    if state.transitionState == TRANSITION_STATE.FADING_OUT then
        local progress = elapsed / CONFIG.FADE_OUT_DURATION
        state.fadeAlpha = math.min(progress, 1.0)

        if elapsed >= CONFIG.FADE_OUT_DURATION then
            state.transitionState = TRANSITION_STATE.SNAPPING
            state.transitionStartTime = currentTime
        end

    elseif state.transitionState == TRANSITION_STATE.SNAPPING then
        state.targetAngleZ = target.az
        state.targetAngleY = target.ay
        state.targetRadius = state.baseRadius * target.rm

        state.angleZ = target.az
        state.angleY = target.ay
        state.radius = state.baseRadius * target.rm

        if elapsed >= CONFIG.SNAP_TRANSITION_DURATION then
            state.transitionState = TRANSITION_STATE.FADING_IN
            state.transitionStartTime = currentTime
        end

    elseif state.transitionState == TRANSITION_STATE.FADING_IN then
        local progress = elapsed / CONFIG.FADE_IN_DURATION
        state.fadeAlpha = math.max(1.0 - progress, 0.0)

        if elapsed >= CONFIG.FADE_IN_DURATION then
            state.fadeAlpha = 0.0
            state.transitionState = TRANSITION_STATE.IDLE
        end
    end
end

local function startInputListener()
    CreateThread(function()
        while state.running and DoesEntityExist(state.entity) do
            DisableAllControlActions(0)

            if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, 175) then -- Arrow Right
                nextCameraPosition()
            end

            if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, 174) then -- Arrow Left
                previousCameraPosition()
            end

            if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 173) then -- Arrow Up
                state.targetFov = math.min(state.targetFov + 0.5, CONFIG.MAX_FOV)
            elseif IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 172) then -- Arrow Down
                state.targetFov = math.max(state.targetFov - 0.5, CONFIG.MIN_FOV)
            end

            handleCameraTransition()
            updateCameraView()
            drawFadeOverlay()

            Wait(0)
        end
    end)
end

function camera.create(entity)
    state.entity = entity
    state.currentIndex = 1

    if DoesEntityExist(entity) then
        state.vehicleDimensions = getVehicleDimensions(entity)
        local optimalRadius, optimalFov = calculateOptimalCameraSettings(state.vehicleDimensions)

        state.baseRadius = optimalRadius
        state.radius = optimalRadius
        state.targetRadius = optimalRadius
        state.fov = optimalFov
        state.targetFov = optimalFov

        CONFIG.MAX_RADIUS = math.max(CONFIG.MAX_RADIUS, optimalRadius * 1.5)
    end

    if not (state.cam and DoesCamExist(state.cam)) then
        state.running = true

        DoScreenFadeOut(500)
        Wait(1000)

        state.transitionState = TRANSITION_STATE.FADING_IN
        state.transitionStartTime = GetGameTimer()
        state.fadeAlpha = 1.0

        local initialTarget = state.cameraPositions[state.currentIndex]

        state.angleZ = initialTarget.az
        state.angleY = initialTarget.ay
        state.radius = state.baseRadius * initialTarget.rm
        state.targetAngleZ = initialTarget.az
        state.targetAngleY = initialTarget.ay
        state.targetRadius = state.baseRadius * initialTarget.rm

        state.cam = CreateCam("DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA", true)
        RenderScriptCams(true, false, 0, false, false)

        Wait(1000)
        DoScreenFadeIn(500)
    end

    startInputListener()
    return state.cam
end

function camera.destroy()
    if state.cam and DoesCamExist(state.cam) then
        RenderScriptCams(false, false, 0, false, false)
        DestroyCam(state.cam, false)
    end

    state.cam = nil
    state.running = false

    state.entity = nil
    state.radius = CONFIG.DEFAULT_RADIUS
    state.angleY = 10.0
    state.angleZ = 0.0
    state.targetRadius = CONFIG.DEFAULT_RADIUS
    state.targetAngleY = 10.0
    state.targetAngleZ = 0.0
    state.fov = CONFIG.DEFAULT_FOV
    state.targetFov = CONFIG.DEFAULT_FOV
    state.currentIndex = 1
    state.transitionState = TRANSITION_STATE.IDLE
    state.transitionStartTime = 0
    state.fadeAlpha = 0.0
    state.vehicleDimensions = nil
    state.baseRadius = CONFIG.DEFAULT_RADIUS
end

function camera.setFov(fov)
    if state.cam and DoesCamExist(state.cam) then
        state.targetFov = math.max(CONFIG.MIN_FOV, math.min(CONFIG.MAX_FOV, fov))
    end
end

function camera.getFov()
    return state.fov
end

function camera.getVehicleDimensions()
    return state.vehicleDimensions
end

function camera.nextPosition()
    nextCameraPosition()
end

function camera.previousPosition()
    previousCameraPosition()
end

function camera.getCurrentPositionName()
    return state.cameraPositions[state.currentIndex].name
end

function camera.getCurrentPositionIndex()
    return state.currentIndex
end

local pedExist = {}

local interact = cfg.rhd_interact and
                    exports.rhd_interact or exports.ox_target

---@param key string
---@param model string
---@param coords vector4
---@param groups string|string[]|table<string, number|number[]>
---@return integer? PedHandle
local function setupPed(key, model, coords, groups)
    model = qbLib.safecall(lib.requestModel, model, 1500)

    if not model then return end

    local ped = CreatePed(0, model --[[@as integer]], coords.x, coords.y, coords.z -1, coords.w, false, false)
    
    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(ped, true)
    SetEntityInvincible(ped, true)
    SetEntityProofs(ped, true, true, true, true, true, true, true, true)
    FreezeEntityPosition(ped, true)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)

    local options_1 = {
        label = 'Access vehicle shop',
        icon = 'fas fa-car',
        onSelect = function ()
            Client.openShop(key)
        end,
        groups = groups,
        distance = 2.5,
    }

    if cfg.rhd_interact then
        options_1.progress = {
            duration = 500
        }
        options_1.distance = 5.0
    end

    local options_2 = {
        label = 'Vehicle installment',
        icon = 'fas fa-file-invoice',
        onSelect = function ()
            Client.openInstallmentUI()
        end,
        groups = groups,
        distance = options_1.distance
    }

    pedExist[#pedExist+1] = ped
    interact:addLocalEntity(ped, { options_1, options_2 })

    return ped
end

CreateThread(function()
    for _, v in pairs(cfg.shops) do
        if v.ped and v.ped.model and v.ped.coords then
            local coords = v.ped.coords

            local points = lib.points.new(coords, 5, {
                pedEntity = nil
            })
            
            
            function points:onEnter()
                if not (self.pedEntity and DoesEntityExist(self.pedEntity)) then
                    self.pedEntity = setupPed(_, v.ped.model, v.ped.coords, v.groups)
                end
            end
            
            function points:onExit()
                if self.pedEntity and DoesEntityExist(self.pedEntity) then
                    pcall(DeleteEntity, self.pedEntity)
                end

                self.pedEntity = nil
            end
            
            qbLib.blip.Add({
                coords = coords,
                sprite = v.blip.sprite,
                color = v.blip.color,
                label = v.label
            })
        end
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource == GetCurrentResourceName() then
        for i=1, #pedExist do
            local entity = pedExist[i]
            qbLib.safecall(DeleteEntity, entity)
        end
    end
end)

local function openInstallmentUI()

    end

    local installments = lib.callback.await('rhd_vehicleshops:getInstallmentDetails', false)

local function refreshInstallmentData()
    if not installmentUI then
        return
    end

    local installments = lib.callback.await('rhd_vehicleshops:getInstallmentDetails', false)

    if not installments then
        return
    end

    SendNUIMessage({
        action = 'setInstallmentVisible',

            state = true,

        }
    })

local storageResolved = {}

---@param key string
---@return VehicleProps[]
local function getVehicleTable(key)
    local list = vehicles[key]

    if not list then
        return {}
    end

    if storageResolved[key] then
        return list
    end

    for i = 1, #list do
        local vehicle = list[i]
        local storage = vehicle_storage.getStorage(vehicle.model)

        if storage then
            vehicle.trunkSlots = storage.trunkSlots
            vehicle.trunkWeight = storage.trunkWeight
            vehicle.gloveSlots = storage.gloveSlots
            vehicle.gloveWeight = storage.gloveWeight
        end
    end

    storageResolved[key] = true
    return list
end

        currentShop = nil

        installmentUI = false

---@param r string

local function changeColor(r, g, b)
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: cast-local-type
    r, g, b = tonumber(r) , tonumber(g), tonumber(b)

    if not (r and g and b) then
        return
    end

    if not (previewVehicle and DoesEntityExist(previewVehicle)) then
        return
    end

    SetVehicleCustomPrimaryColour(previewVehicle, r, g, b)
    SetVehicleModColor_1(previewVehicle, 1 --[[@as integer]], 0, 0)

    SetVehicleCustomSecondaryColour(previewVehicle, r, g, b)
    SetVehicleModColor_2(previewVehicle, 1 --[[@as integer]], 0)
end

local function handleTimer(testDriveTime, prevCoords)

    if inTestDrive then
        return
    end

    inTestDrive = true
    local gameTimer = GetGameTimer()
    local totalMs = 1000 * testDriveTime
    local lastSent

    while inTestDrive and DoesEntityExist(previewVehicle) do
        local elapsed = GetGameTimer() - gameTimer

        if elapsed >= totalMs - 20 or GetPedInVehicleSeat(previewVehicle, -1) ~= cache.ped then
            SetEntityCoords(cache.ped, prevCoords.x, prevCoords.y, prevCoords.z, false, false, false, false)
            deletePreview()
            lib.notify({ description = 'Vehicle test drive complete' })
            break
        end

        local secondsLeft = math.ceil(testDriveTime - elapsed / 1000)

        if secondsLeft ~= lastSent then
            lastSent = secondsLeft

            SendNUIMessage({
                action = 'updateTimer',
                data = {
                    time = secondsLeft
                }
            })
        end

        Wait(250)
    end

    SendNUIMessage({
        action = 'updateTimer',
        data = { time = nil }
    })

    LocalPlayer.state.inTestDrive = false
    inTestDrive = false
    TriggerTokenEvent('rhd_vehicleshops:endTestDrive')
end

local function testDrive()
    local lastShop = currentShop

    camera.destroy()
    resetFocus()
    currentShop = nil
    vehicleShopUI = false

    if not (previewVehicle and DoesEntityExist(previewVehicle)) then
        return
    end

    local shop_data = shops[lastShop]

    if not shop_data then
        return
    end

    if not lib.callback.await('rhd_vehicleshops:startTestDrive', false, lastShop) then
        deletePreview()
        lib.notify({ description = 'Test drive tidak tersedia', type = 'error' })
        return
    end

    local coords = shop_data.coords.testDrive
    local lastCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)

    DoScreenFadeOut(500)
    Wait(1000)
    RequestCollisionAtCoord(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)
    SetEntityCoords(previewVehicle, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false, false)
    TaskWarpPedIntoVehicle(cache.ped, previewVehicle, -1)
    SetEntityHeading(previewVehicle, coords.w)
    SetEntityCollision(previewVehicle, true, true)
    FreezeEntityPosition(previewVehicle, false)
    Wait(1000)
    DoScreenFadeIn(500)

    LocalPlayer.state.inTestDrive = true
    handleTimer(shop_data.testdriveTime * 60, lastCoords)
end

local cv
local am = {}
local dt = false

for category, vehicleList in pairs(vehicles) do
    if not am[category] then
        am[category] = {}
    end
    for i=1, #vehicleList do
        local vehicle = vehicleList[i]
        am[category][joaat(vehicle.model)] = vehicle.price
