local function addBind(name, label, key, onPres, onRelease)
    local data = {
        name = name,
        description = label,
        defaultKey = key,
        onPressed = onPres,
        onReleased = onRelease
    }
    return lib.addKeybind(data)
end

if keybind.cancelEmote ~= '' then
    addBind('cancelemote', 'Cancel Emote', keybind.cancelEmote, Emote.cancel)
end

if keybind.callPtfxEmote ~= '' then
    addBind('callPtfxEmote', 'Ptfx Emote', keybind.callPtfxEmote, function (data)
        if not (PState.isInAnimation and PState.ptfxPrompt) then
            return
        end

        local ptfxData = PState.ptfxPrompt
    
        if data.busy then return end
        if not ptfxData then return end
        
        data.busy = true
        PState:set('emote_ptfx', true, true)
        
        Wait(ptfxData.holdTime)

        if ptfxData.canHold then
            while IsControlPressed(0, 47) and PState.isInAnimation do
                Wait(100)
            end
        end

        data.busy = false
        PState:set('emote_ptfx', nil, true)
    end)
end

if keybind.pointing ~= '' then
    local pointing = addBind('pointing', 'Pointing', keybind.pointing, pointing.enable)
    lib.onCache('weapon', function(v) pointing:disable(v and true or false) end)
end

if keybind.handsup ~= '' then
    addBind('handsup', 'Hands up', keybind.handsup, handsup.onPress, handsup.onRelease)
end

if crouch.enable and crouch.key ~= '' then
    addBind('crouch', locale('register_crouch'), crouch.key, stance.crouch)
end

if crawl.enable and crawl.key ~= '' then
    addBind('crawl', locale('register_crawl'), crawl.key, stance.crawl)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_emotes\client\stateHandler.lua
local cached = {}
PState = LocalPlayer.state

CreateThread(function()
    PState:set('canEmote', true, true)
    PState:set('currentEmote', nil, true)
    PState:set('isInAnimation', nil, false)
end)

local function request(asset)
    local ok, resp = pcall(lib.requestNamedPtfxAsset, asset)
    
    if not ok and resp then
        lib.print.warn(ok, resp)
    end

    return ok and resp
end


AddStateBagChangeHandler('emote_prop', nil, function(bagName, key, value, reserved, replicated)
    local player = GetPlayerFromStateBagName(bagName)

    if player == 0 then return end

    if replicated and player == PlayerId() then return end

    local ped = GetPlayerPed(player)
    local serverId = GetPlayerServerId(player)
    
    if not value then
        Wait(50)
        props.clear(serverId)
        return
    end

    local emote, variant = value.emote, value.variant
    
    if not DoesEntityExist(ped) then
        return
    end
    
    props.clear(serverId)
    
    props.add(ped, serverId, emote, variant)
end)

AddStateBagChangeHandler('emote_ptfx', '', function(bagName, key, value, _unused, replicated)
    local player = GetPlayerFromStateBagName(bagName)
    local serverId = GetPlayerServerId(player)

    if not cached.ptfx then
        cached.ptfx = {}
    end

    if (cached.ptfx[serverId] and value) or (not cached.ptfx[serverId] and not value) then
        return
    end

    local playerPed = GetPlayerPed(player)
    if not DoesEntityExist(playerPed) then return end
    
    local state = Player(serverId).state

    if state.ptfxData then
        if value then
            local asset, name, bone, color, offset, rotation, scale, prop in state.ptfxData 

            local boneIndex = bone and GetPedBoneIndex(playerPed, bone) or
                                GetEntityBoneIndexByName(name, "VFX")

            local entity = prop and props.get(serverId) or playerPed

            request(asset)
            UseParticleFxAsset(asset)

            cached.ptfx[serverId] = StartNetworkedParticleFxLoopedOnEntityBone(
                name, entity, offset.x, offset.y, offset.z,
                rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z, boneIndex,
                (scale or 1) + 0.0, false, false, false
            )

            if color then
                if color[1] and type(color[1]) == 'table' then
                    local randomIndex = math.random(1, #color)
                    color = color[randomIndex]
                end
                SetParticleFxLoopedAlpha(cached.ptfx[serverId], color.A)
                SetParticleFxLoopedColour(cached.ptfx[serverId], color.R / 255, color.G / 255, color.B / 255, false)
            end
            
            -- lib.print.info("Started PTFX: " .. cached.ptfx[serverId])
        else
            -- lib.print.info("Stopped PTFX: " .. cached.ptfx[serverId])
            StopParticleFxLooped(cached.ptfx[serverId], false)
            RemoveNamedPtfxAsset(state.ptfxData?.asset)
            cached.ptfx[serverId] = nil
        end
    end
end)

AddStateBagChangeHandler('inSharedEmote', nil, function(bagName, key, value, reserved, replicated)
    if replicated then return end

    local state = LocalPlayer.state
    local inSharedEmote = state.inSharedEmote

    if not inSharedEmote then return end

    local player = GetPlayerFromStateBagName(bagName)

    if player == 0 then return end

    local serverId = GetPlayerServerId(player)
    
    if not value and inSharedEmote == serverId then
        Emote.cancel()
    end
end)

AddStateBagChangeHandler('targetAnim', nil, function(bagName, key, value, reserved, replicated)
    if replicated or not value then return end

    local player = GetPlayerFromStateBagName(bagName)

    if player == 0 then return end

    local playerPed = GetPlayerPed(player)
    local freePosition = type(value) == 'table'
    local sourceId = freePosition and value.source or value

    if type(sourceId) ~= 'number' then return end

    local playerSource = GetPlayerFromServerId(sourceId)

    if not playerSource then
        return
    end

    local sourcePed = GetPlayerPed(playerSource)

    local emote = Player(sourceId).state.currentEmote
    if not emote then return end

    target_dance.sync(playerPed, sourcePed, emote, freePosition)
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= GetCurrentResourceName() then return end

    if PState.isInAnimation then
        PState:set('isInAnimation', false, false)
    end
    if PState.currentEmote then
        PState:set('currentEmote', nil, true)
    end
    if PState.emote_prop then
        PState:set('emote_prop', nil, true)
    end
    if PState.ptfxPrompt then
        PState:set('ptfxPrompt', nil, false)
    end
    if PState.emote_ptfx then
        PState:set('emote_ptfx', nil, true)
    end
    if PState.inSharedEmote then
        PState:set('inSharedEmote', nil, true)
    end

    ClearPedTasks(cache.ped)
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_emotes\data\emotes.lua
local animalEmotes = require 'animations.AnimalEmotes'
local customAnimations = require 'animations.CustomAnimations'
local dances = require 'animations.Dances'
local emotes = require 'animations.Emotes'
local expressions = require 'animations.Expressions'
local propEmotes = require 'animations.PropEmotes'
local scenario = require 'animations.Scenario'
local shared = require 'animations.Shared'
local walks = require 'animations.Walks'
local Exits = require 'animations.Exits'

local enable = require 'config.client'.menuEnable

local emoteMenu = {}
local all_emotes = {}
local emotes_category = {}

local gifPath = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reyyghi/gif/main/%s'

local function getCategoryIcon(emote)
    if emote.secondPlayersAnim then
        return {
            label = 'Shared',
            icon = 'fas fa-people-pulling'
        }
    elseif emote.AnimationOptions and emote.AnimationOptions.Prop then
        return {
            label = 'Props',
            icon = 'fas fa-person-walking-luggage'
        }
    elseif emote.label:lower():match('dance') then
        return {
            label = 'Dances',
            icon = 'fas fa-child-reaching'
        }
    end
    return {
        label = 'Basic',
        icon = 'fas fa-child'
    }
end

local function createCategory(id, icon, data)
    local category = id:lower() ---@type cache_category
    
    local hasDefaultOptions = (
        category == 'walks' or category == 'expressions'
    )

    local allowedPlacement = not hasDefaultOptions and (
        category ~= 'shared' and category ~= 'animalemotes' and category ~= 'scenario'
    )

    if not emotes_category[id:lower()] then
        emotes_category[id:lower()] = {}
    end

    emoteMenu[#emoteMenu+1] = {
        id = id,
        label = Label[id],
        icon = icon,
        defaultOption = hasDefaultOptions,
        options = {}
    }

    local options = {}

    for k, v in pairs(data) do
        
        v.id = id
        v.category = id:lower() ---@type cache_category
        v.command = k:lower()
        v.label = v.label or k
    
        options[#options+1] = {
            id = id .. ':' .. k,
            label = v.label,
            command = k:lower(),
            gifPath = gifPath:format(id),
            texture = v.AnimationOptions?.PropTextureVariations,
            placement = allowedPlacement and not v.secondPlayersAnim
        }

        if v.category == 'customanimations' then
            options[#options].categoryIcon = getCategoryIcon(v)
        end

        all_emotes[k:lower()] = v
        emotes_category[id:lower()][k] = v
    end

    emoteMenu[#emoteMenu].options = options
end


if enable.animal then
    createCategory('AnimalEmotes', 'fas fa-dog', animalEmotes)
end

if enable.customAnim then
    createCategory('CustomAnimations', 'fas fa-person-rays', customAnimations)
end

if enable.dances then
    createCategory('Dances', 'fas fa-child-reaching', dances)
end

if enable.emotes then
    createCategory('Emotes', 'fas fa-child', emotes)
end

if enable.expressions then
    createCategory('Expressions', 'fas fa-face-smile', expressions)
end

if enable.propEmotes then
    createCategory('PropEmotes', 'fas fa-person-walking-luggage', propEmotes)
end

if enable.scenario then
    createCategory('Scenario', 'fas fa-person-cane', scenario)
end

if enable.shared then
    createCategory('Shared', 'fas fa-people-pulling', shared)
end

if enable.walks then
    createCategory('Walks', 'fas fa-person-walking', walks)
end

return {
    ui = emoteMenu,
    shared = all_emotes,
    exits = Exits,
    category = emotes_category
}

local function HandleZoomAndCheckRotation(cam, fov)
    local zoomspeed = 10.0 -- camera zoom speed
    local lPed = PlayerPedId()

    local fov_max = 70.0
    local fov_min = 10.0 -- max zoom level (smaller fov is more zoom)
    local speed_lr = 8.0 -- speed by which the camera pans left-right
    local speed_ud = 8.0 -- speed by which the camera pans up-down

    local zoomvalue = (1.0 / (fov_max - fov_min)) * (fov - fov_min)
    local rightAxisX = GetDisabledControlNormal(0, 220)
    local rightAxisY = GetDisabledControlNormal(0, 221)
    local rotation = GetCamRot(cam, 2)

    if rightAxisX ~= 0.0 or rightAxisY ~= 0.0 then
        local new_z = rotation.z + rightAxisX * -1.0 * (speed_ud) * (zoomvalue + 0.1)
        local new_x = math.max(math.min(20.0, rotation.x + rightAxisY * -1.0 * (speed_lr) * (zoomvalue + 0.1)), -29.5)
        SetCamRot(cam, new_x, 0.0, new_z, 2)
    end

    if not IsPedSittingInAnyVehicle(lPed) then
        if IsControlJustPressed(0, 241) then -- Scrollup
            fov = math.max(fov - zoomspeed, fov_min)
        end
        if IsControlJustPressed(0, 242) then
            fov = math.min(fov + zoomspeed, fov_max) -- ScrollDown
        end
        local current_fov = GetCamFov(cam)
        if math.abs(fov - current_fov) < 0.1 then
            fov = current_fov
        end
        SetCamFov(cam, current_fov + (fov - current_fov) * 0.05)
    else
        if IsControlJustPressed(0, 17) then -- Scrollup
            fov = math.max(fov - zoomspeed, fov_min)
        end
        if IsControlJustPressed(0, 16) then
            fov = math.min(fov + zoomspeed, fov_max) -- ScrollDown
        end
        local current_fov = GetCamFov(cam)
        if math.abs(fov - current_fov) < 0.1 then -- the difference is too small, just set the value directly to avoid unneeded updates to FOV of order 10^-5
            fov = current_fov
        end
        SetCamFov(cam, current_fov + (fov - current_fov) * 0.05) -- Smoothing of camera zoom
    end

    return fov
end

local function IsInActionWithErrorMessage(ignores)
    if ignores == nil then ignores = {} end

    if not ignores.isUsingBinoculars and PState.isUsingBinoculars then
        return true
    end
    if not ignores.isUsingNewscam and PState.isUsingNewscam then
        return true
    end
    if not ignores.isUsingNewsmic and PState.isUsingNewsmic then
        return true
    end
    if not ignores.isUsingNewsbmic and PState.isUsingNewsbmic then
        return true
    end

    return false
end

    if not isUsing then
        if PState.isInAnimation then

        end
        
        CreateThread(function()
    
            ClearPedTasks(PlayerPedId())
            RequestAnimDict("amb@world_human_binoculars@male@idle_a")

            AttachEntityToEntity(

            TaskPlayAnim(PlayerPedId(), "amb@world_human_binoculars@male@idle_a", "idle_c", 5.0, 5.0, -1, 51, 0, false, false, false)
            PlayAmbientSpeech1(PlayerPedId(), "GENERIC_CURSE_MED", "SPEECH_PARAMS_FORCE")
            SetCurrentPedWeapon(PlayerPedId(), `WEAPON_UNARMED`, true)

            RemoveAnimDict("amb@world_human_binoculars@male@idle_a")
            SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded("prop_binoc_01")
        end)

        Wait(200)

        SetTimecycleModifier("default")
        SetTimecycleModifierStrength(0.3)
        scaleform_bin = RequestScaleformMovie("BINOCULARS")
        while not HasScaleformMovieLoaded(scaleform_bin) do

local function UseNewscam()
    if IsPedSittingInAnyVehicle(PlayerPedId()) then
        QBCore.Functions.Notify("Tidak bisa menggunakan newscam di dalam kendaraan!", "error")
        return
    end

    if IsInActionWithErrorMessage({isUsingNewscam = true}) then
        return
    end

    local isUsing = PState.isUsingNewscam or false
    PState:set('isUsingNewscam', not isUsing, false)

    if not isUsing then

        if PState.isInAnimation then
            Emote.cancel()
            lib.print.info('Emote cancelled')
        end

        QBCore.Functions.Notify("Newscam diaktifkan!", "success")

        CreateThread(function()
            
            ClearPedTasks(PlayerPedId())
            RequestAnimDict("missfinale_c2mcs_1")

                Wait(5)
            end

            local boneIndex = GetPedBoneIndex(PlayerPedId(), 28422)

            lib.requestModel('prop_v_cam_01')
            prop_newscam = CreateObject(`prop_v_cam_01`, x, y, z + 0.2, true, true, true)
            AttachEntityToEntity(
                prop_newscam,
                PlayerPedId(),
                boneIndex,
                0.0, 0.03, 0.01,
                0.0, 0.0, 0.0,
                true, true, false, true, 1, true
            )

            TaskPlayAnim(PlayerPedId(), "missfinale_c2mcs_1", "fin_c2_mcs_1_camman", 5.0, 5.0, -1, 51, 0, false, false, false)
            PlayAmbientSpeech1(PlayerPedId(), "GENERIC_CURSE_MED", "SPEECH_PARAMS_FORCE")
            SetCurrentPedWeapon(PlayerPedId(), `WEAPON_UNARMED`, true)

            RemoveAnimDict("missfinale_c2mcs_1")
            SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded("prop_v_cam_01")
        end)

        Wait(200)

        SetTimecycleModifier("default")
        SetTimecycleModifierStrength(0.3)

        local breaking_news = RequestScaleformMovie("breaking_news")
        while not HasScaleformMovieLoaded(breaking_news) do
            Wait(10)
        end

        PushScaleformMovieFunction(breaking_news, "breaking_news")
        PopScaleformMovieFunctionVoid()

        BeginScaleformMovieMethod(breaking_news, 'SET_TEXT')
        PushScaleformMovieMethodParameterString(msg)
        PushScaleformMovieMethodParameterString(bottom)
        EndScaleformMovieMethod()

        BeginScaleformMovieMethod(breaking_news, 'SET_SCROLL_TEXT')
        PushScaleformMovieMethodParameterInt(0)
        PushScaleformMovieMethodParameterInt(0)
        PushScaleformMovieMethodParameterString(title)
        EndScaleformMovieMethod()

        BeginScaleformMovieMethod(breaking_news, 'DISPLAY_SCROLL_TEXT')
        PushScaleformMovieMethodParameterInt(0)
        PushScaleformMovieMethodParameterInt(0)
        EndScaleformMovieMethod()

        scaleform_news = breaking_news

        cam = CreateCam("DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_FLY_CAMERA", true)

        AttachCamToEntity(cam, PlayerPedId(), 0.0, 0.0, 1.2, true)
        SetCamRot(cam, 0.0, 0.0, GetEntityHeading(PlayerPedId()))
        SetCamFov(cam, fov)
        RenderScriptCams(true, false, 0, true, false)

        scaleform_instructions = SetupButtons({
            { key = 177, text = 'exit_news' },
            { key = 19,  text = 'toggle_news_vision' },
            { key = 74,  text = "edit_values_newscam" },

        while PState.isUsingNewscam and not IsEntityDead(PlayerPedId()) and not IsPedSittingInAnyVehicle(PlayerPedId()) do

function SetMsgBottomTitle()
    AddTextEntry("top", "Enter the top message of the news")
    DisplayOnscreenKeyboard(1, "top", "", "", "", "", "", 200)
    while (UpdateOnscreenKeyboard() == 0) do
        DisableAllControlActions(0)
        Wait(0)
    end
    if (GetOnscreenKeyboardResult()) then
        title = tostring(GetOnscreenKeyboardResult())
    end

    AddTextEntry("bottom", "Enter the bottom title of the news")
    DisplayOnscreenKeyboard(1, "bottom", "", "", "", "", "", 200)
    while (UpdateOnscreenKeyboard() == 0) do
        DisableAllControlActions(0)
        Wait(0)
    end
    if (GetOnscreenKeyboardResult()) then
        bottom = tostring(GetOnscreenKeyboardResult())
    end

    AddTextEntry("title", "Enter the title of the news")
    DisplayOnscreenKeyboard(1, "title", "", "", "", "", "", 200)
    while (UpdateOnscreenKeyboard() == 0) do
        DisableAllControlActions(0)
        Wait(0)
    end
    if (GetOnscreenKeyboardResult()) then
        msg = tostring(GetOnscreenKeyboardResult())
    end

    SetScaleformMovieAsNoLongerNeeded(breaking_news)
    breaking_news = RequestScaleformMovie("breaking_news")
    while not HasScaleformMovieLoaded(breaking_news) do
        Wait(10)
    end

    PushScaleformMovieFunction(breaking_news, "breaking_news")
    PopScaleformMovieFunctionVoid()

    BeginScaleformMovieMethod(breaking_news, 'SET_TEXT')
    PushScaleformMovieMethodParameterString(msg)
    PushScaleformMovieMethodParameterString(bottom)
    EndScaleformMovieMethod()

    BeginScaleformMovieMethod(breaking_news, 'SET_SCROLL_TEXT')
    PushScaleformMovieMethodParameterInt(0)
    PushScaleformMovieMethodParameterInt(0)
    PushScaleformMovieMethodParameterString(title)
    EndScaleformMovieMethod()

    BeginScaleformMovieMethod(breaking_news, 'DISPLAY_SCROLL_TEXT')
    PushScaleformMovieMethodParameterInt(0)
    PushScaleformMovieMethodParameterInt(0)
    EndScaleformMovieMethod()
end

-- Models dan animasi - Boom Microphone
local newsbmicModel = "prop_v_bmike_01"
local newsbmicanimDict = "missfra1"
local newsbmicanimName = "mcs2_crew_idle_m_boom"

-- ============================================
-- FUNCTIONS
-- ============================================

-- Toggle News Microphone
local function ToggleNewsmic()
    local holdingNewsmic = PState.isUsingNewsmic or false
    local holdingNewsbmic = PState.isUsingNewsbmic or false

    if not holdingNewsmic then
        if holdingNewsbmic then
            QBCore.Functions.Notify("You are already holding boom microphone!", "error")
            return
        end

        -- Load model
        RequestModel(GetHashKey(newsmicModel))
        while not HasModelLoaded(GetHashKey(newsmicModel)) do
            Wait(100)
        end

        -- Load animation
        RequestAnimDict(newsmicanimDict)
        while not HasAnimDictLoaded(newsmicanimDict) do
            Wait(100)
        end

        -- Create and setup object
        local plyCoords = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(GetPlayerPed(PlayerId()), 0.0, 0.0, -5.0)
        local newsmicspawned = CreateObject(GetHashKey(newsmicModel), plyCoords.x, plyCoords.y, plyCoords.z, true, true, false)
        Wait(1000)

        local netid = ObjToNet(newsmicspawned)
        SetNetworkIdExistsOnAllMachines(netid, true)
        NetworkSetNetworkIdDynamic(netid, true)
        SetNetworkIdCanMigrate(netid, false)

        -- Attach to hand
        AttachEntityToEntity(
            newsmicspawned,
            GetPlayerPed(PlayerId()),
            GetPedBoneIndex(GetPlayerPed(PlayerId()), 4154),
            -0.00, -0.0200, 0.1100,
            0.00, 0.0, 60.0,
            true, true, false, true, 0, true
        )

        -- Play animation
        TaskPlayAnim(GetPlayerPed(PlayerId()), newsmicanimDict, newsmicanimName, 1.0, -1, -1, 50, 0, false, false, false)

        newsmic_net = netid
        PState:set('isUsingNewsmic', true, true)

        lib.showTextUI('News Microphone | Cancel [X]', {
            position = "top-center",
            icon = 'microphone',
        })

        QBCore.Functions.Notify("You are now using news microphone", "success")
    else
        -- Cleanup
        ClearPedSecondaryTask(GetPlayerPed(PlayerId()))
        DetachEntity(NetToObj(newsmic_net), true, true)
        DeleteEntity(NetToObj(newsmic_net))
        newsmic_net = nil
        PState:set('isUsingNewsmic', false, true)
        lib.hideTextUI()
        QBCore.Functions.Notify("News microphone cancelled", "error")
    end
end

-- News Microphone Animation & Controls
CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        local holdingNewsmic = PState.isUsingNewsmic or false
        if holdingNewsmic then
            if not IsEntityPlayingAnim(PlayerPedId(), newsmicanimDict, newsmicanimName, 3) then
                TaskPlayAnim(PlayerPedId(), newsmicanimDict, newsmicanimName, 1.0, -1, -1, 50, 0, false, false, false)
            end

            DisablePlayerFiring(PlayerId(), true)
            DisableControlAction(0, 25, true) -- Aim
            DisableControlAction(0, 44, true) -- Cover
            DisableControlAction(0, 37, true) -- Select weapon
            SetCurrentPedWeapon(PlayerPedId(), GetHashKey("WEAPON_UNARMED"), true)

            if IsControlJustPressed(0, 73) then
                ToggleNewsmic()
            end

            if IsPedInAnyVehicle(PlayerPedId(), false) or QBCore.Functions.GetPlayerData().metadata["ishandcuffed"] then
                ToggleNewsmic()
            end

            Wait(7)
        else
            Wait(100)
        end
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resourceName)
    if GetCurrentResourceName() == resourceName then
        local holdingNewsmic = PState.isUsingNewsmic or false
        local holdingNewsbmic = PState.isUsingNewsbmic or false

        if holdingNewsmic then
            ClearPedSecondaryTask(GetPlayerPed(PlayerId()))
            DetachEntity(NetToObj(newsmic_net), true, true)
            DeleteEntity(NetToObj(newsmic_net))
            lib.hideTextUI()
        end
        if holdingNewsbmic then
            ClearPedSecondaryTask(GetPlayerPed(PlayerId()))
            DetachEntity(NetToObj(newsbmic_net), true, true)
            DeleteEntity(NetToObj(newsbmic_net))
            lib.hideTextUI()
        end
    end
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_emote:invitePlayer', function(sender)

    PlaySoundFrontend(-1, 'NAV', 'HUD_AMMO_SHOP_SOUNDSET', false)

    local desc = [[
Pemain (%s) mengajak anda untuk
bergabung dengan group emote nya.

Tekan **Y** untuk menerima
Tekan **N** untuk menolak

sisa waktu %s detik
]]

    local terima = false
    local maxTime = 5
    local start = GetGameTimer()

    while true do
        Wait(0)

        local timer = GetGameTimer() - start
        local second = math.floor(timer / 1000)

        local remaining = maxTime - second
        if remaining < 0 then remaining = 0 end

        info.show({
            id = 'sm_emote:requestGroup',
            title = 'Group request',
            description = desc:format(sender, remaining)
        })

        if remaining <= 0 then
            break
        end

        -- Y
        if IsControlJustPressed(0, 246) then
            terima = true
            break
        end

        -- N
        if IsControlJustPressed(0, 306) then
            break
        end
    end

    info.remove('sm_emote:requestGroup')

    return terima
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_emote:playGroupEmote', function(_, command, texture)
    -- Server will send net id `65535` for events from the server
    if source ~= 65535 then return end

    if not command then return end
    Emote.playFromMenu(command, texture)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_emote:updateGroup', function(data)
    -- Server will send net id `65535` for events from the server
    if source ~= 65535 then return end

    SendNUIMessage({
        action = 'updateGroups',
        data = { members = data}
    })
end)

local expression = {}

function expression.set(emote, save)
    local emote_data = require 'data.emotes'.shared[emote] ---@type CacheEmote

    if emote_data and emote_data.category == 'expressions' then
        SetFacialIdleAnimOverride(cache.ped, emote_data.anim, 0)

        if not save then return end
        kvp.update('expression', emote_data.anim)
    else
        ClearFacialIdleAnimOverride(cache.ped)
        kvp.delete('expression')
    end
end

AddEventHandler('onResourceStart', function(resource)
    if resource == GetCurrentResourceName() then
        local mood = kvp.getString('expression')
    
        if not mood then return end
        expression.set(mood, false)
    end
end)

_ENV.expression = expression

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_emotes\modules\anim\handsup.lua
local isToggle = require 'config.client'.handsUpIsToggle
local handsupThreadActive = false
local lastHandsupTime = 0
local handsupCooldown = 500
---@type number?
local animationPed

---@return number
local function animPed()
    if animationPed and DoesEntityExist(animationPed) then
        return animationPed
    end

    return cache.ped
end

local function stopHandsup()
    local ped = animPed()

    if PState.handsup then
        TriggerServerEvent('sm_emote:server:setHandsup', false)
    end

    handsupThreadActive = false

    if IsEntityPlayingAnim(ped, 'random@mugging3', 'handsup_standing_base', 3) then
        StopAnimTask(ped, 'random@mugging3', 'handsup_standing_base', 8.0)
    end

    RemoveAnimDict('random@mugging3')
end

local QBCore

local function isPlayerDead()
    if PState.isdead or IsEntityDead(cache.ped) or GetEntityHealth(cache.ped) <= 0 then return true end
    if utils and utils.isDead and utils.isDead() then return true end

    if not QBCore then
        local ok, core = pcall(function() return exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject() end)
        QBCore = ok and core or nil
    end

    if QBCore then
        local pd = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayerData()
        if pd and pd.metadata and (pd.metadata.isdead or pd.metadata.inlaststand) then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function onPress()

    if isPlayerDead() or PState.naikSapi then
        return
    end

    -- Block handsup when player is handcuffed
    local ok, isCuffed = pcall(function() return exports.sm_policejob:IsHandcuffed() end)
    if ok and isCuffed then
        return
    end

    local currentTime = GetGameTimer()
    if currentTime - lastHandsupTime < handsupCooldown then
        return
    end

    if isToggle and PState.handsup then
        stopHandsup()
        lastHandsupTime = currentTime
        return
    end

    if GetVehiclePedIsEntering(cache.ped) ~= 0 then return end

    if cache.vehicle then
        local model = GetEntityModel(cache.vehicle)
        local onBike = IsThisModelABike(model)
        
        if not onBike then
            return
        end
    end

    if handsupThreadActive or PState.handsup then
        stopHandsup()
        Wait(50)
    end

    local onBike = false
    if cache.vehicle then
        local model = GetEntityModel(cache.vehicle)
        onBike = IsThisModelABike(model)
    end

    if not lib.requestAnimDict('random@mugging3') then
        return
    end

    local ped = animPed()

    TaskPlayAnim(ped, 'random@mugging3', 'handsup_standing_base', 2.0, 2.0, -1, 49, 0, false, (onBike and 4127 or false), false)

    TriggerServerEvent('sm_emote:server:setHandsup', true)

    handsupThreadActive = true
    lastHandsupTime = currentTime

    local needsReset = false
    CreateThread(function()
        local timeout = 0
        local maxTimeout = 100

        while not IsEntityPlayingAnim(ped, 'random@mugging3', 'handsup_standing_base', 3) and timeout < maxTimeout do
            Wait(100)
            timeout = timeout + 1
        end

        if timeout >= maxTimeout then
            stopHandsup()
            return
        end

        local confirmed = false
        local waited = 0

        while handsupThreadActive do
            Wait(10)

            if PState.handsup then
                confirmed = true
            elseif confirmed then
                stopHandsup()
                break
            else
                waited = waited + 10

                if waited >= 1000 then
                    stopHandsup()
                    break
                end
            end

            if not IsEntityPlayingAnim(ped, 'random@mugging3', 'handsup_standing_base', 3) and not IsPedRagdoll(ped) and not needsReset then
                stopHandsup()
                break
            end

            if cache.vehicle then
                DisableControlAction(0, 59, true)
            end

            DisableControlAction(0, 25, true)
            DisablePlayerFiring(cache.playerId, true)

            if IsPedRagdoll(ped) then
                needsReset = true
            end

            if (isToggle and not IsEntityPlayingAnim(ped, 'random@mugging3', 'handsup_standing_base', 3)) or (needsReset and not IsPedRagdoll(ped)) then
                TaskPlayAnim(ped, 'random@mugging3', 'handsup_standing_base', 2.0, 2.0, -1, 49, 0, false, onBike and 4127 or false, false)
                needsReset = false
            end
        end

        handsupThreadActive = false
        if isToggle then
            StopAnimTask(ped, 'random@mugging3', 'handsup_standing_base', 8.0)
            RemoveAnimDict('random@mugging3')
        end
    end)
end

local function onRelease()
    if not PState.handsup or isToggle then return end
    stopHandsup()
end

---@param ped? number
local function setAnimationPed(ped)
    if handsupThreadActive or PState.handsup then
        stopHandsup()
    end

    animationPed = ped and DoesEntityExist(ped) and ped or nil
end

exports('SetAnimationPed', setAnimationPed)

_ENV.handsup = {
    onPress = onPress,
    onRelease = onRelease,
    stop = stopHandsup
}

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_emotes\modules\anim\placement.lua
local placement = {}

local placement_info = [[
Gunakan **[Up/Down Arrows]** untuk mengatur ketinggian
Gunakan **[Mouse Scroll]** untuk mengatur rotasi

Tekan **Enter** untuk konfirmasi
Tekan **Right Click** untuk membatalkan
]]

local placement_info_locked = [[
Gunakan **[Mouse Scroll]** untuk mengatur rotasi

Tekan **Enter** untuk konfirmasi
Tekan **Right Click** untuk membatalkan
]]

local placement_finish = [[
Force in %s
Tekan **Right Click** untuk membatalkan
]]

---Finish the emote placement
---@param location vector3
---@param heading number
---@param data table
---@param onPlayed? fun()
function placement.finish(location, heading, data, onPlayed)
    if DoesEntityExist(placement.ped) then DeleteEntity(placement.ped) end

    TaskGoToCoordAnyMeans(cache.ped, location.x, location.y, location.z, 1.0, 0, false, 786603, 0xbf800000)

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local startTime = GetGameTimer()
    local timeout = 10000
    local lastUpdate = 0

    info.show({
        id = 'sm_emote:placement',
        title = 'Placement Info',
        description = placement_finish:format('10s')
    })

    while #(coords - location) > 1.5 do
        Wait(0)

        coords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
        local elapsedTime = GetGameTimer() - startTime
        local remainingTime = math.ceil((timeout - elapsedTime) / 1000)

        if remainingTime ~= lastUpdate then
            lastUpdate = remainingTime
            info.show({
                id = 'sm_emote:placement',
                title = 'Placement Info',
                description = placement_finish:format(remainingTime .. 's')
            })
        end

        if elapsedTime >= timeout then
            ClearPedTasks(cache.ped)
            break
        end

        if IsControlJustPressed(0, 177) then
            lib.hideTextUI()
            ClearPedTasks(cache.ped)

            location = vec3(0)
            break
        end
    end

    info.remove('sm_emote:placement')

    if location ~= vec3(0) then
        SetEntityCoords(cache.ped, location.x, location.y, location.z, false, false, false, false)
        SetEntityHeading(cache.ped, heading)

        data.Advanced = {
            coords = location,
            heading = heading,
        }

        Emote.play(data)

        if onPlayed then
            onPlayed()
        end
    end
end

---@param emote string
---@param onPlayed? fun()
---@param lockHeight? boolean
function placement.start(emote, onPlayed, lockHeight)
    if placement.ped and DoesEntityExist(placement.ped) then return end

    placement.ped = ClonePed(cache.ped, false, false, true)

    local emote_data = utils.getEmote(emote)

    if not emote_data then
        DeleteEntity(placement.ped)

        return lib.notify({
            description = 'Emote tidak valid', type = 'error'
        })
    end

    FreezeEntityPosition(placement.ped, true)
    SetEntityAlpha(placement.ped, 0, false)

    local duration, movementFlag = nil, 0

    local dict, anim, AnimationOptions in emote_data
    local isValid = lib.requestAnimDict(dict)

    if not isValid then
        lib.notify({ description = 'Emote tidak valid', type = 'error' })
        DeleteEntity(placement.ped)
        return
    end

    local placementProps = {}

    if AnimationOptions then

        local Prop, EmoteDuration, Flag, onFootFlag, StartDelay in AnimationOptions

        if StartDelay then Wait(StartDelay) end

        if Flag or onFootFlag then
            movementFlag = Flag or onFootFlag or 0
        end

        if Prop then
            props.addLocal(placement.ped, emote)
        end

        duration = EmoteDuration
    end

    TaskPlayAnim(placement.ped, dict, anim, 2.0, 2.0, duration or -1, movementFlag, 0, false, false, false)
    RemoveAnimDict(dict)

    SetEntityCollision(placement.ped, false, false)
    SetEntityAlpha(placement.ped, 200, false)
    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(placement.ped, true)

    local currentCoords = nil
    local heading = GetEntityHeading(cache.ped) + 90.0
    
    info.show({
        id = 'sm_emote:placement',
        title = 'Placement Info',
        description = lockHeight and placement_info_locked or placement_info
    })

    CreateThread(function()
        local offsetZ = 0.0
        local hit, _, endCoords

        CreateThread(function()
            while DoesEntityExist(placement.ped) do
                hit, _, endCoords = lib.raycast.cam(511, 15)
                Wait(5)
            end
        end)

        while DoesEntityExist(placement.ped) do
            Wait(0)

            DisableControlAction(0, 22, true)

            if hit then
                currentCoords = endCoords

                SetEntityCoords(placement.ped, currentCoords.x, currentCoords.y, currentCoords.z + offsetZ, false, false, false, false)
                SetEntityHeading(placement.ped, heading)
            end

            if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, 14) then
                heading += 5

                if heading > 360 then heading = 0.0 end
            elseif IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, 15) then
                heading -= 5

                if heading < 0 then heading = 360.0 end
            elseif lockHeight then
                offsetZ = 0.0
            elseif IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 27) then
                offsetZ += 0.01

                if offsetZ > 1.0 then offsetZ = 1.0 end
            elseif IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 173) then
                offsetZ -= 0.01

                if offsetZ < -1.0 then offsetZ = -1.0 end
            end

            if IsControlJustPressed(0, 201) then
                local coords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)

                if not currentCoords then
                    lib.notify({ description = 'Arahkan ke permukaan dulu', type = 'error' })
                elseif #(coords - currentCoords) < 5.0 then
                    placement.finish(GetEntityCoords(placement.ped), GetEntityHeading(placement.ped), lib.table.deepclone(emote_data), onPlayed)
                else
                    lib.notify({ description = 'Terlalu jauh', type = 'error' })
                end
            elseif IsControlJustPressed(0, 177) then
                if DoesEntityExist(placement.ped) then DeleteEntity(placement.ped) end

                info.remove('sm_emote:placement')
            end
        end

        for i = 1, #placementProps do
            local entity = placementProps[i].entity
    
            if DoesEntityExist(entity) then
                DeleteEntity(entity)
            end
        end
    end)
end

_ENV.placement = placement

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_emotes\modules\anim\pointing.lua
local animDict = 'anim@mp_point'
local SetTaskMoveNetworkSignalFloat =SetTaskMoveNetworkSignalFloat
local GetGameplayCamRelativePitch = GetGameplayCamRelativePitch
local GetGameplayCamRelativeHeading = GetGameplayCamRelativeHeading

local pointactive = false

local function disabled ()
    local ped = cache.ped
    RequestTaskMoveNetworkStateTransition(ped, 'Stop')
    ClearPedSecondaryTask(ped)
    RemoveAnimDict(animDict)
    pointactive = false
end

local function PointingLoop(ped)
    while pointactive do
        if PState.isdead or cache.weapon or cache.vehicle then return disabled() end
        SetTaskMoveNetworkSignalFloat(ped, 'Pitch', (GetGameplayCamRelativePitch() + 70) / 110)
        SetTaskMoveNetworkSignalFloat(ped, 'Heading', (GetGameplayCamRelativeHeading() + 180) / 360 * -1.0 + 1.0)
        Wait(15)
    end
end

local keybind = lib.addKeybind({
    name = 'pointing',
    description = 'Menunjuk',
    defaultKey = 'B',
    onPressed = function(self)
        local ped = cache.ped
        lib.requestAnimDict(animDict)

        if not pointactive then
            pointactive = not pointactive
            TaskMoveNetworkByName(ped, 'task_mp_pointing', 0.5, 0, animDict, 24)
            PointingLoop(ped)
        else
            RequestTaskMoveNetworkStateTransition(ped, 'Stop')
            ClearPedSecondaryTask(ped)
            RemoveAnimDict(animDict)
            pointactive = not pointactive
        end
    end,
})

lib.onCache('weapon', function(v) keybind:disable(v and true or false) end)

_ENV.pointing = {
    enable = function ()
        local ped = cache.ped
        lib.requestAnimDict(animDict)

        if not pointactive then
            pointactive = not pointactive
            TaskMoveNetworkByName(ped, 'task_mp_pointing', 0.5, 0, animDict, 24)
            PointingLoop(ped)
        else
            RequestTaskMoveNetworkStateTransition(ped, 'Stop')
            ClearPedSecondaryTask(ped)
            RemoveAnimDict(animDict)
            pointactive = not pointactive
        end
    end
}

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_emotes\modules\anim\preview.lua
local preview = {}

preview.ped = nil
preview.props = {}
preview.id = 0
preview.active = false
preview.isZoom = false

local PREVIEW_SCREEN_X = 0.65
local PREVIEW_SCREEN_Y = 0.60
local PREVIEW_DISTANCE = 6.0

local ZOOM_SCREEN_X = 0.6
local ZOOM_SCREEN_Y = 1.5
local ZOOM_DISTANCE = 2.0

function preview.finish()
    if not preview.active then return end

    for i = 1, #preview.props do
        local entity = preview.props[i]

        if DoesEntityExist(entity) then
            DeleteEntity(entity)
        end
    end

    preview.props = {}

    if preview.ped and DoesEntityExist(preview.ped) then
        DeleteEntity(preview.ped)
    end

    preview.ped = nil
    preview.active = false
    preview.isZoom = false
end

---@return number? ped
function preview.createPreviewPed()
    local ped = ClonePed(cache.ped, false, false, true)

    if not DoesEntityExist(ped) then
        return nil
    end

    SetEntityCollision(ped, false, true)
    SetEntityInvincible(ped, true)
    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(ped, true)

    local buffers = {}
    CreateThread(function()
        while DoesEntityExist(ped) and preview.active do
            Wait(0)

            local screenX = preview.isZoom and ZOOM_SCREEN_X or PREVIEW_SCREEN_X
            local screenY = preview.isZoom and ZOOM_SCREEN_Y or PREVIEW_SCREEN_Y
            local distance = preview.isZoom and ZOOM_DISTANCE or PREVIEW_DISTANCE

            local worldVector, normalVector = GetWorldCoordFromScreenCoord(screenX, screenY)
            local buffer = worldVector + normalVector * distance
            local camRot = GetGameplayCamRot(2)

            buffers[#buffers + 1] = buffer

            if #buffers > 5 then
                table.remove(buffers, 1)
            end

            local previewCoords = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)

            for i = 1, #buffers do
                previewCoords = previewCoords + buffers[i]
            end

            previewCoords = previewCoords / #buffers

            local heading = camRot.z + 180.0

            SetEntityCoords(ped, previewCoords.x, previewCoords.y, previewCoords.z, false, false, false, false)
            SetEntityHeading(ped, heading)
            SetEntityRotation(ped, camRot.x * (-1), 0.0, camRot.z + 170.0, 2, false)
        end
    end)

    return ped
end

---@param ped number
---@param emote_data CacheEmote
---@param texture? number
local function addPreviewProps(ped, emote_data, texture)
    local AnimationOptions = emote_data.AnimationOptions

    if not AnimationOptions or not AnimationOptions.Prop then
        return
    end

    local x, y, z, rx, ry, rz = table.unpack(AnimationOptions.PropPlacement)
    local propHash = AnimationOptions.Prop

    if not IsModelValid(propHash) then
        return
    end

    lib.requestModel(propHash, 15000)

    local previewCoords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local object = CreateObject(propHash, previewCoords.x, previewCoords.y, previewCoords.z, false, false, false)

    if texture then
        SetObjectTextureVariation(object, texture)
    end

    SetEntityCollision(object, false, false)
    AttachEntityToEntity(
        object, ped,
        GetPedBoneIndex(ped, AnimationOptions.PropBone),
        x or 0.0, y or 0.0, z or 0.0,
        rx or 0.0, ry or 0.0, rz or 0.0,
        true, true, false, true, 1, true
    )

    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(propHash)
    preview.props[#preview.props + 1] = object

    if AnimationOptions.SecondProp then
        local sx, sy, sz, srx, sry, srz = table.unpack(AnimationOptions.SecondPropPlacement)
        local secondPropHash = AnimationOptions.SecondProp

        if IsModelValid(secondPropHash) then
            lib.requestModel(secondPropHash, 15000)

            local secondObject = CreateObject(secondPropHash, previewCoords.x, previewCoords.y, previewCoords.z, false, false, false)

            if texture then
                SetObjectTextureVariation(secondObject, texture)
            end

            SetEntityCollision(secondObject, false, false)
            AttachEntityToEntity(
                secondObject,
                ped,
                GetPedBoneIndex(ped, AnimationOptions.SecondPropBone),
                sx or 0.0, sy or 0.0, sz or 0.0,
                srx or 0.0, sry or 0.0, srz or 0.0,
                true, true, false, true, 1, true
            )
            SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(secondPropHash)

            preview.props[#preview.props + 1] = secondObject
        end
    end
end

---@param ped number
---@param emote_data CacheEmote
local function previewWalks(ped, emote_data)
    local clipset = emote_data.anim

    lib.requestAnimSet(clipset)
    SetPedMovementClipset(ped, clipset, 0.2)

    local camRot = GetGameplayCamRot(2)

    TaskGoStraightToCoord(ped,
    targetCoords.x, targetCoords.y + 0.5, targetCoords.z,
        0.5, -1, hading, 0.1
    )
end

---@param ped number
---@param emote_data CacheEmote
local function previewScenario(ped, emote_data)
    local scenario = emote_data.scenario
    local scenarioType = emote_data.scenarioType

    if scenarioType == ScenarioType.OBJECT then
        local pedCoords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
        local behindPed = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(ped, 0.0, -0.5, -0.5)
        TaskStartScenarioAtPosition(ped, scenario, behindPed.x, behindPed.y, behindPed.z, GetEntityHeading(ped), 0, true, false)
    else
        TaskStartScenarioInPlace(ped, scenario, 0, true)
    end
end

---@param command string
---@param texture? number
function preview.show(command, texture)
    if not command then return end

    if preview.active then
        preview.finish()
    end

    local emote_data = utils.getEmote(command)

    if not emote_data then
        return
    end

    local category = emote_data.category


    preview.id = preview.id + 1
    local previewId = preview.id

    preview.active = true
    preview.ped = preview.createPreviewPed()

    if not preview.ped then
        preview.active = false
        return
    end

    preview.props = {}

    if category == 'walks' then
        previewWalks(preview.ped, emote_data)
    elseif category == 'expressions' then
        previewExpressions(preview.ped, emote_data)
    elseif category == 'scenario' or emote_data.scenario then
        previewScenario(preview.ped, emote_data)
    else
        local dict = emote_data.dict
        local anim = emote_data.anim
        local AnimationOptions = emote_data.AnimationOptions

        if not lib.requestAnimDict(dict) then
            preview.finish()
            return
        end

        local duration = -1
        local movementFlag = 0

        if AnimationOptions then
            if AnimationOptions.EmoteDuration then
                duration = AnimationOptions.EmoteDuration
            end

            if AnimationOptions.Flag then
                movementFlag = AnimationOptions.Flag
            elseif AnimationOptions.onFootFlag then
                movementFlag = AnimationOptions.onFootFlag
            end

            if AnimationOptions.Prop then
                addPreviewProps(preview.ped, emote_data, texture)
            end
        end

        TaskPlayAnim(preview.ped, dict, anim, 2.0, 2.0, duration, movementFlag, 0, false, false, false)
        RemoveAnimDict(dict)
    end

    SetTimeout(5000, function()
        if previewId == preview.id and preview.active then
            preview.finish()
        end
    end)
end

_ENV.preview = preview

local isRagdoll = false

local function toggle()
    if PState.isInAnimation then
        return
    end

    if not IsPedOnFoot(cache.ped) then
        return
    end

    isRagdoll = not isRagdoll

    if isRagdoll then
        while isRagdoll do
            SetPedRagdollForceFall(cache.ped)
            ResetPedRagdollTimer(cache.ped)
            SetPedToRagdoll(cache.ped, 1000, 1000, 3, false, false, false)
            ResetPedRagdollTimer(cache.ped)
            Wait(100)
        end
    end
end

_ENV.ragdoll = {
    toggle = toggle
}

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_emotes\modules\anim\stance.lua
local isCrouched = false
local isCrawling = false
local inAction = false
local proneType = 'onfront'
local lastKeyPress = 0
local forceEndProne = false
local wasCrouched = false

local CRAWL_SETTING = require 'config.client'.crawlSetting
local CROUCH_SETTING = require 'config.client'.crouchSetting

local function changeHeadingSmooth(amount, time)
    local times = math.abs(amount)
    local test = amount / times
    local wait = time / times

    for _i = 1, times do
        Wait(wait)
        SetEntityHeading(cache.ped, GetEntityHeading(cache.ped) + test)
    end
end

local function playAnimOnce(animDict, animName, blendInSpeed, blendOutSpeed, duration, startTime)
    lib.playAnim(cache.ped, animDict, animName, blendInSpeed or 2.0, blendOutSpeed or 2.0, duration or -1, 0,
        startTime or 0.0, false, false, false)
    RemoveAnimDict(animDict)
end

local function canPlayerCrouchCrawl()
    return not LocalPlayer.state.rtxNoCrouch
        and IsPedOnFoot(cache.ped)
        and not IsPedJumping(cache.ped)
        and not IsPedFalling(cache.ped)
        and not IsPedInjured(cache.ped)
        and not IsPedInMeleeCombat(cache.ped)
        and not IsPedRagdoll(cache.ped)
end

local function resetCrouch()
    ResetPedStrafeClipset(cache.ped)
    ResetPedWeaponMovementClipset(cache.ped)
    SetPedMaxMoveBlendRatio(cache.ped, 1.0)
    SetPedCanPlayAmbientAnims(cache.ped, true)

    local walkstyle = kvp.getString("walkstyle")

    if walkstyle then
        lib.requestAnimSet(walkstyle, 1500)
        SetPedMovementClipset(cache.ped, walkstyle, 0.5)
        RemoveClipSet(walkstyle)
    else
        ResetPedMovementClipset(cache.ped, 0.5)
    end

    RemoveAnimSet('move_ped_crouched')
end

local function crouchLoop()
    while isCrouched do
        if not canPlayerCrouchCrawl() then
            isCrouched = false
            break
        end

        if CROUCH_SETTING.overideStealthMode and GetPedStealthMovement(cache.ped) ~= 0 then
            SetPedStealthMovement(cache.ped, false, 'DEFAULT_ACTION')
        end

        if utils.isAiming() then
            SetPedMaxMoveBlendRatio(cache.ped, 0.15)
        end

        DisableControlAction(0, 36, true)
        SetPedCanPlayAmbientAnims(cache.ped, false)

        if IsPedUsingActionMode(cache.ped) == 1 then
            SetPedUsingActionMode(cache.ped, false, -1, 'DEFAULT_ACTION')
        end

        DisableFirstPersonCamThisFrame()

        if CROUCH_SETTING.fpsMode == true then
            DisableControlAction(2, 25, true)
        end

        Wait(0)
    end

    TriggerEvent('crouch_crawl:onCrouch', false)

    resetCrouch()
end

local function StartCrouch()
    isCrouched = true

    lib.requestAnimSet('move_ped_crouched')
    if GetPedStealthMovement(cache.ped) ~= 0 then
        SetPedStealthMovement(cache.ped, false, 'DEFAULT_ACTION')
        Wait(100)
    end

    if GetFollowPedCamViewMode() == 4 then
        SetFollowPedCamViewMode(0) -- THIRD_PERSON_NEAR
    end

    SetPedMovementClipset(cache.ped, 'move_ped_crouched', 0.6)
    SetPedStrafeClipset(cache.ped, 'move_ped_crouched_strafing')

    TriggerEvent('crouch_crawl:onCrouch', true)
    CreateThread(crouchLoop)
end

---@return boolean success
local function attemptCrouch()
    if canPlayerCrouchCrawl() and IsPedHuman(cache.ped) then
        StartCrouch()
        return true
    else
        return false
    end
end

---@param padIndex integer
---@param control integer
local function disableControlUntilReleased(padIndex, control)
    CreateThread(function()
        while IsDisabledControlPressed(padIndex, control) do
            DisableControlAction(padIndex, control, true)
            Wait(0)
        end
    end)
end

local function crouchKeyPressed()
    if not PState.canEmote then return end

    if inAction then
        return
    end

    if IsPauseMenuActive() or IsNuiFocused() then
        return
    end

    if isCrouched then
        isCrouched = false

        local crouchKey = GetControlInstructionalButton(0, `+crouch` | 0x80000000, false)
        local lookBehindKey = GetControlInstructionalButton(0, 26, false) -- INPUT_LOOK_BEHIND

        if crouchKey == lookBehindKey then
            disableControlUntilReleased(0, 26) -- INPUT_LOOK_BEHIND
        end

        return
    end

    if not canPlayerCrouchCrawl() or not IsPedHuman(cache.ped) then
        return
    end

    local crouchKey = GetControlInstructionalButton(0, `+crouch` | 0x80000000, false)
    local lookBehindKey = GetControlInstructionalButton(0, 26, false) -- INPUT_LOOK_BEHIND
    local duckKey = GetControlInstructionalButton(0, 36, false) -- INPUT_DUCK

    if crouchKey == lookBehindKey then
        disableControlUntilReleased(0, 26) -- INPUT_LOOK_BEHIND
    end

    if crouchKey == duckKey then
        if CROUCH_SETTING.overideStealthMode then
            DisableControlAction(0, 36, true) -- Disable INPUT_DUCK this frame
        elseif not PState.isProne then
            local timer = GetGameTimer()

            if GetPedStealthMovement(cache.ped) ~= 0 and timer - lastKeyPress < 1000 then
                DisableControlAction(0, 36, true) -- Disable INPUT_DUCK this frame
                lastKeyPress = 0
            else
                lastKeyPress = timer
                return
            end
        end
    end

    StartCrouch()

    if PState.isProne then
        inAction = true
        PState:set('isProne', true, false)
        playAnimOnce('get_up@directional@transition@prone_to_knees@crawl', 'front', nil, nil, 780)
        Wait(780)
        inAction = false
    end
end


-- Crawling --
---@return boolean
local function chouldPlayerDiveToCrawl()
    return IsPedRunning(cache.ped) or IsPedSprinting(cache.ped)
end

---Stops the player from being prone
---@param force boolean If forced then no exit anim is played
local function stopPlayerProne(force)
    forceEndProne = force
    PState:set('isProne', false, false)
end

---@param blendInSpeed number|nil
local function playIdleCrawlAnim(heading, blendInSpeed)
    local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)

    heading = heading or GetEntityHeading(cache.ped)
    TaskPlayAnimAdvanced(cache.ped, 'move_crawl', proneType..'_fwd', playerCoords.x, playerCoords.y, playerCoords.z, 0.0, 0.0, heading, blendInSpeed or 2.0, 2.0, -1, 2, 1.0, false, false)
end

---@param forceEnd boolean
local function playExitCrawlAnims(forceEnd)
    if forceEnd then return end
    inAction = true

    local animDict, animName, waitTime
    if proneType == 'onfront' then
        animDict, animName, waitTime = 'get_up@directional@transition@prone_to_knees@crawl', 'front', 780
    else
        animDict, animName, waitTime = 'get_up@directional@transition@prone_to_seated@crawl', 'back', 950
    end

    playAnimOnce(animDict, animName, nil, nil, waitTime)

    if not isCrouched then
        Wait(waitTime)
        playAnimOnce('get_up@directional@movement@from_'..(proneType == 'onfront' and 'knees' or 'seated')..'@standard', 'getup_l_0', nil, nil, 1300)
    end
end

---@param type string
---@param direction string
local function crawl(type, direction)
    isCrawling = true

    lib.playAnim(cache.ped, 'move_crawl', type..'_'..direction, 8.0, -8.0, -1, 2, 0.0, false, false, false)

    local time = {
        onfront = {
            fwd = 820,
            bwd = 990
        },
        onback = {
            fwd = 1200,
            bwd = 1200
        }
    }

    SetTimeout(time[type][direction], function()
        isCrawling = false
    end)
end

local function crawlFlip()
    inAction = true
    local heading = GetEntityHeading(cache.ped)

    proneType = proneType == 'onfront' and 'onback' or 'onfront'

    if proneType == 'onback' then
        playAnimOnce('get_up@directional_sweep@combat@pistol@front', 'front_to_prone', 2.0)
        changeHeadingSmooth(-18.0, 3600)
    else
        playAnimOnce('move_crawlprone2crawlfront', 'back', 2.0, nil, -1)
        changeHeadingSmooth(12.0, 1700)
    end

    playIdleCrawlAnim(heading + 180.0)
    Wait(400)
    inAction = false
end

local function crawlLoop()
    Wait(400)

    while PState.isProne do

        if not canPlayerCrouchCrawl() or IsEntityInWater(cache.ped) then
            ClearPedTasks(cache.ped)
            stopPlayerProne(true)
            break
        end

        local forward, backwards = IsControlPressed(0, 32), IsControlPressed(0, 33) -- INPUT_MOVE_UP_ONLY, INPUT_MOVE_DOWN_ONLY
        
        if not isCrawling then
            if forward then -- Forward
                crawl(proneType, 'fwd')
            elseif backwards then -- Back
                crawl(proneType, 'bwd')
            end
        end

        -- Moving left/right
        if IsControlPressed(0, 34) then -- INPUT_MOVE_LEFT_ONLY
            if isCrawling then
                local headingDiff = forward and 1.0 or -1.0
                SetEntityHeading(cache.ped, GetEntityHeading(cache.ped) + headingDiff)
            else
                inAction = true
                if proneType == 'onfront' then
                    local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
                    TaskPlayAnimAdvanced(cache.ped, 'move_crawlprone2crawlfront', 'left', playerCoords.x, playerCoords.y, playerCoords.z, 0.0, 0.0, GetEntityHeading(cache.ped), 2.0, 2.0, -1, 2, 0.1, false, false)
                    changeHeadingSmooth(-10.0, 300)
                    Wait(700)
                else
                    playAnimOnce('get_up@directional_sweep@combat@pistol@left', 'left_to_prone')
                    changeHeadingSmooth(25.0, 400)
                    playIdleCrawlAnim(cache.ped)
                    Wait(600)
                end
                inAction = false
            end
        elseif IsControlPressed(0, 35) then -- INPUT_MOVE_RIGHT_ONLY
            if isCrawling then
                local headingDiff = backwards and 1.0 or -1.0
                SetEntityHeading(cache.ped, GetEntityHeading(cache.ped) + headingDiff)
            else
                inAction = true
                if proneType == 'onfront' then
                    local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
                    TaskPlayAnimAdvanced(cache.ped, 'move_crawlprone2crawlfront', 'right', playerCoords.x, playerCoords.y, playerCoords.z, 0.0, 0.0, GetEntityHeading(cache.ped), 2.0, 2.0, -1, 2, 0.1, false, false)
                    changeHeadingSmooth(10.0, 300)
                    Wait(700)
                else
                    playAnimOnce('get_up@directional_sweep@combat@pistol@right', 'right_to_prone')
                    changeHeadingSmooth(-25.0, 400)
                    playIdleCrawlAnim(cache.ped)
                    Wait(600)
                end
                inAction = false
            end
        end

        if not isCrawling then
            if IsControlPressed(0, 22) then -- INPUT_JUMP
                crawlFlip()
            end
        end

        Wait(0)
    end

    TriggerEvent('crouch_crawl:onCrawl', false)

    playExitCrawlAnims(forceEndProne)

    isCrawling = false
    inAction = false
    forceEndProne = false
    proneType = 'onfront'
    SetPedConfigFlag(cache.ped, 48, false)

    RemoveAnimDict('move_crawl')
    RemoveAnimDict('move_crawlprone2crawlfront')
end

local function CrawlKeyPressed()
    if not PState.canEmote then return end

    if inAction then
        return
    end

    if IsPauseMenuActive() or IsNuiFocused() then
        return
    end

    if PState.isProne then
        PState:set('isProne', false, false)
        return
    end

    if PState.isInAnimation then
        Emote.cancel()
    end

    wasCrouched = false

    if isCrouched then
        isCrouched = false
        wasCrouched = true
    end

    if not canPlayerCrouchCrawl() or IsEntityInWater(cache.ped) or not IsPedHuman(cache.ped) then
        return
    end

    inAction = true

    if Pointing then
        Pointing = false
    end

    if PState.handsup then
        return
    end

    if utils.isInActionWithErrorMessage({isProne = true}) then
        return
    end

    PState:set('isProne', true, false)
    SetPedConfigFlag(cache.ped, 48, true)

    if GetPedStealthMovement(cache.ped) ~= 0 then
        SetPedStealthMovement(cache.ped, false, 'DEFAULT_ACTION')
        Wait(100)
    end

    lib.requestAnimDict('move_crawl')
    lib.requestAnimDict('move_crawlprone2crawlfront')

    if chouldPlayerDiveToCrawl() then
        playAnimOnce('explosions', 'react_blown_forwards', nil, 3.0)
        Wait(1100)
    elseif wasCrouched then
        playAnimOnce('amb@world_human_sunbathe@male@front@enter', 'enter', nil, nil, -1, 0.3)
        Wait(1500)
    else
        playAnimOnce('amb@world_human_sunbathe@male@front@enter', 'enter')
        Wait(3000)
    end

    if canPlayerCrouchCrawl() and not IsEntityInWater(cache.ped) then
        playIdleCrawlAnim(nil, 3.0)
    end

    TriggerEvent('crouch_crawl:onCrawl', true)

    inAction = false
    CreateThread(crawlLoop)
end


if CROUCH_SETTING.enable then
    RegisterCommand('crouch', function()
        if not PState.canEmote or PState.isdead then return end

        if isCrouched then
            isCrouched = false
            return
        end

        attemptCrouch()
    end, false)

    TriggerEvent('chat:addSuggestion', '/crouch', locale('crouch'))
end

if CRAWL_SETTING.enable then
    RegisterCommand('crawl', function() CrawlKeyPressed() end, false)
    TriggerEvent('chat:addSuggestion', '/crawl', locale('crawl'))
end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_emotes\modules\anim\target_dance.lua
local target_dance = {}

local emotes = require 'data.emotes'.shared

---@param emoteData CacheEmote
local function allowedSync(emoteData)
    local category = emoteData?.category
    local customDance = emoteData.category == 'customanimations' and not (
        emoteData.secondPlayersAnim
    )

    return category and (
        category == 'dances' or customDance
    )
end

---@param ped number
---@param source number
---@param emote string
---@param keepHeading? boolean
function target_dance.sync(ped, source, emote, keepHeading)
    if not (ped and source and emote) then
        return
    end

    local emoteData = emotes[emote] ---@type CacheEmote

    if not (emoteData and allowedSync(emoteData)) then
        return
    end

    local dict, anim in emoteData

    if IsEntityPlayingAnim(source, dict, anim, 3) then
        local targetTime = GetEntityAnimCurrentTime(source, dict, anim)

        if not keepHeading then
            SetEntityHeading(ped, GetEntityHeading(source))
        end

        SetEntityAnimCurrentTime(ped, dict, anim, targetTime)
    end
end

---@param entity number
---@return number? serverId
---@return string? emote
---@return CacheEmote? emotedata
local function getSyncTarget(entity)
    local playerId = NetworkGetPlayerIndexFromPed(entity)
    local serverId = GetPlayerServerId(playerId)
    local emote = Player(serverId).state.currentEmote

    if not emote then
        lib.notify({
            description = 'Player tidak sedang melakukan emote',
            type = 'error'
        })
        return
    end

    local emotedata = emotes[emote] ---@type CacheEmote

    if not emotedata then
        lib.notify({
            description = 'Emote data tidak ditemukan',
            type = 'error'
        })
        return
    end

    if not allowedSync(emotedata) then
        lib.notify({
            description = 'Emote ini tidak bisa di-sync',
            type = 'error'
        })
        return
    end

    if not IsEntityPlayingAnim(entity, emotedata.dict, emotedata.anim, 3) then
        return
    end

    return serverId, emote, emotedata
end

local function syncSamePosition(data)
    local entity = data.entity
    local serverId, _, emotedata = getSyncTarget(entity)

    if not emotedata then return end

    local dict, anim in emotedata

    Emote.play(emotedata)

    Wait(300)

    if IsEntityPlayingAnim(entity, dict, anim, 3) then
        local heading = GetEntityHeading(entity)
        local targetTime = GetEntityAnimCurrentTime(entity, dict, anim)
        SetEntityAnimCurrentTime(cache.ped, dict, anim, targetTime)
        SetEntityHeading(cache.ped, heading)
        LocalPlayer.state:set('targetAnim', serverId, true)
    else
        Emote.cancel()
    end
end

local function syncFreePosition(data)
    local entity = data.entity
    local serverId, emote, emotedata = getSyncTarget(entity)

    if not emotedata then return end

    local dict, anim in emotedata

    placement.start(emote, function()
        Wait(300)

        if not DoesEntityExist(entity) then return end

        if not IsEntityPlayingAnim(entity, dict, anim, 3) then return end

        if not IsEntityPlayingAnim(cache.ped, dict, anim, 3) then return end

        local targetTime = GetEntityAnimCurrentTime(entity, dict, anim)

        SetEntityAnimCurrentTime(cache.ped, dict, anim, targetTime)
        LocalPlayer.state:set('targetAnim', { source = serverId }, true)
    end, true)
end

CreateThread(function()
    exports.ox_target:addGlobalPlayer({
        {
            label = 'Sync Emote',
            icon = 'fas fa-child-reaching',
            distance = 1.5,
            onSelect = syncSamePosition
        },
        {
            label = 'Sync Emote (Atur Posisi)',
            icon = 'fas fa-arrows-up-down-left-right',
            distance = 3.0,
            onSelect = syncFreePosition
        },
    })
end)

local walkstyle = {}

function walkstyle.set(emote, save)
    local emote_data = require 'data.emotes'.shared[emote] ---@type CacheEmote

    if PState.healing_progress then
        if save then
            lib.notify({ description = 'Tidak bisa mengubah gaya jalan saat Anti Combat', type = 'error' })
        end

        return
    end

    if emote_data and emote_data.category == 'walks' and not PState.canEmote then
        lib.notify({ description = 'Tidak bisa mengubah gaya jalan saat ini', type = 'error' })
        return
    end

    if emote_data and emote_data.category == 'walks' then
        lib.requestAnimSet(emote_data.anim)
        SetPedMovementClipset(cache.ped, emote_data.anim, 0.2)
        PState.walkstyle = emote_data.anim

        if not save then return end
        kvp.update('walkstyle', emote_data.anim)
    else
        PState.walkstyle = nil
        ResetPedMovementClipset(cache.ped, 0.0)
        kvp.delete('walkstyle')
    end
end

function walkstyle.load()
    local walks = kvp.getString('walkstyle')

    if not walks then return end
    walkstyle.set(walks, false)
end

AddEventHandler('onResourceStart', function(resource)
    if resource == GetCurrentResourceName() then
        local walks = kvp.getString('walkstyle')

        if not walks then return end
        walkstyle.set(walks, false)
    end
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_emotes\modules\lib\kvp.lua
local kvp = {
    store = {}
}

function kvp.getString(name)
    local data = kvp.store[name]

    if not data then
        data = GetResourceKvpString(cache.resource .. ':' .. name)
        kvp.store[name] = data
    end

    return data
end

function kvp.getTable(name)
    local data = kvp.store[name]

    if not data then
        data = json.decode(GetResourceKvpString(cache.resource .. ':' .. name)) or {}
        kvp.store[name] = data
    end

    return data
end

function kvp.update(name, data)
    kvp.store[name] = data

    if type(data) == 'string' then
        SetResourceKvp(cache.resource .. ':' .. name, data)
    elseif type(data) == 'table' then
        SetResourceKvp(cache.resource .. ':' .. name, json.encode(data))
    end
end

function kvp.delete(name)
    kvp.store[name] = nil

    DeleteResourceKvp(cache.resource .. ':' .. name)
end

_ENV.kvp = kvp

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_emotes\modules\lib\props.lua
if lib.context == 'server' then return end

local cacheProps = {}
local localProps = {}

local function clearProps(serverId)
    if not serverId then
        for k, v in pairs(cacheProps) do
            if v and type(v) == 'table' then
                for i = 1, #v do
                    local entity = v[i]
                    if DoesEntityExist(entity) then
                        DetachEntity(entity, true, true)
                        Wait(0)
                        pcall(DeleteEntity, entity)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        cacheProps = {}
        return
    end

    local props = cacheProps[serverId]
    
    if not props then
        return
    end

    for i=1, #props do
        local entity = props[i]
        if DoesEntityExist(entity) then
            DetachEntity(entity, true, true)
            Wait(0)
            pcall(DeleteEntity, entity)
        end
    end
    cacheProps[serverId] = nil
end

local function clearLocal()
    if #localProps < 1 then
        return
    end

    for i=1, #localProps do
        local entity = localProps[i]
        if DoesEntityExist(entity) then
            DetachEntity(entity, true, true)
            Wait(0)
            pcall(DeleteEntity, entity)
        end
    end

    localProps = {}
end

local function clearPropsFromPed(ped)
    if not DoesEntityExist(ped) then return end
    
    local deletedEntities = {}
    
    for k, v in pairs(cacheProps) do
        if v and type(v) == 'table' then
            for i = #v, 1, -1 do
                local entity = v[i]
                if DoesEntityExist(entity) and not deletedEntities[entity] then
                    local attachedTo = GetEntityAttachedTo(entity)
                    if attachedTo == ped then
                        DetachEntity(entity, true, true)
                        Wait(0)
                        pcall(DeleteEntity, entity)
                        deletedEntities[entity] = true
                        table.remove(v, i)
                    end
                end
            end
            if #v == 0 then
                cacheProps[k] = nil
            end
        end
    end
    
    for i = #localProps, 1, -1 do
        local entity = localProps[i]
        if DoesEntityExist(entity) and not deletedEntities[entity] then
            local attachedTo = GetEntityAttachedTo(entity)
            if attachedTo == ped then
                DetachEntity(entity, true, true)
                Wait(0)
                pcall(DeleteEntity, entity)
                deletedEntities[entity] = true
                table.remove(localProps, i)
            end
        end
    end
end

---@param data table
---@return integer?
local function addProp(ped, data)
    local prop, bone, offset, rotation, texture, nocoll = data.prop, data.bone, data.offset, data.rotation, data.texture, data.nocoll

    assert(prop, 'No prop passed')
    assert(bone, 'No bone passed')
    assert(nocoll == nil or type(nocoll) == "boolean", 'noCollision must be a boolean')

    if not DoesEntityExist(ped) then
        return nil
    end

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local x, y, z = table.unpack(coords)

    if not IsModelValid(prop) then
        lib.print.warn(prop .. " is not a valid model!")
        return
    end

    local model = lib.requestModel(prop, 15000)

    if not model then
        return
    end

    local props = CreateObject(model, x, y, z + 0.2, false, true, false)
    SetEntityAsMissionEntity(props, true, true)

    if texture ~= nil then
        SetObjectTextureVariation(props, texture)
    end

    if nocoll then
        SetEntityCollision(props, false, false)
    end

    AttachEntityToEntity(
        props,
        ped,
        GetPedBoneIndex(ped, bone),
        offset.x, offset.y, offset.z,
        rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z,
        true, true, false, true, 1, true
    )

    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(prop)

    return props
end

---@param ped number
---@param serverId number
---@param emote string
---@param texture? integer
local function addProps(ped, serverId, emote, texture)
    if not emote or type(emote) ~= 'string' then
        return
    end
    
    local emote_data = utils.getEmote(emote)
    
    if not emote_data then
        return
    end

    local options = emote_data.AnimationOptions
    if not options then return end
    
    if not options.Prop then
        return
    end

    if not options.PropPlacement then
        return
    end
    
    if type(options.PropPlacement) ~= 'table' then
        return
    end
    
    local propLen = 0
    pcall(function()
        propLen = #options.PropPlacement
    end)
    
    if propLen < 5 then
        return
    end

    local x, y, z, rx, ry, rz = table.unpack(options.PropPlacement)

    local waitTime = options and options.EmoteDuration or 0
    if waitTime > 0 then
        Wait(waitTime)
        if not DoesEntityExist(ped) then
            return
        end
    end

    local nt = cacheProps[serverId] or {}

    local added = addProp(ped, {
        prop = options.Prop,
        bone = options.PropBone,
        offset = vec(x or 0.0, y or 0.0, z or 0.0),
        rotation = vec(rx or 0.0, ry or 0.0, rz or 0.0),
        texture = texture,
        nocoll = options.PropNoCollision
    })

    if added then
        nt[#nt+1] = added
        cacheProps[serverId] = nt
    end
    
    if added and options.SecondProp then
        if not DoesEntityExist(ped) then
            clearProps(serverId)
            return
        end
        
        if not options.SecondPropPlacement then
            return added
        end
        
        if type(options.SecondPropPlacement) ~= 'table' then
            return added
        end
        
        local secondPropLen = 0
        pcall(function()
            secondPropLen = #options.SecondPropPlacement
        end)
        
        if secondPropLen < 5 then
            return added
        end

        x, y, z, rx, ry, rz = table.unpack(options.SecondPropPlacement)
        
        local secondAdded = addProp(ped, {
            prop = options.SecondProp,
            bone = options.SecondPropBone,
            offset = vec(x or 0.0, y or 0.0, z or 0.0),
            rotation = vec(rx or 0.0, ry or 0.0, rz or 0.0),
            texture = texture,
            nocoll = options.SecondPropNoCollision
        })
        
        if secondAdded then
            nt[#nt+1] = secondAdded
        end
    end

    if not added then
        clearProps(serverId)
        return
    end

    return added
end


---@param ped number
---@param emote string
---@param texture? integer

    end

    return added
end

local function getProps(serverId)

    end

end

local utils = {}
local busyState = {}

if lib.context == 'client' then
    function utils.isAiming()

            IsPlayerFreeAiming(cache.ped) or IsAimCamActive() or IsAimCamThirdPersonActive()
        )
    end

    function utils.isInActionWithErrorMessage(ignores)
        if ignores == nil then ignores = {} end

        if not ignores.isUsingBinoculars and PState.isUsingBinoculars then
            return true
        end
        if not ignores.isUsingNewscam and PState.isUsingNewscam then
            return true
        end
        if not ignores.isUsingNewsmic and PState.isUsingNewsmic then
            return true
        end
        if not ignores.isUsingNewsbmic and PState.isUsingNewsbmic then
            return true
        end
        if not ignores.isProne and PState.isProne then
            return true
        end

        return false
    end

    function utils.setupButtons(button)
        local scaleform = RequestScaleformMovie("instructional_buttons")
        while not HasScaleformMovieLoaded(scaleform) do
            Wait(10)
        end
        PushScaleformMovieFunction(scaleform, "CLEAR_ALL")
        PopScaleformMovieFunctionVoid()

        PushScaleformMovieFunction(scaleform, "SET_CLEAR_SPACE")
        PushScaleformMovieFunctionParameterInt(200)
        PopScaleformMovieFunctionVoid()

        for i, btn in pairs(button) do
            PushScaleformMovieFunction(scaleform, "SET_DATA_SLOT")
            PushScaleformMovieFunctionParameterInt(i - 1)
            ScaleformMovieMethodAddParamPlayerNameString(GetControlInstructionalButton(0, btn.key, true))
            BeginTextCommandScaleformString("STRING")
            AddTextComponentScaleform(locale(btn.text))
            EndTextCommandScaleformString()
            PopScaleformMovieFunctionVoid()
        end

        PushScaleformMovieFunction(scaleform, "DRAW_INSTRUCTIONAL_BUTTONS")
        PopScaleformMovieFunctionVoid()

        return scaleform
    end

    function utils.hideHUDThisFrame()
        HideHelpTextThisFrame()
        HideHudAndRadarThisFrame()
        HideHudComponentThisFrame(19) -- weapon wheel
        HideHudComponentThisFrame(1)  -- Wanted Stars
        HideHudComponentThisFrame(2)  -- Weapon icon
