local function spawnNpc(index)
    local entry = shopConfig.npc[index]
    local hash = SmPets.loadModel(entry.model)
    if not hash then return end
    local c = entry.coords
    local ped = CreatePed(4, hash, c.x, c.y, c.z - 1.0, c.w, false, true)
    SetEntityInvincible(ped, true)
    FreezeEntityPosition(ped, true)
    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(ped, true)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(hash)
    npcPeds[index] = ped
end

for i = 1, #shopConfig.npc do
    local entry = shopConfig.npc[i]
    local coords = entry.coords.xyz
    if entry.blip then npcBlips[i] = makeBlip(coords, entry.blip, entry.label) end
    lib.points.new({
        coords = coords,
        distance = 60.0,
        onEnter = function() spawnNpc(i) end,
        onExit = function()
            local ped = npcPeds[i]
            if ped and DoesEntityExist(ped) then DeletePed(ped) end
            npcPeds[i] = nil
        end,
    })
end

SmPets.onInteractReady(function()
    for i = 1, #shopConfig.npc do
        exports.rhd_interact:addCoords({
            id = ('sm_pets:npc:%d'):format(i),
            coords = shopConfig.npc[i].coords.xyz + vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.2),
            options = {
                {
                    name = 'sm_pets:npc:open',
                    label = 'Buka Pet Shop',
                    icon = 'fas fa-paw',
                    distance = shopConfig.openDistance,
                    onSelect = function() SmPets.openShop(('npc:%d'):format(i)) end,
                },
            },
        })
    end
end)

---@param shop table
---@return boolean
local function isManager(shop)
    local job = QBPlayerData.job
    return job ~= nil and job.name == shop.job and (job.grade and job.grade.level or 0) >= shop.manageGrade
end

local function clearShopPoints()
    for i = 1, #shopBlips do
        if DoesBlipExist(shopBlips[i]) then RemoveBlip(shopBlips[i]) end
        shopBlips[i] = nil
    end
    local ready = SmPets.interactReady()
    for i = 1, #shopPoints do
        if ready then exports.rhd_interact:removeCoords(shopPoints[i]) end
        shopPoints[i] = nil
    end
end

---@param shops table[]|nil
local function buildShopPoints(shops)
    clearShopPoints()
    if not shops or not SmPets.interactReady() then return end
    for i = 1, #shops do
        local shop = shops[i]
        local counter, manage = shop.points.counter, shop.points.manage
        if counter then
            local coords = vec3(counter.x, counter.y, counter.z)
            if shop.blip and shop.blip.enabled ~= false then
                shopBlips[#shopBlips + 1] = makeBlip(coords, shop.blip, shop.name)
            end
            local id = sformat('sm_pets:shop:%d:counter', shop.id)
            exports.rhd_interact:addCoords({
                id = id,
                coords = coords + vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0),
                options = {
                    {
                        name = 'sm_pets:shop:open',
                        label = ('Belanja di %s'):format(shop.name),
                        icon = 'fas fa-store',
                        distance = shopConfig.openDistance,
                        onSelect = function() SmPets.openShop(('shop:%d'):format(shop.id)) end,
                    },
                },
            })
            shopPoints[#shopPoints + 1] = id
        end
        if manage then
            local id = sformat('sm_pets:shop:%d:manage', shop.id)
            exports.rhd_interact:addCoords({
                id = id,
                coords = vec3(manage.x, manage.y, manage.z + 1.0),
                options = {
                    {
                        name = 'sm_pets:shop:manage',
                        label = 'Manajemen Toko',
                        icon = 'fas fa-clipboard-list',
                        distance = shopConfig.openDistance,
                        canInteract = function() return isManager(shop) end,
                        onSelect = function() SmPets.openManage(shop.id) end,
                    },
                },
            })
            shopPoints[#shopPoints + 1] = id
        end
    end
end

AddStateBagChangeHandler('smPetShops', 'global', function(_, _, value)
    buildShopPoints(value)
    TriggerEvent('sm_pets:client:shopsUpdated', value)
end)

SmPets.onInteractReady(function()
    buildShopPoints(GlobalState.smPetShops)
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resourceName)
    if resourceName ~= cache.resource then return end
    for _, ped in pairs(npcPeds) do
        if DoesEntityExist(ped) then DeletePed(ped) end
    end
    for _, blip in pairs(npcBlips) do
        if DoesBlipExist(blip) then RemoveBlip(blip) end
    end
    clearShopPoints()
end)


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_resource\interface\sm_pets\client\vet.lua
local Config = SmPets.Config
local vet = Config.Vet

local DoesEntityExist = DoesEntityExist
local SetEntityCoords = SetEntityCoords
local SetEntityHeading = SetEntityHeading
local FreezeEntityPosition = FreezeEntityPosition
local DetachEntity = DetachEntity
local ClearPedTasks = ClearPedTasks
local sformat = string.format
local mrad = math.rad
local msin = math.sin
local mcos = math.cos

local tablePoints = {}

---@return boolean
local function isVet()
    local job = QBPlayerData.job
    if not job then return false end
    if vet.jobs[job.name] then return true end
    local level = job.grade and job.grade.level or 0
    local shops = GlobalState.smPetShops
    if not shops then return false end
    for i = 1, #shops do
        local shop = shops[i]
        if shop.job == job.name and level >= shop.vetGrade then return true end
    end
    return false
end

---@param anim table
---@param label string
---@return boolean
local function treatProgress(anim, label)
    return lib.progressBar({
        duration = anim.duration,
        label = label,
        useWhileDead = false,
        canCancel = true,
        disable = { move = true, car = true, combat = true },
        anim = { dict = anim.dict, clip = anim.clip, flag = 1 },
    })
end

---@param point table
---@return vector3 spot
---@return number heading
local function tableSpot(point)
    local heading = point.w or 0.0
    local rad = mrad(heading)
    local forward = vet.tableForward
    return vec3(point.x - msin(rad) * forward, point.y + mcos(rad) * forward, point.z + vet.tableHeight), heading + 90.0
end

---@param shopId integer
---@param index integer
---@param point table
local function placePet(shopId, index, point)
    local pet = SmPets.pet
    if not pet then return SmPets.notify('Kamu tidak sedang membawa pet.', 'error') end
    local result = lib.callback.await('sm_pets:vet:placeOnTable', false, shopId, index)
    if not result or not result.ok then return SmPets.notify(result and result.msg or 'Meja tidak bisa dipakai.', 'error') end

    if pet.cancel then
        local cancel = pet.cancel
        pet.cancel = nil
        cancel(true)
    end
    local ped = pet.ped
    DetachEntity(ped, true, true)
    ClearPedTasks(ped)
    local spot, heading = tableSpot(point)
    SetEntityCoords(ped, spot.x, spot.y, spot.z, false, false, false, false)
    SetEntityHeading(ped, heading)
    FreezeEntityPosition(ped, true)
    if pet.state ~= 'dead' then SmPets.playAnim(ped, pet.anims.sleep, 1) end
    SmPets.setAction(pet.state == 'dead' and 'dead' or 'table', function()
        lib.callback('sm_pets:vet:removeFromTable', false, function() end)
        local p = SmPets.pet
        if p and DoesEntityExist(p.ped) then
            FreezeEntityPosition(p.ped, false)
            SetEntityCoords(p.ped, point.x, point.y, point.z, false, false, false, false)
        end
    end)
end

---@param key string
---@return boolean
local function petOnThisTable(key)
    local pet = SmPets.pet
    return pet ~= nil and pet.tableKey == key
end

local function clearTables()
    local ready = SmPets.interactReady()
    for i = 1, #tablePoints do
        if ready then exports.rhd_interact:removeCoords(tablePoints[i]) end
        tablePoints[i] = nil
    end
end

---@param shops table[]|nil
local function buildTables(shops)
    clearTables()
    if not shops or not SmPets.interactReady() then return end
    for i = 1, #shops do
        local shop = shops[i]
        local tables = shop.points.tables or {}
        for index = 1, #tables do
            local point = tables[index]
            local key = sformat('%d:%d', shop.id, index)
            local id = 'sm_pets:table:' .. key
            local spot = tableSpot(point)
            exports.rhd_interact:addCoords({
                id = id,
                coords = spot,
                options = {
                    {
                        name = 'sm_pets:table:place',
                        label = 'Taruh Pet di Meja',
                        icon = 'fas fa-paw',
                        distance = vet.tableDistance,
                        canInteract = function()
                            local occupied = GlobalState.smPetTables
                            return SmPets.pet ~= nil and not (occupied and occupied[key])
                        end,
                        onSelect = function()
                            placePet(shop.id, index, point)
                            if SmPets.pet then SmPets.pet.tableKey = key end
                        end,
                    },
                    {
                        name = 'sm_pets:table:take',
                        label = 'Ambil Pet dari Meja',
                        icon = 'fas fa-hand',
                        distance = vet.tableDistance,
                        canInteract = function() return petOnThisTable(key) end,
                        onSelect = function()
                            SmPets.pet.tableKey = nil
                            SmPets.cancelAction()
                        end,
                    },
                    {
                        name = 'sm_pets:table:treat',
                        label = 'Rawat Pet',
                        icon = 'fas fa-stethoscope',
                        distance = vet.tableDistance,
                        canInteract = function()
                            local occupied = GlobalState.smPetTables
                            return occupied ~= nil and occupied[key] ~= nil and isVet()
                        end,
                        onSelect = function()
                            if not treatProgress(vet.tableAnim, 'Merawat pet...') then return end
                            local result = lib.callback.await('sm_pets:vet:treat', false, shop.id, index)
                            if result and result.msg then SmPets.notify(result.msg, result.ok and 'success' or 'error') end
                        end,
                    },
                },
            })
            tablePoints[#tablePoints + 1] = id
        end
    end
end

AddEventHandler('sm_pets:client:shopsUpdated', buildTables)

SmPets.onInteractReady(function()
    buildTables(GlobalState.smPetShops)
end)

AddEventHandler('sm_pets:client:removed', function(pet)
    pet.tableKey = nil
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resourceName)
    if resourceName ~= cache.resource then return end
    clearTables()
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_resource\interface\taxi\client.lua
local cfg = localmodule('config.shared')

interface.init(false)

local meterRunning    = false
local isPaused        = false
local fare            = cfg.baseFare
local distance        = 0.0
local lastPos         = nil
local isDriver        = false
local inTaxi          = false
local history         = {}
local meterLoopActive = false
local lastCorrection  = 0
local currentVehicle  = nil
local tripData        = {}
local frameShown      = false
local frameToken      = 0

local function isTaxiModel(vehicle)
    local model = GetEntityModel(vehicle)
    for _, m in ipairs(cfg.taxiModels) do
        if model == GetHashKey(m) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function sendUI(data)
    if not frameShown then return end
    interface.send(data)
end

local function openFrame()
    frameToken += 1
    if frameShown then return end

    frameShown = true
    interface.show()
    sendUI({ action = 'updateHistory', history = history })
end

local function closeFrame()
    if not frameShown then return end

    sendUI({ action = 'ui', status = false })
    frameShown = false
    frameToken += 1
    local token = frameToken

    SetTimeout(400, function()
        if token == frameToken and not frameShown then
            interface.hide()
        end
    end)
end

local function setMeterState(vehicle, state)
    Entity(vehicle).state:set('taxiMeter', state, true)
end

local function addToHistory()
    if fare > cfg.baseFare and distance > 0 then
        if #history >= cfg.maxHistory then table.remove(history, 1) end
        table.insert(history, { fare = fare, distance = distance })
        sendUI({ action = 'updateHistory', history = history })
    end
end

local function runMeterLoop()
    if meterLoopActive then return end
    meterLoopActive = true

    CreateThread(function()
        while meterRunning do
            if not isPaused then
                local veh = GetVehiclePedIsIn(cache.ped, false)
                if veh ~= 0 then
                    local pos = GetEntityCoords(veh)
                    if lastPos then
                        local dist = #(pos - lastPos)
                        distance = distance + dist
                        fare     = fare + (dist * cfg.fareRate)
                        sendUI({ action = 'update', fare = fare, distance = distance })
                    end
                    lastPos = pos

                    if isDriver then
                        local now = GetGameTimer()
                        if now - lastCorrection > 10000 then
                            lastCorrection = now
                            Entity(veh).state:set('taxiMeterData', {
                                fare     = fare,
                                distance = distance
                            }, true)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            Wait(1000)
        end
        meterLoopActive = false
    end)
end

local function applyMeterState(state)
    if not state then
        if meterRunning then addToHistory() end
        meterRunning = false
        isPaused     = false
        fare         = cfg.baseFare
        distance     = 0.0
        lastPos      = nil
        sendUI({ action = 'update', fare = fare, distance = distance })
        sendUI({ action = 'setActive', button = '' })
        return
    end

    if state.cmd == 'start' then
        meterRunning = true
        isPaused     = false
        fare         = cfg.baseFare
        distance     = 0.0
        local veh    = GetVehiclePedIsIn(cache.ped, false)
        lastPos      = veh ~= 0 and GetEntityCoords(veh) or nil
        sendUI({ action = 'update', fare = fare, distance = distance })
        sendUI({ action = 'setActive', button = 'start' })
        runMeterLoop()
    elseif state.cmd == 'pause' then
        isPaused = true
        lastPos  = nil
        sendUI({ action = 'setActive', button = 'pause' })
    elseif state.cmd == 'resume' then
        isPaused = false
        local veh = GetVehiclePedIsIn(cache.ped, false)
        lastPos   = veh ~= 0 and GetEntityCoords(veh) or nil
        sendUI({ action = 'setActive', button = 'start' })
    end
end

local function clearLocalState()
    meterRunning = false
    isPaused     = false
    fare         = cfg.baseFare
    distance     = 0.0
    lastPos      = nil
end

AddStateBagChangeHandler('taxiMeter', nil, function(bagName, _, value)
    if isDriver then return end

    local veh = GetVehiclePedIsIn(cache.ped, false)
    if veh == 0 then return end

    local netId = tonumber(bagName:gsub('entity:', ''), 10)
    if not netId or not NetworkDoesEntityExistWithNetworkId(netId) then return end

    if veh ~= NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netId) then return end

    applyMeterState(value)
end)

AddStateBagChangeHandler('taxiMeterData', nil, function(bagName, _, value)
    if isDriver or not value then return end

    local veh = GetVehiclePedIsIn(cache.ped, false)
    if veh == 0 then return end

    local netId = tonumber(bagName:gsub('entity:', ''), 10)
    if not netId or not NetworkDoesEntityExistWithNetworkId(netId) then return end

    if veh ~= NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netId) then return end

    fare     = value.fare
    distance = value.distance
    sendUI({ action = 'update', fare = fare, distance = distance })
end)

local function startMeter()
    if not inTaxi or not isDriver then
        return lib.notify({ description = 'Kamu harus menjadi pengemudi taksi!', type = 'error' })
    end
    if meterRunning then return end

    applyMeterState({ cmd = 'start' })
    setMeterState(currentVehicle, { cmd = 'start' })
    lib.notify({ description = 'Meteran Taksi Dimulai!', type = 'success' })
end

local function togglePause()
    if not meterRunning then return end

    if isPaused then
        applyMeterState({ cmd = 'resume' })
        if currentVehicle ~= 0 then setMeterState(currentVehicle, { cmd = 'resume' }) end
        lib.notify({ description = 'Meteran Dilanjutkan!', type = 'success' })
    else
        applyMeterState({ cmd = 'pause' })
        if currentVehicle ~= 0 then setMeterState(currentVehicle, { cmd = 'pause' }) end
        lib.notify({ description = 'Meteran Dijeda!', type = 'inform' })
    end
end

local function resetMeter()
    applyMeterState(nil)
    if currentVehicle and currentVehicle ~= 0 and isDriver then
        if DoesEntityExist(currentVehicle) then
            Entity(currentVehicle).state:set('taxiMeter', nil, true)
            Entity(currentVehicle).state:set('taxiMeterData', nil, true)
        end
    end
end

local function restoreMeter(vehicle)
    local data = Entity(vehicle).state.taxiMeterData
    if data then
        fare     = data.fare
        distance = data.distance
        sendUI({ action = 'update', fare = fare, distance = distance })
    end

    local state = Entity(vehicle).state.taxiMeter
    if state then
        meterRunning = true
        isPaused     = state.cmd == 'pause'
        lastPos      = not isPaused and GetEntityCoords(vehicle) or nil
        sendUI({ action = 'setActive', button = isPaused and 'pause' or 'start' })
        runMeterLoop()
    end
end

lib.onCache('vehicle', function(vehicle)
    if vehicle and isTaxiModel(vehicle) then
        currentVehicle = vehicle
        inTaxi   = true
        isDriver = GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, -1) == cache.ped
        openFrame()
        sendUI({ action = 'ui', status = true })
        restoreMeter(vehicle)
    else
        if inTaxi and isDriver and meterRunning and currentVehicle then
            if DoesEntityExist(currentVehicle) then
                isPaused = true
                lastPos  = nil
                meterRunning = false
                setMeterState(currentVehicle, { cmd = 'pause' })
                Entity(currentVehicle).state:set('taxiMeterData', {
                    fare     = fare,
                    distance = distance
                }, true)
            end
        else
            clearLocalState()
        end

        currentVehicle = nil
        inTaxi   = false
        isDriver = false
        closeFrame()
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('qb-taxi:startmeter', startMeter)
AddEventHandler('qb-taxi:pausemeter', togglePause)

AddEventHandler('qb-taxi:resetmeter', function()
    if not inTaxi or not isDriver then return end
    resetMeter()
end)

AddEventHandler('qb-taxi:startTaxiRide', function()
    TriggerEvent('sm_taxi:startRide')
end)

local function getNearbyPlayers(radius)
    local origin = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local result = {}
    for _, player in ipairs(GetActivePlayers()) do
        local target = GetPlayerPed(player)
        if target ~= cache.ped and #(origin - GetEntityCoords(target)) <= radius then
            table.insert(result, {
                label = 'ID: ' .. GetPlayerServerId(player),
                value = tostring(GetPlayerServerId(player))
            })
        end
    end
    return result
end

local function setDestinationBlip(coords)
    if tripData.blip then RemoveBlip(tripData.blip) end
    tripData.blip = AddBlipForCoord(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)
    SetBlipRoute(tripData.blip, true)
    SetBlipSprite(tripData.blip, 1)
    SetBlipColour(tripData.blip, 2)
    SetBlipScale(tripData.blip, 1.0)
    SetBlipRouteColour(tripData.blip, 2)
    BeginTextCommandSetBlipName('STRING')
    AddTextComponentString('Tujuan Taksi')
    EndTextCommandSetBlipName(tripData.blip)
end

AddEventHandler('sm_taxi:startRide', function()
    local veh = GetVehiclePedIsIn(cache.ped, false)

    if veh == 0 or GetPedInVehicleSeat(veh, -1) ~= cache.ped or not isTaxiModel(veh) then
        return lib.notify({ description = 'Kamu harus menjadi pengemudi taksi!', type = 'error' })
    end

    local nearby = getNearbyPlayers(5.0)
    if #nearby == 0 then
        return lib.notify({ description = 'Tidak ada penumpang di sekitar!', type = 'error' })
    end

    local input = lib.inputDialog('Pilih Penumpang', {
        { type = 'select', label = 'ID Penumpang', options = nearby }
    })

    if input and input[1] then
        TriggerTokenEvent('sm_taxi:requestRide', tonumber(input[1]))
        lib.notify({ description = 'Permintaan terkirim!', type = 'inform' })
    end
end)

        id    = 'taxi_offer',

        options = {
            { title = 'Terima', icon = 'check', event = 'sm_taxi:acceptRide', args = driverSrc },
            { title = 'Tolak',  icon = 'xmark' },
        }
    })
    lib.showContext('taxi_offer')
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_taxi:acceptRide', function(driverSrc)
    TriggerServerEvent('sm_taxi:confirmRide', driverSrc)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_taxi:beginRide', function()
    lib.notify({ description = 'Penumpang setuju. Set waypoint ke tujuan!', type = 'inform' })

    CreateThread(function()
        while true do
            Wait(1000)
            local waypoint = GetFirstBlipInfoId(8)
            if DoesBlipExist(waypoint) then
                TriggerTokenEvent('sm_taxi:setDestination', GetBlipCoords(waypoint))
                break
            end
        end
    end)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_taxi:receiveDestination', function(coords)
    local ok, groundZ = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z + 50.0, false)
    tripData.dest = ok and vector3(coords.x, coords.y, groundZ) or vector3(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)

    setDestinationBlip(tripData.dest)
    lib.notify({ description = 'Perjalanan dimulai! Ikuti rute.', type = 'success' })

    CreateThread(function()
        while tripData.dest do
            Wait(1000)
            local pos = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
            if #(pos.xy - tripData.dest.xy) < 25.0 then
                TriggerTokenEvent('sm_taxi:completeRide')
                RemoveBlip(tripData.blip)
                tripData = {}
                break
            end
        end
    end)
end)

local QBCore = exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject()
local Config = require 'interface.taxui.config'

local isUIOpen                 = false
local currentNotificationActive = false
local currentNotificationId     = 0

local function formatNumber(amount)
    if not amount or amount == 0 then return '0' end
    local formatted = tostring(math.floor(amount))
    local k
    while true do  
        formatted, k = string.gsub(formatted, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", '%1,%2')
        if (k==0) then
            break
        end
    end
    return formatted
end

local function ShowTaxNotification(data)
    if not data then return end

    currentNotificationActive = true
    isUIOpen = true
    currentNotificationId = currentNotificationId + 1
    local myNotifId = currentNotificationId

    local icon = 'fa-solid fa-coins'
    local title = data.title or 'Pajak'
    local desc = {}

    if data.type == 'deduction' then
        icon = 'fa-solid fa-coins'
        title = data.title or 'Pajak Kekayaan'
        desc['Keterangan'] = 'Pajak harian berhasil dipotong'
        desc['Jumlah'] = '-$' .. formatNumber(data.amount)
        if data.wealth and data.wealth.total then
            desc['Saldo Sebelumnya'] = '$' .. formatNumber(data.wealth.total)
        end

    elseif data.type == 'insufficient' then
        icon = 'fa-solid fa-circle-exclamation'
        title = data.title or 'Pajak Tertunggak'
        desc['Keterangan'] = data.message or 'Saldo tidak mencukupi'
        if data.amount then
            desc['Jumlah'] = '$' .. formatNumber(data.amount)
        end
        if data.available then
            desc['Saldo Tersedia'] = '$' .. formatNumber(data.available)
        end

    elseif data.type == 'pending' then
        icon = 'fa-solid fa-circle-check'
        title = data.title or 'Pajak Tertunggak Terbayar'
        desc['Keterangan'] = data.message or 'Pajak tertunggak berhasil dibayar!'
        if data.amount then
            desc['Jumlah'] = '-$' .. formatNumber(data.amount)
        end



    elseif data.type == 'login_info' then
        local totalDays     = tonumber(data.totalDays) or 0
        local paidDays      = tonumber(data.paidDays) or 0
        local failedDays    = tonumber(data.failedDays) or 0
        local pendingDays   = tonumber(data.pendingDays) or 0
        local paidAmount    = tonumber(data.paidAmount) or 0
        local totalPaid     = tonumber(data.totalPaid) or 0
        local failedAmount  = tonumber(data.failedAmount) or 0
        local pendingAmount = tonumber(data.pendingAmount) or 0

        title = data.title or 'Informasi Pajak'

        if not data.hasData and totalDays == 0 then
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-circle-info'
            desc['Keterangan'] = 'Pajak dipotong otomatis setiap hari'
            desc['Tarif'] = '0.5% dari total kekayaan'
        elseif totalDays > 0 then
            local multi = totalDays > 1
            if paidDays > 0 and failedDays == 0 and pendingDays == 0 then
                icon = 'fa-solid fa-circle-check'
                desc['Status'] = multi and ('Pajak %d hari berhasil dipotong!'):format(totalDays) or 'Pajak hari ini berhasil dipotong!'
                desc['Dipotong'] = '$' .. formatNumber(paidAmount)
                desc['Total Terbayar'] = '$' .. formatNumber(totalPaid)
            elseif paidDays > 0 and failedDays > 0 then
                icon = 'fa-solid fa-circle-exclamation'
                desc['Status'] = ('%d hari terbayar, %d hari tertunggak'):format(paidDays, failedDays)
                desc['Dipotong'] = '$' .. formatNumber(paidAmount)
                desc['Kurang'] = '$' .. formatNumber(failedAmount)
            elseif failedDays > 0 then
                icon = 'fa-solid fa-circle-xmark'
                desc['Status'] = multi and ('%d hari pajak tertunggak! (Saldo kurang)'):format(failedDays) or 'Pajak hari ini tertunggak! (Saldo kurang)'
                desc['Tertunggak'] = '$' .. formatNumber(failedAmount)
                desc['Tindakan'] = 'Bayar pajak segera'
            elseif pendingDays > 0 then
                icon = 'fa-solid fa-hourglass-half'
                desc['Status'] = multi and ('%d hari pajak masih tertunda'):format(pendingDays) or 'Pajak hari ini masih tertunda'
                desc['Menunggu'] = '$' .. formatNumber(pendingAmount)
                desc['Keterangan'] = 'Akan diproses otomatis'
            end
        else
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-circle-check'
            desc['Status'] = 'Tidak ada pajak baru hari ini'
            if totalPaid > 0 then
                desc['Total Terbayar'] = ('$%s (%d hari)'):format(formatNumber(totalPaid), tonumber(data.taxDays) or 0)
            else
                desc['Keterangan'] = 'Belum ada history pembayaran'
            end
        end
    end

    infoUI.show({
        id = 'tax_notification',
        icon = icon,
        title = title,
        description = desc
    })

    local duration = data.type == 'login_info' and Config.UIDisplayTime or 6000

    CreateThread(function()
        Wait(duration)
        if currentNotificationId == myNotifId then
            infoUI.remove('tax_notification')
            isUIOpen = false
            currentNotificationActive = false
        end
    end)
end

local function GetTaxInfo()
    local attempts = 0
    CreateThread(function()
        while attempts < 10 do
            attempts = attempts + 1
            local ok, err = pcall(function()
                lib.callback('tax-system:server:getTaxInfo', false, function(data)
                    if not data then return end

                    local todayTaxAmount = data.todayTax and tonumber(data.todayTax.tax_amount) or 0
                    local todayStatus    = data.todayTax and data.todayTax.status or nil
                    local totalPaid      = tonumber(data.summary.total_paid) or 0
                    local paidDays       = tonumber(data.summary.paid_days) or 0

                    ShowTaxNotification({
                        type        = 'login_info',
                        title       = 'Informasi Pajak',
                        wealth      = data.wealth,
                        totalPaid   = totalPaid,
                        taxDays     = paidDays,
                        totalDays   = todayStatus and 1 or 0,
                        paidDays    = todayStatus == 'paid' and 1 or 0,
                        failedDays  = todayStatus == 'failed' and 1 or 0,
                        pendingDays = todayStatus == 'pending' and 1 or 0,
                        paidAmount  = todayStatus == 'paid' and todayTaxAmount or 0,
                        failedAmount  = todayStatus == 'failed' and todayTaxAmount or 0,
                        pendingAmount = todayStatus == 'pending' and todayTaxAmount or 0,
                        hasData     = todayStatus ~= nil or paidDays > 0
                    })
                end)
            end)
            if ok then return end
            Wait(1000)
        end
    end)
end

AddEventHandler('rhd_spawn:client:onSpawn', function()
    if Config.ShowUIOnSpawn then
        Wait(3000)
        GetTaxInfo()
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('tax-system:client:notification', function(data)
    ShowTaxNotification(data)
end)

RegisterCommand('cekpajak', function() GetTaxInfo() end, false)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resourceName)
    if GetCurrentResourceName() ~= resourceName then return end
    currentNotificationActive = false
    isUIOpen = false
    infoUI.remove('tax_notification')
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_resource\interface\taxui\shared.lua
VehicleClassification = {}
local Config = require 'interface.taxui.config'

-- Function to check if vehicle is import based on brand
function VehicleClassification.IsImportVehicle(brand)
    if not brand then return false end
    return Config.ImportBrands[brand] == true
end

-- Function to get vehicle value
function VehicleClassification.GetVehicleValue(brand)
    if VehicleClassification.IsImportVehicle(brand) then
        return Config.VehicleValues.import
    end
    return Config.VehicleValues.lokal
end

-- Function to classify all player vehicles
function VehicleClassification.ClassifyVehicles(vehicles)
    local classification = {
        import = {
            count = 0,
            value = 0,
            vehicles = {}
        },
        local_vehicles = {
            count = 0,
            value = 0,
            vehicles = {}
        },
        total = {
            count = 0,
            value = 0
        }
    }
    
    if not vehicles or type(vehicles) ~= 'table' then
        return classification
    end
    
    for _, vehicle in pairs(vehicles) do
        if vehicle and vehicle.vehicle then
            local brand = vehicle.vehicle.brand or 'Unknown'
            local model = vehicle.vehicle.model or vehicle.vehicle
            local isImport = VehicleClassification.IsImportVehicle(brand)
            local value = VehicleClassification.GetVehicleValue(brand)
            
            if isImport then
                classification.import.count = classification.import.count + 1
                classification.import.value = classification.import.value + value
                table.insert(classification.import.vehicles, {
                    model = model,
                    brand = brand,
                    value = value,
                    plate = vehicle.plate
                })
            else
                classification.local_vehicles.count = classification.local_vehicles.count + 1
                classification.local_vehicles.value = classification.local_vehicles.value + value
                table.insert(classification.local_vehicles.vehicles, {
                    model = model,
                    brand = brand,
                    value = value,
                    plate = vehicle.plate
                })
            end
            
            classification.total.count = classification.total.count + 1
            classification.total.value = classification.total.value + value
        end
    end
    
    return classification
end

-- Function to get detailed vehicle breakdown
function VehicleClassification.GetVehicleBreakdown(vehicles)
    local breakdown = {
        import_vehicles = {},
        local_vehicles = {},
        summary = {
            total_import = 0,
            total_local = 0,
            total_value = 0,
            import_count = 0,
            local_count = 0
        }
    }
    
    if not vehicles or type(vehicles) ~= 'table' then
        return breakdown
    end
    
    for _, vehicle in pairs(vehicles) do
        if vehicle and vehicle.vehicle then
            local brand = vehicle.vehicle.brand or 'Unknown'
            local model = vehicle.vehicle.model or vehicle.vehicle
            local isImport = VehicleClassification.IsImportVehicle(brand)
            local value = VehicleClassification.GetVehicleValue(brand)
            
            local vehicleData = {
                model = model,
                brand = brand,
                value = value,
                plate = vehicle.plate or 'N/A',
                garage = vehicle.garage or 'Unknown'
            }
            
            if isImport then
                table.insert(breakdown.import_vehicles, vehicleData)
                breakdown.summary.total_import = breakdown.summary.total_import + value
                breakdown.summary.import_count = breakdown.summary.import_count + 1
            else
                table.insert(breakdown.local_vehicles, vehicleData)
                breakdown.summary.total_local = breakdown.summary.total_local + value
                breakdown.summary.local_count = breakdown.summary.local_count + 1
            end
        end
    end
    
    breakdown.summary.total_value = breakdown.summary.total_import + breakdown.summary.total_local
    
    return breakdown
end

return VehicleClassification

local inputValue
local inVideoInput = false
local playingVideo = false

local function showVideoInput(disabled)
    if playingVideo then
        return lib.notify({
            description = 'A video is already playing. Please stop the current video before playing a new one.',
            type = 'error'
        })
    end

    interface.send({
        action = 'videoInput:open',
        data = disabled or {}
    })

    inVideoInput = true
    interface.focus(inVideoInput, inVideoInput)

    inputValue = promise.new()
    local value = Citizen.Await(inputValue)

    inVideoInput = false
    interface.focus(inVideoInput, inVideoInput)

    return value
end

local function stopVideo()
    interface.send({
        action = 'videoPlayer:stop',
        data = {}
    })
end

local function pauseVideo()
    interface.send({
        action = 'videoPlayer:pause',
        data = {}
    })
end

local function resumeVideo()
    interface.send({
        action = 'videoPlayer:resume',
        data = {}
    })
end

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_video_player:showInput', function ()
    if source == '' then return end

    interface.send({
        action = 'videoInput:open',
        data = {}
    })
    inVideoInput = true
    interface.focus(inVideoInput, inVideoInput)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_video_player:playVideo', function (link, volume)
    if source == '' then return end

    interface.send({
        action = 'videoPlayer:play',
        data = {
            link = link,
            volume = volume
        }
    })

    interface.focus(true, false)
    playingVideo = true
end)

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_video_player:sendAction', function (action)
    if source == '' or type(action) ~= 'string' then return end
    action = action:lower()

    if action == 'play' then
        local value = showVideoInput()
        if value then
            TriggerTokenEvent('rhd_video_player:submitVideo', value)
        end
    elseif action == 'stop' then
        stopVideo()
    elseif action == 'pause' then
        pauseVideo()
    elseif action == 'resume' then
        resumeVideo()
    elseif action == 'setvolume' then
        local value = showVideoInput({ link = true, distance = true })
        if value then
            TriggerTokenEvent('rhd_video_player:setVolume', value)
        end
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_video_player:setVolume', function (volume)
    if source == '' or not playingVideo then return end

    interface.send({
        action = 'videoPlayer:setVolume',
        data = volume
    })
end)

interface.callback('videoPlayer:stopped', function (data, cb)
    playingVideo = false
    interface.focus(false, false)
    cb(true)
end)

interface.callback('videoInput:submit', function (data, cb)
    inVideoInput = false
    interface.focus(inVideoInput, inVideoInput)
    cb(true)

    if inputValue then
        inputValue:resolve(data)
        inputValue = nil
    end
end)

interface.callback('videoInput:close', function (data, cb)
    inVideoInput = false
    interface.focus(inVideoInput, inVideoInput)
    cb(true)

    if inputValue then
        inputValue:resolve(false)
        inputValue = nil
    end
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_resource\modules\blipHandle\client.lua
local blipExist = {}

---@class BlipHandle: OxClass
---@field id string
---@field blip number
---@field data Modules_BlipData
local blip = lib.class('BlipHandle')

local function generateId()
    local id
    repeat
        ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: undefined-field
        id = string.random('...-...-..')
    until not blipExist[id]

    return id
end

---@param data Modules_BlipData
function blip:constructor(data)
    if not (data.coords or data.entity) then
        error('Blip requires either coords or entity')
        return
    end

    self.visible = true
    self.id = data.id or generateId()

    if blipExist[self.id] then
        warn(('Blip with id "%s" already exists, removing old one'):format(self.id))
        blipExist[self.id]:remove()
    end

    if data.coords then
        self.blip = AddBlipForCoord(data.coords.x, data.coords.y, data.coords.z)
    elseif data.entity then
        self.blip = AddBlipForEntity(data.entity)
    end

    if not DoesBlipExist(self.blip) then
        error('Failed to create blip')
        return
    end

    self.data = data
    SetBlipSprite(self.blip, data.sprite or 1)
    SetBlipColour(self.blip, data.color or 0)
    SetBlipScale(self.blip, data.scale or 0.6)
    SetBlipDisplay(self.blip, data.display or 4)

    if data.label then
        BeginTextCommandSetBlipName('STRING')
        AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(data.label)
        EndTextCommandSetBlipName(self.blip)
    end

    if data.shortRange ~= nil then
        SetBlipAsShortRange(self.blip, data.shortRange)
    end

    if data.category then
        SetBlipCategory(self.blip, data.category)
    end

    if data.alpha then
        SetBlipAlpha(self.blip, data.alpha)
    end

    if data.rotation then
        SetBlipRotation(self.blip, data.rotation)
    end

    if data.route then
        SetBlipRoute(self.blip, true)
        SetBlipRouteColour(self.blip, (data.routeColor or data.color or 1))
    end

    blipExist[self.id] = self
end

---@param coords vector3
function blip:setCoords(coords)
    if DoesBlipExist(self.blip) then
        SetBlipCoords(self.blip, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)
        self.data.coords = coords
    end
end

---@param sprite number
function blip:setSprite(sprite)
    if DoesBlipExist(self.blip) then
        SetBlipSprite(self.blip, sprite)
        self.data.sprite = sprite
    end
end

---@param color number
function blip:setColor(color)
    if DoesBlipExist(self.blip) then
        SetBlipColour(self.blip, color)
        self.data.color = color
    end
end

---@param scale number
function blip:setScale(scale)
    if DoesBlipExist(self.blip) then
        SetBlipScale(self.blip, scale)
        self.data.scale = scale
    end
end

---@param label string
function blip:setLabel(label)
    if DoesBlipExist(self.blip) then
        BeginTextCommandSetBlipName('STRING')
        AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(label)
        EndTextCommandSetBlipName(self.blip)
        self.data.label = label
    end
end

---@param alpha number
function blip:setAlpha(alpha)
    if DoesBlipExist(self.blip) then
        SetBlipAlpha(self.blip, alpha)
        self.data.alpha = alpha
    end
end

---@param rotation number
function blip:setRotation(rotation)
    if DoesBlipExist(self.blip) then
        SetBlipRotation(self.blip, rotation)
        self.data.rotation = rotation
    end
end

---@param enabled boolean
---@param color? number Route color
function blip:setRoute(enabled, color)
    if DoesBlipExist(self.blip) then
        SetBlipRoute(self.blip, enabled)
        if enabled and color then
            SetBlipRouteColour(self.blip, color)
            self.data.routeColor = color
        end
        self.data.route = enabled
    end
end

---@param duration? number Flash duration in ms (default: infinite)
function blip:flash(duration)
    if DoesBlipExist(self.blip) then
        SetBlipFlashes(self.blip, true)
        
        if duration then
            SetTimeout(duration, function()
                if DoesBlipExist(self.blip) then
                    SetBlipFlashes(self.blip, false)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end

function blip:stopFlash()
    if DoesBlipExist(self.blip) then
        SetBlipFlashes(self.blip, false)
    end
end

function blip:pulse()
    if DoesBlipExist(self.blip) then
        PulseBlip(self.blip)
    end
end

---@param visible boolean
function blip:setVisible(visible)
    self.visible = visible
    if DoesBlipExist(self.blip) then
        SetBlipHiddenOnLegend(self.blip, not self.visible)
    end
end

---@return boolean
function blip:exists()
    return DoesBlipExist(self.blip)
end

---@return number
function blip:getHandle()
    return self.blip
end

function blip:remove()
    if DoesBlipExist(self.blip) then
        RemoveBlip(self.blip)
    end
    blipExist[self.id] = nil
end

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource == GetCurrentResourceName() then
        for id, blipHandle in pairs(blipExist) do
            blipHandle:remove()
        end
    end
end)

return blip

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_resource\modules\datehandler\server.lua
local date = {}

---@alias DateFormat
---| 'DD-MM-YYYY'  # Format: 21-01-2026
---| 'MM-DD-YYYY'  # Format: 01-21-2026
---| 'YYYY-MM-DD'  # Format: 2026-01-21
---| 'DD/MM/YYYY'  # Format: 21/01/2026
---| 'MM/DD/YYYY'  # Format: 01/21/2026
---| 'YYYY/MM/DD'  # Format: 2026/01/21
---| 'id-ID'       # Format: 21 Januari 2026
---| 'en-US'       # Format: January 21, 2026

local MONTH_NAMES = {
    ['id-ID'] = {
        'Januari', 'Februari', 'Maret', 'April', 'Mei', 'Juni',
        'Juli', 'Agustus', 'September', 'Oktober', 'November', 'Desember'
    },
    ['en-US'] = {
        'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
        'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'
    }
}

local function pad(num)
    return num < 10 and '0' .. num or tostring(num)
end

---Convert timestamp or current time to formatted string
---@param format DateFormat
---@param timestamp? number Unix timestamp (optional, defaults to current time)
---@return string
function date.tostring(format, timestamp)
    if not format then return '' end
    
    local t = timestamp and os.date('*t', timestamp) or os.date('*t')
    local day = pad(t.day)
    local month = pad(t.month)
    local year = tostring(t.year)
    
    if format == 'DD-MM-YYYY' then
        return ('%s-%s-%s'):format(day, month, year)
    elseif format == 'MM-DD-YYYY' then
        return ('%s-%s-%s'):format(month, day, year)
    elseif format == 'YYYY-MM-DD' then
        return ('%s-%s-%s'):format(year, month, day)
    elseif format == 'DD/MM/YYYY' then
        return ('%s/%s/%s'):format(day, month, year)
    elseif format == 'MM/DD/YYYY' then
        return ('%s/%s/%s'):format(month, day, year)
    elseif format == 'YYYY/MM/DD' then
        return ('%s/%s/%s'):format(year, month, day)
    elseif format == 'id-ID' then
        local monthName = MONTH_NAMES['id-ID'][t.month]
        return ('%s %s %s'):format(t.day, monthName, year)
    elseif format == 'en-US' then
        local monthName = MONTH_NAMES['en-US'][t.month]
        return ('%s %s, %s'):format(monthName, t.day, year)
    end
    
    return ''
end

---Check if a date string is valid
---@param dateStr string Date string to validate
---@param format DateFormat Format to validate against
---@return boolean
function date.check(dateStr, format)
    if not dateStr or not format then return false end
    
    local day, month, year
    
    if format == 'DD-MM-YYYY' then
        day, month, year = dateStr:match('^(%d%d)-(%d%d)-(%d%d%d%d)$')
    elseif format == 'MM-DD-YYYY' then
        month, day, year = dateStr:match('^(%d%d)-(%d%d)-(%d%d%d%d)$')
    elseif format == 'YYYY-MM-DD' then
        year, month, day = dateStr:match('^(%d%d%d%d)-(%d%d)-(%d%d)$')
    elseif format == 'DD/MM/YYYY' then
        day, month, year = dateStr:match('^(%d%d)/(%d%d)/(%d%d%d%d)$')
    elseif format == 'MM/DD/YYYY' then
        month, day, year = dateStr:match('^(%d%d)/(%d%d)/(%d%d%d%d)$')
    elseif format == 'YYYY/MM/DD' then
        year, month, day = dateStr:match('^(%d%d%d%d)/(%d%d)/(%d%d)$')
    elseif format == 'id-ID' or format == 'en-US' then
        local monthNames = MONTH_NAMES[format]
        for i, monthName in ipairs(monthNames) do
            if dateStr:find(monthName) then
                month = i
                day, year = dateStr:match('^(%d+)%s+' .. monthName .. '%s+(%d%d%d%d)$')
                break
            end
        end
    else
        return false
    end
    
    if not day or not month or not year then return false end
    
    day = tonumber(day)
    month = tonumber(month)
    year = tonumber(year)
    
    if not day or not month or not year then return false end
    if month < 1 or month > 12 then return false end
    if day < 1 or day > 31 then return false end
    if year < 1900 or year > 2100 then return false end
    
    local daysInMonth = { 31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31 }
    
    if year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 ~= 0 or year % 400 == 0) then
        daysInMonth[2] = 29
    end
    
    return day <= daysInMonth[month]
end

---Parse date string and convert to timestamp
---@param dateStr string Date string to parse
---@param format DateFormat Format of the date string
---@return number? timestamp Unix timestamp or nil if invalid
function date.parse(dateStr, format)
    if not date.check(dateStr, format) then return nil end
    
    local day, month, year
    
    if format == 'DD-MM-YYYY' then
        day, month, year = dateStr:match('^(%d%d)-(%d%d)-(%d%d%d%d)$')
    elseif format == 'MM-DD-YYYY' then
        month, day, year = dateStr:match('^(%d%d)-(%d%d)-(%d%d%d%d)$')
    elseif format == 'YYYY-MM-DD' then
        year, month, day = dateStr:match('^(%d%d%d%d)-(%d%d)-(%d%d)$')
    elseif format == 'DD/MM/YYYY' then
        day, month, year = dateStr:match('^(%d%d)/(%d%d)/(%d%d%d%d)$')
    elseif format == 'MM/DD/YYYY' then
        month, day, year = dateStr:match('^(%d%d)/(%d%d)/(%d%d%d%d)$')
    elseif format == 'YYYY/MM/DD' then
        year, month, day = dateStr:match('^(%d%d%d%d)/(%d%d)/(%d%d)$')
    elseif format == 'id-ID' or format == 'en-US' then
        local monthNames = MONTH_NAMES[format]
        for i, monthName in ipairs(monthNames) do
            if dateStr:find(monthName) then
                month = i
                day, year = dateStr:match('^(%d+)%s+' .. monthName .. '%s+(%d%d%d%d)$')
                break
            end
        end
    end

    return os.time({
        ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: assign-type-mismatch
        year = tonumber(year), month = tonumber(month), day = tonumber(day),
        hour = 0, min = 0, sec = 0
    })
end

---Get difference between two dates in days
---@param date1 string|number First date (string or timestamp)
---@param date2 string|number Second date (string or timestamp)
---@param format DateFormat Format if dates are strings
---@return number days Difference in days
function date.diff(date1, date2, format)
    local ts1 = type(date1) == 'string' and date.parse(date1, format) or date1
    local ts2 = type(date2) == 'string' and date.parse(date2, format) or date2
    
    if not ts1 or not ts2 then return 0 end
    
    return math.floor(math.abs(ts2 - ts1) / 86400)
end

---Add days to a date
---@param timestamp number Unix timestamp
---@param days number Number of days to add (can be negative)
---@return number timestamp New timestamp
function date.add(timestamp, days)
    return timestamp + (days * 86400)
end

---Get current timestamp
---@return number timestamp Unix timestamp
function date.now()
    return os.time()
end

---Convert between date formats
---@param dateStr string Date string to convert
---@param fromFormat DateFormat Source format
---@param toFormat DateFormat Target format
---@return string? convertedDate Converted date string or nil if invalid
function date.convert(dateStr, fromFormat, toFormat)
    local timestamp = date.parse(dateStr, fromFormat)
    if not timestamp then return nil end
    return date.tostring(toFormat, timestamp)
end

return date

local handler = {}

---Gets and returns an entity handle and network id from a state bag name
---([source](https://github.com/overextended/ox_core/blob/main/client/utils.lua)).
---Statebag handlers receive changes for every entity on the server, including
---entities outside this client's scope which will never exist locally. Those
---must return quietly instead of throwing, so the wait is short and guarded.
---@async
---@param bagName string
---@return integer? entity, integer? netId
function handler.getEntityAndNetIdFromBagName(bagName)
    local netId = tonumber(bagName:gsub('entity:', ''), 10)
    if not netId then return end

    if NetworkDoesEntityExistWithNetworkId(netId) then
        return NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netId), netId
    end

    local ok, entity = pcall(lib.waitFor, function()
        if NetworkDoesEntityExistWithNetworkId(netId) then
            return NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netId)
        end
    end, nil, 1500)

    if not ok or not entity or entity == 0 then return end

    return entity, netId
end

---Returns a state bag handler made for entities
---([source](https://github.com/overextended/ox_core/blob/main/client/utils.lua)).
---@param keyFilter string
---@param cb fun(entity: number, netId: number, value: any, bagName: string)
---@return number
function handler.entityStateHandler(keyFilter, cb)
    return AddStateBagChangeHandler(keyFilter, '', function(bagName, _, value)
        local entity, netId = handler.getEntityAndNetIdFromBagName(bagName)
        if not entity or entity == 0 or not netId then return end

        cb(entity, netId, value, bagName)
    end)
end

return handler

---@param tbl table
---@return table
local function protect_table(tbl)
    return setmetatable(tbl, {
        __index = function(_, key)
            error(('Key `%s` is not supported.'):format(tostring(key)), 2)
        end,
        __newindex = function(_, key)
            error(('Key `%s` is not supported.'):format(tostring(key)), 2)
        end
    })
end

---@return boolean
local function is_gamepad_active()
    return not IsInputDisabled(2)
end

---@param keyboard table
---@param gamepad table
---@return table
local function create_gamepad_metatable(keyboard, gamepad)
    return setmetatable({}, {
        __index = function(_, key)
            return (is_gamepad_active() and gamepad or keyboard)[key]
        end
    })
end

local CONFIG = {}

CONFIG.BASE_CONTROL_MAPPING = protect_table({

local STATE = {
    camera = nil,
    is_frozen = false,
    is_active = false,
    position = nil,
    rotation = nil,
    fov = nil,
    matrix = {
        x = nil,
        y = nil,

---@param value number
---@param min_val number
---@param max_val number
---@return number
local function clamp(value, min_val, max_val)
    return math_min(math_max(value, min_val), max_val)
end

---@param rot_x number
---@param rot_y number
---@param rot_z number
---@return number, number, number
local function clamp_camera_rotation(rot_x, rot_y, rot_z)
    return clamp(rot_x, -90.0, 90.0), rot_y % 360, rot_z % 360
end

---@param rot_x number
---@param rot_y number
---@param rot_z number
---@return vector3, vector3, vector3
local function euler_to_matrix(rot_x, rot_y, rot_z)
    local rad_x, rad_y, rad_z = math_rad(rot_x), math_rad(rot_y), math_rad(rot_z)
    local sin_x, sin_y, sin_z = math_sin(rad_x), math_sin(rad_y), math_sin(rad_z)
    local cos_x, cos_y, cos_z = math_cos(rad_x), math_cos(rad_y), math_cos(rad_z)

    return vector3(cos_y * cos_z, cos_y * sin_z, -sin_y),
           vector3(cos_z * sin_x * sin_y - cos_x * sin_z, cos_x * cos_z - sin_x * sin_y * sin_z, cos_y * sin_x),
           vector3(-cos_x * cos_z * sin_y + sin_x * sin_z, -cos_z * sin_x + cos_x * sin_y * sin_z, cos_x * cos_y)
end

---@return vector3
local function get_initial_position()
    return (CONFIG.camera_settings.KEEP_POSITION and STATE.position) or GetGameplayCamCoord()
end

---@return vector3
local function get_initial_rotation()
    if CONFIG.camera_settings.KEEP_ROTATION and STATE.rotation then
        return STATE.rotation
    end
    local rot = GetGameplayCamRot(2)
    return vector3(rot.x, 0.0, rot.z)
end

---@param control integer|table
---@return number
local function get_control_normal(control)
    if type(control) == 'table' then
        return GetDisabledControlNormal(0, control[1]) - GetDisabledControlNormal(0, control[2])
    end
    return GetDisabledControlNormal(0, control)
end

---@return number
local function get_speed_multiplier()
    local fast_normal = get_control_normal(CONFIG.CONTROL_MAPPING.MOVE_FAST)
    local slow_normal = get_control_normal(CONFIG.CONTROL_MAPPING.MOVE_SLOW)
    local settings = CONFIG.CONTROL_SETTINGS

    local base_speed = settings.BASE_MOVE_MULTIPLIER
    local fast_speed = 1 + ((settings.FAST_MOVE_MULTIPLIER - 1) * fast_normal)
    local slow_speed = 1 + ((settings.SLOW_MOVE_MULTIPLIER - 1) * slow_normal)

    return base_speed * fast_speed / slow_speed * GetFrameTime() * 60
end

local function update_camera()
    if not STATE.is_active or IsPauseMenuActive() or STATE.is_frozen then
        return
    end

    local vec_x, vec_y = STATE.matrix.x, STATE.matrix.y
    local vec_z = vector3(0, 0, 1)
    local position, rotation = STATE.position, STATE.rotation
    local controls, settings = CONFIG.CONTROL_MAPPING, CONFIG.CONTROL_SETTINGS

    local speed_multiplier = get_speed_multiplier()
    local look_x = get_control_normal(controls.LOOK_X)
    local look_y = get_control_normal(controls.LOOK_Y)
    local move_x = get_control_normal(controls.MOVE_X)
    local move_y = get_control_normal(controls.MOVE_Y)
    local move_z = get_control_normal(controls.MOVE_Z)

    local new_rotation = vector3(
        rotation?.x + (-look_y * settings.LOOK_SENSITIVITY_X),
        rotation?.y,
        rotation?.z + (-look_x * settings.LOOK_SENSITIVITY_Y)
    )

    local new_position = position
        + (vec_x * move_x * speed_multiplier)
        + (vec_y * -move_y * speed_multiplier)
        + (vec_z * move_z * speed_multiplier)

    freecam.setPosition(new_position.x, new_position.y, new_position.z)
    freecam.setRotation(new_rotation.x, new_rotation.y, new_rotation.z)
end

local camera_thread = false
local function start_camera_loop()
    if camera_thread then return end

    CreateThread(function()
        camera_thread = true

        while STATE.is_active do
            update_camera()
            Wait(0)
        end

        camera_thread = false
    end)
end

end

end

    local interior = GetInteriorAtCoords(position.x, position.y, position.z)

    LoadInterior(interior)
    SetFocusArea(position.x, position.y, position.z, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    LockMinimapPosition(x, y)
    
    if STATE.camera then
        SetCamCoord(STATE.camera, position.x, position.y, position.z)
    end

    STATE.position = position
end

    if STATE.camera then
        SetCamFov(STATE.camera, clamped_fov)
    end
    
    STATE.fov = clamped_fov
end

end

end

end

    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: return-type-mismatch

end

---@param x number
---@param y number
---@param z number
function freecam.setRotation(x, y, z)
    local rot_x, rot_y, rot_z = clamp_camera_rotation(x, y, z)
    local vec_x, vec_y, vec_z = euler_to_matrix(rot_x, rot_y, rot_z)
    local rotation = vector3(rot_x, rot_y, rot_z)

    LockMinimapAngle(math_floor(rot_z))
    
    if STATE.camera then
        SetCamRot(STATE.camera, rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z, 0)
    end

    STATE.rotation = rotation
    STATE.matrix.x = vec_x
    STATE.matrix.y = vec_y
    STATE.matrix.z = vec_z
end

function freecam.toggle()
    STATE.is_active = not freecam.isActive()

    if STATE.is_active then
        local position = get_initial_position()
        local rotation = get_initial_rotation()

        STATE.camera = CreateCam('DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA', true)

        freecam.setFov(CONFIG.camera_settings.FOV)
        freecam.setPosition(position.x, position.y, position.z)
        freecam.setRotation(rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z)
        
        start_camera_loop()
        SetEntityVisible(cache.ped, false, false)
    else
        if STATE.camera then
            DestroyCam(STATE.camera, false)
            STATE.camera = nil
        end
        
        ClearFocus()
        UnlockMinimapPosition()
        UnlockMinimapAngle()
        SetEntityVisible(cache.ped, true, true)
    end

    SetPlayerControl(cache.playerId, not STATE.is_active, 0)
    RenderScriptCams(
        STATE.is_active,
        CONFIG.camera_settings.ENABLE_EASING,
        CONFIG.camera_settings.EASING_DURATION,
        false,
        false
    )
end

        freecam.toggle()
        SetPlayerControl(cache.playerId, true, 0)
        SetEntityVisible(cache.ped, true, true)
    end
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_resource\modules\items\client.lua
local items = {}

function items.has_count(name, count)
    return ox_inventory:GetItemCount(name) >= (count or 1)
end

function items.checkRequired(required)
    local _tr = type(required)
    local missing = {}

    if _tr == 'string' then
        local count = 1
        local haveItems = items.has_count(required, count)

        if not haveItems then
            missing[#missing+1] = ('x%s %s'):format(count, ox_items[required]?.label or required)
        end
    elseif _tr == 'table' then
        if array.isArray(required) then
            array.forEach(required, function (val)
                local count = 1
                local haveItems = items.has_count(val, count)

                if not haveItems then
                    missing[#missing+1] = ('x%s %s'):format(count, ox_items[val]?.label or val)
                end
            end)
        else
            for name, count in pairs(required) do
                local haveItems = items.has_count(name, count)

                if not haveItems then
                    missing[#missing+1] = ('x%s %s'):format(count, ox_items[name]?.label or name)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if #missing > 0 then
        lib.notify({
            description = ('Kamu membutuhkan (%s)'):format(table.concat(missing, ', '))
        })
        return false
    end

    return true
end

return items

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_resource\modules\items\server.lua
local items = {}

function items.has_count(source, name, count)
    return ox_inventory:GetItemCount(source, name) >= (count or 1)
end

function items.add(source, ...)
    local canAdd = ox_inventory:CanCarryItem(source, ...)
    return canAdd and ox_inventory:AddItem(source, ...)
end

function items.remove(source, ...)
    return ox_inventory:RemoveItem(source, ...)
end

function items.checkRequired(source, required)
    local _tr = type(required)

    local missing = {}

    if _tr == 'string' then
        local count = 1
        local haveItems = items.has_count(source, required, count)

        if haveItems then
            missing[#missing+1] = ('x%s %s'):format(count, ox_items[required]?.label or required)
        end
    elseif _tr == 'table' then
        if array.isArray(required) then
            array.forEach(required, function (val)
                local count = 1
                local haveItems = items.has_count(source, val, count)

                if haveItems then
                    missing[#missing+1] = ('x%s %s'):format(count, ox_items[val]?.label or val)
                end
            end)
        else
            for name, count in pairs(required) do
                local inventory_count = ox_inventory:GetItemCount(source, name)

                if inventory_count < count then
                    missing[#missing+1] = ('x%s %s'):format(count, ox_items[name]?.label or name)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if #missing > 0 then
        return lib.notify(source, {
            description = ('Kamu membutuhkan (%s)'):format(table.concat(missing, ', '))
        })
    end

    return true
end

---@class TransactionItemsData
---@field name string
---@field count? number
---@field metadata? any
---@field required? boolean

---@class TransactionItems
---@field add? string|string[]|table<string, number>|TransactionItemsData|TransactionItemsData[]
---@field remove? string|string[]|table<string, number>|TransactionItemsData|TransactionItemsData[]

---@param source number
---@param data TransactionItems
---@param giveBack? boolean
---@param notify? boolean
---@return boolean
function items.transaction(source, data, giveBack, notify)
    local removed = {}
    local added = {}
    local missing = {}
    local canProceed = true

    if data.remove then
        local _tr = type(data.remove)

        if _tr == 'string' then
            local success = items.remove(source, data.remove, 1)

            if success then
                removed[#removed+1] = { name = data.remove, count = 1 }
            else
                canProceed = false
                missing[#missing+1] = ('x%s %s'):format(1, ox_items[data.remove]?.label or data.remove)
            end
        elseif _tr == 'table' then
            if array.isArray(data.remove) then
                array.forEach(data.remove, function(val)
                    local _tv = type(val)

                    if _tv == 'string' then
                        local success = items.remove(source, val, 1)

                        if success then
                            removed[#removed+1] = { name = val, count = 1 }
                        else
                            canProceed = false
                            missing[#missing+1] = ('x%s %s'):format(1, ox_items[val]?.label or val)
                        end
                    elseif _tv == 'table' then
                        local success = items.remove(source, val.name, val.count or 1, val.metadata)

                        if success then
                            removed[#removed+1] = { name = val.name, count = val.count or 1, metadata = val.metadata }
                        else
                            missing[#missing+1] = ('x%s %s'):format(val.count or 1, ox_items[val.name]?.label or val.name)

                            if val.required then
                                if giveBack then
                                    for j = 1, #removed do
                                        items.add(source, removed[j].name, removed[j].count, removed[j].metadata)
                                    end
                                end

                                if notify then
                                    lib.notify(source, {
                                        description = ('Kamu membutuhkan (%s)'):format(table.concat(missing, ', '))
                                    })
                                end

                                return false
                            end
                            canProceed = false
                        end
                    end
                end)
            else
                local isKeyValueFormat = false
                local hasNameField = data.remove.name ~= nil
                
                if not hasNameField then
                    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: param-type-mismatch
                    for k, v in pairs(data.remove) do
                        if type(k) == 'string' and type(v) == 'number' then
                            isKeyValueFormat = true
                            local success = items.remove(source, k, v)

                            if success then
                                removed[#removed+1] = { name = k, count = v }
                            else
                                canProceed = false
                                missing[#missing+1] = ('x%s %s'):format(v, ox_items[k]?.label or k)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                if not isKeyValueFormat then
                    local success = items.remove(source, data.remove.name, data.remove.count or 1, data.remove.metadata)

                    if success then
                        removed[#removed+1] = { name = data.remove.name, count = data.remove.count or 1, metadata = data.remove.metadata }
                    else
                        missing[#missing+1] = ('x%s %s'):format(data.remove.count or 1, ox_items[data.remove.name]?.label or data.remove.name)

                        if data.remove.required then
                            if notify then
                                lib.notify(source, {
                                    description = ('Kamu membutuhkan (%s)'):format(table.concat(missing, ', '))
                                })
                            end

                            return false
                        end
                        canProceed = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if not canProceed then
        if giveBack then
            for j = 1, #removed do
                items.add(source, removed[j].name, removed[j].count, removed[j].metadata)
            end
        end

        if notify and #missing > 0 then
            lib.notify(source, {
                description = ('Kamu membutuhkan (%s)'):format(table.concat(missing, ', '))
            })
        end

        return false
    end

    if data.add then
        local _ta = type(data.add)

        if _ta == 'string' then
            local success = items.add(source, data.add, 1)

            if not success then
                missing[#missing+1] = ('x%s %s'):format(1, ox_items[data.add]?.label or data.add)

                if giveBack then
                    for j = 1, #removed do
                        items.add(source, removed[j].name, removed[j].count, removed[j].metadata)
                    end
                end

                if notify then
                    lib.notify(source, {
                        description = ('Gagal menambahkan (%s)'):format(table.concat(missing, ', '))
                    })
                end

                return false
            end
        elseif _ta == 'table' then
            if array.isArray(data.add) then
                local hasError = false

                array.forEach(data.add, function(val)
                    local _tv = type(val)

                    if _tv == 'string' then
                        local success = items.add(source, val, 1)

                        if not success then
                            missing[#missing+1] = ('x%s %s'):format(1, ox_items[val]?.label or val)
                            hasError = true
                        else
                            added[#added+1] = { name = val, count = 1 }
                        end
                    elseif _tv == 'table' then
                        local success = items.add(source, val.name, val.count or 1, val.metadata)

                        if not success then
                            missing[#missing+1] = ('x%s %s'):format(val.count or 1, ox_items[val.name]?.label or val.name)

                            if val.required then
                                hasError = true
                            end
                        else
                            added[#added+1] = { name = val.name, count = val.count or 1, metadata = val.metadata }
                        end
                    end
                end)

                if hasError then
                    if giveBack then
                        for j = 1, #added do
                            items.remove(source, added[j].name, added[j].count, added[j].metadata)
                        end
                        for j = 1, #removed do
                            items.add(source, removed[j].name, removed[j].count, removed[j].metadata)
                        end
                    end

                    if notify then
                        lib.notify(source, {
                            description = ('Gagal menambahkan (%s)'):format(table.concat(missing, ', '))
                        })
                    end

                    return false
                end
            else
                local isKeyValueFormat = false
                local hasNameField = data.add.name ~= nil
                local hasError = false
                
                if not hasNameField then
                    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: param-type-mismatch
                    for k, v in pairs(data.add) do
                        if type(k) == 'string' and type(v) == 'number' then
                            isKeyValueFormat = true
                            local success = items.add(source, k, v)

                            if not success then
                                missing[#missing+1] = ('x%s %s'):format(v, ox_items[k]?.label or k)
                                hasError = true
                            else
                                added[#added+1] = { name = k, count = v }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                if hasError then
                    if giveBack then
                        for j = 1, #added do
                            items.remove(source, added[j].name, added[j].count, added[j].metadata)
                        end
                        for j = 1, #removed do
                            items.add(source, removed[j].name, removed[j].count, removed[j].metadata)
                        end
                    end

                    if notify then
                        lib.notify(source, {
                            description = ('Gagal menambahkan (%s)'):format(table.concat(missing, ', '))
                        })
                    end

                    return false
                end

                if not isKeyValueFormat then
                    local success = items.add(source, data.add.name, data.add.count or 1, data.add.metadata)

                    if not success then
                        missing[#missing+1] = ('x%s %s'):format(data.add.count or 1, ox_items[data.add.name]?.label or data.add.name)

                        if data.add.required then
                            if giveBack then
                                for j = 1, #removed do
                                    items.add(source, removed[j].name, removed[j].count, removed[j].metadata)
                                end
                            end

                            if notify then
                                lib.notify(source, {
                                    description = ('Gagal menambahkan (%s)'):format(table.concat(missing, ', '))
                                })
                            end

                            return false
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return true
end

return items
