########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_resource\resource\rhd_utils\shared\jobhandler.lua
local handler = {}
handler.cache = {}

---@class PlayerJobGrades
---@field name string
---@field level number

---@class PlayerJob
---@field name string
---@field type? string
---@field onduty boolean
---@field grade PlayerJobGrades
---@field isboss boolean

---@param job PlayerJob
---@param t string|string[]|table<string, number|number[]>
---@param duty? boolean
---@return boolean
local function checkjob(job, t, duty)
    if not job then return false end

    local jn = job.name
    local jt = job.type
    local jd = job.onduty
    local jg = job.grade.level

    if duty and not jd then
        return false
    end

    local tt = type(t)

    if tt == 'string' then
        if t == 'ems' then
            return jn == 'ambulance' or jn == 'banmeskota' or jt == 'ambulance' or jt == 'banmeskota'
        end
        return jn == t or jt == t
    end

    if tt == 'table' then
        if array.isArray(t) then
            if tbl.contains(t, 'ems') then
                if jn == 'ambulance' or jn == 'banmeskota' or jt == 'ambulance' or jt == 'banmeskota' then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return tbl.contains(t, jn) or tbl.contains(t, jt)
        end

        local requirement = t[jn] or t[jt]
        if not requirement and t['ems'] and (jn == 'ambulance' or jn == 'banmeskota') then
            requirement = t['ems']
        end
        if not requirement then return false end

        local rt = type(requirement)

        if rt == 'number' then
            return jg >= requirement
        end

        if rt == 'table' and array.isArray(requirement) then
            return tbl.contains(requirement, jg)
        end

        return false
    end

    return false
end

---@param job string
---@param onduty? boolean
---@return number
local function resolveCount(job, onduty)
    if onduty and handler.getOnDutyCount then
        return handler.getOnDutyCount(job)
    end

    -- getCount('ems') already returns ambulance + banmeskota, so don't add them again.
    local count = handler.getCount(job)
    return type(count) == 'number' and count or 0
end

---@param t string|string[]|table<string, number>
---@param onduty? boolean
local function checkavailable(t, onduty)
    local _t = type(t)
    local missing = {}

    if _t == 'string' then
        local count = resolveCount(t, onduty)
        if count < 1 then
            local label = t == 'ems' and 'EMS' or (qb_jobs[t]?.label or t)
            missing[#missing + 1] = ('%s (0/1)'):format(label)
        end
    end

    if _t == 'table' then
        if lib.array.isArray(t) then
            lib.array.forEach(t, function(val)
                local count = resolveCount(val, onduty)
                if count < 1 then
                    local label = val == 'ems' and 'EMS' or (qb_jobs[val]?.label or val)
                    missing[#missing + 1] = ('%s (0/1)'):format(label)
                end
            end)
        else
            lib.table.forEach(t, function(required, job)
                local count = resolveCount(job, onduty)
                if count < required then
                    local label = job == 'ems' and 'EMS' or (qb_jobs[job]?.label or job)
                    missing[#missing + 1] = ('%s (%s/%s)'):format(label, count, required)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    local available = #missing < 1

    local err = not available and ([[
Pekerjaan yang dibutuhkan tidak tersedia: %s
    ]]):format(table.concat(missing, ', ')) or nil

    return available, err
end

---@param job_table string|string[]|table<string, number>
---@param onduty? boolean count only on-duty players (server-side only)
---@return boolean, string?
function handler.checkavailable(job_table, onduty)
    return checkavailable(job_table, onduty)
end

if lib.context == 'server' then
    handler.source = {}
    handler.state = {}

    local function update(source, job)
        if not handler.source[job.name] then
            handler.state[job.name] = 0
            handler.source[job.name] = {}
        end

        local state = GlobalState
        local total = #handler.source[job.name]
        local already = array.find(handler.source[job.name], function (val)
            return val == source
        end)

        if not already then
            local oldJob = handler.cache[source]?.name
            local oldIndex = handler.source[oldJob] and array.findIndex(handler.source[oldJob], function (val)
                return val == source
            end)

            if oldIndex then
                table.remove(handler.source[oldJob], oldIndex)
                handler.state[oldJob] = #handler.source[oldJob]
            end

            handler.source[job.name][total+1] = source
            handler.state[job.name] = #handler.source[job.name]
            state:set('sm_jobcount', handler.state, true)
        end
        
        handler.cache[source] = job
    end

    local function removeCache(source)
        local oldJob = handler.cache[source]?.name
        local oldIndex = handler.source[oldJob] and array.findIndex(handler.source[oldJob], function (val)
            return val == source
        end)

        if oldIndex then
            table.remove(handler.source[oldJob], oldIndex)
        end

        handler.cache[source] = nil
    end

    local function reload()
        local players = qb_ecore:GetQBPlayers()

        for _, player in pairs(players) do
            local PlayerData = player.PlayerData
            local playerJob = PlayerData.job
            local playerSource = PlayerData.source

            update(playerSource, playerJob)
        end
    end

    ---@param jobname string|string[]
    ---@return number|table<string, number>
    function handler.getCount(jobname)
        local _t = type(jobname)

        if _t == "table" and array.isArray(jobname) then
            local jt = {}
            array.forEach(jobname, function (job)
                jt[job] = #(handler.source[job] or {})
            end)
            return jt
        end

        if _t ~= 'string' then return 0 end
        if jobname == 'ems' then
            local count1 = #(handler.source['ambulance'] or {})
            local count2 = #(handler.source['banmeskota'] or {})
            return count1 + count2
        end
        return #(handler.source[jobname] or {})
    end

    ---@param jobname string
    ---@return number
    function handler.getOnDutyCount(jobname)
        if type(jobname) ~= 'string' then return 0 end

        if jobname == 'ems' then
            return handler.getOnDutyCount('ambulance') + handler.getOnDutyCount('banmeskota')
        end

        local sources = handler.source[jobname] or {}
        local count = 0
        for _, src in ipairs(sources) do
            local job = handler.cache[src]
            if job and job.onduty then
                count = count + 1
            end
        end
        return count
    end

    ---@param source number
    ---@param job_table string|string[]|table<string, number|number[]>
    ---@param onduty? boolean
    ---@return boolean
    function handler.check(source, job_table, onduty)
        local myjob = handler.cache[source]
        return checkjob(myjob, job_table, onduty)
    end

    ---@param event string
    ---@param jobname string|string[]
    ---@param ... any Parameter
    function handler.triggerJobEvent(event, jobname, ...)
        local _t = type(jobname)

        if _t == "table" and array.isArray(jobname) then
            local args = {...}
            array.forEach(jobname, function (job)
                local players = handler.source[job]
                if players then lib.triggerClientEvent(event, players, tbl.unpack(args)) end
            end)
        end

        if _t ~= 'string' then return end

        local players = handler.source[jobname]
        if not players or #players == 0 then return end

        return lib.triggerClientEvent(event, players, ...)
    end

    ---@class OxNotify
    ---@field title? string
    ---@field description string
    ---@field type 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warn'
    ---@field duration? number
    
    ---@param jobname string|string[]
    ---@param notify OxNotify
    function handler.triggerNotify(jobname, notify)
        handler.triggerJobEvent('ox_lib:notify', jobname, notify)
    end

    AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:OnJobUpdate', function (source, job)
        update(source, job)
    end)

    AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:SetDuty', function (source, onDuty)
        local cached = handler.cache[source]
        if cached then
            cached.onduty = onDuty
        end
    end)

    AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:PlayerLoaded', function (self)
        update(self.PlayerData.source, self.PlayerData.job)
    end)

    AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function ()
        local source = source
        removeCache(source)
    end)

    local exportWrapper = require 'export_wrapper'
    exportWrapper('sm_utilized', 'GetByName', handler.getCount)
    exportWrapper('sm_utilized', 'GetOnDutyByName', handler.getOnDutyCount)

    CreateThread(function()
        Wait(1500)
        reload()
    end)
else
    ---@param jobname string|string[]
    ---@return number|table<string, number>
    function handler.getCount(jobname)
        local _t = type(jobname)
        local state = GlobalState.sm_jobcount or {}

        if _t == "table" and array.isArray(jobname) then
            local jt = {}
            array.forEach(jobname, function (job)
                jt[job] = state[job] or 0
            end)
            return jt
        end

        if _t ~= 'string' then return 0 end
        if jobname == 'ems' then
            local count1 = state['ambulance'] or 0
            local count2 = state['banmeskota'] or 0
            return count1 + count2
        end
        return state[jobname] or 0
    end

    ---@param job_table string|string[]|table<string, number|number[]>
    ---@param onduty? boolean
    ---@return boolean
    function handler.check(job_table, onduty)
        local myjob = QBPlayerData.job
        return checkjob(myjob, job_table, onduty)
    end
end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_resource\resource\rhd_utils\shared\math.lua

---Clamp a number between 2 other numbers
---@param val number
---@param lower number
---@param upper number
---@return number
function math.clamp(val, lower, upper)
    if lower > upper then lower, upper = upper, lower end
    return math.max(lower, math.min(upper, val))
end

---Rounds a number to a whole number or to the specified number of decimal places.
---@param value number | string
---@param places? number | string
---@return number
function math.round(value, places)
    ---@type number
    local n = type(value) == 'string' and tonumber(value) or value --[[@as number]]
    if type(n) ~= 'number' then error('Value must be a number') end

    if places then
        ---@type number
        local p = type(places) == 'string' and tonumber(places) or places --[[@as number]]
        if type(p) ~= 'number' then error('Places must be a number') end
        places = p

        if p > 0 then
            local mult = 10 ^ p
            return math.floor(n * mult + 0.5) / mult
        end
    end

    return math.floor(n + 0.5)
end

---Converts input number into grouped digits
---@param number number
---@param separator? string
---@return string
function math.groupdigits(number, separator)
    local left, num, right = string.match(tostring(number), '^([^%d]*%d)(%d*)(.-)$')
    return left .. (num:reverse():gsub('(%d%d%d)', '%1' .. (separator or ',')):reverse()) .. right
end

---Formats a number as a hexadecimal string.
---@param n number | string
---@param upper? boolean
---@return string
function math.tohex(n, upper)
    local formatString = ('0x%s'):format(upper and '%X' or '%x')
    return formatString:format(n)
end

---Takes a hexadecimal string and returns three integers (R, G, B).
---@param input string
---@return integer r
---@return integer g
---@return integer b
function math.hextorgb(input)
    local r, g, b = string.match(input, '([^#]+.)(..)(..)')
    return tonumber(r, 16), tonumber(g, 16), tonumber(b, 16)
end

---Calculates an intermediate value between `start` and `finish` based on the interpolation `factor`.
---@param start number
---@param finish number
---@param factor number The interpolation factor between 0 and 1.
---@return number
function math.interp(start, finish, factor)
    return start + (finish - start) * factor
end

-- â”€â”€â”€ Fungsi Tambahan â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

---Check if a number is NaN (not a number).
---@param n any
---@return boolean
function math.isnan(n)
    return n ~= n
end

---Check if a number is finite (not NaN or infinity).
---@param n number
---@return boolean
function math.isfinite(n)
    return n == n and n ~= math.huge and n ~= -math.huge
end

---Check if a number is infinite.
---@param n number
---@return boolean
function math.isinfinite(n)
    return n == math.huge or n == -math.huge
end

---Check if a number is an integer (no fractional part).
---@param n number
---@return boolean
function math.isinteger(n)
    return n == math.floor(n)
end

---Get the sign of a number: returns 1, -1, or 0.
---@param n number
---@return number
function math.sign(n)
    if n > 0 then return 1
    elseif n < 0 then return -1
    else return 0 end
end

---Truncate a number toward zero (remove decimal part).
---@param n number
---@return number
function math.trunc(n)
    return n >= 0 and math.floor(n) or math.ceil(n)
end

---Get the fractional part of a number.
---@param n number
---@return number
function math.frac(n)
    return n - math.trunc(n)
end

---Wrap a value within a range [min, max).
---Useful for angles, cyclic values, etc.
---@param n number
---@param min number
---@param max number
---@return number
function math.wrap(n, min, max)
    local range = max - min
    if range == 0 then return min end
    return min + ((n - min) % range)
end

---Map a value from one range to another.
---@param value number
---@param inMin number
---@param inMax number
---@param outMin number
---@param outMax number
---@return number
function math.map(value, inMin, inMax, outMin, outMax)
    if inMin == inMax then return outMin end
    return outMin + (value - inMin) * (outMax - outMin) / (inMax - inMin)
end

---Normalize a value to a 0..1 range within [min, max].
---@param value number
---@param min number
---@param max number
---@return number
function math.normalize(value, min, max)
    if min == max then return 0 end
    return (value - min) / (max - min)
end

---Smooth step interpolation (ease-in-out) between 0 and 1.
---@param edge0 number Lower edge
---@param edge1 number Upper edge
---@param x number Input value
---@return number
function math.smoothstep(edge0, edge1, x)
    x = math.clamp((x - edge0) / (edge1 - edge0), 0.0, 1.0)
    return x * x * (3 - 2 * x)
end

---Smoother step interpolation (Ken Perlin's version) between 0 and 1.
---@param edge0 number Lower edge
---@param edge1 number Upper edge
---@param x number Input value
---@return number
function math.smootherstep(edge0, edge1, x)
    x = math.clamp((x - edge0) / (edge1 - edge0), 0.0, 1.0)
    return x * x * x * (x * (x * 6 - 15) + 10)
end

---Return average (mean) of a list of numbers.
---@param ... number
---@return number
function math.average(...)
    local args = {...}
    local sum = 0
    local count = #args
    if count == 0 then return 0 end
    for i = 1, count do
        sum = sum + args[i]
    end
    return sum / count
end

---Return the sum of a list of numbers.
---@param ... number
---@return number
function math.sum(...)
    local args = {...}
    local total = 0
    for i = 1, #args do
        total = total + args[i]
    end
    return total
end

---Return the minimum value from a table (array of numbers).
---@param t table
---@return number?
function math.tmin(t)
    local min = nil
    for i = 1, #t do
        if min == nil or t[i] < min then
            min = t[i]
        end
    end
    return min
end

---Return the maximum value from a table (array of numbers).
---@param t table
---@return number?
function math.tmax(t)
    local max = nil
    for i = 1, #t do
        if max == nil or t[i] > max then
            max = t[i]
        end
    end
    return max
end

---Return the median of a list of numbers.
---@param t table
---@return number
function math.median(t)
    local sorted = {}
    for i = 1, #t do sorted[i] = t[i] end
    table.sort(sorted)
    local n = #sorted
    if n == 0 then return 0 end
    if n % 2 == 1 then
        return sorted[math.ceil(n / 2)]
    else
        return (sorted[n / 2] + sorted[n / 2 + 1]) / 2
    end
end

---Return the variance of a list of numbers.
---@param t table
---@param population? boolean Use population variance (default: sample variance)
---@return number
function math.variance(t, population)
    local n = #t
    if n < 2 then return 0 end

    local mean = 0
    for i = 1, n do mean = mean + t[i] end
    mean = mean / n

    local sumSq = 0
    for i = 1, n do
        local diff = t[i] - mean
        sumSq = sumSq + diff * diff
    end

    return sumSq / (population and n or (n - 1))
end

---Return the standard deviation of a list of numbers.
---@param t table
---@param population? boolean Use population std dev (default: sample)
---@return number
function math.stddev(t, population)
    return math.sqrt(math.variance(t, population))
end

---Greatest common divisor (GCD) of two integers.
---@param a integer
---@param b integer
---@return integer
function math.gcd(a, b)
    a, b = math.abs(a), math.abs(b)
    while b ~= 0 do
        a, b = b, a % b
    end
    return a
end

---Least common multiple (LCM) of two integers.
---@param a integer
---@param b integer
---@return integer
function math.lcm(a, b)
    if a == 0 or b == 0 then return 0 end
    return math.abs(a * b) / math.gcd(a, b)
end

---Check if an integer is prime.
---@param n integer
---@return boolean
function math.isprime(n)
    if n < 2 then return false end
    if n == 2 then return true end
    if n % 2 == 0 then return false end
    local limit = math.floor(math.sqrt(n))
    for i = 3, limit, 2 do
        if n % i == 0 then return false end
    end
    return true
end

---Factorial of a non-negative integer.
---@param n integer
---@return integer
function math.factorial(n)
    if n < 0 then error('factorial of negative number', 2) end
    if n == 0 then return 1 end
    local result = 1
    for i = 2, n do
        result = result * i
    end
    return result
end

---Fibonacci number at position n (0-indexed).
---@param n integer
---@return integer
function math.fibonacci(n)
    if n < 0 then error('fibonacci of negative index', 2) end
    if n == 0 then return 0 end
    if n == 1 then return 1 end
    local a, b = 0, 1
    for _ = 2, n do
        a, b = b, a + b
    end
    return b
end

---Degrees to radians.
---@param deg number
---@return number
function math.torad(deg)
    return deg * (math.pi / 180.0)
end

---Radians to degrees.
---@param rad number
---@return number
function math.todeg(rad)
    return rad * (180.0 / math.pi)
end

---Calculate the 2D distance between two points.
---@param x1 number
---@param y1 number
---@param x2 number
---@param y2 number
---@return number
function math.dist2d(x1, y1, x2, y2)
    local dx = x2 - x1
    local dy = y2 - y1
    return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
end

---Calculate the 3D distance between two points.
---@param x1 number
---@param y1 number
---@param z1 number
---@param x2 number
---@param y2 number
---@param z2 number
---@return number
function math.dist3d(x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2)
    local dx = x2 - x1
    local dy = y2 - y1
    local dz = z2 - z1
    return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
end

---Calculate bearing angle in degrees from point A to point B (2D, north = 0).
---@param x1 number
---@param y1 number
---@param x2 number
---@param y2 number
---@return number degrees 0-360
function math.bearing(x1, y1, x2, y2)
    local angle = math.todeg(math.atan(x2 - x1, y2 - y1))
    return math.wrap(angle, 0, 360)
end

---Return a random float between min and max.
---@param min number
---@param max number
---@return number
function math.randomfloat(min, max)
    return min + math.random() * (max - min)
end

---Round to the nearest multiple of `step`.
---@param value number
---@param step number
---@return number
function math.roundtostep(value, step)
    if step == 0 then return value end
    return math.floor(value / step + 0.5) * step
end

---Linear interpolation shorthand (alias for math.interp, scalar only).
---@param a number
---@param b number
---@param t number Factor 0..1
---@return number
function math.mix(a, b, t)
    return a + (b - a) * t
end

---Inverse linear interpolation: given a value between a and b, return the factor.
---@param a number
---@param b number
---@param value number
---@return number factor 0..1 (unclamped)
function math.inverselerp(a, b, value)
    if a == b then return 0 end
    return (value - a) / (b - a)
end

---Re-map a value from one [inMin, inMax] range to [outMin, outMax], clamped.
---@param value number
---@param inMin number
---@param inMax number
---@param outMin number
---@param outMax number
---@return number
function math.remap(value, inMin, inMax, outMin, outMax)
    return math.clamp(math.map(value, inMin, inMax, outMin, outMax), outMin, outMax)
end

---Exponential decay: moves `current` toward `target` by `decay` per second.
---Use in render/tick loops: value = math.decay(value, target, decay, dt)
---@param current number
---@param target number
---@param decay number Decay rate (higher = faster)
---@param dt number Delta time in seconds
---@return number
function math.decay(current, target, decay, dt)
    return target + (current - target) * math.exp(-decay * dt)
end

---Check if two numbers are approximately equal within an epsilon.
---@param a number
---@param b number
---@param epsilon? number Default 1e-9
---@return boolean
function math.approxequal(a, b, epsilon)
    epsilon = epsilon or 1e-9
    return math.abs(a - b) <= epsilon
end

---Safe divide: returns fallback if denominator is zero.
---@param numerator number
---@param denominator number
---@param fallback? number Default 0
---@return number
function math.safediv(numerator, denominator, fallback)
    if denominator == 0 then return fallback or 0 end
    return numerator / denominator
end

---Percentage: what percent is `part` of `total`?
---@param part number
---@param total number
---@return number 0..100
function math.percent(part, total)
    if total == 0 then return 0 end
    return (part / total) * 100
end

---Convert a percentage (0..100) to a 0..1 factor.
---@param pct number
---@return number
function math.percenttofactor(pct)
    return math.clamp(pct / 100, 0, 1)
end

local f = setmetatable({}, {
    __newindex = function(self, key, fn)
        rawset(self, key, fn)
        exports(key, fn)
    end
})

---@param cb function Callback function to execute safely
---@param ... any Arguments to pass to callback
---@return any|nil result Returns callback result or nil on error
function f.fun(cb, ...)
    assert(type(cb) == 'function', 'safecall: callback must be a function')

    local success, result = pcall(cb, ...)

    if not success then
        local info = debug.getinfo(2, 'Sl')
        local source = info.source:match('^@?(.+)$') or info.source
        local line = info.currentline or 0
        
        lib.print.error(('safecall failed at %s:%d\n%s'):format(source, line, result))
        return nil
    end

    return result
end

_ENV.safecall = f

---Split string by delimiter
---@param s string
---@param delimiter string
---@param plain? boolean Use plain text matching (default: true)
---@return table
function string.split(s, delimiter, plain)
    if plain == nil then plain = true end
    
    local result = {}
    local from = 1
    local delim_from, delim_to = s:find(delimiter, from, plain)
    
    while delim_from do
        result[#result + 1] = s:sub(from, delim_from - 1)
        from = delim_to + 1
        delim_from, delim_to = s:find(delimiter, from, plain)
    end
    
    result[#result + 1] = s:sub(from)
    return result
end

---Join table elements with delimiter
---@param tbl table
---@param delimiter string
---@return string
function string.join(tbl, delimiter)
    return table.concat(tbl, delimiter)
end

---Check if string starts with prefix
---@param s string
---@param prefix string
---@return boolean
function string.startswith(s, prefix)
    return s:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix
end

---Check if string ends with suffix
---@param s string
---@param suffix string
---@return boolean
function string.endswith(s, suffix)
    return s:sub(-#suffix) == suffix
end

---Check if string contains substring
---@param s string
---@param substr string
---@param plain? boolean Use plain text matching (default: true)
---@return boolean
function string.contains(s, substr, plain)
    if plain == nil then plain = true end
    return s:find(substr, 1, plain) ~= nil
end

---Count occurrences of substring
---@param s string
---@param substr string
---@param plain? boolean Use plain text matching (default: true)
---@return number
function string.count(s, substr, plain)
    if plain == nil then plain = true end
    
    local count = 0
    local pos = 1
    
    while true do
        local found = s:find(substr, pos, plain)
        if not found then break end
        count = count + 1
        pos = found + 1
    end
    
    return count
end

---Replace all occurrences
---@param s string
---@param old string
---@param new string
---@param plain? boolean Use plain text matching (default: true)
---@return string
function string.replace(s, old, new, plain)
    if plain == nil then plain = true end
    if plain then
        old = old:gsub('[%^%$%(%)%%%.%[%]%*%+%-%?]', '%%%1')
    end
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: redundant-return-value
    return s:gsub(old, new)
end

---Capitalize first character
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.capitalize(s)
    return s:sub(1, 1):upper() .. s:sub(2)
end

---Convert to title case
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.title(s)
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: redundant-return-value
    return s:gsub('(%a)([%w_]*)', function(first, rest)
        return first:upper() .. rest:lower()
    end)
end

---Convert to camelCase
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.camelcase(s)
    local result = s:gsub('[%s_-]+(%w)', function(c) return c:upper() end)
    return result:sub(1, 1):lower() .. result:sub(2)
end

---Convert to PascalCase
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.pascalcase(s)
    local result = s:gsub('[%s_-]+(%w)', function(c) return c:upper() end)
    return result:sub(1, 1):upper() .. result:sub(2)
end

---Convert to snake_case
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.snakecase(s)
    local result = s:gsub('([A-Z])', '_%1'):lower()
    result = result:gsub('[%s-]+', '_')
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: redundant-return-value
    return result:gsub('^_', '')
end

---Convert to kebab-case
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.kebabcase(s)
    local result = s:gsub('([A-Z])', '-%1'):lower()
    result = result:gsub('[%s_]+', '-')
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: redundant-return-value
    return result:gsub('^-', '')
end

---Convert to CONSTANT_CASE
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.constantcase(s)
    return string.snakecase(s):upper()
end

---Convert to specified case
---@param s string
---@param caseType CaseType
---@return string
function string.tocase(s, caseType)
    if caseType == 'upper' then
        return s:upper()
    elseif caseType == 'lower' then
        return s:lower()
    elseif caseType == 'title' then
        return string.title(s)
    elseif caseType == 'sentence' then
        return string.capitalize(s:lower())
    elseif caseType == 'camel' then
        return string.camelcase(s)
    elseif caseType == 'pascal' then
        return string.pascalcase(s)
    elseif caseType == 'snake' then
        return string.snakecase(s)
    elseif caseType == 'kebab' then
        return string.kebabcase(s)
    elseif caseType == 'constant' then
        return string.constantcase(s)
    end
    return s
end

---Repeat string n times
---@param s string
---@param count number
---@param separator? string
---@return string
function string.repeatstr(s, count, separator)
    separator = separator or ''
    local result = {}
    for i = 1, count do
        result[#result + 1] = s
    end
    return table.concat(result, separator)
end

---Pad string to length
---@param s string
---@param length number
---@param char? string Character to pad with (default: ' ')
---@param direction? 'left'|'right'|'both' Direction to pad (default: 'right')
---@return string
function string.pad(s, length, char, direction)
    char = char or ' '
    direction = direction or 'right'
    
    local len = #s
    if len >= length then return s end
    
    local padding = string.rep(char, length - len)
    
    if direction == 'left' then
        return padding .. s
    elseif direction == 'right' then
        return s .. padding
    elseif direction == 'both' then
        local leftPad = math.floor((length - len) / 2)
        local rightPad = length - len - leftPad
        return string.rep(char, leftPad) .. s .. string.rep(char, rightPad)
    end
    
    return s
end

---Truncate string to length
---@param s string
---@param length number
---@param suffix? string Suffix to add (default: '...')
---@return string
function string.truncate(s, length, suffix)
    suffix = suffix or '...'
    if #s <= length then return s end
    return s:sub(1, length - #suffix) .. suffix
end

---Get substring between two delimiters
---@param s string
---@param start_delim string
---@param end_delim string
---@return string?
function string.between(s, start_delim, end_delim)
    local start_pos = s:find(start_delim, 1, true)
    if not start_pos then return nil end
    
    start_pos = start_pos + #start_delim
    local end_pos = s:find(end_delim, start_pos, true)
    if not end_pos then return nil end
    
    return s:sub(start_pos, end_pos - 1)
end

function string.extract(s, pattern)
    local result = {}
    for match in s:gmatch(pattern) do
        result[#result + 1] = match
    end
    return result
end

---Calculate Levenshtein distance
---@param str1 string
---@param str2 string
---@return number
function string.levenshtein(str1, str2)
    if str1 == str2 then return 0 end
    if #str1 == 0 then return #str2 end
    if #str2 == 0 then return #str1 end
    
    local matrix = {}
    
    for i = 0, #str1 do
        matrix[i] = { [0] = i }
    end
    
    for j = 0, #str2 do
        matrix[0][j] = j
    end
    
    for i = 1, #str1 do
        for j = 1, #str2 do
            local cost = str1:sub(i, i) == str2:sub(j, j) and 0 or 1
            matrix[i][j] = math.min(
                matrix[i - 1][j] + 1,
                matrix[i][j - 1] + 1,
                matrix[i - 1][j - 1] + cost
            )
        end
    end
    
    return matrix[#str1][#str2]
end

---Calculate similarity percentage
---@param str1 string
---@param str2 string
---@return number percentage 0-100
function string.similarity(str1, str2)
    local distance = string.levenshtein(str1, str2)
    local maxLen = math.max(#str1, #str2)
    if maxLen == 0 then return 100 end
    return (1 - distance / maxLen) * 100
end

---Word wrap text
---@param s string
---@param width number
---@return string
function string.wordwrap(s, width)
    local result = {}
    local line = ''
    
    for word in s:gmatch('%S+') do
        if #line + #word + 1 > width then
            result[#result + 1] = line
            line = word
        else
            line = line == '' and word or line .. ' ' .. word
        end
    end
    
    if #line > 0 then
        result[#result + 1] = line
    end
    
    return table.concat(result, '\n')
end

---Get lines from string
---@param s string
---@return table
function string.lines(s)
    local result = {}
    for line in s:gmatch('[^\r\n]+') do
        result[#result + 1] = line
    end
    return result
end

---Encode to base64
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.base64encode(s)
    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    return ((s:gsub('.', function(x)
        local r, b = '', x:byte()
        for i = 8, 1, -1 do r = r .. (b % 2 ^ i - b % 2 ^ (i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0') end
        return r
    end) .. '0000'):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if #x < 6 then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 6 do c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2 ^ (6 - i) or 0) end
        return b:sub(c + 1, c + 1)
    end) .. ({ '', '==', '=' })[#s % 3 + 1])
end

---Decode from base64
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.base64decode(s)
    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    s = s:gsub('[^' .. b .. '=]', '')
    return (s:gsub('.', function(x)
        if x == '=' then return '' end
        local r, f = '', b:find(x) - 1
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do r = r .. (f % 2 ^ i - f % 2 ^ (i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0') end
        return r
    end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 8 do c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2 ^ (8 - i) or 0) end
        return string.char(c)
    end))
end

---Generate UUID v4
---@return string
function string.uuid()
    local template = 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: redundant-return-value
    return template:gsub('[xy]', function(c)
        local v = (c == 'x') and math.random(0, 0xf) or math.random(8, 0xb)
        return string.format('%x', v)
    end)
end

---Convert string to bytes table
---@param s string
---@return table
function string.bytes(s)
    local result = {}
    for i = 1, #s do
        result[#result + 1] = s:byte(i)
    end
    return result
end

---Convert bytes table to string
---@param bytes table
---@return string
function string.frombytes(bytes)
    return string.char(table.unpack(bytes))
end

---Format string with template
---@param template string Template with {key} placeholders
---@param data table Data to insert
---@return string
function string.template(template, data)
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: redundant-return-value
    return template:gsub('{(%w+)}', function(key)
        return tostring(data[key] or '')
    end)
end

---Hash string (simple djb2)
---@param s string
---@return number
function string.hash(s)
    local hash = 5381
    for i = 1, #s do
        hash = ((hash * 33) + s:byte(i)) % 2147483647
    end
    return hash
end

---Check if table is empty
---@param t table
---@return boolean
function table.isempty(t)
    return next(t) == nil
end

---Get table size (works for non-sequential tables)
---@param t table
---@return number
function table.size(t)
    local count = 0
    for _ in pairs(t) do
        count = count + 1
    end
    return count
end

---Get table keys as array
---@param t table
---@return table
function table.keys(t)

    for k in pairs(t) do
        result[#result + 1] = k
    end
    return result
end

function table.values(t)
    local result = {}

        result[#result + 1] = v
    end

---Invert table (swap keys and values)
---@param t table
---@return table
function table.invert(t)
    local result = {}
    for k, v in pairs(t) do
        result[v] = k
    end
    return result
end

---Iterate with callback, return first match with truthy result
---@param t table
---@param fn fun(value: any, key: any): boolean?
---@return any? value
---@return any? key
function table.forEach(t, fn)
    for k, v in pairs(t) do
        local res = fn and fn(v, k)
        if res then return v, k end
    end
end

---Check if any element matches predicate
---@param t table
---@param fn fun(value: any, key: any): boolean
---@return boolean
function table.some(t, fn)
    for k, v in pairs(t) do
        if fn(v, k) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

---Find all elements matching predicate
---@param t table
---@param fn fun(value: any, key: any): boolean
---@return table
function table.findAll(t, fn)
    local result = {}
    
    for k, v in pairs(t) do
        if fn(v, k) then
            result[#result + 1] = v
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

---Pick specific keys from table
---@param t table
---@param keys table
---@return table
function table.pick(t, keys)
    local result = {}
    
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
        if t[key] ~= nil then
            result[key] = t[key]
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

---Omit specific keys from table
---@param t table
---@param keys table
---@return table
function table.omit(t, keys)
    local result = table.clone(t)
    local keySet = {}
    
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
        keySet[key] = true
    end
    
    for k in pairs(result) do
        if keySet[k] then
            result[k] = nil
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

---Get value by path (dot notation)
---@param t table
---@param path string
---@return any?
function table.get(t, path)
    local keys = {}
    for key in path:gmatch('[^.]+') do
        keys[#keys + 1] = key
    end
    
    local current = t
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
        if type(current) ~= 'table' then
            return nil
        end
        current = current[key]
    end
    
    return current
end

---Set value by path (dot notation)
---@param t table
---@param path string
---@param value any
function table.set(t, path, value)
    local keys = {}
    for key in path:gmatch('[^.]+') do
        keys[#keys + 1] = key
    end
    
    local current = t
    for i = 1, #keys - 1 do
        local key = keys[i]
        if type(current[key]) ~= 'table' then
            current[key] = {}
        end
        current = current[key]
    end
    
    current[keys[#keys]] = value
end

---Delete value by path (dot notation)
---@param t table
---@param path string
function table.delete(t, path)
    local keys = {}
    for key in path:gmatch('[^.]+') do
        keys[#keys + 1] = key
    end
    
    local current = t
    for i = 1, #keys - 1 do
        local key = keys[i]
        if type(current[key]) ~= 'table' then
            return
        end
        current = current[key]
    end
    
    current[keys[#keys]] = nil
end

---Convert table to JSON string
---@param t table
---@return string
function table.toJSON(t)
    local function serialize(val)
        local valType = type(val)
        
        if valType == 'table' then
            local isArray = #val > 0
            local result = {}
            
            if isArray then
                for i, v in ipairs(val) do
                    result[#result + 1] = serialize(v)
                end
                return '[' .. table.concat(result, ',') .. ']'
            else
                for k, v in pairs(val) do
                    result[#result + 1] = '"' .. tostring(k) .. '":' .. serialize(v)
                end
                return '{' .. table.concat(result, ',') .. '}'
            end
        elseif valType == 'string' then
            return '"' .. val:gsub('"', '\\"') .. '"'
        elseif valType == 'number' or valType == 'boolean' then
            return tostring(val)
        else
            return 'null'
        end
    end
    
    return serialize(t)
end

---Print table structure (for debugging)
---@param t table
---@param indent? number
---@return string
function table.print(t, indent)
    indent = indent or 0
    local result = {}
    local prefix = string.rep('  ', indent)
    
    for k, v in pairs(t) do
        if type(v) == 'table' then
            result[#result + 1] = prefix .. tostring(k) .. ' = {'
            result[#result + 1] = table.print(v, indent + 1)
            result[#result + 1] = prefix .. '}'
        else
            result[#result + 1] = prefix .. tostring(k) .. ' = ' .. tostring(v)
        end
    end
    
    return table.concat(result, '\n')
end

---Flatten nested array by one level
---@param t table
---@return table
function array.flatten(t)
    local result = {}
    
    for _, v in ipairs(t) do
        if type(v) == 'table' then
            for _, inner in ipairs(v) do
                result[#result + 1] = inner
            end
        else
            result[#result + 1] = v
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

---Deep flatten nested arrays
---@param t table
---@return table
function array.deepflatten(t)
    local result = {}
    
    local function flatten_recursive(tbl_inner)
        for _, v in ipairs(tbl_inner) do
            if type(v) == 'table' then
                flatten_recursive(v)
            else
                result[#result + 1] = v
            end
        end
    end
    
    flatten_recursive(t)
    return result
end

---Get unique values from array
---@param t table
---@return table
function array.unique(t)
    local seen = {}
    local result = {}
    
    for _, v in ipairs(t) do
        if not seen[v] then
            seen[v] = true
            result[#result + 1] = v
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

---Get intersection of two arrays
---@param t1 table
---@param t2 table
---@return table
function array.intersection(t1, t2)
    local result = {}
    local set = {}
    
    for _, v in ipairs(t2) do
        set[v] = true
    end
    
    for _, v in ipairs(t1) do
        if set[v] then
            result[#result + 1] = v
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

---Get difference between two arrays (elements in t1 but not in t2)
---@param t1 table
---@param t2 table
---@return table
function array.difference(t1, t2)
    local result = {}
    local set = {}
    
    for _, v in ipairs(t2) do
        set[v] = true
    end
    
    for _, v in ipairs(t1) do
        if not set[v] then
            result[#result + 1] = v
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

---Get union of two arrays
---@param t1 table
---@param t2 table
---@return table
function array.union(t1, t2)
    local combined = {}
    for _, v in ipairs(t1) do
        combined[#combined + 1] = v
    end
    for _, v in ipairs(t2) do
        combined[#combined + 1] = v
    end
    return array.unique(combined)
end

---Get last index of value in array
---@param t table
---@param value any
---@return number?
function array.lastIndexOf(t, value)
    for i = #t, 1, -1 do
        if t[i] == value then
            return i
        end
    end
    return nil
end

---Remove first occurrence of value from array
---@param t table
---@param value any
---@return boolean success
function array.removeValue(t, value)
    for i = 1, #t do
        if t[i] == value then
            table.remove(t, i)
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

---Remove all occurrences of value from array
---@param t table
---@param value any
---@return number count
function array.removeAll(t, value)
    local count = 0
    
    for i = #t, 1, -1 do
        if t[i] == value then
            table.remove(t, i)
            count = count + 1
        end
    end
    
    return count
end

---Get random element from array
---@param t table
---@return any?
function array.random(t)
    if #t == 0 then return nil end
    return t[math.random(#t)]
end

---Get random elements from array (without duplicates)
---@param t table
---@param count number
---@return table
function array.sample(t, count)
    local result = {}
    local indices = {}
    local len = #t
    
    count = math.min(count, len)
    
    while #indices < count do
        local idx = math.random(len)
        if not indices[idx] then
            indices[idx] = true
            result[#result + 1] = t[idx]
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

---Chunk array into smaller arrays
---@param t table
---@param size number
---@return table
function array.chunk(t, size)
    local result = {}
    
    for i = 1, #t, size do
        local chunk = {}
        for j = i, math.min(i + size - 1, #t) do
            chunk[#chunk + 1] = t[j]
        end
        result[#result + 1] = chunk
    end
    
    return result
end

---Partition array by predicate
---@param t table
---@param fn fun(value: any, key: any): boolean
---@return table truthy
---@return table falsy
function array.partition(t, fn)
    local truthy = {}
    local falsy = {}
    
    for k, v in pairs(t) do
        if fn(v, k) then
            truthy[#truthy + 1] = v
        else
            falsy[#falsy + 1] = v
        end
    end
    
    return truthy, falsy
end

---Group array elements by key function
---@param t table
---@param fn fun(value: any): any
---@return table
function array.groupBy(t, fn)
    local result = {}
    
    for _, v in ipairs(t) do
        local key = fn(v)
        if not result[key] then
            result[key] = {}
        end
        result[key][#result[key] + 1] = v
    end
    
    return result
end

---Count occurrences of each value
---@param t table
---@return table
function array.countBy(t)
    local result = {}
    
    for _, v in pairs(t) do
        result[v] = (result[v] or 0) + 1
    end
    
    return result
end

---Zip multiple arrays together
---@param ... table
---@return table
function array.zip(...)
    local args = {...}
    local result = {}
    local maxLen = 0
    
    for _, t in ipairs(args) do
        maxLen = math.max(maxLen, #t)
    end
    
    for i = 1, maxLen do
        local row = {}
        for _, t in ipairs(args) do
            row[#row + 1] = t[i]
        end
        result[#result + 1] = row
    end
    
    return result
end

---Unzip array of arrays
---@param t table
---@return table ...
function array.unzip(t)
    if #t == 0 then return {} end
    
    local result = {}
    local maxLen = 0
    
    for _, row in ipairs(t) do
        maxLen = math.max(maxLen, #row)
    end
    
    for i = 1, maxLen do
        result[i] = {}
        for _, row in ipairs(t) do
            result[i][#result[i] + 1] = row[i]
        end
    end
    
    return table.unpack(result)
end

---Create array from range
---@param start_val number
---@param end_val number
---@param step? number
---@return table
function array.range(start_val, end_val, step)
    step = step or 1
    local result = {}
    
    if step > 0 then
        for i = start_val, end_val, step do
            result[#result + 1] = i
        end
    else
        for i = start_val, end_val, step do
            result[#result + 1] = i
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

---Create array filled with value
---@param count number
---@param value any
---@return table
function array.create(count, value)
    local result = {}
    for i = 1, count do
        result[i] = value
    end
    return result
end

---Sort array and return new table (non-mutating)
---@param t table
---@param compareFn? fun(a: any, b: any): boolean
---@return table
function array.sorted(t, compareFn)
    local result = table.clone(t)
    table.sort(result, compareFn)
    return result
end

---Concatenate multiple arrays
---@param ... table
---@return table
function array.concat(...)
    local result = {}
    
    for i = 1, select('#', ...) do
        local t = select(i, ...)
        for j = 1, #t do
            result[#result + 1] = t[j]
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

            TaskPlayAnim(cache.ped, "melee@hatchet@streamed_core", "plyr_front_takedown_b", -3.0, 3.0, -1, 49, 0, 0, 0, 0)
            Wait(700)
            if LoadParticle("core") then
                StartParticleFxLoopedAtCoord("blood_stab", animalCoords.x, animalCoords.y, animalCoords.z - 0.25, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 2.5, false, false, false, false)
            end
            Wait(1000)
        end
    end)

    lib.progressCircle({
        duration = config.processingTime,
        useWhileDead = false,
        canCancel = false,
        disable = { move = true }
    })

    isAnimating = false
    StopAnimTask(cache.ped, "melee@hatchet@streamed_core", "plyr_front_takedown_b", 1.5)
    if DoesEntityExist(animalEntity) then DeleteEntity(animalEntity) end

    TriggerTokenEvent('sm_hunting:completeProcessing')
    isworking = false
end)

lib.onCache('weapon', function(weapon)
    if State.playerInZone and weapon and not AllowedWeapons[weapon] then
        SetCurrentPedWeapon(PlayerPedId(), `WEAPON_UNARMED`, true)
        RemoveWeaponFromPed(PlayerPedId(), weapon)
        lib.notify({ title = 'Hunting Zone', description = 'Anda hanya boleh menggunakan Sniper Rifle!', type = 'error' })
    end
end)

local function SpawnAnimal()
    if #State.animals >= zone.maxAnimals then return end

    local randomAnimal = GetRandomAnimalModel()
    if State.animalCooldown[randomAnimal] and GetGameTimer() < State.animalCooldown[randomAnimal] then
        return
    end

    local spawnOffset = vec3(
        math.random(-zone.radius, zone.radius),
        math.random(-zone.radius, zone.radius),
        0.0
    )
    local spawnPos = zone.center + spawnOffset
    local _, groundZ = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord(spawnPos.x, spawnPos.y, spawnPos.z + 100.0, true)

    if not LoadModel(randomAnimal) then return end

    local animal = CreatePed(28, GetHashKey(randomAnimal), spawnPos.x, spawnPos.y, groundZ, math.random(0, 360), false, true)
    if not DoesEntityExist(animal) then return end

    SetEntityAsMissionEntity(animal, true, true)
    SetPedRelationshipGroupHash(animal, `HUNTER_ANIMAL`)
    SetEntityHealth(animal, 500)
    TaskWanderStandard(animal, 10.0, 10)
    SetEntityOnlyDamagedByPlayer(animal, true)
    SetEntityProofs(animal, false, true, false, false, false, false, false, false)

    if IsAggressiveAnimal(randomAnimal) then
        SetPedCombatAttributes(animal, 5, true)
        SetPedCombatAbility(animal, 2)
        SetPedCombatMovement(animal, 2)
        SetPedCombatRange(animal, 2)
        CreateThread(function()
            Wait(1000)
            if DoesEntityExist(animal) then
                TaskCombatPed(animal, PlayerPedId(), 0, 16)
            end
        end)
    end

    local blip = AddBlipForEntity(animal)
    SetBlipSprite(blip, 141)
    SetBlipColour(blip, IsAggressiveAnimal(randomAnimal) and 1 or 2)
    SetBlipScale(blip, 0.8)
    BeginTextCommandSetBlipName("STRING")
    AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(IsAggressiveAnimal(randomAnimal) and "Dangerous Animal" or "Hunting Animal")
    EndTextCommandSetBlipName(blip)

    table.insert(State.animals, { entity = animal, blip = blip, model = randomAnimal })
    State.animalCooldown[randomAnimal] = GetGameTimer() + 30000
end

local function CleanupAnimals()
    for i = #State.animals, 1, -1 do
        local data = State.animals[i]
        if DoesEntityExist(data.entity) then
            RemoveBlip(data.blip)
            if NetworkHasControlOfEntity(data.entity) then
                DeleteEntity(data.entity)
            else
                NetworkRequestControlOfEntity(data.entity)
                CreateThread(function()
                    local timeout = GetGameTimer() + 5000
                    while not NetworkHasControlOfEntity(data.entity) and GetGameTimer() < timeout do
                        Wait(10)
                    end
                    if NetworkHasControlOfEntity(data.entity) then
                        DeleteEntity(data.entity)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        table.remove(State.animals, i)
    end
    State.animalCooldown = {}
end

local function KeepAnimalsInZone()
    CreateThread(function()
        while State.playerInZone do
            Wait(5000)
            for i = #State.animals, 1, -1 do
                local data = State.animals[i]
                if DoesEntityExist(data.entity) then
                    local animalPos = GetEntityCoords(data.entity)
                    if #(animalPos - zone.center) > zone.radius then
                        local newX = zone.center.x + math.random(-zone.radius / 2, zone.radius / 2)
                        local newY = zone.center.y + math.random(-zone.radius / 2, zone.radius / 2)
                        local _, groundZ = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord(newX, newY, zone.center.z + 100.0, true)
                        SetEntityCoords(data.entity, newX, newY, groundZ, false, false, false, true)
                        TaskWanderStandard(data.entity, 10.0, 10)
                    end
                else
                    RemoveBlip(data.blip)
                    table.remove(State.animals, i)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function StartAnimalSpawning()
    CreateThread(function()
        while State.playerInZone do
            if #State.animals < zone.maxAnimals then
                SpawnAnimal()
            end
            Wait(10000)
        end
    end)
end

CreateThread(function()
    Wait(1500)

    exports.ox_target:addBoxZone({
        coords = processing.coords,
        size = vec3(2.0, 2.0, 1.0),
        rotation = processing.heading,
        options = {
            {
                label = "Potong Hewan",
                icon = 'fas fa-cut',
                distance = 2.0,
                onSelect = ProcessAnimal,
                canInteract = function()
                    return not isworking
                end
            }
        }
    })

    State.huntingZoneBlip = AddBlipForRadius(zone.center.x, zone.center.y, zone.center.z, zone.radius)
    SetBlipHighDetail(State.huntingZoneBlip, true)
    SetBlipColour(State.huntingZoneBlip, 1)
    SetBlipAlpha(State.huntingZoneBlip, 80)

    for i, animal in pairs(animals) do
        exports.ox_target:addModel(animal.model, {
            {
                label = "Angkat Hewan",
                icon = 'fas fa-people-carry',
                distance = 2.5,
                onSelect = function(data)
                    CarryAnimal(data.entity, i)
                end,
                canInteract = function(entity)
                    return IsEntityDead(entity) and not isworking
                end
            }
        })
    end

    lib.zones.sphere({
        coords = zone.center,
        radius = zone.radius,
        onEnter = function()
            State.playerInZone = true
            lib.notify({ title = 'Hunting Zone', description = 'Selamat datang di Area Berburu!', type = 'success' })
            for _ = 1, zone.maxAnimals do
                SpawnAnimal()
            end
            KeepAnimalsInZone()
            StartAnimalSpawning()
        end,
        onExit = function()
            State.playerInZone = false
            lib.notify({ title = 'Zone Exit', description = 'Anda telah keluar dari Zona Perburuan.', type = 'error' })
            CleanupAnimals()
        end
    })

    if not config.blip then return end
    AddTextEntry("BLIP_CAT_" .. 31, "Hunting")
    for _, blipdata in pairs(config.blip) do
        blipModule:new(blipdata)
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resourceName)
    if GetCurrentResourceName() ~= resourceName then return end
    if State.huntingZoneBlip then RemoveBlip(State.huntingZoneBlip) end
    CleanupAnimals()
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_resource\resource\sm_pawnshop\client.lua
local config = localmodule 'config.shared'

local function getItemLabel(item)
    return config.itemLabels[item] or item
end

local function getItemCount(item)
    return exports.ox_inventory:GetItemCount(item) or 0
end

local function createRegularSellMenu(configTable, menuTitle, selectEvent)
    local options = {}

    for item, price in pairs(configTable) do
        local itemCount = getItemCount(item)
        local itemLabel = getItemLabel(item)
        local statusText = itemCount > 0 and
            string.format("Kamu punya: %dx %s", itemCount, itemLabel) or
            "âŒ Kamu tidak memiliki item ini"

        table.insert(options, {
            title = string.format("%s ($%d per item)", itemLabel, price),
            description = statusText,
            icon = itemCount > 0 and 'fa-solid fa-box' or 'fa-solid fa-box-open',
            event = selectEvent,
            args = item
        })
    end

    if #options == 0 then
        lib.notify({ title = 'Jual Item', description = 'Tidak ada item yang tersedia untuk dijual.', type = 'error' })
        return
    end

    lib.registerContext({ id = 'sell_items_menu', title = menuTitle, options = options })
    lib.showContext('sell_items_menu')
end

local function createBlackmarketCategoryMenu()
    local options = {}

    for categoryId, categoryInfo in pairs(config.blackmarketCategories) do
        table.insert(options, {
            title = string.format('%s %s', categoryInfo.icon, categoryInfo.title),
            description = 'Klik untuk melihat item yang bisa dijual',
            event = 'axon-sellitems:openCategoryMenu',
            args = categoryId
        })
    end

    lib.registerContext({
        id = 'blackmarket_category_menu',
        title = 'Pilih Kategori Blackmarket',
        options = options
    })
    lib.showContext('blackmarket_category_menu')
end

local function createBlackmarketItemMenu(category)
    local categoryData = config.blackmarket[category]
    local categoryInfo = config.blackmarketCategories[category]

    if not categoryData or not categoryInfo then
        lib.notify({ title = 'Error', description = 'Kategori blackmarket tidak ditemukan.', type = 'error' })
        return
    end

    local options = {}

    for item, priceRange in pairs(categoryData) do
        local itemCount = getItemCount(item)
        local itemLabel = getItemLabel(item)
        local statusText = itemCount > 0 and
            string.format("Kamu punya: %dx %s", itemCount, itemLabel) or
            "âŒ Kamu tidak memiliki item ini"

        local priceText
        if priceRange.min == priceRange.max then
            priceText = string.format("$%d", priceRange.min)
        else
            priceText = string.format("$%d - $%d", priceRange.min, priceRange.max)
        end

        table.insert(options, {
            title = string.format("%s (%s)", itemLabel, priceText),
            description = statusText .. " | Dibayar dengan black money",
            icon = itemCount > 0 and 'fa-solid fa-gem' or 'fa-solid fa-box-open',
            event = 'axon-sellitems:selectItemBlackmarket',
            args = { item = item, category = category }
        })
    end

    if #options == 0 then
        lib.notify({ title = 'Jual Item Blackmarket', description = 'Tidak ada item yang tersedia untuk dijual.', type = 'error' })
        return
    end

    lib.registerContext({
        id = 'sell_blackmarket_items_menu',
        title = string.format('Jual Barang - %s %s', categoryInfo.title, categoryInfo.icon),
        menu = 'blackmarket_category_menu',
        options = options
    })
    lib.showContext('sell_blackmarket_items_menu')
end

local function createBlackmarketShopCategoryMenu()
    if not config.blackmarketShopCategories then
        lib.notify({ title = 'Error', description = 'Shop tidak tersedia.', type = 'error' })
        return
    end

    local options = {}

    for categoryId, categoryInfo in pairs(config.blackmarketShopCategories) do
        table.insert(options, {
            title = string.format('%s %s', categoryInfo.icon, categoryInfo.title),
            description = 'Klik untuk melihat item yang bisa dibeli',
            event = 'axon-sellitems:openShopCategoryMenu',
            args = categoryId
        })
    end

    lib.registerContext({
        id = 'blackmarket_shop_category_menu',
        title = 'Black Market - Beli Barang',
        options = options
    })
    lib.showContext('blackmarket_shop_category_menu')
end

local function createBlackmarketShopItemMenu(category)
    local categoryData = config.blackmarketShop and config.blackmarketShop[category]
    local categoryInfo = config.blackmarketShopCategories and config.blackmarketShopCategories[category]

    if not categoryData or not categoryInfo then
        lib.notify({ title = 'Error', description = 'Kategori shop tidak ditemukan.', type = 'error' })
        return
    end

    local options = {}

    for item, itemConfig in pairs(categoryData) do
        local itemLabel = itemConfig.label or getItemLabel(item)
        local currencyLabel = itemConfig.currency == 'red_money' and 'Red Money' or 'Black Money'

        table.insert(options, {
            title = string.format("%s ($%d %s)", itemLabel, itemConfig.price, currencyLabel),
            description = 'Klik untuk membeli',
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-cart-shopping',
            event = 'axon-sellitems:selectBuyItem',
            args = { item = item, category = category }
        })
    end

    if #options == 0 then
        lib.notify({ title = 'Black Market Shop', description = 'Tidak ada item tersedia.', type = 'error' })
        return
    end

    lib.registerContext({
        id = 'blackmarket_shop_items_menu',
        title = string.format('%s %s', categoryInfo.icon, categoryInfo.title),
        menu = 'blackmarket_shop_category_menu',
        options = options
    })
    lib.showContext('blackmarket_shop_items_menu')
end

local function selectItemForSale(item, eventName)
    local maxAmount = getItemCount(item)

    if maxAmount == 0 then
        lib.notify({ title = 'Jual Item', description = 'Kamu tidak memiliki item ini.', type = 'error' })
        return
    end

    local sliderMax = math.min(maxAmount, config.maxAmountPerSale or 500)
    local input = lib.inputDialog('Jumlah Item yang Akan Dijual', {
        {
            type = 'slider',
            label = 'Pilih jumlah',
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-box',
            required = true,
            default = 1,
            min = 1,
            max = sliderMax,
            step = 1
        }
    })

    if input and tonumber(input[1]) then
        TriggerTokenEvent(eventName, item, tonumber(input[1]))
    end
end

local function selectItemForSaleBlackmarket(data)
    local maxAmount = getItemCount(data.item)

    if maxAmount == 0 then
        lib.notify({ title = 'Jual Item Blackmarket', description = 'Kamu tidak memiliki item ini.', type = 'error' })
        return
    end

    local sliderMax = math.min(maxAmount, config.maxAmountPerSale or 500)
    local input = lib.inputDialog('Jumlah Item yang Akan Dijual', {
        {
            type = 'slider',
            label = 'Pilih jumlah',
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-gem',
            required = true,
            default = 1,
            min = 1,
            max = sliderMax,
            step = 1
        }
    })

    if input and tonumber(input[1]) then
        TriggerTokenEvent('axon-sellitems:sellBlackmarket', data.item, tonumber(input[1]), data.category)
    end
end

local function selectItemForPurchase(data)
    local input = lib.inputDialog('Jumlah Item yang Akan Dibeli', {
        {
            type = 'slider',
            label = 'Pilih jumlah',
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-cart-shopping',
            required = true,
            default = 1,
            min = 1,
            max = config.maxAmountPerPurchase or 50,
            step = 1
        }
    })

    if input and tonumber(input[1]) then
        TriggerTokenEvent('axon-sellitems:buyBlackmarket', data.item, tonumber(input[1]), data.category)
    end
end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_resource\resource\sm_prison\client\prison.lua
local cachePrison = {}
local prisonZone = {}
local inOOCJail = false

local prisonJob = localmodule 'modules.prison_job'
local clientConfig = localmodule 'config.location'
local permission = localmodule 'config.permission'

local function secondToClock(seconds)
    local total_seconds = tonumber(seconds)
    if total_seconds <= 0 then return 0, 0, 0 end
    local hours = string.format('%02.f', math.floor(total_seconds / 3600))
    local mins = string.format('%02.f', math.floor(total_seconds / 60 - (hours * 60)))
    local secs = string.format('%02.f', math.floor(total_seconds - hours * 3600 - mins * 60))
    return hours, mins, secs
end

local function createZone(location)
    local zoneData = clientConfig.zone[location]
    prisonZone[location] = lib.zones.poly({
        points = zoneData.points,
        thickness = zoneData.thickness,
        onExit = function()
            local metadata = QBPlayerData and QBPlayerData.metadata
            if cachePrison[cache.serverId] and metadata and metadata.injail and metadata.injail > 0 then
                DoScreenFadeOut(500)
                while not IsScreenFadedOut() do
                    Wait(10)
                end

                DetachEntity(PlayerPedId(), true, false)
                local coordsMasuk = cachePrison[cache.serverId].coords.enter
                SetEntityCoords(PlayerPedId(), coordsMasuk.x, coordsMasuk.y, coordsMasuk.z - 0.9, 0, 0, 0, false)
                TriggerServerEvent("InteractSound_SV:PlayOnSource", "jail", 0.5)
                TriggerServerEvent("sm_prison:server:jailEscapeAlert")
                Wait(2000)
                DoScreenFadeIn(500)
            end
        end
    })
end

local function removeZone(location)
    if prisonZone[location] then
        prisonZone[location]:remove()
    end
end

local oocZone

local function teleportToOOCJail(ped, fadeTime)
    DoScreenFadeOut(fadeTime)
    while not IsScreenFadedOut() do Wait(10) end

    local coords = clientConfig.oocjail.enter
    ClearPedTasks(ped)
    DetachEntity(ped, true, false)
    SetEntityCoords(ped, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z - 0.9, 0, 0, 0, false)
    SetEntityHeading(ped, coords.w)
end

local function removeOOCZone()
    if oocZone then
        oocZone:remove()
        oocZone = nil
    end
end

local function createOOCZone()
    removeOOCZone()
    local zoneData = clientConfig.oocjail.zone
    oocZone = lib.zones.poly({
        points = zoneData.points,
        thickness = zoneData.thickness,
        onExit = function()
            if not inOOCJail then return end
            local ped = PlayerPedId()
            teleportToOOCJail(ped, 500)
            Wait(1000)
            DoScreenFadeIn(500)
        end
    })
end

local function prisonerActionMenu(prisoner)
    local context = {
        id = 'prisoner:contextActionMenu',
        title = 'Prisoner Action Menu',
        options = {
            {
                title = 'Unjail',
                icon = 'fas fa-circle-info',
                description = 'Keluarkan pemain dari penjara',
                onSelect = function()
                    ExecuteCommand('unjail ' .. prisoner.source)
                end
            },
            {
                title = 'Remote time',
                icon = 'fas fa-clock',
                description = 'Kurangi masa tahanan',
                onSelect = function()
                    local input = lib.inputDialog('Waktu', {
                        { type = 'number', label = 'Berapa menit?', placeholder = '' },
                    })
                    if not input then return end
                    TriggerTokenEvent('sm_prison:kurangiWaktuTahanan', { prisoner.source, input[1] })
                end
            }
        }
    }
    lib.registerContext(context)
    lib.showContext('prisoner:contextActionMenu')
end

local function prisonerMenu(location)
    local prisoners = lib.callback.await('sm_prison:getPrisoner', 1500, location)

    if prisoners and #prisoners < 1 then
        return lib.notify({
            description = 'Tidak ada prisoner',
            type = 'error'
        })
    end

    local context = {
        id = 'prisoner:contextMenu',
        title = 'Prisoner Menu',
        options = {}
    }

    for i = 1, #prisoners do
        local prisoner = prisoners[i]
        local h, m, s = secondToClock(prisoner.timer)
        local text = ('%s Jam %s Menit %s Detik'):format(h, m, s)

        context.options[#context.options + 1] = {
            title = prisoner.name,
            description = 'Waktu tersisa: ' .. text,
            icon = 'fas fa-user',
            onSelect = function()
                prisonerActionMenu(prisoner)
            end
        }
    end

    lib.registerContext(context)
    lib.showContext('prisoner:contextMenu')
end

lib.callback.register('sm_prison:getInputData', function()
    local ped = PlayerPedId()
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)

    local players = lib.callback.await('sm_prison:getNearbyPlayers', false, coords)

    if #players < 1 then
        return lib.notify({
            description = 'Tidak ada pemain!',
            type = 'error'
        })
    end

    local input = lib.inputDialog('PENJARA', {
        { type = 'multi-select', label = 'Pilih pemain',        required = true, options = players },
        { type = 'number',       label = 'Waktu penjara (menit)', required = true, min = 1, max = 999999 },
        { type = 'select',       label = 'Lokasi Penjara',      required = true, options = {
            { value = 'police', label = 'Boilingbroke' }
        } }
    })

    if not input then return end

    return {
        players = input[1],
        time = input[2],
        location = input[3]
    }
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_prison:sendToJail', function(location)
    local ped = cache.ped
    if not ped or not DoesEntityExist(ped) then
        return false
    end

    DoScreenFadeOut(500)
    while not IsScreenFadedOut() do
        Wait(10)
    end

    cachePrison[cache.serverId] = {
        coords = clientConfig.coords[location],
        location = location
    }

    local prisonerData = cachePrison[cache.serverId]
    if not prisonerData or not prisonerData.coords or not prisonerData.coords.enter then
        DoScreenFadeIn(500)
        return false
    end

    local coordsMasuk = prisonerData.coords.enter

    ped = PlayerPedId()
    SetEntityCoords(ped, coordsMasuk.x, coordsMasuk.y, coordsMasuk.z - 0.9, 0, 0, 0, false)
    TriggerServerEvent("InteractSound_SV:PlayOnSource", "jail", 0.5)
    Wait(1000)
    DoScreenFadeIn(500)

    createZone(prisonerData.location)
    prisonJob.createPrisonJobs(prisonerData.location)

    lib.notify({
        description = 'Selamat menjalani masa tahanan!',
    })

    return true
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_prison:releaseFromJail', function()
    if source == '' then return end

    local ped = cache.ped
    if not ped or not DoesEntityExist(ped) then return end

    local serverId = cache.serverId
    if not serverId then return end

    local prisonerData = cachePrison[serverId]
    if not prisonerData or not prisonerData.coords or not prisonerData.coords.release then return end

    removeZone(prisonerData.location)
    prisonJob.removePrisonJobs(prisonerData.location)
    cachePrison[serverId] = nil

    DoScreenFadeOut(500)
    while not IsScreenFadedOut() do Wait(10) end

    local coordsKeluar = prisonerData.coords.release
    ped = PlayerPedId()
    SetEntityCoords(ped, coordsKeluar.x, coordsKeluar.y, coordsKeluar.z - 0.9, 0, 0, 0, false)
    SetEntityHeading(ped, coordsKeluar.w)
    Wait(2000)
    DoScreenFadeIn(500)

    lib.notify({
        description = 'Anda telah bebas dari penjara.',
        type = 'success'
    })
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_prison:oocjail:sendToJail', function()
    if source == '' then return end

    local ped = cache.ped
    if not ped or not DoesEntityExist(ped) then return end

    teleportToOOCJail(ped, 1000)
    inOOCJail = true
    createOOCZone()

    Wait(2000)
    DoScreenFadeIn(1000)

    lib.notify({
        description = 'Anda telah dijail OOC!',
        type = 'error'
    })
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_prison:oocjail:leaveJail', function()
    if source == '' then return end
    if not inOOCJail then return end

    local ped = cache.ped
    if not ped or not DoesEntityExist(ped) then return end

    inOOCJail = false
    removeOOCZone()

    DoScreenFadeOut(500)
    while not IsScreenFadedOut() do Wait(10) end

    local coords = clientConfig.oocjail.release
    SetEntityCoords(ped, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z - 0.9, 0, 0, 0, false)

    Wait(500)
    DoScreenFadeIn(1000)

    lib.notify({
        description = 'Anda telah bebas dari jail OOC.',
        type = 'success'
    })
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_prison:openManageMenu', function()
    if source == '' then return end

    local locations = {}
    for location in pairs(clientConfig.prison_handler) do
        locations[#locations + 1] = location
    end

    if #locations == 1 then
        return prisonerMenu(locations[1])
    end

    local options = {}
    for i = 1, #locations do
        local location = locations[i]
        options[i] = {
            title = location,
            icon = 'fas fa-building',
            onSelect = function()
                prisonerMenu(location)
            end
        }
    end

    lib.registerContext({
        id = 'prisoner:contextLocationMenu',
        title = 'Pilih Penjara',
        options = options
    })
    lib.showContext('prisoner:contextLocationMenu')
end)

exports('inOOCJail', function()
    return inOOCJail
end)

CreateThread(function()
    lib.table.forEach(clientConfig.blip, function(val)
        local prisonMainBlip = AddBlipForCoord(val.coords.x, val.coords.y, val.coords.z)
        SetBlipSprite(prisonMainBlip, 189)
        SetBlipDisplay(prisonMainBlip, 2)
        SetBlipScale(prisonMainBlip, 1.0)
        SetBlipAsShortRange(prisonMainBlip, true)
        SetBlipColour(prisonMainBlip, 3)
        BeginTextCommandSetBlipName("STRING")
        AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(val.label)
        EndTextCommandSetBlipName(prisonMainBlip)
    end)

    for k, v in pairs(clientConfig.prison_handler) do
        for i = 1, #v do
            local c = v[i]
            ox_target:addSphereZone({
                coords = c.xyz,
                radius = 0.5,
                options = {
                    {
                        label = 'Manage Prisoner',
                        icon = 'fas fa-user',
                        distance = 1.5,
                        onSelect = function()
                            local job = QBPlayerData.job.name
                            if not permission[job] then return end
                            prisonerMenu(k)
                        end
                    }
                }
            })
        end
    end
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[02_dasar_rp]\sm_resource\resource\sm_prison\client\timer.lua
local uiShow = false
local oocUiShow = false

local function secondToClock(seconds)
    local total_seconds = tonumber(seconds)
    if total_seconds <= 0 then return 0, 0, 0 end
    local hours = string.format('%02.f', math.floor(total_seconds / 3600))
    local mins = string.format('%02.f', math.floor(total_seconds / 60 - (hours * 60)))
    local secs = string.format('%02.f', math.floor(total_seconds - hours * 3600 - mins * 60))
    return hours, mins, secs
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_prison:updateTimer', function(value)
    if source == '' then return end

    if not value or value < 1 then
        uiShow = false
        infoUI.remove('prison:timer')
        return
    end

    local h, m, s = secondToClock(value)
    local text = ('%s Jam %s Menit %s Detik'):format(h, m, s)

    uiShow = true
    infoUI.show({
        id = 'prison:timer',
        title = 'Masa tahanan',
        icon = 'fa-solid fa-clock',
        description = text
    })
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_prison:updateOOCTimer', function(value)
    if source == '' then return end

    if not value or value < 1 then
        oocUiShow = false
        infoUI.remove('oocprison:timer')
        return
    end

    local h, m, s = secondToClock(value)
    local text = ('%s Jam %s Menit %s Detik'):format(h, m, s)

    oocUiShow = true
    infoUI.show({
        id = 'oocprison:timer',
        title = 'Penjara OOC',
        icon = 'fa-solid fa-lock',
        description = text
    })
end)

exports('inPrison', function()
    return uiShow
end)

exports('inOOCPrison', function()
    return oocUiShow
end)
