    BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_blackjack:client:retrieveCards', tableIdx, 0)
    for seat = 1, 4 do
        BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_blackjack:client:retrieveCards', tableIdx, seat)
    end
end

---@param tableIdx integer
---@param phase string
---@param timeLeft number
---@param isSplit boolean?
local function sendPhaseToSeatedPlayers(tableIdx, phase, timeLeft, isSplit)
    for src in pairs(tablePlayers[tableIdx]) do
        TriggerCasinoEvent(
            'rhd_casino_blackjack:client:phase',
            src,
            tableIdx,
            phase,
            timeLeft,
            isSplit
        )
    end
end

---@param tableIdx integer
local function phaseBetting(tableIdx)
    tableState[tableIdx] = 'betting'
    tableEarlyStart[tableIdx] = false

    dealerAnim(tableIdx, 'female_place_bet_request')
    dealerSpeech(tableIdx, 'MINIGAME_DEALER_PLACE_CHIPS')
    sendPhaseToSeatedPlayers(tableIdx, 'betting', config.bettingTime)

    local deadline = GetGameTimer() + (config.bettingTime * 1000)
    tableBettingDeadline[tableIdx] = deadline
    while GetGameTimer() < deadline do
        if tableEarlyStart[tableIdx] then break end
        Wait(300)
    end
    tableEarlyStart[tableIdx] = false
    tableBettingDeadline[tableIdx] = nil

    for src, p in pairs(tablePlayers[tableIdx]) do
        if p.pendingBet and p.pendingBet > 0 then
            if takeChips(src, p.pendingBet) then
                p.bet = p.pendingBet
                p.inRound = true
                TriggerCasinoEvent('rhd_casino_blackjack:client:betLocked', src, tableIdx, p.seat, p.bet)
            else
                BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_blackjack:client:retrieveCards', tableIdx, p.seat)
            end
            p.pendingBet = 0
        end
    end

    sendPhaseToSeatedPlayers(tableIdx, 'idle', 0)
end

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_blackjack:callback:placeBet', function(source, tableIdx, bet)
    if type(tableIdx) ~= 'number' or type(bet) ~= 'number' then return false end

    local p = tablePlayers[tableIdx] and tablePlayers[tableIdx][source]
    if not p then return false end
    if tableState[tableIdx] ~= 'betting' then return false end
    if p.inRound then return false end
    if p.pendingBet and p.pendingBet > 0 then return false end

    local tbl = config.tables[tableIdx]
    if not tbl then return false end

    bet = math.floor(bet)
    local minBet = (tbl.bettingAmounts and tbl.bettingAmounts[1]) or 1
    local maxBet = tbl.maxBettingAmount or math.huge
    if bet < minBet or bet > maxBet then return false end

    if getChipBalance(source) < bet then return false end

    p.pendingBet = bet
    BroadcastCasinoPlayers(
        'rhd_casino_blackjack:client:placeChip',
        tableIdx, p.seat, bet, false, false
    )
    return true
end)

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_casino_blackjack:server:confirmBet', function(tableIdx)
    local source = source
    if type(tableIdx) ~= 'number' then return end
    local p = tablePlayers[tableIdx] and tablePlayers[tableIdx][source]
    if not p then return end
    if tableState[tableIdx] ~= 'betting' then return end
    if not p.pendingBet or p.pendingBet <= 0 then return end

    p.betConfirmed = true

    local allConfirmed = true
    for _, player in pairs(tablePlayers[tableIdx]) do
        if not player.betConfirmed then
            allConfirmed = false
            break
        end
    end
    if allConfirmed then
        tableEarlyStart[tableIdx] = true
    end
end)

local function dealOne(tableIdx, seat, hand, card, flipped, isSplit, isDouble)
    table.insert(hand, card)
    BroadcastCasinoPlayers(
        'rhd_casino_blackjack:client:giveCard',
        tableIdx, seat, #hand, card, flipped or false, isSplit or false, isDouble or false
    )
end

---@param tableIdx integer
---@param deck string[]
---@param dealerHand string[]
local function phaseDealing(tableIdx, deck, dealerHand)
    tableState[tableIdx] = 'dealing'
    dealerSpeech(tableIdx, 'MINIGAME_DEALER_CLOSED_BETS')
    Wait(1500)

    for round = 1, 2 do
        local card = cards.takeCard(deck)
        table.insert(dealerHand, card)

        BroadcastCasinoPlayers(
            'rhd_casino_blackjack:client:giveCard',
            tableIdx, 0, #dealerHand, card, #dealerHand == 1, false
        )

        if #dealerHand == 1 then
            dealerAnim(tableIdx, 'female_deal_card_self')
        else
            dealerAnim(tableIdx, 'female_deal_card_self_second_card')
        end

        Wait(2000)

        if #dealerHand > 1 then
            dealerSpeech(tableIdx, 'MINIGAME_BJACK_DEALER_' .. cards.cardValue(dealerHand[2]))
        end

        local dealRoundPlayers = getOrderedPlayers(tableIdx)
        for i = 1, #dealRoundPlayers do
            local p = dealRoundPlayers[i]
            if p.inRound then
                local c
                if round == 2 and rigSplit[p.src] and p.hand[1] then
                    rigSplit[p.src] = nil
					c = drawCardOfValue(deck, cards.cardValue(p.hand[1]))
                else
                    c = cards.takeCard(deck)
                end
                dealOne(tableIdx, p.seat, p.hand, c, false, false)
                dealerAnim(tableIdx, ('female_deal_card_player_0%s'):format(5 - p.seat))
                Wait(2000)

                if round == 2 and cards.handValue(p.hand) == 21 then
                    local mult = (config.tables[tableIdx].payoutMultipliers and config.tables[tableIdx].payoutMultipliers.blackjack) or 2.5
                    local payout = math.floor(p.bet * mult)
                    TriggerCasinoEvent('rhd_casino_blackjack:client:gameEndReaction', p.src, 'good')
                    giveChips(p.src, payout, math.max(payout - p.bet, 0))
                    p.inRound = false
                    dealerSpeech(tableIdx, 'MINIGAME_BJACK_DEALER_BLACKJACK')
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

---@param tableIdx integer
---@param p BJ_PlayerData
---@param hand string[]
---@param deck string[]
---@param isSplit boolean
---@return boolean continued
local function playerTurnLoop(tableIdx, p, hand, deck, isSplit)
    while #hand < 5 do
        if not tablePlayers[tableIdx][p.src] then return false end

        if cards.handValue(hand) >= 21 then return true end

        if isSplit then
            dealerAnim(tableIdx, ('female_hit_second_card_player_0%s'):format(5 - p.seat))
            Wait(600)
        else
            dealerAnim(tableIdx, ('female_dealer_focus_player_0%s_idle'):format(5 - p.seat))
        end
        dealerSpeech(tableIdx, 'MINIGAME_BJACK_DEALER_ANOTHER_CARD')

        TriggerCasinoEvent('rhd_casino_blackjack:client:phase', p.src,
            tableIdx, 'move', config.moveTime, isSplit)

        local canDouble = (#hand == 2) and (isSplit and not p.splitDoubled or not isSplit and not p.doubled)
        local move = lib.callback.await(
            'rhd_casino_blackjack:callback:requestMove',
            p.src, tableIdx, config.moveTime,
            canDouble,
            (not isSplit) and canSplit(hand)
        ) or 'stand'

        if not tablePlayers[tableIdx][p.src] then return false end

        if move == 'hit' then
            local c
            if rigBlackjack[p.src] then
                rigBlackjack[p.src] = nil
                local need = 21 - cards.handValue(hand)
                if need >= 2 and need <= 11 then
                    c = drawCardOfValue(deck, need)
                else
                    c = cards.takeCard(deck)
                end
            else
                c = cards.takeCard(deck)
            end
            dealOne(tableIdx, p.seat, hand, c, false, isSplit)
            dealerAnim(tableIdx, (isSplit and 'female_hit_second_card_player_0%s' or 'female_hit_card_player_0%s'):format(5 - p.seat))
            Wait(1500)

            local v = cards.handValue(hand)
            if v == 21 then
                dealerSpeech(tableIdx, 'MINIGAME_BJACK_DEALER_21')
                return true
            elseif v > 21 then
                TriggerCasinoEvent('rhd_casino_blackjack:client:gameEndReaction', p.src, 'bad')
                dealerSpeech(tableIdx, 'MINIGAME_BJACK_DEALER_PLAYER_BUST')
                return false
            else
                dealerSpeech(tableIdx, 'MINIGAME_BJACK_DEALER_' .. v)
            end
        elseif move == 'double' and #hand == 2 and (isSplit and not p.splitDoubled or not isSplit and not p.doubled) then
            local doubleCost = isSplit and p.splitBet or p.bet
            if takeChips(p.src, doubleCost) then
                if isSplit then
                    p.splitDoubled = true
                    p.splitBet = p.splitBet * 2
                    BroadcastCasinoPlayers(
                        'rhd_casino_blackjack:client:placeChip',
                        tableIdx, p.seat, doubleCost, true, true
                    )
                else
                    p.doubled = true
                    p.bet = p.bet * 2
                    BroadcastCasinoPlayers(
                        'rhd_casino_blackjack:client:placeChip',
                        tableIdx, p.seat, doubleCost, true, false
                    )
                end

                local c = cards.takeCard(deck)
                dealOne(tableIdx, p.seat, hand, c, false, isSplit, true)
                dealerAnim(tableIdx, (isSplit and 'female_hit_second_card_player_0%s' or 'female_hit_card_player_0%s'):format(5 - p.seat))
                Wait(1500)

                local v = cards.handValue(hand)
                if v > 21 then
                    TriggerCasinoEvent('rhd_casino_blackjack:client:gameEndReaction', p.src, 'bad')
                    dealerSpeech(tableIdx, 'MINIGAME_BJACK_DEALER_PLAYER_BUST')
                    return false
                else
                    dealerSpeech(tableIdx, 'MINIGAME_BJACK_DEALER_' .. v)
                    return true
                end
            end
        elseif move == 'split' and not isSplit and canSplit(hand) and not p.splitDone then
            if takeChips(p.src, p.bet) then
                p.splitDone = true
                p.splitBet = p.bet
                p.splitHand = { table.remove(hand, 2) }

                dealerAnim(tableIdx, ('female_split_card_player_0%s'):format(5 - p.seat))
                BroadcastCasinoPlayers(
                    'rhd_casino_blackjack:client:placeChip',
                    tableIdx, p.seat, p.bet, false, true
                )
                BroadcastCasinoPlayers(
                    'rhd_casino_blackjack:client:split',
                    tableIdx, p.seat, #p.splitHand, p.hand, p.splitHand
                )
                Wait(1000)

                local c1 = cards.takeCard(deck)
                dealOne(tableIdx, p.seat, p.hand, c1, false, false)
                dealerAnim(tableIdx, ('female_hit_card_player_0%s'):format(5 - p.seat))
                Wait(1200)

                local c2 = cards.takeCard(deck)
                dealOne(tableIdx, p.seat, p.splitHand, c2, false, true)
                dealerAnim(tableIdx, ('female_hit_second_card_player_0%s'):format(5 - p.seat))
                Wait(1200)
            end
        else
            return true
        end
    end
    return true
end

---@param tableIdx integer
---@param deck string[]
local function phasePlayers(tableIdx, deck)
    tableState[tableIdx] = 'playing'

    local orderedPlayers = getOrderedPlayers(tableIdx)
    for i = 1, #orderedPlayers do
        local p = orderedPlayers[i]
        if p.inRound and tablePlayers[tableIdx][p.src] then
            dealerAnim(tableIdx, ('female_dealer_focus_player_0%s_idle_intro'):format(5 - p.seat))
            Wait(800)

            local handAlive = playerTurnLoop(tableIdx, p, p.hand, deck, false)

            if not tablePlayers[tableIdx][p.src] then
                BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_blackjack:client:retrieveCards', tableIdx, p.seat)
            elseif p.splitHand then
                dealerAnim(tableIdx, ('female_hit_second_card_player_0%s'):format(5 - p.seat))
                Wait(800)
                playerTurnLoop(tableIdx, p, p.splitHand, deck, true)
            end

            dealerAnim(tableIdx, ('female_dealer_focus_player_0%s_idle_outro'):format(5 - p.seat))
            Wait(800)
        end
    end
end

---@param tableIdx integer
---@param deck string[]
---@param dealerHand string[]
local function phaseDealer(tableIdx, deck, dealerHand)
    tableState[tableIdx] = 'dealer'

    local anyAlive = false
    for _, p in pairs(tablePlayers[tableIdx]) do
        if p.inRound then
            if cards.handValue(p.hand) <= 21 then anyAlive = true break end
            if p.splitHand and cards.handValue(p.splitHand) <= 21 then anyAlive = true break end
        end
    end

    if not anyAlive then return end

    dealerAnim(tableIdx, 'female_turn_card')
    BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_blackjack:client:dealerTurnOverCard', tableIdx)
    Wait(2000)

    dealerSpeech(tableIdx, 'MINIGAME_BJACK_DEALER_' .. cards.handValue(dealerHand))
    Wait(1000)

    local rigWin = not shared.rollDifficulty(config.Difficulty)
    local best = 0
    if rigWin then
        for _, p in pairs(tablePlayers[tableIdx]) do
            if p.inRound then
                local v = cards.handValue(p.hand)
                if v <= 21 and v > best then best = v end
                if p.splitHand then
                    local sv = cards.handValue(p.splitHand)
                    if sv <= 21 and sv > best then best = sv end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    while cards.handValue(dealerHand) < 17 do
        local c
        if rigWin and best > 0 then
            c = drawDealerWinningCard(deck, dealerHand, best) or cards.takeCard(deck)
        else
            c = cards.takeCard(deck)
        end
        table.insert(dealerHand, c)
        BroadcastCasinoPlayers(
            'rhd_casino_blackjack:client:giveCard',
            tableIdx, 0, #dealerHand, c, false, false
        )
        dealerAnim(tableIdx, 'female_deal_card_self_second_card')
        Wait(2200)

        dealerSpeech(tableIdx, 'MINIGAME_BJACK_DEALER_' .. cards.handValue(dealerHand))
    end

    if cards.handValue(dealerHand) > 21 then
        dealerSpeech(tableIdx, 'MINIGAME_DEALER_BUSTS')
    end
end

---@param tableIdx integer
---@param dealerHand string[]
local function phaseResolve(tableIdx, dealerHand)
    tableState[tableIdx] = 'resolving'

    local mults = config.tables[tableIdx].payoutMultipliers or { blackjack = 2.5, win = 2.0, push = 1.0 }
    local dealerVal = cards.handValue(dealerHand)
    local dealerBust = dealerVal > 21

    for _, p in pairs(tablePlayers[tableIdx]) do
        if p.inRound then
            local handsToCheck = { { hand = p.hand, bet = p.bet } }
            if p.splitHand then
                handsToCheck[#handsToCheck + 1] = { hand = p.splitHand, bet = p.splitBet }
            end

            local winAmount = 0
            local totalBet = 0
            local outcome = 'bad'

            for i = 1, #handsToCheck do
                local hData = handsToCheck[i]
                local v = cards.handValue(hData.hand)
                local hBet = hData.bet
                totalBet = totalBet + hBet
                if v > 21 then
                    -- player bust always loses
                elseif dealerBust or v > dealerVal then
                    winAmount = winAmount + (hBet * (mults.win or 2.0))
                    outcome = 'good'
                elseif v == dealerVal then
                    winAmount = winAmount + (hBet * (mults.push or 1.0))
                    if outcome == 'bad' then outcome = 'impartial' end
                end
            end

            if winAmount > 0 then
                giveChips(p.src, math.floor(winAmount), math.max(winAmount - totalBet, 0))
            end

            local netLoss = totalBet - winAmount
            if netLoss > 0 then
                shared.depositCasinoLoss(p.src, netLoss, 'blackjack')
            end
            TriggerCasinoEvent('rhd_casino_blackjack:client:gameEndReaction', p.src, outcome)
        end
    end

    if dealerBust then
        dealerAnim(tableIdx, 'female_dealer_reaction_bad_var0' .. math.random(1, 3))
    elseif dealerVal >= 17 then
        dealerAnim(tableIdx, 'female_dealer_reaction_impartial_var0' .. math.random(1, 3))
    end

    Wait(2500)

    for _, p in pairs(tablePlayers[tableIdx]) do
        if p.hand and #p.hand > 0 then
            dealerAnim(tableIdx, ('female_retrieve_cards_player_0%s'):format(5 - p.seat))
            Wait(400)
            BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_blackjack:client:retrieveCards', tableIdx, p.seat)
            Wait(800)
        end
    end

    dealerAnim(tableIdx, 'female_retrieve_own_cards_and_remove')
    Wait(500)
    BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_blackjack:client:retrieveCards', tableIdx, 0)
    Wait(800)
end

local function startTableThread(tableIdx)
    if tableActive[tableIdx] then return end
    tableActive[tableIdx] = true

    CreateThread(function()
        Wait(2500)

        while countPlayers(tableIdx) > 0 do
            resetRoundData(tableIdx)

            phaseBetting(tableIdx)

            local anyIn = false
            for _, p in pairs(tablePlayers[tableIdx]) do
                if p.inRound then anyIn = true break end
            end

            if not anyIn then
                tableState[tableIdx] = 'idle'
                Wait(2000)
                goto continue
            end

            do
                local deck = cards.getDeck()
                local dealerHand = {}

                phaseDealing(tableIdx, deck, dealerHand)

                if cards.handValue(dealerHand) == 21 then
                    dealerAnim(tableIdx, 'female_check_and_turn_card')
                    BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_blackjack:client:dealerTurnOverCard', tableIdx)
                    Wait(1500)
                    dealerSpeech(tableIdx, 'MINIGAME_BJACK_DEALER_BLACKJACK')

                    for _, p in pairs(tablePlayers[tableIdx]) do
                        if p.inRound and cards.handValue(p.hand) ~= 21 then
                            shared.depositCasinoLoss(p.src, p.bet, 'blackjack')
                            TriggerCasinoEvent('rhd_casino_blackjack:client:gameEndReaction', p.src, 'bad')
                        end
                    end
                    Wait(3000)
                else
                    phasePlayers(tableIdx, deck)
                    phaseDealer(tableIdx, deck, dealerHand)
                    phaseResolve(tableIdx, dealerHand)
                end

                clearTableVisuals(tableIdx)
                Wait(1500)
            end

            ::continue::
        end

        tableState[tableIdx] = 'idle'
        tableActive[tableIdx] = false
    end)
end

local function removePlayer(src)
    local data = playerSeats[src]
    if not data then return end

    playerSeats[src] = nil
    local p = tablePlayers[data.tableIdx][src]
    if not p then return end

    if p.pendingBet and p.pendingBet > 0 and tableState[data.tableIdx] == 'betting' then
        p.pendingBet = 0
    end

    tablePlayers[data.tableIdx][src] = nil
    BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_blackjack:client:retrieveCards', data.tableIdx, p.seat)
    dealerSpeech(data.tableIdx, 'MINIGAME_DEALER_LEAVE_NEUTRAL_GAME')
end

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_blackjack:callback:sitDown', function(source, tableIdx, seat)
    if type(tableIdx) ~= 'number' or not config.tables[tableIdx] then return false end
    if type(seat) ~= 'number' or seat < 1 or seat > 4 then return false end

    local configTable = config.tables[tableIdx]

    if configTable.vipOnly and not shared.checkVIP(source) then
        return false, 'Meja ini hanya untuk pemain VIP. Dapatkan VIP untuk bisa bermain di meja ini!'
    end

    if playerSeats[source] then return false end
    if isSeatTaken(tableIdx, seat) then return false end

    local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(GetPlayerPed(source))
    local tableCoords = configTable.coords
    if #(playerCoords - vec3(tableCoords.x, tableCoords.y, tableCoords.z)) > 4.5 then
        return false
    end

    tablePlayers[tableIdx][source] = {
        src = source,
        seat = seat,
        bet = 0,
        splitBet = 0,
        pendingBet = 0,
        hand = {},
        splitHand = nil,
        inRound = false,
        doubled = false,
        splitDoubled = false,
        splitDone = false,
        betConfirmed = false,
    }
    playerSeats[source] = { tableIdx = tableIdx, seat = seat }

    dealerSpeech(tableIdx, 'MINIGAME_DEALER_GREET')
    startTableThread(tableIdx)

    local remaining = config.bettingTime
    if tableState[tableIdx] == 'betting' and tableBettingDeadline[tableIdx] then
        remaining = math.max(1, math.ceil((tableBettingDeadline[tableIdx] - GetGameTimer()) / 1000))
    end

    return true, tableState[tableIdx] or 'idle', remaining
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_blackjack:callback:getState', function(source)
    local data = playerSeats[source]
    if not data then return false end

    local remaining = 0
    if tableState[data.tableIdx] == 'betting' and tableBettingDeadline[data.tableIdx] then
        remaining = math.max(
            0,
            math.ceil((tableBettingDeadline[data.tableIdx] - GetGameTimer()) / 1000)
        )
    end

    return true, tableState[data.tableIdx] or 'idle', remaining
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_blackjack:callback:standUp', function(source)
    local data = playerSeats[source]
    if not data then return true end
    local p = tablePlayers[data.tableIdx] and tablePlayers[data.tableIdx][source]
    if not p then
        playerSeats[source] = nil
        return true
    end

    if p.inRound then return false end

    removePlayer(source)
    return true
end)

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_casino_blackjack:server:leaveTable', function()
    local data = playerSeats[source]
    if not data then return end
    local p = tablePlayers[data.tableIdx] and tablePlayers[data.tableIdx][source]
    if not p then return end

    if p.inRound then return end

    removePlayer(source)
end)

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    removePlayer(source)
    rigBlackjack[source] = nil
    rigSplit[source] = nil
end)

AddEventHandler('rhd_casino:releasePlayer', function(playerId)
    removePlayer(playerId)
    rigBlackjack[playerId] = nil
    rigSplit[playerId] = nil
end)

lib.addCommand('setblackjack', {
    help = 'Rig the next blackjack hit for a player to land exactly 21.',
    params = {
        { name = 'target', type = 'playerId', help = 'Player server id (defaults to self)' },
    },
    restricted = 'group.admin',
}, function(source, args)
    local target = args.target or source
    if not playerSeats[target] then
        return lib.notify(source, { type = 'error', description = ('Player %s is not seated at a blackjack table.'):format(target) })
    end
    rigBlackjack[target] = true
    lib.notify(source, { type = 'success', description = ('Player %s will hit blackjack on next hit.'):format(target) })
end)

lib.addCommand('setsplit', {
    help = 'Force a player to be dealt a splittable pair this round (must be in betting phase).',
    params = {
        { name = 'target', type = 'playerId', help = 'Player server id (defaults to self)' },
    },
    restricted = 'group.admin',
}, function(source, args)
    local target = args.target or source
    local seatData = playerSeats[target]
    if not seatData then
        return lib.notify(source, { type = 'error', description = ('Player %s is not seated at a blackjack table.'):format(target) })
    end
    if tableState[seatData.tableIdx] ~= 'betting' then
        return lib.notify(source, { type = 'error', description = 'This command can only be used during the betting phase.' })
    end
    rigSplit[target] = true
    lib.notify(source, { type = 'success', description = ('Player %s will be dealt a splittable pair this round.'):format(target) })
end)

---@param tbl string[]
---@return string[]
function cards.shuffle(tbl)
	for i = #tbl, 2, -1 do
		local j = math.random(i)
		tbl[i], tbl[j] = tbl[j], tbl[i]
	end
	return tbl
end

---@return string[]
function cards.getDeck()
	local tDeck = {}
	for i = 1, #ranks do
		for j = 1, #suits do
			table.insert(tDeck, suits[j] .. '_' .. ranks[i])
		end
	end
	return cards.shuffle(tDeck)
end

---@param tDeck string[]
---@return string?
function cards.takeCard(tDeck)
	return table.remove(tDeck, 1)
end

---@param hand string[]
---@return integer
function cards.handValue(hand)
	local tmpValue = 0
	local numAces = 0

	for i = 1, #hand do
		tmpValue = tmpValue + cards.cardValue(hand[i])
	end

	for i = 1, #hand do
		if string.find(hand[i], 'ACE') then numAces = numAces + 1 end
	end

	repeat
		if tmpValue > 21 and numAces > 0 then
			tmpValue = tmpValue - 10
			numAces = numAces - 1
		else
			break
		end
	until numAces == 0

	return tmpValue
end

---@param card string
---@return integer
function cards.cardValue(card)
    local rank = 10
    for i=2,11 do
        if string.find(card, tostring(i)) then
            rank = i
        end
    end
    if string.find(card, 'ACE') then
        rank = 11
    end

    return rank
end

return cards

---@param key string

    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'setVariable', key = key, value = value })

local function loadPokerTable()
    if pokerTablesLoaded or pokerTablesLoading then return end
    pokerTablesLoading = true
    cacheEntities.tables = cacheEntities.tables or {}
    cacheEntities.dealerPeds = cacheEntities.dealerPeds or {}
    lib.requestAnimDict(pokerConfig.dealerAnimDictShared, 25000)
    lib.requestAnimDict(pokerConfig.playerAnimDictShared, 25000)

    for i = 1, #pokerTables do
        local v = pokerTables[i]
        if not cacheEntities.tables[v.id] then
            lib.requestModel(pokerTableModel, 25000)
            local obj = CreateObjectNoOffset(pokerTableModel, v.coords.x, v.coords.y, v.coords.z, false, false, false)
            SetEntityRotation(obj, 0.0, 0.0, v.coords.w, 2, true)
            SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(pokerTableModel)
            PlaceObjectOnGroundProperly(obj)
            cacheEntities.tables[v.id] = obj

            local outfitPool = v.dealerOutfit
            local outfit = outfitPool[math.random(1, #outfitPool)]
            local dealerPos = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(obj, -1.0, 0.0, 0.0)
            local dealerPed = spawnDealer[outfit](vector4(dealerPos.x, dealerPos.y, v.coords.z - 1.0, v.coords.w + 270.0))
            Wait(0)

            local scenePos = GetObjectOffsetFromCoords(v.coords.x, v.coords.y, v.coords.z, v.coords.w, -0.3, 0.0, 0.0)
            local scene = CreateSynchronizedScene(scenePos.x, scenePos.y, scenePos.z, 0.0, 0.0, v.coords.w + 90.0, 2)
            TaskSynchronizedScene(
                dealerPed, scene,
                pokerConfig.dealerAnimDictShared, 'idle',
                1000.0, -2.0, -1.0, 33, 1000.0, 0
            )
            NetworkStartSynchronisedScene(scene)
            cacheEntities.dealerPeds[v.id] = dealerPed
        end
    end
    pokerTablesLoaded = true
    pokerTablesLoading = false
end

---@param index integer
---@param offsetVec vector3
---@param headingOffset number
---@return vector3|nil, number|nil
local function calculateChairCoords(index, offsetVec, headingOffset)
    local tableEntity = cacheEntities.tables[index]
    if not DoesEntityExist(tableEntity) then return end

    local tableCoords = GetEntityCoords(tableEntity)
    local tableHeading = GetEntityHeading(tableEntity)
    local worldPos = GetObjectOffsetFromCoords(
        tableCoords.x, tableCoords.y, tableCoords.z, tableHeading,
        offsetVec.x, offsetVec.y, offsetVec.z
    )
    return worldPos, tableHeading + headingOffset
end

local function unloadPokerTables()
    if not pokerTablesLoaded and not pokerTablesLoading then return end
    pokerTablesLoading = false
    pokerTablesLoaded = false

    for i = 1, #pokerTables do
        local v = pokerTables[i]
        if cacheEntities.tables?[v.id] then
            DeleteEntity(cacheEntities.tables[v.id])
            cacheEntities.tables[v.id] = nil
        end
        if cacheEntities.dealerPeds?[v.id] then
            DeleteEntity(cacheEntities.dealerPeds[v.id])
            cacheEntities.dealerPeds[v.id] = nil
        end
    end
end

---@param index integer
---@param chairOffset vector3
---@param chairHeading number
local function sitDownClient(index, chairOffset, chairHeading)
    local tableEntity = cacheEntities.tables[index]
    if not DoesEntityExist(tableEntity) then return end

    local chairPos, chairFacing = calculateChairCoords(index, chairOffset, chairHeading)
    if not (chairPos and chairFacing) then return end

    ---@cast chairPos vector3
    ---@cast chairFacing number
    setCefVariable('joined', true)
    SetPlayerControl(cache.ped, false, 0)

    local enterScene = NetworkCreateSynchronisedScene(
        chairPos.x, chairPos.y, chairPos.z,
        0.0, 0.0, chairFacing,
        2, true, false, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0
    )
    local enterAnimName = enterAnim[math.random(1, #enterAnim)]
    NetworkAddPedToSynchronisedScene(
        cache.ped, enterScene, pokerConfig.playerAnimDictShared, enterAnimName, 2.0, -2.0, 13, 16, 2.0, 0)
    NetworkStartSynchronisedScene(enterScene)
    Wait(4000)

    if activeTable ~= index or IsEntityDead(cache.ped) then
        ClearPedTasksImmediately(cache.ped)
        return
    end

    local activeScene = NetworkCreateSynchronisedScene(
        chairPos.x, chairPos.y, chairPos.z,
        0.0, 0.0, chairFacing,
        2, true, false, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0
    )
    NetworkAddPedToSynchronisedScene(
        cache.ped, activeScene, pokerConfig.playerAnimDictShared, 'idle_cardgames', 2.0, -2.0, 13, 16, 1000.0, 0)
    NetworkStartSynchronisedScene(activeScene)
    SetPlayerControl(cache.ped, true, 0)
end

---@param index integer
---@param chairOffset vector3
---@param chairFacing number
local function standUpClient(index, chairOffset, chairFacing)
    local seatCoords, seatHeading = calculateChairCoords(index, chairOffset, chairFacing)
    if not (seatCoords and seatHeading) then return end

    local exitScene = NetworkCreateSynchronisedScene(
        seatCoords.x, seatCoords.y, seatCoords.z,
        0.0, 0.0, seatHeading,
        2, true, false, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0
    )
    NetworkAddPedToSynchronisedScene(
        cache.ped, exitScene, pokerConfig.playerAnimDictShared, 'sit_exit_left', 2.0, -2.0, 13, 16, 2.0, 0)
    NetworkStartSynchronisedScene(exitScene)
    Wait(4000)

    TriggerServerEvent('AquiverTexasPoker:standUp', index)
    NetworkStopSynchronisedScene(exitScene)
end

---@param index integer
---@param state boolean
local function openTable(index, state)
    if state then
        if currentCam and DoesCamExist(currentCam) then
            DestroyCam(currentCam, false)
        end

        local tableEntity = cacheEntities.tables[index]
        if not DoesEntityExist(tableEntity) then return end

        local tableCoords = GetEntityCoords(tableEntity)
        local camPos = tableCoords + vector3(0.0, 0.0, 2.5)
        currentCam = CreateCamWithParams(
            'DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA',
            camPos.x, camPos.y, camPos.z,
            -90.0, 0.0, GetEntityHeading(tableEntity) + 90.0,
            90.0, true, 2
        )
        SetCamActive(currentCam, true)
        RenderScriptCams(true, true, 900, true, false)

        if not pokerConfig.AntiCheatRadarDebug then
            DisplayRadar(false)
        end

        setCefVariable('opened', true)
        pcall(function()
            local hud = exports.sm_hud
            hud:setComponentVisible('compass', false)
            hud:setComponentVisible('information', false)
            hud:setComponentVisible('healthArmor', false)
        end)
    else
        RenderScriptCams(false, true, 900, false, false)

        if currentCam and DoesCamExist(currentCam) then
            DestroyCam(currentCam, false)
        end

        if not pokerConfig.AntiCheatRadarDebug then
            DisplayRadar(true)
        end
        
        pcall(function()
            local hud = exports.sm_hud
            hud:setComponentVisible('compass', true)
            hud:setComponentVisible('information', true)
            hud:setComponentVisible('healthArmor', true)
        end)
    end

    activeTable = state and index or nil
end

_ENV.CasinoPoker = {}
---@param source number
---@param message string
function CasinoPoker.notify(source, message)
    return TriggerCasinoEvent('rhd_casino_holdemPoker:notify', source, message)
end

---@param source number
---@return integer|nil
function CasinoPoker.getPlayerTableId(source)
    return lib.array.find(CasinoPoker.tables, function (table)
        return lib.array.includes(table._playersOpened, source)
    end)?._index
end

---@param source number
---@return PokerTable|nil
function CasinoPoker.getInstanceBySource(source)
    local tableId = CasinoPoker.getPlayerTableId(source)
    if not tableId then return end
    return CasinoPoker.tables[tableId]
end

local restoring = {}

---@param source number
---@return boolean
function CasinoPoker.restoreSavedChips(source)
    if restoring[source] then return false end

    local identifier = shared.getIdentifier(source)
    if not identifier then return false end

    restoring[source] = true
    local restoredAll = true

    for index, instance in pairs(CasinoPoker.tables) do
        local seat = instance:getPlayerChairData(source)
        local saved = (not seat or seat.disconnected) and shared.loadBuyIn(identifier --[[@as string]], index)

        if saved then
            if saved.chips > 0 and not shared.addChip(source, saved.chips) then
                restoredAll = false
                lib.notify(source, {
                    title = 'Casino Poker',
                    description = ('Inventory penuh. %s chip poker tersimpan belum bisa dikembalikan.'):format(saved.chips),
                    type = 'error',
                })
            else
                shared.clearBuyIn(identifier --[[@as string]], index)

                if saved.chips > 0 then
                    lib.notify(source, {
                        title = 'Casino Poker',
                        description = ('%s chip dari sesi poker sebelumnya sudah dikembalikan ke inventory.'):format(saved.chips),
                        type = 'success',
                    })
                    shared.log({
                        title = 'Poker Chips Restored',
                        type = 'money',
                        fields = {
                            { name = 'Player', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(shared.getPlayerName(source), source) },
                            { name = 'Table', value = tostring(index), inline = true },
                            { name = 'Chips', value = ('%s chips'):format(saved.chips), inline = true },
                        },
                    })
                end
            end
        end
    end

    restoring[source] = nil
    return restoredAll
end

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_casino_holdemPoker:fold', function()
    local source = source

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_holdemPoker:canJoin', function (source, index)
    index = math.floor(tonumber(index) or 0)
    local instance = CasinoPoker.tables[index]
    if not instance then return false end
    if not instance:isPlayerNear(source) then return false end

    for _, tableInstance in pairs(CasinoPoker.tables) do
        if tableInstance:isPlayerSitAtTable(source) then
            return false
        end
    end

    if not instance:getFreeChairId() then
        return lib.notify(source, {
            title = 'Poker',
            description = 'Semua kursi di meja ini sedang digunakan.',
            type = 'error',
        })
    end
    
    if instance._vipOnly and not shared.checkVIP(source) then
        return lib.notify(source, {
            title = 'Akses Ditolak',
            description = 'Meja ini hanya untuk pemain VIP. Dapatkan VIP untuk bisa bermain di meja ini!',
            type = 'error',
        })
    end
    
    return true
end)

---@param source number
---@param dropped boolean
local function releasePlayer(source, dropped)
    for _, instance in pairs(CasinoPoker.tables) do
        local inOpened = lib.array.includes(instance._playersOpened, source)
        local inChair = instance:isPlayerSitAtTable(source)
        if inOpened or inChair then
            local playerData = inChair and instance:getPlayerChairData(source)
            if playerData and playerData.disconnected then return end

            instance:openedStatePlayer(source, false, dropped)
            break
        end
    end
end

    releasePlayer(source, true)
end)

    releasePlayer(playerId, reason == 'disconnect')
end)

    end
end)

            type = 'inform',
            duration = 8000,
        })
    elseif savedBuyIn then
        shared.clearBuyIn(identifier)
    end
end)

local function getCardRank(card)
    return tonumber(card:sub(2)) or 2
end

local function getCardSuit(card)
    return card:sub(1, 1)
end

---@param holeCards string[]
---@param communityCards string[]
---@return number
local function evaluateHandStrength(holeCards, communityCards)
    local all = {}
    for i = 1, #communityCards do all[#all + 1] = communityCards[i] end
    all[#all + 1] = holeCards[1]
    all[#all + 1] = holeCards[2]
    local rankCount = {}
    local suitCount = {}
    local ranks = {}
    for i = 1, #all do
        local r = getCardRank(all[i])
        local s = getCardSuit(all[i])
        rankCount[r] = (rankCount[r] or 0) + 1
        suitCount[s] = (suitCount[s] or 0) + 1
        ranks[#ranks + 1] = r
    end
    local pairs_, threes, fours = 0, 0, 0
    for _, cnt in pairs(rankCount) do
        if cnt == 4 then fours = fours + 1
        elseif cnt == 3 then threes = threes + 1
        elseif cnt == 2 then pairs_ = pairs_ + 1
        end
    end
    local hasFlush = false
    for _, cnt in pairs(suitCount) do
        if cnt >= 5 then hasFlush = true; break end
    end
    local seen = {}
    local uniqRanks = {}
    for i = 1, #ranks do
        local r = ranks[i]
        if not seen[r] then seen[r] = true; uniqRanks[#uniqRanks + 1] = r end
    end
    table.sort(uniqRanks, function(a, b) return a > b end)
    if uniqRanks[1] == 14 then uniqRanks[#uniqRanks + 1] = 1 end
    local hasStraight = false
    local consec = 1
    for i = 2, #uniqRanks do
        if uniqRanks[i - 1] - uniqRanks[i] == 1 then
            consec = consec + 1
            if consec >= 5 then hasStraight = true; break end
        else
            consec = 1
        end
    end
    if hasStraight and hasFlush then return 9 end
    if fours >= 1 then return 8 end
    if threes >= 1 and pairs_ >= 1 then return 7 end
    if hasFlush then return 6 end
    if hasStraight then return 5 end
    if threes >= 1 then return 4 end
    if pairs_ >= 2 then return 3 end
    if pairs_ >= 1 then return 2 end
    return 1
end

---@param holeCards string[]
---@return number
local function evaluatePreFlop(holeCards)
    local r1 = getCardRank(holeCards[1])
    local r2 = getCardRank(holeCards[2])
    local s1 = getCardSuit(holeCards[1])
    local s2 = getCardSuit(holeCards[2])
    local score = 0
    if r1 == r2 then
        score = 4 + math.floor(r1 / 5)
    else
        local hi = math.max(r1, r2)
        local lo = math.min(r1, r2)
        local suited = s1 == s2
        local gap = hi - lo
        score = math.floor((hi / 14) * 3.5)
        if suited then score = score + 1 end
        if gap <= 1 then score = score + 1 end
        if gap <= 2 then score = score + 0.5 end
        if hi >= 13 then score = score + 1 end
        if lo >= 10 then score = score + 0.5 end
    end
    return math.max(1, math.min(9, math.floor(score)))
end

---@param instance PokerTable
---@param botSrc number
local function makeBotDecision(instance, botSrc)
    local playerData = instance:getPlayerChairData(botSrc)
    if not playerData then return end
    local bot = BotManager:getBot(botSrc)
    if not bot then return end
    if not instance:isPlayerCurrentPlayer(botSrc) then return end
    local community = instance._dealerCards
    local holeCards = playerData.cards
    local strength = 1
    if #holeCards >= 2 then
        if #community == 0 then
            strength = evaluatePreFlop(holeCards)
        else
            strength = evaluateHandStrength(holeCards, community)
        end
    end
    local sr = strength / 9.0
    local foldThreshold, raiseThreshold
    local p = bot.personality
    if p == BOT_PERSONALITIES.AGGRESSIVE then
        foldThreshold = 0.08
        raiseThreshold = 0.35
    elseif p == BOT_PERSONALITIES.PASSIVE then
        foldThreshold = 0.25
        raiseThreshold = 0.85
    elseif p == BOT_PERSONALITIES.TIGHT then
        foldThreshold = 0.45
        raiseThreshold = 0.72
    else
        foldThreshold = 0.22
        raiseThreshold = 0.58
    end
    local rand = math.random()
    local bluff = rand < 0.10
    local canCheck = instance:canPass(botSrc)
    local callAmount = instance:calculateCall(botSrc)
    local botChips = shared.getChip(botSrc)
    local blind = instance._blind
    local highestBet = instance:getHighestBet()
    local raiseAmt
    if highestBet > 0 then
        raiseAmt = math.floor(highestBet * 2.5)
    else
        raiseAmt = math.floor(blind * (2 + math.random(1, 3)))
    end
    if bluff and sr < foldThreshold then
        if botChips >= raiseAmt and raiseAmt > callAmount then
            instance:betPoker(botSrc, { amount = raiseAmt })
            return
        end
    end
    if sr >= raiseThreshold then
        if botChips >= raiseAmt and raiseAmt > callAmount then
            instance:betPoker(botSrc, { amount = raiseAmt })
        elseif callAmount <= botChips and callAmount > 0 then
            instance:callPoker(botSrc)
        elseif canCheck then
            instance:passPoker(botSrc)
        else
            instance:allInPoker(botSrc)
        end
    elseif sr >= foldThreshold then
        if canCheck then
            instance:passPoker(botSrc)
        elseif callAmount <= botChips then
            instance:callPoker(botSrc)
        else
            instance:throwPoker(botSrc)
        end
    else
        if canCheck then
            instance:passPoker(botSrc)
        else
            instance:throwPoker(botSrc)
        end
    end
end

local botActionPending = {}
CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(400)
        for _, instance in pairs(CasinoPoker.tables) do
            local currentSrc = instance:getCurrentPlayerSrc()
            if currentSrc and BotManager:isBot(currentSrc) then
                local key = tostring(instance._index) .. "_" .. tostring(currentSrc)
                if not botActionPending[key] then
                    botActionPending[key] = true
                    local thinkTime = math.random(BOT_THINK_MIN_MS, BOT_THINK_MAX_MS)
                    SetTimeout(thinkTime, function()
                        botActionPending[key] = nil
                        if instance:getCurrentPlayerSrc() == currentSrc then
                            local ok, err = pcall(makeBotDecision, instance, currentSrc)
                            if not ok then
                                lib.print.error(("[PokerBot] Decision error: %s"):format(err))
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

---@param tableId integer
---@param personality? string
---@param name? string
---@return number|false
function BotManager:addBotToTable(tableId, personality, name)
    local instance = CasinoPoker.tables[tableId]
    if not instance then
        lib.print.warn(("[PokerBot] Table %s tidak ditemukan"):format(tableId))
        return false
    end
    if instance._gamestage ~= 1 then
        lib.print.warn("[PokerBot] Tidak bisa join saat permainan berlangsung.")
        return false
    end
    local freeChairId = instance:getFreeChairId()
    if not freeChairId then
        lib.print.warn(("[PokerBot] Tidak ada kursi kosong di meja %s"):format(tableId))
        return false
    end
    local botSrc = self:createBot(name, personality)
    local bot = self.bots[botSrc]
    local botGender = math.random(2) == 1 and 'male' or 'female'
    table.insert(instance._chairPlayers, {
        src = botSrc,
        cards = {},
        throwed = false,
        passed = false,
        dealer = false,
        playername = "[BOT] " .. bot.name,
        roundbet = 0,
        chairId = freeChairId,
        wasInRound = false,
        chips = bot.chips,
        img = botGender == 'female' and 'images/user/user-women.png' or 'images/user/user-man.png',
        gender = botGender,
        isBot = true,
    })
    instance:update("everyone", "players")
    lib.print.info(('[PokerBot] %s bergabung ke meja %s (src: %s, personality: %s)')
        :format(bot.name, tableId, botSrc, bot.personality))
    return botSrc
end

---@param tableId integer
---@param botSrc number
function BotManager:removeBotFromTable(tableId, botSrc)
    local instance = CasinoPoker.tables[tableId]
    if not instance then
        lib.print.warn(("[PokerBot] Table %s tidak ditemukan"):format(tableId))
        return
    end
    if not BotManager:isBot(botSrc) then
        lib.print.warn(("[PokerBot] Source %s bukan bot"):format(botSrc))
        return
    end
    if instance._gamestage == 2 and instance:isPlayerCurrentPlayer(botSrc) then
        botActionPending[tostring(tableId) .. "_" .. tostring(botSrc)] = nil
        local ok, err = pcall(instance.throwPoker, instance, botSrc, true)
        if not ok then lib.print.error("[PokerBot] Error force-fold: " .. tostring(err)) end
    end
    for i = 1, #instance._chairPlayers do
        local p = instance._chairPlayers[i]
        if p.src == botSrc then
            table.remove(instance._chairPlayers, i)
            break
        end
    end
    local botName = self.bots[botSrc] and self.bots[botSrc].name or "Unknown"
    instance:update("everyone", "players")
    self:destroyBot(botSrc)
    lib.print.info(('[PokerBot] Bot %s (src: %s) dihapus dari meja %s'):format(botName, botSrc, tableId))
end

---@param instance PokerTable
---@return integer
local function countRealPlayers(instance)
    local n = 0
    for i = 1, #instance._chairPlayers do
        if not BotManager:isBot(instance._chairPlayers[i].src) then n = n + 1 end
    end
    return n
end

---@param instance PokerTable
---@return integer
local function countBots(instance)
    local n = 0
    for i = 1, #instance._chairPlayers do
        if BotManager:isBot(instance._chairPlayers[i].src) then n = n + 1 end
    end
    return n
end

---@param instance PokerTable
---@return number[]
local function getBotSrcs(instance)
    local srcs = {}
    for i = 1, #instance._chairPlayers do
        if BotManager:isBot(instance._chairPlayers[i].src) then
            srcs[#srcs + 1] = instance._chairPlayers[i].src
        end
    end
    return srcs
end

---@param instance PokerTable
---@param targetCount integer
local function fillBots(instance, targetCount)
    local botCount = countBots(instance)
    if botCount >= targetCount then return end
    if instance._gamestage ~= 1 then return end
    local toAdd = targetCount - botCount
    for _ = 1, toAdd do
        if not instance:getFreeChairId() then break end
        BotManager:addBotToTable(instance._index, AUTO_BOT_PERSONALITY)
    end
end

---@param instance PokerTable
local function removeAllBots(instance)
    local srcs = getBotSrcs(instance)
    for i = 1, #srcs do
        BotManager:removeBotFromTable(instance._index, srcs[i])
    end
end

local churnNextTick = {}
CreateThread(function()
    Wait(3000)
    local tick = 0
    while true do
        Wait(1500)
        tick = tick + 1
        for _, instance in pairs(CasinoPoker.tables) do
            local tid = instance._index
            local realCount = countRealPlayers(instance)
            local botCount = countBots(instance)
            local gameStage = instance._gamestage
            if realCount == 0 then
                if botCount > 0 then
                    removeAllBots(instance)
                end
                churnNextTick[tid] = nil
            else
                if botCount == 0 and gameStage == 1 then
                    fillBots(instance, AUTO_BOT_COUNT)
                    local interval = math.random(BOT_CHURN_INTERVAL_MIN, BOT_CHURN_INTERVAL_MAX)
                    churnNextTick[tid] = tick + math.floor(interval / 1.5)
                end
                if gameStage == 1 and botCount < AUTO_BOT_COUNT then
                    fillBots(instance, AUTO_BOT_COUNT)
                end
                if gameStage == 1 and churnNextTick[tid] and tick >= churnNextTick[tid] then
                    local srcs = getBotSrcs(instance)
                    if #srcs > 0 and math.random() < BOT_CHURN_LEAVE_CHANCE then
                        local victim = srcs[math.random(#srcs)]
                        local botName = BotManager.bots[victim] and BotManager.bots[victim].name or "?"
                        BotManager:removeBotFromTable(tid, victim)
                        local rejoinMs = math.random(BOT_REJOIN_DELAY_MIN_MS, BOT_REJOIN_DELAY_MAX_MS)
                        SetTimeout(rejoinMs, function()
                            local inst2 = CasinoPoker.tables[tid]
                            if inst2 and countRealPlayers(inst2) > 0 and inst2._gamestage == 1 then
                                BotManager:addBotToTable(tid, AUTO_BOT_PERSONALITY)
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                    local interval = math.random(BOT_CHURN_INTERVAL_MIN, BOT_CHURN_INTERVAL_MAX)
                    churnNextTick[tid] = tick + math.floor(interval / 1.5)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

---@class PokerPlayers
local Players = lib.class('PokerPlayers')

local storage = require 'modules.storage'

function Players:constructor()
    self._players = {}
    self._identifiers = {}
end

---@param source number
function Players:addPlayer(source)
    local identifier = shared.getIdentifier(source)
    if not identifier then return end

    local savedImg = storage.getPokerImage(identifier)
    if not savedImg or savedImg == '' then
        local gender = shared.getGender(source)
        savedImg = gender == 'female' and 'images/user/user-women.png' or 'images/user/user-man.png'
    end

    self._players[identifier] = {
        img = savedImg,
    }
    self._identifiers[source] = identifier
end

---@param source number
function Players:removePlayer(source)
    local identifier = self._identifiers[source]
    if not identifier then return end

    self._players[identifier] = nil
    self._identifiers[source] = nil
end

---@param source number
---@param url string
function Players:setImage(source, url)
    local identifier = self._identifiers[source]
    local player = identifier and self._players[identifier]
    if not player then return end

    player.img = url
    storage.setPokerImage(identifier, url)

    local tableId = CasinoPoker.getPlayerTableId(source)
    local tableInstance = CasinoPoker.tables[tableId]

    if tableInstance then
        tableInstance:updatePlayerImages()
    end
end

---@param source number
---@return string|nil
function Players:getPlayerImage(source)
    local identifier = self._identifiers[source]
    local player = identifier and self._players[identifier]
    return player and player.img or nil
end

---@param source number
function Players:updatePlayerChips(source)
    local instance = CasinoPoker.getInstanceBySource(source)
    local playerData = instance and instance:getPlayerChairData(source)
    local chips = playerData and playerData.chips or shared.getChip(source)
    TriggerCasinoEvent('rhd_casino_holdemPoker:setVariables', source, 'mychips', chips)
end

---@diagnostic disable-next-line: undefined-field
CasinoPoker.player = Players:new()

AddEventHandler('rhd_casino:interiorChanged', function (source, state)
    if state then
        CasinoPoker.player:addPlayer(source)
        CasinoPoker.player:updatePlayerChips(source)
    else
        CasinoPoker.player:removePlayer(source)
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    local source = source
    CasinoPoker.player:removePlayer(source)
end)

local TIMES = {

local RAKE_RATE = 0.05

local GAMESTAGE = require 'casino.holdemPoker.config'.gameStage

local Chairs = {
    { offset = vector3(-0.75, 1.43, -0.45), heading = 310.0 },
    { offset = vector3( 0.75, 1.43, -0.45), heading = 225.0 },
    { offset = vector3( 1.10, 0.00, -0.45), heading = 180.0 },
    { offset = vector3( 0.75, -1.43, -0.45), heading = 130.0 },
    { offset = vector3(-0.75, -1.43, -0.45), heading = 45.0 },

do

---@class PokerChairPlayer

---@class PokerTable
local PokerTable = lib.class("PokerTable")

---@param blind number

    self._coords = tableConfig and tableConfig.coords or nil

    self._maxBet = tableConfig and tableConfig.maxBet or nil
    self._buyIn = tableConfig and tableConfig.buyIn or (blind * 2)

    self._chairPlayers = {}
