    lib.print.info(("Poker table created: %s"):format(self._index))
end

---@param msg string
function PokerTable:debug(msg)
    lib.print.info(("PokerTable debug [%s]: %s"):format(self._index, msg))
end

function PokerTable:playBetSFX()
    local sfxes = {
        "player_bet.wav", "player_bet_2.wav", "player_bet_3.wav",
        "player_bet_4.wav", "player_bet_5.wav", "player_bet_6.wav",
    }

    local randomSfx = sfxes[math.random(#sfxes)]
    self:TCE_OnTablePlayers("rhd_casino_holdemPoker:playSound", randomSfx)
end

---@return integer
function PokerTable:count_playersTable()
    return #self._chairPlayers
end

---@return integer
function PokerTable:count_playersIngame()
    local count = 0

    for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
        local p = self._chairPlayers[i]
        if not p.throwed and not p.allined then
            count += 1
        end
    end

    return count
end

---@param source number
---@return PokerChairPlayer|nil
function PokerTable:getPlayerChairData(source)

    for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
        local p = self._chairPlayers[i]
        if p.src == source then return p end
    end

    return nil
end

---@param source number
---@return boolean
function PokerTable:isPlayerSitAtTable(source)
    return self:getPlayerChairData(source) ~= nil
end

---@param source number
---@param maxDistance? number
---@return boolean
function PokerTable:isPlayerNear(source, maxDistance)
    if not self._coords then return false end

    local ped = GetPlayerPed(source)
    if ped == 0 then return false end

    local tableCoords = vec3(self._coords.x, self._coords.y, self._coords.z)
    return #(GetEntityCoords(ped) - tableCoords) <= (maxDistance or 5.0)
end

---@param source number
---@return boolean
function PokerTable:isPlayerCurrentPlayer(source)
    return self._chairPlayers[self._currentplayer]?.src == source
end

---@return number|nil
function PokerTable:getCurrentPlayerSrc()
    return self._chairPlayers[self._currentplayer]?.src
end

---@return string
function PokerTable:getCurrentPlayerName()
    return self._chairPlayers[self._currentplayer]?.playername or "UNKNOWN_PLAYER_NAME"
end

---@return integer|nil
function PokerTable:getFreeChairId()
    self:clearExpiredChairReservations()

    for i = 1, #Chairs do
        local found = self._chairReservations[i] ~= nil
        for j = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
            if self._chairPlayers[j].chairId == i then found = true; break end
        end
        if not found then return i end
    end
    return nil
end

---@param chairId integer
---@return boolean
function PokerTable:isChairOccupied(chairId)
    for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
        if self._chairPlayers[i].chairId == chairId then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

function PokerTable:clearExpiredChairReservations()
    local now = GetGameTimer()

    for chairId, reservation in pairs(self._chairReservations) do
        if not reservation.source or not GetPlayerName(reservation.source) or now >= reservation.expiresAt then
            self._chairReservations[chairId] = nil
        end
    end
end

---@param source number
---@return integer|nil
function PokerTable:reserveFreeChair(source)
    self:clearExpiredChairReservations()

    for chairId, reservation in pairs(self._chairReservations) do
        if reservation.source == source then
            return chairId
        end
    end

    local chairId = self:getFreeChairId()
    if not chairId then return nil end

    self._chairReservations[chairId] = {
        source = source,
        expiresAt = GetGameTimer() + 60000,
    }

    return chairId
end

---@param source number
---@param chairId integer?
function PokerTable:releaseChairReservation(source, chairId)
    if chairId then
        local reservation = self._chairReservations[chairId]
        if reservation and reservation.source == source then
            self._chairReservations[chairId] = nil
        end
        return
    end

    for reservedChairId, reservation in pairs(self._chairReservations) do
        if reservation.source == source then
            self._chairReservations[reservedChairId] = nil
        end
    end
end

---@return number
function PokerTable:getHighestBet()
    local highest = 0
    for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
        local p = self._chairPlayers[i]
        if p.roundbet > highest then highest = p.roundbet end
    end
    return highest
end

---@param source number
---@return number
function PokerTable:calculateCall(source)
    local highest = self:getHighestBet()
    local playerData = self:getPlayerChairData(source)
    return highest - (playerData and playerData.roundbet or 0)
end

---@return number
function PokerTable:calculateNeededRaise()
    return self:getHighestBet() * 2
end

---Sums current round bets from all players into the main pot.
function PokerTable:declareMainPot()
    local total = 0

    for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
        total += self._chairPlayers[i].roundbet
    end

    self._mainPot += total
    self:update("everyone", "mainpot")
end

---@param amount any
---@return boolean
function PokerTable:isValidBet(amount)
    amount = type(amount) == "number" and math.floor(amount) or -1
    if amount <= 0 then return false end
    return true
end

---@param source number
---@return boolean
function PokerTable:canPass(source)
    local playerData = self:getPlayerChairData(source)
    if not playerData then return false end

    local highest = self:getHighestBet()
    if (not playerData.wasInRound and not playerData.passed and highest == 0)
        or highest == playerData.roundbet then
        return true
    end

    return false
end

---@return string
function PokerTable:getRandomCard()
    local max = #Cards
    local r = math.random(1, max)

    while self._cardIndexesExist[r] do
        r = math.random(1, max)
    end

    self._cardIndexesExist[r] = true
    return Cards[r]
end

---@param event string
---@param ... any
function PokerTable:TCE_OnTablePlayers(event, ...)
    for i = 1, #self._playersOpened do
        local src = self._playersOpened[i]
        TriggerCasinoEvent(event, tonumber(src), ...)
    end
end

---@param stage integer
function PokerTable:setGameStage(stage)
    self._gamestage = stage
    self:update("everyone", "gamestage")
end

---@param time integer
function PokerTable:setTime(time)
    self._time = time
    self:update("everyone", "timer")
end

function PokerTable:syncActionState()
    local currentSrc = self:getCurrentPlayerSrc()

    for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
        local playerData = self._chairPlayers[i]
        local isCurrentPlayer = currentSrc ~= nil and currentSrc == playerData.src
        self:setVar(playerData.src, "disableallbuttons", isCurrentPlayer)
        self:setVar(playerData.src, "canpass", isCurrentPlayer and self:canPass(playerData.src) or false)
    end

    if self._gamestage ~= GAMESTAGE.ROUNDS or currentSrc == nil then return end

    local playerData = self:getPlayerChairData(currentSrc)
    if not playerData then return end

    local callAmount = self:calculateCall(currentSrc)
    local minRaise = self:getHighestBet() * 2 - (playerData.roundbet or 0)
    if minRaise <= 0 then minRaise = self._blind * 2 end

    self:setVar(currentSrc, "callAmount", callAmount)
    self:setVar(currentSrc, "minRaiseAmount", minRaise)
end

---@param id integer?
function PokerTable:setCurrentPlayer(id)
    self._currentplayer = id

    if id ~= nil then
        if self._gamestage == GAMESTAGE.ROUNDS then
            self:setTime(TIMES.ROUNDS)
        end

        TriggerCasinoEvent("rhd_casino_holdemPoker:playSound", self:getCurrentPlayerSrc(), "player_alert.wav")
    end
    self:update("everyone", "currentplayer")
    self:syncActionState()
end

---@param source number|string
---@param key string
---@param val any
function PokerTable:setVar(source, key, val)
    if type(source) == 'string' then
        self:TCE_OnTablePlayers("rhd_casino_holdemPoker:setVariables", key, val)
    else
        TriggerCasinoEvent("rhd_casino_holdemPoker:setVariables", source, key, val)
    end
end

---@param source number|string
---@param updateType string
function PokerTable:update(source, updateType)
    local e = "rhd_casino_holdemPoker:setVariables"

    if updateType == "mainpot" then
        self:setVar(source, "mainpot", self._mainPot)
    elseif updateType == "dealercards" then
        self:setVar(source, "dealercards", self._dealerCards)
    elseif updateType == "timer" then
        self:setVar(source, "timer", self._time)
    elseif updateType == "gamestage" then
        self:setVar(source, "gamestage", self._gamestage)
    elseif updateType == "currentplayer" then
        local cp = self._chairPlayers[self._currentplayer]
        self:setVar(source, "currentplayer", cp?.src)
    elseif updateType == "players" then
        if self._gamestage ~= GAMESTAGE.SHOWING_CARDS then
            local players = lib.table.deepclone(self._chairPlayers)
            for i = 1, #players do players[i].cards = {} end

            if type(source) == "number" then
                TriggerCasinoEvent(e, source, "players", players)
            else
                self:TCE_OnTablePlayers(e, "players", players)

                for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
                    local playerData = self._chairPlayers[i]
                    TriggerCasinoEvent("rhd_casino_holdemPoker:updateCards", playerData.src, playerData)
                end
            end
        else
            self:setVar(source, "players", self._chairPlayers)
        end
    elseif updateType == "all" then
        local all = { "mainpot", "dealercards", "timer", "gamestage", "currentplayer", "players" }

        for i = 1, #all do
            self:update(source, all[i])
        end
    else
        self:debug(("update type not found: %s"):format(updateType))
    end
end

function PokerTable:dealPlayerCards()
    for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
        local playerData = self._chairPlayers[i]
        while #playerData.cards < 2 do
            local card = self:getRandomCard()
            table.insert(playerData.cards, card)
        end
    end
    self:update("everyone", "players")
end

function PokerTable:resetRoundBets()
    self:declareMainPot()
    for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
        local p = self._chairPlayers[i]
        p.roundbet = 0
        p.wasInRound = false
        p.passed = false
    end
end

---Advances the current player pointer, skipping folded or all-in players. Deals dealer cards if all players are done.
function PokerTable:getNextPlayer()
    self._currentplayer = (self._currentplayer or 0) + 1

    if self._currentplayer > self:count_playersTable() then
        self._currentplayer = 1
    end

    local visited = 0
    local total = self:count_playersTable()

    while self._chairPlayers[self._currentplayer] and (
        self._chairPlayers[self._currentplayer].wasInRound or
        self._chairPlayers[self._currentplayer].throwed or
        self._chairPlayers[self._currentplayer].allined
    ) do
        self._currentplayer += 1
        if self._currentplayer > total then
            self._currentplayer = 1
        end
        visited += 1
        if visited >= total then break end
    end

    self:setCurrentPlayer(self._currentplayer)

    local activeCount = 0
    for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
        local p = self._chairPlayers[i]
        if not p.wasInRound and not p.throwed and not p.allined then
            activeCount += 1
        end
    end

    if activeCount < 1 then
        local dealed = self:dealDealerCards()
        if dealed then
            for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
                local p = self._chairPlayers[i]
                if p.dealer then self._currentplayer = i; break end
            end
            self:getNextPlayer()
        else
            self:checkingWinners()
        end
    else
        self:update("everyone", "players")
    end
end

function PokerTable:raffleDealerPosition()
    if self:count_playersTable() < 1 then return end

    table.sort(self._chairPlayers, function(a, b) return a.chairId < b.chairId end)

    local dealerIdx
    if self._dealerChair then
        dealerIdx = 1
        for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
            if self._chairPlayers[i].chairId > self._dealerChair then
                dealerIdx = i
                break
            end
        end
    else
        dealerIdx = math.random(1, #self._chairPlayers)
    end

    self._chairPlayers[dealerIdx].dealer = true
    self._dealerChair = self._chairPlayers[dealerIdx].chairId
    self._currentplayer = dealerIdx
    self:betAutomaticBlinds()
end

function PokerTable:betAutomaticBlinds()
    local count = #self._chairPlayers
    local dealerIdx = self._currentplayer
    if not dealerIdx then return self:resetGame() end

    local smallBlindIdx = count == 2 and dealerIdx or dealerIdx % count + 1
    local bigBlindIdx = smallBlindIdx % count + 1
    local smallBlindPlayerData = self._chairPlayers[smallBlindIdx]
    local bigBlindPlayerData = self._chairPlayers[bigBlindIdx]

    if not smallBlindPlayerData then
        self:resetGame()
        return
    end

    if smallBlindPlayerData == bigBlindPlayerData then
        self:setGameStage(GAMESTAGE.ROUNDS)
        self:setTime(TIMES.ROUNDS)
        self._currentplayer = bigBlindIdx
        self:getNextPlayer()
        self:dealPlayerCards()
        self:playBetSFX()
        return
    end

    local smallblind = self._blind
    local bigblind = self._blind * 2

    if not shared.playerExist(smallBlindPlayerData.src)
        or smallBlindPlayerData.chips < smallblind then
        lib.print.warn(('[Poker] Small blind has insufficient chips, game aborted.'))
        self:openedStatePlayer(smallBlindPlayerData.src, false)
        self:resetGame()
        return
    end

    if not shared.playerExist(bigBlindPlayerData.src)
        or bigBlindPlayerData.chips < bigblind then
        lib.print.warn(('[Poker] Big blind has insufficient chips, game aborted.'))
        self:openedStatePlayer(bigBlindPlayerData.src, false)
        self:resetGame()
        return
    end

    smallBlindPlayerData.smallblind = true
    smallBlindPlayerData.roundbet += smallblind
    bigBlindPlayerData.roundbet += bigblind
    bigBlindPlayerData.bigblind = true
    smallBlindPlayerData.chips -= smallblind
    bigBlindPlayerData.chips -= bigblind
    smallBlindPlayerData.totalContrib = (smallBlindPlayerData.totalContrib or 0) + smallblind
    bigBlindPlayerData.totalContrib = (bigBlindPlayerData.totalContrib or 0) + bigblind

    self:setGameStage(GAMESTAGE.ROUNDS)
    self:setTime(TIMES.ROUNDS)
    self._currentplayer = bigBlindIdx
    self:getNextPlayer()
    self:dealPlayerCards()
    self:playBetSFX()
end

---Deals the next community cards (flop/turn/river). Returns false if all cards are already dealt.
---@return boolean
function PokerTable:dealDealerCards()
    if self:count_playersIngame() <= 1 and #self._chairPlayers > 1 then return false end
    local dc = #self._dealerCards

    if dc == 0 then
        lib.print.info('[Poker] Dealing the flop.')
        while #self._dealerCards < 3 do
            table.insert(self._dealerCards, self:getRandomCard())
        end
        self:resetRoundBets()
        self:TCE_OnTablePlayers("rhd_casino_holdemPoker:playSound", "shuffle_cards.wav")
        self:update("everyone", "dealercards")
        return true
    elseif dc == 3 then
        lib.print.info('[Poker] Dealing the turn.')
        table.insert(self._dealerCards, self:getRandomCard())
        self:resetRoundBets()
        self:TCE_OnTablePlayers("rhd_casino_holdemPoker:playSound", "shuffle_cards_2.wav")
        self:update("everyone", "dealercards")
        return true
    elseif dc == 4 then
        lib.print.info('[Poker] Dealing the river.')
        table.insert(self._dealerCards, self:getRandomCard())
        self:resetRoundBets()
        self:TCE_OnTablePlayers("rhd_casino_holdemPoker:playSound", "shuffle_cards_3.wav")
        self:update("everyone", "dealercards")
        return true
    end

    return false
end

---Reveals all hands, computes side pots, distributes winnings, and transitions to SHOWING_CARDS.
function PokerTable:checkingWinners()
    self:resetRoundBets()
    self:setGameStage(GAMESTAGE.SHOWING_CARDS)
    self:setTime(TIMES.SHOWING_CARDS)
    self:update("everyone", "players")
    self:setCurrentPlayer(nil)

    while #self._dealerCards < 5 do
        table.insert(self._dealerCards, self:getRandomCard())
    end

    self:update("everyone", "dealercards")
    self:TCE_OnTablePlayers("rhd_casino_holdemPoker:playSound", "shuffle_cards.wav")
    local playersNotThrowed = {}
    for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
        local p = self._chairPlayers[i]
        if not p.throwed then table.insert(playersNotThrowed, p) end
    end
    local activeContribs = {}
    for i = 1, #playersNotThrowed do
        local p = playersNotThrowed[i]
        if (p.totalContrib or 0) > 0 then
            table.insert(activeContribs, p)
        end
    end
    local caps = {}
    do
        local seen = {}
        for i = 1, #activeContribs do
            local p = activeContribs[i]
            local c = p.totalContrib or 0
            if not seen[c] then
                seen[c] = true
                table.insert(caps, c)
            end
        end
        table.sort(caps)
    end
    local winnerSrcs = {}
    local winnerSeen = {}
    local rakeTotal = 0
    local prevCap = 0
    for ci = 1, #caps do
        local cap = caps[ci]
        local layerTotal = 0
        for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
            local p = self._chairPlayers[i]
            local contrib = p.totalContrib or 0
            if contrib > prevCap then
                layerTotal += math.min(contrib, cap) - prevCap
            end
        end
        local eligible = {}
        for i = 1, #activeContribs do
            local p = activeContribs[i]
            if (p.totalContrib or 0) >= cap then
                table.insert(eligible, p)
            end
        end
        if layerTotal > 0 and #eligible > 0 then
            local layerWinners = get_winners(self._dealerCards, eligible) or {}
            local layerWinnerCount = 0
            for i = 1, #eligible do
                if layerWinners[i] then layerWinnerCount += 1 end
            end
            if layerWinnerCount > 0 then
                local layerRake = math.floor(layerTotal * RAKE_RATE)
                local payout = layerTotal - layerRake
                rakeTotal += layerRake
                local share = math.floor(payout / layerWinnerCount)
                for i = 1, #eligible do
                    if layerWinners[i] then
                        local p = eligible[i]
                        p.chips += share
                        if share > 0 and not p.isBot then
                            shared.recordChipWinnings(p.src, share, 'holdemPoker')
                        end
                        if not winnerSeen[p.src] then
                            winnerSeen[p.src] = true
                            table.insert(winnerSrcs, p.src)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        prevCap = cap
    end
    if rakeTotal > 0 then
        shared.depositCasinoIncome(rakeTotal, 'holdemPoker:rake', 1.0)
    end
    local winnerCount = #winnerSrcs
    self:setVar("everyone", "winnerSrcs", winnerSrcs)
    for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
        local p = self._chairPlayers[i]
        if not p.isBot and not p.disconnected and p.chips <= 0 then
            p.needsRebuy = true
            if shared.playerExist(p.src) then
                TriggerCasinoEvent('rhd_casino_holdemPoker:showRebuyModal', p.src)
                CasinoPoker.notify(p.src, "Chip kamu habis! Lakukan re-buy sekarang atau kamu akan keluar dari meja.")
            end
        end
    end
    local distributionSec = math.ceil(0.9 + (math.max(winnerCount, 1) * 2.15) + 2)
    self:setTime(math.max(TIMES.SHOWING_CARDS, distributionSec))
    self:update("everyone", "players")
end

---@param source number
---@param args { amount: number }
function PokerTable:betPoker(source, args)
    local amount = math.floor(tonumber(args.amount) or -1)
    if self._gamestage ~= GAMESTAGE.ROUNDS then return end
    if not self:isPlayerCurrentPlayer(source) then
        return self:debug("Not the current player is the action holder.")
    end
    if not shared.playerExist(source) then return self:debug("Player not exist: " .. tostring(source)) end
    if not self:isValidBet(amount) then return CasinoPoker.notify(source, "Not a valid bet.") end
    local playerData = self:getPlayerChairData(source)
    local playerChips = playerData and playerData.chips or 0
    if not playerData then return CasinoPoker.notify(source, "Error: Not sitting.") end
    if playerChips < amount then return CasinoPoker.notify(source, "Not enough chips.") end
    if amount >= playerChips then
        playerData.allined = true
        playerData.roundbet += amount
        for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
            local p = self._chairPlayers[i]
            if p.src ~= source and p.roundbet < amount then
                p.wasInRound = false
            end
        end
    else
        local minimumBet = self:calculateCall(source)
        if amount < minimumBet and minimumBet > 0 then
            return CasinoPoker.notify(source, ("Minimum bet is %s chips."):format(minimumBet))
        end
        if self._maxBet and amount > self._maxBet then
            return CasinoPoker.notify(source, ("Maximum bet is %s chips."):format(self._maxBet))
        end
        local neededRaiseAdditional = math.max(
            self:getHighestBet() * 2 - playerData.roundbet,
            self._blind * 2
        )
        if playerData.roundbet + amount > self:getHighestBet() then
            if amount < neededRaiseAdditional then
                return CasinoPoker.notify(source, ("Minimum raise is +%s chips."):format(neededRaiseAdditional))
            end
            for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
                local p = self._chairPlayers[i]
                if p.src ~= source then p.wasInRound = false end
            end
        else
            if self:getHighestBet() == 0 and amount < self._minBet then
                return CasinoPoker.notify(source, ("Minimum bet is %s chips."):format(self._minBet))
            end
        end
        playerData.roundbet += amount
    end
    self:playBetSFX()
    for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
        local p = self._chairPlayers[i]
        if p.passed then
            p.wasInRound = false
            p.passed = false
        end
    end
    playerData.wasInRound = true
    playerData.chips -= amount
    playerData.totalContrib = (playerData.totalContrib or 0) + amount
    self:setTime(TIMES.ROUNDS)
    self:getNextPlayer()
end

---@param source number
function PokerTable:allInPoker(source)
    if self._gamestage ~= GAMESTAGE.ROUNDS then return end
    if not shared.playerExist(source) then return self:debug("Player not exist: " .. tostring(source)) end
    local playerData = self:getPlayerChairData(source)
    if not playerData then return CasinoPoker.notify(source, "Error: Not sitting.") end
    if not self:isPlayerCurrentPlayer(source) then return end
    local maxChips = playerData.chips
    self:betPoker(source, { amount = maxChips })
end

---@param source number
function PokerTable:callPoker(source)
    if self._gamestage ~= GAMESTAGE.ROUNDS then return end
    if not shared.playerExist(source) then return self:debug("Player not exist: " .. tostring(source)) end
    local call = self:calculateCall(source)
    if call == nil then return CasinoPoker.notify(source, "Error: Something went wrong.") end
    local amount = math.floor(call)
    if amount <= 0 then return CasinoPoker.notify(source, "Nothing to call. Use Check.") end
    local playerData = self:getPlayerChairData(source)
    if not playerData then return CasinoPoker.notify(source, "Error: Not sitting.") end
    if not self:isPlayerCurrentPlayer(source) then return end
    if playerData.chips < amount then return CasinoPoker.notify(source, "Not enough chips.") end
    self:betPoker(source, { amount = amount })
end

---@param source number
function PokerTable:passPoker(source)
    if self._gamestage ~= GAMESTAGE.ROUNDS then return end
    if not shared.playerExist(source) then return self:debug("Player not exist: " .. tostring(source)) end
    local playerData = self:getPlayerChairData(source)
    if not playerData then return CasinoPoker.notify(source, "Error: Not sitting.") end
    if not self:isPlayerCurrentPlayer(source) then return end
    if self:canPass(source) then
        self:setTime(TIMES.ROUNDS)
        playerData.wasInRound = true
        playerData.passed = true
        self:getNextPlayer()
    end
end

---@param source number
---@param leaved boolean?
function PokerTable:throwPoker(source, leaved)
    if self._gamestage ~= GAMESTAGE.ROUNDS then return end
    local playerData = self:getPlayerChairData(source)
    if not playerData then return CasinoPoker.notify(source, "Error: Not sitting.") end
    if not self:isPlayerCurrentPlayer(source) and not leaved then return end
    playerData.throwed = true
    self:TCE_OnTablePlayers("rhd_casino_holdemPoker:playSound", "shuffle_cards_2.wav")
    if self:count_playersIngame() <= 1 then
        self:checkingWinners()
    else
        self:setTime(TIMES.ROUNDS)
        self:getNextPlayer()
    end
end

---@param source number
---@param amount number?
function PokerTable:rebuyPlayer(source, amount)
    local playerData = self:getPlayerChairData(source)
    if not playerData then return CasinoPoker.notify(source, "Kamu tidak sedang duduk di meja.") end
    local duringShowdown = self._gamestage == GAMESTAGE.SHOWING_CARDS and playerData.needsRebuy
    if self._gamestage ~= GAMESTAGE.GAME_NOT_STARTED and not duringShowdown then
        return CasinoPoker.notify(source, "Re-buy hanya bisa dilakukan antara putaran.")
    end
    if not shared.playerExist(source) then return end
    if playerData.chips > 0 and not playerData.needsRebuy then
        return CasinoPoker.notify(source, ("Kamu masih punya %s chips."):format(playerData.chips))
    end
    local invChips = shared.getChip(source)
    if invChips < self._buyIn then
        return CasinoPoker.notify(source, ("Butuh minimal %s chips untuk re-buy. Kamu hanya punya %s."):format(self._buyIn, invChips))
    end
    local takeAmount = amount and math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0) or invChips
    if takeAmount < self._buyIn then
        return CasinoPoker.notify(source, ("Minimum re-buy adalah %s chips."):format(self._buyIn))
    end
    if takeAmount > invChips then
        takeAmount = invChips
    end
    if self._maxBuyIn and takeAmount > self._maxBuyIn then
        takeAmount = self._maxBuyIn
    end
    if not shared.removeChip(source, takeAmount) then
        return CasinoPoker.notify(source, 'Gagal mengambil chip re-buy.')
    end

    playerData.chips = takeAmount --[[@as integer]]
    playerData.needsRebuy = false
    self._chipOutAt[source] = nil
    local identifier = shared.getIdentifier(source)
    if not identifier then
        shared.addChip(source, takeAmount)
        playerData.chips = 0
        return CasinoPoker.notify(source, 'Identifier pemain tidak ditemukan. Chip dikembalikan.')
    end

    shared.saveBuyIn(identifier --[[@as string]], self._index, takeAmount --[[@as integer]])
    shared.log({
        title = 'Poker Re-Buy',
        type = 'info',
        fields = {
            { name = 'Player', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(shared.getPlayerName(source), source) },
            { name = 'Table', value = tostring(self._index), inline = true },
            { name = 'Buy-In', value = ('%s chips'):format(takeAmount), inline = true },
        },
    })
    self:update("everyone", "players")
    CasinoPoker.player:updatePlayerChips(source)
    CasinoPoker.notify(source, ("Re-buy berhasil! Kamu membawa %s chips ke meja."):format(takeAmount))
end

---@param source number
function PokerTable:joinPlayer(source)
    if self._gamestage ~= GAMESTAGE.GAME_NOT_STARTED then
        return CasinoPoker.notify(source, "Cannot join yet.")
    end
    if not self:isPlayerNear(source) then
        return CasinoPoker.notify(source, 'Kamu terlalu jauh dari meja poker.')
    end
    if self._joinLock[source] then
        return CasinoPoker.notify(source, "Permintaan join sedang diprosesâ€¦")
    end
    self._joinLock[source] = true
    if self:isPlayerSitAtTable(source) then
        self._joinLock[source] = nil
        return CasinoPoker.notify(source, "Kamu sudah duduk di meja ini.")
    end
    for _, inst in pairs(CasinoPoker.tables) do
        if inst ~= self and type(inst.isPlayerSitAtTable) == "function" then
            if inst:isPlayerSitAtTable(source) then
                self._joinLock[source] = nil
                return CasinoPoker.notify(source, "Kamu masih duduk di meja poker lain. Tinggalkan meja itu dulu.")
            end
        end
    end
    local freeChairId = self:reserveFreeChair(source)
    if not (freeChairId and Chairs[freeChairId]) then
        self._joinLock[source] = nil
        return CasinoPoker.notify(source, "No free chair.")
    end

    local function cancelJoin(message)
        self:releaseChairReservation(source, freeChairId)
        self._joinLock[source] = nil
        if message then
            return CasinoPoker.notify(source, message)
        end
    end

    local identifier = shared.getIdentifier(source)
    if not identifier then
        return cancelJoin('Identifier pemain tidak ditemukan.')
    end

    if shared.loadBuyIn(identifier --[[@as string]], self._index) and not CasinoPoker.restoreSavedChips(source) then
        return cancelJoin('Chip poker tersimpan kamu belum bisa dikembalikan. Kosongkan inventory lalu coba lagi.')
    end

    local invChips = shared.getChip(source)
    local buyInAmount = math.floor(tonumber(
        lib.callback.await('rhd_casino_holdemPoker:getBuyInAmount', source, self._index)
    ) or 0)

    if buyInAmount < self._buyIn then
        return cancelJoin("Invalid buy-in amount.")
    end

    if invChips < buyInAmount then
        return cancelJoin(("Minimum buy-in untuk meja ini adalah %s chips."):format(buyInAmount))
    end
    if self:isPlayerSitAtTable(source) then
        return cancelJoin()
    end
    for _, inst in pairs(CasinoPoker.tables) do
        if inst ~= self and type(inst.isPlayerSitAtTable) == "function" then
            if inst:isPlayerSitAtTable(source) then
                return cancelJoin("Kamu masih duduk di meja poker lain.")
            end
        end
    end
    if self:isChairOccupied(freeChairId) then
        return cancelJoin("Kursi ini baru saja digunakan pemain lain. Silakan coba kursi lain.")
    end
    local takeAmount = buyInAmount
    if self._maxBuyIn and takeAmount > self._maxBuyIn then
        takeAmount = self._maxBuyIn
    end
    if not shared.removeChip(source, takeAmount) then
        return cancelJoin("Gagal mengambil chip buy-in.")
    end
    shared.saveBuyIn(identifier --[[@as string]], self._index, takeAmount --[[@as integer]])
    shared.log({
        title = 'Poker Buy-In',
        type = 'info',
        fields = {
            { name = 'Player', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(shared.getPlayerName(source), source) },
            { name = 'Table', value = tostring(self._index), inline = true },
            { name = 'Buy-In', value = ('%s chips'):format(takeAmount), inline = true },
        },
    })
    local ok, gender = pcall(shared.getGender, source)
    if not ok then gender = 'male' end
    local defaultImg = gender == 'female' and 'images/user/user-women.png' or 'images/user/user-man.png'
    local savedImg = CasinoPoker.player:getPlayerImage(source)
    if not savedImg or savedImg == '' then savedImg = defaultImg end
    table.insert(self._chairPlayers, {
        src = source,
        cards = {},
        throwed = false,
        passed = false,
        dealer = false,
        playername = shared.getPlayerName(source),
        roundbet = 0,
        chairId = freeChairId,
        wasInRound = false,
        chips = takeAmount,
        img = savedImg,
        gender = gender,
    })
    self._identifiers[source] = identifier
    local chair = Chairs[freeChairId]
    TriggerCasinoEvent("rhd_casino_holdemPoker:sitDownClient", source, self._index, chair.offset, chair.heading)
    CasinoPoker.player:updatePlayerChips(source)
    self:update("everyone", "players")
    self:releaseChairReservation(source, freeChairId)
    self._joinLock[source] = nil
end

---@param source number
---@param state boolean
---@param dropped boolean?
function PokerTable:openedStatePlayer(source, state, dropped)
    if state then
        if not self:isPlayerNear(source, 7.0) then return end
        if lib.array.includes(self._playersOpened, source) then return end
        if not shared.getIdentifier(source) then return end

        CasinoPoker.restoreSavedChips(source)
        table.insert(self._playersOpened, source)
        self:update(source, "all")
        self:setVar(source, 'myPlayerSrc', source)
        self:setVar(source, 'minBet', self._minBet)
        self:setVar(source, 'maxBet', self._maxBet)
        self:setVar(source, 'buyIn', self._buyIn)
        self:setVar(source, 'maxBuyIn', self._maxBuyIn)
    else
        self:releaseChairReservation(source)
        self._joinLock[source] = nil

        for i = 1, #self._playersOpened do
            local src = self._playersOpened[i]
            if src == source then table.remove(self._playersOpened, i); break end
        end
        if self:isPlayerSitAtTable(source) then
            local playerData = self:getPlayerChairData(source)
            if playerData then
                local chair = Chairs[playerData.chairId]
                local identifier = self._identifiers[source] or shared.getIdentifier(source)
                local chips = playerData.chips
                local cashedOut = not dropped and chips > 0 and shared.addChip(source, chips)

                if not dropped then
                    TriggerCasinoEvent("rhd_casino_holdemPoker:standUpClient", source, self._index, chair.offset, chair.heading)
                end

                if identifier then
                    if chips > 0 and not cashedOut then
                        shared.saveBuyIn(identifier --[[@as string]], self._index, chips)
                    else
                        shared.clearBuyIn(identifier --[[@as string]], self._index)
                    end
                end

                if chips > 0 then
                    if not dropped and not cashedOut then
                        lib.notify(source, {
                            title = 'Casino Poker',
                            description = ('Inventory penuh. %s chip disimpan dan dikembalikan saat kamu kembali ke kasino.'):format(chips),
                            type = 'warning',
                        })
                    end

                    shared.log({
                        title = cashedOut and 'Poker Cash-Out' or 'Poker Chips Saved',
                        type = 'money',
                        fields = {
                            { name = 'Player', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(shared.getPlayerName(source), source) },
                            { name = 'Table', value = tostring(self._index), inline = true },
                            { name = cashedOut and 'Chips Taken' or 'Chips Saved', value = ('%s chips'):format(chips), inline = true },
                            { name = 'Reason', value = dropped and 'disconnect' or 'leave', inline = true },
                        },
                    })
                end

                playerData.chips = 0

                if self._gamestage == GAMESTAGE.ROUNDS then
                    playerData.disconnected = true
                    self:throwPoker(source, true)
                    self:update("everyone", "players")
                else
                    for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
                        if self._chairPlayers[i].chairId == playerData.chairId then
                            table.remove(self._chairPlayers, i); break
                        end
                    end
                    self._identifiers[source] = nil
                    self:update("everyone", "players")
                end
            end
        end
        self:setVar(source, 'opened', false)
    end
end

function PokerTable:updatePlayerImages()
    for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
        local playerData = self._chairPlayers[i]
        playerData.img = CasinoPoker.player:getPlayerImage(playerData.src)
    end
    self:update("everyone", "players")
end

---Decrements the round timer and advances game phase when it expires.
function PokerTable:tickTime()
    if self._gamestage == GAMESTAGE.GAME_NOT_STARTED then
        if self:count_playersTable() >= minimalPlayer then
            local canPlay = 0
            for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
                local p = self._chairPlayers[i]
                if (p.chips or 0) > 0 then canPlay += 1 end
            end
            if canPlay >= minimalPlayer then
                self:setTime(self._time - 1)
                if self._time < 1 then
                    self:raffleDealerPosition()
                end
            end
        end
    elseif self._gamestage == GAMESTAGE.ROUNDS then
        self:setTime(self._time - 1)
        self:syncActionState()
        if self._time < 1 then
            local inactiveSrc = self:getCurrentPlayerSrc()
            if inactiveSrc == nil then return self:resetGame() end
            self:throwPoker(inactiveSrc)
        end
    elseif self._gamestage == GAMESTAGE.SHOWING_CARDS then
        self:setTime(self._time - 1)
        if self._time < 1 then
            self:resetGame()
        end
    end
end

---Removes disconnected players, kicks non-rebuy players, resets all round state, and returns to GAME_NOT_STARTED.
function PokerTable:resetGame()
    for i = #self._chairPlayers, 1, -1 do
        if self._chairPlayers[i].disconnected then
            self._identifiers[self._chairPlayers[i].src] = nil
            table.remove(self._chairPlayers, i)
        end
    end
    for i = #self._chairPlayers, 1, -1 do
        local p = self._chairPlayers[i]
        if p and not p.disconnected and p.needsRebuy then
            local src = p.src
            self._chipOutAt[src] = nil
            if shared.playerExist(src) then
                lib.notify(src, {
                    title = 'Casino Holdem Poker',
                    description = 'Kamu dikeluarkan dari meja karena tidak melakukan re-buy.',
                    type = 'error',
                })
            end
            self:openedStatePlayer(src, false)
        end
    end
    for i = 1, #self._chairPlayers do
        local p = self._chairPlayers[i]
        p.roundbet = 0
        p.cards = {}
        p.throwed = false
        p.passed = false
        p.dealer = false
        p.wasInRound = false
        p.smallblind = false
        p.bigblind = false
        p.allined = false
        p.totalContrib = 0
    end
    self:declareMainPot()
    self._cardIndexesExist = {}
    self._dealerCards = {}
    self._mainPot = 0
    self:setCurrentPlayer(nil)
    self:setGameStage(GAMESTAGE.GAME_NOT_STARTED)
    self:setTime(TIMES.GAME_NOT_STARTED)
    self:update("everyone", "all")
end

AddEventHandler('onServerResourceStart', function(resourceName)
    if GetCurrentResourceName() ~= resourceName then return end
    Wait(1000)
    local tables = require 'casino.holdemPoker.config'.pokerTables
    for i = 1, #tables do
        local a = tables[i]
        ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: undefined-field
        PokerTable:new(a.blind, a.id, a)
    end
end)

local tests = {
    "straight_flush", "four_of_a_kind", "full_house",
    "flush", "straight", "three_of_a_kind",
    "two_pair", "one_pair", "hi_card"
}
local function getCardRank(card)
    return tonumber(card:sub(2, 3))
end

local function getCardSuit(card)
    return card:sub(1, 1)
end

local function group_cards(dealerdeck, playerdeck)
    local c = {}
    for i = 1, 5 do c[i] = dealerdeck[i] end
    c[6] = playerdeck[1]
    c[7] = playerdeck[2]
    return c
end

local function get_predominant_suit(my_cards)
    local count = { c = 0, s = 0, h = 0, d = 0 }
    for i = 1, #my_cards do
        local s = getCardSuit(my_cards[i])
        if count[s] then count[s] = count[s] + 1 end
    end
    local best = "c"
    for i = 1, 3 do
        local suit = ({ "s", "h", "d" })[i]
        if count[suit] > count[best] then best = suit end
    end
    return best
end

local function fill_and_sort(t, size)
    for i = 1, size do
        if t[i] == nil then t[i] = -1 end
    end
    table.sort(t, function(a, b) return a > b end)
end

local function find_best_stretch(wc)
    local abs_len, abs_hi = 0, 0
    local cur_len, cur_hi = 1, 0
    for i = 1, 8 do
        local a = wc[i]
        local b = wc[i + 1]
        if a and b and a > 0 and b > 0 and (a - b) == 1 then
            cur_len = cur_len + 1
            if cur_hi < 1 then cur_hi = a end
        elseif a and a > 0 then
            if cur_len > abs_len then
                abs_len = cur_len
                if cur_hi < 1 then cur_hi = a end
                abs_hi = cur_hi
            end
            cur_len = 1
            cur_hi = 0
        end
    end
    return abs_len, abs_hi
end

local compare_straight
local function compare_straight_flush(a, b)
    return compare_straight(a, b)
end

local function test_straight_flush(dealercards, playercards)
    local my_cards = group_cards(dealercards, playercards)
    local the_suit = get_predominant_suit(my_cards)
    local wc = {}
    local wi = 1
    for i = 1, 7 do
        if getCardSuit(my_cards[i]) == the_suit then
            local r = getCardRank(my_cards[i])
            wc[wi] = r
            wi = wi + 1
            if r == 14 then wc[8] = 1 end
        end
    end
    fill_and_sort(wc, 8)
    local abs_len, abs_hi = find_best_stretch(wc)
    local num_mine = 0
    for i = 0, abs_len - 1 do
        local r = abs_hi - i
        if the_suit .. r == playercards[1] or
           the_suit .. r == playercards[2] then
            num_mine = num_mine + 1
        end
    end
    return {
        straight_hi = abs_hi,
        num_needed = 5 - abs_len,
        num_mine = num_mine,
        hand_name = "Straight Flush",
    }
end

local function test_four_of_a_kind(dealercards, playercards)
    local my_cards = group_cards(dealercards, playercards)
    local ranks = {}
    for i = 1, 13 do ranks[i] = 0 end
    for i = 1, #my_cards do
        local idx = getCardRank(my_cards[i]) - 1
        ranks[idx] = ranks[idx] + 1
    end
    local four, kicker
    for i = 1, 13 do
        if ranks[i] == 4 then
            four = i + 1
        elseif ranks[i] > 0 then
            kicker = i + 1
        end
    end
    local num_mine = 0
    if four then
        if getCardRank(playercards[1]) == four then num_mine = num_mine + 1 end
        if getCardRank(playercards[2]) == four then num_mine = num_mine + 1 end
    end
    return {
        rank = four,
        kicker = kicker,
        num_needed = four and 0 or 4,
        num_mine = num_mine,
        hand_name = "Four of a Kind",
    }
end

local function compare_four_of_a_kind(a, b)
    if a.rank > b.rank then return "a"
    elseif b.rank > a.rank then return "b"
    elseif a.kicker > b.kicker then return "a"
    elseif b.kicker > a.kicker then return "b"
    else return "c" end
end

local function test_full_house(dealercards, playercards)
    local my_cards = group_cards(dealercards, playercards)
    local ranks = {}
    for i = 1, 13 do ranks[i] = 0 end
    for i = 1, #my_cards do
        local idx = getCardRank(my_cards[i]) - 1
        ranks[idx] = ranks[idx] + 1
    end
    local three, two
    for i = 1, 13 do
        if ranks[i] == 3 then
            if three and three > (two or 0) then two = three end
            three = i + 1
        elseif ranks[i] == 2 then
            two = i + 1
        end
    end
    local num_needed = 5
    local major_rank, num_mine_major = nil, 0
    if three then
        num_needed = num_needed - 3
        major_rank = three
        if getCardRank(playercards[1]) == three then num_mine_major = num_mine_major + 1 end
        if getCardRank(playercards[2]) == three then num_mine_major = num_mine_major + 1 end
    end
    local minor_rank, num_mine_minor = nil, 0
    if two then
        num_needed = num_needed - 2
        minor_rank = two
        if getCardRank(playercards[1]) == two then num_mine_minor = num_mine_minor + 1 end
        if getCardRank(playercards[2]) == two then num_mine_minor = num_mine_minor + 1 end
    end
    return {
        major_rank = major_rank,
        minor_rank = minor_rank,
        num_mine_major = num_mine_major,
        num_mine_minor = num_mine_minor,
        num_mine = num_mine_major + num_mine_minor,
        num_needed = num_needed,
        hand_name = "Full House",
    }
end

local function compare_full_house(a, b)
    if a.major_rank > b.major_rank then return "a"
    elseif b.major_rank > a.major_rank then return "b"
    elseif a.minor_rank > b.minor_rank then return "a"
    elseif b.minor_rank > a.minor_rank then return "b"
    else return "c" end
end

local function test_flush(dealercards, playercards)
    local my_cards = group_cards(dealercards, playercards)
    local the_suit = get_predominant_suit(my_cards)
    local wc = {}
    local wi = 1
    local num_in_flush = 0
    for i = 1, #my_cards do
        local card = my_cards[i]
        if getCardSuit(card) == the_suit then
            num_in_flush = num_in_flush + 1
            wc[wi] = getCardRank(card)
            wi = wi + 1
        end
    end
    for i = 1, 7 do
        if wc[i] == nil then wc[i] = -1 end
    end
    table.sort(wc, function(a, b) return a > b end)
    local result = { num_needed = 5 - num_in_flush, suit = the_suit, hand_name = "Flush" }
    local num_mine = 0
    for i = 1, 5 do
        local rank = wc[i]
        result["flush_" .. (i - 1)] = (rank > 0) and rank or ""
        if rank > 0 then
            if the_suit .. rank == playercards[1] or
               the_suit .. rank == playercards[2] then
                num_mine = num_mine + 1
            end
        end
    end
    result.num_mine = num_mine
    return result
end

local function compare_flush(a, b)
    for i = 0, 4 do
        local fa = a["flush_" .. i]
        local fb = b["flush_" .. i]
        if fa > fb then return "a" elseif fb > fa then return "b" end
    end
    return "c"
end

local function test_straight(dealercards, playercards)
    local my_cards = group_cards(dealercards, playercards)
    local wc = {}
    local seen = {}
    local wi = 1
    for i = 1, 7 do
        local r = getCardRank(my_cards[i])
        if not seen[r] then
            seen[r] = true
            wc[wi] = r
            wi = wi + 1
            if r == 14 then wc[8] = 1 end
        end
    end
    fill_and_sort(wc, 8)
    local abs_len, abs_hi = find_best_stretch(wc)
    local num_mine = 0
    for i = 0, abs_len - 1 do
        local r = abs_hi - i
        if r == getCardRank(playercards[1]) or
           r == getCardRank(playercards[2]) then
            num_mine = num_mine + 1
        end
    end
    return {
        straight_hi = abs_hi,
        num_needed = 5 - abs_len,
        num_mine = num_mine,
        hand_name = "Straight",
    }
end

compare_straight = function(a, b)
    if a.straight_hi > b.straight_hi then return "a"
    elseif b.straight_hi > a.straight_hi then return "b"
    else return "c" end
end

local function test_three_of_a_kind(dealercards, playercards)
    local my_cards = group_cards(dealercards, playercards)
    local ranks = {}
    for i = 1, 13 do ranks[i] = 0 end
    for i = 1, #my_cards do
        local idx = getCardRank(my_cards[i]) - 1
        ranks[idx] = ranks[idx] + 1
    end
    local three, k1, k2
    for i = 1, 13 do
        if ranks[i] == 3 then
            three = i + 1
        elseif ranks[i] == 1 then
            k2 = k1 ; k1 = i + 1
        elseif ranks[i] > 1 then
            k1 = i + 1 ; k2 = i + 1
        end
    end
    local num_mine = 0
    if three then
        if getCardRank(playercards[1]) == three then num_mine = num_mine + 1 end
        if getCardRank(playercards[2]) == three then num_mine = num_mine + 1 end
    end
    return {
        rank = three,
        num_needed = three and 0 or 3,
        num_mine = num_mine,
        kicker_1 = k1,
        kicker_2 = k2,
        hand_name = "Three of a Kind",
    }
end

local function compare_three_of_a_kind(a, b)
    if a.rank > b.rank then return "a"
    elseif b.rank > a.rank then return "b"
    elseif a.kicker_1 > b.kicker_1 then return "a"
    elseif b.kicker_1 > a.kicker_1 then return "b"
    elseif a.kicker_2 > b.kicker_2 then return "a"
    elseif b.kicker_2 > a.kicker_2 then return "b"
    else return "c" end
end

local function test_two_pair(dealercards, playercards)
    local my_cards = group_cards(dealercards, playercards)
    local ranks = {}
    for i = 1, 13 do ranks[i] = 0 end
    for i = 1, #my_cards do
        local idx = getCardRank(my_cards[i]) - 1
        ranks[idx] = ranks[idx] + 1
    end
    local first, second, kicker
    for i = 13, 1, -1 do
        if ranks[i] == 2 then
            if not first then first = i + 1
            elseif not second then second = i + 1
            elseif not kicker then kicker = i + 1
            else break end
        elseif not kicker and ranks[i] > 0 then
            kicker = i + 1
        end
    end
    local r0 = getCardRank(playercards[1])
    local r1 = getCardRank(playercards[2])
    local num_mine = 0
    if r0 == first or r0 == second then num_mine = num_mine + 1 end
    if r1 == first or r1 == second then num_mine = num_mine + 1 end
    return {
        rank_1 = first,
        rank_2 = second,
        kicker = kicker,
        num_needed = second and 0 or (first and 1 or 2),
        num_mine = num_mine,
        hand_name = "Two Pair",
    }
end

local function compare_two_pair(a, b)
    if a.rank_1 > b.rank_1 then return "a"
    elseif b.rank_1 > a.rank_1 then return "b"
    elseif a.rank_2 > b.rank_2 then return "a"
    elseif b.rank_2 > a.rank_2 then return "b"
    elseif a.kicker > b.kicker then return "a"
    elseif b.kicker > a.kicker then return "b"
    else return "c" end
end

local function test_one_pair(dealercards, playercards)
    local my_cards = group_cards(dealercards, playercards)
    local ranks = {}
    for i = 1, 13 do ranks[i] = 0 end
    for i = 1, #my_cards do
        local idx = getCardRank(my_cards[i]) - 1
        ranks[idx] = ranks[idx] + 1
    end
    local pair = 0
    local k1, k2, k3
    for i = 1, 13 do
        if ranks[i] == 2 then
            pair = i + 1
        elseif ranks[i] == 1 then
            k3 = k2 ; k2 = k1 ; k1 = i + 1
        elseif ranks[i] > 2 then
            k1 = i + 1 ; k2 = i + 1 ; k3 = i + 1
        end
    end
    local num_mine = 0
    if pair ~= 0 then
        if getCardRank(playercards[1]) == pair then num_mine = num_mine + 1 end
        if getCardRank(playercards[2]) == pair then num_mine = num_mine + 1 end
    end
    return {
        rank = pair,
        num_needed = (pair ~= 0) and 0 or 1,
        num_mine = num_mine,
        kicker_1 = k1,
        kicker_2 = k2,
        kicker_3 = k3,
        hand_name = "One Pair",
    }
end

local function compare_one_pair(a, b)
    if a.rank > b.rank then return "a"
    elseif b.rank > a.rank then return "b"
    elseif a.kicker_1 > b.kicker_1 then return "a"
    elseif b.kicker_1 > a.kicker_1 then return "b"
    elseif a.kicker_2 > b.kicker_2 then return "a"
    elseif b.kicker_2 > a.kicker_2 then return "b"
    elseif a.kicker_3 > b.kicker_3 then return "a"
    elseif b.kicker_3 > a.kicker_3 then return "b"
    else return "c" end
end

local function test_hi_card(dealercards, playercards)
    local my_cards = group_cards(dealercards, playercards)
    local wc = {}
    for i = 1, #my_cards do
        wc[i] = getCardRank(my_cards[i]) or -1
    end
    table.sort(wc, function(a, b) return a > b end)
    local result = { num_needed = 0, hand_name = "High Card" }
    for i = 1, 5 do
        result["hi_card_" .. (i - 1)] = wc[i] or ""
    end
    return result
end

local function compare_hi_card(a, b)
    for i = 0, 4 do
        local ha = a["hi_card_" .. i]
        local hb = b["hi_card_" .. i]
        if ha > hb then return "a" elseif hb > ha then return "b" end
    end
    return "c"
end

local test_fn = {
    straight_flush = test_straight_flush,
    four_of_a_kind = test_four_of_a_kind,
    full_house = test_full_house,
    flush = test_flush,
    straight = test_straight,
    three_of_a_kind = test_three_of_a_kind,
    two_pair = test_two_pair,
    one_pair = test_one_pair,
    hi_card = test_hi_card,
}
local compare_fn = {
    straight_flush = compare_straight_flush,
    four_of_a_kind = compare_four_of_a_kind,
    full_house = compare_full_house,
    flush = compare_flush,
    straight = compare_straight,
    three_of_a_kind = compare_three_of_a_kind,
    two_pair = compare_two_pair,
    one_pair = compare_one_pair,
    hi_card = compare_hi_card,
}
local function execute_test(name, dealercards, playercards)
    local fn = test_fn[name]
    assert(fn, "execute_test: unknown test '" .. name .. "'")
    return fn(dealercards, playercards)
end

local function execute_compare(name, hand_in, best_hand)
    local fn = compare_fn[name]
    assert(fn, "execute_compare: unknown compare '" .. name .. "'")
    return fn(hand_in, best_hand)
end

local function winners_helper(dealercards, my_players, test)
    local best
    local winners = {}
    for i = 1, #my_players do
        if not my_players[i] then goto continue end
        local a = execute_test(test, dealercards, my_players[i].cards)
        if a.num_needed > 0 then goto continue end
        if best == nil then
            best = a
            winners = {}
            winners[i] = a
        else
            local comp = execute_compare(test, a, best)
            if comp == "a" then
                best = a
                winners = {}
                winners[i] = a
            elseif comp == "b" then
            elseif comp == "c" then
                winners[i] = a
            end
        end
        ::continue::
    end
    for i = 1, #my_players do
        if winners[i] then return winners end
    end
    return nil
end
---Determines which players hold the best hand against the community cards.
---@param dealercards string[]
---@param my_players PokerChairPlayer[]
---@return table<integer, PokerChairPlayer>|nil
return function (dealercards, my_players)
    local winners
    for i = 1, #tests do
        local test = tests[i]
        winners = winners_helper(dealercards, my_players, test)
        if winners then break end
    end
    return winners
end

---Loads and initializes the big screen wall scaleform with current race state.
local function bigScreenLoad()
    local cfg = config.BigScreen
    if not IsNamedRendertargetRegistered(cfg.renderTarget) then
        RegisterNamedRendertarget(cfg.renderTarget, false)
    end
    if not IsNamedRendertargetLinked(cfg.objectModel) then
        LinkNamedRendertarget(cfg.objectModel)
    end
    big.target = GetNamedRendertargetRenderId(cfg.renderTarget)
    big.sf = IT.LoadWall()
    if big.sf == -1 then
        ReleaseNamedRendertarget(cfg.renderTarget)
        big.target = -1
        return
    end

    SetScaleformFitRendertarget(big.sf, true)
    IT.SetHorses(big.sf, Horses.buildClient(mainSync.horses))
    IT.SetState(mainSync.phase, false)
    IT.LockMainEvent(big.sf, mainSync.phase ~= 'open')
    IT.ToggleBetting(big.sf, mainSync.phase == 'open')
    IT.SetCountdown(big.sf, mainSync.timer)
    IT.ShowScreen(big.sf, IT.SCREEN_WALL_MAIN, nil)
    big.loaded = true
    big.podiumShown = false
    big.raceStarted = false
    big.intermissionShown = false
    big.currentScreen = IT.SCREEN_WALL_MAIN
    big.cycleSegment = -1
end
local function bigScreenUnload()
    big.loaded = false
    big.rendering = false
    big.podiumShown = false
    big.raceStarted = false
    big.intermissionShown = false
    big.currentScreen = nil
    big.cycleSegment = -1
    if big.sf ~= -1 then
        SetScaleformMovieAsNoLongerNeeded(big.sf)
        big.sf = -1
    end
end
local function bigScreenSync()
    if not big.loaded or big.sf == -1 then return end
    local p = mainSync.phase
    IT.SetState(p, false)
    IT.LockMainEvent(big.sf, p ~= 'open')
    IT.ToggleBetting(big.sf, p == 'open')
    IT.SetCountdown(big.sf, p == 'open' and mainSync.timer or 0)
    if p == 'open' then
        if big.raceStarted or big.podiumShown or big.intermissionShown then
            big.raceStarted = false
            big.podiumShown = false
            big.intermissionShown = false
            IT.CleanUp(big.sf)
            big.cycleSegment = -1
        end
        if mainSync.horses then
            IT.SetHorses(big.sf, Horses.buildClient(mainSync.horses))
        end
        local cycleSecs = (config.MainEvent and config.MainEvent.cycleSeconds) or 5
        local elapsed = (config.MainEvent.betWindowSeconds or 60) - (mainSync.timer or 0)
        if elapsed < 0 then elapsed = 0 end
        local segIdx = math.floor(elapsed / cycleSecs)
        if segIdx ~= big.cycleSegment then
            big.cycleSegment = segIdx
            local pos = segIdx % 12
            local isDetail = (pos % 2) == 1
            if isDetail then
                local horseSlot = math.floor(pos / 2) + 1
                IT.FocusHorseOnBigScreen(big.sf, horseSlot, mainSync.perHorse and mainSync.perHorse[horseSlot])
                if big.currentScreen ~= IT.SCREEN_WALL_DETAIL then
                    IT.ShowScreen(big.sf, IT.SCREEN_WALL_DETAIL, big.currentScreen)
                    big.currentScreen = IT.SCREEN_WALL_DETAIL
                end
            else
                IT.SetDetailHorse(big.sf, 0)
                if big.currentScreen ~= IT.SCREEN_WALL_MAIN then
                    IT.ShowScreen(big.sf, IT.SCREEN_WALL_MAIN, big.currentScreen)
                    big.currentScreen = IT.SCREEN_WALL_MAIN
                end
            end
        end
    elseif p == 'racing' and mainSync.raceOrder then
        if not big.raceStarted then
            big.raceStarted = true
            big.podiumShown = false
            big.intermissionShown = false
            big.cycleSegment = -1
            IT.SetDetailHorse(big.sf, 0)
            if mainSync.horses then
                IT.SetHorses(big.sf, Horses.buildClient(mainSync.horses))
            end
            if big.currentScreen ~= IT.SCREEN_WALL_MAIN then
                IT.ShowScreen(big.sf, IT.SCREEN_WALL_MAIN, big.currentScreen)
                big.currentScreen = IT.SCREEN_WALL_MAIN
            end
            if mainSync.perHorse then
                for hi = 1, 6 do
                    local list = mainSync.perHorse[hi] or {}
                for i = 1, #list do
                        IT.AddPlayer(big.sf, list[i].name or 'Unknown', hi, list[i].bet or 0)
                    end
                end
            end
            IT.StartRace(big.sf, config.RaceDuration, mainSync.raceOrder)
        end
    elseif p == 'results' then
        if not big.podiumShown then
            big.podiumShown = true
            big.intermissionShown = false
            big.cycleSegment = -1
            local entries = {}
            for hi = 1, 6 do
                local list = mainSync.perHorse and mainSync.perHorse[hi] or {}
                for i = 1, #list do
                    local b = list[i]
                    local won = (hi == mainSync.winner)
                    local entry = { name = b.name, horse = hi, bet = b.bet, won = won }
                    if won then
                        local oddsR = config.HorseOdds[hi]
                        local oddsAvg = oddsR and ((oddsR.min + oddsR.max) / 2) or 2.0
                        entry.payout = math.floor((b.bet or 0) * oddsAvg)
                    end
                    entries[#entries + 1] = entry
                end
            end
            IT.ShowResultsOnBigScreen(big.sf, entries, big.currentScreen)
            big.currentScreen = IT.SCREEN_WALL_RESULTS
        end
    elseif p == 'intermission' then
        if not big.intermissionShown then
            big.intermissionShown = true
            big.podiumShown = false
            big.raceStarted = false
            big.cycleSegment = -1
            IT.CleanUp(big.sf)
            if big.currentScreen ~= IT.SCREEN_WALL_INTERMISSION then
                IT.ShowScreen(big.sf, IT.SCREEN_WALL_INTERMISSION, big.currentScreen)
                big.currentScreen = IT.SCREEN_WALL_INTERMISSION
            end
        end
    elseif p == 'idle' then
        if big.currentScreen ~= IT.SCREEN_WALL_MAIN then
            IT.ShowScreen(big.sf, IT.SCREEN_WALL_MAIN, big.currentScreen)
            big.currentScreen = IT.SCREEN_WALL_MAIN
        end
    end
end

---Plays a full race animation on the console scaleform and shows results on completion.
---@param raceOrder integer[]
---@param lockClose boolean
---@param onFinish fun()?
local function playRaceOnConsole(raceOrder, lockClose, onFinish)
    if not console.active or console.sf == -1 then return end
    console.phase = PHASE_RACE
    console.raceLocked = lockClose == true
    IT.StartRace(console.sf, config.RaceDuration, raceOrder)
    console.raceSoundId = GetSoundId()
    PlaySoundFrontend(console.raceSoundId, config.RaceSound, config.RaceAudioBank, false)
    Ambient.spawnRaceAnnouncer(raceOrder, false, function()
        return console.active and console.phase == PHASE_RACE
    end)
    CreateThread(function()
        local timeout = GetGameTimer() + config.RaceDuration + 8000
        while console.active and GetGameTimer() < timeout do
            if IT.IsRaceFinished(console.sf) then break end
            Wait(150)
        end
        if console.raceSoundId ~= -1 then
            StopSound(console.raceSoundId)
            ReleaseSoundId(console.raceSoundId)
            console.raceSoundId = -1
        end
        if not console.active then return end
        IT.ClearPlayers(console.sf)
        if console.mode == MODE_MAIN_EVENT and mainSync.perHorse then
            for hi = 1, 6 do
                local list = mainSync.perHorse[hi] or {}
                for i = 1, #list do
                    local b = list[i]
                    local bname = b.name or 'Unknown'
                    local bbet = b.bet or 0
                    IT.AddPlayer(console.sf, bname, hi, bbet)
                    local net
                    if mainSync.winner and hi == mainSync.winner then
                        local oddsR = config.HorseOdds[hi]
                        local oddsAvg = oddsR and ((oddsR.min + oddsR.max) / 2) or 2.0
                        local payout = math.floor(bbet * oddsAvg)
                        net = payout - bbet
                        if net <= 0 then net = payout end
                    else
                        net = -bbet
                    end
                
                    IT.SetPlayerResult(console.sf, bname, net)
                end
            end
        elseif console.mode == MODE_SINGLE then
            local myName = GetPlayerName(cache.playerId) or 'You'
            IT.AddPlayer(console.sf, myName, console.horseIndex, console.bet)
        end
        IT.ShowScreen(console.sf, IT.SCREEN_RESULTS)
        console.raceLocked = false
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        Wait(4000)
        if console.active then
            refreshConsoleMain()
        end
    end)
end

local function seatKeyThread()
    local info = [[
    [kbd]E[/kbd] - Open Inside Track
    [kbd]Backspace[/kbd] - Stand up
    ]]
    infoUI:show({
        id = 'insidetrack_seat',
        title = 'Inside Track',
        icon = 'fas fa-horse',
        description = info
    })
    CreateThread(function (threadId)
        local showInfo = true
        while seatSession.active do
            local sleep = 500
            if not console.active then
                sleep = 0
                if not showInfo then
                    infoUI:show({
                        id = 'insidetrack_seat',
                        title = 'Inside Track',
                        icon = 'fas fa-horse',
                        description = info
                    })
                    showInfo = true
                end
                DisableControlAction(0, KEY_PAUSE, true)
                DisableControlAction(0, KEY_ESC, true)
                DisableControlAction(0, KEY_BACK, true)
                if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, KEY_BACK) then
                    standUp()
                elseif IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, 38) then
                    openInsideTrack()
                end
            else
                if showInfo then
                    infoUI:remove('insidetrack_seat')
                    showInfo = false
                end
            end
            Wait(sleep)
        end
        infoUI:remove('insidetrack_seat')
    end)
end

refreshConsoleMain = function()
    if not console.active or console.sf == -1 then return end
    console.mode = nil
    console.horseIndex = -1
    local p = mainSync.phase
    if console.mainBetPlaced
       and (p == 'racing' or p == 'results' or p == 'intermission') then
        console.phase = PHASE_LOCKED
        IT.CleanUp(console.sf)
        IT.SetState(p, true)
        IT.LockMainEvent(console.sf, true)
        IT.ToggleBetting(console.sf, false)
        IT.SetCountdown(console.sf, 0)
        currentScreen = IT.SCREEN_MAIN
        IT.ShowScreen(console.sf, IT.SCREEN_MAIN, nil)
        return
    end
    console.phase = PHASE_MAIN
    IT.CleanUp(console.sf)
    IT.SetState(p, console.mainBetPlaced)
    IT.LockMainEvent(console.sf, p ~= 'open')
    IT.ToggleBetting(console.sf, p == 'open' and not console.mainBetPlaced)
    IT.SetHorses(console.sf, console.horses or Horses.buildClient(mainSync.horses))
    IT.SetCountdown(console.sf, p == 'open' and mainSync.timer or 0)
    if console.mainBetPlaced and console.myMainBet then
        local bet = console.myMainBet.bet  or 0
        local odds = console.myMainBet.odds or 2.0
        local gain = math.floor(bet * odds)
        IT.ResetBettingValues(console.sf,
            console.myMainBet.horseIndex or 0,
            bet, console.balance, gain)
        IT.ToggleBetting(console.sf, false)
    end
    currentScreen = IT.SCREEN_MAIN
    IT.ShowScreen(console.sf, IT.SCREEN_MAIN, nil)
end

sitDown = function(tIndex)
    if seatSession.active then return end
    local chairPos = chairs[tIndex]
    if not chairPos then return end
    seatSession.active = true
    seatSession.tIndex = tIndex
    Anim.setup(chairPos, config.ChairHeading)
    Anim.enter(seatKeyThread)
end

standUp = function()
    if not seatSession.active then return end
    local tIndex = seatSession.tIndex
    seatSession.active = false
    seatSession.tIndex = nil
    Anim.exit(function()
        TriggerServerEvent('rhd_casino_insidetrack:releaseSeat', tIndex)
    end)
end

openInsideTrack = function(tIndex)
    if console.active then return end
    local canOpen, myBet = lib.callback.await('rhd_casino_insidetrack:canOpen')
    if not canOpen then
        return
    end
    local balance = ox_inventory:GetItemCount(shared.chipItemName) or 0
    console.balance = balance
    console.bet = config.BetMin
    console.horseIndex = -1
    console.mode = nil
    console.phase = PHASE_MAIN
    console.mainBetPlaced = myBet ~= nil
    console.myMainBet = myBet
    console.active = true
    console.raceLocked = false
    DisplayHud(false)
    SetPlayerControl(cache.playerId, false, 0)

    pcall(function()
        local hud = exports.sm_hud
        hud:setComponentVisible('compass', false)
        hud:setComponentVisible('information', false)
        hud:setComponentVisible('healthArmor', false)
    end)

    Ambient.loadBank()
    console.sf = IT.LoadConsole()
    if console.sf == -1 then
        lib.notify({
            title = 'Inside Track',
            description = 'Tampilan Inside Track gagal dimuat. Silakan coba lagi.',
            type = 'error',
        })
        closeInsideTrack()
        return
    end

    local horsesShow = Horses.buildClient(mainSync.horses)
    console.horses = horsesShow
    IT.SetState(mainSync.phase, console.mainBetPlaced)
    IT.LockMainEvent(console.sf, mainSync.phase ~= 'open')
    IT.CleanUp(console.sf)
    IT.ToggleBetting(console.sf, mainSync.phase == 'open' and not console.mainBetPlaced)
    IT.SetHorses(console.sf, horsesShow)
    IT.SetCountdown(console.sf, mainSync.timer)
    if console.mainBetPlaced and console.myMainBet then
        local bet = console.myMainBet.bet  or 0
        local odds = console.myMainBet.odds or 2.0
        local gain = math.floor(bet * odds)
        IT.ResetBettingValues(console.sf,
            console.myMainBet.horseIndex or 0,
            bet, console.balance, gain)
        IT.ToggleBetting(console.sf, false)
    end
    currentScreen = IT.SCREEN_MAIN
    IT.ShowScreen(console.sf, IT.SCREEN_MAIN, IT.SCREEN_MAIN)
    if console.mainBetPlaced
       and (mainSync.phase == 'racing'
            or mainSync.phase == 'results'
            or mainSync.phase == 'intermission') then
        console.phase = PHASE_LOCKED
    end
    CreateThread(function()
        while console.active do
            Wait(0)
            if console.sf ~= -1 then
                local mouseX = GetDisabledControlNormal(2, 239)
                local mouseY = GetDisabledControlNormal(2, 240)
                BeginScaleformMovieMethod(console.sf, 'SET_MOUSE_INPUT')
                ScaleformMovieMethodAddParamFloat(mouseX)
                ScaleformMovieMethodAddParamFloat(mouseY)
                EndScaleformMovieMethod()
                DrawScaleformMovieFullscreen(console.sf, 255, 255, 255, 255, 0)
            end
        end
    end)
    CreateThread(function()
        while console.active do
            Wait(0)
            DisableAllControlActions(0)
            
            EnableControlAction(0, 249, true)
            EnableControlAction(0, KEY_LEFT_CLICK, true)
            if not console.raceLocked then
                EnableControlAction(0, KEY_ESC, true)
                EnableControlAction(0, KEY_BACK, true)
                if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, KEY_ESC) or
                   IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, KEY_BACK) then
                    closeInsideTrack()
                    break
                end
            else
                DisableControlAction(0, KEY_ESC, true)
                DisableControlAction(0, KEY_BACK, true)
            end
            if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, KEY_LEFT_CLICK) then
                if console.sf ~= -1 then
                    local btn = IT.GetClickedButton(console.sf)
                    if btn and btn ~= -1 then
                        handleClick(btn)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

closeInsideTrack = function()
    if not console.active then return end
    if console.raceLocked then return end
    console.active = false
    DisplayHud(true)
    SetPlayerControl(cache.playerId, true, 0)
    EnableAllControlActions(0)
    if console.sf ~= -1 then
        IT.CleanUp(console.sf)
        IT.ShowScreen(console.sf, IT.SCREEN_MAIN, IT.SCREEN_MAIN)
        SetScaleformMovieAsNoLongerNeeded(console.sf)
        console.sf = -1
    end
    if console.raceSoundId ~= -1 then
        StopSound(console.raceSoundId)
        ReleaseSoundId(console.raceSoundId)
        console.raceSoundId = -1
    end
    if not inBettingArea then
        Ambient.releaseBank()
    end

    pcall(function()
        local hud = exports.sm_hud
        hud:setComponentVisible('compass', true)
        hud:setComponentVisible('information', true)
        hud:setComponentVisible('healthArmor', true)
    end)

    console.phase = PHASE_MAIN
    console.mode = nil
    console.horseIndex = -1
end

AddEventHandler('rhd_casino:client:forceLeave', function()
    if console.active then
        console.raceLocked = false
        closeInsideTrack()
    end

    if seatSession.active then
        infoUI:remove('insidetrack_seat')
        Anim.cleanup()
        seatSession.active = false
        seatSession.tIndex = nil
    end
end)

enterBetView = function()
    if not console.myMainBet then return end
    console.mode = MODE_MAIN_EVENT
    console.horseIndex = console.myMainBet.horseIndex
    console.bet = console.myMainBet.bet
    console.odds = console.myMainBet.odds or 2.0
    local gain = math.floor(console.bet * console.odds)
    if mainSync.horses then
        console.horses = Horses.buildClient(mainSync.horses)
        IT.SetHorses(console.sf, console.horses)
    end
    IT.SetState(mainSync.phase, true)
    IT.ToggleBetting(console.sf, false)
    IT.ResetBettingValues(console.sf, console.horseIndex, console.bet, console.balance, gain)
    switchScreen(console.sf, IT.SCREEN_BET_MAIN)
    console.phase = PHASE_VIEW
end

handleClick = function(btn)
    local effectivePhase = console.phase
    if effectivePhase == PHASE_RACE then return end
    if effectivePhase == PHASE_LOCKED then
        effectivePhase = PHASE_MAIN
    end
    if effectivePhase == PHASE_VIEW then
        if btn == BTN_CLOSE or btn == BTN_BACK then
            refreshConsoleMain()
        end
        return
    end
    if effectivePhase == PHASE_MAIN then
        if btn == BTN_PLACE_BET_MAIN or btn == BTN_PLACE_BET_ALT then
            if console.mainBetPlaced then
                enterBetView()
                return
            end
            if mainSync.phase ~= 'open' then
                lib.notify({
                    title = 'Inside Track',
                    description = 'Main event belum dibuka. Tunggu round berikutnya.',
                    type = 'inform',
                })
                return
            end
            console.mode = MODE_MAIN_EVENT
            console.bet = config.BetMin
            if mainSync.horses then
                console.horses = Horses.buildClient(mainSync.horses)
            end
            IT.SetHorses(console.sf, console.horses)
            switchScreen(console.sf, IT.SCREEN_SELECT_MAIN)
            console.phase = PHASE_SELECT
            return
        end
        if btn == BTN_PLACE_BET_SINGLE then
            console.mode = MODE_SINGLE
            console.bet = config.BetMin
            IT.SetHorses(console.sf, console.horses)
            switchScreen(console.sf, IT.SCREEN_SELECT)
            console.phase = PHASE_SELECT
            return
        end
        if btn == BTN_RULES then
            switchScreen(console.sf, IT.SCREEN_RULES)
            console.phase = PHASE_RULES
            return
        end
        return
    end
    if console.phase == PHASE_RULES then
        if btn == BTN_CLOSE or btn == BTN_BACK then
            refreshConsoleMain()
        end
        return
    end
    if console.phase == PHASE_SELECT then
        if btn == BTN_CLOSE or btn == BTN_BACK then
            refreshConsoleMain()
            return
        end
        if btn >= 2 and btn <= 7 then
            console.horseIndex = btn - 1
            local r = config.HorseOdds[console.horseIndex]
            console.odds = r and r.min or 2.0
            local gain = math.floor(console.bet * console.odds)
            local betScreen = (console.mode == MODE_MAIN_EVENT) and IT.SCREEN_BET_MAIN or IT.SCREEN_BET
            IT.SetState(mainSync.phase, console.mainBetPlaced)
            IT.ToggleBetting(console.sf, true)
            IT.SetBettingValues(console.sf, console.horseIndex, console.bet, console.balance, gain)
            switchScreen(console.sf, betScreen)
            console.phase = PHASE_BET
        end
        return
    end
    if console.phase == PHASE_BET then
        if btn == BTN_BET_UP then
            local newBet = math.min(console.bet + config.BetStep, config.BetMax, console.balance)
            if newBet ~= console.bet then
                console.bet = newBet
                local gain = math.floor(console.bet * console.odds)
                IT.SetBettingValues(console.sf, console.horseIndex, console.bet, console.balance, gain)
            end
            return
        end
        if btn == BTN_BET_DOWN then
            local newBet = math.max(console.bet - config.BetStep, config.BetMin)
            if newBet ~= console.bet then
                console.bet = newBet
                local gain = math.floor(console.bet * console.odds)
                IT.SetBettingValues(console.sf, console.horseIndex, console.bet, console.balance, gain)
            end
            return
        end
        if btn == BTN_CONFIRM then
            if console.mode == MODE_MAIN_EVENT then
                placeMainBet()
            else
                startSingleRace()
            end
            return
        end
        if btn == BTN_CLOSE or btn == BTN_BACK then
            local selectScreen = (console.mode == MODE_MAIN_EVENT) and IT.SCREEN_SELECT_MAIN or IT.SCREEN_SELECT
            switchScreen(console.sf, selectScreen)
            console.phase = PHASE_SELECT
            console.horseIndex = -1
            return
        end
    end
end

placeMainBet = function()
    if not console.active then return end
    local res = lib.callback.await('rhd_casino_insidetrack:betMain', false, {
        horseIndex = console.horseIndex,
        bet = console.bet,
    })
    if not res then
        return
    end
    console.balance = res.newBalance
    console.mainBetPlaced = true
    console.myMainBet = {
        horseIndex = console.horseIndex,
        bet = console.bet,
        odds = res.odds,
        roundId = res.roundId,
    }
    console.odds = res.odds
    lib.notify({
        title = 'Inside Track',
        description = ('Bet $%s pada kuda #%d (odds: %.2fx). Race dalam %ds.'):format(
            lib.math.groupdigits(console.bet),
            console.horseIndex,
            res.odds,
            res.timer
        ),
        type = 'success',
        duration = 5000,
    })
    refreshConsoleMain()
end

startSingleRace = function()
    if not console.active then return end
    local res = lib.callback.await('rhd_casino_insidetrack:betSingle', false, {
        horseIndex = console.horseIndex,
        bet = console.bet,
    })
    if not res then
        return
    end
    console.balance = res.newBalance
    playRaceOnConsole(res.raceOrder, true, function()
        lib.notify({
            title = 'Inside Track',
            description = ('Kuda #%d menang. Hasil sedang diproses...'):format(res.winner),
            type = 'inform',
            duration = 3000,
        })
    end)
end

            bigScreenUnload()

        Ambient.resetRoundState()
        if not console.active then
            Ambient.releaseBank()
        end
    end
end)

    local nowInside = (roomname == 'rm_BettingRoom')
    if nowInside ~= inBettingArea then
        inBettingArea = nowInside
        if inBettingArea then
            Ambient.loadBank()
        else
            Ambient.stopMainRaceLoop()
            Ambient.resetRoundState()
            if not console.active then
                Ambient.releaseBank()
            end
        end
    end
end)

    while true do
        local sleep =
        (not console.active and big.target ~= 0 and big.sf ~= -1 and inBettingArea) and 0 or 500
        if sleep == 0 then

            SetTextRenderId(GetDefaultScriptRendertargetRenderId())
            SetScriptGfxDrawBehindPausemenu(false)
        end
        Wait(sleep)
    end
end)
