RegisterNetEvent('rhd_casino_insidetrack:client:singleResult', function(data)
    if source == '' or not data then return end
    console.balance = data.finalBalance or console.balance
    if console.active and console.sf ~= -1 then
        local myName = GetPlayerName(cache.playerId) or 'You'
        local net = (data.won or data.isConsol)
            and ((data.payout or 0) - (data.bet or 0))
            or -(data.bet or 0)
        if (data.won or data.isConsol) and net <= 0 then net = data.payout or 0 end
        IT.SetPlayerResult(console.sf, myName, net)
    end
    if data.won or data.isConsol then
        lib.notify({
            title = 'Inside Track',
            description = ('Kuda #%d menang! Kamu menang **$%s**'):format(
                data.winner, lib.math.groupdigits(data.payout)
            ),
            type = 'success',
            duration = 6000,
        })
    else
        lib.notify({
            title = 'Inside Track',
            description = ('Kuda #%d menang. Kamu kalah $%s.'):format(
                data.winner, lib.math.groupdigits(data.bet)
            ),
            type = 'error',
            duration = 4000,
        })
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_casino_insidetrack:client:mainState', function(data)
    if source == '' or not data then return end
    if data.roundId and data.roundId ~= mainSync.roundId then
        if data.phase == 'open' or data.phase == 'idle' then
            console.mainBetPlaced = false
            console.myMainBet = nil
        end
        Ambient.resetRoundState()
    end
    local prevPhase = mainSync.phase
    mainSync.roundId = data.roundId or mainSync.roundId
    mainSync.phase = data.phase or mainSync.phase
    mainSync.horses = data.horses or mainSync.horses
    mainSync.timer = data.timer or 0
    mainSync.perHorse = data.perHorse or mainSync.perHorse
    mainSync.raceOrder = data.raceOrder
    mainSync.winner = data.winner
    local newPhase = mainSync.phase
    if inBettingArea or console.active then
        if newPhase ~= prevPhase then
            if newPhase == 'open' then
                Ambient.resetRoundState()
                Ambient.announceCustom('MINIGAME_TRACK_EVENT_STARTING', true)
            elseif newPhase == 'racing' then
                Ambient.stopMainRaceLoop()
                Ambient.startMainRaceLoop()
                Ambient.spawnRaceAnnouncer(mainSync.raceOrder, true, function()
                    return mainSync.phase == 'racing'
                end)
            elseif newPhase == 'results' then
                Ambient.stopMainRaceLoop()
                Ambient.spawnPodiumAnnounce(mainSync.raceOrder, mainSync.winner, function()
                    return mainSync.phase == 'results'
                end)
            elseif newPhase == 'intermission' or newPhase == 'idle' then
                Ambient.stopMainRaceLoop()
            end
        end
    end
    if console.active and console.sf ~= -1 then
        local p = mainSync.phase
        if p == 'racing' then
            if (console.phase == PHASE_SELECT or console.phase == PHASE_BET)
               and console.mode == MODE_MAIN_EVENT then
                lib.notify({
                    title = 'Inside Track',
                    description = 'Waktu betting habis. Tunggu round berikutnya.',
                    type = 'error',
                    duration = 4000,
                })
                refreshConsoleMain()
            elseif console.phase ~= PHASE_RACE then
                refreshConsoleMain()
            end
        elseif p == 'open' or p == 'results' or p == 'intermission' or p == 'idle' then
            if console.phase == PHASE_MAIN
               or console.phase == PHASE_LOCKED
               or console.phase == PHASE_VIEW then
                refreshConsoleMain()
            end
        end
    end
    bigScreenSync()
end)

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_casino_insidetrack:client:mainTick', function(round, phase, timer)
    if source == '' then return end
    mainSync.timer = timer or 0
    if phase then mainSync.phase = phase end
    if (inBettingArea or console.active) and mainSync.phase == 'open' then
        Ambient.tickCountdown(mainSync.timer)
    end
    local showTimer = (mainSync.phase == 'open') and mainSync.timer or 0
    if console.active and console.sf ~= -1
       and (console.phase == PHASE_MAIN or console.phase == PHASE_SELECT
            or console.phase == PHASE_BET or console.phase == PHASE_VIEW) then
        IT.SetCountdown(console.sf, showTimer)
    end
    if big.loaded and big.sf ~= -1 then
        IT.SetCountdown(big.sf, showTimer)
        bigScreenSync()
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_casino_insidetrack:client:perHorseUpdate', function(data)
    if source == '' then return end
    if not data or data.roundId ~= mainSync.roundId then return end
    mainSync.perHorse[data.horseIndex] = data.bettors or {}
    if big.loaded and big.sf ~= -1 and mainSync.phase == 'open'
       and big.currentScreen == IT.SCREEN_WALL_DETAIL then
        IT.FocusHorseOnBigScreen(big.sf, data.horseIndex, mainSync.perHorse[data.horseIndex])
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_casino_insidetrack:client:mainResult', function(data)
    if source == '' or not data then return end
    console.balance = data.finalBalance or console.balance
    lib.notify({
        title = 'Inside Track',
        description = ('Kuda #%d berhasil memenangkan Main Event. Round akan segera dimulai kembali.'):format(
            data.winner
        ),
        type = 'info',
        duration = 8000,
    })
    console.mainBetPlaced = false
    console.myMainBet = nil
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource == cache.resource then
        if console.active then
            DisplayHud(true)
            SetPlayerControl(PlayerId(), true, 0)
            EnableAllControlActions(0)
            if console.sf ~= -1 then
                SetScaleformMovieAsNoLongerNeeded(console.sf)
            end
        end
        if seatSession.active then
            Anim.cleanup()
            seatSession.active = false
            seatSession.tIndex = nil
        end
        Ambient.stopMainRaceLoop()
        Ambient.releaseBank()
        bigScreenUnload()
    end
end)

return {

    BetMin = 20000,
    BetMax = 100000,
    BetStep = 5000,

    -- Durasi race scaleform (milliseconds) â€” harus sama di server & client
    RaceDuration = 30000,

    -- Heading (derajat) yang menghadap ke big screen untuk semua kursi
    -- terminal. -167 = menghadap big screen di interior casino GTAO default.
    ChairHeading = -167.0,

    -- Multiplier kemenangan berdasarkan odds kuda
    -- Setiap kuda mendapat odds yang di-assign server, bukan client
    -- Odds = kelipatan dari bet yang dikembalikan jika menang (termasuk modal)
    HorseOdds = {
        [1] = { min = 1, max = 2 },   -- Kuda 1: odds rendah (favorit)
        [2] = { min = 2, max = 3 },
        [3] = { min = 2, max = 4 },
        [4] = { min = 3, max = 5 },
        [5] = { min = 4, max = 7 },
        [6] = { min = 5, max = 10 },  -- Kuda 6: odds tinggi (underdog)
    },

    -- Peluang menang tiap kuda (total harus = 100)
    -- Server menggunakan ini untuk menentukan pemenang
    HorseWinChance = {
        [1] = 30, -- 30%
        [2] = 22, -- 22%
        [3] = 18, -- 18%
        [4] = 15, -- 15%
        [5] = 10, -- 10%
        [6] = 5, --  5%
    },

    -- Level kesulitan global inside track.
    -- level: pilih salah satu kunci di presets ('easy'|'normal'|'hard'|'rigged').
    -- winChance: peluang (0-100, boleh desimal) sebuah ronde dibiarkan menghasilkan pemenang dari kuda yang ditaruhi.
    --            Jika gagal, server memilih kuda pemenang yang tidak ditaruhi siapa pun (semua bettor kalah penuh).
    Difficulty = {
        level = 'hard',
        presets = {
            easy = { winChance = 100.0 },
            normal = { winChance = 100.0 },
            hard = { winChance = 35.0 },
            rigged = { winChance = 0.1 },
        },
    },

    BigScreen = {
        coords = vector3(952.2609, 85.3877, 70.0328),
        renderTarget = 'casinoscreen_02',
        objectModel = `vw_vwint01_betting_screen`,
        drawDistance = 30.0,
    },

    -- Audio
    AudioBank = 'DLC_VINEWOOD/CASINO_GENERAL',
    RaceAudioBank = 'dlc_vw_casino_inside_track_betting_single_event_sounds',
    RaceMainAudioBank = 'dlc_vw_casino_inside_track_betting_main_event_sounds',
    RaceSound = 'race_loop',

    -- Voice ambient untuk announcer (CAS_HORSE_ANNOUNCER = preset asli GTAO)
    AnnouncerVoice = 'CAS_HORSE_ANNOUNCER',

    -- Mapping slot kuda (1-6) ke speech name id (untuk MINIGAME_TRACK_*_<NAME>)
    -- Sesuai dengan urutan horseDisplayNames di modules/horses.lua
    HorseSpeechIds = {
        'DURBAN_POISON',
        'SWEET_RELEAF',
        'ROBOCALL',
        'BANANA_HAMMOCK',
        'SALTY_AND_WOKE',
        'WONDER_BOY',
    },

    -- â”€â”€ Main Event (Multiplayer) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    -- Main Event = race bersama semua pemain di casino setiap beberapa menit
    -- Semua pemain yang pasang bet pada main event akan ikut race yang SAMA
    --
    -- Flow: idle â†’ open (countdown) â†’ presentation â†’ racing â†’ results â†’ idle
    MainEvent = {
        -- Durasi countdown utuh (detik). Betting TERBUKA SELAMA countdown ini.
        -- Saat timer = 0 â†’ race start, menu bet ditutup paksa untuk participant.
        betWindowSeconds = 120,

        -- Durasi tiap segmen big screen selama countdown (detik).
        -- Big screen alternasi: list (5s) â†’ detail kuda 1 (5s) â†’ list (5s) â†’
        -- detail kuda 2 (5s) â†’ ... â†’ detail kuda 6 (5s) â†’ ulang.
        cycleSeconds = 5,

        -- Layar hasil (screen 4) setelah race selesai (detik)
        resultDisplaySeconds = 10,

        -- Layar intermission (screen 5) sebelum round berikutnya (detik)
        intermissionSeconds = 2,

        -- Radius pemain dianggap "menonton" big screen (subscribe ke broadcast)
        broadcastRadius = 90.0,
    },
}


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\rhd_casino\casino\insidetrack\server.lua
local insidetrack = {}
insidetrack.roundId = 0
insidetrack.phase = 'idle'  ---@type 'idle' | 'open' | 'racing' | 'results' | 'intermission'
insidetrack.bets = {}
insidetrack.players = {}
insidetrack.timer = 0
insidetrack.seats = {}
insidetrack.perHorse = {
    [1] = {}, [2] = {}, [3] = {}, [4] = {}, [5] = {}, [6] = {},
}
insidetrack.single = {
    pending = {},
    raceLockUntil = {},
}
local config = require 'casino.insidetrack.config'
local Horses = require 'casino.insidetrack.modules.horses'
local Chairs = require 'casino.insidetrack.data.chairs'
---@class InsideTrackState
---@field roundId number
---@field phase string
---@field horses table?
---@field timer number
---@field winner integer?
---@field raceOrder integer[]?
---@field perHorse table<integer, table>
---@param source number
---@return boolean
local function isNearScreen(source)
    local ped = GetPlayerPed(source)
    local coords = config.BigScreen.coords
    local pos = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local dist = #(pos - coords)
    return dist <= 150
end

---@param source number
---@param chairIndex integer
---@return boolean
local function isNearChair(source, chairIndex)
    local chair = Chairs[chairIndex]
    if not chair then return false end

    local ped = GetPlayerPed(source)
    if ped == 0 then return false end

    return #(GetEntityCoords(ped) - chair) <= 3.0
end
---@return InsideTrackState
local function getState()
    return {
        roundId = insidetrack.roundId,
        phase = insidetrack.phase,
        horses = insidetrack.horses,
        timer = insidetrack.timer,
        winner = insidetrack.winner,
        raceOrder = insidetrack.raceOrder,
        perHorse = insidetrack.perHorse,
    }
end
---Sends full current state and screen assignment to a newly subscribed player.
---@param source number
local function addSubscriber(source)
    TriggerCasinoEvent('rhd_casino_insidetrack:client:mainState', source, getState())
    if insidetrack.phase == 'racing' then
        TriggerCasinoEvent('rhd_casino_insidetrack:client:setScreen', source, 5)
    else
        TriggerCasinoEvent('rhd_casino_insidetrack:client:setScreen', source, 0)
    end
end
---@return integer
local function pickWinner()
    local total = 0
    for i = 1, 6 do total = total + (config.HorseWinChance[i] or 0) end
    if total <= 0 then return math.random(1, 6) end
    local roll = math.random() * total
    local cum = 0
    for i = 1, 6 do
        cum = cum + (config.HorseWinChance[i] or 0)
        if roll <= cum then return i end
    end
    return 6
end
---@param winner integer
---@return integer[]
local function generateRaceOrder(winner)
    local order = { winner }
    local pool = {}
    for i = 1, 6 do
        if i ~= winner then pool[#pool + 1] = i end
    end
    for i = #pool, 2, -1 do
        local j = math.random(i)
        pool[i], pool[j] = pool[j], pool[i]
    end
    for i = 1, #pool do order[#order + 1] = pool[i] end
    return order
end
---@param horseIndex integer
---@return number
local function rollOdds(horseIndex)
    local r = config.HorseOdds[horseIndex]
    if not r then return 2.0 end
    local odds = r.min + (r.max - r.min) * math.random()
    return math.floor(odds * 100) / 100
end
---Resolves all active main event bets against the current winner and populates insidetrack.players.
local function settleMainEventBets()
    for src, bd in pairs(insidetrack.bets) do
        local won = (bd.horseIndex == insidetrack.winner)
        local payout = won and math.floor(bd.bet * bd.odds) or 0
        insidetrack.players[src] = {
            won = won,
            payout = payout,
            bet = bd.bet,
            horseIndex = bd.horseIndex,
            name = bd.name,
        }
    end
end
---Resets all round state and advances the round ID for a new betting window.
local function resetMainEventForNewRound()
    insidetrack.roundId = insidetrack.roundId + 1
    insidetrack.phase = 'open'
    insidetrack.horses = Horses.generate()
    insidetrack.bets = {}
    insidetrack.timer = config.MainEvent.betWindowSeconds
    insidetrack.players = {}
    insidetrack.perHorse = {
        [1] = {}, [2] = {}, [3] = {}, [4] = {}, [5] = {}, [6] = {},
    }
    BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_insidetrack:client:setScreen')
end
---@param source number
---@param amount number
local function addBalance(source, amount)
    ox_inventory:AddItem(source, shared.chipItemName, amount)
end

---@param source number
---@param amount number
---@param game string
---@param bankAmount number?
---@return boolean
local function payPrize(source, amount, game, bankAmount)
    return shared.payCasinoChipPrize(source, amount, game, bankAmount)
end
---Pays out winnings and triggers result notification for all settled players.
local function payoutMainEventBets()
    for src, p in pairs(insidetrack.players) do
        local bet = p.bet or 0
        local payout = p.payout or 0
        if p.won and p.payout > 0 then
            payPrize(src, payout, 'insidetrack_main', math.max(payout - bet, 0))
        end
        local netLoss = bet - payout
        if netLoss > 0 then
            shared.depositCasinoLoss(src, netLoss, 'insidetrack_main')
        end
        local results = {
            won = p.won,
            payout = payout,
            bet = bet,
            horseIndex = p.horseIndex,
            winner = insidetrack.winner,
            finalBalance = ox_inventory:GetItemCount(src, shared.chipItemName) or 0,
        }
        TriggerCasinoEvent('rhd_casino_insidetrack:client:mainResult', src, results)
    end
end
CreateThread(function()
    Wait(5000)
    while true do
        resetMainEventForNewRound()
        BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_insidetrack:client:mainState', getState())
        for i = config.MainEvent.betWindowSeconds - 1, 0, -1 do
            Wait(1000)
            insidetrack.timer = i
            BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_insidetrack:client:mainTick',
                insidetrack.roundId, insidetrack.phase, insidetrack.timer)
        end
        insidetrack.winner = pickWinner()
        if not shared.rollDifficulty(config.Difficulty) then
            local betHorses = {}
            for _, bd in pairs(insidetrack.bets) do
                betHorses[bd.horseIndex] = true
            end
            local candidates = {}
            for i = 1, 6 do
                if not betHorses[i] then candidates[#candidates + 1] = i end
            end
            if #candidates > 0 then
                insidetrack.winner = candidates[math.random(1, #candidates)]
            end
        end
        insidetrack.raceOrder = generateRaceOrder(insidetrack.winner)
        insidetrack.phase = 'racing'
        insidetrack.timer = 0
        settleMainEventBets()
        BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_insidetrack:client:mainState', getState())
        Wait(config.RaceDuration + 2000)
        insidetrack.phase = 'results'
        BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_insidetrack:client:mainState', getState())
        payoutMainEventBets()
        Wait(config.MainEvent.resultDisplaySeconds * 1000)
        insidetrack.phase = 'intermission'
        insidetrack.bets = {}
        insidetrack.players = {}
        BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_insidetrack:client:mainState', getState())
        Wait(config.MainEvent.intermissionSeconds * 1000)
    end
end)
lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_insidetrack:canOpen', function(source)
    if not isNearScreen(source) then
        lib.notify(source, {
            title = 'Inside Track',
            description = 'Terlalu jauh dari terminal.',
            type = 'error',
        })
        return false
    end
    return true, insidetrack.bets[source]
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_insidetrack:betMain', function(source, data)
    local horseIndex = data and data.horseIndex
    local bet = math.floor(tonumber(data and data.bet) or 0)
    if insidetrack.phase ~= 'open' then
        lib.notify(source, {
            title = 'Inside Track',
            description = 'Pendaftaran main event ditutup.',
            type = 'error',
        })
        return false
    end
    if insidetrack.bets[source] then
        lib.notify(source, {
            title = 'Inside Track',
            description = 'Kamu sudah pasang bet di event ini.',
            type = 'error',
        })
        return false
    end
    if not isNearScreen(source) then
        lib.notify(source, {
            title = 'Inside Track',
            description = 'Terlalu jauh dari terminal.',
            type = 'error',
        })
        return false
    end
    if type(horseIndex) ~= 'number' or horseIndex < 1 or horseIndex > 6 then
        lib.notify(source, {
            title = 'Inside Track',
            description = 'Kuda tidak valid.',
            type = 'error',
        })
        return false
    end
    if bet < config.BetMin or bet > config.BetMax then
        lib.notify(source, {
            title = 'Inside Track',
            description = ('Bet harus $%s - $%s.'):format(config.BetMin, config.BetMax),
            type = 'error',
        })
        return false
    end
    local balance = ox_inventory:GetItemCount(source, shared.chipItemName) or 0
    if balance < bet then
        lib.notify(source, {
            title = 'Inside Track',
            description = 'Uang tidak cukup.',
            type = 'error',
        })
        return false
    end
    if not ox_inventory:RemoveItem(source, shared.chipItemName, bet) then
        lib.notify(source, {
            title = 'Inside Track',
            description = 'Gagal potong saldo.',
            type = 'error',
        })
        return false
    end
    local odds = rollOdds(horseIndex)
    local pname = shared.getPlayerName(source)
    insidetrack.bets[source] = {
        horseIndex = horseIndex,
        bet = bet,
        odds = odds,
        name = pname,
        roundId = insidetrack.roundId,
    }
    table.insert(insidetrack.perHorse[horseIndex], {
        name = pname,
        bet = bet,
        src = source,
    })
    BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_insidetrack:client:perHorseUpdate', {
        roundId = insidetrack.roundId,
        horseIndex = horseIndex,
        bettors = insidetrack.perHorse[horseIndex],
    })
    return {
        odds = odds,
        newBalance = balance - bet,
        timer = insidetrack.timer,
        roundId = insidetrack.roundId,
    }
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_insidetrack:betSingle', function(source, data)
    local bet = math.floor(tonumber(data?.bet) or 0)
    local horseIndex = data?.horseIndex
    local sess = insidetrack.single
    if sess.pending[source] or os.time() < (sess.raceLockUntil[source] or 0) then
        lib.notify(source, {
            title = 'Inside Track',
            description = 'Race sedang berlangsung.',
            type = 'error',
        })
        return false
    end
    if not isNearScreen(source) then
        lib.notify(source, {
            title = 'Inside Track',
            description = 'Terlalu jauh dari terminal.',
            type = 'error',
        })
        return false
    end
    if type(horseIndex) ~= 'number' or horseIndex < 1 or horseIndex > 6 then
        lib.notify(source, {
            title = 'Inside Track',
            description = 'Kuda tidak valid.',
            type = 'error',
        })
        return false
    end
    if bet < config.BetMin or bet > config.BetMax then
        lib.notify(source, {
            title = 'Inside Track',
            description = ('Bet harus $%s - $%s.'):format(config.BetMin, config.BetMax),
            type = 'error',
        })
        return false
    end
    local balance = ox_inventory:GetItemCount(source, shared.chipItemName) or 0
    if balance < bet then
        lib.notify(source, {
            title = 'Inside Track',
            description = 'Uang tidak cukup.',
            type = 'error',
        })
        return false
    end
    if not ox_inventory:RemoveItem(source, shared.chipItemName, bet) then
        lib.notify(source, {
            title = 'Inside Track',
            description = 'Gagal potong saldo.',
            type = 'error',
        })
        return false
    end
    local newBalance = balance - bet
    local winner = pickWinner()
    local raceOrder = generateRaceOrder(winner)
    local won = (winner == horseIndex)
    local payout = 0
    local isConsol = false
    if won then
        local odds = rollOdds(horseIndex)
        payout = math.floor(bet * odds)
        sess.lossStreak = 0
        sess.totalWon = (sess.totalWon or 0) + (payout - bet)
    else
        sess.lossStreak = (sess.lossStreak or 0) + 1
    end
    local netLoss = bet - payout
    if netLoss > 0 then
        shared.depositCasinoLoss(source, netLoss, 'insidetrack_single')
    end
    local identifier = shared.getIdentifier(source)
    sess.raceLockUntil[source] = os.time() + math.ceil(config.RaceDuration / 1000) + 5
    sess.pending[source] = {
        payAt = GetGameTimer() + config.RaceDuration,
        amount = payout,
        won = won,
        isConsol = isConsol,
        winner = winner,
        bet = bet,
        horseIndex = horseIndex,
        finalBalance = newBalance + payout,
        identifier = identifier,
    }
    SetTimeout(config.RaceDuration, function()
        local p = sess.pending[source]
        if not p then return end
        sess.pending[source] = nil
        sess.raceLockUntil[source] = nil

        if not shared.playerExist(source) or shared.getIdentifier(source) ~= p.identifier then
            return
        end

        if p.amount > 0 then
            payPrize(source, p.amount, 'insidetrack_single', math.max(p.amount - p.bet, 0))
        end
        TriggerCasinoEvent('rhd_casino_insidetrack:client:singleResult', source, {
            won = p.won,
            isConsol = p.isConsol,
            payout = p.amount,
            bet = p.bet,
            horseIndex = p.horseIndex,
            winner = p.winner,
            finalBalance = ox_inventory:GetItemCount(source, shared.chipItemName) or 0,
        })
    end)
    return {
        raceOrder = raceOrder,
        winner = winner,
        newBalance = newBalance,
    }
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_insidetrack:checkSeat', function(source, tIndex)
    tIndex = math.floor(tonumber(tIndex) or 0)
    if tIndex < 1 or not Chairs[tIndex] or not isNearChair(source, tIndex) then
        return false
    end

    for _, occupant in pairs(insidetrack.seats) do
        if occupant == source then return false end
    end

    local occupant = insidetrack.seats[tIndex]
    if not occupant then
        insidetrack.seats[tIndex] = source
        gstate:set('insidetrack_seat_' .. tIndex, true, true)
        return true
    end
    return false
end)

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_casino_insidetrack:releaseSeat', function(tIndex)
    local source = source
    if type(tIndex) ~= 'number' then return end
    if insidetrack.seats[tIndex] == source then
        insidetrack.seats[tIndex] = nil
        gstate:set('insidetrack_seat_' .. tIndex, false, true)
    end
end)

---@param source number
local function releasePlayer(source)
    if insidetrack.phase == 'open' and insidetrack.bets[source] then
        addBalance(source, insidetrack.bets[source].bet)
        local horseIndex = insidetrack.bets[source].horseIndex
        insidetrack.bets[source] = nil

        local bettors = insidetrack.perHorse[horseIndex]
        if bettors then
            for i = #bettors, 1, -1 do
                if bettors[i].src == source then
                    table.remove(bettors, i)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for tIndex, occupant in pairs(insidetrack.seats) do
        if occupant == source then
            insidetrack.seats[tIndex] = nil
            gstate:set('insidetrack_seat_' .. tIndex, false, true)
        end
    end

    insidetrack.single.pending[source] = nil
    insidetrack.single.raceLockUntil[source] = nil
end

AddEventHandler('rhd_casino:interiorChanged', function(source, inInterior)
    if inInterior then
        addSubscriber(source)
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    releasePlayer(source)
end)

AddEventHandler('rhd_casino:releasePlayer', function(playerId)
    releasePlayer(playerId)
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\rhd_casino\casino\insidetrack\modules\ambient.lua
local Ambient = {}
local NUMBER_WORDS <const> = { 'ONE', 'TWO', 'THREE', 'FOUR', 'FIVE', 'SIX' }
local PLACE_WORDS  <const> = { 'FIRST', 'SECOND', 'THIRD', 'FOURTH', 'FIFTH', 'LAST' }
local state = {
    bankLoaded = false,
    bankRequested = false,
    mainRaceSoundId = -1,
    lastMinAnnounced = -1,
    countdownAnnounced = false,
    podiumThreadActive = false,
}
local config = require 'casino.insidetrack.config'
local function getMainEventCoord()
    return (config.BigScreen and config.BigScreen.coords)
        or vector3(952.17804, 85.37027, 70.032761)
end

local function speechCoord(isMain)
    if isMain then return getMainEventCoord() end
    return GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
end

function Ambient.loadBank()
    if state.bankLoaded or state.bankRequested then return end
    state.bankRequested = true
    state.bankLoaded = pcall(lib.requestAudioBank, config.AudioBank, 1500)
    state.bankRequested = false
end

function Ambient.releaseBank()
    if state.bankLoaded then
        ReleaseNamedScriptAudioBank(config.AudioBank)
        state.bankLoaded = false
    end
    state.bankRequested = false
end

---@return boolean
function Ambient.isBankLoaded()
    return state.bankLoaded
end

---@param speech string
---@param pos vector3?
function Ambient.playAnnouncer(speech, pos)
    if not speech then return end
    pos = pos or GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    PlayAmbientSpeechFromPositionNative(
        speech,
        config.AnnouncerVoice or 'CAS_HORSE_ANNOUNCER',
        pos.x, pos.y, pos.z,
        'SPEECH_PARAMS_FORCE'
    )
end

---@param speech string
---@param isMain boolean?
function Ambient.announceCustom(speech, isMain)
    Ambient.playAnnouncer(speech, speechCoord(isMain))
end

---@param horseId number
---@param isMain  boolean?
function Ambient.announceFinalWinner(horseId, isMain)
    if not horseId then return end
    local nameId = config.HorseSpeechIds and config.HorseSpeechIds[horseId]
    if not nameId then return end
    local prefixes <const> = {
        'MINIGAME_TRACK_FIRST_PLACE_',
        'MINIGAME_TRACK_CLOSE_FINISH_',
        'MINIGAME_TRACK_LEAD_',
    }
    local prefix = prefixes[math.random(1, #prefixes)]
    Ambient.playAnnouncer(prefix .. nameId, speechCoord(isMain))
end

---@param horseId number 1-6
---@param place number 1-6
---@param isFinal boolean?
---@param isMain  boolean?
function Ambient.announcePlace(horseId, place, isFinal, isMain)
    if not horseId or not place then return end
    if horseId < 1 or horseId > 6 then return end
    if place   < 1 or place   > 6 then return end
    local prefix = isFinal and 'MINIGAME_TRACK_FINISH_' or 'MINIGAME_TRACK_'
    local speech = prefix .. PLACE_WORDS[place] .. '_PLACE_' .. NUMBER_WORDS[horseId]
    Ambient.playAnnouncer(speech, speechCoord(isMain))
end

function Ambient.startMainRaceLoop()
    Ambient.stopMainRaceLoop()
    state.mainRaceSoundId = GetSoundId()
    local pos = getMainEventCoord()
    PlaySoundFromCoord(
        state.mainRaceSoundId,
        config.RaceSound or 'race_loop',
        pos.x, pos.y, pos.z,
        config.RaceMainAudioBank or 'dlc_vw_casino_inside_track_betting_main_event_sounds',
        false, 13, false
    )
end

function Ambient.stopMainRaceLoop()
    if state.mainRaceSoundId ~= -1 then
        StopSound(state.mainRaceSoundId)
        ReleaseSoundId(state.mainRaceSoundId)
        state.mainRaceSoundId = -1
    end
end

---@param raceOrder integer[]
---@param isMain boolean?
---@param getActive fun():boolean
function Ambient.spawnRaceAnnouncer(raceOrder, isMain, getActive)
    CreateThread(function()
        local duration = config.RaceDuration or 30000
        local startedAt = GetGameTimer()
        Ambient.announceCustom('MINIGAME_TRACK_RACE_START', isMain)
        local halfwayAt = startedAt + math.floor(duration / 2)
        local nearEndAt = startedAt + math.max(duration - 5000, 0)
        local endAt = startedAt + duration
        local placeAt1 = startedAt + 4000
        local placeAt2 = startedAt + math.floor(duration * 0.65)
        local saidHalf, saidNear = false, false
        local saidPlace1, saidPlace2 = false, false
        while true do
            if getActive and not getActive() then break end
            local now = GetGameTimer()
            if now >= endAt then break end
            if not saidPlace1 and now >= placeAt1 and raceOrder and raceOrder[1] then
                saidPlace1 = true
                Ambient.announcePlace(raceOrder[1], 1, false, isMain)
            elseif not saidHalf and now >= halfwayAt then
                saidHalf = true
                Ambient.announceCustom('MINIGAME_TRACK_HALFWAY', isMain)
            elseif not saidPlace2 and now >= placeAt2 and raceOrder and raceOrder[2] then
                saidPlace2 = true
                Ambient.announcePlace(raceOrder[2], 2, false, isMain)
            elseif not saidNear and now >= nearEndAt then
                saidNear = true
                Ambient.announceCustom('MINIGAME_TRACK_FINISH_NEAR', isMain)
            end
            Wait(500)
        end
    end)
end

---@param raceOrder integer[]
---@param winnerSlot number?
---@param isPhaseOk fun():boolean
function Ambient.spawnPodiumAnnounce(raceOrder, winnerSlot, isPhaseOk)
    if state.podiumThreadActive then return end
    state.podiumThreadActive = true
    CreateThread(function()
        if winnerSlot and raceOrder and raceOrder[1] then
            Ambient.announceFinalWinner(raceOrder[1], true)
        end
        for place = 1, 3 do
            if isPhaseOk and not isPhaseOk() then break end
            local horseId = raceOrder and raceOrder[place]
            if horseId then
                Ambient.announcePlace(horseId, place, true, true)
            end
            Wait(4000)
        end
        state.podiumThreadActive = false
    end)
end

function Ambient.tickCountdown(timer)
    if not timer or timer <= 0 then return end
    local minsLeft = math.floor(timer / 60) + 1
    if minsLeft >= 1 and minsLeft <= 5 and state.lastMinAnnounced ~= minsLeft then
        state.lastMinAnnounced = minsLeft
        Ambient.announceCustom('MINIGAME_TRACK_' .. minsLeft .. 'MIN', true)
    end
    if timer == 10 and not state.countdownAnnounced then
        state.countdownAnnounced = true
        Ambient.announceCustom('MINIGAME_TRACK_COUNTDOWN', true)
    end
end

function Ambient.resetRoundState()
    state.lastMinAnnounced = -1
    state.countdownAnnounced = false
end

local Anim = {}
local _scene, _seatPos, _seatRot
local _enterSeq = 0
local _exitSeq = 0
local ANIM_DICT_MALE <const> = 'anim_casino_a@amb@casino@games@insidetrack@male'
local ANIM_DICT_FEMALE <const> = 'anim_casino_a@amb@casino@games@insidetrack@female'
local function getDict()
    return IsPedMale(cache.ped) and ANIM_DICT_MALE or ANIM_DICT_FEMALE
end

local function stopScene()
    _scene = nil
    ClearPedTasksImmediately(cache.ped)
end

---@param animName string
---@param looped boolean
---@return number durasi
local function playScene(animName, looped)
    if not _seatPos or not _seatRot then return 0 end
    local dict = getDict()
    if not lib.requestAnimDict(dict, 5000) then
        return 0
    end
    local hold = looped and true or false
    local scene = NetworkCreateSynchronisedScene(
        _seatPos.x, _seatPos.y, _seatPos.z,
        _seatRot.x, _seatRot.y, _seatRot.z,
        0, false, hold, 1065353216, 0, 1065353216
    )
    NetworkAddPedToSynchronisedScene(cache.ped, scene, dict, animName, 2.0, -1.5, 13, 16, 1148846080, 0)
    NetworkStartSynchronisedScene(scene)
    _scene = scene
    return GetAnimDuration(dict, animName) * 1000
end

---@param seatPos  vector3
---@param heading  number
function Anim.setup(seatPos, heading)
    _seatPos = seatPos
    _seatRot = vector3(0.0, 0.0, heading)
    lib.requestAnimDict(getDict(), 5000)
end

---@param onDone fun()
function Anim.enter(onDone)
    local clips = {
        'enter_left_readyidle',
        'enter_left_readyidle_short',
        'enter_right_readyidle',
        'enter_right_readyidle_short',
    }
    local clip = clips[math.random(1, #clips)]
    _enterSeq = _enterSeq + 1
    local mySeq = _enterSeq
    local dur = playScene(clip, false)
    if dur <= 0 then dur = 2000 end
    CreateThread(function()
        Wait(math.max(0, math.floor(dur) - 300))
        if mySeq ~= _enterSeq or not _seatPos then return end
        FreezeEntityPosition(cache.ped, true)
        Anim.idle()
        if onDone then onDone() end
    end)
end

function Anim.idle()
    playScene('readyidle', true)
end

---@param onDone fun()|nil
function Anim.exit(onDone)
    local clips = { 'exit_left', 'exit_right' }
    local clip = clips[math.random(1, 2)]
    _exitSeq = _exitSeq + 1
    local mySeq = _exitSeq
    FreezeEntityPosition(cache.ped, false)
    local dur = playScene(clip, false)
    if dur <= 0 then dur = 1500 end
    CreateThread(function()
        local wait = math.min(5000, math.max(0, math.floor(dur) - 200))
        Wait(wait)
        if mySeq ~= _exitSeq then return end
        Anim.cleanup()
        if onDone then onDone() end
    end)
end

function Anim.cleanup()
    _enterSeq = _enterSeq + 1
    _exitSeq = _exitSeq + 1
    stopScene()
    FreezeEntityPosition(cache.ped, false)
    ClearPedTasks(cache.ped)
    _seatPos = nil
    _seatRot = nil
end
return Anim

    'Banana Hammock', 'Salty And Woke', 'Wonder Boy',

---@return IT_Horse[]
function Horses.generate()
    local result = {}
    local usedNames = {}

    for i = 1, 6 do
        local idx
        repeat idx = math.random(0, 99) until not usedNames[idx]
        usedNames[idx] = true

        local nameKey = (idx < 10) and ('ITH_NAME_00' .. idx) or ('ITH_NAME_0' .. idx)
        local r = config.HorseOdds[i]
        local oddsStr = r and (r.min .. '/1') or '2/1'

        result[i] = {
            nameKey = nameKey,
            displayName = horseDisplayNames[i],
            styleIndex = i,
            style = horseStyles[i],
            oddsStr = oddsStr,
        }
    end

    return result
end

---@param serverHorses IT_ServerHorse[]|nil
---@return IT_Horse[]
function Horses.buildClient(serverHorses)
    local out = {}

    for i = 1, 6 do
        local sh = (serverHorses and serverHorses[i]) or {}
        local oddsRange = config.HorseOdds[i]
        local oddsStr = sh.oddsStr or (oddsRange and (oddsRange.min .. '/1') or '2/1')

        out[i] = {
            nameKey = sh.nameKey or ('ITH_NAME_00' .. i),
            oddsStr = oddsStr,
            style = horseStyles[sh.styleIndex or i],
        }
    end

    return out
end

    while not HasScaleformMovieLoaded(sf) and GetGameTimer() < timeout do
        Wait(0)
    end

    if HasScaleformMovieLoaded(sf) then return sf end

    SetScaleformMovieAsNoLongerNeeded(sf)
    return -1

---@param returnValue integer

    local timeout = GetGameTimer() + RETURN_TIMEOUT_MS

    while not IsScaleformMovieMethodReturnValueReady(returnValue)
        and GetGameTimer() < timeout
    do
        Wait(0)
    end

    return IsScaleformMovieMethodReturnValueReady(returnValue)
end

local function playSpinAnim()

    if not lib.requestAnimDict(dict, 5000) then
        isSpinning = false
        return

---Animates the wheel to land on the given prize index.
---@param prizeIndex integer
---@param prize LW_Prize
---@param checkReward boolean
---@param jitter number?
local function animateWheel(prizeIndex, prize, checkReward, jitter)
    if not DoesEntityExist(cacheEntities.wheelEnt) then return end
    local targetAngle = (prizeIndex - 1) * 18 + (config.WheelOffset or 0)
    playSound('Spin_Start', cacheEntities.wheelEnt)
    local j = 360.0
    for i = 1, 1100 do
        local step
        if i < 50 then step = 1.5
        elseif i < 100 then step = 2.0
        elseif i < 150 then step = 2.5
        elseif i > 1060 then step = 0.3
        elseif i > 1030 then step = 0.6
        elseif i > 1000 then step = 0.9
        elseif i > 970 then step = 1.2
        elseif i > 940 then step = 1.5
        elseif i > 910 then step = 1.8
        elseif i > 880 then step = 2.1
        elseif i > 850 then step = 2.4
        elseif i > 820 then step = 2.7
        else step = 3.0
        end
        j = j - step
        if i == 850 then
            local snapTarget = (targetAngle + 327.0) % 360
            j = snapTarget + (jitter or 0)
            if j < 0 then j = j + 360 end
            if j > 360 then j = j - 360 end
        end
        if j < 0 then j = j + 360 end
        if j > 360 then j = j - 360 end
        SetEntityRotation(cacheEntities.wheelEnt, wheelRot.x, j, wheelRot.z, 0, false)
        Wait(0)
    end
    Wait(300)
    local sound = (prize and prize.sound) or 'win'
    if sound == 'car' then playSound('Win_Car', cacheEntities.wheelEnt)
    elseif sound == 'cash' then playSound('Win_Cash', cacheEntities.wheelEnt)
    elseif sound == 'chips' then playSound('Win_Chips', cacheEntities.wheelEnt)
    elseif sound == 'clothes' then playSound('Win_Clothes', cacheEntities.wheelEnt)
    elseif sound == 'mystery' then playSound('Win_Mystery', cacheEntities.wheelEnt)
    else playSound('Win', cacheEntities.wheelEnt) end
    if checkReward and isSpinning then
        SetTimeout(500, function()
            lib.callback.await('rhd_casino_luckywheel:callback:claimPrize', false)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\rhd_casino\casino\luckywheel\server.lua
local activePlayers = {}
local pendingClaims = {}
local config = require 'casino.luckywheel.config'
local storage = require 'modules.storage'

math.randomseed(os.time() + GetGameTimer())

local function getPrizeChanceTotal()
    local total = 0.0
    for i = 1, #config.Prizes do
        total += math.max(tonumber(config.Prizes[i].chance) or 0, 0)
    end
    return total
end

local function getMachineStorageId()
    local pos = config.WheelPos
    return ('__luckywheel_machine:%s:%s:%s'):format(
        math.floor((pos.x or 0) * 100),
        math.floor((pos.y or 0) * 100),
        math.floor((pos.z or 0) * 100)
    )
end

local prizeChanceTotal = getPrizeChanceTotal()
if math.abs(prizeChanceTotal - 100.0) > 0.001 then
    lib.print.warn(('[Lucky Wheel] Total prize chance is %.2f, expected 100.00. Chances will be normalized by total weight.'):format(prizeChanceTotal))
end

---@param prize table?
---@return boolean
local function isVehiclePrize(prize)
    if type(prize) ~= 'table' then return false end
    if prize.type == 'vehicle' then return true end

    local cooldownConfig = config.VehiclePrizeCooldown or {}
    local names = cooldownConfig.prizeNames or {}
    return names[prize.name] == true
end

---@return boolean
local function isVehiclePrizeOnCooldown()
    local cooldownConfig = config.VehiclePrizeCooldown or {}
    if not cooldownConfig.enabled then return false end

    local last = storage.getLuckyWheelTimestamp(getMachineStorageId(), 'vehicle_prize')
    if not last then return false end

    local cooldownSecs = math.max(tonumber(cooldownConfig.hours) or 0, 0) * 3600
    return cooldownSecs > 0 and (os.time() - last) < cooldownSecs
end

local function markVehiclePrizeWon()
    local cooldownConfig = config.VehiclePrizeCooldown or {}
    if not cooldownConfig.enabled then return end

    storage.setLuckyWheelTimestamp(getMachineStorageId(), 'vehicle_prize', os.time())
end

---Generates a unique vehicle plate that does not conflict with existing DB records.
---@return string|nil
local function generatePlate()
    for _ = 1, 30 do
        local plate = 'LW ' .. math.random(1000, 9999)
        if not storage.vehiclePlateExists(plate) then
            return plate
        end
    end

    return nil
end

---@param source number
---@return boolean
local function hasFreeSpin(source)
    if not config.FreeSpin.enabled then return false end
    local id = shared.getIdentifier(source)
    if not id then return false end
    local last = storage.getLuckyWheelTimestamp(id, 'free')
    if not last then return true end
    local cooldownSecs = config.FreeSpin.cooldownHours * 3600
    return (os.time() - last) >= cooldownSecs
end

---@param source number
---@return number seconds remaining, 0 if not on cooldown
local function freeSpinCooldownLeft(source)
    if not config.FreeSpin.enabled then return 0 end
    local id = shared.getIdentifier(source)
    if not id then return 0 end
    local last = storage.getLuckyWheelTimestamp(id, 'free')
    if not last then return 0 end
    local cooldownSecs = config.FreeSpin.cooldownHours * 3600
    local elapsed = os.time() - last
    if elapsed >= cooldownSecs then return 0 end
    return cooldownSecs - elapsed
end

---Checks if the player has already used their daily spin today.
---@param source number
---@return boolean true jika masih bisa spin hari ini
local function hasDailySpinLeft(source)
    if not config.DailySpin.enabled then return true end
    local id = shared.getIdentifier(source)
    if not id then return false end
    local last = storage.getLuckyWheelTimestamp(id, 'daily')
    if not last then return true end
    return (os.time() - last) >= 86400
end

---Records that the player has used their daily spin.
---@param source number
local function markDailySpin(source)
    local id = shared.getIdentifier(source)
    if not id then return end
    storage.setLuckyWheelTimestamp(id, 'daily', os.time())
end

---Returns seconds remaining before daily spin resets, 0 if available.
---@param source number
---@return number
local function dailySpinCooldownLeft(source)
    if not config.DailySpin.enabled then return 0 end
    local id = shared.getIdentifier(source)
    if not id then return 0 end
    local last = storage.getLuckyWheelTimestamp(id, 'daily')
    if not last then return 0 end
    local elapsed = os.time() - last
    if elapsed >= 86400 then return 0 end
    return 86400 - elapsed
end

---@param source number
---@return boolean
local function isNearWheel(source)
    local ped = GetPlayerPed(source)
    if not ped or ped == 0 then return false end
    local pos = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local wheelPos = config.WheelPos
    local dist = #(vector3(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z) - vector3(wheelPos.x, wheelPos.y, wheelPos.z))
    return dist <= config.MaxDistance
end

---@param prize table
---@param isVip boolean
---@return number
local function prizeWeight(prize, isVip)
    return math.max(tonumber(isVip and prize.vipChance or prize.chance) or 0, 0)
end

---Rolls a weighted random prize from config.Prizes.
---@param isVip boolean
---@return integer prizeIndex
---@return table prize
local function rollPrize(isVip)
    local vehicleOnCooldown = isVehiclePrizeOnCooldown()
    local total = 0.0
    for i = 1, #config.Prizes do
        local prize = config.Prizes[i]
        if not (vehicleOnCooldown and isVehiclePrize(prize)) then
            total += prizeWeight(prize, isVip)
        end
    end

    if total <= 0 and vehicleOnCooldown then
        total = prizeChanceTotal
        vehicleOnCooldown = false
    end

    if total <= 0 then
        return #config.Prizes, config.Prizes[#config.Prizes]
    end

    local rnd = math.random() * total
    local cumulative = 0.0
    for k = 1, #config.Prizes do
        local prize = config.Prizes[k]
        if not (vehicleOnCooldown and isVehiclePrize(prize)) then
            cumulative += prizeWeight(prize, isVip)
            if rnd <= cumulative then
                return k, prize
            end
        end
    end
    return #config.Prizes, config.Prizes[#config.Prizes]
end

---@return integer?
local function pickZonkIndex()
    local zonks = {}
    for i = 1, #config.Prizes do
        if config.Prizes[i].type == 'zonk' then
            zonks[#zonks + 1] = i
        end
    end
    if #zonks == 0 then return nil end
    return zonks[math.random(1, #zonks)]
end

---@param source number
---@return boolean
local function canAffordSpin(source)
    local cash = ox_inventory:GetItemCount(source, shared.chipItemName)
    return cash >= config.SpinPrice
end

---Inserts a vehicle prize into the database for the player.
---@param source number
---@return boolean success
local function giveVehiclePrize(source)
    local plate = generatePlate()
    if not plate then
        lib.print.error('Lucky Wheel: gagal membuat plate unik, hadiah kendaraan dibatalkan')
        return false
    end

    local playerdata = sm_core:GetPlayerData(source)
    if not playerdata then return false end
    local license = playerdata.license
    local citizenid = playerdata.citizenid
    local props = {
        model = joaat(config.Vehicle.model),
        fuelLevel = 100.0,
        bodyHealth = 1000.0,
        engineHealth = 1000.0,
        plate = plate,
    }
    local veh_color = config.Vehicle.color
    if veh_color?.primary then
        local rgb = lib.math.tovector(veh_color.primary)
        props.color1 = {rgb.x, rgb.y, rgb.z}
    end
    if veh_color?.secondary then
        local rgb = lib.math.tovector(veh_color.secondary)
        props.color2 = {rgb.x, rgb.y, rgb.z}
    end
    return storage.insertVehiclePrize({
        license = license,
        citizenid = citizenid,
        model = config.Vehicle.model,
        hash = joaat(config.Vehicle.model),
        mods = json.encode(props),
        plate = plate,
        garage = config.Vehicle.default_garage,
        state = 1
    })
end

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_luckywheel:callback:canSpin', function(source)
    if not isNearWheel(source) then
        lib.notify(source, {
            id = 'lw_far',
            title = 'Lucky Wheel',
            description = 'Kamu terlalu jauh dari roda!',
            type = 'error',
        })
        return { allowed = false }
    end
    if next(activePlayers) ~= nil then
        lib.notify(source, {
            id = 'lw_busy',
            title = 'Lucky Wheel',
            description = 'Roda sedang digunakan, tunggu sebentar.',
            type = 'error',
        })
        return { allowed = false }
    end
    if not hasDailySpinLeft(source) then
        local remaining = dailySpinCooldownLeft(source)
        local hours = math.floor(remaining / 3600)
        local mins = math.floor((remaining % 3600) / 60)
        lib.notify(source, {
            id = 'lw_daily_limit',
            title = 'Lucky Wheel',
            description = ('Kamu sudah spin hari ini! Kembali dalam %dj %dm.'):format(hours, mins),
            type = 'error',
        })
        return { allowed = false, dailyLimitReached = true, cooldownLeft = remaining }
    end
    local isFree = hasFreeSpin(source)
    local cooldownLeft = freeSpinCooldownLeft(source)
    return {
        allowed = true,
        freeSpin = isFree,
        cooldownLeft = cooldownLeft,
        spinPrice = config.SpinPrice,
    }
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_luckywheel:callback:startSpin', function(source)
    if not isNearWheel(source) then return false end
    if activePlayers[source] then return false end
    if next(activePlayers) ~= nil then return false end
    if not hasDailySpinLeft(source) then return false end
    local isFree = hasFreeSpin(source)
    if not isFree then
        if not canAffordSpin(source) then
            lib.notify(source, {
                id = 'lw_nomoney',
                title = 'Lucky Wheel',
                description = ('Kamu butuh $%s untuk spin!'):format(config.SpinPrice),
                type = 'error',
            })
            return false
        end
        if not ox_inventory:RemoveItem(source, shared.chipItemName, config.SpinPrice) then
            return false
        end
        shared.depositCasinoIncome(config.SpinPrice, 'luckywheel_spin')
    end
    activePlayers[source] = true
    local prizeIndex, prize = rollPrize(shared.checkVIP(source))
    if prize.type ~= 'zonk' and not shared.rollDifficulty(config.Difficulty) then
        local zonkIndex = pickZonkIndex()
        if zonkIndex then
            prizeIndex = zonkIndex
            prize = config.Prizes[zonkIndex]
        end
    end
    pendingClaims[source] = {
        prizeIndex = prizeIndex,
        prize = prize,
        timestamp = os.time(),
        isFree = isFree,
        claiming = false,
    }
    if isFree and config.FreeSpin.enabled then
        local id = shared.getIdentifier(source)
        if id then
            storage.setLuckyWheelTimestamp(id, 'free', os.time())
        end
    end
    markDailySpin(source)
    local jitter = math.random(-3, 3)
    BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_luckywheel:client:spinWheel', source, prizeIndex, jitter)
    return true
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_luckywheel:callback:claimPrize', function(source)
    local claim = pendingClaims[source]
    if not claim then
        lib.notify(source, {
            id = 'lw_noclaim',
            title = 'Lucky Wheel',
            description = 'Tidak ada hadiah yang bisa diklaim.',
            type = 'error',
        })
        activePlayers[source] = nil
        return false
    end
    if claim.claiming then return false end

    claim.claiming = true

    if (os.time() - claim.timestamp) > 90 then
        lib.notify(source, {
            id = 'lw_timeout',
            title = 'Lucky Wheel',
            description = 'Waktu klaim hadiah habis.',
            type = 'error',
        })
        pendingClaims[source] = nil
        activePlayers[source] = nil
        return false
    end
    CreateThread(function ()
        local lastWheelAngle = ((claim.prizeIndex - 1) * 18 + (config.WheelOffset or 0)) % 360
        BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_luckywheel:client:syncAngle', lastWheelAngle)
    end)

    local delivered = false

        local paid = shared.payCasinoMoneyPrize(source, prize.count, 'luckywheel_money')
        if not paid then
            lib.notify(source, {
                id = 'lw_win_money_failed',
                title = 'Lucky Wheel',
                description = 'Selamat! Kamu menang uang, namun rekening casino gagal membayar hadiah. Hubungi staff.',
                duration = 12000,
                type = 'warning',
            })
            claim.claiming = false
            return false
        end
        delivered = true
        lib.notify(source, {
            id = 'lw_win_money',
            title = 'Lucky Wheel',
            description = ('Selamat! Kamu menang $%s!'):format(prize.count),
            duration = 12000,
            type = 'success',
        })
    elseif prize.type == 'item' then
        local added
        if prize.name == shared.chipItemName then
            added = shared.payCasinoChipPrize(source, prize.count, 'luckywheel')
        else
            added = ox_inventory:AddItem(source, prize.name, prize.count)
        end
        if not added then
            lib.notify(source, {
                id = 'lw_win_item_failed',
                title = 'Lucky Wheel',
                description = 'Selamat! Kamu menang hadiah, namun rekening casino gagal membayar hadiah. Hubungi staff.',
                duration = 12000,
                type = 'warning',
            })
            claim.claiming = false
            return false
        end
        delivered = true
        if isVehiclePrize(prize) then
            markVehiclePrizeWon()
        end
        lib.notify(source, {
            id = 'lw_win_item',
            title = 'Lucky Wheel',
            description = ('Selamat! Kamu menang %s x%s!'):format(prize.label or prize.name, prize.count),
            duration = 12000,
            type = 'success',
        })
    elseif prize.type == 'vehicle' then
        local success = giveVehiclePrize(source)
        if not success then
            lib.notify(source, {
                id = 'lw_win_vehicle_failed',
                title = 'Lucky Wheel',
                description = 'Selamat! Kamu menang kendaraan! Namun terjadi kesalahan saat memberikan hadiah, silakan hubungi staff.',
                duration = 12000,
                type = 'warning',
            })
            claim.claiming = false
            return false
        end
        delivered = true
        markVehiclePrizeWon()
        lib.notify(source, {
            id = 'lw_win_vehicle',
            title = 'Lucky Wheel',
            description = 'Selamat! Kamu menang kendaraan!',
            duration = 12000,
            type = 'success',
        })
    elseif prize.type == 'zonk' then
        delivered = true
        lib.notify(source, {
            id = 'lw_zonk',
            title = 'Lucky Wheel',
            description = 'Zonk! Lebih beruntung lain kali.',
            duration = 12000,
            type = 'error',
        })
    end

    if delivered then
        pendingClaims[source] = nil
        activePlayers[source] = nil
        return true
    end

    claim.claiming = false
    return false
end)

local function buildBetAmounts(tableConfig)
    local amounts = tableConfig.bettingAmmounts or tableConfig.bettingAmounts or {}
    local maxBet = tableConfig.maxBettingAmount or math.huge
    local values = {}

    for i = 1, #amounts do
        local value = tonumber(amounts[i])
        if value and value > 0 and value <= maxBet then
            values[#values + 1] = math.floor(value)
        end
    end

    table.sort(values)
    return values
end

local function getTableColourIndex(tableIdx)
    local roulette = config.Roulettes[tableIdx or currentTableIndex]
    local tableConfig = config.TableType[roulette.tableType]
    return TABLE_COLOUR_MAP[tableConfig.tableColour] or 0
end

---@param v vector3
---@param angleDeg number
---@return vector3
local function rotateVec3(v, angleDeg)
    local rad = math.rad(angleDeg)
    local sinA = math.sin(rad)
    local cosA = math.cos(rad)
    return vec3(
        v.x * cosA - v.y * sinA,
        v.x * sinA + v.y * cosA,
        v.z
    )
end

---@param cellIndex integer
---@return string
local function getMarkerModel(cellIndex)
    local row = cellIndex % 8
    local col = math.floor(cellIndex / 8)
    if col == 0 and row >= 2 then
        return 'vw_prop_vw_marker_01a'
    end
    return 'vw_prop_vw_marker_02a'
end

---@param row integer
---@param col integer
---@return number
local function getCellWidth(row, col)
    if col == 0 and row >= 2 then return 0.1245195 end
    if row == 0 or row == 1 then return 0.074 end
    return 0.083013
end

---@param row integer
---@param col integer
---@return number
local function getCellHeight(row, col)
    if col == 0 and row >= 2 and row ~= 3 then return 0.1 end
    if col == 0 and row == 3 then return 0.081287 end
    if row == 0 then return 0.162574 end
    if row == 1 then return 0.325148 end
    return 0.081287
end

---@param entity integer
---@param tableIdx integer?
local function setTextureVariation(entity, tableIdx)
    local colorIndex = getTableColourIndex(tableIdx)
    Citizen.InvokeNative(SET_TEXTURE_VARIATION, entity, colorIndex)
end

---@param cellIndex integer
---@param tableIdx integer?
---@return vector3
local function getGridWorldPos(cellIndex, tableIdx)
    local row = cellIndex % 8
    local col = math.floor(cellIndex / 8)
    local localPos
    if row >= 2 then
        local cellW = getCellWidth(row, col)
        local cellH = getCellHeight(row, col)
        local x = (row - 2) * cellW + 0.148
        local y = col * cellH * 0.5
        if col ~= 25 then
            y = y - cellH * 0.5
            if col == 0 then
                x = x + cellW
                y = -0.04
                if row == 4 then
                    x = x + 0.004
                end
            end
        else
            x = x + cellW * (row - 3)
        end
        localPos = vec3(y, x, 0.0)
    else
        local cellW = getCellWidth(row, col)
        local cellH = getCellHeight(row, col)
        local x = row * cellW + cellW * 0.5
        local y = col * cellH + cellH * 0.5
        localPos = vec3(y, x, 0.0)
    end
    local idx = tableIdx or currentTableIndex
    local heading = config.Roulettes[idx].coords.w
    local baseWorld = rotateVec3(CHIP_BASE_OFFSET, heading) + config.Roulettes[idx].coords.xyz
    local offset = rotateVec3(localPos, heading)
    return baseWorld + offset
end

---@param inputPos vector3
---@return integer row, integer col
local function screenToGridCell(inputPos)
    local pos = vec3(inputPos.y, inputPos.x, inputPos.z)
    local gridStartX = 0.148
    local gridEndY = 1.056731
    local gridMinY = -0.1
    local gridMaxX = gridStartX + 0.498078
    if pos.x < 0.0 or pos.x > gridMaxX or pos.y > gridEndY or pos.y < gridMinY then
        return -1, -1
    end
    local row, col
    if pos.x < 0.074 then
        local cellH = 0.162574
        row = 0
        col = math.floor((pos.y - cellH * 0.5) / cellH + 0.5)
    elseif pos.x < gridStartX then
        local cellH = 0.325148
        row = 1
        col = math.floor((pos.y - cellH * 0.5) / cellH + 0.5)
    else
        local rawX = (pos.x - 0.0415065 + gridStartX) / 0.083013 - gridStartX
        col = math.floor(pos.y / 0.0406435 + 0.5) + 1
        row = math.min(math.floor(rawX + 0.5) - 1, 7)
        if pos.y < -0.02032175 then
            col = 0
            row = 2
            local gap = 0.06641040000000001
            if pos.x > gridStartX + 0.249039 + gap then
                row = 4
            elseif pos.x > gridStartX + 0.166026 + gap then
                row = 3
            end
        elseif pos.y >= 0.975444 then
            col = 25
            if pos.x > gridStartX + 0.332052 then
                row = 5
            elseif pos.x > gridStartX + 0.166026 then
                row = 4
            else
                row = 3
            end
        elseif pos.y >= 0.9348004999999999 then
            col = 24
        end
    end
    if row < 0 or row > 7 or col < 0 or col > 25 then
        return -1, -1
    end
    return row, col
end

local function playSitEnterAnimation()
    local playerPos = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local diff = { x = playerPos.x - seatPosition.x, y = playerPos.y - seatPosition.y }
    local distance = math.sqrt(diff.x * diff.x + diff.y * diff.y)
    local angle = math.rad(seatRotation.z)
    local forward = { x = math.sin(angle), y = -math.cos(angle) }
    local dot = diff.x * forward.x + diff.y * forward.y
    local leftAnims = { 'sit_enter_left', 'sit_enter_left_side' }
    local rightAnims = { 'sit_enter_right', 'sit_enter_right_side' }
    local anims = (dot < 0) and leftAnims or rightAnims
    local animName = (distance < 0.9) and anims[2] or anims[1]
    local scene = NetworkCreateSynchronisedScene(
        seatPosition.x, seatPosition.y, seatPosition.z,
        seatRotation.x, seatRotation.y, seatRotation.z,
        2, true, false, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0
    )
    NetworkAddPedToSynchronisedScene(cache.ped, scene, PLAYER_SHARED_DICT, animName, 2.0, -2.0, 13, 16, 2.0, 0)
    NetworkStartSynchronisedScene(scene)
    while true do
        if HasAnimEventFired(cache.ped, -1424880317) then break end
        SetTableGamesCameraThisUpdate('CASINO_ROULETTE_CAMERA')
        Wait(0)
    end
end

end
