########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\rhd_casino\casino\sportsbook\modules\common.lua
local config = require 'casino.sportsbook.config'

local Common = {}

---@param source number
---@return 'admin'|'staff'|nil
function Common.getRole(source)
    local job = sm_core:GetPlayerData(source, 'job')
    if not job or job.name ~= shared.casinoJobName then return nil end

    local level = tonumber(job.grade?.level) or 0
    if level >= config.access.admin then return 'admin' end
    if level >= config.access.staff then return 'staff' end

    return nil
end

---@param source number
---@param required 'admin'|'staff'
---@return boolean
function Common.hasRole(source, required)
    local role = Common.getRole(source)
    if not role then return false end
    if required == 'staff' then return true end
    return role == 'admin'
end

---@param source number
---@return { identifier: string?, name: string }
function Common.staffInfo(source)
    return {
        identifier = shared.getIdentifier(source),
        name = shared.getPlayerName(source),
    }
end

---@param value any
---@param maxLength integer
---@return string?
function Common.cleanString(value, maxLength)
    if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil end
    local trimmed = value:gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '')
    if trimmed == '' then return nil end
    return trimmed:sub(1, maxLength)
end

---@param value any
---@param min number
---@param max number
---@return integer?
function Common.cleanInt(value, min, max)
    local number = math.floor(tonumber(value) or -1)
    if number < min or number > max then return nil end
    return number
end

---@param staffSource number
---@param targetSource number
---@return boolean
function Common.isNearStaff(staffSource, targetSource)
    if staffSource == targetSource then return true end
    if not shared.playerExist(targetSource) then return false end

    local staffPed = GetPlayerPed(staffSource)
    local targetPed = GetPlayerPed(targetSource)
    if staffPed == 0 or targetPed == 0 then return false end

    return #(GetEntityCoords(staffPed) - GetEntityCoords(targetPed)) <= config.maxBettorDistance
end

return Common


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\rhd_casino\casino\sportsbook\modules\locks.lua
local held = {}

local Locks = {}

---@param keys string[]
function Locks.acquire(keys)
    table.sort(keys)

    for i = 1, #keys do
        local key = keys[i]
        while held[key] do Wait(0) end
        held[key] = true
    end
end

---@param keys string[]
function Locks.release(keys)
    for i = 1, #keys do
        held[keys[i]] = nil
    end
end

return Locks


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\rhd_casino\casino\sportsbook\modules\odds.lua
local Odds = {}

---@param value number
---@return number
local function round2(value)
    return math.floor(value * 100 + 0.5) / 100
end

Odds.round2 = round2

---Fair odds tanpa house edge.
---@param probability number persen 0-100
---@return number
function Odds.fair(probability)
    local p = tonumber(probability) or 0
    if p <= 0 then return 0 end
    return round2(100 / p)
end

---Fixed odds = 1 / (probabilitas * (1 + house edge)).
---@param probability number persen 0-100
---@param houseEdge number persen
---@return number
function Odds.fixed(probability, houseEdge)
    local p = (tonumber(probability) or 0) / 100
    local edge = (tonumber(houseEdge) or 0) / 100
    if p <= 0 then return 0 end
    return round2(1 / (p * (1 + edge)))
end

---@param stake number
---@param odds number
---@return integer
function Odds.potentialReturn(stake, odds)
    local value = (tonumber(stake) or 0) * (tonumber(odds) or 0)
    if value <= 0 then return 0 end
    return math.floor(value)
end

return Odds


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\rhd_casino\casino\sportsbook\parlay\client.lua
local FORWARDED <const> = {
    'placeParlay',
    'lookupParlay',
    'markPaid',
}

local HEAVY <const> = {
    'getParlays',
}

local prefix <const> = 'rhd_casino_parlay'
local HEAVY_TIMEOUT <const> = 30000

for i = 1, #FORWARDED do
    local name = ('%s:%s'):format(prefix, FORWARDED[i])

    RegisterNUICallback(name, function(data, cb)
        local args = type(data) == 'table' and data.args or nil
        local ok, result

        if type(args) == 'table' and #args > 0 then
            ok, result = lib.callback.await(name, false, table.unpack(args, 1, #args))
        else
            ok, result = lib.callback.await(name, false)
        end

        cb({
            ok = ok == true,
            data = ok == true and result or nil,
            error = ok ~= true and result or nil,
        })
    end)
end

local pending = {}
local nextRequestId = 0

RegisterNetEvent(('%s:response'):format(prefix), function(requestId, ok, result)
    if source == '' then return end

    local resolve = pending[requestId]
    if not resolve then return end

    pending[requestId] = nil
    resolve(ok, result)
end)

for i = 1, #HEAVY do
    local action = HEAVY[i]
    local name = ('%s:%s'):format(prefix, action)

    RegisterNUICallback(name, function(data, cb)
        local args = type(data) == 'table' and data.args or nil

        nextRequestId += 1
        local requestId = nextRequestId
        local answered = false

        pending[requestId] = function(ok, result)
            answered = true
            cb({
                ok = ok == true,
                data = ok == true and result or nil,
                error = ok ~= true and result or nil,
            })
        end

        if type(args) == 'table' and #args > 0 then
            TriggerServerEvent(('%s:request'):format(prefix), requestId, action, table.unpack(args, 1, #args))
        else
            TriggerServerEvent(('%s:request'):format(prefix), requestId, action)
        end

        SetTimeout(HEAVY_TIMEOUT, function()
            if answered then return end

            pending[requestId] = nil
            cb({ ok = false, error = 'Server tidak membalas permintaan data.' })
        end)
    end)
end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\rhd_casino\casino\sportsbook\parlay\server.lua
local config = require 'casino.sportsbook.parlay.config'
local common = require 'casino.sportsbook.modules.common'
local odds = require 'casino.sportsbook.modules.odds'
local locks = require 'casino.sportsbook.modules.locks'
local storage = require 'casino.sportsbook.parlay.storage'
local ufcStorage = require 'casino.sportsbook.ufc.storage'
local racingStorage = require 'casino.sportsbook.racing.storage'

---@alias ParlaySport 'ufc'|'racing'

---@class ParlayLegInput
---@field fightId any
---@field pick any
---@field lineId any

---@class ParlayResolvedLeg : ParlayLegRow
---@field lock string
---@field max_liability integer
---@field min_stake integer
---@field max_stake integer
---@field liability fun(): integer

local Parlay = {}

Parlay.publicConfig = {
    legBounds = config.legBounds,
    stakeBounds = config.stakeBounds,
    maxPayout = config.maxPayout,
    receiptItem = config.receiptItem,
    betIdPrefix = config.betId.prefix,
}

local prefix <const> = 'rhd_casino_parlay'
local handlers = {}

---@param name string
---@param handler function
local function callback(name, handler)
    handlers[name] = handler
    lib.callback.register(('%s:%s'):format(prefix, name), handler)
end

---@param title string
---@param logType string
---@param fields table[]
local function log(title, logType, fields)
    shared.log({ title = ('Parlay â€” %s'):format(title), type = logType, fields = fields })
end

---@param value any
---@return integer
local function toInt(value)
    return math.floor(tonumber(value) or 0)
end

---@param fightId integer?
---@return table<integer, { a: integer, b: integer }>
function Parlay.ufcLiability(fightId)
    return storage.getUfcLiability(fightId)
end

---@param eventId integer?
---@return table<integer, integer>
function Parlay.racingLiability(eventId)
    return storage.getRacingLiability(eventId)
end

---@param sport ParlaySport
---@param eventId integer
---@return { won: integer, lost: integer, void: integer }
local function resolveParlays(sport, eventId)
    local rows = storage.getOpenLegsForEvent(sport, eventId)
    local groups = {}
    local order = {}

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local row = rows[i]
        local seq = toInt(row.parlay_seq)

        if not groups[seq] then
            groups[seq] = { stake = toInt(row.stake), legs = {} }
            order[#order + 1] = seq
        end

        table.insert(groups[seq].legs, row)
    end

    local counts = { won = 0, lost = 0, void = 0 }

    for i = 1, #order do
        local seq = order[i]
        local group = groups[seq]
        local anyLost, anyPending = false, false
        local wonCount, product = 0, 1.0

        for j = 1, #group.legs do
            local status = group.legs[j].status

            if status == 'lost' then
                anyLost = true
            elseif status == 'pending' then
                anyPending = true
            elseif status == 'won' then
                wonCount += 1
                product *= tonumber(group.legs[j].odds) or 0
            end
        end

        if anyLost then
            if storage.finalizeParlay(seq, 'lost') then counts.lost += 1 end
        elseif not anyPending then
            if wonCount == 0 then
                if storage.finalizeParlay(seq, 'void') then counts.void += 1 end
            else
                local finalOdds = odds.round2(product)
                local payout = odds.potentialReturn(group.stake, finalOdds)
                if storage.finalizeParlay(seq, 'won', finalOdds, payout) then counts.won += 1 end
            end
        end
    end

    return counts
end

---@param sport ParlaySport
---@param eventId integer
---@param counts { won: integer, lost: integer, void: integer }
local function logResolution(sport, eventId, counts)
    if counts.won + counts.lost + counts.void == 0 then return end

    log('Parlay Resolved', 'info', {
        { name = 'Sport', value = sport:upper(), inline = true },
        { name = 'Event', value = ('#%s'):format(eventId), inline = true },
        { name = 'WON', value = tostring(counts.won), inline = true },
        { name = 'LOST', value = tostring(counts.lost), inline = true },
        { name = 'VOID', value = tostring(counts.void), inline = true },
    })
end

---@param fightId integer
---@param winner 'a'|'b'
function Parlay.settleUfc(fightId, winner)
    if not storage.settleUfcLegs(fightId, winner) then return end
    logResolution('ufc', fightId, resolveParlays('ufc', fightId))
end

---@param fightId integer
function Parlay.voidUfc(fightId)
    if not storage.voidLegs('ufc', fightId) then return end
    logResolution('ufc', fightId, resolveParlays('ufc', fightId))
end

---@param eventId integer
---@param resultOutcomeIds integer[]
---@param marketPlaces table<string, integer>
function Parlay.settleRacing(eventId, resultOutcomeIds, marketPlaces)
    if not storage.settleRacingLegs(eventId, resultOutcomeIds, marketPlaces) then return end
    logResolution('racing', eventId, resolveParlays('racing', eventId))
end

---@param eventId integer
function Parlay.voidRacing(eventId)
    if not storage.voidLegs('racing', eventId) then return end
    logResolution('racing', eventId, resolveParlays('racing', eventId))
end

---@param input ParlayLegInput
---@return ParlayResolvedLeg? leg
---@return string? err
local function buildUfcLeg(input)
    if type(input) ~= 'table' then return nil, 'Data leg tidak valid.' end

    local fightId = common.cleanInt(input.fightId, 1, math.maxinteger)
    local pick = input.pick
    if not fightId or (pick ~= 'a' and pick ~= 'b') then return nil, 'Pilihan fight tidak valid.' end

    local fight = ufcStorage.getFight(fightId)
    if not fight then return nil, 'Fight tidak ditemukan.' end
    if fight.status ~= 'open' then
        return nil, ('Betting untuk %s sedang tidak dibuka.'):format(fight.label)
    end

    local legOdds = tonumber(pick == 'a' and fight.odds_a or fight.odds_b) or 0
    if legOdds <= 0 then return nil, ('Odds %s tidak valid.'):format(fight.label) end

    return {
        event_id = fightId,
        pick = pick,
        event_label = fight.label,
        pick_name = pick == 'a' and fight.fighter_a or fight.fighter_b,
        odds = legOdds,
        lock = ('ufc:%d'):format(fightId),
        max_liability = toInt(pick == 'a' and fight.max_liability_a or fight.max_liability_b),
        min_stake = toInt(fight.min_stake),
        max_stake = toInt(fight.max_stake),
        liability = function()
            local extra = storage.getUfcLiability(fightId)[fightId]
            return ufcStorage.getLiability(fightId)[pick] + (extra and extra[pick] or 0)
        end,
    }
end

---@param input ParlayLegInput
---@return ParlayResolvedLeg? leg
---@return string? err
local function buildRacingLeg(input)
    if type(input) ~= 'table' then return nil, 'Data leg tidak valid.' end

    local lineId = common.cleanInt(input.lineId, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not lineId then return nil, 'Pilihan taruhan tidak valid.' end

    local line = racingStorage.getLine(lineId)
    if not line then return nil, 'Pilihan taruhan tidak valid.' end

    local eventId = toInt(line.event_id)
    local event = racingStorage.getEvent(eventId)
    if not event then return nil, 'Event tidak ditemukan.' end
    if event.status ~= 'open' then
        return nil, ('Betting untuk %s sedang tidak dibuka.'):format(event.label)
    end
    if toInt(line.manual_closed) == 1 then
        return nil, ('%s sedang ditutup untuk taruhan.'):format(line.outcome_name)
    end

    local lineOdds = tonumber(line.odds) or 0
    if lineOdds <= 0 then return nil, ('Odds %s tidak valid.'):format(line.outcome_name) end

    return {
        event_id = eventId,
        line_id = lineId,
        market = line.market,
        outcome_id = toInt(line.outcome_id),
        event_label = event.label,
        pick_name = line.outcome_name,
        odds = lineOdds,
        lock = ('racing:%d'):format(lineId),
        max_liability = toInt(line.max_liability),
        min_stake = toInt(event.min_stake),
        max_stake = toInt(event.max_stake),
        liability = function()
            return (racingStorage.getLiability(eventId)[lineId] or 0)
                + (storage.getRacingLiability(eventId)[lineId] or 0)
        end,
    }
end

---@param rows table[]
---@return table[]
local function mapLegs(rows)
    local legs = {}

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local row = rows[i]
        legs[i] = {
            eventId = toInt(row.event_id),
            eventLabel = row.event_label,
            market = row.market,
            pickName = row.pick_name,
            odds = tonumber(row.odds) or 0,
            status = row.status or 'pending',
        }
    end

    return legs
end

---@param header table
---@param legRows table[]
---@return table
local function mapParlay(header, legRows)
    return {
        betId = header.bet_id,
        sport = header.sport,
        legCount = toInt(header.leg_count),
        odds = tonumber(header.odds) or 0,
        stake = toInt(header.stake),
        potentialReturn = toInt(header.potential_return),
        status = header.status,
        legs = mapLegs(legRows),
        bettorName = header.bettor_name,
        staffBetName = header.staff_bet_name,
        staffPaidName = header.staff_paid_name,
        receiptTaken = toInt(header.receipt_taken) == 1,
        createdAt = header.created_at,
        paidAt = header.paid_at,
    }
end

callback('placeParlay', function(source, data)
    if not common.hasRole(source, 'staff') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end
    if type(data) ~= 'table' then return false, 'Data parlay tidak valid.' end

    local sport = data.sport
    local buildLeg = sport == 'ufc' and buildUfcLeg
        or sport == 'racing' and buildRacingLeg
        or nil
    if not buildLeg then return false, 'Sport tidak valid.' end

    local input = data.legs
    if type(input) ~= 'table' then return false, 'Daftar leg tidak valid.' end

    local count = #input
    if count < config.legBounds.min or count > config.legBounds.max then
        return false, ('Parlay harus berisi %d sampai %d leg.'):format(config.legBounds.min, config.legBounds.max)
    end

    local bettorSource = common.cleanInt(data.bettorSource, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not bettorSource or not shared.playerExist(bettorSource) then
        return false, 'Bettor tidak ditemukan.'
    end
    if not common.isNearStaff(source, bettorSource) then
        return false, 'Bettor harus berada di dekat kamu.'
    end

    local legs = {}
    local keys = {}
    local seenEvent = {}
    local minStake, maxStake = config.stakeBounds.min, config.stakeBounds.max
    local product = 1.0

    for i = 1, count do
        local leg, err = buildLeg(input[i])
        if not leg then return false, err end

        if seenEvent[leg.event_id] then
            return false, ('%s dipakai lebih dari satu leg.'):format(leg.event_label)
        end
        seenEvent[leg.event_id] = true

        legs[i] = leg
        keys[i] = leg.lock
        if leg.min_stake > minStake then minStake = leg.min_stake end
        if leg.max_stake < maxStake then maxStake = leg.max_stake end
        product *= leg.odds
    end

    if minStake > maxStake then
        return false, 'Batas stake antar event tidak bisa digabung dalam satu parlay.'
    end

    local stake = common.cleanInt(data.stake, minStake, maxStake)
    if not stake then
        return false, ('Stake harus antara %s dan %s chip.'):format(minStake, maxStake)
    end

    local combinedOdds = odds.round2(product)
    local potentialReturn = odds.potentialReturn(stake, combinedOdds)
    if potentialReturn <= 0 then return false, 'Potential return tidak valid.' end
    if potentialReturn > config.maxPayout then
        return false, ('Potential return %s melebihi batas maksimum %s chip.'):format(potentialReturn, config.maxPayout)
    end

    locks.acquire(keys)

    for i = 1, #legs do
        local leg = legs[i]
        local remaining = math.max(leg.max_liability - leg.liability(), 0)

        if potentialReturn > remaining then
            locks.release(keys)
            return false, ('BET REJECTED â€” sisa liability %s (%s) %s chip, potential return %s chip.')
                :format(leg.event_label, leg.pick_name, remaining, potentialReturn)
        end
    end

    local staff = common.staffInfo(source)
    local bettorName = shared.getPlayerName(bettorSource)

    local betId = storage.insertParlay({
        sport = sport,
        leg_count = count,
        odds = combinedOdds,
        stake = stake,
        potential_return = potentialReturn,
        bettor_identifier = shared.getIdentifier(bettorSource),
        bettor_name = bettorName,
        staff_bet_identifier = staff.identifier,
        staff_bet_name = staff.name,
    }, legs)

    locks.release(keys)

    if not betId then return false, 'Gagal menyimpan parlay.' end

    local summary = {}
    for i = 1, #legs do
        summary[i] = ('%s: %s @ %s'):format(legs[i].event_label, legs[i].pick_name, legs[i].odds)
    end

    local receiptGiven = ox_inventory:AddItem(bettorSource, config.receiptItem, 1, {
        betId = betId,
        sport = sport,
        legs = table.concat(summary, '\n'),
        odds = combinedOdds,
        stake = stake,
        potentialReturn = potentialReturn,
        description = ('%s\n%d leg @ %s\nStake %s â†’ %s'):format(betId, count, combinedOdds, stake, potentialReturn),
    })

    log('Parlay Confirmed', 'money', {
        { name = 'Bet ID', value = betId },
        { name = 'Sport', value = sport:upper(), inline = true },
        { name = 'Bettor', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(bettorName, bettorSource), inline = true },
        { name = 'Leg', value = table.concat(summary, '\n') },
        { name = 'Combined Odds', value = tostring(combinedOdds), inline = true },
        { name = 'Stake', value = ('%s chips'):format(stake), inline = true },
        { name = 'Potential Return', value = ('%s chips'):format(potentialReturn), inline = true },
        { name = 'Staff', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(staff.name, source), inline = true },
        { name = 'Receipt', value = receiptGiven and 'Given' or 'FAILED (inventory full)', inline = true },
    })

    return true, {
        betId = betId,
        sport = sport,
        legs = mapLegs(legs),
        odds = combinedOdds,
        stake = stake,
        potentialReturn = potentialReturn,
        bettorName = bettorName,
        staffName = staff.name,
        receiptGiven = receiptGiven == true,
    }
end)

callback('lookupParlay', function(source, betId)

callback('markPaid', function(source, betId, claimantSource)
    if not common.hasRole(source, 'staff') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local id = common.cleanString(betId, 24)
    if not id then return false, 'Bet ID tidak valid.' end

    local header = storage.getParlay(id:upper())
    if not header then return false, 'Bet ID tidak ditemukan.' end

    if header.status == 'paid' or header.status == 'refunded' then
        return false, 'BET ALREADY PAID'
    end

    local nextStatus = header.status == 'won' and 'paid'
        or header.status == 'void' and 'refunded'
        or nil

    if not nextStatus then
        return false, ('Parlay berstatus %s tidak bisa diklaim.'):format(header.status:upper())
    end

    local claimant = common.cleanInt(claimantSource, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not claimant or not shared.playerExist(claimant) then
        return false, 'Penerima pembayaran tidak ditemukan.'
    end
    if not common.isNearStaff(source, claimant) then
        return false, 'Penerima harus berada di dekat kamu.'
    end

    local staff = common.staffInfo(source)

    if not storage.markPaid(header.bet_id, nextStatus, header.status, staff, false) then
        return false, 'Status parlay berubah, coba cari ulang Bet ID.'
    end

    local receiptTaken = false
    local slots = ox_inventory:Search(claimant, 'slots', config.receiptItem, { betId = header.bet_id })

    if type(slots) == 'table' and slots[1] then
        receiptTaken = ox_inventory:RemoveItem(claimant, config.receiptItem, 1, nil, slots[1].slot) == true
        if receiptTaken then
            storage.setReceiptTaken(header.bet_id)
        end
    end

    local amount = nextStatus == 'paid' and toInt(header.potential_return) or toInt(header.stake)

    log(nextStatus == 'paid' and 'Payout Paid' or 'Stake Refunded', 'money', {
        { name = 'Bet ID', value = header.bet_id },
        { name = 'Sport', value = tostring(header.sport):upper(), inline = true },
        { name = 'Bettor', value = header.bettor_name, inline = true },
        { name = 'Receiver', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(shared.getPlayerName(claimant), claimant), inline = true },
        { name = 'Amount', value = ('%s chips'):format(amount), inline = true },
        { name = 'Staff', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(staff.name, source), inline = true },
        { name = 'Receipt', value = receiptTaken and 'Collected' or 'NOT in receiver inventory', inline = true },
    })

    return true, {
        betId = header.bet_id,
        status = nextStatus,
        amount = amount,
        receiptTaken = receiptTaken,
    }
end)

callback('getParlays', function(source, sport)
    if not common.hasRole(source, 'admin') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end
    if sport ~= 'ufc' and sport ~= 'racing' then return false, 'Sport tidak valid.' end

    local headers = storage.getParlays(sport)
    local seqs = {}
    for i = 1, #headers do
        seqs[i] = toInt(headers[i].seq)
    end

    local legsBySeq = storage.getLegs(seqs)
    local parlays = {}
    for i = 1, #headers do
        parlays[i] = mapParlay(headers[i], legsBySeq[seqs[i]] or {})
    end

    local totals = storage.getTotals(sport) or {}
    local totalStake = toInt(totals.total_stake)
    local paidOut = toInt(totals.paid_out)
    local refundedOut = toInt(totals.refunded_out)

    return true, {
        parlays = parlays,
        totals = {
            betCount = toInt(totals.bet_count),
            totalStake = totalStake,
            totalPotential = toInt(totals.total_potential),
            actualPayout = paidOut + refundedOut,
            profit = totalStake - paidOut - refundedOut,
            confirmed = toInt(totals.count_confirmed),
            won = toInt(totals.count_won),
            lost = toInt(totals.count_lost),
            void = toInt(totals.count_void),
            paid = toInt(totals.count_paid),
            refunded = toInt(totals.count_refunded),
        },
    }
end)

return Parlay

local baseStorage = require 'modules.storage'

local tablesReady = false

local function ensureTables()
    if tablesReady then return true end

    local ok = safeCall('ensure parlay tables', function()
        db:execute_async([[
            create table if not exists rhd_casino_parlay_bets (
                seq bigint unsigned not null auto_increment,
                bet_id varchar(24) null,
                sport varchar(16) not null,
                leg_count tinyint unsigned not null,
                odds decimal(12,2) not null,
                stake bigint unsigned not null,
                potential_return bigint unsigned not null,
                status varchar(16) not null default 'confirmed',
                bettor_identifier varchar(64) null,
                bettor_name varchar(128) not null,
                staff_bet_identifier varchar(64) null,
                staff_bet_name varchar(128) null,
                staff_paid_identifier varchar(64) null,
                staff_paid_name varchar(128) null,
                receipt_taken tinyint(1) not null default 0,
                created_at timestamp not null default current_timestamp,
                settled_at timestamp null,
                paid_at timestamp null,
                primary key (seq),
                unique key idx_bet_id (bet_id),
                key idx_sport_status (sport, status)
            )
        ]])

        db:execute_async([[
            create table if not exists rhd_casino_parlay_legs (
                id bigint unsigned not null auto_increment,
                parlay_seq bigint unsigned not null,
                sport varchar(16) not null,
                event_id int unsigned not null,
                line_id int unsigned null,
                pick varchar(1) null,
                market varchar(16) null,
                outcome_id int unsigned null,
                event_label varchar(64) not null,
                pick_name varchar(64) not null,
                odds decimal(8,2) not null,
                status varchar(16) not null default 'pending',

                key idx_parlay (parlay_seq),
                key idx_event (sport, event_id),
                key idx_line (line_id)
            )
        ]])

    end, false)

---@param seq integer
---@return string
local function formatBetId(seq)
    return ('%s%0' .. config.betId.digits .. 'd'):format(config.betId.prefix, seq)
end

---@param ids integer[]
---@return string
local function idList(ids)
    local parts = {}
    for i = 1, #ids do
        parts[i] = tostring(math.floor(ids[i]))
    end
    return table.concat(parts, ',')
end

---@param limit any
---@return integer
local function sanitizeLimit(limit)
    limit = math.floor(tonumber(limit) or 100)
    if limit < 1 then return 100 end
    if limit > 500 then return 500 end
    return limit
end

---@class ParlayLegRow
---@field event_id integer
---@field line_id integer?
---@field pick string?
---@field market string?
---@field outcome_id integer?
---@field event_label string
---@field pick_name string
---@field odds number

---@param header table
---@param legs ParlayLegRow[]
---@return string? betId
function Storage.insertParlay(header, legs)
    if not ensureTables() then return nil end

    return safeCall('insert parlay', function()
        local seq = db:insert_async([[
            insert into rhd_casino_parlay_bets (
                sport, leg_count, odds, stake, potential_return,
                bettor_identifier, bettor_name, staff_bet_identifier, staff_bet_name
            ) values (
                @sport, @leg_count, @odds, @stake, @potential_return,
                @bettor_identifier, @bettor_name, @staff_bet_identifier, @staff_bet_name
            )
        ]], header)

        if not seq then return nil end

        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            for i = 1, #legs do
                local leg = legs[i]

                db:execute_async([[
                    insert into rhd_casino_parlay_legs (
                        parlay_seq, sport, event_id, line_id, pick, market, outcome_id,
                        event_label, pick_name, odds
                    ) values (
                        @parlay_seq, @sport, @event_id, @line_id, @pick, @market, @outcome_id,
                        @event_label, @pick_name, @odds
                    )
                ]], {
                    parlay_seq = seq,
                    sport = header.sport,
                    event_id = leg.event_id,
                    line_id = leg.line_id,
                    pick = leg.pick,
                    market = leg.market,
                    outcome_id = leg.outcome_id,
                    event_label = leg.event_label,
                    pick_name = leg.pick_name,
                    odds = leg.odds,
                })
            end
        end)

        if not ok then
            db:execute_async('delete from rhd_casino_parlay_legs where parlay_seq = @seq', { seq = seq })
            db:execute_async('delete from rhd_casino_parlay_bets where seq = @seq', { seq = seq })
            error(err)
        end

        local betId = formatBetId(seq)

        db:execute_async(
            'update rhd_casino_parlay_bets set bet_id = @bet_id where seq = @seq',
            { bet_id = betId, seq = seq }
        )

        return betId
    end, nil)
end

---@param seqs integer[]
---@return table<integer, table[]>
function Storage.getLegs(seqs)
    local result = {}
    if #seqs == 0 or not ensureTables() then return result end

    local rows = safeCall('get parlay legs', function()
        return db:query_async([[
            select * from rhd_casino_parlay_legs
            where find_in_set(parlay_seq, @seqs)
            order by parlay_seq, id
        ]], { seqs = idList(seqs) })
    end, {}) or {}

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local row = rows[i]
        local seq = math.floor(tonumber(row.parlay_seq) or 0)
        result[seq] = result[seq] or {}
        table.insert(result[seq], row)
    end

    return result
end

---@param betId string
---@return table? header

    end, nil)

---@param sport string
---@return table?
function Storage.getTotals(sport)
    if not ensureTables() then return nil end

    return safeCall('get parlay totals', function()
        return db:single_async([[
            select
                count(*) as bet_count,
                coalesce(sum(stake), 0) as total_stake,
                coalesce(sum(case when status in ('confirmed', 'won') then potential_return else 0 end), 0) as total_potential,
                coalesce(sum(case when status = 'paid' then potential_return else 0 end), 0) as paid_out,
                coalesce(sum(case when status = 'refunded' then stake else 0 end), 0) as refunded_out,
                coalesce(sum(status = 'confirmed'), 0) as count_confirmed,
                coalesce(sum(status = 'won'), 0) as count_won,
                coalesce(sum(status = 'lost'), 0) as count_lost,
                coalesce(sum(status = 'void'), 0) as count_void,
                coalesce(sum(status = 'paid'), 0) as count_paid,
                coalesce(sum(status = 'refunded'), 0) as count_refunded
            from rhd_casino_parlay_bets
            where sport = @sport
        ]], { sport = sport })
    end, nil)
end

---@param fightId integer?
---@return table<integer, { a: integer, b: integer }>
function Storage.getUfcLiability(fightId)
    local result = {}
    if not ensureTables() then return result end

    local rows = safeCall('get parlay ufc liability', function()
        return db:query_async([[
            select l.event_id, l.pick, coalesce(sum(p.potential_return), 0) as liability
            from rhd_casino_parlay_legs l
            inner join rhd_casino_parlay_bets p on p.seq = l.parlay_seq
            where l.sport = 'ufc' and p.status in ('confirmed', 'won')
              and (@fightId is null or l.event_id = @fightId)
            group by l.event_id, l.pick
        ]], { fightId = fightId })
    end, {}) or {}

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local row = rows[i]
        local id = math.floor(tonumber(row.event_id) or 0)
        result[id] = result[id] or { a = 0, b = 0 }
        if row.pick == 'a' or row.pick == 'b' then
            result[id][row.pick] = math.floor(tonumber(row.liability) or 0)
        end
    end

    return result
end

---@param eventId integer?
---@return table<integer, integer>
function Storage.getRacingLiability(eventId)
    local result = {}
    if not ensureTables() then return result end

    local rows = safeCall('get parlay racing liability', function()
        return db:query_async([[
            select l.line_id, coalesce(sum(p.potential_return), 0) as liability
            from rhd_casino_parlay_legs l
            inner join rhd_casino_parlay_bets p on p.seq = l.parlay_seq
            where l.sport = 'racing' and p.status in ('confirmed', 'won')
              and (@eventId is null or l.event_id = @eventId)
            group by l.line_id
        ]], { eventId = eventId })
    end, {}) or {}

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local row = rows[i]
        result[math.floor(tonumber(row.line_id) or 0)] = math.floor(tonumber(row.liability) or 0)
    end

    return result
end

function Storage.settleRacingLegs(eventId, resultOutcomeIds, marketPlaces)
    if not ensureTables() then return false end

    return safeCall('settle parlay racing legs', function()
        for market, places in pairs(marketPlaces) do
            local winners = {}
            for i = 1, math.min(places, #resultOutcomeIds) do
                winners[i] = resultOutcomeIds[i]
            end

            db:execute_async([[
                update rhd_casino_parlay_legs
                set status = 'won'
                where sport = 'racing' and event_id = @id and market = @market and status = 'pending'
                  and find_in_set(outcome_id, @winners)
            ]], { id = eventId, market = market, winners = idList(winners) })

            db:execute_async([[
                update rhd_casino_parlay_legs
                set status = 'lost'
                where sport = 'racing' and event_id = @id and market = @market and status = 'pending'
            ]], { id = eventId, market = market })
        end

        return true
    end, false)
end

    setTabletState(true)
end)

    setTabletState(false)
end)

    RegisterNUICallback(name, function(data, cb)
        local args = type(data) == 'table' and data.args or nil
        local ok, result

        if type(args) == 'table' and #args > 0 then
            ok, result = lib.callback.await(name, false, table.unpack(args, 1, #args))
        else
            ok, result = lib.callback.await(name, false)
        end

        cb({
            ok = ok == true,
            data = ok == true and result or nil,
            error = ok ~= true and result or nil,
        })
    end)
end

local pending = {}
local nextRequestId = 0

RegisterNetEvent(('%s:response'):format(prefix), function(requestId, ok, result)
    if source == '' then return end

    local resolve = pending[requestId]
    if not resolve then return end

    pending[requestId] = nil
    resolve(ok, result)
end)

for i = 1, #HEAVY do
    local action = HEAVY[i]
    local name = ('%s:%s'):format(prefix, action)

    RegisterNUICallback(name, function(data, cb)
        local args = type(data) == 'table' and data.args or nil

        nextRequestId += 1
        local requestId = nextRequestId
        local answered = false

        pending[requestId] = function(ok, result)
            answered = true
            cb({
                ok = ok == true,
                data = ok == true and result or nil,
                error = ok ~= true and result or nil,
            })
        end

        if type(args) == 'table' and #args > 0 then
            TriggerServerEvent(('%s:request'):format(prefix), requestId, action, table.unpack(args, 1, #args))
        else
            TriggerServerEvent(('%s:request'):format(prefix), requestId, action)
        end

        SetTimeout(HEAVY_TIMEOUT, function()
            if answered then return end

            pending[requestId] = nil
            cb({ ok = false, error = 'Server tidak membalas permintaan data.' })
        end)
    end)
end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\rhd_casino\casino\sportsbook\racing\server.lua
local sportsbook = require 'casino.sportsbook.config'
local config = require 'casino.sportsbook.racing.config'
local odds = require 'casino.sportsbook.modules.odds'
local locks = require 'casino.sportsbook.modules.locks'
local storage = require 'casino.sportsbook.racing.storage'
local parlay = require 'casino.sportsbook.parlay.server'

---@class RacingConfig
---@field receiptItem string
---@field betId { prefix: string, digits: integer }
---@field houseEdge { default: number, min: number, max: number }
---@field stakeBounds { min: integer, max: integer }
---@field liabilityBounds { min: integer, max: integer }
---@field labelLength integer
---@field outcomeNameLength integer
---@field outcomeBounds { min: integer, max: integer }
---@field markets RacingMarketDef[] urut tampil di tablet

---@class RacingMarketDef
---@field id string
---@field places integer jumlah posisi finish teratas yang dibayar

---@alias RacingRole 'admin'|'staff'

---@param source number
---@return RacingRole?
local function getRole(source)
    local job = sm_core:GetPlayerData(source, 'job')
    if not job or job.name ~= shared.casinoJobName then return nil end

    local level = tonumber(job.grade?.level) or 0
    if level >= sportsbook.access.admin then return 'admin' end
    if level >= sportsbook.access.staff then return 'staff' end

    return nil
end

---@param source number
---@param required RacingRole
---@return boolean
local function hasRole(source, required)
    local role = getRole(source)
    if not role then return false end
    if required == 'staff' then return true end
    return role == 'admin'
end

---@param source number
---@return { identifier: string?, name: string }
local function staffInfo(source)
    return {
        identifier = shared.getIdentifier(source),
        name = shared.getPlayerName(source),
    }
end

---@param value any
---@param maxLength integer
---@return string?
local function cleanString(value, maxLength)
    if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil end
    local trimmed = value:gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '')
    if trimmed == '' then return nil end
    return trimmed:sub(1, maxLength)
end

---@param value any
---@param min number
---@param max number
---@return integer?
local function cleanInt(value, min, max)
    local number = math.floor(tonumber(value) or -1)
    if number < min or number > max then return nil end
    return number
end

---@param staffSource number
---@param targetSource number
---@return boolean
local function isNearStaff(staffSource, targetSource)
    if staffSource == targetSource then return true end
    if not shared.playerExist(targetSource) then return false end

    local staffPed = GetPlayerPed(staffSource)
    local targetPed = GetPlayerPed(targetSource)
    if staffPed == 0 or targetPed == 0 then return false end

    return #(GetEntityCoords(staffPed) - GetEntityCoords(targetPed)) <= sportsbook.maxBettorDistance
end

---Market baru aktif kalau jumlah outcome melebihi jumlah posisi yang dibayar.
---@param outcomeCount integer
---@return string[]
local function activeMarkets(outcomeCount)
    local list = {}

    for i = 1, #config.markets do
        local market = config.markets[i]
        if outcomeCount > market.places then
            list[#list + 1] = market.id
        end
    end

    return list
end

---@param marketId string
---@return integer
local function placesOf(marketId)
    for i = 1, #config.markets do
        if config.markets[i].id == marketId then return config.markets[i].places end
    end
    return 0
end

---@param markets string[]
---@return integer
local function maxPlaces(markets)
    local places = 0
    for i = 1, #markets do
        local marketPlaces = placesOf(markets[i])
        if marketPlaces > places then places = marketPlaces end
    end
    return places
end

---Membentuk payload event yang sudah divalidasi, sekaligus menghitung odds dari probabilitas.
---@param data any
---@return table? event, table[]? outcomes, string? err
local function buildEventPayload(data)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' then return nil, nil, 'Data event tidak valid.' end

    local label = cleanString(data.label, config.labelLength)
    if not label then return nil, nil, 'Nama event wajib diisi.' end

    local houseEdge = tonumber(data.houseEdge)
    if not houseEdge or houseEdge < config.houseEdge.min or houseEdge > config.houseEdge.max then
        return nil, nil, ('House edge harus antara %s%% dan %s%%.'):format(config.houseEdge.min, config.houseEdge.max)
    end

    local minStake = cleanInt(data.minStake, config.stakeBounds.min, config.stakeBounds.max)
    local maxStake = cleanInt(data.maxStake, config.stakeBounds.min, config.stakeBounds.max)
    if not (minStake and maxStake) then return nil, nil, 'Batas stake di luar rentang yang diizinkan.' end
    if minStake > maxStake then return nil, nil, 'Minimum stake tidak boleh melebihi maximum stake.' end

    local input = data.outcomes
    if type(input) ~= 'table' then return nil, nil, 'Daftar peserta tidak valid.' end

    local count = #input
    if count < config.outcomeBounds.min or count > config.outcomeBounds.max then
        return nil, nil, ('Jumlah peserta harus antara %d dan %d.'):format(config.outcomeBounds.min, config.outcomeBounds.max)
    end

    local markets = activeMarkets(count)
    if #markets == 0 then return nil, nil, 'Jumlah peserta belum cukup untuk membuka market apa pun.' end

    local outcomes = {}
    local seenNames = {}
    local probTotals = {}

    for i = 1, count do
        local entry = input[i]
        if type(entry) ~= 'table' then return nil, nil, ('Data peserta #%d tidak valid.'):format(i) end

        local name = cleanString(entry.name, config.outcomeNameLength)
        if not name then return nil, nil, ('Nama peserta #%d wajib diisi.'):format(i) end

        local lowered = name:lower()
        if seenNames[lowered] then return nil, nil, ('Nama peserta "%s" dipakai lebih dari sekali.'):format(name) end
        seenNames[lowered] = true

        local entryMarkets = type(entry.markets) == 'table' and entry.markets or {}
        local lines = {}
        local probByMarket = {}

        for m = 1, #markets do
            local market = markets[m]
            local line = entryMarkets[market]
            if type(line) ~= 'table' then
                return nil, nil, ('Data market %s untuk "%s" belum diisi.'):format(market, name)
            end

            local probability = tonumber(line.probability)
            if not probability or probability <= 0 or probability > 100 then
                return nil, nil, ('Probabilitas %s untuk "%s" harus di antara 0%% dan 100%%.'):format(market, name)
            end

            local maxLiability = cleanInt(line.maxLiability, config.liabilityBounds.min, config.liabilityBounds.max)
            if not maxLiability then
                return nil, nil, ('Maximum liability %s untuk "%s" di luar batas yang diizinkan.'):format(market, name)
            end

            probByMarket[market] = probability
            probTotals[market] = (probTotals[market] or 0) + probability

            lines[#lines + 1] = {
                market = market,
                probability = odds.round2(probability),
                odds = odds.fixed(probability, houseEdge),
                maxLiability = maxLiability,
            }
        end

        if probByMarket.podium and probByMarket.winner and probByMarket.podium < probByMarket.winner then
            return nil, nil, ('Probabilitas podium "%s" tidak boleh lebih kecil daripada probabilitas winner.'):format(name)
        end

        outcomes[i] = { name = name, lines = lines }
    end

    for m = 1, #markets do
        local market = markets[m]
        local expected = placesOf(market) * 100
        if math.abs((probTotals[market] or 0) - expected) > 0.01 then
            return nil, nil, ('Total probabilitas market %s harus %s%%, sekarang %s%%.')
                :format(market, expected, odds.round2(probTotals[market] or 0))
        end
    end

    return {
        label = label,
        house_edge = odds.round2(houseEdge),
        min_stake = minStake,
        max_stake = maxStake,
    }, outcomes
end

---@param value string?
---@return integer[]
local function parseIdList(value)
    local ids = {}
    if type(value) ~= 'string' then return ids end

    for chunk in value:gmatch('[^,]+') do
        local id = math.floor(tonumber(chunk) or 0)
        if id > 0 then ids[#ids + 1] = id end
    end

    return ids
end

---@param lineRow table
---@param minStake integer
---@param eventStatus string
---@return table
local function mapLine(lineRow, minStake, eventStatus)
    local maxLiability = math.floor(tonumber(lineRow.max_liability) or 0)
    local liability = math.floor(tonumber(lineRow.liability) or 0)
    local remaining = math.max(maxLiability - liability, 0)
    local lineOdds = tonumber(lineRow.odds) or 0
    local manualClosed = (tonumber(lineRow.manual_closed) or 0) == 1

    local minReturn = odds.potentialReturn(minStake, lineOdds)
    local autoClosed = minReturn <= 0 or remaining < minReturn

    return {
        id = math.floor(tonumber(lineRow.id) or 0),
        market = lineRow.market,
        probability = tonumber(lineRow.probability) or 0,
        fairOdds = odds.fair(lineRow.probability),
        odds = lineOdds,
        maxLiability = maxLiability,
        liability = liability,
        remaining = remaining,
        manualClosed = manualClosed,
        autoClosed = autoClosed,
        open = eventStatus == 'open' and not manualClosed and not autoClosed,
    }
end

---@param eventRow table
---@param outcomeRows table[]
---@param lineRows table[]
---@return table
local function mapEvent(eventRow, outcomeRows, lineRows)
    local eventId = math.floor(tonumber(eventRow.id) or 0)
    local minStake = math.floor(tonumber(eventRow.min_stake) or 0)
    local status = eventRow.status

    local linesByOutcome = {}
    local marketSeen = {}

    for i = 1, #lineRows do
        local row = lineRows[i]
        local outcomeId = math.floor(tonumber(row.outcome_id) or 0)
        linesByOutcome[outcomeId] = linesByOutcome[outcomeId] or {}
        linesByOutcome[outcomeId][row.market] = mapLine(row, minStake, status)
        marketSeen[row.market] = true
    end

    local markets = {}
    for i = 1, #config.markets do
        local market = config.markets[i].id
        if marketSeen[market] then markets[#markets + 1] = market end
    end

    local outcomes = {}
    for i = 1, #outcomeRows do
        local row = outcomeRows[i]
        local outcomeId = math.floor(tonumber(row.id) or 0)
        outcomes[#outcomes + 1] = {
            id = outcomeId,
            slot = math.floor(tonumber(row.slot) or 0),
            name = row.name,
            lines = linesByOutcome[outcomeId] or {},
        }
    end

    return {
        id = eventId,
        label = eventRow.label,
        status = status,
        houseEdge = tonumber(eventRow.house_edge) or 0,
        minStake = minStake,
        maxStake = math.floor(tonumber(eventRow.max_stake) or 0),
        betCount = math.floor(tonumber(eventRow.bet_count) or 0),
        createdBy = eventRow.created_by_name,
        createdAt = eventRow.created_at,
        markets = markets,
        result = parseIdList(eventRow.result_outcome_ids),
        outcomes = outcomes,
    }
end

---@param eventIds integer[]
---@return table[]
local function linesWithParlay(eventIds)
    local rows = storage.getLinesForEvents(eventIds)
    local extra = parlay.racingLiability(#eventIds == 1 and eventIds[1] or nil)

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local lineExtra = extra[math.floor(tonumber(rows[i].id) or 0)]
        if lineExtra then
            rows[i].liability = (tonumber(rows[i].liability) or 0) + lineExtra
        end
    end

    return rows
end

---@param eventRows table[]
---@return table[]
local function mapEventList(eventRows)
    if #eventRows == 0 then return {} end

    local ids = {}
    for i = 1, #eventRows do
        ids[i] = math.floor(tonumber(eventRows[i].id) or 0)
    end

    local outcomeRows = storage.getOutcomesForEvents(ids)
    local lineRows = linesWithParlay(ids)

    local outcomesByEvent = {}
    for i = 1, #outcomeRows do
        local row = outcomeRows[i]
        local eventId = math.floor(tonumber(row.event_id) or 0)
        outcomesByEvent[eventId] = outcomesByEvent[eventId] or {}
        table.insert(outcomesByEvent[eventId], row)
    end

    local linesByEvent = {}
    for i = 1, #lineRows do
        local row = lineRows[i]
        local eventId = math.floor(tonumber(row.event_id) or 0)
        linesByEvent[eventId] = linesByEvent[eventId] or {}
        table.insert(linesByEvent[eventId], row)
    end

    local mapped = {}
    for i = 1, #eventRows do
        local row = eventRows[i]
        local eventId = math.floor(tonumber(row.id) or 0)
        mapped[i] = mapEvent(row, outcomesByEvent[eventId] or {}, linesByEvent[eventId] or {})
    end

    return mapped
end

---@param id integer
---@return table?
local function mapSingleEvent(id)
    local row = storage.getEvent(id)
    if not row then return nil end

    return mapEvent(row, storage.getOutcomesForEvents({ id }), linesWithParlay({ id }))
end

---@param row table
---@return table
local function mapBet(row)
    return {
        betId = row.bet_id,
        eventId = math.floor(tonumber(row.event_id) or 0),
        eventLabel = row.label,
        market = row.market,
        outcomeId = math.floor(tonumber(row.outcome_id) or 0),
        outcomeName = row.outcome_name,
        odds = tonumber(row.odds) or 0,
        stake = math.floor(tonumber(row.stake) or 0),
        potentialReturn = math.floor(tonumber(row.potential_return) or 0),
        status = row.status,
        bettorName = row.bettor_name,
        staffBetName = row.staff_bet_name,
        staffPaidName = row.staff_paid_name,
        receiptTaken = (tonumber(row.receipt_taken) or 0) == 1,
        createdAt = row.created_at,
        paidAt = row.paid_at,
    }
end

local prefix <const> = 'rhd_casino_racing'
local handlers = {}

---@param name string
---@param handler function
local function callback(name, handler)
    handlers[name] = handler
    lib.callback.register(('%s:%s'):format(prefix, name), handler)
end

---@param title string
---@param logType string
---@param fields table[]
local function log(title, logType, fields)
    shared.log({ title = ('Racing â€” %s'):format(title), type = logType, fields = fields })
end

callback('getState', function(source)
    local role = getRole(source)
    if not role then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local marketInfo = {}
    local marketNames = {}
    for i = 1, #config.markets do
        local market = config.markets[i]
        marketNames[i] = market.id
        marketInfo[market.id] = { places = market.places }
    end

    return true, {
        role = role,
        sport = 'racing',
        events = mapEventList(storage.getEvents()),
        recapEvents = mapEventList(storage.getRecapEvents()),
        receiptItem = config.receiptItem,
        outcomeBounds = config.outcomeBounds,
        markets = marketNames,
        marketInfo = marketInfo,
        stakeBounds = config.stakeBounds,
        liabilityBounds = config.liabilityBounds,
        houseEdge = config.houseEdge,
        parlay = parlay.publicConfig,
    }
end)

callback('createEvent', function(source, data)
    if not hasRole(source, 'admin') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local payload, outcomes, err = buildEventPayload(data)
    if not (payload and outcomes) then return false, err end

    local staff = staffInfo(source)
    payload.created_by_name = staff.name
    payload.created_by_identifier = staff.identifier

    local eventId = storage.createEvent(payload, outcomes)
    if not eventId then return false, 'Gagal menyimpan event.' end

    log('Event Created', 'info', {
        { name = 'Admin', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(staff.name, source) },
        { name = 'Event', value = ('#%s %s'):format(eventId, payload.label) },
        { name = 'Participants', value = tostring(#outcomes), inline = true },
        { name = 'House Edge', value = ('%s%%'):format(payload.house_edge), inline = true },
    })

    return true
end)

callback('updateEvent', function(source, eventId, data)
    if not hasRole(source, 'admin') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local id = cleanInt(eventId, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not id then return false, 'Event tidak ditemukan.' end

    local event = storage.getEvent(id)
    if not event then return false, 'Event tidak ditemukan.' end
    if event.status ~= 'draft' then return false, 'Event hanya bisa diubah saat masih draft.' end

    local payload, outcomes, err = buildEventPayload(data)
    if not (payload and outcomes) then return false, err end

    if not storage.updateEvent(id, payload, outcomes) then return false, 'Gagal menyimpan perubahan.' end

    return true
end)

callback('setEventStatus', function(source, eventId, status)
    if not hasRole(source, 'admin') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local id = cleanInt(eventId, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not id then return false, 'Event tidak ditemukan.' end

    local event = storage.getEvent(id)
    if not event then return false, 'Event tidak ditemukan.' end

    local allowedFrom = status == 'open' and { 'draft', 'closed' }
        or status == 'closed' and { 'open' }
        or nil

    if not allowedFrom then return false, 'Status tidak valid.' end
    if not storage.setEventStatus(id, status, allowedFrom) then
        return false, 'Status event tidak bisa diubah dari kondisi saat ini.'
    end

    local staff = staffInfo(source)
    log(status == 'open' and 'Betting Opened' or 'Betting Closed', status == 'open' and 'success' or 'warning', {
        { name = 'Admin', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(staff.name, source) },
        { name = 'Event', value = ('#%s %s'):format(id, event.label), inline = true },
    })

    return true
end)

callback('setLineClosed', function(source, lineId, closed)
    if not hasRole(source, 'admin') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local id = cleanInt(lineId, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not id then return false, 'Peserta tidak ditemukan.' end

    local line = storage.getLine(id)
    if not line then return false, 'Peserta tidak ditemukan.' end

    local event = storage.getEvent(math.floor(tonumber(line.event_id) or 0))
    if not event then return false, 'Peserta tidak ditemukan.' end

    if not storage.setLineClosed(id, closed == true) then return false, 'Gagal mengubah status peserta.' end

    return true
end)

callback('settleEvent', function(source, eventId, result)
    if not hasRole(source, 'admin') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local id = cleanInt(eventId, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not id then return false, 'Event tidak ditemukan.' end

    local event = storage.getEvent(id)
    if not event then return false, 'Event tidak ditemukan.' end

    local staff = staffInfo(source)

    if result == 'void' then
        if event.status == 'settled' or event.status == 'void' then
            return false, 'Event ini sudah diselesaikan.'
        end
        if not storage.voidEvent(id) then return false, 'Gagal membatalkan event.' end

        parlay.voidRacing(id)

        log('Event Cancelled (VOID)', 'warning', {
            { name = 'Admin', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(staff.name, source) },
            { name = 'Event', value = ('#%s %s'):format(id, event.label), inline = true },
        })

        return true
    end

    if event.status ~= 'open' and event.status ~= 'closed' then
        return false, 'Hasil hanya bisa diinput untuk event yang sudah berjalan.'
    end

    local outcomeRows = storage.getOutcomesForEvents({ id })
    local validOutcome = {}
    local outcomeName = {}
    for i = 1, #outcomeRows do
        local outcomeId = math.floor(tonumber(outcomeRows[i].id) or 0)
        validOutcome[outcomeId] = true
        outcomeName[outcomeId] = outcomeRows[i].name
    end

    local markets = activeMarkets(#outcomeRows)
    local places = maxPlaces(markets)

    if type(result) ~= 'table' or #result ~= places then
        return false, ('Hasil harus berisi %d posisi finish.'):format(places)
    end

    local resultIds = {}
    local seen = {}
    for i = 1, places do
        local outcomeId = cleanInt(result[i], 1, math.maxinteger)
        if not outcomeId or not validOutcome[outcomeId] then
            return false, ('Peserta untuk posisi %d tidak valid.'):format(i)
        end
        if seen[outcomeId] then return false, 'Satu peserta tidak boleh mengisi dua posisi.' end
        seen[outcomeId] = true
        resultIds[i] = outcomeId
    end

    local marketPlaces = {}
    for i = 1, #markets do
        marketPlaces[markets[i]] = placesOf(markets[i])
    end

    if not storage.settleEvent(id, resultIds, marketPlaces) then return false, 'Gagal menyimpan hasil event.' end

    parlay.settleRacing(id, resultIds, marketPlaces)

    local podium = {}
    for i = 1, #resultIds do
        podium[i] = ('P%d: %s'):format(i, outcomeName[resultIds[i]])
    end

    log('Event Result', 'success', {
        { name = 'Admin', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(staff.name, source) },
        { name = 'Event', value = ('#%s %s'):format(id, event.label) },
        { name = 'Result', value = table.concat(podium, '\n') },
    })

    return true
end)

callback('deleteEvent', function(source, eventId)
    if not hasRole(source, 'admin') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local id = cleanInt(eventId, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not id then return false, 'Event tidak ditemukan.' end

    local event = storage.getEvent(id)
    if not event then return false, 'Event tidak ditemukan.' end

    local staff = staffInfo(source)
    local isFinished = event.status == 'settled' or event.status == 'void'

    -- Event yang sudah selesai hanya diarsipkan supaya rekapnya tidak ikut hilang.
    if isFinished then
        if not storage.archiveEvent(id) then return false, 'Gagal mengarsipkan event.' end

        log('Event Removed from List', 'warning', {
            { name = 'Admin', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(staff.name, source) },
            { name = 'Event', value = ('#%s %s'):format(id, event.label) },
            { name = 'Status', value = tostring(event.status):upper(), inline = true },
            { name = 'Summary', value = 'Kept', inline = true },
        })

        return true
    end

    local ok, deletedBets = storage.deleteEvent(id)
    if not ok then return false, 'Gagal menghapus event.' end

    parlay.voidRacing(id)

    log('Event Permanently Deleted', 'error', {
        { name = 'Admin', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(staff.name, source) },
        { name = 'Event', value = ('#%s %s'):format(id, event.label) },
        { name = 'Status When Deleted', value = tostring(event.status):upper(), inline = true },
        { name = 'Bets Deleted', value = tostring(deletedBets), inline = true },
    })

    return true
end)

callback('deleteRecap', function(source, eventId)
    if not hasRole(source, 'admin') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local id = cleanInt(eventId, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not id then return false, 'Event tidak ditemukan.' end

    local event = storage.getEvent(id)

    if event.status ~= 'settled' and event.status ~= 'void' then
        return false, 'Rekap hanya bisa dihapus untuk event yang sudah selesai.'
    end

        { name = 'Admin', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(staff.name, source) },
        { name = 'Event', value = ('#%s %s'):format(id, event.label) },
        { name = 'Status When Deleted', value = tostring(event.status):upper(), inline = true },
        { name = 'Bets Deleted', value = tostring(deletedBets), inline = true },
    })

    return true
end)

callback('placeBet', function(source, data)
    if not hasRole(source, 'staff') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end
    if type(data) ~= 'table' then return false, 'Data taruhan tidak valid.' end

    local lineId = cleanInt(data.lineId, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not lineId then return false, 'Pilihan taruhan tidak valid.' end

    local line = storage.getLine(lineId)
    if not line then return false, 'Pilihan taruhan tidak valid.' end

    local eventId = math.floor(tonumber(line.event_id) or 0)
    local event = storage.getEvent(eventId)
    if not event then return false, 'Event tidak ditemukan.' end
    if event.status ~= 'open' then return false, 'Betting untuk event ini sedang tidak dibuka.' end
    if (tonumber(line.manual_closed) or 0) == 1 then return false, 'Peserta ini sedang ditutup untuk taruhan.' end

    local bettorSource = cleanInt(data.bettorSource, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not bettorSource or not shared.playerExist(bettorSource) then
        return false, 'Bettor tidak ditemukan.'
    end
    if not isNearStaff(source, bettorSource) then
        return false, 'Bettor harus berada di dekat kamu.'
    end

    local minStake = math.floor(tonumber(event.min_stake) or 0)
    local maxStake = math.floor(tonumber(event.max_stake) or 0)
    local stake = cleanInt(data.stake, minStake, maxStake)
    if not stake then
        return false, ('Stake harus antara %s dan %s chip.'):format(minStake, maxStake)
    end

    local lineOdds = tonumber(line.odds) or 0
    if lineOdds <= 0 then return false, 'Odds tidak valid.' end

    local potentialReturn = odds.potentialReturn(stake, lineOdds)
    if potentialReturn <= 0 then return false, 'Potential return tidak valid.' end

    local maxLiability = math.floor(tonumber(line.max_liability) or 0)

    local lockKeys = { ('racing:%d'):format(lineId) }
    locks.acquire(lockKeys)

    local liability = (storage.getLiability(eventId)[lineId] or 0) + (parlay.racingLiability(eventId)[lineId] or 0)
    local remaining = math.max(maxLiability - liability, 0)

    if potentialReturn > remaining then
        locks.release(lockKeys)
        return false, ('BET REJECTED â€” sisa liability %s chip, potential return %s chip.'):format(remaining, potentialReturn)
    end

    local staff = staffInfo(source)
    local bettorName = shared.getPlayerName(bettorSource)

    local betId = storage.insertBet({
        event_id = eventId,
        line_id = lineId,
        outcome_id = math.floor(tonumber(line.outcome_id) or 0),
        market = line.market,
        odds = lineOdds,
        stake = stake,
        potential_return = potentialReturn,
        bettor_identifier = shared.getIdentifier(bettorSource),
        bettor_name = bettorName,
        staff_bet_identifier = staff.identifier,
        staff_bet_name = staff.name,
    }, config.betId)

    locks.release(lockKeys)

    if not betId then return false, 'Gagal menyimpan taruhan.' end

    local receiptGiven = ox_inventory:AddItem(bettorSource, config.receiptItem, 1, {
        betId = betId,
        event = event.label,
        market = line.market,
        pick = line.outcome_name,
        odds = lineOdds,
        stake = stake,
        potentialReturn = potentialReturn,
        description = ('%s\n%s â€” %s @ %s\nStake %s â†’ %s')
            :format(betId, line.market:upper(), line.outcome_name, lineOdds, stake, potentialReturn),
    })

    log('Bet Confirmed', 'money', {
        { name = 'Bet ID', value = betId },
        { name = 'Event', value = ('#%s %s'):format(eventId, event.label), inline = true },
        { name = 'Market', value = line.market:upper(), inline = true },
        { name = 'Bettor', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(bettorName, bettorSource), inline = true },
        { name = 'Pick', value = ('%s @ %s'):format(line.outcome_name, lineOdds), inline = true },
        { name = 'Stake', value = ('%s chips'):format(stake), inline = true },
        { name = 'Potential Return', value = ('%s chips'):format(potentialReturn), inline = true },
        { name = 'Staff', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(staff.name, source), inline = true },
        { name = 'Receipt', value = receiptGiven and 'Given' or 'FAILED (inventory full)', inline = true },
    })

    return true, {
        betId = betId,
        eventLabel = event.label,
        market = line.market,
        outcomeName = line.outcome_name,
        odds = lineOdds,
        stake = stake,
        potentialReturn = potentialReturn,
        bettorName = bettorName,
        staffName = staff.name,
        receiptGiven = receiptGiven == true,
    }
end)

callback('lookupBet', function(source, betId)
    if not hasRole(source, 'staff') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local id = cleanString(betId, 24)
    if not id then return false, 'Bet ID tidak valid.' end

    local row = storage.getBet(id:upper())
    if not row then return false, 'Bet ID tidak ditemukan.' end

    return true, mapBet(row)
end)

callback('markPaid', function(source, betId, claimantSource)
    if not hasRole(source, 'staff') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local id = cleanString(betId, 24)
    if not id then return false, 'Bet ID tidak valid.' end

    local row = storage.getBet(id:upper())
    if not row then return false, 'Bet ID tidak ditemukan.' end

    if row.status == 'paid' or row.status == 'refunded' then
        return false, 'BET ALREADY PAID'
    end

    local nextStatus = row.status == 'won' and 'paid'
        or row.status == 'void' and 'refunded'
        or nil

    if not nextStatus then
        return false, ('Taruhan berstatus %s tidak bisa diklaim.'):format(row.status:upper())
    end

    local claimant = cleanInt(claimantSource, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not claimant or not shared.playerExist(claimant) then
        return false, 'Penerima pembayaran tidak ditemukan.'
    end
    if not isNearStaff(source, claimant) then
        return false, 'Penerima harus berada di dekat kamu.'
    end

    local staff = staffInfo(source)

    if not storage.markBetPaid(row.bet_id, nextStatus, row.status, staff, false) then
        return false, 'Status taruhan berubah, coba cari ulang Bet ID.'
    end

    local receiptTaken = false
    local slots = ox_inventory:Search(claimant, 'slots', config.receiptItem, { betId = row.bet_id })

    if type(slots) == 'table' and slots[1] then
        receiptTaken = ox_inventory:RemoveItem(claimant, config.receiptItem, 1, nil, slots[1].slot) == true
        if receiptTaken then
            storage.setReceiptTaken(row.bet_id)
        end
    end

    local amount = nextStatus == 'paid'
        and math.floor(tonumber(row.potential_return) or 0)
        or math.floor(tonumber(row.stake) or 0)

    log(nextStatus == 'paid' and 'Payout Paid' or 'Stake Refunded', 'money', {
        { name = 'Bet ID', value = row.bet_id },
        { name = 'Bettor', value = row.bettor_name, inline = true },
        { name = 'Receiver', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(shared.getPlayerName(claimant), claimant), inline = true },
        { name = 'Amount', value = ('%s chips'):format(amount), inline = true },
        { name = 'Staff', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(staff.name, source), inline = true },
        { name = 'Receipt', value = receiptTaken and 'Collected' or 'NOT in receiver inventory', inline = true },
    })

    return true, {
        betId = row.bet_id,
        status = nextStatus,
        amount = amount,
        receiptTaken = receiptTaken,
    }
end)

callback('getRecap', function(source, eventId)
    if not hasRole(source, 'admin') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local id = cleanInt(eventId, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not id then return false, 'Event tidak ditemukan.' end

    local eventRow = storage.getEvent(id)
    if not eventRow then return false, 'Event tidak ditemukan.' end

    local totals = storage.getRecapTotals(id) or {}
    local rows = storage.getBetsByEvent(id)
    local bets = {}

    for i = 1, #rows do
        rows[i].label = eventRow.label
        bets[i] = mapBet(rows[i])
    end

    local totalStake = math.floor(tonumber(totals.total_stake) or 0)
    local paidOut = math.floor(tonumber(totals.paid_out) or 0)
    local refundedOut = math.floor(tonumber(totals.refunded_out) or 0)

    return true, {
        event = mapSingleEvent(id),
        totals = {
            betCount = math.floor(tonumber(totals.bet_count) or 0),
            totalStake = totalStake,
            totalPotential = math.floor(tonumber(totals.total_potential) or 0),
            actualPayout = paidOut + refundedOut,
            profit = totalStake - paidOut - refundedOut,
            confirmed = math.floor(tonumber(totals.count_confirmed) or 0),
            won = math.floor(tonumber(totals.count_won) or 0),
            lost = math.floor(tonumber(totals.count_lost) or 0),
            void = math.floor(tonumber(totals.count_void) or 0),
            paid = math.floor(tonumber(totals.count_paid) or 0),
            refunded = math.floor(tonumber(totals.count_refunded) or 0),
        },
        bets = bets,
    }
end)

local baseStorage = require 'modules.storage'

local safeCall = baseStorage.safeCall
local Storage = {}

local tablesReady = false

local function ensureTables()
    if tablesReady then return true end

    local ok = safeCall('ensure racing tables', function()
        db:execute_async([[
            create table if not exists rhd_casino_racing_events (
                id int unsigned not null auto_increment,
                label varchar(64) not null,
                house_edge decimal(5,2) not null default 0,
                min_stake bigint unsigned not null default 0,
                max_stake bigint unsigned not null default 0,
                status varchar(16) not null default 'draft',
                result_outcome_ids varchar(191) null,
                archived tinyint(1) not null default 0,
                created_by_name varchar(128) null,
                created_by_identifier varchar(64) null,
                created_at timestamp not null default current_timestamp,
                updated_at timestamp not null default current_timestamp on update current_timestamp,
                primary key (id),
                key idx_status (status)
            )
        ]])

        db:execute_async([[
            create table if not exists rhd_casino_racing_outcomes (
                id int unsigned not null auto_increment,
                event_id int unsigned not null,
                slot tinyint unsigned not null,
                name varchar(64) not null,
                primary key (id),
                key idx_event (event_id)
            )
        ]])

        db:execute_async([[
            create table if not exists rhd_casino_racing_lines (
                id int unsigned not null auto_increment,
                event_id int unsigned not null,
                outcome_id int unsigned not null,
                market varchar(16) not null,
                probability decimal(5,2) not null,
                odds decimal(8,2) not null,
                max_liability bigint unsigned not null default 0,
                manual_closed tinyint(1) not null default 0,
                primary key (id),
                unique key idx_outcome_market (outcome_id, market),
                key idx_event_market (event_id, market)
            )
        ]])

        db:execute_async([[
            create table if not exists rhd_casino_racing_bets (

---@param ids integer[]
---@return string
local function idList(ids)
    local parts = {}
    for i = 1, #ids do
        parts[i] = tostring(math.floor(ids[i]))
    end
    return table.concat(parts, ',')
end

---@param limit any
---@return integer
local function sanitizeLimit(limit)
    limit = math.floor(tonumber(limit) or 100)
    if limit < 1 then return 100 end
    if limit > 500 then return 500 end
    return limit
end

local EVENT_SELECT = [[
    select
        e.*,
        (select count(*) from rhd_casino_racing_bets b where b.event_id = e.id) as bet_count
    from rhd_casino_racing_events e
]]

---Menulis outcome beserta line-nya. Dipakai saat create maupun saat draft di-update.
---@param eventId integer
---@param outcomes { name: string, lines: { market: string, probability: number, odds: number, maxLiability: integer }[] }[]
local function writeOutcomes(eventId, outcomes)
    for i = 1, #outcomes do
        local outcome = outcomes[i]

        local outcomeId = db:insert_async([[
            insert into rhd_casino_racing_outcomes (event_id, slot, name)
            values (@event_id, @slot, @name)
        ]], { event_id = eventId, slot = i, name = outcome.name })

        if not outcomeId then error(('gagal menyimpan outcome slot %d'):format(i)) end

        for j = 1, #outcome.lines do
            local line = outcome.lines[j]

            db:execute_async([[
                insert into rhd_casino_racing_lines (
                    event_id, outcome_id, market, probability, odds, max_liability
                ) values (
                    @event_id, @outcome_id, @market, @probability, @odds, @max_liability
                )
            ]], {
                event_id = eventId,
                outcome_id = outcomeId,
                market = line.market,
                probability = line.probability,
                odds = line.odds,
                max_liability = line.maxLiability,
            })
        end
    end
end

---@param eventId integer
local function clearOutcomes(eventId)
    db:execute_async('delete from rhd_casino_racing_lines where event_id = @id', { id = eventId })
    db:execute_async('delete from rhd_casino_racing_outcomes where event_id = @id', { id = eventId })
end

---@param event table
---@param outcomes table[]
---@return integer? eventId
function Storage.createEvent(event, outcomes)
    if not ensureTables() then return nil end

    return safeCall('create racing event', function()
        local eventId = db:insert_async([[
            insert into rhd_casino_racing_events (
                label, house_edge, min_stake, max_stake,
                created_by_name, created_by_identifier
            ) values (
                @label, @house_edge, @min_stake, @max_stake,
                @created_by_name, @created_by_identifier
            )
        ]], event)

        if not eventId then return nil end

        -- Outcome gagal disimpan berarti event-nya tidak berguna; buang supaya tidak jadi baris yatim.
        local ok, err = pcall(writeOutcomes, eventId, outcomes)
        if not ok then
            clearOutcomes(eventId)
            db:execute_async('delete from rhd_casino_racing_events where id = @id', { id = eventId })
            error(err)
        end

        return eventId
    end, nil)
end

---@param id integer
---@param event table
---@param outcomes table[]
---@return boolean
function Storage.updateEvent(id, event, outcomes)
    if not ensureTables() then return false end

    return safeCall('update racing event', function()
        event.id = id

        local affected = db:update_async([[
            update rhd_casino_racing_events set
                label = @label,
                house_edge = @house_edge,
                min_stake = @min_stake,
                max_stake = @max_stake
            where id = @id and status = 'draft'
        ]], event)

        if (tonumber(affected) or 0) <= 0 then
            -- Nilai bisa saja tidak berubah sama sekali; pastikan lewat status, bukan lewat affected rows.
            local status = db:scalar_async(
                'select status from rhd_casino_racing_events where id = @id', { id = id }
            )
            if status ~= 'draft' then return false end
        end

        clearOutcomes(id)
        writeOutcomes(id, outcomes)

        return true
    end, false)
end

end

---Line beserta liability berjalannya, supaya daftar event tidak perlu query per baris.
---@param eventIds integer[]
---@return table[]
function Storage.getLinesForEvents(eventIds)
    if #eventIds == 0 or not ensureTables() then return {} end

    return safeCall('get racing lines', function()
        return db:query_async([[
            select
                l.*,
                coalesce((
                    select sum(b.potential_return) from rhd_casino_racing_bets b
                    where b.line_id = l.id and b.status in ('confirmed', 'won')
                ), 0) as liability
            from rhd_casino_racing_lines l
            where find_in_set(l.event_id, @ids)
            order by l.event_id, l.market, l.id
        ]], { ids = idList(eventIds) })
    end, {}) or {}
end
