---@param lineId integer
---@return table?
function Storage.getLine(lineId)
    if not ensureTables() then return nil end

    return safeCall('get racing line', function()
        return db:single_async([[
            select
                l.*,
                o.name as outcome_name,
                o.slot as outcome_slot,
                coalesce((
                    select sum(b.potential_return) from rhd_casino_racing_bets b
                    where b.line_id = l.id and b.status in ('confirmed', 'won')
                ), 0) as liability
            from rhd_casino_racing_lines l
            inner join rhd_casino_racing_outcomes o on o.id = l.outcome_id
            where l.id = @id
        ]], { id = lineId })
    end, nil)
end

---Menyelesaikan event. Bet menang kalau outcome-nya masuk `places` teratas di market tersebut.
---@param id integer
---@param resultOutcomeIds integer[] urut dari posisi pertama
---@param marketPlaces table<string, integer>
---@return boolean
function Storage.settleEvent(id, resultOutcomeIds, marketPlaces)
    if not ensureTables() then return false end

    return safeCall('settle racing event', function()
        db:execute_async([[
            update rhd_casino_racing_events
            set status = 'settled', result_outcome_ids = @result
            where id = @id and status in ('open', 'closed')
        ]], { id = id, result = idList(resultOutcomeIds) })

        for market, places in pairs(marketPlaces) do
            local winners = {}
            for i = 1, math.min(places, #resultOutcomeIds) do
                winners[i] = resultOutcomeIds[i]
            end

            db:execute_async([[
                update rhd_casino_racing_bets
                set status = 'won'
                where event_id = @id and market = @market and status = 'confirmed'
                  and find_in_set(outcome_id, @winners)
            ]], { id = id, market = market, winners = idList(winners) })

            db:execute_async([[
                update rhd_casino_racing_bets
                set status = 'lost'
                where event_id = @id and market = @market and status = 'confirmed'
            ]], { id = id, market = market })
        end

        return true
    end, false)
end

---@param id integer
---@return boolean
function Storage.voidEvent(id)
    if not ensureTables() then return false end

    return safeCall('void racing event', function()
        db:execute_async([[
            update rhd_casino_racing_events
            set status = 'void', result_outcome_ids = null
            where id = @id and status in ('draft', 'open', 'closed')
        ]], { id = id })

        db:execute_async([[
            update rhd_casino_racing_bets
            set status = 'void'
            where event_id = @id and status = 'confirmed'
        ]], { id = id })

        return true
    end, false)
end

---Menyembunyikan event dari daftar kelola tanpa menghapus datanya, supaya rekapnya tetap utuh.
---@param id integer
---@return boolean
function Storage.archiveEvent(id)
    if not ensureTables() then return false end

    local affected = safeCall('archive racing event', function()
        return db:update_async([[
            update rhd_casino_racing_events
            set archived = 1
            where id = @id and status in ('settled', 'void')
        ]], { id = id })
    end, 0)

    if (tonumber(affected) or 0) > 0 then return true end

    lib.print.warn(('[CasinoRacing] archiveEvent(%s) tidak mengubah baris apa pun.'):format(id))

    return false
end

---Menghapus event beserta outcome, line, dan seluruh taruhannya.
---@param id integer
---@return boolean ok, integer deletedBets
function Storage.deleteEvent(id)
    if not ensureTables() then return false, 0 end

    local betCount = 0

    local ok = safeCall('delete racing event', function()
        betCount = math.floor(tonumber(db:scalar_async([[
            select count(*) from rhd_casino_racing_bets where event_id = @id
        ]], { id = id })) or 0)

        db:execute_async('delete from rhd_casino_racing_bets where event_id = @id', { id = id })
        clearOutcomes(id)

        local affected = db:update_async(
            'delete from rhd_casino_racing_events where id = @id', { id = id }
        )

        return (tonumber(affected) or 0) > 0
    end, false)

    return ok == true, betCount
end

---Total potential payout yang masih ditanggung casino, per line.
---@param eventId integer
---@return table<integer, integer>
function Storage.getLiability(eventId)
    local result = {}
    if not ensureTables() then return result end

    local rows = safeCall('get racing liability', function()
        return db:query_async([[
            select line_id, coalesce(sum(potential_return), 0) as liability
            from rhd_casino_racing_bets
            where event_id = @eventId and status in ('confirmed', 'won')
            group by line_id
        ]], { eventId = eventId })
    end, {}) or {}

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local row = rows[i]
        result[math.floor(tonumber(row.line_id) or 0)] = math.floor(tonumber(row.liability) or 0)
    end

    return result
end

---@param data table
---@param betIdFormat { prefix: string, digits: integer }
---@return string? betId
function Storage.insertBet(data, betIdFormat)
    if not ensureTables() then return nil end

    return safeCall('insert racing bet', function()
        local seq = db:insert_async([[
            insert into rhd_casino_racing_bets (
                event_id, line_id, outcome_id, market, odds, stake, potential_return,
                bettor_identifier, bettor_name, staff_bet_identifier, staff_bet_name
            ) values (
                @event_id, @line_id, @outcome_id, @market, @odds, @stake, @potential_return,
                @bettor_identifier, @bettor_name, @staff_bet_identifier, @staff_bet_name
            )
        ]], data)

        if not seq then return nil end

        local betId = ('%s%0' .. betIdFormat.digits .. 'd'):format(betIdFormat.prefix, seq)

        db:execute_async(
            'update rhd_casino_racing_bets set bet_id = @bet_id where seq = @seq',
            { bet_id = betId, seq = seq }
        )

        return betId
    end, nil)
end

---@param betId string
---@return table?
function Storage.getBet(betId)
    if not ensureTables() then return nil end

    return safeCall('get racing bet', function()
        return db:single_async([[
            select
                b.*,
                e.label, e.status as event_status, e.result_outcome_ids,
                o.name as outcome_name, o.slot as outcome_slot
            from rhd_casino_racing_bets b
            inner join rhd_casino_racing_events e on e.id = b.event_id
            inner join rhd_casino_racing_outcomes o on o.id = b.outcome_id
            where b.bet_id = @betId
        ]], { betId = betId })
    end, nil)
end

---Menandai bet sebagai sudah dibayar. Hanya berhasil kalau status masih bisa diklaim.
---@param betId string
---@param nextStatus 'paid'|'refunded'
---@param fromStatus string
---@param staff { identifier: string?, name: string }
---@param receiptTaken boolean
---@return boolean
function Storage.markBetPaid(betId, nextStatus, fromStatus, staff, receiptTaken)
    if not ensureTables() then return false end

    local affected = safeCall('mark racing bet paid', function()
        return db:update_async([[
            update rhd_casino_racing_bets set
                status = @nextStatus,
                staff_paid_identifier = @staffIdentifier,
                staff_paid_name = @staffName,
                receipt_taken = @receiptTaken,
                paid_at = current_timestamp
            where bet_id = @betId and status = @fromStatus
        ]], {
            betId = betId,
            nextStatus = nextStatus,
            fromStatus = fromStatus,
            staffIdentifier = staff.identifier,
            staffName = staff.name,
            receiptTaken = receiptTaken and 1 or 0,
        })
    end, 0)

    return (tonumber(affected) or 0) > 0
end

---@param betId string
---@return boolean
function Storage.setReceiptTaken(betId)
    if not ensureTables() then return false end

    return safeCall('set racing receipt taken', function()
        db:execute_async(
            'update rhd_casino_racing_bets set receipt_taken = 1 where bet_id = @betId',
            { betId = betId }
        )
        return true
    end, false)
end

---@param eventId integer
---@return table[]
function Storage.getBetsByEvent(eventId)
    if not ensureTables() then return {} end

    return safeCall('get racing bets by event', function()
        return db:query_async([[
            select b.*, o.name as outcome_name, o.slot as outcome_slot
            from rhd_casino_racing_bets b
            inner join rhd_casino_racing_outcomes o on o.id = b.outcome_id
            where b.event_id = @eventId
            order by b.seq desc
        ]], { eventId = eventId })
    end, {}) or {}
end

---@param eventId integer
---@return table?
function Storage.getRecapTotals(eventId)
    if not ensureTables() then return nil end

    return safeCall('get racing recap totals', function()
        return db:single_async([[
            select
                count(*) as bet_count,
                coalesce(sum(stake), 0) as total_stake,
                coalesce(sum(case when status in ('confirmed', 'won') then potential_return else 0 end), 0) as total_potential,
                coalesce(sum(case when status = 'paid' then potential_return else 0 end), 0) as paid_out,
                coalesce(sum(case when status = 'refunded' then stake else 0 end), 0) as refunded_out,
                coalesce(sum(status = 'confirmed'), 0) as count_confirmed,
                coalesce(sum(status = 'won'), 0) as count_won,
                coalesce(sum(status = 'lost'), 0) as count_lost,
                coalesce(sum(status = 'void'), 0) as count_void,
                coalesce(sum(status = 'paid'), 0) as count_paid,
                coalesce(sum(status = 'refunded'), 0) as count_refunded
            from rhd_casino_racing_bets
            where event_id = @eventId
        ]], { eventId = eventId })
    end, nil)
end

return Storage

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\rhd_casino\casino\sportsbook\ufc\server.lua
local sportsbook = require 'casino.sportsbook.config'
local config = require 'casino.sportsbook.ufc.config'
local odds = require 'casino.sportsbook.modules.odds'
local locks = require 'casino.sportsbook.modules.locks'
local storage = require 'casino.sportsbook.ufc.storage'
local parlay = require 'casino.sportsbook.parlay.server'

---@alias UfcRole 'admin'|'staff'
---@alias UfcPick 'a'|'b'

---@param source number
---@return UfcRole?
local function getRole(source)
    local job = sm_core:GetPlayerData(source, 'job')
    if not job or job.name ~= shared.casinoJobName then return nil end

    local level = tonumber(job.grade?.level) or 0
    if level >= sportsbook.access.admin then return 'admin' end
    if level >= sportsbook.access.staff then return 'staff' end

    return nil
end

---@param source number
---@param required UfcRole
---@return boolean
local function hasRole(source, required)
    local role = getRole(source)
    if not role then return false end
    if required == 'staff' then return true end
    return role == 'admin'
end

---@param source number
---@return { identifier: string?, name: string }
local function staffInfo(source)
    return {
        identifier = shared.getIdentifier(source),
        name = shared.getPlayerName(source),
    }
end

---@param value any
---@param maxLength integer
---@return string?
local function cleanString(value, maxLength)
    if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil end
    local trimmed = value:gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '')
    if trimmed == '' then return nil end
    return trimmed:sub(1, maxLength)
end

---@param value any
---@param min number
---@param max number
---@return integer?
local function cleanInt(value, min, max)
    local number = math.floor(tonumber(value) or -1)
    if number < min or number > max then return nil end
    return number
end

---@param staffSource number
---@param targetSource number
---@return boolean
local function isNearStaff(staffSource, targetSource)
    if staffSource == targetSource then return true end
    if not shared.playerExist(targetSource) then return false end

    local staffPed = GetPlayerPed(staffSource)
    local targetPed = GetPlayerPed(targetSource)
    if staffPed == 0 or targetPed == 0 then return false end

    return #(GetEntityCoords(staffPed) - GetEntityCoords(targetPed)) <= sportsbook.maxBettorDistance
end

---Membentuk payload fight yang sudah divalidasi, sekaligus menghitung odds dari probabilitas.
---@param data any
---@return table? payload, string? err
local function buildFightPayload(data)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' then return nil, 'Data fight tidak valid.' end

    local label = cleanString(data.label, 64)
    local fighterA = cleanString(data.fighterA, 64)
    local fighterB = cleanString(data.fighterB, 64)

    if not label then return nil, 'Nama fight wajib diisi.' end
    if not (fighterA and fighterB) then return nil, 'Nama kedua fighter wajib diisi.' end
    if fighterA:lower() == fighterB:lower() then return nil, 'Nama fighter tidak boleh sama.' end

    local probA = tonumber(data.probA)
    local probB = tonumber(data.probB)
    if not (probA and probB) then return nil, 'Probabilitas tidak valid.' end
    if probA <= 0 or probB <= 0 then return nil, 'Probabilitas tiap fighter harus lebih dari 0%.' end
    if math.abs((probA + probB) - 100) > 0.01 then return nil, 'Total probabilitas harus 100%.' end

    local houseEdge = tonumber(data.houseEdge)
    if not houseEdge or houseEdge < config.houseEdge.min or houseEdge > config.houseEdge.max then
        return nil, ('House edge harus antara %s%% dan %s%%.'):format(config.houseEdge.min, config.houseEdge.max)
    end

    local liabilityA = cleanInt(data.maxLiabilityA, config.liabilityBounds.min, config.liabilityBounds.max)
    local liabilityB = cleanInt(data.maxLiabilityB, config.liabilityBounds.min, config.liabilityBounds.max)
    if not (liabilityA and liabilityB) then return nil, 'Maximum liability di luar batas yang diizinkan.' end

    local minStake = cleanInt(data.minStake, config.stakeBounds.min, config.stakeBounds.max)
    local maxStake = cleanInt(data.maxStake, config.stakeBounds.min, config.stakeBounds.max)
    if not (minStake and maxStake) then return nil, 'Batas stake di luar rentang yang diizinkan.' end
    if minStake > maxStake then return nil, 'Minimum stake tidak boleh melebihi maximum stake.' end

    return {
        label = label,
        fighter_a = fighterA,
        fighter_b = fighterB,
        prob_a = odds.round2(probA),
        prob_b = odds.round2(probB),
        house_edge = odds.round2(houseEdge),
        odds_a = odds.fixed(probA, houseEdge),
        odds_b = odds.fixed(probB, houseEdge),
        max_liability_a = liabilityA,
        max_liability_b = liabilityB,
        min_stake = minStake,
        max_stake = maxStake,
    }
end

---@param fightId integer
---@return { a: integer, b: integer }
local function totalLiability(fightId)
    local liability = storage.getLiability(fightId)
    local extra = parlay.ufcLiability(fightId)[fightId]

    if extra then
        liability.a += extra.a
        liability.b += extra.b
    end

    return liability
end

---@param row table
---@param liability { a: integer, b: integer }? dipakai kalau pemanggil sudah menghitungnya lebih murah
---@return table
local function mapFight(row, liability)
    liability = liability or totalLiability(row.id)
    local maxLiabilityA = math.floor(tonumber(row.max_liability_a) or 0)
    local maxLiabilityB = math.floor(tonumber(row.max_liability_b) or 0)

    return {
        id = row.id,
        label = row.label,
        status = row.status,
        winner = row.winner,
        houseEdge = tonumber(row.house_edge) or 0,
        minStake = math.floor(tonumber(row.min_stake) or 0),
        maxStake = math.floor(tonumber(row.max_stake) or 0),
        betCount = math.floor(tonumber(row.bet_count) or 0),
        createdBy = row.created_by_name,
        createdAt = row.created_at,
        fighters = {
            a = {
                name = row.fighter_a,
                probability = tonumber(row.prob_a) or 0,
                fairOdds = odds.fair(row.prob_a),
                odds = tonumber(row.odds_a) or 0,
                maxLiability = maxLiabilityA,
                liability = liability.a,
                remaining = math.max(maxLiabilityA - liability.a, 0),
            },
            b = {
                name = row.fighter_b,
                probability = tonumber(row.prob_b) or 0,
                fairOdds = odds.fair(row.prob_b),
                odds = tonumber(row.odds_b) or 0,
                maxLiability = maxLiabilityB,
                liability = liability.b,
                remaining = math.max(maxLiabilityB - liability.b, 0),
            },
        },
    }
end

---@param row table
---@return table
local function mapBet(row)
    return {
        betId = row.bet_id,
        fightId = row.fight_id,
        fightLabel = row.label,
        pick = row.pick,
        pickName = row.pick == 'a' and row.fighter_a or row.fighter_b,
        fighterA = row.fighter_a,
        fighterB = row.fighter_b,
        odds = tonumber(row.odds) or 0,
        stake = math.floor(tonumber(row.stake) or 0),
        potentialReturn = math.floor(tonumber(row.potential_return) or 0),
        status = row.status,
        bettorName = row.bettor_name,
        staffBetName = row.staff_bet_name,
        staffPaidName = row.staff_paid_name,
        receiptTaken = (tonumber(row.receipt_taken) or 0) == 1,
        createdAt = row.created_at,
        paidAt = row.paid_at,
    }
end

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_ufc:getState', function(source)
    local role = getRole(source)
    if not role then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local parlayLiability = parlay.ufcLiability()

    ---@param rows table[]
    ---@return table[]
    local function mapRows(rows)
        local mapped = {}
        for i = 1, #rows do
            local row = rows[i]
            local extra = parlayLiability[math.floor(tonumber(row.id) or 0)]
            mapped[i] = mapFight(row, {
                a = math.floor(tonumber(row.liability_a) or 0) + (extra and extra.a or 0),
                b = math.floor(tonumber(row.liability_b) or 0) + (extra and extra.b or 0),
            })
        end
        return mapped
    end

    return true, {
        role = role,
        fights = mapRows(storage.getFights()),
        recapFights = mapRows(storage.getRecapFights()),
        receiptItem = config.receiptItem,
        stakeBounds = config.stakeBounds,
        liabilityBounds = config.liabilityBounds,
        houseEdge = config.houseEdge,
        parlay = parlay.publicConfig,
    }
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_ufc:createFight', function(source, data)
    if not hasRole(source, 'admin') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local payload, err = buildFightPayload(data)
    if not payload then return false, err end

    local staff = staffInfo(source)
    payload.created_by_name = staff.name
    payload.created_by_identifier = staff.identifier

    local fightId = storage.createFight(payload)
    if not fightId then return false, 'Gagal menyimpan fight.' end

    shared.log({
        title = 'UFC â€” Fight Created',
        type = 'info',
        fields = {
            { name = 'Admin', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(staff.name, source) },
            { name = 'Fight', value = ('#%s %s'):format(fightId, payload.label) },
            { name = payload.fighter_a, value = ('%s%% @ %s'):format(payload.prob_a, payload.odds_a), inline = true },
            { name = payload.fighter_b, value = ('%s%% @ %s'):format(payload.prob_b, payload.odds_b), inline = true },
            { name = 'House Edge', value = ('%s%%'):format(payload.house_edge), inline = true },
        },
    })

    return true
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_ufc:updateFight', function(source, fightId, data)
    if not hasRole(source, 'admin') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local id = cleanInt(fightId, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not id then return false, 'Fight tidak ditemukan.' end

    local fight = storage.getFight(id)
    if not fight then return false, 'Fight tidak ditemukan.' end
    if fight.status ~= 'draft' then return false, 'Fight hanya bisa diubah saat masih draft.' end

    local payload, err = buildFightPayload(data)
    if not payload then return false, err end

    if not storage.updateFight(id, payload) then return false, 'Gagal menyimpan perubahan.' end

    return true
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_ufc:setFightStatus', function(source, fightId, status)
    if not hasRole(source, 'admin') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local id = cleanInt(fightId, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not id then return false, 'Fight tidak ditemukan.' end

    local allowedFrom = status == 'open' and { 'draft', 'closed' }
        or status == 'closed' and { 'open' }
        or nil

    if not allowedFrom then return false, 'Status tidak valid.' end
    if not storage.setFightStatus(id, status, allowedFrom) then
        return false, 'Status fight tidak bisa diubah dari kondisi saat ini.'
    end

    local staff = staffInfo(source)
    shared.log({
        title = status == 'open' and 'UFC â€” Betting Opened' or 'UFC â€” Betting Closed',
        type = status == 'open' and 'success' or 'warning',
        fields = {
            { name = 'Admin', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(staff.name, source) },
            { name = 'Fight', value = ('#%s'):format(id), inline = true },
        },
    })

    return true
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_ufc:settleFight', function(source, fightId, result)
    if not hasRole(source, 'admin') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local id = cleanInt(fightId, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not id then return false, 'Fight tidak ditemukan.' end

    local fight = storage.getFight(id)
    if not fight then return false, 'Fight tidak ditemukan.' end

    local staff = staffInfo(source)

    if result == 'void' then
        if fight.status == 'settled' or fight.status == 'void' then
            return false, 'Fight ini sudah diselesaikan.'
        end
        if not storage.voidFight(id) then return false, 'Gagal membatalkan fight.' end

        parlay.voidUfc(id)

        shared.log({
            title = 'UFC â€” Fight Cancelled (VOID)',
            type = 'warning',
            fields = {
                { name = 'Admin', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(staff.name, source) },
                { name = 'Fight', value = ('#%s %s'):format(id, fight.label), inline = true },
            },
        })

        return true
    end

    if result ~= 'a' and result ~= 'b' then return false, 'Pemenang tidak valid.' end
    if fight.status ~= 'open' and fight.status ~= 'closed' then
        return false, 'Hasil hanya bisa diinput untuk fight yang sudah berjalan.'
    end

    if not storage.settleFight(id, result) then return false, 'Gagal menyimpan hasil fight.' end

    parlay.settleUfc(id, result)

    shared.log({
        title = 'UFC â€” Fight Result',
        type = 'success',
        fields = {
            { name = 'Admin', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(staff.name, source) },
            { name = 'Fight', value = ('#%s %s'):format(id, fight.label), inline = true },
            { name = 'Winner', value = result == 'a' and fight.fighter_a or fight.fighter_b, inline = true },
        },
    })

    return true
end)

---@param source number
---@param fight table
---@param staff { identifier: string?, name: string }
---@param deletedBets integer
local function logFightRemoval(source, fight, staff, deletedBets)
    shared.log({
        title = 'UFC â€” Summary Deleted',
        type = 'error',
        fields = {
            { name = 'Admin', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(staff.name, source) },
            { name = 'Fight', value = ('#%s %s'):format(fight.id, fight.label) },
            { name = 'Status When Deleted', value = tostring(fight.status):upper(), inline = true },
            { name = 'Bets Deleted', value = tostring(deletedBets), inline = true },
        },
    })
end

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_ufc:deleteFight', function(source, fightId)
    if not hasRole(source, 'admin') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local id = cleanInt(fightId, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not id then return false, 'Fight tidak ditemukan.' end

    local fight = storage.getFight(id)
    if not fight then return false, 'Fight tidak ditemukan.' end

    local staff = staffInfo(source)
    local isFinished = fight.status == 'settled' or fight.status == 'void'

    if isFinished then
        if not storage.archiveFight(id) then
            return false, 'Gagal mengarsipkan fight. Cek konsol server â€” kolom `archived` kemungkinan belum ada di database.'
        end

        shared.log({
            title = 'UFC â€” Fight Removed from List',
            type = 'warning',
            fields = {
                { name = 'Admin', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(staff.name, source) },
                { name = 'Fight', value = ('#%s %s'):format(id, fight.label) },
                { name = 'Status', value = tostring(fight.status):upper(), inline = true },
                { name = 'Summary', value = 'Kept', inline = true },
            },
        })

        return true
    end

    local ok, deletedBets = storage.deleteFight(id)
    if not ok then return false, 'Gagal menghapus fight.' end

    parlay.voidUfc(id)

    shared.log({
        title = 'UFC â€” Fight Permanently Deleted',
        type = 'error',
        fields = {
            { name = 'Admin', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(staff.name, source) },
            { name = 'Fight', value = ('#%s %s'):format(id, fight.label) },
            { name = 'Status When Deleted', value = tostring(fight.status):upper(), inline = true },
            { name = 'Bets Deleted', value = tostring(deletedBets), inline = true },
        },
    })

    return true
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_ufc:deleteRecap', function(source, fightId)
    if not hasRole(source, 'admin') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local id = cleanInt(fightId, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not id then return false, 'Fight tidak ditemukan.' end

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_ufc:placeBet', function(source, data)
    if not hasRole(source, 'staff') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end
    if type(data) ~= 'table' then return false, 'Data taruhan tidak valid.' end

    local fightId = cleanInt(data.fightId, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not fightId then return false, 'Fight tidak ditemukan.' end

    local pick = data.pick
    if pick ~= 'a' and pick ~= 'b' then return false, 'Pilihan fighter tidak valid.' end

    local fight = storage.getFight(fightId)
    if not fight then return false, 'Fight tidak ditemukan.' end
    if fight.status ~= 'open' then return false, 'Betting untuk fight ini sedang tidak dibuka.' end

    local bettorSource = cleanInt(data.bettorSource, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not bettorSource or not shared.playerExist(bettorSource) then
        return false, 'Bettor tidak ditemukan.'
    end
    if not isNearStaff(source, bettorSource) then
        return false, 'Bettor harus berada di dekat kamu.'
    end

    local minStake = math.floor(tonumber(fight.min_stake) or 0)
    local maxStake = math.floor(tonumber(fight.max_stake) or 0)
    local stake = cleanInt(data.stake, minStake, maxStake)
    if not stake then
        return false, ('Stake harus antara %s dan %s chip.'):format(minStake, maxStake)
    end

    local fightOdds = tonumber(pick == 'a' and fight.odds_a or fight.odds_b) or 0
    if fightOdds <= 0 then return false, 'Odds fight tidak valid.' end

    local potentialReturn = odds.potentialReturn(stake, fightOdds)
    if potentialReturn <= 0 then return false, 'Potential return tidak valid.' end

    local maxLiability = math.floor(tonumber(pick == 'a' and fight.max_liability_a or fight.max_liability_b) or 0)

    local lockKeys = { ('ufc:%d'):format(fightId) }
    locks.acquire(lockKeys)

    local liability = totalLiability(fightId)
    local remaining = math.max(maxLiability - liability[pick], 0)

    if potentialReturn > remaining then
        locks.release(lockKeys)
        return false, ('BET REJECTED â€” sisa liability %s chip, potential return %s chip.'):format(remaining, potentialReturn)
    end

    local staff = staffInfo(source)
    local bettorName = shared.getPlayerName(bettorSource)

    local betId = storage.insertBet({
        fight_id = fightId,
        pick = pick,
        odds = fightOdds,
        stake = stake,
        potential_return = potentialReturn,
        bettor_identifier = shared.getIdentifier(bettorSource),
        bettor_name = bettorName,
        staff_bet_identifier = staff.identifier,
        staff_bet_name = staff.name,
    })

    locks.release(lockKeys)

    if not betId then return false, 'Gagal menyimpan taruhan.' end

    local pickName = pick == 'a' and fight.fighter_a or fight.fighter_b
    local receiptGiven = ox_inventory:AddItem(bettorSource, config.receiptItem, 1, {
        betId = betId,
        fight = fight.label,
        pick = pickName,
        odds = fightOdds,
        stake = stake,
        potentialReturn = potentialReturn,
        description = ('%s\n%s @ %s\nStake %s â†’ %s'):format(betId, pickName, fightOdds, stake, potentialReturn),
    })

    shared.log({
        title = 'UFC â€” Bet Confirmed',
        type = 'money',
        fields = {
            { name = 'Bet ID', value = betId },
            { name = 'Fight', value = ('#%s %s'):format(fightId, fight.label), inline = true },
            { name = 'Bettor', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(bettorName, bettorSource), inline = true },
            { name = 'Pick', value = ('%s @ %s'):format(pickName, fightOdds), inline = true },
            { name = 'Stake', value = ('%s chips'):format(stake), inline = true },
            { name = 'Potential Return', value = ('%s chips'):format(potentialReturn), inline = true },
            { name = 'Staff', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(staff.name, source), inline = true },
            { name = 'Receipt', value = receiptGiven and 'Given' or 'FAILED (inventory full)', inline = true },
        },
    })

    return true, {
        betId = betId,
        fightLabel = fight.label,
        fighterA = fight.fighter_a,
        fighterB = fight.fighter_b,
        pickName = pickName,
        odds = fightOdds,
        stake = stake,
        potentialReturn = potentialReturn,
        bettorName = bettorName,
        staffName = staff.name,
        receiptGiven = receiptGiven == true,
    }
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_ufc:lookupBet', function(source, betId)
    if not hasRole(source, 'staff') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local id = cleanString(betId, 24)
    if not id then return false, 'Bet ID tidak valid.' end

    local row = storage.getBet(id:upper())
    if not row then return false, 'Bet ID tidak ditemukan.' end

    return true, mapBet(row)
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_ufc:markPaid', function(source, betId, claimantSource)
    if not hasRole(source, 'staff') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local id = cleanString(betId, 24)
    if not id then return false, 'Bet ID tidak valid.' end

    local row = storage.getBet(id:upper())
    if not row then return false, 'Bet ID tidak ditemukan.' end

    if row.status == 'paid' or row.status == 'refunded' then
        return false, 'BET ALREADY PAID'
    end

    local nextStatus = row.status == 'won' and 'paid'
        or row.status == 'void' and 'refunded'
        or nil

    if not nextStatus then
        return false, ('Taruhan berstatus %s tidak bisa diklaim.'):format(row.status:upper())
    end

    local claimant = cleanInt(claimantSource, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not claimant or not shared.playerExist(claimant) then
        return false, 'Penerima pembayaran tidak ditemukan.'
    end
    if not isNearStaff(source, claimant) then
        return false, 'Penerima harus berada di dekat kamu.'
    end

    local staff = staffInfo(source)

    if not storage.markBetPaid(row.bet_id, nextStatus, row.status, staff, false) then
        return false, 'Status taruhan berubah, coba cari ulang Bet ID.'
    end

    local receiptTaken = false
    local slots = ox_inventory:Search(claimant, 'slots', config.receiptItem, { betId = row.bet_id })

    if type(slots) == 'table' and slots[1] then
        receiptTaken = ox_inventory:RemoveItem(claimant, config.receiptItem, 1, nil, slots[1].slot) == true
        if receiptTaken then
            storage.setReceiptTaken(row.bet_id)
        end
    end

    local amount = nextStatus == 'paid'
        and math.floor(tonumber(row.potential_return) or 0)
        or math.floor(tonumber(row.stake) or 0)

    shared.log({
        title = nextStatus == 'paid' and 'UFC â€” Payout Paid' or 'UFC â€” Stake Refunded',
        type = 'money',
        fields = {
            { name = 'Bet ID', value = row.bet_id },
            { name = 'Bettor', value = row.bettor_name, inline = true },
            { name = 'Receiver', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(shared.getPlayerName(claimant), claimant), inline = true },
            { name = 'Amount', value = ('%s chips'):format(amount), inline = true },
            { name = 'Staff', value = ('%s (%s)'):format(staff.name, source), inline = true },
            { name = 'Receipt', value = receiptTaken and 'Collected' or 'NOT in receiver inventory', inline = true },
        },
    })

    return true, {
        betId = row.bet_id,
        status = nextStatus,
        amount = amount,
        receiptTaken = receiptTaken,
    }
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_ufc:getRecap', function(source, fightId)
    if not hasRole(source, 'admin') then return false, 'Akses ditolak.' end

    local id = cleanInt(fightId, 1, math.maxinteger)
    if not id then return false, 'Fight tidak ditemukan.' end

    local fight = storage.getFight(id)
    if not fight then return false, 'Fight tidak ditemukan.' end

    local totals = storage.getRecapTotals(id) or {}
    local rows = storage.getBetsByFight(id)
    local bets = {}

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local row = rows[i]
        row.label = fight.label
        row.fighter_a = fight.fighter_a
        row.fighter_b = fight.fighter_b
        bets[i] = mapBet(row)
    end

    local totalStake = math.floor(tonumber(totals.total_stake) or 0)
    local paidOut = math.floor(tonumber(totals.paid_out) or 0)
    local refundedOut = math.floor(tonumber(totals.refunded_out) or 0)

    return true, {
        fight = mapFight(fight),
        totals = {
            betCount = math.floor(tonumber(totals.bet_count) or 0),
            totalStake = totalStake,
            totalPotential = math.floor(tonumber(totals.total_potential) or 0),
            actualPayout = paidOut + refundedOut,
            profit = totalStake - paidOut - refundedOut,
            confirmed = math.floor(tonumber(totals.count_confirmed) or 0),
            won = math.floor(tonumber(totals.count_won) or 0),
            lost = math.floor(tonumber(totals.count_lost) or 0),
            void = math.floor(tonumber(totals.count_void) or 0),
            paid = math.floor(tonumber(totals.count_paid) or 0),
            refunded = math.floor(tonumber(totals.count_refunded) or 0),
        },
        bets = bets,
    }
end)

local baseStorage = require 'modules.storage'
local config = require 'casino.sportsbook.ufc.config'

local safeCall = baseStorage.safeCall
local Storage = {}

local tablesReady = false

---@param tableName string
---@param columnName string
---@return boolean? exists nil kalau pengecekan sendiri gagal
local function columnExists(tableName, columnName)
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        return db:scalar_async([[
            select 1 from information_schema.columns
            where table_schema = database() and table_name = ? and column_name = ?
            limit 1
        ]], { tableName, columnName })
    end)

    if not ok then return nil end
    return result ~= nil
end

---Kolom `archived` ditambahkan belakangan, jadi instalasi lama perlu di-migrasi.
---@return boolean
local function ensureArchivedColumn()
    if columnExists('rhd_casino_ufc_fights', 'archived') == true then return true end

    local altered = pcall(function()
        db:execute_async([[
            alter table rhd_casino_ufc_fights
            add column archived tinyint(1) not null default 0
        ]])
    end)

    if altered then
        lib.print.info('[CasinoUFC] kolom `archived` ditambahkan ke rhd_casino_ufc_fights')
        return true
    end

    -- ALTER bisa gagal justru karena kolomnya sudah ada; pastikan ulang sebelum menyerah.
    if columnExists('rhd_casino_ufc_fights', 'archived') == true then return true end

    lib.print.error('[CasinoUFC] gagal menambahkan kolom `archived`. Hapus fight yang sudah selesai tidak akan berfungsi.')
    return false
end

local function ensureTables()
    if tablesReady then return true end

    local ok = safeCall('ensure ufc tables', function()
        db:execute_async([[
            create table if not exists rhd_casino_ufc_fights (
                id int unsigned not null auto_increment,
                label varchar(64) not null,
                fighter_a varchar(64) not null,
                fighter_b varchar(64) not null,
                prob_a decimal(5,2) not null,
                prob_b decimal(5,2) not null,
                house_edge decimal(5,2) not null default 0,
                odds_a decimal(8,2) not null,
                odds_b decimal(8,2) not null,
                max_liability_a bigint unsigned not null default 0,
                max_liability_b bigint unsigned not null default 0,
                min_stake bigint unsigned not null default 0,
                max_stake bigint unsigned not null default 0,
                status varchar(16) not null default 'draft',
                winner varchar(1) null,
                archived tinyint(1) not null default 0,
                created_by_name varchar(128) null,
                created_by_identifier varchar(64) null,
                created_at timestamp not null default current_timestamp,
                updated_at timestamp not null default current_timestamp on update current_timestamp,
                primary key (id),
                key idx_status (status)
            )
        ]])

        db:execute_async([[
            create table if not exists rhd_casino_ufc_bets (
                seq bigint unsigned not null auto_increment,
                bet_id varchar(24) null,
                fight_id int unsigned not null,
                pick varchar(1) not null,
                odds decimal(8,2) not null,
                stake bigint unsigned not null,
                potential_return bigint unsigned not null,
                status varchar(16) not null default 'confirmed',
                bettor_identifier varchar(64) null,
                bettor_name varchar(128) not null,
                staff_bet_identifier varchar(64) null,
                staff_bet_name varchar(128) null,
                staff_paid_identifier varchar(64) null,
                staff_paid_name varchar(128) null,
                receipt_taken tinyint(1) not null default 0,
                created_at timestamp not null default current_timestamp,
                paid_at timestamp null,
                primary key (seq),
                unique key idx_bet_id (bet_id),
                key idx_fight (fight_id),
                key idx_status (status)
            )
        ]])

        return true
    end, false)

    -- Kolom archived wajib ada; tanpa itu arsip fight selesai tidak jalan.
    tablesReady = ok == true and ensureArchivedColumn()
    return tablesReady
end

---@param id integer
---@return table?
function Storage.getFight(id)
    if not ensureTables() then return nil end

    return safeCall('get ufc fight', function()
        return db:single_async([[
            select
                f.*,
                (select count(*) from rhd_casino_ufc_bets b where b.fight_id = f.id) as bet_count
            from rhd_casino_ufc_fights f
            where f.id = @id
        ]], { id = id })
    end, nil)
end

local FIGHT_SELECT = [[
    select
        f.*,
        coalesce((
            select sum(b.potential_return) from rhd_casino_ufc_bets b
            where b.fight_id = f.id and b.pick = 'a' and b.status in ('confirmed', 'won')
        ), 0) as liability_a,
        coalesce((
            select sum(b.potential_return) from rhd_casino_ufc_bets b
            where b.fight_id = f.id and b.pick = 'b' and b.status in ('confirmed', 'won')
        ), 0) as liability_b,
        (select count(*) from rhd_casino_ufc_bets b where b.fight_id = f.id) as bet_count
    from rhd_casino_ufc_fights f
]]

---@param limit any
---@return integer
local function sanitizeLimit(limit)
    limit = math.floor(tonumber(limit) or 100)
    if limit < 1 then return 100 end
    if limit > 500 then return 500 end
    return limit
end

---Daftar untuk tab Kelola Fight. Fight terarsip disaring langsung di SQL.
---@param limit integer?
---@return table[]
function Storage.getFights(limit)
    if not ensureTables() then return {} end

    return safeCall('get ufc fights', function()
        return db:query_async(FIGHT_SELECT .. [[
            where f.archived = 0
            order by field(f.status, 'open', 'closed', 'draft', 'settled', 'void'), f.id desc
            limit @limit
        ]], { limit = sanitizeLimit(limit) })
    end, {}) or {}
end

---Daftar untuk tab Rekap: hanya fight selesai, terarsip atau tidak.
---@param limit integer?
---@return table[]
function Storage.getRecapFights(limit)
    if not ensureTables() then return {} end

    return safeCall('get ufc recap fights', function()
        return db:query_async(FIGHT_SELECT .. [[
            where f.status in ('settled', 'void')
            order by f.id desc
            limit @limit
        ]], { limit = sanitizeLimit(limit) })
    end, {}) or {}
end

---@param id integer
---@param status string
---@param allowedFrom string[]
---@return boolean
function Storage.setFightStatus(id, status, allowedFrom)
    if not ensureTables() then return false end

    local affected = safeCall('set ufc fight status', function()
        return db:update_async([[
            update rhd_casino_ufc_fights
            set status = @status
            where id = @id and find_in_set(status, @allowed)
        ]], {
            id = id,
            status = status,
            allowed = table.concat(allowedFrom, ','),
        })
    end, 0)

    return (tonumber(affected) or 0) > 0
end

---@param id integer
---@param winner 'a'|'b'
---@return boolean
function Storage.settleFight(id, winner)
    if not ensureTables() then return false end

    local loser = winner == 'a' and 'b' or 'a'

    return safeCall('settle ufc fight', function()
        db:execute_async([[
            update rhd_casino_ufc_fights
            set status = 'settled', winner = @winner
            where id = @id and status in ('open', 'closed')
        ]], { id = id, winner = winner })

        db:execute_async([[
            update rhd_casino_ufc_bets
            set status = 'won'
            where fight_id = @id and status = 'confirmed' and pick = @winner
        ]], { id = id, winner = winner })

        db:execute_async([[
            update rhd_casino_ufc_bets
            set status = 'lost'
            where fight_id = @id and status = 'confirmed' and pick = @loser
        ]], { id = id, loser = loser })

        return true
    end, false)
end

---@param id integer
---@return boolean
function Storage.voidFight(id)
    if not ensureTables() then return false end

    return safeCall('void ufc fight', function()
        db:execute_async([[
            update rhd_casino_ufc_fights
            set status = 'void', winner = null
            where id = @id and status in ('draft', 'open', 'closed')
        ]], { id = id })

        db:execute_async([[
            update rhd_casino_ufc_bets
            set status = 'void'
            where fight_id = @id and status = 'confirmed'
        ]], { id = id })

        return true
    end, false)
end

---Menyembunyikan fight dari daftar kelola tanpa menghapus datanya, supaya rekapnya tetap utuh.
---@param id integer
---@return boolean
function Storage.archiveFight(id)
    if not ensureTables() then return false end

    local affected = safeCall('archive ufc fight', function()
        return db:update_async([[
            update rhd_casino_ufc_fights
            set archived = 1
            where id = @id and status in ('settled', 'void')
        ]], { id = id })
    end, 0)

    if (tonumber(affected) or 0) > 0 then return true end

    lib.print.warn(('[CasinoUFC] archiveFight(%s) tidak mengubah baris apa pun.'):format(id))

    return false
end

---Menghapus fight beserta seluruh taruhannya, tanpa memandang status.
---@param id integer
---@return boolean ok, integer deletedBets
function Storage.deleteFight(id)
    if not ensureTables() then return false, 0 end

    local betCount = 0

    local ok = safeCall('delete ufc fight', function()
        betCount = math.floor(tonumber(db:scalar_async([[
            select count(*) from rhd_casino_ufc_bets where fight_id = @id
        ]], { id = id })) or 0)

        db:execute_async([[
            delete from rhd_casino_ufc_bets where fight_id = @id
        ]], { id = id })

        local affected = db:update_async([[
            delete from rhd_casino_ufc_fights where id = @id
        ]], { id = id })

        return (tonumber(affected) or 0) > 0
    end, false)

    return ok == true, betCount
end

---Total potential payout yang masih ditanggung casino per fighter.
---@param fightId integer
---@return { a: integer, b: integer }
function Storage.getLiability(fightId)
    local result = { a = 0, b = 0 }
    if not ensureTables() then return result end

    local rows = safeCall('get ufc liability', function()
        return db:query_async([[
            select pick, coalesce(sum(potential_return), 0) as liability
            from rhd_casino_ufc_bets
            where fight_id = @fightId and status in ('confirmed', 'won')
            group by pick
        ]], { fightId = fightId })
    end, {}) or {}

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local row = rows[i]
        if row.pick == 'a' or row.pick == 'b' then
            result[row.pick] = math.floor(tonumber(row.liability) or 0)
        end
    end

    return result
end

---@param data table
---@return string? betId
function Storage.insertBet(data)
    if not ensureTables() then return nil end

    return safeCall('insert ufc bet', function()
        local seq = db:insert_async([[
            insert into rhd_casino_ufc_bets (
                fight_id, pick, odds, stake, potential_return,
                bettor_identifier, bettor_name, staff_bet_identifier, staff_bet_name
            ) values (
                @fight_id, @pick, @odds, @stake, @potential_return,
                @bettor_identifier, @bettor_name, @staff_bet_identifier, @staff_bet_name
            )
        ]], data)

        if not seq then return nil end

        local betId = formatBetId(seq)

        db:execute_async([[
            update rhd_casino_ufc_bets set bet_id = @bet_id where seq = @seq
        ]], { bet_id = betId, seq = seq })

        return betId
    end, nil)
end

---@param betId string
---@return table?
function Storage.getBet(betId)
    if not ensureTables() then return nil end

    return safeCall('get ufc bet', function()
        return db:single_async([[
            select b.*, f.label, f.fighter_a, f.fighter_b, f.status as fight_status, f.winner
            from rhd_casino_ufc_bets b
            inner join rhd_casino_ufc_fights f on f.id = b.fight_id
            where b.bet_id = @betId
        ]], { betId = betId })
    end, nil)
end

---Menandai bet sebagai sudah dibayar. Hanya berhasil kalau status masih bisa diklaim.
---@param betId string
---@param nextStatus 'paid'|'refunded'
---@param fromStatus string
---@param staff { identifier: string?, name: string }
---@param receiptTaken boolean
---@return boolean
function Storage.markBetPaid(betId, nextStatus, fromStatus, staff, receiptTaken)
    if not ensureTables() then return false end

    local affected = safeCall('mark ufc bet paid', function()
        return db:update_async([[
            update rhd_casino_ufc_bets set
                status = @nextStatus,
                staff_paid_identifier = @staffIdentifier,
                staff_paid_name = @staffName,
                receipt_taken = @receiptTaken,
                paid_at = current_timestamp
            where bet_id = @betId and status = @fromStatus
        ]], {
            betId = betId,
            nextStatus = nextStatus,
            fromStatus = fromStatus,
            staffIdentifier = staff.identifier,
            staffName = staff.name,
            receiptTaken = receiptTaken and 1 or 0,
        })
    end, 0)

    return (tonumber(affected) or 0) > 0
end

---@param betId string
---@return boolean
function Storage.setReceiptTaken(betId)
    if not ensureTables() then return false end

    return safeCall('set ufc receipt taken', function()
        db:execute_async([[
            update rhd_casino_ufc_bets set receipt_taken = 1 where bet_id = @betId
        ]], { betId = betId })
        return true
    end, false)
end

---@param fightId integer
---@return table[]
function Storage.getBetsByFight(fightId)
    if not ensureTables() then return {} end

    return safeCall('get ufc bets by fight', function()
        return db:query_async([[
            select * from rhd_casino_ufc_bets
            where fight_id = @fightId
            order by seq desc
        ]], { fightId = fightId })
    end, {}) or {}
end

---@param fightId integer
---@return table?
function Storage.getRecapTotals(fightId)
    if not ensureTables() then return nil end

    return safeCall('get ufc recap totals', function()
        return db:single_async([[
            select
                count(*) as bet_count,
                coalesce(sum(stake), 0) as total_stake,
                coalesce(sum(case when status in ('confirmed', 'won') then potential_return else 0 end), 0) as total_potential,
                coalesce(sum(case when status = 'paid' then potential_return else 0 end), 0) as paid_out,
                coalesce(sum(case when status = 'refunded' then stake else 0 end), 0) as refunded_out,
                coalesce(sum(status = 'confirmed'), 0) as count_confirmed,
                coalesce(sum(status = 'won'), 0) as count_won,
                coalesce(sum(status = 'lost'), 0) as count_lost,
                coalesce(sum(status = 'void'), 0) as count_void,
                coalesce(sum(status = 'paid'), 0) as count_paid,
                coalesce(sum(status = 'refunded'), 0) as count_refunded
            from rhd_casino_ufc_bets
            where fight_id = @fightId
        ]], { fightId = fightId })
    end, nil)
end

return Storage

local function mockEntries(count, top1Amount)
    local entries = {}

    for i=1, count do
        local amount = math.floor(top1Amount * (1 - (i - 1) * 0.1))
        if amount < 0 then amount = 0 end
        table.insert(entries, {
            name = ('Player%d'):format(i),
            amount = amount,
            image = ('https://randomuser.me/api/portraits/lego/%d.jpg'):format(i)
        })
    end
    return entries
end

local function prepareWinners(sEntries)
    local entries = {}
    local winners = sEntries or lib.callback.await('rhd_casino_leaderboards:getWinnersLeaderboard', 500)
    if #winners > 0 then
        for i=1, #winners do
            local w = winners[i]
            entries[#entries+1] = {
                id = w.id,
                name = w.name or w.player_name,
                amount = w.amount or w.totalchipwin or w.total_chip_winnings,
                image = w.image
            }
        end
    end

    if debugMode then
        entries = lib.array.merge(entries, mockEntries(10 - #entries, entries[1] and entries[1].amount or 100000))
    end

    return entries
end

local function prepareSpenders(sEntries)
    local entries = {}
    local spenders = sEntries or lib.callback.await('rhd_casino_leaderboards:getSpendersLeaderboard', 500)
    if #spenders > 0 then
        for i=1, #spenders do
            local spender = spenders[i]
            entries[#entries+1] = {
                id = spender.id,
                name = spender.name,
                amount = spender.amount,
                image = spender.image
            }
        end
    end

    if debugMode then
        entries = lib.array.merge(entries, mockEntries(10 - #entries, entries[1] and entries[1].amount or 100000))
    end

    return entries
end

---@param board string
---@param entries table[]
local function sendRanking(board, entries)
    local screen = rankingDui[board]
    if not screen?.dui or not IsDuiAvailable(screen.dui.duiObject) then return end

    local rows = {}
    for i = 1, #entries do
        local entry = entries[i]
        rows[i] = {
            name = entry.name,
            image = entry.image,
            amount = board == 'fight' and entry.wins or entry.points,
            wins = entry.wins,
            losses = entry.losses,
        }
    end

    screen.dui:sendMessage({
        action = 'set_casino_rankings',
        data = {
            entries = rows
        }
    })
end

    if source == '' then return end

end)

for board, screen in pairs(rankingConfig.screens) do
    lib.points.new({
        coords = screen.coords,
        distance = rankingConfig.renderDistance,
        onEnter = function ()
            rankingInRange[board] = true
            if rankingDui[board] or rankingPending[board] then return end

            rankingPending[board] = true
            CreateThread(function ()
                local created = dui:new(screen.prop, screen.page)
                rankingPending[board] = nil

                if not rankingInRange[board] then
                    created:destroy()
                    return
                end

                rankingDui[board] = created
                Wait(1500)
                sendRanking(board, lib.callback.await('rhd_casino_leaderboards:getRankingScreen', false, board) or {})
            end)
        end,
        onExit = function ()
            rankingInRange[board] = false

            local created = rankingDui[board]
            if not created then return end

            created:destroy()
            rankingDui[board] = nil
        end,
    })
end

useAreaHooks(function (state)
    if state then
        casinoDui.winners = dui:new('winning', 'leaderboardWinners')
        casinoDui.spenders = dui:new('spender', 'leaderboardSpenders')

        Wait(1500)
        if casinoDui.winners?.dui then

                action = 'set_casino_winners',
                data = {
                    entries = prepareWinners()
                }
            })
        end

        if casinoDui.spenders?.dui then
            casinoDui.spenders.dui:sendMessage({
                action = 'set_casino_spenders',
                data = {
                    entries = prepareSpenders()
                }
            })
        end
    else
        for k, v in pairs(casinoDui) do
             if v and type(v) == 'table' and v.destroy then
                v:destroy()
                casinoDui[k] = nil
            end
        end
    end
end)

local storage = require 'modules.storage'
local sportsbookConfig = require 'casino.sportsbook.config'

local RESET_GRADES <const> = { 3, 4 }
local RANKING_BOARDS <const> = { fight = true, racing = true }
local RANKING_SCREEN_SIZE <const> = 10
local RANKING_MAX_VALUE <const> = 1000000

---@param source number
---@param grade? number|number[]
---@return boolean
local function canManageSpenders(source, grade)
    local playerJob = sm_core:GetPlayerData(source, 'job')

    if grade then
        local tg = type(grade)
        local level = playerJob?.grade?.level

        if tg == "number" then
            return playerJob?.name == shared.casinoJobName and level >= grade
        elseif tg == 'table' and grade[1] then
            return playerJob?.name == shared.casinoJobName and lib.array.includes(grade, level) --[[@as boolean]]
        end

        return false
    end

    return playerJob?.name == shared.casinoJobName
end

---@param source number
---@param grade? number|number[]
---@return boolean
local function rejectUnauthorized(source, grade)
    if canManageSpenders(source, grade) then return false end

    lib.notify(source, {
        title = 'Access Denied',
        description = 'You do not have permission to manage spender entries.',
        type = 'error',
    })
    return true
end

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_leaderboards:getWinnersLeaderboard', function (source)
    return storage.getTopChipWinners(10)
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_leaderboards:getSpendersLeaderboard', function (source)
    return storage.spender.getTopSpender(10)
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_leaderboards:getAllSpenders', function (source)
    if rejectUnauthorized(source) then return {} end
    return storage.getAllSpenders()
end)

lib.cron.new('*/5 * * * *', function ()
    local winners = storage.getTopChipWinners(10)
    BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_leaderboards:updateWinners', winners)
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_leaderboards:getManageData', function (source)
    if not canManageSpenders(source) then return false, 'Menu ini khusus pegawai Velvet Casino.' end

    local winners = {}
    for i, row in ipairs(storage.getTopChipWinners(10)) do
        winners[i] = { name = row.name, amount = tonumber(row.amount) or 0 }
    end

    return true, {
        spenders = storage.getAllSpenders(),
        winners = winners,
        canReset = canManageSpenders(source, RESET_GRADES),
    }
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_leaderboards:resetChipWinnings', function (source)
    if not canManageSpenders(source, RESET_GRADES) then
        return false, 'Hanya General Manager dan Owner yang bisa mereset leaderboard.'
    end

    if not storage.resetChipWinnings() then
        return false, 'Gagal mereset leaderboard chip winnings.'
    end

    BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_leaderboards:updateWinners', storage.getTopChipWinners(10))
    lib.print.info(('[CasinoLeaderboards] Total chip winnings leaderboard reset by %s.'):format(shared.getPlayerName(source)))

    return true
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_leaderboards:update_spender', function (source, data)
    if rejectUnauthorized(source) or type(data) ~= 'table' then return false end

    local entry = data?.entry or {}
    entry.id = data?.id or entry.id
    entry.name = type(entry.name) == 'string' and entry.name:sub(1, 128) or nil
    entry.image = type(entry.image) == 'string' and entry.image:sub(1, 512) or nil
    entry.amount = math.floor(tonumber(entry.amount) or -1)

    if not entry.name or entry.name == '' or entry.amount < 0 then return false end

    local success = storage.insertOrUpdateSpender(entry)

    if success then
        BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_leaderboards:updateSpenders', storage.getTopSpender(10))
    end

    return success
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_leaderboards:remove_spender', function (source, data)
    if rejectUnauthorized(source) or type(data) ~= 'table' then return false end

    local id = type(data.id) == 'string' and data.id:sub(1, 128) or nil
    if not id or id == '' then return false end

    local success = storage.removeSpender(id)

    if success then
        BroadcastCasinoPlayers('rhd_casino_leaderboards:updateSpenders', storage.getTopSpender(10))
    end

    return success
end)

---@param board string
---@return table[]
local function rankingScreen(board)
    local entries = {}

    for i, row in ipairs(storage.ranking.list(board, RANKING_SCREEN_SIZE)) do
        entries[i] = {
            name = row.name,
            image = row.image,
            wins = tonumber(row.wins) or 0,
            losses = tonumber(row.losses) or 0,
            points = tonumber(row.points) or 0,
        }
    end

    return entries
end

---@param board string
local function broadcastRanking(board)
    local entries = rankingScreen(board)

    for _, playerId in ipairs(GetPlayers()) do
        TriggerCasinoEvent('rhd_casino_leaderboards:updateRanking', playerId, board, entries)
    end
end

---@param value any
---@return integer?
local function rankingNumber(value)
    local number = tonumber(value)
    if not number or number ~= number then return nil end

    number = math.floor(number)
    if number < 0 or number > RANKING_MAX_VALUE then return nil end

    return number
end

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_leaderboards:getRankingScreen', function (_, board)
    if not RANKING_BOARDS[board] then return {} end
    return rankingScreen(board)
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_leaderboards:getRankings', function (source, data)
    local board = type(data) == 'table' and data.board or nil
    if not RANKING_BOARDS[board] then return false, 'Papan ranking tidak dikenal.' end
    if not canManageSpenders(source) then return false, 'Menu ini khusus pegawai Velvet Casino.' end

    local entries = {}
    for i, row in ipairs(storage.ranking.list(board, 100)) do
        entries[i] = {
            id = row.id,
            name = row.name,
            image = row.image,
            wins = tonumber(row.wins) or 0,
            losses = tonumber(row.losses) or 0,
            points = tonumber(row.points) or 0,
        }
    end

    return true, {
        entries = entries,
        canEdit = canManageSpenders(source, sportsbookConfig.access.admin),
    }
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_leaderboards:saveRanking', function (source, data)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or not RANKING_BOARDS[data.board] then return false, 'Data tidak valid.' end
    if not canManageSpenders(source, sportsbookConfig.access.admin) then
        return false, 'Hanya General Manager dan Owner yang bisa mengubah ranking.'
    end

    local name = type(data.name) == 'string' and data.name:gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', ''):sub(1, 128) or ''
    if name == '' then return false, 'Nama wajib diisi.' end

    local image = type(data.image) == 'string' and data.image:sub(1, 512) or ''
    local wins, losses, points = rankingNumber(data.wins or 0), rankingNumber(data.losses or 0), rankingNumber(data.points or 0)
    if not wins or not losses or not points then
        return false, ('Angka harus antara 0 dan %s.'):format(RANKING_MAX_VALUE)
    end

    local id = type(data.id) == 'string' and data.id ~= '' and data.id:sub(1, 64) or nil
    if id and not storage.ranking.exists(data.board, id) then return false, 'Data ranking tidak ditemukan.' end

    local savedId = storage.ranking.save({
        id = id,
        board = data.board,
        name = name,
        image = image ~= '' and image or nil,
        wins = data.board == 'fight' and wins or 0,
        losses = data.board == 'fight' and losses or 0,
        points = data.board == 'racing' and points or 0,
    })

    if not savedId then return false, 'Gagal menyimpan ranking.' end

    broadcastRanking(data.board)
    return true, { id = savedId }
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_casino_leaderboards:removeRanking', function (source, data)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or not RANKING_BOARDS[data.board] then return false, 'Data tidak valid.' end
    if not canManageSpenders(source, sportsbookConfig.access.admin) then
        return false, 'Hanya General Manager dan Owner yang bisa mengubah ranking.'
    end

    local id = type(data.id) == 'string' and data.id:sub(1, 64) or nil
    if not id or id == '' then return false, 'Data tidak valid.' end

    if not storage.ranking.remove(data.board, id) then return false, 'Gagal menghapus ranking.' end

    broadcastRanking(data.board)
    return true
end)



########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\rhd_casino\modules\ambient.lua
local STREAM_NAME = 'casino_walla'
local STREAM_SET = 'DLC_VW_Casino_Interior_Sounds'
local AUDIO_SCENE = 'dlc_vw_casino_slot_machines_playing'

local isPlaying = false
local startTokenSeq = 0

local function stopAmbient()
    startTokenSeq = startTokenSeq + 1
    isPlaying = false

    if IsAudioSceneActive(AUDIO_SCENE) then
        StopAudioScene(AUDIO_SCENE)
    end
    StopStream()
end

---Starts the casino ambient audio stream. Guards against duplicate playback via token sequencing.
local function startAmbient()
    if isPlaying then return end

    startTokenSeq = startTokenSeq + 1
    local token = startTokenSeq
    isPlaying = true

    StopStream()
    Wait(500)

    while not LoadStream(STREAM_NAME, STREAM_SET) do
        if token ~= startTokenSeq or not isPlaying then
            return
        end
        Wait(33)
    end

    if token ~= startTokenSeq or not isPlaying then
        StopStream()
        return
    end

    if not IsAudioSceneActive(AUDIO_SCENE) then
        StartAudioScene(AUDIO_SCENE)
    end

    local pos = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    PlayStreamFromPosition(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z)
end

useAreaHooks(function(inArea)
    if inArea then
        CreateThread(startAmbient)
    else
        stopAmbient()
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource then return end
    stopAmbient()
end)

---@param entity integer
local function applyAttributes(entity)
    SetEntityCanBeDamaged(entity, false)
    SetPedAsEnemy(entity, false)
    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(entity, true)
    SetPedResetFlag(entity, 249, true)
    SetPedConfigFlag(entity, 185, true)
    SetPedConfigFlag(entity, 108, true)
    SetPedCanEvasiveDive(entity, false)
    SetPedCanRagdollFromPlayerImpact(entity, false)
    SetPedConfigFlag(entity, 208, true)
    SetEntityCollision(entity, false, false)
    FreezeEntityPosition(entity, true)
end

local SetPedComponentVariation = SetPedComponentVariation
---@param entity integer
---@param components integer[][]
local function applyOutfitComponents(entity, components)
    for i = 1, #components do
        local comp = components[i]
        SetPedComponentVariation(entity, comp[1], comp[2], comp[3], comp[4])
    end
end

local SpawnDealer = {}

for k, v in pairs(dealerOutfits) do
    SpawnDealer[k] = function(coords)
        lib.requestModel(v.model)
        local entity = CreatePed(4, v.model, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, coords.w, false, false)
        applyAttributes(entity)
        SetPedDefaultComponentVariation(entity)
        applyOutfitComponents(entity, v.components)
        if v.prop then
            SetPedPropIndex(entity, v.prop[1], v.prop[2], v.prop[3], v.prop[4])
        end
        SetPedVoiceGroup(entity, v.voice)
        SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(v.model)
        return entity
    end
end

return SpawnDealer

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\rhd_casino\modules\interior.lua
local areaHooks = {}
local interiorHooks = {}

local currentData = {
    inArea = false,
    currentRoom = nil
}

local casinoZone = lib.zones.poly(shared.casinoCoords.bigArea)

function casinoZone:roomChange()
    TriggerServerEvent('rhd_casino:onRoom', currentData.currentRoom)

    for i = 1, #interiorHooks do
        CreateThread(function ()
            interiorHooks[i](currentData.currentRoom)
        end)
    end
end

function casinoZone:onAreaChange(state)
    TriggerServerEvent('rhd_casino:interior', state)

    for i = 1, #areaHooks do
        CreateThread(function ()
            areaHooks[i](currentData.inArea)
        end)
    end
end

function casinoZone:inside()
    if not playerState.isLoggedIn then return end

    local coords1 = shared.casinoCoords.area[1]
    local coords2 = shared.casinoCoords.area[2]

    local interiorId = GetInteriorFromEntity(cache.ped)

    local closest = IsEntityInArea(
        cache.ped, coords1.x, coords1.y, coords1.z, coords2.x, coords2.y, coords2.z, false, true, 0)

    if currentData.inArea ~= closest then
        currentData.inArea = closest
        self:onAreaChange(currentData.inArea)
    end

    if interiorId ~= 0 then
        local roomHash = GetRoomKeyFromEntity(cache.ped)
        local roomId = GetInteriorRoomIndexByHash(interiorId, roomHash)
        local roomName = roomId ~= -1 and GetInteriorRoomName(interiorId, roomId) or 'unknown'

        if currentData.currentRoom ~= roomName then
            currentData.currentRoom = roomName
            self:roomChange()
        end
    else
        if currentData.currentRoom then
            currentData.currentRoom = nil
            self:roomChange()
        end
    end

    Wait(500)
end

function casinoZone:onExit()
    currentData.inArea = false
    currentData.currentRoom = nil

    self:roomChange()
    self:onAreaChange(false)
end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\rhd_casino\modules\lifecycle.lua
local releasedForDeath = false

local function isDead()
    return playerState.isdead or IsEntityDead(cache.ped)
end

local function releaseCasinoSeat()
    if releasedForDeath or not isDead() then return end

    releasedForDeath = true
    TriggerServerEvent('rhd_casino:server:releasePlayer', 'death')
    TriggerEvent('rhd_casino:client:forceLeave', 'death')
end

local function refreshDeathState()
    if isDead() then
        releaseCasinoSeat()
    else
        releasedForDeath = false
    end
end

local playerBag = ('player:%s'):format(GetPlayerServerId(PlayerId()))

AddStateBagChangeHandler('isdead', playerBag, function ()
    SetTimeout(5, refreshDeathState)
end)

AddEventHandler('baseevents:onPlayerDied', releaseCasinoSeat)
AddEventHandler('baseevents:onPlayerKilled', releaseCasinoSeat)

AddEventHandler('gameEventTriggered', function(eventName, args)
    if eventName ~= 'CEventNetworkEntityDamage' or args[1] ~= cache.ped then return end
    SetTimeout(0, releaseCasinoSeat)
end)

AddEventHandler('playerSpawned', function()
    releasedForDeath = false
end)
