local pipeActive = false

function Minigame.stopPipe()
    pipeActive = false
end

---@param mode 'open'|'close'
---@param entity number
---@param objId string
---@param totalNeeded? number
---@return boolean success
function Minigame.pipeGame(mode, entity, objId, totalNeeded)
    if pipeActive then return false end
    if not entity or not DoesEntityExist(entity) then return false end

    pipeActive = true

    local coords = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(entity, 0.0, -1.0, 0.0)
    local cam = CreateCam('DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA', true)
    if not DoesCamExist(cam) then
        pipeActive = false
        return false
    end

    PointCamAtEntity(cam, entity, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, true)
    SetCamCoord(cam, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)
    RenderScriptCams(true, true, 500, false, false)

    Nui.send('OPEN_PIPE_GAME', { mode = mode, id = objId })
    Nui.send('SET_PIPE_PRESSURE', { pressure = 0 })

    local screenX, screenY = GetActiveScreenResolution()
    local objRot = GetEntityRotation(entity)
    local startRotation = objRot.y
    local rotation = startRotation
    local rotationMult = 7.0 * 75
    local isClosing = mode == 'close'
    totalNeeded = totalNeeded or (isClosing and 720.0 or 360.0)
    local isStuck = false
    local stuckDuration = 0
    local nextStuckCheck = 0
    local success = false

    while pipeActive do
        if not DoesEntityExist(entity) then break end
        if not State.mission then break end

        DisableAllControlActions(0)
        EnableControlAction(0, 1, true)
        EnableControlAction(0, 2, true)
        SetMouseCursorActiveThisFrame()
        SetEntityLocallyInvisible(cache.ped)

        if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, 200) then
            break
        end

        if IsControlPressed(0, 24) or IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 24) then
            SetMouseCursorSprite(4)
            local right = GetControlNormal(0, 1)
            local down = GetControlNormal(0, 2)
            local x, y = GetNuiCursorPosition()

            nextStuckCheck = nextStuckCheck - 1
            if nextStuckCheck <= 0 then
                nextStuckCheck = math.random(30, 60)
                if math.random() < 0.2 and not isStuck then
                    isStuck = true
                    stuckDuration = math.random(40, 90)
                end
            end
            if isStuck then
                stuckDuration = stuckDuration - 1
                if stuckDuration <= 0 then isStuck = false end
            end

            local mult = isStuck and rotationMult * 0.05 or rotationMult
            local old = rotation

            if x > screenX / 2 then
                if y > screenY / 2 then
                    rotation = rotation - (right - down) * mult * GetFrameTime()
                else
                    rotation = rotation - (-right - down) * mult * GetFrameTime()
                end
            else
                if y > screenY / 2 then
                    rotation = rotation - (right + down) * mult * GetFrameTime()
                else
                    rotation = rotation - (-right + down) * mult * GetFrameTime()
                end
            end

            local delta = math.abs(rotation - old)
            if isStuck then
                delta = delta * 0.1
                if math.random() < 0.05 and delta > 0.005 then isStuck = false end
            end

            SetEntityRotation(entity, objRot.x, rotation, objRot.z, 0, false)

            local signed = rotation - startRotation
            if isClosing then signed = -signed end
            local progress = math.max(0.0, math.min(1.0, signed / totalNeeded))
            local pressure = progress * 100.0

            Nui.send('SET_PIPE_PRESSURE', { pressure = pressure })

            if math.abs(startRotation - rotation) > 45 and math.floor(rotation) % 25 == 0 then
                Util.loadParticleLib('core')
                StartParticleFxNonLoopedOnEntity('bul_decal_water_heli', entity, 0.0, -0.2, 0.0, 0.0, math.random(-90, 90) + 0.0, 0.0, 0.3, false, false, false)
            end

            if pressure >= 75.0 then
                Nui.send('SET_PIPE_PRESSURE', { pressure = 78.0 })
                success = true
                break
            end
        else
            SetMouseCursorSprite(3)
        end

        Wait(0)
    end

    Nui.send('CLOSE_PIPE_GAME')
    RenderScriptCams(false, true, 500, true, false)
    DestroyCam(cam, false)
    pipeActive = false
    return success
end

local toiletActive = false

function Minigame.stopToilet()
    toiletActive = false
end

---@param coords vector3
---@param heading number
---@param offset { x: number, y: number, z: number }
---@return vector3
local function rotatedOffset(coords, heading, offset)
    local rad = math.rad(heading)
    local rx = offset.x * math.cos(rad) - offset.y * math.sin(rad)
    local ry = offset.x * math.sin(rad) + offset.y * math.cos(rad)
    return vector3(coords.x + rx, coords.y + ry, coords.z + offset.z)
end

---@param toiletData { coords: vector3, heading: number, shitProps: table[], waterProp: table, plungerOffset: vector3 }
---@return boolean success
function Minigame.toilet(toiletData)
    if toiletActive then return false end

    local toiletOffsets = State.offsets.toilet
    local coords = toiletData.coords
    local heading = toiletData.heading or 0.0

    local restoreCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local restoreHeading = GetEntityHeading(cache.ped)

    local plungerModel = utils.waitForModel(PLUNGER_MODEL)
    if not plungerModel then
        lib.print.warn('PELUMBER: Failed to load plunger model, contact server developer to fix this issue.')
        return Util.progress('Membersihkan toilet...', 8000, {
            dict = 'anim@amb@business@coc@coc_unpack_cut@',
            clip = 'fullcut_cycle_v6_cokecutter',
            flag = 49,
        })
    end

    toiletActive = true

    local playerPos = rotatedOffset(coords, heading, toiletOffsets.playerOffset)
    SetEntityCoords(cache.ped, playerPos.x, playerPos.y, playerPos.z, true, false, false, true)
    SetEntityHeading(cache.ped, heading)

    local props = {}
    local shitProps = {}

    local plungerPos = rotatedOffset(coords, heading, toiletData.plungerOffset or toiletOffsets.playerOffset)
    local plunger = utils.createProp(PLUNGER_MODEL, plungerPos, false)
    if not plunger then
        toiletActive = false
        return false
    end
    FreezeEntityPosition(plunger, true)
    SetEntityHeading(plunger, heading)
    props[#props + 1] = plunger

    for i = 1, #toiletData.shitProps do
        local info = toiletData.shitProps[i]
        local off = toiletOffsets.shitOffsets[i] or toiletOffsets.shitOffsets[1]
        local pos = rotatedOffset(coords, heading, off)
        local shit = utils.createProp(info.prop, pos, false)
        if shit then
            FreezeEntityPosition(shit, true)
            SetEntityRotation(shit, off.rotX, off.rotY, off.rotZ + heading, 0, true)
            props[#props + 1] = shit
            shitProps[#shitProps + 1] = shit
        end
    end

    local waterPos = rotatedOffset(coords, heading, toiletOffsets.waterOffset)
    local water = utils.createProp(toiletData.waterProp.prop, waterPos, false)
    if water then
        FreezeEntityPosition(water, true)
        local wo = toiletOffsets.waterOffset
        SetEntityRotation(water, wo.rotX, wo.rotY, wo.rotZ + heading, 0, true)
        props[#props + 1] = water
    end

    EnterCursorMode()

    local pedCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local forward = GetEntityForwardVector(cache.ped)
    local rightVec = vector3(-forward.y, forward.x, 0.0)

    local camPos = vector3(
        pedCoords.x - forward.x * toiletOffsets.cameraOffset.distance + rightVec.x * 0.05,
        pedCoords.y - forward.y * toiletOffsets.cameraOffset.distance + rightVec.y * 0.05,
        pedCoords.z + toiletOffsets.cameraOffset.z
    )

    local cam = CreateCamWithParams('DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA', camPos.x, camPos.y, camPos.z, -45.0, 0.0, heading, 60.0, true, 0)
    SetCamRot(cam, -45.0, 0.0, heading, 2)
    SetCamActive(cam, true)
    RenderScriptCams(true, true, 500, true, true)

    local baseZ = GetEntityCoords(plunger).z
    local minZ = baseZ + toiletOffsets.zLimits.min
    local maxZ = baseZ + toiletOffsets.zLimits.max

    local pumps = 0
    local pumpDirection = 0
    local lastY = GetControlNormal(0, 240)
    local lastZ = baseZ
    local success = false
    local animDict = 'anim@amb@business@coc@coc_unpack_cut@'
    local animClip = 'fullcut_cycle_v6_cokecutter'
    utils.waitForAnim(animDict)

    while toiletActive do
        Wait(0)
        if not State.mission then break end

        DisableControlAction(0, 140, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 141, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 142, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 24, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 257, true)

        SetEntityLocallyInvisible(cache.ped)

        if DoesEntityExist(plunger) then
            SetEntityDrawOutline(plunger, true)
            SetEntityDrawOutlineColor(0, 255, 0, 255)
            SetEntityDrawOutlineShader(0)
        end

        if not IsEntityPlayingAnim(cache.ped, animDict, animClip, 49) then
            TaskPlayAnim(cache.ped, animDict, animClip, 8.0, -8.0, -1, 49, 0, false, false, false)
        end

        if IsControlJustPressed(0, 194) or IsControlJustPressed(0, 202) then
            break
        end

        local mouseY = GetControlNormal(0, 240)
        local diffY = mouseY - lastY

        if math.abs(diffY) >= 0.0005 and IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 237) then
            local plungerCoords = GetEntityCoords(plunger)
            local camCoords = GetFinalRenderedCamCoord()
            local heightDiff = math.max(1.0, camCoords.z - plungerCoords.z)
            local moveZ = -diffY * (heightDiff * 1.83)
            local newZ = math.max(minZ, math.min(maxZ, plungerCoords.z + moveZ))
            SetEntityCoords(plunger, plungerCoords.x, plungerCoords.y, newZ, true, false, false, true)

            local currentDir = diffY > 0 and 1 or -1
            if pumpDirection == 0 then
                pumpDirection = currentDir
            elseif currentDir ~= pumpDirection and math.abs(diffY) > 0.003 then
                pumps = pumps + 1
                pumpDirection = currentDir
            end

            local zDiff = math.abs(newZ - lastZ)
            if zDiff > 0.01 and pumps > 0 then
                local allRemoved = true
                local minShitZ = 99999.0
                for i = 1, #shitProps do
                    local shit = shitProps[i]
                    if shit and DoesEntityExist(shit) then
                        allRemoved = false
                        local sc = GetEntityCoords(shit)
                        local nz = sc.z - (zDiff * 0.02)
                        SetEntityCoords(shit, sc.x, sc.y, nz, true, false, false, true)
                        if nz < minShitZ then minShitZ = nz end
                        if nz < baseZ - 0.3 then
                            DeleteEntity(shit)
                            shitProps[i] = false
                        end
                    end
                end

                if allRemoved or (pumps >= REQUIRED_PUMPS and minShitZ < baseZ - 0.1) then
                    success = true
                    break
                end
            end
            lastZ = newZ
        end
        lastY = mouseY
    end

    LeaveCursorMode()
    SetCamActive(cam, false)
    DestroyCam(cam, false)
    RenderScriptCams(false, false, 0, true, true)
    ClearPedTasksImmediately(cache.ped)
    ClearPedTasks(cache.ped)
    ClearFocus()
    FreezeEntityPosition(cache.ped, false)

    for i = 1, #props do
        if props[i] and DoesEntityExist(props[i]) then DeleteEntity(props[i]) end
    end

    SetEntityCoords(cache.ped, restoreCoords.x, restoreCoords.y, restoreCoords.z, true, false, false, true)
    SetEntityHeading(cache.ped, restoreHeading)
    toiletActive = false
    return success
end

return Minigame

local State = require 'pelumber.modules.client.state'

local Nui = {}

---@type promise?
local pending = nil

---@param action string
---@param payload? any
function Nui.send(action, payload)
    while not State.nuiLoaded do Wait(0) end
    interface.send({ action = action, payload = payload })
end

---@param cursor boolean
---@param cursor2 boolean
---@param keepInput? boolean
function Nui.focus(cursor, cursor2, keepInput)
    interface.focus(cursor, cursor2, keepInput)
end

---@param name string
---@param cb fun(data: any, cb: fun(result?: any))
function Nui.callback(name, cb)
    interface.callback(name, cb)
end

---@param action string
---@param payload any
---@return boolean success
function Nui.runNuiMinigame(action, payload)
    if pending then return false end

    pending = promise.new()
    Nui.send(action, payload)
    Nui.focus(true, true)

    local result = Citizen.Await(pending)
    pending = nil
    Nui.focus(false, false)

    return type(result) == 'table' and result.success == true
end

function Nui.cancel()
    if pending then
        pending:resolve({ success = false, cancelled = true })
    end
end

function Nui.pingUntilReady()
    CreateThread(function()
        while not State.nuiLoaded do
            if NetworkIsSessionStarted() then
                interface.send({ action = 'CHECK_NUI' })
            end
            Wait(2000)
        end
    end)
end

interface.callback('minigameClose', function(data, cb)
    cb('ok')
    if pending then pending:resolve(data or {}) end
end)

interface.callback('valveGameResult', function(data, cb)
    cb('ok')
    if pending then pending:resolve(data or {}) end
end)

return Nui

local State = require 'pelumber.modules.client.state'
local utils = require 'modules.utils'

local Util = {}

---@param dict string
function Util.loadParticleLib(dict)
    if HasNamedPtfxAssetLoaded(dict) then
        UseParticleFxAssetNextCall(dict)
        return
    end
    RequestNamedPtfxAsset(dict)
    while not HasNamedPtfxAssetLoaded(dict) do
        Wait(0)
    end
    UseParticleFxAssetNextCall(dict)
end

---@param label string
---@param duration number ms
---@param anim? { dict: string, clip: string, flag?: number }
---@return boolean
function Util.progress(label, duration, anim)
    if State.showBar then return false end
    State.showBar = true

    local ok = lib.progressBar({
        duration = duration,
        label = label,
        useWhileDead = false,
        canCancel = false,
        disable = { car = true, move = true, combat = true },
        anim = anim,
    })

    State.showBar = false
    return ok == true
end

---@param description string
---@param notifyType? 'success'|'error'|'info'|'warning'
function Util.notifyLocal(description, notifyType)
    lib.notify({
        title = 'Kerja Pelumber',
        description = description,
        type = notifyType or 'info',
    })
end

---@param description string
---@param notifyType? 'success'|'error'|'info'|'warning'
function Util.notifyGroup(description, notifyType)
    TriggerServerEvent(State.event('server:relayGroupNotify'), description, notifyType)
end

---@return boolean
function Util.startDisableThread()
    if State.disableThreadRunning then return false end
    State.disableThreadRunning = true
    CreateThread(function()
        while State.disableThreadRunning do
            DisableControlAction(0, 140, true)
            DisableControlAction(0, 141, true)
            DisableControlAction(0, 142, true)
            Wait(0)
        end
    end)
    return true
end

function Util.stopDisableThread()
    State.disableThreadRunning = false
end

local carryDict = 'missfinale_c2mcs_1'
local carryClip = 'fin_c2_mcs_1_camman'

local function startCarryAnim()
    local ped = cache.ped
    if IsEntityPlayingAnim(ped, carryDict, carryClip, 3) then return end
    if not utils.waitForAnim(carryDict) then return end
    TaskPlayAnim(ped, carryDict, carryClip, 4.0, 4.0, -1, 51, 0, false, false, false)
end

---@param object number
---@param modelName string
---@param kind 'pipe'|'valve'
---@param pipeType? string
function Util.addPlayerHandObject(object, modelName, kind, pipeType)
    if not object or not modelName then return end

    State.playerHandObject.object = object
    State.playerHandObject.objectNetId = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(object)
    State.playerHandObject.objectModel = modelName
    State.playerHandObject.pipe = kind == 'pipe'
    State.playerHandObject.valve = kind == 'valve'
    State.playerHandObject.pipeType = pipeType

    local attach = State.offsets.attach[modelName]
    if attach then
        local ped = cache.ped
        AttachEntityToEntity(
            object, ped, attach.bone,
            attach.xPos, attach.yPos, attach.zPos,
            attach.xRot, attach.yRot, attach.zRot,
            true, true, false, true, 1, true
        )
    end

    startCarryAnim()
    Util.startDisableThread()
end

function Util.resetPlayerHandObject()
    local ped = cache.ped
    local ho = State.playerHandObject

    if ho.object and DoesEntityExist(ho.object) then
        DetachEntity(ho.object, true, true)
        DeleteEntity(ho.object)
    end

    ho.object = nil
    ho.objectNetId = nil
    ho.objectModel = nil
    ho.pipe = false
    ho.valve = false
    ho.pipeType = nil

    ClearPedTasks(ped)
    ClearPedTasksImmediately(ped)
    Util.stopDisableThread()
end

---@return number? object
---@return string? model
function Util.getValidHandObject()
    local ho = State.playerHandObject
    if not ho.object then return nil, nil end

    if DoesEntityExist(ho.object) then
        return ho.object, ho.objectModel
    end

    if ho.objectNetId and NetworkDoesEntityExistWithNetworkId(ho.objectNetId) then
        local ent = NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(ho.objectNetId)
        if ent and DoesEntityExist(ent) then
            ho.object = ent
            return ent, ho.objectModel
        end
    end

    return nil, ho.objectModel
end

---@param model string
---@return boolean
function Util.isHoldingModel(model)
    local obj, held = Util.getValidHandObject()
    if not obj then return false end
    return held == model
end

---@param pipeType string
---@return boolean
function Util.isHoldingPipeType(pipeType)
    if not State.playerHandObject.pipe then return false end
    return State.playerHandObject.pipeType == pipeType
end

---@return boolean
function Util.isHoldingValve()
    return State.playerHandObject.valve == true
end

---@param coords vector3
---@param maxDistance number
---@return number[] vehicles
function Util.getVehiclesInArea(coords, maxDistance)
    local list = {}
    for _, entity in ipairs(GetGamePool('CVehicle')) do
        if #(coords - GetEntityCoords(entity)) <= maxDistance then
            list[#list + 1] = entity
        end
    end
    return list
end

---@return number? vehicle
function Util.getJobVehicle()
    local mission = State.mission
    if not mission or not mission.vehicleNetId then return nil end
    if not NetworkDoesEntityExistWithNetworkId(mission.vehicleNetId) then return nil end
    local veh = NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(mission.vehicleNetId)
    if not veh or veh == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(veh) then return nil end
    return veh
end

---@param coords vector3
---@param rot vector3
---@param fov? number
function Util.createCamera(coords, rot, fov)
    if IsPedInAnyVehicle(cache.ped, false) then return end

    RenderScriptCams(true, true, 500, true, true)
    DestroyCam(State.cam, false)

    State.cam = CreateCam('DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA', true)
    SetCamActive(State.cam, true)
    RenderScriptCams(true, true, 500, true, true)
    SetCamCoord(State.cam, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)
    SetCamRot(State.cam, rot.x, rot.y, rot.z, 2)
    SetCamNearClip(State.cam, 0.1)
    SetCamFarClip(State.cam, 1000.0)
    SetCamFov(State.cam, fov or 40.0)
end

function Util.exitCamera()
    SetEntityAlpha(cache.ped, 255, false)
    RenderScriptCams(false, true, 500, true, true)
    DestroyCam(State.cam, false)
    ClearFocus()
    State.cam = nil
end

return Util

local TAKE_CLIP = 'pickup'

---@type string[]?

local isInteracting = false

---@param veh number
---@return boolean
local function trunkOpen(veh)
    return GetVehicleDoorAngleRatio(veh, 2) > 0.0 or GetVehicleDoorAngleRatio(veh, 3) > 0.0
end

---@param veh number
local function toggleTrunk(veh)
    for _, doorIndex in ipairs({ 2, 3 }) do
        if GetVehicleDoorAngleRatio(veh, doorIndex) > 0.0 then
            SetVehicleDoorShut(veh, doorIndex, false)
        else
            SetVehicleDoorOpen(veh, doorIndex, false, false)
        end
    end
end

---@param entity? number
---@return boolean
local function isJobVehicle(entity)
    if not State.mission or not entity then return false end
    return entity == Util.getJobVehicle()
end

---@param entity? number
---@return boolean
local function canTakeFromTrunk(entity)
    if not isJobVehicle(entity) then return false end
    return not IsPedInAnyVehicle(cache.ped, false)
        and Util.getValidHandObject() == nil
        and not isInteracting
        and trunkOpen(entity --[[@as number]])
end

---@param entity? number
---@return boolean
local function canTakeSide(entity)
    if not isJobVehicle(entity) then return false end
    return not IsPedInAnyVehicle(cache.ped, false)
        and Util.getValidHandObject() == nil
        and not isInteracting
end

---@param entity? number
---@return boolean
local function canPutBack(entity)
    if not isJobVehicle(entity) then return false end
    return not IsPedInAnyVehicle(cache.ped, false)
        and Util.getValidHandObject() ~= nil
        and not isInteracting
end

---@param model string
---@param kind 'pipe'|'valve'
local function takeProp(model, kind)
    if isInteracting then return end
    if Util.getValidHandObject() then
        Util.notifyLocal('Kembalikan dulu peralatan yang sedang kamu bawa.', 'error')
        return
    end

    isInteracting = true

    local ped = cache.ped
    if utils.waitForAnim(TAKE_DICT) then
        TaskPlayAnim(ped, TAKE_DICT, TAKE_CLIP, 4.0, 4.0, 500, 48, 0, false, false, false)
    end
    Wait(500)

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local obj = utils.createProp(model, coords, false)
    if obj then
        Util.addPlayerHandObject(obj, model, kind, kind == 'pipe' and model or nil)
    else
        Util.notifyLocal('Gagal menyiapkan peralatan.', 'error')
    end

    SetTimeout(400, function() isInteracting = false end)
end

local function putBack()
    if isInteracting then return end
    if not Util.getValidHandObject() then return end

    isInteracting = true

    local ped = cache.ped
    if utils.waitForAnim(TAKE_DICT) then
        TaskPlayAnim(ped, TAKE_DICT, TAKE_CLIP, 4.0, 4.0, 400, 48, 0, false, false, false)
    end
    Wait(400)

    Util.resetPlayerHandObject()
    SetTimeout(400, function() isInteracting = false end)
end

local State = require 'pelumber.modules.client.state'
local Util = require 'pelumber.modules.client.util'
local Sync = require 'pelumber.modules.client.sync'
local interact = exports.rhd_interact
local Minigame = require 'pelumber.modules.client.minigame'
local blipUtils = require 'modules.blips'
local utils = require 'modules.utils'

---@class SwitchEntry
---@field entity? number
---@field blip? number

---@type table<number, SwitchEntry>
local entries = {}

---@param i number
---@param objId string
local function runGame(_, objId)
    if State.isDone(objId) then return end
    if not Sync.acquire(objId) then
        Util.notifyLocal('Saklar sedang dikerjakan pemain lain.', 'error')
        return
    end

    local success = Minigame.switchGame(objId)
    if success then
        Sync.objectDone(objId)
        Util.notifyLocal('Saklar berhasil diperbaiki.', 'success')
    else
        Sync.release(objId)
    end
end

---@param mission ClientMission
local function setup(mission)
    local list = mission.location.fixswitch
    if not list then return end

    for i = 1, #list do
        local data = list[i]
        local objId = State.idSwitch(i)

        local ent = utils.createProp(data.object, data.coords, false)
        if ent then
            if data.rotation then
                SetEntityRotation(ent, data.rotation.x, data.rotation.y, data.rotation.z, 0, true)
            end
            FreezeEntityPosition(ent, true)

            interact:addLocalEntity(ent, {
                {
                    name = ('sm_pelumber_fs_%d'):format(i),
                    label = 'Perbaiki Saklar',
                    icon = 'fa-solid fa-bolt',
                    distance = 1.8,
                    canInteract = function()
                        if State.isDone(objId) then return false end
                        return not State.isBusyByOther(objId)
                    end,
                    onSelect = function()
                        runGame(i, objId)
                    end,
                },
            })
        end

        local blip = blipUtils.create({
            coords = data.coords,
            sprite = 354,
            color = 5,
            scale = 0.7,
            name = 'Perbaiki Saklar',
        })

        entries[i] = { entity = ent, blip = blip }
    end
end

local function teardown()
    for _, entry in pairs(entries) do
        if entry.entity and DoesEntityExist(entry.entity) then
            interact:removeLocalEntity(entry.entity)
            DeleteEntity(entry.entity)
        end
        if entry.blip then blipUtils.remove(entry.blip) end
    end
    entries = {}
end

Minigame.registerTask('fixswitch', {
    setup = setup,
    teardown = teardown,
})


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_mp_worker\pelumber\modules\client\minigames\insertpipe.lua
local State = require 'pelumber.modules.client.state'
local Util = require 'pelumber.modules.client.util'
local Sync = require 'pelumber.modules.client.sync'
local interact = exports.rhd_interact
local Minigame = require 'pelumber.modules.client.minigame'
local blipUtils = require 'modules.blips'
local utils = require 'modules.utils'

local pipeNames = State.offsets.pipeNames

local VALVE_MODEL = 'prop_oil_valve_01'
local PLACE_ANIM = { dict = 'anim@mp_fireworks', clip = 'place_firework_3_box', flag = 2 }

---@class InsertSet
---@field valveEnt? number
---@field valveId string
---@field pipes table<number, number>
---@field pipeIds table<number, string>
---@field blip? number

---@type table<number, InsertSet>
local sets = {}

---@param ent? number
---@param solid boolean
local function applyPipeVisual(ent, solid)
    if not ent or not DoesEntityExist(ent) then return end
    if solid then
        SetEntityAlpha(ent, 255, false)
        SetEntityCollision(ent, true, true)
    else
        SetEntityAlpha(ent, 100, false)
        SetEntityCollision(ent, false, false)
    end
end

---@param s number
---@return boolean
local function allPipesDone(s)
    local set = sets[s]
    if not set then return false end
    for _, pipeId in pairs(set.pipeIds) do
        if not State.isDone(pipeId) then return false end
    end
    return true
end

---@param s number
---@param i number
---@return boolean
local function prevPipesDone(s, i)
    for k = 1, i - 1 do
        if not State.isDone(State.idInsertPipe(s, k)) then return false end
    end
    return true
end

---@param s number
---@param i number
---@param pipeId string
---@param pipeData table
local function placePipe(s, i, pipeId, pipeData)
    if State.isDone(pipeId) then return end
    if not prevPipesDone(s, i) then
        Util.notifyLocal('Pasang pipa sebelumnya terlebih dahulu.', 'error')
        return
    end
    if not Util.isHoldingPipeType(pipeData.object) then
        Util.notifyLocal('Kamu tidak memegang pipa yang sesuai.', 'error')
        return
    end
    if not Sync.acquire(pipeId) then
        Util.notifyLocal('Pipa ini sedang dikerjakan pemain lain.', 'error')
        return
    end

    local pipeLabel = pipeNames[pipeData.object] or 'Pipa'
    local ok = Util.progress(('Memasang %s...'):format(pipeLabel), 3500, PLACE_ANIM)
    if not ok then
        Sync.release(pipeId)
        return
    end

    Util.resetPlayerHandObject()
    Sync.objectDone(pipeId)
end

---@param s number
---@param valveId string
local function placeValve(s, valveId)
    if State.isDone(valveId) then return end
    if State.valveState(valveId) == 'placed' then return end
    if not allPipesDone(s) then
        Util.notifyLocal('Pasang semua pipa terlebih dahulu.', 'error')
        return
    end
    if not Util.isHoldingValve() then
        Util.notifyLocal('Kamu harus memegang katup dari kendaraan.', 'error')
        return
    end
    if not Sync.acquire(valveId) then
        Util.notifyLocal('Katup sedang dikerjakan pemain lain.', 'error')
        return
    end

    local ok = Util.progress('Memasang katup...', 3500, PLACE_ANIM)
    if not ok then
        Sync.release(valveId)
        return
    end

    Util.resetPlayerHandObject()
    Sync.valveState(valveId, 'placed')
    Util.notifyLocal('Katup terpasang. Sekarang buka katup.', 'success')
end

---@param s number
---@param valveId string
---@param valveEnt number
local function openValve(_, valveId, valveEnt)
    if State.isDone(valveId) then return end
    if State.valveState(valveId) ~= 'placed' then return end
    if not Sync.acquire(valveId) then
        Util.notifyLocal('Katup sedang dikerjakan pemain lain.', 'error')
        return
    end

    local success = Minigame.pipeGame('open', valveEnt, valveId)
    if success then
        Sync.objectDone(valveId)
        Util.notifyLocal('Rangkaian pipa selesai.', 'success')
    else
        Sync.release(valveId)
    end
end

---@param mission ClientMission
local function setup(mission)
    local list = mission.location.insertpipe
    if not list then return end

    for s = 1, #list do
        local setData = list[s]
        local valveId = State.idInsertValve(s)

        local valveEnt = utils.createProp(VALVE_MODEL, setData.valve.coords, false)
        if valveEnt then
            SetEntityHeading(valveEnt, setData.valve.heading or 0.0)
            FreezeEntityPosition(valveEnt, true)
            applyPipeVisual(valveEnt, State.valveState(valveId) == 'placed' or State.isDone(valveId))
        end

        local pipes = {}
        local pipeIds = {}
        for i = 1, #setData.pipes do
            local pipeData = setData.pipes[i]
            local pipeId = State.idInsertPipe(s, i)
            pipeIds[i] = pipeId

            local ent = utils.createProp(pipeData.object, pipeData.coords, false)
            if ent then
                if pipeData.rotation then
                    SetEntityRotation(ent, pipeData.rotation.x, pipeData.rotation.y, pipeData.rotation.z, 0, true)
                end
                FreezeEntityPosition(ent, true)
                applyPipeVisual(ent, State.isDone(pipeId))
                pipes[i] = ent

                interact:addLocalEntity(ent, {
                    {
                        name = ('sm_pelumber_ip_pipe_%d_%d'):format(s, i),
                        label = ('Pasang %s'):format(pipeNames[pipeData.object] or 'Pipa'),
                        icon = 'fa-solid fa-wrench',
                        distance = 1.4,
                        canInteract = function()
                            if State.isDone(pipeId) then return false end
                            if State.isBusyByOther(pipeId) then return false end
                            if not prevPipesDone(s, i) then return false end
                            return Util.isHoldingPipeType(pipeData.object)
                        end,
                        onSelect = function()
                            placePipe(s, i, pipeId, pipeData)
                        end,
                    },
                })
            end
        end

        if valveEnt then
            interact:addLocalEntity(valveEnt, {
                {
                    name = ('sm_pelumber_ip_valve_place_%d'):format(s),
                    label = 'Pasang Katup',
                    icon = 'fa-solid fa-screwdriver-wrench',
                    distance = 1.5,
                    canInteract = function()
                        if State.isDone(valveId) then return false end
                        if State.isBusyByOther(valveId) then return false end
                        if State.valveState(valveId) == 'placed' then return false end
                        if not allPipesDone(s) then return false end
                        return Util.isHoldingValve()
                    end,
                    onSelect = function()
                        placeValve(s, valveId)
                    end,
                },
                {
                    name = ('sm_pelumber_ip_valve_open_%d'):format(s),
                    label = 'Buka Katup',
                    icon = 'fa-solid fa-gear',
                    distance = 1.5,
                    canInteract = function()
                        if State.isDone(valveId) then return false end
                        if State.isBusyByOther(valveId) then return false end
                        return State.valveState(valveId) == 'placed'
                    end,
                    onSelect = function()
                        openValve(s, valveId, valveEnt)
                    end,
                },
            })
        end

        local blip = blipUtils.create({
            coords = setData.valve.coords,
            sprite = 354,
            color = 5,
            scale = 0.7,
            name = 'Pemasangan Pipa',
        })

        sets[s] = { valveEnt = valveEnt, valveId = valveId, pipes = pipes, pipeIds = pipeIds, blip = blip }
    end

    for _, set in pairs(sets) do
        for i, pipeId in pairs(set.pipeIds) do
            applyPipeVisual(set.pipes[i], State.isDone(pipeId))
        end
        applyPipeVisual(set.valveEnt, State.valveState(set.valveId) == 'placed' or State.isDone(set.valveId))
    end
end

---@param objId string
local function onObjectDone(objId)
    for _, set in pairs(sets) do
        for i, pipeId in pairs(set.pipeIds) do
            if pipeId == objId then
                applyPipeVisual(set.pipes[i], true)
                return
            end
        end
    end
end

---@param objId string
---@param state string
local function onValveState(objId, state)
    if state ~= 'placed' then return end
    for _, set in pairs(sets) do
        if set.valveId == objId then
            applyPipeVisual(set.valveEnt, true)
            return
        end
    end
end

local function teardown()
    for _, set in pairs(sets) do
        for _, ent in pairs(set.pipes) do
            if DoesEntityExist(ent) then
                interact:removeLocalEntity(ent)
                DeleteEntity(ent)
            end
        end
        if set.valveEnt and DoesEntityExist(set.valveEnt) then
            interact:removeLocalEntity(set.valveEnt)
            DeleteEntity(set.valveEnt)
        end
        if set.blip then blipUtils.remove(set.blip) end
    end
    sets = {}
end

Minigame.registerTask('insertpipe', {
    setup = setup,
    teardown = teardown,
    onObjectDone = onObjectDone,
    onValveState = onValveState,
})

---@class OpenValveEntry

---@param model string

local function spawnProp(model, spot)

    if not ent then return nil end
    if spot.rotation then
        SetEntityRotation(ent, spot.rotation.x, spot.rotation.y, spot.rotation.z, 0, true)
    end
    if spot.heading then
        SetEntityHeading(ent, spot.heading)
    end
    FreezeEntityPosition(ent, true)

end

---@param mission ClientMission
local function setup(mission)

        local valve = spawnProp(data.valve.object, data.valve)

        if valve then

                {
                    name = ('sm_pelumber_ov_%d'):format(i),
                    label = 'Buka Katup',
                    icon = 'fa-solid fa-gear',

        end

            coords = data.valve.coords,
            sprite = 354,
            color = 5,
            scale = 0.7,
            name = 'Buka Katup',
        })

        entries[i] = { pipe = pipe, valve = valve, blip = blip }
    end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_mp_worker\pelumber\modules\client\minigames\repairpipe.lua
local State = require 'pelumber.modules.client.state'
local Util = require 'pelumber.modules.client.util'
local Sync = require 'pelumber.modules.client.sync'
local interact = exports.rhd_interact
local Minigame = require 'pelumber.modules.client.minigame'
local blipUtils = require 'modules.blips'
local utils = require 'modules.utils'

local pipeNames = State.offsets.pipeNames

local VALVE_MODEL = 'prop_oil_valve_01'
local BROKEN_MODEL = 'veo_pipes_asd'
local REPAIR_ANIM = { dict = 'anim@mp_fireworks', clip = 'place_firework_3_box', flag = 2 }

---@class RepairSet
---@field valveEnt? number
---@field valveId string
---@field pipes table<number, number>
---@field pipeIds table<number, string>
---@field brokenPipe table<number, boolean>
---@field stage table<number, 'broken'|'removed'|'done'>
---@field pipeData table<number, table>
---@field blip? number

---@type table<number, RepairSet>
local sets = {}

local buildPipeOptions

---@param s number
---@return boolean
local function allBrokenDone(s)
    local set = sets[s]
    if not set then return false end
    for i, pipeId in pairs(set.pipeIds) do
        if set.brokenPipe[i] and not State.isDone(pipeId) then return false end
    end
    return true
end

---@param s number
---@param i number
---@param pipeId string
local function startWaterParticle(s, i, pipeId)
    CreateThread(function()
        while true do
            Wait(0)
            local set = sets[s]
            if not set or not State.mission or set.stage[i] == 'done' or State.isDone(pipeId) then break end
            if State.valveState(set.valveId) == 'closed' then break end
            local ent = set.pipes[i]
            if ent and DoesEntityExist(ent) then
                Util.loadParticleLib('core')
                StartParticleFxNonLoopedOnEntity('bul_decal_water_heli', ent, 0.0, 0.16, 0.3, 0.0, math.random(-90, 90) + 0.0, 0.0, 1.4, false, false, false)
            end
        end
    end)
end

---@param s number
---@param i number
local function replaceWithSolid(s, i)
    local set = sets[s]
    if not set or set.stage[i] == 'done' then return end
    set.stage[i] = 'done'

    local ent = set.pipes[i]
    if ent and DoesEntityExist(ent) then
        interact:removeLocalEntity(ent)
        DeleteEntity(ent)
    end

    local pipeData = set.pipeData[i]
    local solid = utils.createProp(pipeData.object, pipeData.coords, false)
    if solid then
        if pipeData.rotation then
            SetEntityRotation(solid, pipeData.rotation.x, pipeData.rotation.y, pipeData.rotation.z, 0, true)
        end
        FreezeEntityPosition(solid, true)
        set.pipes[i] = solid
    end
end

---@param s number
---@param i number
local function replaceWithGhost(s, i)
    local set = sets[s]
    if not set or set.stage[i] ~= 'broken' then return end
    set.stage[i] = 'removed'

    local ent = set.pipes[i]
    if ent and DoesEntityExist(ent) then
        interact:removeLocalEntity(ent)
        DeleteEntity(ent)
    end

    local pipeData = set.pipeData[i]
    local ghost = utils.createProp(pipeData.object, pipeData.coords, false)
    if ghost then
        if pipeData.rotation then
            SetEntityRotation(ghost, pipeData.rotation.x, pipeData.rotation.y, pipeData.rotation.z, 0, true)
        end
        FreezeEntityPosition(ghost, true)
        SetEntityAlpha(ghost, 60, false)
        SetEntityDrawOutline(ghost, true)
        SetEntityDrawOutlineColor(255, 0, 0, 255)
        set.pipes[i] = ghost
        interact:addLocalEntity(ghost, buildPipeOptions(s, i, set.pipeIds[i], pipeData, set.valveId))
    end
end

---@param s number
---@param i number
---@param pipeId string
---@param valveId string
local function removePipe(_, _, pipeId, valveId)
    if State.isDone(pipeId) or State.isPipeRemoved(pipeId) then return end
    if State.valveState(valveId) ~= 'closed' then
        Util.notifyLocal('Tutup katup terlebih dahulu.', 'error')
        return
    end
    if Util.getValidHandObject() then
        Util.notifyLocal('Tanganmu harus kosong untuk melepas pipa.', 'error')
        return
    end
    if not Sync.acquire(pipeId) then
        Util.notifyLocal('Pipa ini sedang dikerjakan pemain lain.', 'error')
        return
    end

    local ok = Util.progress('Melepas pipa rusak...', 4000, REPAIR_ANIM)
    if not ok then
        Sync.release(pipeId)
        return
    end

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local obj = utils.createProp(BROKEN_MODEL, coords, false)
    if obj then
        Util.addPlayerHandObject(obj, BROKEN_MODEL, 'pipe', BROKEN_MODEL)
    end
    Sync.pipeRemoved(pipeId)
    Util.notifyLocal('Pipa rusak dilepas. Kembalikan ke kendaraan dan ambil pipa baru.', 'success')
end

---@param s number
---@param i number
---@param pipeId string
---@param pipeData table
local function repairPipe(s, _, pipeId, pipeData)
    if State.isDone(pipeId) then return end
    if State.valveState(State.idRepairValve(s)) ~= 'closed' then
        Util.notifyLocal('Tutup katup terlebih dahulu.', 'error')
        return
    end
    if not State.isPipeRemoved(pipeId) then
        Util.notifyLocal('Lepas pipa rusak terlebih dahulu.', 'error')
        return
    end
    if not Util.isHoldingPipeType(pipeData.object) then
        Util.notifyLocal('Kamu tidak memegang pipa yang sesuai.', 'error')
        return
    end
    if not Sync.acquire(pipeId) then
        Util.notifyLocal('Pipa ini sedang dikerjakan pemain lain.', 'error')
        return
    end

    local pipeLabel = pipeNames[pipeData.object] or 'Pipa'
    local ok = Util.progress(('Memasang %s...'):format(pipeLabel), 4000, REPAIR_ANIM)
    if not ok then
        Sync.release(pipeId)
        return
    end

    Util.resetPlayerHandObject()
    Sync.objectDone(pipeId)
end

---@param s number
---@param i number
---@param pipeId string
---@param pipeData table
---@param valveId string
---@return table[]
function buildPipeOptions(s, i, pipeId, pipeData, valveId)
    return {
        {
            name = ('sm_pelumber_rp_remove_%d_%d'):format(s, i),
            label = 'Lepas Pipa Rusak',
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-wrench',
            distance = 1.4,
            canInteract = function()
                if State.isDone(pipeId) or State.isPipeRemoved(pipeId) then return false end
                if State.isBusyByOther(pipeId) then return false end
                if State.valveState(valveId) ~= 'closed' then return false end
                return Util.getValidHandObject() == nil
            end,
            onSelect = function()
                removePipe(s, i, pipeId, valveId)
            end,
        },
        {
            name = ('sm_pelumber_rp_pipe_%d_%d'):format(s, i),
            label = ('Pasang %s'):format(pipeNames[pipeData.object] or 'Pipa'),
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-wrench',
            distance = 1.4,
            canInteract = function()
                if State.isDone(pipeId) then return false end
                if not State.isPipeRemoved(pipeId) then return false end
                if State.isBusyByOther(pipeId) then return false end
                if State.valveState(valveId) ~= 'closed' then return false end
                return Util.isHoldingPipeType(pipeData.object)
            end,
            onSelect = function()
                repairPipe(s, i, pipeId, pipeData)
            end,
        },
    }
end

---@param s number
---@param valveId string
---@param valveEnt number
---@param heading number
local function closeValve(_, valveId, valveEnt, heading)
    if State.isDone(valveId) then return end
    if State.valveState(valveId) == 'closed' then return end
    if not Sync.acquire(valveId) then
        Util.notifyLocal('Katup sedang dikerjakan pemain lain.', 'error')
        return
    end

    SetEntityHeading(valveEnt, heading)
    local success = Minigame.pipeGame('close', valveEnt, valveId)
    if success then
        Sync.valveState(valveId, 'closed')
        Util.notifyLocal('Katup tertutup. Ganti pipa yang rusak.', 'success')
    else
        Sync.release(valveId)
    end
end

---@param s number
---@param valveId string
---@param valveEnt number
---@param heading number
local function openValve(s, valveId, valveEnt, heading)
    if State.isDone(valveId) then return end
    if State.valveState(valveId) ~= 'closed' then return end
    if not allBrokenDone(s) then
        Util.notifyLocal('Ganti semua pipa rusak terlebih dahulu.', 'error')
        return
    end
    if not Sync.acquire(valveId) then
        Util.notifyLocal('Katup sedang dikerjakan pemain lain.', 'error')
        return
    end

    SetEntityHeading(valveEnt, heading)
    local success = Minigame.pipeGame('open', valveEnt, valveId, 450.0)
    if success then
        Sync.objectDone(valveId)
        Util.notifyLocal('Pipa berhasil diperbaiki.', 'success')
    else
        Sync.release(valveId)
    end
end

---@param mission ClientMission
local function setup(mission)
    local list = mission.location.repairpipe
    if not list then return end

    for s = 1, #list do
        local setData = list[s]
        local valveId = State.idRepairValve(s)

        local valveEnt = utils.createProp(VALVE_MODEL, setData.valve.coords, false)
        if valveEnt then
            SetEntityHeading(valveEnt, setData.valve.heading or 0.0)
            FreezeEntityPosition(valveEnt, true)
        end

        local pipes = {}
        local pipeIds = {}
        local brokenPipe = {}
        local stage = {}
        local pipeDataMap = {}

        for i = 1, #setData.pipes do
            local pipeData = setData.pipes[i]
            local pipeId = State.idRepairPipe(s, i)
            pipeIds[i] = pipeId
            pipeDataMap[i] = pipeData
            local isBroken = mission.brokenPipes[pipeId] == true
            brokenPipe[i] = isBroken

            if not isBroken or State.isDone(pipeId) then
                if isBroken then stage[i] = 'done' end
                local ent = utils.createProp(pipeData.object, pipeData.coords, false)
                if ent then
                    if pipeData.rotation then
                        SetEntityRotation(ent, pipeData.rotation.x, pipeData.rotation.y, pipeData.rotation.z, 0, true)
                    end
                    FreezeEntityPosition(ent, true)
                    pipes[i] = ent
                end
            else
                local removed = State.isPipeRemoved(pipeId)
                stage[i] = removed and 'removed' or 'broken'
                local ent = utils.createProp(removed and pipeData.object or BROKEN_MODEL, pipeData.coords, false)
                if ent then
                    if pipeData.rotation then
                        SetEntityRotation(ent, pipeData.rotation.x, pipeData.rotation.y, pipeData.rotation.z, 0, true)
                    end
                    FreezeEntityPosition(ent, true)
                    if removed then
                        SetEntityAlpha(ent, 60, false)
                        SetEntityDrawOutline(ent, true)
                        SetEntityDrawOutlineColor(255, 0, 0, 255)
                    end
                    pipes[i] = ent

                    interact:addLocalEntity(ent, buildPipeOptions(s, i, pipeId, pipeData, valveId))
                end
            end
        end

        if valveEnt then
            interact:addLocalEntity(valveEnt, {
                {
                    name = ('sm_pelumber_rp_valve_close_%d'):format(s),
                    label = 'Tutup Katup',
                    icon = 'fa-solid fa-lock',
                    distance = 1.5,
                    canInteract = function()
                        if State.isDone(valveId) then return false end
                        if State.isBusyByOther(valveId) then return false end
                        return State.valveState(valveId) ~= 'closed'
                    end,
                    onSelect = function()
                        closeValve(s, valveId, valveEnt, setData.valve.heading or 0.0)
                    end,
                },
                {
                    name = ('sm_pelumber_rp_valve_open_%d'):format(s),
                    label = 'Buka Katup',
                    icon = 'fa-solid fa-unlock',
                    distance = 1.5,
                    canInteract = function()
                        if State.isDone(valveId) then return false end
                        if State.isBusyByOther(valveId) then return false end
                        if State.valveState(valveId) ~= 'closed' then return false end
                        return allBrokenDone(s)
                    end,
                    onSelect = function()
                        openValve(s, valveId, valveEnt, setData.valve.heading or 0.0)
                    end,
                },
            })
        end

        local blip = blipUtils.create({
            coords = setData.valve.coords,
            sprite = 354,
            color = 5,
            scale = 0.7,
            name = 'Perbaikan Pipa',
        })

        sets[s] = {
            valveEnt = valveEnt,
            valveId = valveId,
            pipes = pipes,
            pipeIds = pipeIds,
            brokenPipe = brokenPipe,
            stage = stage,
            pipeData = pipeDataMap,
            blip = blip,
        }
    end

    for s, set in pairs(sets) do
        for i, pipeId in pairs(set.pipeIds) do
            if set.brokenPipe[i] then
                if State.isDone(pipeId) then
                    replaceWithSolid(s, i)
                elseif State.isPipeRemoved(pipeId) then
                    replaceWithGhost(s, i)
                end
                if set.stage[i] ~= 'done' then
                    startWaterParticle(s, i, pipeId)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

---@param objId string
local function onObjectDone(objId)
    for s, set in pairs(sets) do
        for i, pipeId in pairs(set.pipeIds) do
            if pipeId == objId and set.brokenPipe[i] then
                replaceWithSolid(s, i)
                return
            end
        end
    end
end

---@param objId string
local function onPipeRemoved(objId)
    for s, set in pairs(sets) do
        for i, pipeId in pairs(set.pipeIds) do
            if pipeId == objId and set.brokenPipe[i] then
                replaceWithGhost(s, i)
                return
            end
        end
    end
end

local function teardown()
    for _, set in pairs(sets) do
        for _, ent in pairs(set.pipes) do
            if DoesEntityExist(ent) then
                interact:removeLocalEntity(ent)
                DeleteEntity(ent)
            end
        end
        if set.valveEnt and DoesEntityExist(set.valveEnt) then
            interact:removeLocalEntity(set.valveEnt)
            DeleteEntity(set.valveEnt)
        end
        if set.blip then blipUtils.remove(set.blip) end
    end
    sets = {}
end

Minigame.registerTask('repairpipe', {
    setup = setup,
    teardown = teardown,
    onObjectDone = onObjectDone,
    onPipeRemoved = onPipeRemoved,
})


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_mp_worker\pelumber\modules\client\minigames\toilet.lua
local State = require 'pelumber.modules.client.state'
local Util = require 'pelumber.modules.client.util'
local Sync = require 'pelumber.modules.client.sync'
local interact = exports.rhd_interact
local Minigame = require 'pelumber.modules.client.minigame'
local blipUtils = require 'modules.blips'
local utils = require 'modules.utils'

---@class ToiletEntry
---@field ent? number
---@field blip? number

---@type table<number, ToiletEntry>
local entries = {}

---@param i number
---@param objId string
---@param data table
local function runGame(_, objId, data)
    if State.isDone(objId) then return end
    if not Sync.acquire(objId) then
        Util.notifyLocal('Toilet ini sedang dibersihkan pemain lain.', 'error')
        return
    end

    local success = Minigame.toilet(data)
    if success then
        Sync.objectDone(objId)
        Util.notifyLocal('Toilet berhasil dibersihkan.', 'success')
    else
        Sync.release(objId)
    end
end

---@param mission ClientMission
local function setup(mission)
    local list = mission.location.toilet
    if not list then return end

    for i = 1, #list do
        local data = list[i]
        local objId = State.idToilet(i)

        local ent = utils.createProp(data.object, data.coords, false)
        if ent then
            SetEntityHeading(ent, data.heading or 0.0)
            FreezeEntityPosition(ent, true)

            interact:addLocalEntity(ent, {
                {
                    name = ('sm_pelumber_tl_opt_%d'):format(i),
                    label = 'Bersihkan Toilet',
                    icon = 'fa-solid fa-toilet',
                    distance = 1.5,
                    offset = vec(0.0, 0.0, 1.0),
                    canInteract = function()
                        if State.isDone(objId) then return false end
                        return not State.isBusyByOther(objId)
                    end,
                    onSelect = function()
                        runGame(i, objId, data)
                    end,
                },
            })
        end

        local blip = blipUtils.create({
            coords = data.coords,
            sprite = 354,
            color = 5,
            scale = 0.7,
            name = 'Bersihkan Toilet',
        })

        entries[i] = { ent = ent, blip = blip }
    end
end

local function teardown()
    for _, entry in pairs(entries) do
        if entry.ent and DoesEntityExist(entry.ent) then
            interact:removeLocalEntity(entry.ent)
            DeleteEntity(entry.ent)
        end
        if entry.blip then blipUtils.remove(entry.blip) end
    end
    entries = {}
end

Minigame.registerTask('toilet', {
    setup = setup,
    teardown = teardown,
})


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_mp_worker\pelumber\modules\server\mission.lua
local locations = require 'pelumber.data.locations'

local Mission = {}

local TASK_ORDER = { 'insertpipe', 'repairpipe', 'toilet', 'openvalve', 'fixswitch' }

local REPAIR_CANDIDATE = 'veo_pipes_d'
local REPAIR_BROKEN_COUNT = 2

local TASK_META = {
    insertpipe = { name = 'Pemasangan Pipa', description = 'Pasang seluruh rangkaian pipa baru.' },
    repairpipe = { name = 'Perbaikan Pipa', description = 'Ganti pipa yang rusak.' },
    toilet = { name = 'Bersihkan Toilet', description = 'Bersihkan semua toilet yang tersumbat.' },
    openvalve = { name = 'Buka Katup', description = 'Pasang dan buka katup.' },
    fixswitch = { name = 'Perbaiki Saklar', description = 'Perbaiki panel saklar.' },
}

---@param n number
---@param count number
---@return number[]
local function pickRandom(n, count)
    local pool = {}
    for i = 1, n do pool[i] = i end
    for i = n, 2, -1 do
        local j = math.random(i)
        pool[i], pool[j] = pool[j], pool[i]
    end
    local out = {}
    for i = 1, math.min(count, n) do out[i] = pool[i] end
    return out
end

---@param mission table
---@param location table
local function buildRepairBroken(mission, location)
    if not location.repairpipe then return end

    for s = 1, #location.repairpipe do
        local set = location.repairpipe[s]
        local candidates = {}
        for i = 1, #set.pipes do
            if set.pipes[i].object == REPAIR_CANDIDATE then
                candidates[#candidates + 1] = i
            end
        end

        local chosen = pickRandom(#candidates, REPAIR_BROKEN_COUNT)
        for _, ci in ipairs(chosen) do
            local pipeIndex = candidates[ci]
            mission.brokenPipes[('rp_%d_p_%d'):format(s, pipeIndex)] = true
        end
    end
end

---@param mission table
---@param taskType string
---@param location table
---@return string[]? units
local function buildUnits(mission, taskType, location)
    local data = location[taskType]
    if not data or #data == 0 then return nil end

    local units = {}

    if taskType == 'insertpipe' or taskType == 'repairpipe' then
        local prefix = taskType == 'insertpipe' and 'ip' or 'rp'
        local pipeGate = taskType == 'insertpipe' and 'sequence' or 'closed'
        local expectedState = taskType == 'insertpipe' and 'placed' or 'closed'
        for s = 1, #data do
            local set = data[s]
            local valveId = ('%s_%d_v'):format(prefix, s)
            local pipeIds = {}

            for i = 1, #set.pipes do
                local pipeId = ('%s_%d_p_%d'):format(prefix, s, i)
                if taskType == 'insertpipe' or mission.brokenPipes[pipeId] then
                    pipeIds[#pipeIds + 1] = pipeId
                    mission.pipeValve[pipeId] = valveId
                    mission.pipeGate[pipeId] = pipeGate
                    mission.unitCoords[pipeId] = set.pipes[i].coords
                    units[#units + 1] = pipeId
                end
            end

            mission.valveDeps[valveId] = pipeIds
            mission.valveExpectedState[valveId] = expectedState
            mission.unitCoords[valveId] = set.valve.coords
            units[#units + 1] = valveId
        end
    elseif taskType == 'toilet' then
        for i = 1, #data do
            local objId = ('tl_%d'):format(i)
            mission.unitCoords[objId] = data[i].coords
            units[#units + 1] = objId
        end
    elseif taskType == 'openvalve' then
        for i = 1, #data do
            local objId = ('ov_%d'):format(i)
            mission.unitCoords[objId] = data[i].valve.coords
            units[#units + 1] = objId
        end
    elseif taskType == 'fixswitch' then
        for i = 1, #data do
            local objId = ('fs_%d'):format(i)
            mission.unitCoords[objId] = data[i].coords
            units[#units + 1] = objId
        end
    end

    return units
end

---@param groupId string
---@param ownerSrc number
---@param locationIndex number
---@param vehicle { entity: number, netId: number, plate: string }
---@return table
function Mission.new(groupId, ownerSrc, locationIndex, vehicle)
    local location = locations[locationIndex]

    local mission = {
        groupId = groupId,
        ownerSrc = ownerSrc,
        locationIndex = locationIndex,
        vehicleEntity = vehicle.entity,
        vehicleNetId = vehicle.netId,
        vehiclePlate = vehicle.plate,
        taskOrder = {},
        currentTaskIndex = 1,
        brokenPipes = {},
        pipeRemoved = {},
        done = {},
        valveState = {},
        processing = {},
        units = {},
        unitDone = {},
        unitCoords = {},
        pipeValve = {},
        pipeGate = {},
        valveDeps = {},
        valveExpectedState = {},
        finishing = false,
    }

    buildRepairBroken(mission, location)

    for _, taskType in ipairs(TASK_ORDER) do
        local units = buildUnits(mission, taskType, location)
        if units and #units > 0 then
            mission.taskOrder[#mission.taskOrder + 1] = taskType
            mission.units[taskType] = units
            mission.unitDone[taskType] = 0
        end
    end

    return mission
end

---@param mission table
---@return table
function Mission.snapshot(mission)
    return {
        locationIndex = mission.locationIndex,
        vehicleNetId = mission.vehicleNetId,
        vehiclePlate = mission.vehiclePlate,
        ownerSrc = mission.ownerSrc,
        taskOrder = mission.taskOrder,
        currentTaskIndex = mission.currentTaskIndex,
        brokenPipes = mission.brokenPipes,
        pipeRemoved = mission.pipeRemoved,
        done = mission.done,
        valveState = mission.valveState,
        processing = mission.processing,
    }
end

---@param mission table
---@return string? taskType
function Mission.currentTask(mission)
    return mission.taskOrder[mission.currentTaskIndex]
end

---@param mission table
---@param objId string
---@return boolean
local function isCurrentUnit(mission, objId)
    local taskType = Mission.currentTask(mission)
    if not taskType then return false end

    local units = mission.units[taskType]
    for i = 1, #units do
        if units[i] == objId then return true end
    end
    return false
end

Mission.isCurrentUnit = isCurrentUnit

---@param mission table
---@param objId string
---@return boolean
function Mission.canComplete(mission, objId)
    if mission.done[objId] then return false end
    if not isCurrentUnit(mission, objId) then return false end

    local deps = mission.valveDeps[objId]
    if deps then
        for i = 1, #deps do
            if not mission.done[deps[i]] then return false end
        end
        return mission.valveState[objId] == mission.valveExpectedState[objId]
    end

    local valveId = mission.pipeValve[objId]
    if valveId then
        local gate = mission.pipeGate[objId]
        if gate == 'closed' then
            if not mission.pipeRemoved[objId] then return false end
            return mission.valveState[valveId] == 'closed'
        elseif gate == 'sequence' then
            local list = mission.valveDeps[valveId]
            for i = 1, #list do
                if list[i] == objId then return true end
                if not mission.done[list[i]] then return false end
            end
            return true
        end
        return true
    end

    return true
end

---@param mission table
---@param objId string
---@return boolean marked
function Mission.markDone(mission, objId)
    if not Mission.canComplete(mission, objId) then return false end

    local taskType = Mission.currentTask(mission)
    if not taskType then return false end

    mission.done[objId] = true
    mission.unitDone[taskType] = mission.unitDone[taskType] + 1

    if mission.valveDeps[objId] then
        mission.valveState[objId] = 'open'
    end

    return true
end

---@param mission table
---@param objId string
---@param state string
---@return boolean applied
function Mission.setValveState(mission, objId, state)
    if not mission.valveDeps[objId] then return false end
    if mission.done[objId] then return false end
    if not isCurrentUnit(mission, objId) then return false end

    if state ~= mission.valveExpectedState[objId] then return false end

    if state == 'placed' then
        local deps = mission.valveDeps[objId]
        for i = 1, #deps do
            if not mission.done[deps[i]] then return false end
        end
    end

    mission.valveState[objId] = state
    return true
end

---@param mission table
---@param objId string
---@return boolean applied
function Mission.setPipeRemoved(mission, objId)
    if mission.done[objId] then return false end
    if mission.pipeRemoved[objId] then return false end
    if mission.pipeGate[objId] ~= 'closed' then return false end
    if not isCurrentUnit(mission, objId) then return false end

    local valveId = mission.pipeValve[objId]
    if mission.valveState[valveId] ~= 'closed' then return false end

    mission.pipeRemoved[objId] = true
    return true
end

---@param mission table
---@param objId string
---@param playerSrc number
---@return boolean granted
function Mission.acquireProcessing(mission, objId, playerSrc)
    if mission.processing[objId] then return false end
    mission.processing[objId] = playerSrc
    return true
end

---@param mission table
---@param objId string
---@param playerSrc number
---@return boolean released
function Mission.releaseProcessing(mission, objId, playerSrc)
    if mission.processing[objId] ~= playerSrc then return false end
    mission.processing[objId] = nil
    return true
end

---@param mission table
---@param playerSrc number
---@return string[] released
function Mission.releaseAllForPlayer(mission, playerSrc)
    local released = {}
    for objId, src in pairs(mission.processing) do
        if src == playerSrc then
            mission.processing[objId] = nil
            released[#released + 1] = objId
        end
    end
    return released
end

---@param mission table
---@return boolean
function Mission.isCurrentTaskComplete(mission)
    local taskType = Mission.currentTask(mission)
    if not taskType then return true end
    return mission.unitDone[taskType] >= #mission.units[taskType]
end

---@param mission table
---@return string[] completed
function Mission.forceCompletePipes(mission)
    local taskType = Mission.currentTask(mission)
    if not taskType then return {} end
    if taskType ~= 'insertpipe' and taskType ~= 'repairpipe' then return {} end

    local completed = {}
    local units = mission.units[taskType]
    for i = 1, #units do
        local objId = units[i]
        if mission.pipeValve[objId] and not mission.done[objId] then
            if mission.pipeGate[objId] == 'closed' then
                mission.pipeRemoved[objId] = true
            end
            mission.done[objId] = true
            mission.unitDone[taskType] = (mission.unitDone[taskType] or 0) + 1
            completed[#completed + 1] = objId
        end
    end
    return completed
end

---@param mission table
---@return boolean advanced
---@return boolean finished
function Mission.advance(mission)
    if mission.currentTaskIndex >= #mission.taskOrder then
        return false, true
    end
    mission.currentTaskIndex = mission.currentTaskIndex + 1
    return true, false
end

---@param mission table
---@return { id: string, name: string, description: string, tasksType: string, target: number }[]
function Mission.groupTasks(mission)
    local tasks = {}
    for i = 1, #mission.taskOrder do
        local taskType = mission.taskOrder[i]
        local meta = TASK_META[taskType]
        tasks[#tasks + 1] = {
            id = taskType,
            name = meta.name,
            description = meta.description,
            tasksType = 'count',
            target = #mission.units[taskType],
        }
    end
    return tasks
end

---@param mission table
---@param taskType string
---@return number
function Mission.taskValue(mission, taskType)
    return mission.unitDone[taskType] or 0
end

return Mission

local QBCore = exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject()

local serverConfig = require 'pelumber.config.server'

local Rewards = {}
local rewardCfg = serverConfig.reward

local function giveMoney(source)
    local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(source)
    if not player then return end
    player.Functions.AddMoney(rewardCfg.moneyType, rewardCfg.moneyPerMember, 'pelumber-reward')
end

local function giveItem(source, item, count)
    local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(source)
    if not player then return end
    player.Functions.AddItem(item, count)
end

---@param source number
local function giveWeightedPool(source)
    local pool = rewardCfg.items.pool
    for i = 1, #pool do
        local entry = pool[i]
        if math.random(100) <= entry.chance then
            giveItem(source, entry.item, entry.count)
            return
        end
    end
end

---@param source number
local function givePerItem(source)
    local pool = rewardCfg.items.pool
    for i = 1, #pool do
        local entry = pool[i]
        if math.random(100) <= entry.chance then
            giveItem(source, entry.item, entry.count)
        end
    end
end

---@param source number
function Rewards.give(source)
    giveMoney(source)

    if rewardCfg.items and rewardCfg.items.enabled then
        if rewardCfg.items.mode == 'perItem' then
            givePerItem(source)
        else
            giveWeightedPool(source)
        end
    end
end

return Rewards

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_racingtablet\client\classes.lua
local GetVehicleHandlingFloat = GetVehicleHandlingFloat
local GetVehicleAcceleration = GetVehicleAcceleration
local GetVehicleEstimatedMaxSpeed = GetVehicleEstimatedMaxSpeed
local GetVehicleMaxBraking = GetVehicleMaxBraking
local mexp = math.exp
local mfloor = math.floor

local pi = Config.PerformanceIndex
local accelMagic = pi.accelerationMagic
local mods = pi.mods
local balance = pi.balance

local sortedClasses = {}
for class, startsAt in pairs(pi.classes) do
    sortedClasses[#sortedClasses + 1] = { class = class, startsAt = startsAt }
end
table.sort(sortedClasses, function(a, b) return a.startsAt < b.startsAt end)
local sortedCount = #sortedClasses

---@param vehicle number
---@param field string
---@return number
local function handlingField(vehicle, field)
    return GetVehicleHandlingFloat(vehicle, 'CHandlingData', field)
end

---@param acceleration number
---@return number
local function normalizeAcceleration(acceleration)
    local adjusted = (acceleration - accelMagic.adjust) / accelMagic.divide
    return 1 / (1 + mexp(accelMagic.negMulti * (adjusted - accelMagic.adjustTwo))) * 9 + 1
end

---@param score number
---@return string
local function classFromScore(score)
    local result = pi.lowestClass
    for i = 1, sortedCount do
        local entry = sortedClasses[i]
        if entry.startsAt > score then return result end
        result = entry.class
    end
    return result
end

---@param vehicle number
---@return number
local function getPerformanceScore(vehicle)
    local driveBiasFront = handlingField(vehicle, 'fDriveBiasFront')
    local awdMod = (driveBiasFront ~= 0.0 and driveBiasFront ~= 1.0) and mods.awdDrivetrain or 0.0

    local lowSpeedTraction = 1.0
    if mods.lowSpeedTractionLoss then
        local lowSpeedMult = handlingField(vehicle, 'fLowSpeedTractionLossMult')
        lowSpeedTraction = lowSpeedTraction + (lowSpeedMult - lowSpeedTraction) * 0.15
    end

    local normalizedAccel = normalizeAcceleration(GetVehicleAcceleration(vehicle))
    local accelScore = normalizedAccel + awdMod * normalizedAccel + handlingField(vehicle, 'fClutchChangeRateScaleUpShift') * mods.gearUpMultiplier
    local speedScore = GetVehicleEstimatedMaxSpeed(vehicle) / (handlingField(vehicle, 'fInitialDragCoeff') + 2.0)
    local brakingScore = GetVehicleMaxBraking(vehicle) * 10.0
    local suspension = (handlingField(vehicle, 'fSuspensionForce') + handlingField(vehicle, 'fSuspensionReboundDamp') + handlingField(vehicle, 'fSuspensionCompDamp') + handlingField(vehicle, 'fAntiRollBarForce')) / 4
    local handlingScore = (handlingField(vehicle, 'fTractionCurveMax') + suspension) * (handlingField(vehicle, 'fTractionCurveMin') / lowSpeedTraction) + awdMod

    return mfloor(((accelScore ^ balance.acceleration) + (speedScore ^ balance.speed) + (handlingScore ^ balance.handling) + (brakingScore ^ balance.braking)) * balance.ratingMultiplier)
end

---@param vehicle number
---@return string
function getVehicleClass(vehicle)
    if Config.UseCustomClassSystem then
        return 'No Class'
    end
    return classFromScore(getPerformanceScore(vehicle))
end

---@return table<string, number>
function getVehicleClasses()
    if Config.UseCustomClassSystem then
        return { ['No Class'] = 100 }
    end
    return pi.classes
end


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_racingtablet\client\drift.lua
if not ConfigDrift or not ConfigDrift.useDrift then DebugLog('Drift is disabled') return end
DebugLog('^2Drift is enabled^0')

local DriftLocal = {
    countdownActive = {},
    localFinished = false,
    lastSentDrift = 0
}

local Wait = Wait
local GetGameTimer = GetGameTimer
local PlayerPedId = PlayerPedId
local GetVehiclePedIsIn = GetVehiclePedIsIn
local GetPedInVehicleSeat = GetPedInVehicleSeat
local GetEntitySpeed = GetEntitySpeed
local GetEntityVelocity = GetEntityVelocity
local GetEntityForwardVector = GetEntityForwardVector
local msqrt = math.sqrt
local macos = math.acos
local mdeg = math.deg
local mfloor = math.floor
local mmin = math.min
local mmax = math.max

local scoring = ConfigDrift.scoring
local HOLD_CURRENT_UNTIL_RESET = scoring.holdCurrentUntilReset ~= false
local MULTIPLIER_MAX = scoring.multiplierMax
local MULTIPLIER_TIMER = scoring.multiplierTimer
local DRIFT_THRESHOLD = scoring.driftThreshold
local MIN_DRIFT_SPEED = scoring.minDriftSpeed
local MULTIPLIER_INCREMENT_TIME = scoring.multiplierIncrementTime
local SCORE_INCREMENT = scoring.scoreIncrement
local TICK_INTERVAL = scoring.tickInterval

local systemActive = false
local threadRunning = false
local scoringPaused = false
local totalScore = 0
local latestScore = 0
local multiplier = 1
local drifting = false
local lastAngle = 0
local lastDriftTime = 0
local lastMultiplierIncrement = 0
local multiplierPercent = 0

local uiInfo = {}
local uiDirty = true

---@param vehicle number
---@return number
local function getDriftAngle(vehicle)
    local velocity = GetEntityVelocity(vehicle)
    local vx, vy = velocity.x, velocity.y
    local speed = msqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy)
    if speed < 5.0 then return 0 end

    local forward = GetEntityForwardVector(vehicle)
    local dot = mmax(-1.0, mmin(1.0, (forward.x * vx + forward.y * vy) / speed))
    local degrees = mdeg(macos(dot))
    if degrees > 120 then return 0 end
    return mfloor(degrees)
end

local function bankLatestScore()
    if HOLD_CURRENT_UNTIL_RESET then
        totalScore = totalScore + latestScore * multiplier
    end
    latestScore = 0
    multiplier = 1
    multiplierPercent = 0
end

---@param ped number
---@param vehicle number
---@param now number
local function processDriftTick(ped, vehicle, now)
    if scoringPaused then return end

    if vehicle == 0 or GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, -1) ~= ped then
        drifting = false
        return
    end

    if GetEntitySpeed(vehicle) * 2.237 <= MIN_DRIFT_SPEED then
        bankLatestScore()
        drifting = false
        return
    end

    local angle = getDriftAngle(vehicle)
    lastAngle = angle

    if angle >= DRIFT_THRESHOLD then
        if not drifting then
            drifting = true
            lastMultiplierIncrement = now
        end

        local scoreToAdd = mfloor(SCORE_INCREMENT * (angle / 90) * (HOLD_CURRENT_UNTIL_RESET and 1 or multiplier))
        if not HOLD_CURRENT_UNTIL_RESET then
            totalScore = totalScore + scoreToAdd
        end
        latestScore = latestScore + scoreToAdd
        lastDriftTime = now

        local sinceIncrement = now - lastMultiplierIncrement
        multiplierPercent = mmin(100, sinceIncrement / MULTIPLIER_INCREMENT_TIME * 100)
        if sinceIncrement >= MULTIPLIER_INCREMENT_TIME and multiplier < MULTIPLIER_MAX then
            multiplier = multiplier + 1
            lastMultiplierIncrement = now
        end
    else
        drifting = false
        multiplierPercent = 0
    end

    if now - lastDriftTime >= MULTIPLIER_TIMER then
        bankLatestScore()
    end
end

local function pushDriftUi()
    if not systemActive then return end
    if not uiDirty
        and uiInfo.score == totalScore
        and uiInfo.multiplier == multiplier
        and uiInfo.latestDriftScore == latestScore
        and uiInfo.isDrifting == drifting
        and uiInfo.driftAngle == lastAngle
        and uiInfo.scoringIsPaused == scoringPaused
        and uiInfo.multiplierPercent == multiplierPercent then
        return
    end
    uiDirty = false
    uiInfo.score = totalScore
    uiInfo.multiplier = multiplier
    uiInfo.latestDriftScore = latestScore
    uiInfo.isDrifting = drifting
    uiInfo.driftAngle = lastAngle
    uiInfo.scoringIsPaused = scoringPaused
    uiInfo.multiplierPercent = multiplierPercent
    UpdateDriftUi(uiInfo)
end

local function startDriftThread()
    if threadRunning then return end
    threadRunning = true
    CreateThread(function()
        while systemActive do
            Wait(TICK_INTERVAL)
            local ped = PlayerPedId()
            processDriftTick(ped, GetVehiclePedIsIn(ped, false), GetGameTimer())
            pushDriftUi()
        end
        threadRunning = false
    end)
end

local function resetDriftSystem()
    totalScore = 0
    latestScore = 0
    multiplier = 1
    multiplierPercent = 0
    drifting = false
    lastDriftTime = 0
    scoringPaused = false
    uiDirty = true
    pushDriftUi()
end

---@param enable boolean
---@return boolean
local function setDriftSystem(enable)
    systemActive = enable
    if enable then
        resetDriftSystem()
        startDriftThread()
    else
        drifting = false
        multiplier = 1
    end
    return systemActive
end

function ForceDriftScore()
    if HOLD_CURRENT_UNTIL_RESET then
        totalScore = totalScore + latestScore * multiplier
    end
end

---@return number
function GetCurrentDriftScore()
    return totalScore
end

---@return boolean
function StartDriftSystem()
    ToggleDriftHud(true)
    return setDriftSystem(true)
end

---@return boolean
function StopDriftSystem()
    ToggleDriftHud(false)
    return setDriftSystem(false)
end

function PauseDriftScoring()
    scoringPaused = true
end

---@return boolean
function DriftIsActive()
    return systemActive
end

---@param score number?
local function setTotalDriftScore(score)
    totalScore = tonumber(score) or 0
    uiDirty = true
end

local function finalizeDriftRace(raceId)
        if not DriftLocal.localFinished and CurrentRaceData and CurrentRaceData.RaceId == raceId then
            DriftLocal.localFinished = true
        end
    end
RegisterNetEvent('sm_racingtablet:client:driftFinishCountdown', function(raceId, countdown)
    if not raceId then return end
    if DriftLocal.countdownActive[raceId] then return end
    DriftLocal.countdownActive[raceId] = true
    DriftLocal.localFinished = DriftLocal.localFinished or false

    if not countdown then 
        finalizeDriftRace(raceId)
        return
    end


    showDriftCountdown(raceId, countdown)

    CreateThread(function()
        local t = countdown
        while t > 0 do
            Wait(1000)
            t = t - 1
            showDriftCountdown(raceId, t)
        end

        finalizeDriftRace(raceId)
        
        DriftLocal.countdownActive[raceId] = nil
        showDriftCountdown(raceId, -1)
    end)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_racingtablet:client:driftRaceFinished', function(raceId, results)
    if CurrentRaceData and CurrentRaceData.RaceId == raceId then
        local top = results and results[1] and results[1].RacerName or "?"
        SendNUIMessage({
            action = "update",
            type = "drift_results",
            data = { raceId = raceId, results = results },
            active = true
        })
    end
    DriftLocal.localFinished = false
    DriftLocal.countdownActive[raceId] = nil
end)
