########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\interface\pauseblip\modules\mapdata.lua
---@class MapLocation
---@field index integer
---@field label string
---@field icon string?
---@field color string
---@field count integer
---@field value integer
---@field pending boolean
---@field truncated boolean?
---@field labels table<integer, string>?

---@alias MapProgressFn fun(list: MapLocation[])
---@alias MapCancelledFn fun(): boolean

local OP_DUMP = -0x52480001
local OP_PICK = -0x52480002
local OP_HIGHLIGHT = -0x52480003
local OP_CLEAR = -0x52480004
local OP_REVISION = -0x52480005
local OP_PROBE = -0x52480006
local OP_BUDGET = -0x52480007
local OP_DIGEST = -0x52480008
local OP_LABEL = -0x52480009

local COLUMN = 0
local BATCH = 8
local REPLY_TIMEOUT_MS = 150
local PM_READY = 15

---@param opcode integer
---@param a integer?
---@param b integer?
---@return boolean
local function sendOpcode(opcode, a, b)
    if not BeginScaleformMovieMethodOnFrontend('SET_DATA_SLOT') then
        return false
    end
    ScaleformMovieMethodAddParamInt(COLUMN)
    ScaleformMovieMethodAddParamInt(opcode)
    ScaleformMovieMethodAddParamInt(a or 0)
    ScaleformMovieMethodAddParamInt(b or 0)
    EndScaleformMovieMethod()
    return true
end

---@return string?
local function readSelection()
    if not BeginScaleformMovieMethodOnFrontend('GET_COLUMN_SELECTION') then
        return nil
    end
    ScaleformMovieMethodAddParamInt(COLUMN)

    local handle = EndScaleformMovieMethodReturnValue()
    local deadline = GetGameTimer() + REPLY_TIMEOUT_MS

    while not IsScaleformMovieMethodReturnValueReady(handle) do
        if GetGameTimer() > deadline or GetPauseMenuState() ~= PM_READY then return nil end
        Wait(0)
    end

    return GetScaleformMovieMethodReturnValueString(handle)
end

---@param opcode integer
---@param a integer?
---@return integer?
local function queueSelection(opcode, a)
    if not sendOpcode(opcode, a) then return nil end
    if not BeginScaleformMovieMethodOnFrontend('GET_COLUMN_SELECTION') then return nil end
    ScaleformMovieMethodAddParamInt(COLUMN)

    local handle = EndScaleformMovieMethodReturnValue()
    if not handle or handle == 0 then return nil end

    return handle
end

---@param handles integer[]
---@return string[]?
local function awaitSelections(handles)
    local deadline = GetGameTimer() + REPLY_TIMEOUT_MS
    local results = {}

    for i = 1, #handles do
        while not IsScaleformMovieMethodReturnValueReady(handles[i]) do
            if GetGameTimer() > deadline or GetPauseMenuState() ~= PM_READY then return nil end
            Wait(0)
        end
        results[i] = GetScaleformMovieMethodReturnValueString(handles[i])
    end

    return results
end

---@param opcode integer
---@param a integer?
---@param b integer?
---@param validate fun(packed: string): boolean
---@return string?
local function readTagged(opcode, a, b, validate)
    for _ = 1, 3 do
        if not sendOpcode(opcode, a, b) then return nil end

        local packed = readSelection()
        if not packed then return nil end

        if validate(packed) then
            return packed
        end
    end

    return nil
end

---@param entry string
---@return MapLocation?
local function parseEntry(entry)
    local index, label, icon, colour, flags, count, value =
        entry:match('^(%d+)~(.-)~(.-)~(%x%x%x%x%x%x)([pm]*)~(%d+)~(%d+)$')

    index = tonumber(index)
    if not index then return nil end

    return {
        index = index,
        label = label,
        icon = icon ~= '' and ('radar_' .. icon) or nil,
        color = '#' .. colour,
        count = tonumber(count) or 1,
        value = tonumber(value) or 0,
        pending = flags:find('p', 1, true) ~= nil,
        truncated = flags:find('m', 1, true) ~= nil or nil,
    }
end

---@param item MapLocation
---@return MapLocation
local function completeLabel(item)
    if not item.truncated then return item end

    for _ = 1, 40 do
        local offset = #item.label
        local packed = readTagged(OP_LABEL, item.index, offset, function(s)
            local index, at = s:match('^L~(%d+)~(%d+)~%d+~')
            return tonumber(index) == item.index and tonumber(at) == offset
        end)

        if not packed then break end

        local total, chunk = packed:match('^L~%d+~%d+~(%d+)~(.*)$')
        if chunk == '' then break end

        item.label = item.label .. chunk
        if #item.label >= tonumber(total) then break end
    end

    item.truncated = nil

    return item
end

---@param onProgress MapProgressFn?
---@param cancelled MapCancelledFn?
---@return MapLocation[]
---@return boolean complete
local function fetchSequential(onProgress, cancelled)
    local list = {}
    local cursor = 0
    local complete = false

    for _ = 1, 300 do
        if cancelled and cancelled() then break end
        if not sendOpcode(OP_DUMP, cursor) then break end

        local packed = readSelection()
        if not packed then break end

        if packed == '' then
            complete = true
            break
        end

        local advanced = false

        for entry in packed:gmatch('[^|]+') do
            local item = parseEntry(entry)

            if item and item.index >= cursor then
                list[#list + 1] = completeLabel(item)
                cursor = item.index + 1
                advanced = true
            end
        end

        if not advanced then break end
        if onProgress then onProgress(list) end
    end

    sendOpcode(OP_CLEAR)

    return list, complete
end

---@return integer?
local function readCount()
    if not sendOpcode(OP_REVISION) then return nil end

    local packed = readSelection()
    if not packed then return nil end

    return tonumber(packed:match('^R~%d+~(%d+)$'))
end

---@param onProgress MapProgressFn?
---@param cancelled MapCancelledFn?
---@return MapLocation[]
---@return boolean complete
local function fetchLocations(onProgress, cancelled)
    local total = readCount()
    if not total then return fetchSequential(onProgress, cancelled) end

    local list = {}
    local cursor = 0
    local complete = total == 0
    local retries = 0

    while cursor < total do
        if cancelled and cancelled() then break end

        local handles, indices = {}, {}
        local last = math.min(cursor + BATCH - 1, total - 1)

        for i = cursor, last do
            local handle = queueSelection(OP_DUMP, i)
            if not handle then break end
            handles[#handles + 1] = handle
            indices[#indices + 1] = i
        end

        if #handles == 0 then
            sendOpcode(OP_CLEAR)
            local rest, restComplete = fetchSequential(onProgress, cancelled)
            for i = 1, #rest do
                if rest[i].index >= cursor then list[#list + 1] = rest[i] end
            end
            return list, restComplete
        end

        local results = awaitSelections(handles)
        local batch = {}

        if results then
            for k = 1, #results do
                local first = results[k] and results[k]:match('^[^|]+')
                local item = first and parseEntry(first)
                if not item or item.index ~= indices[k] then
                    batch = nil
                    break
                end
                batch[k] = item
            end
        else
            batch = nil
        end

        if batch then
            for k = 1, #batch do list[#list + 1] = completeLabel(batch[k]) end
            cursor = indices[#indices] + 1
            retries = 0
            if onProgress then onProgress(list) end
        else
            retries = retries + 1
            if retries > 3 then break end
            Wait(0)
        end
    end

    if cursor >= total then complete = true end

    sendOpcode(OP_CLEAR)

    return list, complete
end

---@return integer? index
---@return integer? value
local function fetchHighlight()
    if not sendOpcode(OP_HIGHLIGHT) then return nil end

    local packed = readSelection()
    sendOpcode(OP_CLEAR)

    if not packed then return nil end

    local index, value = packed:match('^H~(%-?%d+)~(%d+)$')
    if not index then return nil end

    return tonumber(index), tonumber(value)
end

---@class MapData
MapData = {}

---@type fun(onProgress: MapProgressFn?, cancelled: MapCancelledFn?): MapLocation[], boolean
MapData.fetch = fetchLocations

---@type fun(): integer?, integer?
MapData.highlight = fetchHighlight

---@param index integer
---@return MapLocation?
MapData.fetchOne = function(index)
    local packed = readTagged(OP_DUMP, index, 0, function(s)
        local first = s:match('^[^|]+')
        local item = first and parseEntry(first)
        return item ~= nil and item.index == index
    end)

    local item = packed and parseEntry(packed:match('^[^|]+'))
    if item then completeLabel(item) end

    sendOpcode(OP_CLEAR)

    return item
end

---@return integer? revision
---@return integer? count
MapData.revision = function()
    if not sendOpcode(OP_REVISION) then return nil end

    local packed = readSelection()
    sendOpcode(OP_CLEAR)

    if not packed then return nil end

    local revision, count = packed:match('^R~(%d+)~(%d+)$')
    if not revision then return nil end

    return tonumber(revision), tonumber(count)
end

---@param index integer
---@param valueIndex integer? Indeks blip, atau -1 (maju) / -2 (mundur).
---@return boolean
MapData.pick = function(index, valueIndex)
    return sendOpcode(OP_PICK, index, valueIndex or 0)
end

---@param chars integer
---@return boolean
MapData.setBudget = function(chars)
    return sendOpcode(OP_BUDGET, chars)
end

---@return string?
MapData.digest = function()
    for _ = 1, 3 do
        local out, cursor, total = {}, 0, 0
        local ok = true

        for _ = 1, 20 do
            local packed = readTagged(OP_DIGEST, cursor, 0, function(s)
                local n, start = s:match('^(%d+)~(%d+)~')
                return n ~= nil and tonumber(start) == cursor
            end)

            if not packed then
                ok = false
                break
            end

            local n, _, chunk = packed:match('^(%d+)~(%d+)~(.*)$')
            total = tonumber(n) --[[@as integer]]

            if chunk == '' then break end

            out[#out + 1] = chunk
            cursor = cursor + #chunk

            if cursor >= total then break end
        end

        sendOpcode(OP_CLEAR)

        local joined = table.concat(out)
        if ok and #joined == total then return joined end
    end

    return nil
end

---@param n integer
---@return integer?
MapData.probe = function(n)
    if not sendOpcode(OP_PROBE, n) then return nil end

    local packed = readSelection()
    sendOpcode(OP_CLEAR)

    return packed and #packed or 0
end

return MapData

local elevatorId
local floorsTextInfo = false

local config = localmodule 'config.client'

if not interface.init(false) then
    return lib.print.error('Failed to initialize interface')
end

local frameToken = 0

local function openFrame()
    frameToken += 1
    interface.show()
end

local function closeFrame()
    frameToken += 1
    local token = frameToken

    SetTimeout(400, function()
        if token == frameToken then
            interface.hide()
        end
    end)
end

---@param groups string|string[]|table<string, number>
---@return boolean
local function filterGroups(groups)
    local playerJob = QBPlayerData.job

    if not groups then
        return true
    end

    local _lt = type(groups)
    local jobname, jobtype = playerJob.name, playerJob.type

    if _lt == "string" then
        return (jobname == groups) or (jobtype == groups)
    elseif _lt == "table" then
        if lib.array.isArray(groups) then
            return lib.table.contains(groups, jobname)
        else
            local gradeLevel = groups[jobname] or groups[jobtype]
            return gradeLevel and playerJob.grade.level >= gradeLevel
        end
    end

    return false
end

---@param eid string
local function prepareElevator(eid)
    local myCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local floorsConfig = config[eid]

    local floors = {}
    for i=1, #floorsConfig do
        local floor = floorsConfig[i]
        local currentFloor = false
        local isAuthorize = filterGroups(floor.groups)

        local distance = #(myCoords - floor.coords.xyz)

        if distance < 2.5 then
            currentFloor = true
        end

        local disable = currentFloor or floor.groups and not isAuthorize

        floors[#floors+1] = {
            floorId = i,
            label = floor.label,
            disable = disable
        }
    end

    openFrame()
    interface.send({
        action = 'openElevator',
        data = {
            floors = floors
        }
    })
    interface.focus(true, true)
end

---@param floorId number
local function executeElevator(eId, floorId)
    if not eId then
        return
    end

    local floor = config[eId]

    if not floor then
        return
    end

    if not floor[floorId] then
        return
    end

    local destination = floor[floorId]
    local isInVehicle = destination.allowVehicle and cache.vehicle

    local liftReady = lib.progressBar({
        label = 'Waiting elevator...',
        duration = 5000,
        useWhileDead = false,
        canCancel = true,
        disable = {
            combat = true,
            move = true,
            car = true
        },
        anim = not isInVehicle and {
            dict = 'anim@apt_trans@elevator',
            clip = 'elev_1'
        } or nil
    })

    if not liftReady then
        return
    end

    if not isInVehicle then
        StopAnimTask(cache.ped, "anim@apt_trans@elevator", "elev_1", 1.0)
    end
    DoScreenFadeOut(500)
    Wait(1000)
    if isInVehicle then
        SetPedCoordsKeepVehicle(cache.ped, destination.coords.x, destination.coords.y, destination.coords.z)
        SetVehicleOnGroundProperly(cache.vehicle)
        SetEntityHeading(cache.vehicle, destination.coords.w)
    else
        SetEntityCoords(cache.ped, destination.coords.x, destination.coords.y, destination.coords.z, false, false, false, false)
        SetEntityHeading(cache.ped, destination.coords.w)
    end
    Wait(1000)
    DoScreenFadeIn(600)
end

    cb('ok')
    interface.focus(false, false)

end)

local function setUpPoints(coords, eId)
    local points = lib.points.new(coords.xyz, 1.5)
    
    function points:onExit()
        if floorsTextInfo then
            infoUI.remove('elevator_information')
            floorsTextInfo = false
        end
    end

    function points:nearby()
        if self.currentDistance < 1.5 then
            if not floorsTextInfo then
                local description = [[
                [kbd]E[/kbd] untuk menggunakan elevator
                ]]
                infoUI.show({
                    id = 'elevator_information',
                    title = 'Elevator',
                    icon = 'fa-solid fa-building',
                    description = description,
                })
                floorsTextInfo = true
            end

            if IsControlJustPressed(0, 51) then
                elevatorId = eId
                prepareElevator(eId)
            end
        end
    end
end

    for eId, floors in pairs(config) do
        lib.array.forEach(floors, function (floor)
            setUpPoints(floor.coords, eId)
        end)
    end
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\interface\rhd_giftbox\client.lua
local packObject
local packMode = false

localmodule 'modules.carry'
localmodule 'modules.objectManagement'

local config = localmodule 'config'

interface.init(false)

local frameToken = 0

local function openFrame()
    frameToken += 1
    interface.show()
end

local function closeFrame()
    frameToken += 1
    local token = frameToken

    SetTimeout(400, function()
        if token == frameToken then
            interface.hide()
        end
    end)
end

local function playAnim(anim)
    lib.requestAnimDict(anim.dict)
    TaskPlayAnim(cache.ped, anim.dict, anim.clip or anim.name, 2.0, 2.0, -1, anim.flag or 51, 0, false, false, false)
    RemoveAnimDict(anim.dict)
end

local function removePackObject()
    if packObject and DoesEntityExist(packObject) then
        DeleteEntity(packObject)
        packObject = nil
    end
end

local function setupPackObject()
    removePackObject()

    local model = joaat(config.PropsData.packing.props.model)
    lib.requestModel(model, 5000)

    local coords = config.PropsData.packing.props.coords
    local heading = config.PropsData.packing.props.heading

    packObject = CreateObject(model, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false)
    SetEntityHeading(packObject, heading)
    SetEntityCollision(packObject, false, false)
    FreezeEntityPosition(packObject, true)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
end

local function setGiftBoxFocus(state)
    interface.focus(state, state)
end

local function openGiftBox()
    local itemList = ox_inventory:GetPlayerItems()
    local itemFiltered = {}

    for _, item in pairs(itemList) do
        local itemData = ox_inventory.Items and ox_inventory:Items(item.name)
        local isDegradable = config.BlockDegradable and itemData and itemData.degrade
        local hasDurability = config.BlockWithDurability and item.metadata and (item.metadata.durability or item.metadata.degrade or item.metadata.createDate)

        if not config.ForbiddenPackItems[item.name] and item.name:sub(1, 7):lower() ~= 'weapon_' and not isDegradable and not hasDurability then
            itemFiltered[#itemFiltered + 1] = {
                name = item.name,
                label = item.label,
                count = item.count,
                metadata = item.metadata,
                slot = item.slot
            }
        end
    end

    packMode = true
    setupPackObject()

    openFrame()
    interface.send({
        action = 'openGiftBox',
        data = {
            boxLabel = 'Gift Box',
            maxSlots = config.MaxSlots,
            items = itemFiltered
        }
    })

    setGiftBoxFocus(true)
    playAnim({ dict = 'mini@repair', clip = 'fixing_a_ped', flag = 41 })
end

local function closeGiftBox(skipObject, skipAnim)
    interface.send({
        action = 'closeGiftBox',
        data = {}
    })

    if packMode then
        packMode = false

        if not skipObject then
            removePackObject()
        end

        if not skipAnim then
            ClearPedTasks(cache.ped)
        end
    end

    setGiftBoxFocus(false)
    closeFrame()
end

interface.callback('exit', function(_, cb)
    cb('ok')
    closeGiftBox()
end)

interface.callback('closeGiftBox', function(_, cb)
    cb('ok')
    closeGiftBox()
end)

interface.callback('packGiftBox', function(data, cb)
    if not packMode then
        cb({ success = false, message = 'Not in pack mode' })
        lib.notify({ type = 'error', description = 'You are not packing a gift box' })
        return
    end

    closeGiftBox(true, true)
    local success, response

    success = lib.progressBar({
        duration = config.PropsData.packing.progressBar.duration,
        label = config.PropsData.packing.progressBar.label,
        useWhileDead = config.PropsData.packing.progressBar.useWhileDead,
        canCancel = config.PropsData.packing.progressBar.canCancel,
        disable = {
            move = true,
            car = true,
            combat = true,
            mouse = false
        }
    })

    removePackObject()
    ClearPedTasks(cache.ped)

    if not success then
        cb({ success = false, message = 'Packing cancelled' })
        lib.notify({ type = 'error', description = 'Packing cancelled' })
        return
    end

    success, response = lib.callback.await('rhd_giftbox:server:packGiftBox', false, data)
    cb({ success = success, message = response })

    if success then return end
    lib.notify({ type = 'error', description = response or 'Failed to pack gift box' })
end)


RegisterNetEvent('rhd_giftbox:client:showNote', function(note)
    if source == '' then return end

    openFrame()
    interface.send({
        action = 'showGiftNote',
        data = {
            note = note or ''
        }
    })

    interface.focus(true, true)
end)


ox_target:addSphereZone({
    coords = config.PropsData.packing.target.coords.xyz,
    radius = config.PropsData.packing.target.zoneRadius,
    options = {
        {
            label = config.PropsData.packing.target.label,
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-box',
            groups = config.PropsData.packing.target.groups,
            distance = config.PropsData.packing.target.distance,
            onSelect = openGiftBox
        }
    }
})

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\interface\rhd_giftbox\modules\carry.lua
local carryObject
local carrying = false
local carryThread
local actionBusy = false

local config = localmodule 'config'

local function showInstruction()
    infoUI.show({
        id = 'giftbox_instruction',
        title = 'Gift Box',
        description = [[
        [kbd]ESC[/kbd] Put back gift box
        [kbd]E[/kbd] Drop gift box
        [kbd]G[/kbd] Give gift box to nearest player
        ]]
    })
end

local function removeInstruction()
    infoUI.remove('giftbox_instruction')
end

local function playCarryAnim()
    local anim = config.PropsData.carry.animation
    lib.requestAnimDict(anim.dict)
    TaskPlayAnim(cache.ped, anim.dict, anim.clip or anim.name, 2.0, 2.0, -1, anim.flag or 51, 0, false, false, false)
    RemoveAnimDict(anim.dict)
end

local function deleteCarryObject()
    if carryObject and DoesEntityExist(carryObject) then
        DeleteEntity(carryObject)
    end

    carryObject = nil
end

local function createCarryObject()
    deleteCarryObject()

    local prop = config.PropsData.carry.props
    local model = joaat(prop.model)
    local offset = prop.position[1]
    local rotation = prop.position[2]

    lib.requestModel(model, 5000)
    carryObject = CreateObject(model, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, true, true, false)
    AttachEntityToEntity(
        carryObject,
        cache.ped,
        GetPedBoneIndex(cache.ped, prop.bone),
        offset.x, offset.y, offset.z,
        rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z,
        true, true, false, true, 1, true
    )
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
end

local function getDropPosition()
    local ped = cache.ped
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local forward = GetEntityForwardVector(ped)
    local target = coords + (forward * config.Drop.placeDistance)
    local found, groundZ = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord(target.x, target.y, target.z + 1.0, false)

    return {
        x = target.x,
        y = target.y,
        z = found and groundZ or target.z - 0.9,
    }, GetEntityHeading(ped)
end

local function getNearestPlayer(maxDistance)
    local myPed = cache.ped
    local myCoords = GetEntityCoords(myPed)
    local closestPlayer
    local closestDistance = maxDistance or 2.5

    local players = GetActivePlayers()
    for i = 1, #players do
        local player = players[i]
        if player ~= PlayerId() then
            local ped = GetPlayerPed(player)
            local distance = #(myCoords - GetEntityCoords(ped))

            if distance < closestDistance then
                closestDistance = distance
                closestPlayer = GetPlayerServerId(player)
            end
        end
    end

    return closestPlayer
end

local function stopCarry()
    carrying = false
    actionBusy = false
    removeInstruction()
    deleteCarryObject()
    ClearPedTasks(cache.ped)
    StopAnimTask(cache.ped, config.PropsData.carry.animation.dict, config.PropsData.carry.animation.clip, 3)
end

local function putBack()
    if actionBusy then return end
    actionBusy = true

    local success, message = lib.callback.await('rhd_giftbox:server:putBackCarry', false)

    if not success and message then
        lib.notify({ type = 'error', description = message })
    end

    actionBusy = false
end

local function dropCarry()
    if actionBusy then return end
    actionBusy = true

    local coords, heading = getDropPosition()
    local success, message = lib.callback.await('rhd_giftbox:server:dropCarry', false, coords, heading)

    if not success and message then
        lib.notify({ type = 'error', description = message })
    end

    actionBusy = false
end

local function giveCarry()
    if actionBusy then return end
    actionBusy = true

    local target = getNearestPlayer(2.5)
    if not target then
        lib.notify({ type = 'error', description = 'No player nearby' })
        actionBusy = false
        return
    end

    local confirm = lib.alertDialog({
        header = 'Give Gift Box',
        content = 'Give this gift box to the nearest player?',
        centered = true,
        cancel = true
    })

    if confirm ~= 'confirm' then
        actionBusy = false
        return
    end

    local success, message = lib.callback.await('rhd_giftbox:server:requestGiveCarry', false, target)
    lib.notify({
        type = success and 'success' or 'error',
        description = message or (success and 'Offer sent' or 'Failed to send offer')
    })

    actionBusy = false
end

local function disableInstructionControls()
    DisableControlAction(0, config.CarryControls.putBack, true)
    DisableControlAction(0, config.CarryControls.drop, true)
    DisableControlAction(0, config.CarryControls.give, true)
    DisableControlAction(2, config.CarryControls.putBack, true)
    DisableControlAction(2, config.CarryControls.drop, true)
    DisableControlAction(2, config.CarryControls.give, true)
end

local function isInstructionControlReleased(control)
    return IsDisabledControlJustReleased(0, control) or IsDisabledControlJustReleased(2, control)
end

local function startControlThread()
    if carryThread then return end

    carryThread = CreateThread(function()
        while carrying do
            disableInstructionControls()
            DisableControlAction(0, 21, true)
            DisableControlAction(0, 22, true)
            DisableControlAction(0, 24, true)
            DisableControlAction(0, 25, true)

            if isInstructionControlReleased(config.CarryControls.putBack) then
                putBack()
            elseif isInstructionControlReleased(config.CarryControls.drop) then
                dropCarry()
            elseif isInstructionControlReleased(config.CarryControls.give) then
                giveCarry()
            end

            if not IsEntityPlayingAnim(cache.ped, config.PropsData.carry.animation.dict, config.PropsData.carry.animation.clip, 3) then
                playCarryAnim()
            end

            Wait(0)
        end

        stopCarry()
        carryThread = nil
    end)
end

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_giftbox:client:startCarry', function()
    if source == '' then return end

    carrying = true
    createCarryObject()
    playCarryAnim()
    showInstruction()
    startControlThread()
end)

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_giftbox:client:stopCarry', function()
    if source == '' then return end

    stopCarry()
end)

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_giftbox:client:confirmReceiveGift', function(token, giver, giverName)
    if source == '' then return end

    local result = lib.alertDialog({
        header = 'Receive Gift Box',
        content = ('%s wants to give you a gift box. Accept?'):format(giverName or ('Player %s'):format(giver)),
        centered = true,
        cancel = true
    })

    local success, message = lib.callback.await('rhd_giftbox:server:answerGiveCarry', false, token, result == 'confirm')
    if not success and message then
        lib.notify({ type = 'error', description = message })
    elseif result == 'confirm' then
        lib.notify({ type = 'success', description = 'You received a gift box.' })
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= GetCurrentResourceName() then return end
    stopCarry()
end)


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\interface\rhd_giftbox\modules\objectManagement.lua
local ObjectManagement = {}
local knownDrops = {}
local droppedObjects = {}

local config = localmodule 'config'

local function playAnim(anim)
    lib.requestAnimDict(anim.dict)
    TaskPlayAnim(cache.ped, anim.dict, anim.clip or anim.name, 2.0, 2.0, -1, anim.flag or 51, 0, false, false, false)
    RemoveAnimDict(anim.dict)
end

local function removeDropObject(id)
    local drop = droppedObjects[id]
    if not drop then return end

    if drop.entity and DoesEntityExist(drop.entity) then
        for i = 1, #drop.names do
            ox_target:removeLocalEntity(drop.entity, drop.names[i])
        end

        DeleteEntity(drop.entity)
    end

    droppedObjects[id] = nil
end

local function removeDrop(id)
    knownDrops[id] = nil
    removeDropObject(id)
end

local function shouldSpawnDrop(drop)
    local coords = drop and drop.coords
    if type(coords) ~= 'table' or not coords.x or not coords.y or not coords.z then return false end

    local dropCoords = vector3(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)
    return #(GetEntityCoords(cache.ped) - dropCoords) <= (config.Drop.streamDistance or 80.0)
end

local function openDroppedGiftBox(id)
    playAnim(config.PropsData.opening.anim)

    local opened = lib.progressBar({
        duration = config.PropsData.opening.progressBar.duration,
        label = config.PropsData.opening.progressBar.label,
        useWhileDead = config.PropsData.opening.progressBar.useWhileDead,
        canCancel = config.PropsData.opening.progressBar.canCancel,
        disable = {
            move = true,
            car = true,
            combat = true,
            mouse = false
        }
    })

    ClearPedTasks(cache.ped)

    if not opened then
        lib.notify({
            type = 'error',
            description = 'Opening cancelled'
        })
        return
    end

    local success, message = lib.callback.await('rhd_giftbox:server:openDroppedGiftBox', false, id)
    if success then
        removeDrop(id)
    end

    lib.notify({
        type = success and 'success' or 'error',
        description = message or (success and 'Gift box opened' or 'Failed to open gift box')
    })
end

print('loaded object management')

local function takeDroppedGiftBox(id)
    local success, message = lib.callback.await('rhd_giftbox:server:takeDroppedGiftBox', false, id)
    if success then
        removeDrop(id)
    end

    lib.notify({
        type = success and 'success' or 'error',
        description = message or (success and 'Gift box picked up' or 'Failed to pick up gift box')
    })
end

local function createDropObject(drop)
    local id = tonumber(drop and drop.id)
    local coords = drop and drop.coords
    if not id or type(coords) ~= 'table' or not coords.x or not coords.y or not coords.z then return end
    if droppedObjects[id] or not shouldSpawnDrop(drop) then return end

    droppedObjects[id] = {
        loading = true,
        names = {}
    }

    local model = joaat(drop.model or config.PropsData.carry.props.model)
    lib.requestModel(model, 5000)

    if not knownDrops[id] or not droppedObjects[id] then
        SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
        return
    end

    local entity = CreateObject(model, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false)
    SetEntityHeading(entity, drop.heading or 0.0)
    SetEntityCollision(entity, true, true)
    FreezeEntityPosition(entity, true)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)

    local name = ('rhd_giftbox_drop_%s'):format(id)
    local takeName = ('%s_take'):format(name)
    droppedObjects[id] = {
        entity = entity,
        names = { name, takeName }
    }

    ox_target:addLocalEntity(entity, {
        {
            name = name,
            label = 'Open Gift Box',
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-gift',
            distance = config.Drop.interactDistance,
            onSelect = function()
                openDroppedGiftBox(id)
            end
        },
        {
            name = takeName,
            label = 'Take Gift Box',
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-hand',
            distance = config.Drop.interactDistance,
            onSelect = function()
                takeDroppedGiftBox(id)
            end
        }
    })
end

local function refreshDropObject(id)
    local drop = knownDrops[id]
    if not drop then
        removeDropObject(id)
        return
    end

    if shouldSpawnDrop(drop) then
        createDropObject(drop)
    else
        removeDropObject(id)
    end
end

function ObjectManagement.syncDrops(drops)
    if type(drops) ~= 'table' then return end

    local synced = {}
    for i = 1, #drops do
        local drop = drops[i]
        local id = tonumber(drop and drop.id)
        if id then
            synced[id] = true
            knownDrops[id] = drop
            refreshDropObject(id)
        end
    end

    for id in pairs(knownDrops) do
        if not synced[id] then
            removeDrop(id)
        end
    end
end

function ObjectManagement.addDrop(drop)
    local id = tonumber(drop and drop.id)
    if not id then return end

    knownDrops[id] = drop
    refreshDropObject(id)
end

function ObjectManagement.removeDrop(id)
    removeDrop(tonumber(id))
end

function ObjectManagement.cleanup()
    for id in pairs(droppedObjects) do
        removeDropObject(id)
    end
end

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_giftbox:client:syncDrops', function(drops)
    if source == '' then return end

    ObjectManagement.syncDrops(drops)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_giftbox:client:addDrop', function(drop)
    if source == '' then return end

    ObjectManagement.addDrop(drop)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_giftbox:client:removeDrop', function(id)
    if source == '' then return end

    ObjectManagement.removeDrop(id)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_giftbox:client:removeDropTarget', function(id)
    if source == '' then return end

    ObjectManagement.removeDrop(id)
end)

CreateThread(function()
    Wait(1500)

    local drops = lib.callback.await('rhd_giftbox:server:getDrops', 1500)
    ObjectManagement.syncDrops(drops or {})
end)

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(2500)

        for id in pairs(knownDrops) do
            refreshDropObject(id)
        end
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= GetCurrentResourceName() then return end

    ObjectManagement.cleanup()
end)

return ObjectManagement


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\interface\rhd_giftbox\modules\storage.lua
local Storage = {}

local config = localmodule 'config'
local tableName = config.Drop.tableName

local function safeCall(fn)
    local ok, result = pcall(fn)
    if not ok then
        print(('[rhd_giftbox] oxmysql error: %s'):format(result))
        return nil
    end

    return result
end

function Storage.init()
    if not config.PrepareDB then return end
    return safeCall(function()
        return db:query_async(([[
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `%s` (
                `id` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
                `item_name` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
                `metadata` LONGTEXT NOT NULL,
                `coords` LONGTEXT NOT NULL,
                `heading` FLOAT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                `created_at` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
            ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
        ]]):format(tableName), {})
    end)
end

function Storage.getAllDrops()
    return safeCall(function()
        return db:query_async(('SELECT id, item_name, metadata, coords, heading FROM `%s`'):format(tableName), {})
    end) or {}
end

function Storage.createDrop(itemName, metadata, coords, heading)
    return safeCall(function()
        return db:insert_async(
            ('INSERT INTO `%s` (item_name, metadata, coords, heading) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)'):format(tableName),
            { itemName, json.encode(metadata or {}), json.encode(coords), heading or 0.0 }
        )
    end)
end

function Storage.deleteDrop(id)
    return safeCall(function()
        return db:update_async(('DELETE FROM `%s` WHERE id = ?'):format(tableName), { id })
    end)
end

return Storage

local config = localmodule 'config.shared'

local GetGameTimer = GetGameTimer
local IsEntityAVehicle = IsEntityAVehicle
local IsEntityAPed = IsEntityAPed
local IsPedAPlayer = IsPedAPlayer
local GetPedInVehicleSeat = GetPedInVehicleSeat
local GetVehiclePedIsIn = GetVehiclePedIsIn
local NetworkGetPlayerIndexFromPed = NetworkGetPlayerIndexFromPed
local GetPlayerServerId = GetPlayerServerId
local TriggerServerEvent = TriggerServerEvent

local reportCooldown = config.reportCooldown
local maxWarnings = config.maxWarnings
local warnDuration = config.warnDuration
local finalDuration = config.finalDuration

local vehicleWeapons = {}
for _, name in ipairs({ 'WEAPON_RUN_OVER_BY_CAR', 'WEAPON_RAMMED_BY_CAR' }) do
    local hash = joaat(name)
    local signed = hash > 0x7FFFFFFF and hash - 0x100000000 or hash
    vehicleWeapons[signed] = true
    vehicleWeapons[signed % 0x100000000] = true
end

local lastReport = {}
local payload = { action = 'warn', title = 'You received a VDM warning', max = maxWarnings }
local mounted = false
local frameReady = false
local pending = false
local generation = 0

CreateThread(function()
    while not interface.ready() do
        Wait(100)
    end
    interface.init(false)
end)

interface.callback('ready', function(_, cb)
    cb(true)
    frameReady = true
    if pending then
        pending = false
        interface.send(payload)
    end
end)

---@param count number
local function showWarning(count)
    local final = count >= maxWarnings
    local duration = final and finalDuration or warnDuration

    payload.count = count
    payload.duration = duration
    payload.description = final and 'Limit reached, this violation has been reported to the admins' or 'Do not hit other players with your vehicle'

    generation = generation + 1
    local current = generation

    if frameReady then
        interface.send(payload)
    else
        pending = true
        if not mounted then
            mounted = true
            interface.show()
        end
    end

    SetTimeout(duration + 400, function()
        if current ~= generation then return end
        mounted = false
        frameReady = false
        pending = false
        interface.hide()
    end)
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_antivdm:client:warn', function(count)
    if type(count) ~= 'number' then return end
    showWarning(count)
end)

---@param attacker number
---@return number?
local function resolveDriver(attacker)
    if IsEntityAVehicle(attacker) then
        return GetPedInVehicleSeat(attacker, -1)
    end

    if IsEntityAPed(attacker) and GetVehiclePedIsIn(attacker, false) ~= 0 then
        return attacker
    end
end

AddEventHandler('gameEventTriggered', function(name, args)
    if name ~= 'CEventNetworkEntityDamage' then return end

    local ped = cache.ped
    if args[1] ~= ped or cache.vehicle or not vehicleWeapons[args[7]] then return end

    local attacker = args[2]
    if not attacker or attacker == 0 then return end

    local driver = resolveDriver(attacker)
    if not driver or driver == 0 or driver == ped or not IsPedAPlayer(driver) then return end

    local playerIndex = NetworkGetPlayerIndexFromPed(driver)
    if playerIndex == -1 then return end

    local serverId = GetPlayerServerId(playerIndex)
    if serverId <= 0 then return end

    local now = GetGameTimer()
    local last = lastReport[serverId]
    if last and now - last < reportCooldown then return end
    lastReport[serverId] = now

    TriggerServerEvent('sm_antivdm:server:report', serverId)
end)

---@param permissions table[]
---@param filters table[]
---@param data? table
---@return table[]
local function fullSpeakerTypeFields(permissions, filters, data)
    local fields = speakerTypeFields(data)

    local defaults
    if data and data.permissions then
        defaults = {}
        local count = 0
        for permission in pairs(data.permissions) do
            count = count + 1
            defaults[count] = permission
        end
    end

    fields[7] = {
        type = 'multi-select',
        label = locale('Permissions'),
        required = true,
        options = permissions,
        default = defaults,
    }

    fields[8] = {
        type = 'multi-select',
        label = locale('Allowed filters'),
        options = filters,
        default = data and data.allowedFilters or nil,
    }

    fields[9] = {
        type = 'input',
        label = locale('Inventory item ID'),
        description = locale('Leave this blank if you are are running inventory that supports metadata or are using command creation method.'),
        default = data and data.itemId or nil,
    }

    fields[10] = {
        type = 'number',
        label = locale('Shop price'),
        description = locale('Leave this blank if you are not using built-in speaker shop.'),
        icon = 'dollar-sign',
        min = 1,
        max = 100000000,
        default = data and data.price or nil,
    }

    return fields
end

local Config = localmodule 'config'

    attachRegistry = registry
end)

    attachRegistry[name] = data
end)

---@param serverId number
---@param objects table[]
local function attachObjects(serverId, objects)
    local ped = GetPlayerPed(GetPlayerFromServerId(serverId))

    if not DoesEntityExist(ped) or not IsEntityVisible(ped) then
        return
    end

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)

    for i = 1, #objects do
        local object = objects[i]

        if not (object.handle and DoesEntityExist(object.handle)) then
            local config = attachRegistry[object.name]

            if config and lib.requestModel(config.model, Config.modelTimeout) then
                local handle = CreateObjectNoOffset(config.model, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false)

                SetEntityAsMissionEntity(handle, true, true)
                SetEntityCollision(handle, false, false)

                local offset, rotation = config.offset, config.rotation
                AttachEntityToEntity(handle, ped, GetPedBoneIndex(ped, config.bone),
                    offset.x, offset.y, offset.z, rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z,
                    true, true, false, true, 1, true)

                SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(config.model)
                object.handle = handle
            end
        end
    end
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:attachObject', function(serverId, name)
    local objects = attachedObjects[serverId]

    if not objects then
        objects = {}
        attachedObjects[serverId] = objects
    end

    objects[#objects + 1] = { name = name }

    if players[serverId] then
        attachObjects(serverId, objects)
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:detachObject', function(serverId, name)
    local objects = attachedObjects[serverId]
    if not objects then return end

    for i = #objects, 1, -1 do
        local object = objects[i]

        if object.name == name then
            if object.handle and DoesEntityExist(object.handle) then
                SetEntityAsMissionEntity(object.handle, true, true)
                DeleteEntity(object.handle)
            end
            table.remove(objects, i)
        end
    end
end)

---@param serverId number
---@param name string
---@return number|false
function GetAttachedEntityByKey(serverId, name)
    local objects = attachedObjects[serverId]
    if not objects then return false end

    for i = 1, #objects do
        if objects[i].name == name then
            return objects[i].handle or false
        end
    end

    return false
end

---@param serverId number
local function removePlayerObjects(serverId)
    local objects = attachedObjects[serverId]
    if not objects then return end

    for i = 1, #objects do
        local object = objects[i]

        if object.handle and DoesEntityExist(object.handle) then
            SetEntityAsMissionEntity(object.handle, true, true)
            DeleteEntity(object.handle)
        end

        object.handle = nil
    end
end

---@param entity number
---@param data table
local function attachVehicleObject(entity, data)
    if not DoesEntityExist(entity) or not IsEntityVisible(entity) then
        return
    end

    if data.handle and DoesEntityExist(data.handle) then
        return
    end

    if not lib.requestModel(data[1], Config.modelTimeout) then
        return
    end

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(entity)
    local handle = CreateObjectNoOffset(data[1], coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false)

    SetEntityAsMissionEntity(handle, true, true)
    SetEntityCollision(handle, false, false)

    local offset, rotation = data[2], data[3]
    AttachEntityToEntity(handle, entity, 0,
        offset.x, offset.y, offset.z, rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z,
        false, false, false, false, 0, true)

    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(data[1])
    data.handle = handle
end

---@param data table
local function detachVehicleObject(data)
    if data.handle and DoesEntityExist(data.handle) then
        SetEntityAsMissionEntity(data.handle, true, true)
        DeleteEntity(data.handle)
    end

    data.handle = nil
end

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(500)

        for entity, data in pairs(vehicleAttachments) do
            if DoesEntityExist(entity) then
                attachVehicleObject(entity, data)
            else
                detachVehicleObject(data)
                vehicleAttachments[entity] = nil
            end
        end
    end
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\interface\sm_audio\client\audio.lua
local Config = localmodule 'config'
local ClientUtil = localmodule 'modules/clientutil'

local GetEntityCoords = GetEntityCoords

local NetworkDoesEntityExistWithNetworkId = NetworkDoesEntityExistWithNetworkId

local IsVehicleWindowIntact = IsVehicleWindowIntact
local GetVehiclePedIsIn = GetVehiclePedIsIn
local GetCloudTimeAsInt = GetCloudTimeAsInt
local SendDuiMessage = SendDuiMessage
local CreateDui = CreateDui
local DestroyDui = DestroyDui

local mathFloor = math.floor
local mathRad = math.rad

local mathCos = math.cos

---@type table[]
local sounds = {}
local soundIndex = {}

local isNear = {}
local activeSounds = {}

local sourceFilters = {}
local sourceEntities = {}
local ogSoundIdToSoundId = {}
local ogKeyToSourceId = {}

local musicVolume = 1.0
local safetyPreference = 'all'
local updateInterval = 100

local maxActiveDui = Config.maxActiveDui
local hearingRange = Config.hearingRange

local RANGE_MARGIN = 10.0

---@param dui number?
---@param data table
local function sendDui(dui, data)
    if not dui then return end
    SendDuiMessage(dui, json.encode(data))
end

---@param value number
---@return number
local function round(value)
    return mathFloor(value * 100 + 0.5) * 0.01
end

---@param rot vector3
local function getCamDirections(rot)
    local radZ = mathRad(rot.z)
    local radX = mathRad(rot.x)
    local radY = mathRad(rot.y)

    return
        mathSin(radZ), mathSin(radX), mathCos(radZ + mathPi),
        mathSin(radY), mathCos(radX), mathSin(radY)
end

---@param dist number
---@param range number
---@param volume number
---@return number
local function getVolume(dist, range, volume)
    if range < dist or musicVolume == 0 then
        return 0
    end

    local minRange = range * 0.1
    if dist <= minRange then
        return volume * musicVolume
    end

    return volume * (1 - (dist - minRange) / (range * 0.9)) * musicVolume
end

---@param soundId string
---@param source table
---@return number|false|nil
local function getSourceEntity(soundId, source)
    local netId = source.netId

    if netId and netIdToEntity[netId] then
        return netIdToEntity[netId]
    end

    local entities = sourceEntities[soundId]
    return entities and entities[source.id] or nil
end

---@param soundId string
---@param source table
local function indexSource(soundId, source)
    local filters = sourceFilters[soundId]
    if not filters then
        filters = {}
        sourceFilters[soundId] = filters
    end

    local list = filters[source.id]
    if not list then
        list = {}
        filters[source.id] = list
    end

    local incoming = source.filters
    if incoming then
        for i = 1, #incoming do
            list[#list + 1] = incoming[i]
        end
    end

    if not sourceEntities[soundId] then
        sourceEntities[soundId] = {}
    end

    local ogSoundId, ogSourceId = source.ogSoundId, source.ogSourceId

    if ogSoundId then
        ogSoundIdToSoundId[ogSoundId] = soundId
    end

    if ogSourceId then
        ogKeyToSourceId[('%s-%s'):format(ogSoundId, ogSourceId)] = source.id
    end

    if ogSoundId and ogSourceId then
        local origin = sourceEntities[ogSoundId]
        if origin and origin[ogSourceId] then
            sourceEntities[soundId][source.id] = origin[ogSourceId]
        end
    end
end

---@param sound table
local function trackSound(sound)
    local count = #sounds + 1
    sounds[count] = sound
    soundIndex[sound.id] = sound

    local sources = sound.sources
    for i = 1, #sources do
        local netId = sources[i].netId
        if netId then
            pendingNetIds[#pendingNetIds + 1] = netId
        end
    end
end

---@param slot number
---@return number
local function createDuiForSlot(slot)
    local dui = CreateDui(DUI_URL:format(slot), 1280, 720)

    local deadline = GetCloudTimeAsInt() + 5
    while not duiReadySlots[slot] and (deadline - GetCloudTimeAsInt()) > 0 do
        Wait(100)
    end

    duiReadySlots[slot] = nil
    return dui
end

---@type function
local getApplicableFilters

---@param sound table
---@param dui number
---@param ctx table?
local function pushSoundCoords(sound, dui, ctx)
    if not dui then return end

    if not ctx then
        local fX, fY, fZ, uX, uY, uZ = getCamDirections(GetFinalRenderedCamRot())

        ctx = {
            coords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped),
            interior = GetInteriorFromEntity(cache.ped),
            fX = fX, fY = fY, fZ = fZ,
            uX = uX, uY = uY, uZ = uZ,
        }
    end

    local playerCoords = ctx.coords
    local playerInterior = ctx.interior

    local id = sound.id
    local sources = sound.sources
    local muted = restrictedSounds[id]
    local locations = {}
    local count = 0

    for j = 1, #sources do
        local source = sources[j]
        local entity = getSourceEntity(id, source)

        if entity then
            local entityCoords = GetEntityCoords(entity)
            local dist = #(entityCoords - playerCoords)

            count = count + 1
            locations[count] = {
                id = source.id,
                x = round(entityCoords.x),
                y = round(entityCoords.y),
                z = round(entityCoords.z),
                volume = muted and 0.0 or getVolume(dist, source.range, source.volume),
                filters = getApplicableFilters(
                    id, source.id, entity, dist,
                    playerInterior ~= GetInteriorFromEntity(entity),
                    GetEntityType(entity) == 2
                ),
            }
        end
    end

    sendDui(dui, {
        action = 'updateCoords',
        posX = round(playerCoords.x),
        posY = round(playerCoords.y),
        posZ = round(playerCoords.z),
        fX = round(ctx.fX),
        fY = round(ctx.fY) * -1,
        fZ = round(ctx.fZ),
        uX = round(ctx.uX),
        uY = round(ctx.uY),
        uZ = round(ctx.uZ),
        locations = locations,
    })
end

---@param sound table
---@return boolean
local function createSound(sound)
    local skipTo = sound.timer or 0

    if not (sound.paused and sound.timer) then
        skipTo = skipTo + math.max(0, GetCloudTimeAsInt() - (sound.startedAt or 0))
    end

    slotCounter = slotCounter + 1
    if slotCounter >= 60000 then slotCounter = 1 end

    local dui = createDuiForSlot(slotCounter)
    duiObjects[sound.id] = dui

    sendDui(dui, {
        action = 'play',
        id = sound.id,
        videoId = sound.videoId,
        paused = sound.paused,
        skipTo = skipTo,
    })

    pushSoundCoords(sound, dui)

    return true
end

---@param soundId string
local function destroyDui(soundId)
    local dui = duiObjects[soundId]
    if not dui then return end

    DestroyDui(dui)
    duiObjects[soundId] = nil
end

---@param soundId string
---@param sourceId number
---@param vehicleEntity number
---@param dist number
---@param insideInterior boolean
---@param insideVehicle boolean
---@return table
function getApplicableFilters(soundId, sourceId, vehicleEntity, dist, insideInterior, insideVehicle)
    local result = {}

    local bySound = sourceFilters[soundId]
    if not bySound then return result end

    local filters = bySound[sourceId]
    if not filters then return result end

    local count = 0

    for i = 1, #filters do
        local filter = filters[i]
        local method = filter.applyMethod
        local keep = true

        if method == 'insideInterior' then
            keep = insideInterior
        elseif method == 'insideVehicle' then
            keep = insideVehicle

            if keep and vehicleEntity then
                if vehicleEntity == GetVehiclePedIsIn(cache.ped, false)
                    or GetVehicleDoorAngleRatio(vehicleEntity, 0) ~= 0.0
                    or GetVehicleDoorAngleRatio(vehicleEntity, 1) ~= 0.0
                    or GetVehicleDoorAngleRatio(vehicleEntity, 2) ~= 0.0
                    or GetVehicleDoorAngleRatio(vehicleEntity, 3) ~= 0.0
                    or not IsVehicleWindowIntact(vehicleEntity, 0)
                    or not IsVehicleWindowIntact(vehicleEntity, 1)
                    or not IsVehicleWindowIntact(vehicleEntity, 2)
                    or not IsVehicleWindowIntact(vehicleEntity, 3)
                then
                    keep = false
                end
            end
        elseif method == 'distance' then
            if filter.minDist and dist < filter.minDist then
                keep = false
            elseif filter.maxDist and dist > filter.maxDist then
                keep = false
            end
        end

        if keep then
            count = count + 1
            result[count] = filter
        end
    end

    return result
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:receiveAllSounds', function(allSounds)
    if stopped then return end

    for i = 1, #allSounds do
        local sound = allSounds[i]
        local sources = sound.sources

        if sources then
            for j = 1, #sources do
                indexSource(sound.id, sources[j])
            end
        end

        trackSound(sound)
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:addSound', function(sound)
    if stopped then return end

    trackSound(sound)

    local sources = sound.sources
    if sources then
        for i = 1, #sources do
            indexSource(sound.id, sources[i])
        end
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:addSoundSource', function(soundId, source)
    local sound = soundIndex[soundId]

    if sound then
        sound.sources[#sound.sources + 1] = source

        if source.netId then
            pendingNetIds[#pendingNetIds + 1] = source.netId
        end
    end

    indexSource(soundId, source)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:updateSoundSource', function(soundId, sourceId, data)
    local sound = soundIndex[soundId]
    if not sound then return end

    local sources = sound.sources

    for i = 1, #sources do
        local source = sources[i]

        if source.id == sourceId then
            local newNetId = data.netId

            if newNetId and newNetId ~= source.netId then
                if NetworkDoesEntityExistWithNetworkId(newNetId) then
                    local entity = NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(newNetId)
                    if entity and entity ~= 0 and DoesEntityExist(entity) then
                        netIdToEntity[newNetId] = entity
                    end
                end

                pendingNetIds[#pendingNetIds + 1] = newNetId
            end

            if source.netId and source.netId ~= newNetId then
                local oldNetId = source.netId
                SetTimeout(3000, function()
                    netIdDirty[oldNetId] = true
                end)
            end

            source.netId = newNetId
            source.volume = data.volume
            source.range = data.range
            return
        end
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:updateSoundSourcesVolumes', function(soundId, volumes)
    local sound = soundIndex[soundId]
    if not sound then return end

    local sources = sound.sources

    for i = 1, #sources do
        local volume = volumes[sources[i].id]
        if volume then
            sources[i].volume = volume
        end
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:removeSoundSource', function(soundId, sourceId)
    local sound = soundIndex[soundId]
    if not sound then return end

    local sources = sound.sources

    for i = 1, #sources do
        if sources[i].id == sourceId then
            sources[i].remove = true

            if sources[i].netId then
                netIdDirty[sources[i].netId] = true
            end

            return
        end
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:addSoundSourceFilter', function(soundId, sourceId, filter)
    local bySound = sourceFilters[soundId]
    if not bySound then
        bySound = {}
        sourceFilters[soundId] = bySound
    end

    local list = bySound[sourceId]
    if not list then
        list = {}
        bySound[sourceId] = list
    end

    list[#list + 1] = filter
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:removeSoundSourceFilter', function(soundId, sourceId, filterId)
    local bySound = sourceFilters[soundId]
    if not bySound then return end

    local list = bySound[sourceId]
    if not list then return end

    for i = #list, 1, -1 do
        if list[i].id == filterId then
            table.remove(list, i)
            return
        end
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:setSoundPaused', function(soundId, paused, data)
    local sound = soundIndex[soundId]
    if not sound then return end

    sound.paused = paused

    if data then
        if data.timer then sound.timer = data.timer end
        if data.startedAt then sound.startedAt = data.startedAt end
    end

    sendDui(duiObjects[soundId], { action = 'updatePaused', state = paused })
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:removeSound', function(soundId)
    local sound = soundIndex[soundId]
    if not sound then return end

    sound.remove = true

    local sources = sound.sources
    if sources then
        for i = 1, #sources do
            if sources[i].netId then

            end
        end
    end
end)

    if not sound then return end

    sendDui(duiObjects[soundId], {
        action = 'updateSound',
        videoId = data.videoId,
        skipTo = data.timer,

    sound.startedAt = data.startedAt

    sound.timer = data.timer
    sound.paused = data.paused
    sound.finished = false

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:setSafetyPreference', function(preference, restricted)
    safetyPreference = preference

    if preference == 'nothing' then
        musicVolume = 0.0
    else
        local storedVolume = GetResourceKvpString('sm_audio-volume')
        musicVolume = storedVolume and mathMin(2.0, tonumber(storedVolume) or 1.0) or 1.0
    end

    table.wipe(restrictedSounds)

    if restricted then
        for soundId, status in pairs(restricted) do
            restrictedSounds[soundId] = status
        end
    end

    if preference == 'nothing' then
        table.wipe(isNear)

        for i = 1, #sounds do
            if activeSounds[sounds[i].id] then
                sounds[i].markedForDestroy = true
            end
        end
    end

    TriggerEvent('sm_audio:client:safetyPreferenceChanged', preference)
    TriggerEvent('sm_audio:streamerMode', preference == 'nothing')
end)

AddEventHandler('sm_audio:client:mapEntityToSource', function(soundId, sourceId, entity)
    local entities = sourceEntities[soundId]
    if not entities then
        entities = {}
        sourceEntities[soundId] = entities
    end

    entities[sourceId] = entity

    local mappedSoundId = ogSoundIdToSoundId[soundId]
    local mappedSourceId = ogKeyToSourceId[('%s-%s'):format(soundId, sourceId)]

    if mappedSoundId and mappedSourceId then
        local mapped = sourceEntities[mappedSoundId]
        if not mapped then
            mapped = {}
            sourceEntities[mappedSoundId] = mapped
        end
        mapped[mappedSourceId] = entity
    end
end)

end)

RegisterNUICallback('sm_audio:soundFinished', function(data, cb)
    cb('ok')

    if sound then
        sound.finished = true
    end
end)

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(updateInterval)

        if #sounds > 0 then
            local fX, fY, fZ, uX, uY, uZ = getCamDirections(GetFinalRenderedCamRot())

            tickContext.coords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
            tickContext.interior = GetInteriorFromEntity(cache.ped)
            tickContext.fX, tickContext.fY, tickContext.fZ = fX, fY, fZ
            tickContext.uX, tickContext.uY, tickContext.uZ = uX, uY, uZ

            for i = #sounds, 1, -1 do
                local sound = sounds[i]

                if sound.remove then
                    destroyDui(sound.id)
                    activeSounds[sound.id] = nil
                    isNear[sound.id] = nil
                    soundIndex[sound.id] = nil
                    table.remove(sounds, i)
                    goto continue
                end

                if sound.markedForDestroy then
                    sound.markedForDestroy = false
                    activeSounds[sound.id] = nil
                    isNear[sound.id] = nil
                    destroyDui(sound.id)
                    goto continue
                end

                do
                    local id = sound.id
                    if sound.finished or not activeSounds[id] or not isNear[id] then
                        goto continue
                    end

                    local dui = duiObjects[id]
                    local sources = sound.sources

                    for j = #sources, 1, -1 do
                        if sources[j].remove then
                            sendDui(dui, { action = 'removeSoundLocation', locationId = sources[j].id })
                            table.remove(sources, j)
                        end
                    end

                    pushSoundCoords(sound, dui, tickContext)
                end

                ::continue::
            end
        end
    end
end)

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(100)

        for i = 1, #sounds do
            local sound = sounds[i]
            if sound then
                local id = sound.id
                local near = isNear[id]

                if near and not activeSounds[id] and safetyPreference ~= 'nothing' then
                    activeSounds[id] = createSound(sound)
                elseif not near and activeSounds[id] then
                    sound.markedForDestroy = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

local candidates = {}

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(1000)

        local count = #sounds

        if count > 0 and safetyPreference ~= 'nothing' then
            local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
            local found = 0

            for i = 1, count do
                local sound = sounds[i]

                if sound then
                    local sources = sound.sources
                    local closest

                    for j = 1, #sources do
                        local source = sources[j]
                        local entity = source.netId and netIdToEntity[source.netId] or getSourceEntity(sound.id, source)

                        if entity and DoesEntityExist(entity) then
                            local entityCoords = GetEntityCoords(entity)

                            if entityCoords.x ~= 0.0 or entityCoords.y ~= 0.0 then
                                local dist = #(playerCoords - entityCoords)
                                local audible = mathMin(hearingRange, (source.range or hearingRange) + RANGE_MARGIN)

                                if dist < audible and (not closest or dist < closest) then
                                    closest = dist
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if closest then
                        found = found + 1
                        local entry = candidates[found]

                        if entry then
                            entry.id = sound.id
                            entry.dist = closest
                        else
                            candidates[found] = { id = sound.id, dist = closest }
                        end
                    else
                        isNear[sound.id] = nil
                    end
                end
            end

            for i = #candidates, found + 1, -1 do
                candidates[i] = nil
            end

            if found > 1 then
                table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
                    return a.dist < b.dist
                end)
            end

            for i = 1, found do
                isNear[candidates[i].id] = i <= maxActiveDui or nil
            end
        end
    end
end)

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(1000)

        for i = #pendingNetIds, 1, -1 do
            local netId = pendingNetIds[i]

            if netIdDirty[netId] then
                netIdToEntity[netId] = nil
                netIdDirty[netId] = nil
                table.remove(pendingNetIds, i)
                goto continue
            end

            do
                local cached = netIdToEntity[netId]
                if cached and DoesEntityExist(cached) then
                    goto continue
                end

                if not NetworkDoesEntityExistWithNetworkId(netId) then
                    netIdToEntity[netId] = nil
                else
                    local entity = NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netId)
                    netIdToEntity[netId] = (entity and entity ~= 0) and entity or nil
                end
            end

            ::continue::
        end
    end
end)

local function resetAll()
    for i = 1, #sounds do
        destroyDui(sounds[i].id)
    end

    table.wipe(sounds)
    table.wipe(soundIndex)
    table.wipe(activeSounds)
    table.wipe(isNear)
    table.wipe(pendingNetIds)
    table.wipe(netIdToEntity)
    table.wipe(netIdDirty)
    table.wipe(sourceFilters)
    table.wipe(sourceEntities)
    table.wipe(ogSoundIdToSoundId)
    table.wipe(ogKeyToSourceId)
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:stop', function()
    stopped = true
    resetAll()
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource == cache.resource then
        resetAll()
    end
end)

RegisterCommand('musicvolume', function(_, args)
    if safetyPreference == 'nothing' then
        ClientUtil.notify(locale("Music volume can't be changed while streamer mode is on."), 'error')
        return
    end

    local value = tonumber(args[1])
    if not value or value < 0 or value > 2 then
        ClientUtil.notify('/musicvolume 0-2', 'error')
        return
    end

    musicVolume = value
    SetResourceKvp('sm_audio-volume', tostring(value))

    ClientUtil.notify(locale('Music volume modifier is now %s.', value), 'success')
    TriggerEvent('sm_audio:client:musicVolumeChanged', value)
end)

RegisterCommand('updateinterval', function()
    local input = lib.inputDialog(locale('Speakers update interval'), {
        {
            type = 'select',
            label = locale('Interval'),
            description = locale('How frequently we send speaker location updates.'),
            options = {
                { value = 50, label = 'High' },
                { value = 100, label = 'Medium' },
                { value = 300, label = 'Low' },
            },
            default = updateInterval,
        },
    })

    if not input then return end

    updateInterval = input[1]
    SetResourceKvpInt('sm_audio-interval', updateInterval)

    for _, dui in pairs(duiObjects) do
        sendDui(dui, { action = 'updateInterval', interval = updateInterval })
    end

    ClientUtil.notify(locale('Update interval is now %s.', updateInterval), 'success')
end)

CreateThread(function()
    local storedInterval = GetResourceKvpInt('sm_audio-interval')
    if storedInterval and storedInterval > 0 then
        updateInterval = storedInterval
    end

    local storedVolume = GetResourceKvpString('sm_audio-volume')
    if storedVolume then
        musicVolume = mathMin(2.0, tonumber(storedVolume) or 1.0)
    end

    TriggerServerEvent('sm_audio:server:requestAllSounds')
end)

exports('getMusicVolume', function()
    return musicVolume
end)

exports('getSafetyPreference', function()
    return safetyPreference
end)

exports('isStreamerMode', function()
    return safetyPreference == 'nothing'
end)

---@param keybind? table
---@param disabled boolean
local function setKeybindDisabled(keybind, disabled)
    if keybind then
        keybind:disable(disabled)
    end
end

---@param keybind? table
---@param fallback string
---@return string
local function keybindLabel(keybind, fallback)
    return keybind and keybind.currentKey or fallback
end

---@param extra? string
local function showCarryInfo(extra)
    local lines = ('[kbd]%s[/kbd] Taruh speaker di tanah'):format(keybindLabel(dropKeybind, Config.keybinds.drop))

    if extra then
        lines = lines .. '\n' .. extra
    end

    infoUI.show({
        id = INFO_CARRY,
        title = 'Membawa Speaker',
        icon = 'fa-solid fa-music',
        description = lines,
    })
end

---@param netId number
local function addDetachTarget(netId)
    if targetResource ~= 'ox_target' then return end

    local ok, exists = pcall(lib.waitFor, function()
        if NetworkDoesNetworkIdExist(netId) then return true end
    end, 'netId tidak muncul', 2000)

    if not ok or not exists then return end

    exports.ox_target:addEntity({ netId }, {
        {
            label = locale('Detach speaker'),
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-paperclip',
            name = 'sm-speaker-detach',
            distance = 1.4,
            onSelect = function(data)
                if not ClientUtil.interactionCheck() then return end
                TriggerServerEvent('sm_audio:server:detachFromVehicle', VehToNet(data.entity))
            end,
            canInteract = function(entity)
                return GetEntityHealth(entity) > 200
            end,
        },
    })
end

---@param netId number
local function removeDetachTarget(netId)
    if targetResource ~= 'ox_target' then return end
    exports.ox_target:removeEntity({ netId }, { 'sm-speaker-detach' })
end

---@param vehicleClasses number[]
local function addAttachTarget(vehicleClasses)
    if targetResource ~= 'ox_target' then return end

    exports.ox_target:addGlobalVehicle({
        {
            label = locale('Attach speaker'),
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-paperclip',
            name = 'sm-speaker-attach',
            distance = 1.4,
            onSelect = function(data)
                if not ClientUtil.interactionCheck() then return end
                TriggerServerEvent('sm_audio:server:attachToVehicle', VehToNet(data.entity))
            end,
            canInteract = function(entity)
                return GetEntityHealth(entity) > 200 and lib.table.contains(vehicleClasses, GetVehicleClass(entity))
            end,
        },
    })
end

local function removeAttachTarget()
    if targetResource ~= 'ox_target' then return end
    exports.ox_target:removeGlobalVehicle({ 'sm-speaker-attach' })
end

function DropSpeaker()
    if IsCloseToAnotherSpeaker() then
        ClientUtil.notify(locale('You are too close to another speaker.'), 'error')
        return
    end

    if not ClientUtil.interactionCheck() then return end

    removeAttachTarget()
    setKeybindDisabled(dropKeybind, true)
    isCarrying = false
    infoUI.remove(INFO_CARRY)

    TriggerServerEvent('sm_audio:server:dropSpeaker')
end

---@param data table
local function playCarryAnimation(data)
    if not lib.requestAnimDict(data.animationDict, Config.modelTimeout) then
        return
    end

    CreateThread(function()
        local ped = cache.ped

        while isCarrying do
            if not IsEntityPlayingAnim(ped, data.animationDict, data.animationName, 3) then
                TaskPlayAnim(ped, data.animationDict, data.animationName, data.blendInSpeed, data.blendOutSpeed,
                    data.duration, data.flag, data.playbackRate, data.lockX, data.lockY, data.lockZ)
            end
            Wait(250)
        end

        ClearPedTasksImmediately(ped)
    end)
end

local function vehicleProximityLoop()
    CreateThread(function()
        local showing = false
        local lastModel

        while isCarrying do
            Wait(500)

            local coords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
            local vehicle = ClientUtil.getNearestVehicle(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, 0.75)

            if vehicle then
                nearestVehicle = vehicle

                local model = GetEntityModel(vehicle)
                if lastModel ~= model then
                    lastModel = model
                    showing = false
                end

                if not showing then
                    showing = true
                    showCarryInfo(('[kbd]%s[/kbd] Pasang ke %s'):format(
                        keybindLabel(attachKeybind, Config.keybinds.attach), GetDisplayNameFromVehicleModel(model)))
                    setKeybindDisabled(attachKeybind, false)
                end
            else
                nearestVehicle = false

                if showing then
                    showing = false
                    showCarryInfo()
                    setKeybindDisabled(attachKeybind, true)
                end
            end
        end

        nearestVehicle = false
        setKeybindDisabled(attachKeybind, true)
    end)
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:carrySpeaker', function(data)
    isCarrying = true

    CreateThread(function()
        local ped = cache.ped

        while isCarrying do
            if IsPedGettingIntoAVehicle(ped) then
                ClientUtil.notify(locale("You can't enter a vehicle while holding a speaker."), 'error')
                ClearPedTasksImmediately(ped)
            end
            Wait(200)
        end
    end)

    CreateThread(function()
        Wait(500)
        setKeybindDisabled(dropKeybind, false)
        showCarryInfo()
    end)

    if data.animationData then
        playCarryAnimation(data.animationData)
    end

    local attachType = data.vehicleAttach

    if attachType == 'direct' or attachType == 'gizmo' or attachType == 'both' then
        if Config.useTargeting then
            addAttachTarget(data.vehicleClasses)
        else
            vehicleProximityLoop()
        end
    end
end)

lib.onCache('vehicle', function(vehicle)
    inVehicle = vehicle ~= false

    if not inVehicle then
        setKeybindDisabled(vehicleInteractKeybind, true)
        setKeybindDisabled(detachKeybind, true)

        if vehicleInteractKeybind then
            vehicleInteractKeybind.speakerId = nil
        end

        return
    end

    local speakerId = attachedSpeakers[VehToNet(vehicle)]

    if not vehicleInteractKeybind then return end

    if not speakerId then
        vehicleInteractKeybind.speakerId = nil
        return
    end

    SetInteractKeybindDisabled(true)
    vehicleInteractKeybind:disable(false)
    vehicleInteractKeybind.speakerId = speakerId
end)

exports('isCarryingSpeaker', function()
    if isCarrying then return true end

    local ped = cache.ped
    local objects = GetGamePool('CObject')

    for i = 1, #objects do
        local object = objects[i]
        if IsEntityAttachedToEntity(ped, object) and speakerProps[GetEntityModel(object)] then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end)
