    if type(source) ~= 'number' then return end

    if playerManager[source] then
        playerManager[source]:setduty(onduty)
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:OnJobUpdate', function(source, job)
    if type(source) ~= 'number' then return end

    if playerManager[source] then
        playerManager[source]:setjob(job)
        return
    end

    local player = sm_core:GetPlayer(source)
    if not player then return end

    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: undefined-field
    playerManager[source] = playerInstance:new(player)
    blipUpdate(source, true)
end)

    if type(source) ~= 'number' then return end

    blipUpdate.logout(source)
    removePlayer(source)
end)

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    local source = source --[[@as number]]

    blipUpdate.logout(source)
    removePlayer(source)
end)

    local players = sm_core:GetQBPlayers()

    for _, instance in pairs(players) do
        local source = instance.PlayerData.source
        playerManager[source] = playerInstance:new(instance)
        blipUpdate(source, true)
    end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\resource\rhd_job_blip\modules\renderer.lua
local config = localmodule 'config.shared'
local settings = config.Settings or {}

---@class JobBlipRecord
---@field id number
---@field kind 'entity'|'coord'
---@field entity? number
---@field signature string

---@class JobBlipTarget
---@field kind 'entity'|'coord'
---@field entity? number
---@field coords? vector3
---@field isCoordBlip boolean
---@field vehicleType? string

---@class JobBlipRenderer
---@field activeBlips table<string, table<string, JobBlipRecord>>
---@field revisions table<string, number>
local JobBlipRenderer = {
    activeBlips = {},
    revisions = {}
}

local BLIP_SPRITES = {
    bike = 226,
    automobile = 225,
    boat = 427,
    heli = 43,
    plane = 307,
    default = 1
}

local BLIP_CATEGORY = 7
local BLIP_SCALE = 0.8
local UPDATE_DISTANCE = 150.0

---@param blipId number
---@param name string
---@param color number?
---@param isCoordBlip boolean
---@param vehicleType? string
local function configureBlip(blipId, name, color, isCoordBlip, vehicleType)
    if not blipId or not DoesBlipExist(blipId) then return end

    SetBlipCategory(blipId, BLIP_CATEGORY)
    SetBlipSprite(blipId, type(vehicleType) == 'number' and vehicleType or BLIP_SPRITES[vehicleType] or BLIP_SPRITES.default)
    SetBlipColour(blipId, color or 3)
    SetBlipDisplay(blipId, 6)
    SetBlipFlashes(blipId, false)

    local scale = BLIP_SCALE
    local sirenSettings = settings.siren or {}
    if sirenSettings.enabled and type(vehicleType) == 'number' and vehicleType == (sirenSettings.sprite or 42) then
        scale = sirenSettings.scale or 0.5
    end
    SetBlipScale(blipId, scale)

    if not isCoordBlip then
        SetBlipAsShortRange(blipId, true)
        SetBlipShowCone(blipId, true)
    end

    BeginTextCommandSetBlipName('STRING')
    AddTextComponentString(name)
    EndTextCommandSetBlipName(blipId)
end

---@param member JobBlipMember
---@param color number?
---@param target JobBlipTarget
---@return string
local function getBlipSignature(member, color, target)
    return ('%s|%s|%s|%s'):format(member.name, member.color or color or 3, target.kind, member.sprite or target.vehicleType or 'default')
end

---@param record JobBlipRecord?
local function removeRecord(record)
    if record and DoesBlipExist(record.id) then
        RemoveBlip(record.id)
    end
end

---@param ped number
---@return string?
local function getVehicleType(ped)
    local vehicle = GetVehiclePedIsIn(ped, false)
    return vehicle ~= 0 and GetVehicleType(vehicle) or nil
end

---@param playerPed number
---@return boolean
local function isPlayerNearby(playerPed)
    if playerPed == 0 or playerPed == cache.ped then return false end

    return #(GetEntityCoords(playerPed) - GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)) <= UPDATE_DISTANCE
end

---@param jobName string
function JobBlipRenderer:clearJob(jobName)
    local records = self.activeBlips[jobName]
    if not records then return end

    for _, record in pairs(records) do
        removeRecord(record)
    end

    self.activeBlips[jobName] = nil
end

function JobBlipRenderer:clearAll()
    for jobName in pairs(self.activeBlips) do
        self:clearJob(jobName)
    end
end

---@param member JobBlipMember
---@return JobBlipTarget?
local function resolveMemberTarget(member)
    local playerId = GetPlayerFromServerId(member.source)
    local playerPed = playerId ~= -1 and GetPlayerPed(playerId) or 0

    if member.source == cache.serverId then
        if settings.showSelfBlip == false then
            return
        end

        return {
            kind = 'entity',
            entity = cache.ped,
            isCoordBlip = false,
            vehicleType = member.sprite or getVehicleType(cache.ped)
        }
    end

    if DoesEntityExist(playerPed) and isPlayerNearby(playerPed) then
        return {
            kind = 'entity',
            entity = playerPed,
            isCoordBlip = false,
            vehicleType = member.sprite or getVehicleType(playerPed)
        }
    end

    if member.coords then
        return {
            kind = 'coord',
            coords = member.coords,
            isCoordBlip = true,
            vehicleType = member.sprite
        }
    end
end

---@param target JobBlipTarget
---@return number?
local function createBlip(target)
    if target.kind == 'entity' and target.entity then
        return AddBlipForEntity(target.entity)
    end

    if target.kind == 'coord' and target.coords then
        return AddBlipForCoord(target.coords.x, target.coords.y, target.coords.z)
    end
end

---@param jobName string
---@return table<string, JobBlipRecord>
function JobBlipRenderer:getJobRecords(jobName)
    local records = self.activeBlips[jobName]

    if not records then
        records = {}
        self.activeBlips[jobName] = records
    end

    return records
end

---@param record JobBlipRecord
---@param member JobBlipMember
---@param color number?
---@param target JobBlipTarget
local function updateRecord(record, member, color, target)
    if not DoesBlipExist(record.id) then return end

    if record.kind == 'coord' and target.coords then
        SetBlipCoords(record.id, target.coords.x, target.coords.y, target.coords.z)
    end

    local signature = getBlipSignature(member, color, target)

    if record.signature ~= signature then
        configureBlip(record.id, member.name, color, target.isCoordBlip, target.vehicleType)
        record.signature = signature
    end
end

---@param jobName string
---@param memberKey string
---@param member JobBlipMember
---@param color number?
function JobBlipRenderer:upsertMember(jobName, memberKey, member, color)
    local records = self:getJobRecords(jobName)
    local current = records[memberKey]
    local target = resolveMemberTarget(member)

    if not target then
        removeRecord(current)
        records[memberKey] = nil
        return
    end

    if current
        and DoesBlipExist(current.id)
        and current.kind == target.kind
        and (target.kind == 'coord' or current.entity == target.entity)
    then
        updateRecord(current, member, member.color or color, target)
        return
    end

    local blipId = createBlip(target)

    if not blipId then
        removeRecord(current)
        records[memberKey] = nil
        return
    end

    removeRecord(current)
    configureBlip(blipId, member.name, member.color or color, target.isCoordBlip, target.vehicleType)

    records[memberKey] = {
        id = blipId,
        kind = target.kind,
        entity = target.entity,
        signature = getBlipSignature(member, color, target)
    }
end

---@param jobName string
---@param memberKey string
function JobBlipRenderer:removeMember(jobName, memberKey)
    local records = self.activeBlips[jobName]
    if not records then return end

    removeRecord(records[memberKey])
    records[memberKey] = nil
end

---@param payload table
function JobBlipRenderer:applyPayload(payload)
    local jobName = payload and payload.jobName
    if not jobName then return end

    local revision = payload.revision or 0
    if revision < (self.revisions[jobName] or 0) then
        return
    end

    self.revisions[jobName] = revision

    if payload.action == 'clear' then
        self:clearJob(jobName)
        return
    end

    if payload.action == 'set' then
        local records = self:getJobRecords(jobName)
        local seen = {}

        for memberKey, member in pairs(payload.members or {}) do
            seen[memberKey] = true
            self:upsertMember(jobName, memberKey, member, payload.color)
        end

        for memberKey in pairs(records) do
            if not seen[memberKey] then
                self:removeMember(jobName, memberKey)
            end
        end

        return
    end

    if payload.action ~= 'delta' then
        return
    end

    local removes = payload.removes or {}
    for i = 1, #removes do
        local memberKey = removes[i]
        self:removeMember(jobName, memberKey)
    end

    for memberKey, member in pairs(payload.upserts or {}) do
        self:upsertMember(jobName, memberKey, member, payload.color)
    end
end

return JobBlipRenderer


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\resource\rhd_utils\client\cache.lua
local getters = {
    coords = function ()
        local coords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
        local heading = GetEntityHeading(cache.ped)
        return vec(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, heading)
    end
}

local setters = {}

RHDCache = setmetatable({}, {
    __index = function(self, key)
        local fn = getters[key]
        local value = rawget(self, key)
        
        if fn then
            value = fn()
        end

        return value
    end,
    __newindex = function(self, key, value)
        local fn = setters[key]

        if fn then
            fn(value)
        end

        rawset(self, key, value)
    end,

local handler = {}
handler.cache = {}

---@class PlayerJobGrades
---@field name string
---@field level number

---@class PlayerJob
---@field name string
---@field type? string
---@field onduty boolean
---@field grade PlayerJobGrades
---@field isboss boolean

---@param job PlayerJob
---@param t string|string[]|table<string, number|number[]>
---@param duty? boolean
---@return boolean
local function checkjob(job, t, duty)
    if not job then return false end

    local jn = job.name
    local jt = job.type
    local jd = job.onduty
    local jg = job.grade.level

    if duty and not jd then
        return false
    end

    local tt = type(t)

    if tt == 'string' then
        return jn == t or jt == t
    end

    if tt == 'table' then
        if array.isArray(t) then
            return tbl.contains(t, jn) or tbl.contains(t, jt)
        end

        local requirement = t[jn] or t[jt]
        if not requirement then return false end

        local rt = type(requirement)

        if rt == 'number' then
            return jg >= requirement
        end

        if rt == 'table' and array.isArray(requirement) then
            return tbl.contains(requirement, jg)
        end

        return false
    end

    return false
end

---@param t string|string[]|table<string, number>
local function checkavailable(t)
    local _t = type(t)
    local missing = {}

    if _t == 'string' then
        local count = handler.getCount(t)
        if count < 1 then
            missing[#missing + 1] = ('%s (0/1)'):format(qb_jobs[t]?.label or t)
        end
    end

    if _t == 'table' then
        if lib.array.isArray(t) then
            lib.array.forEach(t, function(val)
                local count = handler.getCount(val)
                if count < 1 then
                    missing[#missing + 1] = ('%s (0/1)'):format(qb_jobs[val]?.label or val)
                end
            end)
        else
            lib.table.forEach(t, function(required, job)
                local count = handler.getCount(job)
                if count < required then
                    missing[#missing + 1] = ('%s (%s/%s)'):format(qb_jobs[job]?.label or job, count, required)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    local available = #missing < 1

    local err = not available and ([[
Pekerjaan yang dibutuhkan tidak tersedia: %s
    ]]):format(table.concat(missing, ', ')) or nil

    return available, err
end

---@param job_table string|string[]|table<string, number>
---@return boolean, string?
function handler.checkavailable(job_table)
    return checkavailable(job_table)
end

        end

            return val == source

---Clamp a number between 2 other numbers
---@param val number
---@param lower number
---@param upper number
---@return number
function math.clamp(val, lower, upper)
    if lower > upper then lower, upper = upper, lower end
    return math.max(lower, math.min(upper, val))
end

---Rounds a number to a whole number or to the specified number of decimal places.
---@param value number | string
---@param places? number | string
---@return number
function math.round(value, places)
    ---@type number
    local n = type(value) == 'string' and tonumber(value) or value --[[@as number]]
    if type(n) ~= 'number' then error('Value must be a number') end

    if places then
        ---@type number
        local p = type(places) == 'string' and tonumber(places) or places --[[@as number]]
        if type(p) ~= 'number' then error('Places must be a number') end
        places = p

        if p > 0 then
            local mult = 10 ^ p
            return math.floor(n * mult + 0.5) / mult
        end
    end

    return math.floor(n + 0.5)
end

---Converts input number into grouped digits
---@param number number
---@param separator? string
---@return string
function math.groupdigits(number, separator)
    local left, num, right = string.match(tostring(number), '^([^%d]*%d)(%d*)(.-)$')
    return left .. (num:reverse():gsub('(%d%d%d)', '%1' .. (separator or ',')):reverse()) .. right
end

---Formats a number as a hexadecimal string.
---@param n number | string
---@param upper? boolean
---@return string
function math.tohex(n, upper)
    local formatString = ('0x%s'):format(upper and '%X' or '%x')
    return formatString:format(n)
end

---Takes a hexadecimal string and returns three integers (R, G, B).
---@param input string
---@return integer r
---@return integer g
---@return integer b
function math.hextorgb(input)
    local r, g, b = string.match(input, '([^#]+.)(..)(..)')
    return tonumber(r, 16), tonumber(g, 16), tonumber(b, 16)
end

---Calculates an intermediate value between `start` and `finish` based on the interpolation `factor`.
---@param start number
---@param finish number
---@param factor number The interpolation factor between 0 and 1.
---@return number
function math.interp(start, finish, factor)
    return start + (finish - start) * factor
end

---Check if a number is NaN (not a number).
---@param n any
---@return boolean
function math.isnan(n)
    return n ~= n
end

---Check if a number is finite (not NaN or infinity).
---@param n number
---@return boolean
function math.isfinite(n)
    return n == n and n ~= math.huge and n ~= -math.huge
end

---Check if a number is infinite.
---@param n number
---@return boolean
function math.isinfinite(n)
    return n == math.huge or n == -math.huge
end

---Check if a number is an integer (no fractional part).
---@param n number
---@return boolean
function math.isinteger(n)
    return n == math.floor(n)
end

---Get the sign of a number: returns 1, -1, or 0.
---@param n number
---@return number
function math.sign(n)
    if n > 0 then return 1
    elseif n < 0 then return -1
    else return 0 end
end

---Truncate a number toward zero (remove decimal part).
---@param n number
---@return number
function math.trunc(n)
    return n >= 0 and math.floor(n) or math.ceil(n)
end

---Get the fractional part of a number.
---@param n number
---@return number
function math.frac(n)
    return n - math.trunc(n)
end

---Wrap a value within a range [min, max).
---Useful for angles, cyclic values, etc.
---@param n number
---@param min number
---@param max number
---@return number
function math.wrap(n, min, max)
    local range = max - min
    if range == 0 then return min end
    return min + ((n - min) % range)
end

---Map a value from one range to another.
---@param value number
---@param inMin number
---@param inMax number
---@param outMin number
---@param outMax number
---@return number
function math.map(value, inMin, inMax, outMin, outMax)
    if inMin == inMax then return outMin end
    return outMin + (value - inMin) * (outMax - outMin) / (inMax - inMin)
end

---Normalize a value to a 0..1 range within [min, max].
---@param value number
---@param min number
---@param max number
---@return number
function math.normalize(value, min, max)
    if min == max then return 0 end
    return (value - min) / (max - min)
end

---Smooth step interpolation (ease-in-out) between 0 and 1.
---@param edge0 number Lower edge
---@param edge1 number Upper edge
---@param x number Input value
---@return number
function math.smoothstep(edge0, edge1, x)
    x = math.clamp((x - edge0) / (edge1 - edge0), 0.0, 1.0)
    return x * x * (3 - 2 * x)
end

---Smoother step interpolation (Ken Perlin's version) between 0 and 1.
---@param edge0 number Lower edge
---@param edge1 number Upper edge
---@param x number Input value
---@return number
function math.smootherstep(edge0, edge1, x)
    x = math.clamp((x - edge0) / (edge1 - edge0), 0.0, 1.0)
    return x * x * x * (x * (x * 6 - 15) + 10)
end

---Return average (mean) of a list of numbers.
---@param ... number
---@return number
function math.average(...)
    local args = {...}
    local sum = 0
    local count = #args
    if count == 0 then return 0 end
    for i = 1, count do
        sum = sum + args[i]
    end
    return sum / count
end

---Return the sum of a list of numbers.
---@param ... number
---@return number
function math.sum(...)
    local args = {...}
    local total = 0
    for i = 1, #args do
        total = total + args[i]
    end
    return total
end

---Return the minimum value from a table (array of numbers).
---@param t table
---@return number?
function math.tmin(t)
    local min = nil
    for i = 1, #t do
        if min == nil or t[i] < min then
            min = t[i]
        end
    end
    return min
end

---Return the maximum value from a table (array of numbers).
---@param t table
---@return number?
function math.tmax(t)
    local max = nil
    for i = 1, #t do
        if max == nil or t[i] > max then
            max = t[i]
        end
    end
    return max
end

---Return the median of a list of numbers.
---@param t table
---@return number
function math.median(t)
    local sorted = {}
    for i = 1, #t do sorted[i] = t[i] end
    table.sort(sorted)
    local n = #sorted
    if n == 0 then return 0 end
    if n % 2 == 1 then
        return sorted[math.ceil(n / 2)]
    else
        return (sorted[n / 2] + sorted[n / 2 + 1]) / 2
    end
end

---Return the variance of a list of numbers.
---@param t table
---@param population? boolean Use population variance (default: sample variance)
---@return number
function math.variance(t, population)
    local n = #t
    if n < 2 then return 0 end

    local mean = 0
    for i = 1, n do mean = mean + t[i] end
    mean = mean / n

    local sumSq = 0
    for i = 1, n do
        local diff = t[i] - mean
        sumSq = sumSq + diff * diff
    end

    return sumSq / (population and n or (n - 1))
end

---Return the standard deviation of a list of numbers.
---@param t table
---@param population? boolean Use population std dev (default: sample)
---@return number
function math.stddev(t, population)
    return math.sqrt(math.variance(t, population))
end

---Greatest common divisor (GCD) of two integers.
---@param a integer
---@param b integer
---@return integer
function math.gcd(a, b)
    a, b = math.abs(a), math.abs(b)
    while b ~= 0 do
        a, b = b, a % b
    end
    return a
end

---Least common multiple (LCM) of two integers.
---@param a integer
---@param b integer
---@return integer
function math.lcm(a, b)
    if a == 0 or b == 0 then return 0 end
    return math.abs(a * b) / math.gcd(a, b)
end

---Check if an integer is prime.
---@param n integer
---@return boolean
function math.isprime(n)
    if n < 2 then return false end
    if n == 2 then return true end
    if n % 2 == 0 then return false end
    local limit = math.floor(math.sqrt(n))
    for i = 3, limit, 2 do
        if n % i == 0 then return false end
    end
    return true
end

---Factorial of a non-negative integer.
---@param n integer
---@return integer
function math.factorial(n)
    if n < 0 then error('factorial of negative number', 2) end
    if n == 0 then return 1 end
    local result = 1
    for i = 2, n do
        result = result * i
    end
    return result
end

---Fibonacci number at position n (0-indexed).
---@param n integer
---@return integer
function math.fibonacci(n)
    if n < 0 then error('fibonacci of negative index', 2) end
    if n == 0 then return 0 end
    if n == 1 then return 1 end
    local a, b = 0, 1
    for _ = 2, n do
        a, b = b, a + b
    end
    return b
end

---Degrees to radians.
---@param deg number
---@return number
function math.torad(deg)
    return deg * (math.pi / 180.0)
end

---Radians to degrees.
---@param rad number
---@return number
function math.todeg(rad)
    return rad * (180.0 / math.pi)
end

---Calculate the 2D distance between two points.
---@param x1 number
---@param y1 number
---@param x2 number
---@param y2 number
---@return number
function math.dist2d(x1, y1, x2, y2)
    local dx = x2 - x1
    local dy = y2 - y1
    return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
end

---Calculate the 3D distance between two points.
---@param x1 number
---@param y1 number
---@param z1 number
---@param x2 number
---@param y2 number
---@param z2 number
---@return number
function math.dist3d(x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2)
    local dx = x2 - x1
    local dy = y2 - y1
    local dz = z2 - z1
    return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
end

---Calculate bearing angle in degrees from point A to point B (2D, north = 0).
---@param x1 number
---@param y1 number
---@param x2 number
---@param y2 number
---@return number degrees 0-360
function math.bearing(x1, y1, x2, y2)
    local angle = math.todeg(math.atan(x2 - x1, y2 - y1))
    return math.wrap(angle, 0, 360)
end

---Return a random float between min and max.
---@param min number
---@param max number
---@return number
function math.randomfloat(min, max)
    return min + math.random() * (max - min)
end

---Round to the nearest multiple of `step`.
---@param value number
---@param step number
---@return number
function math.roundtostep(value, step)
    if step == 0 then return value end
    return math.floor(value / step + 0.5) * step
end

---Linear interpolation shorthand (alias for math.interp, scalar only).
---@param a number
---@param b number
---@param t number Factor 0..1
---@return number
function math.mix(a, b, t)
    return a + (b - a) * t
end

---Inverse linear interpolation: given a value between a and b, return the factor.
---@param a number
---@param b number
---@param value number
---@return number factor 0..1 (unclamped)
function math.inverselerp(a, b, value)
    if a == b then return 0 end
    return (value - a) / (b - a)
end

---Re-map a value from one [inMin, inMax] range to [outMin, outMax], clamped.
---@param value number
---@param inMin number
---@param inMax number
---@param outMin number
---@param outMax number
---@return number
function math.remap(value, inMin, inMax, outMin, outMax)
    return math.clamp(math.map(value, inMin, inMax, outMin, outMax), outMin, outMax)
end

---Exponential decay: moves `current` toward `target` by `decay` per second.
---Use in render/tick loops: value = math.decay(value, target, decay, dt)
---@param current number
---@param target number
---@param decay number Decay rate (higher = faster)
---@param dt number Delta time in seconds
---@return number
function math.decay(current, target, decay, dt)
    return target + (current - target) * math.exp(-decay * dt)
end

---Check if two numbers are approximately equal within an epsilon.
---@param a number
---@param b number
---@param epsilon? number Default 1e-9
---@return boolean
function math.approxequal(a, b, epsilon)
    epsilon = epsilon or 1e-9
    return math.abs(a - b) <= epsilon
end

---Safe divide: returns fallback if denominator is zero.
---@param numerator number
---@param denominator number
---@param fallback? number Default 0
---@return number
function math.safediv(numerator, denominator, fallback)
    if denominator == 0 then return fallback or 0 end
    return numerator / denominator
end

---Percentage: what percent is `part` of `total`?
---@param part number
---@param total number
---@return number 0..100
function math.percent(part, total)
    if total == 0 then return 0 end
    return (part / total) * 100
end

---Convert a percentage (0..100) to a 0..1 factor.
---@param pct number
---@return number
function math.percenttofactor(pct)
    return math.clamp(pct / 100, 0, 1)
end


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\resource\rhd_utils\shared\safecall.lua
local f = setmetatable({}, {
    __newindex = function(self, key, fn)
        rawset(self, key, fn)
    end
})

---@param cb function Callback function to execute safely
---@param ... any Arguments to pass to callback
---@return any|nil result Returns callback result or nil on error
function f.fun(cb, ...)
    assert(type(cb) == 'function', 'safecall: callback must be a function')

    local success, result = pcall(cb, ...)

    if not success then
        local info = debug.getinfo(2, 'Sl')
        local source = info.source:match('^@?(.+)$') or info.source
        local line = info.currentline or 0
        
        lib.print.error(('safecall failed at %s:%d\n%s'):format(source, line, result))
        return nil
    end

    return result
end

_ENV.safecall = f

---Split string by delimiter
---@param s string
---@param delimiter string
---@param plain? boolean Use plain text matching (default: true)
---@return table
function string.split(s, delimiter, plain)
    if plain == nil then plain = true end
    
    local result = {}
    local from = 1
    local delim_from, delim_to = s:find(delimiter, from, plain)
    
    while delim_from do
        result[#result + 1] = s:sub(from, delim_from - 1)
        from = delim_to + 1
        delim_from, delim_to = s:find(delimiter, from, plain)
    end
    
    result[#result + 1] = s:sub(from)
    return result
end

---Join table elements with delimiter
---@param tbl table
---@param delimiter string
---@return string
function string.join(tbl, delimiter)
    return table.concat(tbl, delimiter)
end

---Check if string starts with prefix
---@param s string
---@param prefix string
---@return boolean
function string.startswith(s, prefix)
    return s:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix
end

---Check if string ends with suffix
---@param s string
---@param suffix string
---@return boolean
function string.endswith(s, suffix)
    return s:sub(-#suffix) == suffix
end

---Check if string contains substring
---@param s string
---@param substr string
---@param plain? boolean Use plain text matching (default: true)
---@return boolean
function string.contains(s, substr, plain)
    if plain == nil then plain = true end
    return s:find(substr, 1, plain) ~= nil
end

---Count occurrences of substring
---@param s string
---@param substr string
---@param plain? boolean Use plain text matching (default: true)
---@return number
function string.count(s, substr, plain)
    if plain == nil then plain = true end
    
    local count = 0
    local pos = 1
    
    while true do
        local found = s:find(substr, pos, plain)
        if not found then break end
        count = count + 1
        pos = found + 1
    end
    
    return count
end

---Replace all occurrences
---@param s string
---@param old string
---@param new string
---@param plain? boolean Use plain text matching (default: true)
---@return string
function string.replace(s, old, new, plain)
    if plain == nil then plain = true end
    if plain then
        old = old:gsub('[%^%$%(%)%%%.%[%]%*%+%-%?]', '%%%1')
    end
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: redundant-return-value
    return s:gsub(old, new)
end

---Capitalize first character
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.capitalize(s)
    return s:sub(1, 1):upper() .. s:sub(2)
end

---Convert to title case
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.title(s)
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: redundant-return-value
    return s:gsub('(%a)([%w_]*)', function(first, rest)
        return first:upper() .. rest:lower()
    end)
end

---Convert to camelCase
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.camelcase(s)
    local result = s:gsub('[%s_-]+(%w)', function(c) return c:upper() end)
    return result:sub(1, 1):lower() .. result:sub(2)
end

---Convert to PascalCase
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.pascalcase(s)
    local result = s:gsub('[%s_-]+(%w)', function(c) return c:upper() end)
    return result:sub(1, 1):upper() .. result:sub(2)
end

---Convert to snake_case
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.snakecase(s)
    local result = s:gsub('([A-Z])', '_%1'):lower()
    result = result:gsub('[%s-]+', '_')
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: redundant-return-value
    return result:gsub('^_', '')
end

---Convert to kebab-case
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.kebabcase(s)
    local result = s:gsub('([A-Z])', '-%1'):lower()
    result = result:gsub('[%s_]+', '-')
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: redundant-return-value
    return result:gsub('^-', '')
end

---Convert to CONSTANT_CASE
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.constantcase(s)
    return string.snakecase(s):upper()
end

---Convert to specified case
---@param s string
---@param caseType CaseType
---@return string
function string.tocase(s, caseType)
    if caseType == 'upper' then
        return s:upper()
    elseif caseType == 'lower' then
        return s:lower()
    elseif caseType == 'title' then
        return string.title(s)
    elseif caseType == 'sentence' then
        return string.capitalize(s:lower())
    elseif caseType == 'camel' then
        return string.camelcase(s)
    elseif caseType == 'pascal' then
        return string.pascalcase(s)
    elseif caseType == 'snake' then
        return string.snakecase(s)
    elseif caseType == 'kebab' then
        return string.kebabcase(s)
    elseif caseType == 'constant' then
        return string.constantcase(s)
    end
    return s
end

---Repeat string n times
---@param s string
---@param count number
---@param separator? string
---@return string
function string.repeatstr(s, count, separator)
    separator = separator or ''
    local result = {}
    for i = 1, count do
        result[#result + 1] = s
    end
    return table.concat(result, separator)
end

---Pad string to length
---@param s string
---@param length number
---@param char? string Character to pad with (default: ' ')
---@param direction? 'left'|'right'|'both' Direction to pad (default: 'right')
---@return string
function string.pad(s, length, char, direction)
    char = char or ' '
    direction = direction or 'right'
    
    local len = #s
    if len >= length then return s end
    
    local padding = string.rep(char, length - len)
    
    if direction == 'left' then
        return padding .. s
    elseif direction == 'right' then
        return s .. padding
    elseif direction == 'both' then
        local leftPad = math.floor((length - len) / 2)
        local rightPad = length - len - leftPad
        return string.rep(char, leftPad) .. s .. string.rep(char, rightPad)
    end
    
    return s
end

---Truncate string to length
---@param s string
---@param length number
---@param suffix? string Suffix to add (default: '...')
---@return string
function string.truncate(s, length, suffix)
    suffix = suffix or '...'
    if #s <= length then return s end
    return s:sub(1, length - #suffix) .. suffix
end

---Get substring between two delimiters
---@param s string
---@param start_delim string
---@param end_delim string
---@return string?
function string.between(s, start_delim, end_delim)
    local start_pos = s:find(start_delim, 1, true)
    if not start_pos then return nil end
    
    start_pos = start_pos + #start_delim
    local end_pos = s:find(end_delim, start_pos, true)
    if not end_pos then return nil end
    
    return s:sub(start_pos, end_pos - 1)
end

---Extract all matches of pattern
---@param s string
---@param pattern string
---@return table
function string.extract(s, pattern)
    local result = {}
    for match in s:gmatch(pattern) do
        result[#result + 1] = match
    end
    return result
end

---Slugify string (URL-friendly)
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.slugify(s)
    s = s:lower()
    s = s:gsub('[Ã Ã¡Ã¢Ã£Ã¤Ã¥]', 'a')
    s = s:gsub('[Ã¨Ã©ÃªÃ«]', 'e')
    s = s:gsub('[Ã¬Ã­Ã®Ã¯]', 'i')
    s = s:gsub('[Ã²Ã³Ã´ÃµÃ¶]', 'o')
    s = s:gsub('[Ã¹ÃºÃ»Ã¼]', 'u')
    s = s:gsub('[Ã±]', 'n')
    s = s:gsub('[Ã§]', 'c')
    s = s:gsub('[^%w%s-]', '')

---Calculate Levenshtein distance
---@param str1 string
---@param str2 string
---@return number
function string.levenshtein(str1, str2)
    if str1 == str2 then return 0 end
    if #str1 == 0 then return #str2 end
    if #str2 == 0 then return #str1 end
    
    local matrix = {}
    
    for i = 0, #str1 do
        matrix[i] = { [0] = i }
    end
    
    for j = 0, #str2 do
        matrix[0][j] = j
    end
    
    for i = 1, #str1 do
        for j = 1, #str2 do
            local cost = str1:sub(i, i) == str2:sub(j, j) and 0 or 1
            matrix[i][j] = math.min(
                matrix[i - 1][j] + 1,
                matrix[i][j - 1] + 1,
                matrix[i - 1][j - 1] + cost
            )
        end
    end
    
    return matrix[#str1][#str2]
end

---Calculate similarity percentage
---@param str1 string
---@param str2 string
---@return number percentage 0-100
function string.similarity(str1, str2)
    local distance = string.levenshtein(str1, str2)
    local maxLen = math.max(#str1, #str2)
    if maxLen == 0 then return 100 end
    return (1 - distance / maxLen) * 100
end

---Word wrap text
---@param s string
---@param width number
---@return string
function string.wordwrap(s, width)
    local result = {}
    local line = ''
    
    for word in s:gmatch('%S+') do
        if #line + #word + 1 > width then
            result[#result + 1] = line
            line = word
        else
            line = line == '' and word or line .. ' ' .. word
        end
    end
    
    if #line > 0 then
        result[#result + 1] = line
    end
    
    return table.concat(result, '\n')
end

---Get lines from string
---@param s string
---@return table
function string.lines(s)
    local result = {}
    for line in s:gmatch('[^\r\n]+') do
        result[#result + 1] = line
    end
    return result
end

---Encode to base64
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.base64encode(s)
    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    return ((s:gsub('.', function(x)
        local r, b = '', x:byte()
        for i = 8, 1, -1 do r = r .. (b % 2 ^ i - b % 2 ^ (i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0') end
        return r
    end) .. '0000'):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if #x < 6 then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 6 do c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2 ^ (6 - i) or 0) end
        return b:sub(c + 1, c + 1)
    end) .. ({ '', '==', '=' })[#s % 3 + 1])
end

---Decode from base64
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.base64decode(s)
    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    s = s:gsub('[^' .. b .. '=]', '')
    return (s:gsub('.', function(x)
        if x == '=' then return '' end
        local r, f = '', b:find(x) - 1
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do r = r .. (f % 2 ^ i - f % 2 ^ (i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0') end
        return r
    end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 8 do c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2 ^ (8 - i) or 0) end
        return string.char(c)
    end))
end

---Generate UUID v4
---@return string
function string.uuid()
    local template = 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: redundant-return-value
    return template:gsub('[xy]', function(c)
        local v = (c == 'x') and math.random(0, 0xf) or math.random(8, 0xb)
        return string.format('%x', v)
    end)
end

---Convert string to bytes table
---@param s string
---@return table
function string.bytes(s)
    local result = {}
    for i = 1, #s do
        result[#result + 1] = s:byte(i)
    end
    return result
end

---Convert bytes table to string
---@param bytes table
---@return string
function string.frombytes(bytes)
    return string.char(table.unpack(bytes))
end

---Format string with template
---@param template string Template with {key} placeholders
---@param data table Data to insert
---@return string
function string.template(template, data)
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: redundant-return-value
    return template:gsub('{(%w+)}', function(key)
        return tostring(data[key] or '')
    end)
end

---Hash string (simple djb2)
---@param s string
---@return number
function string.hash(s)
    local hash = 5381
    for i = 1, #s do
        hash = ((hash * 33) + s:byte(i)) % 2147483647
    end
    return hash
end

---Iterate with callback, return first match with truthy result
---@param t table
---@param fn fun(value: any, key: any): boolean?
---@return any? value
---@return any? key
function table.forEach(t, fn)
    for k, v in pairs(t) do
        local res = fn and fn(v, k)
        if res then return v, k end
    end
end

---@return boolean
function table.some(t, fn)

            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

---Pick specific keys from table
---@param t table
---@param keys table
---@return table
function table.pick(t, keys)
    local result = {}
    
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
        if t[key] ~= nil then
            result[key] = t[key]
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

---Omit specific keys from table
---@param t table
---@param keys table
---@return table
function table.omit(t, keys)
    local result = table.clone(t)
    local keySet = {}
    
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
        keySet[key] = true
    end
    
    for k in pairs(result) do
        if keySet[k] then
            result[k] = nil
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

---Get value by path (dot notation)
---@param t table
---@param path string
---@return any?
function table.get(t, path)
    local keys = {}
    for key in path:gmatch('[^.]+') do
        keys[#keys + 1] = key
    end
    
    local current = t
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
        if type(current) ~= 'table' then
            return nil
        end
        current = current[key]
    end
    
    return current
end

---Set value by path (dot notation)
---@param t table
---@param path string
---@param value any
function table.set(t, path, value)
    local keys = {}
    for key in path:gmatch('[^.]+') do
        keys[#keys + 1] = key
    end
    
    local current = t
    for i = 1, #keys - 1 do
        local key = keys[i]
        if type(current[key]) ~= 'table' then
            current[key] = {}
        end
        current = current[key]
    end
    
    current[keys[#keys]] = value
end

---Delete value by path (dot notation)
---@param t table
---@param path string
function table.delete(t, path)
    local keys = {}
    for key in path:gmatch('[^.]+') do
        keys[#keys + 1] = key
    end
    
    local current = t
    for i = 1, #keys - 1 do
        local key = keys[i]
        if type(current[key]) ~= 'table' then
            return
        end
        current = current[key]
    end
    
    current[keys[#keys]] = nil
end

---Convert table to JSON string
---@param t table
---@return string
function table.toJSON(t)
    local function serialize(val)
        local valType = type(val)
        
        if valType == 'table' then
            local isArray = #val > 0
            local result = {}
            
            if isArray then
                for i, v in ipairs(val) do
                    result[#result + 1] = serialize(v)
                end
                return '[' .. table.concat(result, ',') .. ']'
            else
                for k, v in pairs(val) do
                    result[#result + 1] = '"' .. tostring(k) .. '":' .. serialize(v)
                end
                return '{' .. table.concat(result, ',') .. '}'
            end
        elseif valType == 'string' then
            return '"' .. val:gsub('"', '\\"') .. '"'
        elseif valType == 'number' or valType == 'boolean' then
            return tostring(val)
        else
            return 'null'
        end
    end
    
    return serialize(t)
end

---Print table structure (for debugging)
---@param t table
---@param indent? number
---@return string
function table.print(t, indent)
    indent = indent or 0
    local result = {}
    local prefix = string.rep('  ', indent)
    
    for k, v in pairs(t) do
        if type(v) == 'table' then
            result[#result + 1] = prefix .. tostring(k) .. ' = {'
            result[#result + 1] = table.print(v, indent + 1)
            result[#result + 1] = prefix .. '}'
        else
            result[#result + 1] = prefix .. tostring(k) .. ' = ' .. tostring(v)
        end
    end
    
    return table.concat(result, '\n')
end

---Flatten nested array by one level
---@param t table
---@return table
function array.flatten(t)
    local result = {}
    
    for _, v in ipairs(t) do
        if type(v) == 'table' then
            for _, inner in ipairs(v) do
                result[#result + 1] = inner
            end
        else
            result[#result + 1] = v
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

---Deep flatten nested arrays
---@param t table
---@return table
function array.deepflatten(t)
    local result = {}
    
    local function flatten_recursive(tbl_inner)
        for _, v in ipairs(tbl_inner) do
            if type(v) == 'table' then
                flatten_recursive(v)
            else
                result[#result + 1] = v
            end
        end
    end
    
    flatten_recursive(t)
    return result
end

---Get unique values from array
---@param t table
---@return table
function array.unique(t)
    local seen = {}
    local result = {}
    
    for _, v in ipairs(t) do
        if not seen[v] then
            seen[v] = true
            result[#result + 1] = v
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

---Get intersection of two arrays
---@param t1 table
---@param t2 table
---@return table
function array.intersection(t1, t2)
    local result = {}
    local set = {}
    
    for _, v in ipairs(t2) do
        set[v] = true
    end
    
    for _, v in ipairs(t1) do
        if set[v] then
            result[#result + 1] = v
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

---Get difference between two arrays (elements in t1 but not in t2)
---@param t1 table
---@param t2 table
---@return table
function array.difference(t1, t2)
    local result = {}
    local set = {}
    
    for _, v in ipairs(t2) do
        set[v] = true
    end
    
    for _, v in ipairs(t1) do
        if not set[v] then
            result[#result + 1] = v
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

---Get union of two arrays
---@param t1 table
---@param t2 table
---@return table
function array.union(t1, t2)
    local combined = {}
    for _, v in ipairs(t1) do
        combined[#combined + 1] = v
    end
    for _, v in ipairs(t2) do
        combined[#combined + 1] = v
    end
    return array.unique(combined)
end

---Get random element from array

---Get random elements from array (without duplicates)
---@param t table
---@param count number
---@return table
function array.sample(t, count)
    local result = {}
    local indices = {}
    local len = #t
    
    count = math.min(count, len)
    
    while #indices < count do
        local idx = math.random(len)
        if not indices[idx] then
            indices[idx] = true
            result[#result + 1] = t[idx]
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

---Chunk array into smaller arrays
---@param t table
---@param size number
---@return table
function array.chunk(t, size)
    local result = {}
    
    for i = 1, #t, size do
        local chunk = {}
        for j = i, math.min(i + size - 1, #t) do
            chunk[#chunk + 1] = t[j]
        end
        result[#result + 1] = chunk
    end
    
    return result
end

---Partition array by predicate
---@param t table
---@param fn fun(value: any, key: any): boolean
---@return table truthy
---@return table falsy
function array.partition(t, fn)
    local truthy = {}
    local falsy = {}
    
    for k, v in pairs(t) do
        if fn(v, k) then
            truthy[#truthy + 1] = v
        else
            falsy[#falsy + 1] = v
        end
    end
    
    return truthy, falsy
end

---Group array elements by key function
---@param t table
---@param fn fun(value: any): any
---@return table
function array.groupBy(t, fn)
    local result = {}
    
    for _, v in ipairs(t) do
        local key = fn(v)
        if not result[key] then
            result[key] = {}
        end
        result[key][#result[key] + 1] = v
    end
    
    return result
end

---Count occurrences of each value
---@param t table
---@return table
function array.countBy(t)
    local result = {}
    
    for _, v in pairs(t) do
        result[v] = (result[v] or 0) + 1
    end
    
    return result
end

---Zip multiple arrays together
---@param ... table
---@return table
function array.zip(...)
    local args = {...}
    local result = {}
    local maxLen = 0
    
    for _, t in ipairs(args) do
        maxLen = math.max(maxLen, #t)
    end
    
    for i = 1, maxLen do
        local row = {}
        for _, t in ipairs(args) do
            row[#row + 1] = t[i]
        end
        result[#result + 1] = row
    end
    
    return result
end

---Unzip array of arrays
---@param t table
---@return table ...
function array.unzip(t)
    if #t == 0 then return {} end
    
    local result = {}
    local maxLen = 0
    
    for _, row in ipairs(t) do
        maxLen = math.max(maxLen, #row)
    end
    
    for i = 1, maxLen do
        result[i] = {}
        for _, row in ipairs(t) do
            result[i][#result[i] + 1] = row[i]
        end
    end
    
    return table.unpack(result)
end

---Create array from range
---@param start_val number
---@param end_val number
---@param step? number
---@return table
function array.range(start_val, end_val, step)
    step = step or 1
    local result = {}
    
    if step > 0 then
        for i = start_val, end_val, step do
            result[#result + 1] = i
        end
    else
        for i = start_val, end_val, step do
            result[#result + 1] = i
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

---Create array filled with value
---@param count number
---@param value any
---@return table
function array.create(count, value)
    local result = {}
    for i = 1, count do
        result[i] = value
    end
    return result
end

---Sort array and return new table (non-mutating)
---@param t table
---@param compareFn? fun(a: any, b: any): boolean
---@return table
function array.sorted(t, compareFn)
    local result = table.clone(t)
    table.sort(result, compareFn)
    return result
end

---Concatenate multiple arrays
---@param ... table
---@return table
function array.concat(...)
    local result = {}
    
    for i = 1, select('#', ...) do
        local t = select(i, ...)
        for j = 1, #t do
            result[#result + 1] = t[j]
        end
    end
    
    return result
end


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\resource\sm_drugsystem\client\main.lua
local config = localmodule 'config.shared'
local Growth = localmodule 'modules.growth'
local Placer = localmodule 'modules.placer'
local Render = localmodule 'modules.render'
local Scene = localmodule 'modules.scene'

local TICK_MS = 250
local ANIMATE_EVERY = 4

---@type table<integer, DrugClientObject>
local objects = {}
---@type table<DrugClientObject, true>
local pending = {}
local busy = false

---@param description string
---@param kind? NotificationType
local function notify(description, kind)
    lib.notify({ description = description, type = kind or 'info' })
end

---@param obj DrugClientObject
local function schedule(obj)
    pending[obj] = true
end

---@param fn fun()
---@return fun()
local function async(fn)
    return function()
        CreateThread(fn)
    end
end

---@param obj DrugClientObject
---@return boolean
local function isReady(obj)
    return obj.state.progress ~= nil and Render.progress(obj) >= 1
end

---@param id integer
local function remove(id)
    local obj = objects[id]

    if not obj then return end

    objects[id] = nil
    obj.point:remove()
    obj.removed = true
    obj.visible = false
    schedule(obj)
end

---@param obj DrugClientObject
---@param amount integer
---@param cleanup? fun()
---@return boolean
local function cook(obj, amount, cleanup)
    local cooking = config.cooking

    obj.locked = false
    Render.sync(obj)

    if cleanup then
        cleanup()
    end

    return lib.progressBar({
        duration = cooking.batchMs * amount,
        label = ('%s x%d'):format(cooking.label, amount),
        canCancel = true,
        disable = { move = true, sprint = true, car = true, combat = true },
    }) == true
end

---@param obj DrugClientObject
---@param action string
---@param option? any
---@param amount? integer
local function runAction(obj, action, option, amount)
    if busy then return end

    busy = true

    local ok, message, granted, minimum = lib.callback.await('sm_drugsystem:start', false, obj.id, action, option, amount)

    if not ok then
        busy = false
        return notify(message or 'Tidak bisa sekarang', 'error')
    end

    if not obj.parts then
        TriggerServerEvent('sm_drugsystem:server:cancel', obj.id)
        busy = false
        return
    end

    obj.locked = true

    local completed, cleanup, failed = true, nil, false
    local data

    if Scene.supported(action, obj) then
        completed, cleanup, failed = Scene.play(action, obj, option, granted, action == 'cook' and config.cooking.sceneMs or minimum)
    end

    if completed and action == 'cook' then
        completed = cook(obj, granted, cleanup)
    end

    if completed then
        ok, message, data = lib.callback.await('sm_drugsystem:finish', false, obj.id)
    else
        TriggerServerEvent('sm_drugsystem:server:cancel', obj.id)
        ok, message = false, failed and 'Terjadi kesalahan, cek console F8' or 'Dibatalkan'
    end

    if ok and data then
        obj.state = data.state
        obj.receivedAt = GetGameTimer()
    elseif ok then
        remove(obj.id)
    end

    obj.locked = false
    Render.sync(obj)

    if cleanup then
        cleanup()
    end

    busy = false

    if message then
        notify(message, ok and 'success' or 'error')
    end
end

---@param obj DrugClientObject
---@param callback string
local function request(obj, callback)
    if busy then return end

    busy = true

    local ok, message = lib.callback.await(callback, false, obj.id)

    busy = false

    if message then
        notify(message, ok and 'success' or 'error')
    end
end

---@param name string
---@return string
local function itemLabel(name)
    return ox_inventory:Items(name)?.label or name
end

---@alias DrugRecipe { input: table<string, integer>, output: string, amount: { min: integer, max: integer } }

---@param recipe DrugRecipe
---@param limit integer
---@return integer
local function craftable(recipe, limit)
    local batches = limit

    for item, count in pairs(recipe.input) do
        batches = math.min(batches, math.floor(ox_inventory:GetItemCount(item) / count))
    end

    return batches
end

---@param recipe DrugRecipe
---@return string
local function describeRecipe(recipe)
    local inputs = {}

    for item, count in pairs(recipe.input) do
        inputs[#inputs + 1] = ('%dx %s'):format(count, itemLabel(item))
    end

    return ('%s â†’ %d-%dx %s'):format(table.concat(inputs, ' + '), recipe.amount.min, recipe.amount.max, itemLabel(recipe.output))
end

---@param obj DrugClientObject
local function inspect(obj)
    local state = obj.state
    local equipment = config.equipment[obj.kind]
    local station = config.stations[equipment.group]

    if equipment.group == 'table' then
        local cooking = config.cooking

        return notify(('Per kelipatan (%d detik): %s. Bisa dimasak: x%d'):format(cooking.batchMs // 1000, describeRecipe(cooking), craftable(cooking, cooking.maxBatches)))
    end

    if station then
        local left = Render.timeLeft(obj)

        if not left then
            return notify(('%s siap dipakai'):format(equipment.label))
        end

        if left > 0 then
            return notify(('%s sedang diproses, %d detik lagi'):format(itemLabel(station.output), math.ceil(left)))
        end

        return notify(('%s siap diambil'):format(itemLabel(station.output)), 'success')
    end

    if not state.soil then
        return notify('Pot masih kosong, isi tanah dulu')
    end

    local plant = config.plants[state.seed]

    if not plant then
        return notify(state.watered and 'Tanah sudah disiram, tinggal tanam benih' or 'Tanah siap, tanam benih')
    end

    if not state.watered then
        return notify(('%s belum disiram'):format(plant.label), 'warning')
    end

    local progress = Render.progress(obj)

    if progress >= 1 then
        return notify(('%s siap dipanen'):format(plant.label), 'success')
    end

    local left = math.ceil((1 - progress) / Growth.rate(state.lamp))
    local lamp = state.lamp and ', UV Lamp aktif' or ''

    notify(('%s tumbuh %d%%, siap dalam %d detik%s'):format(plant.label, math.floor(progress * 100), left, lamp))
end

---@param obj DrugClientObject
---@param index integer
---@param recipe DrugRecipe
---@param batches integer
local function startPacking(obj, index, recipe, batches)
    local amount = 1

    if batches > 1 then
        local input = lib.inputDialog(itemLabel(recipe.output), {
            {
                type = 'slider',
                label = 'Kelipatan',
                min = 1,
                max = batches,
                step = 1,
                default = 1,
            },
        })

        if not input then return end

        amount = math.floor(input[1])
    end

    runAction(obj, 'pack', index, amount)
end

---@param obj DrugClientObject
local function openPacking(obj)
    local equipment = config.equipment[obj.kind]
    local options = {}

    for index, recipe in ipairs(config.packing.recipes[equipment.group]) do
        local batches = craftable(recipe, config.packing.maxBatches)

        options[index] = {
            title = itemLabel(recipe.output),
            description = describeRecipe(recipe),
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-box',
            disabled = batches == 0,
            metadata = { ('Bisa diproses: x%d'):format(batches) },
            onSelect = async(function()
                startPacking(obj, index, recipe, batches)
            end),
        }
    end

    lib.registerContext({
        id = 'sm_drugsystem:packing',
        title = equipment.label,
        options = options,
    })
    lib.showContext('sm_drugsystem:packing')
end

---@alias DrugBatchRecipe { label: string, icon: string, start: string, maxBatches: integer, input: table<string, integer>, output: string, amount: { min: integer, max: integer } }

---@param obj DrugClientObject
---@param action string
---@param recipe DrugBatchRecipe
---@param seconds integer
local function startBatch(obj, action, recipe, seconds)
    local input = lib.inputDialog(recipe.label, {
        {
            type = 'slider',
            label = ('Kelipatan (%d detik per kelipatan)'):format(seconds),
            description = ('Per kelipatan: %s'):format(describeRecipe(recipe)),
            min = 1,
            max = recipe.maxBatches,
            step = 1,
            default = 1,
        },
    })

    if not input then return end

    runAction(obj, action, nil, math.floor(input[1]))
end

---@param obj DrugClientObject
---@param action string
---@param recipe DrugBatchRecipe
---@param seconds integer
local function openBatch(obj, action, recipe, seconds)
    local options = {}

    for item, count in pairs(recipe.input) do
        local owned = ox_inventory:GetItemCount(item)
        local enough = owned >= count

        options[#options + 1] = {
            title = itemLabel(item),
            description = ('Butuh %dx per kelipatan, kamu punya %d'):format(count, owned),
            icon = enough and 'fa-solid fa-check' or 'fa-solid fa-xmark',
            iconColor = enough and '#40c057' or '#fa5252',
            readOnly = true,
        }
    end

    options[#options + 1] = {
        title = recipe.start,
        description = describeRecipe(recipe),
        icon = recipe.icon,
        metadata = {
            ('Bisa diproses: x%d'):format(craftable(recipe, recipe.maxBatches)),
            ('Durasi: %d detik per kelipatan'):format(seconds),
        },
        onSelect = async(function()
            startBatch(obj, action, recipe, seconds)
        end),
    }

    lib.registerContext({
        id = 'sm_drugsystem:batch',
        title = recipe.label,
        options = options,
    })
    lib.showContext('sm_drugsystem:batch')
end

---@param obj DrugClientObject
---@return table[]
local function optionsFor(obj)
    local equipment = config.equipment[obj.kind]
    local station = config.stations[equipment.group]
    local distance = config.targetDistance
    local options = {}

    if equipment.group == 'pot' then
        options[#options + 1] = {
            name = 'sm_drugsystem:soil',
            label = 'Isi Tanah',
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-trowel',
            distance = distance,
            items = config.grow.soilItem,
            canInteract = function()
                return not obj.state.soil
            end,
            onSelect = async(function()
                runAction(obj, 'soil')
            end),
        }

        for name, plant in pairs(config.plants) do
            options[#options + 1] = {
                name = ('sm_drugsystem:seed_%s'):format(name),
                label = ('Tanam Benih %s'):format(plant.label),
                icon = 'fa-solid fa-seedling',
                distance = distance,
                items = plant.seed,
                canInteract = function()
                    return obj.state.soil and not obj.state.seed
                end,
                onSelect = async(function()
                    runAction(obj, 'seed', name)
                end),
            }
        end

        options[#options + 1] = {
            name = 'sm_drugsystem:water',
            label = 'Siram',
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-droplet',
            distance = distance,
            items = config.grow.waterItem,
            canInteract = function()
                return obj.state.soil and not isReady(obj)
            end,
            onSelect = async(function()
                runAction(obj, 'water')
            end),
        }

        options[#options + 1] = {
            name = 'sm_drugsystem:harvest',
            label = 'Panen',
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-scissors',
            distance = distance,
            items = config.grow.harvestTool,
            canInteract = function()
                return isReady(obj)
            end,
            onSelect = async(function()
                runAction(obj, 'harvest')
            end),
        }
    elseif equipment.group == 'table' then
        options[#options + 1] = {
            name = 'sm_drugsystem:cook',
            label = config.cooking.label,
            icon = config.cooking.icon,
            distance = distance,
            onSelect = function()
                openBatch(obj, 'cook', config.cooking, config.cooking.batchMs // 1000)
            end,
        }
    elseif station then
        options[#options + 1] = {
            name = 'sm_drugsystem:process',
            label = station.label,
            icon = station.icon,
            distance = distance,
            items = not station.maxBatches and station.input or nil,
            canInteract = function()
                return obj.state.remaining == nil
            end,
            onSelect = station.maxBatches and function()
                openBatch(obj, 'process', station, station.seconds)
            end or async(function()
                runAction(obj, 'process')
            end),
        }

        options[#options + 1] = {
            name = 'sm_drugsystem:collect',
            label = 'Ambil Hasil',
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-hand-holding',
            distance = distance,
            canInteract = function()
                return Render.timeLeft(obj) == 0
            end,
            onSelect = async(function()
                runAction(obj, 'collect')
            end),
        }
    elseif config.packing.recipes[equipment.group] then
        options[#options + 1] = {
            name = 'sm_drugsystem:pack',
            label = 'Packing',
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-box',
            distance = distance,
            onSelect = function()
                openPacking(obj)
            end,
        }
    end

    if equipment.group == 'pot' or equipment.group == 'table' or station then
        options[#options + 1] = {
            name = 'sm_drugsystem:inspect',
            label = 'Periksa',
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass',
            distance = distance,
            onSelect = function()
                inspect(obj)
            end,
        }
    end

    options[#options + 1] = {
        name = 'sm_drugsystem:remove',
        label = ('Ambil %s'):format(equipment.label),
        icon = 'fa-solid fa-hand',
        distance = distance,
        onSelect = async(function()
            request(obj, 'sm_drugsystem:remove')
        end),
    }

    return options
end

---@param obj DrugClientObject
local function add(obj)
    obj.receivedAt = GetGameTimer()
    obj.options = optionsFor(obj)
    obj.optionNames = {}

    for i = 1, #obj.options do
        obj.optionNames[i] = obj.options[i].name
    end

    obj.point = lib.points.new({
        coords = obj.coords,
        distance = config.renderDistance,
        onEnter = function()
            obj.visible = true
            schedule(obj)
        end,
        onExit = function()
            obj.visible = false
            schedule(obj)
        end,
    })

    objects[obj.id] = obj
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_drugsystem:client:snapshot', function(list)
    for id in pairs(objects) do
        remove(id)
    end

    for i = 1, #list do
        add(list[i])
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_drugsystem:client:upsert', function(data)
    local obj = objects[data.id]

    if not obj then
        return add(data)
    end

    obj.state = data.state
    obj.receivedAt = GetGameTimer()
    schedule(obj)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_drugsystem:client:remove', remove)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_drugsystem:client:place', function(kind, slot)
    local equipment = config.equipment[kind]

    if busy or not equipment then return end

    if cache.vehicle then
        return notify('Turun dari kendaraan dulu', 'error')
    end

    busy = true

    local coords, heading = Placer.start(equipment.model)

    if coords then
        local ok, message = lib.callback.await('sm_drugsystem:place', false, kind, coords, heading, slot)

        if not ok then
            notify(message or 'Gagal memasang', 'error')
        end
    end

    busy = false
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource then return end

    Scene.abort()

    for _, obj in pairs(objects) do
        Render.clear(obj)
    end
end)

CreateThread(function()
    local tick = 0

    while true do
        local batch = pending

        pending = {}

        for obj in pairs(batch) do
            Render.sync(obj)
        end

        tick += 1

        if tick >= ANIMATE_EVERY then
            local animated = {}

            tick = 0

            for _, obj in pairs(objects) do
                if Render.animated(obj) then
                    animated[#animated + 1] = obj
                end
            end

            for i = 1, #animated do
                Render.sync(animated[i])
            end
        end

        Wait(TICK_MS)
    end
end)

TriggerServerEvent('sm_drugsystem:server:requestSnapshot')
