########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\resource\tacticalgas\modules\effects.lua
local config = localmodule 'config.shared'

local progressBar = config.progressBar
local barColor = progressBar.color
local barLabel = progressBar.label

local DrawRect = DrawRect
local DrawSprite = DrawSprite
local SetTextFont = SetTextFont
local SetTextScale = SetTextScale
local SetTextColour = SetTextColour
local BeginTextCommandDisplayText = BeginTextCommandDisplayText
local AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName = AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName
local EndTextCommandDisplayText = EndTextCommandDisplayText
local GetSafeZoneSize = GetSafeZoneSize
local IsEntityPlayingAnim = IsEntityPlayingAnim
local TaskPlayAnim = TaskPlayAnim

local BAR_WIDTH = 0.13
local BAR_HEIGHT = 0.038
local BAR_FILL_WIDTH = 0.0516
local BAR_FILL_HEIGHT = 0.0105
local BAR_FILL_OFFSET = 0.03
local TEXTURE_DICT = 'timerbars'

local effects = {}

function effects.playAnim(dict, clip)
    if IsEntityPlayingAnim(cache.ped, dict, clip, 3) then return end

    if not lib.requestAnimDict(dict, 5000) then return end

    TaskPlayAnim(cache.ped, dict, clip, 8.0, -8.0, -1, 51, 0, false, false, false)
end

local function drawText(text, x, y)
    SetTextFont(0)
    SetTextScale(0.32, 0.32)
    SetTextColour(254, 254, 254, 255)
    BeginTextCommandDisplayText('STRING')
    AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(text)
    EndTextCommandDisplayText(x, y)
end

function effects.drawRecoveryBar(progress)
    local safeZone = GetSafeZoneSize()
    local x = safeZone - (BAR_WIDTH / 2)
    local y = safeZone - (BAR_HEIGHT / 2) - (BAR_HEIGHT + 0.005)

    if not HasStreamedTextureDictLoaded(TEXTURE_DICT) then
        RequestStreamedTextureDict(TEXTURE_DICT, true)
    else
        DrawSprite(TEXTURE_DICT, 'all_black_bg', x, y, BAR_WIDTH, BAR_HEIGHT, 0.0, 0, 0, 0, 128)
    end

    drawText(barLabel, safeZone - BAR_WIDTH + 0.01, y - 0.012)

    if progress < 0 then progress = 0 elseif progress > 100 then progress = 100 end

    local filled = (BAR_FILL_WIDTH * progress) / 100
    local fillX = x + BAR_FILL_OFFSET

    DrawRect(fillX, y, BAR_FILL_WIDTH, BAR_FILL_HEIGHT, 155, 155, 155, 200)
    DrawRect(
        fillX - (BAR_FILL_WIDTH / 2) + (filled / 2),
        y,
        filled,
        BAR_FILL_HEIGHT,
        barColor[1], barColor[2], barColor[3], 255
    )
end

function effects.disableControls(grenade)
    local disable = grenade.disable
    if not disable then return end

    if disable.sprint then DisableControlAction(0, 21, true) end
    if disable.vehicle then DisableControlAction(0, 23, true) end
    if disable.jump then DisableControlAction(0, 22, true) end

    if disable.combat then
        DisableControlAction(0, 24, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 25, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 142, true)
        DisablePlayerFiring(cache.ped, true)
    end
end

return effects


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\resource\tacticalgas\modules\protection.lua
local config = localmodule 'config.shared'

local masks = config.masks

local GetEntityModel = GetEntityModel
local GetPedDrawableVariation = GetPedDrawableVariation
local GetGameTimer = GetGameTimer

local MASK_CACHE_TTL = 1000

local override = false
local maskCached = false
local maskCheckedAt = 0

local protection = {}

function protection.setOverride(value)
    override = value
end

local function isWearingScriptedMask()
    local now = GetGameTimer()

    if now - maskCheckedAt < MASK_CACHE_TTL then
        return maskCached
    end

    maskCheckedAt = now

    local ok, wearing = pcall(function()
        return exports['sm_resource']:isWearingGasMask()
    end)

    maskCached = ok and wearing == true

    return maskCached
end

function protection.isImmune(grenade)
    if override or playerState.illegalGasMask or isWearingScriptedMask() then return true end

    local byModel = masks[grenade]
    local components = byModel and byModel[GetEntityModel(cache.ped)]
    if not components then return false end

    for slot, drawables in pairs(components) do
        local current = GetPedDrawableVariation(cache.ped, slot)

        for i = 1, #drawables do
            if drawables[i] == current then return true end
        end
    end

    return false
end

return protection


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\resource\tacticalgas\modules\smoke.lua
local config = localmodule 'config.shared'

local grenades = config.grenades
local broadcastRadius = config.broadcastRadius
local BROADCAST_RADIUS_SQ = broadcastRadius * broadcastRadius

local MIN_PARTICLE_SIZE = 0.5
local MAX_PARTICLE_SIZE = 2.5
local STEP_INTERVAL = 10000.0
local STALE_TTL = 60000

local RequestNamedPtfxAsset = RequestNamedPtfxAsset
local HasNamedPtfxAssetLoaded = HasNamedPtfxAssetLoaded
local UseParticleFxAssetNextCall = UseParticleFxAssetNextCall
local StartParticleFxLoopedAtCoord = StartParticleFxLoopedAtCoord
local StopParticleFxLooped = StopParticleFxLooped
local GetEntityCoords = GetEntityCoords
local GetGameTimer = GetGameTimer

local clouds = {}
local handles = {}

local smoke = { clouds = clouds }

---@param duration integer
---@param step integer
---@return number
function smoke.sizeForStep(duration, step)
    local scale = duration / STEP_INTERVAL
    if scale <= 0 then return MIN_PARTICLE_SIZE end

    return MIN_PARTICLE_SIZE + ((step / scale) * (MAX_PARTICLE_SIZE - MIN_PARTICLE_SIZE))
end

---@param dict string
local function loadPtfx(dict)
    if HasNamedPtfxAssetLoaded(dict) then return end

    RequestNamedPtfxAsset(dict)

    while not HasNamedPtfxAssetLoaded(dict) do
        Wait(0)
    end
end

smoke.loadPtfx = loadPtfx

---@param id integer
local function stop(id)
    local handle = handles[id]
    if not handle then return end

    StopParticleFxLooped(handle, 0)
    handles[id] = nil
end

---@param id integer
local function start(id)
    local cloud = clouds[id]
    if not cloud or handles[id] then return end

    local grenade = grenades[cloud.grenade]
    if not grenade then return end

    local particle = grenade.particle
    local coords = cloud.coords

    loadPtfx(particle.dict)

    if not clouds[id] then return end

    UseParticleFxAssetNextCall(particle.dict)

    handles[id] = StartParticleFxLoopedAtCoord(
        particle.fx,
        coords.x, coords.y, coords.z + 0.2,
        0.0, 0.0, 0.0,
        smoke.sizeForStep(grenade.duration, cloud.step),
        false, false, false, false
    )
end

---@param cloud TacticalGas_Cloud
---@return TacticalGas_Cloud
local function normalise(cloud)
    local coords = cloud.coords

    if type(coords) ~= 'vector3' then
        cloud.coords = vec3(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)
    end

    cloud.seenAt = GetGameTimer()

    return cloud
end

---@param list table<integer, TacticalGas_Cloud>?
function smoke.merge(list)
    if not list then return end

    for id, cloud in pairs(list) do
        local known = clouds[id]

        if known then
            known.step = cloud.step
            known.active = cloud.active
            known.seenAt = GetGameTimer()
        else
            clouds[id] = normalise(cloud)
        end
    end
end

---@param id integer
---@param cloud TacticalGas_Cloud
function smoke.add(id, cloud)
    clouds[id] = normalise(cloud)
end

---@param id integer
function smoke.remove(id)
    stop(id)
    clouds[id] = nil
end

---@param id integer
---@param step integer
function smoke.setStep(id, step)
    local cloud = clouds[id]
    if not cloud then return end

    cloud.step = step
    cloud.seenAt = GetGameTimer()

    if handles[id] then
        stop(id)
        start(id)
    end
end

---@param id integer
function smoke.activate(id)
    local cloud = clouds[id]
    if cloud then cloud.active = true end
end

function smoke.refresh()
    local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local px, py, pz = playerCoords.x, playerCoords.y, playerCoords.z
    local now = GetGameTimer()

    for id, cloud in pairs(clouds) do
        local coords = cloud.coords
        local dx, dy, dz = coords.x - px, coords.y - py, coords.z - pz

        if dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz < BROADCAST_RADIUS_SQ then
            cloud.seenAt = now

            start(id)
        else
            stop(id)

            if now - (cloud.seenAt or now) > STALE_TTL then
                clouds[id] = nil
            end
        end
    end
end

---@param cloud TacticalGas_Cloud
---@return number
function smoke.effectRadius(cloud)
    local grenade = grenades[cloud.grenade]
    if not grenade then return 0.0 end

    return smoke.sizeForStep(grenade.duration, cloud.step) * 6
end

function smoke.clear()
    for id in pairs(handles) do
        stop(id)
    end

    for id in pairs(clouds) do
        clouds[id] = nil
    end
end

return smoke


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\resource\tk_zipline\client\main.lua
local config = localmodule 'config.shared'
local shared = localmodule 'modules.shared'
local placer = localmodule 'modules.placer'

local PULLEY_MODEL = -1232739548
local ZIPLINE_ANIM_DICT = 'skydive@parachute@'
local ZIPLINE_ANIM_NAME = 'chute_idle_alt'
local POSE_ANIM_DICT = 'mp_player_int_uppergang_sign_a'
local POSE_ANIM_NAME = 'mp_player_int_gang_sign_a'
local MOTION_STATE_ZIPLINE = -1871534317
local STREAM_DISTANCE = 100.0
local ROPE_HEIGHT = 2.0
local CANCEL_CONTROL = 73
local FIRE_CONTROLS = { 24, 69, 92, 257 }

local text = config.text
local ziplines = {}
local isZiplining = false
local isPlacing = false
local lastGrappleUse = 0

local function notify(description, notifyType)
    lib.notify({
        title = 'Zipline',
        description = description,
        type = notifyType or 'error'
    })
end

local function playProgress(anim, label)
    return lib.progressCircle({
        duration = anim.duration,
        label = label,
        canCancel = true,
        disable = { move = true, car = true, combat = true },
        anim = { dict = anim.dict, clip = anim.name }
    })
end

---Abort the ride when the player is shot, stunned, or presses the cancel key.
local function shouldAbortRide(ped, health, armour)
    if GetEntityHealth(ped) < health or GetPedArmour(ped) < armour then
        return true
    end

    if IsPedBeingStunned(ped, 0) then
        return true
    end

    DisableControlAction(0, CANCEL_CONTROL, true)

    return IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, CANCEL_CONTROL)
end

local function createRope(zipline)
    if zipline.rope then return end

    local startPole, endPole = zipline.startPole, zipline.endPole

    if not (startPole and endPole) then return end
    if not (DoesEntityExist(startPole) and DoesEntityExist(endPole)) then return end

    RopeLoadTextures()

    local timeout = GetGameTimer() + 5000

    while not RopeAreTexturesLoaded() and GetGameTimer() < timeout do
        Wait(10)
    end

    if not RopeAreTexturesLoaded() then return end

    local startPos, endPos = zipline.startPos, zipline.endPos
    local ropeStart = vec3(startPos.x, startPos.y, startPos.z + ROPE_HEIGHT)
    local ropeEnd = vec3(endPos.x, endPos.y, endPos.z + ROPE_HEIGHT)
    local length = #(ropeEnd - ropeStart)

    -- Type 4 is the thick, clearly visible rope used elsewhere on the server.
    local rope = AddRope(
        ropeStart.x, ropeStart.y, ropeStart.z,
        0.0, 0.0, 0.0,
        length, 4, length,
        1.0, 1.0,
        false, true, false,
        1.0, false, 0
    )

    if not rope or rope == 0 then return end

    timeout = GetGameTimer() + 5000

    while not DoesRopeExist(rope) and GetGameTimer() < timeout do
        Wait(10)
    end

    if not DoesRopeExist(rope) then return end

    zipline.rope = rope

    AttachEntitiesToRope(
        rope, startPole, endPole,
        ropeStart.x, ropeStart.y, ropeStart.z,
        ropeEnd.x, ropeEnd.y, ropeEnd.z,
        length, false, false, '', ''
    )

    -- Pull the slack out so the line reads as a taut zipline, not a hanging rope.
    RopeForceLength(rope, length)
end

local function destroyRope(zipline)
    if not zipline.rope then return end

    DeleteRope(zipline.rope)
    RopeUnloadTextures()

    zipline.rope = nil
end

---Slide the player along a pulley travelling from startPos to endPos.
local function ride(startPos, endPos, travelDuration, angle, heading, onTick, onFinish)
    local ped = cache.ped

    lib.requestModel(PULLEY_MODEL)

    local pulley = CreateObject(PULLEY_MODEL, startPos.x, startPos.y, startPos.z + 2.0, true, true, false)
    SetEntityRotation(pulley, 0.0, 90.0, heading, 2, true)

    local hangOffset = shared.getHangOffset(angle, heading)

    SetEntityCoords(ped, startPos.x, startPos.y, startPos.z, false, false, false, false)
    SetEntityRotation(ped, 0.0, 90.0, heading, 2, true)

    AttachEntityToEntity(
        ped, pulley, 0,
        hangOffset.x, hangOffset.y, hangOffset.z,
        angle, 0.0, heading,
        false, false, false, true, 2, false
    )

    lib.requestAnimDict(ZIPLINE_ANIM_DICT)
    TaskPlayAnim(ped, ZIPLINE_ANIM_DICT, ZIPLINE_ANIM_NAME, 4.0, 4.0, -1, 1, 0, false, false, false)

    lib.requestAnimDict(POSE_ANIM_DICT)
    TaskPlayAnim(ped, POSE_ANIM_DICT, POSE_ANIM_NAME, 8.0, -8.0, -1, 49, 0, false, false, false)

    local health, armour = GetEntityHealth(ped), GetPedArmour(ped)
    local startTime = GetGameTimer()
    local delta = endPos - startPos

    isZiplining = true

    CreateThread(function()
        while true do
            if shouldAbortRide(ped, health, armour) then break end

            ForcePedMotionState(ped, MOTION_STATE_ZIPLINE, false, 0, false)

            local step = shared.clampProgress((GetGameTimer() - startTime) / travelDuration)
            local pos = startPos + delta * step

            SetEntityCoords(pulley, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z + 2.0, false, false, false, false)

            if onTick then onTick(step) end

            if step >= 1.0 then break end

            Wait(0)
        end

        DetachEntity(ped, true, true)
        DeleteObject(pulley)
        ClearPedTasks(ped)

        isZiplining = false

        if onFinish then onFinish() end
    end)
end

local function startZipline(startPos, endPos, ziplineConfig)
    if isZiplining then return end

    local angle, distance = shared.getAngle(startPos, endPos)
    local maxUpwardsAngle = ziplineConfig.maxUpwardsAngle or config.baseMaxUpwardsAngle

    if angle > 0 and angle > maxUpwardsAngle then
        return notify(text.angleTooSteep)
    end

    local travelDuration = shared.getTravelDuration(
        distance,
        angle,
        config.baseDurationMultiplier * (ziplineConfig.durationMultiplier or 1.0),
        config.baseAngleEffectMultiplier * (ziplineConfig.angleEffectMultiplier or 1.0)
    )

    ride(
        startPos,
        endPos,
        travelDuration,
        angle,
        GetHeadingFromVector_2d(endPos.x - startPos.x, endPos.y - startPos.y)
    )
end

---Ride whichever direction the player is standing closest to.
local function useZipline(zipline)
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local ziplineConfig = shared.getConfig(zipline.ziplineType, zipline.configIndex) or {}

    if #(coords - zipline.startPos) < #(coords - zipline.endPos) then
        startZipline(zipline.startPos, zipline.endPos, ziplineConfig)
    else
        startZipline(zipline.endPos, zipline.startPos, ziplineConfig)
    end
end

local function removeZipline(zipline)
    if not playProgress(config.anims.remove, text.removing) then return end

    TriggerServerEvent('tk_zipline:removeZipline', zipline.id)
end

local warnedModels = {}

local function spawnPole(model, coords, offset)
    -- requestModel throws on a genuinely missing model, so keep it contained:
    -- a bad pole must not stop the rope or the rest of the zipline from loading.
    local loaded = pcall(lib.requestModel, model, 5000)

    if not loaded or not HasModelLoaded(model) then
        if not warnedModels[model] then
            warnedModels[model] = true
            print(('[tk_zipline] poleModel %s gagal dimuat - cek config/shared.lua'):format(model))
        end

        return
    end

    local pos = coords + (offset or vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    local pole = CreateObjectNoOffset(model, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, false, true, false)

    if not pole or pole == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(pole) then return end

    SetEntityRotation(pole, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 2, true)
    FreezeEntityPosition(pole, true)

    return pole
end

local function addPoleTarget(zipline, pole)
    local ziplineConfig = shared.getConfig(zipline.ziplineType, zipline.configIndex) or {}

    local options = {
        {
            name = ('tk_zipline_use_%s'):format(zipline.id),
            label = text.useZipline,
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-hand',
            distance = 2.0,
            onSelect = function()
                useZipline(zipline)
            end
        }
    }

    if ziplineConfig.canRemove then
        options[#options + 1] = {
            name = ('tk_zipline_remove_%s'):format(zipline.id),
            label = text.remove,
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-trash',
            distance = 2.0,
            onSelect = function()
                removeZipline(zipline)
            end
        }
    end

    exports.ox_target:addLocalEntity(pole, options)
end

local function spawnZipline(zipline)
    if zipline.startPole then return end

    local ziplineConfig = shared.getConfig(zipline.ziplineType, zipline.configIndex) or {}
    local model = ziplineConfig.poleModel or config.ziplineGun.poleModel
    local offset = ziplineConfig.offset

    zipline.startPole = spawnPole(model, zipline.startPos, offset)
    zipline.endPole = spawnPole(model, zipline.endPos, offset)

    if zipline.startPole then addPoleTarget(zipline, zipline.startPole) end
    if zipline.endPole then addPoleTarget(zipline, zipline.endPole) end

    createRope(zipline)
end

local function despawnZipline(zipline)
    destroyRope(zipline)

    local startPole, endPole = zipline.startPole, zipline.endPole

    if startPole then
        exports.ox_target:removeLocalEntity(startPole)

        if DoesEntityExist(startPole) then
            DeleteEntity(startPole)
        end

        zipline.startPole = nil
    end

    if endPole then
        exports.ox_target:removeLocalEntity(endPole)

        if DoesEntityExist(endPole) then
            DeleteEntity(endPole)
        end

        zipline.endPole = nil
    end
end

---Register a zipline plus the two points that stream its poles in and out.
local function registerZipline(id, data)
    if ziplines[id] then return end

    local zipline = {
        id = id,
        startPos = data.startPos,
        endPos = data.endPos,
        configIndex = data.configIndex,
        ziplineType = data.ziplineType or 'static'
    }

    -- Both ends share the prop set, so only despawn once the player leaves both.
    local nearby = 0

    local function onEnter()
        nearby = nearby + 1

        spawnZipline(zipline)
    end

    local function onExit()
        nearby = nearby - 1

        if nearby > 0 then return end

        nearby = 0

        despawnZipline(zipline)
    end

    zipline.points = {
        lib.points.new({ coords = zipline.startPos, distance = STREAM_DISTANCE, onEnter = onEnter, onExit = onExit }),
        lib.points.new({ coords = zipline.endPos, distance = STREAM_DISTANCE, onEnter = onEnter, onExit = onExit })
    }

    ziplines[id] = zipline
end

local function unregisterZipline(id)
    local zipline = ziplines[id]

    if not zipline then return end

    for i = 1, #zipline.points do
        zipline.points[i]:remove()
    end

    despawnZipline(zipline)

    ziplines[id] = nil
end

local function startGrapple(startPos, endPos)
    if isZiplining then return end

    local now = GetGameTimer()

    if now - lastGrappleUse < config.grappleGun.cooldown then
        return notify(text.grappleCooldown)
    end

    if not lib.callback.await('tk_zipline:useGrappleAmmo', false) then return end

    lastGrappleUse = now

    local angle, distance = shared.getAngle(startPos, endPos)
    local travelDuration = shared.getTravelDuration(
        distance,
        angle,
        config.grappleGun.durationMultiplier,
        config.grappleGun.angleEffectMultiplier
    )

    RopeLoadTextures()

    local timeout = GetGameTimer() + 5000

    while not RopeAreTexturesLoaded() and GetGameTimer() < timeout do
        Wait(10)
    end

    local rope = AddRope(
        startPos.x, startPos.y, startPos.z + 1.0,
        endPos.x, endPos.y, endPos.z,
        distance, 4, distance,
        0.1, 1.0,
        false, false, true, 1.0, false, 0
    )

    if rope and rope ~= 0 then
        StartRopeWinding(rope)
    end

    ride(
        startPos,
        endPos + vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0),
        travelDuration,
        angle,
        GetHeadingFromVector_2d(endPos.x - startPos.x, endPos.y - startPos.y),
        function(step)
            if rope and DoesRopeExist(rope) then
                RopeForceLength(rope, distance * (1.0 - step))
            end
        end,
        function()
            if rope and DoesRopeExist(rope) then
                DeleteRope(rope)
                RopeUnloadTextures()
            end
        end
    )
end

---Anchor a gun zipline at the aimed point, dropping it to the surface below.
local function fireZiplineGun()
    local gun = config.ziplineGun
    local hit, hitEntity, hitCoords = lib.raycast.fromCamera(511, 4, gun.maxDist)

    if not hit then
        return notify(text.invalidPosition)
    end

    local down = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    local groundHit, _, groundCoords = lib.raycast.fromCoords(hitCoords, hitCoords - (down * 5.0), 1, hitEntity)
    local endCoords = groundHit and groundCoords or (hitCoords + down)
    local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped) - down
    local distance = #(endCoords - playerCoords)

    if distance > gun.maxDist or distance < gun.minDist then
        return notify(text.invalidPosition)
    end

    TriggerServerEvent('tk_zipline:saveZipline', 'zipline', {
        startCoords = playerCoords,
        endCoords = endCoords,
        ziplineType = 'gun'
    })
end

local function fireGrappleGun()
    local gun = config.grappleGun
    local hit, _, hitCoords = lib.raycast.fromCamera(511, 4, gun.maxDist)

    if not hit then
        return notify(text.invalidPosition)
    end

    local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local distance = #(hitCoords - playerCoords)

    if distance <= gun.minDist or distance >= gun.maxDist then
        return notify(text.invalidPosition)
    end

    startGrapple(playerCoords, hitCoords)
end

---Place a pole at each end of an item zipline, then hand it to the server.
local function placeZiplineFromItem(itemIndex)
    if isPlacing then return end

    local itemConfig = config.items[itemIndex]

    if not itemConfig then return end

    isPlacing = true

    local function finish()
        isPlacing = false
    end

    local placeProps = { { model = itemConfig.poleModel, offset = itemConfig.offset } }

    placer.start(placeProps, function(startCoords)
        if not startCoords then return finish() end

        if shared.isInDisabledArea(startCoords) then
            notify(text.disabledArea)
            return finish()
        end

        if not playProgress(config.anims.place, text.placing) then return finish() end

        placer.start(placeProps, function(endCoords)
            if not endCoords then return finish() end

            if shared.isInDisabledArea(endCoords) then
                notify(text.disabledArea)
                return finish()
            end

            local up = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)
            local blocked = lib.raycast.fromCoords(startCoords + up, endCoords + up, 1)

            if blocked then
                notify(text.pathBlocked)
                return finish()
            end

            local distance = #(endCoords - startCoords)

            if distance > itemConfig.maxDist or distance < itemConfig.minDist then
                notify(text.tooFar)
                return finish()
            end

            if not playProgress(config.anims.place, text.placing) then return finish() end

            finish()

            TriggerServerEvent('tk_zipline:saveZipline', itemIndex, {
                startCoords = startCoords,
                endCoords = endCoords,
                ziplineType = 'item'
            })
        end)
    end)
end

---Runs per-frame only while a zipline or grapple gun is equipped; idle players
---cost nothing, since ox_lib only fires this event when the weapon changes.
local gunThreadActive = false

local function startGunThread(isZiplineGun)
    if gunThreadActive then return end

    gunThreadActive = true

    CreateThread(function()
        local fireCount = #FIRE_CONTROLS

        while gunThreadActive do
            for i = 1, fireCount do
                DisableControlAction(0, FIRE_CONTROLS[i], true)
            end

            if IsControlPressed(0, 25) then
                for i = 1, fireCount do
                    if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, FIRE_CONTROLS[i]) then
                        if isZiplineGun then
                            fireZiplineGun()
                        else
                            fireGrappleGun()
                        end

                        break
                    end
                end
            end

            Wait(0)
        end
    end)
end

local function onWeaponChanged(weapon)
    local isZiplineGun = weapon == config.ziplineGun.weaponHash
    local isGrappleGun = weapon == config.grappleGun.weaponHash

    if isZiplineGun or isGrappleGun then
        startGunThread(isZiplineGun)
    else
        gunThreadActive = false
    end
end

AddEventHandler('ox_lib:cache:weapon', onWeaponChanged)

-- The event only fires on change, so pick up a gun already equipped at start.
onWeaponChanged(cache.weapon)

RegisterNetEvent('tk_zipline:createZipline', function(id, data)
    registerZipline(id, data)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('tk_zipline:removeZipline', function(id)
    unregisterZipline(id)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('tk_zipline:removeZiplines', function(ids)
    for i = 1, #ids do
        unregisterZipline(ids[i])
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('tk_zipline:placeZiplinePole', function(itemIndex)
    placeZiplineFromItem(itemIndex)
end)

CreateThread(function()
    for index = 1, #config.ziplines do
        local data = config.ziplines[index]

        registerZipline(('static_%d'):format(index), {
            startPos = data.startPos,
            endPos = data.endPos,
            configIndex = index,
            ziplineType = 'static'
        })
    end

    local saved = lib.callback.await('tk_zipline:getZiplines', false)

    for id, data in pairs(saved) do
        registerZipline(id, data)
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource then return end

    for _, zipline in pairs(ziplines) do
        despawnZipline(zipline)
    end
end)


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\resource\tk_zipline\config\shared.lua
local placeAnim = {
    dict = 'weapons@first_person@aim_rng@generic@projectile@sticky_bomb@',
    name = 'plant_floor',
    duration = 1000
}

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\resource\tk_zipline\modules\placer.lua
local shared = localmodule 'modules.shared'

local MAX_PLACE_DIST = 10.0
local MIN_PLAYER_DIST = 3.0
local ROTATE_STEP = 5.0
local CONTROL_CANCEL = 194
local CONTROL_PLACE = 38
local CONTROL_ROTATE_LEFT = 14
local CONTROL_ROTATE_RIGHT = 15

local ZiplinePlacer = {}

local function outline(entity, canPlace)
    SetEntityDrawOutline(entity, true)
    SetEntityDrawOutlineShader(1)

    if canPlace then
        SetEntityDrawOutlineColor(0, 255, 0, 255)
    else
        SetEntityDrawOutlineColor(255, 0, 0, 255)
    end
end

---Spawn ghost props the player aims to position, then resolve with the chosen coords.
---@param props { model: number, offset: vector3? }[]
---@param onPlace fun(coords: vector3?, heading: number?)
function ZiplinePlacer.start(props, onPlace)
    local ghosts = {}
    local ped = cache.ped
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)

    -- Load every model up front so a failure cancels cleanly instead of
    -- leaving half the ghost props floating in the world.
    for i = 1, #props do
        local model = props[i].model

        if not pcall(lib.requestModel, model, 5000) or not HasModelLoaded(model) then
            print(('[tk_zipline] model %s gagal dimuat - cek config/shared.lua'):format(model))
            onPlace(nil)
            return
        end
    end

    for i = 1, #props do
        local prop = props[i]

        local entity = CreateObjectNoOffset(prop.model, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false)

        SetEntityAlpha(entity, 102, false)
        SetEntityCollision(entity, false, false)
        SetEntityRotation(entity, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 2, true)

        ghosts[i] = { entity = entity, offset = prop.offset or vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0) }
    end

    local anchor = ghosts[1].entity
    local heading = 0.0
    local placing = true

    local function cleanup()
        placing = false

        for i = 1, #ghosts do
            DeleteEntity(ghosts[i].entity)
        end
    end

    CreateThread(function()
        while placing do
            local hit, _, target = lib.raycast.fromCamera(511, 4, MAX_PLACE_DIST)
            local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
            local canPlace = hit and #(target - playerCoords) < MIN_PLAYER_DIST

            if hit then
                for i = 1, #ghosts do
                    local ghost = ghosts[i]
                    local offset = shared.rotateVector(ghost.offset, heading)

                    SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(ghost.entity, target.x + offset.x, target.y + offset.y, target.z + offset.z, false, false, false)
                    SetEntityRotation(ghost.entity, 0.0, 0.0, heading, 2, true)
                    outline(ghost.entity, canPlace)
                end
            end

            if IsControlJustPressed(0, CONTROL_CANCEL) then
                cleanup()
                onPlace(nil)
                return
            end

            if IsControlJustPressed(0, CONTROL_ROTATE_LEFT) then
                heading = (heading - ROTATE_STEP) % 360.0
            elseif IsControlJustPressed(0, CONTROL_ROTATE_RIGHT) then
                heading = (heading + ROTATE_STEP) % 360.0
            end

            if canPlace and IsControlJustPressed(0, CONTROL_PLACE) then
                local placed = GetEntityCoords(anchor) - shared.rotateVector(ghosts[1].offset, heading)

                cleanup()
                onPlace(placed, heading)
                return
            end

            Wait(0)
        end
    end)
end

return ZiplinePlacer


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\resource\tk_zipline\modules\shared.lua
local config = localmodule 'config.shared'

local rad, cos, sin, atan, deg, min = math.rad, math.cos, math.sin, math.atan, math.deg, math.min

local ZiplineShared = {}

---Resolve the config table backing a zipline of the given type.
---@param ziplineType 'item'|'gun'|'static'
---@param index any
---@return table?
function ZiplineShared.getConfig(ziplineType, index)
    if ziplineType == 'item' then
        return config.items[index]
    end

    if ziplineType == 'gun' then
        return config.ziplineGun
    end

    return config.ziplines[index]
end

---Travel angle in degrees between two points (positive = uphill).
---@param startPos vector3
---@param endPos vector3
---@return number angle
---@return number distance
function ZiplineShared.getAngle(startPos, endPos)
    local distance = #(endPos - startPos)

    if distance == 0 then
        return 0.0, 0.0
    end

    return deg(atan(endPos.z - startPos.z, distance)), distance
end

---How long a ride across the given span should take, in milliseconds.
---@param distance number
---@param angle number
---@param durationMultiplier number
---@param angleEffectMultiplier number
---@return number
function ZiplineShared.getTravelDuration(distance, angle, durationMultiplier, angleEffectMultiplier)
    local duration = distance / (durationMultiplier / 50)

    return duration * (1.0 - ((-angle / 90.0) * (angleEffectMultiplier * 1.5)))
end

---Rotate a vector around the Z axis.
---@param vector vector3
---@param angle number degrees
---@return vector3
function ZiplineShared.rotateVector(vector, angle)
    local radians = rad(angle)
    local cosAngle, sinAngle = cos(radians), sin(radians)

    return vec3(
        vector.x * cosAngle - vector.y * sinAngle,
        vector.x * sinAngle + vector.y * cosAngle,
        vector.z
    )
end

---Offset used to hang the ped below the pulley at a given travel angle.
---@param angle number degrees
---@param heading number
---@return vector3
function ZiplineShared.getHangOffset(angle, heading)
    local angleRad = rad(angle)
    local angleCos, angleSin = cos(angleRad), sin(angleRad)

    return ZiplineShared.rotateVector(
        vec3(0.05, -0.4 * angleCos + 0.93 * angleSin, -0.4 * angleSin - 0.93 * angleCos),
        heading
    )
end

---@param coords vector3
---@return boolean
function ZiplineShared.isInDisabledArea(coords)
    local areas = config.disabledAreas

    for i = 1, #areas do
        local area = areas[i]

        if #(coords - area.coords) < area.radius then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

---@param progress number
---@return number
function ZiplineShared.clampProgress(progress)
    return min(progress, 1.0)
end

return ZiplineShared


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\resource\trapshop\client.lua
local config = localmodule 'config.shared'

local itemByName = {}

for _, item in ipairs(config.items) do
    itemByName[item.name] = item
end

local RENDER_DISTANCE = 25.0

local Inventory = exports.ox_inventory:GetPlayerItems() or {}
local players = {}
local renderTokens = {}

local function loadModel(model)
    local hash = joaat(model)
    if not lib.requestModel(hash, 10000) then return nil end
    return hash
end

local function createProp(hash, ped)
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local prop = CreateObject(hash, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false)

    SetEntityCollision(prop, false, false)

    return prop
end

local function attachProp(prop, ped, point)
    AttachEntityToEntity(
        prop, ped, GetPedBoneIndex(ped, point.bone),
        point.pos.x, point.pos.y, point.pos.z,
        point.rot.x, point.rot.y, point.rot.z,
        false, false, false, false, point.rotOrder, point.fixedRot
    )
end

local function removeProps(serverId)
    local worn = players[serverId]
    if not worn then return end

    for _, prop in pairs(worn) do
        if DoesEntityExist(prop) then
            DeleteEntity(prop)
        end
    end

    players[serverId] = nil
end

local function removeAll()
    for _, worn in pairs(players) do
        for _, prop in pairs(worn) do
            if DoesEntityExist(prop) then
                DeleteEntity(prop)
            end
        end
    end

    players = {}
    renderTokens = {}
end

---@param serverId number
---@param ped number
---@param item table
---@param token number penanda render, dibatalkan kalau ada render baru
local function wearProp(serverId, ped, item, token)
    local point = config.attachPoints[item.point]
    if not point then return end

    local hash = loadModel(item.model)
    if not hash then return end

    if renderTokens[serverId] ~= token or not DoesEntityExist(ped) then
        SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(hash)
        return
    end

    local prop = createProp(hash, ped)

    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(hash)

    if not DoesEntityExist(prop) then return end

    if renderTokens[serverId] ~= token then
        DeleteEntity(prop)
        return
    end

    attachProp(prop, ped, point)

    local worn = players[serverId]

    if not worn then
        worn = {}
        players[serverId] = worn
    end

    local previous = worn[item.point]

    if previous and previous ~= prop and DoesEntityExist(previous) then
        DeleteEntity(previous)
    end

    worn[item.point] = prop
end

local function findBagsInInventory()
    local found, slots = {}, {}

    for slot, data in pairs(Inventory) do
        local item = data and data.name and itemByName[data.name]

        if item and (not slots[item.point] or slot < slots[item.point]) then
            found[item.point] = item
            slots[item.point] = slot
        end
    end

    return found
end

local function propsHidden()
    local state = LocalPlayer.state
    return state.hide_props == true or state.hide_itemattach == true
end

local function syncProp()
    local bags = {}

    if not propsHidden() then
        for pointName, item in pairs(findBagsInInventory()) do
            bags[pointName] = item.name
        end
    end

    if lib.table.matches(LocalPlayer.state.trap_bags or {}, bags) then return end

    LocalPlayer.state:set('trap_bags', bags, true)
end

local function skipRender(serverId)
    return serverId ~= cache.serverId and LocalPlayer.state.prophide == true
end

local function renderPlayer(serverId, ped, bags)
    local token = (renderTokens[serverId] or 0) + 1
    renderTokens[serverId] = token

    removeProps(serverId)

    if not bags or skipRender(serverId) then return end

    for pointName, itemName in pairs(bags) do
        if renderTokens[serverId] ~= token then return end

        local item = itemByName[itemName]

        if item and item.point == pointName then
            wearProp(serverId, ped, item, token)
        end
    end
end

---@param ped number
---@return vector3
local function pedCoords(ped)
    local vehicle = GetVehiclePedIsIn(ped, false)

    return vehicle == 0 and GetEntityCoords(ped) or GetWorldPositionOfEntityBone(ped, 0)
end

---@param serverId number
---@return number ped 0 kalau ga ada atau kejauhan
local function getRenderablePed(serverId)
    local playerId = GetPlayerFromServerId(serverId)
    local ped = playerId ~= -1 and GetPlayerPed(playerId) or 0

    if ped <= 0 or not DoesEntityExist(ped) then return 0 end

    if serverId == cache.serverId then return ped end

    return #(pedCoords(cache.ped) - pedCoords(ped)) <= RENDER_DISTANCE and ped or 0
end

---@param seen table<number, true>
local function removeUnseen(seen)
    local stale
    local amount = 0

    for serverId in pairs(players) do
        if serverId ~= cache.serverId and not seen[serverId] then
            stale = stale or {}
            amount += 1
            stale[amount] = serverId
        end
    end

    for i = 1, amount do
        removeProps(stale[i])
    end
end

---@param serverId number
---@param bags table?
local function sync(serverId, bags)
    local ped = bags and next(bags) and getRenderablePed(serverId) or 0

    if ped == 0 then
        return removeProps(serverId)
    end

    renderPlayer(serverId, ped, bags)
end

AddEventHandler('ox_inventory:updateInventory', function(changes)
    if not changes then return end

    for slot, item in pairs(changes) do
        Inventory[slot] = item or nil
    end

    syncProp()
end)

RegisterNetEvent('ox_inventory:setPlayerInventory', function(_, inventory)
    Inventory = inventory or {}
    syncProp()
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:OnPlayerUnload', function()
    Inventory = {}
    LocalPlayer.state:set('trap_bags', nil, true)
end)

AddStateBagChangeHandler('trap_bags', nil, function(bagName, _, value, _, replicated)
    if replicated then return end

    local serverId = tonumber(bagName:gsub('player:', ''), 10)
    if not serverId then return end

    sync(serverId, value)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('onPlayerDropped', function(serverId)
    removeProps(serverId)
end)

local function onHideStateChanged()
    syncProp()
end

AddStateBagChangeHandler('hide_props', ('player:%s'):format(cache.serverId), onHideStateChanged)
AddStateBagChangeHandler('hide_itemattach', ('player:%s'):format(cache.serverId), onHideStateChanged)

local function refreshAll()
    local seen = {}

    for _, playerId in ipairs(GetActivePlayers()) do
        local serverId = GetPlayerServerId(playerId)

        seen[serverId] = true

        sync(serverId, Player(serverId).state.trap_bags)
    end

    removeUnseen(seen)
end

AddStateBagChangeHandler('prophide', ('player:%s'):format(cache.serverId), refreshAll)

lib.onCache('ped', function()
    removeProps(cache.serverId)

    CreateThread(function()
        Wait(500)
        refreshAll()
    end)
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStart', function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource then return end

    CreateThread(function()
        Wait(500)
        Inventory = exports.ox_inventory:GetPlayerItems() or {}
        LocalPlayer.state:set('trap_bags', nil, true)
        syncProp()
    end)
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource then return end
    removeAll()
end)

    }

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_2\localmodule.lua
local currentResource = GetCurrentResourceName()

local function normalizeSource(src)
    if type(src) ~= 'string' then return nil end
    if src:find('citizen:', 1, true) or src:find('localmodule', 1, true) then return nil end

    src = src:gsub('\\', '/'):gsub('^@+', '')
    if not src:match('^[^/]+/.+%.lua$') then return nil end

    return src
end

local function getModuleBasePath(fullPath)
    local basePath = fullPath:match('(.+)/[^/]+%.lua$') or ''

    local scope, name = fullPath:match('^([^/]+)/([^/]+)/')
    if scope and name then
        return ('%s/%s'):format(scope, name)
    end

    return basePath
end

---Get caller's resource and base path
---@return string resource
---@return string basePath
local function getCallerInfo()
    for level = 1, 20 do
        local info = debug.getinfo(level, 'S')
        if not info then break end

        local path = normalizeSource(info.source)

        if path then
            local resource = path:match('^([^/]+)')
            if resource ~= currentResource then goto continue end

            local fullPath = path:match('^[^/]+/(.+)$')
            if not fullPath then
                return resource, ''
            end

            return resource, getModuleBasePath(fullPath)
        end

        ::continue::
    end
    
    return currentResource, ''
end

---Load module from file
---@param modName string
---@param resource string
---@param basePath string
---@return any? result
---@return string? error
local function loadModule(modName, resource, basePath)
    local modPath = modName:gsub('%.', '/')
    local filePath = basePath ~= '' and (basePath .. '/' .. modPath .. '.lua') or (modPath .. '.lua')

    local chunk = LoadResourceFile(resource, filePath)

    if not chunk then
        return nil, ("file not found: @%s/%s"):format(resource, filePath)
    end

    local chunkName = ('@@%s/%s'):format(resource, filePath)
    local fn, loadErr = load(chunk, chunkName, 't', _ENV)

    if not fn then
        return nil, ("syntax error in '%s': %s"):format(filePath, loadErr)
    end

    local success, result = pcall(fn)

    if not success then
        return nil, ("runtime error in '%s': %s"):format(filePath, result)
    end

    return result ~= nil and result or true, nil
end

---Main require function
---@param self table
---@param modName string
---@return any
local function localrequire(self, modName)
    if type(modName) ~= 'string' then
        error(("module name must be a string (received '%s')"):format(type(modName)), 2)
    end

    local resource, basePath = getCallerInfo()
    local cacheKey = ('%s:%s:%s'):format(resource, basePath, modName)

    if self.loaded[cacheKey] then
        return self.loaded[cacheKey]
    end

    local result, err = loadModule(modName, resource, basePath)

    if not result then
        error(("localmodule: failed to load '%s'\n\nResource: %s\nBase: %s\n\n%s"):format(
            modName, resource, basePath ~= '' and basePath or '(root)', err
        ), 2)
    end

    self.loaded[cacheKey] = result
    return result
end

_ENV.localmodule = setmetatable({
    loaded = {}
}, {
    __call = localrequire
})

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_2\interface\core.lua
local originalSendNUIMessage = SendNUIMessage
function SendNUIMessage(data)
    if type(data) == 'table' then
        data._resource = cache.resource
    end
    originalSendNUIMessage(data)
end

local registeredFrames = {}
local nuiReady = false
local pendingFrames = {}

---@return string|nil
local function getCallerModule()
    for level = 2, 10 do
        local info = debug.getinfo(level, 'S')
        if not info then break end
        if info.source then
            local module = info.source:match('interface/([^/]+)/')
            if module then
                return module
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

---@param name string
---@param url string
---@param visible? boolean defaults true; pass false to register without mounting
local function createFrame(name, url, visible)
    if visible == nil then visible = true end
    SendNUIMessage({action = 'create_frame', name = name, url = url, visible = visible})
    registeredFrames[name] = true
end

---@return boolean
local function init(startVisible)
    if startVisible == nil then startVisible = true end
    local moduleName = getCallerModule()
    if not moduleName then
        lib.print.error('Tidak dapat mendeteksi module yang memanggil')
        return false
    end

    if registeredFrames[moduleName] then
        lib.print.warn(('Frame "%s" sudah terdaftar'):format(moduleName))
        return false
    end

    local function findHtml(module)
        local paths = {
            ('interface/%s/dist/index.html'):format(module),
            ('interface/%s/web/build/index.html'):format(module),
            ('interface/%s/build/index.html'):format(module),
        }

        for i = 1, #paths do
            local path = paths[i]
            if LoadResourceFile(cache.resource, path) ~= nil then
                return path
            end
        end
    end

    local htmlPath = findHtml(moduleName)

    if not htmlPath then
        return false
    end

    local url = ('https://cfx-nui-%s/%s'):format(cache.resource, htmlPath)

    if nuiReady then
        createFrame(moduleName, url, startVisible)
    else
        pendingFrames[#pendingFrames + 1] = {
            name = moduleName,
            url = url,
            visible = startVisible
        }
    end

    return true
end

---@param msg table
local function send(msg)
    local moduleName = getCallerModule()
    if moduleName and registeredFrames[moduleName] then
        SendNUIMessage({target = moduleName, data = msg})
    end
end

---@param name string
---@param cb fun(data: any, cb: fun(...))
local function callback(name, cb)
    local moduleName = getCallerModule()
    if not moduleName then
        lib.print.error('callback() harus dipanggil dari module interface')
        return
    end

    local fullName = ('%s:%s'):format(moduleName, name)

    return RegisterRawNuiCallback(fullName, function(req, nuiCallback)
        local origin = req.headers and req.headers['Origin']
        local validOrigin = ('https://cfx-nui-%s'):format(cache.resource)

        if origin and origin ~= '' and origin ~= validOrigin then
            lib.print.error(('[Interface] Callback %s rejected - invalid origin'):format(fullName))
            return nuiCallback({ status = 403, body = json.encode({ error = 'Forbidden' }) })
        end

        local data = json.decode(req.body)

        cb(data, function(result)
            nuiCallback({ status = 200, body = json.encode(result or {}) })
        end)
    end)
end

---@param name string
---@param cursor boolean
---@param cursor2 boolean
---@param keepInput? boolean
local function setFocus(name, cursor, cursor2, keepInput)
    SendNUIMessage({action = 'focus_frame', name = name})
    SetNuiFocus(cursor and cursor or false, cursor2 and cursor2 or false)
    SetNuiFocusKeepInput(keepInput or false)
end

---@param cursor boolean
---@param cursor2 boolean
---@param keepInput? boolean
local function focus(cursor, cursor2, keepInput)
    local moduleName = getCallerModule()
    if moduleName and registeredFrames[moduleName] then
        setFocus(moduleName, cursor, cursor2, keepInput)
    end
end

---@param name string
local function destroyFrame(name)
    if registeredFrames[name] then
        SendNUIMessage({action = 'destroy_frame', name = name})
        registeredFrames[name] = nil
    end
end

local function hide()
    local moduleName = getCallerModule()
    if moduleName and registeredFrames[moduleName] then
        SendNUIMessage({action = 'hide_frame', name = moduleName})
    end
end

local function show()
    local moduleName = getCallerModule()
    if moduleName and registeredFrames[moduleName] then
        SendNUIMessage({action = 'show_frame', name = moduleName})
    end
end

RegisterNUICallback('nui_ready', function(_, cb)
    nuiReady = true
    for i = 1, #pendingFrames do
        local frame = pendingFrames[i]
        createFrame(frame.name, frame.url, frame.visible)
    end
    pendingFrames = {}
    cb('')
end)

RegisterNUICallback('frame_message', function (data, cb)
    local name, msg in data
    lib.print.info(('[%s] %s jcnk'):format(name, msg))
    cb('')
end)

_ENV.interface = {
    init = init,
    send = send,
    callback = callback,
    focus = focus,
    setFocus = setFocus,
    show = show,
    hide = hide,
    destroyFrame = destroyFrame,
    ready = function ()
        return nuiReady
    end
}

    interface.focus(true, true)

local function closeFrame()
    defuseId = nil
    pending = nil
    interface.focus(false, false)
    StopAnimTask(cache.ped, DEFUSE_ANIM_DICT, DEFUSE_ANIM_CLIP, 1.0)

    SetTimeout(50, function()
        if defuseId or not frameMounted then return end
        frameMounted = false
        frameReady = false
        interface.hide()
    end)
end

---@param reason? string
local function forceCloseDefuse(reason)
    if not defuseId then return end
    if frameReady then
        interface.send({ action = 'close' })
    end
    closeFrame()
    if reason == 'exploded' then
        notify('Bom meledak!')
    elseif reason == 'removed' then
        notify('Bom sudah tidak ada.', 'inform')
    elseif reason == 'far' then
        notify('Kamu terlalu jauh dari bom.')
    elseif reason == 'idle' then
        notify('Sesi penjinakan berakhir.')
    end
end

---@param id string
local function openDefuse(id)
    if not hasFrame or defuseId or placing or armed then return end

    local ok, data = lib.callback.await('sm_bomb:open', false, id)
    if not ok then return notify(data or 'Gagal membuka defuse kit.') end

    defuseId = id
    pending = { action = 'open', data = data }

    if loadDict(DEFUSE_ANIM_DICT) then
        TaskPlayAnim(cache.ped, DEFUSE_ANIM_DICT, DEFUSE_ANIM_CLIP, 3.0, 3.0, -1, 1, 0, false, false, false)
    end

    if frameReady then
        flush()
    elseif not frameMounted then
        frameMounted = true
        interface.show()
    end

    CreateThread(function()
        while defuseId == id do
            local bomb = known[id]
            local entity = bomb and entityFromNet(bomb.net) or 0
            if entity == 0 or #(GetEntityCoords(cache.ped) - GetEntityCoords(entity)) > DEFUSE_BREAK or IsEntityDead(cache.ped) then
                lib.callback('sm_bomb:close', false, noop, id)
                forceCloseDefuse(entity == 0 and 'removed' or 'far')
                break
            end
            Wait(500)
        end
    end)
end

    return netToId[NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(entity)]
end

---@param list any
local function syncBombs(list)
    if type(list) ~= 'table' then list = {} end

    local seen = {}
    for i = 1, #list do
        local entry = list[i]
        local id = entry.id
        seen[id] = true
        local current = known[id]
        if not current then
            known[id] = { net = entry.net, kind = entry.kind, ends = entry.ends }
            knownCount = knownCount + 1
            netToId[entry.net] = id
        else
            current.ends = entry.ends
        end
    end

    for id, bomb in pairs(known) do
        if not seen[id] then
            known[id] = nil
            knownCount = knownCount - 1
            if netToId[bomb.net] == id then
                netToId[bomb.net] = nil
            end
            if defuseId == id then
                forceCloseDefuse('removed')
            end
        end
    end

    local current = defuseId and known[defuseId]
    if current and frameReady then
        interface.send({ action = 'update', data = { ends = current.ends } })
    end
end

AddStateBagChangeHandler('smBombs', 'global', function(_, _, value)
    syncBombs(value)
end)

CreateThread(function()
    syncBombs(GlobalState.smBombs)
end)

---@param bombCfg table
---@return integer?, string?
local function askSettings(bombCfg)
    local fields = {}
    if bombCfg.timer then
        fields[1] = {
            type = 'number',
            label = 'Durasi (detik)',
            description = ('Minimal %d detik, maksimal %d detik (%d menit)'):format(config.timer.min, config.timer.max, config.timer.max // 60),
            default = config.timer.default,
            min = config.timer.min,
            max = config.timer.max,
            required = true,
        }
    end
    fields[#fields + 1] = {
        type = 'input',
        label = ('PIN (%d digit)'):format(config.pinLength),
        password = true,
        required = true,
    }

    local input = lib.inputDialog(bombCfg.label, fields)
    if not input then return end

    local timer = bombCfg.timer and tonumber(input[1]) or 0
    local pin = tostring(input[#fields] or '')
    if #pin ~= config.pinLength or not pin:match('^%d+$') then
        notify(('PIN harus %d digit angka.'):format(config.pinLength))
        return
    end

    return timer, pin
end

local camRay = { valid = false }

---@param heading number
---@return table
local function trace(heading)
    local camCoords = GetGameplayCamCoord()
    local camRot = GetGameplayCamRot(2)
    local rx, rz = mrad(camRot.x), mrad(camRot.z)
    local cx = mabs(mcos(rx))
    local reach = PLACE_DISTANCE + 3.0
    local tx = camCoords.x - msin(rz) * cx * reach
    local ty = camCoords.y + mcos(rz) * cx * reach
    local tz = camCoords.z + msin(rx) * reach

    local ped = cache.ped
    local ray = StartExpensiveSynchronousShapeTestLosProbe(camCoords.x, camCoords.y, camCoords.z, tx, ty, tz, RAY_FLAGS, ped, 7)
    local _, hit, coords, normal, entity = GetShapeTestResult(ray)

    local result = camRay
    result.valid = false
    result.vehicle = nil

    if not (hit == 1 or hit == true) then
        return result
    end

    local pedCoords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    if #(pedCoords - coords) > PLACE_DISTANCE then
        result.coords = coords
        return result
    end

    local face = GetHeadingFromVector_2d(pedCoords.x - coords.x, pedCoords.y - coords.y) + 180.0 + heading
    local pitch = -mdeg(matan(normal.y, normal.z))
    local roll = mdeg(matan(normal.x, normal.z))

    result.coords = coords + normal * 0.02
    result.rot = vector3(pitch, roll, face)
    result.valid = true

    if entity and entity ~= 0 and DoesEntityExist(entity) and GetEntityType(entity) == 2 then
        if not NetworkGetEntityIsNetworked(entity) then
            result.valid = false
            return result
        end
        result.vehicle = entity
    end

    return result
end

---@param bombCfg table
---@param result table
---@param timer integer
---@param pin string
---@return table
local function buildPayload(bombCfg, result, timer, pin)
    local rot = result.rot
    local payload = { timer = timer, pin = pin }
    local vehicle = result.vehicle

    if vehicle and bombCfg.vehicle then
        local offset = GetOffsetFromEntityGivenWorldCoords(vehicle, result.coords.x, result.coords.y, result.coords.z)
        local vrot = GetEntityRotation(vehicle, 2)
        payload.vehicle = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(vehicle)
        payload.offset = { x = offset.x, y = offset.y, z = offset.z }
        payload.rot = { x = rot.x - vrot.x, y = rot.y - vrot.y, z = rot.z - vrot.z }
    else
        payload.coords = { x = result.coords.x, y = result.coords.y, z = result.coords.z }
        payload.rot = { x = rot.x, y = rot.y, z = rot.z }
    end

    return payload
end

---@param bombCfg table
---@param result table
---@return boolean
local function plant(bombCfg, result)
    local ped = cache.ped
    local low = result.coords.z < GetEntityCoords(ped).z - 0.5
    local anim = low and config.crouchAnim or config.plantAnim

    return lib.progressBar({
        duration = config.plantDuration,
        label = ('Memasang %s...'):format(bombCfg.label),
        useWhileDead = false,
        canCancel = true,
        disable = { move = true, car = true, combat = true },
        anim = { dict = anim.dict, clip = anim.clip, flag = 1 },
    }) == true
end

---@param slot integer
---@param kind string
local function placeBomb(slot, kind)
    local bombCfg = BOMBS[kind]
    local timer, pin = askSettings(bombCfg)
    if not timer then return end

    local hash = loadModel(bombCfg.model)
    if not hash then return end

    local preview = CreateObject(hash, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, false, false, false)
    SetEntityCollision(preview, false, false)
    SetEntityAlpha(preview, 0, false)
    FreezeEntityPosition(preview, true)
    startHold(bombCfg)

    infoui:show({
        id = INFO_PLACE,
        title = bombCfg.label,
        icon = 'fa-solid fa-bomb',
        description = '[kbd]E[/kbd] Pasang  [kbd]Scroll[/kbd] Putar  [kbd]X[/kbd] Batal',
    })

    local heading = 0.0
    local nextTrace = 0
    local result = camRay
    local confirmed = false

    while placing do
        DisableControlAction(0, CONTROL_SCROLL_UP, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, CONTROL_SCROLL_DOWN, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, CONTROL_ATTACK, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, CONTROL_AIM, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, CONTROL_BACK, true)

        if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, CONTROL_SCROLL_UP) then
            heading = heading + ROTATE_STEP
        elseif IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, CONTROL_SCROLL_DOWN) then
            heading = heading - ROTATE_STEP
        end

        local now = GetGameTimer()
        if now >= nextTrace then
            nextTrace = now + 30
            result = trace(heading)
            if result.coords then
                SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(preview, result.coords.x, result.coords.y, result.coords.z, false, false, false)
                if result.rot then
                    SetEntityRotation(preview, result.rot.x, result.rot.y, result.rot.z, 2, true)
                end
                SetEntityAlpha(preview, result.valid and PREVIEW_ALPHA or 60, false)
            else
                SetEntityAlpha(preview, 0, false)
            end
        end

        if IsControlJustPressed(0, CONTROL_PLACE) then
            if result.valid and (not result.vehicle or bombCfg.vehicle) then
                confirmed = true
                break
            end
            notify(result.vehicle and 'Bom ini tidak bisa dipasang di kendaraan.' or 'Tidak bisa dipasang di sini.')
        elseif IsControlJustPressed(0, CONTROL_CANCEL) or IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, CONTROL_BACK) or IsEntityDead(cache.ped) then
            break
        end

        Wait(0)
    end

    infoui:remove(INFO_PLACE)
    deleteLocal(preview)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(hash)

    if not confirmed then
        stopHold()
        return
    end

    local payload = buildPayload(bombCfg, result, timer, pin)
    local done = plant(bombCfg, result)
    stopHold()
    if not done then return notify('Pemasangan dibatalkan.', 'inform') end

    local ok, reason = lib.callback.await('sm_bomb:place', false, slot, kind, payload)
    if not ok then return notify(reason or 'Gagal memasang bom.') end

    notify(bombCfg.timer and ('%s aktif, meledak dalam %d detik.'):format(bombCfg.label, timer) or ('%s terpasang. Gunakan detonator untuk meledakkan.'):format(bombCfg.label), 'success')
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_bomb:client:place', function(slot, kind)
    if source == '' or placing or armed or defuseId or not BOMBS[kind] then return end
    if cache.vehicle then return notify('Tidak bisa memasang bom dari dalam kendaraan.') end

    placing = true
    local ok, err = pcall(placeBomb, slot, kind)
    placing = false
    if not ok then
        infoui:remove(INFO_PLACE)
        stopHold()
        lib.print.error(err)
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_bomb:client:attach', function(net, vehNet, offset, rot)
    if source == '' then return end

    local entity, vehicle = 0, 0
    for _ = 1, 60 do
        entity, vehicle = entityFromNet(net), entityFromNet(vehNet)
        if entity ~= 0 and vehicle ~= 0 then break end
        Wait(50)
    end
    if entity == 0 or vehicle == 0 then return end

    for _ = 1, 20 do
        if NetworkHasControlOfEntity(entity) then break end
        NetworkRequestControlOfEntity(entity)
        Wait(50)
    end

    FreezeEntityPosition(entity, false)
    AttachEntityToEntity(entity, vehicle, 0, offset.x, offset.y, offset.z, rot.x, rot.y, rot.z, false, false, false, false, 2, true)
end)

local function disarm()
    armed = false
    infoui:remove(INFO_DETONATOR)
    deleteLocal(detonatorProp)
    detonatorProp = nil
    StopAnimTask(cache.ped, DETONATOR.anim.dict, DETONATOR.anim.clip, 1.0)
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_bomb:client:detonator', function(slot)
    if source == '' or armed or placing or defuseId then return end
    armed = true

    local ped = cache.ped
    local hash = loadModel(DETONATOR.model)
    if hash then
        local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
        local o = DETONATOR.offset
        detonatorProp = CreateObject(hash, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false)
        SetEntityCollision(detonatorProp, false, false)
        AttachEntityToEntity(detonatorProp, ped, GetPedBoneIndex(ped, DETONATOR.bone), o.x, o.y, o.z, o.rx, o.ry, o.rz, true, true, false, true, 1, true)
        SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(hash)
    end

    local anim = DETONATOR.anim
    if loadDict(anim.dict) then
        TaskPlayAnim(ped, anim.dict, anim.clip, 8.0, -8.0, -1, 50, 0, false, false, false)
    end

    infoui:show({
        id = INFO_DETONATOR,
        title = 'Detonator',
        icon = 'fa-solid fa-tower-broadcast',
        description = '[kbd]Klik Kiri[/kbd] Ledakkan  [kbd]Klik Kanan[/kbd] Simpan',
    })

    local count = #DETONATOR_CONTROLS
    while armed do
        for i = 1, count do
            DisableControlAction(0, DETONATOR_CONTROLS[i], true)
        end

        if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, CONTROL_ATTACK) then
            disarm()
            local ok, reason = lib.callback.await('sm_bomb:detonate', false, slot)
            if not ok then notify(reason or 'Detonator gagal.') end
            break
        elseif IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, CONTROL_AIM) or IsEntityDead(cache.ped) then
            disarm()
            break
        end

        Wait(0)
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_bomb:client:explode', function(data)
    if source == '' or type(data) ~= 'table' then return end

    local bombCfg = BOMBS[data.kind]
    if not bombCfg then return end

    local coords = data.coords
    local entity = entityFromNet(data.net)
    if entity ~= 0 then
        coords = GetEntityCoords(entity)
    end

    local ownerPlayer = data.owner and GetPlayerFromServerId(data.owner) or -1
    local ownerPed = ownerPlayer ~= -1 and GetPlayerPed(ownerPlayer) or 0
    local explosion = bombCfg.explosion
    local types = explosion.types

    for i = 1, #types do
        if ownerPed ~= 0 and DoesEntityExist(ownerPed) then
            AddOwnedExplosion(ownerPed, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, types[i], explosion.damageScale, true, false, explosion.shake)
        else
            AddExplosion(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, types[i], explosion.damageScale, true, false, explosion.shake)
        end
    end
end)

    SetTimeout(5000, function()

    end)
end)

local screen = { dui = nil, txdReady = false, replaced = false, bombId = nil, ends = nil, volume = -1, idleSince = 0 }

---@param message table
local function duiSend(message)
    if screen.dui then
        SendDuiMessage(screen.dui, jencode(message))
    end
end

---@return boolean
local function ensureScreen()
    if not screen.dui then
        local dui = CreateDui(SCREEN_URL, SCREEN.width, SCREEN.height)
        local waited = 0
        while not IsDuiAvailable(dui) do
            Wait(100)
            waited = waited + 100
            if waited >= 5000 then
                DestroyDui(dui)
                return false
            end
        end
        screen.dui = dui
        if not screen.txdReady then
            CreateRuntimeTextureFromDuiHandle(CreateRuntimeTxd('sm_bomb_screen'), 'sm_bomb_screen', GetDuiHandle(dui))
            screen.txdReady = true
        end
    end

    if not screen.replaced then
        AddReplaceTexture(SCREEN.txd, SCREEN.texture, 'sm_bomb_screen', 'sm_bomb_screen')
        screen.replaced = true
    end
    return true
end

local function releaseScreen()
    if screen.replaced then
        RemoveReplaceTexture(SCREEN.txd, SCREEN.texture)
        screen.replaced = false
    end
    if screen.bombId then
        duiSend({ action = 'stop' })
        screen.bombId = nil
        screen.ends = nil
        screen.volume = -1
    end
end

local function destroyScreen()
    releaseScreen()
    if screen.dui then
        DestroyDui(screen.dui)
        screen.dui = nil
        screen.txdReady = false
    end
end

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        local sleep = 1000

        if knownCount > 0 then
            sleep = 250
            local camCoords = GetGameplayCamCoord()
            local bestId, bestDist, bestBomb

            for id, bomb in pairs(known) do
                if bomb.ends then
                    local entity = entityFromNet(bomb.net)
                    if entity ~= 0 and TIMER_HASHES[GetEntityModel(entity)] then
                        local dist = #(camCoords - GetEntityCoords(entity))
                        if dist <= SCREEN_DISTANCE and (not bestDist or dist < bestDist) then
                            bestId, bestDist, bestBomb = id, dist, bomb
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            if bestId and ensureScreen() then
                screen.idleSince = 0
                if screen.bombId ~= bestId or screen.ends ~= bestBomb.ends then
                    screen.bombId = bestId
                    screen.ends = bestBomb.ends
                    duiSend({ action = 'state', ends = bestBomb.ends, now = GetCloudTimeAsInt() })
                end

                local falloff = 1.0 - bestDist / SCREEN_DISTANCE
                local volume = SCREEN.volume * falloff * falloff
                if mabs(volume - screen.volume) > 0.02 then
                    screen.volume = volume
                    duiSend({ action = 'volume', value = volume })
                end
            else
                releaseScreen()
            end
        else
            releaseScreen()
        end

        if screen.dui and not screen.bombId then
            local now = GetGameTimer()
            if screen.idleSince == 0 then
                screen.idleSince = now
            elseif now - screen.idleSince > 30000 then
                destroyScreen()
                screen.idleSince = 0
            end
        end

        Wait(sleep)
    end
end)

if hasFrame then
    interface.callback('ready', function(_, cb)
        frameReady = true
        flush()
        cb({})
    end)

    interface.callback('decryptStart', function(_, cb)
        local id = defuseId
        if not id then return cb({ ok = false }) end
        local ok, result, wait = lib.callback.await('sm_bomb:decryptStart', false, id)
        cb({ ok = ok == true, cells = ok and result or nil, reason = not ok and result or nil, wait = wait })
    end)

    interface.callback('decryptSubmit', function(data, cb)
        local id = defuseId
        if not id or type(data) ~= 'table' then return cb({ ok = false }) end
        local ok, result, extra = lib.callback.await('sm_bomb:decryptSubmit', false, id, data.cells)
        cb({ ok = ok == true, revealed = ok and result or nil, reason = not ok and result or nil, extra = extra })
    end)

    interface.callback('pin', function(data, cb)
        local id = defuseId
        if not id or type(data) ~= 'table' then return cb({ ok = false }) end
        local ok, reason, extra = lib.callback.await('sm_bomb:pin', false, id, data.pin)
        cb({ ok = ok == true, reason = reason, extra = extra })
        if ok then
            SetTimeout(900, function()
                if defuseId == id then
                    closeFrame()
                    notify('Bom berhasil dijinakkan.', 'success')
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    interface.callback('close', function(_, cb)
        cb({})
        local id = defuseId
        if not id then return end
        closeFrame()
        lib.callback('sm_bomb:close', false, noop, id)
    end)
end

AddEventHandler('sm_bomb:client:forceClose', function()
    if armed then disarm() end
    if defuseId then
        local id = defuseId
        forceCloseDefuse()
        lib.callback('sm_bomb:close', false, noop, id)
    end
end)

end)
