RegisterNetEvent('sm_domino:client:place', function(slot)
    if source == '' then return end
    if placing or seated then return end
    if cache.vehicle then return notify(REASONS.vehicle) end
    if not loadModel(TABLE_MODEL) then return notify('Could not load the table model.') end
    applyBoardTexture()

    placing = true
    local ped = cache.ped
    local origin = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local ghost = CreateObjectNoOffset(TABLE_MODEL, origin.x, origin.y, origin.z, false, false, false)
    SetEntityCollision(ghost, false, false)
    SetEntityAlpha(ghost, 170, false)

    local heading = GetEntityHeading(ped)
    local start = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(ped, 0.0, 1.8, 0.0)
    local px, py = start.x, start.y
    local result

    infoui:show({ id = INFO_ID, title = 'Domino table', icon = 'fa-solid fa-dice-six', description = PLACE_HINT })

    while placing do
        DisableAllControlActions(0)
        for i = 1, #PLACE_CONTROLS do
            EnableControlAction(0, PLACE_CONTROLS[i], true)
        end

        if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, CONTROL_WHEEL_UP) then heading = heading + 5.0 end
        if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, CONTROL_WHEEL_DOWN) then heading = heading - 5.0 end

        local step = GetFrameTime() * MOVE_SPEED
        local yaw = rad(GetGameplayCamRot(2).z)
        local fx, fy = -sin(yaw), cos(yaw)
        local forward, right = 0.0, 0.0
        if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, CONTROL_UP) then forward = forward + step end
        if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, CONTROL_DOWN) then forward = forward - step end
        if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, CONTROL_RIGHT) then right = right + step end
        if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, CONTROL_LEFT) then right = right - step end
        px = px + fx * forward + fy * right
        py = py + fy * forward - fx * right

        local pedPos = GetEntityCoords(ped)
        local dx, dy = px - pedPos.x, py - pedPos.y
        local reach = (dx * dx + dy * dy) ^ 0.5
        if reach > PLACE_REACH then
            local scale = PLACE_REACH / reach
            px, py = pedPos.x + dx * scale, pedPos.y + dy * scale
        end

        SetEntityCoords(ghost, px, py, pedPos.z + 1.0, false, false, false, false)
        PlaceObjectOnGroundProperly(ghost)
        SetEntityHeading(ghost, heading)

        local valid = #(pedPos - GetEntityCoords(ghost)) <= PLACE_DISTANCE

        if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, CONTROL_ENTER) then
            if valid then
                result = GetEntityCoords(ghost)
                break
            end
            notify(REASONS.far)
        elseif IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, CONTROL_BACK) or IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, CONTROL_ESC) then
            break
        end

        Wait(0)
    end

    DeleteEntity(ghost)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(TABLE_MODEL)
    infoui:remove(INFO_ID)

    if result and lib.progressBar({
        duration = 3500,
        label = 'Setting up the table...',
        useWhileDead = false,
        canCancel = true,
        disable = { move = true, combat = true, car = true },
        anim = { dict = 'anim@heists@money_grab@briefcase', clip = 'put_down_case' },
    }) then
        local ok, reason = lib.callback.await('sm_domino:place', false, slot, { x = result.x, y = result.y, z = result.z }, heading % 360.0)
        if ok then
            notify('Table set up. Grab a chair to play.', 'success')
        else
            notifyFail(reason, 'Could not set up the table.')
        end
    end

    placing = false
end)

---@param value any
---@return number?
local function toInt(value)
    return type(value) == 'number' and tointeger(value) or nil
end

if hasFrame then
    interface.callback('ready', function(_, cb)
        frameReady = true
        cb({})
        if seated then pushState() end
    end)

    interface.callback('focus', function(data, cb)
        cb({})
        setFocus(type(data) == 'table' and data.on == true)
    end)

    interface.callback('host', function(data, cb)
        if not seated or type(data) ~= 'table' or type(data.action) ~= 'string' then return cb({ ok = false }) end
        local value = data.value
        if type(value) == 'number' then value = toInt(value) end
        local ok, reason = lib.callback.await('sm_domino:host', false, data.action, value)
        if not ok and reason then notifyFail(reason, 'Action failed.') end
        cb({ ok = ok == true })
    end)

    interface.callback('view', function(_, cb)
        if not seated then return cb({ view = 'seat' }) end
        seated.view = seated.view == 'seat' and 'top' or 'seat'
        updateCamera()
        cb({ view = seated.view })
    end)

    interface.callback('continue', function(_, cb)
        if not seated then return cb({ ok = false }) end
        cb({ ok = lib.callback.await('sm_domino:ready', false) == true })
    end)

    interface.callback('stand', function(_, cb)
        cb({})
        CreateThread(function() standUp() end)
    end)
end

    if resource ~= cache.resource then return end
    if seated then
        local ped = cache.ped
        FreezeEntityPosition(ped, false)
        ClearPedTasks(ped)
        destroyCamera()
        playerState.invBusy = false
    end
    infoui:remove(INFO_ID)
    RemoveReplaceTexture(config.tableModel, config.boardTexture)
    for _, entry in pairs(tables) do
        despawnTable(entry)
    end
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_2\interface\sm_domino\modules\engine.lua
local layout = localmodule 'modules.layout'

local random = math.random
local huge = math.huge

local engine = {}

---@class DominoTile
---@field id number
---@field lo number
---@field hi number

---@type DominoTile[]
local TILES = {}
for lo = 0, 6 do
    for hi = lo, 6 do
        TILES[#TILES + 1] = { id = #TILES + 1, lo = lo, hi = hi }
    end
end
engine.tiles = TILES

local DOUBLE_SIX = #TILES

---@param count number
---@param fourMode string
---@return string?
function engine.modeFor(count, fourMode)
    if count == 2 then return 'duel' end
    if count == 3 then return 'ffa' end
    if count == 4 then return fourMode == 'ffa' and 'ffa4' or 'pairs' end
end

---@param mode string
---@return boolean
function engine.drawMode(mode)
    return mode == 'duel' or mode == 'ffa'
end

---@param seats number[]
---@param mode string
---@param target number
---@return table
function engine.newMatch(seats, mode, target)
    local teamOf, teams = {}, 0
    for i = 1, #seats do
        local seat = seats[i]
        if mode == 'pairs' then
            teamOf[seat] = seat % 2 == 1 and 1 or 2
        else
            teamOf[seat] = i
        end
    end
    teams = mode == 'pairs' and 2 or #seats

    local scores = {}
    for i = 1, teams do scores[i] = 0 end

    return { mode = mode, seats = seats, teamOf = teamOf, teams = teams, target = target, scores = scores, round = 0 }
end

---@param match table
---@param seat number
---@return number
function engine.nextSeat(match, seat)
    local seats = match.seats
    for i = 1, #seats do
        if seats[i] == seat then
            return seats[i % #seats + 1]
        end
    end
    return seats[1]
end

---@param tile DominoTile
---@return number
local function pips(tile)
    return tile.lo + tile.hi
end

---@param hand DominoTile[]
---@return number
function engine.handPips(hand)
    local total = 0
    for i = 1, #hand do total = total + pips(hand[i]) end
    return total
end

---@return DominoTile[]
function engine.shuffleDeck()
    local deck = {}
    for i = 1, #TILES do deck[i] = TILES[i] end
    for i = #deck, 2, -1 do
        local j = random(i)
        deck[i], deck[j] = deck[j], deck[i]
    end
    return deck
end

---@param match table
---@param hands table<number, DominoTile[]>
---@param stock DominoTile[]
---@return table
function engine.beginHand(match, hands, stock)
    match.round = match.round + 1

    local hand = { hands = hands, stock = stock, board = {}, passes = 0, turn = 0 }

    local opener = match.opener
    if opener and hands[opener] then
        hand.turn = opener
        hand.free = true
        return hand
    end

    local bestSeat, bestTile, bestScore = nil, nil, -1
    for seat, tiles in pairs(hands) do
        for i = 1, #tiles do
            local tile = tiles[i]
            local score
            if engine.drawMode(match.mode) then
                score = (tile.lo == tile.hi and 100 or 0) + pips(tile)
            else
                score = tile.id == DOUBLE_SIX and 1 or -1
            end
            if score > bestScore then
                bestSeat, bestTile, bestScore = seat, tile, score
            end
        end
    end

    hand.turn = bestSeat or match.seats[1]
    hand.forced = bestTile and bestTile.id
    return hand
end

---@param match table
---@return table
function engine.newHand(match)
    local deck = engine.shuffleDeck()
    local hands, cursor = {}, 0
    for i = 1, #match.seats do
        local tiles = {}
        for n = 1, 7 do
            cursor = cursor + 1
            tiles[n] = deck[cursor]
        end
        hands[match.seats[i]] = tiles
    end

    local stock = {}
    if engine.drawMode(match.mode) then
        for i = cursor + 1, #deck do stock[#stock + 1] = deck[i] end
    end

    return engine.beginHand(match, hands, stock)
end

---@param hand table
---@param tile DominoTile
---@return boolean left
---@return boolean right
function engine.fits(hand, tile)
    if #hand.board == 0 then
        local ok = hand.free or hand.forced == nil or hand.forced == tile.id
        return ok, false
    end
    local left, right = hand.left, hand.right
    return tile.lo == left or tile.hi == left, tile.lo == right or tile.hi == right
end

---@param hand table
---@param seat number
---@return { tile: DominoTile, side: string }[]
function engine.moves(hand, seat)
    local list = {}
    local tiles = hand.hands[seat]
    if not tiles then return list end

    for i = 1, #tiles do
        local tile = tiles[i]
        local left, right = engine.fits(hand, tile)
        if left then list[#list + 1] = { tile = tile, side = 'left' } end
        if right and not (left and hand.left == hand.right) then
            list[#list + 1] = { tile = tile, side = 'right' }
        end
    end

    return list
end

---@param tiles DominoTile[]
---@param id number
---@return number?
local function indexOf(tiles, id)
    for i = 1, #tiles do
        if tiles[i].id == id then return i end
    end
end

---@param hand table
---@param seat number
---@param tileId number
---@param side string
---@return table?
function engine.play(hand, seat, tileId, side)
    if hand.turn ~= seat then return end
    if side ~= 'left' and side ~= 'right' then return end

    local tiles = hand.hands[seat]
    local index = tiles and indexOf(tiles, tileId)
    if not index then return end

    local tile = tiles[index]
    local fitsLeft, fitsRight = engine.fits(hand, tile)
    local board = hand.board

    if #board == 0 then
        if not fitsLeft then return end
        local x, y, yaw, branches = layout.first(tile)
        hand.branches = branches
        hand.left, hand.right = tile.lo, tile.hi
        board[1] = { id = tile.id, lo = tile.lo, hi = tile.hi, x = x, y = y, r = yaw, seat = seat }
    else
        if (side == 'left' and not fitsLeft) or (side == 'right' and not fitsRight) then return end

        local branchIndex = side == 'left' and 1 or 2
        local match = hand[side]
        local x, y, yaw, branch = layout.next(board, hand.branches[branchIndex], tile, match)
        hand.branches[branchIndex] = branch
        hand[side] = tile.lo == match and tile.hi or tile.lo
        board[#board + 1] = { id = tile.id, lo = tile.lo, hi = tile.hi, x = x, y = y, r = yaw, seat = seat }
    end

    table.remove(tiles, index)
    hand.passes = 0
    hand.free = nil
    hand.forced = nil

    local domino = #tiles == 0
    return { tile = tile, domino = domino }
end

---@param hand table
---@param seat number
---@return DominoTile?
function engine.draw(hand, seat)
    if hand.turn ~= seat then return end
    local stock = hand.stock
    local count = #stock
    if count == 0 then return end

    local tile = stock[count]
    stock[count] = nil
    local tiles = hand.hands[seat]
    tiles[#tiles + 1] = tile
    return tile
end

---@param hand table
---@param seat number
---@return boolean
function engine.canPass(hand, seat)
    return hand.turn == seat and #hand.stock == 0 and #engine.moves(hand, seat) == 0
end

---@param match table
---@param hand table
---@param winnerSeat number?
---@return table
function engine.score(match, hand, winnerSeat)
    local teamOf = match.teamOf
    local seatPips, teamPips = {}, {}
    for i = 1, match.teams do teamPips[i] = 0 end

    for seat, tiles in pairs(hand.hands) do
        local total = engine.handPips(tiles)
        seatPips[seat] = total
        local team = teamOf[seat]
        teamPips[team] = teamPips[team] + total
    end

    local blocked = winnerSeat == nil
    local team = winnerSeat and teamOf[winnerSeat] or 0

    if blocked then
        local lowest, ties = huge, 0
        for i = 1, match.teams do
            local total = teamPips[i]
            if total < lowest then
                lowest, team, ties = total, i, 1
            elseif total == lowest then
                ties = ties + 1
            end
        end
        if ties ~= 1 then team = 0 end

        if team ~= 0 then
            local best = huge
            for seat, total in pairs(seatPips) do
                if teamOf[seat] == team and total < best then
                    best, winnerSeat = total, seat
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local points = 0
    if team ~= 0 then
        for i = 1, match.teams do
            if i ~= team then points = points + teamPips[i] end
        end
        match.scores[team] = match.scores[team] + points
    end

    match.opener = winnerSeat

    local over = team ~= 0 and match.scores[team] >= match.target

    return {
        seat = winnerSeat,
        team = team,
        points = points,
        blocked = blocked,
        seatPips = seatPips,
        over = over,
    }
end

---@param hand table
---@param seat number
---@param tile DominoTile
---@param side string
---@return number
local function evaluate(hand, seat, tile, side)
    local tiles = hand.hands[seat]
    local newEnd
    if #hand.board == 0 then
        newEnd = tile.hi
    else
        local match = hand[side]
        newEnd = tile.lo == match and tile.hi or tile.lo
    end

    local keep = 0
    for i = 1, #tiles do
        local other = tiles[i]
        if other.id ~= tile.id and (other.lo == newEnd or other.hi == newEnd) then
            keep = keep + 1
        end
    end

    local value = pips(tile) + keep * 3 + random() * 0.5
    if tile.lo == tile.hi then value = value + 8 end
    return value
end

---@param hand table
---@param seat number
---@return string action
---@return number? tileId
---@return string? side
function engine.botMove(hand, seat)
    local moves = engine.moves(hand, seat)

    if #moves == 0 then
        if #hand.stock > 0 then return 'draw' end
        return 'pass'
    end

    local best, bestValue = moves[1], -huge
    for i = 1, #moves do
        local move = moves[i]
        local value = evaluate(hand, seat, move.tile, move.side)
        if value > bestValue then
            best, bestValue = move, value
        end
    end

    return 'play', best.tile.id, best.side
end

return engine


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_2\interface\sm_domino\modules\layout.lua
local abs, rad, deg, cos, sin, atan = math.abs, math.rad, math.deg, math.cos, math.sin, math.atan

local HALF_W = 0.0125
local HALF_L = 0.025
local GAP = 0.0008
local BEND_LIMIT = 0.34
local BOUND = 0.38
local GRID_STEP = 0.03

local layout = {}

---@param yaw number
---@return number halfX
---@return number halfY
local function extents(yaw)
    local r = rad(yaw)
    local c, s = abs(cos(r)), abs(sin(r))
    return c * HALF_W + s * HALF_L, s * HALF_W + c * HALF_L
end

---@param board table[]
---@param x number
---@param y number
---@param yaw number
---@return boolean
local function isClear(board, x, y, yaw)
    local hx, hy = extents(yaw)
    if abs(x) + hx > BOUND or abs(y) + hy > BOUND then return false end

    for i = 1, #board do
        local placed = board[i]
        local px, py = extents(placed.r)
        if abs(x - placed.x) < hx + px - 0.0001 and abs(y - placed.y) < hy + py - 0.0001 then
            return false
        end
    end

    return true
end

---@param dx number
---@param dy number
---@param tile { lo: number, hi: number }
---@param match number
---@return number
local function yawFor(dx, dy, tile, match)
    local yaw = deg(atan(-dx, dy))
    if tile.lo == tile.hi then
        yaw = yaw + 90.0
    elseif tile.lo == match then
        yaw = yaw + 180.0
    end
    return (yaw + 0.5) // 90 * 90 % 360
end

---@param tile { lo: number, hi: number }
---@return number x
---@return number y
---@return number yaw
---@return table branches
function layout.first(tile)
    local double = tile.lo == tile.hi
    local along = double and HALF_W or HALF_L
    local across = double and HALF_L or HALF_W

    return 0.0, 0.0, double and 0.0 or 90.0, {
        { x = 0.0, y = 0.0, dx = -1, dy = 0, along = along, across = across, turn = -1 },
        { x = 0.0, y = 0.0, dx = 1, dy = 0, along = along, across = across, turn = 1 },
    }
end

---@param board table[]
---@param branch table
---@param tile { lo: number, hi: number }
---@param match number
---@return number x
---@return number y
---@return number yaw
---@return table branch
function layout.next(board, branch, tile, match)
    local double = tile.lo == tile.hi
    local along = double and HALF_W or HALF_L
    local across = double and HALF_L or HALF_W
    local bx, by, dx, dy = branch.x, branch.y, branch.dx, branch.dy

    if dy == 0 then
        local cx = bx + dx * (branch.along + along + GAP)
        local yaw = yawFor(dx, 0, tile, match)
        if abs(cx) + along <= BEND_LIMIT and isClear(board, cx, by, yaw) then
            return cx, by, yaw, { x = cx, y = by, dx = dx, dy = 0, along = along, across = across, turn = branch.turn }
        end

        local turn = branch.turn
        local vAlong = double and HALF_W or HALF_L
        local vAcross = double and HALF_L or HALF_W
        local vx = bx + dx * (branch.along - vAcross)
        local vy = by + turn * (branch.across + vAlong + GAP)
        yaw = yawFor(0, turn, tile, match)
        if isClear(board, vx, vy, yaw) then
            return vx, vy, yaw, { x = vx, y = vy, dx = 0, dy = turn, along = vAlong, across = vAcross, turn = turn, back = -dx }
        end
    else
        local back = branch.back or 1
        local hy = by + dy * (branch.along - across)
        local hx = bx + back * (branch.across + along + GAP)
        local yaw = yawFor(back, 0, tile, match)
        if isClear(board, hx, hy, yaw) then
            return hx, hy, yaw, { x = hx, y = hy, dx = back, dy = 0, along = along, across = across, turn = branch.turn }
        end
    end

    local yaw = yawFor(dx, dy, tile, match)
    local start = -BOUND + 0.03
    local gy = start
    while gy <= BOUND - 0.03 do
        local gx = start
        while gx <= BOUND - 0.03 do
            if isClear(board, gx, gy, yaw) then
                return gx, gy, yaw, { x = gx, y = gy, dx = dx, dy = dy, along = along, across = across, turn = branch.turn, back = branch.back }
            end
            gx = gx + GRID_STEP
        end
        gy = gy + GRID_STEP
    end

    return bx, by, yaw, branch
end

return layout

---@param pct number
---@return number value
---@return number index
function HRS_EngVolSnap(pct)
    pct = tonumber(pct) or 0
    if pct <= 0 then return 0, 0 end
    local levels = ECUConfig.EngineVolumeLevels
    local best, bi, bd = 0, 0, math.huge
    for i = 1, #levels do
        local d = math.abs(levels[i] - pct)
        if d < bd then best, bi, bd = levels[i], i, d end
    end
    return best, bi
end

function HRSVehicleBlocked(model, class)
    if model and model ~= '' then
        local m = string.lower(tostring(model))
        for _, name in ipairs(ECUConfig.BlacklistVehicles or {}) do
            if string.lower(name) == m then return true end
        end
    end
    if class then
        local cl = tonumber(class)
        for _, c in ipairs(ECUConfig.BlacklistClasses or {}) do
            if tonumber(c) == cl then return true end
        end
        local allowed = ECUConfig.AllowedClasses
        if allowed and #allowed > 0 then
            for _, c in ipairs(allowed) do
                if tonumber(c) == cl then return false end
            end
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function HRSPartDisabled(key)
    local keinHandling = ECUConfig.ModifyHandling == false
    if (ECUConfig.EnableDrift   == false or keinHandling) and key == 'driftflash'   then return true end
    if (ECUConfig.EnableAntiLag == false or keinHandling) and key == 'antilagflash' then return true end
    return false
end

local placedDynos = {}

local startSetup

    dui = nil, txd = nil, tex = nil,
    rt = {}, replaced = false,
}

local function screenSendRaw(payload)
    if scr.dui then SendDuiMessage(scr.dui, json.encode(payload)) end
end

local function screenSend(payload)
    if scr.dui then SendDuiMessage(scr.dui, json.encode(payload)) end
end
local runState     = nil





local function dnotify(ntype, key, ...)
    if HRS_Notify then
        HRS_Notify(ntype, key, ...)
    else
        print(('^3[Debug Dyno]^7 %s: %s'):format(ntype, key))
    end
end

local function dnui(data)
    ECU_SendNUI(data)
end

local function loadModel(hash)
    if not IsModelInCdimage(hash) or not IsModelValid(hash) then return false end
    RequestModel(hash)
    local t = GetGameTimer() + 8000
    while not HasModelLoaded(hash) do
        Wait(0)
        if GetGameTimer() > t then return false end
    end
    return true
end

local function originFixFor(model)
    for _, d in ipairs(ECUConfig.Dyno.Props) do
        if d.model == model and d.originFix then return d.originFix end
    end
    return vector3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
end

local function applyOriginFix(model, pos, yawDeg)
    local f = originFixFor(model)
    if f.x == 0.0 and f.y == 0.0 and f.z == 0.0 then return pos end
    local r = math.rad(yawDeg or 0.0)
    local cs, sn = math.cos(r), math.sin(r)
    return vector3(pos.x + (f.x * cs - f.y * sn),
                   pos.y + (f.x * sn + f.y * cs),
                   pos.z + f.z)
end

local function createProp(model, pos, rot, ghost)
    local hash = GetHashKey(model)
    if not loadModel(hash) then
        print(('^1[Debug EcuTuning]^7 dyno model "%s" failed to load (missing ytyp?)'):format(model))
        return nil
    end

    local wp = applyOriginFix(model, pos, rot.z)
    local obj
    if model == 'hrs_dyno' then
        obj = CreateObjectNoOffset(hash, wp.x, wp.y, wp.z, false, false, false)
    else
        obj = CreateObject(hash, wp.x, wp.y, wp.z, false, false, false)
    end
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(hash)
    if not obj or obj == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(obj) then return nil end

    SetEntityRotation(obj, rot.x, rot.y, rot.z, 2, true)
    FreezeEntityPosition(obj, true)
    if ghost then
        SetEntityCollision(obj, false, false)
        SetEntityAlpha(obj, 190, false)
    else
        SetEntityCollision(obj, true, true)
        ResetEntityAlpha(obj)
    end
    if model == 'hrs_dyno' and HRS_DynoRollers then
        HRS_DynoRollers.spawn(obj, ghost)
    end
    return obj
end

local function destroySet(objs)
    for _, o in ipairs(objs or {}) do
        if HRS_DynoRollers then HRS_DynoRollers.remove(o) end
        if DoesEntityExist(o) then DeleteEntity(o) end
    end
end

local rebuildTries = 0

local function rebuildWorld()
    for _, set in pairs(spawnedProps) do destroySet(set) end
    spawnedProps = {}

    local expected, created = 0, 0
    for _, d in ipairs(placedDynos) do
        local objs = {}
        for _, pr in ipairs(d.props or {}) do
            expected = expected + 1
            local o = createProp(pr.model,
                vector3(pr.x, pr.y, pr.z),
                vector3(pr.rx or 0.0, pr.ry or 0.0, pr.rz or 0.0), false)
            if o then
                objs[#objs + 1] = o
                created = created + 1
            end
        end
        spawnedProps[d.owner] = objs
    end

    if expected > 0 and created < expected then
        rebuildTries = rebuildTries + 1
        if rebuildTries <= 6 then
            print(('^3[Debug Dyno]^7 only %d of %d props created, retry in 4s (%d/6)')
                :format(created, expected, rebuildTries))
            SetTimeout(4000, function()
                if #placedDynos > 0 then rebuildWorld() end
            end)
            lastSig = nil
        else
            print(('^1[Debug Dyno]^7 props could not be created (%d/%d).')
                :format(created, expected))
            print('^1[Debug Dyno]^7 check that hrs_dyno.ytyp is streamed')
        end
    elseif expected > 0 then
        rebuildTries = 0
        print(('^2[Debug Dyno]^7 %d prop(s) built'):format(created))
    end
end

local function nearestDyno(coords)
    local best, bestProp, bestD = nil, nil, ECUConfig.Dyno.MountDistance + 3.0
    for _, d in ipairs(placedDynos) do
        for _, pr in ipairs(d.props or {}) do
            if pr.isdyno == 1 or pr.isdyno == true then
                local dist = #(coords - vector3(pr.x, pr.y, pr.z))
                if dist < bestD then best, bestProp, bestD = d, pr, dist end
            end
        end
    end
    return best, bestProp, bestD
end

local dynoBlips = {}

local function clearBlips()
    for _, b in ipairs(dynoBlips) do
        if DoesBlipExist(b) then RemoveBlip(b) end
    end
    dynoBlips = {}
end

local function rebuildBlips()
    clearBlips()
    local cfg = ECUConfig.Dyno.Blip
    if not cfg or not cfg.enabled then return end

    for _, d in ipairs(placedDynos) do
        local isStatic = tostring(d.owner or ''):find('^static') ~= nil
        if isStatic or not cfg.staticOnly then
            for _, pr in ipairs(d.props or {}) do
                if pr.isdyno == 1 or pr.isdyno == true then
                    local b = AddBlipForCoord(pr.x, pr.y, pr.z)
                    SetBlipSprite(b, cfg.sprite or 446)
                    SetBlipColour(b, cfg.color or 3)
                    SetBlipScale(b, cfg.scale or 0.75)
                    SetBlipAsShortRange(b, true)
                    BeginTextCommandSetBlipName('STRING')
                    AddTextComponentString(cfg.label or 'Dyno')
                    EndTextCommandSetBlipName(b)
                    dynoBlips[#dynoBlips + 1] = b
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function listSignature(list)
    local parts = {}
    for _, d in ipairs(list or {}) do
        for _, pr in ipairs(d.props or {}) do
            parts[#parts + 1] = ('%s|%s|%.2f|%.2f|%.2f|%.2f|%.2f|%.2f')
                :format(tostring(d.owner), tostring(pr.model),
                        pr.x or 0, pr.y or 0, pr.z or 0,
                        pr.rx or 0, pr.ry or 0, pr.rz or 0)
        end
    end
    table.sort(parts)
    return table.concat(parts, ';')
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_ecutuning:dyno:sync', function(list)
    gotSync = true
    placedDynos = list or {}

    local sig = listSignature(placedDynos)
    if sig == lastSig then return end
    lastSig = sig

    rebuildTries = 0
    rebuildWorld()
    rebuildBlips()
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_ecutuning:dyno:ownState', function(s)
    ownState = s or ownState
    dnui({ type = 'dynoOwnState', state = ownState })
    rebuildBlips()
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_ecutuning:dyno:useGranted', function()
    if pendingMount and not mounted then
        local d = pendingMount
        pendingMount = nil
        startMount(d)
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_ecutuning:dyno:notify', function(ntype, key, ...)
    if ntype == 'error' then pendingMount = nil end
    dnotify(ntype, key, ...)
end)

local curPlate = ''

local function plateOf(veh)
    if veh and veh ~= 0 and DoesEntityExist(veh) then
        local p = GetVehicleNumberPlateText(veh)
        if p then
            p = p:gsub('%s+', '')
            if p ~= '' then return p end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function refreshPlate(veh)
    local p = plateOf(veh or GetVehiclePedIsIn(PlayerPedId(), false))
    if p then curPlate = p end
    return curPlate
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_ecutuning:openGranted', function(plate)
    curPlate = plate or ''
    TriggerTokenEvent('sm_ecutuning:dyno:lastRun', curPlate)
    TriggerTokenEvent('sm_ecutuning:dyno:request')
end)

local refCurve, refPs, refNm, showRef = nil, 0, 0, false

local lastLocal = nil

RegisterNetEvent('sm_ecutuning:dyno:lastRunResult', function(row)
    if not row and lastLocal and lastLocal.plate ~= ''
       and lastLocal.plate == curPlate then
        row = {
            ps    = lastLocal.ps,    nm    = lastLocal.nm,
            psrpm = lastLocal.psRpm, nmrpm = lastLocal.nmRpm,
            model = lastLocal.model, curve = lastLocal.curve,
        }
        dnui({ type = 'dynoLastRun', has = true,
               ps = row.ps, nm = row.nm,
               psRpm = row.psrpm, nmRpm = row.nmrpm,
               model = row.model, boost = lastLocal.boost,
               curve = row.curve, base = lastLocal.base,
               hasCurve = row.curve ~= nil })
        refCurve, refPs, refNm = row.curve, row.ps, row.nm
        return
    end

    refCurve = row and row.curve or nil
    refPs    = row and row.ps or 0
    refNm    = row and row.nm or 0
    dnui({ type = 'dynoLastRun', has = row ~= nil, ps = refPs, nm = refNm,
           psRpm = row and row.psrpm or nil,
           nmRpm = row and row.nmrpm or nil,
           model = row and row.model or nil,
           curve = refCurve,
           hasCurve = refCurve ~= nil })
end)

        dnotify('warn', 'dyno_no_ref')

    end

    dnui({ type = 'dynoRef', show = showRef, curve = showRef and refCurve or nil,
           ps = refPs, nm = refNm })
