---@class PenRecord
---@field id integer
---@field data table
---@field ped integer|nil
---@field ground number
---@field lift number
---@field matrix number[]|nil
---@field props table<string, integer[]>
---@field levels table<string, integer>
---@field gen integer
---@field grazeAt integer|nil

---@type table<integer, PenRecord>
local records = {}
local list = {}
local generation = 0
local warned = {}
local loopRunning = false
local grazeRunning = false
---@type table<string, table|false>
local grazeAnims = {}

---@param model string
---@return boolean
local function validModel(model)
    if IsModelInCdimage(joaat(model)) then return true end

    if not warned[model] then
        warned[model] = true
        lib.print.warn(('sm_animalfarm: model %s not found'):format(model))
    end

    return false
end

---@param x number
---@param y number
---@param z number
---@return number
local function groundAt(x, y, z)
    RequestCollisionAtCoord(x, y, z)

    for _ = 1, 20 do
        local found, ground = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord(x, y, z + 2.0, false)

        if found then return ground end

        Wait(50)
    end

    return z - 1.0
end

---@param record PenRecord
local function rebuildMatrix(record)
    local data = record.data

    if not record.ped or data.dead then
        record.matrix = nil
        return
    end

    local coords = PLOTS[data.plot].coords
    local s = geo.scale(data.growth, data.weight)
    local h = rad(coords.w)
    local sh, ch = sin(h), cos(h)

    record.matrix = {
        -sh * s, ch * s, 0.0,
        ch * s, sh * s, 0.0,
        0.0, 0.0, s,
        coords.x, coords.y, record.ground + record.lift * s,
    }
end

---@param record PenRecord
---@param kind 'food'|'water'
local function clearProps(record, kind)
    local props = record.props[kind]

    for i = 1, #props do
        if DoesEntityExist(props[i]) then
            DeleteEntity(props[i])
        end

        props[i] = nil
    end
end

---@param record PenRecord
---@param kind 'food'|'water'
local function syncProps(record, kind)
    local data = record.data
    local level = data.dead and 0 or ceil((data[kind] or 0) / PER_PROP)

    if level > 3 then level = 3 end
    if record.levels[kind] == level then return end

    record.levels[kind] = level
    clearProps(record, kind)

    local trough = TROUGH[kind]

    if level == 0 or not validModel(trough.model) then return end
    if not lib.requestModel(trough.model, 5000) then return end

    local coords = PLOTS[data.plot].coords
    local props = record.props[kind]

    for i = 1, level do
        local x, y = geo.offset(coords, trough.offset.x + (i - 2) * trough.spacing, trough.offset.y)
        local object = CreateObject(trough.model, x, y, record.ground, false, false, false)

        PlaceObjectOnGroundProperly(object)
        FreezeEntityPosition(object, true)
        props[i] = object
    end

    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(trough.model)
end

---@param id integer
---@param speciesKey? string
function farm.milk(id, speciesKey)
    local data = records[id] and records[id].data
    local species = SPECIES[speciesKey or (data and data.species) or '']
    local milk = species and species.milk

    if not milk then return end

    local done = lib.progressBar({
        duration = milk.duration,
        label = 'Memerah susu...',
        useWhileDead = false,
        canCancel = true,
        disable = { move = true, car = true, combat = true },
        anim = { dict = MILK_ANIM.dict, clip = MILK_ANIM.clip },
    })

    if not done then return end

    local result = lib.callback.await('sm_animalfarm:milk', false, id)

    if type(result) ~= 'table' then return end

    lib.notify({ title = 'Peternakan', description = result.message, type = result.ok and 'success' or 'error' })
end

---@param data table
---@return string
local function conditionText(data)
    local stageLabel = data.stage == 'adult' and 'Dewasa' or data.stage == 'young' and 'Remaja' or 'Anak'

    if data.dead then
        return ('%s sudah mati. Hidupkan kembali lewat menu peternak.'):format(data.name)
    end

    return ('%s (%s)\nTumbuh: %.0f%%  Kesehatan: %.0f%%\nJerami: %d/%d  Air: %d/%d'):format(
        data.name,
        stageLabel,
        data.growth,
        data.weight,
        data.food,
        CAPACITY,
        data.water,
        CAPACITY
    )
end

---@param id integer

    if type(result) ~= 'table' then return end

    lib.notify({ title = 'Peternakan', description = result.message, type = result.ok and 'success' or 'error' })

    if result.ok and result.spawn then
        farm.spawnReleased(result.spawn)
    end
end

---@param id integer

    local result = lib.callback.await('sm_animalfarm:slaughter', false, id)

    if type(result) ~= 'table' then return end

---@param record PenRecord
local function addPedOptions(record)
    local id = record.id
    local isOwner = farm.penOwner == cache.serverId

    local options = {
        {
            name = 'sm_animalfarm:condition',
            label = 'Cek Kondisi',
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-heart-pulse',
            distance = 2.5,
            onSelect = function()
                local current = records[id]

                if not current then return end

                lib.notify({ title = 'Peternakan', description = conditionText(current.data), type = 'inform', duration = 7000 })
            end,
        },
    }

    if isOwner then
        options[#options + 1] = {
            name = 'sm_animalfarm:milk',
            label = 'Perah Susu',
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-bottle-droplet',
            distance = 2.5,
            canInteract = function()
                local current = records[id]
                local data = current and current.data

                return data and not data.dead and data.stage == 'adult' and SPECIES[data.species].milk and true or false
            end,
            onSelect = function()
                farm.milk(id)
            end,
        }

        options[#options + 1] = {
            name = 'sm_animalfarm:release',
            label = 'Take Out',
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-person-walking',
            distance = 2.5,
            canInteract = function()
                local current = records[id]
                local data = current and current.data

                if not data or data.dead then return false end
                if data.stage ~= 'adult' and not farm.isKid() then return false end

                return data.weight >= config.takeOutMinHealth
            end,
            onSelect = function()
                release(id)
            end,
        }

        options[#options + 1] = {
            name = 'sm_animalfarm:slaughter',
            label = 'Potong',
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-drumstick-bite',
            distance = 2.5,
            canInteract = function()
                local current = records[id]
                local data = current and current.data

                return data and not data.dead and data.stage == 'adult' and SPECIES[data.species].meat and true or false
            end,
            onSelect = function()
                slaughter(id)
            end,
        }
    end

    interact:addLocalEntity(record.ped, options)
end

---@param record PenRecord
local function destroyRecord(record)
    record.gen = -1
    clearProps(record, 'food')
    clearProps(record, 'water')

    local ped = record.ped

    record.ped = nil
    record.matrix = nil

    if ped and DoesEntityExist(ped) then
        interact:removeLocalEntity(ped)
        DeleteEntity(ped)
    end
end

local function rebuildList()
    local count = 0

    for _, record in pairs(records) do
        count += 1
        list[count] = record
    end

    for i = count + 1, #list do
        list[i] = nil
    end
end

---@param speciesKey string
---@return table|nil
local function grazeAnim(speciesKey)
    local cached = grazeAnims[speciesKey]

    if cached ~= nil then return cached or nil end

    local wanted = SPECIES[speciesKey].graze
    local anim = wanted and DoesAnimDictExist(wanted.dict) and wanted or GRAZE.fallback

    if not pcall(lib.requestAnimDict, anim.dict, 3000) then
        grazeAnims[speciesKey] = false
        return nil
    end

    grazeAnims[speciesKey] = anim

    return anim
end

local function startGraze()
    if grazeRunning then return end

    grazeRunning = true

    CreateThread(function()
        while farm.inPen do
            local now = GetGameTimer()

            for i = 1, #list do
                local record = list[i]
                local ped = record.ped
                local data = record.data

                if ped and not data.dead and now >= (record.grazeAt or 0) then
                    local anim = ((data.food or 0) > 0 or SPECIES[data.species].noCare) and grazeAnim(data.species)

                    if anim then
                        local duration = random(GRAZE.duration[1], GRAZE.duration[2])

                        TaskPlayAnim(ped, anim.dict, anim.clip, 2.0, -2.0, duration, 1, 0.0, false, false, false)
                        record.grazeAt = now + duration + random(GRAZE.rest[1], GRAZE.rest[2])
                    else
                        record.grazeAt = now + 5000
                    end
                end
            end

            Wait(1000)
        end

        grazeRunning = false
    end)
end

local function startLoop()
    if loopRunning then return end

    loopRunning = true

    CreateThread(function()
        while farm.inPen do
            for i = 1, #list do
                local record = list[i]
                local matrix = record.matrix
                local ped = record.ped

                if matrix and ped then
                    SetEntityMatrix(
                        ped,
                        matrix[1], matrix[2], matrix[3],
                        matrix[4], matrix[5], matrix[6],
                        matrix[7], matrix[8], matrix[9],
                        matrix[10], matrix[11], matrix[12]
                    )
                end
            end

            Wait(0)
        end

        loopRunning = false
    end)
end

---@param record PenRecord
local function spawnRecord(record)
    local gen = record.gen
    local data = record.data
    local species = SPECIES[data.species]
    local coords = PLOTS[data.plot].coords

    CreateThread(function()
        local ground = groundAt(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)

        if record.gen ~= gen then return end

        record.ground = ground

        syncProps(record, 'food')
        syncProps(record, 'water')

        if not validModel(species.model) or not lib.requestModel(species.model, 10000) then return end
        if record.gen ~= gen then return end

        local ped = CreatePed(28, species.model, coords.x, coords.y, ground + 0.5, coords.w, false, true)

        SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(species.model)
        SetEntityInvincible(ped, true)
        SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(ped, true)
        SetPedFleeAttributes(ped, 0, false)
        SetPedCanRagdoll(ped, false)

        local started = GetGameTimer()

        while GetGameTimer() - started < 600 and record.gen == gen do
            Wait(50)
        end

        if record.gen ~= gen then
            DeleteEntity(ped)
            return
        end

        if IsPedRagdoll(ped) or IsPedFalling(ped) then
            ClearPedTasksImmediately(ped)
            SetEntityCoords(ped, coords.x, coords.y, ground + 0.5, false, false, false, false)
            Wait(300)
        end

        SetEntityHeading(ped, coords.w)

        record.lift = GetEntityCoords(ped).z - ground

        if record.lift < 0.0 or record.lift > 3.0 then
            record.lift = 0.5
        end

        FreezeEntityPosition(ped, true)
        record.ped = ped
        record.grazeAt = GetGameTimer() + random(1000, 6000)

        if data.dead then
            SetEntityInvincible(ped, false)
            FreezeEntityPosition(ped, false)
            SetEntityHealth(ped, 0)
        end

        addPedOptions(record)
        rebuildMatrix(record)
    end)
end

---@param kind 'food'|'water'
---@param spots table[]
---@return integer
function farm.troughSpots(kind, spots)
    local count = 0

    if farm.inPen and farm.penOwner == cache.serverId then
        local trough = TROUGH[kind]
        local limit = CAPACITY - TROUGH.fillAmount * 0.5

        for i = 1, #list do
            local record = list[i]
            local data = record.data

            if record.ped and not data.dead and not SPECIES[data.species].noCare and (data[kind] or 0) <= limit then
                local level = record.levels[kind] or 0
                local slot = level < 3 and level + 1 or 3
                local coords = PLOTS[data.plot].coords
                local x, y = geo.offset(coords, trough.offset.x + (slot - 2) * trough.spacing, trough.offset.y)

                count += 1

                local spot = spots[count] or {}

                spot.id = record.id
                spot.x = x
                spot.y = y
                spot.z = record.ground
                spot.h = coords.w
                spots[count] = spot
            end
        end
    end

    for i = count + 1, #spots do
        spots[i] = nil
    end

    return count
end

local function clearPen()
    for id, record in pairs(records) do
        destroyRecord(record)
        records[id] = nil
    end

    rebuildList()
end

---@param animals table[]
local function renderPen(animals)
    local seen = {}

    for i = 1, #animals do
        local data = animals[i]

        if not data.released and SPECIES[data.species] and PLOTS[data.plot] then
            seen[data.id] = true

            local record = records[data.id]

            if record and (record.data.species ~= data.species or record.data.dead ~= data.dead or record.data.plot ~= data.plot) then
                destroyRecord(record)
                record = nil
            end

            if record then
                record.data = data
                rebuildMatrix(record)

                syncProps(record, 'food')
                syncProps(record, 'water')
            else
                generation += 1
                record = {
                    id = data.id,
                    data = data,
                    ground = PLOTS[data.plot].coords.z - 1.0,
                    lift = 0.5,
                    props = { food = {}, water = {} },
                    levels = {},
                    gen = generation,
                }
                records[data.id] = record
                spawnRecord(record)
            end
        end
    end

    for id, record in pairs(records) do
        if not seen[id] then
            destroyRecord(record)
            records[id] = nil
        end
    end

    rebuildList()
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_animalfarm:client:pen', function(payload)
    if source == '' or type(payload) ~= 'table' then return end

    local wasOwner = farm.penOwner

    farm.inPen = true
    farm.penOwner = payload.owner
    farm.penStock = type(payload.stock) == 'table' and payload.stock or nil

    if wasOwner ~= payload.owner then
        clearPen()
    end

    renderPen(type(payload.animals) == 'table' and payload.animals or {})
    startLoop()
    startGraze()
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_animalfarm:client:penLeft', function(kicked)
    if source == '' then return end

    farm.inPen = false
    farm.penOwner = nil
    farm.penStock = nil
    clearPen()

    if kicked then
        lib.notify({ title = 'Peternakan', description = 'Pemilik kandang sudah keluar.', type = 'inform' })
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource then return end

    farm.inPen = false
    clearPen()
end)

        keys = {
            { key = 'W A S D', label = 'Jalan' },
            { key = 'SHIFT', label = 'Lari' },
        }

        if canJump then
            keys[#keys + 1] = { key = 'SPACE', label = 'Lompat' }
        end

        if hasLasso then
            keys[#keys + 1] = { key = 'G', label = 'Lasso' }
        else
            hint = 'Beli Lasso di peternak untuk mengikat orang sambil menunggang.'
        end

        keys[#keys + 1] = { key = 'F', label = 'Turun' }
    else
        keys = { { key = 'F', label = 'Turun' } }
    end

    farm.setHud({
        title = label,
        hint = hint,
        keys = keys,
    })
end

---@param ped integer
local function playSit(ped)
    if not IsEntityPlayingAnim(ped, ANIM.dict, ANIM.clip, 3) then
        lib.playAnim(ped, ANIM.dict, ANIM.clip, 5.0, 5.0, -1, 1, 0.0, false, 0, false)
    end
end

function farm.hasReleased()
    return out ~= nil
end

function farm.riderPed()
    return ride and ride.rider or nil
end

---@param entity integer
local function follow(entity)
    TaskFollowToOffsetOfEntity(entity, cache.ped, 0.0, -2.0, 0.0, 2.0, -1, 2.5, true)
    SetPedKeepTask(entity, true)
end

local function leashLoop()
    CreateThread(function()
        local catchUp = LEASH.catchUpDistance * LEASH.catchUpDistance
        local teleport = LEASH.teleportDistance * LEASH.teleportDistance
        local behind = LEASH.behind
        local speed = 0.0

        while out and out.leashed do
            local entity = out.entity
            local owner = cache.ped

            if not entity or not DoesEntityExist(entity) then break end

            if cache.vehicle then
                farm.setLeash(false)
                break
            end

            local a, b = GetEntityCoords(entity), GetEntityCoords(owner)
            local dx, dy = a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y
            local dist = dx * dx + dy * dy
            local rate = IsPedSprinting(owner) and 1.5 or IsPedRunning(owner) and 1.25 or 1.0

            if dist > teleport then
                local spot = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(owner, 0.0, -behind, 0.0)

                SetEntityCoords(entity, spot.x, spot.y, spot.z, false, false, false, false)
                SetEntityHeading(entity, GetEntityHeading(owner))
                speed = 0.0
            end

            SetPedMoveRateOverride(entity, rate)

            local wanted = dist > catchUp and 3.0 or 2.0

            if speed ~= wanted or GetScriptTaskStatus(entity, FOLLOW_TASK) == 7 then
                TaskFollowToOffsetOfEntity(entity, owner, 0.0, -behind, 0.0, wanted, -1, 1.0, true)
                speed = wanted
            end

            Wait(400)
        end

        local entity = out and out.entity

        if entity and DoesEntityExist(entity) then
            SetPedMoveRateOverride(entity, 1.0)
        end
    end)
end

---@param enable boolean
function farm.setLeash(enable)
    if not out or not out.entity then return end

    local result = lib.callback.await('sm_animalfarm:leash', false, enable)

    if type(result) ~= 'table' then return end
    if not result.ok then return notify(result.message) end
    if not out or not out.entity then return end

    out.leashed = enable

    if enable then
        out.following = true
        leashLoop()
    else
        follow(out.entity)
    end
end

    local species = SPECIES[out.species]

    interact:addEntity(netId, {

        },

            name = 'sm_animalfarm:leash',

            icon = 'fa-solid fa-link',
            distance = 2.5,

            end,

            end,

local function removeOutBlip()
    if out and out.blip then
        RemoveBlip(out.blip)
        out.blip = nil
    end
end

---@param entity integer
local function addOutBlip(entity)
    removeOutBlip()

    local blip = AddBlipForEntity(entity)

    SetBlipSprite(blip, OUT_BLIP.sprite)
    SetBlipColour(blip, OUT_BLIP.color)
    SetBlipScale(blip, OUT_BLIP.scale)
    SetBlipAsShortRange(blip, false)
    BeginTextCommandSetBlipName('STRING')
    AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(out.name or SPECIES[out.species].localLabel)
    EndTextCommandSetBlipName(blip)
    out.blip = blip
end

local function watchOut()
    CreateThread(function()
        while out do
            local entity = out.entity

            if entity and not DoesEntityExist(entity) then
                if out.netId then
                    interact:removeEntity(out.netId)
                end

                removeOutBlip()
                out = nil
                lib.callback.await('sm_animalfarm:lost', false)
                notify('Hewanmu hilang dan kembali ke kandang.', 'inform')
                break
            end

            if entity and IsEntityDead(entity) then
                local netId = out.netId

                removeOutBlip()
                out = nil

                if netId then
                    interact:removeEntity(netId)
                end

                if not lib.callback.await('sm_animalfarm:died', false) then
                    lib.callback.await('sm_animalfarm:lost', false)
                end

                break
            end

            Wait(250)
        end
    end)
end

---@param ped integer
---@return integer[]
local function readLook(ped)
    local look = {}

    for component = 0, 11 do
        look[#look + 1] = GetPedDrawableVariation(ped, component)
        look[#look + 1] = GetPedTextureVariation(ped, component)
    end

    return look
end

---@param ped integer
---@param look integer[]|nil
local function applyLook(ped, look)
    if not look then return end

    for component = 0, 11 do
        local index = component * 2 + 1

        SetPedComponentVariation(ped, component, look[index], look[index + 1], 0)
    end
end

---@param entity integer
---@return false
local function failSpawn(entity)
    if DoesEntityExist(entity) then
        DeleteEntity(entity)
    end

    removeOutBlip()
    out = nil
    lib.callback.await('sm_animalfarm:lost', false)
    notify('Hewan gagal dimunculkan dan dikembalikan ke kandang.')

    return false
end

---@param id integer
---@param speciesKey string
---@param x number
---@param y number
---@param z number
---@param h number
---@param onCreated? fun(entity: integer)
---@return boolean
local function spawnAnimal(id, speciesKey, x, y, z, h, onCreated)
    local species = SPECIES[speciesKey]

    if not species or not lib.requestModel(species.model, 10000) then
        notify('Model hewan gagal dimuat.')
        return false
    end

    local entity = CreatePed(28, species.model, x, y, z, h, true, true)

    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(species.model)

    if onCreated then
        onCreated(entity)
    end

    local tries = 0

    while not NetworkGetEntityIsNetworked(entity) do
        tries += 1

        if tries > 50 then
            return failSpawn(entity)
        end

        Wait(20)
    end

    local netId = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(entity)

    SetNetworkIdCanMigrate(netId, false)
    SetEntityAsMissionEntity(entity, true, true)
    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(entity, true)
    SetPedFleeAttributes(entity, 0, false)

    if out.look then
        applyLook(entity, out.look)
    else
        out.look = readLook(entity)
    end

    if not lib.callback.await('sm_animalfarm:spawned', false, id, netId) then
        return failSpawn(entity)
    end

    out.entity = entity
    out.netId = netId
    addOutBlip(entity)
    out.following = true
    addOptions(netId)

    if not out.settling then
        follow(entity)
    end

    return true
end

---@param spawn table
function farm.spawnReleased(spawn)
    if type(spawn) ~= 'table' or type(spawn.coords) ~= 'table' then return end

    out = { id = spawn.id, species = spawn.species, name = type(spawn.name) == 'string' and spawn.name or nil, young = spawn.young == true, following = false }

    CreateThread(function()
        local c = spawn.coords

        if spawnAnimal(spawn.id, spawn.species, c.x, c.y, c.z, c.w) then
            watchOut()
        end
    end)
end

function farm.storeReleased()
    if not out or ride then return end

    local result = lib.callback.await('sm_animalfarm:store', false)

    if type(result) ~= 'table' then return end
    if not result.ok then return notify(result.message) end

    local netId = out.netId

    removeOutBlip()
    out = nil

    if netId then
        interact:removeEntity(netId)
    end

    notify(result.message, 'success')
end

local ANIM_PED_RESOURCES = { 'lb-phone', 'sm_emotes', 'mm_radio', 'pma-voice' }

local kidSeat = { RIDE.kidSeat[1], RIDE.kidSeat[2], RIDE.kidSeat[3] }

---@param base number[]
---@param kid boolean
---@return number[]
local function seatOffset(base, kid)
    if not kid then return base end

    return { base[1] + kidSeat[1], base[2] + kidSeat[2], base[3] + kidSeat[3], base[4], base[5], base[6] }
end

---@param ped integer|nil
local function setAnimationPed(ped)
    local netId = ped and DoesEntityExist(ped) and NetworkGetEntityIsNetworked(ped) and NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(ped) or nil

    playerState:set('animPed', netId, true)

    for i = 1, #ANIM_PED_RESOURCES do
        local resource = ANIM_PED_RESOURCES[i]

        if GetResourceState(resource) == 'started' then
            pcall(exports[resource].SetAnimationPed, exports[resource], ped)
        end
    end
end

---@param rider integer
---@param host integer
---@param offset number[]
local function attachRider(rider, host, offset)
    AttachEntityToEntity(
        rider, host, GetPedBoneIndex(host, BONE),
        offset[1], offset[2], offset[3],
        offset[4], offset[5], offset[6],
        false, true, false, true, 2, true
    )
end

---@param host integer
---@param appearance table
---@param offset number[]
---@return integer|nil
local function createRider(host, appearance, offset)
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(host)
    local model = appearance and appearance.model

    if not model or not lib.requestModel(model, 10000) then return end

    local rider = CreatePed(4, model, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, GetEntityHeading(host), true, false)

    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
    illenium:setPedAppearance(rider, appearance)
    SetEntityAsMissionEntity(rider, true, true)
    SetNetworkIdCanMigrate(NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(rider), false)
    SetEntityInvincible(rider, true)
    SetEntityCollision(rider, false, false)
    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(rider, true)
    SetPedCanRagdoll(rider, false)
    SetPedCanBeTargetted(rider, false)
    attachRider(rider, host, offset)
    playSit(rider)

    CreateThread(function()
        Wait(0)

        for _ = 1, 50 do
            if not DoesEntityExist(rider) then return end
            if NetworkGetEntityIsNetworked(rider) then break end

            Wait(100)
        end

        if not DoesEntityExist(rider) or not NetworkGetEntityIsNetworked(rider) then return end

        local hair = appearance.hair

        Entity(rider).state:set('smFarmFace', {
            headBlend = appearance.headBlend,
            faceFeatures = appearance.faceFeatures,
            headOverlays = appearance.headOverlays,
            hairColor = hair and hair.color or 0,
            hairHighlight = hair and hair.highlight or 0,
            eyeColor = appearance.eyeColor,
            decorations = GetPedDecorations(rider),
        }, true)

        if ride and ride.rider == rider then
            setAnimationPed(rider)
        end
    end)

    return rider
end

local dismount

local function controlLoop()
    CreateThread(function()
        local nextCheck = 0
        local ragdollFrom = GetGameTimer() + 2000

        while ride do
            local ped = PlayerPedId()
            local current = ride

            if IsEntityDead(ped) then
                dismount(true)
                break
            end

            if current.ragdollFrom then
                ragdollFrom = current.ragdollFrom
                current.ragdollFrom = nil
            end

            if cache.vehicle then
                dismount(false)
                break
            end

            if not current.jumping and IsPedRagdoll(ped) and GetGameTimer() > ragdollFrom then
                dismount(false, false, true)
                break
            end

            if not IsPauseMenuActive() then
                for i = 1, BLOCKED_COUNT do
                    DisableControlAction(0, BLOCKED[i], true)
                end
            end

            RestorePlayerStamina(cache.playerId, 1.0)
            SetPedMoveRateOverride(ped, current.moveRate)
            DisableOnFootFirstPersonViewThisUpdate()

            local now = GetGameTimer()

            if now >= nextCheck then
                nextCheck = now + 750

                if not DoesEntityExist(current.rider) then
                    dismount(false)
                    break
                end

                if GetEntityModel(ped) ~= current.model then
                    lib.print.warn('sm_animalfarm: model player berubah saat menunggang, turun otomatis')
                    dismount(false)
                    break
                end

                if ped ~= current.host or not IsEntityAttachedToEntity(current.rider, ped) then
                    lib.print.warn(('sm_animalfarm: rider %s, ditempel ulang'):format(ped ~= current.host and 'ped player berganti' or 'terlepas'))
                    current.host = ped
                    attachRider(current.rider, ped, current.offset)
                end

                playSit(current.rider)
            end

            Wait(0)
        end
    end)
end

function mount()
    if busy or ride or seat or not out or not out.entity then return end
    if cache.vehicle or IsEntityDead(cache.ped) then return end
    if playerState.isInAnimation or playerState.handsup then return notify('Kamu sedang dalam animasi.') end

    local entity = out.entity

    if not DoesEntityExist(entity) then return end

    local wanted = SPECIES[out.species]

    if not lib.requestModel(wanted.model, 10000) then return notify('Model hewan gagal dimuat.') end

    local result = lib.callback.await('sm_animalfarm:mount', false)

    if type(result) ~= 'table' then return end
    if not result.ok then return notify(result.message) end

    local species = SPECIES[result.species]
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(entity)
    local heading = GetEntityHeading(entity)
    local look = readLook(entity)
    local ped = cache.ped
    local kid = farm.isKid()

    local backup = {
        appearance = illenium:getPedAppearance(ped),
        health = GetEntityHealth(ped),
        armour = GetPedArmour(ped),
        cam = GetFollowPedCamViewMode(),
        canUseWeapons = playerState.canUseWeapons,
        canEmote = playerState.canEmote,
    }

    TriggerEvent('ox_inventory:disarm', true)
    TriggerEvent('sm_animalfarm:lasso:reset')
    interact:removeEntity(out.netId)
    removeOutBlip()

    local driverOffset = seatOffset(species.ride.driver, kid)
    local seatKey = ('%s:driver:%s'):format(result.species, kid and 'kid' or 'adult')

    busy = true
    ClearPedTasks(entity)
    TaskStandStill(entity, 8000)
    farm.seatTransition(ped, entity, driverOffset, 'getIn', seatKey, true)
    busy = false

    if not out then return end

    if DoesEntityExist(entity) then
        coords = GetEntityCoords(entity)
        heading = GetEntityHeading(entity)
    end

    DeleteEntity(entity)
    out.entity = nil
    out.netId = nil
    out.look = look
    out.leashed = nil

    illenium:setPlayerModel(species.model)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(species.model)

    local animalPed = PlayerPedId()

    applyLook(animalPed, look)
    SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(animalPed, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, true)
    SetEntityHeading(animalPed, heading)
    SetPedCanRagdollFromPlayerImpact(animalPed, false)

    local rider = createRider(animalPed, backup.appearance, driverOffset)

    ride = {
        id = result.id,
        species = result.species,
        rider = rider or 0,
        host = animalPed,
        model = GetEntityModel(animalPed),
        offset = driverOffset,
        seatKey = seatKey,
        kid = kid,
        backup = backup,
        moveRate = species.ride.moveRate,
        jump = species.ride.jump,
    }

    if ride.jump then
        RequestAnimDict(ride.jump.dict)
    end

    farm.riding = true
    showHelp(out and out.name or species.localLabel, true, ride.jump ~= nil)
    playerState:set('canUseWeapons', false, false)
    playerState:set('canEmote', false, true)
    SetFollowPedCamViewMode(1)
    controlLoop()
end

---@param dead boolean
---@param skipServer? boolean
---@param fall? boolean
function dismount(dead, skipServer, fall)
    local current = ride

    if not current then return end

    ride = nil
    farm.riding = false
    farm.setHud(nil)

    local animalPed = PlayerPedId()
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(animalPed)
    local heading = GetEntityHeading(animalPed)
    local side = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(animalPed, 1.5, 0.0, 0.0)
    local riderSpot = current.rider ~= 0 and DoesEntityExist(current.rider) and GetEntityCoords(current.rider) or coords
    local pendingId = not skipServer and lib.callback.await('sm_animalfarm:dismount', false, dead)

    TriggerEvent('sm_animalfarm:lasso:reset')
    setAnimationPed(nil)

    if current.jump then
        RemoveAnimDict(current.jump.dict)
    end

    if current.rider ~= 0 and DoesEntityExist(current.rider) then
        DetachEntity(current.rider, true, true)
        DeleteEntity(current.rider)
    end

    local backup = current.backup

    illenium:setPlayerAppearance(backup.appearance)

    local ped = PlayerPedId()
    local animate = RIDE.mount.enabled and not dead and not fall and pendingId and out and true or false

    SetPedArmour(ped, backup.armour)

    if animate then
        FreezeEntityPosition(ped, true)
        SetEntityCollision(ped, false, false)
    elseif fall and not dead then
        local push = RIDE.mount.fallPush

        SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(ped, riderSpot.x, riderSpot.y, riderSpot.z, false, false, false)
        SetPedToRagdoll(ped, RIDE.mount.fallRagdollMs, RIDE.mount.fallRagdollMs, 0, false, false, false)
        SetEntityVelocity(ped, (side.x - coords.x) * push, (side.y - coords.y) * push, push)
    else
        SetEntityCoords(ped, side.x, side.y, side.z, false, false, false, false)
    end

    SetFollowPedCamViewMode(backup.cam == 4 and 1 or backup.cam)
    playerState:set('canUseWeapons', backup.canUseWeapons ~= false, false)
    playerState:set('canEmote', backup.canEmote ~= false, true)

    if dead then
        SetEntityHealth(ped, 0)
    else
        SetEntityHealth(ped, backup.health)
    end

    if not pendingId or not out then return end

    if not animate then
        spawnAnimal(pendingId, current.species, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, heading)
        return
    end

    local created = false

    out.settling = true
    busy = true

    spawnAnimal(pendingId, current.species, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, heading, function(entity)
        created = true

        CreateThread(function()
            TaskStandStill(entity, 6000)
            FreezeEntityPosition(ped, false)
            SetEntityCollision(ped, true, true)

            local finished = farm.seatTransition(ped, entity, current.offset, 'getOut', current.seatKey)

            busy = false

            if not finished then
                SetEntityCoords(ped, side.x, side.y, side.z, false, false, false, false)
            end

            if not out then return end

            out.settling = nil

            if out.entity == entity then
                follow(entity)
            end
        end)
    end)

    if created then return end

    busy = false
    FreezeEntityPosition(ped, false)
    SetEntityCollision(ped, true, true)
    SetEntityCoords(ped, side.x, side.y, side.z, false, false, false, false)

    if out then
        out.settling = nil
    end
end

---@param driver integer
local function boardOptions(driver)
    return {
        {
            name = ('sm_animalfarm:board:%d'):format(driver),
            label = 'Bonceng',
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-user-group',
            distance = 2.5,
            canInteract = function()
                if farm.riding or seat or cache.vehicle or farm.inPen then return false end

                return Player(driver).state.smFarmPassenger == nil
            end,
            onSelect = function()
                farm.board(driver)
            end,
        },
    }
end

---@param driver integer
local function unregister(driver)
    local entry = registered[driver]

    if not entry then return end

    registered[driver] = nil
    interact:removeEntity(entry.netId)
end

local function startWatcher()
    if watcherRunning then return end

    watcherRunning = true

    CreateThread(function()
        while next(riders) do
            for driver in pairs(riders) do
                local player = GetPlayerFromServerId(driver)
                local ped = player ~= -1 and GetPlayerPed(player) or 0
                local entry = registered[driver]

                if ped == 0 then
                    unregister(driver)
                elseif not entry or entry.ped ~= ped then
                    unregister(driver)

                    local netId = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(ped)

                    registered[driver] = { ped = ped, netId = netId }
                    interact:addEntity(netId, boardOptions(driver))
                end
            end

            Wait(1000)
        end

        watcherRunning = false
    end)
end

AddStateBagChangeHandler('smFarmFace', nil, function(bagName, _, value)
    if type(value) ~= 'table' then return end

    local netId = tonumber(smatch(bagName, '^entity:(%d+)$'))

    if not netId then return end

    CreateThread(function()
        local ped = 0

        for _ = 1, 50 do
            ped = NetworkDoesNetworkIdExist(netId) and NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netId) or 0

            if ped ~= 0 and DoesEntityExist(ped) then break end

            Wait(100)
        end

        if ped == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(ped) then return end
        if NetworkGetEntityOwner(ped) == PlayerId() then return end

        if value.headBlend then
            illenium:setPedHeadBlend(ped, value.headBlend)
        end

        if value.faceFeatures then
            illenium:setPedFaceFeatures(ped, value.faceFeatures)
        end

        if value.headOverlays then
            illenium:setPedHeadOverlays(ped, value.headOverlays)
        end

        SetPedHairTint(ped, tonumber(value.hairColor) or 0, tonumber(value.hairHighlight) or 0)
        SetPedEyeColor(ped, tonumber(value.eyeColor) or 0)
        ClearPedDecorations(ped)

        local decorations = value.decorations

        if type(decorations) ~= 'table' then return end

        for i = 1, #decorations do
            local decoration = decorations[i]

            AddPedDecorationFromHashes(ped, decoration[1], decoration[2])
        end
    end)
end)

AddStateBagChangeHandler('smFarmRide', nil, function(bagName, _, value)
    local driver = tonumber(smatch(bagName, '^player:(%d+)$'))

    if not driver or driver == cache.serverId then return end

    if value then
        riders[driver] = value
        startWatcher()
    else
        riders[driver] = nil
        unregister(driver)
    end
end)

---@param notifyServer boolean
---@param animate? boolean
local function unboard(notifyServer, animate)
    local current = seat

    if not current then return end

    seat = nil
    farm.boarded = false
    farm.setHud(nil)

    local ped = cache.ped

    playerState:set('canUseWeapons', current.canUseWeapons ~= false, false)

    if notifyServer then
        TriggerTokenEvent('sm_animalfarm:unboard')
    end

    if animate and DoesEntityExist(current.host) then
        busy = true

        local finished = farm.seatTransition(ped, current.host, current.offset, 'getOut', current.seatKey)

        busy = false

        if finished then return end
    end

    local side = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(ped, -1.2, 0.0, 0.0)

    DetachEntity(ped, true, false)
    StopAnimTask(ped, ANIM.dict, ANIM.clip, 1.0)
    ClearPedTasks(ped)
    SetEntityCoords(ped, side.x, side.y, side.z, false, false, false, false)
end

---@param driver integer
function farm.board(driver)
    if busy or seat or farm.riding then return end

    local result = lib.callback.await('sm_animalfarm:board', false, driver)

    if type(result) ~= 'table' then return end
    if not result.ok then return notify(result.message) end

    local species = SPECIES[result.species]
    local player = GetPlayerFromServerId(driver)
    local host = player ~= -1 and GetPlayerPed(player) or 0

    if host == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(host) then
        TriggerTokenEvent('sm_animalfarm:unboard')
        return
    end

    local ped = cache.ped
    local kid = farm.isKid()
    local offset = seatOffset(species.ride.passenger, kid)

    local seatKey = ('%s:passenger:%s'):format(result.species, kid and 'kid' or 'adult')

    TriggerEvent('ox_inventory:disarm', true)
    busy = true
    farm.seatTransition(ped, host, offset, 'getIn', seatKey, true)
    busy = false

    if not DoesEntityExist(host) then
        DetachEntity(ped, true, false)
        ClearPedTasks(ped)
        TriggerTokenEvent('sm_animalfarm:unboard')
        return
    end

    seat = { driver = driver, host = host, canUseWeapons = playerState.canUseWeapons, species = result.species, kid = kid, offset = offset, seatKey = seatKey }
    farm.boarded = true
    showHelp(species.localLabel, false)
    playerState:set('canUseWeapons', false, false)
    AttachEntityToEntity(
        ped, host, GetPedBoneIndex(host, BONE),
        offset[1], offset[2], offset[3],
        offset[4], offset[5], offset[6],
        false, true, false, true, 2, true
    )
    playSit(ped)

    CreateThread(function()
        local nextCheck = 0

        while seat do
            if not IsPauseMenuActive() then
                for i = 1, BLOCKED_COUNT do
                    DisableControlAction(0, BLOCKED[i], true)
                end
            end

            DisableControlAction(0, 30, true)
            DisableControlAction(0, 31, true)

            local now = GetGameTimer()

            if now >= nextCheck then
                nextCheck = now + 500

                local current = seat
                local hostPlayer = GetPlayerFromServerId(current.driver)
                local valid = hostPlayer ~= -1 and GetPlayerPed(hostPlayer) == current.host

                if not valid or IsEntityDead(cache.ped) then
                    unboard(true)
                    break
                end

                playSit(cache.ped)
            end

            Wait(0)
        end
    end)
end

    if source == '' then return end

    unboard(false)
end)

---@param ped integer
---@param host integer
---@param offset number[]
local function reattach(ped, host, offset)
    AttachEntityToEntity(
        ped, host, GetPedBoneIndex(host, BONE),
        offset[1], offset[2], offset[3],
        offset[4], offset[5], offset[6],
        false, true, false, true, 2, true
    )
end

local function jump()
    local current = ride

    if not current or not current.jump then return end

    local now = GetGameTimer()

    if now < jumpReadyAt then return end

    local scale = playerState.smFarmScale

    if scale and scale ~= 1.0 then return end

    local ped = PlayerPedId()

    if IsEntityInAir(ped) or IsEntityInWater(ped) or IsPedRagdoll(ped) then return end

    local jumpDict = current.jump.dict
    local jumpClip = current.jump.clip

    if not HasAnimDictLoaded(jumpDict) then
        RequestAnimDict(jumpDict)
        return
    end

    jumpReadyAt = now + JUMP.cooldown

    local velocity = GetEntityVelocity(ped)
    local forward = GetEntityForwardVector(ped)
    local speed = sqrt(velocity.x * velocity.x + velocity.y * velocity.y)

    if speed < current.jump.forward then
        speed = current.jump.forward
    end

    if speed > current.jump.forwardMax then
        speed = current.jump.forwardMax
    end

    local up = current.jump.up
    local velocityX = forward.x * speed
    local velocityY = forward.y * speed
    local gravity = JUMP.gravity
    local maxFall = JUMP.maxFall
    local apexHeight = up * up / (2.0 * gravity)
    local fallAccelTime = maxFall / gravity
    local fallAccelHeight = maxFall * maxFall / (2.0 * gravity)
    local descentTime = fallAccelTime + (apexHeight - fallAccelHeight) / maxFall

    if apexHeight <= fallAccelHeight then
        descentTime = up / gravity
    end

    local airtime = up / gravity + descentTime
    local landPhase = current.jump.landPhase
    local rate = current.jump.duration * landPhase / airtime
    local started = now
    local standHeight = GetEntityHeightAboveGround(ped)
    local jumpId = (current.jumpId or 0) + 1

    current.jumpId = jumpId
    current.jumping = true
    SetPedCanRagdoll(ped, false)
    TaskPlayAnim(ped, jumpDict, jumpClip, 4.0, 4.0, -1, 0, 0.0, false, false, false)

    CreateThread(function()
        while ride == current do
            local elapsed = (GetGameTimer() - started) / 1000

            if elapsed > airtime + 1.0 then break end

            local velocityZ = up - gravity * elapsed

            if velocityZ < -maxFall then
                velocityZ = -maxFall
            end

            if velocityZ < 0.0 then
                if GetEntityHeightAboveGround(ped) <= standHeight + JUMP.landHeight then break end
                if velocityZ < -2.0 and GetEntityVelocity(ped).z > -0.5 then break end
            end

            local holding = GetEntityAnimCurrentTime(ped, jumpDict, jumpClip) >= landPhase

            SetEntityVelocity(ped, velocityX, velocityY, velocityZ)
            SetEntityAnimSpeed(ped, jumpDict, jumpClip, holding and 0.0 or rate)

            Wait(0)
        end

        SetEntityAnimSpeed(ped, jumpDict, jumpClip, 1.0)

        current.ragdollFrom = GetGameTimer() + JUMP.landingGrace * 2
        current.jumping = false

        Wait(JUMP.landingGrace)

        if current.jumpId ~= jumpId then return end

        SetPedCanRagdoll(PlayerPedId(), true)
    end)
end

if config.debug and config.debug.enabled then
    RegisterCommand('farmjump', function(_, args)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_3\interface\sm_animalfarm\client\scale.lua
local config = localmodule 'config'

local Wait = Wait
local GetGameTimer = GetGameTimer
local DoesEntityExist = DoesEntityExist
local GetEntityCoords = GetEntityCoords
local GetEntityHeading = GetEntityHeading
local GetEntityModel = GetEntityModel
local GetModelDimensions = GetModelDimensions
local GetEntityHeightAboveGround = GetEntityHeightAboveGround
local IsEntityInAir = IsEntityInAir
local SetEntityMatrix = SetEntityMatrix
local GetGroundZFor_3dCoord = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord
local GetPlayerFromServerId = GetPlayerFromServerId
local GetPlayerPed = GetPlayerPed
local NetworkDoesNetworkIdExist = NetworkDoesNetworkIdExist
local NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId = NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId
local smatch = string.match
local rad, sin, cos = math.rad, math.sin, math.cos
local tonumber, type, pairs, next = tonumber, type, pairs, next

local RIDE = config.ride

if not RIDE.youngScaleOutside then return end

local RANGE_SQ = RIDE.scaleRenderDistance * RIDE.scaleRenderDistance
local REFRESH_MS = 500
local SETTLE_MS = 1500
local GIVE_UP_MS = 6000

---@type table<integer, number>
local entityScales = {}
---@type table<integer, number>
local playerScales = {}
---@type table<integer, number>
local lifts = {}
---@type table<integer, number>
local fallbacks = {}
---@type table<integer, integer>
local firstSeen = {}
---@type { entity: integer, scale: number, lift: number }[]
local active = {}
local activeCount = 0
local running = false

---@param model integer
---@return number
local function fallbackLift(model)
    local lift = fallbacks[model]

    if lift then return lift end

    local minimum = GetModelDimensions(model)

    lift = -minimum.z

    if lift < 0.2 or lift > 2.0 then
        lift = 0.5
    end

    fallbacks[model] = lift

    return lift
end

---@param entity integer
---@param now integer
---@return number|nil
local function liftOf(entity, now)
    local model = GetEntityModel(entity)
    local lift = lifts[model]

    if lift then return lift end

    local seen = firstSeen[entity]

    if not seen then
        firstSeen[entity] = now
        return
    end

    local waited = now - seen

    if waited >= SETTLE_MS and not IsEntityInAir(entity) then
        local height = GetEntityHeightAboveGround(entity)

        if height > 0.1 and height < 3.0 then
            lifts[model] = height

            return height
        end
    end

    if waited >= GIVE_UP_MS then
        return fallbackLift(model)
    end
end

---@param entity integer
---@param scale number
---@param me vector3
---@param now integer
local function track(entity, scale, me, now)
    if entity == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(entity) then return end

    local pos = GetEntityCoords(entity)
    local dx, dy = pos.x - me.x, pos.y - me.y

    if dx * dx + dy * dy > RANGE_SQ then return end

    local lift = liftOf(entity, now)

    if not lift then return end

    activeCount += 1

    local slot = active[activeCount]

    if slot then
        slot.entity = entity
        slot.scale = scale
        slot.lift = lift
    else
        active[activeCount] = { entity = entity, scale = scale, lift = lift }
    end
end

local function refresh()
    local me = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local now = GetGameTimer()

    for entity in pairs(firstSeen) do
        if not DoesEntityExist(entity) then
            firstSeen[entity] = nil
        end
    end

    activeCount = 0

    for netId, scale in pairs(entityScales) do
        if NetworkDoesNetworkIdExist(netId) then
            track(NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netId), scale, me, now)
        end
    end

    for serverId, scale in pairs(playerScales) do
        local player = GetPlayerFromServerId(serverId)

        if player ~= -1 then
            track(GetPlayerPed(player), scale, me, now)
        end
    end
end

---@param slot { entity: integer, scale: number, lift: number }
local function apply(slot)
    local entity = slot.entity

    if not DoesEntityExist(entity) then return end

    local s = slot.scale
    local pos = GetEntityCoords(entity)
    local found, ground = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z + 0.5, false)
    local z = found and ground + slot.lift * s or pos.z - slot.lift * (1.0 - s)
    local h = rad(GetEntityHeading(entity))
    local sh, ch = sin(h), cos(h)

    SetEntityMatrix(
        entity,
        -sh * s, ch * s, 0.0,
        ch * s, sh * s, 0.0,
        0.0, 0.0, s,
        pos.x, pos.y, z
    )
end

local function start()
    if running then return end

    running = true

    CreateThread(function()
        local nextRefresh = 0

        while next(entityScales) or next(playerScales) do
            local now = GetGameTimer()

            if now >= nextRefresh then
                nextRefresh = now + REFRESH_MS
                refresh()
            end

            for i = 1, activeCount do
                apply(active[i])
            end

            Wait(activeCount > 0 and 0 or REFRESH_MS)
        end

        activeCount = 0
        running = false
    end)
end

---@param value any
---@return number|nil
local function readScale(value)
    local scale = tonumber(value)

    if not scale or scale <= 0.1 or scale >= 1.0 then return end

    return scale
end

AddStateBagChangeHandler('smFarmAnimal', nil, function(bagName, _, value)
    local netId = tonumber(smatch(bagName, '^entity:(%d+)$'))

    if not netId then return end

    entityScales[netId] = type(value) == 'table' and readScale(value.scale) or nil

    if entityScales[netId] then
        start()
    end
end)

AddStateBagChangeHandler('smFarmScale', nil, function(bagName, _, value)
    local serverId = tonumber(smatch(bagName, '^player:(%d+)$'))

    if not serverId then return end

    playerScales[serverId] = readScale(value)

    if playerScales[serverId] then
        start()
    end
end)


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_3\interface\sm_animalfarm\client\sound.lua
local config = localmodule 'config'

local Wait = Wait
local GetGameTimer = GetGameTimer
local DoesEntityExist = DoesEntityExist
local IsEntityDead = IsEntityDead
local GetEntityCoords = GetEntityCoords
local GetEntitySpeed = GetEntitySpeed
local GetResourceState = GetResourceState

local GetPlayerPed = GetPlayerPed
local NetworkDoesNetworkIdExist = NetworkDoesNetworkIdExist
local NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId = NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId
local smatch = string.match
local random = math.random
local tonumber, type, pairs, next, pcall = tonumber, type, pairs, next, pcall

local SOUND = config.sound
local SPECIES = config.species
local RANGE = SOUND.distance
local RANGE_SQ = RANGE * RANGE
local URL = ('nui://%s/interface/sm_animalfarm/web/build/sounds/%%s.ogg'):format(cache.resource)

---@class FarmSoundSource
---@field species string
---@field entity fun(): integer
---@field loop string|nil
---@field loopId string
---@field fxId string
---@field nextIdle integer
---@field nextRun integer

---@type table<string, FarmSoundSource>
local sources = {}
local running = false

---@param fn string
local function xs(fn, ...)
    pcall(exports.xsound[fn], exports.xsound, ...)
end

---@param source FarmSoundSource
local function stopLoop(source)
    if not source.loop then return end

    xs('Destroy', source.loopId)
    source.loop = nil
end

---@param source FarmSoundSource
---@param name string
---@param coords vector3
local function playOnce(source, name, coords)
    xs('PlayUrlPos', source.fxId, URL:format(name), SOUND.volume, coords, false)
    xs('Distance', source.fxId, RANGE)
end

---@param range integer[]
---@param now integer
---@return integer
local function later(range, now)
    return now + random(range[1], range[2])
end

---@param source FarmSoundSource
---@param me vector3
---@param now integer
local function update(source, me, now)
    local sounds = SPECIES[source.species] and SPECIES[source.species].sounds
    local entity = source.entity()

    if not sounds or entity == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(entity) or IsEntityDead(entity) then
        return stopLoop(source)
    end

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(entity)
    local dx, dy, dz = coords.x - me.x, coords.y - me.y, coords.z - me.z

    if dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz > RANGE_SQ then
        return stopLoop(source)
    end

    local speed = GetEntitySpeed(entity)
    local wanted = speed >= SOUND.runSpeed and 'running' or speed >= SOUND.walkSpeed and 'walking' or nil

    if wanted ~= source.loop then
        stopLoop(source)

        local name = wanted and sounds[wanted]

        if name then
            xs('PlayUrlPos', source.loopId, URL:format(name), SOUND.volume, coords, true)
            xs('Distance', source.loopId, RANGE)
            source.loop = wanted
        end
    elseif source.loop then
        xs('Position', source.loopId, coords)
    end

    if not wanted and sounds.idle and now >= source.nextIdle then
        source.nextIdle = later(SOUND.idleEvery, now)
        playOnce(source, sounds.idle, coords)
    elseif wanted == 'running' and sounds.randomrunning and now >= source.nextRun then
        source.nextRun = later(SOUND.runEvery, now)
        playOnce(source, sounds.randomrunning, coords)
    end
end

local function start()
    if running then return end

    running = true

    CreateThread(function()
        while next(sources) do
            if GetResourceState('xsound') == 'started' then
                local me = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
                local now = GetGameTimer()

                for _, source in pairs(sources) do
                    update(source, me, now)
                end
            end

            Wait(SOUND.tickMs)
        end

        running = false
    end)
end

---@param key string
---@param species string|nil
---@param resolve fun(): integer
local function setSource(key, species, resolve)
    local current = sources[key]

    if current then
        stopLoop(current)
        sources[key] = nil
    end

    if not species or not SPECIES[species] or not SPECIES[species].sounds then return end

    local now = GetGameTimer()

    sources[key] = {
        species = species,
        entity = resolve,
        loopId = 'smfarm_loop_' .. key,
        fxId = 'smfarm_fx_' .. key,
        nextIdle = later(SOUND.idleEvery, now),
        nextRun = later(SOUND.runEvery, now),
    }
    start()
end

AddStateBagChangeHandler('smFarmAnimal', nil, function(bagName, _, value)
    local netId = tonumber(smatch(bagName, '^entity:(%d+)$'))

    if not netId then return end

    setSource('a' .. netId, type(value) == 'table' and value.species or nil, function()

    end)
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource then return end

        stopLoop(source)
    end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_3\interface\sm_animalfarm\modules\geo.lua
local config = localmodule 'config'

local rad, sin, cos = math.rad, math.sin, math.cos

local geo = {}

---@param coords vector4
---@param right number
---@param forward number
---@return number x
---@return number y
function geo.offset(coords, right, forward)
    local h = rad(coords.w)
    local s, c = sin(h), cos(h)

    return coords.x + c * right - s * forward, coords.y + s * right + c * forward
end

---@param plot integer
---@param kind 'food'|'water'
---@return vector3|nil
function geo.trough(plot, kind)
    local entry = config.plots[plot]
    local trough = config.trough[kind]

    if not entry or not trough then return end

    local coords = entry.coords
    local x, y = geo.offset(coords, trough.offset.x, trough.offset.y)

    return vec3(x, y, coords.z)
end

---@param growth number
---@param weight number
---@return number
function geo.scale(growth, weight)
    local scale = config.scale
    local size = scale.baby + (scale.adult - scale.baby) * (growth / 100.0)
    local body = scale.thin + (1.0 - scale.thin) * (weight / 100.0)

    return size * body
end

---@param rule string|string[]|nil
---@param name string|nil
---@return boolean
function geo.jobAllowed(rule, name)
    if not rule then return true end
    if not name then return false end
    if type(rule) == 'string' then return rule == name end

    for i = 1, #rule do
        if rule[i] == name then return true end
    end

    return false
end

local kidSet

---@param model integer
---@return boolean
function geo.isKidModel(model)
    if not kidSet then
        kidSet = {}

        local list = config.ride.kidModels or {}

        for i = 1, #list do
            kidSet[joaat(list[i])] = true
        end
    end

    return kidSet[model] == true
end

---@param growth number
---@return 'baby'|'young'|'adult'
function geo.stage(growth)
    if growth >= 100.0 then return 'adult' end
    if growth < config.care.babyUntil then return 'baby' end

    return 'young'
end

return geo

local config = localmodule 'config'
