local ATTACKER = 0
local TARGET = 0
local ALLY = 0

local function ensureGroups()
    if ATTACKER ~= 0 then return end

    local _, attacker = AddRelationshipGroup('SMGM_ATTACKER')
    local _, target = AddRelationshipGroup('SMGM_TARGET')
    local _, ally = AddRelationshipGroup(PED.allyGroup)

    ATTACKER = attacker
    TARGET = target
    ALLY = ally

    SetRelationshipBetweenGroups(5, ATTACKER, TARGET)
    SetRelationshipBetweenGroups(5, TARGET, ATTACKER)
    SetRelationshipBetweenGroups(0, ATTACKER, ATTACKER)
    SetRelationshipBetweenGroups(2, TARGET, TARGET)
    SetRelationshipBetweenGroups(0, ALLY, ALLY)
end

---@type table<string, integer>
local teams = {}
---@type table<integer, true>
local teamHashes = {}

---@param hash integer
local function bindTeam(hash)
    SetRelationshipBetweenGroups(0, hash, hash)
    SetRelationshipBetweenGroups(5, hash, TARGET)
    SetRelationshipBetweenGroups(5, TARGET, hash)
    SetRelationshipBetweenGroups(5, hash, ATTACKER)
    SetRelationshipBetweenGroups(5, ATTACKER, hash)

    for other in pairs(teamHashes) do
        if other ~= hash then
            SetRelationshipBetweenGroups(5, hash, other)
            SetRelationshipBetweenGroups(5, other, hash)
        end
    end
end

---@param ped integer
---@return integer?
local function teamOf(ped)
    local ids = groups.of(ped)
    local id = ids[1]

    if not id then return nil end

    local hash = teams[id]

    if not hash then
        local _, created = AddRelationshipGroup('SMGM_TEAM_' .. id)

        hash = created
        teams[id] = hash
        teamHashes[hash] = true
    end

    bindTeam(hash)

    return hash
end

local function neutralizeOthers()
    local now = GetGameTimer()

    if now - lastNeutralize < 1500 then return end

    lastNeutralize = now

    local seen = {}
    local pool = GetGamePool('CPed')

    for i = 1, #pool do
        local hash = GetPedRelationshipGroupHash(pool[i])

        if hash ~= 0 and hash ~= ATTACKER and hash ~= TARGET and not teamHashes[hash] and not seen[hash] then
            seen[hash] = true
            SetRelationshipBetweenGroups(3, ATTACKER, hash)
            SetRelationshipBetweenGroups(3, hash, ATTACKER)
            SetRelationshipBetweenGroups(3, TARGET, hash)
            SetRelationshipBetweenGroups(3, hash, TARGET)
        end
    end

    SetRelationshipBetweenGroups(5, ATTACKER, TARGET)
    SetRelationshipBetweenGroups(5, TARGET, ATTACKER)

    for hash in pairs(teamHashes) do
        bindTeam(hash)
    end
end

---@param ped integer
local function remember(ped)
    if not oldRelation[ped] then
        oldRelation[ped] = GetPedRelationshipGroupHash(ped)
    end
end

---@param ped integer
local function revert(ped)
    local old = oldRelation[ped]

    if not old then return end

    oldRelation[ped] = nil

    if DoesEntityExist(ped) and NetworkHasControlOfEntity(ped) then
        SetPedRelationshipGroupHash(ped, old)
    end
end

---@param attacker integer
---@param target integer
local function hostile(attacker, target)
    ensureGroups()
    neutralizeOthers()
    remember(attacker)
    SetPedRelationshipGroupHash(attacker, teamOf(attacker) or ATTACKER)
    SetCanAttackFriendly(attacker, false, false)

    if not IsPedAPlayer(target) and NetworkHasControlOfEntity(target) then
        remember(target)
        SetPedRelationshipGroupHash(target, teamOf(target) or TARGET)
    end

    pairTarget[attacker] = target
end

---@param ped integer
local function releasePair(ped)
    local target = pairTarget[ped]

    pairTarget[ped] = nil
    revert(ped)

    if target then
        revert(target)
    end
end

---@param ped integer
---@return GmPedSettings
function orders.settings(ped)
    local entry = settings[ped]

    if not entry then
        entry = { mode = 'none', range = RANGE.default, accuracy = 50 }
        settings[ped] = entry
    end

    return entry
end

---@param ped integer
---@return GmPedSettings
function orders.peek(ped)
    return settings[ped] or DEFAULT_SETTINGS
end

---@param ped integer
---@return boolean
local function armed(ped)
    return IsPedArmed(ped, 4) or IsPedArmed(ped, 2)
end

---@param kind 'ped'|'vehicle'
---@return number
local function speedOf(kind)
    local entry = SPEEDS[kind]

    return state.options.run and entry.run or entry.walk
end

---@param ped integer
---@param vehicle integer
---@return boolean
local function attacksFromSeat(ped, vehicle)
    if GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, -1) ~= ped then return false end

    return GetVehicleModelNumberOfSeats(GetEntityModel(vehicle)) <= 1
end

---@param ped integer
---@param vehicle integer
---@param x number
---@param y number
---@param z number
---@param speed number
---@param style integer
local function drive(ped, vehicle, x, y, z, speed, style)
    SetVehicleEngineOn(vehicle, true, true, false)
    SetVehicleHandbrake(vehicle, false)
    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(ped, true)
    SetPedKeepTask(ped, true)

    if GetVehicleType(vehicle) == 'heli' then
        TaskHeliMission(ped, vehicle, 0, 0, x, y, z, 4, speed * 2.0, -1.0, -1.0, -1, -1, -1.0, 288)
        return
    end

    TaskVehicleDriveToCoordLongrange(ped, vehicle, x, y, z, speed, style, 4.0)
    SetDriveTaskCruiseSpeed(ped, speed)
    SetDriveTaskDrivingStyle(ped, style)
end

---@param center vector3
---@param color { r: integer, g: integer, b: integer }
---@param heading number
local function marker(center, color, heading)
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    local ground = util.groundZ(center.x, center.y, center.z + 2.0)
    local list = state.markers

    list[#list + 1] = {
        x = center.x,
        y = center.y,
        z = (ground or center.z) + 0.05,
        r = color.r,
        g = color.g,
        b = color.b,
        heading = heading,
        startAt = now,
        expiresAt = now + 3000,
    }
end

local GREEN = { r = 38, g = 187, b = 183 }
local BLUE = { r = 0, g = 150, b = 200 }
local RED = { r = 220, g = 60, b = 60 }
local ORANGE = { r = 245, g = 140, b = 40 }

---@param ped integer
local function forget(ped)
    active[ped] = nil
    releasePair(ped)
end

local tick

local function startTicking()
    if ticking then return end

    ticking = true
    CreateThread(tick)
end

---@param ped integer
---@param order table
local function assign(ped, order)
    active[ped] = order
    startTicking()
end

---@param entities integer[]
---@return integer[]
local function withVehicles(entities)
    local list = {}
    local count = 0

    for i = 1, #entities do
        local ped = entities[i]

        count += 1
        list[count] = ped

        local vehicle = selection.vehicleOf(ped)

        if vehicle ~= 0 then
            count += 1
            list[count] = vehicle
        end
    end

    return list
end

---@param target vector3
---@param kind 'direct'|'path'|'stand'
function orders.goTo(target, kind)
    local actors = selection.actors()

    if #actors == 0 then return end

    control.ensure(withVehicles(actors))

    local positions = util.formation(target, #actors, 1.5)
    local pedSpeed = speedOf('ped')
    local vehicleSpeed = speedOf('vehicle')
    local style = kind == 'direct' and STYLE_RUSH or STYLE_NORMAL

    for i = 1, #actors do
        local ped = actors[i]
        local pos = positions[i] or target

        forget(ped)

        local vehicle = selection.vehicleOf(ped)

        if vehicle ~= 0 then
            if GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, -1) == ped then
                drive(ped, vehicle, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, vehicleSpeed, style)
            end
        else
            local heading = util.headingTo(ped, pos)

            ClearPedTasks(ped)

            if kind == 'direct' then
                TaskGoStraightToCoord(ped, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, pedSpeed, -1, heading, 0.5)
            else
                TaskFollowNavMeshToCoord(ped, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, pedSpeed, -1, 0.25, 0, heading)
            end

            if kind == 'stand' then
                assign(ped, { kind = 'stand', dest = pos })
            end
        end
    end

    local color = kind == 'direct' and GREEN or BLUE

    marker(target, color, util.headingTo(actors[1], target))
end

---@param ped integer
local function fightReady(ped)
    SetPedDropsWeaponsWhenDead(ped, false)
    SetCanAttackFriendly(ped, false, false)
    SetPedCombatAttributes(ped, 68, true)
    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(ped, true)
    SetPedFleeAttributes(ped, 0, false)
    SetPedCombatAttributes(ped, 46, true)
    SetPedCombatAttributes(ped, 0, true)
    SetPedCombatAttributes(ped, 5, true)
    SetPedCombatAbility(ped, 2)
    SetPedCombatRange(ped, 2)
    SetPedAlertness(ped, 3)
    SetPedCombatMovement(ped, 2)

    if IsPedHuman(ped) and not IsPedArmed(ped, 7) then
        SetCurrentPedWeapon(ped, UNARMED, true)
    end
end

---@param ped integer
---@param target integer
local function engage(ped, target)
    local vehicle = selection.vehicleOf(ped)

    hostile(ped, target)

    if vehicle == 0 then
        fightReady(ped)
        TaskCombatPed(ped, target, 0, 16)
        SetPedKeepTask(ped, true)
        return 'foot'
    end

    local isDriver = GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, -1) == ped

    if isDriver and not attacksFromSeat(ped, vehicle) then
        SetVehicleEngineOn(vehicle, true, true, false)
        SetVehicleHandbrake(vehicle, false)

        if armed(ped) then
            TaskVehicleChase(ped, target)
            SetPedKeepTask(ped, true)
            return 'chase'
        end

        local coords = GetEntityCoords(target)

        drive(ped, vehicle, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, 24.0, STYLE_RUSH)
        return 'approach'
    end

    if armed(ped) then
        TaskVehicleShootAtPed(ped, target, 20.0)
    else
        TaskCombatPed(ped, target, 0, 16)
    end

    SetPedKeepTask(ped, true)

    return 'seat'
end

---@param target integer
function orders.attack(target)
    local actors = selection.actors()

    if #actors == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(target) then return end

    local list = withVehicles(actors)

    list[#list + 1] = target
    control.ensure(list)

    for i = 1, #actors do
        local ped = actors[i]

        if ped ~= target and not groups.share(ped, target) then
            forget(ped)

            if selection.vehicleOf(ped) == 0 then
                ClearPedTasksImmediately(ped)
            end

            local how = engage(ped, target)

            if how == 'approach' then
                assign(ped, { kind = 'driveExit', target = target })
            else
                assign(ped, { kind = 'attack', target = target, retaskAt = 0 })
            end
        end
    end

    marker(GetEntityCoords(target), RED, 0.0)
end

---@param ped integer
---@param center vector3
---@param radius number
---@param skip table<integer, true>
---@return boolean
local function attackNearest(ped, center, radius, skip)
    local pool = GetGamePool('CPed')
    local best = nil
    local bestDist = radius * radius
    local own = PlayerPedId()

    for i = 1, #pool do
        local candidate = pool[i]

        if candidate ~= ped and candidate ~= own and not skip[candidate] and NetworkGetEntityIsNetworked(candidate) and not IsPedDeadOrDying(candidate, true) then
            local coords = GetEntityCoords(candidate)
            local dx = coords.x - center.x
            local dy = coords.y - center.y
            local dz = coords.z - center.z
            local dist = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz

            if dist <= bestDist and not groups.share(ped, candidate) then
                bestDist = dist
                best = candidate
            end
        end
    end

    if not best then return false end

    control.request(best)
    engage(ped, best)

    return true
end

---@param center vector3
function orders.attackArea(center)
    local actors = selection.actors()

    if #actors == 0 then return end

    control.ensure(withVehicles(actors))

    local skip = {}

    for i = 1, #actors do
        skip[actors[i]] = true
    end

    local untilAt = GetGameTimer() + ATTACK_AREA_MS

    for i = 1, #actors do
        local ped = actors[i]
        local range = orders.settings(ped).range
        local vehicle = selection.vehicleOf(ped)

        forget(ped)

        if vehicle ~= 0 then
            if GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, -1) == ped then
                drive(ped, vehicle, center.x, center.y, center.z, 22.0, STYLE_RUSH)
                assign(ped, { kind = 'moveArea', center = center, skip = skip, exitOnArrive = not armed(ped), untilAt = untilAt })
            elseif armed(ped) then
                attackNearest(ped, center, range, skip)
                assign(ped, { kind = 'area', center = center, skip = skip, untilAt = untilAt })
            end
        else
            ClearPedTasksImmediately(ped)
            fightReady(ped)

            local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
            local dx = coords.x - center.x
            local dy = coords.y - center.y
            local reach = math.max(8.0, range * 0.8)

            if dx * dx + dy * dy > reach * reach then
                TaskFollowNavMeshToCoord(ped, center.x, center.y, center.z, 2.0, -1, range * 0.5, 0, util.headingTo(ped, center))
                assign(ped, { kind = 'moveArea', center = center, skip = skip, untilAt = untilAt })
            else
                attackNearest(ped, center, range, skip)
                assign(ped, { kind = 'area', center = center, skip = skip, untilAt = untilAt })
            end
        end
    end

    marker(center, ORANGE, 0.0)
end

---@param ped integer
local function standStill(ped)
    ClearPedTasks(ped)
    TaskStandStill(ped, -1)
end

---@param ped integer
---@param order table
---@param now integer
---@return boolean done
local function step(ped, order, now)
    local kind = order.kind

    if kind == 'stand' then
        local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
        local dest = order.dest
        local dx = coords.x - dest.x
        local dy = coords.y - dest.y

        if dx * dx + dy * dy > 1.5625 then return false end

        SetEntityHeading(ped, util.headingTo(ped, dest))
        standStill(ped)

        return true
    end

    if kind == 'attack' then
        local target = order.target

        if not DoesEntityExist(target) or IsPedDeadOrDying(target, true) then
            standStill(ped)
            releasePair(ped)
            return true
        end

        if not IsPedInCombat(ped, target) and now >= order.retaskAt then
            order.retaskAt = now + 2000
            engage(ped, target)
        end

        return false
    end

    if kind == 'driveExit' then
        local target = order.target

        if not DoesEntityExist(target) then return true end

        local vehicle = selection.vehicleOf(ped)

        if vehicle == 0 then
            fightReady(ped)
            engage(ped, target)
            active[ped] = { kind = 'attack', target = target, retaskAt = now + 2000 }
            return false
        end

        local a = GetEntityCoords(ped)
        local b = GetEntityCoords(target)
        local dx = a.x - b.x
        local dy = a.y - b.y

        if dx * dx + dy * dy <= 144.0 and not order.leaving then
            order.leaving = true
            TaskLeaveVehicle(ped, vehicle, 0)
        end

        return false
    end

    if kind == 'moveArea' then
        if now > order.untilAt then
            standStill(ped)
            return true
        end

        local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
        local center = order.center
        local range = orders.settings(ped).range
        local dx = coords.x - center.x
        local dy = coords.y - center.y

        if dx * dx + dy * dy > range * range then return false end

        local vehicle = selection.vehicleOf(ped)

        if vehicle ~= 0 and order.exitOnArrive then
            TaskLeaveVehicle(ped, vehicle, 0)
            active[ped] = { kind = 'exitArea', center = center, skip = order.skip, untilAt = order.untilAt }
            return false
        end

        attackNearest(ped, center, range, order.skip)
        active[ped] = { kind = 'area', center = center, skip = order.skip, untilAt = order.untilAt }

        return false
    end

    if kind == 'exitArea' then
        if now > order.untilAt then
            standStill(ped)
            return true
        end

        if selection.vehicleOf(ped) ~= 0 then return false end

        fightReady(ped)
        attackNearest(ped, order.center, orders.settings(ped).range, order.skip)
        active[ped] = { kind = 'area', center = order.center, skip = order.skip, untilAt = order.untilAt }

        return false
    end

    if kind == 'area' then
        if now > order.untilAt then
            standStill(ped)
            releasePair(ped)
            return true
        end

        if not IsPedInCombat(ped, 0) then
            attackNearest(ped, order.center, orders.settings(ped).range, order.skip)
        end

        return false
    end

    return true
end

---@param ped integer
---@param mode 'players'|'everyone'
---@param own integer
local function aggro(ped, mode, own)
    if IsPedInCombat(ped, 0) then return end

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local range = orders.settings(ped).range
    local best = nil
    local bestDist = range * range

    if mode == 'players' then
        local players = GetActivePlayers()

        for i = 1, #players do
            local target = GetPlayerPed(players[i])

            if target ~= own and target ~= 0 and not IsPedDeadOrDying(target, true) then
                local pos = GetEntityCoords(target)
                local dx = pos.x - coords.x
                local dy = pos.y - coords.y
                local dz = pos.z - coords.z
                local dist = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz

                if dist <= bestDist then
                    bestDist = dist
                    best = target
                end
            end
        end
    else
        local pool = GetGamePool('CPed')

        for i = 1, #pool do
            local target = pool[i]

            if target ~= ped and target ~= own and not IsPedDeadOrDying(target, true) and not groups.share(ped, target) then
                local pos = GetEntityCoords(target)
                local dx = pos.x - coords.x
                local dy = pos.y - coords.y
                local dz = pos.z - coords.z
                local dist = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz

                if dist <= bestDist then
                    bestDist = dist
                    best = target
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if not best then return end

    hostile(ped, best)
    TaskCombatPed(ped, best, 0, 16)
end

local behave

function tick()
    local lastAggro = 0
    local finished = {}

    while next(active) or next(stabilize) or next(settings) do
        local now = GetGameTimer()
        local own = PlayerPedId()
        local doneCount = 0

        for ped, order in pairs(active) do
            if not DoesEntityExist(ped) then
                doneCount += 1
                finished[doneCount] = ped
            else
                control.request(ped)

                if NetworkHasControlOfEntity(ped) and step(ped, order, now) then
                    doneCount += 1
                    finished[doneCount] = ped
                end
            end
        end

        for i = 1, doneCount do
            local ped = finished[i]

            if active[ped] then
                active[ped] = nil
            end

            finished[i] = nil
        end

        for ped, count in pairs(stabilize) do
            if not DoesEntityExist(ped) or count <= 0 then
                stabilize[ped] = nil
            elseif not active[ped] and NetworkHasControlOfEntity(ped) then
                behave(ped)
                stabilize[ped] = count - 1
            end
        end

        if now - lastAggro >= 500 then
            lastAggro = now

            for ped, entry in pairs(settings) do
                if not DoesEntityExist(ped) then
                    settings[ped] = nil
                    god[ped] = nil
                    frozen[ped] = nil
                    oldRelation[ped] = nil
                elseif entry.mode ~= 'none' and not active[ped] and not IsPedDeadOrDying(ped, true) then
                    control.request(ped)

                    if NetworkHasControlOfEntity(ped) then
                        aggro(ped, entry.mode, own)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        Wait(TICK_MS)
    end

    ticking = false
end

---@param ped integer
function behave(ped)
    ensureGroups()
    SetPedRelationshipGroupHash(ped, ALLY)
    SetCanAttackFriendly(ped, false, false)
    SetPedCombatAttributes(ped, 17, false)
    SetPedCombatAttributes(ped, 58, true)
    SetPedCombatAttributes(ped, 5, false)
    SetPedCombatAbility(ped, 0)
    SetPedAlertness(ped, 0)
    SetPedCanEvasiveDive(ped, false)
    SetPedKeepTask(ped, true)
    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(ped, true)
    SetPedFleeAttributes(ped, 0, false)

    if PED.hearingRange > 0.0 then
        SetPedHearingRange(ped, PED.hearingRange)
    end

    SetPedCanRagdollFromPlayerImpact(ped, false)
    SetPedDropsWeaponsWhenDead(ped, false)
end

---@param ped integer
function orders.stabilize(ped)
    behave(ped)
    stabilize[ped] = PED.reapplyCount
    startTicking()
end

---@param ped integer
---@param mode 'none'|'players'|'everyone'
function orders.setMode(ped, mode)
    local entry = orders.settings(ped)

    entry.mode = mode

    if mode == 'none' then
        releasePair(ped)
    else
        SetPedCombatAttributes(ped, 5, true)
        SetPedCombatAttributes(ped, 46, true)
        SetPedCombatAbility(ped, 2)
        SetPedAlertness(ped, 3)
    end

    startTicking()
end

---@param ped integer
---@param range number
function orders.setRange(ped, range)
    orders.settings(ped).range = util.clamp(math.floor(range), RANGE.min, RANGE.max)
end

---@param ped integer
---@param accuracy number
function orders.setAccuracy(ped, accuracy)
    local value = util.clamp(math.floor(accuracy), 0, 100)

    orders.settings(ped).accuracy = value
    SetPedAccuracy(ped, value)
end

---@param ped integer
---@param radius number
function orders.previewRange(ped, radius)
    rangePreview = { ped = ped, radius = radius, untilAt = GetGameTimer() + 2000 }
end

---@return { ped: integer, radius: number, untilAt: integer }?
function orders.rangePreview()
    if rangePreview and GetGameTimer() > rangePreview.untilAt then
        rangePreview = nil
    end

    return rangePreview
end

---@param ped integer
---@return boolean
function orders.isGod(ped)
    return god[ped] == true
end

---@param ped integer
---@return boolean
function orders.isFrozen(ped)
    return frozen[ped] == true
end

---@param ped integer
function orders.stand(ped)
    forget(ped)
    standStill(ped)
end

---@param ped integer
---@param immediate boolean
function orders.clear(ped, immediate)
    forget(ped)

    if immediate then
        ClearPedTasksImmediately(ped)
    else
        ClearPedTasks(ped)
    end

    SetPedKeepTask(ped, false)
    TaskStandStill(ped, -1)
    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(ped, false)
end

---@param ped integer
function orders.ambient(ped)
    forget(ped)
    stabilize[ped] = nil
    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(ped, false)
    ClearPedTasks(ped)
    FreezeEntityPosition(ped, false)
    frozen[ped] = nil
    SetPedCanPlayAmbientAnims(ped, true)
    SetPedCanPlayAmbientBaseAnims(ped, true)

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)

    if DoesScenarioExistInArea(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, 15.0, true) then
        TaskUseNearestScenarioToCoord(ped, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, 15.0, -1)
    else
        TaskWanderStandard(ped, 10.0, 10)
    end

    SetPedKeepTask(ped, true)
end

---@param ped integer
function orders.flee(ped)
    forget(ped)

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)

    TaskSmartFleeCoord(ped, coords.x + 1.0, coords.y + 1.0, coords.z, 80.0, -1, false, false)
end

---@param ped integer
---@param weapon string
function orders.giveWeapon(ped, weapon)
    if not IsPedHuman(ped) then return end

    local hash = joaat(weapon)

    GiveWeaponToPed(ped, hash, 500, false, true)
    SetPedDropsWeaponsWhenDead(ped, false)
    SetCurrentPedWeapon(ped, hash, true)
    SetPedCurrentWeaponVisible(ped, true, false, false, false)
    SetPedInfiniteAmmo(ped, true, hash)
end

---@param ped integer
function orders.removeWeapons(ped)
    RemoveAllPedWeapons(ped, true)
end

---@param ped integer
function orders.revive(ped)
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local ground = util.groundZ(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z + 2.0)
    local z = ground and ground + 0.15 or coords.z
    local _, maxHealth = util.health(ped)

    ResurrectPed(ped)
    ClearPedTasksImmediately(ped)
    SetEntityCoords(ped, coords.x, coords.y, z, false, false, false, false)
    SetEntityHealth(ped, maxHealth)
    ClearPedBloodDamage(ped)
end

---@param ped integer
function orders.heal(ped)
    if IsPedDeadOrDying(ped, true) then
        orders.revive(ped)
        return
    end

    local _, maxHealth = util.health(ped)

    SetEntityHealth(ped, maxHealth)
    ClearPedBloodDamage(ped)
end

---@param ped integer
function orders.kill(ped)
    forget(ped)
    SetEntityHealth(ped, 0)
end

---@param ped integer
function orders.toggleGod(ped)
    local enabled = not god[ped]

    god[ped] = enabled or nil
    orders.settings(ped)

    SetEntityInvincible(ped, enabled)
    SetEntityProofs(ped, enabled, enabled, enabled, enabled, enabled, enabled, enabled, enabled)
    SetPedCanRagdoll(ped, not enabled)
    SetPedDiesWhenInjured(ped, not enabled)
    SetPedSuffersCriticalHits(ped, not enabled)
end

---@param ped integer
function orders.toggleFreeze(ped)
    local enabled = not frozen[ped]

    frozen[ped] = enabled or nil
    orders.settings(ped)
    FreezeEntityPosition(ped, enabled)

    if enabled then
        ClearPedTasksImmediately(ped)
    end
end

---@param ped integer
---@param anim { dict: string, name: string, flag?: integer }
function orders.playAnim(ped, anim)
    if not IsPedHuman(ped) then return end

    lib.requestAnimDict(anim.dict, 5000)
    forget(ped)
    ClearPedTasks(ped)
    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(ped, true)
    TaskPlayAnim(ped, anim.dict, anim.name, 4.0, -4.0, -1, anim.flag or 1, 0.0, false, false, false)
    SetPedKeepTask(ped, true)
end

---@param ped integer
---@param coords vector3
---@param warp boolean
function orders.scenario(ped, coords, warp)
    forget(ped)
    ClearPedTasks(ped)
    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(ped, false)

    if warp then
        TaskUseNearestScenarioToCoordWarp(ped, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, 6.0, 0)
    else
        TaskUseNearestScenarioToCoord(ped, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, 6.0, -1)
    end

    SetPedKeepTask(ped, true)
end

---@param ped integer
function orders.dismount(ped)
    local vehicle = selection.vehicleOf(ped)

    if vehicle == 0 then return end

    forget(ped)
    TaskLeaveVehicle(ped, vehicle, 0)

    CreateThread(function()
        local tries = 0

        while DoesEntityExist(ped) and IsPedInAnyVehicle(ped, false) do
            tries += 1

            if tries > 40 then break end

            Wait(50)
        end

        if DoesEntityExist(ped) and NetworkHasControlOfEntity(ped) then
            TaskStandStill(ped, -1)
            SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(ped, true)
            SetPedKeepTask(ped, true)
        end
    end)
end

---@param vehicle integer
---@return integer
local function maxSeat(vehicle)
    return GetVehicleModelNumberOfSeats(GetEntityModel(vehicle)) - 2
end

---@param vehicle integer
function orders.unmountAll(vehicle)
    local last = maxSeat(vehicle)
    local peds = {}
    local count = 0

    for seat = -1, last do
        local ped = GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, seat)

        if ped ~= 0 and not IsPedAPlayer(ped) then
            count += 1
            peds[count] = ped
        end
    end

    if count == 0 then return end

    control.ensure(peds)

    for i = 1, count do
        orders.dismount(peds[i])
    end
end

---@param vehicle integer
function orders.disable(vehicle)
    orders.unmountAll(vehicle)

    if not control.one(vehicle) then return end

    for wheel = 0, 3 do
        BreakOffVehicleWheel(vehicle, wheel, false, false, true, false)
    end

    SetVehicleEngineHealth(vehicle, -4000.0)
    SetVehicleUndriveable(vehicle, true)
end

---@param vehicle integer
---@return boolean
function orders.isFlyingHeli(vehicle)
    return GetVehicleType(vehicle) == 'heli' and GetEntityHeightAboveGround(vehicle) > 3.0
end

---@param vehicle integer
---@param coords? vector3
function orders.land(vehicle, coords)
    local pilot = GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, -1)

    if pilot == 0 or IsPedAPlayer(pilot) then return end

    control.ensure({ vehicle, pilot })

    local pos = coords or GetEntityCoords(vehicle)
    local ground = util.groundZ(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z + 30.0)
    local z = ground and ground + 1.0 or pos.z

    forget(pilot)
    SetVehicleEngineOn(vehicle, true, true, false)
    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(pilot, true)
    SetPedKeepTask(pilot, true)
    TaskHeliMission(pilot, vehicle, 0, 0, pos.x, pos.y, z, 20, 24.0, -1.0, -1.0, -1, -1, -1.0, 288)
end

---@param vehicle integer
---@param seat integer
---@return boolean
function orders.seatFree(vehicle, seat)
    return IsVehicleSeatFree(vehicle, seat)
end

---@param vehicle integer
---@return integer
function orders.lastSeat(vehicle)
    return maxSeat(vehicle)
end

---@param ped integer
---@param vehicle integer
---@param seat integer
function orders.enter(ped, vehicle, seat)
    if not IsPedHuman(ped) or IsPedInAnyVehicle(ped, false) then return end

    local occupant = GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, seat)
    local list = { ped, vehicle }

    if occupant ~= 0 and not IsPedAPlayer(occupant) then
        list[3] = occupant
    end

    control.ensure(list)
    forget(ped)
    SetVehicleDoorsLocked(vehicle, 1)

    if occupant ~= 0 and not IsPedAPlayer(occupant) then
        TaskLeaveVehicle(occupant, vehicle, 16)
    end

    TaskEnterVehicle(ped, vehicle, -1, seat, 1.0, 1, 0)
end

---@param vehicle integer
function orders.enterAll(vehicle)
    local peds = selection.peds()
    local seats = {}
    local seatCount = 0

    for seat = -1, maxSeat(vehicle) do
        if IsVehicleSeatFree(vehicle, seat) then
            seatCount += 1
            seats[seatCount] = seat
        end
    end

    local index = 0

    for i = 1, #peds do
        local ped = peds[i]

        if IsPedHuman(ped) and not IsPedInAnyVehicle(ped, false) then
            index += 1

            local seat = seats[index]

            if not seat then break end

            orders.enter(ped, vehicle, seat)
        end
    end
end

---@param ped integer
---@return boolean
function orders.hasOrder(ped)
    return active[ped] ~= nil
end

---@param entity integer
---@return boolean
function orders.isArmed(entity)
    return IsEntityAPed(entity) and armed(entity)
end

function orders.reset()
    for ped in pairs(active) do
        releasePair(ped)
    end

    active = {}
    stabilize = {}
    rangePreview = nil
end

return orders


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_3\interface\sm_gamemaster\modules\placement.lua
local state = localmodule 'modules.state'
local util = localmodule 'modules.util'
local camera = localmodule 'modules.camera'
local gizmo = localmodule 'modules.gizmo'
local objects = localmodule 'modules.objects'
local keys = localmodule 'modules.keys'
local nui = localmodule 'modules.nui'

local type = type
local joaat = joaat
local Wait = Wait
local CreateThread = CreateThread
local DoesEntityExist = DoesEntityExist
local DeleteEntity = DeleteEntity
local IsModelInCdimage = IsModelInCdimage
local RequestModel = RequestModel
local HasModelLoaded = HasModelLoaded
local SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded = SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded
local CreateObjectNoOffset = CreateObjectNoOffset
local SetEntityAlpha = SetEntityAlpha
local ResetEntityAlpha = ResetEntityAlpha
local SetEntityCollision = SetEntityCollision
local SetEntityCoordsNoOffset = SetEntityCoordsNoOffset
local SetEntityRotation = SetEntityRotation
local GetEntityCoords = GetEntityCoords
local GetEntityRotation = GetEntityRotation
local FreezeEntityPosition = FreezeEntityPosition

local placement = {}

---@class GmPlacement
---@field kind 'new'|'modify'
---@field entity integer
---@field model string
---@field id? string
---@field gizmo GmGizmo
---@field original? { pos: vector3, rot: vector3 }
---@field busy boolean

---@type GmPlacement?
local session = nil

local function publish()
    nui.send('placement', {
        active = session ~= nil,
        mode = session and session.gizmo.mode or 'translate',
        kind = session and session.kind or nil,
        persist = state.options.persist,
    })
end

---@param hash integer
---@return boolean
local function loadModel(hash)
    if not IsModelInCdimage(hash) then return false end

    RequestModel(hash)

    local tries = 0

    while not HasModelLoaded(hash) do
        tries += 1

        if tries > 250 then return false end

        Wait(20)
    end

    return true
end

---@return boolean
function placement.active()
    return session ~= nil
end

---@param model string
---@param coords vector3
function placement.begin(model, coords)
    if session then return end

    state.placing = true

    CreateThread(function()
        local hash = joaat(model)

        if not loadModel(hash) then
            state.placing = false
            nui.log('error', ('Model %s gagal dimuat'):format(model))
            return
        end

        local entity = CreateObjectNoOffset(hash, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false)

        SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(hash)

        if entity == 0 then
            state.placing = false
            return
        end

        local rot = { x = 0.0, y = 0.0, z = state.heading }

        SetEntityAlpha(entity, 200, false)
        SetEntityCollision(entity, false, false)
        FreezeEntityPosition(entity, true)
        SetEntityRotation(entity, rot.x, rot.y, rot.z, 2, true)

        if not state.enabled or not state.placing then
            DeleteEntity(entity)
            return
        end

        session = {
            kind = 'new',
            entity = entity,
            model = model,
            gizmo = gizmo.new(coords, rot),
            busy = false,
        }

        publish()
    end)
end

---@param entity integer
function placement.modify(entity)
    if session then return end

    local id = objects.idOf(entity)
    local record = id and objects.record(id)

    if not record then return end

    local pos = GetEntityCoords(entity)
    local rot = GetEntityRotation(entity, 2)

    SetEntityAlpha(entity, 200, false)
    SetEntityCollision(entity, false, false)

    state.placing = true
    session = {
        kind = 'modify',
        entity = entity,
        model = record.model,
        id = id,
        gizmo = gizmo.new(pos, { x = rot.x, y = rot.y, z = rot.z }),
        original = { pos = pos, rot = rot },
        busy = false,
    }

    publish()
end

local function finish()
    session = nil
    state.placing = false
    publish()
end

function placement.cancel()
    local current = session

    if not current then
        state.placing = false
        return
    end

    local entity = current.entity

    if DoesEntityExist(entity) then
        if current.kind == 'new' then
            DeleteEntity(entity)
        else
            local original = current.original

            SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(entity, original.pos.x, original.pos.y, original.pos.z, false, false, false)
            SetEntityRotation(entity, original.rot.x, original.rot.y, original.rot.z, 2, true)
            ResetEntityAlpha(entity)
            SetEntityCollision(entity, true, true)
        end
    end

    finish()
end

local function confirm()
    local current = session

    if not current or current.busy then return end

    current.busy = true

    local g = current.gizmo
    local payload = {
        coords = g.pos,
        rot = { x = g.rot.x, y = g.rot.y, z = g.rot.z },
    }

    CreateThread(function()
        local result

        if current.kind == 'new' then
            payload.model = current.model
            payload.persist = state.options.persist
            result = lib.callback.await('sm_gamemaster:server:objectPlace', false, payload)
        else
            payload.id = current.id
            result = lib.callback.await('sm_gamemaster:server:objectUpdate', false, payload)
        end

        if session ~= current then return end

        if type(result) ~= 'table' or not result.ok then
            current.busy = false
            nui.log('error', type(result) == 'table' and result.reason or 'Server tidak merespons')
            return
        end

        if current.kind == 'new' then
            if DoesEntityExist(current.entity) then
                DeleteEntity(current.entity)
            end

            nui.log('success', ('Objek %s ditaruh%s'):format(current.model, payload.persist and ' (permanen)' or ''))
        else
            nui.log('success', 'Posisi objek diperbarui')
        end

        finish()
    end)
end

---@param input { pressed: boolean, released: boolean, rmb: boolean }
function placement.update(input)
    local current = session

    if not current then return end

    local entity = current.entity

    if not DoesEntityExist(entity) then
        finish()
        return
    end

    local g = current.gizmo
    local origin, dir = camera.ray()

    if not state.typing and not current.busy then
        if input.rmb and not g.drag then
            placement.cancel()
            return
        end

        if keys.pressed(keys.TAB) then
            gizmo.toggleMode(g)
            publish()
        end

        if keys.pressed(keys.G) and not g.drag then
            g.pos = util.toGround(g.pos)
        end

        if keys.pressed(keys.ENTER) and not g.drag then
            confirm()
        end

        gizmo.update(g, origin, dir, {
            pressed = input.pressed and not state.overUi,
            released = input.released,
            pitch = state.pitch,
            heading = state.heading,
        })
    end

    SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(entity, g.pos.x, g.pos.y, g.pos.z, false, false, false)
    SetEntityRotation(entity, g.rot.x, g.rot.y, g.rot.z, 2, true)
    gizmo.draw(g, origin)
end

function placement.confirm()
    confirm()
end

function placement.toggleMode()
    if not session then return end

    gizmo.toggleMode(session.gizmo)
    publish()
end

function placement.publish()
    publish()
end

return placement

local config = localmodule 'config'
local state = localmodule 'modules.state'
local objects = localmodule 'modules.objects'
local keys = localmodule 'modules.keys'

local tremove = table.remove
local min = math.min
local max = math.max
local DoesEntityExist = DoesEntityExist
local IsEntityAPed = IsEntityAPed

local NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity
local GetEntityCoords = GetEntityCoords
local GetGamePool = GetGamePool

local GetVehicleModelNumberOfSeats = GetVehicleModelNumberOfSeats

local GetVehiclePedIsIn = GetVehiclePedIsIn

local SELECT_RADIUS_SQ = config.selectRadius * config.selectRadius
local HEAD_BONE = 31086

local selection = {}

---@param entity integer
---@return boolean
function selection.isPed(entity)
    if not entity or entity == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(entity) then return false end
    if not IsEntityAPed(entity) or IsPedAPlayer(entity) then return false end

    return NetworkGetEntityIsNetworked(entity)
end

---@param entity integer
---@return boolean
function selection.isVehicle(entity)
    if not entity or entity == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(entity) then return false end
    if not IsEntityAVehicle(entity) then return false end

    return NetworkGetEntityIsNetworked(entity)
end

---@param entity integer
---@return boolean
function selection.isObject(entity)
    if not entity or entity == 0 then return false end

    return objects.idOf(entity) ~= nil and DoesEntityExist(entity)
end

---@param entity integer
---@return boolean
function selection.pickable(entity)
    local options = state.options

    if options.pickPeds and selection.isPed(entity) then return true end
    if options.pickVehicles and selection.isVehicle(entity) then return true end
    if options.pickObjects and selection.isObject(entity) then return true end

    return false
end

---@param entity integer
---@return boolean
function selection.has(entity)
    return state.selected[entity] == true
end

---@param entity integer
---@return boolean
function selection.add(entity)
    if state.selected[entity] or not selection.pickable(entity) then return false end

    local list = state.selection

    list[#list + 1] = entity
    state.selected[entity] = true
    state.selectionDirty = true

    return true
end

---@param entity integer
---@return boolean
function selection.remove(entity)
    if not state.selected[entity] then return false end

    local list = state.selection

    for i = #list, 1, -1 do
        if list[i] == entity then
            tremove(list, i)
            break
        end
    end

    state.selected[entity] = nil
    state.selectionDirty = true

    return true
end

function selection.clear()
    if #state.selection == 0 then return end

    state.selection = {}
    state.selected = {}
    state.selectionDirty = true
end

---@param entities integer[]
function selection.set(entities)
    state.selection = {}
    state.selected = {}
    state.selectionDirty = true

    for i = 1, #entities do
        selection.add(entities[i])
    end
end

---@param entity integer
function selection.only(entity)
    state.selection = { entity }
    state.selected = { [entity] = true }
    state.selectionDirty = true
end

---@return boolean
function selection.prune()
    local list = state.selection
    local changed = false

    for i = #list, 1, -1 do
        local entity = list[i]

        if not DoesEntityExist(entity) then
            tremove(list, i)
            state.selected[entity] = nil
            changed = true
        end
    end

    if changed then
        state.selectionDirty = true
    end

    return changed
end

---@return integer[]
function selection.peds()
    local result = {}
    local count = 0
    local list = state.selection

    for i = 1, #list do
        local entity = list[i]

        if selection.isPed(entity) then
            count += 1
            result[count] = entity
        end
    end

    return result
end

---@return integer[]
function selection.vehicles()

    local count = 0
    local list = state.selection

    for i = 1, #list do
        local entity = list[i]

        if selection.isVehicle(entity) then
            count += 1
            result[count] = entity
        end
    end

    return result
end

---@return integer[]
function selection.actors()
    local result = {}
    local seen = {}
    local count = 0
    local list = state.selection

    for i = 1, #list do
        local entity = list[i]
        local ped = 0

        if selection.isPed(entity) then
            ped = entity
        elseif selection.isVehicle(entity) then
            local driver = GetPedInVehicleSeat(entity, -1)

            if driver ~= 0 and not IsPedAPlayer(driver) then
                ped = driver
            end
        end

        if ped ~= 0 and not seen[ped] then
            seen[ped] = true
            count += 1
            result[count] = ped
        end
    end

    return result
end

---@return integer[] netIds, string[] objectIds
function selection.deletable()
    local netIds = {}
    local objectIds = {}
    local netCount = 0
    local objectCount = 0
    local list = state.selection

    for i = 1, #list do
        local entity = list[i]
        local objectId = objects.idOf(entity)

        if objectId then
            objectCount += 1
            objectIds[objectCount] = objectId
        elseif DoesEntityExist(entity) and NetworkGetEntityIsNetworked(entity) then
            netCount += 1
            netIds[netCount] = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(entity)
        end
    end

    return netIds, objectIds
end

---@param entity integer
---@return vector3
function selection.anchor(entity)
    if IsEntityAPed(entity) then
        return GetPedBoneCoords(entity, HEAD_BONE, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    end

    return GetEntityCoords(entity)
end

---@param entity integer
---@param minX number
---@param maxX number
---@param minY number
---@param maxY number
---@return boolean
local function insideRect(entity, minX, maxX, minY, maxY)
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(entity)
    local cam = state.camPos
    local dx = coords.x - cam.x
    local dy = coords.y - cam.y
    local dz = coords.z - cam.z

    if dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz > SELECT_RADIUS_SQ then return false end

    local onScreen, sx, sy = GetScreenCoordFromWorldCoord(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)

    if not onScreen then return false end

    return sx >= minX and sx <= maxX and sy >= minY and sy <= maxY
end

---@param pool integer[]
---@param check fun(entity: integer): boolean
---@param minX number
---@param maxX number
---@param minY number
---@param maxY number
---@param subtract boolean
local function sweep(pool, check, minX, maxX, minY, maxY, subtract)
    for i = 1, #pool do
        local entity = pool[i]

        if check(entity) and insideRect(entity, minX, maxX, minY, maxY) then
            if subtract then
                selection.remove(entity)
            else
                selection.add(entity)
            end
        end
    end
end

---@param x1 number
---@param y1 number
---@param x2 number
---@param y2 number
function selection.rect(x1, y1, x2, y2)
    local minX = min(x1, x2)
    local maxX = max(x1, x2)
    local minY = min(y1, y2)
    local maxY = max(y1, y2)
    local additive = keys.shift()
    local subtract = keys.ctrl()

    if not additive and not subtract then
        selection.clear()
    end

    local options = state.options

    if options.pickPeds then
        sweep(GetGamePool('CPed'), selection.isPed, minX, maxX, minY, maxY, subtract)
    end

    if options.pickVehicles then
        sweep(GetGamePool('CVehicle'), selection.isVehicle, minX, maxX, minY, maxY, subtract)
    end

    if options.pickObjects then
        sweep(objects.entities(), selection.isObject, minX, maxX, minY, maxY, subtract)
    end
end

---@param vehicle integer
---@return integer?
function selection.occupantNear(vehicle)
    local seats = GetVehicleModelNumberOfSeats(GetEntityModel(vehicle))
    local best = nil
    local bestDist = 0.0016

    for seat = -1, seats - 2 do
        local ped = GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, seat)

        if ped ~= 0 and not IsPedAPlayer(ped) then
            local coords = GetPedBoneCoords(ped, HEAD_BONE, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
            local onScreen, sx, sy = GetScreenCoordFromWorldCoord(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)

            if onScreen then
                local dx = state.cursorX - sx
                local dy = state.cursorY - sy
                local dist = dx * dx + dy * dy

                if dist < bestDist then
                    bestDist = dist
                    best = ped
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return best
end

---@param ped integer
---@return integer
function selection.vehicleOf(ped)
    if not IsPedInAnyVehicle(ped, false) then return 0 end

    return GetVehiclePedIsIn(ped, false)
end

return selection

    preview.entity = 0
    preview.model = nil
    preview.kind = nil

    if entity ~= 0 and DoesEntityExist(entity) then
        DeleteEntity(entity)
    end
end

---@param item GmItem
---@param coords vector3
local function createPreview(item, coords)
    preview.loading = true
    preview.model = item.model
    preview.kind = item.kind

    CreateThread(function()
        local hash = joaat(item.model)
        local loaded = loadModel(hash)
        local current = state.item

        preview.loading = false

        if not loaded or not current or current.model ~= item.model or preview.model ~= item.model then
            SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(hash)
            return
        end

        local heading = state.heading
        local entity

        if item.kind == 'ped' then
            entity = CreatePed(4, hash, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z + PED_OFFSET, heading, false, false)
            SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(entity, true)
            SetPedRandomComponentVariation(entity, 0)
        elseif item.kind == 'vehicle' then
            entity = CreateVehicle(hash, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, heading, false, false)
        else
            entity = CreateObjectNoOffset(hash, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false)
        end

        SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(hash)

        if not entity or entity == 0 then return end

        SetEntityAlpha(entity, PREVIEW_ALPHA, false)
        SetEntityCollision(entity, false, false)
        SetEntityInvincible(entity, true)
        FreezeEntityPosition(entity, true)

        if preview.entity ~= 0 or preview.model ~= item.model then
            DeleteEntity(entity)
            return
        end

        preview.entity = entity
        preview.x = coords.x
        preview.y = coords.y
        preview.vx = 0.0
        preview.vy = 0.0
    end)
end

---@param dt number
function spawn.updatePreview(dt)
    local item = state.item

    if not item or state.mode ~= 'spawn' or not state.options.preview or state.placing then
        if preview.entity ~= 0 or preview.model then
            spawn.clearPreview()
        end

        return
    end

    if preview.model ~= item.model then
        spawn.clearPreview()
    end

    local target = hold and hold.start or camera.ground(preview.entity ~= 0 and preview.entity or nil)

    if not target then return end

    if preview.entity == 0 then
        if not preview.loading and not preview.model then
            createPreview(item, target)
        end

        return
    end

    local entity = preview.entity

    if state.overUi then
        SetEntityVisible(entity, false, false)
        return
    end

    SetEntityVisible(entity, true, false)

    preview.x, preview.vx = util.smoothDamp(preview.x, target.x, preview.vx, 0.06, 120.0, dt)
    preview.y, preview.vy = util.smoothDamp(preview.y, target.y, preview.vy, 0.06, 120.0, dt)

    local z = target.z

    if preview.kind == 'ped' then
        z = z + PED_OFFSET
    end

    SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(entity, preview.x, preview.y, z, false, false, false)
    SetEntityHeading(entity, hold and hold.heading or state.heading)

    if preview.kind == 'vehicle' then
        SetVehicleOnGroundProperly(entity)
    end
end

---@param coords vector3
function spawn.holdStart(coords)
    hold = { start = coords, heading = state.heading, startAt = GetGameTimer(), moved = false }
end

---@param coords? vector3
function spawn.holdUpdate(coords)
    if not hold or not coords then return end

    local dx = coords.x - hold.start.x
    local dy = coords.y - hold.start.y

    if dx * dx + dy * dy > 0.0625 then
        hold.moved = true
        hold.heading = util.headingFrom(dx, dy)
    end
end

---@return { start: vector3, heading: number, startAt: integer, moved: boolean }?
function spawn.hold()
    return hold
end

---@param coords? vector3
---@return vector3?, number?
function spawn.holdEnd(coords)
    local current = hold

    hold = nil

    if not current then return nil end

    if current.moved or GetGameTimer() - current.startAt > 200 then
        return current.start, current.heading
    end

    return coords or current.start, state.heading
end

---@param netId integer
---@return integer
local function resolve(netId)
    local tries = 0

    while not NetworkDoesEntityExistWithNetworkId(netId) do
        tries += 1

        if tries > 100 then return 0 end

        Wait(50)
    end

    return NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netId)
end

---@param kind 'ped'|'vehicle'
---@param entity integer
---@param ambient boolean
function spawn.after(kind, entity, ambient)
    if not control.one(entity) then return end

    if kind == 'ped' then
        SetPedRandomComponentVariation(entity, 0)
        SetPedRandomProps(entity)

        if ambient then
            orders.ambient(entity)
        else
            orders.stabilize(entity)
        end

        return
    end

    SetVehicleOnGroundProperly(entity)
    SetVehicleEngineOn(entity, true, true, false)
end

---@param kind 'ped'|'vehicle'
---@param model string
---@param coords vector3
---@param heading number
---@return table?
function spawn.payload(kind, model, coords, heading)
    local payload = { kind = kind, model = model, coords = coords, heading = heading }

    if kind == 'vehicle' then
        local vehicleType = spawn.vehicleType(model)

        if not vehicleType then return nil end

        payload.vehicleType = vehicleType
    end

    return payload
end

---@param kind 'ped'|'vehicle'
---@param model string
---@param coords vector3
---@param heading number
---@return integer
function spawn.request(kind, model, coords, heading)
    local payload = spawn.payload(kind, model, coords, heading)

    if not payload then
        nui.log('error', ('Model %s tidak bisa di-spawn'):format(model))
        return 0
    end

    local result = lib.callback.await('sm_gamemaster:server:spawn', false, payload)

    if type(result) ~= 'table' or not result.ok then
        nui.log('error', type(result) == 'table' and result.reason or 'Server tidak merespons')
        return 0
    end

    local entity = resolve(result.netId)

    if entity == 0 then
        nui.log('warn', 'Entitas dibuat tapi belum terlihat di sekitar kamera')
        return 0
    end

    spawn.after(kind, entity, state.options.ambient)
    nui.log('success', ('%s di-spawn: %s'):format(kind == 'ped' and 'NPC' or 'Kendaraan', model))

    return entity
end

return spawn

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_3\interface\sm_gamemaster\modules\util.lua
local sqrt = math.sqrt
local exp = math.exp
local max = math.max
local min = math.min
local GetGroundZFor_3dCoord = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord
local GetHeadingFromVector_2d = GetHeadingFromVector_2d
local GetEntityCoords = GetEntityCoords
local GetEntityHealth = GetEntityHealth
local GetEntityMaxHealth = GetEntityMaxHealth

local util = {}

---@param value number
---@param low number
---@param high number
---@return number
function util.clamp(value, low, high)
    if value < low then return low end
    if value > high then return high end

    return value
end

---@param value number
---@return number
function util.wrap360(value)
    local result = value % 360.0

    if result < 0.0 then
        result = result + 360.0
    end

    return result
end

---@param current number
---@param target number
---@param velocity number
---@param smoothTime number
---@param maxSpeed number
---@param dt number
---@return number, number
function util.smoothDamp(current, target, velocity, smoothTime, maxSpeed, dt)
    local time = max(0.0001, smoothTime)
    local omega = 2.0 / time
    local x = omega * dt
    local factor = 1.0 / (1.0 + x + 0.48 * x * x + 0.235 * x * x * x)
    local maxChange = maxSpeed * time
    local change = util.clamp(current - target, -maxChange, maxChange)
    local goal = current - change
    local temp = (velocity + omega * change) * dt
    local nextVelocity = (velocity - omega * temp) * factor
    local output = goal + (change + temp) * factor

    if (target - current > 0.0) == (output > target) then
        output = target
        nextVelocity = 0.0
    end

    return output, nextVelocity
end

---@param remaining number
---@param smoothing number
---@param dt number
---@return number
function util.expStep(remaining, smoothing, dt)
    local factor = util.clamp(1.0 - exp(-smoothing * dt), 0.0, 1.0)

    return remaining * factor
end

---@param t number
---@return number
function util.smootherStep(t)
    if t <= 0.0 then return 0.0 end
    if t >= 1.0 then return 1.0 end

    return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6.0 - 15.0) + 10.0)
end

---@param a number
---@param b number
---@param t number
---@return number
function util.lerp(a, b, t)
    return a + (b - a) * t
end

---@param t number
---@return number
function util.easeOutCubic(t)
    local p = 1.0 - util.clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0)

    return 1.0 - p * p * p
end

---@param v vector3
---@return vector3
function util.normalize(v)
    local length = sqrt(v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y + v.z * v.z)

    if length <= 0.0000001 then return vector3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0) end

    return vector3(v.x / length, v.y / length, v.z / length)
end

---@param a vector3
---@param b vector3
---@return number
function util.dot(a, b)
    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z
end

---@param a vector3
---@param b vector3
---@return vector3
function util.cross(a, b)
    return vector3(a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y, a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z, a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x)
end

---@param x number
---@param y number
---@param z number
---@return number?
function util.groundZ(x, y, z)
    local found, ground = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord(x, y, z, false)

    if found then return ground end

    found, ground = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord(x, y, z + 50.0, false)

    if found then return ground end

    return nil
end

---@param coords vector3
---@return vector3
function util.toGround(coords)
    local ground = util.groundZ(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z + 1.0)

    if not ground then return coords end

    return vector3(coords.x, coords.y, ground)
end

---@param dx number
---@param dy number
---@return number
function util.headingFrom(dx, dy)
    return util.wrap360(GetHeadingFromVector_2d(dx, dy))
end

---@param entity integer
---@param target vector3
---@return number
function util.headingTo(entity, target)
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(entity)

    return util.headingFrom(target.x - coords.x, target.y - coords.y)
end

---@param entity integer
---@return integer, integer
function util.health(entity)
    local health = GetEntityHealth(entity)
    local maxHealth = GetEntityMaxHealth(entity)

    if maxHealth <= 0 or health > maxHealth then
        maxHealth = max(100, health)
    end

    return min(health, maxHealth), maxHealth
end

---@param center vector3
---@param count integer
---@param spacing number
---@return vector3[]
function util.formation(center, count, spacing)
    local positions = { center }

    if count <= 1 then return positions end

    local made = 1
    local ring = 1
    local offset = 2.399963229728653
    local tau = math.pi * 2.0
    local cos = math.cos
    local sin = math.sin

    while made < count do
        local points = 6 * ring
        local radius = spacing * ring

        for i = 0, points - 1 do
            local a = (i / points) * tau + offset
            local x = center.x + cos(a) * radius
            local y = center.y + sin(a) * radius
            local ground = util.groundZ(x, y, center.z + 2.0)

            made += 1
            positions[made] = vector3(x, y, ground and ground + 0.05 or center.z)

            if made >= count then break end
        end

        ring += 1
    end

    return positions
end

return util

---@param hex string

---@param data SceneStyle

---@param s PreparedScene
---@param scale number
local function applyTextStyle(s, scale)
    SetTextScale(0.0, scale)
    SetTextFont(s.font)
    SetTextColour(s.r, s.g, s.b, 255)
    SetTextProportional(true)
    SetTextWrap(0.0, 1.0)
    SetTextCentre(true)

    if s.shadow then
        SetTextDropshadow(1, 0, 0, 0, 255)
    end

    if s.outline then
        SetTextOutline()
    end

---@param s PreparedScene
local function drawScene(s)
    local c = s.coords
    local onScreen, sx, sy = GetScreenCoordFromWorldCoord(c.x, c.y, c.z)

    if not onScreen then return end

    local distance = #(c - GetFinalRenderedCamCoord())

    if distance < 0.5 then distance = 0.5 end

    local scale = 4.0 / distance * (75.0 / GetGameplayCamFov()) * s.size

    if s.sprite then
        applyTextStyle(s, scale)
        BeginTextCommandGetWidth('STRING')
        AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(s.text)

        local width = EndTextCommandGetWidth(s.font) + 0.005
        local height = GetRenderedCharacterHeight(scale, s.font) + 0.003

        DrawSprite(TXD, s.sprite, sx + s.bx * scale, sy + s.by * scale, width + s.bw * scale, height + s.bh * scale, 0.0, s.br, s.bg, s.bb, s.ba)
    end

    applyTextStyle(s, scale)
    BeginTextCommandDisplayText('STRING')
    AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(s.text)
    EndTextCommandDisplayText(sx, sy)
end

---@param id integer
local function removePoint(id)
    local point = points[id]

    if not point then return end

    point:remove()
    points[id] = nil
end

---@param data table
local function addPoint(data)
    local coords = scene.coords(data.coords)
    local id = tonumber(data.id)

    if not coords or not id then return end

    removePoint(id)

    local style = scene.style(data)
    local prepared = prepare(style, coords, id)
    local point = lib.points.new({
        coords = coords,
        distance = style.viewDistance,
    })

    function point:nearby()
        drawScene(prepared)
    end

    points[id] = point
end

local function clearPoints()
    for id in pairs(points) do
        removePoint(id)
    end
end

---@return boolean, vector3
local function cameraRay()
    local rot = GetGameplayCamRot(2)
    local origin = GetGameplayCamCoord()
    local rx, rz = rad(rot.x), rad(rot.z)
    local pitch = abs(cos(rx))
    local tx = origin.x - sin(rz) * pitch * MAX_DISTANCE
    local ty = origin.y + cos(rz) * pitch * MAX_DISTANCE
    local tz = origin.z + sin(rx) * MAX_DISTANCE
    local handle = StartExpensiveSynchronousShapeTestLosProbe(origin.x, origin.y, origin.z, tx, ty, tz, 1 | 16, cache.ped, 4)
    local _, hit, coords = GetShapeTestResult(handle)

    return hit == true or hit == 1, coords
end

---@param dict string
---@param anim string
---@param props { model: string, bone: integer, offset: number[] }[]
---@return fun()
local function playTool(dict, anim, props)
    lib.requestAnimDict(dict)

    local ped = cache.ped
    local spawned = {}

    for i = 1, #props do
        local prop = props[i]
        local model = lib.requestModel(prop.model)
        local o = prop.offset
        local entity = CreateObject(model, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, false, false, false)

        AttachEntityToEntity(entity, ped, GetPedBoneIndex(ped, prop.bone), o[1], o[2], o[3], o[4], o[5], o[6], true, true, false, true, 1, true)
        SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
        spawned[i] = entity
    end

    TaskPlayAnim(ped, dict, anim, 8.0, -8.0, -1, 51, 0, false, false, false)
    RemoveAnimDict(dict)

    return function()
        StopAnimTask(ped, dict, anim, 8.0)

        for i = 1, #spawned do
            local entity = spawned[i]

            if DoesEntityExist(entity) then
                DeleteEntity(entity)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function stopTool()
    if not stopToolAnim then return end

    stopToolAnim()
    stopToolAnim = nil
end

---@param coords vector3
local function openEditor(coords)
    if not hasFrame then return end

    local context = lib.callback.await('sm_scenes:server:context', false)

    if type(context) ~= 'table' then return end

    editing = true
    preview = prepare(scene.style(config.defaults), coords)
    editorContext = {
        coords = coords,
        payload = {
            fonts = config.fonts,
            backgrounds = config.backgrounds,
            defaults = config.defaults,
            maxDistance = MAX_DISTANCE,
            maxDuration = config.maxDuration,
            maxText = config.maxText,
            admin = context.admin == true,
            used = tonumber(context.used) or 0,
            max = tonumber(context.max) or config.maxScenes,
        },
    }

    CreateThread(previewLoop)

    if ready then
        send('open', editorContext.payload)
        interface.focus(true, true)
    elseif not mounted then
        mounted = true
        interface.show()
    end
end

local function stopPlacing()
    if not placing then return end

    placing = false
    infoui:remove(INFO_ID)
end

local function placeLoop()
    infoui:show({
        id = INFO_ID,
        title = 'Pasang Scene',
        icon = 'fa-solid fa-pen-nib',
        description = 'Arahkan ke dinding atau lantai\n[kbd]E[/kbd] Pilih lokasi   [kbd]Backspace[/kbd] Batal',
    })

    while placing do
        local hit, coords = cameraRay()

        if hit then
            local origin = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)

            DrawLine(origin.x, origin.y, origin.z, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, LASER.r, LASER.g, LASER.b, LASER.a)
            DrawMarker(28, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 180.0, 0.0, 0.08, 0.08, 0.08, LASER.r, LASER.g, LASER.b, LASER.a, false, true, 2, false, nil, nil, false)
        end

        DisableControlAction(0, 200, true)

        if IsControlJustReleased(0, KEY_CANCEL) then
            stopPlacing()
        elseif IsControlJustReleased(0, KEY_CONFIRM) then
            if hit then
                stopPlacing()
                openEditor(coords)
            else
                lib.notify({ title = 'Scene', description = 'Arahkan ke permukaan yang lebih dekat.', type = 'error' })
            end
        end

        Wait(0)
    end
end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_3\interface\sm_scenes\modules\scene.lua
local config = localmodule 'config'

local type = type
local tonumber = tonumber
local floor = math.floor
local smatch = string.match
local sgsub = string.gsub
local ssub = string.sub

local DEFAULTS = config.defaults
local MAX_TEXT = config.maxText
local RAW_LIMIT = MAX_TEXT * 4
local MAX_DISTANCE = config.maxDistance
local MAX_DURATION = config.maxDuration
local LEGACY_FONTS = config.legacyFonts

---@type table<string, true>
local fontKeys = {}
for i = 1, #config.fonts do
    fontKeys[config.fonts[i].key] = true
end

---@type table<string, true>
local backgroundKeys = {}
for i = 1, #config.backgrounds do
    backgroundKeys[config.backgrounds[i].key] = true
end

---@class SceneStyle
---@field text string
---@field font string
---@field colour string
---@field fontSize number
---@field viewDistance number
---@field shadow boolean
---@field outline boolean
---@field background string
---@field backgroundColour string
---@field backgroundAlpha integer
---@field backgroundX number
---@field backgroundY number
---@field backgroundWidth number
---@field backgroundHeight number

---@param value any
---@param min number
---@param max number
---@param fallback number
---@return number
local function clampNumber(value, min, max, fallback)
    local number = tonumber(value)

    if not number or number ~= number then return fallback end
    if number < min then return min end
    if number > max then return max end

    return number
end

---@param value any
---@param fallback string
---@return string
local function hexColour(value, fallback)
    if type(value) ~= 'string' then return fallback end
    if not smatch(value, '^#%x%x%x%x%x%x$') then return fallback end

    return value
end

---@param value any
---@return string
local function cleanText(value)
    if type(value) ~= 'string' then return '' end

    if #value > RAW_LIMIT then
        value = ssub(value, 1, RAW_LIMIT)
    end

    local text = sgsub(value, '\r', '')
    text = sgsub(text, '[\0-\9\11-\31\127]', '')
    text = sgsub(text, '~', '')
    text = sgsub(text, '\n\n\n+', '\n\n')
    text = smatch(text, '^%s*(.-)%s*$') or ''

    if #text > MAX_TEXT then
        text = ssub(text, 1, MAX_TEXT)
        text = sgsub(text, '[\128-\191]*$', '')
        text = sgsub(text, '[\192-\255]$', '')
    end

    return text
end

---@param value any
---@return string
local function fontKey(value)
    if type(value) == 'string' and fontKeys[value] then return value end

    local legacy = tonumber(value)

    return legacy and LEGACY_FONTS[legacy] or DEFAULTS.font
end

---@param input any
---@return SceneStyle
local function style(input)
    if type(input) ~= 'table' then input = {} end

    local background = input.background

    if type(background) ~= 'string' or not backgroundKeys[background] then
        background = 'none'
    end

    return {
        text = cleanText(input.text),
        font = fontKey(input.font),
        colour = hexColour(input.colour, DEFAULTS.colour),
        fontSize = clampNumber(input.fontSize, 0.1, 1.0, DEFAULTS.fontSize),
        viewDistance = floor(clampNumber(input.viewDistance, 1, MAX_DISTANCE, DEFAULTS.viewDistance)),
        shadow = input.shadow == true,
        outline = input.outline == true,
        background = background,
        backgroundColour = hexColour(input.backgroundColour, DEFAULTS.backgroundColour),
        backgroundAlpha = floor(clampNumber(input.backgroundAlpha, 0, 255, DEFAULTS.backgroundAlpha)),
        backgroundX = clampNumber(input.backgroundX, -0.2, 0.2, DEFAULTS.backgroundX),
        backgroundY = clampNumber(input.backgroundY, -0.2, 0.2, DEFAULTS.backgroundY),
        backgroundWidth = clampNumber(input.backgroundWidth, -0.5, 0.5, DEFAULTS.backgroundWidth),
        backgroundHeight = clampNumber(input.backgroundHeight, -0.5, 0.5, DEFAULTS.backgroundHeight),
    }
end

---@param value any
---@return integer
local function duration(value)
    return floor(clampNumber(value, 1, MAX_DURATION, DEFAULTS.duration))
end

---@param value any
---@return vector3?
local function coords(value)
    if type(value) ~= 'table' and type(value) ~= 'vector3' then return nil end

    local x, y, z = tonumber(value.x), tonumber(value.y), tonumber(value.z)

    if not x or not y or not z then return nil end
    if x ~= x or y ~= y or z ~= z then return nil end

    return vector3(x, y, z)
end

return {
    style = style,
    duration = duration,
    coords = coords,
}

local config = localmodule 'config'
local util = localmodule 'modules.util'

local mmax = math.max

local type = type

local WEAPON_HASH = joaat(config.weapon)
local CARTRIDGE_ITEM = config.cartridge.item

local RAYCAST_FLAGS = 31

---@param a vector3
---@param b vector3
---@return vector3
local function cross(a, b)
    return vec3(a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y, a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z, a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x)
end

---@param v vector3
---@param axis vector3
---@param degrees number
---@return vector3
local function rotate(v, axis, degrees)
    local rad = mrad(degrees)
    local c = mcos(rad)
    local dot = axis.x * v.x + axis.y * v.y + axis.z * v.z

    return v * c + cross(axis, v) * msin(rad) + axis * dot * (1.0 - c)
end

---@param from vector3
---@param to vector3
---@param ignore number
---@param flags integer
---@return boolean hit
---@return vector3 coords
---@return number entity
local function raycast(from, to, ignore, flags)
    local handle = StartExpensiveSynchronousShapeTestLosProbe(from.x, from.y, from.z, to.x, to.y, to.z, flags, ignore, 7)
    local _, hit, coords, _, entity = GetShapeTestResult(handle)

    return hit == 1 or hit == true, coords, entity
end

---@param ped number
---@return vector3
local function aimPoint(ped)
    local cam = GetFinalRenderedCamCoord()
    local rot = GetFinalRenderedCamRot(2)
    local rx, rz = mrad(rot.x), mrad(rot.z)
    local forward = vec3(-msin(rz) * mcos(rx), mcos(rz) * mcos(rx), msin(rx))
    local toPed = GetEntityCoords(ped) - cam
    local skip = mmax(toPed.x * forward.x + toPed.y * forward.y + toPed.z * forward.z, 0.0)
    local start = cam + forward * (skip + 0.5)
    local finish = cam + forward * (skip + RANGE)
    local hit, coords = raycast(start, finish, ped, RAYCAST_FLAGS)

    return hit and coords or finish
end

---@param ped number
---@param point vector3
---@return integer
local function closestBone(ped, point)
    local best, bestDistance = BONES[1], nil

    for i = 1, BONE_COUNT do
        local bone = BONES[i]
        local distance = #(GetPedBoneCoords(ped, bone, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0) - point)

        if not bestDistance or distance < bestDistance then
            best = bone
            bestDistance = distance
        end
    end

    return best
end

---@param entity number
---@return boolean
local function isTaseable(entity)
    if entity == 0 or GetEntityType(entity) ~= 1 then return false end
    if not NetworkGetEntityIsNetworked(entity) or IsPedInAnyVehicle(entity, false) then return false end

    return NPC_ENABLED or IsPedAPlayer(entity)
end

---@param ped number
---@param origin vector3
---@param direction vector3
---@return table hit
local function traceProbe(ped, origin, direction)
    local finish = origin + direction * RANGE
    local hit, coords, entity = raycast(origin + direction * 0.05, finish, ped, RAYCAST_FLAGS)

    if hit and isTaseable(entity) then
        return {
            target = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(entity),
            bone = closestBone(entity, coords),
            point = coords,
        }
    end

    if not hit then
        local ground, groundCoords = raycast(finish, finish - vec3(0.0, 0.0, 50.0), ped, 1)
        coords = ground and groundCoords or finish
    end

    return { point = coords }
end

---@param aim vector3
---@return vector3[]
local function probeDirections(aim)
    local right = cross(aim, UP)
    right = #right < 1.0e-4 and vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0) or norm(right)

    local list = {}

    for i = 1, PROBES_PER_SHOT do
        local direction = aim

        if i > 1 then
            direction = rotate(direction, right, -SPREAD * (i - 1) / (PROBES_PER_SHOT - 1))
        end

        if JITTER > 0 then
            direction = rotate(direction, right, (mrandom() * 2.0 - 1.0) * JITTER)
            direction = rotate(direction, UP, (mrandom() * 2.0 - 1.0) * JITTER)
        end

        list[i] = norm(direction)
    end

    return list
end

---@param ped number
---@return boolean
local function canFire(ped)
    if reloading or effect.selfTased then return false end
    if IsPedRagdoll(ped) or IsPedDeadOrDying(ped, true) then return false end
    if IsPedInAnyVehicle(ped, false) then return false end

    return not IsPauseMenuActive() and not IsNuiFocused()
end

local function fire()
    local ped = cache.ped
    if not canFire(ped) or shots == nil then return end

    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if now - lastShot < FIRE_COOLDOWN then return end

    if shots < 1 then
        sound('dry')

        if now - lastEmptyNotice > 2000 then
            lastEmptyNotice = now
            notify(('Cartridge empty. Press %s to load a new cartridge.'):format(config.reloadKey))
        end

        return
    end

    lastShot = now
    shots -= 1

    local muzzle = util.muzzle(ped)
    local aim = norm(aimPoint(ped) - muzzle)
    local directions = probeDirections(aim)
    local hits = {}
    local struck = false

    for i = 1, #directions do
        local hit = traceProbe(ped, muzzle, directions[i])
        hits[i] = hit
        struck = struck or hit.target ~= nil
    end

    TriggerTokenEvent('sm_taser:fire', hits)
    util.muzzleFlash(muzzle)
    sound('fire')

    if struck then
        sound('arc', ARC_TIME)
    end

    pushHud()
end

---@param token integer
local function holdLoop(token)
    local playerId = cache.playerId

    while holding and token == holdToken do
        DisablePlayerFiring(playerId, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 24, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 257, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 45, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 140, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 141, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 142, true)

        if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, 24) or IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, 257) then
            fire()
        end

        Wait(0)
    end
end

local function reload()
    if not holding or reloading or effect.selfTased then return end

    if shots and shots > 0 then
        return notify(('Cartridge still has %d shot(s) left.'):format(shots))
    end

    if cartridgeCount() < 1 then
        return notify('You have no Taser Cartridge.')
    end

    reloading = true

    local started, reason = lib.callback.await('sm_taser:reloadStart', false)

    if not started then
        reloading = false
        return reason and notify(reason)
    end

    pushHud()
    sound('reload')

    local ped = cache.ped
    local anim = util.playAnim(ped, RELOAD_ANIMS, 49)
    local finishAt = GetGameTimer() + RELOAD_TIME
    local completed = true

    while GetGameTimer() < finishAt do
        if not holding or effect.selfTased or IsPedRagdoll(ped) then
            completed = false
            break
        end

        DisableControlAction(0, 21, true)
        Wait(0)
    end

    util.stopAnim(ped, anim)

    if completed then
        local ok, result = lib.callback.await('sm_taser:reloadFinish', false)

        if ok then
            shots = result
        elseif type(result) == 'string' then
            notify(result)
        end
    end

    reloading = false
    pushHud()
end

local function fetchShots()
    for _ = 1, 3 do
        Wait(400)

        if not holding then return end

        local value = lib.callback.await('sm_taser:getShots', false)

        if value then
            shots = value
            pushHud()
            return
        end
    end
end

---@param state boolean
local function setHolding(state)
    if holding == state then return end

    holding = state

    if state then
        shots = nil
        holdToken += 1

        local token = holdToken

        CreateThread(function()
            holdLoop(token)
        end)
        CreateThread(fetchShots)
    end

    syncFrame()
    pushHud()
end

effect.onSelf = function(tased, info)
    syncFrame()

    if not tased or not info then return end

    sound('arc', mmax(0, info.twitchEnd - GetGameTimer()))
end

lib.onCache('weapon', function(weapon)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_3\interface\sm_taser\modules\effect.lua
local config = localmodule 'config'
local util = localmodule 'modules.util'

local Wait = Wait
local GetGameTimer = GetGameTimer
local GetCloudTimeAsInt = GetCloudTimeAsInt
local DoesEntityExist = DoesEntityExist
local IsPedDeadOrDying = IsPedDeadOrDying
local IsPedRagdoll = IsPedRagdoll
local NetworkHasControlOfEntity = NetworkHasControlOfEntity
local IsEntityPlayingAnim = IsEntityPlayingAnim
local TaskPlayAnim = TaskPlayAnim
