local function restoreAttachedObject(entity)
    if gizmoMode ~= 'attach' or not attachData then return end
    if not entity or not DoesEntityExist(entity) then return end

    local ped = cache.ped

    AttachEntityToEntity(entity, ped, GetPedBoneIndex(ped, attachData.bone),
        attachData.xCoord, attachData.yCoord, attachData.zCoord,
        attachData.xRotation, attachData.yRotation, attachData.zRotation,
        true, true, false, true, 1, true)
end

---@param entity number
local function openGizmo(entity)
    gizmoEntity = entity

    if not frameMounted then
        frameMounted = true
        interface.show()
        Wait(250)
    end

    infoUI.show({
        id = INFO_GIZMO,
        title = 'Atur Posisi Speaker',
        icon = 'fa-solid fa-arrows-to-dot',
        description = [[
        [kbd]Z[/kbd] Geser
        [kbd]R[/kbd] Putar
        [kbd]ENTER[/kbd] Simpan
        [kbd]ESC[/kbd] Batal
        [kbd]RMB[/kbd] Lihat sekeliling
        ]],
    })

    interface.send({
        action = 'setGizmoEntity',
        data = {
            handle = entity,
            position = GetEntityCoords(entity),
            rotation = GetEntityRotation(entity),
        },
    })

    interface.focus(true, true, true)

    CreateThread(function()
        while gizmoEntity do
            interface.send({
                action = 'setCameraPosition',
                data = {
                    position = GetFinalRenderedCamCoord(),
                    rotation = GetFinalRenderedCamRot(),
                },
            })
            Wait(0)
        end
    end)

    CreateThread(function()
        while gizmoEntity do
            for i = 1, #blockedControls do
                DisableControlAction(0, blockedControls[i], true)
            end

            if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 25) then
                for i = 1, #lookAroundControls do
                    EnableControlAction(0, lookAroundControls[i], true)
                end
            end

            if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, CONTROL_ENTER) then
                local target = gizmoEntity
                closeGizmo()
                resolveGizmo({ GetEntityCoords(target), GetEntityRotation(target) })
            elseif IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, CONTROL_ESC) then
                local target = gizmoEntity
                closeGizmo()
                restoreAttachedObject(target)
                attachData = nil
                resolveGizmo(false)
            end

            Wait(0)
        end
    end)
end

interface.callback('moveEntity', function(data, cb)
    cb('ok')

    if not data or not data.handle or not DoesEntityExist(data.handle) then return end

    SetEntityCoords(data.handle, data.position.x, data.position.y, data.position.z, false, false, false, false)
    SetEntityRotation(data.handle, data.rotation.x, data.rotation.y, data.rotation.z, 2, true)
end)

interface.callback('saveEntity', function(_, cb)
    cb('ok')

    if not activePromise then return end

    local entity = gizmoEntity
    closeGizmo()
    resolveGizmo({ GetEntityCoords(entity), GetEntityRotation(entity) })
end)

interface.callback('cancel', function(_, cb)
    cb('ok')

    if not activePromise then return end

    local entity = gizmoEntity
    closeGizmo()
    restoreAttachedObject(entity)
    attachData = nil
    resolveGizmo(false)
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_audio:client:getAttachOffset', function(serverId, data, netId)
    if activePromise then
        resolveGizmo(false)
    end

    local entity = GetAttachedEntityByKey(serverId, data.key)
    if not entity or not DoesEntityExist(entity) then
        return false
    end

    gizmoMode = 'attach'
    attachData = data

    DetachEntity(entity, true, true)
    PlaceObjectOnGroundProperly(entity)

    activePromise = promise.new()
    openGizmo(entity)

    local result = Citizen.Await(activePromise)
    if not result then return false end

    local vehicle = NetToVeh(netId)

    if not IsEntityTouchingEntity(entity, vehicle) then
        restoreAttachedObject(entity)
        attachData = nil

        ClientUtil.notify(locale('The speaker must be in contact with the vehicle.'), 'error')
        return false
    end

    attachData = nil

    local newCoords, newRotation = result[1], result[2]
    local offset = GetOffsetFromEntityGivenWorldCoords(vehicle, newCoords.x, newCoords.y, newCoords.z)
    local vehicleRotation = GetEntityRotation(vehicle)

    return {
        offset,
        vec3(
            (newRotation.x - vehicleRotation.x + 360) % 360,
            (newRotation.y - vehicleRotation.y + 360) % 360,
            (newRotation.z - vehicleRotation.z + 360) % 360
        ),
    }
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_audio:client:getNewCoords', function(soundId, sourceId)
    if activePromise then
        resolveGizmo(false)
    end

    local entity = GetSoundSourceEntity(soundId, sourceId)
    if not entity or not DoesEntityExist(entity) then
        return false
    end

    gizmoMode = 'move'
    attachData = nil

    activePromise = promise.new()
    openGizmo(entity)

    return Citizen.Await(activePromise)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:stop', function()
    if not gizmoEntity then return end

    closeGizmo()
    resolveGizmo(false)
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource then return end

    if gizmoEntity then
        closeGizmo()
        resolveGizmo(false)
    end
end)

---@param speakerId string
function InteractSpeaker(speakerId)
    local allowed, data = lib.callback.await('sm_audio:server:getInteractionData', false, speakerId)

    if not allowed then
        ClientUtil.notify(locale("You don't have the necessary permissions."), 'error')
        return
    end

    local options = {}
    local count = 0
    local permissions = data.permissions

    for i = 1, #interactOptions do
        local option = interactOptions[i]

        if permissions[option.key] then
            local args = {
                speakerId = speakerId,
                volume = data.volume,
                range = data.range,
                maxRange = data.maxRange,
                maxVolume = data.maxVolume,
                permanent = data.permanent,
                public = data.public,
                name = data.name,
                groupId = data.groupId,
            }

            if option.key == 'settings' then
                args.filters = data.filters
                args.permissions = permissions
                args.allowedFilters = data.allowedFilters
            end

            count = count + 1
            options[count] = {
                title = locale(option.title),
                description = locale(option.description),
                icon = option.icon,
                args = args,
                event = option.event,
                onSelect = option.onSelect,
                disabled = option.disableOnGroup and data.groupId ~= nil or nil,
            }
        end
    end

    lib.registerContext({
        id = 'speaker-interact',
        title = locale('Speaker interaction'),
        options = options,
    })

    lib.showContext('speaker-interact')
end

---@param speakerId string
---@param action string
function InteractSpeakerTarget(speakerId, action)
    if IsPedInAnyVehicle(cache.ped, true) or IsPedGettingIntoAVehicle(cache.ped) then
        ClientUtil.notify(locale("This can't be done while inside a vehicle."), 'error')
        return
    end

    if not ClientUtil.interactionCheck() then return end

    local allowed, data = lib.callback.await('sm_audio:server:getInteractionData', false, speakerId)

    if not allowed then
        ClientUtil.notify(locale("You don't have the necessary permissions."), 'error')
        return
    end

    if not data.permissions[action] then
        ClientUtil.notify(locale('This action is not supported on this type of speaker.'), 'error')
        return
    end

    if action == 'playMusic' then
        local input = lib.inputDialog(locale('Play music'), playMusicFields())
        if not input then return end
        TriggerServerEvent('sm_audio:server:playMusic', speakerId, input)
    elseif action == 'volumeRange' then
        local input = lib.inputDialog(locale('Change volume/range'),
            volumeRangeFields(data.maxVolume, data.maxRange, data.volume, data.range))
        if not input then return end
        TriggerServerEvent('sm_audio:server:changeVolumeRange', speakerId, input)
    elseif action == 'carry' then
        TriggerServerEvent('sm_audio:server:carrySpeaker', speakerId)
    elseif action == 'store' then
        TriggerServerEvent('sm_audio:server:removeSpeaker', speakerId)
    elseif action == 'addGroup' then
        local input = lib.inputDialog(locale('Connect'), {
            {
                type = 'input',
                label = locale('Group code'),
                description = locale('Connect code of the group you want to connect to.'),
                icon = 'hashtag',
            },
        })
        if not input then return end
        TriggerServerEvent('sm_audio:server:addToGroup', speakerId, input)
    end
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:notify', function(message, kind)
    ClientUtil.notify(message, kind)
end)

    })

    if Config.useTargeting then
        if GetResourceState('ox_target') ~= 'missing' then
            targetResource = 'ox_target'

        interactKeybind:disable(disabled)
    end

    })

    closestSpeakerId = speakerId
    SetInteractKeybindDisabled(false)

local targetNames = {
    'sm-speaker-play',
    'sm-speaker-range',
    'sm-speaker-pickup',
    'sm-speaker-connect',
    'sm-speaker-disconnect',
    'sm-speaker-store',
    'sm-speaker-other',
}

---@param entity number
local function removeTargetOptions(entity)
    if targetResource ~= 'ox_target' or not entity then return end
    exports.ox_target:removeLocalEntity({ entity }, targetNames)
end

---@param speakerId string
local function spawnPointObject(speakerId)
    local point = outerPoints[speakerId]
    if not point or point.handle then return end

    if not lib.requestModel(point.model, Config.modelTimeout) then
        return
    end

    local coords = point.coords
    local handle = CreateObjectNoOffset(point.model, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false)

    if not DoesEntityExist(handle) then
        SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(point.model)
        return
    end

    FreezeEntityPosition(handle, true)
    SetEntityRotation(handle, point.rotation.x, point.rotation.y, point.rotation.z, 2, true)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(point.model)

    point.handle = handle

    TriggerEvent('sm_audio:client:mapEntityToSource', point.soundId, point.sourceId, handle)

    if Config.useTargeting then
        addTargetOptions(handle, speakerId, {
            groupId = point.groupId,
            permissions = point.permissions,
        })
    end
end

---@param speakerId string
local function despawnPointObject(speakerId)
    local point = outerPoints[speakerId]
    if not point then return end

    if Config.useTargeting then
        removeTargetOptions(point.handle)
    end

    if point.handle and DoesEntityExist(point.handle) then
        SetEntityAsMissionEntity(point.handle, true, true)
        DeleteEntity(point.handle)
    end

    point.handle = nil

    TriggerEvent('sm_audio:client:mapEntityToSource', point.soundId, point.sourceId, nil)
end

---@param speakerId string
---@param data table
function CreatePoint(speakerId, data)
    if outerPoints[speakerId] then return end

    if not Config.useTargeting and not interactPoints[speakerId] then
        local inner = lib.points.new(data.coords, 2.5, {
            speakerId = speakerId,
            bucketId = data.bucketId,
        })

        function inner:onEnter()
            if currentBucketId ~= self.bucketId then return end
            showInteract(self.speakerId)
        end

        function inner:onExit()
            hideInteract(self.speakerId)
        end

        interactPoints[speakerId] = inner
    end

    local outer = lib.points.new(data.coords, 150.0, {
        model = data.model,
        rotation = data.rotation,
        soundId = data.soundId,
        sourceId = data.sourceId,
        groupId = data.groupId,
        permissions = data.permissions,
        speakerId = speakerId,
        bucketId = data.bucketId,
    })

    function outer:onEnter()
        if currentBucketId ~= self.bucketId then return end
        spawnPointObject(self.speakerId)
    end

    function outer:onExit()
        despawnPointObject(self.speakerId)
    end

    outerPoints[speakerId] = outer
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:addPoint', function(speakerId, data)
    CreatePoint(speakerId, data)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:removePoint', function(speakerId)
    local inner = interactPoints[speakerId]

    if inner then
        inner:remove()
        interactPoints[speakerId] = nil
    end

    if closestSpeakerId == speakerId then
        infoUI.remove(INFO_INTERACT)
        closestSpeakerId = nil
        SetInteractKeybindDisabled(true)
    end

    local outer = outerPoints[speakerId]
    if not outer then return end

    despawnPointObject(speakerId)
    outer:remove()
    outerPoints[speakerId] = nil
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:updatePointCoords', function(speakerId, coords, rotation)
    local outer = outerPoints[speakerId]
    if not outer then return end

    outer.coords = coords
    outer.rotation = rotation

    local inner = interactPoints[speakerId]
    if inner then
        inner.coords = coords
    end

    if outer.handle and DoesEntityExist(outer.handle) then
        SetEntityCoords(outer.handle, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false, false)
        SetEntityRotation(outer.handle, rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z, 2, true)
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:updatePointData', function(speakerId, data)
    local outer = outerPoints[speakerId]
    if not outer then return end

    outer.groupId = data.groupId
    outer.permissions = data.permissions

    if outer.handle and DoesEntityExist(outer.handle) then
        removeTargetOptions(outer.handle)
        addTargetOptions(outer.handle, speakerId, data)
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('sm_audio:client:routingBucketUpdated', function(bucketId)
    for speakerId, point in pairs(outerPoints) do
        if point.currentDistance then
            if point.bucketId == bucketId then
                spawnPointObject(speakerId)
            else
                despawnPointObject(speakerId)
            end
        end
    end

    for speakerId, point in pairs(interactPoints) do
        if point.currentDistance then
            if point.bucketId == bucketId then
                showInteract(speakerId)
            else
                hideInteract(speakerId)
            end
        end
    end
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_audio:client:getCreationCoords', function(model)
    if closestSpeakerId then
        return false
    end

    if not lib.requestModel(model, Config.modelTimeout) then
        return false
    end

    local ped = cache.ped
    local dimensions = GetModelDimensions(GetEntityModel(ped))
    local offset = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(ped, 0.0, dimensions.y + 0.8, dimensions.z)

    local object = CreateObjectNoOffset(model, offset.x, offset.y, offset.z + 0.35, false, false, false)

    if not DoesEntityExist(object) then
        SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
        return false
    end

    SetEntityAsMissionEntity(object, true, true)
    FreezeEntityPosition(object, true)
    PlaceObjectOnGroundProperly(object)

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(object)
    local rotation = GetEntityRotation(ped)

    DeleteEntity(object)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)

    return true, coords, rotation + vec3(0.0, 0.0, 180.0)
end)

---@param soundId string
---@param sourceId number
---@return number?
function GetSoundSourceEntity(soundId, sourceId)
    for _, point in pairs(outerPoints) do
        if point.soundId == soundId and point.sourceId == sourceId then
            return point.handle
        end
    end
end

    if value ~= currentBucketId then
        currentBucketId = value
        TriggerEvent('sm_audio:client:routingBucketUpdated', value)
    end
end)

    local state = LocalPlayer.state
    if state and state.routingBucket then
        currentBucketId = state.routingBucket
    end

    for speakerId, data in pairs(startupPoints) do
        CreatePoint(speakerId, data)
    end

    TriggerEvent('sm_audio:client:receiveFilters', filters, filterLimits)
end)

    TriggerServerEvent('sm_audio:server:requestStartup')
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource then return end

    infoUI.remove(INFO_INTERACT)

    for speakerId in pairs(outerPoints) do
        despawnPointObject(speakerId)
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('sm_audio:client:speakerSettings', function(data)
    local options = {}
    local count = 0
    local permissions = data.permissions

    for i = 1, #settingsOptions do
        local setting = settingsOptions[i]

        local skip = (setting.skipOnGroup and data.groupId)
            or (setting.requireGroup and not data.groupId)
            or (setting.skipWhenPermanent and data.permanent)
            or (setting.requirePermanent and not data.permanent)

        if not skip then
            local option = {
                title = locale(setting.title),
                icon = setting.icon,
                arrow = setting.arrow,
                event = setting.event,
                serverEvent = setting.serverEvent,
                onSelect = setting.onSelect,
                disabled = not permissions[setting.key] or nil,
            }

            if setting.key == 'rename' then
                option.description = locale(setting.description, data.name)
                option.args = { data.speakerId, data.name }
            elseif setting.key == 'useFilters' then
                option.description = locale(setting.description)
                option.args = data
            else
                option.description = locale(setting.description)
                option.args = data.speakerId
            end

            count = count + 1
            options[count] = option
        end
    end

    lib.registerContext({
        id = 'speaker-settings',
        title = locale('Speaker settings'),
        menu = 'speaker-interact',
        options = options,
    })

    lib.showContext('speaker-settings')
end)

local Config = localmodule 'config'

local shopPoint

---@param entity number
local function addShopTarget(entity)
    if targetResource ~= 'ox_target' then return end

    exports.ox_target:addLocalEntity({ entity }, {
        {
            label = locale('Speaker shop'),
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-basket-shopping',
            name = 'sm-speaker-shop',
            distance = 2.0,
            onSelect = function()
                TriggerServerEvent('sm_audio:server:openSpeakerShop')
            end,
        },
    })
end

---@param entity number
local function removeShopTarget(entity)
    if targetResource ~= 'ox_target' or not entity then return end
    exports.ox_target:removeLocalEntity({ entity }, { 'sm-speaker-shop' })
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:createShop', function(shop)
    if shopPoint then return end

    local coords = vec3(shop.coords.x, shop.coords.y, shop.coords.z)

    shopPoint = lib.points.new(coords, 60.0, {
        model = shop.pedModel,
        heading = shop.coords.w,
    })

    function shopPoint:onEnter()
        if not lib.requestModel(self.model, Config.modelTimeout) then return end

        self.handle = CreatePed(0, self.model, self.coords.x, self.coords.y, self.coords.z, self.heading, false, true)

        SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(self.model)
        FreezeEntityPosition(self.handle, true)
        SetEntityInvincible(self.handle, true)
        SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(self.handle, true)

        addShopTarget(self.handle)
    end

    function shopPoint:onExit()
        removeShopTarget(self.handle)

        if self.handle and DoesEntityExist(self.handle) then
            SetEntityAsMissionEntity(self.handle, false, true)
            DeleteEntity(self.handle)
        end

        self.handle = nil
    end

    if shop.blip and shop.blip.enabled then
        shopBlip = AddBlipForCoord(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)

        SetBlipSprite(shopBlip, shop.blip.sprite)
        SetBlipColour(shopBlip, shop.blip.color)
        SetBlipScale(shopBlip, shop.blip.scale or 1.0)
        SetBlipAsShortRange(shopBlip, true)
        BeginTextCommandSetBlipName('STRING')
        AddTextComponentString(shop.blip.text)
        EndTextCommandSetBlipName(shopBlip)
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_audio:client:openSpeakerShop', function(speakerTypes, maxRange, maxVolume)
    local options = {}

    for i = 1, #speakerTypes do
        local speakerType = speakerTypes[i]
        local rangeProgress = math.floor((speakerType.maxRange / maxRange) * 100)
        local volumeProgress = math.floor((speakerType.maxVolume / maxVolume) * 100)

        options[i] = {
            title = ('%s ($%.2f)'):format(speakerType.label, speakerType.price),
            description = speakerType.description,
            icon = speakerType.image,
            image = speakerType.image,
            arrow = true,
            progress = rangeProgress,
            colorScheme = 'teal',
            metadata = {
                { label = locale('Range'), value = ('%s/%s'):format(speakerType.maxRange, maxRange), progress = rangeProgress },
                { label = locale('Max volume'), value = ('%s/%s'):format(speakerType.maxVolume, maxVolume), progress = volumeProgress },
            },
            onSelect = function()
                local confirm = lib.alertDialog({
                    header = locale('Confirmation'),
                    content = locale('Are sure you want to purchase %s for $%.2f?', speakerType.label, speakerType.price),
                    centered = true,
                    cancel = true,
                })

                if confirm ~= 'confirm' then return end

                TriggerServerEvent('sm_audio:server:purchaseSpeaker', speakerType.id)
            end,
        }
    end

    lib.registerContext({
        id = 'speaker-shop',
        title = locale('Speaker shop'),
        options = options,
    })

    lib.showContext('speaker-shop')
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\interface\sm_audio\modules\clientutil.lua
local GetGameTimer = GetGameTimer
local StartShapeTestCapsule = StartShapeTestCapsule
local GetShapeTestResult = GetShapeTestResult
local IsEntityAVehicle = IsEntityAVehicle

local Util = {}

local notifyIcons = {
    error = 'ban',
    success = 'check',
}

local notifyColors = {
    error = '#C53030',
    success = '#019430',
}

local lastInteraction = 0

---@param message string
---@param kind? string
function Util.notify(message, kind)
    kind = kind or 'info'

    lib.notify({
        title = ('%s!'):format(kind:gsub('^%l', string.upper)),
        description = message,
        type = kind,
        icon = notifyIcons[kind],
        iconColor = notifyColors[kind],
    })
end

---@return boolean
function Util.interactionCheck()
    local now = GetGameTimer()

    if now - lastInteraction <= 2000 then
        Util.notify(locale('Please wait a little.'), 'info')
        return false
    end

    lastInteraction = now
    return true
end

---@param x number
---@param y number
---@param z number
---@param radius? number
---@return number|false
function Util.getNearestVehicle(x, y, z, radius)
    if not (x and y and z) then
        return false
    end

    local handle = StartShapeTestCapsule(x, y, z, x, y, z, radius or 2.0, 10, cache.ped, 7)
    local _, hit, _, _, entity = GetShapeTestResult(handle)

    if hit == 1 and entity and IsEntityAVehicle(entity) then
        return entity
    end

    return false
end

return Util

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\interface\sm_audio\modules\ratelimit.lua
local Config = localmodule 'config'

local osClock = os.clock

local buckets = {}

local RateLimit = {}

---@param playerId number
---@param key string
---@param interval? number
---@return boolean
function RateLimit.check(playerId, key, interval)
    interval = (interval or Config.rateLimit.default) / 1000

    local bucket = buckets[playerId]

    if not bucket then
        bucket = {}
        buckets[playerId] = bucket
    end

    local now = osClock()
    local last = bucket[key]

    if last and (now - last) < interval then
        return false
    end

    bucket[key] = now
    return true
end

---@param playerId number
function RateLimit.clear(playerId)
    buckets[playerId] = nil
end

return RateLimit

---@param str string
---@return string
function Util.ucfirst(str)
    return (gsub(str, '^%l', upper))
end

---@return string
function Util.uniqueId()
    return (gsub('xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx', '[xy]', function(c)
        if c == 'x' then
            return format('%x', random(0, 15))
        end
        return format('%x', 8 + random(0, 3))
    end))
end

---@return string
function Util.generateSpeakerName()
    return Util.ucfirst(animals[random(animalCount)])
        .. Util.ucfirst(animals[random(animalCount)])
        .. Util.ucfirst(animals[random(animalCount)])
end

---@param value number
---@return number
function Util.formatFloat(value)
    return tonumber(format('%.2f', value))
end

---@param value number
---@param total number
---@return number
function Util.percent(value, total)
    return floor(value * (total / 100) * 100 + 0.5) / 100
end

---@param url string
---@return string
function Util.formatShortUrl(url)
    local id = match(url, 'youtu%.be/([%w-_]+)')
    if not id then
        return url
    end

    local result = format('https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=%s', id)

    local list = match(url, 'list=([%w-_]+)')
    if list then
        result = result .. format('&list=%s', list)
    end

    local time = match(url, 't=(%d+)')
    if time then
        result = result .. format('&t=%ss', time)
    end

    return result
end

---@param url string
---@return boolean
function Util.isValidYouTubeUrl(url)
    url = Util.formatShortUrl(url)

    return match(url, 'https://www%.youtube%.com/watch%?v=...........') ~= nil
        or match(url, 'https://music%.youtube%.com/watch%?v=...........') ~= nil
end

---@param url string
---@return string? videoId
---@return string? playlistId
---@return string? startTime
function Util.getYouTubeIds(url)
    url = Util.formatShortUrl(url)
    return match(url, 'v=([%w-_]+)'), match(url, 'list=([%w-_]+)'), match(url, 't=(%d+)')
end

---@param iso string
---@return number
function Util.isoToSeconds(iso)
    local seconds = 0

    for value, unit in iso:gmatch('([%d.,]+)(%u)') do
        local multiplier = timeMultipliers[unit]
        if multiplier then
            seconds = seconds + (tonumber(value) or 0) * multiplier
        end
    end

    return seconds
end

return Util

local function anyBillingOpen()
    return billingUiOpen or incomingFocused or companyLogsOpen
end

local function openSurface(key, sender)
    frameGen = frameGen + 1
    openSenders[key] = sender
    if not frameMounted then
        frameReady = false
        interface.show()
        frameMounted = true
    elseif frameReady then
        sender()
    end
end

local function sendOnce(sender)
    frameGen = frameGen + 1
    if not frameMounted then
        frameReady = false
        interface.show()
        frameMounted = true
        pendingOneShots[#pendingOneShots + 1] = sender
    elseif frameReady then
        sender()
    else
        pendingOneShots[#pendingOneShots + 1] = sender
    end
end

local function closeSurface(key)
    openSenders[key] = nil
    if not frameMounted or anyBillingOpen() then return end
    local gen = frameGen
    SetTimeout(50, function()
        if gen == frameGen and frameMounted and not anyBillingOpen() then
            interface.hide()
            frameMounted = false
            frameReady = false
        end
    end)
end

    cb('ok')
    frameReady = true
    for _, sender in pairs(openSenders) do
        sender()
    end
    local shots = pendingOneShots
    pendingOneShots = {}
    for i = 1, #shots do
        shots[i]()
    end
end)

function FormatMoneyClient(amount)
    if not amount then return "$0" end
    local num = tonumber(amount)
    if not num then return "$0" end

    local formatted = ""
    local str = tostring(math.floor(num))
    local len = string.len(str)

    for i = len, 1, -1 do
        formatted = string.sub(str, i, i) .. formatted
        if (len - i + 1) % 3 == 0 and i > 1 then
            formatted = "." .. formatted
        end
    end

    return "$" .. formatted
end

function PlayBillingAnimation()
    local playerPed = PlayerPedId()

    if tabletProp and DoesEntityExist(tabletProp) then
        DeleteEntity(tabletProp)
        tabletProp = nil
    end

    RequestAnimDict("amb@code_human_in_bus_passenger_idles@female@tablet@idle_a")
    while not HasAnimDictLoaded("amb@code_human_in_bus_passenger_idles@female@tablet@idle_a") do Wait(100) end

    RequestModel("prop_cs_tablet")
    while not HasModelLoaded("prop_cs_tablet") do Wait(100) end

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(playerPed)
    tabletProp = CreateObject(GetHashKey("prop_cs_tablet"), coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, true, true, false)
    SetEntityAsMissionEntity(tabletProp, true, true)
    AttachEntityToEntity(tabletProp, playerPed, GetPedBoneIndex(playerPed, 28422), -0.05, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, -90.0, 0.0, true, true, false, true, 1, true)

    TaskPlayAnim(playerPed, "amb@code_human_in_bus_passenger_idles@female@tablet@idle_a", "idle_a", 3.0, 3.0, -1, 49, 0, false, false, false)
    isMenuOpen = true
end

function StopBillingAnimation()
    local playerPed = PlayerPedId()

    ClearPedTasks(playerPed)
    StopAnimTask(playerPed, "amb@code_human_in_bus_passenger_idles@female@tablet@idle_a", "idle_a", 1.0)

    if tabletProp then
        if DoesEntityExist(tabletProp) then
            DetachEntity(tabletProp, true, true)
            DeleteEntity(tabletProp)
            DeleteObject(tabletProp)
        end
        tabletProp = nil
    end

    isMenuOpen = false
    RemoveAnimDict("amb@code_human_in_bus_passenger_idles@female@tablet@idle_a")
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded("prop_cs_tablet")
end

function GetNearbyPlayers()
    local players = {}
    local playerPed = PlayerPedId()
    local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(playerPed)

    local nearbyPlayers = {}
    for _, player in pairs(GetActivePlayers()) do
        if player ~= PlayerId() then
            local targetPed = GetPlayerPed(player)
            local distance = #(playerCoords - GetEntityCoords(targetPed))
            if distance <= 10.0 then
                table.insert(nearbyPlayers, GetPlayerServerId(player))
            end
        end
    end

    if #nearbyPlayers == 0 then return players end

    local playerData = lib.callback.await('xx-billing:server:GetPlayersData', false, nearbyPlayers)
    if playerData then
        for _, data in pairs(playerData) do
            table.insert(players, {value = data.citizenid, label = 'Warga (ID: ' .. data.source .. ')'})
        end
    end

    return players
end

local function BuildBillingContext()
    local jobName = PlayerData.job and PlayerData.job.name or 'unemployed'
    local jobLabel = PlayerData.job and PlayerData.job.label or jobName
    local dueDays = Config.AutoCollectionDays[jobName] or Config.AutoCollectionDays['default'] or 7

    local presetItems = {}
    for _, item in ipairs(Config.PresetItems[jobName] or {}) do
        presetItems[#presetItems + 1] = {
            label = item.label,
            description = item.description or '',
            price = item.price
        }
    end

    return {
        jobName = jobName,
        jobLabel = jobLabel,
        playerName = PlayerData.charinfo.firstname .. ' ' .. PlayerData.charinfo.lastname,
        grade = PlayerData.job and PlayerData.job.grade.name or '',
        canCreateInvoice = CanCreateInvoice(),
        cash = PlayerData.money and PlayerData.money.cash or 0,
        bank = PlayerData.money and PlayerData.money.bank or 0,
        dueDateLabel = dueDays .. ' hari dari sekarang',
        presetItems = presetItems,
        minAmount = Config.MinInvoiceAmount,
        maxAmount = Config.MaxInvoiceAmount
    }
end

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resourceName)
    if GetCurrentResourceName() ~= resourceName then return end

    if isMenuOpen then StopBillingAnimation() end
    if billingUiOpen or incomingFocused then SetNuiFocus(false, false) end

    Wait(100)
    local playerPed = PlayerPedId()
    local tabletHash = GetHashKey("prop_cs_tablet")
    for _, object in ipairs(GetGamePool('CObject')) do
        if GetEntityModel(object) == tabletHash and IsEntityAttachedToEntity(object, playerPed) then
            DetachEntity(object, true, true)
            DeleteEntity(object)
        end
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStart', function(resourceName)
    if GetCurrentResourceName() ~= resourceName then return end
    PlayerData = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayerData()
    Wait(1000)
    SetupCompanyLogTargets()
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\interface\sm_blindfold\client.lua
if not interface.init(false) then
    return
end

local Config = localmodule 'config'

local Item = Config.item
local TargetDistance = Config.targetDistance
local InstallDuration = Config.installDuration
local RemoveDuration = Config.removeDuration
local PropModel = Config.prop
local Bone = Config.bone
local Offset = Config.offset
local Rotation = Config.rotation

local Wait = Wait
local Player = Player
local DoesEntityExist = DoesEntityExist
local DeleteEntity = DeleteEntity
local NetworkGetPlayerIndexFromPed = NetworkGetPlayerIndexFromPed
local GetPlayerServerId = GetPlayerServerId

local pState = LocalPlayer.state
local bag = nil
local overlay = false
local generation = 0
local phoneCheck = nil

---@param entity number
---@return number?
local function serverIdFromPed(entity)
    local player = NetworkGetPlayerIndexFromPed(entity)
    if player == -1 then return end

    return GetPlayerServerId(player)
end

local function phoneRunning()
    return GetResourceState('lb-phone') == 'started'
end

local function closePhone()
    if phoneRunning() and exports['lb-phone']:IsOpen() then
        exports['lb-phone']:ToggleOpen(false)
    end
end

local function blindfoldPhoneCheck()
    return not pState.blindfolded
end

local function addPhoneCheck()
    return exports['lb-phone']:AddCheck('openPhone', blindfoldPhoneCheck)
end

local function registerPhoneCheck()
    CreateThread(function()
        for _ = 1, 30 do
            if phoneCheck then return end

            if phoneRunning() then
                local ok, id = pcall(addPhoneCheck)
                if ok then
                    phoneCheck = id
                    return
                end
            end

            Wait(1000)
        end
    end)
end

local function removeBag()
    if bag and DoesEntityExist(bag) then
        DeleteEntity(bag)
    end

    bag = nil
end

local function attachBag()
    if bag or not pcall(lib.requestModel, PropModel, 5000) then return end

    local ped = cache.ped
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)

    bag = CreateObject(PropModel, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, true, true, false)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(PropModel)

    if bag == 0 then
        bag = nil
        return
    end

    AttachEntityToEntity(bag, ped, GetPedBoneIndex(ped, Bone), Offset.x, Offset.y, Offset.z, Rotation.x, Rotation.y, Rotation.z, true, true, false, true, 1, true)
    TriggerTokenEvent('sm_blindfold:server:prop', ObjToNet(bag))
end

---@param state boolean
local function setOverlay(state)
    if overlay == state then return end

    overlay = state

    if state then
        interface.show()
    else
        interface.hide()
    end
end

AddStateBagChangeHandler('blindfolded', ('player:%s'):format(cache.serverId), function(_, _, value)
    generation += 1
    local current = generation

    if value then
        closePhone()
    end

    CreateThread(function()
        Wait(value and InstallDuration or RemoveDuration)
        if current ~= generation then return end

        if not value then
            removeBag()
            setOverlay(false)
            return
        end

        attachBag()

        if current ~= generation then
            removeBag()
            return
        end

        closePhone()
        setOverlay(true)
    end)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_blindfold:client:act', function(label, duration)
    local ped = cache.ped

    lib.requestAnimDict('mini@repair', 1000)
    TaskPlayAnim(ped, 'mini@repair', 'fixing_a_ped', 8.0, -8.0, -1, 0, 0, false, false, false)

    lib.progressBar({
        duration = duration,
        label = label,
        useWhileDead = false,
        canCancel = false,
        disable = { car = true, move = true, combat = true },
    })

    ClearPedTasks(ped)
    RemoveAnimDict('mini@repair')
end)

ox_target:addGlobalPlayer({
    {
        name = 'sm_blindfold:put',
        icon = 'fa-solid fa-eye-slash',
        label = 'Put Blindfold',
        distance = TargetDistance,
        canInteract = function(entity, distance)
            if distance > TargetDistance then return false end

            local serverId = serverIdFromPed(entity)
            if not serverId or Player(serverId).state.blindfolded then return false end

            return ox_inventory:Search('count', Item) > 0
        end,
        onSelect = function(data)
            local serverId = serverIdFromPed(data.entity)
            if serverId then
                TriggerTokenEvent('sm_blindfold:server:put', serverId)
            end
        end
    },
    {
        name = 'sm_blindfold:remove',
        icon = 'fa-solid fa-eye',
        label = 'Remove Blindfold',
        distance = TargetDistance,
        canInteract = function(entity, distance)
            if distance > TargetDistance then return false end

            local serverId = serverIdFromPed(entity)
            return serverId ~= nil and Player(serverId).state.blindfolded == true
        end,
        onSelect = function(data)
            local serverId = serverIdFromPed(data.entity)
            if serverId then
                TriggerTokenEvent('sm_blindfold:server:remove', serverId)
            end
        end
    }
})

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\interface\sm_carmaintenance\client.lua
if not interface.init(false) then
    return

local Config = localmodule 'config'

local QBCore = exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject()

local Parts = Config.Parts
local PartOrder = Config.PartOrder
local Penalty = Config.Penalty
local PenaltyBase = Config.PenaltyBase
local Jobs = Config.Jobs
local TickInterval = Config.TickInterval
local SyncInterval = Config.SyncInterval
local BodyImpact = Config.BodyImpact
local MinEngineHealth = Config.MinEngineHealth
local EffectInterval = Config.EffectInterval
local MinSpeedMs = Config.MinSpeedMs
local RepairDuration = Config.RepairDuration
local RepairAnim = Config.RepairAnim
local InspectAnim = Config.InspectAnim
local InspectRange = Config.InspectRange
local AllowedClasses = Config.AllowedClasses

local GetEntitySpeed = GetEntitySpeed
local GetEntityCoords = GetEntityCoords
local GetVehicleNumberPlateText = GetVehicleNumberPlateText
local GetVehicleWheelBrakePressure = GetVehicleWheelBrakePressure
local GetVehicleNumberOfWheels = GetVehicleNumberOfWheels
local SetVehicleHandlingFloat = SetVehicleHandlingFloat
local GetVehicleHandlingFloat = GetVehicleHandlingFloat
local SetVehicleEngineHealth = SetVehicleEngineHealth
local SetVehicleMaxSpeed = SetVehicleMaxSpeed
local GetVehicleEngineHealth = GetVehicleEngineHealth
local GetVehicleBodyHealth = GetVehicleBodyHealth
local DoesEntityExist = DoesEntityExist
local GetEntityModel = GetEntityModel
local GetVehicleClass = GetVehicleClass
local Wait = Wait
local mathFloor = math.floor

local INFO_ID = 'sm_carmaintenance:prompt'

local PART_COUNT = #PartOrder

local HANDLING = {
    brakes = { 'fBrakeForce', 'fHandBrakeForce', 'fTractionCurveMax', 'fTractionCurveMin' },
    clutch = { 'fInitialDriveForce', 'fDriveInertia', 'fClutchChangeRateScaleUpShift', 'fClutchChangeRateScaleDownShift' },
    engine = { 'fInitialDriveMaxFlatVel' }
}

local active = {
    plate = nil,
    parts = nil,
    vehicle = nil,
    netId = nil
}

local pending = nil
local brakeDirty = false

local baseline = {}

local inspectAnim = false

---@param plate string?
---@return string
local function normalize(plate)
    return plate and plate:gsub('%s+', ''):upper() or ''
end

---@param vehicle integer
---@return boolean
local function isSupported(vehicle)
    return AllowedClasses[GetVehicleClass(vehicle)] == true
end

---@param vehicle integer
---@return string
local function plateOf(vehicle)
    return normalize(GetVehicleNumberPlateText(vehicle))
end

---@param vehicle integer
---@return string
local function vehicleName(vehicle)
    local model = GetEntityModel(vehicle)
    local data = qb_vehicles.hash(model)

    if data and data.name then
        return data.name
    end

    return GetDisplayNameFromVehicleModel(model)
end

local function resetLocals()
    for i = 1, PART_COUNT do
        local part = PartOrder[i]
        accum[part] = 0.0
        baseline[part] = nil
        applied[part] = nil
    end

    lastCoords = nil
end

local function flushBrake()
    if not brakeDirty or not active.parts then return end

    brakeDirty = false
    pending = pending or {}
    pending.brakes = active.parts.brakes
end

local function pushSync()
    if not active.plate or not active.parts or not pending then return end

    TriggerServerEvent('sm_carmaintenance:sync', active.plate, pending, active.netId)
    pending = nil
end

---@param vehicle integer
---@param part string
---@param health number
local function applyEffect(vehicle, part, health)
    local fields = HANDLING[part]
    local config = Parts[part]
    if not config then return end

    local threshold = config.threshold

    if part == 'body' then
        applied.body = health < threshold
        return
    end

    if not fields then return end

    if health >= threshold then
        if applied[part] then
            local backup = baseline[part]

            if backup then
                for i = 1, #fields do
                    local field = fields[i]
                    if backup[field] then
                        SetVehicleHandlingFloat(vehicle, 'CHandlingData', field, backup[field])
                    end
                end
            end

            if part == 'engine' then
                SetVehicleMaxSpeed(vehicle, 0.0)
            end

            applied[part] = nil
        end

        return
    end

    if not baseline[part] then
        local backup = {}

        for i = 1, #fields do
            local field = fields[i]
            backup[field] = GetVehicleHandlingFloat(vehicle, 'CHandlingData', field)
        end

        baseline[part] = backup
    end

    local ratio = health / threshold
    local base = PenaltyBase[part] or 0.0
    local scale = 1.0 - (base + (1.0 - ratio) * (Penalty[part] - base))

    if scale < 0.15 then scale = 0.15 end

    if applied[part] == scale then return end

    local backup = baseline[part]

    for i = 1, #fields do
        local field = fields[i]
        local base = backup[field]

        if base then
            local value

            if field == 'fDriveInertia' then
                value = base * (1.0 + (1.0 - scale) * 0.5)
            elseif field == 'fTractionCurveMax' or field == 'fTractionCurveMin' then
                value = base * (1.0 - (1.0 - scale) * 0.35)
            else
                value = base * scale
            end

            SetVehicleHandlingFloat(vehicle, 'CHandlingData', field, value)
        end
    end

    if part == 'engine' then
        local topSpeed = backup.fInitialDriveMaxFlatVel

        if topSpeed then
            SetVehicleMaxSpeed(vehicle, topSpeed * 0.75 * scale)
        end
    end

    applied[part] = scale
end

---@param vehicle integer
local function restoreAll(vehicle)
    if not DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then return end

    if powerApplied then
        SetVehicleMaxSpeed(vehicle, 0.0)
        powerApplied = false
    end

    for part, backup in pairs(baseline) do
        if applied[part] and backup then
            for field, value in pairs(backup) do
                SetVehicleHandlingFloat(vehicle, 'CHandlingData', field, value)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function startDriveThread()
    if driveThread then return end
    driveThread = true

    CreateThread(function()
        local effectTimer = 0
        local syncTimer = 0
        local lastBody = nil
        brakeDirty = false

        while active.vehicle and cache.seat == -1 do
            local vehicle = active.vehicle
            local parts = active.parts

            if not parts or not DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then
                break
            end

            local speed = GetEntitySpeed(vehicle)

            if speed > MinSpeedMs then
                local coords = GetEntityCoords(vehicle)

                if lastCoords then
                    local travelled = #(coords - lastCoords)

                    for i = 1, PART_COUNT do
                        local part = PartOrder[i]
                        local config = Parts[part]
                        local step = config.distance

                        if step > 0 then
                            local total = accum[part] + travelled

                            if total >= step then
                                local ticks = mathFloor(total / step)
                                total = total - ticks * step

                                local health = parts[part] - config.wear * ticks
                                if health < 0.0 then health = 0.0 end

                                parts[part] = health
                                pending = pending or {}
                                pending[part] = health
                            end

                            accum[part] = total
                        end
                    end
                end

                lastCoords = coords

                local brakeConfig = Parts.brakes
                local pressure = 0.0
                local wheels = GetVehicleNumberOfWheels(vehicle)

                for i = 0, wheels - 1 do
                    pressure = pressure + GetVehicleWheelBrakePressure(vehicle, i)
                end

                if pressure > 0.0 then
                    local health = parts.brakes - brakeConfig.wear * (pressure / (wheels > 0 and wheels or 1))
                    if health < 0.0 then health = 0.0 end

                    parts.brakes = health
                    brakeDirty = true
                end
            else
                lastCoords = nil
            end

            effectTimer = effectTimer + TickInterval

            if effectTimer >= EffectInterval then
                effectTimer = 0

                for i = 1, PART_COUNT do
                    local part = PartOrder[i]
                    applyEffect(vehicle, part, parts[part])
                end

                if applied.engine and baseline.engine then
                    local topSpeed = baseline.engine.fInitialDriveMaxFlatVel

                    if topSpeed then
                        SetVehicleMaxSpeed(vehicle, topSpeed * 0.75 * applied.engine)
                        powerApplied = true
                    end
                elseif powerApplied then
                    SetVehicleMaxSpeed(vehicle, 0.0)
                    powerApplied = false
                end

                if applied.body then
                    local body = GetVehicleBodyHealth(vehicle)

                    if lastBody and body < lastBody - BodyImpact then
                        local ratio = parts.body / Parts.body.threshold
                        local extra = (1.0 - ratio) * Penalty.body * (lastBody - body)

                        SetTimeout(250, function()
                            if not DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then return end

                            local engineHealth = GetVehicleEngineHealth(vehicle) - extra

                            if engineHealth < MinEngineHealth then
                                engineHealth = MinEngineHealth
                            end

                            SetVehicleEngineHealth(vehicle, engineHealth)
                        end)
                    end

                    lastBody = body
                else
                    lastBody = nil
                end
            end

            syncTimer = syncTimer + TickInterval

            if syncTimer >= SyncInterval then
                syncTimer = 0

                flushBrake()

                if pending then
                    pushSync()
                end
            end

            Wait(TickInterval)
        end

        driveThread = false

        flushBrake()

        if pending then
            pushSync()
        end
    end)
end

---@param vehicle integer
local function attach(vehicle)
    if not isSupported(vehicle) then return end

    local plate = plateOf(vehicle)
    if plate == '' then return end

    local netId = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(vehicle)
    local cached = Entity(vehicle).state.carParts
    local parts

    if cached then
        parts = {}

        for i = 1, PART_COUNT do
            local part = PartOrder[i]
            parts[part] = tonumber(cached[part]) or 100.0
        end
    else
        parts = lib.callback.await('sm_carmaintenance:load', false, plate, netId)
        if not parts then return end

        if cache.vehicle ~= vehicle or cache.seat ~= -1 then return end
    end

    active.plate = plate
    active.parts = parts
    active.vehicle = vehicle
    active.netId = netId

    resetLocals()
    startDriveThread()
end

local function detach()
    local vehicle = active.vehicle
    local plate = active.plate

    flushBrake()

    if plate and pending then
        TriggerServerEvent('sm_carmaintenance:release', plate, pending, active.netId)
        pending = nil
    end

    if vehicle then
        restoreAll(vehicle)
    end

    active.plate = nil
    active.parts = nil
    active.vehicle = nil
    active.netId = nil

    resetLocals()
end

lib.onCache('seat', function(seat)
    if seat == -1 and cache.vehicle then
        attach(cache.vehicle)
    else
        detach()
    end
end)

lib.onCache('vehicle', function(vehicle)
    if not vehicle then
        detach()
    end
end)

---@param vehicle integer
local function openDoors(vehicle)
    if not DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then return end

    inspected = vehicle

    for door = 0, 5 do
        SetVehicleDoorOpen(vehicle, door, false, false)
    end
end

local function closeDoors()
    local vehicle = inspected
    inspected = nil

    if not vehicle or not DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then return end

    for door = 0, 5 do
        SetVehicleDoorShut(vehicle, door, false)
    end
end

end

    inspectAnim = false

end

    if not frameMounted then
        frameReady = false
        frameMounted = true
        interface.show()

        interface.send({ action = 'setData', data = payload })
        interface.focus(true, true)
        pendingPayload = nil
    end
end

end)

interface.callback('repair', function(data, cb)
    if not data or not data.part or not viewPlate then
        return cb({ success = false })
    end

    local part = data.part
    local plate = viewPlate
    local netId = viewNetId
    local config = Parts[part]

    local ok, reason = lib.callback.await('sm_carmaintenance:canRepair', false, plate, part, netId)

    if not ok then
        lib.notify({ type = 'error', description = reason })
        return cb({ success = false })
    end

    cb({ success = true, closing = true })

    closeUI()

    local anim = config and config.anim or RepairAnim

    CreateThread(function()
        local done = lib.progressBar({
            duration = RepairDuration,
            label = ('Mengganti %s'):format(config and config.label or part),
            useWhileDead = false,
            canCancel = true,
            disable = {
                move = true,
                car = true,
                combat = true
            },
            anim = {
                dict = anim.dict,
                clip = anim.clip,
                flag = anim.flag or 1
            }
        })

        ClearPedTasks(cache.ped)

        if not done then
            return lib.notify({ type = 'error', description = 'Perbaikan dibatalkan' })
        end

        local success, message = lib.callback.await('sm_carmaintenance:repair', false, plate, part, netId)

        lib.notify({
            type = success and 'success' or 'error',
            description = message
        })
    end)
end)

---@param vehicle integer
---@param canRepair boolean
local function showStatus(vehicle, canRepair)
    if not isSupported(vehicle) then return end

    local plate = plateOf(vehicle)
    if plate == '' then return end

    local netId = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(vehicle)
    local parts = Entity(vehicle).state.carParts

    if not parts then
        parts = lib.callback.await('sm_carmaintenance:load', false, plate, netId)
        if not parts then return end
    end

    viewPlate = plate
    viewNetId = netId

    local list = {}

    for i = 1, PART_COUNT do
        local part = PartOrder[i]
        local config = Parts[part]

        list[i] = {
            name = part,
            label = config.label,
            health = parts[part],
            item = config.item,
            itemLabel = ox_items[config.item] and ox_items[config.item].label or config.label,
            owned = canRepair and (ox_inventory:Search('count', config.item) or 0) or 0,
            amount = config.amount,
            description = config.description,
            effect = config.effect,
            threshold = config.threshold
        }
    end

    if not cache.vehicle then
        openDoors(vehicle)
        startInspectAnim()

        CreateThread(function()
            while uiOpen and inspected == vehicle do
                if not DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then break end
                if #(GetEntityCoords(cache.ped) - GetEntityCoords(vehicle)) > InspectRange then break end

                Wait(500)
            end

            if uiOpen and inspected == vehicle then
                closeUI()
            end
        end)
    end

    local tune
    if GetResourceState('sm_resource_2') == 'started' then
        tune = lib.callback.await('sm_ecutuning:status', false, GetVehicleNumberPlateText(vehicle), netId)
        if type(tune) == 'table' then
            local ok, live = pcall(function() return exports.sm_ecutuning:getTuneStatus(vehicle) end)
            if ok and type(live) == 'table' then
                tune.pops, tune.flame, tune.mode = live.pops, live.flame, live.mode
            end
        else
            tune = nil
        end
    end

    openUI({
        plate = plate,
        vehicle = vehicleName(vehicle),
        canRepair = canRepair,
        parts = list,
        tune = tune
    })
end

exports('showVehicleStatus', showStatus)

AddStateBagChangeHandler('carParts', nil, function(bagName, _, value)
    if type(value) ~= 'table' then return end

    local netId = tonumber(bagName:match('entity:(%d+)'))
    if not netId then return end

    local entity = NetworkDoesEntityExistWithNetworkId(netId) and NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netId)
    if not entity or entity == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(entity) then return end

    local mine = active.parts ~= nil and active.netId == netId

    for i = 1, PART_COUNT do
        local part = PartOrder[i]
        local health = tonumber(value[part])

        if health then
            if mine and health > active.parts[part] then
                active.parts[part] = health
                accum[part] = 0.0
            end

            if mine or applied[part] ~= nil then
                applyEffect(entity, part, health)
            end
        end
    end
end)

        end
    end
end)

---@param zone ZoneConfig
---@return boolean
local function canRepairHere(zone)
    local job = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayerData().job
    if not job or not job.name then return false end
    if not Jobs[job.name] then return false end
    if job.name ~= zone.job then return false end
    if not job.onduty then return false end

    local grade = job.grade and job.grade.level or 0

    return grade >= zone.grade
end

local function hideZoneInfo()
    if not promptVisible then return end

    promptVisible = false
    infoUI.remove(INFO_ID)
end

---@param zone ZoneConfig
local function showZoneInfo(zone)
    if promptVisible then return end

    promptVisible = true

    infoUI.show({
        id = INFO_ID,
        title = 'Car Maintenance',
        icon = 'wrench',
        description = zone.label
    })
end

---@param vehicle integer
---@return boolean
local function repairTarget(vehicle)
    if not currentZone then return false end
    if not vehicle or not DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then return false end

    return canRepairHere(currentZone)
end

CreateThread(function()
    local zones = Config.Zones

    for i = 1, #zones do

        local areas = zone.areas

        for j = 1, #areas do

            lib.zones.poly({
                points = area.points,
                thickness = area.thickness,
                debug = false,
                onEnter = function()
                    currentZone = zone
                    showZoneInfo(zone)
                end,
                onExit = function()
                    if currentZone ~= zone then return end

                    currentZone = nil
                    hideZoneInfo()

                    if uiOpen then
                        closeUI()
                    end
                end
            })
        end
    end
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\interface\sm_carmaintenance\config.lua
---@class PartConfig
---@field name string
---@field label string
---@field item string
---@field amount integer jumlah item per perbaikan
---@field distance number jarak (meter) untuk satu tick keausan
---@field wear number pengurangan persen tiap tick
---@field threshold number batas persen sebelum efek negatif aktif
---@field order integer urutan tampil di UI
---@field anim { dict: string, clip: string, flag: integer? }? animasi saat ganti part, kosong = config.RepairAnim

---@class ZoneArea
---@field coords vector3 titik pusat untuk validasi jarak di server
---@field thickness number tinggi area poly
---@field points vector3[] titik sudut area

---@class ZoneConfig
---@field job string
---@field label string
---@field grade integer grade minimum untuk memperbaiki
---@field areas ZoneArea[] satu bengkel bisa punya beberapa area terpisah

local config = {}

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\interface\sm_crafting\client.lua
if not interface.init(false) then
    return
end

local Config = localmodule 'config'
local Catalog = localmodule 'modules.catalog'

local Tables = Catalog.tables
local canUseTable = Catalog.canUseTable

local DefaultIcon = Config.defaultIcon
local TargetDistance = Config.targetDistance
local ZoneSize = Config.zoneSize

local IsPedArmed = IsPedArmed
local CreateObject = CreateObject
local SetEntityHeading = SetEntityHeading
local PlaceObjectOnGroundProperly = PlaceObjectOnGroundProperly
local FreezeEntityPosition = FreezeEntityPosition
local SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded = SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded
local DoesEntityExist = DoesEntityExist
local DeleteEntity = DeleteEntity
local pairs = pairs
local type = type
local sgsub = string.gsub
local GetCloudTimeAsInt = GetCloudTimeAsInt

local EMPTY = {}

local frameMounted = false
local frameReady = false
local uiOpen = false
local busy = false
local pendingPayload = nil
local currentTable = nil
local entities = {}

---@param message string
---@param kind? string
local function notify(message, kind)
    lib.notify({ description = message, type = kind or 'error' })
end

---@param metadata table?
---@param now integer
---@return boolean
local function isFresh(metadata, now)
    local durability = metadata and metadata.durability
    if type(durability) ~= 'number' then return true end
    if durability > 100 then return durability > now end
    return durability > 0
end

---@param name string
---@return string?
local function itemImage(name)
    local item = ox_items and ox_items[name]
    local image = item and item.client and item.client.image
    if type(image) ~= 'string' then return nil end
    return (sgsub(image, '^nui://', 'https://cfx-nui-'))
end

---@param name string
---@param now integer
---@return { label: string?, image: string?, count: integer }[] entries
---@return integer total
local function freshStock(name, now)
    local slots = ox_inventory:Search('slots', name) or EMPTY
    local sorted = {}

    for _, slot in pairs(slots) do
        if isFresh(slot.metadata, now) then sorted[#sorted + 1] = slot end
    end

    table.sort(sorted, function(a, b) return a.slot < b.slot end)

    local entries, total = {}, 0

    for i = 1, #sorted do
        local slot = sorted[i]
        local metadata = slot.metadata or EMPTY
        entries[i] = { label = metadata.label, image = metadata.imageurl, count = slot.count }
        total += slot.count
    end

    return entries, total
end

---@param menu table
local function attachInventory(menu)
    local recipes = menu.recipes
    local owned, stock, images = {}, {}, {}
    local now = GetCloudTimeAsInt()

    for i = 1, #recipes do
        local recipe = recipes[i]
        local outputs, materials = recipe.outputs, recipe.materials

        for j = 1, #outputs do
            local name = outputs[j].name
            images[name] = images[name] or itemImage(name)
        end

        for j = 1, #materials do
            local name = materials[j].name
            images[name] = images[name] or itemImage(name)

            if owned[name] == nil then
                if recipe.package then
                    stock[name], owned[name] = freshStock(name, now)
                else
                    owned[name] = ox_inventory:GetItemCount(name) or 0
                end
            end
        end
    end

    menu.owned = owned
    menu.stock = stock
    menu.images = images
end

local function closeUI()
    if not uiOpen then return end

    uiOpen = false
    pendingPayload = nil
    interface.focus(false, false)

    SetTimeout(50, function()
        if uiOpen or not frameMounted then return end

        frameMounted = false
        frameReady = false
        interface.hide()
    end)
end

---@param payload table
local function openUI(payload)
    pendingPayload = payload
    uiOpen = true

    if not frameMounted then
        frameReady = false
        frameMounted = true
        interface.show()
    elseif frameReady then
        interface.send({ action = 'open', data = payload })
        interface.focus(true, true)
        pendingPayload = nil
    end
end

---@param tableName string
local function openCrafting(tableName)
    if uiOpen or busy then return end

    if IsPedArmed(cache.ped, 7) then
        return notify('Simpan senjata dulu sebelum crafting.')
    end

    local menu = lib.callback.await('sm_crafting:getMenu', false, tableName)
    if not menu then return end

    attachInventory(menu)
    currentTable = tableName
    openUI(menu)
end

---@param tableName string
---@param recipeKey string
---@param amount integer
local function craft(tableName, recipeKey, amount)
    if busy then return end

    local job = lib.callback.await('sm_crafting:startCraft', false, tableName, recipeKey, amount)
    if not job then return end

    busy = true

    local finished = lib.progressCircle({
        duration = job.duration,
        label = ('Membuat %s'):format(job.label),
        position = 'bottom',
        useWhileDead = false,
        canCancel = true,
        disable = { move = true, car = true, combat = true, sprint = true },
        anim = { dict = job.anim.dict, clip = job.anim.anim, flag = 1 },
    })

    busy = false

    if finished then
        TriggerTokenEvent('sm_crafting:finishCraft')
    else
        TriggerServerEvent('sm_crafting:cancelCraft')
        notify('Crafting dibatalkan.')
    end
end

interface.callback('ready', function(_, cb)
    frameReady = true

    if pendingPayload then
        interface.send({ action = 'open', data = pendingPayload })
        interface.focus(true, true)
        pendingPayload = nil
    end

    cb('ok')
end)

interface.callback('exit', function(_, cb)
    cb('ok')
    closeUI()
end)

interface.callback('craft', function(data, cb)
    cb('ok')

    local tableName = currentTable
    closeUI()

    if not tableName or type(data) ~= 'table' or type(data.recipe) ~= 'string' then return end

    CreateThread(function()
        craft(tableName, data.recipe, data.amount)
    end)
end)

interface.callback('saveCustom', function(data, cb)
    if not currentTable or type(data) ~= 'table' then
        return cb({ success = false, message = 'Data tidak valid.' })
    end

    cb(lib.callback.await('sm_crafting:saveCustom', false, currentTable, data.recipe, data.label, data.image))
end)

interface.callback('resetCustom', function(data, cb)
    if not currentTable or type(data) ~= 'table' then
        return cb({ success = false, message = 'Data tidak valid.' })
    end

    cb(lib.callback.await('sm_crafting:resetCustom', false, currentTable, data.recipe))
end)

exports('openPackage', function(_, slot)
    if type(slot) ~= 'table' or type(slot.slot) ~= 'number' then return end
    TriggerTokenEvent('sm_crafting:openPackage', slot.slot)
end)

---@param name string
---@param bench CraftingTable
---@return table[]
local function targetOptions(name, bench)
    return {
        {
            name = 'sm_crafting:' .. name,
            label = bench.title,
            icon = bench.icon or DefaultIcon,
            distance = TargetDistance,
            canInteract = function()
                return not busy and canUseTable(bench, QBPlayerData.job)
            end,
            onSelect = function()
                openCrafting(name)
            end,
        },
    }
end

---@param name string
---@param bench CraftingTable
local function createBench(name, bench)
    local options = targetOptions(name, bench)
    local locations = bench.locations
    local spawns = bench.spawnTable

    if locations then
        for i = 1, #locations do
            ox_target:addBoxZone({ coords = locations[i], size = ZoneSize, options = options })
        end
    end

    if spawns then
        for i = 1, #spawns do
            local spawn = spawns[i]
            local coords = spawn.coords
            local loaded, model = pcall(lib.requestModel, spawn.prop)

            if loaded and model then
                local entity = CreateObject(model, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, true)
                SetEntityHeading(entity, coords.w)

                if not spawn.skipPlaceObjectOnGroundProperly then
                    PlaceObjectOnGroundProperly(entity)
                end

                FreezeEntityPosition(entity, true)
                SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
                entities[#entities + 1] = entity
                ox_target:addLocalEntity(entity, options)
            end
        end
    end
end

CreateThread(function()
    for name, bench in pairs(Tables) do
        createBench(name, bench)
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource then return end

    if uiOpen then
        SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    end

    for i = 1, #entities do
        local entity = entities[i]
        if DoesEntityExist(entity) then DeleteEntity(entity) end
    end
end)


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\interface\sm_crafting\config.lua
---@class CraftingAnimation
---@field dict string
---@field anim string

---@class CraftingSpawnTable
---@field coords vector4
---@field prop string
---@field skipPlaceObjectOnGroundProperly? boolean

---@class CraftingTable
---@field title string
---@field icon? string
---@field animation? CraftingAnimation
---@field jobs? table<string, integer|integer[]> job => grade minimal, atau daftar grade
---@field publicAccess? boolean semua pemain boleh pakai
---@field locations? vector3[] titik ox_target box zone
---@field spawnTable? CraftingSpawnTable[] prop yang di-spawn lalu di-target

---@class CraftingRecipe
---@field label? string default = label item hasil
---@field category string
---@field toItems table<string, integer|integer[]> item => jumlah, atau { min, max }
---@field toItemsMeta? table<string, table> metadata tetap per item hasil
---@field materials table<string, integer>
---@field craftingTime? integer ms per batch
---@field maxCraft? integer batch maksimal sekali craft
---@field tables string[]
---@field jobs? table<string, integer|integer[]>
---@field package? boolean resep paket: waktu sekali per batch, bahan basi ditolak, isi + label kustom disimpan di box dan keluar lagi saat dibuka
---@field key string diisi otomatis
---@field output? string diisi otomatis, item hasil kalau cuma satu

---@class CraftingCustomMenu
---@field editors table<string, integer[]> job => grade yang boleh ganti nama & gambar menu
---@field labelLength { min: integer, max: integer }
---@field imageHosts string[] host https yang diizinkan untuk gambar menu
---@field imageExtensions string[]
---@field saveCooldown integer ms jeda antar simpan per pemain

---@class CraftingConfig
---@field data string[] nama file di folder data/, satu file per job atau kategori
---@field defaultCraftingTime integer
---@field defaultMaxCraft integer
---@field defaultIcon string
---@field defaultAnimation CraftingAnimation
---@field targetDistance number
---@field zoneSize vector3
---@field interactDistance number jarak maksimal pemain ke meja, dicek server
---@field timeTolerance integer ms toleransi lag saat server cek durasi crafting
---@field customMenu CraftingCustomMenu

---@type CraftingConfig
