local hudEnabled = interface.init(false)
local hudMounted = false
local hudReady = false
local hudPending
local soundCount = 0

local flight
---@type number|false
local launching = false

local boostKey, detonateKey, visionKey

---@param payload table
local function hudSend(payload)
    if hudReady then
        interface.send(payload)
    end
end

local function mountFrame()
    if hudMounted or not hudEnabled then return end
    hudMounted = true
    hudReady = false
    interface.show()
end

local function unmountFrame()
    if not hudMounted or hudPending or soundCount > 0 then return end
    hudMounted = false
    hudReady = false
    interface.hide()
end

---@param payload table
local function hudOpen(payload)
    hudPending = payload
    if hudMounted then
        return hudSend(payload)
    end
    mountFrame()
end

local function hudClose()
    hudPending = nil
    hudSend({ action = 'close' })
    unmountFrame()
end

if hudEnabled then
    interface.callback('ready', function(_, cb)
        hudReady = true
        if hudPending then
            interface.send(hudPending)
        end
        cb('ok')
    end)
end

---@return boolean
local function isIncapacitated()
    local metadata = QBPlayerData.metadata
    return metadata ~= nil and (metadata.isdead or metadata.inlaststand) == true
end

---@param pitch number
---@param yaw number
---@return vector3
local function direction(pitch, yaw)
    local p, y = mathRad(pitch), mathRad(yaw)
    local cp = mathCos(p)
    return vec3(-mathSin(y) * cp, mathCos(y) * cp, mathSin(p))
end

---@param value number
---@param low number
---@param high number
---@return number
local function clamp(value, low, high)
    return value < low and low or (value > high and high or value)
end

local function startTablet()
    local ped = cache.ped
    lib.requestAnimDict(tabletCfg.dict)
    lib.requestModel(tabletCfg.prop)

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local prop = CreateObject(tabletCfg.prop, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z + 0.2, true, true, false)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(tabletCfg.prop)

    local offset, rotation = tabletCfg.offset, tabletCfg.rotation
    AttachEntityToEntity(prop, ped, GetPedBoneIndex(ped, tabletCfg.bone), offset.x, offset.y, offset.z, rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z, true, true, false, true, 1, true)
    TaskPlayAnim(ped, tabletCfg.dict, tabletCfg.clip, 3.0, 3.0, -1, 49, 0, false, false, false)

    LocalPlayer.state:set('invBusy', true, false)
    ox_target:disableTargeting(true)

    return prop
end

local gameHudHidden = false

---@param hidden boolean
local function setGameHudHidden(hidden)
    if gameHudHidden == hidden then return end
    gameHudHidden = hidden
    LocalPlayer.state:set(HUD_HIDE_KEY, hidden or nil, false)
    TriggerEvent('sm_hud:client:setVisible', not hidden)
end

---@param prop number?
local function stopTablet(prop)
    local ped = cache.ped
    StopAnimTask(ped, tabletCfg.dict, tabletCfg.clip, 2.0)
    RemoveAnimDict(tabletCfg.dict)
    if prop and DoesEntityExist(prop) then
        DeleteEntity(prop)
    end
    LocalPlayer.state:set('invBusy', false, false)
    ox_target:disableTargeting(false)
    setGameHudHidden(false)
end

---@param state table
local function applyVision(state)
    local mode = state.vision
    SetNightvision(mode == 2)
    SetSeethrough(mode == 3)
end

local KEY_NAMES = { CAPITAL = 'CAPS LOCK', ['1012'] = 'CAPS LOCK' }

---@param bind table
---@param fallback string
---@return string
local function keyLabel(bind, fallback)
    local key = bind:getCurrentKey()
    if not key or key == '' then
        key = fallback
    end
    return KEY_NAMES[key] or (key:match('^%d+$') and (KEY_NAMES[fallback] or fallback)) or key
end

---@param enabled boolean
local function setKeybindsEnabled(enabled)
    boostKey:disable(not enabled)
    detonateKey:disable(not enabled)
    visionKey:disable(not enabled)
end

---@param entity number
---@param list table
---@return table
local function startParticles(entity, list)
    local handles = {}
    for i = 1, #list do
        local fx = list[i]
        if pcall(lib.requestNamedPtfxAsset, fx.asset) then
            UseParticleFxAssetNextCall(fx.asset)
            local offset, rotation = fx.offset, fx.rotation
            local handle = StartParticleFxLoopedOnEntity(fx.name, entity, offset.x, offset.y, offset.z, rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z, fx.scale, false, false, false)
            if fx.alpha then
                SetParticleFxLoopedAlpha(handle, fx.alpha)
            end
            handles[#handles + 1] = handle
        end
    end
    return handles
end

---@param handles table?
local function stopParticles(handles)
    if not handles then return end
    for i = 1, #handles do
        RemoveParticleFx(handles[i], false)
    end
end

---@param entity number
---@return table
local function createTrail(entity)
    return { fx = startParticles(entity, particles), smoke = nil, boosting = false }
end

---@param trail table
local function clearTrail(trail)
    stopParticles(trail.fx)
    stopParticles(trail.smoke)
    trail.fx = nil
    trail.smoke = nil
end

---@param entity number
---@param trail table
---@param boosting boolean
local function setBoostVisual(entity, trail, boosting)
    if trail.boosting == boosting then return end
    trail.boosting = boosting

    local handles = trail.fx
    if handles then
        local multiplier = boosting and BOOST_FLAME_SCALE or 1.0
        for i = 1, #handles do
            local fx = particles[i]
            if fx then
                SetParticleFxLoopedScale(handles[i], fx.scale * multiplier)
            end
        end
    end

    if boosting then
        trail.smoke = startParticles(entity, boostParticles)
    else
        stopParticles(trail.smoke)
        trail.smoke = nil
    end
end

---@param state table
---@param reason string
local function endFlight(state, reason)
    if state.ended then return end
    state.ended = true
    flight = nil
    setKeybindsEnabled(false)

    local missile = state.missile
    local cam = state.cam
    local camCoords = GetCamCoord(cam)
    local camRot = GetCamRot(cam, 2)
    DetachCam(cam)
    SetCamCoord(cam, camCoords.x, camCoords.y, camCoords.z)
    SetCamRot(cam, camRot.x, camRot.y, camRot.z, 2)

    local hit = state.hitCoords or (DoesEntityExist(missile) and GetEntityCoords(missile))
    if hit then
        SetFocusPosAndVel(hit.x, hit.y, hit.z, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
        AddOwnedExplosion(cache.ped, hit.x, hit.y, hit.z, missileCfg.explosionType, missileCfg.damageScale, true, false, missileCfg.cameraShake)
    end

    clearTrail(state.trail)
    if DoesEntityExist(missile) then
        DeleteEntity(missile)
    end

    TriggerServerEvent('sm_mwmissile:server:finish', state.token)
    hudSend({ action = 'lost', data = { reason = reason } })

    if reason == 'range' or reason == 'operator' or reason == 'timeout' then
        lib.notify({ description = text.signalLost, type = 'error' })
    end

    CreateThread(function()
        local releaseAt = GetGameTimer() + LOST_SCREEN_TIME
        while GetGameTimer() < releaseAt do
            DisableAllControlActions(0)
            EnableControlAction(0, 249, true)
            HideHudAndRadarThisFrame()
            Wait(0)
        end
        SetNightvision(false)
        SetSeethrough(false)
        ClearTimecycleModifier()
        RenderScriptCams(false, false, 0, true, true)
        DestroyCam(cam, false)
        ClearFocus()
        stopTablet(state.tablet)
        hudClose()
        launching = false
    end)
end

---@param state table
local function flightLoop(state)
    local missile = state.missile
    local cam = state.cam
    local origin = state.origin
    local ped = cache.ped
    local pitch, yaw, roll = state.pitch, state.yaw, 0.0
    local speed = CRUISE_SPEED
    local fuel = MAX_FUEL
    local position = GetEntityCoords(missile)
    local launchedAt = GetGameTimer()
    local nextHud = 0
    local nextGuard = 0
    local lastFuzz = -1.0
    local boostSynced = false
    local nextBoostSync = 0
    local missileState = Entity(missile).state
    local trail = state.trail

    SetTimecycleModifier(FUZZ_MODIFIER)
    SetTimecycleModifierStrength(BASE_FUZZ)

    while not state.ended do
        local dt = GetFrameTime()
        local now = GetGameTimer()

        DisableAllControlActions(0)
        EnableControlAction(0, 249, true)
        HideHudAndRadarThisFrame()

        local maxTurn = TURN_RATE * dt
        local yawInput = -GetDisabledControlNormal(0, 1) * MOUSE_SENSITIVITY
        local pitchInput = -GetDisabledControlNormal(0, 2) * MOUSE_SENSITIVITY

        if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 34) then yawInput = yawInput + maxTurn end
        if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 35) then yawInput = yawInput - maxTurn end
        if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 32) then pitchInput = pitchInput - maxTurn end
        if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 33) then pitchInput = pitchInput + maxTurn end

        local yawStep = clamp(yawInput, -maxTurn, maxTurn)
        yaw = (yaw + yawStep) % 360.0
        pitch = clamp(pitch + clamp(pitchInput, -maxTurn, maxTurn), MIN_PITCH, MAX_PITCH)

        local rollTarget = maxTurn > 0 and -(yawStep / maxTurn) * MAX_ROLL or 0.0
        roll = roll + (rollTarget - roll) * mathMin(1.0, dt * 4.0)

        local boosting = state.boosting and fuel > 0.0
        if boosting then
            fuel = mathMax(0.0, fuel - BOOST_CONSUMPTION * dt)
        end

        if boosting ~= trail.boosting then
            setBoostVisual(missile, trail, boosting)
        end

        if boosting ~= boostSynced and now >= nextBoostSync then
            boostSynced = boosting
            nextBoostSync = now + BOOST_SYNC_INTERVAL
            missileState:set(BOOST_KEY, boosting, true)
        end

        local targetSpeed = boosting and BOOST_SPEED or CRUISE_SPEED
        if speed < targetSpeed then
            speed = mathMin(targetSpeed, speed + ACCELERATION * dt)
        elseif speed > targetSpeed then
            speed = mathMax(targetSpeed, speed - ACCELERATION * dt)
        end

        local dir = direction(pitch, yaw)
        local velocity = dir * speed
        local nextPos = position + velocity * dt
        local probeEnd = nextPos + dir * 1.5

        local probe = StartExpensiveSynchronousShapeTestLosProbe(position.x, position.y, position.z, probeEnd.x, probeEnd.y, probeEnd.z, RAY_FLAGS, missile, 7)
        local _, hit, hitCoords = GetShapeTestResult(probe)

        if hit == 1 or hit == true then
            state.hitCoords = hitCoords
            return endFlight(state, 'impact')
        end

        local inWater, waterCoords = TestProbeAgainstWater(position.x, position.y, position.z, probeEnd.x, probeEnd.y, probeEnd.z)
        if inWater then
            state.hitCoords = waterCoords
            return endFlight(state, 'impact')
        end

        position = nextPos
        SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(missile, position.x, position.y, position.z, false, false, false)
        SetEntityRotation(missile, pitch, 0.0, yaw, 2, true)
        SetEntityVelocity(missile, velocity.x, velocity.y, velocity.z)
        SetCamRot(cam, pitch, roll, yaw, 2)

        if state.detonate then
            if now - launchedAt >= ARM_DELAY then
                return endFlight(state, 'detonate')
            end
            state.detonate = false
        end

        local distance = #(position - origin)

        if distance >= MAX_DISTANCE then
            return endFlight(state, 'range')
        end

        if now - launchedAt >= MAX_FLIGHT_MS then
            return endFlight(state, 'fuel')
        end

        local signal = distance <= WEAK_DISTANCE and 1.0 or 1.0 - (distance - WEAK_DISTANCE) / SIGNAL_RANGE

        if now >= nextGuard then
            nextGuard = now + GUARD_INTERVAL

            if not DoesEntityExist(missile) then
                return endFlight(state, 'impact')
            end

            if IsPedDeadOrDying(ped, true) or IsPedRagdoll(ped) or IsPedInAnyVehicle(ped, false) or isIncapacitated() then
                return endFlight(state, 'operator')
            end

            if not IsEntityPlayingAnim(ped, tabletCfg.dict, tabletCfg.clip, 3) then
                TaskPlayAnim(ped, tabletCfg.dict, tabletCfg.clip, 3.0, 3.0, -1, 49, 0, false, false, false)
            end

            local fuzz = BASE_FUZZ + (1.0 - signal) * 0.85
            if fuzz - lastFuzz > 0.02 or lastFuzz - fuzz > 0.02 then
                lastFuzz = fuzz
                SetTimecycleModifierStrength(fuzz)
            end
        end

        if now >= nextHud then
            nextHud = now + HUD_INTERVAL
            local hud = state.hud
            hud.speed = mathFloor(speed * 3.6)
            hud.heading = mathFloor((360.0 - yaw) % 360.0)
            hud.altitude = mathFloor(GetEntityHeightAboveGround(missile))
            hud.distance = mathFloor(distance)
            hud.signal = mathFloor(signal * 100)
            hud.fuel = mathFloor(fuel / MAX_FUEL * 100)
            hud.boosting = boosting
            hud.vision = VISION_LABELS[state.vision]
            hud.timeLeft = mathMax(0, mathFloor((MAX_FLIGHT_MS - (now - launchedAt)) / 1000))
            hud.x = mathFloor(position.x)
            hud.y = mathFloor(position.y)
            hudSend(state.hudMessage)
        end

        Wait(0)
    end
end

---@param origin vector3
---@param yaw number
---@return number?
---@return number?
local function spawnMissile(origin, yaw)
    local dir = direction(0.0, yaw)
    local spawn = origin + dir * missileCfg.spawnForward + vec3(0.0, 0.0, missileCfg.spawnHeight)

    lib.requestModel(MISSILE_MODEL)
    SetFocusPosAndVel(spawn.x, spawn.y, spawn.z, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)

    local missile = CreateObjectNoOffset(MISSILE_MODEL, spawn.x, spawn.y, spawn.z, true, true, false)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(MISSILE_MODEL)
    if not missile or missile == 0 then return nil end

    local networked = pcall(lib.waitFor, function()
        return NetworkGetEntityIsNetworked(missile) and NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(missile) ~= 0 or nil
    end, nil, 3000)

    if not networked then
        DeleteEntity(missile)
        return nil
    end

    SetEntityAsMissionEntity(missile, true, true)
    SetEntityInvincible(missile, true)
    SetEntityCollision(missile, false, true)
    SetEntityHasGravity(missile, false)
    SetEntityLodDist(missile, LOD_DISTANCE)
    SetEntityRotation(missile, missileCfg.startPitch, 0.0, yaw, 2, true)

    local netId = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(missile)
    SetNetworkIdCanMigrate(netId, false)
    NetworkUseHighPrecisionBlending(netId, true)

    return missile, netId
end

---@param token number
---@param prop number|false
---@param message string?
local function abortLaunch(token, prop, message)
    TriggerServerEvent('sm_mwmissile:server:finish', token)
    if prop ~= false then
        stopTablet(prop)
    end
    ClearFocus()
    launching = false
    if message then
        lib.notify({ description = message, type = 'error' })
    end
end

---@param token number
local function launch(token)
    local ped = cache.ped

    if IsPedInAnyVehicle(ped, false) then
        return abortLaunch(token, false, text.inVehicle)
    end

    if IsPedDeadOrDying(ped, true) or isIncapacitated() then
        return abortLaunch(token, false, text.isDead)
    end

    if IsPedSwimming(ped) or IsEntityInWater(ped) then
        return abortLaunch(token, false, text.inWater)
    end

    local prop = startTablet()

    local connected = lib.progressCircle({
        duration = config.connectDuration,
        label = text.connecting,
        position = 'bottom',
        canCancel = true,
        disable = { move = true, car = true, combat = true },
    })

    if not connected or launching ~= token then
        return abortLaunch(token, prop, text.cancelled)
    end

    local origin = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local yaw = GetEntityHeading(ped)
    local missile, netId = spawnMissile(origin, yaw)

    if not missile then
        lib.print.warn('[sm_mwmissile] objek missile gagal dibuat / tidak ter-network dalam 3 detik')
        return abortLaunch(token, prop, text.failed)
    end

    if not lib.callback.await('sm_mwmissile:register', false, token, netId) then
        if DoesEntityExist(missile) then DeleteEntity(missile) end
        return abortLaunch(token, prop, text.failed)
    end

    local cam = CreateCam('DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA', true)
    AttachCamToEntity(cam, missile, CAM_OFFSET.x, CAM_OFFSET.y, CAM_OFFSET.z, true)
    SetCamFov(cam, missileCfg.camFov)
    SetCamRot(cam, missileCfg.startPitch, 0.0, yaw, 2)
    SetCamActive(cam, true)
    RenderScriptCams(true, false, 0, true, true)
    SetFocusEntity(missile)
    setGameHudHidden(true)

    local hud = {}
    local state = {
        token = token,
        missile = missile,
        cam = cam,
        tablet = prop,
        origin = origin,
        pitch = missileCfg.startPitch,
        yaw = yaw,
        vision = 1,
        boosting = false,
        detonate = false,
        ended = false,
        trail = createTrail(missile),
        hud = hud,
        hudMessage = { action = 'update', data = hud },
    }

    flight = state
    setKeybindsEnabled(true)

    hudOpen({
        action = 'open',
        data = {
            label = missileCfg.label,
            maxDistance = MAX_DISTANCE,
            soundVolume = config.launchSound.enabled and config.launchSound.volume or 0,
            keys = {
                { key = keyLabel(detonateKey, keys.detonate), label = 'Detonate' },
                { key = keyLabel(boostKey, keys.boost), label = 'Boost' },
                { key = keyLabel(visionKey, keys.vision), label = 'Switch Vision' },
            },
        },
    })

    flightLoop(state)
end

boostKey = lib.addKeybind({
    name = 'sm_mwmissile_boost',
    description = 'Missile: boost',
    defaultKey = keys.boost,
    disabled = true,
    onPressed = function()
        if flight then flight.boosting = true end
    end,
    onReleased = function()
        if flight then flight.boosting = false end
    end,
})

detonateKey = lib.addKeybind({
    name = 'sm_mwmissile_detonate',
    description = 'Missile: detonate',
    defaultKey = keys.detonate,
    disabled = true,
    onPressed = function()
        if flight then flight.detonate = true end
    end,
})

visionKey = lib.addKeybind({
    name = 'sm_mwmissile_vision',
    description = 'Missile: switch vision',
    defaultKey = keys.vision,
    disabled = true,
    onPressed = function()
        local state = flight
        if not state then return end
        state.vision = state.vision % #VISION_LABELS + 1
        applyVision(state)
    end,
})

RegisterNetEvent('sm_mwmissile:client:start', function(token)
    if launching then
        return TriggerServerEvent('sm_mwmissile:server:finish', token)
    end
    launching = token
    launch(token)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_mwmissile:client:abort', function(token)
    local state = flight
    if state and state.token == token then
        endFlight(state, 'timeout')
    elseif launching == token then
        launching = false
    end
end)

local activeIds = {}
local startTimes = {}
local remotes = {}
local remoteWatcher = false
local soundMessage = { action = 'sound', data = { id = 0, volume = 0.0, offset = 0 } }
local soundData = soundMessage.data

---@param netId number
---@param volume number
local function sendSound(netId, volume)
    soundData.id = netId
    soundData.volume = volume
    soundData.offset = GetCloudTimeAsInt() - (startTimes[netId] or GetCloudTimeAsInt())
    hudSend(soundMessage)
end

---@param remote table
local function stopRemoteSound(remote)
    if not remote.soundOn then return end
    remote.soundOn = false
    soundCount = soundCount - 1
    hudSend({ action = 'soundStop', data = { id = remote.netId } })
    unmountFrame()
end

---@param remote table
---@param now number
local function updateRemoteSound(remote, now)
    if now < remote.nextSound then return end
    remote.nextSound = now + SOUND_UPDATE_MS

    local listener = GetFinalRenderedCamCoord()
    local distance = #(remote.pos - listener)

    if distance >= SOUND_DISTANCE then
        return stopRemoteSound(remote)
    end

    local falloff = 1.0 - distance / SOUND_DISTANCE
    local volume = SOUND_VOLUME * falloff * falloff

    if not remote.soundOn then
        remote.soundOn = true
        soundCount = soundCount + 1
        mountFrame()
    end

    sendSound(remote.netId, volume)
end

---@param netId number
---@param entity number
---@return table
local function createRemote(netId, entity)
    lib.requestModel(MISSILE_MODEL)
    local pos = GetEntityCoords(entity)
    local rot = GetEntityRotation(entity, 2)
    local clone = CreateObjectNoOffset(MISSILE_MODEL, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, false, false, false)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(MISSILE_MODEL)
    SetEntityCollision(clone, false, false)
    FreezeEntityPosition(clone, true)
    SetEntityLodDist(clone, LOD_DISTANCE)
    SetEntityRotation(clone, rot.x, rot.y, rot.z, 2, false)

    return {
        netId = netId,
        entity = entity,
        clone = clone,
        trail = createTrail(clone),
        pos = pos,
        lastPos = pos,
        lastChange = GetGameTimer(),
        vel = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
        nextBoostPoll = 0,
        nextSound = 0,
        soundOn = false,
    }
end

---@param netId number
local function destroyRemote(netId)
    local remote = remotes[netId]
    if not remote then return end
    remotes[netId] = nil
    stopRemoteSound(remote)
    clearTrail(remote.trail)
    if DoesEntityExist(remote.clone) then
        DeleteEntity(remote.clone)
    end
end

---@param remote table
---@param now number
---@param dt number
local function updateRemote(remote, now, dt)
    local entity = remote.entity
    local netPos = GetEntityCoords(entity)
    local moved = netPos - remote.lastPos

    if moved.x ~= 0.0 or moved.y ~= 0.0 or moved.z ~= 0.0 then
        local elapsed = (now - remote.lastChange) * 0.001
        if elapsed >= 0.03 then
            remote.vel = remote.vel + (moved / elapsed - remote.vel) * 0.5
            remote.lastPos = netPos
            remote.lastChange = now
        end
    end

    local syncedVel = GetEntityVelocity(entity)
    local vel = (syncedVel.x * syncedVel.x + syncedVel.y * syncedVel.y + syncedVel.z * syncedVel.z) > 1.0 and syncedVel or remote.vel

    local pos = remote.pos + vel * dt
    local drift = netPos - pos
    if (drift.x * drift.x + drift.y * drift.y + drift.z * drift.z) > SNAP_DISTANCE_SQ then
        pos = netPos
    else
        pos = pos + drift * mathMin(1.0, dt * CORRECTION_RATE)
    end
    remote.pos = pos

    local clone = remote.clone
    SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(clone, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, false, false, false)
    local rot = GetEntityRotation(entity, 2)
    SetEntityRotation(clone, rot.x, rot.y, rot.z, 2, false)
    SetEntityLocallyInvisible(entity)

    if now >= remote.nextBoostPoll then
        remote.nextBoostPoll = now + BOOST_POLL_MS
        setBoostVisual(clone, remote.trail, Entity(entity).state[BOOST_KEY] == true)
    end

    if SOUND_ENABLED then
        updateRemoteSound(remote, now)
    end
end

local function remoteLoop()
    local myId = cache.playerId

    while #activeIds > 0 do
        local list = activeIds
        local now = GetGameTimer()
        local dt = GetFrameTime()
        local visible = false

        for i = 1, #list do
            local netId = list[i]
            local remote = remotes[netId]
            local entity = NetworkDoesNetworkIdExist(netId) and NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netId) or 0

            if entity ~= 0 and DoesEntityExist(entity) and NetworkGetEntityOwner(entity) ~= myId then
                if remote and remote.entity ~= entity then
                    destroyRemote(netId)
                    remote = nil
                end
                if not remote then
                    remote = createRemote(netId, entity)
                    remotes[netId] = remote
                    now = GetGameTimer()
                end
                updateRemote(remote, now, dt)
                visible = true
            elseif remote then
                destroyRemote(netId)
            end
        end

        Wait(visible and 0 or REMOTE_IDLE_MS)
    end

    for netId in pairs(remotes) do
        destroyRemote(netId)
    end
    remoteWatcher = false
end

---@param value any
local function syncActive(value)
    local entries = type(value) == 'table' and value or {}
    local list = {}
    table.wipe(startTimes)

    for i = 1, #entries do
        local entry = entries[i]
        if type(entry) == 'table' and entry.id then
            list[#list + 1] = entry.id
            startTimes[entry.id] = entry.t
        end
    end

    activeIds = list

    for netId in pairs(remotes) do
        if not startTimes[netId] then
            destroyRemote(netId)
        end
    end

    if #list > 0 and not remoteWatcher then
        remoteWatcher = true
        CreateThread(remoteLoop)
    end
end

AddStateBagChangeHandler(ACTIVE_KEY, 'global', function(_, _, value)
    syncActive(value)
end)

CreateThread(function()
    syncActive(GlobalState[ACTIVE_KEY])
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource then return end

    for netId in pairs(remotes) do
        destroyRemote(netId)
    end

    local state = flight
    if not state then return end

    state.ended = true
    if state.trail then
        clearTrail(state.trail)
    end
    if DoesEntityExist(state.missile) then
        DeleteEntity(state.missile)
    end
    SetNightvision(false)
    SetSeethrough(false)
    ClearTimecycleModifier()
    RenderScriptCams(false, false, 0, true, true)
    DestroyCam(state.cam, false)
    ClearFocus()
    stopTablet(state.tablet)
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\interface\sm_outfitbag\client\main.lua
local config = localmodule 'config'

interface.init(false)

local points = {}
local myBagId = nil
local outfitCache = nil
local originalLook = nil
local nuiOpen = false
local nextChangeAt = 0
local frameToken = 0

local function openFrame()
    frameToken += 1
    interface.show()
end

local function closeFrame()
    frameToken += 1
    local token = frameToken

    SetTimeout(400, function()
        if token == frameToken then
            interface.hide()
        end
    end)
end

local function notify(msg, kind)
    lib.notify({ description = msg, type = kind or 'inform', position = 'center-right' })
end

local function formatRemaining(ms)
    local totalSec = math.ceil(ms / 1000)
    local mins = math.floor(totalSec / 60)
    local secs = totalSec % 60
    if mins > 0 then
        return ('%d menit %d detik'):format(mins, secs)
    end
    return ('%d detik'):format(secs)
end

local function loadDict(dict)
    if HasAnimDictLoaded(dict) then return true end
    RequestAnimDict(dict)
    local deadline = GetGameTimer() + 3000
    while not HasAnimDictLoaded(dict) and GetGameTimer() < deadline do
        Wait(10)
    end
    return HasAnimDictLoaded(dict)
end

local function playBagAnim()
    local ped = cache.ped
    local a = config.BagAnim
    if not loadDict(a.dict) then return end
    TaskPlayAnim(ped, a.dict, a.anim, 4.0, -4.0, config.DropAnimTime, a.flag, 0.0, false, false, false)
    Wait(config.DropAnimTime)
    ClearPedTasks(ped)
    RemoveAnimDict(a.dict)
end

local function bagTargetOptions(bagId)
    return {
        {
            name = 'sm_outfitbag_open',
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-shirt',
            label = config.Locale.open_label,
            distance = config.InteractDistance,
            onSelect = function() TriggerEvent('sm_outfitbag:client:openBag', bagId) end,
        },
        {
            name = 'sm_outfitbag_pickup',
            icon = 'fa-solid fa-hand',
            label = config.Locale.pickup_label,
            distance = config.InteractDistance,
            onSelect = function() TriggerEvent('sm_outfitbag:client:pickupBag', bagId) end,
        },
    }
end

local function spawnLocalProp(point)
    local model = config.BagProp
    if not lib.requestModel(model, 3000) then return end

    local c = point.coords
    local obj = CreateObject(model, c.x, c.y, c.z, false, false, false)
    SetEntityHeading(obj, point.heading or 0.0)
    PlaceObjectOnGroundProperly(obj)
    FreezeEntityPosition(obj, true)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)

    point.object = obj

    if point.isOwner then
        ox_target:addLocalEntity(obj, bagTargetOptions(point.bagId))
    end
end

local function deleteLocalProp(point)
    if point.object and DoesEntityExist(point.object) then
        if point.isOwner then
            ox_target:removeLocalEntity(point.object, { 'sm_outfitbag_open', 'sm_outfitbag_pickup' })
        end
        DeleteObject(point.object)
    end
    point.object = nil
end

local function addBag(bagId, bag)
    if points[bagId] then return end

    points[bagId] = lib.points.new({
        coords = bag.coords,
        distance = config.SpawnRadius,
        bagId = bagId,
        heading = bag.heading,
        isOwner = bag.ownerSrc == GetPlayerServerId(PlayerId()),
        onEnter = spawnLocalProp,
        onExit = deleteLocalProp,
    })
end

local function removeBag(bagId)
    local point = points[bagId]
    if not point then return end
    deleteLocalProp(point)
    point:remove()
    points[bagId] = nil
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_outfitbag:client:addBag', addBag)
RegisterNetEvent('sm_outfitbag:client:removeBag', function(bagId)
    if points[bagId] and points[bagId].isOwner then myBagId = nil end
    removeBag(bagId)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_outfitbag:client:placeBag', function()
    if myBagId then
        notify(config.Locale.already_placed, 'error')
        return
    end

    if cache.vehicle then
        notify(config.Locale.in_vehicle, 'error')
        TriggerServerEvent('sm_outfitbag:server:cancelPlace')
        return
    end

    local ped = cache.ped
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped) + (GetEntityForwardVector(ped) * 0.6)
    local heading = GetEntityHeading(ped)

    playBagAnim()

    local found, groundZ = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false)
    coords = vec3(coords.x, coords.y, found and groundZ or coords.z)

    myBagId = true
    TriggerServerEvent('sm_outfitbag:server:bagPlaced', coords, heading)
    notify(config.Locale.bag_placed, 'success')
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_outfitbag:client:pickupBag', function(bagId)
    local point = points[bagId]
    if nuiOpen or not point or not point.isOwner then return end

    playBagAnim()
    TriggerServerEvent('sm_outfitbag:server:bagPicked')
    notify(config.Locale.bag_picked, 'success')
end)

local function closeNui()
    if not nuiOpen then return end
    nuiOpen = false
    interface.focus(false, false)
    interface.send({ action = 'closeMenu' })
    closeFrame()
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_outfitbag:client:openBag', function(bagId)
    local point = points[bagId]
    if nuiOpen or not point or not point.isOwner then return end

    local remaining = nextChangeAt - GetGameTimer()
    if remaining > 0 then
        notify(config.Locale.cooldown:format(formatRemaining(remaining)), 'error')
        return
    end

    local outfits = lib.callback.await('illenium-appearance:server:getOutfits', false)
    if not outfits or #outfits == 0 then
        notify(config.Locale.no_outfits, 'error')
        return
    end

    outfitCache = outfits
    originalLook = {
        components = illenium_appearance:getPedComponents(cache.ped),
        props = illenium_appearance:getPedProps(cache.ped),
    }
    nuiOpen = true
    openFrame()
    interface.focus(true, true)
    interface.send({
        action = 'openMenu',
        outfits = outfits,
        owner = {
            cid = QBPlayerData and QBPlayerData.citizenid or nil,
            name = QBPlayerData and QBPlayerData.charinfo and
                ('%s %s'):format(QBPlayerData.charinfo.firstname or '', QBPlayerData.charinfo.lastname or '') or nil,
        },
    })
end)

local function findOutfit(outfitId)
    if not outfitId or not outfitCache then return nil end
    for i = 1, #outfitCache do
        if tostring(outfitCache[i].id) == tostring(outfitId) then
            return outfitCache[i]
        end
    end
end

local function applyLook(components, props)
    local ped = cache.ped
    illenium_appearance:setPedComponents(ped, components)
    illenium_appearance:setPedProps(ped, props)
end

interface.callback('previewOutfit', function(data, cb)
    cb({})
    local outfit = findOutfit(data.outfitId)
    if outfit then applyLook(outfit.components, outfit.props) end
end)

interface.callback('cancelPreview', function(_, cb)
    closeNui()
    cb({})
    if originalLook then
        applyLook(originalLook.components, originalLook.props)
        originalLook = nil
    end
end)

interface.callback('confirmOutfit', function(data, cb)
    closeNui()
    cb({})

    local outfit = findOutfit(data.outfitId)
    if not outfit then
        if originalLook then applyLook(originalLook.components, originalLook.props) end
        originalLook = nil
        return
    end
    originalLook = nil

    local ped = cache.ped
    local anim = config.ChangeOutfit
    if loadDict(anim.dict) then
        TaskPlayAnim(ped, anim.dict, anim.anim, 3.0, 3.0, anim.duration, anim.flag, 0.0, false, false, false)
        Wait(anim.duration // 2)
    end

    applyLook(outfit.components, outfit.props)

    if HasAnimDictLoaded(anim.dict) then
        Wait(anim.duration - (anim.duration // 2))
        ClearPedTasks(ped)
        RemoveAnimDict(anim.dict)
    end

    TriggerServerEvent('illenium-appearance:server:saveAppearance', illenium_appearance:getPedAppearance(ped))
    nextChangeAt = GetGameTimer() + (config.ChangeCooldown * 60000)
    notify(config.Locale.outfit_changed, 'success')
end)

local function syncBags()
    local mySrc = GetPlayerServerId(PlayerId())
    local current = lib.callback.await('sm_outfitbag:server:syncBags', false)
    if not current then return end
    for bagId, bag in pairs(current) do
        addBag(bagId, bag)
        if bag.ownerSrc == mySrc then myBagId = true end
    end
end

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:OnPlayerLoaded', syncBags)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(res)
    if res ~= cache.resource then return end
    for bagId in pairs(points) do
        removeBag(bagId)
    end
    interface.focus(false, false)
end)

CreateThread(function()
    Wait(1000)
    if LocalPlayer.state.isLoggedIn ~= false then syncBags() end
end)

---@param ink number

local function inkColor(ink)
    if ink >= 75 then return 'green' end
    if ink >= 50 then return 'yellow' end
    if ink >= 25 then return 'orange' end
    return 'red'
end

---@param id number
local function supplyMenu(id)
    local storage = lib.callback.await('sm_printer:server:getStorage', false, id)

                    local ok, amount = lib.callback.await('sm_printer:server:refill', false, id, 'paper')
                    if ok then notify(('Menambah %d lembar kertas.'):format(amount), 'success') end
                end,

                icon = 'pen-nib',

                progress = ink,

---@param id number
local function printDocument(id)
    local input = lib.inputDialog('Printer', {
        { type = 'input', label = 'Judul', description = 'Judul dokumen', required = true, max = 64 },
        { type = 'input', label = 'Deskripsi', description = 'Deskripsi dokumen', max = 256 },
        { type = 'input', label = 'Link', description = 'Link gambar yang dicetak', required = true, max = 512 },
        { type = 'number', label = 'Salinan', description = 'Jumlah salinan', min = 1, max = maxCopies, default = 1, required = true },
    })
    if not input then return end

    local copies = mathFloor(tonumber(input[4]) or 0)
    if copies < 1 or copies > maxCopies then return end

    if not lib.callback.await('sm_printer:server:startPrint', false, id, copies) then
        return notify('Tidak bisa memakai printer ini.', 'error')
    end

    if not lib.progressCircle({
        label = 'Mencetak...',
        duration = copies * msPerPage,
        position = 'bottom',
        canCancel = false,
        disable = { car = true },
    }) then return end

    local result = lib.callback.await('sm_printer:server:completePrint', false, input[1], input[2], input[3])
    if result == 'given' then
        notify('Print selesai.', 'success')
    elseif result == 'queued' then
        notify('Print selesai, ambil hasilnya di printer.', 'success')
    else
        notify('Print gagal.', 'error')
    end
end

---@param point table
local function spawnObject(point)
    local printer = point.printer
    if printer.entity then return end

    local model = joaat(printer.model)
    if not pcall(lib.requestModel, model, 5000) then return end
    if printers[printer.id] ~= printer or printer.entity or point.currentDistance and point.currentDistance > spawnDistance then
        SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
        return
    end

    local coords = printer.coords
    local entity = CreateObject(model, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
    SetEntityHeading(entity, printer.heading)
    PlaceObjectOnGroundProperly(entity)
    FreezeEntityPosition(entity, true)

    printer.entity = entity
    exports.rhd_interact:addLocalEntity(entity, printer.options)
end

---@param point table
local function despawnObject(point)
    local printer = point.printer
    local entity = printer.entity
    if not entity then return end

    printer.entity = nil
    exports.rhd_interact:removeLocalEntity(entity)
    if DoesEntityExist(entity) then
        DeleteEntity(entity)
    end
end

---@param id number
local function removePrinter(id)
    local printer = printers[id]
    if not printer then return end

    printers[id] = nil

    if printer.kind == 'coords' then
        exports.rhd_interact:removeCoords(INTERACT_PREFIX .. id)
        return
    end

    local point = printer.point
    if point then
        despawnObject(point)
        point:remove()
    end
end

---@param data table
local function addPrinter(data)
    local id = data.id
    if printers[id] then removePrinter(id) end

    local raw = data.coords
    local printer = {
        id = id,
        kind = data.kind,
        model = data.model,
        coords = vec3(raw.x, raw.y, raw.z),
        heading = data.heading or 0.0,
        group = data.group,
        public = data.public == true,
    }
    printer.options = buildOptions(printer)
    printers[id] = printer

    if printer.kind == 'coords' then
        exports.rhd_interact:addCoords({
            id = INTERACT_PREFIX .. id,
            coords = printer.coords,
            options = printer.options,
        })
        return
    end

    printer.point = lib.points.new({
        coords = printer.coords,
        distance = spawnDistance,
        printer = printer,
        onEnter = spawnObject,
        onExit = despawnObject,
    })
end

local function clearAll()
    for id in pairs(printers) do
        removePrinter(id)
    end
end

---@param list table
local function syncAll(list)
    clearAll()
    loaded = true
    for i = 1, #list do
        addPrinter(list[i])
    end
end

local function loadAll()
    if loaded then return end
    local list = lib.callback.await('sm_printer:server:getAll', false)
    if list then syncAll(list) end
end

---@param distance number
---@return vector3 origin
---@return vector3 target
local function cameraRay(distance)
    local rot = GetFinalRenderedCamRot(2)
    local rx, rz = mathRad(rot.x), mathRad(rot.z)
    local cosX = mathAbs(mathCos(rx))
    local origin = GetFinalRenderedCamCoord()
    return origin, origin + vec3(-mathSin(rz) * cosX, mathCos(rz) * cosX, mathSin(rx)) * distance
end

---@param modelName string
---@return vector3?
---@return number?
local function placeObject(modelName)
    if placing then return end

    local model = joaat(modelName)
    if not pcall(lib.requestModel, model, 5000) then return end

    placing = true
    local ghost = CreateObject(model, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, false, false, false)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
    SetEntityAlpha(ghost, 150, false)
    SetEntityCollision(ghost, false, false)
    FreezeEntityPosition(ghost, true)

    infoUI.show({
        id = 'sm_printer_place',
        title = 'Pasang Printer',
        icon = 'fa-solid fa-print',
        description = '[kbd]E[/kbd] Pasang  [kbd]X[/kbd] Batal  [kbd]Scroll[/kbd] Putar',
    })

    local heading = 0.0
    local outlined = false
    local resultCoords, resultHeading
    local rayLength = placeDistance + 5.0

    while placing do
        DisableControlAction(0, 14, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 15, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 24, true)

        local origin, target = cameraRay(rayLength)
        local probe = StartExpensiveSynchronousShapeTestLosProbe(origin.x, origin.y, origin.z, target.x, target.y, target.z, 1, cache.ped, 4)
        local _, hit, coords = GetShapeTestResult(probe)

        if hit == 1 then
            SetEntityCoords(ghost, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false, false)
            SetEntityHeading(ghost, heading)
            PlaceObjectOnGroundProperly(ghost)

            local valid = #(GetEntityCoords(cache.ped) - coords) < placeDistance
            if valid == outlined then
                outlined = not valid
                SetEntityDrawOutline(ghost, outlined)
            end

            if valid and IsControlJustReleased(0, 38) then
                resultCoords = GetEntityCoords(ghost)
                resultHeading = heading
                placing = false
            end
        end

        if IsControlJustReleased(0, 73) then
            placing = false
        elseif IsDisabledControlJustReleased(0, 14) then
            heading = (heading + 5.0) % 360
        elseif IsDisabledControlJustReleased(0, 15) then
            heading = (heading - 5.0) % 360
        end

        Wait(0)
    end

    infoUI.remove('sm_printer_place')
    if DoesEntityExist(ghost) then
        DeleteEntity(ghost)
    end

    return resultCoords, resultHeading
end

---@return boolean
local function askPublic()
    return lib.alertDialog({
        header = 'Akses Publik?',
        content = 'Izinkan semua orang memakai printer ini untuk mencetak?',
        centered = true,
        cancel = true,
        labels = { cancel = 'Hanya Job', confirm = 'Publik' },
    }) == 'confirm'
end

---@param kind string
---@param model string
---@param coords vector3
---@param heading number
local function submitPrinter(kind, model, coords, heading)
    local created = lib.callback.await('sm_printer:server:create', false, {
        kind = kind,
        model = model,
        coords = coords,
        heading = heading,
        public = askPublic(),
    })

    if created then
        notify('Printer ditambahkan.', 'success')
    else
        notify('Gagal menambahkan printer.', 'error')
    end
end

local function chooseModelMenu()
    local options = {}

    for i = 1, #printerModels do
        local name = printerModels[i]
        options[i] = {
            title = name,
            image = MODEL_IMAGE:format(name),
            onSelect = function()
                local coords, heading = placeObject(name)
                if coords then submitPrinter('object', name, coords, heading) end
            end,
        }
    end

    lib.registerContext({
        id = 'sm_printer_models',
        title = 'Pilih Model Printer',
        menu = 'sm_printer_main',
        options = options,
    })
    lib.showContext('sm_printer_models')
end

local function addCoordsPrinter()
    local input = lib.inputDialog('Printer di Koordinat', {
        { type = 'input', label = 'Nama', required = true, default = 'Printer Station', max = 40 },
        { type = 'number', label = 'X', required = true },
        { type = 'number', label = 'Y', required = true },
        { type = 'number', label = 'Z', required = true },
    })
    if not input then return end

    submitPrinter('coords', input[1], vec3(input[2], input[3], input[4]), 0.0)
end

local function addPrinterHere()
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local input = lib.inputDialog('Printer di Lokasi Ini', {
        { type = 'input', label = 'Nama', required = true, default = 'Printer Station', max = 40 },
        { type = 'checkbox', label = 'Atur koordinat manual', checked = false },
    })
    if not input then return end

    if input[2] then
        local adjusted = lib.inputDialog('Atur Koordinat', {
            { type = 'number', label = 'X', required = true, default = mathFloor(coords.x * 100) / 100 },
            { type = 'number', label = 'Y', required = true, default = mathFloor(coords.y * 100) / 100 },
            { type = 'number', label = 'Z', required = true, default = mathFloor(coords.z * 100) / 100 },
        })
        if adjusted then
            coords = vec3(adjusted[1], adjusted[2], adjusted[3])
        end
    end

    submitPrinter('coords', input[1], coords, 0.0)
end

local viewPrinters

---@param entry table
local function confirmDelete(entry)
    local answer = lib.alertDialog({
        header = 'Hapus Printer?',
        content = 'Printer dan isi lacinya akan dihapus permanen.',
        centered = true,
        cancel = true,
        labels = { cancel = 'Kembali', confirm = 'Hapus' },
    })
    if answer ~= 'confirm' then return end

    if not lib.callback.await('sm_printer:server:delete', false, entry.id) then
        return notify('Gagal menghapus printer.', 'error')
    end

    notify('Printer dihapus.', 'success')
    viewPrinters()
end

function viewPrinters()
    local list = lib.callback.await('sm_printer:server:listOwned', false)
    if not list or not list[1] then
        return notify('Belum ada printer untuk job ini.')
    end

    local options = {}
    for i = 1, #list do
        local entry = list[i]
        local isCoords = entry.kind == 'coords'
        options[i] = {
            title = (isCoords and '[Titik] ' or '') .. entry.model,
            image = not isCoords and MODEL_IMAGE:format(entry.model) or nil,
            icon = isCoords and 'location-dot' or nil,
            description = ('Kertas: %d  \nTinta: %d%%'):format(entry.paper or 0, entry.ink or 0),
            onSelect = function() confirmDelete(entry) end,
        }
    end

    lib.registerContext({
        id = 'sm_printer_list',
        title = 'Daftar Printer',
        menu = 'sm_printer_main',
        options = options,
    })
    lib.showContext('sm_printer_list')
end

local function openMenu()
    lib.registerContext({
        id = 'sm_printer_main',
        title = 'Kelola Printer',
        options = {
            { title = 'Printer Fisik Baru', icon = 'plus', description = 'Pasang objek printer', onSelect = chooseModelMenu },
            { title = 'Printer di Koordinat', icon = 'map-marker-alt', description = 'Titik printer tanpa objek di koordinat tertentu', onSelect = addCoordsPrinter },
            { title = 'Printer di Sini', icon = 'location-arrow', description = 'Titik printer tanpa objek di posisimu', onSelect = addPrinterHere },
            { title = 'Daftar Printer', icon = 'print', description = 'Lihat dan hapus printer job', onSelect = viewPrinters },
        },
    })
    lib.showContext('sm_printer_main')
end

local viewerOpen = false
local viewerMounted = false
local viewerReady = false
local pendingLink

local function sendDocument()
    local link = pendingLink
    pendingLink = nil
    interface.send({ action = 'show', data = { url = link } })
    interface.focus(true, true)
end

local function closeViewer()
    if not viewerOpen then return end

    viewerOpen = false
    pendingLink = nil
    interface.focus(false, false)

    SetTimeout(50, function()
        if viewerOpen or not viewerMounted then return end

        viewerMounted = false
        viewerReady = false
        interface.hide()
    end)
end

---@param link string
local function openDocument(link)
    if not hasFrame or viewerOpen then return end

    viewerOpen = true
    pendingLink = link

    if viewerReady then
        return sendDocument()
    end

    if not viewerMounted then
        viewerMounted = true
        interface.show()
    end
end

if hasFrame then
    interface.callback('ready', function(_, cb)
        viewerReady = true
        if viewerOpen and pendingLink then
            sendDocument()
        end
        cb('ok')
    end)

    interface.callback('closed', function(_, cb)
        cb('ok')
        closeViewer()
    end)
end

AddEventHandler('sm_printer:client:forceClose', function()
    if not viewerOpen then return end
    if viewerReady then
        interface.send({ action = 'close' })
    end
    closeViewer()
end)

exportWrapper('sm_printer', 'printerdocument', function(_, slot)
    local link = slot and slot.metadata and slot.metadata.imagelink
    if type(link) ~= 'string' or link == '' then return end

    openDocument(link)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_printer:client:openMenu', function()
    if GetInvokingResource() then return end
    openMenu()
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_printer:client:sync', function(list)
    if GetInvokingResource() or not playerState.isLoggedIn then return end
    syncAll(list)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_printer:client:add', function(data)
    if GetInvokingResource() or not loaded then return end
    addPrinter(data)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_printer:client:remove', function(id)
    if GetInvokingResource() or not loaded then return end
    removePrinter(id)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:OnPlayerLoaded', loadAll)

CreateThread(function()
    if playerState.isLoggedIn then loadAll() end
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource then return end
    placing = false
    infoUI.remove('sm_printer_place')
    clearAll()
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\interface\sm_scoreboard\client.lua
local Config = localmodule 'config'
local isOpened = false

-- Register the frame unmounted: it holds no GPU surface until first opened.
-- openScoreboard calls show() to mount it; the iframe boots, fires 'ready',
-- and we push everything from there so we never race the React mount.
interface.init(false)

---@return table
local function buildData()
    local data = lib.callback.await('sm_scoreboard:getServerData', false)

    if data.groups then
        local groups = {}
        for index, group in ipairs(Config.groups) do
            groups[index] = {
                label = group.label,
                count = data.groups[index],
                icon = group.icon,
            }
        end
        data.groups = groups
    end

    if data.statusIndicators then
        local indicators = {}
        for index, indicator in ipairs(Config.statusIndicators) do
            indicators[index] = {
                label = indicator.label,
                icon = indicator.icon,
                state = data.statusIndicators[index],
            }
        end
        data.statusIndicators = indicators
    end

    if data.footer then
        data.footer.serverId = cache.serverId
    end

    return data
end

-- Fired by the app after it has mounted (and frame init completed). Because the
-- frame is created fresh on each open, this runs every open and is the safe
-- point to push config + data + make it visible.
interface.callback('ready', function(_, cb)
    cb(1)

    interface.send({ action = 'setConfig', data = Config.settings })
    interface.send({ action = 'setLocales', data = Config.locales })

    if not isOpened then return end

    interface.send({ action = 'setData', data = buildData() })

    interface.focus(true, true, true)
    SetCursorLocation(Config.settings.side == 'right' and 0.8 or 0.2, 0.5)

    interface.send({ action = 'setVisible', data = true })
end)

interface.callback('close', function(_, cb)
    cb(1)
    isOpened = false
end)

interface.callback('copyServerId', function(_, cb)
    cb(1)
    lib.setClipboard(tostring(cache.serverId))
end)

local function openScoreboard()
    if isOpened then
        isOpened = false
        interface.send({ action = 'setVisible', data = false })
        interface.focus(false, false)
        -- The originally-running open coroutine exits its loop and unmounts the
        -- frame at the end of this function; don't hide() here or we'd race it.
        return
    end

    isOpened = true

    -- Mount the iframe; data/visibility are pushed from the 'ready' callback
    -- once the freshly mounted app reports in.
    interface.show()

    while isOpened do
        HudWeaponWheelIgnoreSelection()
        DisablePlayerFiring(cache.playerId, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 1, true) -- INPUT_LOOK_LR
        DisableControlAction(0, 2, true) -- INPUT_LOOK_UD
        DisableControlAction(0, 200, true) -- INPUT_FRONTEND_PAUSE_ALTERNATE
        Wait(0)
    end

    while IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 200) do
        DisableControlAction(0, 200, true)
        Wait(0)
    end

    interface.focus(false, false)
    interface.hide() -- single close chokepoint: unmount and free the GPU surface
end

TriggerEvent('chat:addSuggestion', ('/%s'):format(Config.commandName), 'Opens the scoreboard UI')
RegisterCommand(Config.commandName, openScoreboard, false)

if Config.commandKey then
    RegisterKeyMapping(Config.commandName, 'Open scoreboard UI', 'keyboard', Config.commandKey)
end

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource == cache.resource and isOpened then
        interface.focus(false, false)
    end
end)

---@param key string
local function notify(key)
    local entry = Notify[key]
    if not entry then return end

    lib.notify({
        title = 'Studio',
        description = entry[1],
        type = entry[2],
        duration = entry[3],
    })
end

---@param action string
---@param data any
local function sendUI(action, data)
    if not mounted then return end

    local msg = { action = action, data = data }

    if frameReady then
        interface.send(msg)
    else
        pending[#pending + 1] = msg
    end
end

local function mountFrame()
    if mounted then return end
    mounted = true

    if frameAlive then
        frameReady = true
    else
        frameReady = false
        interface.show()
    end
end

local function unmountFrame()
    if not mounted then return end
    mounted = false
    frameReady = false
    table.wipe(pending)

    SetTimeout(50, function()
        if mounted then return end
        frameAlive = false
        interface.hide()
    end)
end

---@return boolean
local function isDead()
    local metadata = QBPlayerData.metadata
    return metadata ~= nil and (metadata.isdead or metadata.inlaststand) == true
end

---@param key string
---@return boolean
local function canUseComputer(key)
    local studio = Studios[key]
    if studio.forall then return true end

    local job = QBPlayerData.job
    local minGrade = job and studio.jobs and studio.jobs[job.name]
    if not minGrade then return false end

    local grade = job.grade
    return (tonumber(type(grade) == 'table' and grade.level or grade) or 0) >= minGrade
end

local function startVolumeLoop()
    if volumeLoop then return end
    volumeLoop = true

    CreateThread(function()
        local last = -1

        while activeStudio and speakerActive do
            if frameReady then
                local computer = Studios[activeStudio].computer
                local maxDistance = computer.maxVolumeDistance
                local distance = #(GetEntityCoords(cache.ped) - computer.coords)
                local volume = distance >= maxDistance and 0.0 or mathExp(-distance / (maxDistance * 2.25))

                if mathAbs(volume - last) >= 0.01 then
                    last = volume
                    interface.send({ action = 'speakerVolume', data = volume })
                end
            else
                last = -1
            end

            Wait(150)
        end

        volumeLoop = false
    end)
end

---@param payload table?
local function setSpeaker(payload)
    speakerActive = payload ~= nil
    sendUI('speaker', payload or false)
    if speakerActive then startVolumeLoop() end
end

local function stopAnim()
    animToken = animToken + 1
    pendingAnim = nil

    if animProp then
        if DoesEntityExist(animProp) then DeleteEntity(animProp) end
        animProp = nil
    end

    if not activeAnim then return end
    StopAnimTask(cache.ped, activeAnim.dict, activeAnim.clip, 1.0)
    RemoveAnimDict(activeAnim.dict)
    activeAnim = nil
end

---@param anim table
local function playAnim(anim)
    stopAnim()
    local token = animToken
    pendingAnim = anim

    CreateThread(function()
        lib.requestAnimDict(anim.dict)
        if anim.prop then lib.requestModel(anim.prop) end
        if token ~= animToken then return end
        pendingAnim = nil

        local ped = cache.ped
        TaskPlayAnim(ped, anim.dict, anim.clip, 3.0, 3.0, -1, anim.flag, 0, false, false, false)
        activeAnim = anim

        if anim.prop then
            local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
            local p = anim.placement
            animProp = CreateObject(anim.prop, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z + 0.2, true, true, false)
            SetEntityCollision(animProp, false, false)
            AttachEntityToEntity(animProp, ped, GetPedBoneIndex(ped, anim.bone), p[1], p[2], p[3], p[4], p[5], p[6], true, true, false, true, 1, true)
            SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(anim.prop)
        end
    end)
end

---@param anim table
local function stopAnimIf(anim)
    if activeAnim == anim or pendingAnim == anim then stopAnim() end
end

local function closeComputer()
    if not computerOpen then return end
    computerOpen = false
    stopAnimIf(Animations.computer)

    interface.focus(false, false)
    sendUI('close', true)

    if jobBusy then
        releasePending = true
        return
    end

    TriggerTokenEvent('sm_studio:computer:release')
end

local function closeMicSettings()
    if not micSettingsOpen then return end
    micSettingsOpen = false
    sendUI('micSettings', false)
    interface.focus(false, false)
end

local function openMicSettings()
    if micSettingsOpen or computerOpen then return end
    micSettingsOpen = true
    sendUI('micSettings', true)
    interface.focus(true, true)
end

local function playerOnMic()
    onMic = true
    FreezeEntityPosition(cache.ped, true)
    sendUI('micPanel', true)
    notify('on_mic')
    openMicSettings()
end

local function playerOutMic()
    onMic = false
    recording = false
    stopAnimIf(Animations.microphone)
    FreezeEntityPosition(cache.ped, false)
    sendUI('micPanel', false)
    closeMicSettings()
    notify('out_mic')
end

---@param key string
local function spawnTelevision(key)
    local tv = Studios[key].television
    if not tv or tvProps[key] then return end

    lib.requestModel(tv.model)

    local coords, rotation = tv.coords, tv.rotation
    local object = CreateObject(tv.model, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(tv.model)
    FreezeEntityPosition(object, true)
    SetEntityInvincible(object, true)
    SetEntityRotation(object, rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z, 0, true)

    tvProps[key] = object
end

---@param key string
local function deleteTelevision(key)
    local object = tvProps[key]
    if not object then return end

    if DoesEntityExist(object) then DeleteEntity(object) end
    tvProps[key] = nil
end

---@param action string
---@param data any
local function tvSend(action, data)
    if not tvDui then return end
    local message = json.encode({ action = action, data = data })
    if tvReady then
        SendDuiMessage(tvDui, message)
    else
        tvQueue[#tvQueue + 1] = message
    end
end

local function destroyTv()
    tvToken = tvToken + 1
    tvReady = false
    table.wipe(tvQueue)

    if tvDui then
        DestroyDui(tvDui)
        tvDui = nil
    end

    if tvOwnsTarget and tvTarget and IsNamedRendertargetRegistered(tvTarget) then
        ReleaseNamedRendertarget(tvTarget)
    end
    tvOwnsTarget = false
    tvTarget = nil
end

---@param key string
local function createTv(key)
    local tv = Studios[key].television
    if not tv or tvDui then return end

    tvToken = tvToken + 1
    local token = tvToken
    tvTarget = tv.target or 'tvscreen'

    local handle = CreateDui(TV_URL, TV_WIDTH, TV_HEIGHT)
    tvDui = handle

    CreateThread(function()
        local deadline = GetGameTimer() + 10000
        while not IsDuiAvailable(handle) and GetGameTimer() < deadline do
            Wait(50)
        end
        if token ~= tvToken then return end
        if not IsDuiAvailable(handle) then
            destroyTv()
            return
        end

        if not tvTxd then tvTxd = CreateRuntimeTxd(TV_TXD) end
        tvSerial = tvSerial + 1
        tvTexture = 'screen' .. tvSerial
        CreateRuntimeTextureFromDuiHandle(tvTxd, tvTexture, GetDuiHandle(handle))

        local target = tvTarget
        local model = tv.model
        local defaultId = GetDefaultScriptRendertargetRenderId()

        while token == tvToken do
            if not IsNamedRendertargetRegistered(target) then
                RegisterNamedRendertarget(target, false)
                tvOwnsTarget = true
            end
            if not IsNamedRendertargetLinked(model) then
                LinkNamedRendertarget(model)
            end

            SetTextRenderId(GetNamedRendertargetRenderId(target))
            SetScriptGfxDrawOrder(4)
            SetScriptGfxDrawBehindPausemenu(true)
            DrawSprite(TV_TXD, tvTexture, 0.5, 0.5, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0, 255, 255, 255, 255)
            SetTextRenderId(defaultId)
            SetScriptGfxDrawBehindPausemenu(false)
            Wait(0)
        end
    end)
end

---@param key string
local function enterStudio(key)
    if activeStudio == key then return end
    activeStudio = key

    mountFrame()
    spawnTelevision(key)
    createTv(key)

    lib.callback('sm_studio:room:enter', false, function(data)
        if activeStudio ~= key then return end

        if not data then
            if Debug then lib.print.warn(('[sm_studio] server menolak masuk studio %s'):format(key)) end
            return
        end

        if data.speaker then setSpeaker(data.speaker) end
        tvSend('studio', data.label)
        if data.mirror then tvSend('mirror', data.mirror) end
    end, key)
end

---@param key string
local function exitStudio(key)
    if activeStudio ~= key then return end

    closeComputer()

    if onMic then
        lib.callback('sm_studio:mic:leave', false, function() end)
        playerOutMic()
    end

    TriggerTokenEvent('sm_studio:room:leave')
    destroyTv()
    deleteTelevision(key)

    activeStudio = nil
    speakerActive = false
    uploading = false

    unmountFrame()
end

---@param key string
local function openComputer(key)
    lib.callback('sm_studio:computer:open', false, function(result)
        if not result.status then
            return notify(result.message)
        end

        if activeStudio ~= key or isDead() then
            TriggerTokenEvent('sm_studio:computer:release')
            return
        end

        computerOpen = true
        releasePending = false
        playAnim(Animations.computer)
        result.status = nil
        sendUI('open', result)
        interface.focus(true, true)
    end)
end

local function toggleMic()
    if onMic then
        if uploading then return notify('record_uploading_wait') end

        lib.callback('sm_studio:mic:leave', false, function(success)
            if success then
                playerOutMic()
            else
                notify('went_wrong')
            end
        end)
        return
    end

    lib.callback('sm_studio:mic:take', false, function(success)
        if success then
            playerOnMic()
        else
            notify('microphone_busy')
        end
    end)
end

local B64 = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
local B64_PAIRS = {}
local B64_CHARS = {}

for i = 0, 63 do
    B64_CHARS[i] = B64:sub(i + 1, i + 1)
end

for i = 0, 4095 do
    B64_PAIRS[i] = B64_CHARS[i >> 6] .. B64_CHARS[i & 63]
end

local sbyte = string.byte
local tconcat = table.concat

---@param data string
---@return string
local function base64(data)
    local length = #data
    local full = length - length % 3
    local out = {}
    local n = 0

    for i = 1, full, 3 do
        local a, b, c = sbyte(data, i, i + 2)
        local value = (a << 16) | (b << 8) | c
        out[n + 1] = B64_PAIRS[value >> 12]
        out[n + 2] = B64_PAIRS[value & 4095]
        n = n + 2
        if n % 40000 == 0 then Wait(0) end
    end

    local rest = length - full
    if rest == 1 then
        local value = sbyte(data, length) << 16
        out[n + 1] = B64_PAIRS[value >> 12] .. '=='
    elseif rest == 2 then
        local a, b = sbyte(data, length - 1, length)
        local value = (a << 16) | (b << 8)
        out[n + 1] = B64_PAIRS[value >> 12] .. B64_CHARS[(value >> 6) & 63] .. '='
    end

    return tconcat(out)
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_studio:export:chunk', function(req, index, total, part)
    if not computerOpen then return end
    sendUI('exportChunk', { req = req, index = index, total = total, data = base64(part) })
    if index < total then TriggerTokenEvent('sm_studio:export:next', req, index) end
end)

end)

local controls = config.controls
local text = config.text
local joinDistance = config.joinDistance
local markerDistance = config.markerDistance
local ballRadius = config.ballRadius
local highlightSize = config.ballHighlight.size

local shadowSize = config.ballShadow.size
local shadowAlpha = config.ballShadow.alpha
