########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\interface\sm_tv\modules\media.lua
local smatch = string.match
local slower = string.lower
local sfind = string.find
local sformat = string.format
local ssub = string.sub
local mathFloor = math.floor

local media = {}

local LABELS = {
    youtube = 'YouTube',
    twitch = 'Twitch',
    kick = 'Kick',
    streamable = 'Streamable',
    vimeo = 'Vimeo',
    dailymotion = 'Dailymotion',
    soundcloud = 'SoundCloud',
    video = 'Video',
    audio = 'Audio',
    image = 'Gambar',
}

local PLAYER_TYPES = { youtube = true, video = true, audio = true, image = true }

local EXTENSIONS = {
    mp4 = 'video',
    webm = 'video',
    mp3 = 'audio',
    ogg = 'audio',
    wav = 'audio',
    m4a = 'audio',
    png = 'image',
    jpg = 'image',
    jpeg = 'image',
    gif = 'image',
    webp = 'image',
}

local EMBEDS = {
    twitch = 'https://player.twitch.tv/?channel=%s&parent=streamernews.example.com&autoplay=true',
    kick = 'https://player.kick.com/%s?autoplay=true&muted=false',
    streamable = 'https://streamable.com/e/%s?autoplay=1&t=%d',
    vimeo = 'https://player.vimeo.com/video/%s?autoplay=1#t=%ds',
    dailymotion = 'https://www.dailymotion.com/embed/video/%s?autoplay=1&start=%d',
}

local MAX_LENGTH = 512

---@param host string
---@param path string
---@return string?
local function youtubeId(host, path)
    local id
    if host == 'youtu.be' then
        id = smatch(path, '^/([%w_%-]+)')
    elseif host == 'youtube.com' or host == 'music.youtube.com' or host == 'youtube-nocookie.com' then
        id = smatch(path, '[?&]v=([%w_%-]+)')
            or smatch(path, '^/shorts/([%w_%-]+)')
            or smatch(path, '^/live/([%w_%-]+)')
            or smatch(path, '^/embed/([%w_%-]+)')
    end
    if id and #id == 11 then
        return id
    end
end

---@param host string
---@param path string
---@return string? kind
---@return string? src
local function provider(host, path)
    local id = youtubeId(host, path)
    if id then
        return 'youtube', id
    end

    if host == 'twitch.tv' then
        id = smatch(path, '^/([%w_]+)/?$') or smatch(path, '^/([%w_]+)[?#]')
        return id and 'twitch', id
    elseif host == 'kick.com' then
        id = smatch(path, '^/([%w_%-]+)/?$') or smatch(path, '^/([%w_%-]+)[?#]')
        return id and 'kick', id
    elseif host == 'streamable.com' then
        id = smatch(path, '^/e/(%w+)') or smatch(path, '^/(%w+)')
        return id and 'streamable', id
    elseif host == 'vimeo.com' then
        id = smatch(path, '^/(%d+)')
        return id and 'vimeo', id
    elseif host == 'player.vimeo.com' then
        id = smatch(path, '^/video/(%d+)')
        return id and 'vimeo', id
    elseif host == 'dailymotion.com' then
        id = smatch(path, '^/video/(%w+)')
        return id and 'dailymotion', id
    elseif host == 'dai.ly' then
        id = smatch(path, '^/(%w+)')
        return id and 'dailymotion', id
    elseif host == 'soundcloud.com' then
        id = smatch(path, '^/([%w_%-]+/[%w_%-/]+)')
        return id and 'soundcloud', id
    end
end

---@param host string
---@param blocked string[]
---@return boolean
local function isBlocked(host, blocked)
    for i = 1, #blocked do
        local entry = blocked[i]
        local start = #host - #entry + 1
        if start >= 1 and ssub(host, start) == entry and (start == 1 or ssub(host, start - 1, start - 1) == '.') then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

---@param raw string
---@param links table<string, boolean>
---@param blocked string[]
---@return table? result
---@return string? reason
function media.parse(raw, links, blocked)
    local url = smatch(raw, '^%s*(.-)%s*$')
    if #url == 0 or #url > MAX_LENGTH or sfind(url, '[%s"\'<>\\`]') then
        return nil, 'unsupported'
    end

    if not sfind(url, '^[Hh][Tt][Tt][Pp][Ss]?://') then
        url = 'https://' .. url
    end

    local host, path = smatch(url, '^[Hh][Tt][Tt][Pp][Ss]?://([^/?#]+)(.*)$')
    if not host then
        return nil, 'unsupported'
    end

    host = slower(smatch(host, '^([^:]+)') or host)
    host = smatch(host, '^www%.(.+)$') or smatch(host, '^m%.(.+)$') or host

    if isBlocked(host, blocked) then
        return nil, 'blocked'
    end

    local kind, src = provider(host, path)
    if not kind then
        local ext = smatch(smatch(path, '^([^?#]*)'), '%.(%w+)$')
        kind = ext and EXTENSIONS[slower(ext)]
        src = url
    end

    if not kind or not links[kind] then
        return nil, 'unsupported'
    end

    return { type = kind, src = src, label = LABELS[kind], url = url }
end

---@param kind string
---@return boolean
function media.isPlayer(kind)
    return PLAYER_TYPES[kind] == true
end

---@param item table
---@param elapsed number
---@return string
function media.embed(item, elapsed)
    local seconds = mathFloor(elapsed)
    if item.type == 'soundcloud' then
        return sformat('https://soundcloud.com/%s#t=%d:%02d', item.src, mathFloor(seconds / 60), seconds % 60)
    end
    return sformat(EMBEDS[item.type], item.src, seconds)
end

return media

    pendingSender = sender
    if not frameMounted then
        frameReady = false
        frameMounted = true
        interface.show()
    elseif frameReady then
        pendingSender = nil
        sender()
    end
end

    pendingSender = nil

    frameReady = false
end

                    { label = 'Model', value = vehicle.model },
                    { label = 'Status', value = claimed and 'Claimed' or 'Available' }

                title = 'Kendaraan Sudah Di-Claim',

        lib.registerContext({
            id = 'sm_vip_tvremote_claim',
            title = ('TV Remote %s'):format(Config.VipTypes[vipData.vip_type].label),
            menu = 'sm_vip_status',
            options = options
        })
        lib.showContext('sm_vip_tvremote_claim')
    end)
end

local function openDailyItemMenu(vipData)
    lib.callback('sm_vip:server:getDailyItemStatus', false, function(itemStatus)
        local items = Config.DailyItems[vipData.vip_type].items
        local options = {}
        local canClaim = itemStatus.canClaim

        for i = 1, #items do
            local item = items[i]
            options[#options + 1] = {
                title = ('%s x%d'):format(item.label, item.amount),
                description = item.description,
                icon = 'fas fa-box',
                iconColor = canClaim and 'green' or 'gray',
                disabled = not canClaim,
                metadata = {
                    { label = 'Item', value = item.name },
                    { label = 'Jumlah', value = item.amount }
                }
            }
        end

        if canClaim then
            options[#options + 1] = {
                title = 'Claim Semua Item',
                description = ('Claim %d jenis item sekaligus'):format(#items),
                icon = 'fas fa-check-circle',
                iconColor = 'green',
                onSelect = function()
                    TriggerTokenEvent('sm_vip:server:claimDailyItem')
                    lib.hideContext()
                end
            }
        else
            local cooldownText = itemStatus.timeLeft or 'Menghitung...'
            options[#options + 1] = {
                title = 'Sedang Cooldown',
                description = ('Silakan tunggu %s'):format(cooldownText),
                icon = 'fas fa-clock',
                iconColor = 'orange',
                disabled = true,
                metadata = {
                    { label = 'Cooldown', value = cooldownText }
                }
            }
        end

        lib.registerContext({
            id = 'sm_vip_daily_item',
            title = ('Daily Item %s'):format(Config.VipTypes[vipData.vip_type].label),
            menu = 'sm_vip_status',
            options = options
        })
        lib.showContext('sm_vip_daily_item')
    end)
end

local function checkVipStatus()
    lib.callback('sm_vip:server:getPlayerVipStatus', false, function(vipData)
        if not vipData then
            lib.registerContext({
                id = 'sm_vip_status',
                title = 'VIP Status',
                options = {
                    {
                        title = 'No VIP Status',
                        description = 'Anda belum memiliki status VIP',
                        icon = 'fas fa-times-circle',
                        iconColor = 'red'
                    }
                }
            })
            lib.showContext('sm_vip_status')
            return
        end

        local vipType = vipData.vip_type
        local typeData = Config.VipTypes[vipType]

        -- Tipe lama yang sudah dihapus dari config (mis. 'vip') masih mungkin ada
        -- di DB; tampilkan apa adanya tanpa opsi claim daripada error.
        if not typeData then
            lib.registerContext({
                id = 'sm_vip_status',
                title = 'VIP Status',
                options = {
                    {
                        title = ('Tipe "%s" sudah tidak berlaku'):format(tostring(vipType):upper()),
                        description = 'Hubungi admin untuk memperbarui status VIP Anda',
                        icon = 'fas fa-triangle-exclamation',
                        iconColor = 'orange'
                    }
                }
            })
            lib.showContext('sm_vip_status')
            return
        end

        local options = {
            {
                title = ('%s Active'):format(typeData.label),
                description = ('Sisa waktu: %s'):format(vipData.timeLeft or 'Unknown'),
                icon = 'fas fa-crown',
                iconColor = vipType == 'vvip' and 'gold' or 'silver'
            }
        }

        local vehicleTier = Config.VipVehicles[vipType]
        local tvTier = Config.TVRemote[vipType]
        local dailyTier = Config.DailyItems[vipType]

        if Config.VipVehicles.enabled and vehicleTier and vehicleTier.enabled then
            options[#options + 1] = {
                title = 'Claim Kendaraan VIP',
                description = 'Lihat daftar kendaraan yang tersedia',
                icon = 'fas fa-car',
                iconColor = 'blue',
                onSelect = function()
                    openVehicleClaimMenu(vipData)
                end
            }
        end

        if Config.TVRemote.enabled and tvTier and tvTier.enabled then
            options[#options + 1] = {
                title = 'Claim TV Remote',
                description = 'Claim remote TV (1x per periode VIP)',
                icon = 'fas fa-tv',
                iconColor = 'purple',
                onSelect = function()
                    openTVRemoteClaimMenu(vipData)
                end
            }
        end

        if Config.DailyItems.enabled and dailyTier and dailyTier.enabled then
            options[#options + 1] = {
                title = 'Claim Daily Item',
                description = 'Lihat daftar item harian yang tersedia',
                icon = 'fas fa-gift',
                iconColor = 'green',
                onSelect = function()
                    openDailyItemMenu(vipData)
                end
            }
        end

        lib.registerContext({
            id = 'sm_vip_status',
            title = 'VIP Status',
            options = options
        })
        lib.showContext('sm_vip_status')
    end)
end

local function spawnVipNPC()
    if npcEntity and DoesEntityExist(npcEntity) then return end

    local npc = Config.VipNPC
    local coords = npc.coords

    if not lib.requestModel(npc.model, 10000) then
        lib.print.error(('sm_vip: gagal load model NPC "%s"'):format(npc.model))
        return
    end

    npcEntity = CreatePed(4, npc.model, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z - 1.0, coords.w, false, true)

    SetEntityInvincible(npcEntity, true)
    SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(npcEntity, true)
    FreezeEntityPosition(npcEntity, true)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(npc.model)

    if npc.scenario then
        TaskStartScenarioInPlace(npcEntity, npc.scenario, 0, true)
    end

    ox_target:addLocalEntity(npcEntity, {
        {
            name = 'sm_vip_check',
            icon = 'fas fa-crown',
            label = 'Check VIP Status',
            onSelect = checkVipStatus
        }
    })
end

    interface.focus(true, true)

local renderer = localmodule 'modules.renderer'
local config = localmodule 'config.shared'

local event = localmodule 'enum.event'
local settings = config.Settings or {}

RegisterNetEvent(event.SYNC, function(payload)
    renderer:applyPayload(payload)
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resourceName)
    if resourceName == GetCurrentResourceName() then
        renderer:clearAll()
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:OnJobUpdate', function(job)
    renderer:clearAll()
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:OnPlayerUnload', function()
    renderer:clearAll()
end)

CreateThread(function()
    while not QBPlayerData.job do
        Wait(500)
    end

    TriggerServerEvent(event.REQUEST_SYNC)
end)

CreateThread(function()
    local siren = settings.siren or {}
    if not siren.enabled then return end

    local lastState = false

    while true do
        local vehicle = cache.vehicle
        local state = vehicle and IsVehicleSirenOn(vehicle) == true or false

        if state ~= lastState then
            lastState = state
            TriggerServerEvent(event.SIREN, state)
        end

        Wait(siren.checkInterval or 500)
    end
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\resource\rhd_job_blip\modules\instance.lua
---@class JobBlipMember
---@field source number
---@field name string
---@field coords? vector3
---@field sprite? number
---@field color? number
---@field mock? boolean
---@field velocity? vector3

---@class JobBlipInstance
---@field jobName string
---@field config table
---@field members table<string, JobBlipMember>
---@field viewers table<number, true>
---@field dirtyUpserts table<string, JobBlipMember>
---@field dirtyRemoves string[]
---@field revision number
---@field nextUpdate number
local JobBlipInstance = lib.class('JobBlipInstance')

---@param jobName string
---@param config table
function JobBlipInstance:constructor(jobName, config)
    self.jobName = jobName
    self.config = config
    self.members = {}
    self.viewers = {}
    self.dirtyUpserts = {}
    self.dirtyRemoves = {}
    self.revision = 0
    self.nextUpdate = 0
end

---@param viewerJob string?
---@return boolean
function JobBlipInstance:canBeSeenBy(viewerJob)
    if not viewerJob then return false end
    return viewerJob == self.jobName or (self.config.shared and self.config.shared[viewerJob] == true)
end

---@param source number
function JobBlipInstance:addViewer(source)
    self.viewers[source] = true
end

---@param source number
function JobBlipInstance:removeViewer(source)
    self.viewers[source] = nil
end

---@param source number
---@return boolean
function JobBlipInstance:hasViewer(source)
    return self.viewers[source] == true
end

---@param source number
---@param identifier string
---@param name string
---@param sprite? number
---@param color? number
---@return boolean
function JobBlipInstance:addMember(source, identifier, name, sprite, color)
    if not identifier then return false end

    local member = self.members[identifier]

    if member
        and member.source == source
        and member.name == name
        and member.sprite == sprite
        and member.color == color
    then
        return false
    end

    self.members[identifier] = {
        source = source,
        name = name,
        coords = member and member.coords or nil,
        sprite = sprite,
        color = color
    }

    self:markDirty(identifier)
    return true
end

---@param identifier string
---@param name string
---@param coords vector3
---@param sprite? number
---@param velocity? vector3
---@return boolean
function JobBlipInstance:addMockMember(identifier, name, coords, sprite, velocity)
    local member = self.members[identifier]

    if member
        and member.name == name
        and member.coords
        and #(member.coords - coords) <= 0.01
        and member.sprite == sprite
    then
        return false
    end

    self.members[identifier] = {
        source = -1,
        name = name,
        coords = coords,
        sprite = sprite,
        mock = true,
        velocity = velocity
    }

    self:markDirty(identifier)
    return true
end

---@param identifier string?
---@param sprite? number
---@param color? number
---@return boolean
function JobBlipInstance:setMemberBlipOverride(identifier, sprite, color)
    if not identifier then return false end

    local member = self.members[identifier]
    if not member or (member.sprite == sprite and member.color == color) then return false end

    member.sprite = sprite
    member.color = color
    self:markDirty(identifier)

    return true
end

---@param identifier string?
---@return boolean
function JobBlipInstance:removeMember(identifier)
    if not identifier or not self.members[identifier] then return false end

    self.members[identifier] = nil
    self:markDirty(nil, identifier)

    return true
end

---@return boolean
function JobBlipInstance:updateMemberCoords()
    local hasUpdates = false

    for identifier, member in pairs(self.members) do
        if member.mock then
            if member.velocity and member.coords then
                member.coords = member.coords + member.velocity
                self.dirtyUpserts[identifier] = member
                hasUpdates = true
            end
        else
            local playerPed = GetPlayerPed(member.source)

            if playerPed and playerPed ~= 0 then
                local coords = GetEntityCoords(playerPed)

                if not member.coords or #(member.coords - coords) > 1.0 then
                    member.coords = coords
                    self.dirtyUpserts[identifier] = member
                    hasUpdates = true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if hasUpdates then
        self:markDirty()
    end

    return hasUpdates
end

---@param upsertKey? string
---@param removeKey? string
function JobBlipInstance:markDirty(upsertKey, removeKey)
    self.revision = self.revision + 1

    if upsertKey then
        self.dirtyUpserts[upsertKey] = self.members[upsertKey]
    end

    if removeKey then
        self.dirtyUpserts[removeKey] = nil
        self.dirtyRemoves[#self.dirtyRemoves + 1] = removeKey
    end
end

function JobBlipInstance:clearDirty()
    self.dirtyUpserts = {}
    self.dirtyRemoves = {}
end

---@param defaultInterval number
---@return number
function JobBlipInstance:getUpdateInterval(defaultInterval)
    return self.config.updateInterval or defaultInterval
end

---@param now number
---@param defaultInterval number
---@return boolean
function JobBlipInstance:shouldUpdate(now, defaultInterval)
    return now >= self.nextUpdate
end

---@param now number
---@param defaultInterval number
function JobBlipInstance:scheduleNextUpdate(now, defaultInterval)
    self.nextUpdate = now + self:getUpdateInterval(defaultInterval)
end

---@param defaultLimit? number
---@return number?
function JobBlipInstance:getMaxVisibleMembers(defaultLimit)
    local limit = self.config.maxVisibleMembers

    if limit == nil then
        limit = defaultLimit
    end

    if not limit or limit <= 0 then
        return nil
    end

    return math.floor(limit)
end

---@param defaultLimit? number
---@return boolean
function JobBlipInstance:isOverVisibleLimit(defaultLimit)
    local limit = self:getMaxVisibleMembers(defaultLimit)
    if not limit then return false end

    local count = 0
    for _ in pairs(self.members) do
        count = count + 1

        if count > limit then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

---@param defaultLimit? number
---@return table<string, JobBlipMember>
function JobBlipInstance:getLimitedMembers(defaultLimit)
    local limit = self:getMaxVisibleMembers(defaultLimit)
    if not limit then return self.members end

    local members = {}
    local count = 0

    for identifier, member in pairs(self.members) do
        count = count + 1
        if count > limit then break end

        members[identifier] = member
    end

    return members
end

---@return table
function JobBlipInstance:toPayload(defaultLimit)
    return {
        action = 'set',
        jobName = self.jobName,
        revision = self.revision,
        color = self.config.color,
        members = self:getLimitedMembers(defaultLimit)
    }
end

---@return table
function JobBlipInstance:toDeltaPayload(defaultLimit)
    if self:isOverVisibleLimit(defaultLimit) then
        return self:toPayload(defaultLimit)
    end

    return {
        action = 'delta',
        jobName = self.jobName,
        revision = self.revision,
        color = self.config.color,
        upserts = self.dirtyUpserts,
        removes = self.dirtyRemoves
    }
end

---@return table
function JobBlipInstance:toClearPayload()
    return {
        action = 'clear',
        jobName = self.jobName,
        revision = self.revision
    }
end

return JobBlipInstance

---@class MockPlayersOptions
---@field spread? number
---@field moving? boolean
---@field moveStep? number
---@field sprite? number
---@field command? string
---@field clearCommand? string
---@field defaultCount? number
---@field color? number

---@class MockPlayersContext
---@field getInstance fun(instanceName: string): JobBlipInstance?
---@field ensureViewer fun(source: number, instance: JobBlipInstance)
---@field syncInstance fun(instance: JobBlipInstance)
---@field beforeSpawn? fun(source: number)

---@class MockPlayers
---@field instanceName string
---@field count number
---@field options MockPlayersOptions
local MockPlayers = lib.class('MockPlayers')

---@param instanceName string
---@param count number
---@param options? MockPlayersOptions
function MockPlayers:constructor(instanceName, count, options)
    self.instanceName = instanceName
    self.count = count
    self.options = options or {}
end

---@param source number
---@return vector3
function MockPlayers:getCenter(source)
    local ped = source > 0 and GetPlayerPed(source) or 0

    if ped and ped ~= 0 then
        return GetEntityCoords(ped)
    end

    return vector3(0.0, 0.0, 72.0)
end

---@param index number
---@return vector3
function MockPlayers:getOffset(index)
    local spread = self.options.spread or 1500.0
    local angle = (index / self.count) * math.pi * 2.0
    local ring = math.floor((index - 1) / 60) + 1
    local radius = math.min(spread, 35.0 * ring)

    return vector3(math.cos(angle) * radius, math.sin(angle) * radius, 0.0)
end

---@param index number
---@return vector3?
function MockPlayers:getVelocity(index)
    if not self.options.moving then return nil end

    local step = self.options.moveStep or 8.0
    local angle = (index % 360) * math.pi / 180.0

    return vector3(math.cos(angle) * step, math.sin(angle) * step, 0.0)
end

---@param index number
---@return string
function MockPlayers:getIdentifier(index)
    return ('mock:%s:%03d'):format(self.instanceName, index)
end

---@param blipInstance JobBlipInstance
---@return number
function MockPlayers:clear(blipInstance)
    local removed = 0

    for identifier, member in pairs(blipInstance.members) do
        if member.mock and blipInstance:removeMember(identifier) then
            removed = removed + 1
        end
    end

    return removed
end

---@param source number
---@param blipInstance JobBlipInstance
---@return number
function MockPlayers:spawn(source, blipInstance)
    local center = self:getCenter(source)

    self:clear(blipInstance)

    for i = 1, self.count do
        local identifier = self:getIdentifier(i)
        local coords = center + self:getOffset(i)

        blipInstance:addMockMember(
            identifier,
            ('Mock %03d'):format(i),
            coords,
            self.options.sprite,
            self:getVelocity(i)
        )
    end

    return self.count
end

---@param value string?
---@param fallback number
---@param min number
---@param max number
---@return number
function MockPlayers.parseBoundedNumber(value, fallback, min, max)
    local parsed = tonumber(value) or fallback
    parsed = math.floor(parsed)

    if parsed < min then return min end
    if parsed > max then return max end

    return parsed
end

---@param options MockPlayersOptions
---@return string
function MockPlayers.getInstanceName(options)
    return options.instance or '__mock'
end

---@param options MockPlayersOptions
---@return table
function MockPlayers.getInstanceConfig(options)
    return {
        color = options.color or 5,
        shared = {}
    }
end

---@param options MockPlayersOptions
---@param count? number
---@return MockPlayers
function MockPlayers.newFromOptions(options, count)
    return MockPlayers:new(
        MockPlayers.getInstanceName(options),
        count or options.defaultCount or 500,
        options
    )
end

---@param source number
---@param context MockPlayersContext
function MockPlayers:spawnForSource(source, context)
    local instance = context.getInstance(self.instanceName)

    if not instance then
        lib.print.warn(('[rhd_job_blip] Mock instance "%s" does not exist.'):format(self.instanceName))
        return
    end

    if source > 0 and context.beforeSpawn then
        context.beforeSpawn(source)
    end

    context.ensureViewer(source, instance)
    self:spawn(source, instance)
    context.syncInstance(instance)

    lib.print.info(('[rhd_job_blip] Created %s mock blips in instance "%s".'):format(self.count, self.instanceName))
end

---@param context MockPlayersContext
---@return number
function MockPlayers:clearForContext(context)
    local instance = context.getInstance(self.instanceName)
    if not instance then return 0 end

    local removed = self:clear(instance)

    if removed > 0 then
        context.syncInstance(instance)
    end

    return removed
end

---@param options MockPlayersOptions
---@param context MockPlayersContext
function MockPlayers.registerCommands(options, context)
    local manager

    RegisterCommand(options.command or 'jobblip_mock', function(source, args)
        local count = MockPlayers.parseBoundedNumber(args[1], options.defaultCount or 500, 1, 2000)

        manager = MockPlayers.newFromOptions(options, count)
        manager:spawnForSource(source, context)
    end, false)

    RegisterCommand(options.clearCommand or 'jobblip_mock_clear', function()
        manager = manager or MockPlayers.newFromOptions(options, 0)

        local removed = manager:clearForContext(context)
        lib.print.info(('[rhd_job_blip] Removed %s mock blips from instance "%s".'):format(removed, manager.instanceName))
    end, false)
end

return MockPlayers

        table.wipe(playerManager[source])
        playerManager[source] = nil
    end

    local source = source --[[@as number]]

    if playerManager[source] then
        playerManager[source]:setduty(onduty)
    end
end)

    if playerManager[source] then
        playerManager[source]:setjob(job)

    local player = sm_core:GetPlayer(source)
    if not player then return end

    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: undefined-field

    blipUpdate(source, true)
end)

    blipUpdate.logout(source)
    removePlayer(source)
end)

    blipUpdate.logout(source)
    removePlayer(source)
end)

    for _, instance in pairs(players) do

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\resource\rhd_job_blip\modules\renderer.lua
local config = localmodule 'config.shared'
local settings = config.Settings or {}

---@class JobBlipRecord
---@field id number
---@field kind 'entity'|'coord'
---@field entity? number
---@field signature string

---@class JobBlipTarget
---@field kind 'entity'|'coord'
---@field entity? number
---@field coords? vector3
---@field isCoordBlip boolean
---@field vehicleType? string

---@class JobBlipRenderer
---@field activeBlips table<string, table<string, JobBlipRecord>>
---@field revisions table<string, number>
local JobBlipRenderer = {
    activeBlips = {},
    revisions = {}
}

local BLIP_SPRITES = {
    bike = 226,
    automobile = 225,
    boat = 427,
    heli = 43,
    plane = 307,
    default = 1
}

local BLIP_CATEGORY = 7
local BLIP_SCALE = 0.8
local UPDATE_DISTANCE = 150.0

---@param blipId number
---@param name string
---@param color number?
---@param isCoordBlip boolean
---@param vehicleType? string
local function configureBlip(blipId, name, color, isCoordBlip, vehicleType)
    if not blipId or not DoesBlipExist(blipId) then return end

    SetBlipCategory(blipId, BLIP_CATEGORY)
    SetBlipSprite(blipId, type(vehicleType) == 'number' and vehicleType or BLIP_SPRITES[vehicleType] or BLIP_SPRITES.default)
    SetBlipColour(blipId, color or 3)
    SetBlipDisplay(blipId, 6)
    SetBlipFlashes(blipId, false)

    local scale = BLIP_SCALE
    local sirenSettings = settings.siren or {}
    if sirenSettings.enabled and type(vehicleType) == 'number' and vehicleType == (sirenSettings.sprite or 42) then
        scale = sirenSettings.scale or 0.5
    end
    SetBlipScale(blipId, scale)

    if not isCoordBlip then
        SetBlipAsShortRange(blipId, true)
        SetBlipShowCone(blipId, true)
    end

    BeginTextCommandSetBlipName('STRING')
    AddTextComponentString(name)
    EndTextCommandSetBlipName(blipId)
end

---@param member JobBlipMember
---@param color number?
---@param target JobBlipTarget
---@return string
local function getBlipSignature(member, color, target)
    return ('%s|%s|%s|%s'):format(member.name, member.color or color or 3, target.kind, member.sprite or target.vehicleType or 'default')
end

---@param record JobBlipRecord?
local function removeRecord(record)
    if record and DoesBlipExist(record.id) then
        RemoveBlip(record.id)
    end
end

---@param ped number
---@return string?
local function getVehicleType(ped)
    local vehicle = GetVehiclePedIsIn(ped, false)
    return vehicle ~= 0 and GetVehicleType(vehicle) or nil
end

---@param playerPed number
---@return boolean
local function isPlayerNearby(playerPed)
    if playerPed == 0 or playerPed == cache.ped then return false end

    return #(GetEntityCoords(playerPed) - GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)) <= UPDATE_DISTANCE
end

---@param jobName string
function JobBlipRenderer:clearJob(jobName)
    local records = self.activeBlips[jobName]
    if not records then return end

    for _, record in pairs(records) do
        removeRecord(record)
    end

    self.activeBlips[jobName] = nil
end

function JobBlipRenderer:clearAll()
    for jobName in pairs(self.activeBlips) do
        self:clearJob(jobName)
    end
end

---@param member JobBlipMember
---@return JobBlipTarget?
local function resolveMemberTarget(member)
    local playerId = GetPlayerFromServerId(member.source)
    local playerPed = playerId ~= -1 and GetPlayerPed(playerId) or 0

    if member.source == cache.serverId then
        if settings.showSelfBlip == false then
            return
        end

        return {
            kind = 'entity',
            entity = cache.ped,
            isCoordBlip = false,
            vehicleType = member.sprite or getVehicleType(cache.ped)
        }
    end

    if DoesEntityExist(playerPed) and isPlayerNearby(playerPed) then
        return {
            kind = 'entity',
            entity = playerPed,
            isCoordBlip = false,
            vehicleType = member.sprite or getVehicleType(playerPed)
        }
    end

    if member.coords then
        return {
            kind = 'coord',
            coords = member.coords,
            isCoordBlip = true,
            vehicleType = member.sprite
        }
    end
end

---@param target JobBlipTarget
---@return number?
local function createBlip(target)
    if target.kind == 'entity' and target.entity then
        return AddBlipForEntity(target.entity)
    end

    if target.kind == 'coord' and target.coords then
        return AddBlipForCoord(target.coords.x, target.coords.y, target.coords.z)
    end
end

---@param jobName string
---@return table<string, JobBlipRecord>
function JobBlipRenderer:getJobRecords(jobName)
    local records = self.activeBlips[jobName]

    if not records then
        records = {}
        self.activeBlips[jobName] = records
    end

    return records
end

---@param record JobBlipRecord
---@param member JobBlipMember
---@param color number?
---@param target JobBlipTarget
local function updateRecord(record, member, color, target)
    if not DoesBlipExist(record.id) then return end

    if record.kind == 'coord' and target.coords then
        SetBlipCoords(record.id, target.coords.x, target.coords.y, target.coords.z)
    end

    local signature = getBlipSignature(member, color, target)

    if record.signature ~= signature then
        configureBlip(record.id, member.name, color, target.isCoordBlip, target.vehicleType)
        record.signature = signature
    end
end

---@param jobName string
---@param memberKey string
---@param member JobBlipMember
---@param color number?
function JobBlipRenderer:upsertMember(jobName, memberKey, member, color)
    local records = self:getJobRecords(jobName)
    local current = records[memberKey]
    local target = resolveMemberTarget(member)

    if not target then
        removeRecord(current)
        records[memberKey] = nil
        return
    end

    if current
        and DoesBlipExist(current.id)
        and current.kind == target.kind
        and (target.kind == 'coord' or current.entity == target.entity)
    then
        updateRecord(current, member, member.color or color, target)
        return
    end

    local blipId = createBlip(target)

    if not blipId then
        removeRecord(current)
        records[memberKey] = nil
        return
    end

    removeRecord(current)
    configureBlip(blipId, member.name, member.color or color, target.isCoordBlip, target.vehicleType)

    records[memberKey] = {
        id = blipId,
        kind = target.kind,
        entity = target.entity,
        signature = getBlipSignature(member, color, target)
    }
end

---@param jobName string
---@param memberKey string
function JobBlipRenderer:removeMember(jobName, memberKey)
    local records = self.activeBlips[jobName]
    if not records then return end

    removeRecord(records[memberKey])
    records[memberKey] = nil
end

---@param payload table
function JobBlipRenderer:applyPayload(payload)
    local jobName = payload and payload.jobName
    if not jobName then return end

    local revision = payload.revision or 0
    if revision < (self.revisions[jobName] or 0) then
        return
    end

    self.revisions[jobName] = revision

    if payload.action == 'clear' then
        self:clearJob(jobName)
        return
    end

    if payload.action == 'set' then
        local records = self:getJobRecords(jobName)
        local seen = {}

        for memberKey, member in pairs(payload.members or {}) do
            seen[memberKey] = true
            self:upsertMember(jobName, memberKey, member, payload.color)
        end

        for memberKey in pairs(records) do
            if not seen[memberKey] then
                self:removeMember(jobName, memberKey)
            end
        end

        return
    end

    if payload.action ~= 'delta' then
        return
    end

    local removes = payload.removes or {}
    for i = 1, #removes do
        local memberKey = removes[i]
        self:removeMember(jobName, memberKey)
    end

    for memberKey, member in pairs(payload.upserts or {}) do
        self:upsertMember(jobName, memberKey, member, payload.color)
    end
end

return JobBlipRenderer

local getters = {
    coords = function ()
        local coords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
        local heading = GetEntityHeading(cache.ped)
        return vec(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, heading)
    end
}

local setters = {}

RHDCache = setmetatable({}, {
    __index = function(self, key)
        local fn = getters[key]
        local value = rawget(self, key)
        
        if fn then
            value = fn()
        end

        return value
    end,
    __newindex = function(self, key, value)
        local fn = setters[key]

        if fn then
            fn(value)
        end

        rawset(self, key, value)
    end,
})

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_1\resource\rhd_utils\shared\jobhandler.lua
local handler = {}
handler.cache = {}

---@class PlayerJobGrades
---@field name string
---@field level number

---@class PlayerJob
---@field name string
---@field type? string
---@field onduty boolean
---@field grade PlayerJobGrades
---@field isboss boolean

---@param job PlayerJob
---@param t string|string[]|table<string, number|number[]>
---@param duty? boolean
---@return boolean
local function checkjob(job, t, duty)
    if not job then return false end

    local jn = job.name
    local jt = job.type
    local jd = job.onduty
    local jg = job.grade.level

    if duty and not jd then
        return false
    end

    local tt = type(t)

    if tt == 'string' then
        return jn == t or jt == t
    end

    if tt == 'table' then
        if array.isArray(t) then
            return tbl.contains(t, jn) or tbl.contains(t, jt)
        end

        local requirement = t[jn] or t[jt]
        if not requirement then return false end

        local rt = type(requirement)

        if rt == 'number' then
            return jg >= requirement
        end

        if rt == 'table' and array.isArray(requirement) then
            return tbl.contains(requirement, jg)
        end

        return false
    end

    return false
end

---@param t string|string[]|table<string, number>
local function checkavailable(t)
    local _t = type(t)
    local missing = {}

    if _t == 'string' then
        local count = handler.getCount(t)
        if count < 1 then
            missing[#missing + 1] = ('%s (0/1)'):format(qb_jobs[t]?.label or t)
        end
    end

    if _t == 'table' then
        if lib.array.isArray(t) then
            lib.array.forEach(t, function(val)
                local count = handler.getCount(val)
                if count < 1 then
                    missing[#missing + 1] = ('%s (0/1)'):format(qb_jobs[val]?.label or val)
                end
            end)
        else
            lib.table.forEach(t, function(required, job)
                local count = handler.getCount(job)
                if count < required then
                    missing[#missing + 1] = ('%s (%s/%s)'):format(qb_jobs[job]?.label or job, count, required)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    local available = #missing < 1

    local err = not available and ([[
Pekerjaan yang dibutuhkan tidak tersedia: %s
    ]]):format(table.concat(missing, ', ')) or nil

    return available, err
end

---@param job_table string|string[]|table<string, number>
---@return boolean, string?
function handler.checkavailable(job_table)
    return checkavailable(job_table)
end

if lib.context == 'server' then
    handler.source = {}
    handler.state = {}

    local function update(source, job)
        if not handler.source[job.name] then
            handler.state[job.name] = 0
            handler.source[job.name] = {}
        end

        local state = GlobalState
        local total = #handler.source[job.name]
        local already = array.find(handler.source[job.name], function (val)
            return val == source
        end)

        if not already then
            local oldJob = handler.cache[source]?.name
            local oldIndex = handler.source[oldJob] and array.findIndex(handler.source[oldJob], function (val)
                return val == source
            end)

            if oldIndex then
                table.remove(handler.source[oldJob], oldIndex)
                handler.state[oldJob] = #handler.source[oldJob]
            end

            handler.source[job.name][total+1] = source
            handler.state[job.name] = #handler.source[job.name]
            state:set('sm_jobcount', handler.state, true)
        end
        
        handler.cache[source] = job
    end

    local function removeCache(source)
        local oldJob = handler.cache[source]?.name
        local oldIndex = handler.source[oldJob] and array.findIndex(handler.source[oldJob], function (val)
            return val == source
        end)

        if oldIndex then
            table.remove(handler.source[oldJob], oldIndex)
        end

        handler.cache[source] = nil
    end

---Clamp a number between 2 other numbers
---@param val number
---@param lower number
---@param upper number
---@return number
function math.clamp(val, lower, upper)
    if lower > upper then lower, upper = upper, lower end
    return math.max(lower, math.min(upper, val))
end

---Rounds a number to a whole number or to the specified number of decimal places.
---@param value number | string
---@param places? number | string
---@return number
function math.round(value, places)
    ---@type number
    local n = type(value) == 'string' and tonumber(value) or value --[[@as number]]
    if type(n) ~= 'number' then error('Value must be a number') end

    if places then
        ---@type number
        local p = type(places) == 'string' and tonumber(places) or places --[[@as number]]
        if type(p) ~= 'number' then error('Places must be a number') end
        places = p

        if p > 0 then
            local mult = 10 ^ p
            return math.floor(n * mult + 0.5) / mult
        end
    end

    return math.floor(n + 0.5)
end

---Converts input number into grouped digits
---@param number number
---@param separator? string
---@return string
function math.groupdigits(number, separator)
    local left, num, right = string.match(tostring(number), '^([^%d]*%d)(%d*)(.-)$')
    return left .. (num:reverse():gsub('(%d%d%d)', '%1' .. (separator or ',')):reverse()) .. right
end

---Formats a number as a hexadecimal string.
---@param n number | string
---@param upper? boolean
---@return string
function math.tohex(n, upper)
    local formatString = ('0x%s'):format(upper and '%X' or '%x')
    return formatString:format(n)
end

---Takes a hexadecimal string and returns three integers (R, G, B).
---@param input string
---@return integer r
---@return integer g
---@return integer b
function math.hextorgb(input)
    local r, g, b = string.match(input, '([^#]+.)(..)(..)')
    return tonumber(r, 16), tonumber(g, 16), tonumber(b, 16)
end

---Calculates an intermediate value between `start` and `finish` based on the interpolation `factor`.
---@param start number
---@param finish number
---@param factor number The interpolation factor between 0 and 1.
---@return number
function math.interp(start, finish, factor)
    return start + (finish - start) * factor
end

---Check if a number is NaN (not a number).
---@param n any
---@return boolean
function math.isnan(n)
    return n ~= n
end

---Check if a number is finite (not NaN or infinity).
---@param n number
---@return boolean
function math.isfinite(n)
    return n == n and n ~= math.huge and n ~= -math.huge
end

---Check if a number is infinite.
---@param n number
---@return boolean
function math.isinfinite(n)
    return n == math.huge or n == -math.huge
end

---Check if a number is an integer (no fractional part).
---@param n number
---@return boolean
function math.isinteger(n)
    return n == math.floor(n)
end

---Get the sign of a number: returns 1, -1, or 0.
---@param n number
---@return number
function math.sign(n)
    if n > 0 then return 1
    elseif n < 0 then return -1
    else return 0 end
end

---Truncate a number toward zero (remove decimal part).
---@param n number
---@return number
function math.trunc(n)
    return n >= 0 and math.floor(n) or math.ceil(n)
end

---Get the fractional part of a number.
---@param n number
---@return number
function math.frac(n)
    return n - math.trunc(n)
end

---Wrap a value within a range [min, max).
---Useful for angles, cyclic values, etc.
---@param n number
---@param min number
---@param max number
---@return number
function math.wrap(n, min, max)
    local range = max - min
    if range == 0 then return min end
    return min + ((n - min) % range)
end

---Map a value from one range to another.
---@param value number
---@param inMin number
---@param inMax number
---@param outMin number
---@param outMax number
---@return number
function math.map(value, inMin, inMax, outMin, outMax)
    if inMin == inMax then return outMin end
    return outMin + (value - inMin) * (outMax - outMin) / (inMax - inMin)
end

---Normalize a value to a 0..1 range within [min, max].
---@param value number
---@param min number
---@param max number
---@return number
function math.normalize(value, min, max)
    if min == max then return 0 end
    return (value - min) / (max - min)
end

---Smooth step interpolation (ease-in-out) between 0 and 1.
---@param edge0 number Lower edge
---@param edge1 number Upper edge
---@param x number Input value
---@return number
function math.smoothstep(edge0, edge1, x)
    x = math.clamp((x - edge0) / (edge1 - edge0), 0.0, 1.0)
    return x * x * (3 - 2 * x)
end

---Smoother step interpolation (Ken Perlin's version) between 0 and 1.
---@param edge0 number Lower edge
---@param edge1 number Upper edge
---@param x number Input value
---@return number
function math.smootherstep(edge0, edge1, x)
    x = math.clamp((x - edge0) / (edge1 - edge0), 0.0, 1.0)
    return x * x * x * (x * (x * 6 - 15) + 10)
end

---Return average (mean) of a list of numbers.
---@param ... number
---@return number
function math.average(...)
    local args = {...}
    local sum = 0
    local count = #args
    if count == 0 then return 0 end
    for i = 1, count do
        sum = sum + args[i]
    end
    return sum / count
end

---Return the sum of a list of numbers.
---@param ... number
---@return number
function math.sum(...)
    local args = {...}
    local total = 0
    for i = 1, #args do
        total = total + args[i]
    end
    return total
end

---Return the minimum value from a table (array of numbers).
---@param t table
---@return number?
function math.tmin(t)
    local min = nil
    for i = 1, #t do
        if min == nil or t[i] < min then
            min = t[i]
        end
    end
    return min
end

---Return the maximum value from a table (array of numbers).
---@param t table
---@return number?
function math.tmax(t)
    local max = nil
    for i = 1, #t do
        if max == nil or t[i] > max then
            max = t[i]
        end
    end
    return max
end

---Return the median of a list of numbers.
---@param t table
---@return number
function math.median(t)
    local sorted = {}
    for i = 1, #t do sorted[i] = t[i] end
    table.sort(sorted)
    local n = #sorted
    if n == 0 then return 0 end
    if n % 2 == 1 then
        return sorted[math.ceil(n / 2)]
    else
        return (sorted[n / 2] + sorted[n / 2 + 1]) / 2
    end
end

---Return the variance of a list of numbers.
---@param t table
---@param population? boolean Use population variance (default: sample variance)
---@return number
function math.variance(t, population)
    local n = #t
    if n < 2 then return 0 end

    local mean = 0
    for i = 1, n do mean = mean + t[i] end
    mean = mean / n

    local sumSq = 0
    for i = 1, n do
        local diff = t[i] - mean
        sumSq = sumSq + diff * diff
    end

    return sumSq / (population and n or (n - 1))
end

---Return the standard deviation of a list of numbers.
---@param t table
---@param population? boolean Use population std dev (default: sample)
---@return number
function math.stddev(t, population)
    return math.sqrt(math.variance(t, population))
end

---Greatest common divisor (GCD) of two integers.
---@param a integer
---@param b integer
---@return integer
function math.gcd(a, b)
    a, b = math.abs(a), math.abs(b)
    while b ~= 0 do
        a, b = b, a % b
    end
    return a
end

---Least common multiple (LCM) of two integers.
---@param a integer
---@param b integer
---@return integer
function math.lcm(a, b)
    if a == 0 or b == 0 then return 0 end
    return math.abs(a * b) / math.gcd(a, b)
end

---Check if an integer is prime.
---@param n integer
---@return boolean
function math.isprime(n)
    if n < 2 then return false end
    if n == 2 then return true end
    if n % 2 == 0 then return false end
    local limit = math.floor(math.sqrt(n))
    for i = 3, limit, 2 do
        if n % i == 0 then return false end
    end
    return true
end

---Factorial of a non-negative integer.
---@param n integer
---@return integer
function math.factorial(n)
    if n < 0 then error('factorial of negative number', 2) end
    if n == 0 then return 1 end
    local result = 1
    for i = 2, n do
        result = result * i
    end
    return result
end

---Fibonacci number at position n (0-indexed).
---@param n integer
---@return integer
function math.fibonacci(n)
    if n < 0 then error('fibonacci of negative index', 2) end
    if n == 0 then return 0 end
    if n == 1 then return 1 end
    local a, b = 0, 1
    for _ = 2, n do
        a, b = b, a + b
    end
    return b
end

---Degrees to radians.

function math.torad(deg)
    return deg * (math.pi / 180.0)
end

---Radians to degrees.
---@param rad number
---@return number
function math.todeg(rad)
    return rad * (180.0 / math.pi)
end

---Calculate the 2D distance between two points.
---@param x1 number
---@param y1 number
---@param x2 number
---@param y2 number
---@return number
function math.dist2d(x1, y1, x2, y2)
    local dx = x2 - x1
    local dy = y2 - y1
    return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
end

---Calculate the 3D distance between two points.
---@param x1 number
---@param y1 number
---@param z1 number
---@param x2 number
---@param y2 number
---@param z2 number
---@return number
function math.dist3d(x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2)
    local dx = x2 - x1
    local dy = y2 - y1
    local dz = z2 - z1
    return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
end

---Calculate bearing angle in degrees from point A to point B (2D, north = 0).
---@param x1 number
---@param y1 number
---@param x2 number
---@param y2 number
---@return number degrees 0-360
function math.bearing(x1, y1, x2, y2)
    local angle = math.todeg(math.atan(x2 - x1, y2 - y1))
    return math.wrap(angle, 0, 360)
end

function math.randomfloat(min, max)

end

---Inverse linear interpolation: given a value between a and b, return the factor.

---@param b number
---@param value number

function math.inverselerp(a, b, value)
    if a == b then return 0 end

---Exponential decay: moves `current` toward `target` by `decay` per second.
---Use in render/tick loops: value = math.decay(value, target, decay, dt)
---@param current number
---@param target number
---@param decay number Decay rate (higher = faster)
---@param dt number Delta time in seconds
---@return number
function math.decay(current, target, decay, dt)
    return target + (current - target) * math.exp(-decay * dt)
end

    return math.abs(a - b) <= epsilon
end

function math.safediv(numerator, denominator, fallback)

local f = setmetatable({}, {
    __newindex = function(self, key, fn)
        rawset(self, key, fn)
    end
})

---@param cb function Callback function to execute safely
---@param ... any Arguments to pass to callback
---@return any|nil result Returns callback result or nil on error
function f.fun(cb, ...)
    assert(type(cb) == 'function', 'safecall: callback must be a function')

    local success, result = pcall(cb, ...)

    if not success then
        local info = debug.getinfo(2, 'Sl')
        local source = info.source:match('^@?(.+)$') or info.source
        local line = info.currentline or 0
        
        lib.print.error(('safecall failed at %s:%d\n%s'):format(source, line, result))
        return nil
    end

    return result
end

_ENV.safecall = f

---@alias CaseType
---| 'upper'      # UPPERCASE
---| 'lower'      # lowercase
---| 'title'      # Title Case
---| 'sentence'   # Sentence case
---| 'camel'      # camelCase
---| 'pascal'     # PascalCase
---| 'snake'      # snake_case
---| 'kebab'      # kebab-case

---Return empty string
---@return string
function string.empty()
    return ''
end

---Check if string is empty or nil
---@param s string?
---@return boolean
function string.isempty(s)
    return not s or s == ''
end

---Check if string is blank (empty or only whitespace)
---@param s string?
---@return boolean
function string.isblank(s)
    return not s or s:match('^%s*$') ~= nil
end

---Trim whitespace from both ends
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.trim(s)
    return s:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$')
end

---Trim whitespace from start
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.ltrim(s)
    return s:match('^%s*(.-)$')
end

---Trim whitespace from end
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.rtrim(s)
    return s:match('^(.-)%s*$')
end

---Split string by delimiter
---@param s string
---@param delimiter string
---@param plain? boolean Use plain text matching (default: true)
---@return table
function string.split(s, delimiter, plain)
    if plain == nil then plain = true end
    
    local result = {}
    local from = 1
    local delim_from, delim_to = s:find(delimiter, from, plain)
    
    while delim_from do
        result[#result + 1] = s:sub(from, delim_from - 1)
        from = delim_to + 1
        delim_from, delim_to = s:find(delimiter, from, plain)
    end
    
    result[#result + 1] = s:sub(from)
    return result
end

---Join table elements with delimiter
---@param tbl table
---@param delimiter string
---@return string
function string.join(tbl, delimiter)
    return table.concat(tbl, delimiter)
end

---Check if string starts with prefix
---@param s string
---@param prefix string
---@return boolean
function string.startswith(s, prefix)
    return s:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix
end

---Check if string ends with suffix
---@param s string
---@param suffix string
---@return boolean
function string.endswith(s, suffix)
    return s:sub(-#suffix) == suffix
end

---Check if string contains substring
---@param s string
---@param substr string
---@param plain? boolean Use plain text matching (default: true)
---@return boolean
function string.contains(s, substr, plain)
    if plain == nil then plain = true end
    return s:find(substr, 1, plain) ~= nil
end

---Count occurrences of substring
---@param s string
---@param substr string
---@param plain? boolean Use plain text matching (default: true)
---@return number
function string.count(s, substr, plain)
    if plain == nil then plain = true end
    
    local count = 0
    local pos = 1
    
    while true do
        local found = s:find(substr, pos, plain)
        if not found then break end
        count = count + 1
        pos = found + 1
    end
    
    return count
end

---Replace all occurrences
---@param s string
---@param old string
---@param new string
---@param plain? boolean Use plain text matching (default: true)
---@return string
function string.replace(s, old, new, plain)
    if plain == nil then plain = true end
    if plain then
        old = old:gsub('[%^%$%(%)%%%.%[%]%*%+%-%?]', '%%%1')
    end
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: redundant-return-value
    return s:gsub(old, new)
end

---Capitalize first character
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.capitalize(s)
    return s:sub(1, 1):upper() .. s:sub(2)
end

---Convert to title case
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.title(s)
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: redundant-return-value
    return s:gsub('(%a)([%w_]*)', function(first, rest)
        return first:upper() .. rest:lower()
    end)
end

---Convert to camelCase
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.camelcase(s)
    local result = s:gsub('[%s_-]+(%w)', function(c) return c:upper() end)
    return result:sub(1, 1):lower() .. result:sub(2)
end

---Convert to PascalCase
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.pascalcase(s)
    local result = s:gsub('[%s_-]+(%w)', function(c) return c:upper() end)
    return result:sub(1, 1):upper() .. result:sub(2)
end

---Convert to snake_case
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.snakecase(s)
    local result = s:gsub('([A-Z])', '_%1'):lower()
    result = result:gsub('[%s-]+', '_')
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: redundant-return-value
    return result:gsub('^_', '')
end

---Convert to kebab-case
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.kebabcase(s)
    local result = s:gsub('([A-Z])', '-%1'):lower()
    result = result:gsub('[%s_]+', '-')
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: redundant-return-value
    return result:gsub('^-', '')
end

---Convert to CONSTANT_CASE
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.constantcase(s)
    return string.snakecase(s):upper()
end

---Convert to specified case
---@param s string
---@param caseType CaseType
---@return string
function string.tocase(s, caseType)
    if caseType == 'upper' then
        return s:upper()
    elseif caseType == 'lower' then
        return s:lower()
    elseif caseType == 'title' then
        return string.title(s)
    elseif caseType == 'sentence' then
        return string.capitalize(s:lower())
    elseif caseType == 'camel' then
        return string.camelcase(s)
    elseif caseType == 'pascal' then
        return string.pascalcase(s)
    elseif caseType == 'snake' then
        return string.snakecase(s)
    elseif caseType == 'kebab' then
        return string.kebabcase(s)
    elseif caseType == 'constant' then
        return string.constantcase(s)
    end
    return s
end

---Repeat string n times
---@param s string
---@param count number
---@param separator? string
---@return string
function string.repeatstr(s, count, separator)
    separator = separator or ''
    local result = {}
    for i = 1, count do
        result[#result + 1] = s
    end
    return table.concat(result, separator)
end

---Pad string to length
---@param s string
---@param length number
---@param char? string Character to pad with (default: ' ')
---@param direction? 'left'|'right'|'both' Direction to pad (default: 'right')
---@return string
function string.pad(s, length, char, direction)
    char = char or ' '
    direction = direction or 'right'
    
    local len = #s
    if len >= length then return s end
    
    local padding = string.rep(char, length - len)
    
    if direction == 'left' then
        return padding .. s
    elseif direction == 'right' then
        return s .. padding
    elseif direction == 'both' then
        local leftPad = math.floor((length - len) / 2)
        local rightPad = length - len - leftPad
        return string.rep(char, leftPad) .. s .. string.rep(char, rightPad)
    end
    
    return s
end

---Truncate string to length
---@param s string
---@param length number
---@param suffix? string Suffix to add (default: '...')
---@return string
function string.truncate(s, length, suffix)
    suffix = suffix or '...'
    if #s <= length then return s end
    return s:sub(1, length - #suffix) .. suffix
end

---Get substring between two delimiters
---@param s string
---@param start_delim string
---@param end_delim string
---@return string?
function string.between(s, start_delim, end_delim)
    local start_pos = s:find(start_delim, 1, true)
    if not start_pos then return nil end
    
    start_pos = start_pos + #start_delim
    local end_pos = s:find(end_delim, start_pos, true)
    if not end_pos then return nil end
    
    return s:sub(start_pos, end_pos - 1)
end

---Extract all matches of pattern
---@param s string
---@param pattern string
---@return table
function string.extract(s, pattern)
    local result = {}
    for match in s:gmatch(pattern) do
        result[#result + 1] = match
    end
    return result
end

---Slugify string (URL-friendly)
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.slugify(s)
    s = s:lower()
    s = s:gsub('[Ã Ã¡Ã¢Ã£Ã¤Ã¥]', 'a')
    s = s:gsub('[Ã¨Ã©ÃªÃ«]', 'e')
    s = s:gsub('[Ã¬Ã­Ã®Ã¯]', 'i')
    s = s:gsub('[Ã²Ã³Ã´ÃµÃ¶]', 'o')
    s = s:gsub('[Ã¹ÃºÃ»Ã¼]', 'u')
    s = s:gsub('[Ã±]', 'n')
    s = s:gsub('[Ã§]', 'c')
    s = s:gsub('[^%w%s-]', '')
    s = s:gsub('%s+', '-')
    s = s:gsub('-+', '-')
    s = s:gsub('^-', '')
    s = s:gsub('-$', '')
    return s
end

---Calculate Levenshtein distance
---@param str1 string
---@param str2 string
---@return number
function string.levenshtein(str1, str2)
    if str1 == str2 then return 0 end
    if #str1 == 0 then return #str2 end
    if #str2 == 0 then return #str1 end
    
    local matrix = {}
    
    for i = 0, #str1 do
        matrix[i] = { [0] = i }
    end
    
    for j = 0, #str2 do
        matrix[0][j] = j
    end
    
    for i = 1, #str1 do
        for j = 1, #str2 do
            local cost = str1:sub(i, i) == str2:sub(j, j) and 0 or 1
            matrix[i][j] = math.min(
                matrix[i - 1][j] + 1,
                matrix[i][j - 1] + 1,
                matrix[i - 1][j - 1] + cost
            )
        end
    end
    
    return matrix[#str1][#str2]
end

---Calculate similarity percentage
---@param str1 string
---@param str2 string
---@return number percentage 0-100
function string.similarity(str1, str2)
    local distance = string.levenshtein(str1, str2)
    local maxLen = math.max(#str1, #str2)
    if maxLen == 0 then return 100 end
    return (1 - distance / maxLen) * 100
end

---Word wrap text
---@param s string
---@param width number
---@return string
function string.wordwrap(s, width)
    local result = {}
    local line = ''
    
    for word in s:gmatch('%S+') do
        if #line + #word + 1 > width then
            result[#result + 1] = line
            line = word
        else
            line = line == '' and word or line .. ' ' .. word
        end
    end
    
    if #line > 0 then
        result[#result + 1] = line
    end
    
    return table.concat(result, '\n')
end

---Get lines from string
---@param s string
---@return table
function string.lines(s)
    local result = {}
    for line in s:gmatch('[^\r\n]+') do
        result[#result + 1] = line
    end
    return result
end

---Encode to base64
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.base64encode(s)
    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    return ((s:gsub('.', function(x)
        local r, b = '', x:byte()
        for i = 8, 1, -1 do r = r .. (b % 2 ^ i - b % 2 ^ (i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0') end
        return r
    end) .. '0000'):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if #x < 6 then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 6 do c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2 ^ (6 - i) or 0) end
        return b:sub(c + 1, c + 1)
    end) .. ({ '', '==', '=' })[#s % 3 + 1])
end

---Decode from base64
---@param s string
---@return string
function string.base64decode(s)
    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    s = s:gsub('[^' .. b .. '=]', '')
    return (s:gsub('.', function(x)
        if x == '=' then return '' end
        local r, f = '', b:find(x) - 1
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do r = r .. (f % 2 ^ i - f % 2 ^ (i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0') end
        return r
    end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 8 do c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2 ^ (8 - i) or 0) end
        return string.char(c)
    end))
end

---Generate UUID v4
---@return string
function string.uuid()
    local template = 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: redundant-return-value
    return template:gsub('[xy]', function(c)
        local v = (c == 'x') and math.random(0, 0xf) or math.random(8, 0xb)
        return string.format('%x', v)
    end)
end

    end
    return result
end

end

---Format string with template
---@param template string Template with {key} placeholders
---@param data table Data to insert
---@return string
function string.template(template, data)
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: redundant-return-value
    return template:gsub('{(%w+)}', function(key)
        return tostring(data[key] or '')
    end)
end

---Hash string (simple djb2)
---@param s string
---@return number
function string.hash(s)
    local hash = 5381
    for i = 1, #s do
        hash = ((hash * 33) + s:byte(i)) % 2147483647
    end
    return hash
end

---Get value by path (dot notation)
---@param t table
---@param path string
---@return any?
function table.get(t, path)
    local keys = {}
    for key in path:gmatch('[^.]+') do
        keys[#keys + 1] = key
    end
    
    local current = t
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
        if type(current) ~= 'table' then
            return nil
        end
        current = current[key]
    end
    
    return current
end

---Set value by path (dot notation)
---@param t table
---@param path string
---@param value any
function table.set(t, path, value)
    local keys = {}
    for key in path:gmatch('[^.]+') do
        keys[#keys + 1] = key
    end
    
    local current = t
    for i = 1, #keys - 1 do
        local key = keys[i]
        if type(current[key]) ~= 'table' then
            current[key] = {}
        end
        current = current[key]
    end
    
    current[keys[#keys]] = value
end

---Delete value by path (dot notation)
---@param t table
---@param path string
function table.delete(t, path)
    local keys = {}
    for key in path:gmatch('[^.]+') do
        keys[#keys + 1] = key
    end
    
    local current = t
    for i = 1, #keys - 1 do
        local key = keys[i]
        if type(current[key]) ~= 'table' then
            return
        end
        current = current[key]
    end
    
    current[keys[#keys]] = nil
end

---Convert table to JSON string
---@param t table
---@return string
function table.toJSON(t)
    local function serialize(val)
        local valType = type(val)
        
        if valType == 'table' then
            local isArray = #val > 0
            local result = {}
            
            if isArray then
                for i, v in ipairs(val) do
                    result[#result + 1] = serialize(v)
                end
                return '[' .. table.concat(result, ',') .. ']'
            else
                for k, v in pairs(val) do
                    result[#result + 1] = '"' .. tostring(k) .. '":' .. serialize(v)
                end
                return '{' .. table.concat(result, ',') .. '}'
            end
        elseif valType == 'string' then
            return '"' .. val:gsub('"', '\\"') .. '"'
        elseif valType == 'number' or valType == 'boolean' then
            return tostring(val)
        else
            return 'null'
        end
    end
    
    return serialize(t)
end

---Print table structure (for debugging)
---@param t table
---@param indent? number
---@return string
function table.print(t, indent)
    indent = indent or 0
    local result = {}
    local prefix = string.rep('  ', indent)
    
    for k, v in pairs(t) do
        if type(v) == 'table' then
            result[#result + 1] = prefix .. tostring(k) .. ' = {'
            result[#result + 1] = table.print(v, indent + 1)
            result[#result + 1] = prefix .. '}'
        else
            result[#result + 1] = prefix .. tostring(k) .. ' = ' .. tostring(v)
        end
    end
    
    return table.concat(result, '\n')
end

---Flatten nested array by one level
---@param t table
---@return table
function array.flatten(t)
    local result = {}
    
    for _, v in ipairs(t) do
        if type(v) == 'table' then
            for _, inner in ipairs(v) do
                result[#result + 1] = inner
            end
        else
            result[#result + 1] = v
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

---Deep flatten nested arrays
---@param t table
---@return table
function array.deepflatten(t)
    local result = {}
    
    local function flatten_recursive(tbl_inner)
        for _, v in ipairs(tbl_inner) do
            if type(v) == 'table' then
                flatten_recursive(v)
            else
                result[#result + 1] = v
            end
        end
    end
    
    flatten_recursive(t)
    return result
end

---Get unique values from array

        if not seen[v] then
            seen[v] = true
            result[#result + 1] = v
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

---Get intersection of two arrays
---@param t1 table
---@param t2 table
---@return table
function array.intersection(t1, t2)
    local result = {}
    local set = {}
    
    for _, v in ipairs(t2) do
        set[v] = true
    end
    
    for _, v in ipairs(t1) do
        if set[v] then
            result[#result + 1] = v
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

    end

end

---Get union of two arrays
---@param t1 table
---@param t2 table
---@return table
function array.union(t1, t2)
    local combined = {}
    for _, v in ipairs(t1) do
        combined[#combined + 1] = v
    end
    for _, v in ipairs(t2) do
        combined[#combined + 1] = v
    end
    return array.unique(combined)
end

---Get random elements from array (without duplicates)
---@param t table
---@param count number
---@return table
function array.sample(t, count)
    local result = {}
    local indices = {}
    local len = #t
    
    count = math.min(count, len)
    
    while #indices < count do
        local idx = math.random(len)
        if not indices[idx] then
            indices[idx] = true
            result[#result + 1] = t[idx]
        end
    end
    
    return result
end

---@param t table
---@param size number
---@return table

    for i = 1, #t, size do
        local chunk = {}
        for j = i, math.min(i + size - 1, #t) do
            chunk[#chunk + 1] = t[j]
        end
        result[#result + 1] = chunk
    end
    
    return result
end

---Partition array by predicate
---@param t table
---@param fn fun(value: any, key: any): boolean
---@return table truthy
---@return table falsy
function array.partition(t, fn)
    local truthy = {}
    local falsy = {}
    
    for k, v in pairs(t) do
        if fn(v, k) then
            truthy[#truthy + 1] = v
        else
            falsy[#falsy + 1] = v
        end
    end
    
    return truthy, falsy
end

---Group array elements by key function
---@param t table
---@param fn fun(value: any): any
---@return table
function array.groupBy(t, fn)
    local result = {}
    
    for _, v in ipairs(t) do
        local key = fn(v)
        if not result[key] then
            result[key] = {}
        end
        result[key][#result[key] + 1] = v
    end
    
    return result
end

    end
    
    return result
end

---Zip multiple arrays together
---@param ... table
---@return table
function array.zip(...)
    local args = {...}
    local result = {}
    local maxLen = 0
    
    for _, t in ipairs(args) do
        maxLen = math.max(maxLen, #t)
    end
    
    for i = 1, maxLen do
        local row = {}
        for _, t in ipairs(args) do
            row[#row + 1] = t[i]
        end
        result[#result + 1] = row
    end
    
    return result
end

---Unzip array of arrays
---@param t table
---@return table ...
function array.unzip(t)
    if #t == 0 then return {} end
    
    local result = {}
    local maxLen = 0
    
    for _, row in ipairs(t) do
        maxLen = math.max(maxLen, #row)
    end
    
    for i = 1, maxLen do
        result[i] = {}
        for _, row in ipairs(t) do
            result[i][#result[i] + 1] = row[i]
        end
    end
    
    return table.unpack(result)
end

    else
        for i = start_val, end_val, step do
            result[#result + 1] = i
        end
    end

end

local Growth = localmodule 'modules.growth'
local Placer = localmodule 'modules.placer'
local Render = localmodule 'modules.render'

local TICK_MS = 250
