########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_2\interface\sm_domino\modules\engine.lua
local layout = localmodule 'modules.layout'

local random = math.random
local huge = math.huge

local engine = {}

---@class DominoTile
---@field id number
---@field lo number
---@field hi number

---@type DominoTile[]
local TILES = {}
for lo = 0, 6 do
    for hi = lo, 6 do
        TILES[#TILES + 1] = { id = #TILES + 1, lo = lo, hi = hi }
    end
end
engine.tiles = TILES

local DOUBLE_SIX = #TILES

---@param count number
---@param fourMode string
---@return string?
function engine.modeFor(count, fourMode)
    if count == 2 then return 'duel' end
    if count == 3 then return 'ffa' end
    if count == 4 then return fourMode == 'ffa' and 'ffa4' or 'pairs' end
end

---@param mode string
---@return boolean
function engine.drawMode(mode)
    return mode == 'duel' or mode == 'ffa'
end

---@param seats number[]
---@param mode string
---@param target number
---@return table
function engine.newMatch(seats, mode, target)
    local teamOf, teams = {}, 0
    for i = 1, #seats do
        local seat = seats[i]
        if mode == 'pairs' then
            teamOf[seat] = seat % 2 == 1 and 1 or 2
        else
            teamOf[seat] = i
        end
    end
    teams = mode == 'pairs' and 2 or #seats

    local scores = {}
    for i = 1, teams do scores[i] = 0 end

    return { mode = mode, seats = seats, teamOf = teamOf, teams = teams, target = target, scores = scores, round = 0 }
end

---@param match table
---@param seat number
---@return number
function engine.nextSeat(match, seat)
    local seats = match.seats
    for i = 1, #seats do
        if seats[i] == seat then
            return seats[i % #seats + 1]
        end
    end
    return seats[1]
end

---@param tile DominoTile
---@return number
local function pips(tile)
    return tile.lo + tile.hi
end

---@param hand DominoTile[]
---@return number
function engine.handPips(hand)
    local total = 0
    for i = 1, #hand do total = total + pips(hand[i]) end
    return total
end

---@return DominoTile[]
function engine.shuffleDeck()
    local deck = {}
    for i = 1, #TILES do deck[i] = TILES[i] end
    for i = #deck, 2, -1 do
        local j = random(i)
        deck[i], deck[j] = deck[j], deck[i]
    end
    return deck
end

---@param match table
---@param hands table<number, DominoTile[]>
---@param stock DominoTile[]
---@return table
function engine.beginHand(match, hands, stock)
    match.round = match.round + 1

    local hand = { hands = hands, stock = stock, board = {}, passes = 0, turn = 0 }

    local opener = match.opener
    if opener and hands[opener] then
        hand.turn = opener
        hand.free = true
        return hand
    end

    local bestSeat, bestTile, bestScore = nil, nil, -1
    for seat, tiles in pairs(hands) do
        for i = 1, #tiles do
            local tile = tiles[i]
            local score
            if engine.drawMode(match.mode) then
                score = (tile.lo == tile.hi and 100 or 0) + pips(tile)
            else
                score = tile.id == DOUBLE_SIX and 1 or -1
            end
            if score > bestScore then
                bestSeat, bestTile, bestScore = seat, tile, score
            end
        end
    end

    hand.turn = bestSeat or match.seats[1]
    hand.forced = bestTile and bestTile.id
    return hand
end

---@param match table
---@return table
function engine.newHand(match)
    local deck = engine.shuffleDeck()
    local hands, cursor = {}, 0
    for i = 1, #match.seats do
        local tiles = {}
        for n = 1, 7 do
            cursor = cursor + 1
            tiles[n] = deck[cursor]
        end
        hands[match.seats[i]] = tiles
    end

    local stock = {}
    if engine.drawMode(match.mode) then
        for i = cursor + 1, #deck do stock[#stock + 1] = deck[i] end
    end

    return engine.beginHand(match, hands, stock)
end

---@param hand table
---@param tile DominoTile
---@return boolean left
---@return boolean right
function engine.fits(hand, tile)
    if #hand.board == 0 then
        local ok = hand.free or hand.forced == nil or hand.forced == tile.id
        return ok, false
    end
    local left, right = hand.left, hand.right
    return tile.lo == left or tile.hi == left, tile.lo == right or tile.hi == right
end

---@param hand table
---@param seat number
---@return { tile: DominoTile, side: string }[]
function engine.moves(hand, seat)
    local list = {}
    local tiles = hand.hands[seat]
    if not tiles then return list end

    for i = 1, #tiles do
        local tile = tiles[i]
        local left, right = engine.fits(hand, tile)
        if left then list[#list + 1] = { tile = tile, side = 'left' } end
        if right and not (left and hand.left == hand.right) then
            list[#list + 1] = { tile = tile, side = 'right' }
        end
    end

    return list
end

---@param tiles DominoTile[]
---@param id number
---@return number?
local function indexOf(tiles, id)
    for i = 1, #tiles do
        if tiles[i].id == id then return i end
    end
end

---@param hand table
---@param seat number
---@param tileId number
---@param side string
---@return table?
function engine.play(hand, seat, tileId, side)
    if hand.turn ~= seat then return end
    if side ~= 'left' and side ~= 'right' then return end

    local tiles = hand.hands[seat]
    local index = tiles and indexOf(tiles, tileId)
    if not index then return end

    local tile = tiles[index]
    local fitsLeft, fitsRight = engine.fits(hand, tile)
    local board = hand.board

    if #board == 0 then
        if not fitsLeft then return end
        local x, y, yaw, branches = layout.first(tile)
        hand.branches = branches
        hand.left, hand.right = tile.lo, tile.hi
        board[1] = { id = tile.id, lo = tile.lo, hi = tile.hi, x = x, y = y, r = yaw, seat = seat }
    else
        if (side == 'left' and not fitsLeft) or (side == 'right' and not fitsRight) then return end

        local branchIndex = side == 'left' and 1 or 2
        local match = hand[side]
        local x, y, yaw, branch = layout.next(board, hand.branches[branchIndex], tile, match)
        hand.branches[branchIndex] = branch
        hand[side] = tile.lo == match and tile.hi or tile.lo
        board[#board + 1] = { id = tile.id, lo = tile.lo, hi = tile.hi, x = x, y = y, r = yaw, seat = seat }
    end

    table.remove(tiles, index)
    hand.passes = 0
    hand.free = nil
    hand.forced = nil

    local domino = #tiles == 0
    return { tile = tile, domino = domino }
end

---@param hand table
---@param seat number
---@return DominoTile?
function engine.draw(hand, seat)
    if hand.turn ~= seat then return end
    local stock = hand.stock
    local count = #stock
    if count == 0 then return end

    local tile = stock[count]
    stock[count] = nil
    local tiles = hand.hands[seat]
    tiles[#tiles + 1] = tile
    return tile
end

---@param hand table
---@param seat number
---@return boolean
function engine.canPass(hand, seat)
    return hand.turn == seat and #hand.stock == 0 and #engine.moves(hand, seat) == 0
end

---@param match table
---@param hand table
---@param winnerSeat number?
---@return table
function engine.score(match, hand, winnerSeat)
    local teamOf = match.teamOf
    local seatPips, teamPips = {}, {}
    for i = 1, match.teams do teamPips[i] = 0 end

    for seat, tiles in pairs(hand.hands) do
        local total = engine.handPips(tiles)
        seatPips[seat] = total
        local team = teamOf[seat]
        teamPips[team] = teamPips[team] + total
    end

    local blocked = winnerSeat == nil
    local team = winnerSeat and teamOf[winnerSeat] or 0

    if blocked then
        local lowest, ties = huge, 0
        for i = 1, match.teams do
            local total = teamPips[i]
            if total < lowest then
                lowest, team, ties = total, i, 1
            elseif total == lowest then
                ties = ties + 1
            end
        end
        if ties ~= 1 then team = 0 end

        if team ~= 0 then
            local best = huge
            for seat, total in pairs(seatPips) do
                if teamOf[seat] == team and total < best then
                    best, winnerSeat = total, seat
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local points = 0
    if team ~= 0 then
        for i = 1, match.teams do
            if i ~= team then points = points + teamPips[i] end
        end
        match.scores[team] = match.scores[team] + points
    end

    match.opener = winnerSeat

    local over = team ~= 0 and match.scores[team] >= match.target

    return {
        seat = winnerSeat,
        team = team,
        points = points,
        blocked = blocked,
        seatPips = seatPips,
        over = over,
    }
end

---@param hand table
---@param seat number
---@param tile DominoTile
---@param side string
---@return number
local function evaluate(hand, seat, tile, side)
    local tiles = hand.hands[seat]
    local newEnd
    if #hand.board == 0 then
        newEnd = tile.hi
    else
        local match = hand[side]
        newEnd = tile.lo == match and tile.hi or tile.lo
    end

    local keep = 0
    for i = 1, #tiles do
        local other = tiles[i]
        if other.id ~= tile.id and (other.lo == newEnd or other.hi == newEnd) then
            keep = keep + 1
        end
    end

    local value = pips(tile) + keep * 3 + random() * 0.5
    if tile.lo == tile.hi then value = value + 8 end
    return value
end

---@param hand table
---@param seat number
---@return string action
---@return number? tileId
---@return string? side
function engine.botMove(hand, seat)
    local moves = engine.moves(hand, seat)

    if #moves == 0 then
        if #hand.stock > 0 then return 'draw' end
        return 'pass'
    end

    local best, bestValue = moves[1], -huge
    for i = 1, #moves do
        local move = moves[i]
        local value = evaluate(hand, seat, move.tile, move.side)
        if value > bestValue then
            best, bestValue = move, value
        end
    end

    return 'play', best.tile.id, best.side
end

return engine


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_2\interface\sm_domino\modules\layout.lua
local abs, rad, deg, cos, sin, atan = math.abs, math.rad, math.deg, math.cos, math.sin, math.atan

local HALF_W = 0.0125
local HALF_L = 0.025
local GAP = 0.0008
local BEND_LIMIT = 0.34
local BOUND = 0.38
local GRID_STEP = 0.03

local layout = {}

---@param yaw number
---@return number halfX
---@return number halfY
local function extents(yaw)
    local r = rad(yaw)
    local c, s = abs(cos(r)), abs(sin(r))
    return c * HALF_W + s * HALF_L, s * HALF_W + c * HALF_L
end

---@param board table[]
---@param x number
---@param y number
---@param yaw number
---@return boolean
local function isClear(board, x, y, yaw)
    local hx, hy = extents(yaw)
    if abs(x) + hx > BOUND or abs(y) + hy > BOUND then return false end

    for i = 1, #board do
        local placed = board[i]
        local px, py = extents(placed.r)
        if abs(x - placed.x) < hx + px - 0.0001 and abs(y - placed.y) < hy + py - 0.0001 then
            return false
        end
    end

    return true
end

---@param dx number
---@param dy number
---@param tile { lo: number, hi: number }
---@param match number
---@return number
local function yawFor(dx, dy, tile, match)
    local yaw = deg(atan(-dx, dy))
    if tile.lo == tile.hi then
        yaw = yaw + 90.0
    elseif tile.lo == match then
        yaw = yaw + 180.0
    end
    return (yaw + 0.5) // 90 * 90 % 360
end

---@param tile { lo: number, hi: number }
---@return number x
---@return number y
---@return number yaw
---@return table branches
function layout.first(tile)
    local double = tile.lo == tile.hi
    local along = double and HALF_W or HALF_L
    local across = double and HALF_L or HALF_W

    return 0.0, 0.0, double and 0.0 or 90.0, {
        { x = 0.0, y = 0.0, dx = -1, dy = 0, along = along, across = across, turn = -1 },
        { x = 0.0, y = 0.0, dx = 1, dy = 0, along = along, across = across, turn = 1 },
    }
end

---@param board table[]
---@param branch table
---@param tile { lo: number, hi: number }
---@param match number
---@return number x
---@return number y
---@return number yaw
---@return table branch
function layout.next(board, branch, tile, match)
    local double = tile.lo == tile.hi
    local along = double and HALF_W or HALF_L
    local across = double and HALF_L or HALF_W
    local bx, by, dx, dy = branch.x, branch.y, branch.dx, branch.dy

    if dy == 0 then
        local cx = bx + dx * (branch.along + along + GAP)
        local yaw = yawFor(dx, 0, tile, match)
        if abs(cx) + along <= BEND_LIMIT and isClear(board, cx, by, yaw) then
            return cx, by, yaw, { x = cx, y = by, dx = dx, dy = 0, along = along, across = across, turn = branch.turn }
        end

        local turn = branch.turn
        local vAlong = double and HALF_W or HALF_L
        local vAcross = double and HALF_L or HALF_W
        local vx = bx + dx * (branch.along - vAcross)
        local vy = by + turn * (branch.across + vAlong + GAP)
        yaw = yawFor(0, turn, tile, match)
        if isClear(board, vx, vy, yaw) then
            return vx, vy, yaw, { x = vx, y = vy, dx = 0, dy = turn, along = vAlong, across = vAcross, turn = turn, back = -dx }
        end
    else
        local back = branch.back or 1
        local hy = by + dy * (branch.along - across)
        local hx = bx + back * (branch.across + along + GAP)
        local yaw = yawFor(back, 0, tile, match)
        if isClear(board, hx, hy, yaw) then
            return hx, hy, yaw, { x = hx, y = hy, dx = back, dy = 0, along = along, across = across, turn = branch.turn }
        end
    end

    local yaw = yawFor(dx, dy, tile, match)
    local start = -BOUND + 0.03
    local gy = start
    while gy <= BOUND - 0.03 do
        local gx = start
        while gx <= BOUND - 0.03 do
            if isClear(board, gx, gy, yaw) then
                return gx, gy, yaw, { x = gx, y = gy, dx = dx, dy = dy, along = along, across = across, turn = branch.turn, back = branch.back }
            end
            gx = gx + GRID_STEP
        end
        gy = gy + GRID_STEP
    end

    return bx, by, yaw, branch
end

return layout

---@param pct number
---@return number value
---@return number index
function HRS_EngVolSnap(pct)
    pct = tonumber(pct) or 0
    if pct <= 0 then return 0, 0 end
    local levels = ECUConfig.EngineVolumeLevels
    local best, bi, bd = 0, 0, math.huge
    for i = 1, #levels do
        local d = math.abs(levels[i] - pct)
        if d < bd then best, bi, bd = levels[i], i, d end
    end
    return best, bi
end

function HRSVehicleBlocked(model, class)
    if model and model ~= '' then
        local m = string.lower(tostring(model))
        for _, name in ipairs(ECUConfig.BlacklistVehicles or {}) do
            if string.lower(name) == m then return true end
        end
    end
    if class then
        local cl = tonumber(class)
        for _, c in ipairs(ECUConfig.BlacklistClasses or {}) do
            if tonumber(c) == cl then return true end
        end
        local allowed = ECUConfig.AllowedClasses
        if allowed and #allowed > 0 then
            for _, c in ipairs(allowed) do
                if tonumber(c) == cl then return false end
            end
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function HRSPartDisabled(key)
    local keinHandling = ECUConfig.ModifyHandling == false
    if (ECUConfig.EnableDrift   == false or keinHandling) and key == 'driftflash'   then return true end
    if (ECUConfig.EnableAntiLag == false or keinHandling) and key == 'antilagflash' then return true end
    return false
end

local placedDynos = {}

    dui = nil, txd = nil, tex = nil,

local function screenSendRaw(payload)
    if scr.dui then SendDuiMessage(scr.dui, json.encode(payload)) end

    if scr.dui then SendDuiMessage(scr.dui, json.encode(payload)) end
