function selection.add(entity)
    if state.selected[entity] or not selection.pickable(entity) then return false end

    local list = state.selection

    list[#list + 1] = entity
    state.selected[entity] = true
    state.selectionDirty = true

    return true
end

---@param entity integer
---@return boolean
function selection.remove(entity)
    if not state.selected[entity] then return false end

    local list = state.selection

    for i = #list, 1, -1 do
        if list[i] == entity then
            tremove(list, i)
            break
        end
    end

    state.selected[entity] = nil
    state.selectionDirty = true

    return true
end

function selection.clear()
    if #state.selection == 0 then return end

    state.selection = {}
    state.selected = {}
    state.selectionDirty = true
end

---@param entities integer[]
function selection.set(entities)
    state.selection = {}
    state.selected = {}
    state.selectionDirty = true

    for i = 1, #entities do
        selection.add(entities[i])
    end
end

---@param entity integer
function selection.only(entity)
    state.selection = { entity }
    state.selected = { [entity] = true }
    state.selectionDirty = true
end

---@return boolean
function selection.prune()
    local list = state.selection
    local changed = false

    for i = #list, 1, -1 do
        local entity = list[i]

        if not DoesEntityExist(entity) then
            tremove(list, i)
            state.selected[entity] = nil
            changed = true
        end
    end

    if changed then
        state.selectionDirty = true
    end

    return changed
end

---@return integer[]
function selection.actors()
    local result = {}
    local seen = {}
    local count = 0
    local list = state.selection

    for i = 1, #list do
        local entity = list[i]
        local ped = 0

        if selection.isPed(entity) then
            ped = entity
        elseif selection.isVehicle(entity) then
            local driver = GetPedInVehicleSeat(entity, -1)

            if driver ~= 0 and not IsPedAPlayer(driver) then
                ped = driver
            end
        end

        if ped ~= 0 and not seen[ped] then
            seen[ped] = true
            count += 1
            result[count] = ped
        end
    end

    return result
end

---@return integer[] netIds, string[] objectIds
function selection.deletable()

---@param entity integer
---@param minX number
---@param maxX number
---@param minY number
---@param maxY number
---@return boolean
local function insideRect(entity, minX, maxX, minY, maxY)
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(entity)
    local cam = state.camPos
    local dx = coords.x - cam.x
    local dy = coords.y - cam.y
    local dz = coords.z - cam.z

    if dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz > SELECT_RADIUS_SQ then return false end

    local onScreen, sx, sy = GetScreenCoordFromWorldCoord(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)

    if not onScreen then return false end

    return sx >= minX and sx <= maxX and sy >= minY and sy <= maxY
end

---@param pool integer[]
---@param check fun(entity: integer): boolean
---@param minX number
---@param maxX number
---@param minY number
---@param maxY number
---@param subtract boolean
local function sweep(pool, check, minX, maxX, minY, maxY, subtract)
    for i = 1, #pool do
        local entity = pool[i]

        if check(entity) and insideRect(entity, minX, maxX, minY, maxY) then
            if subtract then
                selection.remove(entity)
            else
                selection.add(entity)
            end
        end
    end
end

---@param x1 number
---@param y1 number
---@param x2 number
---@param y2 number
function selection.rect(x1, y1, x2, y2)
    local minX = min(x1, x2)
    local maxX = max(x1, x2)
    local minY = min(y1, y2)
    local maxY = max(y1, y2)
    local additive = keys.shift()
    local subtract = keys.ctrl()

    if not additive and not subtract then
        selection.clear()
    end

    local options = state.options

    if options.pickPeds then
        sweep(GetGamePool('CPed'), selection.isPed, minX, maxX, minY, maxY, subtract)
    end

    if options.pickVehicles then
        sweep(GetGamePool('CVehicle'), selection.isVehicle, minX, maxX, minY, maxY, subtract)
    end

    if options.pickObjects then
        sweep(objects.entities(), selection.isObject, minX, maxX, minY, maxY, subtract)
    end
end

---@param vehicle integer
---@return integer?
function selection.occupantNear(vehicle)
    local seats = GetVehicleModelNumberOfSeats(GetEntityModel(vehicle))
    local best = nil
    local bestDist = 0.0016

    for seat = -1, seats - 2 do
        local ped = GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, seat)

        if ped ~= 0 and not IsPedAPlayer(ped) then
            local coords = GetPedBoneCoords(ped, HEAD_BONE, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
            local onScreen, sx, sy = GetScreenCoordFromWorldCoord(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)

            if onScreen then
                local dx = state.cursorX - sx
                local dy = state.cursorY - sy
                local dist = dx * dx + dy * dy

                if dist < bestDist then
                    bestDist = dist
                    best = ped
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return best
end

---@param ped integer
---@return integer
function selection.vehicleOf(ped)
    if not IsPedInAnyVehicle(ped, false) then return 0 end

    return GetVehiclePedIsIn(ped, false)
end

return selection

local config = localmodule 'config'

    tanker = true,
    tanker2 = true,
    tr2 = true,
    tr3 = true,
    tr4 = true,
    trflat = true,
    armytanker = true,

local spawn = {}

---@type { entity: integer, model?: string, kind?: string, loading: boolean, x: number, y: number, vx: number, vy: number }
local preview = { entity = 0, model = nil, kind = nil, loading = false, x = 0.0, y = 0.0, vx = 0.0, vy = 0.0 }
---@type { start: vector3, heading: number, startAt: integer, moved: boolean }?
local hold = nil

---@param hash integer
---@return boolean
local function loadModel(hash)
    if not IsModelInCdimage(hash) then return false end

    RequestModel(hash)

    local tries = 0

    while not HasModelLoaded(hash) do
        tries += 1

        if tries > 250 then return false end

        Wait(20)
    end

    return true
end

---@param model string
---@return string?
function spawn.vehicleType(model)
    local hash = joaat(model)

    if IsThisModelATrain(hash) then return nil end
    if IsThisModelAHeli(hash) then return 'heli' end
    if IsThisModelAPlane(hash) then return 'plane' end
    if IsThisModelABoat(hash) or IsThisModelAJetski(hash) then return 'boat' end
    if IsThisModelABike(hash) or IsThisModelABicycle(hash) then return 'bike' end
    if sfind(model, 'submersible', 1, true) then return 'submarine' end
    if TRAILERS[model] or sfind(model, 'trailer', 1, true) then return 'trailer' end

    return 'automobile'
end

function spawn.clearPreview()
    local entity = preview.entity

    preview.entity = 0
    preview.model = nil
    preview.kind = nil

    if entity ~= 0 and DoesEntityExist(entity) then
        DeleteEntity(entity)
    end
end

---@param item GmItem
---@param coords vector3
local function createPreview(item, coords)
    preview.loading = true
    preview.model = item.model
    preview.kind = item.kind

    CreateThread(function()
        local hash = joaat(item.model)
        local loaded = loadModel(hash)
        local current = state.item

        preview.loading = false

        if not loaded or not current or current.model ~= item.model or preview.model ~= item.model then
            SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(hash)
            return
        end

        local heading = state.heading
        local entity

        if item.kind == 'ped' then
            entity = CreatePed(4, hash, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z + PED_OFFSET, heading, false, false)
            SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(entity, true)
            SetPedRandomComponentVariation(entity, 0)
        elseif item.kind == 'vehicle' then
            entity = CreateVehicle(hash, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, heading, false, false)
        else
            entity = CreateObjectNoOffset(hash, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false)
        end

        SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(hash)

        if not entity or entity == 0 then return end

        SetEntityAlpha(entity, PREVIEW_ALPHA, false)
        SetEntityCollision(entity, false, false)
        SetEntityInvincible(entity, true)
        FreezeEntityPosition(entity, true)

        if preview.entity ~= 0 or preview.model ~= item.model then
            DeleteEntity(entity)
            return
        end

        preview.entity = entity
        preview.x = coords.x
        preview.y = coords.y
        preview.vx = 0.0
        preview.vy = 0.0
    end)
end

---@param dt number
function spawn.updatePreview(dt)
    local item = state.item

    if not item or state.mode ~= 'spawn' or not state.options.preview or state.placing then
        if preview.entity ~= 0 or preview.model then
            spawn.clearPreview()
        end

        return
    end

    if preview.model ~= item.model then
        spawn.clearPreview()
    end

    local target = hold and hold.start or camera.ground(preview.entity ~= 0 and preview.entity or nil)

    if not target then return end

    if preview.entity == 0 then
        if not preview.loading and not preview.model then
            createPreview(item, target)
        end

        return
    end

    local entity = preview.entity

    if state.overUi then
        SetEntityVisible(entity, false, false)
        return
    end

    SetEntityVisible(entity, true, false)

    preview.x, preview.vx = util.smoothDamp(preview.x, target.x, preview.vx, 0.06, 120.0, dt)
    preview.y, preview.vy = util.smoothDamp(preview.y, target.y, preview.vy, 0.06, 120.0, dt)

    local z = target.z

    if preview.kind == 'ped' then
        z = z + PED_OFFSET
    end

    SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(entity, preview.x, preview.y, z, false, false, false)
    SetEntityHeading(entity, hold and hold.heading or state.heading)

    if preview.kind == 'vehicle' then
        SetVehicleOnGroundProperly(entity)
    end
end

---@param coords vector3
function spawn.holdStart(coords)
    hold = { start = coords, heading = state.heading, startAt = GetGameTimer(), moved = false }
end

---@param coords? vector3
function spawn.holdUpdate(coords)
    if not hold or not coords then return end

    local dx = coords.x - hold.start.x
    local dy = coords.y - hold.start.y

    if dx * dx + dy * dy > 0.0625 then
        hold.moved = true
        hold.heading = util.headingFrom(dx, dy)
    end
end

---@return { start: vector3, heading: number, startAt: integer, moved: boolean }?
function spawn.hold()
    return hold
end

---@param coords? vector3
---@return vector3?, number?
function spawn.holdEnd(coords)
    local current = hold

    hold = nil

    if not current then return nil end

    if current.moved or GetGameTimer() - current.startAt > 200 then
        return current.start, current.heading
    end

    return coords or current.start, state.heading
end

---@param netId integer
---@return integer
local function resolve(netId)
    local tries = 0

    while not NetworkDoesEntityExistWithNetworkId(netId) do
        tries += 1

        if tries > 100 then return 0 end

        Wait(50)
    end

    return NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netId)
end

---@param kind 'ped'|'vehicle'
---@param entity integer
---@param ambient boolean
function spawn.after(kind, entity, ambient)
    if not control.one(entity) then return end

    if kind == 'ped' then
        SetPedRandomComponentVariation(entity, 0)
        SetPedRandomProps(entity)

        if ambient then
            orders.ambient(entity)
        else
            orders.stabilize(entity)
        end

        return
    end

    SetVehicleOnGroundProperly(entity)
    SetVehicleEngineOn(entity, true, true, false)
end

---@param kind 'ped'|'vehicle'
---@param model string
---@param coords vector3
---@param heading number
---@return table?
function spawn.payload(kind, model, coords, heading)
    local payload = { kind = kind, model = model, coords = coords, heading = heading }

    if kind == 'vehicle' then
        local vehicleType = spawn.vehicleType(model)

        if not vehicleType then return nil end

        payload.vehicleType = vehicleType
    end

    return payload
end

---@param kind 'ped'|'vehicle'
---@param model string
---@param coords vector3
---@param heading number
---@return integer
function spawn.request(kind, model, coords, heading)
    local payload = spawn.payload(kind, model, coords, heading)

    if not payload then
        nui.log('error', ('Model %s tidak bisa di-spawn'):format(model))
        return 0
    end

    local result = lib.callback.await('sm_gamemaster:server:spawn', false, payload)

    if type(result) ~= 'table' or not result.ok then
        nui.log('error', type(result) == 'table' and result.reason or 'Server tidak merespons')
        return 0
    end

    local entity = resolve(result.netId)

    if entity == 0 then
        nui.log('warn', 'Entitas dibuat tapi belum terlihat di sekitar kamera')
        return 0
    end

    spawn.after(kind, entity, state.options.ambient)
    nui.log('success', ('%s di-spawn: %s'):format(kind == 'ped' and 'NPC' or 'Kendaraan', model))

    return entity
end

return spawn

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_3\interface\sm_gamemaster\modules\util.lua
local sqrt = math.sqrt
local exp = math.exp
local max = math.max
local min = math.min
local GetGroundZFor_3dCoord = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord
local GetHeadingFromVector_2d = GetHeadingFromVector_2d
local GetEntityCoords = GetEntityCoords
local GetEntityHealth = GetEntityHealth
local GetEntityMaxHealth = GetEntityMaxHealth

local util = {}

---@param value number
---@param low number
---@param high number
---@return number
function util.clamp(value, low, high)
    if value < low then return low end
    if value > high then return high end

    return value
end

---@param value number
---@return number
function util.wrap360(value)
    local result = value % 360.0

    if result < 0.0 then
        result = result + 360.0
    end

    return result
end

---@param current number
---@param target number
---@param velocity number
---@param smoothTime number
---@param maxSpeed number
---@param dt number
---@return number, number
function util.smoothDamp(current, target, velocity, smoothTime, maxSpeed, dt)
    local time = max(0.0001, smoothTime)
    local omega = 2.0 / time
    local x = omega * dt
    local factor = 1.0 / (1.0 + x + 0.48 * x * x + 0.235 * x * x * x)
    local maxChange = maxSpeed * time
    local change = util.clamp(current - target, -maxChange, maxChange)
    local goal = current - change
    local temp = (velocity + omega * change) * dt
    local nextVelocity = (velocity - omega * temp) * factor
    local output = goal + (change + temp) * factor

    if (target - current > 0.0) == (output > target) then
        output = target
        nextVelocity = 0.0
    end

    return output, nextVelocity
end

---@param remaining number
---@param smoothing number
---@param dt number
---@return number
function util.expStep(remaining, smoothing, dt)
    local factor = util.clamp(1.0 - exp(-smoothing * dt), 0.0, 1.0)

    return remaining * factor
end

---@param t number
---@return number
function util.smootherStep(t)
    if t <= 0.0 then return 0.0 end
    if t >= 1.0 then return 1.0 end

    return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6.0 - 15.0) + 10.0)
end

---@param a number
---@param b number
---@param t number
---@return number
function util.lerp(a, b, t)
    return a + (b - a) * t
end

---@param t number
---@return number
function util.easeOutCubic(t)
    local p = 1.0 - util.clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0)

    return 1.0 - p * p * p
end

---@param v vector3
---@return vector3
function util.normalize(v)
    local length = sqrt(v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y + v.z * v.z)

    if length <= 0.0000001 then return vector3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0) end

    return vector3(v.x / length, v.y / length, v.z / length)
end

---@param a vector3
---@param b vector3
---@return number
function util.dot(a, b)
    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z
end

---@param a vector3
---@param b vector3
---@return vector3
function util.cross(a, b)
    return vector3(a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y, a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z, a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x)
end

---@param x number
---@param y number
---@param z number
---@return number?
function util.groundZ(x, y, z)
    local found, ground = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord(x, y, z, false)

    if found then return ground end

    found, ground = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord(x, y, z + 50.0, false)

    if found then return ground end

    return nil
end

---@param coords vector3
---@return vector3
function util.toGround(coords)
    local ground = util.groundZ(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z + 1.0)

    if not ground then return coords end

    return vector3(coords.x, coords.y, ground)
end

---@param dx number
---@param dy number
---@return number
function util.headingFrom(dx, dy)
    return util.wrap360(GetHeadingFromVector_2d(dx, dy))
end

---@param entity integer
---@param target vector3
---@return number
function util.headingTo(entity, target)
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(entity)

    return util.headingFrom(target.x - coords.x, target.y - coords.y)
end

---@param entity integer
---@return integer, integer
function util.health(entity)
    local health = GetEntityHealth(entity)
    local maxHealth = GetEntityMaxHealth(entity)

    if maxHealth <= 0 or health > maxHealth then
        maxHealth = max(100, health)
    end

    return min(health, maxHealth), maxHealth
end

---@param center vector3
---@param count integer
---@param spacing number
---@return vector3[]
function util.formation(center, count, spacing)
    local positions = { center }

    if count <= 1 then return positions end

    local made = 1
    local ring = 1
    local offset = 2.399963229728653
    local tau = math.pi * 2.0
    local cos = math.cos
    local sin = math.sin

    while made < count do
        local points = 6 * ring
        local radius = spacing * ring

        for i = 0, points - 1 do
            local a = (i / points) * tau + offset
            local x = center.x + cos(a) * radius
            local y = center.y + sin(a) * radius
            local ground = util.groundZ(x, y, center.z + 2.0)

            made += 1
            positions[made] = vector3(x, y, ground and ground + 0.05 or center.z)

            if made >= count then break end
        end

        ring += 1
    end

    return positions
end

return util

---@param hex string

---@param data SceneStyle

        br = br,
        bg = bg,
        bb = bb,
        ba = data.backgroundAlpha,
        bx = data.backgroundX,
        by = data.backgroundY,
        bw = data.backgroundWidth,
        bh = data.backgroundHeight,
    }
end

---@param s PreparedScene
---@param scale number
local function applyTextStyle(s, scale)
    SetTextScale(0.0, scale)
    SetTextFont(s.font)
    SetTextColour(s.r, s.g, s.b, 255)
    SetTextProportional(true)
    SetTextWrap(0.0, 1.0)
    SetTextCentre(true)

    if s.shadow then
        SetTextDropshadow(1, 0, 0, 0, 255)
    end

    if s.outline then
        SetTextOutline()
    end
end

---@param s PreparedScene
local function drawScene(s)
    local c = s.coords
    local onScreen, sx, sy = GetScreenCoordFromWorldCoord(c.x, c.y, c.z)

    if not onScreen then return end

    local distance = #(c - GetFinalRenderedCamCoord())

    if distance < 0.5 then distance = 0.5 end

    local scale = 4.0 / distance * (75.0 / GetGameplayCamFov()) * s.size

    if s.sprite then
        applyTextStyle(s, scale)
        BeginTextCommandGetWidth('STRING')
        AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(s.text)

        local width = EndTextCommandGetWidth(s.font) + 0.005
        local height = GetRenderedCharacterHeight(scale, s.font) + 0.003

        DrawSprite(TXD, s.sprite, sx + s.bx * scale, sy + s.by * scale, width + s.bw * scale, height + s.bh * scale, 0.0, s.br, s.bg, s.bb, s.ba)
    end

    applyTextStyle(s, scale)
    BeginTextCommandDisplayText('STRING')
    AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(s.text)
    EndTextCommandDisplayText(sx, sy)
end

---@param id integer
local function removePoint(id)
    local point = points[id]

    if not point then return end

    point:remove()
    points[id] = nil
end

---@param data table
local function addPoint(data)
    local coords = scene.coords(data.coords)
    local id = tonumber(data.id)

    if not coords or not id then return end

    removePoint(id)

    local style = scene.style(data)
    local prepared = prepare(style, coords, id)
    local point = lib.points.new({
        coords = coords,
        distance = style.viewDistance,
    })

    function point:nearby()
        drawScene(prepared)
    end

    points[id] = point
end

local function clearPoints()
    for id in pairs(points) do
        removePoint(id)
    end
end

---@return boolean, vector3
local function cameraRay()
    local rot = GetGameplayCamRot(2)
    local origin = GetGameplayCamCoord()
    local rx, rz = rad(rot.x), rad(rot.z)
    local pitch = abs(cos(rx))
    local tx = origin.x - sin(rz) * pitch * MAX_DISTANCE
    local ty = origin.y + cos(rz) * pitch * MAX_DISTANCE
    local tz = origin.z + sin(rx) * MAX_DISTANCE
    local handle = StartExpensiveSynchronousShapeTestLosProbe(origin.x, origin.y, origin.z, tx, ty, tz, 1 | 16, cache.ped, 4)
    local _, hit, coords = GetShapeTestResult(handle)

    return hit == true or hit == 1, coords
end

---@param dict string
---@param anim string
---@param props { model: string, bone: integer, offset: number[] }[]
---@return fun()
local function playTool(dict, anim, props)
    lib.requestAnimDict(dict)

    local ped = cache.ped
    local spawned = {}

    for i = 1, #props do
        local prop = props[i]
        local model = lib.requestModel(prop.model)
        local o = prop.offset
        local entity = CreateObject(model, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, false, false, false)

        AttachEntityToEntity(entity, ped, GetPedBoneIndex(ped, prop.bone), o[1], o[2], o[3], o[4], o[5], o[6], true, true, false, true, 1, true)
        SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
        spawned[i] = entity
    end

    TaskPlayAnim(ped, dict, anim, 8.0, -8.0, -1, 51, 0, false, false, false)
    RemoveAnimDict(dict)

    return function()
        StopAnimTask(ped, dict, anim, 8.0)

        for i = 1, #spawned do
            local entity = spawned[i]

            if DoesEntityExist(entity) then
                DeleteEntity(entity)
            end
        end
    end
end

local stopToolAnim = nil

local function stopTool()
    if not stopToolAnim then return end

    stopToolAnim()
    stopToolAnim = nil
end

local function unmountLater()
    SetTimeout(150, function()
        if editing or not mounted then return end

        mounted = false
        ready = false
        interface.hide()
    end)

local function closeEditor()
    if not editing then return end

    editing = false
    preview = nil
    editorContext = nil
    send('close')
    interface.focus(false, false)
    unmountLater()
end

local function previewLoop()
    while editing do
        if preview then
            drawScene(preview)
        end

        Wait(0)
    end
end

---@param coords vector3
local function openEditor(coords)
    if not hasFrame then return end

    local context = lib.callback.await('sm_scenes:server:context', false)

    if type(context) ~= 'table' then return end

    editing = true
    preview = prepare(scene.style(config.defaults), coords)
    editorContext = {
        coords = coords,
        payload = {
            fonts = config.fonts,
            backgrounds = config.backgrounds,
            defaults = config.defaults,
            maxDistance = MAX_DISTANCE,
            maxDuration = config.maxDuration,
            maxText = config.maxText,
            admin = context.admin == true,
            used = tonumber(context.used) or 0,
            max = tonumber(context.max) or config.maxScenes,
        },
    }

    CreateThread(previewLoop)

    if ready then
        send('open', editorContext.payload)
        interface.focus(true, true)
    elseif not mounted then
        mounted = true
        interface.show()
    end
end

local function stopPlacing()
    if not placing then return end

    placing = false
    infoui:remove(INFO_ID)
end

local function placeLoop()
    infoui:show({
        id = INFO_ID,
        title = 'Pasang Scene',
        icon = 'fa-solid fa-pen-nib',
        description = 'Arahkan ke dinding atau lantai\n[kbd]E[/kbd] Pilih lokasi   [kbd]Backspace[/kbd] Batal',
    })

    while placing do
        local hit, coords = cameraRay()

        if hit then
            local origin = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)

            DrawLine(origin.x, origin.y, origin.z, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, LASER.r, LASER.g, LASER.b, LASER.a)
            DrawMarker(28, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 180.0, 0.0, 0.08, 0.08, 0.08, LASER.r, LASER.g, LASER.b, LASER.a, false, true, 2, false, nil, nil, false)
        end

        DisableControlAction(0, 200, true)

        if IsControlJustReleased(0, KEY_CANCEL) then
            stopPlacing()
        elseif IsControlJustReleased(0, KEY_CONFIRM) then
            if hit then
                stopPlacing()
                openEditor(coords)
            else
                lib.notify({ title = 'Scene', description = 'Arahkan ke permukaan yang lebih dekat.', type = 'error' })
            end
        end

        Wait(0)
    end
end

    if source == '' or type(texts) ~= 'table' then return end

    end

    local answer = lib.alertDialog({
        header = 'Hapus Scene',
        content = ('Ditemukan **%d scene** dalam radius **%d meter**:\n\n%s\n\nHapus semuanya?'):format(#texts, tonumber(radius) or 0, table.concat(lines, '\n')),
        centered = true,
        cancel = true,
        labels = { confirm = 'Hapus', cancel = 'Batal' },
    })

    if answer == 'confirm' then
        TriggerServerEvent('sm_scenes:server:confirmBulk')
    end
end)

if hasFrame then
    interface.callback('ready', function(_, cb)
        ready = true
        cb({})

        if editing and editorContext then
            send('open', editorContext.payload)
            interface.focus(true, true)
        end
    end)

    interface.callback('close', function(_, cb)
        cb({})

        if not submitting then
            closeEditor()
        end
    end)

    interface.callback('preview', function(data, cb)
        cb({})

        if not editing or not editorContext then return end

        preview = prepare(scene.style(data), editorContext.coords)
    end)

    interface.callback('submit', function(data, cb)
        if not editing or not editorContext or submitting or type(data) ~= 'table' then
            return cb({ ok = false, message = 'Editor tidak aktif.' })
        end

        local style = scene.style(data.style)

        if style.text == '' then
            return cb({ ok = false, message = 'Teks scene tidak boleh kosong.' })
        end

        submitting = true
        stopToolAnim = playTool('missheistdockssetup1clipboard@base', 'base', WRITE_PROPS)

        local finished = lib.progressBar({
            duration = WRITE_MS,
            label = 'Menulis scene...',
            useWhileDead = false,
            canCancel = false,
            disable = { move = true, car = true, combat = true },
        })

        stopTool()

        if not finished or not editing then
            submitting = false
            return cb({ ok = false, message = 'Penulisan dibatalkan.' })
        end

        local result = lib.callback.await('sm_scenes:server:create', false, editorContext.coords, style, data.duration, data.neverExpire == true)

        submitting = false

        if type(result) ~= 'table' or not result.ok then
            return cb({ ok = false, message = type(result) == 'table' and result.message or 'Server tidak merespons, coba lagi.' })
        end

        cb({ ok = true })
        closeEditor()
        lib.notify({ title = 'Scene', description = 'Scene berhasil dipasang.', type = 'success' })
    end)
end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_3\interface\sm_scenes\modules\scene.lua
local config = localmodule 'config'

local type = type
local tonumber = tonumber
local floor = math.floor
local smatch = string.match
local sgsub = string.gsub
local ssub = string.sub

local DEFAULTS = config.defaults
local MAX_TEXT = config.maxText
local RAW_LIMIT = MAX_TEXT * 4
local MAX_DISTANCE = config.maxDistance
local MAX_DURATION = config.maxDuration
local LEGACY_FONTS = config.legacyFonts

---@type table<string, true>
local fontKeys = {}
for i = 1, #config.fonts do
    fontKeys[config.fonts[i].key] = true
end

---@type table<string, true>
local backgroundKeys = {}
for i = 1, #config.backgrounds do
    backgroundKeys[config.backgrounds[i].key] = true
end

---@class SceneStyle
---@field text string
---@field font string
---@field colour string
---@field fontSize number
---@field viewDistance number
---@field shadow boolean
---@field outline boolean
---@field background string
---@field backgroundColour string
---@field backgroundAlpha integer
---@field backgroundX number
---@field backgroundY number
---@field backgroundWidth number
---@field backgroundHeight number

---@param value any
---@param min number
---@param max number
---@param fallback number
---@return number
local function clampNumber(value, min, max, fallback)
    local number = tonumber(value)

    if not number or number ~= number then return fallback end
    if number < min then return min end
    if number > max then return max end

    return number
end

---@param value any
---@param fallback string
---@return string
local function hexColour(value, fallback)
    if type(value) ~= 'string' then return fallback end
    if not smatch(value, '^#%x%x%x%x%x%x$') then return fallback end

    return value
end

---@param value any
---@return string
local function cleanText(value)
    if type(value) ~= 'string' then return '' end

    if #value > RAW_LIMIT then
        value = ssub(value, 1, RAW_LIMIT)
    end

    local text = sgsub(value, '\r', '')
    text = sgsub(text, '[\0-\9\11-\31\127]', '')
    text = sgsub(text, '~', '')
    text = sgsub(text, '\n\n\n+', '\n\n')
    text = smatch(text, '^%s*(.-)%s*$') or ''

    if #text > MAX_TEXT then
        text = ssub(text, 1, MAX_TEXT)
        text = sgsub(text, '[\128-\191]*$', '')
        text = sgsub(text, '[\192-\255]$', '')
    end

    return text
end

---@param value any
---@return string
local function fontKey(value)
    if type(value) == 'string' and fontKeys[value] then return value end

    local legacy = tonumber(value)

    return legacy and LEGACY_FONTS[legacy] or DEFAULTS.font
end

---@param input any
---@return SceneStyle
local function style(input)
    if type(input) ~= 'table' then input = {} end

    local background = input.background

    if type(background) ~= 'string' or not backgroundKeys[background] then
        background = 'none'
    end

    return {
        text = cleanText(input.text),
        font = fontKey(input.font),
        colour = hexColour(input.colour, DEFAULTS.colour),
        fontSize = clampNumber(input.fontSize, 0.1, 1.0, DEFAULTS.fontSize),
        viewDistance = floor(clampNumber(input.viewDistance, 1, MAX_DISTANCE, DEFAULTS.viewDistance)),
        shadow = input.shadow == true,
        outline = input.outline == true,
        background = background,
        backgroundColour = hexColour(input.backgroundColour, DEFAULTS.backgroundColour),
        backgroundAlpha = floor(clampNumber(input.backgroundAlpha, 0, 255, DEFAULTS.backgroundAlpha)),
        backgroundX = clampNumber(input.backgroundX, -0.2, 0.2, DEFAULTS.backgroundX),
        backgroundY = clampNumber(input.backgroundY, -0.2, 0.2, DEFAULTS.backgroundY),
        backgroundWidth = clampNumber(input.backgroundWidth, -0.5, 0.5, DEFAULTS.backgroundWidth),
        backgroundHeight = clampNumber(input.backgroundHeight, -0.5, 0.5, DEFAULTS.backgroundHeight),
    }
end

---@param value any
---@return integer
local function duration(value)
    return floor(clampNumber(value, 1, MAX_DURATION, DEFAULTS.duration))
end

---@param value any
---@return vector3?
local function coords(value)
    if type(value) ~= 'table' and type(value) ~= 'vector3' then return nil end

    local x, y, z = tonumber(value.x), tonumber(value.y), tonumber(value.z)

    if not x or not y or not z then return nil end
    if x ~= x or y ~= y or z ~= z then return nil end

    return vector3(x, y, z)
end

return {
    style = style,
    duration = duration,
    coords = coords,
}

---@param description string
---@param kind? string
local function notify(description, kind)
    lib.notify({ title = 'Taser', description = description, type = kind or 'error', icon = 'bolt' })
end

---@return integer
local function cartridgeCount()
    return ox_inventory:GetItemCount(CARTRIDGE_ITEM) or 0
end

---@param message table
local function send(message)
    if not frameShown then return end

    if not frameReady then
        pending[#pending + 1] = message
        return
    end

    interface.send(message)
end

local function pushHud()
    send({
        action = 'hud',
        show = holding,
        known = shots ~= nil,
        shots = shots or 0,
        capacity = SHOTS_PER_CARTRIDGE,
        cartridges = cartridgeCount(),
        maxCarry = MAX_CARRY,
        reloading = reloading and RELOAD_TIME or 0,
        cooldown = mmax(0, lastShot + FIRE_COOLDOWN - GetGameTimer()),
        cooldownTotal = FIRE_COOLDOWN,
        reloadKey = config.reloadKey,
    })
end

---@param name string
---@param duration? number
local function sound(name, duration)
    send({ action = 'sound', name = name, volume = SOUND_VOLUME, duration = duration })
end

local function syncFrame()
    if not hasFrame then return end

    local want = holding or effect.selfTased

    if want and not frameShown then
        frameShown = true
        frameReady = false
        interface.show()
    elseif not want and frameShown then
        frameShown = false
        frameReady = false
        pending = {}
        interface.hide()
    end
end

interface.callback('ready', function(_, cb)
    cb({})

    frameReady = true
    pushHud()

    local queued = pending
    pending = {}

    for i = 1, #queued do
        interface.send(queued[i])
    end
end)

---@param a vector3
---@param b vector3
---@return vector3
local function cross(a, b)
    return vec3(a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y, a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z, a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x)
end

---@param v vector3
---@param axis vector3
---@param degrees number
---@return vector3
local function rotate(v, axis, degrees)
    local rad = mrad(degrees)
    local c = mcos(rad)
    local dot = axis.x * v.x + axis.y * v.y + axis.z * v.z

    return v * c + cross(axis, v) * msin(rad) + axis * dot * (1.0 - c)
end

---@param from vector3
---@param to vector3
---@param ignore number
---@param flags integer
---@return boolean hit
---@return vector3 coords
---@return number entity
local function raycast(from, to, ignore, flags)
    local handle = StartExpensiveSynchronousShapeTestLosProbe(from.x, from.y, from.z, to.x, to.y, to.z, flags, ignore, 7)
    local _, hit, coords, _, entity = GetShapeTestResult(handle)

    return hit == 1 or hit == true, coords, entity
end

---@param ped number
---@return vector3
local function aimPoint(ped)
    local cam = GetFinalRenderedCamCoord()
    local rot = GetFinalRenderedCamRot(2)
    local rx, rz = mrad(rot.x), mrad(rot.z)
    local forward = vec3(-msin(rz) * mcos(rx), mcos(rz) * mcos(rx), msin(rx))
    local toPed = GetEntityCoords(ped) - cam
    local skip = mmax(toPed.x * forward.x + toPed.y * forward.y + toPed.z * forward.z, 0.0)
    local start = cam + forward * (skip + 0.5)
    local finish = cam + forward * (skip + RANGE)
    local hit, coords = raycast(start, finish, ped, RAYCAST_FLAGS)

    return hit and coords or finish
end

---@param ped number
---@param point vector3
---@return integer
local function closestBone(ped, point)
    local best, bestDistance = BONES[1], nil

    for i = 1, BONE_COUNT do
        local bone = BONES[i]
        local distance = #(GetPedBoneCoords(ped, bone, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0) - point)

        if not bestDistance or distance < bestDistance then
            best = bone
            bestDistance = distance
        end
    end

    return best
end

---@param entity number
---@return boolean
local function isTaseable(entity)
    if entity == 0 or GetEntityType(entity) ~= 1 then return false end
    if not NetworkGetEntityIsNetworked(entity) or IsPedInAnyVehicle(entity, false) then return false end

    return NPC_ENABLED or IsPedAPlayer(entity)
end

---@param ped number
---@param origin vector3
---@param direction vector3
---@return table hit
local function traceProbe(ped, origin, direction)
    local finish = origin + direction * RANGE
    local hit, coords, entity = raycast(origin + direction * 0.05, finish, ped, RAYCAST_FLAGS)

    if hit and isTaseable(entity) then
        return {
            target = NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(entity),
            bone = closestBone(entity, coords),
            point = coords,
        }
    end

    if not hit then
        local ground, groundCoords = raycast(finish, finish - vec3(0.0, 0.0, 50.0), ped, 1)
        coords = ground and groundCoords or finish
    end

    return { point = coords }
end

---@param aim vector3
---@return vector3[]
local function probeDirections(aim)
    local right = cross(aim, UP)
    right = #right < 1.0e-4 and vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0) or norm(right)

    local list = {}

    for i = 1, PROBES_PER_SHOT do
        local direction = aim

        if i > 1 then
            direction = rotate(direction, right, -SPREAD * (i - 1) / (PROBES_PER_SHOT - 1))
        end

        if JITTER > 0 then
            direction = rotate(direction, right, (mrandom() * 2.0 - 1.0) * JITTER)
            direction = rotate(direction, UP, (mrandom() * 2.0 - 1.0) * JITTER)
        end

        list[i] = norm(direction)
    end

    return list
end

---@param ped number
---@return boolean
local function canFire(ped)
    if reloading or effect.selfTased then return false end
    if IsPedRagdoll(ped) or IsPedDeadOrDying(ped, true) then return false end
    if IsPedInAnyVehicle(ped, false) then return false end

    return not IsPauseMenuActive() and not IsNuiFocused()
end

local function fire()
    local ped = cache.ped
    if not canFire(ped) or shots == nil then return end

    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if now - lastShot < FIRE_COOLDOWN then return end

    if shots < 1 then
        sound('dry')

        if now - lastEmptyNotice > 2000 then
            lastEmptyNotice = now
            notify(('Cartridge empty. Press %s to load a new cartridge.'):format(config.reloadKey))
        end

        return
    end

    lastShot = now
    shots -= 1

    local muzzle = util.muzzle(ped)
    local aim = norm(aimPoint(ped) - muzzle)
    local directions = probeDirections(aim)
    local hits = {}
    local struck = false

    for i = 1, #directions do
        local hit = traceProbe(ped, muzzle, directions[i])
        hits[i] = hit
        struck = struck or hit.target ~= nil
    end

    TriggerTokenEvent('sm_taser:fire', hits)
    util.muzzleFlash(muzzle)
    sound('fire')

    if struck then
        sound('arc', ARC_TIME)
    end

    pushHud()
end

---@param token integer
local function holdLoop(token)
    local playerId = cache.playerId

    while holding and token == holdToken do
        DisablePlayerFiring(playerId, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 24, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 257, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 45, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 140, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 141, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 142, true)

        if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, 24) or IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, 257) then
            fire()
        end

        Wait(0)
    end
end

local function reload()
    if not holding or reloading or effect.selfTased then return end

    if shots and shots > 0 then
        return notify(('Cartridge still has %d shot(s) left.'):format(shots))
    end

    if cartridgeCount() < 1 then
        return notify('You have no Taser Cartridge.')
    end

    reloading = true

    local started, reason = lib.callback.await('sm_taser:reloadStart', false)

    if not started then
        reloading = false
        return reason and notify(reason)
    end

    pushHud()
    sound('reload')

    local ped = cache.ped
    local anim = util.playAnim(ped, RELOAD_ANIMS, 49)
    local finishAt = GetGameTimer() + RELOAD_TIME
    local completed = true

    while GetGameTimer() < finishAt do
        if not holding or effect.selfTased or IsPedRagdoll(ped) then
            completed = false
            break
        end

        DisableControlAction(0, 21, true)
        Wait(0)
    end

    util.stopAnim(ped, anim)

    if completed then
        local ok, result = lib.callback.await('sm_taser:reloadFinish', false)

        if ok then
            shots = result
        elseif type(result) == 'string' then
            notify(result)
        end
    end

    reloading = false
    pushHud()
end

local function fetchShots()
    for _ = 1, 3 do
        Wait(400)

        if not holding then return end

        local value = lib.callback.await('sm_taser:getShots', false)

        if value then
            shots = value
            pushHud()
            return
        end
    end
end

---@param state boolean
local function setHolding(state)
    if holding == state then return end

    holding = state

    if state then
        shots = nil
        holdToken += 1

        local token = holdToken

        CreateThread(function()
            holdLoop(token)
        end)
        CreateThread(fetchShots)
    end

    syncFrame()
    pushHud()
end

effect.onSelf = function(tased, info)
    syncFrame()

    if not tased or not info then return end

    sound('arc', mmax(0, info.twitchEnd - GetGameTimer()))
end

lib.onCache('weapon', function(weapon)
    setHolding(weapon == WEAPON_HASH)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_taser:client:shots', function(value)
    if type(value) ~= 'number' then return end

    shots = value
    pushHud()
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_taser:client:shot', function(shooter, list)
    if type(list) ~= 'table' then return end

    wire.add(shooter, list)

    if shooter == cache.serverId then return end

    local player = GetPlayerFromServerId(shooter)
    if player == -1 then return end

    local shooterPed = GetPlayerPed(player)
    local muzzle = util.muzzle(shooterPed)

    util.muzzleFlash(muzzle)

    if GetResourceState('xsound') ~= 'started' then return end
    if #(GetEntityCoords(cache.ped) - muzzle) > SOUND_DISTANCE then return end

    local id = ('sm_taser_%d'):format(shooter)

    exports.xsound:PlayUrlPos(id, FIRE_SOUND_URL, SOUND_VOLUME, muzzle, false)
    exports.xsound:Distance(id, SOUND_DISTANCE)
end)

AddEventHandler('ox_inventory:itemCount', function(name)
    if holding and name == CARTRIDGE_ITEM then
        pushHud()
    end
end)

RegisterCommand('+sm_taser_reload', function()
    if holding then
        CreateThread(reload)
    end
end, false)

RegisterCommand('-sm_taser_reload', function() end, false)

RegisterKeyMapping('+sm_taser_reload', 'Taser: load cartridge', 'keyboard', config.reloadKey)

CreateThread(function()
    util.findAnim(RELOAD_ANIMS)
    pcall(lib.requestNamedPtfxAsset, config.muzzleFx.asset, 5000)

    if cache.weapon == WEAPON_HASH then
        setHolding(true)
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource then return end

    holding = false
    wire.clear()
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_3\interface\sm_taser\modules\effect.lua
local config = localmodule 'config'
local util = localmodule 'modules.util'

local Wait = Wait
local GetGameTimer = GetGameTimer
local GetCloudTimeAsInt = GetCloudTimeAsInt
local DoesEntityExist = DoesEntityExist
local IsPedDeadOrDying = IsPedDeadOrDying
local IsPedRagdoll = IsPedRagdoll
local NetworkHasControlOfEntity = NetworkHasControlOfEntity
local IsEntityPlayingAnim = IsEntityPlayingAnim
local TaskPlayAnim = TaskPlayAnim
local SetPedToRagdoll = SetPedToRagdoll
local ApplyForceToEntity = ApplyForceToEntity
local DisableAllControlActions = DisableAllControlActions
local EnableControlAction = EnableControlAction
local GetEntityFromStateBagName = GetEntityFromStateBagName
local mrandom = math.random
local mmin = math.min
local type = type

local RAGDOLL_TICK = 1000
local NPC_RECOVERY_WAIT = 3000
local UNARMED = `WEAPON_UNARMED`
local ENABLED_CONTROLS = { 1, 2, 199, 200, 245, 249 }
local ENABLED_COUNT = #ENABLED_CONTROLS
local TWITCH_FORCE = config.twitchForce
local SHAKE_ANIMS = config.shakeAnims
local NPC_AFTER = config.npc.after

local effect = {
    selfTased = false,
    onSelf = nil,
}

local active = {}
local running = {}

local function applyTwitch(ped)
    ApplyForceToEntity(ped, 1,
        (mrandom() * 2.0 - 1.0) * TWITCH_FORCE,
        (mrandom() * 2.0 - 1.0) * TWITCH_FORCE,
        mrandom() * TWITCH_FORCE * 0.5,
        0.0, 0.0, 0.0, mrandom(0, 10), false, true, true, false, true)
end

---@param ped number
---@param shooter number
local function npcAfter(ped, shooter)
    local timeout = GetGameTimer() + NPC_RECOVERY_WAIT

    while DoesEntityExist(ped) and IsPedRagdoll(ped) and timeout > GetGameTimer() do
        Wait(100)
    end

    if not DoesEntityExist(ped) or not NetworkHasControlOfEntity(ped) or IsPedDeadOrDying(ped, true) then return end

    if NPC_AFTER == 'cower' then
        TaskCower(ped, 15000)
        return
    end

    if NPC_AFTER ~= 'flee' then return end

    local player = GetPlayerFromServerId(shooter)
    local shooterPed = player ~= -1 and GetPlayerPed(player) or 0

    if shooterPed ~= 0 then
        TaskSmartFleePed(ped, shooterPed, 100.0, -1, false, false)
    else
        TaskWanderStandard(ped, 10.0, 10)
    end
end

---@param ped number
---@param isSelf boolean
local function setSelf(ped, isSelf)
    if ped ~= cache.ped then return end

    effect.selfTased = isSelf

    if effect.onSelf then
        effect.onSelf(isSelf, active[ped])
    end
end

---@param ped number
local function run(ped)
    local isSelf = ped == cache.ped
    local isNpc = not IsPedAPlayer(ped)
    local isMission = isNpc and IsEntityAMissionEntity(ped)
    local couldRagdoll = CanPedRagdoll(ped)
    local shakeAnim = util.findAnim(SHAKE_ANIMS)
    local locked = false
    local nextRagdoll = 0
    local nextTwitch = 0
    local info

    SetPedCanRagdoll(ped, true)

    if isSelf then
        setSelf(ped, true)

        if config.player.holster and GetSelectedPedWeapon(ped) ~= UNARMED then
            TriggerEvent('ox_inventory:disarm', true)
        end
    else
        if isMission then
            SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(ped, true)
        end

        ClearPedTasks(ped)
    end

    while true do
        info = active[ped]

        local now = GetGameTimer()

        if not info or now >= info.endsAt then break end
        if not DoesEntityExist(ped) or IsPedDeadOrDying(ped, true) then break end
        if not NetworkHasControlOfEntity(ped) then break end

        if now < info.shakeEnd then
            if shakeAnim and not IsEntityPlayingAnim(ped, shakeAnim.dict, shakeAnim.clip, 3) then
                TaskPlayAnim(ped, shakeAnim.dict, shakeAnim.clip, 8.0, -8.0, -1, 1, 0.0, false, false, false)
            end
        elseif info.mode == 'lock' then
            if not locked then
                locked = true
                util.stopAnim(ped, shakeAnim)
            end

            if now >= nextRagdoll or not IsPedRagdoll(ped) then
                local duration = mmin(RAGDOLL_TICK + 500, info.endsAt - now)
                SetPedToRagdoll(ped, duration, duration, 0, false, false, false)
                nextRagdoll = now + RAGDOLL_TICK
            end

            if TWITCH_FORCE > 0 and now < info.twitchEnd and now >= nextTwitch then
                applyTwitch(ped)
                nextTwitch = now + mrandom(60, 140)
            end
        end

        if isSelf then
            DisableAllControlActions(0)

            for i = 1, ENABLED_COUNT do
                EnableControlAction(0, ENABLED_CONTROLS[i], true)
            end
        end

        Wait(0)
    end

    local completed = info ~= nil and GetGameTimer() >= info.endsAt

    running[ped] = nil
    active[ped] = nil

    if isSelf then
        setSelf(ped, false)
    end

    if not DoesEntityExist(ped) then return end

    util.stopAnim(ped, shakeAnim)

    if isMission then
        SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(ped, false)
    end

    if not couldRagdoll then
        SetTimeout(NPC_RECOVERY_WAIT, function()
            if DoesEntityExist(ped) and not IsPedRagdoll(ped) then
                SetPedCanRagdoll(ped, false)
            end
        end)
    end

    if isNpc and locked and completed then
        npcAfter(ped, info.shooter)
    end
end

---@param data table
---@return table
local function buildInfo(data)
    local start = GetGameTimer()

    if data.mode == 'lock' then
        local shakeEnd = start + data.shake

        return {
            mode = 'lock',
            shooter = data.shooter,
            shakeEnd = shakeEnd,
            twitchEnd = shakeEnd + data.twitch,
            endsAt = shakeEnd + data.ground,
            total = data.shake + data.ground,
        }
    end

    local shakeEnd = start + data.flinch

    return {
        mode = 'flinch',
        shooter = data.shooter,
        shakeEnd = shakeEnd,
        twitchEnd = shakeEnd,
        endsAt = shakeEnd,
        total = data.flinch,
    }
end

AddStateBagChangeHandler('smTaser', nil, function(bagName, _, value)
    if type(value) ~= 'table' then return end

    local ped = GetEntityFromStateBagName(bagName)
    if ped == 0 or not NetworkHasControlOfEntity(ped) then return end

    local info = buildInfo(value)
    local elapsed = GetCloudTimeAsInt() - (value.at or 0)

    if elapsed * 1000 > info.total + 2000 then return end

    local current = active[ped]

    if current and current.mode == 'lock' and info.mode == 'flinch' and GetGameTimer() < current.endsAt then
        return
    end

    active[ped] = info

    if running[ped] then
        if ped == cache.ped and effect.onSelf then
            effect.onSelf(true, info)
        end

        return
    end

    running[ped] = true

    CreateThread(function()
        run(ped)
    end)
end)

return effect


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_3\interface\sm_taser\modules\util.lua
local GetAnimDuration = GetAnimDuration
local TaskPlayAnim = TaskPlayAnim
local IsEntityPlayingAnim = IsEntityPlayingAnim
local StopAnimTask = StopAnimTask
local GetCurrentPedWeaponEntityIndex = GetCurrentPedWeaponEntityIndex
local GetEntityBoneIndexByName = GetEntityBoneIndexByName
local GetWorldPositionOfEntityBone = GetWorldPositionOfEntityBone
local GetPedBoneIndex = GetPedBoneIndex
local DoesEntityExist = DoesEntityExist
local pcall = pcall

local HAND_BONE = 57005
local MUZZLE_FX = (localmodule 'config').muzzleFx

local util = {}
local animCache = {}

---@param list { dict: string, clip: string }[]
---@return { dict: string, clip: string }|false
function util.findAnim(list)
    local cached = animCache[list]
    if cached ~= nil then return cached end

    local found = false

    for i = 1, #list do
        local anim = list[i]

        if pcall(lib.requestAnimDict, anim.dict, 2000) and GetAnimDuration(anim.dict, anim.clip) > 0.0 then
            found = anim
            break
        end
    end

    animCache[list] = found

    return found
end

---@param ped number
---@param list { dict: string, clip: string }[]
---@param flag integer
---@return { dict: string, clip: string }|false
function util.playAnim(ped, list, flag)
    local anim = util.findAnim(list)

    if anim then
        TaskPlayAnim(ped, anim.dict, anim.clip, 4.0, -4.0, -1, flag, 0.0, false, false, false)
    end

    return anim
end

---@param ped number
---@param anim { dict: string, clip: string }|false|nil
function util.stopAnim(ped, anim)
    if anim and IsEntityPlayingAnim(ped, anim.dict, anim.clip, 3) then
        StopAnimTask(ped, anim.dict, anim.clip, 2.0)
    end
end

---@param ped number
---@return vector3
function util.muzzle(ped)
    local weapon = GetCurrentPedWeaponEntityIndex(ped)

    if weapon ~= 0 and DoesEntityExist(weapon) then
        local bone = GetEntityBoneIndexByName(weapon, 'gun_muzzle')

        if bone ~= -1 then
            return GetWorldPositionOfEntityBone(weapon, bone)
        end
    end

    return GetWorldPositionOfEntityBone(ped, GetPedBoneIndex(ped, HAND_BONE))
end

---@param coords vector3
function util.muzzleFlash(coords)
    local fx = MUZZLE_FX

    if not fx or not HasNamedPtfxAssetLoaded(fx.asset) then
        if fx then RequestNamedPtfxAsset(fx.asset) end
        return
    end

    UseParticleFxAssetNextCall(fx.asset)
    StartParticleFxNonLoopedAtCoord(fx.name, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, fx.scale, false, false, false)
end

return util


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_3\interface\sm_taser\modules\wire.lua
local config = localmodule 'config'

local WIRE = config.wire

local DRAW_DISTANCE = WIRE.drawDistance

local wire = {}
local probes = {}

local drawing = false

---@param sx number
---@param sy number
---@param sz number
---@param ex number
---@param ey number
---@param ez number
---@param length number
---@param startFloor number
---@param endFloor number
local function drawWire(sx, sy, sz, ex, ey, ez, length, startFloor, endFloor)
    local dx, dy, dz = ex - sx, ey - sy, ez - sz
    local distance = msqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
    local sag = mmin(msqrt(0.375 * distance * mmax(length - distance, 0.0)), MAX_SAG) * 4.0
    local px, py, pz = sx, sy, sz

    for i = 1, SEGMENTS do
        local t = i / SEGMENTS
        local x = sx + dx * t
        local y = sy + dy * t
        local z = sz + dz * t - sag * t * (1.0 - t)

        if i < SEGMENTS then
            local floor = startFloor + (endFloor - startFloor) * t + 0.02

            if z < floor then
                z = floor
            end
        end

        DrawLine(px, py, pz, x, y, z, R, G, B, A)
        px, py, pz = x, y, z
    end
end

---@param entity number
---@return number
local function floorOf(entity)
    return GetEntityCoords(entity).z - GetEntityHeightAboveGround(entity)
end

---@param serverId number
---@param frame integer
---@return table?
local function shooterState(serverId, frame)
    local state = shooters[serverId]

    if not state then
        state = { frame = -1 }
        shooters[serverId] = state
    end

    if state.frame == frame then
        return state.valid and state or nil
    end

    state.frame = frame
    state.valid = false

    local player = GetPlayerFromServerId(serverId)
    if player == -1 then return end

    local ped = GetPlayerPed(player)
    if ped == 0 or GetSelectedPedWeapon(ped) ~= WEAPON_HASH then return end

    state.valid = true
    state.muzzle = util.muzzle(ped)
    state.floor = floorOf(ped)

    return state
end

local function drawLoop()
    while next(probes) do
        local now = GetGameTimer()
        local frame = GetFrameCount()
        local cam = GetFinalRenderedCamCoord()

        for id, probe in pairs(probes) do
            local remove = now >= probe.expiresAt
            local shooter = not remove and shooterState(probe.shooter, frame)

            if not shooter then
                remove = true
            end

            local px, py, pz, floor

            if not remove and probe.target then
                local entity = NetworkDoesNetworkIdExist(probe.target) and NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(probe.target) or 0

                if entity == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(entity) then
                    remove = true
                else
                    local bone = GetPedBoneCoords(entity, probe.bone, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
                    px, py, pz = bone.x, bone.y, bone.z
                    floor = floorOf(entity)
                end
            elseif not remove then
                local point = probe.point
                px, py, pz = point.x, point.y, point.z
                floor = pz
            end

            if not remove then
                local muzzle = shooter.muzzle
                local dx, dy, dz = px - muzzle.x, py - muzzle.y, pz - muzzle.z
                local distance = msqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)

                if distance > WIRE_LENGTH then
                    remove = true
                elseif #(muzzle - cam) <= DRAW_DISTANCE then
                    probe.length = mmin(mmax(probe.length or distance * (1.0 + SLACK), distance), WIRE_LENGTH)
                    drawWire(muzzle.x, muzzle.y, muzzle.z, px, py, pz, probe.length, shooter.floor, floor)
                end
            end

            if remove then
                probes[id] = nil
            end
        end

        Wait(0)
    end

    for serverId in pairs(shooters) do
        shooters[serverId] = nil
    end

    drawing = false
end

---@param shooter number
---@param list table[]
function wire.add(shooter, list)
    local now = GetGameTimer()

    for i = 1, #list do
        local probe = list[i]

        probes[probe.id] = {
            shooter = shooter,
            target = probe.target,
            bone = probe.bone,
            point = probe.point,
            expiresAt = now + (probe.ttl or 0),
        }
    end

    if not drawing and next(probes) then
        drawing = true
        CreateThread(drawLoop)
    end
end

function wire.clear()
    for id in pairs(probes) do
        probes[id] = nil
    end
end

return wire

local UNARMED = `WEAPON_UNARMED`
local GROUP_SNIPER = `GROUP_SNIPER`
local MAX_LOCKON = 500.0

---@param ped number
---@param weapon number|false?
local function applyLockon(ped, weapon)
    local playerId = cache.playerId

    if weapon and weapon ~= 0 and weapon ~= UNARMED then
        local farLockon = GetLockonDistanceOfCurrentPedWeapon(ped) > MAX_LOCKON

        if farLockon and GetWeapontypeGroup(weapon) ~= GROUP_SNIPER then
            SetPlayerLockon(playerId, false)
            SetPlayerLockonRangeOverride(playerId, -1.0)
            return
        end
    end

    SetPlayerLockon(playerId, true)
    SetPlayerLockonRangeOverride(playerId, 0.0)
end

---@param ped number
local function initialize(ped)
    if not ped then return end

    SetPlayerTargetingMode(3)
    SetPedConfigFlag(ped, 43, true)
    applyLockon(ped, cache.weapon)
end

initialize(cache.ped)

lib.onCache('ped', initialize)

lib.onCache('weapon', function(weapon)
    local ped = cache.ped
    if not ped then return end

    applyLockon(ped, weapon)
end)

---@param index number

local CONNECT_TIMEOUT = 10000

local busy = false

local function resetVoice()
    local address = GetConvar('voice_externalAddress', '')
    local port = GetConvarInt('voice_externalPort', 0)

    if address ~= '' and port ~= 0 then
        MumbleSetServerAddress(address, port)

        local deadline = GetGameTimer() + CONNECT_TIMEOUT

        while not MumbleIsConnected() and GetGameTimer() < deadline do
            Wait(250)
        end
    end

    NetworkClearVoiceChannel()
    NetworkSessionVoiceLeave()
    Wait(50)
    NetworkSetVoiceActive(false)
    MumbleClearVoiceTarget(2)
    Wait(3000)
    MumbleSetVoiceTarget(2)
    NetworkSetVoiceActive(true)
end

    if busy then return end

    busy = true

    local done = lib.progressBar({

        canCancel = false,
        disable = {
            combat = true,
        },
        anim = {
            dict = 'timetable@gardener@smoking_joint',
            clip = 'idle_cough',
        }
    })

    if done then
        resetVoice()
        lib.notify({ description = 'Voice/Mumble reset', type = 'success' })

---@type table<number, table>

    offsets[joaat(model)] = offset

local attachedBike = 0

local function detach()
    local ped = cache.ped
    local bike = attachedBike
    attachedBike = 0

    DetachEntity(ped, false, true)
    ClearPedTasks(ped)

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    SetEntityCoords(ped, coords.x + 1.0, coords.y + 1.0, coords.z - 1.0, false, false, false, false)

    if bike ~= 0 then
        TriggerTokenEvent('sm_bikeseat:server:release')
    end
end

local function watchBike()
    while attachedBike ~= 0 do
        Wait(1000)

        if attachedBike ~= 0 and not DoesEntityExist(attachedBike) then
            attachedBike = 0
            DetachEntity(cache.ped, true, false)
            ClearPedTasks(cache.ped)
            TriggerTokenEvent('sm_bikeseat:server:release')
        end
    end
end

---@param bike number
---@param offset table
local function attach(bike, offset)
    if not NetworkGetEntityIsNetworked(bike) then return end

    local ok = lib.callback.await('sm_bikeseat:server:claim', false, NetworkGetNetworkIdFromEntity(bike))
    if not ok then return end

    local ped = cache.ped

    AttachEntityToEntity(ped, bike, 0, offset.x, offset.y, offset.z, offset.pitch, offset.roll, offset.yaw, true, false, false, false, 0, true)

        RemoveAnimDict(ANIM_DICT)

end, false)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_3\resource\sm_cruise\client.lua
local IsControlPressed = IsControlPressed
local IsControlJustPressed = IsControlJustPressed
local GetEntitySpeed = GetEntitySpeed
local IsVehicleOnAllWheels = IsVehicleOnAllWheels
local SetVehicleForwardSpeed = SetVehicleForwardSpeed
local Wait = Wait

local TOGGLE_COOLDOWN = 1000
local SPEED_DROP_TOLERANCE = 1.5
local MIN_FORWARD_RATIO = 0.95

local CONTROL_BRAKE = 72
local CONTROL_HANDBRAKE = 76
local CONTROL_STEER_LEFT = 63
local CONTROL_STEER_RIGHT = 64

local ALLOWED_CLASSES = {}

for class = 0, 12 do
    ALLOWED_CLASSES[class] = true
end

for class = 17, 20 do
    ALLOWED_CLASSES[class] = true
end

local cruisedSpeed = 0
local lastToggle = 0

---@param text string
---@param kind string
local function notify(text, kind)
    lib.notify({ description = text, type = kind })
end

local function stopCruise()
    cruisedSpeed = 0
    notify('Cruise control deactivated', 'error')
end

---@param vehicle number
local function runCruise(vehicle)
    while cruisedSpeed > 0 and cache.vehicle == vehicle do
        if IsControlJustPressed(2, CONTROL_BRAKE) or IsControlPressed(2, CONTROL_HANDBRAKE) then
            return stopCruise()
        end

        local speed = GetEntitySpeed(vehicle)
        local steering = IsControlPressed(2, CONTROL_STEER_LEFT) or IsControlPressed(2, CONTROL_STEER_RIGHT)

        if not steering then
            if speed < cruisedSpeed - SPEED_DROP_TOLERANCE then
                return stopCruise()
            end

            if speed < cruisedSpeed and IsVehicleOnAllWheels(vehicle) then
                SetVehicleForwardSpeed(vehicle, cruisedSpeed)
            end
        end

        Wait(0)
    end

    cruisedSpeed = 0
end

---@param vehicle number
---@param speed number
---@return boolean
local function isSliding(vehicle, speed)
    if speed <= 2.0 then return false end

    local velocity = GetEntityVelocity(vehicle)
    local forward = GetEntityForwardVector(vehicle)
    local forwardSpeed = velocity.x * forward.x + velocity.y * forward.y + velocity.z * forward.z

    return forwardSpeed < 0 or forwardSpeed / speed < MIN_FORWARD_RATIO
end

local function toggleCruise()
    if cruisedSpeed > 0 then
        return stopCruise()
    end

    local vehicle = cache.vehicle
    if not vehicle or cache.seat ~= -1 then return end

    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if now - lastToggle < TOGGLE_COOLDOWN then return end

    lastToggle = now

    local braking = IsControlPressed(2, CONTROL_HANDBRAKE) or IsControlPressed(2, CONTROL_BRAKE)
    local steering = IsControlPressed(2, CONTROL_STEER_LEFT) or IsControlPressed(2, CONTROL_STEER_RIGHT)

    if braking or steering then
        return notify('Cruise control unavailable', 'error')
    end

    local speed = GetEntitySpeed(vehicle)

    if isSliding(vehicle, speed) then
        return notify('Cruise control unavailable', 'error')
    end

    if speed <= 0 or GetVehicleCurrentGear(vehicle) <= 0 then return end

    cruisedSpeed = speed
    notify('Cruise control activated', 'success')
    CreateThread(function()
        runCruise(vehicle)
    end)
end

lib.addKeybind({
    name = 'toggle_cruise_control',
    description = 'Toggle Cruise Control',
    defaultKey = 'Y',
    onPressed = function()
        local vehicle = cache.vehicle
        if not vehicle or cache.seat ~= -1 then return end

        if not ALLOWED_CLASSES[GetVehicleClass(vehicle)] then
            return notify('Cruise control unavailable', 'error')
        end

        toggleCruise()
    end
})


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_3\resource\sm_diving\client.lua
local IsPedSwimmingUnderWater = IsPedSwimmingUnderWater
local Wait = Wait
local floor = math.floor

local MAX_OXYGEN = 600
local MASK_MODEL = `p_d_scuba_mask_s`
local TANK_MODEL = `p_s_scuba_tank_s`
local ANIM_DICT = 'clothingshirt'

local oxygen = 0
local wearing = false
local busy = false
local gear = { mask = 0, tank = 0 }

local function deleteGear()
    for key, entity in pairs(gear) do
        if entity ~= 0 and DoesEntityExist(entity) then
            DetachEntity(entity, false, true)
            DeleteEntity(entity)
        end

        gear[key] = 0
    end
end

local function playGearAnim()
    if not lib.requestAnimDict(ANIM_DICT, 5000) then return end

    TaskPlayAnim(cache.ped, ANIM_DICT, 'try_shirt_positive_d', 8.0, 1.0, -1, 49, 0, false, false, false)
    RemoveAnimDict(ANIM_DICT)
end

local function takeOff()
    deleteGear()
    wearing = false

    local ped = cache.ped
    SetEnableScuba(ped, false)
    SetPedMaxTimeUnderwater(ped, 1.0)
end

---@param model number
---@param ped number
---@param bone number
---@param offsetX number
---@param offsetY number
---@return number
local function attachProp(model, ped, bone, offsetX, offsetY)
    local prop = CreateObject(model, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, true, true, false)

    SetEntityCollision(prop, false, false)
    SetEntityCanBeDamaged(prop, false)
    AttachEntityToEntity(prop, ped, GetPedBoneIndex(ped, bone), offsetX, offsetY, 0.0, 180.0, 90.0, 0.0, false, true, false, true, 2, true)

    return prop
end

local function oxygenLoop()
    local shown = -1

    while wearing do
        local ped = cache.ped

        if IsPedSwimmingUnderWater(ped) then
            oxygen = oxygen - 1

            if oxygen <= 0 then
                oxygen = 0
                takeOff()
                lib.notify({ description = 'Oksigen habis!', type = 'error' })
                break
            end

            local percent = floor(oxygen / MAX_OXYGEN * 100)

            if percent ~= shown then
                shown = percent
                lib.showTextUI(('%d%% Oxygen'):format(percent), {
                    position = 'right-center',
                    icon = 'lungs',
                })
            end
        elseif shown ~= -1 then
            shown = -1
            lib.hideTextUI()
        end

        Wait(1000)
    end

    if shown ~= -1 then
        lib.hideTextUI()
    end
end

local function putOn()
    if oxygen <= 0 then
        return lib.notify({ description = 'Isi tabung oksigen terlebih dahulu.', type = 'error' })
    end

    playGearAnim()

    local done = lib.progressBar({
        duration = 5000,
        label = 'Memakai perlengkapan selam...',
        canCancel = true,
        disable = { car = true, combat = true },
    })

    ClearPedTasks(cache.ped)

    if not done then return end

    if not lib.requestModel(MASK_MODEL, 10000) or not lib.requestModel(TANK_MODEL, 10000) then
        return lib.notify({ description = 'Gagal memuat perlengkapan selam.', type = 'error' })
    end

    deleteGear()

    local ped = cache.ped
    gear.mask = attachProp(MASK_MODEL, ped, 12844, 0.0, 0.0)
    gear.tank = attachProp(TANK_MODEL, ped, 24818, -0.25, -0.25)

    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(MASK_MODEL)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(TANK_MODEL)
    SetEnableScuba(ped, true)
    SetPedMaxTimeUnderwater(ped, 2000.0)

    wearing = true
    CreateThread(oxygenLoop)
end

local function remove()
    playGearAnim()

    local done = lib.progressBar({
        duration = 5000,
        label = 'Melepas perlengkapan selam...',
        canCancel = true,
        disable = { car = true, combat = true },
    })

    ClearPedTasks(cache.ped)

    if not done then return end

    takeOff()
    lib.notify({ description = 'Perlengkapan selam dilepas.' })
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_diving:client:useGear', function()
    if busy then return end

    busy = true

    local ok, err = pcall(wearing and remove or putOn)

    busy = false

    if not ok then
        lib.print.error(err)
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_diving:client:fill', function()
    oxygen = MAX_OXYGEN
    lib.notify({ description = 'Tabung oksigen terisi penuh silahkan pakai diving gear.', type = 'success' })
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_diving:client:oxygen', function()
    return floor(oxygen / MAX_OXYGEN * 100)
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource or not wearing then return end

    lib.hideTextUI()
    takeOff()
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_3\resource\sm_fingerprint\client.lua
local TABLET_MODEL = `prop_cs_tablet`
local TABLET_DICT = 'amb@code_human_in_bus_passenger_idles@female@tablet@base'
local SCAN_RADIUS = 2.0
local UNKNOWN = 'TIDAK DIKETAHUI'

local tablet = 0
local scanning = false

local function removeTablet()
    ClearPedSecondaryTask(cache.ped)

    if tablet ~= 0 and DoesEntityExist(tablet) then
        DetachEntity(tablet, true, false)
        DeleteEntity(tablet)
    end

    tablet = 0
end

local function holdTablet()
    if not lib.requestAnimDict(TABLET_DICT, 2000) or not lib.requestModel(TABLET_MODEL, 2000) then return end

    local ped = cache.ped
    tablet = CreateObject(TABLET_MODEL, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, true, true, false)

    AttachEntityToEntity(tablet, ped, GetPedBoneIndex(ped, 60309), 0.03, 0.002, -0.0, 10.0, 160.0, 0.0, true, false, false, false, 2, true)
    TaskPlayAnim(ped, TABLET_DICT, 'base', 3.0, 3.0, -1, 49, 0, false, false, false)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(TABLET_MODEL)
    RemoveAnimDict(TABLET_DICT)
end

---@param text string
---@param label string
local function copy(text, label)
    lib.setClipboard(text)
    lib.notify({ description = label, type = 'success' })
end

local showSummary

---@param data table
local function showDetail(data)
    local info = data.charinfo
    local name = ('%s %s'):format(info.firstname, info.lastname)
    local bloodType = data.metadata.bloodtype or UNKNOWN
    local birthdate = info.birthdate or UNKNOWN
    local nationality = info.nationality or UNKNOWN
    local gender = info.gender == 0 and 'LAKI-LAKI' or 'PEREMPUAN'
    local phone = info.phone or 'TIDAK TERDAFTAR'
    local fingerprint = data.metadata.fingerprint

    lib.registerContext({
        id = 'sm_fingerprint:detail',
        title = 'Detail Biometrik - ' .. name,
        menu = 'sm_fingerprint:summary',
        options = {
            {
                title = 'Identitas',
                description = ('Nama: %s\nCitizen ID: %s\nState ID: %s'):format(name, data.citizenid, data.source),
                icon = 'fa-solid fa-id-card',
                onSelect = function()
                    copy(data.citizenid, 'Citizen ID Copied: ' .. data.citizenid)
                end,
            },
            {
                title = 'Data Biometrik',
                description = ('Fingerprint: %s\nGolongan Darah: %s'):format(fingerprint, bloodType),
                icon = 'fa-solid fa-microscope',
                onSelect = function()
                    copy(('%s | %s'):format(fingerprint, bloodType), 'Biometric Data Copied')
                end,
            },
            {
                title = 'Informasi Personal',
                description = ('Tanggal Lahir: %s\nJenis Kelamin: %s\nKewarganegaraan: %s\nNo. Telepon: %s'):format(birthdate, gender, nationality, phone),
                icon = 'fa-solid fa-user',
                onSelect = function()
                    copy(('%s | %s | %s | %s'):format(birthdate, gender, nationality, phone), 'Personal Info Copied')
                end,
            },
            {
                title = 'Kembali ke Menu Utama',
                description = 'Kembali ke menu fingerprint scanner',
                icon = 'fa-solid fa-arrow-left',
                onSelect = function()
                    showSummary(data)
                end,
            },
        },
    })

    lib.showContext('sm_fingerprint:detail')
end

---@param data table
function showSummary(data)
    local info = data.charinfo
    local name = ('%s %s'):format(info.firstname, info.lastname)
    local bloodType = data.metadata.bloodtype or UNKNOWN
    local fingerprint = data.metadata.fingerprint

    lib.registerContext({
        id = 'sm_fingerprint:summary',
        title = 'Fingerprint Scanner',
        options = {
            {
                title = 'Nama: ' .. name,
                description = ('Print ID: %s \nCitizen ID: %s \nState ID: %s \n\nKlik menu ini untuk copy print ID'):format(fingerprint, data.citizenid, data.source),
                icon = 'fa-solid fa-fingerprint',
                onSelect = function()
                    copy(fingerprint, 'Fingerprint Copied: ' .. fingerprint)
                    showSummary(data)
                end,
            },
            {
                title = 'Golongan Darah: ' .. bloodType,
                description = 'Informasi golongan darah dari hasil scan biometrik',
                icon = 'fa-solid fa-droplet',
                onSelect = function()
                    copy(bloodType, 'Blood Type Copied: ' .. bloodType)
                    showSummary(data)
                end,
            },
            {
                title = 'Detail Lengkap',
                description = 'Tampilkan semua informasi biometrik dan identitas',
                icon = 'fa-solid fa-list',
                onSelect = function()
                    showDetail(data)
                end,
            },
        },
    })

    lib.showContext('sm_fingerprint:summary')
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_fingerprint:client:scan', function()
    if scanning then return end

    local target = lib.getClosestPlayer(GetEntityCoords(cache.ped), SCAN_RADIUS, false)

    if not target then
        return lib.notify({ description = 'Tidak ada orang yang cukup dekat untuk discan.', type = 'error' })
    end

    scanning = true
    holdTablet()

    local done = lib.progressBar({
        duration = 5000,
        label = 'Mencoba memindai sidik jari..',
        canCancel = true,
        disable = { car = true },
    })

    removeTablet()

    if not done then
        scanning = false
        return lib.notify({ description = 'cancel', type = 'error' })
    end

    local ok, data = pcall(lib.callback.await, 'sm_fingerprint:server:scan', false, GetPlayerServerId(target))
    scanning = false

    if ok and type(data) == 'table' then
        showSummary(data)
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource or tablet == 0 then return end

    removeTablet()
end)


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[03_fitur_tambahan]\sm_resource_3\resource\sm_givecash\client.lua
local config = localmodule 'config'

local Wait = Wait
local DoesEntityExist = DoesEntityExist
local GetEntityCoords = GetEntityCoords
local groupdigits = lib.math.groupdigits

local MAX_GIVE = config.maxGive
local WATCH_DISTANCE = 2.0
local ANIM_DICT = 'mp_safehouselost@'

local dialogOpen = false

---@param text string
---@param kind string
local function notify(text, kind)
    lib.notify({ title = text, type = kind })
end

---@param entity number
local function watchTarget(entity)
    CreateThread(function()
        while dialogOpen do
            if not DoesEntityExist(entity) or #(GetEntityCoords(entity) - GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)) > WATCH_DISTANCE then
                dialogOpen = false
                lib.closeInputDialog()
                lib.closeAlertDialog()
                notify('tidak ditemukan orangnya!', 'error')
                break
            end

            Wait(500)
        end
    end)
end

---@param entity number
local function giveCash(entity)
    if dialogOpen or not IsPedAPlayer(entity) then return end

    local playerIndex = NetworkGetPlayerIndexFromPed(entity)
    if playerIndex == -1 then return end

    local targetId = GetPlayerServerId(playerIndex)
    local cash = lib.callback.await('sm_givecash:server:cash', false) or 0

    if cash <= 0 then
        return notify('tidak punya cukup uang!', 'error')
    end

    dialogOpen = true
    watchTarget(entity)

    local input = lib.inputDialog('Give Cash', {
        {
            type = 'number',
            label = 'Jumlah',
            description = 'Uang kamu $' .. groupdigits(cash),
            default = 1,
            min = 1,
            max = MAX_GIVE,
            required = true
        }
    })

    local amount = input and input[1]

    if not dialogOpen or not amount then
        dialogOpen = false
        return
    end

    if amount > cash then
        dialogOpen = false
        return notify('tidak cukup uang!', 'error')
    end

    local confirm = lib.alertDialog({
        header = 'Konfirmasi',
        content = ('Kasih $%s ke orang ini?'):format(groupdigits(amount)),
        centered = true,
        cancel = true,
        size = 'md'
    })

    local stillOpen = dialogOpen
    dialogOpen = false

    if not stillOpen or confirm ~= 'confirm' then return end

    TriggerTokenEvent('sm_givecash:server:give', targetId, amount)
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_givecash:client:given', function()
    if not lib.requestAnimDict(ANIM_DICT, 5000) then return end

    local ped = cache.ped
    TaskPlayAnim(ped, ANIM_DICT, 'package_dropoff', 8.0, -8.0, -1, 0, 0, false, false, false)
    RemoveAnimDict(ANIM_DICT)
    Wait(3500)
    ClearPedTasks(ped)
end)

ox_target:addGlobalPlayer({
    {
        name = 'sm_givecash',
        icon = 'fa-solid fa-money-bill-wave',
        label = 'Give Cash',
        distance = 1.5,
        canInteract = function()
            return not cache.vehicle
        end,
        onSelect = function(data)
            giveCash(data.entity)
        end,
    },
})
