########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[05_map_mlo]\sm_wiwang_motel_v2\modules\management\server.lua
local recentLogsLimit = 5
local logsPageSize = 8

local config = require 'config.shared'
local Layout = require 'modules.layout'
local SelfService = require 'modules.self_service.server'

local management = config.management

local DATA = {
    rooms = {},
    roomById = {},
    dashboardLogs = {},
    logsTotal = 0,
    revenueToday = 0,
    priceOverrides = { rooms = {}, floors = {} },
}

local checkoutMonitorRunning = false
local pendingInvoices = {}
local invoiceSequence = 0

local function today()
    return os.date('%Y-%m-%d')
end

local function buildVisitorSeries(countsByDate)
    local series = {}
    local now = os.time()

    for offset = 6, 0, -1 do
        local ts = now - offset * 86400
        local date = os.date('%Y-%m-%d', ts)

        series[#series + 1] = {
            label = os.date('%a', ts),
            value = countsByDate[date] or 0,
        }
    end

    return series
end

local function getPlayerName(player, fallback)
    local data = player and player.PlayerData
    local charinfo = data and data.charinfo

    if charinfo then
        local firstName = charinfo.firstname or charinfo.firstName
        local lastName = charinfo.lastname or charinfo.lastName

        if firstName or lastName then
            return ('%s %s'):format(firstName or '', lastName or ''):gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '')
        end
    end

    return data and data.name or fallback
end

local function notify(source, notifyType, description)
    return lib.notify(source, {
        type = notifyType,
        description = description,
        duration = 4500,
    })
end

local function getLogPage(page)
    return Storage.getLogs(page, logsPageSize, DATA.logsTotal)
end

local function roomPrice(room)
    local override = DATA.priceOverrides.rooms[room.id] or DATA.priceOverrides.floors[room.floor]

    if override then
        return override
    end

    local customFloorPrices = management.customRoomPrices and management.customRoomPrices[room.floor]
    local customPrice = customFloorPrices and customFloorPrices[room.number]

    if customPrice ~= nil then
        return math.max(0, tonumber(customPrice) or 0)
    end

    local floorPrice = management.floorPrices and management.floorPrices[room.floor]

    return math.max(0, tonumber(floorPrice or management.roomBasePrice) or 450)
end

local function normalizePrice(value)
    local price = tonumber(value)

    if not price or price < 0 then
        return nil
    end

    return math.floor(price)
end

local function dateToTimestamp(value, hour)
    local year, month, day = tostring(value):match('^(%d%d%d%d)%-(%d%d)%-(%d%d)$')

    if not year then
        return
    end

    return os.time({
        year = tonumber(year),
        month = tonumber(month),
        day = tonumber(day),
        hour = hour or 12,
        min = 0,
        sec = 0,
    })
end

local function checkoutDeadline(date)
    local hour = math.min(23, math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(management.checkoutHour) or 18)))

    return dateToTimestamp(date, hour)
end

local function getStayDays(checkinDate, checkoutDate)
    local checkinTimestamp = dateToTimestamp(checkinDate)
    local checkoutTimestamp = dateToTimestamp(checkoutDate)

    if not checkinTimestamp or not checkoutTimestamp then
        return 0
    end

    return math.max(0, math.floor(((checkoutTimestamp - checkinTimestamp) / 86400) + 0.5))
end

---@return Array
local function newOccupantList()
    ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: invisible
    return lib.array:new()
end

local function findOccupant(room, citizenId)
    return room.occupants:find(function(occupant)
        return occupant.citizenId == citizenId
    end)
end

local function hasOccupantSlot(room)
    return #room.occupants + 1 < room.maxOccupants
end

local function buildRooms()
    local builtRooms = {}
    local roomById = {}
    local entries = Layout.list()

    for index = 1, #entries do
        local entry = entries[index]
        local basePrice = roomPrice(entry)

        local room = {
            id = entry.id,
            doorId = entry.id,
            floor = entry.floor,
            number = entry.number,
            status = 'available',
            basePrice = basePrice,
            price = basePrice,
            maxOccupants = Layout.getMaxOccupants(entry.id),
            occupantPrice = Layout.getExtraOccupantPrice(),
            occupants = newOccupantList(),
        }

        builtRooms[#builtRooms + 1] = room
        roomById[room.id] = room
    end

    DATA.rooms = builtRooms
    DATA.roomById = roomById
end

local function findRoom(roomId)
    return DATA.roomById[roomId]
end

local function getCitizenId(player)
    local data = player and player.PlayerData

    return data and data.citizenid
end

local function dashboard()
    local occupied = 0
    local available = 0
    local checkout = 0
    local visitorSeries = buildVisitorSeries(Storage.getVisitorTrend(7))

    for index = 1, #DATA.rooms do
        local room = DATA.rooms[index]

        if room.status == 'occupied' then
            occupied = occupied + 1
            if room.checkoutDate == today() then
                checkout = checkout + 1
            end
        elseif room.status == 'available' then
            available = available + 1
        end
    end

    return {
        visitors = visitorSeries,
        logs = DATA.dashboardLogs,
        stats = {
            occupiedRooms = occupied,
            availableRooms = available,
            expectedCheckout = checkout,
            revenueToday = DATA.revenueToday,
        },
    }
end

local function resetReservedRoom(room)
    room.status = 'available'
    room.citizenId = nil
    room.guestName = nil
    room.checkinDate = nil
    room.checkoutDate = nil
    room.basePrice = roomPrice(room)
    room.price = room.basePrice
    room.note = nil
    room.occupants = newOccupantList()
end

local function syncRooms(rooms, includeLogs)
    local payload = {
        rooms = rooms,
        dashboard = dashboard(),
    }

    if includeLogs then
        payload.logs = getLogPage(1)
    end

    Staff.syncEvent('rhd_motel:management:sync', payload)
end

local function syncRoom(room, includeLogs)
    return syncRooms({ room }, includeLogs)
end

local function applyRoomPrice(room)
    room.basePrice = roomPrice(room)

    if room.status == 'available' then
        room.price = room.basePrice
    end

    Storage.saveRoom(room)
end

local function expireInvoice(invoiceId, reason)
    local invoice = pendingInvoices[invoiceId]

    if not invoice or invoice.status ~= 'pending' then
        return false
    end

    invoice.status = reason or 'expired'
    pendingInvoices[invoiceId] = nil

    local room = findRoom(invoice.roomId)

    if room and invoice.kind == 'room' and room.status == 'reserved' then
        resetReservedRoom(room)
        syncRoom(room, false)
    end

    Event.emitLatentClient('rhd_motel:invoice:closed', invoice.targetSource, {
        id = invoice.id,
        status = invoice.status,
    })

    return true
end

local function createInvoice(source, payload, selfService)
    if type(payload) ~= 'table' then
        return { success = false, message = 'Invalid invoice data.' }
    end

    local targetSource = selfService and source or tonumber(payload.playerId)
    local targetPlayer = targetSource and Core:GetPlayer(targetSource)
    local room = findRoom(payload.roomId)

    if not targetPlayer then
        return { success = false, message = 'Target player is not available.' }
    end

    if not room or room.status ~= 'available' then
        return { success = false, message = 'Room is no longer available.' }
    end

    local checkinDate = tostring(payload.checkinDate or '')
    local checkoutDate = tostring(payload.checkoutDate or '')
    local stayDays = getStayDays(checkinDate, checkoutDate)

    if checkinDate < today() or stayDays < 1 then
        return { success = false, message = 'Invalid check-in or checkout date.' }
    end

    invoiceSequence = invoiceSequence + 1

    local timeoutSeconds = math.max(10, tonumber(management.invoiceTimeout) or 60)
    local basePrice = roomPrice(room)
    local invoiceId = ('motel-%s-%s'):format(os.time(), invoiceSequence)

    local invoice = {
        id = invoiceId,
        kind = 'room',
        roomId = room.id,
        roomNumber = room.number,
        targetSource = targetSource,
        targetCitizenId = getCitizenId(targetPlayer),
        guestName = tostring(payload.guestName or getPlayerName(targetPlayer, 'Guest')),
        checkinDate = checkinDate,
        checkoutDate = checkoutDate,
        stayDays = stayDays,
        basePrice = basePrice,
        amount = basePrice * stayDays,
        note = payload.note and tostring(payload.note) or nil,
        senderSource = source,
        selfService = selfService == true,
        status = 'pending',
        expiresAt = os.time() + timeoutSeconds,
    }

    pendingInvoices[invoiceId] = invoice

    room.status = 'reserved'
    room.citizenId = invoice.targetCitizenId
    room.guestName = invoice.guestName
    room.checkinDate = checkinDate
    room.checkoutDate = checkoutDate
    room.basePrice = basePrice
    room.price = invoice.amount
    room.note = invoice.note

    syncRoom(room, false)

    Event.emitLatentClient('rhd_motel:invoice:open', targetSource, {
        id = invoice.id,
        kind = invoice.kind,
        roomNumber = invoice.roomNumber,
        guestName = invoice.guestName,
        checkinDate = invoice.checkinDate,
        checkoutDate = invoice.checkoutDate,
        stayDays = invoice.stayDays,
        basePrice = invoice.basePrice,
        amount = invoice.amount,
        expiresAt = invoice.expiresAt,
        timeout = timeoutSeconds,
    })

    SetTimeout(timeoutSeconds * 1000, function()
        expireInvoice(invoiceId, 'expired')
    end)

    return {
        success = true,
        invoiceId = invoice.id,
        expiresAt = invoice.expiresAt,
    }
end

local function createOccupantInvoice(source, payload)
    if type(payload) ~= 'table' then
        return { success = false, message = 'Invalid occupant data.' }
    end

    local room = findRoom(payload.roomId)

    if not room or room.status ~= 'occupied' then
        return { success = false, message = 'This room is not rented.' }
    end

    if not hasOccupantSlot(room) then
        return { success = false, message = 'Room occupant capacity is full.' }
    end

    local targetSource = tonumber(payload.playerId)
    local targetPlayer = targetSource and Core:GetPlayer(targetSource)
    local targetCitizenId = targetPlayer and getCitizenId(targetPlayer)

    if not targetCitizenId then
        return { success = false, message = 'Target player is not available.' }
    end

    if targetCitizenId == room.citizenId or findOccupant(room, targetCitizenId) then
        return { success = false, message = 'This player already has access to the room.' }
    end

    for _, pending in pairs(pendingInvoices) do
        if pending.status == 'pending'
            and pending.roomId == room.id
            and pending.occupantCitizenId == targetCitizenId
        then
            return { success = false, message = 'An occupant invoice for this player is still pending.' }
        end
    end

    local renter = room.citizenId and Core:GetPlayerByCitizenId(room.citizenId)
    local renterSource = renter and renter.PlayerData and renter.PlayerData.source

    if not renterSource then
        return { success = false, message = 'The main tenant of this room is offline.' }
    end

    invoiceSequence = invoiceSequence + 1

    local timeoutSeconds = math.max(10, tonumber(management.invoiceTimeout) or 60)
    local invoiceId = ('motel-occupant-%s-%s'):format(os.time(), invoiceSequence)
    local basePrice = normalizePrice(payload.price) or Layout.getExtraOccupantPrice()
    local stayDays = math.max(1, getStayDays(today(), room.checkoutDate))
    local occupantName = payload.guestName and tostring(payload.guestName):match('^%s*(.-)%s*$')

    if not occupantName or occupantName == '' then
        occupantName = getPlayerName(targetPlayer, ('Player %s'):format(targetSource))
    end

    local invoice = {
        id = invoiceId,
        kind = 'occupant',
        roomId = room.id,
        roomNumber = room.number,
        targetSource = renterSource,
        targetCitizenId = room.citizenId,
        occupantCitizenId = targetCitizenId,
        guestName = occupantName,
        checkinDate = today(),
        checkoutDate = room.checkoutDate,
        stayDays = stayDays,
        basePrice = basePrice,
        amount = basePrice * stayDays,
        senderSource = source,
        status = 'pending',
        expiresAt = os.time() + timeoutSeconds,
    }

    pendingInvoices[invoiceId] = invoice

    Event.emitLatentClient('rhd_motel:invoice:open', renterSource, {
        id = invoice.id,
        kind = invoice.kind,
        roomNumber = invoice.roomNumber,
        guestName = invoice.guestName,
        checkinDate = invoice.checkinDate,
        checkoutDate = invoice.checkoutDate,
        stayDays = invoice.stayDays,
        basePrice = invoice.basePrice,
        amount = invoice.amount,
        expiresAt = invoice.expiresAt,
        timeout = timeoutSeconds,
    })

    SetTimeout(timeoutSeconds * 1000, function()
        expireInvoice(invoiceId, 'expired')
    end)

    return {
        success = true,
        invoiceId = invoice.id,
        expiresAt = invoice.expiresAt,
    }
end

local function createExtendInvoice(source, payload)
    if type(payload) ~= 'table' then
        return { success = false, message = 'Invalid extension data.' }
    end

    local room = findRoom(payload.roomId)

    if not room or room.status ~= 'occupied' then
        return { success = false, message = 'This room is not rented.' }
    end

    local checkoutDate = tostring(payload.checkoutDate or '')
    local extraDays = getStayDays(room.checkoutDate, checkoutDate)

    if extraDays < 1 then
        return { success = false, message = 'The new checkout date must be later than the current one.' }
    end

    for _, pending in pairs(pendingInvoices) do
        if pending.status == 'pending' and pending.kind == 'extend' and pending.roomId == room.id then
            return { success = false, message = 'An extension invoice for this room is still pending.' }
        end
    end

    local renter = room.citizenId and Core:GetPlayerByCitizenId(room.citizenId)
    local renterSource = renter and renter.PlayerData and renter.PlayerData.source

    if not renterSource then
        return { success = false, message = 'The main tenant of this room is offline.' }
    end

    invoiceSequence = invoiceSequence + 1

    local timeoutSeconds = math.max(10, tonumber(management.invoiceTimeout) or 60)
    local invoiceId = ('motel-extend-%s-%s'):format(os.time(), invoiceSequence)
    local basePrice = normalizePrice(payload.price) or room.basePrice or roomPrice(room)

    local invoice = {
        id = invoiceId,
        kind = 'extend',
        roomId = room.id,
        roomNumber = room.number,
        targetSource = renterSource,
        targetCitizenId = room.citizenId,
        guestName = room.guestName or 'Guest',
        checkinDate = room.checkoutDate,
        checkoutDate = checkoutDate,
        stayDays = extraDays,
        basePrice = basePrice,
        amount = basePrice * extraDays,
        senderSource = source,
        status = 'pending',
        expiresAt = os.time() + timeoutSeconds,
    }

    pendingInvoices[invoiceId] = invoice

    Event.emitLatentClient('rhd_motel:invoice:open', renterSource, {
        id = invoice.id,
        kind = invoice.kind,
        roomNumber = invoice.roomNumber,
        guestName = invoice.guestName,
        checkinDate = invoice.checkinDate,
        checkoutDate = invoice.checkoutDate,
        stayDays = invoice.stayDays,
        basePrice = invoice.basePrice,
        amount = invoice.amount,
        expiresAt = invoice.expiresAt,
        timeout = timeoutSeconds,
    })

    SetTimeout(timeoutSeconds * 1000, function()
        expireInvoice(invoiceId, 'expired')
    end)

    return {
        success = true,
        invoiceId = invoice.id,
        expiresAt = invoice.expiresAt,
    }
end

local function recordBilling(invoice, title, description)
    local staff = not invoice.selfService and invoice.senderSource and Core:GetPlayer(invoice.senderSource)
    local staffCitizenId = getCitizenId(staff)

    if not staffCitizenId or not invoice.targetCitizenId then
        return
    end

    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        return exports[management.billingResource]:createPaidInvoice({
            senderCitizenId = staffCitizenId,
            senderJob = config.motelJob,
            targetCitizenId = invoice.targetCitizenId,
            title = title,
            description = description,
            amount = invoice.amount,
            items = {
                {
                    label = title,
                    description = ('%s night(s)'):format(invoice.stayDays),
                    price = invoice.basePrice,
                },
            },
        })
    end)

    if not ok then
        return lib.print.error(('[rhd_motel] Billing export failed: %s'):format(result))
    end

    if type(result) ~= 'table' or not result.success then
        lib.print.error(('[rhd_motel] Billing rejected the invoice: %s'):format(type(result) == 'table' and result.message or 'no response'))
    end
end

local function payInvoice(source, invoiceId)
    local invoice = pendingInvoices[invoiceId]

    if not invoice or invoice.status ~= 'pending' or invoice.targetSource ~= source then
        return { success = false, message = 'Invoice is no longer available.' }
    end

    if os.time() >= invoice.expiresAt then
        expireInvoice(invoiceId, 'expired')
        return { success = false, message = 'Invoice has expired.' }
    end

    invoice.status = 'processing'

    local room = findRoom(invoice.roomId)
    local player = Core:GetPlayer(source)
    local expectedStatus = (invoice.kind == 'occupant' or invoice.kind == 'extend') and 'occupied' or 'reserved'

    if not room or room.status ~= expectedStatus or not player then
        invoice.status = 'pending'
        expireInvoice(invoiceId, 'cancelled')
        return { success = false, message = 'Room reservation is no longer available.' }
    end

    if invoice.kind == 'occupant' and (not hasOccupantSlot(room) or findOccupant(room, invoice.occupantCitizenId)) then
        invoice.status = 'pending'
        expireInvoice(invoiceId, 'cancelled')
        return { success = false, message = 'Room occupant capacity is full.' }
    end

    local paymentAccount = management.paymentAccount or 'bank'
    local paid = player.Functions.RemoveMoney(paymentAccount, invoice.amount, 'motel-room-invoice')

    if not paid then
        invoice.status = 'pending'
        return { success = false, message = 'Insufficient balance.' }
    end

    invoice.status = 'paid'
    pendingInvoices[invoiceId] = nil

    DATA.revenueToday = DATA.revenueToday + invoice.amount

    if invoice.kind == 'extend' then
        room.checkoutDate = invoice.checkoutDate
        room.price = (tonumber(room.price) or 0) + invoice.amount

        Storage.saveRoom(room)

        local extendLogId = Storage.addLog(
            room.id,
            ('Room %03d extended'):format(room.number),
            ('%s extended the stay until %s'):format(invoice.guestName, room.checkoutDate),
            'payment',
            invoice.amount
        )

        if extendLogId then
            DATA.logsTotal = DATA.logsTotal + 1
        end

        DATA.dashboardLogs = Storage.getRecentLogs(recentLogsLimit)
        syncRoom(room, true)

        recordBilling(
            invoice,
            ('Motel Room %03d Extension'):format(room.number),
            ('Stay extended until %s'):format(room.checkoutDate)
        )

        Event.emitLatentClient('rhd_motel:invoice:closed', source, {
            id = invoice.id,
            status = 'paid',
        })

        return { success = true, room = room }
    end

    if invoice.kind == 'occupant' then
        local occupant = {
            citizenId = invoice.occupantCitizenId,
            name = invoice.guestName,
        }

        room.occupants:push(occupant)
        Storage.addRoomOccupant(room.id, occupant.citizenId, occupant.name)

        local occupantLogId = Storage.addLog(
            room.id,
            ('Room %03d occupant added'):format(room.number),
            ('%s was added as an occupant until %s'):format(occupant.name, room.checkoutDate),
            'checkin',
            invoice.amount
        )

        if occupantLogId then
            DATA.logsTotal = DATA.logsTotal + 1
        end

        DATA.dashboardLogs = Storage.getRecentLogs(recentLogsLimit)
        syncRoom(room, true)

        recordBilling(
            invoice,
            ('Motel Room %03d Occupant'):format(room.number),
            ('%s was added as an occupant until %s'):format(invoice.guestName, room.checkoutDate)
        )

        Event.emitLatentClient('rhd_motel:invoice:closed', source, {
            id = invoice.id,
            status = 'paid',
        })

        return { success = true, room = room }
    end

    room.status = 'occupied'
    room.citizenId = invoice.targetCitizenId
    room.guestName = invoice.guestName
    room.checkinDate = invoice.checkinDate
    room.checkoutDate = invoice.checkoutDate
    room.basePrice = invoice.basePrice
    room.price = invoice.amount
    room.note = invoice.note

    Storage.saveRoom(room)

    local logId = Storage.addLog(
        room.id,
        ('Room %03d check-in'):format(room.number),
        ('%s paid the room invoice until %s'):format(room.guestName, room.checkoutDate),
        'checkin',
        room.price
    )

    if logId then
        DATA.logsTotal = DATA.logsTotal + 1
    end

    DATA.dashboardLogs = Storage.getRecentLogs(recentLogsLimit)
    syncRoom(room, true)

    recordBilling(
        invoice,
        ('Motel Room %03d'):format(room.number),
        ('Stay from %s until %s'):format(room.checkinDate, room.checkoutDate)
    )

    Event.emitLatentClient('rhd_motel:invoice:closed', source, {
        id = invoice.id,
        status = 'paid',
    })

    return { success = true, room = room }
end

local function clearRoomCheckout(room, forced)
    local guestName = room.guestName or 'Guest'
    local checkoutDate = room.checkoutDate

    room.status = 'available'
    room.citizenId = nil
    room.guestName = nil
    room.checkinDate = nil
    room.checkoutDate = nil
    room.basePrice = roomPrice(room)
    room.price = room.basePrice
    room.note = nil
    room.occupants = newOccupantList()

    Storage.saveRoom(room)
    Storage.clearRoomOccupants(room.id)

    local logId = Storage.addLog(
        room.id,
        forced and ('Room %03d force checkout'):format(room.number) or ('Room %03d checkout'):format(room.number),
        forced
            and ('%s was forced out by %s: %s'):format(guestName, forced.staffName, forced.reason)
            or ('%s checked out on %s'):format(guestName, checkoutDate or today()),
        'checkout',
        0
    )

    if logId then
        DATA.logsTotal = DATA.logsTotal + 1
    end

    TriggerEvent('rhd_motel:doorlock:setStateInternal', room.doorId, true)
end

local function monitorRoomCheckouts()
    if checkoutMonitorRunning then
        return
    end

    checkoutMonitorRunning = true

    local success, errorMessage = pcall(function()
        local now = os.time()
        local checkedOutRooms = {}

        for index = 1, #DATA.rooms do
            local room = DATA.rooms[index]
            local dueAt = room.checkoutDate and checkoutDeadline(room.checkoutDate)

            if room.status == 'occupied' and dueAt and now >= dueAt then
                clearRoomCheckout(room)
                checkedOutRooms[#checkedOutRooms + 1] = room
            end
        end

        if #checkedOutRooms > 0 then
            DATA.dashboardLogs = Storage.getRecentLogs(recentLogsLimit)

            Staff.syncEvent('rhd_motel:management:sync', {
                rooms = checkedOutRooms,
                dashboard = dashboard(),
                logs = getLogPage(1),
            })

            lib.print.info(('[rhd_motel] processed %s room checkout(s)'):format(#checkedOutRooms))
        end
    end)

    checkoutMonitorRunning = false

    if not success then
        lib.print.error(('[rhd_motel] checkout monitor failed: %s'):format(errorMessage))
    end
end

lib.callback.register('rhd_motel:management:removeOccupant', function(source, payload)
    if not Staff.isOnduty(source) then
        return { success = false, message = 'You do not have access to motel management.' }
    end

    local room = type(payload) == 'table' and findRoom(payload.roomId)
    local citizenId = type(payload) == 'table' and payload.citizenId
    local occupant = room and type(citizenId) == 'string' and findOccupant(room, citizenId)

    if not room or not occupant then
        return { success = false, message = 'Occupant is no longer registered.' }
    end

    room.occupants = room.occupants:filter(function(entry)
        return entry.citizenId ~= citizenId
    end) --[[@as Array]]

    Storage.removeRoomOccupant(room.id, citizenId)

    local logId = Storage.addLog(
        room.id,
        ('Room %03d occupant removed'):format(room.number),
        ('%s was removed from the room'):format(occupant.name),
        'checkout',
        0
    )

    if logId then
        DATA.logsTotal = DATA.logsTotal + 1
    end

    DATA.dashboardLogs = Storage.getRecentLogs(recentLogsLimit)
    syncRoom(room, true)

    return { success = true }
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_motel:management:forceCheckout', function(source, payload)
    if not canForceCheckout(source) then
        return { success = false, message = 'Your rank cannot force a checkout.' }
    end

    local room = type(payload) == 'table' and findRoom(payload.roomId)

    if not room or room.status ~= 'occupied' then
        return { success = false, message = 'This room is not rented.' }
    end

    local reason = type(payload.reason) == 'string' and payload.reason:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$')

    if not reason or reason == '' then
        return { success = false, message = 'A checkout reason is required.' }
    end

    clearRoomCheckout(room, {
        reason = reason,
        staffName = Staff.getName(source) or 'Staff',
    })

    DATA.dashboardLogs = Storage.getRecentLogs(recentLogsLimit)
    syncRoom(room, true)

    return { success = true }
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_motel:management:setRoomPrice', function(source, payload)
    if not canSetRoomPrice(source) then
        return { success = false, message = 'Your rank cannot change room prices.' }
    end

    local room = type(payload) == 'table' and findRoom(payload.roomId)

    if not room then
        return { success = false, message = 'Room is no longer available.' }
    end

    local price = normalizePrice(payload.price)

    DATA.priceOverrides.rooms[room.id] = price

    if price then
        Storage.savePriceOverride('room', room.id, price)
    else
        Storage.deletePriceOverride('room', room.id)
    end

    applyRoomPrice(room)
    syncRoom(room, false)

    return { success = true, price = room.basePrice }
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_motel:management:setFloorPrice', function(source, payload)
    if not canSetRoomPrice(source) then
        return { success = false, message = 'Your rank cannot change room prices.' }
    end

    local floor = tonumber(type(payload) == 'table' and payload.floor)

    if not floor then
        return { success = false, message = 'Floor does not exist.' }
    end

    local rooms = {}
    local roomIds = {}

    for index = 1, #DATA.rooms do
        local room = DATA.rooms[index]

        if room.floor == floor then
            rooms[#rooms + 1] = room
            roomIds[#roomIds + 1] = room.id
            DATA.priceOverrides.rooms[room.id] = nil
        end
    end

    if #rooms == 0 then
        return { success = false, message = 'Floor does not exist.' }
    end

    local price = normalizePrice(payload.price)

    Storage.deleteRoomPriceOverrides(roomIds)
    DATA.priceOverrides.floors[floor] = price

    if price then
        Storage.savePriceOverride('floor', floor, price)
    else
        Storage.deletePriceOverride('floor', floor)
    end

    for index = 1, #rooms do
        applyRoomPrice(rooms[index])
    end

    syncRooms(rooms, false)

    return { success = true, price = rooms[1].basePrice }
end)

    local service = SelfService.getStatus()

            message = 'Hotel staff is currently available.'

        return {
            available = false,

            rooms = json.empty_array,

    end

    local availableRooms = {}

    for index = 1, #DATA.rooms do
        local room = DATA.rooms[index]

        if room.status == 'available' then
            availableRooms[#availableRooms + 1] = room
        end
    end

    local player = Core:GetPlayer(source)
    local playerName = getPlayerName(player, GetPlayerName(source) or 'Guest')

    return {
        available = true,
        rooms = availableRooms,
        playerName = playerName,
    }
end)

local config = require 'config.shared'
local rooms = require 'data.rooms'
local roomConfig = config.room

local points = {}
local textVisible = false
local displayedLabel

local labels = {
	stash = '[E] Buka stash',
	wardrobe = '[E] Buka wardrobe',
}

for index = 1, #rooms do
	local room = rooms[index]

	if room.coords.stash then
		points[#points + 1] = {
			roomId = room.id,
			kind = 'stash',
			coords = vector3(room.coords.stash.x, room.coords.stash.y, room.coords.stash.z),
		}
	end

	if room.coords.wardrobe then
		points[#points + 1] = {
			roomId = room.id,
			kind = 'wardrobe',
			coords = vector3(room.coords.wardrobe.x, room.coords.wardrobe.y, room.coords.wardrobe.z),
		}
	end
end

local function showHint(label)
	if textVisible and displayedLabel == label then
		return
	end

	lib.showTextUI(label)
	textVisible = true
	displayedLabel = label
end

local function hideHint()
	if not textVisible then
		return
	end

	lib.hideTextUI()
	textVisible = false
	displayedLabel = nil
end

local function interact(point)
	local result = lib.callback.await('rhd_motel:room:interact', false, {
		roomId = point.roomId,
		kind = point.kind,
	})

	if not result or not result.success then
		if result and result.message then
			lib.notify({ type = 'error', description = result.message })
		end
		return
	end

	if result.kind == 'wardrobe' then
		TriggerEvent('illenium-appearance:client:openOutfitMenu')
	elseif result.kind == 'stash' then
		Inventory:openInventory('stash', result.stashId)
	end
end

CreateThread(function()
	while true do
		local wait = 750
		local nearest
		local nearestDistance = roomConfig.interactDistance

		if #points > 0 then
			local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)

			for index = 1, #points do
				local distance = #(playerCoords - points[index].coords)

				if distance <= nearestDistance then
					nearest = points[index]
					nearestDistance = distance
				end
			end
		end

		if nearest then
			wait = 0
			showHint(labels[nearest.kind])

			if IsControlJustReleased(0, 38) then
				interact(nearest)
			end
		else
			hideHint()
		end

		Wait(wait)
	end
end)

local config = require 'config.shared'
local rooms = require 'data.rooms'
local Layout = require 'modules.layout'
local roomConfig = config.room

local roomById = {}
local registeredStashes = {}

for index = 1, #rooms do
	roomById[rooms[index].id] = rooms[index]
end

local function isNear(source, coords)
	local ped = GetPlayerPed(source)

	if ped == 0 then
		return false
	end

	local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(ped)

	return #(playerCoords - vector3(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)) <= roomConfig.interactDistance
end

local function canAccess(source, roomId)
	local citizenid = Core:GetCitizenId(source)

	if not citizenid then
		return false
	end

	if Staff.hasPermission(source, 'storageBypass') then
		return true
	end

	return Storage.canAccessRoom(roomId, citizenid)
end

local function openStash(source, room)
	local stashId = ('motel_%s'):format(room.id)

	if not registeredStashes[stashId] then
		local slots, weight = Layout.getStorage(room.id)

		Inventory:RegisterStash(stashId, ('Motel %s'):format(room.id), slots, weight, false)
		registeredStashes[stashId] = true
	end

	return { success = true, kind = 'stash', stashId = stashId }
end


local function getDoorOffsetCoords(coords)
    local x, y, z, w = table.unpack(coords)

    local offsetX = -0.5
    local offsetY = 0.7

    local rad = math.rad(w)

    local rotatedX = offsetX * math.cos(rad) - offsetY * math.sin(rad)
    local rotatedY = offsetX * math.sin(rad) + offsetY * math.cos(rad)

    return vector4(
        x - rotatedX,
        y - rotatedY,
        z - 1.0,
        w - 180.0
    )
end

local function getMotelSpawn(source)
    local citizenId = exports.sm_core:GetCitizenId(source)
    if not citizenId then return end

    local roomIds = Storage.getPlayerRoomId(citizenId)

	if not roomIds or not lib.array.isArray(roomIds) or #roomIds < 1 then
		return
	end

    local spawnData = {}

    for i=1, #roomIds do
		local roomid = roomIds[i]
		local doorCoords = lib.array.find(rooms, function (t)
			return t.id == roomid
		end)?.coords?.door

		if doorCoords and type(doorCoords) == 'vector4' then
			local room = roomid:match('_([^_]+)$')
			local spawnId = 'arm_room_' .. room

			spawnData[spawnId] = {
				coords = getDoorOffsetCoords(doorCoords),
				label = 'Avenue Royal Motel - Room ' .. room,
				skipScene = true
			}
		end
    end

	return spawnData
end

exports('getMotelSpawn', getMotelSpawn)

exports('isRentedRoom', function (source)
	local citizenid = Core:GetCitizenId(source)
	local playerRooms = Storage.getPlayerRoomId(citizenid)
	return playerRooms and #playerRooms > 0
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_motel:room:interact', function(source, payload)
	local kind = type(payload) == 'table' and payload.kind
	local room = type(payload) == 'table' and roomById[payload.roomId]

	if not room or (kind ~= 'stash' and kind ~= 'wardrobe') then
		return { success = false }
	end

	local coords = room.coords[kind]

	if not coords or not isNear(source, coords) then
		return { success = false, message = 'Kamu terlalu jauh.' }

		return { success = false, message = 'Kamu tidak punya akses ke kamar ini.' }
	end

	if kind == 'wardrobe' then
		return { success = true, kind = 'wardrobe' }
	end

	return openStash(source, room)
end)


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[05_map_mlo]\sm_wiwang_motel_v2\modules\self_service\server.lua
local config = require 'config.shared'
local settings = config.self_service

local serviceId = 'motel'
local cachedRental
local mutationPending = false

local function getRental()
    if not cachedRental then
        cachedRental = Storage.getSelfServiceRental(serviceId)
    end

    if cachedRental.expiresAt <= os.time() then
        cachedRental.expiresAt = 0
        cachedRental.paused = false
    end

    return cachedRental
end

local function serialize()
    local rental = getRental()
    local active = rental.expiresAt > os.time()
    local staffOnDuty = Staff.isActive()

    return {
        active = active,
        paused = active and rental.paused or false,
        operational = active and not rental.paused and not staffOnDuty,
        staffOnDuty = staffOnDuty,
        expiresAt = rental.expiresAt,
        remainingSeconds = math.max(0, rental.expiresAt - os.time()),
        dailyPrice = math.max(0, tonumber(settings.dailyPrice) or 0),
        maxRentalDays = math.max(1, tonumber(settings.maxRentalDays) or 30),
        rentedBy = rental.rentedBy,
    }
end

local function sync()
    Staff.syncEvent('rhd_motel:selfservice:stateChanged', serialize())
end

lib.callback.register('rhd_motel:management:rentSelfService', function(source, payload)
    local allowed = Staff.hasPermission(source, 'manageSelfService')
    
    if not allowed then
        return { success = false, message = 'You do not have access to this service.' }
    end
    if mutationPending then
        return { success = false, message = 'The service is being updated. Please wait.' }
    end

    local days = math.floor(tonumber(payload and payload.days) or 0)
    local maxDays = math.max(1, tonumber(settings.maxRentalDays) or 30)
    if days < 1 or days > maxDays then
        return { success = false, message = ('Rental duration must be between 1 and %s days.'):format(maxDays) }
    end

    local amount = days * math.max(0, tonumber(settings.dailyPrice) or 0)
    mutationPending = true

    Inventory:SetLogContext(source, 'money', ('motel-rental:%sd'):format(days))

    local paid = Inventory:RemoveItem(source, 'money', amount)

    if not paid then
        mutationPending = false
        return { success = false, message = 'Insufficient balance for this rental.' }
    end

    local rental = getRental()
    rental.expiresAt = math.max(os.time(), rental.expiresAt) + (days * 86400)
    rental.paused = false
    rental.rentedBy = Staff.getName(source)
    Storage.saveSelfServiceRental(serviceId, rental)
    mutationPending = false
    sync()

    return {
        success = true,
        message = ('Self-service hired for %s day%s.'):format(days, days > 1 and 's' or ''),
        service = serialize(),
    }
end)

lib.callback.register('rhd_motel:management:setSelfServicePaused', function(source, payload)
    local allowed = Staff.hasPermission(source, 'manageSelfService')
    if not allowed then
        return { success = false, message = 'You do not have access to this service.' }
    end
    if mutationPending then
        return { success = false, message = 'The service is being updated. Please wait.' }
    end

    local rental = getRental()
    if rental.expiresAt <= os.time() then
        return { success = false, message = 'There is no active self-service rental.' }
    end

    mutationPending = true
    rental.paused = payload and payload.paused == true
    Storage.saveSelfServiceRental(serviceId, rental)
    mutationPending = false
    sync()

    return {
        success = true,
        message = rental.paused and 'Self-service has been paused.' or 'Self-service has been resumed.',
        service = serialize(),
    }
end)


CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        sync()
        Wait(math.max(5000, tonumber(config.statusRefreshInterval) or 15000))
    end
end)

return {
    getStatus = serialize,
    isOperational = function()
        return serialize().operational
    end,
}


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[05_map_mlo]\sm_wiwang_motel_v2\modules\staff\server.lua
Staff = { players = {}}

local net = require 'modules.net'
local config = require 'config.shared'
local motelJob = config.motelJob
local permissions = config.permissions

function Staff.isBoss(source)
    return Staff.players[source]?.isboss
end

function Staff.isStaff(source)
    return Staff.players[source]?.onduty
end

function Staff.isOnduty(source)
    return Staff.players[source]?.onduty
end

function Staff.getRankLevel(source)
    return Staff.players[source]?.rank?.level
end

---@param source number
---@param action string
---@return boolean
function Staff.hasPermission(source, action)
    if not Staff.isOnduty(source) then
        return false
    end

    if permissions.bossBypass and Staff.isBoss(source) then
        return true
    end

    local grades = permissions.actions and permissions.actions[action]

    if not grades then
        return true
    end

    local level = tonumber(Staff.getRankLevel(source))

    if level == nil then
        return false
    end

    local tg = type(grades)

    if tg == 'string' then
        if tg:lower() == 'boss' then
            return Staff.isBoss(source)
        end
    elseif tg == "number" then
        return level >= grades
    elseif tg == "table" and lib.array.isArray(grades) then
        return lib.array.includes(grades, tonumber(level))
    end

    return false
end

function Staff.getName(source)
    if not Staff.players[source] then
        return
    end

    if not Staff.players[source].name then
        local player = Core:GetPlayer(source)
        local charinfo = player.PlayerData.charinfo

        Staff.players[source].name = charinfo.firstname .. ' ' .. charinfo.lastname
    end

    return Staff.players[source].name
end

function Staff.getData(source)
    if not Staff.players[source] then
        return
    end

    return {
        name = Staff.getName(source),
        isBoss = Staff.isBoss(source),
        onDuty = Staff.isOnduty(source),
        rank = Staff.players[source].rank
    }
end

function Staff.syncEvent(event, ...)
    for source in pairs(Staff.players) do
        net.emitLatentClient(event, source, ...)
    end
end

function Staff.count()
    local count = 0
    for _, data in pairs(Staff.players) do
        if data.onduty then
            count = count + 1
        end
    end
    return count
end

function Staff.isActive()
    return Staff.count() > 0
end

local function initializeStaff(player)
    local source = player.PlayerData.source

    if Staff.players[source] then
        return
    end

    local playerJob = player.PlayerData.job

    if playerJob.name ~= motelJob then
        return
    end

    Staff.players[source] = {
        isboss = playerJob.isboss,
        onduty = playerJob.onduty,

        rank = {
            label = playerJob.grade.name,
            level = playerJob.grade.level
        }
    }
end

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function ()
    local source = source
    if Staff.players[source] then
        Staff.players[source] = nil
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:OnJobUpdate', function (source, job)
    if job.name == motelJob then
        Staff.players[source] = {
            isboss = job.isboss,
            onduty = job.onduty,
            rank = {
                label = job.grade.name,
                level = job.grade.level
            }
        }
    else
        if Staff.players[source] then
            Staff.players[source] = nil
        end
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:SetDuty', function (source, duty)
    if not Staff.players[source] then return end

    Staff.players[source].onduty = duty
end)

AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:PlayerLoaded', function (player)
    initializeStaff(player)
end)

CreateThread(function ()
    Wait(1500)

    local players = Core:GetQBPlayers()

    for _, player in pairs(players) do
        initializeStaff(player)
    end
end)

return Staff

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[06_rumah_mansion]\bcs_housing\utils.lua
function round(num, numDecimalPlaces)
  return tonumber(string.format("%." .. (numDecimalPlaces or 2) .. "f", num))
end

function RoundCoordinates(coords)
  return { x = round(coords.x, 3), y = round(coords.y, 3), z = round(coords.z, 3) }
end

---Extract Home Id & optional Apartment Id
---@param data {homeId: string, aptId: string} | string
---@return string, string?
function GetHomeAptId(data)
  if type(data) == 'table' then
    return data.homeId, data.aptId
  else
    return data
  end
end

function TableContainsKey(tbl, value)
  if type(tbl) ~= 'table' then return false end
  for key, _ in pairs(tbl) do
    if type(value) == 'table' then
      for i = 1, #value do
        if key == value[i] then
          return true, key
        end
      end
    else
      if key == value then
        return true, key
      end
    end
  end
  return false
end

function TableContainsValue(tbl, value)
  if type(tbl) ~= 'table' then return false end
  for _, key in pairs(tbl) do
    if key == value then
      return true
    end
  end
  return false
end

function GetTargetScript()
  if IsResourceStarted(Config.exportname.ox_target) then
    return Config.exportname.ox_target
  elseif IsResourceStarted(Config.exportname.qtarget) then
    return Config.exportname.qtarget
  elseif IsResourceStarted(Config.exportname.qbtarget) then
    return Config.exportname.qbtarget
  end
end

function IsResourceStarted(resource)
  return GetResourceState(resource) == 'started'
end

---Converts & confirms a table
---@param value any
---@return table
function ConvertToTable(value)
  if type(value) == 'table' then
    return value
  else
    return json.decode(value)
  end
end

---@param value {x: number, y:number, z:number}
---@return vector3
function ToVector3(value)
  return value and vec3(value.x or 0.0, value.y or 0.0, value.z or 0.0) or nil
end

---@param value {x: number, y:number, z:number, w:number}
---@return vector4
function ToVector4(value)
  return value and vec4(value.x or 0.0, value.y or 0.0, value.z or 0.0, value.w or 0.0) or nil
end

function ReturnDefaultValueNil(value, default)
  if value ~= nil then
    return value
  else
    return default
  end
end

function SplitString(input, separator)
  local result = {}
  for match in input:gmatch("([^" .. separator .. "]+)") do
    table.insert(result, match)
  end
  return result
end

function GetNestedValue(tbl, keys)
  local value = tbl
  for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
    if value[key] then
      value = value[key]
    else
      return nil -- Return nil if key does not exist
    end
  end
  return value
end

function FindEntitySetData(entry)
  local nearest = 50
  local data = {}
  for i = 1, #Config.EntitySet do
    local dist = #(Config.EntitySet[i].coords - entry)
    if dist < nearest then
      data = Config.EntitySet[i]
      nearest = dist
    end
  end
  return data
end

local timeOuts = {}

function SetTimeOut(delay, callback)
  local id = #timeOuts + 1

  timeOuts[id] = true

  CreateThread(function()
    Wait(delay)
    if timeOuts[id] then
      timeOuts[id] = nil
      if callback then
        callback()
      end
    end
  end)

  return id
end

function ClearTimeOut(id)
  if timeOuts[id] then
    timeOuts[id] = nil
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function Lerp(a, b, t)
  return a + (b - a) * t
end

-- baseCoords: vector4(x, y, z, heading)
-- offset: vector3(x, y, z)

function ApplyOffsetToWorldCoords(baseCoords, offset)
  local heading = math.rad(baseCoords.w or 0) -- convert heading to radians

  -- rotation matrix for 2D (heading only rotates on XY plane)
  local cosH = math.cos(heading)
  local sinH = math.sin(heading)

  -- rotate offset
  local rotatedX = offset.x * cosH - offset.y * sinH
  local rotatedY = offset.x * sinH + offset.y * cosH
  local rotatedZ = offset.z -- Z isnâ€™t affected by heading

  -- apply to base coords
  return vector3(
    baseCoords.x + rotatedX,
    baseCoords.y + rotatedY,
    baseCoords.z + rotatedZ
  )
end

function RingBell(entity, homeId)
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local entityCoords = GetEntityCoords(entity)
    local heading = GetEntityHeading(cache.ped)
    local targetHeading = GetHeadingFromVector_2d(entityCoords.x - coords.x, entityCoords.y - coords.y)
    local diff = math.abs(heading - targetHeading)

    if diff > 180 then
        diff = 360 - diff
    end

    if diff > 30 then
        TaskTurnPedToFaceEntity(cache.ped, entity, 1000)
        Wait(1000)
    end

    lib.playAnim(cache.ped, "gestures@m@standing@casual", "gesture_hand_down")
    Wait(1000)
    TriggerServerEvent('Housing:server:Bell', homeId)
end

function LoadBill(homeId, aptId)
    local bill = lib.callback.await('Housing:server:GetBill', false, homeId, aptId) or {}

    for k, v in pairs(bill) do
        local config = Config.Bill[k]

        if config and type(config) == 'table' and config.Reset and config.OnLimitReached then
            if v >= config.limit then
                config.OnLimitReached(homeId, aptId)
            else
                config.Reset(homeId, aptId)
            end
        end
    end
end

function UnloadBill(homeId, aptId)
    for _, v in pairs(Config.Bill) do
        if type(v) == 'table' and v.Reset then
            v.Reset(homeId, aptId)
        end
    end
end

RegisterNetEvent('Housing:client:UpdateBill', function(homeId, bill)
    for k, v in pairs(bill) do
        if v >= Config.Bill[k].limit then
            Config.Bill[k].OnLimitReached(homeId)
        elseif Config.Bill[k].Reset then
            Config.Bill[k].Reset(homeId)
        end
    end
end)

RegisterNUICallback('getHomeBills', function(data, cb)
    local bill = lib.callback.await('Housing:server:GetBill', false, data.id, data.aptId) or {}
    local dataCb = {}

        dataCb[#dataCb + 1] = {
            label = Config.Bill[k].label,
            limit = Config.Bill[k].limit,
            amount = v,
            percent = math.min((v / Config.Bill[k].limit) * 100, 100),

        }

    cb(dataCb)
end)

function WaterHandler(entity, homeId, isArea, furniture)
    local home = Homes[homeId]
    local homeCoords = GetCenterPoint(home, isArea)

    RemoveTargetEntity(entity, "water_" .. homeId .. entity)
    local options = {
        {
            icon = "fas fa-tint",
            label = "Use Water",
            action = function()
                if HomeWater[homeId] then
                    Notify(locale('water_supply'), locale('water_supply_off'), "error", 3000)
                    return
                end

                lib.requestNamedPtfxAsset("core")
                UseParticleFxAssetNextCall("core")

                local coords = {
                    x = homeCoords.x + furniture.coords.x + waterOffsets[furniture.model].x,
                    y = homeCoords.y + furniture.coords.y + waterOffsets[furniture.model].y,
                    z = homeCoords.z + furniture.coords.z + waterOffsets[furniture.model].z,
                }
                local particles = {}

                for _ = 1, 5, 1 do
                    local particle = StartParticleFxLoopedAtCoord("ent_sht_water", coords.x, coords.y,
                        coords.z + 1.2, 0.0,
                        0.0, 0.0, 1.0, false, false, false, false)
                    table.insert(particles, particle)
                    Wait(3000)
                end

                for i = 1, #particles, 1 do
                    StopParticleFxLooped(particles[i], false)
                end
            end
        },
    }

    if furniture.model == 'v_res_mbath' or furniture.model == 'apa_mp_h_bathtub_01' then
        table.insert(options,
            {
                icon = "fas fa-chair",
                label = "Sit in Bathtub",
                action = function()
                    local ped = PlayerPedId()


                    local sitCoords = {
                        x = homeCoords.x + furniture.coords.x,
                        y = homeCoords.y + furniture.coords.y,
                        z = homeCoords.z + furniture.coords.z + 0.2,
                    }

                    SetEntityCoords(ped, sitCoords.x, sitCoords.y, sitCoords.z, false, false, false, true)
                    local heading = GetEntityHeading(entity)
                    SetEntityHeading(ped, heading - 180)
                    lib.playAnim(cache.ped, "anim@amb@business@bgen@bgen_no_work@", "sit_phone_phoneputdown_idle_nowork",
                        8.0, 8.0, -1, 1)

                    CreateThread(function()
                        while true do
                            Wait(0)
                            if IsControlJustPressed(0, 38) then -- E
                                ClearPedTasks(ped)
                                ClearPedTasksImmediately(ped)
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
            })
    end

    AddTargetEntity("water_" .. homeId .. entity, entity, {
        options = options,
        distance = 2.0,
    })
end

RegisterNetEvent('Housing:client:ToggleLightSwitch', function(homeId, furniture)
    local home = Homes[homeId]
    if home then
        local data = FindEntitySetData(home:GetEntryCoords())
        local light = furniture.light
        if data and next(data) then
            local interiorId = GetInteriorFromEntity(light)
            local active = IsInteriorEntitySetActive(interiorId, light)
            exports.bob74_ipl:SetIplPropState(interiorId, light, not active, true)
        else
            if not Config.Bill.enabled then return end
            if HomeElectricity[homeId] then
                return Notify(locale('electricity_supply'), locale('electricity_supply_off'),
                    "error", 3000)
            end
            home.electricity = not home.electricity
            SetArtificialLightsState(home.electricity)
        end
    end
end)

function CreateInsideEntrance(entry)
    if Config.target then
        AddTargetBoxZone("HouseCatalogueEntrance", {
            coords = entry,
            length = 2.0,
            width = 2.0,
            heading = GetEntityHeading(previewObject),
            debugPoly = Config.debug,
            minZ = entry.z - 1.0,
            maxZ = entry.z + 2.0
        }, {
            options = {
                {
                    icon = "fas fa-door-open",
                    label = locale('exit_preview_catalogue'),
                    action = function()
                        TriggerEvent("Housing:client:ExitCatalogue")
                    end
                },
            },
            distance = 3.5
        })
    else
        previewEntrance = lib.zones.box({
            coords = entry,
            size = vec3(2.0, 2.0, 3.0),
            rotation = GetEntityHeading(object),
            debug = Config.debug,
            onEnter = function()
                HelpText(true, locale("prompt_exit_home"))
                inZone = true
                CreateThread(function()
                    while inZone do
                        if IsControlJustPressed(0, 38) then
                            HelpText(false)
                            TriggerEvent("Housing:client:ExitCatalogue")
                            break
                        end
                        Wait(0)
                    end
                end)
            end,
            onExit = function()
                HelpText(false)
                inZone = false
            end
        })
    end
end

RegisterNUICallback('previewCatalogue', function(data, cb)
    initialCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    ToggleNuiFrame(false)

    if data.type == 'shell' then
        for shell in pairs(Shells) do
            if shell == data.interior then
                previewObject = CreateShell(shell)

                if previewObject then
                    DoScreenFadeOut(500)
                    while not IsScreenFadedOut() do
                        Wait(10)
                    end

                    local entry = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(previewObject, Shells[shell].x, Shells[shell].y,
                        Shells[shell].z)
                    SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(cache.ped, entry.x, entry.y, entry.z, false, false, false)
                    ToggleSyncTime()
                    CreateInsideEntrance(entry)
                    Wait(500)
                    DoScreenFadeIn(500)
                    inside = true
                end
                break
            end
        end
    elseif data.type == 'ipl' then
        for i = 1, #CustomizeIPL do
            if CustomizeIPL[i].name == data.interior then
                entry = CustomizeIPL[i].entry
                SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(PlayerPedId(), entry)
                SetEntityHeading(PlayerPedId(), CustomizeIPL[i].entry.w)
                inside = true
                CreateInsideEntrance(entry)
                break
            end
        end
    elseif data.type == 'mlo_teleport' then
        local interior = GetMloTeleport(data.interior)

        if not interior then
            print(('[HOUSING] ^1MLO Teleport %s does not exists!'):format(data.interior))
            DoScreenFadeIn(500)
            return
        end

        for i = 1, #MLOTeleport, 1 do
            if MLOTeleport[i].name == data.interior then
                entry = MLOTeleport[i].entry
                SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(PlayerPedId(), entry)
                SetEntityHeading(PlayerPedId(), tonumber(MLOTeleport[i].entry.w) + 0.0)
                inside = true
                CreateInsideEntrance(entry)
                break
            end
        end
    elseif data.type == 'mlo' then
        for _, v in pairs(Homes) do
            if v.properties.name == data.interior then
                entry = v.properties.entry
                SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(PlayerPedId(), entry.x, entry.y, entry.z)
                SetEntityHeading(PlayerPedId(), entry.w)
                inside = true
                CreateInsideEntrance(entry)
                break
            end
        end
    end

    cb({})
end)

RegisterNUICallback('viewCCTV', function(homeId, cb)
    local home = Homes[homeId]
    if home then
        ToggleNuiFrame(false)
        ViewCCTV(homeId)
    end
    cb(1)
end)

function ViewCCTV(homeId)
    local list = {}

    local home = Homes[homeId]
    if not home then
        return print('^1[HOUSING] ^0The home does not exist')
    end

    local aptId = LocalPlayer.state.CurrentApartment
    local data = lib.callback.await('Housing:server:GetData', false, home.identifier, aptId)
    -- Initialize furniture, storage and wardrobes
    home:SetData(data, aptId)

    if home.properties.furniture and type(home.properties.furniture) == 'table' and next(home.properties.furniture) then
        for i = 1, #home.properties.furniture do
            local furniture = home.properties.furniture[i]
            if not furniture then goto continue end
            if FurnitureModelList[furniture.model] and FurnitureModelList[furniture.model].type == 'cctv' then
                local modelData = FurnitureModelList[furniture.model]
                local id = #list + 1
                list[id] = furniture
                list[id].coords = ToVector3(furniture.coords)
                list[id].pitch = modelData.pitch or Config.CCTV.pitch
                list[id].yaw = modelData.yaw or Config.CCTV.yaw
            end
            ::continue::
        end
    end

    home.cctv:Enter(list)
end

exports('ViewCCTV', ViewCCTV)

function PreviewCCTV(coords, rotation)
    Notify(locale('housing'), locale('setup_cctv_heading'), 'info', 3000)
    if IsResourceStarted('bcs_hud') then
        exports['bcs_hud']:keybind({
            title = locale('cctv_setup_controls'),
            items = {
                {
                    description = locale('keybind_cctv_move'),
                    buttons = { 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D' }
                },
                {
                    description = locale('keybind_cctv_save'),
                    buttons = { 'ENTER' }
                },
                {
                    description = locale('keybind_cctv_exit'),
                    buttons = { 'BACKSPACE' }
                },
            }
        })
    else
        displayHelp(locale('prompt_cctv_preview_keybinds'), 'bottom-right')
    end
    DoScreenFadeOut(500)
    Wait(500)
    local initialCoords = GetEntityCoords(PlayerPedId())
    ClearFocus()
    local playerPed = PlayerPedId()
    local cctvcam = CreateCamWithParams("DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA", coords, 0, 0, 0, Config.CCTV.FOV)
    SetCamRot(cctvcam, rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z, 2)
    SetCamActive(cctvcam, true)
    SetTimecycleModifier("scanline_cam_cheap")

    DisableAllControlActions(0)
    FreezeEntityPosition(playerPed, true)
    SetEntityCollision(playerPed, false, true)
    SetEntityVisible(playerPed, false)
    SetTimecycleModifierStrength(2.0)
    SetFocusArea(coords, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    PointCamAtCoord(cctvcam, coords)
    RenderScriptCams(true, false, 1, true, false)
    Wait(1000)
    DoScreenFadeIn(500)
    RequestAmbientAudioBank("Phone_Soundset_Franklin", 0, 0)
    RequestAmbientAudioBank("HintCamSounds", 0, 0)
    local initCameraRot = GetCamRot(cctvcam, 2)
    local finalCamRot = initCameraRot
    while IsCamActive(cctvcam) do
        Wait(0)
        DisableAllControlActions(0)
        EnableControlAction(0, 245, true)
        EnableControlAction(0, 246, true)
        EnableControlAction(0, 249, true)
        HideHudComponentThisFrame(7)
        HideHudComponentThisFrame(8)
        HideHudComponentThisFrame(9)
        HideHudComponentThisFrame(6)
        HideHudComponentThisFrame(19)
        HideHudAndRadarThisFrame()
        -- ROTATE LEFT
        local getCameraRot = GetCamRot(cctvcam, 2)

        if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, Config.CCTV.Controls.Left) then
            PlaySoundFrontend(-1, "	FocusIn", "HintCamSounds", false)
            SetCamRot(cctvcam, getCameraRot.x, 0.0, getCameraRot.z + Config.CCTV.RotateSpeed, 2)
        end
        -- ROTATE RIGHT
        if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, Config.CCTV.Controls.Right) then
            PlaySoundFrontend(-1, "	FocusIn", "HintCamSounds", false)
            SetCamRot(cctvcam, getCameraRot.x, 0.0, getCameraRot.z - Config.CCTV.RotateSpeed, 2)
        end

        -- ROTATE UP
        if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, Config.CCTV.Controls.Up) then
            PlaySoundFrontend(-1, "	FocusIn", "HintCamSounds", false)
            SetCamRot(cctvcam, getCameraRot.x + Config.CCTV.RotateSpeed, 0.0, getCameraRot.z, 2)
        end

        if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, Config.CCTV.Controls.Down) then
            PlaySoundFrontend(-1, "	FocusIn", "HintCamSounds", false)
            SetCamRot(cctvcam, getCameraRot.x - Config.CCTV.RotateSpeed, 0.0, getCameraRot.z, 2)
        end

        if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(1, 191) then
            finalCamRot = getCameraRot
            Notify(locale('housing'), locale('cctv_rotation_saved'), 'success', 3000)
        end

        if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(1, Config.CCTV.Controls.Exit) then
            if finalCamRot ~= initCameraRot then
                DoScreenFadeOut(1000)
                InCCTV = false
                Wait(1000)
                ClearFocus()
                ClearTimecycleModifier()
                ClearExtraTimecycleModifier()
                RenderScriptCams(false, false, 0, true, false)
                DestroyCam(cctvcam, false)
                SetFocusEntity(playerPed)
                SetNightvision(false)
                SetSeethrough(false)
                SetEntityCollision(playerPed, true, true)
                FreezeEntityPosition(playerPed, false)
                SetEntityVisible(playerPed, true)
                SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(playerPed, initialCoords)
                Wait(1500)
                DoScreenFadeIn(1000)
                break
            else
                Notify(locale('housing'), locale('cctv_rotation_same'), 'error', 3000)
            end
        end
    end
    if IsResourceStarted('bcs_hud') then
        exports.bcs_hud:closeKeybind()
    else
        closeHelp()
    end
    return finalCamRot
end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[06_rumah_mansion]\bcs_housing\client\door.lua
local doors, nearbyDoors = {}, {}
local tempDoor = {}
local tempList = {}
local shown = false
-- CREDITS TO OX_DOORLOCK (https://github.com/overextended/ox_doorlock) FOR CODE LOGIC

function CreateInitialDoors()
    local input = lib.inputDialog(locale('create_a_door'), {
        { type = 'input',    label = locale('name'),       required = true },
        { type = 'number',   label = locale('distance'),   required = true, min = 1, default = 1 },
        { type = 'number',   label = locale('permission'), required = true, min = 1, max = 3,    default = 1 },
        { type = 'checkbox', label = locale('double') },
        { type = 'checkbox', label = locale('locked') },
    })
    if not input then
        return {}
    end
    local data = {
        name = input[1],
        distance = input[2],
        permission = input[3],
        double = input[4],
        locked = input[5]
    }
    local door = CreateDoor(data)
    if door then
        local found = false
        for i = 1, #tempList do
            if #(ToVector3(tempList[i].coords) - ToVector3(door.coords)) < 1.0 and data.model == tempList[i].model then
                found = true
                break
            end
        end
        if not found then
            tempList[#tempList + 1] = door
        else
            Notify(locale('housing'), locale('door_exist'), 'error', 5000)
        end
    end
    local alert = lib.alertDialog({
        header = locale('create_more_doors'),
        cancel = true,
        centered = true,
        labels = {
            cancel = locale('keybind_finish'),
            confirm = locale('continue')
        }
    })
    if alert == 'confirm' then
        return CreateInitialDoors()
    else
        local list = table.clone(tempList)
        table.wipe(tempList)
        return list
    end
end

-- distance: data.distance,
-- permission: data.level,
-- name: data.name,
-- locked: data.locked,
-- double: data.double,
function CreateDoor(data)
    local checkList = CurrentHome and CurrentHome.doors or tempList
    for i = 1, #checkList do
        if checkList[i].name == data.name then
            Notify(locale('housing'), locale('error_duplicate_door_name'), 'error', 3000)
            return false
        end
    end

    data.identifier = nil

    local doorCount = data.double and 2 or 1
    local highlightedEntity = nil

    HelpText(true, locale('prompt_add_door'))

    repeat
        DisablePlayerFiring(cache.playerId, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 25, true)

        local hit, entity, coords = lib.raycast.cam(1|16)
        local firstDoor = tempDoor[1]?.entity
        DrawLine(GetEntityCoords(cache.ped), coords, 0, 255, 34, 255)

        if entity ~= highlightedEntity then
            SetEntityDrawOutline(highlightedEntity, false)
            if hit and entity > 0 and GetEntityType(entity) == 3 then
                SetEntityDrawOutline(entity, true)
            end
        end

        if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, 24) then
            if hit and entity > 0 and GetEntityType(entity) == 3 then
                AddTempDoorlock(entity)
                HelpText(false)
            end
        end

        highlightedEntity = entity

        if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, 25) then
            SetEntityDrawOutline(entity, false)

            SetEntityDrawOutline(firstDoor, false)
            table.wipe(tempDoor)
            HelpText(false)
            return nil
        end
    until tempDoor[doorCount]

    SetEntityDrawOutline(highlightedEntity, false)

    if doorCount > 1 then
        tempDoor[1].entity = nil
        tempDoor[2].entity = nil
        data.doors = table.clone(tempDoor)
        data.coords = data.doors[1].coords - ((data.doors[1].coords - data.doors[2].coords) / 2)
        data.doors[1].coords = RoundCoordinates(data.doors[1].coords)
        data.doors[2].coords = RoundCoordinates(data.doors[2].coords)
    else
        data.model = tempDoor[1].model
        data.coords = tempDoor[1].coords
        data.heading = tempDoor[1].heading
    end

    data.double = nil
    data.locked = data.locked and 1 or 0
    data.coords = RoundCoordinates(data.coords)

    table.wipe(tempDoor)
    return data
end

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        table.wipe(nearbyDoors)
        local coords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)

        for _, door in pairs(doors) do
            local double = door.doors
            door.dist = #(coords - door.coords)

            if double then
                if door.dist < 80 then
                    for i = 1, 2 do
                        if not double[i].entity and IsModelValid(double[i].model) then
                            local entity = GetClosestObjectOfType(double[i].coords.x, double[i].coords.y,
                                double[i].coords.z, 1.0, double[i].model, false, false, false)

                            if entity ~= 0 then
                                double[i].entity = entity
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if door.dist < 20 then
                        nearbyDoors[#nearbyDoors + 1] = door
                    end
                else
                    for i = 1, 2 do
                        double[i].entity = nil
                    end
                end
            elseif door.dist < 80 then
                if not door.entity and IsModelValid(door.model) then
                    local entity = GetClosestObjectOfType(door.coords.x, door.coords.y, door.coords.z, 1.0, door.model,
                        false, false, false)

                    if entity ~= 0 then
                        local min, max = GetModelDimensions(door.model)
                        local points = {
                            GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(entity, min.x, min.y, min.z).xy,
                            GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(entity, min.x, min.y, max.z).xy,
                            GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(entity, min.x, max.y, max.z).xy,
                            GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(entity, min.x, max.y, min.z).xy,
                            GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(entity, max.x, min.y, min.z).xy,
                            GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(entity, max.x, min.y, max.z).xy,
                            GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(entity, max.x, max.y, max.z).xy,
                            GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(entity, max.x, max.y, min.z).xy
                        }

                        local centroid = vec2(0, 0)

                        for i = 1, 8 do
                            centroid += points[i]
                        end

                        centroid = centroid / 8
                        door.coords = vec3(centroid.x, centroid.y, door.coords.z)
                        door.entity = entity
                    end
                end

                if door.dist < 20 then
                    nearbyDoors[#nearbyDoors + 1] = door
                end
            elseif door.entity then
                door.entity = nil
            end
        end

        Wait(500)
    end
end)

function OpenDoor(raid)
    TriggerServerEvent('Housing:server:SetDoorState', ClosestDoor.homeId, ClosestDoor.name,
        ClosestDoor.locked == 1 and 0 or 1, raid)
end

CreateThread(function()
    local showUI

    while true do
        local num = #nearbyDoors

        if num > 0 then
            for i = 1, num do
                local door = nearbyDoors[i]

                if door.dist < door.distance then
                    if door.dist < (ClosestDoor?.dist or 10) then
                        ClosestDoor = door
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            ClosestDoor = nil
        end

        if ClosestDoor and ClosestDoor.dist < ClosestDoor.distance then
            if ClosestDoor.locked ~= showUI then
                HelpText(true, ClosestDoor.locked == 0 and locale('prompt_lock_door') or locale('prompt_unlock_door'))
                showUI = ClosestDoor.locked
            end

            if IsDisabledControlJustReleased(0, 38) then
                local home = Homes[ClosestDoor.homeId]
                local identifier = GetIdentifier()
                if home and home.keys:HasKey(identifier, 'Door ' .. ClosestDoor.permission) or isAdmin('unlock') then
                    TriggerServerEvent('Housing:server:SetDoorState', ClosestDoor.homeId, ClosestDoor.name,
                        ClosestDoor.locked == 1 and 0 or 1)
                else
                    Notify(locale('housing'), locale('door_no_permission'), 'error', 3000)
                end
            end
        elseif showUI then
            HelpText(false)
            showUI = nil
        end

        Wait(num > 0 and 0 or 500)
    end
end)

function IsNearMLODoor()
    return ClosestDoor ~= nil and true or false
end

function AddTempDoorlock(entity)
    local model = GetEntityModel(entity)
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(entity)

    AddDoorToSystem(`temp`, model, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false, false, false)
    DoorSystemSetDoorState(`temp`, 4, false, false)

    coords = GetEntityCoords(entity)
    tempDoor[#tempDoor + 1] = {
        entity = entity,
        model = model,
        coords = coords,
        heading = math.floor(GetEntityHeading(entity) + 0.5)
    }

    RemoveDoorFromSystem(`temp`)
end

function AddDoor(homeId, door)
    local double = door.doors
    doors[#doors + 1] = door
    doors[#doors].homeId = homeId
    debugPrint('[Door] Adding door', doors[#doors].name, doors[#doors].homeId)

    if double then
        for i = 1, 2 do
            double[i].hash = joaat(('house_%s_%s_%s'):format(homeId, door.name, i))
            AddDoorToSystem(double[i].hash, double[i].model, double[i].coords.x, double[i].coords.y, double[i].coords.z,
                false, false, false)
            DoorSystemSetDoorState(double[i].hash, 4, false, false)
            DoorSystemSetDoorState(double[i].hash, door.locked, false, false)
        end
    else
        door.hash = joaat(('house_%s_%s'):format(homeId, door.name))
        AddDoorToSystem(door.hash, door.model, door.coords.x, door.coords.y, door.coords.z, false, false, false)
        DoorSystemSetDoorState(door.hash, 4, false, false)
        DoorSystemSetDoorState(door.hash, door.locked, false, false)
    end
end

function RemoveDoor(homeId, door)
    local double = door.doors

    if double then
        for i = 1, 2 do
            double[i].hash = joaat(('house_%s_%s_%s'):format(homeId, door.name, i))
            RemoveDoorFromSystem(double[i].hash)
        end
    else
        door.hash = joaat(('house_%s_%s'):format(door.homeId, door.name))
        RemoveDoorFromSystem(door.hash)
    end

    for i = 1, #doors do
        if doors[i].homeId == homeId and doors[i].name == door.name then
            table.remove(doors, i)
            break
        end
    end
end

RegisterNUICallback('createDoor', function(data, cb)
    local admin = isAdmin()
    if not CurrentHome or not next(CurrentHome) then
        Notify(locale('housing'), locale('not_inside_home'), 'error', 3000)
        return
    elseif not Homes[CurrentHome.identifier]:isTenant('door') and not Homes[CurrentHome.identifier]:isKeyOwner() and not admin then
        Notify(locale('housing'), locale('not_owned_home'), 'error', 3000)
        return
    elseif CurrentHome and CurrentHome.identifier ~= data.identifier then
        Notify(locale('housing'), locale('incorrect_home'), 'error', 3000)
        return
    elseif not CurrentHome.permission.doorlock and not admin then
        return Notify(locale('housing'), locale('not_allowed_to_doorlock'), 'error', 3000)
    end
    ToggleNuiFrame(false)
    local door = CreateDoor(data)
    if door then
        TriggerServerEvent('Housing:server:AddDoor', CurrentHome.identifier, door)
    end
    cb({})
end)

        Wait(500)
        for i = 1, #doors do
            if doors[i].homeId == data.identifier and doors[i].name == data.name then
                table.remove(doors, i)
                break
            end
        end
        if home.doors then
            for i = 1, #home.doors do

            end
        end
    end

RegisterNetEvent('Housing:client:SetDoorState', function(homeId, name, state)
    local home = Homes[homeId]
    if home then
        for i = 1, #doors do
            if doors[i].homeId == homeId and doors[i].name == name then
                doors[i].locked = state
                local double = doors[i].doors
                if double then
                    for i = 1, 2 do
                        DoorSystemSetDoorState(double[i].hash, 4, false, false)
                        DoorSystemSetDoorState(double[i].hash, state, false, false)
                    end
                else
                    DoorSystemSetDoorState(doors[i].hash, 4, false, false)
                    DoorSystemSetDoorState(doors[i].hash, state, false, false)
                end
                break
            end
        end
        if home.doors then
            for i = 1, #home.doors do
                if home.doors[i].name == name then
                    home.doors[i].locked = state
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

        DrawLine(GetEntityCoords(cache.ped), coords, 0, 255, 34, 255)

        if entity ~= highlightedEntity then
            SetEntityDrawOutline(highlightedEntity, false)
            if hit and entity > 0 and GetEntityType(entity) == 3 then
                SetEntityDrawOutline(entity, true)
            end
        end

        if IsControlJustPressed(0, 38) then
            for i = 1, #doors do
                if #(doors[i].coords - GetEntityCoords(entity)) < 2.0 then
                    lib.callback.await('Housing:server:DeleteDoor', false, doors[i])
                    break
                end
            end
            SetEntityDrawOutline(entity, false)
            HelpText(false)
            break
        end

        if IsControlJustPressed(0, 73) then
            HelpText(false)
            SetEntityDrawOutline(highlightedEntity, false)
            break
        end

        highlightedEntity = entity

        Wait(0)
    end
end)

---Add tries if lockpicks fails. After certain amount of tries, alert and reset tries
---@param identifier string
---@param aptId number
function AddTries(identifier, aptId)
    if tries < Config.robbery.alertAfterFailed then
        tries += 1
    else
        tries = 0
        Dispatch()
        TriggerServerEvent("Housing:server:AlertLockpick", identifier, aptId)
    end
end

---Trigger checks after lockpick minigames
---@param success boolean
---@param identifier string
---@param aptId number
function LockpickResult(success, identifier, aptId)
    if success then
        if IsNearMLODoor() then
            OpenDoor(true)
        else
            TriggerServerEvent('Housing:server:LockHome', identifier, true, aptId)
        end
        Dispatch()
        TriggerServerEvent("Housing:server:AlertLockpick", identifier, aptId)
    else
        AddTries(identifier, aptId)
        Notify(locale('housing'), locale('failed_lockpick'), 'error', 3000)
        TriggerServerEvent('Housing:server:RemoveItem', Config.robbery.lockpickItem)
    end
end

RegisterNetEvent('Housing:client:StartLockpick', function(identifier, aptId)
    if not identifier then
        identifier = CurrentHome.identifier
    end
    lib.callback('Housing:server:CheckRobbery', false, function(allowed)
        if allowed then
            lib.callback('Housing:server:CheckItem', false, function(have)
                if have then
                    if identifier or IsNearMLODoor() then
                        if GetResourceState('qb-lockpick') == 'started' then
                            TriggerEvent('qb-lockpick:client:openLockpick', function(result)
                                LockpickResult(result, identifier, aptId)
                            end)
                        else
                            local result = exports['lockpick']:startLockpick()
                            LockpickResult(result, identifier, aptId)
                        end
                    else
                        Notify(locale('housing'), locale('not_near_any_door'), 'error', 3000)
                    end
                else
                    Notify(locale('housing'), locale('not_enough_item', 'Lockpick'), 'error', 3000)
                end
            end, Config.robbery.lockpickItem)
        else
            Notify(locale('housing'), locale('not_enough_police'), 'error', 3000)
        end
    end, identifier, aptId)
end)
