local dashboardCards = {}

dashboardCards.general = function()
    local ownedHomes = exports[cache.resource]:GetOwnedHomeKeys() or {}
    local totalPrice = 0
    local individualCount = 0
    local apartmentCount = 0
    local flatCount = 0
    local publicCount = 0
    local mortgageCount = 0
    local rentedCount = 0
    local rentalIncome = 0

    for i = 1, #ownedHomes do
        local home = ownedHomes[i]
        local price = home.properties and home.properties.price or 0
        totalPrice = totalPrice + price

        local complex = home.properties and home.properties.complex
        if complex == "Individual" then
            individualCount = individualCount + 1
        elseif complex == "Apartment" then
            apartmentCount = apartmentCount + 1
        elseif complex == "Flat" then
            flatCount = flatCount + 1
        else
            publicCount = publicCount + 1
        end

        if home.mortgage then
            mortgageCount = mortgageCount + 1
        end

        if home.configuration and home.configuration.rentable then
            local rent = home.properties and home.properties.rent
            if rent and rent.isRented and rent.rentedAt then
                rentedCount = rentedCount + 1
                local elapsedDays = math.floor((GetCloudTimeAsInt() - rent.rentedAt) / 86400)
                local income = 0

                if rent.durationType == "day" then
                    income = rent.price * math.floor(elapsedDays / rent.duration)
                elseif rent.durationType == "week" then
                    income = rent.price * math.floor(elapsedDays / rent.duration * 7)
                end

                rentalIncome = rentalIncome + income
            end
        elseif home.properties and home.properties.rented then
            rentedCount = rentedCount + 1
        end
    end

    return {
        { title = "Owned Properties", value = #ownedHomes, description = "Total properties you have keys to", icon = "key" },
        { title = "Individual Houses", value = individualCount, description = "Private individual houses", icon = "home" },
        { title = "Apartment Complexes", value = apartmentCount, description = "Residences in building complexes", icon = "building" },
        { title = "Flat Units & Rooms", value = flatCount, description = "Dedicated flat units and rooms", icon = "door-closed" },
        { title = "Public Housing", value = publicCount, description = "Publicly accessible residences", icon = "users" },
        { title = "Mortgaged Homes", value = mortgageCount, description = "Properties with active mortgage", icon = "credit-card" },
        { title = "Rented Properties", value = rentedCount, description = "Homes currently on lease", icon = "file-text" },
        { title = "Rent Income", value = "$" .. string.format("%d", rentalIncome), description = "Total active rental income", icon = "dollar-sign" },
        { title = "Total Property Value", value = "$" .. string.format("%d", totalPrice), description = "Combined real estate valuation", icon = "dollar-sign" },
    }
end

dashboardCards.realestate = function()
    local jobName = (PlayerData and PlayerData.job and PlayerData.job.name) or ""
    local managedHomes = exports[cache.resource]:GetRealestateHomes(jobName) or {}
    local totalPrice = 0
    local occupiedCount = 0
    local vacantCount = 0
    local individualCount = 0
    local apartmentCount = 0
    local flatCount = 0
    local publicCount = 0

    for i = 1, #managedHomes do
        local home = managedHomes[i]
        local price = home.properties and home.properties.price or 0
        totalPrice = totalPrice + price

        if home.properties then
            if home.properties.owner or home.properties.status then
                occupiedCount = occupiedCount + 1
            end
        else
            vacantCount = vacantCount + 1
        end

        local complex = home.properties and home.properties.complex
        if complex == "Individual" then
            individualCount = individualCount + 1
        elseif complex == "Apartment" then
            apartmentCount = apartmentCount + 1
        elseif complex == "Flat" then
            flatCount = flatCount + 1
        else
            publicCount = publicCount + 1
        end
    end

    return {
        { title = "Total Managed Homes", value = #managedHomes, description = "Properties in agency catalog", icon = "building" },
        { title = "Individual Houses", value = individualCount, description = "Private individual catalog", icon = "home" },
        { title = "Apartment Complexes", value = apartmentCount, description = "Building catalog units", icon = "building-2" },
        { title = "Flat Units & Rooms", value = flatCount, description = "Dedicated flat catalog rooms", icon = "door-closed" },
        { title = "Public Housing", value = publicCount, description = "Public / shared property units", icon = "users" },
        { title = "Occupied / Sold", value = occupiedCount, description = "Properties with active owners", icon = "check-circle-2" },
        { title = "Available / Vacant", value = vacantCount, description = "Ready to be assigned or sold", icon = "tag" },
        { title = "Total Catalog Value", value = "$" .. string.format("%d", totalPrice), description = "Total market capitalization", icon = "dollar-sign" },
    }
end

RegisterNUICallback("getApartmentOptions", function(data, cb)
    local options = {}
    local homes = exports[cache.resource]:GetHomes() or {}

    for i = 1, #homes do
        local home = homes[i]
        if home.properties.complex == "Apartment" then
            local apartmentData = Apartments[home.identifier]
            local apartmentList = apartmentData and apartmentData.apartments
            if apartmentList then
                for j = 1, #apartmentList do
                    options[#options + 1] = {
                        label = string.format("%s - %s - %s", home.properties.name, home.identifier, apartmentList[j].apartment),
                        value = string.format("%s %s", home.identifier, apartmentList[j].apartment),
                    }
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end

    cb(options)
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[06_rumah_mansion]\bcs_housing\escrow\ipl\client\ipl_menu.lua
local ignoredActionKeys = {
    Set = true,
    Clear = true,
    Enable = true,
    Color = true,
    Safe = true,
}

local actionMethodNames = {
    "Set",
    "Enable",
    "Clear",
    "SetColor",
    "Open",
    "Close",
}

local multiArgKeys = {
    Furnitures = true,
    Theme = true,
    Pumps = true,
    Color = true,
    Walls = true,
}

local isChangesConfirmed = false

local ignoredIplKeys = {
    interiorId = true,
    Ipl = true,
    currentInteriorId = true,
    currentSafeDoors = true,
    Clear = true,
    controlModelHash = true,
    Banner = true,
}

local customObjectExports = {
    Clubhouse1 = "GetBikerGangObject",
    Clubhouse2 = "GetBikerGangObject",
    ["Office 1 (Arcadius Business Centre)"] = "GetFinanceOrganizationObject",
    ["Office 2 (Maze Bank Building)"] = "GetFinanceOrganizationObject",
    ["Office 3 (Lom Bank)"] = "GetFinanceOrganizationObject",
    ["Office 4 (Maze Bank West)"] = "GetFinanceOrganizationObject",

    "DryIce",

IplMenu = lib.class("IplMenu")

function IplMenu:constructor(entry, prices, iplObject, name, isVisiting)
    self.id = nil
    self.aptId = nil

    for key, value in pairs(iplObject) do
        if key == "Interior" then
            value.LoadDefault = iplObject.LoadDefault
            iplObject = value
            break
        end
    end

    self.isVisiting = isVisiting
    self.entry = entry
    self.prices = prices
    self.iplObject = iplObject
    self.custom = customObjectExports[name] ~= nil
    self.customObject = nil
    self.name = name
    self.cam = nil

    if self.custom then
        self.customObject = exports[Config.exportname.bob74_ipl][customObjectExports[name]]()
    end
end

function IplMenu:LoadDefault()
    for key, LoadDefaultFunc in pairs(self.iplObject) do
        if key == "LoadDefault" then
            LoadDefaultFunc()
            break
        end
    end
end

function IplMenu:Load(id, aptId)
    self.id = id
    self.aptId = aptId
    self:LoadDefault()
    Wait(100)

    local loadedData = {}
    if not self.isVisiting then
        loadedData = lib.callback.await("Housing:server:GetDataCustomizeIPL", false, self.id, self.aptId) or {}
    end

    self.data = loadedData

    for key, value in pairs(self.data) do
        if multiArgKeys[key] then
            self:Set(key, value[1], value[2])
        else
            self:Set(key, value)
        end
    end

    self:CreateMenu()
end

function IplMenu:Set(key, value, secondaryValue)
    local splitKeys = SplitString(key, "%.")
    if self.customObject then
        if splitKeys[1] == "Name" then
            if #value > 1 then
                self.customObject.Name.Set(value[1], value[2], value[3], value[4])
                if self.customObject.Office then
                    self.customObject.Office.Enable(true)
                end
                if self.customObject.Clubhouse then
                    self.customObject.Clubhouse.ClubName.Enable(true)
                end
                return
            end
        elseif splitKeys[1] == "Emblem" then
            self.customObject.Emblem.Set(value, 90.0)
            self.customObject.Clubhouse.Emblem.Enable(true)
            return
        end
    end

    local nestedValue = GetNestedValue(self.iplObject, splitKeys)
    if not nestedValue then
        return
    end

    if secondaryValue then
        if nestedValue.Set then
            nestedValue.Set(value, secondaryValue, true)
        end
        self.data[splitKeys[1]] = { value, secondaryValue }
    else
        if nestedValue.Set then
            nestedValue.Set(value, true)
        elseif nestedValue.Enable then
            nestedValue.Enable(value, true, true)
        elseif nestedValue.SetColor then
            nestedValue.SetColor(value, true)
        end
        self.data[splitKeys[1]] = value
    end

    self:CreateMenu()
end

function IplMenu:CreateMenu()
    local pendingChanges = {}
    local menuOptions = {}

    local function addOption(optionKey, optionData, parentKey)
        local targetMenu = menuOptions
        if parentKey then
            if not menuOptions[parentKey] then
                menuOptions[parentKey] = {}
            end
            targetMenu = menuOptions[parentKey]
        end

        local hasMultiKey, multiKey = TableContainsKey(optionData, { "Theme", "Pumps", "Color" })
        if optionKey == "Safe" then
            local function setSafeDoorPreview(doorName, isOpen)
                local fullKey = parentKey and (parentKey .. "." .. optionKey) or optionKey
                pendingChanges[fullKey] = isOpen
                self:SetCamIPL(fullKey, true)
                local doorIndex = SplitString(doorName, " ")[2]
                if isOpen then
                    self.iplObject.Safe.Open(doorIndex)
                else
                    self.iplObject.Safe.Close(doorIndex)
                end
            end

            for _, door in ipairs({ "left door", "right door" }) do
                table.insert(targetMenu, {
                    label = string.format("Safe %s", door),
                    description = string.format("Open or Close the %s", optionKey),
                    checked = self.data[optionKey] or false,
                    value = string.format("%s %s", optionKey, door),
                    setPreview = setSafeDoorPreview,
                })
            end
        elseif hasMultiKey then
            local selectValues = {}
            for label, val in pairs(optionData[multiKey]) do
                table.insert(selectValues, {
                    label = string.format("%s $%s", label, self.prices[optionKey] or 0),
                    value = val,
                })
            end

            for subKey, subVal in pairs(optionData) do
                if not ignoredActionKeys[subKey] then
                    local defaultVal = self.data[optionKey]
                    if type(defaultVal) == "table" then
                        defaultVal = self.data[optionKey][2] or self.data[optionKey]
                    end

                    table.insert(targetMenu, {
                        label = string.format("%s %s", optionKey, subKey),
                        description = locale("change_option", subKey),
                        close = false,
                        values = selectValues,
                        defaultIndex = GetDefaultValueByData(selectValues, defaultVal),
                        setPreview = function(val)
                            local fullKey = parentKey and (parentKey .. "." .. optionKey) or optionKey
                            self:SetCamIPL(fullKey, true)
                            if multiKey == "Color" and optionKey == "Walls" then
                                pendingChanges[fullKey] = { subVal, val }
                                self:Set(fullKey, subVal, val)
                            else
                                pendingChanges[fullKey] = val
                                self:Set(fullKey, val)
                            end
                            local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
                            SetEntityCoords(cache.ped, playerCoords.x, playerCoords.y, playerCoords.z - 1.0)
                        end,
                    })
                end
            end
        elseif optionKey == "LoadDefault" then
            table.insert(targetMenu, {
                label = locale("load_default"),
                description = locale("load_default_desc"),
            })
        elseif type(optionData) ~= "table" or not optionData.__cfx_functionReference then
            local values = GenerateValues(optionData, self.prices[optionKey] or 0)
            for i = 1, #disablableFeatures do
                if optionKey == disablableFeatures[i] then
                    table.insert(values, {
                        label = "Disable",
                        value = false,
                    })
                    break
                end
            end

            if values and #values > 0 then
                table.insert(targetMenu, {
                    label = optionKey,
                    description = locale("change_option", optionKey),
                    values = values,
                    close = false,
                    defaultIndex = self.data[optionKey] and GetDefaultValueByData(values, self.data[optionKey]) or nil,
                    setPreview = function(val)
                        local fullKey = parentKey and (parentKey .. "." .. optionKey) or optionKey
                        self:SetCamIPL(fullKey, true)
                        if optionKey == "Furnitures" then
                            pendingChanges[fullKey] = { val, 3 }
                            self:Set(fullKey, val, 3)
                        else
                            pendingChanges[fullKey] = val
                            self:Set(fullKey, val)
                        end
                    end,
                })
            end
        end
    end

    for key, val in pairs(self.iplObject) do
        if not ignoredIplKeys[key] then
            if key == "Lights" or (type(val) == "table" and not TableContainsKey(val, actionMethodNames) and key ~= "LoadDefault" and key ~= "Colors") then
                for subKey, subVal in pairs(val) do
                    if type(subVal) ~= "string" and not ignoredIplKeys[subKey] then
                        addOption(subKey, subVal, key)
                    end
                end
            elseif key == "Walls" and val.SetColor then
                addOption(key, self.iplObject.Colors)
            else
                addOption(key, val)
            end
        end
    end

    if self.custom then
        local customObj = self.customObject
        if TableContainsKey(customObj, "Name") then
            local nameConfig = customObj.Name
            table.insert(menuOptions, {
                label = locale("set_org_name"),
                description = locale("set_org_name_desc"),
                openDialog = function()
                    local dialogRows = {
                        {
                            type = "input",
                            label = locale("name"),
                            required = true,
                        },
                    }

                    if nameConfig.Style then
                        table.insert(dialogRows, {
                            type = "select",
                            label = locale("style"),
                            options = GenerateValues(nameConfig.Style, 0),
                        })
                    end

                    if nameConfig.Colors and nameConfig.Fonts then
                        table.insert(dialogRows, {
                            type = "select",
                            label = locale("color"),
                            options = GenerateValues(nameConfig.Colors, 0),
                        })
                        table.insert(dialogRows, {
                            type = "select",
                            label = locale("color"),
                            options = GenerateValues(nameConfig.Fonts, 0),
                        })
                    end

                    self:SetCamIPL("Name", true)
                    local input = lib.inputDialog(locale("set_org_name"), dialogRows)
                    if not input then
                        return
                    end

                    local orgName = input[1]
                    local style = tonumber(input[2])
                    local color = tonumber(input[3])
                    local font = tonumber(input[4])
                    local nameData = { orgName, style, color, font }

                    TriggerServerEvent("Housing:server:SetDataCustomizeIPL", self.id, self.aptId, "Name", nameData)
                    self:Set("Name", nameData)
                    self:DestroyCam()
                end,
            })
        end

        if TableContainsKey(customObj, "Emblem") then
            local emblemValues = GenerateValues(customObj.Emblem.Logo, 0)
            table.insert(menuOptions, {
                label = locale("set_emblem"),
                description = locale("set_emblem_desc"),
                values = emblemValues,
                defaultIndex = GetDefaultValueByData(emblemValues, self.data.Emblem),
                setPreview = function(val)
                    pendingChanges.Emblem = val
                    self:SetCamIPL("Emblem", true)
                    self:Set("Emblem", val)
                end,
            })
        end
    end

    table.sort(menuOptions, function(a, b)
        return a.label < b.label
    end)

    table.insert(menuOptions, {
        label = locale("confirm"),
        description = locale("confirm_change"),
    })

    local mainOptions = {}
    for i = 1, #menuOptions do
        table.insert(mainOptions, menuOptions[i])
    end

    for categoryName, categoryOptions in pairs(menuOptions) do
        if type(categoryName) ~= "number" then
            table.insert(mainOptions, {
                label = categoryName,
                description = locale("category"),
                value = "submenu",
            })

            lib.registerMenu({
                id = categoryName .. "_submenu",
                title = categoryName,
                options = categoryOptions,
                onClose = function()
                    lib.showMenu("custom_ipl_menu")
                end,
                onSideScroll = function(selected, scrollIndex)
                    local option = categoryOptions[selected]
                    if option.setPreview then
                        option.setPreview(option.values[scrollIndex].value)
                    end
                end,
            }, function(selected, scrollIndex, args)
                local option = categoryOptions[selected]
                if option.openDialog then
                    option.openDialog()
                    return
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    lib.registerMenu({
        id = "custom_ipl_menu",
        title = locale("customize_ipl"),
        options = mainOptions,
        onSideScroll = function(selected, scrollIndex)
            local option = mainOptions[selected]
            if option.setPreview and option.values[scrollIndex] then
                option.setPreview(option.values[scrollIndex].value)
            end
        end,
        onCheck = function(selected, checked)
            local option = menuOptions[selected]
            if option.setPreview then
                option.setPreview(option.value, checked)
            end
        end,
        onClose = function()
            if not isChangesConfirmed then
                self:Load(self.id, self.aptId)
                local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
                SetEntityCoords(cache.ped, playerCoords.x, playerCoords.y, playerCoords.z - 1.0)
                self:DestroyCam()
            end
            isChangesConfirmed = false
        end,
    }, function(selected, scrollIndex, args)
        local option = mainOptions[selected]
        if option.value == "submenu" then
            lib.hideMenu()
            Wait(100)
            lib.showMenu(option.label .. "_submenu")
            return
        end

        if option.openDialog then
            option.openDialog()
            return
        end

        if option.label == "Load Default" then
            local alert = lib.alertDialog({
                header = locale("load_default"),
                content = locale("load_default_confirmation"),
                cancel = true,
                labels = {
                    cancel = locale("no"),
                    confirm = locale("yes"),
                },
            })
            if alert == "confirm" then
                TriggerServerEvent("Housing:server:LoadDefaultCustomizeIPL", self.id, self.aptId)
            end
            return
        end

        if option.label == locale("confirm") then
            local totalPrice = 0
            for changeKey in pairs(pendingChanges) do
                totalPrice = totalPrice + (self.prices[changeKey] or 0)
            end

            local alert = lib.alertDialog({
                header = locale("confirm"),
                content = locale("confirm_changes_total"),
                cancel = true,
                labels = {
                    cancel = locale("no"),
                    confirm = locale("yes"),
                },
            })

            self:DestroyCam()

            if alert == "confirm" then
                isChangesConfirmed = true
                if pendingChanges then
                    for changeKey, changeVal in pairs(pendingChanges) do
                        if TableContainsKey(changeVal, "Color") then
                            TriggerServerEvent("Housing:server:SetDataCustomizeIPL", self.id, self.aptId, changeKey, changeVal[1], changeVal[2])
                        else
                            TriggerServerEvent("Housing:server:SetDataCustomizeIPL", self.id, self.aptId, changeKey, changeVal)
                        end
                    end
                    return
                end
            end

            for changeKey, changeVal in pairs(self.data) do
                if type(changeVal) == "table" then
                    self:Set(changeKey, changeVal[1], changeVal[2])
                else
                    self:Set(changeKey, changeVal)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

function IplMenu:SetCamIPL(camKey, fade)
    local targetIplConfig = nil
    for i = 1, #CustomizeIPL do
        if CustomizeIPL[i].name == self.name then
            targetIplConfig = CustomizeIPL[i]
            break
        end
    end

    if not targetIplConfig or not targetIplConfig.cams then
        return
    end

    local function applyCamTransform(camCoords, camRotation)
        if fade then
            CreateThread(function()
                DoScreenFadeOut(500)
            end)
        end

        if not camCoords then
            return
        end

        SetCamCoord(self.cam, camCoords.x, camCoords.y, camCoords.z)
        if camRotation then
            SetCamRot(self.cam, camRotation.x, camRotation.y, camRotation.z, 2)
        end

        if fade then
            Wait(500)
            CreateThread(function()
                DoScreenFadeIn(500)
            end)
        end
    end

    local camData = targetIplConfig.cams[camKey] or targetIplConfig.cams.default
    if camData then
        local camOffset = vec3(
            camData[1].x + targetIplConfig.entry.x,
            camData[1].y + targetIplConfig.entry.y,
            camData[1].z + targetIplConfig.entry.z
        )

        if not self.cam then
            self.cam = CreateCam("DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA", true)
            RenderScriptCams(true, false, 0, true, false)
            SetCamActive(self.cam, true)
            applyCamTransform(camOffset, camData[2])
        elseif camData then
            applyCamTransform(camOffset, camData[2])
        end
    end
end

function IplMenu:DestroyCam()
    if self.cam then
        RenderScriptCams(false, false, 0, true, false)
        DestroyCam(self.cam, false)
        self.cam = nil
    end
end

RegisterCommand("createcamipl", function(source, args)
    local camKey = args[1]
    local iplName = args[2] and table.concat(args, " ", 2) or nil
    local pedCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local targetIpl = nil

    for i = 1, #CustomizeIPL do
        if not iplName then
            if #(CustomizeIPL[i].entry.xyz - pedCoords) <= 100 then
                targetIpl = CustomizeIPL[i]
                break
            end
        elseif CustomizeIPL[i].name == iplName then
            targetIpl = CustomizeIPL[i]
            break
        end
    end

    if not targetIpl then
        print("IPL not found")
        return
    end

    if #(pedCoords - targetIpl.entry.xyz) <= 100 then
        local heading = GetEntityHeading(cache.ped)
        local camCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped) + vec3(0, 0, 1.5)
        local camRot = vec3(0.0, 0.0, heading)
        local cam = CreateCam("DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA", true)

        RenderScriptCams(true, false, 0, true, false)
        SetCamActive(cam, true)
        SetCamCoord(cam, camCoords.x, camCoords.y, camCoords.z)
        SetCamRot(cam, camRot.x, camRot.y, camRot.z, 2)
        DisableControlAction(0, 1, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 2, true)
        DisableControlAction(0, 24, true)

        while true do
            Wait(0)
            camCoords = GetCamCoord(cam)
            local currentRot = GetCamRot(cam, 2)
            local radYaw = math.rad(currentRot.z)
            local cosYaw = math.cos(radYaw)
            local sinYaw = math.sin(radYaw)
            local lookX = GetControlNormal(0, 1) * 2.0
            local lookY = GetControlNormal(0, 2) * 2.0

            if lookX ~= 0.0 or lookY ~= 0.0 then
                SetCamRot(cam, currentRot.x - lookY, currentRot.y, currentRot.z - lookX, 2)
            end

            if IsControlJustPressed(0, 174) then
                SetCamCoord(cam, camCoords.x - cosYaw * 0.5, camCoords.y - sinYaw * 0.5, camCoords.z)
            elseif IsControlJustPressed(0, 175) then
                SetCamCoord(cam, camCoords.x + cosYaw * 0.5, camCoords.y + sinYaw * 0.5, camCoords.z)
            elseif IsControlJustPressed(0, 172) then
                SetCamCoord(cam, camCoords.x - sinYaw * 0.5, camCoords.y + cosYaw * 0.5, camCoords.z)
            elseif IsControlJustPressed(0, 173) then
                SetCamCoord(cam, camCoords.x + sinYaw * 0.5, camCoords.y - cosYaw * 0.5, camCoords.z)
            end

            if IsControlJustPressed(0, 18) then
                print(targetIpl.name)
                local formatTemplate = [[
                   ["%s"] = {
                       %s,
                       %s
                   },
                ]]
                local formattedOutput = string.format(
                    formatTemplate,
                    camKey or "default",
                    vec3(camCoords.x, camCoords.y, camCoords.z) - targetIpl.entry.xyz,
                    GetCamRot(cam, 2)
                )
                print(formattedOutput)
                RenderScriptCams(false, false, 0, true, false)
                DestroyCam(cam, false)
                break
            end
        end
    end
end, false)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[06_rumah_mansion]\bcs_housing\escrow\ipl\client\main.lua
local customizers = {}

function GetCustomizeIPL(identifier, isMlo, isVisiting)
    local home = Homes[identifier]
    if not home then
        return nil
    end

    if customizers[identifier] then
        if home.properties.type == "ipl" and type(isVisiting) == "boolean" then
            customizers[identifier]:SetVisiting(isVisiting)
        end
        return customizers[identifier]
    end

    if isMlo then
        local entryCoords = ToVector3(home:GetEntryCoords())
        local entitySetData = FindEntitySetData(entryCoords)
        if entitySetData then
            customizers[identifier] = SetMenu:new(entitySetData, home.identifier)
            return customizers[identifier]
        end
    else
        for i = 1, #CustomizeIPL do
            local item = CustomizeIPL[i]
            local interior = home.properties.data.interior
            if item.name == interior then
                customizers[identifier] = IplMenu:new(item.entry, item.prices, item.ipl(), interior, isVisiting)
                return customizers[identifier]
            end
        end
    end

    return nil
end

RegisterCommand("customizeipl", function()
    if not CurrentHome or not CurrentHome.identifier then
        Notify(locale("housing"), locale("not_inside_home"), "error", 2500)
        return
    end

    local home = Homes[CurrentHome.identifier]
    local jobName = PlayerData.job.name
    local isAllowed = false

    if home and home:isOwner() then
        isAllowed = true
    elseif JobConfig.jobs[jobName] and JobConfig.jobs[jobName].permission.furnish and isAgent(CurrentHome.properties.realestate) then
        isAllowed = true
    elseif isAdmin("furnish") then
        isAllowed = true
    elseif home and home:isTenant("furnish") then
        isAllowed = true
    end

    if not isAllowed then
        Notify(locale("housing"), locale("not_allowed"), "error", 2500)
        return
    end

    local menu = GetCustomizeIPL(CurrentHome.identifier, CurrentHome.properties.type == "mlo")
    if menu then
        if menu.isVisiting and CurrentHome.properties.complex == "Apartment" then
            Notify(locale("housing"), locale("not_allowed"), "error", 2500)
            return
        end

        menu:ShowMenu()
    end
end, false)

RegisterNetEvent("Housing:client:SetDataCustomizeIPL", function(identifier, category, item, value)
    if CurrentHome and CurrentHome.identifier == identifier then
        local menu = GetCustomizeIPL(CurrentHome.identifier, CurrentHome.properties.type == "mlo")
        if menu then
            menu:Set(category, item, value)
        end
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent("Housing:client:LoadDefaultCustomizeIPL", function(identifier)
    if CurrentHome and CurrentHome.identifier == identifier then
        local menu = GetCustomizeIPL(CurrentHome.identifier, CurrentHome.properties.type == "mlo")
        if menu then
            menu:LoadDefault()
        end
    end
end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[06_rumah_mansion]\bcs_housing\escrow\ipl\client\menu.lua
function GenerateValues(data, price)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' then
        return {}
    end

    local values = {}

    for name, value in pairs(data) do
        if name ~= 'Set' and name ~= 'Clear' and name ~= 'Enable' then
            local priceText = ''
            if price > 0 then
                priceText = '($' .. price .. ')'
            end

            table.insert(values, { label = string.format('%s %s', name, priceText), close = false, value = value })
        end
    end

    return values, TableContainsKey(data, 'Enable')
end

function GetDefaultValueByData(items, targetValue)
    for i = 1, #items do
        if items[i].value == targetValue then
            return i
        end
    end

    return 1
end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[06_rumah_mansion]\bcs_housing\escrow\ipl\client\set_menu.lua
SetMenu = lib.class("SetMenu")

function SetMenu:constructor(entitySet, id)
    self.id = id
    self.entitySet = entitySet
    self.data = lib.callback.await("Housing:server:GetDataCustomizeIPL", false, self.id)
end

function SetMenu:Load()
    self.entitySet:LoadDefault()

    for name, itemData in pairs(self.data) do
        for i = 1, #self.entitySet.list do
            local item = self.entitySet.list[i]
            if item.name == name then
                exports.bob74_ipl:SetIplPropState(GetInteriorFromEntity(cache.ped), item.values, false, false)

                local isEnabled = itemData[2]
                if not isEnabled then
                    isEnabled = true
                end

                exports.bob74_ipl:SetIplPropState(GetInteriorFromEntity(cache.ped), itemData[1], isEnabled, false)
                break
            end
        end
    end

    RefreshInterior(GetInteriorFromEntity(cache.ped))
end

function SetMenu:Set(name, value, isEnabled)
    for i = 1, #self.entitySet.list do
        local item = self.entitySet.list[i]
        if item.name == name then
            exports.bob74_ipl:SetIplPropState(GetInteriorFromEntity(cache.ped), item.values, false, false)

            local state = isEnabled
            if not isEnabled then
                state = true
            end

            exports.bob74_ipl:SetIplPropState(GetInteriorFromEntity(cache.ped), value, state, true)
            break
        end
    end

    for key, itemData in pairs(self.data) do
        if key == name then
            itemData[1] = value
            itemData[2] = isEnabled
            return
        end
    end

    self.data[name] = { value, isEnabled }
end

function SetMenu:ShowMenu()
    if not Homes[CurrentHome.identifier] then
        return
    end

    local isConfirmed = false
    local pendingChanges = {}

    if self.entitySet.list and next(self.entitySet.list) then
        local options = {}

        for i = 1, #self.entitySet.list do
            local item = self.entitySet.list[i]

            if item.type == "check" then
                for j = 1, #item.values do
                    local propValue = item.values[j]
                    options[#options + 1] = {
                        label = item.name,
                        checked = IsInteriorEntitySetActive(GetInteriorFromEntity(cache.ped), propValue),
                        close = false,
                        value = propValue,
                        setPreview = function(prop, state)
                            exports.bob74_ipl:SetIplPropState(GetInteriorFromEntity(cache.ped), prop, state, true)
                        end
                    }
                end
            else
                local defaultIndex = nil
                for j = 1, #item.values do
                    if IsInteriorEntitySetActive(GetInteriorFromEntity(cache.ped), item.values[j]) then
                        defaultIndex = j
                        break
                    end
                end

                options[#options + 1] = {
                    label = item.name,
                    values = item.values,
                    price = item.price,
                    defaultIndex = defaultIndex,
                    close = false,
                    setPreview = function(propValue)
                        exports.bob74_ipl:SetIplPropState(GetInteriorFromEntity(cache.ped), item.values, false, true)
                        exports.bob74_ipl:SetIplPropState(GetInteriorFromEntity(cache.ped), propValue, true, true)
                    end
                }
            end
        end

        options[#options + 1] = {
            label = locale("confirm"),
            description = locale("confirm_change")
        }

        lib.registerMenu({
            id = "custom_entity_set",
            title = locale("customize_set"),
            options = options,
            onSideScroll = function(selected, scrollIndex)
                local option = options[selected]
                if option.setPreview then
                    option.setPreview(option.values[scrollIndex])
                    pendingChanges[option.label] = { option.values[scrollIndex], nil, option.price }
                end
            end,
            onCheck = function(selected, checked)
                local option = options[selected]
                if option.setPreview then
                    option.setPreview(option.value, checked)
                    pendingChanges[option.label] = { option.value, checked, option.price }
                end
            end,
            onClose = function()
                if not isConfirmed then
                    self:Load()
                end
                isConfirmed = false
            end
        }, function(selected)
            local option = options[selected]
            if option.label == locale("confirm") then
                local totalPrice = 0
                for _, changeData in pairs(pendingChanges) do
                    local price = changeData[3] or 0
                    totalPrice = totalPrice + price
                end

                local confirmation = lib.alertDialog({
                    header = locale("confirm"),
                    content = locale("confirm_changes_total", totalPrice),
                    cancel = true,
                    labels = {
                        cancel = "No",
                        confirm = "Yes"
                    }
                })

                if confirmation == "confirm" then
                    isConfirmed = true
                    if pendingChanges then
                        for name, data in pairs(pendingChanges) do
                            TriggerServerEvent("Housing:server:SetDataCustomizeIPL", self.id, nil, name, data)
                        end
                        return
                    end
                end
            end
        end)

        lib.showMenu("custom_entity_set")
    end
end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[06_rumah_mansion]\bcs_housing\modules\init.lua
Config.framework = 'custom' -- ESX or QB or custom
if IsResourceStarted(Config.exportname.es_extended) then
    Config.framework = 'ESX'
elseif IsResourceStarted(Config.exportname.qbx_core) then
    Config.framework = 'QBX'
elseif IsResourceStarted(Config.exportname.qb_core) then
    Config.framework = 'QB'
end

---@diagnostic disable-next-line
lib, cache, locale = lib, cache, locale --[[@as function]]

lib.locale(Config.Lang)


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[06_rumah_mansion]\bcs_housing\modules\bridge\custom\client.lua
CreateThread(function()
    if Config.framework ~= 'custom' then return end

    --When player logs in to the server
    RegisterNetEvent('framework:playerLoaded', function(xPlayer)
        PlayerData = xPlayer
        RemoveAllBlip()
        TriggerEvent("Housing:initialize")
    end)

    PlayerData = GetPlayerData()

    RegisterNetEvent('framework:setJob')
    AddEventHandler('framework:setJob', function(job)
        PlayerData.job = job
    end)

    function GetIdentifier()
        return PlayerData and PlayerData.citizenid
    end
end)


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[06_rumah_mansion]\bcs_housing\modules\bridge\esx\client.lua
CreateThread(function()
    local firstSpawn = true
    if Config.framework ~= 'ESX' then return end
    ESX = exports[Config.exportname.es_extended]:getSharedObject()

    function GetIdentifier()
        return PlayerData and PlayerData.identifier
    end

    function TriggerServerCallback(func, ...)
        ESX.TriggerServerCallback(func, ...)
    end

    RegisterNetEvent('esx:playerLoaded', function(xPlayer)
        PlayerData = xPlayer
        RemoveAllBlip()
        TriggerEvent("Housing:initialize")
        if not firstSpawn then

                        Apartments[home.identifier]:SetEntranceZone(home.properties.entry, home.properties.name)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        firstSpawn = false
    end)

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[06_rumah_mansion]\bcs_housing\modules\integration\garage\client.lua
local function IsVehicleAllowedToPark(vehicle, garageType)
    local class = GetVehicleClass(vehicle)
    if type(garageType) == 'table' then
        for j = 1, #garageType do
            for i = 1, #VehicleTypes[garageType[j]].class, 1 do
                if class == VehicleTypes[garageType[j]].class[i] then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    else
        for i = 1, #VehicleTypes[garageType].class, 1 do
            if class == VehicleTypes[garageType].class[i] then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function GaragePrompt(data, identifier, garageType, garageId)
    CreateThread(function()
        local home = Homes[identifier]
        local coords = home.garages[garageId].coords
        coords = vec4(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, coords.w)

        if home.properties.complex ~= 'Apartment' then
            debugPrint("[GaragePrompt]", "Garage of owned house " .. home.properties.owner)
        end
        if home.keys:HasKey(GetIdentifier(), 'Garage') or home:isTenant('garage') or (Apartments[home.identifier] and Apartments[home.identifier]:OwnApartment()) then
            if cache.vehicle then
                HelpText(true, locale("prompt_store_vehicle"))
            else
                HelpText(true, locale("prompt_open_garage"))
            end
            while inZone do
                ::continue::
                Wait(2)
                if IsControlJustReleased(0, 38) then
                    if cache.vehicle and not IsVehicleAllowedToPark(cache.vehicle, garageType) then
                        Notify(locale('housing'), locale('vehicle_not_allowed'), 'error', 3000)
                        goto continue
                    end

                    HelpText(false)
                    if IsResourceStarted("garage_insurance") then
                        if cache.vehicle then
                            exports["garage_insurance"]:storeHouseGarage(data.properties.name)
                        else
                            exports["garage_insurance"]:openHouseGarage(data.properties.name, data.properties.data
                                .garage)
                        end
                    elseif IsResourceStarted("zerio-garage") then
                        if cache.vehicle then
                            TriggerServerEvent("bcs_housing:server:storeZerioVehicle", data.properties.name)
                        else
                            TriggerServerEvent("bcs_housing:server:openZerioGarage", data.properties.name)
                        end
                    elseif IsResourceStarted("jg-advancedgarages") then
                        local category = {
                            car = {
                                "mo", "car", "bi"
                            },
                            air = {
                                "he", "pl"
                            },
                            sea = {
                                "bo"
                            }
                        }

                        local vehicleType

                        for i = 1, #garageType do
                            for k, v in pairs(category) do
                                for j = 1, #v do
                                    if garageType[i] == v[j] then
                                        vehicleType = k
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        if not vehicleType then
                            print(('[^3HOUSING^0] ^3 VehicleType not found! Home %s garageId %s'):format(home.identifier,
                                garageId))
                            goto continue
                        end

                        local id = ('%s:%s'):format(home.identifier, garageId)

                        if cache.vehicle then
                            TriggerEvent("jg-advancedgarages:client:store-vehicle", id, vehicleType)
                        else
                            TriggerEvent("jg-advancedgarages:client:open-garage", id, vehicleType, coords)
                        end
                    elseif IsResourceStarted("MojiaGarages") then
                        if cache.vehicle then
                            TriggerEvent("MojiaGarages:client:storeVehicle")
                        else
                            TriggerEvent("MojiaGarages:client:openGarage")
                        end
                    elseif IsResourceStarted("okokGarage") then
                        if cache.vehicle then
                            TriggerEvent("okokGarage:StoreVehiclePrivate")
                        else
                            TriggerEvent("okokGarage:OpenPrivateGarageMenu", GetEntityCoords(PlayerPedId()),
                                GetEntityHeading(PlayerPedId()))
                        end
                    elseif IsResourceStarted("rhd_garage") then
                        if cache.vehicle then
                            exports.rhd_garage:storeVehicle({ garage = data.properties.name, type = { 'car', 'motorcycle', 'others' }, })
                        else
                            exports.rhd_garage:openMenu({
                                garage = data.properties.name,
                                type = { 'car', 'motorcycle', 'others' },
                                spawnpoint = { coords }
                            })
                        end
                    elseif IsResourceStarted("loaf_garage") then
                        if cache.vehicle then
                            exports.loaf_garage:StoreVehicle("property", cache.vehicle)
                        else
                            exports.loaf_garage:BrowseVehicles("property", coords)
                        end
                    elseif IsResourceStarted('fmid_garasi') then
                        data.label = data.properties.name
                        local grs = lib.callback.await('fmid_garasi:getgrs', false, 'lokasi')
                        if grs?[data.properties.name] then
                            TriggerEvent('fmid_garasi:aksesGarasi', data.properties.name)
                        else
                            local saveCustomGarage = lib.callback.await('fmid_garasi:addCustomGarasi', false,
                                data.properties.name, data)
                            TriggerEvent('fmid_garasi:aksesGarasi', data.properties.name)
                        end
                        -- elseif IsResourceStarted("cd_garage") then
                        --     if cache.ped then
                        --         TriggerEvent("cd_garage:StoreVehicle_Main", 1, false)
                        --     else
                        --         ---@diagnostic disable-next-line
                        --         SetEntityCoords(PlayerPedId(), ToVector3(coords) - vector3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
                        --         SetEntityHeading(PlayerPedId(), coords.w)
                        --         Wait(50)
                        --         TriggerEvent("cd_garage:PropertyGarage", "quick")
                        --     end
                    elseif IsResourceStarted('codem-garage') then
                        if cache.vehicle then
                            TriggerEvent("codem-garage:storeVehicle", 'House Garage')
                        else
                            TriggerEvent("codem-garage:openHouseGarage")
                        end
                    elseif IsResourceStarted('ak47_qb_garage') then
                        if cache.vehicle then
                            TriggerEvent("ak47_qb_garage:housing:storevehicle", data.properties.name, 'car')
                        else
                            TriggerEvent("ak47_qb_garage:housing:takevehicle", data.properties.name, 'car')
                        end
                    elseif IsResourceStarted("luke_garages") then
                        local garage = {
                            label = "Property - " .. data.properties.name,
                            type = "car",
                            zone = {
                                name = data.properties.name,
                                x = coords.x,
                                y = coords.y,
                                z = coords.z,
                                w = coords.w
                            },
                            spawns = { vec4(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, coords.w) }
                        }
                        exports.luke_garages:setZone(garage)
                        if cache.vehicle then
                            TriggerEvent("luke_garages:StoreVehicle", { entity = cache.vehicle })
                        else
                            TriggerEvent("luke_garages:GetOwnedVehicles")
                        end
                    elseif IsResourceStarted('mGarage') then
                        local GarageId = data.properties.name
                        if cache.vehicle then
                            exports['mGarage']:SaveCar({
                                name = GarageId,
                                cartype = { 'automobile', 'bike' },
                                entity = cache.vehicle,
                            })
                        else
                            exports['mGarage']:OpenGarage({
                                garagetype = 'garage',
                                intocar    = true,
                                carType    = { 'automobile', 'bike' },
                                name       = GarageId,
                                spawnpos   = {
                                    coords
                                },
                            })
                        end
                    elseif IsResourceStarted("esx_advancedgarage") then
                        if cache.vehicle then
                            local vehicle = cache.vehicle
                            local vehProps = ESX.Game.GetVehicleProperties(vehicle)
                            exports.esx_advancedgarage:setGarage({
                                Spawner = ToVector3(coords),
                                Heading = coords.w
                            })
                            TriggerServerCallback("esx_advancedgarage:storeVehicle", function(valid)
                                if valid then
                                    TriggerServerEvent("esx_advancedgarage:setVehicleState", vehProps.plate, true)
                                    ESX.Game.DeleteVehicle(vehicle)
                                end
                            end, vehProps, data.properties.name)
                        else
                            exports.esx_advancedgarage:setGarage({
                                Spawner = ToVector3(coords),
                                Heading = coords.w
                            })
                            exports.esx_advancedgarage:OpenGarageMenu("civ", "cars")
                        end
                    elseif IsResourceStarted("esx_jb_eden_garage2") then
                        local garage = {
                            SpawnPoint = {
                                Pos = { x = coords.x, y = coords.y, z = coords.z },
                                Heading = coords.w
                            },
                            DeletePoint = ToVector3(coords)
                        }
                        if cache.vehicle then
                            TriggerEvent("esx_eden_garage:StockVehicleMenu", "personal", data.properties.name)
                        else
                            TriggerEvent("esx_eden_garage:ListVehiclesMenu", garage, "personal", data.properties.name)
                        end
                    elseif IsResourceStarted('vms_garagesv2') then
                        exports['vms_garagesv2']:enterHouseGarage()
                    elseif IsResourceStarted('tgiann-realparking') then
                        if cache.vehicle then
                            exports["tgiann-realparking"]:ParkGarage('home:' .. identifier, garageId, true)
                        else
                            exports["tgiann-realparking"]:OpenGarage('home:' .. identifier, garageId, true)
                        end
                    elseif IsResourceStarted('RxGarages') then
                        local vehicleType = 'car'
                        local types = {
                            car = { 'mo', 'bi', 'car' },
                            air = { 'he', 'pl' },
                            boat = { 'bo' }
                        }
                        if type(garageType) == 'table' then
                            for i = 1, #garageType do
                                for k, v in pairs(types) do
                                    for j = 1, #v do
                                        if garageType[i] == v[j] then
                                            vehicleType = k
                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            for k, v in pairs(types) do
                                for j = 1, #v do
                                    if garageType == v[j] then
                                        vehicleType = k
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if cache.vehicle then
                            exports['RxGarages']:ParkVehicle(identifier .. ' - ' .. garageId, 'garage', vehicleType)
                        else
                            exports['RxGarages']:OpenGarage(identifier .. ' - ' .. garageId, 'garage', vehicleType,
                                coords)
                        end
                    elseif IsResourceStarted('op-garages') then
                        exports['op-garages']:OpenGarageHere(coords, true)
                    elseif IsResourceStarted('nfs-garage') then
                        exports['nfs-garage']:showGarage(identifier .. '-' .. garageId)
                    end
                    break
                end
            end

            while IsNuiFocused() do Wait(100) end
            Wait(1000)

            if inZone then
                local updatedData = GetHomeObject(identifier)
                GaragePrompt(updatedData, identifier, garageType, garageId)
            end
        end
    end)
end


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[06_rumah_mansion]\bcs_housing\modules\integration\inventory\client.lua
---@class FurnitureAsItem
---@field model string
---@field label string
---@field imageurl string

---@class KeyAsItem
---@field homeId number
---@field aptId number
---@field label string
---@field name string
---@field permissions table
---@field owner string

function GetInventoryItems(item)
    if Config.Inventory == 'ox_inventory' then
        return exports.ox_inventory:Search('slots', item)
    end

    if Config.Inventory == 'qb-inventory' or Config.Inventory == 'lj-inventory' or Config.Inventory == 'ak47_inventory' or Config.Inventory == 'ps_inventory' then
        local items = PlayerData.items
        local result = {}

        for k, v in pairs(items) do
            if v.name == item then
                table.insert(result, v)
            end
        end

        return result
    end

    if Config.Inventory == 'core_inventory' then
        local items = exports.core_inventory:getInventory()
        local result = {}

        for k, v in pairs(items) do
            if v.name == item then
                table.insert(result, v)
            end
        end

        return result
    end

    if Config.Inventory == 'tgiann' then
        local items = exports["tgiann-inventory"]:GetPlayerItems()
        local result = {}

        for k, v in pairs(items) do
            if v.name == item then
                table.insert(result, v)
            end
        end

        return result
    end


    if Config.Inventory == 'origen_inventory' then
        local items = exports.origen_inventory:Search('slots', item)
        local result = {}

        for k, v in pairs(items) do
            if v.name == item then
                table.insert(result, v)
            end
        end

        return result
    end

    if Config.Inventory == 'jaksam_inventory' then
        local items = exports['jaksam_inventory']:getItemsByName(item)

        local result = {}

        for k, v in pairs(items) do
            if v.name == item then
                table.insert(result, v)
            end
        end

        return result
    end

    return {}
end

--- Get furniture items from inventory
--- @return FurnitureAsItem[]
function GetFurnitureItems()
    local items = GetInventoryItems(Config.FurnitureItem)

    for k, v in pairs(items) do
        if v.name == Config.FurnitureItem and (v.metadata or v.info) then
            items[k] = v.metadata or v.info
            if items[k].data then
                local data = lib.table.deepclone(items[k].data or {})
                for key, value in pairs(data) do
                    items[k][key] = value
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return items
end

function UseFurniture()
    ExecuteCommand('furnish')
end

RegisterNetEvent('Housing:client:UseFurniture', UseFurniture)
exports('UseFurniture', UseFurniture)

--- Get key items from inventory
--- @return KeyAsItem[]
function GetKeyItems()
    local items = GetInventoryItems(Config.KeyAsItem.ItemName)

    for k, v in pairs(items) do
        if v.name == Config.KeyAsItem.ItemName and (v.metadata or v.info) then
            items[k] = v.metadata or v.info
        end
    end

    return items
end


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[06_rumah_mansion]\bcs_housing\modules\integration\storage\client.lua
function OpenStorage(data, home)
    if Config.Inventory == "ox_inventory" then
        if home.properties.complex == 'Apartment' then
            local owner = Apartments[home.identifier]:GetApartmentById(LocalPlayer.state.CurrentApartment).owner
            exports.ox_inventory:openInventory('stash', { id = data.identifier, owner = owner })
        else
            exports.ox_inventory:openInventory('stash', data.identifier)
        end
    elseif Config.Inventory == 'qs-inventory' then
        TriggerServerEvent("inventory:server:OpenInventory", "stash", "Stash_" .. data.identifier,
            {
                maxweight = data.weight or Config.FurnitureStorage.weight,
                slots = data.slots or
                    Config.FurnitureStorage.slots
            })
        TriggerEvent("inventory:client:SetCurrentStash", "Stash_" .. data.identifier)
    elseif Config.Inventory == 'qb-inventory' or Config.Inventory == 'lj-inventory' then
        TriggerServerEvent("inventory:server:OpenInventory", "stash", data.identifier,
            {
                maxweight = data.weight or Config.FurnitureStorage.weight,
                slots = data.slots or
                    Config.FurnitureStorage.slots
            })
        TriggerServerEvent("InteractSound_SV:PlayOnSource", "StashOpen", 0.4)
        TriggerEvent("inventory:client:SetCurrentStash", data.identifier)
    elseif Config.Inventory == 'ak47_inventory' then
        -- Add support for ak47_inventory
        exports['ak47_inventory']:OpenInventory({
            identifier = "stash:" .. data.identifier,
            label = "House Stash",
            type = "stash",
            maxWeight = data.weight or Config.FurnitureStorage.weight,
            slots = data.slots or Config.FurnitureStorage.slots,
        })
    elseif Config.Inventory == 'chezza' then
        TriggerEvent("inventory:openHouse", data.owner, data.identifier, "House Stash", data.weight)
    elseif Config.Inventory == 'core_inventory' then
        TriggerServerEvent('core_inventory:server:openInventory', string.sub(data.identifier, 9), "stash")
    elseif Config.Inventory == 'mInventory' or Config.Inventory == 'tgiann' then
        local name = data.identifier
        local maxweight = data.weight or Config.FurnitureStorage.slots
        local slot = data.slots or Config.FurnitureStorage.slots
        TriggerServerEvent('inventory:server:OpenInventory', 'stash', name,
            { maxweight = maxweight, slots = slot })
    elseif Config.Inventory == 'jaksam_inventory' then
        exports['jaksam_inventory']:openInventory(data.identifier)
    else
        TriggerServerEvent('Housing:server:OpenStash', data.identifier, data.weight, data.slots)
    end
end

function StoragePrompt(data)
    CreateThread(function()
        HelpText(true, locale('prompt_open_storage'))
        while inZone do
            Wait(2)
            if IsControlJustReleased(0, 38) then
                HelpText(false)
                data.owner = Homes[data.home].properties.owner
                TriggerEvent('Housing:Storage', data)
                break
            end
        end
    end)
end


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[06_rumah_mansion]\bcs_housing\modules\integration\wardrobe\client.lua
function OpenWardrobe(identifier)
    if IsResourceStarted('nf-skin') then
        TriggerEvent('nf-skin:client:openOutfitMenu')
    elseif IsResourceStarted('bl_appearance') then
        exports.bl_appearance:OpenMenu('outfits')
    elseif IsResourceStarted('izzy-appearance') then
        TriggerEvent('izzy-appearance:client:openClothingMenu')
    elseif IsResourceStarted('codem-appearance') then
        TriggerEvent('codem-apperance:OpenWardrobe')
    elseif IsResourceStarted('hex_clothing') then
        TriggerEvent('hex_clothing:openOutfitMenu')
    elseif IsResourceStarted('rcore_clothes') then
        TriggerEvent("rcore_clothes:openOutfits")
    elseif IsResourceStarted('onex-creation') then
        TriggerEvent("onex-creation:openOutfitMenu")
    elseif IsResourceStarted('rcore_clothing') then
        TriggerEvent('rcore_clothing:openChangingRoom')
    elseif Config.framework == 'QB' and not IsResourceStarted("illenium-appearance") then
        exports.sm_appearance:openOutfitMenu()
    elseif IsResourceStarted("illenium-appearance") then
        exports.sm_appearance:openOutfitMenu()
    else
        lib.callback("Housing:server:GetWardrobe", false, function(list)
            if GetResourceState("ox_lib") == "started" then
                local options = {}
                for i = 1, #list, 1 do
                    table.insert(options, { label = list[i] })
                end
                if #options == 0 then
                    table.insert(options, { label = locale('no_outfit') })
                end
                lib.registerMenu({
                    id = "wardrobe_change",
                    title = locale("wardrobe"),
                    position = "top-right",
                    onSideScroll = function(selected, scrollIndex, args) end,
                    onSelected = function(selected, scrollIndex, args) end,
                    onClose = function() end,
                    options = options,
                }, function(selected, scrollIndex, args)
                    if #options > 0 then
                        lib.callback("Housing:server:GetOutfit", false, function(clothes)
                            if IsResourceStarted("fivem-appearance") or IsResourceStarted("illenium-appearance") then
                                if not clothes.model then
                                    clothes.model = "mp_m_freemode_01"
                                end
                                if IsResourceStarted("fivem-appearance") then
                                    exports["fivem-appearance"]:setPlayerAppearance(clothes)
                                else
                                    TriggerEvent('illenium-appearance:client:changeOutfit', clothes)
                                end
                                Notify(locale("wardrobe"), locale("loaded_outfit"), "success", 2500)
                            else
                                TriggerEvent("skinchanger:getSkin", function(skin)
                                    TriggerEvent("skinchanger:loadClothes", skin, clothes)
                                    TriggerEvent("esx_skin:setLastSkin", skin)

                                    TriggerEvent("skinchanger:getSkin", function(skin)
                                        TriggerServerEvent("esx_skin:save", skin)
                                        Notify(locale("wardrobe"), locale("loaded_outfit"), "success", 2500)
                                    end)
                                end)
                            end
                        end, identifier, options[selected].label)
                    end
                end)
                lib.registerMenu({
                    id = "wardrobe_delete",
                    title = locale("wardrobe"),
                    position = "top-right",
                    onSideScroll = function(selected, scrollIndex, args) end,
                    onSelected = function(selected, scrollIndex, args) end,
                    onClose = function() end,
                    options = options,
                }, function(selected, scrollIndex, args)
                    if #options > 0 then
                        TriggerServerEvent("Housing:server:DeleteOutfit", identifier, options[selected].label)
                    end
                end)
                lib.showContext("wardrobe_menu")
            end
        end, identifier)
    end
end

function SaveOutfit(name)
    if IsResourceStarted("fivem-appearance") or IsResourceStarted("illenium-appearance") then
        local appearance
        if IsResourceStarted("fivem-appearance") then
            appearance = exports["fivem-appearance"]:getPedAppearance(PlayerPedId())
        else
            appearance = exports["illenium-appearance"]:getPedAppearance(PlayerPedId())
        end
        TriggerServerEvent("Housing:server:SaveOutfit", CurrentHome.identifier, name, appearance)
        Notify(locale("wardrobe"), locale("saved_outfit"), "success", 2500)
    else
        TriggerEvent("skinchanger:getSkin", function(skin)
            TriggerServerEvent("Housing:server:SaveOutfit", CurrentHome.identifier, name, skin)
            Notify(locale("wardrobe"), locale("saved_outfit"), "success", 2500)
        end)
    end
end

function WardrobePrompt(home)
    CreateThread(function()
        if home:isKeyOwner() or home:isTenant('wardrobe') then
            HelpText(true, locale("prompt_open_wardrobe"))
            while inZone do
                Wait(2)
                if IsControlJustReleased(0, 38) then
                    HelpText(false)
                    OpenWardrobe(home.identifier)
                    break
                end
            end
            while IsNuiFocused() do
                Wait(100)
            end
            Wait(1000)
            if inZone then
                WardrobePrompt(home)
            end
        end
    end)
end


########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[06_rumah_mansion]\bcs_housing\modules\integration\weather\client.lua
local weatherSyncScripts = { "av_weather", "cd_easytime", 'weathersync', 'Renewed-Weathersync', 'qb-weathersync',
    'cs_weather', 'night_natural_disasters', 'randol_weather', '0r-easytime' }

function ToggleSyncTime()
    CreateThread(function()
        -- Disable weather sync
        if IsResourceStarted('cd_easytime') then
            TriggerEvent('cd_easytime:PauseSync', true, Config.TimeInShell)
        elseif IsResourceStarted("night_natural_disasters") then
            exports.night_natural_disasters:PauseSynchronization(true)
        elseif IsResourceStarted('qb-weathersync') then
            TriggerEvent('qb-weathersync:client:DisableSync')
        elseif IsResourceStarted('cs_weather') then
            TriggerEvent("cs:weather:client:DisableSync")
        elseif IsResourceStarted('av_weather') then
            TriggerEvent("av_weather:freeze", true, Config.TimeInShell, 00, "CLEAR", false)
        elseif IsResourceStarted('esx-weathersync') then
            TriggerEvent('esx-weathersync:client:DisableSync')
        elseif IsResourceStarted('randol_weather') then
            exports.randol_weather:ToggleSync(false)
        elseif IsResourceStarted('uniq_weathersync') then
            TriggerServerEvent("managesync", "pause")
        elseif not IsResourceStarted('Renewed-Weathersync') then
            TriggerEvent("vSync:toggle", true)
        else
            LocalPlayer.state.syncWeather = false
            TriggerEvent("weathersync:toggleSync")
        end

        local hasWeathersync = false
        for _, script in pairs(weatherSyncScripts) do
            if IsResourceStarted(script) then
                hasWeathersync = true
            end
        end

        -- Set the time to the configured time in shell
        while inside or LocalPlayer.state.designInterior do
            if not hasWeathersync then
                SetRainLevel(0.0)
                ClearOverrideWeather()
                ClearWeatherTypePersist()
                SetWeatherTypePersist("CLEAR")
                SetWeatherTypeNow("CLEAR")
                SetWeatherTypeNowPersist("CLEAR")
                SetForcePedFootstepsTracks(false)
                SetForceVehicleTrails(false)
                RemoveParticleFxInRange(GetEntityCoords(PlayerPedId()), 10.0)

                NetworkOverrideClockTime(Config.TimeInShell, 0, 0)
                Wait(500)
            end
            Wait(500)
        end

        -- Reset weather to server's current weather

        SetRainLevel(-1) -- sets rain back to server's current weather
        if IsResourceStarted('cd_easytime') then
            TriggerEvent('cd_easytime:PauseSync', false)
        elseif IsResourceStarted("night_natural_disasters") then
            exports.night_natural_disasters:PauseSynchronization(false)
        elseif IsResourceStarted('qb-weathersync') then
            TriggerEvent('qb-weathersync:client:EnableSync')
        elseif IsResourceStarted('cs_weather') then
            TriggerEvent("cs:weather:client:EnableSync")
        elseif IsResourceStarted('av_weather') then
            TriggerEvent("av_weather:freeze", false)
        elseif IsResourceStarted('esx-weathersync') then
            TriggerEvent('esx-weathersync:client:EnableSync')
        elseif IsResourceStarted('randol_weather') then
            exports.randol_weather:ToggleSync(true)
        elseif IsResourceStarted('uniq_weathersync') then
            TriggerServerEvent("managesync", "resume")
        elseif not IsResourceStarted('Renewed-Weathersync') then
            TriggerEvent("vSync:toggle", false)
        else
            LocalPlayer.state.syncWeather = true
            TriggerEvent("weathersync:toggleSync")
        end
    end)
end

exports('ToggleSyncTime', ToggleSyncTime)

    if Config.Screenshot == "offline" then
        FurnitureImages[modelKey] = "images/furnitures/" .. image .. ".png"
    else
        FurnitureImages[modelKey] = image
    end
end

########## FILE: A:\Lexar Roleplay\resources\[06_rumah_mansion]\bcs_housing\shared\hook.lua
local hooks = {}

function TriggerEventHooks(eventName, data)
    for i = 1, #hooks do
        if hooks[i].event == eventName then
            local _, result, extra = pcall(hooks[i].handler, data)
            return result, extra
        end
    end
    return true
end

function RegisterHook(eventName, handler)
    local hookId = #hooks + 1
    table.insert(hooks, { event = eventName, resource = GetInvokingResource(), handler = handler, id = hookId })
    return hookId
end

exports("RegisterHook", RegisterHook)

function RemoveHook(hookId)
    for i = 1, #hooks do
        if hooks[i].id == hookId then
            hooks[i] = nil
        end
    end
end

exports("RemoveHook", RemoveHook)

AddEventHandler("onResourceStop", function(resourceName)
    for i = 1, #hooks do
        if hooks[i].resource == resourceName then
            hooks[i] = nil
        end
    end
end)
